Review Text: The Sonobudoyo Museum presents an atmosphere full of historical and cultural nuances. Its classic architecture and diverse Collections, including traditional art and historic artifacts, create a deep and engaging experience. This place feels like a window into the past, offering a rich understanding of the cultural heritage of Java.

Sonobudoyo Museum is one of the most interesting cultural tourism destinations in Yogyakarta. This museum provides visitors with an educational and interactive experience, making it a great place for both local and international tourists to visit. The museum displays a wide range of collections, from traditional weapons, wayang kulit (shadow puppets), and even Indonesian handicrafts, introducing visitors to the rich culture of Indonesia.

Sonobudoyo Museum not only presents exhibitions of the collection but also offers a variety of interesting activities. Visitors can watch documentaries on Indonesian history, which provide a deep insight into the nation's struggles. In addition, the museum also holds batik-making workshops, where participants can learn first-hand the process of making traditional batik cloth, one of Indonesia's world-recognized cultural heritages.

For those who want to feel the cultural atmosphere more deeply, the museum provides other activities such as playing traditional games that are now rarely found. These activities are not only entertaining but also provide a greater understanding of Indonesia's rich and diverse culture. With various activities on offer, the Sonobudoyo Museum is the perfect destination to learn and enjoy the beauty of Indonesian culture in a fun atmosphere.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

This is a very lovely museum that showcases the history, culture and heritage of central Java and Yogyakarta.  It has a lovely collection of ceramics of the Neolithic era and bronze sculptures from the 8th century.  It also includes large collections of wayang shadow puppets, various ancient weapons such as keris, and Javanese masks.  This is an exceptionally pleasing way to learn about Javanese culture.

Review Text:
Départ en taxi vers le "Museum Sonobudoyo", au bas de l'avenue Malioboro, non loin du Kraton.
   Le musée est magnifique, richement doté, avec des explications traduites en anglais et, même si mon anglais n'est guère  brillant, ça aide un peu! Musée très pédagogique, très bien agencé: quelques vidéos, mais, surtout, de très belles statues! A nouveau nous sommes seuls, mais cela ne nous surprend plus.
   Surtout, à la fin, ne manquez pas le fabriquant de marionnettes en peau de buffle. Les marionnettes sont absolument magnifiques!

When asked how many times have I been to Jogja? The answer is uncountable. Since childhood and after growing up, I often visited Jogja. But if asked, how many times have I watched the Shadow Puppets perfomance?  The answer is the first time, precisely last week.
•
I have planned to include the Shadow Puppets performance in my "bucket checklist" when I traveled to Jogja in early 2020.
•
Sonobudoyo Museum is one place that presents Shadow Puppets performance every Monday to Friday at 8 pm if I'm not mistaken. By only paying Rp. 20,000, I can enjoy the appearance of Shadow Puppets perfomance in a large, clean room with the appearance of puppeteer and professional sindens. Even booklets and ticket sheets are printed from quality paper. Shadow Puppets are taken from several parts of the Ramayana story. 
I watched episode 4 titled "Anggada Duta" last week. The puppeteer tells the complete story in Javanese. Even though I don't understand Javanese, I can guess the synopsis story line in the booklet and Shadow Puppets characters that was shown that night, and I browsed in Google to find out every Shadow Puppets character name that appeared in each scene that was displayed to help me understand the storyline presented at that night.
Overall, I was satisfied watching Shadow Puppets perfomance at the Sonobudoyo Museum, mainly because the audience around me was the majority of foreign tourists. I am increasingly proud of Indonesian arts and culture.
ce musee est riche en collection de wayang kulit ,de masques, tout sur la culture javanaise depuis les royaumes indianises jusqu'au sultanat de Mataram tres belle collection de keris

Review Text: A quick air conditioned pit stop that was additional to our itinerary. Tbh we went in because we were hot and it was air conditioned. But what a treat. Exhibits on the history of Yogyakarta in interactive and well curated and accessible format.

The collections inside the museum is really amazing. The building is not very big, but all the collections are nicely exhibited with English narration and the place is easy to go around. The entrance fee is Rp 10,000. The operation hours from 8am till about 3pm. The museum is closed on Monday and Public Holidays.

I know this from the Indonesia markets in Holland, but only from demos. Seeing an entire episode was very impressive. You can sit in the front when you walk in, which is actually the back since you get to see the musicians and the puppets player. And then on the other side of the screen where you can see the actual shadow play. Have a look at both sides! Beautifully done but can be a bit long when you just do an episode. I would recommend the full story!

Sonobudoyo Museum was on my top list of my last visit as I have skipped it four times previously. In fact, the museum itself was not too big, only one floor with several exhibition halls encircled, but the exhibits therein were well maintained. After entering the museum, two courteous ladies serving as guides showed me the way in clockwise to see the exhibits and explained their significance in details. Historical items or artifacts with informative descriptions attached were on display inside glass showcases, from prehistory up to modern. Javanese as well as Yogyakarta's culture and history both were clearly introduced with links to neighbouring countries. At the backyard, a beautiful-decorated pavilion stood. Outside the compound, many aging stone statues and even cannons set idly in open space. As the entrance fee was very cheap, in my opinion it was still worthwhile to visit.
Well maintained museum that give you an insight into Javanese life, culture and history.  The displays are informative and wide ranging from the earliest times to more modern.

Very nice museum.
Not too big (c. 1 hour to visit taking your time).
Résolu accessible from Kraton and Malioboro

Museum Sonobudoyo merupakan museum yang bersifat umum karena memuat sekiyar 10 jenis koleksi museum yang dikategorikan sebagai berikut : Teknologi, Geologi, Seni Rupa, Biologi, Keramologi, Etnografi, Filologika, Arkeologi, Numismatika dan Historika.
Senjata Keris merupakan salah satu jenis koleksi yang dimiliki oleh museum sonobudoyo ini. keris yang menjadi koleksi dari museum ini yang berasal dari berbagai penjuru daerah nusantara. Keris –keris yang berada di museum ini mempunyai bentuk dan tipe yang bermacam-macam. Misalnya keris-keris Jawa yang berbentuk keris luk 7, keris luk 11, keris luk 13, keris lurus dan keris dengan berbagai macam pamor. Seanjutnya keris dari luar Jawa berasal dari Aceh yang berupa keris rencong, Mandau dari Kalimantan, keris dari Madura dan Bali serta keris dari Sulawesi. 
Terdapat juga koleksi yang berupa benda-benda peninggalan dari masa prasejarah sampai dengan masa datangnya Islam di Indonesia. Barang-barang koleksi tersebut seperti kapak batu, teracota, kubur batu, wayang, topeng, kain batik dan lain-lain. 
Museum Sonobudoyo ini juga menyimpan naskah dan buku-buku yang berhubungan dengan kebudayaan yang seringkali museum ini digunakan untuk tempat penelitian dan mencari referensi.
Museum Sonobudoyo terletak di tengah kota yang dapat diakses dengan mudah dari segala arah. Semua alat transportasi dapat dipakai untuk mencapai tempat ini seperti : kendaraan pribadi, bus trans Jogja, bus kota, taxi, becak, andong dan sepeda. Anda juga dapat mencapai tempat ini dengan berjalan kaki bila dari kawasan Malioboro.
Fasilitas penunjang yang tersedia ditempat ini berupa koleksi buku dan naskah yang menggambarkan kebudayaan Indonesia, ruang laboratorium konversi, pendopo untuk ruang pengunjung.
Pada prinsipnya bangunan museum berbentuk Jawa. Hal tersebut dapat terlihat antara halaman luar dengan halaman dalam dipisahkan dengan tembok.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
For an entrance fee of RP10000 (about 70 cents US), you get to see and learn a lot about Yogya history and culture. 

There are some flaws and imperfections in the museum, but it is a steal at such low entrance fee.

Although the museum is not big, it has a lot of genuine artefacts. Established by the sultan of Yogyakarta in 1935. The collections are rotating, the present one is covering the prehistorical period, Javanese kingdoms, Islamic kingdoms, Bali.
Definitely, worth a visit, the ticket is half USD, and the museum has own free parking.

If you are interested in Javanese art and culture then this is not to be missed. The museum shows an array of traditional arts and crafts. The Wayang Kulit shadow puppet performance every evening from 8 -10 pm (except Sundays) for Rp, 20,000 is well worth it. It is a mesmerizing show and especially interesting to see the performance (puppets, puppeteer, musicians, singers) also from in front as well as behind the screen. The show lasts exactly two hours. The usual length of a Wayang Kulit performance lasts all night (~10 pm to ~5 am). This performance at the Museum is a shortened version, showing a specific (alternating) episode each night only.

Wat een aardig museum in de breedste zin van het woord. Moest bij binnenkomst in een schrift invullen waar ik vandaan kwam, naam en een aantal andere gegevens. Vond dit een sfeervol museum met een aantal prachtige stukken. Men wilde graag met mij praten over het museum, mijn bezoek aan Indonesië, vond ik heel aardig en belangstellend en ben hier natuurlijk graag op ingegaan. Aanrader dit museum!

夜、影絵ショーが見られる所として有名ですが、日曜はショーが休みで残念でした。
博物館だけ見学しました。入口にはたくさんのガムラン楽器が並んでいて、やわらかな音色の鉄琴音を響かせて演奏していました。
内部はジョグジャの歴史、遺跡物、バティックや人形劇のパペット、仮面が展示されていました。
エアコンがかなり効いていました。

Review Text: This is a museum of Indonesian culture. A gamelan player was on site providing Indonesian music which was beautiful and haunting. Exhibits of instruments, batik,wayang puppets ,costumes and more. No one told us about it and we accidentally found it on the internet. Totally worth at least an hour. Minimal charge.
昔の文化まだまだ残っているジョッグジャカルタに地方の様々な技術が展示されている。夜にもワヤン・ショーが行います。

Sonobudoyo is a must see museum to understand the culture of the region. The only reason we do not give it a five star rating is that there were no explanative postings in English, or any other languages, besides Indonesian. This limits the Museum’s touristic appeal. Maybe in the interim a printed pamphlet in various languages could be made available. The staff was very helpful and did explain some of the exhibits. Surely worth a visit.

As a separate item, the museum presents a shadow puppet show five times per week at a very minimal cost. Since these shows are an essential part of the culture, we decided to attend. Although the show lasts for approximately two hours and the language was Javanese, it did hold our attention and is well worth seeing.

This is one of my favorite places in Yogyakarta as it is less crowded and very educational.
If you want to escape crowds of people then this is the right place as some locals tend to avoid visiting this place for a reason.
This is a smaller, traditional museum which is conveniently located near the colonial downtown area.   There is a puppet show connected to the museum which is worthwhile.

The only reason why my review isn't five stars is because I was missing information in English about the museum exhibits. Even though each room has one large banner explaining what the exhibit in the respective room is about, this just doesn't cut it to fully understand the significance and history of most objects on display. Nevertheless it's well worth the entrance price of 5000rupiah (foreigners - not sure about the local price) and will keep you entertained for about 1.5 hours.

Luckily for us we were approached by one of the museum staff offering a free tour of the museum. This was definitely worth it as she was able to give us much more background on the objects, their significance and what + in which context they were used for. It was especially interesting to see the batik and wayang collections and to learn how traditonal Indonesian culture was used to spread new religions and colonial ideas (the different wayang puppets and children's toys were good examples pointed out by our guide).

As many others have pointed out, the museum has wayang performances every night (except Sundays) with an entrance fee of 20,000rupiah per person. These run from 8 to 10pm. Unlike some other comments, I had no trouble finding the place. Once you get to the main entrance of the museum, the security guard will tell you to go right and then left. It's not that hard at all. The performance itself had a slow start but after that it was absolutely mesmerizing! I loved that you could walk around the stage and see everything from up close. I was especially impressed with the main puppet master whose multitasking skills are truly next level: he is doing the two-hour long storytelling by heart, managing the puppets and also providing musical guidance with his toe (his toe operates the small gong next to him!). The live traditional orchestra truly makes the show come to life as well.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: There is a shortened Wayang Kulit (shadow puppet show) with complete gamelan orchestra, singers, and the puppet master. Every evening except Sunday (I think). at 8pm-10pm. Small entrance fee.

Sonobudoyo adalah salah satu museum yang wajib dikunjungi oleh turis. Museum ini terletak di dekat keraton jogja. Koleksi di dalamnya banyak berhubungan dengan koleksi keraton dan kerajaan-kerajaan di Jawa jaman dahulu. Selalu ada guide yang siap untuk menjelaskan isi koleksi museum. Museum ini bagus buat orang-orang yang mau belajar sejarah kerajaan di Jogja dan sekitarnya.

Lokasinya strategis dekat Alun-Alun Utara. Museum ini menyimpan banyak koleksi tentang budaya Jawa Tengah. Koleksinya banyak dan sangat terawat. 

Ada beberapa ruang pamer dengan isi koleksi yang berbeda, mulai dari jaman purbakala, koleksi batik, topeng, wayang, senjata tradisional, logam, permainan tradisional, dan lain-lain. Tiap koleksi dilengkapi dengan keterangan yang jelas dalam bahasa Indonesia. Sayangnya tidak semua dilengkapi dengan Bahasa Inggris.

Ruang pamer bersih dan dingin. Ada tempat duduk yang disediakan oleh pengelola. 

Harga tiket masuk cukup murah. Kisaran harga 2.500 - 3.000 untuk lokal dan 5.000 untuk turis asing. 

Ada guide jika mau berkeliling museum bersama pemandu.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Quite interesting for the historians and they will love the museum collections, mostly display javanese culture and also some culture from other region outside java

입구와 연결된 출구의 회랑에서 가믈란연주도 겸하고 있어서 잠시 편안한 마음으로 여행을 정리할 수 있다
이 곳을 방문하시기 전에 힌두신화와 라마야난 신화를미리 읽고 간다면 좀 더 재밌는 관람이 돌 듯하며 아무 정보없이 가면 볼 것이 없다는 말을 할 수 밖에 없을 듯  
일요일 제외한 저녁 8시 부터는 와양쿨릿 공연이 있으며 이 또한 신화를 기반으로 한 인형극이므로 미리 공부는 필수일 듯
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Nice museum to learn more about history and culture of Indonesia. It looks somewhat outdated, but they have great artifacts. One downside was the limited or missing information in English. Entrance fee was only 5000 IDR (0,32€??) and well worth it. If more information was provided you'd easily pay 15k and still be happy. Oh yeah, did I mention it's air conditioned! :-)

Das Puppen Schattenspiel Theater verbindet Gamelan Musik mit einem Schattenspiel. Es ist faszinierend, die Musiker und vor allem den Puppenspieler zu beobachten, der alle Figuren bedient, singt und auch die verschiedenen Stimmen immitiert.
Es gibt Sitzplätze vor und hinter der Leinwand, sodass man die Musiker und auch das Schattenspiel selbst verfolgen kann. Man wechselt einfach nach Belieben die Plätze.
Die Aufführung findet von 20 bis 22 Uhr statt.
Der Text ist zwar nicht zu verstehen, jedoch ist alleine die Musik und die Darstellung einen Besuch wert.

This charming little museum is well worth the time (and it's air conditioned). It's only small and so takes about half an hour to see everything. The exhibits cover things that are important to the area like batik, puppets, masks, furniture, etc. The cost is just IDR 5000

tous les soirs se déroule un spectacle de marionnettes accompagné d'un gamelan, évidemment c'est l'histoire du ramayana qui est contée à l'écran, la musique est assez assourdissante à la longue mais l'ambiance vaut le détour

Sul sito del museo c'è il calendario con l'orario di tutti gli spettacoli. L'ingresso è economico e lo spettacolo vale davvero la pena!
Si ha la possibilità di assistere allo spettacolo e anche di sedersi nel retro, per osservare i musicisti e il master of puppets. Un'esperienza suggestiva. Essendo interamente in lingua javanese per qualcuno può risultare noioso, si può uscire quando si vuole.

This small, well-maintained museum has both inside and ou a variety of objects including costumes, textiles, puppets, pots, musical instruments, stone statues, colonial furniture and my favorite -- long wooden bells.  Although the focus is on central Java, you can see a Balinese gate and pieces from other parrts of Indonesia as well. Thw only downside is the mid-afternoon closure, so do check th eopening times carefully.

pls use the complimentary guide service in the museum. it is worth the time effort. and the guide knows the material shown. a selections of items on display from then till now, including wayang golek puppets.

Try to request for Miss Lucia as your guide. she was patient and informative with us and we had a great visit with her.

Nothing much, just display of old music instruments, drums. Old clothings, old weapons, some buddhist n Hindu relics from the past. Entrance fee- idr5,000 I was the only visitor at 9 am ( open 8 am to 4 pm) Since you are in Jogjakarta, just drop in for about 20 minutes.
Curious small museum, with music shows in the morning. Some good sculptures and a small hindouist temple inside.
ジャワ文化の博物館です。夜に行くと影絵のショーもやっています。このショーの面白い所は360度好きなところから見ることが出来ます。
ジオラマ好きにはたまらない場所。自国の歴史を写真やビデオではなく、ジオラマで学ばせようという発想に脱帽。グーグルマップの道順間違ってます。表通りから入れます。

В музее собрано всё, чем славится Ява.
Крисы, мебель, резьба, марионетки для ваянга, музыкальные инструменты - практически каждый экспонат это произведение искусства.
This is a very frustrating place. The exhibits are fantastic, but it appears to have been years since anyone made a effort to curate them for an international audience. Friendly staff.

We visited the museum on afternoon and enjoyed seeing the artifacts, especially the exhibits of shadow puppets and batik. We saw an artisan making a leather shadow puppet similar to the ones they use in the nightly shows. They have some of his works available for sale. We returned in the evening and really enjoyed the show.

I thoroughly enjoyed this museum. Lots of interesting items, especially those showcasing the country's early history.  Great to have English explanations for about half of the items in the museum.  I hope the remainder is done so that other English speakers can more fully appreciate its treasures.

I found myself in the middle of a rainstorm during my trip to Yogyjakarta. Thankfully I was right next to the Sonobudoyo Museum. If you can, try and get a guide while exploring the museum. During my visit, I had a wonderful guide provide me with a through explanation of all of the artifacts. Staff were very friendly. During the evening they have puppet shows, I did not have a chance to catch a show, but I heard that they are entertaining.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The show is in jawa language. So basically I don't understand a thing even though brochure was given.. i only stayed 30 minutes for the show.

Though the beginning started a bit slow for someone still recovering from jetlag, the later part was definitely great to see.

You can go to both sides of the stage. So you can switch between looking at the puppets shadow performance, and looking at how the performer creates the shadow display.

When I was there (low season) there was plenty of seating left for you to buy tickets at the door or even to show up late.

Terletak di dekat Alun-Alun Utara Yogya, museum ini cukup berbeda dengan museum-museum lain. Museum ini cantik dan terawat sekali, ruangannya adem dan sama sekali tidak terasa pengap. Benda koleksi terawat dengan sangat baik, tiket masuknya pun murah, hanya sebesar Rp 3.000,- saja (tidak ada tambahan utk kamera). Koleksinya lengkap, tidak hanya tentang budaya jawa, tapi lebih mengenai koleksi sejarah. mulai dari zaman pra sejarah. Di akhir tour, ada sebuah replika ruangan candi yang biasanya ada di candi bentar dan cantik sekali, ada pula koleksi tentang tarian. Pembelajaran yang saya dapat dr museum ini sungguh banyak. Museum ini layak sekali dikunjungi.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: The pleasant guide told me that Sonobudoyo has the second most complete collection of artifacts in Indonesia, the first one is National Museum in Jakarta. The museum itself divides into several rooms with different themes. It was a very interesting and educational tour. Well, i think most of the people wont agree with me since when i was there, i was the only visitor, what a shame. Try to visit this place if you're in Yogyakarta, you won't regret it.

Sonobudoyo is een must voor wie de geschiedenis en het leven in Yogyakarta wil bekijken. In aantrelkkelijke vitrines worden de voorwerpen uitgestald : dongketels, gekaligrafeerde boeken, wayangpoppen, maskers,  .... Batik en Javaanse klederdracht. Er is een zeer mooi Javaans interieur. Uiteraard vindt je er ook enge wapens en kanonnen. Bij het museum is een maker van wayangpoppen aanwezig.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I like this kinds of preservations of heritage thus making full use of its richness of cultures for the future generations to witness it and feeling proud of its own country

Situated right on or around the corner from the main "drag" of tourist attractions and shopping in Yogyakarta, the Sonobudoyo Museum is worth a stop and about an hour's worth of wandering around. Incredibly reasonable entrance fees make this museum affordable for everyone, and it has a nice selection of everything Java related. It's well kept, and provides a great respite from the heat (or, if it's monsoon season, the rain). 
The museum also provides traditional Wayang shows in the evenings. Since I have been to them before, I didn't go, but I did happen to meet one of the artists and he was so passionate as he explained the performance and the reasons the artists want to keep this art form alive, I have no doubt it's great.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: If you are looking for some entertainment in the evening, head on down to this museum where there is a shadow puppet or wayang kulit shows to the accompaniment of gamelan music. Shows are held weekdays from 8 pm to 10 pm. This is also a museum with many historical relics showcasing the history and culture of Java. Objects like masks, shadow puppets, bronze statues, ceramics and keris or daggers are on display here.

This is a bargain at only 20,000 each and is a great way to see some traditional puppetry.  The leather puppets are beautiful and whilst you wont be able to understand the story (unless you speak Indonesian!) its worth a visit as there is gamelan music accompanying it and singers too.  The first 30 mins is just the story being explained so probably worth skipping this bit and arriving at 8.30.  Definitely worth a visit and also seeing the puppet making factory too which is inside the Kraton complex (although they also have a small demonstration at the puppet show too).
ここではインドネシアの伝統芸能ワヤン・クリッ（影絵芝居）を毎晩２０時から2時間程行っているのでそれを鑑賞する目的で夜にきました。影絵と伝統音楽は確かに素晴らしいです．．．１０分くらいは．．．ただ朗読がまったくわからないので、１０分たったら飽きてしまいました。私たちは粘って最後までいましたが、数少ない客は途中でどんどんいなくなり最後までいたのは私たちともう一組だけでした。

Harga tiket masuk ke museum ini hanya idr 3,000, tetapi pengalaman yang didapatkan sangatlah mahal.
*harga idr 3,000 sudah termasuk ditemani tour guide atau tidak (boleh pilih sesuai kenyamanan).

Koleksi museum ini meliputi barang2 peninggalan jaman purbakala sampai jaman kolonial.  Ada ruangan yang menjelaskan peralatan jaman raja2 kuno, ruangan berisi patung2 dan makna ukiran2 Jawa, ruangan berisi koleksi batik dan kain, pewayangan, Pura.

Wajib dikunjungi, buka dari jam 8pagi dan sangat dekat dengan Jalan Malioboro, bisa ditempuh dengan jalan kaki.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Untuk anda yang memiliki rasa ingin tahu terhadap sekilas budaya dan sejarah Kota Yogya, saya sarankan Anda mengunjungi museum ini karena dengan biaya dan akses yang murah, Anda dibimbing oleh pekerja museum yang sangat ramah dan seperti keluarga sendiri, bukan hanya mengenai Yogya tapi di dalamnya ada sebuah contoh pintu Candi yang ada di Bali, dan jika Anda berfoto, Anda akan merasa seperti Anda berada di Bali saat itu
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: музей не особо впечатлил, очень много представлено мебели, кухонной утвари, и много предметов роскоши местного правителя, особый интерес вызывают письма султана.

Вход находится рядом со входом в Кратон, султанский дворец. Один из местных промыслов - изготовление сложных и немного пугающих кукол, музей посвящен этим самым куклам и театральным шоу теней с их участием. Посмотреть интересно, разрешают фотографировать. После музея мы еще посетили мастерскую, где кукол изготовляют - получилось цельное впечатление о всем процессе.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: ガムラン楽器、ワヤンクリッの影絵人形、仮面、操り人形、バティック、インドネシアの伝統的な家具、扉などここでインドネシアの文化に触れることができます。日本語のとても上手な女性のガイドさんに案内をしてもらいとても良かったです。とても素晴らしい所なのに見学者がとても少ないのはもったいないと思いました。

We visited the museum reluctantly, but were pleasantly surprised. It is a well kept museum, and we had some very enthusiastic students as our guides as this facility is offered free in this museum. Their dedication amazed us, and made the tour very interesting.

Nel museo Sonobudoyo la sera dalle 20 alle 22 c'è uno spettacolo di marionette tipiche indonesiane. Le marionette sono ricavate da una lamina di cuoio finemente intagliata e decorata. 
Lo spettacolo è fatto in modo che lo spettatore possa vedere sia le ombre delle marionette proiettate su un telo, sia (sul lato opposto) l'orchestra e il marionettista. Musica davvero suggestiva e piacevole. 
La storia rappresentata dalle marionette è incomprensibile per chi non parla l'indonesiano ma lo spettacolo è comunque uno splendore. Da non perdere!

Von einem angeblich zweitbesten Museum des Landes erwartet man mehr. Kein Führer, keine Brochure, keine Cafeteria, kein Shop. Die Vermarktung der Landesgeschichte und des Kunsthandwerks endet hier sogleich mit der Barzahlung des moderaten Eintrittpreises.

Sebenarnya museum Sonobudoyo ada 2, unit 2 terletak tidak jauh dari museum utama, yaitu di Jalan Wijilan dekat dengan kawasan guded Jogja. Museum sonobudoyo menyimpan banyak sekali koleksi, mulai dari zaman prasejarah hingga masa kontemporer. Museum ini juga menyimpan koleksi lengkap manuskrip dan arsip cetak dari berbagai masa. Pada malam hari museum ini juga menyajikan pertunjukan wayang dengan tiket 20.000. Untuk menjangkau museum ini sangat mudah karena lokasinya yang strategis di alun-alun utara Jogja.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Obwohl ich selbst Musiklehrer bin und mit meinen Schülern schon häufig die Themen Gamelan und Schattenspieltheather behandelte, kann ich dennoch keine Empfehlung geben. Zwar ist der Anblick der Vorführung durchaus anfangs reizvoll, doch versteht man so gut wie nichts von der Handlung, selbst wenn man sich vorher eingelesen hat. Auch ist die Musik sehr kontrastarm, sodass man kaum einen Gefühlsausdruck versteht. Kurz: sehr ermüdende Veranstaltung, nur für bedingungslose Geister empfehlenswert.

这里的木偶、面具、蜡染布等藏品都十分精美，有时候会有一些特展，也有课出售的皮影手信。
交通：从日惹皇宫出发，步行10分钟左右可以到达。
开放时间：周一和重要节假日闭馆，周五8:00-14:00，其余时间8:00-15：30。这里最有特色的其实是晚上20:00-22:00会有哇扬戏的演出。
价格:白天门票5000印尼盾，晚上看表演的费用为20,000印尼盾。如果要带相机进去拍照，则每台相机要另外交3000印尼盾。
日惹最具特色的戏剧便是哇扬戏，和中国传统的皮影戏有异曲同工之妙。戏剧内容多数取材自印度史诗《罗摩衍那》和《摩诃婆罗多》中与英雄人物有关的故事。整场表演有2个多小时，说的都是我们听不懂的当地语言，所以看了一会儿会觉得有点无趣，于是我们就起身拍摄这些表演者。哇扬戏的表演会用到很多当地的乐器，我们觉得好奇，结果竟然被邀请加入其中，由奏者亲手带着一起演奏！很特别的体验。但是在起身准备离开的时候，阿伯有偷偷摸我的手- -~。
后来我们白天去日惹皇宫也有表演，买门票的时候他也没说表演什么，就说是local的表演，结果我们买门票进去以后发现又是哇扬戏，而且手上用的皮影人都跟昨晚是一样的，但是日惹皇宫的门票会便宜些，所以大家二选一看看就可以了。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Museum Sonobudoyo yang diresmikan tangal 6 November 1935 (Sono berarti tempat,budoyo:budaya) merupakan museum terlengkap setelah Museum Nasional Jakarta ini terletak di pojok Alun-alun Utara Keraton Yogya dekat Gudeg Mbarek-Bu Hj.Ahmad. Kompleks bangunan terdiri dari beberapa gedung/ruang yang berbentuk joglo (ruang Pendopo,Batik,Wayang,Topeng dst.) di dalamnya tersimpan berbagai koleksi benda bernilai sejarah & budaya Jawa yang tinggi nilainya.
Good museum if you have an hour to spare, or if you want to escape the heat ánd the crowds. Some very beautiful objects.

입구에 가면 영어 가이드가 있습니다. 저는 그냥 입장했는데 거의 모든 설명이 인니어로 되어 있어 그냥 눈요기만 했습니다.

가이드 비용도 크게 비싸지 않으니 유물에 관심이 많으시다면 꼭 가이드 쓰세요. 설명을 읽을 수 없으니 상당히 답답 하더군요.

유물 종류는 많습니다. 족자에서 가장 소장품이 많은듯 싶네요.

I went to Museum Sonobudoyo at night for the 'Wayang Kulit' Show.
It start at 8:00pm. The entrance fee was Rp20.000 for foreigners. The show was interesting.
they have a guide which was effectively bilingual and was able to explain and made the small museum more interesting than it actually is.
koleksi yang sangat lengkap mengenai kebudayaan jawa. mulai dari jaman mataram kuno hingga mataram islam. lokasi di pojok alun-alun utara. pada malam hari tertentu ada pertunjukan wayang singkat.

This is one of the better places to make a short visit to in central Yogya. Only half a dozen rooms, so you can get round fairly quickly. There's a decent range of pieces and some informative narrative. Worth seeing if you are in Yogya.

This is a good place to start for history lovers and before taking a peek at the candi(s) (temples). Informative and artifacts are lovely here. The array of wayang kulit is tremendous. It is cosy and a nice mixture of Jogja and Bali artifacts. Information is clear  and apt. Entrance fee is IDR 3,000 which is a reasonable, actually. Lovely wood carvings, door carvings and stone carvings.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Это скорее не музей, а целое культурное пространство рядом со дворцом Султана, где можно ознакомиться с музыкальной и театральной культурой султаната Джогьякарта.

夜のワヤン・クリッを鑑賞した。入口近くで水牛の皮を加工する人形作りを見学できる。とても細かく根気ある作業に感心した。影絵芝居は人形使い・朗読・木を叩く音を一人で行なっている。ストーリーは分からなくても、スクリーンのこちらと向こう側を自由に行き来ができるので、仕組みを見学できて飽きることがなかった。ガムラン楽器に興味を示すと、伴奏者から一緒に演奏しようと誘われ、演目中に叩かせてくれた。良い思い出ができました。

Nous avons fait la visite du musée avec les services de la guide Pita. Ses explications étaient intructives et elle a su répondre à toutes nos questions dans un excellent anglais et avec le sourire. Nous recommandons fortement de faire la visite avec un guide, car il y a peu de panneaux explicatifs en anglais. L'entrée au musée était de seulement 5000 IDR et nous avons donné un pourboire à la guide pour son excellent travail. La visite guidée dure un peu plus d'une heure et constitue une bonne introduction à la culture de Java, Bali et Lombok.

This museum is not big (not like Musee D'Orsay or British Museum), but I guess this is the best attraction in town. This museum exhibits artifacts from pre-historical ages until pre-modern ages of Central Java, Yogyakarta and Bali. Collections are not much but really worth the visit because my tour guide (Icha) explained a lot of historical things that opened my eyes and my 5 years old daughter was attracted on how she explained things. Visit here if you want to get a glimpse about Yogyakarta Kingdom history - before you visit Kraton Yogyakarta. The explanation in Kraton is not as robust as in this museum. 

Entrance fee is super cheap for locals (Rp 3000), not sure how much they charge foreign tourist. 

They also perform traditional leather-made puppet show (Wayang Kulit) everyday except on Sunday, at 8 PM to 10 PM.

The entrance tix is 3,000 Rp. The collection of cultural artifact is little and not impressive. But hey, for such cheap tix, it is alright to go take a look.

The wayang puppets are lovely though.

No crowd at all on a Monday noon. After that, you can walk briskly to Jl. Maliobo for shopping.

It was totally worth the visit. The museum offers a great array of collection that visitors won't be able to see in the keraton or Taman Sari, to sort of fill in the story after visiting those two tourist destination. Definitely worth visiting.

Non è un capolavoro in quanto mancano spesso didascalie in inglese e sembra tutto un po' messo a caso. Tuttavia il costo irrisorio (5000 rupie) e la varietà della collezione rendono la visita gradevole. Si inizia con strumenti musicali, qualche reperto preistorico, libri sacri, legni intarsiati, batik, marionette, kriss...insomma cultura javanese. A lato un artigiano lavora la pelle di bufalo per le marionette in maniera esemplare e certosina; possibili gli acquisti.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
As a westerner this museum was well displayed, albeit dimly lit, and was without the pressures of other tourist spots. My guide, Aida, was fluent in English and very informative and kind(I felt my donation/tip at the end was well earned)

A+

Berdua dengan Bapak mengunjungi museum ini. Tiket masuknya murah sekali. Museumnya juga sepi sekali. Banyak spot untuk foto-foto juga. Koleksi tidak terlalu banyak tapi lumayan untuk wisata sejarah Keraton. Depan alun-alun Yogyakarta lagi.

Op aanraden van verschillende locals naar de puppet shadows play gegaan. Prachtig om te zien hoe zo'n show in zijn werk gaat, je kan van alle kanten kijken, dus naar de gamelan en naar de poppen. Het is echter erg lastig om het verhaal te begrijpen, zelfs met pamflet. Hierdoor werd het erg saai en duurde het heel lang. Toch interessant om deze Indonesische culuur mee te maken.

Mengunjungi Keraton Jogjakarta, sayang bila melewatkan mengunjungi museum yang berada dalam alun2 Keraton Jogja.  Dengan harga karcis yang terjangkau, kita akan diantar untuk mengenal begitu banyak warisan budaya Jawa  baik dari jaman prasejarah hingga peninggalan masa keemasan Keraton Jogjakarta. Peninggalan yang cukup menyita perhatian adalah beragam keris pusaka dari abad ke 7 hingga abad ke 19 baik berasal dari Jawa juga dari luar jawa. Banyak informasi dapat diperoleh dalam museum yang diklaim sebagai museum terlengkap di Jogjakarta. Museum ini juga menjadi literatur maupun referensi sejarah karena menyimpan begitu banyak peninggalan baik naskah2 kuno dan peninggalan kuno lainnya. Museum ini dikategorikan museum umum karena menyediakan info tentang Teknologi, Geologi, Seni Rupa, Biologi, Keramologi, Etnografi, Filologika, Arkeologi, Numismatika dan Historika. Sangat layak dikunjungi untuk mengenal lebih dalam tentang perdaban Jawa secara umum.

With our professional guide, we visited this small impressive museum - so we were able to understand something about Jarvanese art & puppertry

Highly recommended

All though a small place it still took nearly 1 1/2 hours to go around thanks to a very professional and knowledgeable guide, it was very interesting and factual tour, it was mega cheap to get it and I'm looking forward to tonight's shadow puppet show that's held there with a better understanding of Javanese culture and tradition

Museum Sonobudoyo merupakan museum yang masih dalam satu wilayah dengan kraton Yogyakarta. Museum ini menyimpan berbagai koleksi rumah tangga masyarakat Jawa, alat kesenian dan sosial, buku-buku kebudayaan serta benda-benda pustaka. Museum ini memberikan kesan yang kuat mengenai jalan kehidupan masyarakat Jawa

Saya kagum ... ternyata museum Sonobudoyo adalah salah satu museum negeri yang berbenah diri dengan konsep modern-nya.

Setiap ruangannya dari halaman depan sampai halaman belakang berikut barang-barang koleksinya ditata dengan apik berikut penerangan dan ventilasi udara yang cukup dari setiap ruangan sehingga museum ini jauh dari kesan angker dan kumuh.

CCTV juga sudah dipasang.Cuma sayangnya waktu saya datang berkunjung, ada tangga yang dibiarkan menghalangi barang koleksi.

Dengan harga tiket masuk yang relatif sangat murah, seringkali justru membuat pengunjung jadi merasa tidak gengsi kalo mengunjunginya, loh ... padahal barang koleksinya asli dan tempatnya keren.Gak kalah sama museum lainnya yang dikelola oleh pihak swasta dengan harga tiket masuk yang 10 kali lipat lebih mahal tapi toh, tetap banyak dikunjungi orang.

Ada baiknya pihak museum juga menjalin kerja sama dengan pihak agen perjalanan dengan memberikan sejumlah insentif sehingga berkunjung ke museum Sonobudoyo bisa diagendakan juga dalam jadwal perjalanannya.

Jadi ada semacam subsidi silang antara pengunjung pribadi yang dikenakan tarif mahal dengan pengunjung rombongan (apalagi rombongan anak sekolah sebaiknya digratiskan saja untuk keperluan pendidikan).Sekedar sumbang saran saja, sih...

Dan berhubung pengetahuan pengunjung museum juga terdiri dari berbagai disiplin ilmu, sebaiknya pihak museum berikut instansi terkait di atasnya juga membuka diri sekaligus segera memperbaiki kalau ada saran tentang tata letak barang koleksi tertentu yang sesuai dengan disiplin ilmu yang dimiliki pengunjung.

Museum Sonobudoyo...kereennn....
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
ジョグジャカルタの伝統芸能「ワヤン・クリッ」
（古代インドの叙事詩「ラーマヤナ」と「マハーバーラタ」の世界を
人形遣い（ダラン）が独自の演出をほどこすジャワ島の影絵芝居）
ここソノブドヨ博物館では毎日夜間に上演されています。
博物館で伝統芸能を見るって・・素敵なシチュエーション。
鑑賞料もお手ごろだしここは必見でしょう。
影絵の動きはとても楽しくガムランの演奏や歌・・そしてナレーション。言葉はわからなくても引きこまれる内容で２時間もあっという間でした。
そしてここは上演中も出入り自由で舞台の裏側も見学可能なのも良いですね。

＊チケットは当日開場で購入します。開演２０：００の２０分前から販売開始です。
＊入口近辺暗くてかなりわかりにくかったです。
　工事中？だったからか・・夜間は常にわかりにくいのか不明です。（２０１５年９月訪問時）
＊入口には看板あり。案内係の女性もいました。

It was an exciting trip. Costing only Rp. 3,000.00, it was a breathtaking tour around the museum. I recommend you to be assisted by a tour guide who works there; their guidance and explanations are very clear and understandable. Their collection of things, from prehistoric tools to puppets, are admirable and interesting to take a look at. 

A true fine museum for me.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: ジャワ島の伝統文化を保存・継承することを目的に建てられた博物館。入口で入場料5000ルピアを支払うと、日本語のできる女性の方がいらっしゃって、打楽器や伝統工芸品などの展示物を丁寧にガイドしてくれました。レプリカの展示に関しては、「本物は○○にあるんですよ」と教えてくれました。民芸品の中にさりげなく、ジャワ原人のレプリカもありました。説明を聞きながらしっかり見学し、ガイドしていただいた後でもう一度、写真撮影のために自分達だけで見て回りました。所要時間は１時間くらいでした。何人いるのか判りませんが、日本語の解説はとてもありがたかったです。夜は予定があったので、隣接するシアターで行われる影絵人形芝居｢ワヤン・クリッ｣は鑑賞しませんでした。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
A nice visit, mostly because of their Wayang collection and explanation. To understand the Wayang puppet show a little bit you need to go to the museum! 
The museum organized Wayang shows as well every evening from 8:00 - 10:00. You don't have to be there exactly at 8:00 ...a d if you make it till the end of the show you will be the first tourist ever i think ;-) But if you Just want to get an impression its worth a visit.

20時からのワヤンクリッはいい雰囲気でした。入口が王宮側の道路に面していてわかりにくかったですが検問所のようなものがあり、そこで案内してもらいました。演目はラーマヤナを８回に分けてやるため、全部見るには８日かかるそうです。その日の演目は外の電光表示板にもありました。インドネシア語なのでなにを言っているかはわかりませんが、ラーマヤナを事前に調べておくとより、楽しめると思います。英語の小冊子はありました。客は日本人と欧米人でした。ガムランの演奏も良かったです。

Museum ini letaknya berdekatan dengan Keraton Jogjakarta. Disini ditempatkan beraneka ragam barangan pusaka dari Keraton Ngayoyakarta Hadiningrat seperti keris, barangan hiasan, pakaian dan batik. Lokasinya strategik  sayangnya, barang yang dipamerkan kelijhatan kurang terawat, lusuh, kotor sekali. Lumayan datang kesini sekalian kalau berkunjung ke Keraton.
Berkunjung kesini karena tiket masuknya yang relatif murah, terletak diseberang alun alun, koleksi museumnya kurang lengkap untuk sejarah jogja.
20時からだから、早めに夕食を食べていけばいい。最初のほうはあまり動きもないので、途中から見ても全然問題ない。観光客は欧米人が多い。言葉はわからず、やや単調なので音楽を味わう気持ちで鑑賞すればよい。通りが工事中で入口がわかりにくかったけど、あきらめずに探せば見つかる。

Lo spettacolo delle marionette merita sicuramente una visita, specialmente perché ti permette di seguirlo davanti o dietro le quinte.
I giochi di ombre sono davvero affascinanti mentre i movimenti del "burattinaio" e dell'orchestra sono ancora più interessanti.
Ammetto che 2 ore sono troppe, specialmente perché non si capisce assolutamente nulla della storia e la musica è un po' stridente. In ogni caso merita senza dubbio un salto.
the collection of cultural artifact in sonobudoyo is the second most complete in Museum Jakarta open tuesday - thurday 08.00am - 1 pm

As we didn't check the opening times before our visit, we only had 20 minutes to explore the exhibits at Sonobudoyo Museum before it closed. Frankly, though, that was more than enough time...

With little information to explain its dusty displays, the museum is an unsatisfying and often confusing experience for foreigners. And, like many other cultural sites in Yogyakarta, it mostly caters for domestic tourists, with little to welcome or engage overseas visitors.

To be fair, the museum's large display of shadow puppets and ceremonial masks is impressive, and the small Hindu temple in an outdoor courtyard is a decent taster for anyone planning an onward trip to Bali. But what stuck in our minds most was a small wooden carving in the final room, which shows a deeply unnatural sexual act. It will make even the perviest eyes water!

In the evening, Sonobudoyo Museum often plays host to shadow puppet performances, which are certainly worth a visit. But don't expect a roller coaster thrill ride... there is no explanation of what is happening in the show and, as the plot moves at a glacial pace and is accompanied by shrill gamelan music that will leave you with ringing ears, you’re sure to leave long before the end!

I'd noticed there are more reviews about the Wayang Kulit, which is staged in another building nearby... rather than the actual Sonobudoyo Museum itself!

The museum has quite a respectable collection. The location on the map, while accurate, does not show the entrance. You have to enter via an inner road from the northern city square (Alun Alun) side. It's quite secluded so you may need to search for it and ask the locals.

If you want to come for the Wayang Kulit, I highly suggest you find out the place first because I had a hard time looking for it at night. As mentioned, the map has no indication of where to enter. Also, Waze sends you to the wrong side.

I came here at night to see Wayang, the shadow puppet show. Before the show, you can see the Wayang maker performs his ability just at the outside of the building.

The entrance fee for the show was 20k rupiah for 2 hours show, and for taking pictures you will be asked for additional 3k. I got the ticket and i can oick any seat i want. You can move freely during the show too!

it was a great experience to watch Wayang. But, it would be better if they put some screens to explain the story briefly. The show was brought in Javanese. It was kinda boring if you don't speak Javanese. On the other hand, you can see how they perform, hear a traditional Javanese song, and watch traditional music, and they were awesome.

You should come to this museum while you are in Jogja, and get to know the local culture here.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Visited in June 2013

We visited the museum in the evening for the wayang kulit (shadow puppet) show. Prior to entering the puppet theatre, we were able to explore the artisans at work making the puppets from leather. There was also a small shop selling the puppets. 

Prior to entering the theatre, we were given a pamphlet regarding the night's show. We watched an episode of Hanuman's quest. One could enjoy the show with the 20-piece live orchestra from the shadow side or the light side. Although the show was in Indonesian, there were some english sentences in the pamphlet detailing the story. 

Very entertaining
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Koleksi dimuseum ini bisa dikatakan minim skali, banyak barang yang dalam kondisi tidak kayak disebut barang koleksi dan terlihat jelas palsu ( sendok dari perak tapi berkarat padahal perak kan tidak bisa karatan) macam jenis koleksi nya pun sedikit sehingga museum ini tidak menarik untuk dikunjungi

I did not really have plans for the evening but good thing my hotel is just near Sonobudoyo Museum. I watched Wayang Kulit at night. The entrance was quite dark. There weren't a lot of people so it wasn't noisy. Although, since the performance is in Bahasa many of the tourists inside the theater were getting bored even if they have a plot of the story. But I think it is a good opportunity to watch Wayang Kulit here. You can choose to sit behind the puppet master and musicians to see what's behind the screen. You will be able to appreciate and learn to respect the cultural heritage of Indonesia through it, especially how good the puppet master is.

This museum should be a starting point for anyone wanting to gain a clear overview of the many, diverse influences that have helped form modern Indonesia. Whilst the quantity of exhibits is modest, the range is adequate for giving a clear picture of how this country has evolved. Visits to other museums may overwhelm with the magnitude of their displays whereas this museum successfully tells a story that all can comprehend in a short visit. An evening visit might be a welcome addition for those who wish to experience the traditional "wayang kulit" puppet show.
夕方、他の観光施設が閉まっている時間帯、この博物館だけが開いていたので訪ねてみました 。さほど大きくない博物館ですが、衣装や影絵人形などの展示があって、見どころも多かったです。王宮とマリオボロ通りの間にあるため、王宮の帰りに寄るのも良いと思います。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Museum Sonobudoyo adalah sebuah museum yang sudah berdiri sebelum Indonesia diproklamasikan. Museum ini digagas dan didirikan sejak tahun 1913 oleh Java Institut, kemudian diresmikan pada tahun 1935 oleh Sri Sultan Hamengku Buwono VII. Tiket masuk ke museum hanya Rp 3.000 untuk wisatawan domestik dan Rp 5.000 untuk wisatawan manca negara.
Berlokasi tepat di depan alun alun utara, berhadapan dengan Keraton Yogyakarta. Museum Sonobudoyo memiliki beragam koleksi warisan budaya Jawa, Bali, Lombok dan Madura. Beraneka koleksi senjata tradisionil mulai dari keris, mandau, kapak, pedang, meriam, tombak, clurit dan wedhung dapat dilihat pada etalase yang terpajang apik. 
Beragam koleksi batik, patung dan kerajinan rakyat juga bisa dilihat di sini. Peralatan gamelan Sri Sultan HB VII berada persis di ruang masuk museum. Salah satu atraksi seni yang bisa dinikmati di museum ini adalah pagelaran wayang dengan cerita Ramayana yang digelar setiap pukul 20.00-22.00, dengan tiket seharga Rp 20.000 per orang.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I went to the puppet show and really enjoyed it. Starts at 8pm every night, is two hours, and very cheap. It was fun to watch and nice to listen to the music. They had it set up so you could watch from the screen side or could watch from 'backstage'. Would recommend going if you have a free night.

I only came here for the weekly Shadow Puppet performance on the Saturday evening and didn't have time to visit the rest of the museum earlier in the day.  I was recommended to go there by the official Tourist Information Office in Jl. Marlioboro (which is also very good: they speak English, and gave me a good street map and helpful information about travelling around Yogjakarta).

The Shadow Puppet performance was superb. Not just the 2-hour performance itself (puppet-master, instrumentalists and vocalists) but the technology of the audio transmission - extremely clear with no background interference. It was incredibly good value but sadly there was hardly anybody in the audience: it deserves to be much better known.

It's worth a quick stop here as you make your way towards the Kraton. A small museum but with a few interesting exhibits - guides are available if more detailed explanations are required (I didn't try one so can't attest to quality).

Nel Sonobudoyo le raccolte sono le più varie, vanno dall'archeologia all'etnologia, dalle marionette agli strumenti della musica gamelan, dall'antropologia alla storia recente, dalla geologia al folklore: un quadro abbastanza esaustivo della cultura giavanese. Per la mancanza di didascalie comprensibili che colleghino i reperti le collezioni sembrano però disposte senza criterio. Esiste, perso nei vicoletti a sud del Kraton, anche un Sonobudoyo 2, con padiglioni bui e con materiale espositivo simile al museo principale.

・・と書きましたが、私自身は結局中に入ることができませんでした。
（2日ほど行ったのですが、結局祝日か何かで入ることができませんでした）
（サイトを見たら、祝日はお休み？らしきことが明記されていました）

他の施設が開いているのに・・・です。

場所はマリオボロ通りをDahlan通りを越えた、少し南側です。

ただし、このそばには他の博物館や見ごたえのある場所がたくさんあるので、最悪閉館していても大乗かと思います・・。
This museum is one of my favourite museums around Indonesia, because it has a lot of collection and for who like and study the Indonesian especially Javanese culture, this place is recommended by me

tidak banyak yang tau tentang museum ini, terletak di alun alun utara Jogjakarta, museum ini menyimpan koleksi benda benda purbakala, Benda-benda koleksi Museum Sonobudoyo itu ada yang dipamerkan di luar dan di dalam gedung. Koleksi yang dipamerkan di luar gedung museumterbuat dari batu yang relatif tahan terhadap cuaca,jika yang tidak tahan cuaca diletakkan di dalam gedung
Visita estupenda. Recomiendo ir con guía al menos para conocer la historia, la cual nos resulto muy interesante

Museum ini menyimpan berbagai macam benda peninggalan sejarah Jawa masa lalu. Tetapi yang sangat menarik bagi saya adalah keberadaan tempat khusus penyimpanan naskah Jawa. Naskah-naskah Jawa yang sudah berusia tua disimpan sebagai pusat rujukan penelitian naskah Jawa selain yang ada di kraton. Bagi Anda yang ingin mengetahui lebih jauh bisa berkunjung dan menikmati koleksi yang kaya akan naskah-naskah Jawa tua yang masih asli tulisan pujangga msa lampau.

ジョグジャカルタはジャワ島の古都とのことですが、意外に市内にはみるところが少ないように感じました。街をぶらぶら歩くには、暑くて歩道が整備されていません。　王宮の南側にあるソノブドヨ博物館はこじんまりした建物ですが、少しはみるべきものがありました。　屋外にはバリ風の割れ門があったり、入り口の右側には石像が並べてあります。　屋内には、ジャワの生活の歴史についての展示などがあります。　日本語の話せる係員が説明をしてくれるとのことでしたが、ゆっくりみたいので辞退しました。

Un endroit où l'on peut faire un visite sans être constamment sollicité.  Un heure de bonheur pour les yeux. Des artefacts bien conservé et un effort présentation.    Inscriptions seulement en indonésien mais en ayant fais un certaine préparation préalable au voyage et une certaine habitude après 3 semaines de vacance on comprend plein de choses.  Nous avons choisit de ne pas prendre un guide qui est disponible mais ils ne s'impose pas. Nous avons discuté avec un visiteur indonésien qui nous a fourni quelques clés.  
Localisation 
Très près du Kraton (Palais des sultans) qui en passant plutôt décevant et agressant. Choisissez  plutôt le Budoyo. 

Cet avis n'est que pour le musée. Pour le spectacle cela sera dans deux jours.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
「水の王宮の近くだから、ついでに」と主人に言われて行ったので、何があるかもチェックしていませんでしたが、ジャワ原人の頭蓋骨はあるし、原始的な女性神の像や日本の道祖神に似た男女神など宗教関連がかなり興味深かったです。日本語を勉強しているのでとガイドを申し出てくれた学生さんらしき方が簡単な説明をしてくれたので、それもラッキーでした。「お金は必要ですか」と最初に尋ねたときには「要りません」という返答だったのですが、主人が帰り際チップ程度にお金を渡してました。要求されたわけではなかったようですけど。
昔の道具は国内のものでさえ何だかわからなかったりしますから、やはり拙くても説明があると助かりますね。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Lokasi dekat alun-alun Jogya, di sekitar Kraton yang juga dekat malioboro. Menyediakan pemandu wisata berbahasa Indonesia maupun Inggris. Koleksi museum cukup lengkap. Banyak digunakan untuk rombongan wisata anak-anak sekolah.

If you don't know anything about Yogyakarta and Javanese, come here for general knowledge tour. They have artifacts, puppets and some cultural heritage they explain there. They perform Ramayana on leather puppet (wayang kulit) play every night except Sunday from 8-10 pm. It's kinda boring because we don't understand the language but for me it's interesting to see how the dalang (puppet player) holds and plays the puppets and how it looks from both the front and back of the white screen.

It is not glitzy and glam but it does hold glimpses into Javanese history and the history of the Sultanate of Yogyakarta which for those of us who love that sort of thing makes it well worth the visit. Kids will be ho hum though so maybe not for the young ones!

Spectacle à voir, pas cher (20000 IDR) mais dommage qu'on ne comprenne pas ce qui est raconté ! Du coup, les 2 heures paraissent longues mais 1 heure de spectacle suffit et vaut largement le détour !!! Surtout pour le gamelan (orchestre).

It was a treat to watch the shadow puppets from both sides of the stage.  The Puppeteer manoeuvered the puppets from the front and he had the amazing talent of multi-tasking whilst playing with the puppets.  He used his voice to narrate the story and sing at the same time, used his hands to control the puppets and used his leg to play an instrument whilst sitting down.  The effect of the puppets from the other side was something different where one only gets to see the shadows of  the puppets performing and no humans or  musical intruments in the way.  A must experience highlight.
土曜日に行きましたが、中は広いのであまり人がいる感じはしませんでした。興味があったのは影絵で下が、昼間は練習？をしているようでした。なかなか面白い動きをして楽しそうでした。民族楽器や日用品なども展示されていました。

館内見学と影絵鑑賞で訪れました。
館内の見学はあまり人気が無いのか、フランス人のカップルと一緒になったくらいでしたが、インドネシア中の色々な剣等、展示物も多くかなり見ごたえがありました。
館内の装飾も凝っていて、素晴らしかったです。
影絵は、日替わりで物語の幕が違うようです。
言葉が理解できなくても、物語の大意が書かれたパンフレットを読めば大概理解できますが、やはり2時間はちょっと飽きてきます。
ブラッと来て、良いころ合いで出ていくという感じで観れば良いと思うので、とてもめずらしいものですし、料金も手ごろなので、せっかくジョグジャに行ったら是非鑑賞してください。
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Local guides are knowledgeable and so helpful. If I go back, I woudl start there. The place is compact but spaceous, strategically situated too.

Ich habe heute das Schattenpuppentheater im Museum besucht. Insgesamt ist es ein sehr netter Ort mit freundlichem Personal. Tickets sind mit 20000rp wirklich angemessen und das ganze Team gibt sich grosse Muehe.
Leider sind die Schattenspiele fuer Neulinge nicht leicht verstanedlich und uber zwei Stunden eher ermuedend. Wer in die Materie der hinduistischen Mythologie interessiert ist, wird jedoch auf seine Kosten kommen.
Ticket 5k / pax。Opens Tue-Thur from 8am-1:30pm, Friday from 8am-11:15am, Sat & Sun from 8am-12:00pm。If you have not enough time, just skip here, nothing much to see.

Was very excited to see the show live as I never watched it before. When taking rickshaw from our hotel, the cyclist recommended us to watch a live traditional dance performance instead of the Wayang Kulit. As its the nearest to our hotel and its nighttime (& cheapest, RP20,000 entrance fee only), we chose the latter. Kinda regret it after 30mins because we don’t understand a thing! It’s in Indonesian & there’s no translator. So frustrating! We could only refer to the template to know which show we are watching.

I’m impressed with the puppeteer as he’s the only 1 moving the puppets and make all the characters voices. The most interesting part of the whole thing will be the scene 2 characters fighting. We didn’t finish the show as we start to fall asleep.

If you want to watch Wayang Kulit just once in your lifetime, go for it. If not, please spend your time somewhere else.

影絵を見るために訪問。これまで見た影絵はスクリーンの裏側など見れなかったが、ここは、影絵の舞台を囲むように席が配置されており、上映中も自由に移動しながら前後左右から様子を見ることができる。上映時間は20時～22時と長く、正直途中で飽きてしまい、申し訳ないと思いつつ1時間程度で退散したが、他の観光客も同じように中座していた。ストーリーは理解できず、また入場料20,000Rp.＋カメラ持込み料3,000Rp.と手ごろなので、2時間の間で都合のよい時間帯に行けばよいと思う。

Went there to see leather puppet show, though the ambience and performance was good its difficult for foreigners to understand the story, They should do some alternative to attract people. Also we were sitting in wrong side of the show and no one cared to guide us to move to the right place.

There are seats all around the stage so you can move between watching the shadows of the puppets in performance and watching the musicians, singers and the puppetmaster behind the scenes. This second option also allows you to see the puppets in all their colourful glory and watch the gamelan instruments. Brush up on your Ramayana if you really want to be able to follow the story - although the ushers will also answer your questions and explain parts of the tale. They and the performers seemed to really care about the tradition and keen to share it. Tickets cost us about £1.20 at the door so definitely a bargain, too.

dengan tiket hanya 3000 pengunjung sudah bisa melihat mahakarya bangsa Indonesia. selain koleksi artefak,pengunjung juga bisa melihat koleksi manuskrip kuno langka. lokasinya yang tidak jauh dari malioboro menjadikan museum ini menjadi objek wajib bagi siapa saja yang sedang berkunjung ke Yogyakarta

ワヤンクリ（影絵）を見るために夜行きました。講堂のような場所で上演されており、スクリーンの前後どちらからでも見れるようになっていました。影絵師の人形さばきも抜群ですし、スクリーンに映し出される影の繊細さもとても素晴らしかったです。そして何より生ガムランが個人的にはたまりませんでした。
入場料も20000ルピアだったので、手軽にワヤンクリを見学できます。
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: If you never see Jawa puppet , you can visit this place, with complete music/ gamelan , and you can see from 2 side, you have to understand the story if you don't want to fall sleep.

Go knowing what to expect- and leave early because it is boring. 

Its great to see this for 30 minutes but as there is no English translation you can be looking at a screen with stationery puppets for a few minutes while the narration is given in Indonesian.  This soon gets boring as you cannot follow the story. 

However it is fun to see the show from both sides and worth the cheap 20,000 entrance fee.

This could be really successful if the musicians came out with a smile and there was an English translation. 

On exit we were encouraged to see the processing room. Again this could be great if someone could be bothered to tell me about the process.  Instead 3 men stared at me and I left feeling a bit uncomfortable!

have wanted to see one of these performances for a long time and go to do it here.  Only a few in the audience but that did not distract - the orchestra was marvellous and the on "screen" action was great - spent some time after with the manager learning about what they are doing there and seeing how they made the figures - you can buy some there as well - this is well worth a visit and stay for a whole show.

I went to see the shadow puppets here and was really excited, but an hour of watching shadow puppets kick each other was enough.  80% of the audience that night got up and walked out before me.  Needless to say, I didn't see the end.

This is a medium sized museum with a good number of artefacts. The 5,000 Rp entrance fee is very reasonable and seems to include a free guide (at no point did ours try to sell us anything or hang around at the end expecting a tip). A fair number of status and carvings are displayed outside the museum and you have the opportunity to play traditional instruments in the foyer. The internal curation is pretty standard with only a small portion of the labels translated into English. However our guide was able to explain most of the exhibits in good English and was extremely enthusiastic about the collection. It took us approximately 1.5 hours to tour the museum which were 1.5 hours well spent.

Very well organized, nice presentation, with information in English and good lighting.
Admission for foreigners is Rs. 50,000
Really beautiful way of presenting history, with nice models and scenery. Interactive and good for children to understand

Belle architecture mais musée complètement dépassé et beaucoup de manquements historiques… seuls certains passage de l’histoire sont traités. Seul l’architecture mérite le détour mais certainement pas un must do !

We had a very pleasant visit here. We asked for a guide at the information centre and got one. It was very nice to get a tour here. A must visit for every dutch tourist as it also explains our (to be not proud of) history at Indonesia.

You can see everything in about an hour.
Het fort bestaatvuit 5 gebouwen met vooral diorama's met uitleg. Smaakvol opgesteld en duidelijk uitgelegd. Zeker na het Monas Medeka (in Jakarta) is dit zeer interessant

This museum gives the history of Indonesia focusing on who was in power. The story is told through dioramas which are very detailed. There are descriptions in English so I could understand what each diaroma is about. 

Really enjoyed my experience here.

Het is aangenaam wandelen in het fort Vredeburg terwijl je de diverse tentoonstellingszalen bezoek waar een stuk van de Indonesische geschiedenis wordt verteld en gebruik wordt gemaakt van actuele mediatechnieken.  
Zeker een bezoek waard.

This was the former Dutch fort, now a museum dedicated to Indonesian independence (which began in the Yogyakarta region).  The buildings aren't much to look at, but inside are galleries showing the steps to nationhood.  I found the exhibits a bit odd: there were life-sized mannequins depicting various scenes, and in other places small scale dioramae.  That said, there were good descriptions in Indonesian and English on the wall to understand the context.  This is a perfect place to go to learn about independence, and the kids probably will like the displays if they don't get freaked-out by the sometimes creepy figures.  Entry fee is 10,000 rupiah.

I don’t know if I missed it but I did not find a lot of information about the fort itself. 
I did enjoy some of the information inside the buildings, very informative. The aircon is nice to have.

It's a must visit place when you're in Malioboro. If you wanna relax and stay away from the crowded Malioboro, this museum is an option. You can take a break and enjoy the air-con in the museum. They have some buildings you can enter. There's a lot to read and see. The buildings remind you of the Dutch Colonialism. I didn't really enjoy because there was an event when I was there. They had like a bazaar or something. There's a lot of people selling things, walking around. It's affordable and very easy to reach from Malioboro.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Fort Vredeburg Jogjakarta, lokasinya di jln Achmad Yani Jogjakarta, lokasinya sanhat strategis & sangat jelas, krn bnyk petunjuk jalan menuju ke lokasi ini ...
Benteng peninggalan masa penjajahan Belanda ini persis di jantung kota D.I.Y Jogjakarta ...
Slalu ramai pengunjung, khususnya para pelajar sekolah menengah, bahkan menengah atas ...
Lahan benteng ini sangat luas & msh terawat dgn sangat baik ...
Dgn membayar tiket masuk kita bebas meng explor lokasi ini semau pengunjung,  & slama pengunjung inginkan ...
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I visited this museum cos just wondering what inside and willing to learn again the history of Indonesia. In fact, the museum was authentic Dutch building I got something new. I visited many museums and this place has its uniqueness. I learned the independence day, the history of UGM and other. Well this museum is good and the entrance ticket is super cheap IDR 5.000,- per pax. You can take picture anywhere you want and its very instagramable.

The museum is located on the same road of the busy Malioboro street, and just next to Pasar Beringharjo. The admission fee is Rp 10,000. Open from 7:30am  to 4pm and close on Monday. There are 4 exhibition halls mainly on the history of independence struggle of Indonesia till the modern day. It is a really a good place to learn the history of the country.

For a very cheap price (like $1.50 USD) you can go through the museum which has really creative and well done dioramas of the history of Indonesia. There are English descriptions on all the different pieces which was really nice.
I think stopping at this museum is a must if you are going through Yogyakarta in order to better understand the history of Indonesia and all the hardships this country went through to get to where it is today.

I have not found to much information of the history of Indonesia beyond knowing it was a Dutch colony, invaded by Japan in WWII and the battle for independence. The museum gives a more detailed written narrative in Indonesian and English about the major events in Indonesian history through a series of simulations using diorama to portray the story.
From a historical perspective it's very interesting although the diorama is a little boring in its presentation. The fort has been kept in good condition and the buildings are interesting.

Je viens d'en sortir, ce musée qui explique l'histoire de l'Indonésie est composé de diorama, c'est vraiment ludique et interessant, toute l'histoire y est reconstituée dans l'ordre chronologique. Le bâtiment en lui même est déjà remarquable.
Paid a fair fee for entrance. Super amaze with the figurines. First museum with so many dolls. Will visit again.

Benteng ini terletak diujung Malioboro..paling enak datang pagi" baru setelah dari benteng kita jalan" di Malioboro..😀
Menyimpan sejarah jogja,benteng ini dibangun thn 1767 jaman Sultan Hamengkubuwono I...benteng yg sejak thn 1987 jadi museum ini sangat terawat dan bersih.
Tiket masuknya hanya Rp 3000...di dalam ada diorama dan banyak peninggalan masa lalu...sangat menarik...
Buat yg suka photo" jg menarik ...di dalam ada toilet yg bersih,kursi di taman...ada kantin jg,jd ga usah takut kehausan.
Datang kesini klu saya suka di pagi hari biar ga panas...mungkin sore jelang sonja jg bagus...
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
For just RP15000 or just over US$1, you can get reprieve from the heat and bustle of Malioboro.

Make sure to follow the Dioramas in sequence, i.e. start with Diorama 1.

One drawback is that not all the displays have explanations in English.

Ook dit was voor mij een 'must see' attractie tijdens mijn verblijf in Yogyakarta. Absoluut de moeite waard vond ik. De diorama's doen wel een beetje ouderwets aan maar geven wel een goede indruk van hoe het geweest is. Er lopen seniore gidsen van het type 'stoere (ex) militair' rond die Nederlands spreken om de vele Nederlanders die er komen rond te leiden. Sprak er met 1, hij was ontzettend aardig en we hebben even staan praten. 
Jazeker, dit museum hoort er echt bij als je wat historisch besef en hierin interesse hebt ;-)

Small very well maintained museum with very good displays about Indonesian history.
Nice break from the busy main street outside.

From the Molioboro Shopping Tour , we detour into Vredeburg. It was formerly a colonial  fortress but has become the Independence Struggle Monument called Fort Vredeburg Museum.

In front of Fort Vredeburg Museum,  there are some of statues of the past heroes. 
4 Dioramas with  display of many antiques from the Dutch era, past pictures and paintings on the Indonesian struggle to defend their country , historical objects including Indonesia’s proclamation era until the New Order . All display are very detailed in Indonesian and English language.

The Museum area is quite complete set up with public toilets, mosque and chairs for resting. Visitors could surf the cyberspace as free wireless internet connection is available around the Museum area. Interior inside the building is modern and well design. 

There are also interactive games booth, a library for those who wish to read to learn about Indonesia’ history. Tricyle and bicycle for rent around the premises.  For those who like to take a break , there is a café inside the Museum waiting to serve you !!!!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Perjalan dari bali ke jogja terbayarkan,pengalaman yang tidak akan terlupakan.liburan 2 hari sangat kurang,tahun depan ingin sekali kembali ke sni🥰
recommended for visit. to learn about the history. the fees is cheapest.. open until 16:00. have short movie to watch to know about the history of the vredeburg and yogyakarta..
我在博物館廣場上發現了日本兵，荷蘭兵，印尼兵的雕像，我覺得著很有趣因為沒有在其他地方看見豎立殖民者的雕像。整體而言，堡壘是殖民地風格，非常精緻
オランダ占領時から残る要塞は、日本占領時代には日本軍の本部としても使われたとのことですが、現在はインドネシア独立戦争を記念する博物館となっています。写真や動画も展示されていますが、ジオラマがわかりやすくていいですね。王宮「クラトン」のすぐ北にあります。

This is our second visit to this place.  Almost half of it on the left is under maintenance and we cannot enter.

Be sure to watch the movie on DIORAMA on the left hand side upon entering this place.  Otherwise it will confusing for you to see the illustrated scene inside each rooms of this place.

It is a nice place, unfortunately we were not come on the right time.

A good place to observe more of the Indonesian history during the colonisation period. The fort many hidden corner that u can venture into & the diorama are especially helpful.
Be prepared to walk & wear ur most comfy walking shoes. The weather can get really hot in the late afternoon so packed a bottle of water if u need. Otherwise, enjoy the educational walk in the fort. Ticket are 3k/pax
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Once again a museum that misses the mark, because of a lack of understanding about good exhibit curation and presentation. A former Dutch colonial fort, which has been restored and the buildings at least are in good order.  However, do not visit expecting to see any information about the actual history of the fort itself, it's construction or how the Dutch military conducted operations here and the relationship of the fort to the colonial civil area that once surrounded it.  Instead there are a series of dusty dioramas with only minimal translation into poor English of the early stages of the National independence movement. Nothing wrong with that, as subject matter,  but could have been so much better presented, and there needs to be some exhibits about the fort itself and the impact of 200 years of Dutch colonisation on the archipelago and Java in particular. One of the large barracks has been converted into a huge and comfy, traditionally furnished cafe, the massive walls make it a cool environment for a rest break out of the sun. Served good coffee.

I can only recommend this to visitor who are really interested in a history lesson. Other than that you might spend tops 10minutes running thru the whole area. I spent 2 hours, cause I read all diorama and information boards. That's why it took me that long.

Not everything is translated into English.

Very well maintained fort (at least something good they learned from the Dutch) with a nice overview of Indonesian history and the role the Dutch played in that. Not to be proud of !
Indeed presentation a bit outdated but worthwhile visiting.

The museum is very interesting. It includes collections of old photographs, historical objects, replicas and also display diorama that portraying Indonesia's journey for independence. I love this building and architecture.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: I visited Fort Vredeburg today and was a little underwhelmed. There is almost no information about the fortress itself, it's basically all about the Indonesian struggle for independence. Also very interesting, but not at all what I'd expected nor why I visited the place. The architecture is very nice to see and the entrance fee is low (10000 IRD for foreigners). There is also a cafe and toilet.

This is part of the history of Yogyakarta. It is actually an old Dutch fort turned into a museum. For a small entrance fee, we got to tour around the small compound and looked at the exhibits housed in a few air-conditioned buildings. While we were there, it was quite packed with crowds of noisy schoolchildren.

Vredeburg , are the name of fort at city of jogja, 
clean place and nice spot to taking picture of this
the educational was great enough,
it was so great place
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Inside this fort is a museum consisting of 3 or 4 rooms (kind of long rectangular-shaped ones) with displays of the country's Independence movement including many of these great "dioramas" (with miniature but "life-like" figures), some of which depicting guerilla battle scenes & such; and what's kind of unique about this museum is that it tells the history "in relation to" the city of Jogja (meaning many of the displays are those of the events that took place in the city).  Then on the grounds of the Fort are some wax figures of soldiers (looking like "real") & statues of their two top generals of the past (about one of whom there are also some enlarged photos in the museum such as those of his arrival in the city).  Also can be done (like on your way out) is to go up the front entrance gate and look out over the water which is like a moat between the fort & the area like a square that you'll have to get through from the street to get to the Fort.

If taking the transjogja bus (2A, 2B & 3A are the numbers that I know of), the bus stop is very conveniently right in front of the Fort which is on the south end of the "shopping street" Jl. Malioboro (a stretch of about 2 km that is just "ideal" for souvenir shopping or just for hanging out).  And nearby, as time permits after this fort & the shopping street or on another day by taking the bus to the same bus stop, there's Kraton or the Sultan's Palace with "a number of small museums" inside where you can learn quite a bit about the sultans of the past (in a walkable distance to the south from the bus stop, but I would suggest taking a rickshaw or a horse-drawn buggy since the area around the palace is just like a "maze" of narrow streets); then about a 10-minute walk further south after leaving Kraton is Tamansari Water Castle with a big "bathing pool" (and a bit further from the exit side of the castle is an ancient mosque which is both underground & above ground).
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Salah satu bangunan bersejarah di Yogyakarta, berada di daerah jalan malioboro. Benteng vredeburg ini wajib dikunjungi karena dirawat dgn baik dan di dalamnya ada 4 diorama yang berisikan miniatur2 dari jaman penjajahan di indonesia dan gerakan2 pemuda di Yogyakarta

Just at the end of Malioboro St is this Museum that uses many diorama to show you the history of Indonesia. A fascinating and inexpensive museum. Easy to navigate for all. 

Recommended for history buffs.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Situated near the Point 0 Spot of Yogyakarta, near the palace and just one the corner of the ever busy and crowded Malioboro Street, this Museum gave us a relieve from the busy crowded place and a place to rest ourselves after a long walk. The ticket were quite cheap, the atmosphere were very nice (especially during the afternoon). And yes, the complex also had some small inn, a little canteen & an interesting cafe inside the complex

A little advice : 
If you want to have an interesting experience on the complex, make sure you came to this place by the end of February and beginning of March, around February 27th to March 5th because they have "The Annual Serangan Oemoem 1 Maret Commemoration Event" on which they had some Historical Reenactment Battle event taken from Indonesia War of Independence History Chapter.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Di museum ini kita bisa lihat sejarah kenapa kraton jogja dikelilingi benteng, ada bioskop mini yang memutarkan tentang hal tersebut. Selebihnya tidak banyak yang bisa di explore dari tempat ini

I didn't find this place enormously interesting, but if you need a break after crowded streets, then it can do. There isn't much to see at the museum, there is a bunch of rooms with very detailed dioramas, but after you look at about dozen of them, you kind of lose interest, unless you are well familiar with that particular piece of history, or have a special interest. As a tourist, I just wandered around a bit, and then went on with sightseeing. I wouldn't say the museum is a must-see, but if you are in the neighbourhood, give it a try, the entrance fee is very small, and the atmosphere inside is quite friendly. There is a little courtyard/park inside the buildings, which is perfect for a little break.

Usually I do not like a Indonesian museum because some of them look dirty, dark, and abandoned. 

But this one is surprisingly nice, well organized, clean, educative, nice view, and close to malioboro, cheap ticket, and helpful staff.

This place tells us a lot about what happen in Yogyakarta during wars with Dutch and Japanese. 
The most interesting spots are diorama buildings. There are a lot of dioramas and memorabilias from the past during war.
The vredeburg itself was a fortress back then. 
This is a good place to learn Indonesian history. We don't really need a tour guide to visit this place since all events are clearly explained in dioramas.

A bit old fashioned, but very informative.
After the presentation there was a nice café (indian kopii) and as a highlight - provinces presented in traditional costumes...
Het fort is in een goede staat. Het heeft een mooi beeld van een fort vanuit de koloniale tijd. Het wordt nu gebruikt voor metname de de geschiedenis na de dekolonialisatie.

If you're interest in history and want to learn a bit about yogyas history and the revolution. Then this is a  must do on your list.

The museum is situated at the end of the malioboro street in the old barracks and headquarters of the Dutch colonialists.

The museum had nice little displays with English texts and little miniature dolls of certain historical scenes.

There's also a nice coffee place in the compound.

Fort Vredeburg can be considered above the average compared to other Yogya museums. Considering that the entrance fee is rather cheap, the place is well-maintained and clean.
