Their dioramas depict the historical war/s in Yogyakarta. They have touch screen games, life-sized statues that look like they came out of 80's comic books.

I didn't know that there is an audio guide for this one. Please make sure to ask their staff if they have one.

Niet zo’n groot museum, maar je krijgt wel een goede indruk van de geschiedenis. Ik had nog een klein uurtje voor sluitingstijd, maar had voldoende de tijd om het te bezichtigen. Je wordt niet richting uitgang gedreven als het museum dicht gaat, want je mag je bezoek rustig afmaken. Wellicht dat je met een gids meer te horen krijgt, maar met de handleiding die je erbij krijgt, is het goed te doen.

Still under maintenance.. surprisingly this site is on the great shape !.. above average of most Indonesian museum's. Building are well maintain, all looks clean.. and the best part its equipped with a coffee shop.. "Indische Coffe".. an excellent colonial dutch atmosphere.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: this spot is the heritage of Yogyakarta Palace. The unique museum with the a lot of collection about the struggling of Indonesia people especially Yogyakarta to beat Netherland Collonial .
Kinderlijke geschiedenisles met oubollige presentatie. Voor nederlanders wel te bezoeken maar niet voor langer dan een half uurtje ;)

Historic photos n well explained n clear video.Mainly the " fight " for indepedence from the Dutch n against the Japanese.Appointment of the 1st president Sukarno n pm Hatta. And their war hero Gen.Sudirman.There are 3 exibition rooms .Large area where on weekends they have a mini bazzar selling gift items n in August( independent month) they have a " cultural show" .A cafe is available n rest room too.Entrance fee is minimal idr5k n in August........its  free. A must visit.

We hadden op tv een programma gezien waar nl dit bezochten. Vol verwachtingen gingen we hier na toe. Entree was gratis omdat het deze maand feest is vanwege onafhankelijkheid17-8. Anders betaal
Je 10k rupiah. Het was jammer dat er geen nl gids aanwezig was. Je ziet hier mooi de historie. 
Ergens schaam je, je dan een beetje dat he nl bent. Hoe nl hier toen om gegaan zijn met deze mensen. 

Later kwamen we er achter dat er wel een gids aanwezig was. Als je binnen komt direct links staat een loket informatie. Schijnt dat je daar een gids kan krijgen,
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: In het museum is goed te zien wat de Nederlanders in de periode van kolonisatie hebben uitgevoerd. In positieve en negatieve zin.
i get many knowledge from this place, i love classi olace make me know past of history, and i hope i can watch over inheritance
gaat wel. Weinig interessant. Nu nog wel onderhouden gebouwen, maar moet wel snel wat geld bij. Vriendelijke mensen
Very interesting pieces , good collection of different topics, with careful presentation, good lighting, information in English and correct price

This is a private museum that contains relics and artifacts from royal families of Java.  The tours are guided, and English-speaking visitors must wait for an English-speaking guide to be available.  My guide was difficult to understand and uninspired.  Also, no pictures can be taken inside the museum.  The grounds to the museum were very lovely ..... impressive, actually.  I was a bit disappointed in this museum, mainly due to a need for a guide, and the inability to take pictures.

The museum contains valuable paintings of the Sultan's family, and exhibits such as batik depicting Javanese culture. The grounds are beautiful but photography is not allowed until in a special area at the conclusion of the tour, which is just outside a restaurant. The guide was excellent, but she spoke very fast. Visitors must use a guide, either English or Indonesian speaking, and the prices for either differ quite a bit. I think we chose one who spoke Indonesian, but either way, it would turn out good as, based on what we saw, the items on exhibit were esthetically interesting and educational.
There's plenty of parking.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: I'm very impressed with the museum's collection and our English speaking guide was really helpful!  I learnt many things about the history of Jogja and Java. I especially loved the room with all the letters. Reading them was very heartwarming. I highly recommend.

This museum was on our list when we were in Yogyakarta. It was a guided tour that you could take in English as well. It was nice to hear about the history of Yogyakarta/Solo and their royal families. The tour lasted about 50 minutes but it was very informative and interesting. Would recommend if you’re in the area :) Also a pretty place to take photos after. Do note that no photos are allowed during the tour.

The museum is good, the guide is friendly, fun, tanks to you mba Roro.....
The place is clean❤️💙🌈
Worth it, really

Es un museo bien organizado, con temas claramente definidos por sala. Una colección privada y por tanto reúne un gusto específico por cierta parte de la historia y el arte/cultura de Indonesia.  Si estás por la zona podría ser una opción, pero no considero que valga la pena hacer el viaje exclusivamente por visitarlo de más de 1 hora desde el centro de la ciudad. La guía en inglés muy amable - tienen horarios de inicio de los tours guiados. No se puede tomar ninguna foto en el museo.

I've lived in Jogja for a number years and I've earmarked this place but has not gotten around to visit. Pleasantly surprised that this place is just 30 mins away from the city. The museum is well maintained, organized and clean. The English guide was charming and she answered our dozens of questions with enthusiasm. Not to forget that in this forest-like place is a cozy and elegant restaurant that served good food. It's that kind of place you can visit during weekends to unwind and disconnect in the middle of a forest.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Because we speak English, not local language, we are given Tour Option 1 only as Tour Option 2 is in local language only. Tour 1 discusses the Rulers in the 20th Century to the present only. The clothes they wore & a little bit about their lives. Tour 2 covers the history of Indonsia from the pre-islam period thru present time stressing the kingdoms & the colonial periods. Even a brief discussion on Princess Diana's visits. Tour 1 is terrible. Don't do it. Tour 2 is excellent but their is a language problem. The Museum & grounds are gorgeous. What a shame they changed their pre-pandemic policy on tours. The guide Etu was very rude & should be kinder to foreigners. A demotion is appropriate in my opinion.
Nice place. Nice collection. Knowledgeable tour guide. Well preserved facility. Too bad the restaurant already out most of their stocks

It was very great experience to visit this museum. Very nice place to know more about history of Yogyakarta and Surakarta. The local guide was so kind and informative. The best time to visit probably will be in the morning and the afternoon before 2 pm

We visited Ullen Sentalu museum last Dec 31st, which proven to be very interesting and enjoyable.  This is a privately run museum but under coordination with government ministry.  The best way to enjoy this museum is to join both tours provided, at very reasonable fees, to understand the history about Java and its people, and Yogyakarta & Surakarta Sultanate. One tour is conducted in Bahasa Indonesia and the other one is in English. Photos taking only allowed at certain locations and not allowed during the tours themselves. I strongly recommend visiting this museum when you’re in Yogyakarta or Magelang area.

Museum with collection of  instruments, paintings, letters, photos, sculptures and also the history of batik  from the royal families of Yogyakarta and also Solo. It's located in a beautiful building. My friends bought four entrance tickets but when we entered the building and the staff saw us as foreigner, we had to get back to the ticket booth to change the ticket for "Foreigner Ticket" that cost double than the local price. Yep, tourist!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Great museum, great price-to-value. Well managed, neat, well trained staffs. 

In short this museum tells about Javanese kingdom stories. Not so many antiques, expect batiks pictures and photos. It’s more about story and history.

What I do like the most is the architecture, the building, the surroundings. 
Have some great food and snacks after.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: This museum located in Kaliurang and quite far from downtown Yogyakarta. However, it has exquisite exterior and interior building with natural design. It has lots of private collection from collectors that remark the Mataram and Ngayogyakarta Sultan. This museum is private owned, there for quite pricey for the entrance fees, but it's worth it. They also provide tour guide included with entrance fees.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
2x sudah ketempat ini. Selalu menarik untuk dikunjungi, suasana yg sangat tenang, indah, sekaligus mistis hehe.. 

Senang mendengarkan guide yg menjelaskan dengan detail foto2 yg terpajang Dan keseluruhan sjarah2nya.

The museum contains valuable paintings of the Sultan's family, and exhibits such as batik depicting Javanese culture. The grounds are beautiful but photography is not allowed until in a special area at the conclusion of the tour, which is just outside a restaurant. The guide was excellent, but she spoke very fast. All visit must use a guide, either English or Indonesian speaking, and the prices for either differ a lot.
There's plenty of parking.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Visited here after Burobudor. Had been mentioned to me by woman at coffee shop, and another museum as well as my driver.
The tour of this museum is by guided tour, entry fee is 100k for foreigner. (not sure for locals) 
I typically avoid guided tours like the plague.
It's a good thing I didn't know that before going and until after buying ticket, or I would have missed out on a very insightful tour.
One can only take photos in a couple of places, which is more understandable once one begins the tour.
Tour introduces one to a more intimate history of the royal families.
There is also a restaurant and coffee shop at the location.
Couple small local vendors at parking area.
Some work was being done at the site, perhaps for more exhibits?
Beautiful museum, loving the paintings and the stories but everything went to fast, i wish i could enjoy them bit longer.
Great experience to learn about Jawa culture and batik. Extraordinary collection and love the architecture. Definitely worth to visit!
pertama kunjungan kesini, cocok untuk sama anak2 mengenalkan kepada keluarga pembelajaran, datang pada sabtu minggu lumayan rame
Excellent to experience more historical sites about Yogyakarta palace and how woman should live and act as a image standard

Thought the place was overrated. An large area was condoned off and some part under renovations. Only has a small collection of artifacts were all related to a particular princess. Free Touring of the place was not allowed.Not worthy of the time and the ticket place
Kawasannya rimbun dan sari, tempatnya bersih, pemandunya ramah dan penjelasannya mudah dimengerti, barang koleksinya juga tertata dengan baik

Such an interesting feeling about Jogja is that whenever you visit Jogja and wherever place you visit there, it carries traditional touches. And Ullen Sentalu carries lots of 'em! The museum displays cultural heritage granted by the Jogja Royal family to its owner. The ticket price is IDR 50.000 (local) and it includes the museum guide and free Jamu (Javanese herbal drink).
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Waktu sy ke jogja saya gk tau ada tempat ini, karena tdk ada dilist teratas google wisata ke jogja, sy tau tmpt ini dr teman, tempatnya keren bgt dr pintu masuk ampe pintu keluar juaraaaa, Dingin ,bersih rapi,pelayanan tertata rapi, masuk 50 rb include tour guide dan jamu ratu mas yg konon bkn awet muda 😁, masuk museum gk boleh foto2, hanya boleh foto di area masuk dan area luar
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Ullen Sentalu Museum? Seven years have lived in the city of Yogyakarta, apparently there are still many tourist attractions that were not known before, including this museum. I just found out from Jakarta with a friend to reminisce. The museum is located in an area that I used to go through but no one told me. I have come, wait for me again at the Monumen Yogya Kembali.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
The private museum is very unusual in its construction and offers many interesting location within it.
The exhibitions although interesting become very boring. The guide has little in the way of customer relations skills and told us all the things we cannot do, as opposed to welcoming us. The exhibitions are mostly pictures and photographs indisposed with the occasional original stone carvings and come concrete copies.
There is an interesting shop and cafe on sight which you stumble across and is not promoted at all, not surprisingly, when we went in we were the only customers.
There is a wealth of history here, they just don't know how to tell and display it in the best way.

This Museum is one of a must visit Museum if you visit Yogyakarta and you're interested to know about history and tradition of Java (especially Yogyakarta and Surakarta area). There will be a guide that will accompany you (and your group) to have a tour around this Museum. Note : YOU'RE NOT ALLOWED TO DOCUMENT ANY PICTURE/VIDEO in this place (except in the areas like waiting area and outdoor area). And to enter this Museum, you must pay IDR 50.000. This Museum closes every Monday, so make sure you go the other day. And it's located pretty far from the town, so you'd better prepare your trip ahead. I suggest you to try the Beukenhof Restaurant in the Museum Area. The food was great (but a bit pricey). There is also a souvenir shop.

Museum milik swasta ini menampilkan budaya dan kehidupan para bangsawan Dinasti Mataram dalam bentuk lukisan tokoh raja-raja dan permaisuri, koleksi kain batik, pakaian yang digunakan, dan sebagainya.
Tour guide yang interaktif akan menemani kita untuk menelusuri setiap ruangan di dalam museum selama +/- 1 jam. Fasilitas ini sudah termasuk harga tiket masuk Rp40.000,- (dewasa). Selama tour, dilarang mengambil gambar dalam bentuk dan jenis kamera apapun terutama di sepanjang galeri yang menampilkan koleksi museum.
Area yang diperbolehkan untuk spot foto antara lain di sekitar entrance museum, replika Candi Borobudur, dan restaurant Beukenhof.
Konsep museum yang unik, kondisi museum beserta koleksinya yang terawat dengan baik, ambience Jawa - kolonial yang dihadirkan lewat arsitek dan interior bangunan, serta cara penyampaian yang interaktif akan membuat pengunjung seperti terbawa ke masa Jawa kuno yang sarat dengan budaya dan nilai kehidupan.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I think this is the best place to go and learn about javanese culture. You can spot the difference meaning of javanese cloth and their tradition

totally forgot about the admission, but we all enjoyed learning about the history from a very well trained guide. a must visit place when you're in Yogyakarta. don't forget to visit Kopi Klotok afterwards.

Museum perorangan yang keren banget, tiket masuk 40rb, sesuai dengan apa yang dilihat di dalam terutama bagi pecinta sejarah. Ada ruang khusus alat musik gamelan dan teman temannya. Ada ruang untuk kain kain batik dan baju baju jaman dulu. Ada juga ruang puisi jaman dulu juga. Dapat free minum semacam wedang gitu yang konon katanya bisa bikin awet muda

This museum is difficult to get to on the far north side of Yogya. It is private and in a beautiful setting. You go by tour and the cost is 100k pp.  The museum mostly is pictures of the royal families of Yogya and Solo. No pictures were allowed. It certainly wasn’t worth the trip and admission cost.

Museum like ullen sentalu need to be duplicated by the Indonesian people. For me, Museum in Indonesia which identical with boring concept makes me wondering about ullen sentalu before we went to this place. After entering the complex, I got impressed by the concept of strolling into museum. We were assisted by the guide which spoke in bilingual, if there are foreigners, but since we are in a group of Indonesia so she spoke in Bahasa.

The guide gave us the story of Yogya, from the earlier century until current year. We could see the pictures, letters, costumes and others historical ornaments.

Overall, if ur are foreigners, you should visit this museum. But if ur local, you should also entering this museum. For me, its awesome, o ya, my kids also enjoyed a lot strolling into the museum and listening the guide's explanation.

Ps. if you want to heard more on the history, you may choose joined the group with the elderly since they have more info or question and it will gave u more info.

Cheers,
Indah
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Museum ini sebenarnya sangat menarik dan artistik. Sayangnya hampir semua tempat tidak boleh difoto. Juga tidak ada tempat untuk sekedar melepas lelah atau kantin.

Museum pribadi yg berisi barang2 koleksi pribadi salah satu warga jogja... bisa menikmati sejarah jogja dari barang2 koleksi pribadi... lokasi di lereng gunung merapi, sejuk dan nyaman.... tiket masuk sekitar 30k sdh termasuk pemandu yg akan menginformasikan seluruh isi museum... free jamu

Tiket masuk 40rb, no foto di dalam museum, hanya boleh di luar. Museum keren milik perorangan. Bagi yang suka wisata museum recommended sekali. Di dalamnya banyak foto, kain, baju, alat musik sampai puisi jaman dulu

We visited the museum based on good TripAdvisor`s reviews. Definitely our biggest disappointment in Yogyakarta, as it is far away in the city and noting significant inside.
Photo is forbidden in the exhibition part, and after the visit, we understood why-nothing significant inside, and if this fact would be known to the interested public nobody would come.
Most of the artefacts in the museum are mostly not genuine-photos, letters, all of them are reproductions or printed scans from Surakarta Kraton (royal) family. Also, there are portraits of Javanese royals, however very poorly done and even not signed. It looks like the museum did not want to pay regular painters and commissioned the paintings from some amateurs or unskilled painters who were even ashamed to sign their paintings.
There is a collection of batiks, and this does not look bad, for ones who are interested in batik.
The museum is located near an old villa.

Wisata sambil belajar? Ya, itu dapat dilakukan di museum Ullen Sentalu Yogyakarta. Tempatnya sangat asyik dan langsung disediakan pemandu yang menceritakan sejarah yang ada. Di dalam museum tidak diperbolehkan berfoto. Namun jangan khawatir, bagi para penggemar instagram disediakan area khusus untuk foto. Bila anda ke Yogyakarta dan ke arah Kaliurang, maka jangan lewatkan museum Ullen Sentalu ini.

Different with other museums which have huge building, Ullen sentalu is a small, traditional museum with traditional indonesian building.

Tourguide is excellent with clear and loud voice. The place is clean and has interesting collections. Recommended to visit
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Biaya masuk ke museum ini 40k termasuk guide dan dapat jamu awet muda didalam museum tidak boleh memotret dan merekam video, hanya spot tertentu saja yang boleh digunakan untuk foto

This museum really really blow my mind. I thought it’s just another history but it turns out more than a history! We were not allowed to take pictures, videos or record what the guide said because all of the items in this museum are prohibited and personal. And it is really really worth it! This is a must place you have to visit while in Yogyakarta.

Sebenarnya tempat ini biasa saja menurut saya. Mungkin karena lokasinya di kaliurang yang sejuk dan bagus maka tempat ini memiliki nilai plus. Untuk interiornya bagus dan isinya pun memang untuk wisata belajar dan mengenang sejarah , sehingga wisatawan tidak dapat mengambil foto sembarangan bahkan untuk masukpun harus dibatasi jumlahnya serta harus didampingi tour guide. Setelah masuk kedalam dan berkeliling kita akan disuguhi minuman sejenis jamu khas Ullen Sentalu.

I visit with my mom last year after a friend recommend this place

it was far away from main city but worth to visit. As a private museum this place has great collection and great service and not for mass tourist

I do enjoy this place and gave me lesson that if you are part of the kingdom, you could not avoid those BLESS to be rich, well education facility and all good things in the world

only one comment, the guide explain fast and move fast as well, I want to enjoy every picture, every part cause the museum collection are something that you could not find outside. 

The rest was great

Not just a museum but Ullen Sentalu is an extraordinary place both in terms of buildings, style, architectural decoration and the aura inside ... the cleanest and most well-maintained museum I've ever visited is just a little disappointed because some spots are not allowed to take photos or even videos some rooms with cool collections are a pity to miss but cannot be immortalized. Friendly welcome with a local guide only at Ullen Sentalu Museum I was able to really read a love letter from a princess as well as a rejection story from a great figure but a neatly arranged collection of very beautiful places more like a stately house rather than a museum. see paintings that are very alive and look real until sometimes they feel a magical aura but still curious. being treated with herbs really made me more fascinated and the more I fell in love with this museum because of it I will return again to visit the museum Ullen Sentalu which is very charismatic and interesting atmosphere. Thank you for my best Tour guide Ivy coz you show me amazing place
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Saya tidak menyangka kunjungan saya ke museum Ullen Sentalu jadi titik penting kecintaan saya akan museum. Museum ini keren sekali, sangat indah, dan dikelola dengan sangat baik. Tidak diijinkan untuk mengambil foto malah jadi hal bagus karena kita bisa menyerap apa yang dilihat dan didengar selama berada di museum

Spot wajib dan harus dikunjungi saat ke Jogja. Tidak diijinkannmengambil foto / video selama tour musium. Justru ini yang menjadi kelebihan musium ini. Pengunjung jadi berkonsentrasi mempelajari sejarah jogja.

地元の大学生もオススメの場所。
郊外にあり、何度もリノベーションされているらしく、来る度に変わっているそう。
博物館は、5つの建物に分かれており、ガイドさん同伴のもと、それぞれの建物を順に回っていきます。
インドネシア語のガイドだけでなく、英語もあるので、ガイドを頼むとより楽しいと思います。日本語ガイドがあるかどうかは分かりません……。

ただ、インドネシア人学生がいうには、
「インドネシア語のガイドは難しすぎて理解し辛いけれど、英語だとシンプルに説明されていて、わかりやすかった。」
とのこと。

また、建物のうちのひとつ、たくさん手紙が保管されているところでは、インドネシア語、英語に並び、何故か日本語訳がありました。こんなところで母国語を見かけるとは予想もしていなかったので、嬉しかったです。
インドネシアは、日本語学習者がとても多いそうで（世界で2番目?だとか）、その影響もあるのかもしれません。
受付で日本人だと伝えると、歓迎されました。笑

また、ガイド終了後にジンジャーティーのような伝統的な飲み物というのが振る舞われました。

注意しておかなければならないのは、写真を撮っても良い場所が限定されているということです。
基本的に、写真撮影は禁止。
ここで撮っていいよ、と言ってくれれば許されるみたいです。
外にある大きなモニュメントの側で、たくさん写真を撮りました。
併設されているショップでも、撮影は禁止みたいなので、気をつけてください。

王国について、王、女王や王女の人生についてなど、写真や実際の手紙のやり取りを通じて、歴史的な事実を知ることができて、とても面白いですよ。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This private museum offers an "aperçu" of History of Royal families of Yogyakarta and Surakarta. In a natural area full of nature. We had a very good guide girl name Aby despite being in training she was able to answer all our questions in detail and with passion. Thank you and good luck !

It's way out of town but a journey out to the foot of Mt Merapi worth it. I felt that this museum added and enhanced more to my knowledge of the royal families in Jogja and Surakarta. I dare say that I learnt more here than I did at the Kraton! Our guide, Abby, was very informative and shared a lot about the history, relationships and significance of the royal families. It gave an insight into the mindsets and attitudes of the royalty and their culture.

There is a cafe in the museum grounds. Lovely art deco style. The food is so-so but great place for chilling out and having a chat.

Museum yang sangat indah, bersih dan benar-benar terjaga. Terletak di atas dekat dengan daerah gunung merapi. Museum ini dilengkapi dengan fasilitas yang sangat lengkap, restoran, tempat souvenir, dan juga terdapat fasilitas tour guide yang akan menerangkan tentang sejarah-sejarah keraton pada jaman dulu.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Penasaran dengan kisah para Raja Jawa Dinasti Mataram dengan para Istrinya? Bagaimana keseharian mereka, apa saja yang pernah mereka tulis? Are they happy? Atau pernikahan mereka merupakan hal yang sudah ditentukan? Banyak cerita disana. Anda akan dipandu oleh seorang Tour guide untuk mengungkap cerita trah kerajaan Jawa Tengah dengan kesehariannya. Tiket masuk kira-kira 50 ribu untuk dewasa. 

Terus terang bagi saya penggila bangunan tua, Ullen Sentalu merupakan favorit. Ada sisi sejarah, romantisme kala itu dan juga banyak arsitektur yang menawan. Soo you have to try. Highly recomended.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Always wanna visit this museum. 
Learned more about the history that maybe not many Indonesian/Javanese knows about it
Strict rules about cant take any pictures even we just did a silly wefie pictures with a toilet background LOL but thats ok tho
The guide were very helpful to explain all the stuff. Good in english too.. good job!!

Museumnya gak disangka ternyata besar. Sayangnya di dalem kita gak boleh foto-foto. Setelah tour keliling Ullen Sentalu, kami diberi minuman gratis seperti jamu. Sepanjang museum kami disuguhkan koleksi keraton (bukan budaya Jawa lebih tepatnya).

A private gallery built by the wealthy family that lives on the same grounds--grounds that are inaccessible--this is interesting only for its depth of narcissism.  Room after room is filled with dull photographs or cheesy paintings, all explained by a mandatory guide.  It takes forever to get there, it's expensive, and the family you'll be looking at supported the Dutch during Indonesia's fight for independence.  The positive reviews are a complete mystery to me.

I had expected a lot based on the TA reviews, in particular imagined that there would a certain amount about Java history and culture too, but it was quite a let down.
The vast majority of the museum is about the local royal families, consisting of portrait paintings, photos, some poems and some possessions. The non royal related items are a gamelan, two showcases of batik (compare Solo to Yogya styles) and eight or so statue fragments from temples.
The building and setting itself is impressive, and our guide was entertaining and very knowledgeable, which earns it one more "star".

Buat yang pengen liburan adem ngga panas di jogja boleh naik ke atas ke daerah kaliurang dan berkunjung ke museum ullen sentalu. Museum yang menceritakan sejarah budaya Jogja - Solo yang apik. Kerennya ini museum milik perseorangan bukan punya pemerintah. Kalo kesini nanti kita akan dipandu sama guide dan ngga boleh selfie atau foto-foto yaah di dalem. Gunanya menjaga privasi museum itu sendiri tapi nanti ada spot fotonya kok.
Ngga bakal cukup kesini sekali, pengen lagi dijamin karna tempatnya yang apik dan adem sekaligus cerita dalam museumnya yang menarik.
One of the best museum I've ever visited. I would highly recommend this to my family and my friends.

We had a great time visiting Ulla Sentalu. It’s a great place to get to know Javanese heritage at the foot of Merapi mountain in a jungle environment. We had a very engaged guide with quite good English. A nice half day tour from Yogyakarta with a beautiful little restaurant.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This museum focuses largely on the royal family of Yoayakarta and associated cultrual activities. It is arranged in a series of rooms in a number of linked buildings built within the forest but very much in sympathy with it. Visits are accompanied by a very well-informed guide. Photographs within the museum are not allowed. Our visit lated over one hour and was full of interest and stimulating information. An excellent experience.
A beautiful historical museum of Batik, neatly arranged. You will be accompanied by a guide who will tell history from every angle. it is worth to visit

I have always wanted to visit  Museum Ulen Sentalu.
And got those chance to visit last year, but I still remember clearly about the simple tour around this museum. 
With tour guide provided by the museum, we can hear all about the history behind every relics, artifact, painting, fabrics, artwork and many more. It was a really memorable and fun experience for me to really soaked into the past of Islamic Mataram Kingdom.  
The place is also very beautiful with trees and stone relief and not to be a mention of the cool temperature because this museum is located in Kaliurang area. 
Also, don’t forget to try their cafe, they serve a good coffee and also good food. 
Amazing museum, must visit and remember to behave.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
amazing museum.. the flow of story from start until end is amazing... recommend must visit this museum.. during visit, no camera audio or video allowed. have pic area.. must visit.. the fees
local 40k
international 100k

This is one of the best museums I've ever visited. This museum Broadly speaking, it presents the history of the Islamic Mataram kingdom. In addition, you will also find so many works of art and diversity of Javanese culture, especially those related to royal life.

Objects in it include, statues in the Hindu-Buddhist era, Yogyakarta and solo batik, genealogy of the Kings of Islam, batik, gamelan, and others.
When you are in Yogyakarta you may include Ullen Sentalu in your itinerary. Our suggestion: one guide for a group of 10-15 people max please, so we can listen well to what the guide explains.
Museum ini unik. Menawarkan tour guide yang menjelaskan budaya jawa terutama Jogja dan Solo. Dilarang berfoto-foto selama di dalam museum.

When you enter this museum you will fell being sucked into the time space. It offers a tour guide that explains very well about history of mataram kingdom, yogyakarta and surakarta royal families. The tours divided in 3 segments, after the second you are brought to a room and gave a glass of javanese traditional drink. If yoy hungry you can eat at restaurant that is located above the museum. There are many trees outside so you can feel fresh air and cool weather of foot of Merapi mountain.
This is my second time visit. Many valuable knowledge can be gathered, Cafe is also great (Beukenhof)

Located on the slopes of Merapi, Ullen Sentalu is a privately owned museum detailing the history of the royal families. It's been an educational trip for me and my kids. The museum painting and royal family's batik collection are amazing!! There're many photos of the Royal Family Members from the past time (Mataram Empire and the dynasties of the Solo and Yogyakarta) plus many memorabilia and letters, pictures and statues of the various key figures in the royal families' history. 

At the beginning, the guide warned no picture is allowed coz it will damage the preserved original batik displayed in the museum.

It's really worth to visit. Doesn't cost expensive too much (IDR 40.000 adults and IDR 20.000 for kids under 12 yrs), but you can learn something there. The 50-mins tour has 5 minutes break interval for herbal drink. End of the tour, we can take pictures in its beautiful gardens and forest.
One of the most interesting historical tour about the biggest kingdom in Indonesia, price is quite cheap, very nice & knowledgeable tour guide. Really really nice place.

Mungkin sudah lebih dari 10 kali saya bolak balik ke Museum ini jika pulang ke Jogja.Dari mulai saat berdiri hingga sekarang, Dari tiket hanya sekitar Rp 10.000 an hingga terakhir Rp 40,000 saya selalu mampir kesini.Bukan karena suka dalam mereka menata lingkungan sekitar saja tetapi juga menikmati koleksi koleksi yang ditambahkan atau diganti.

Pergilah kesini karena cantik, indah dan sangat informatif menjabarkan tentang seluk beluk kerajaan Mataranm yang lalu pecah menjadi 4.Meski pemilik museum ini lebih banyak menceritakan dari sisi trah Pakualaman, tetapi cukup fair juga menceritakan kerajaan lain.Ringan dan mengusik keinginan tahuan kita akan cerita masa lalu.

Sangat menyenangkan untuk bisa datang dan mempelajari hal2 di dalam museum ini. Sudah 2x mengunjungi tetapi tidak bosan. Tour guide juga menguasai bahan. Informasi yang berguna karena menjadi tahu tentang tradisi dan asal usul kerajaan di jawa ini.

The Ullen Sentalu Museum is a tour which highlights the royal family history. You should know that it is not a museum which allows for you to just pop in for a quick look around. After paying, you wait until the next tour group is led through the complex. Our tour guide spoke good English, and somehow had memorized the impossibly long names of various members of the royal family through the years. 
The museum included photos, letters, and displays of royal batik. 
Count on about an hour for this museum visit. It is worth including this on your trip to Mt Agung.

Kalau biasanya museum yang kita kunjungi kesannya monoton dan kaku, maka lain halnya dengan museum Ullen Sentalu ini.
Wisata sejarah yg disajikan disini, sangat apik dan unik. Peserta digabung dalam 1 kelompok, kemudian diajak berkeliling museum, layaknya berkeliling taman sejarah. Museum ini menampilkan sejarah kerajaan Yogyakarta dan Solo. Berikut dengan silsilah keturunan raja2nya. Terdapat pula alat2 kesenian dan kain batik yang sarat makna dalam setiap guratannya.
Sangat menarik dan recommended bagi para pecinta sejarah.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Sebenarnya saya tidak menyangka ada tempat yang sekeren ini disini. Saya kira hanyalah museum yang membosankan tetapi ternyata dugaan saya salah.

Salah satu museum di Yogyakarta yang jarang masih agak jarang dikunjungi wisatawan. Museum ini memiliki koleksi budaya Jawa dari Keraton Surakarta dan Keraton Yogyakarta.
Pengunjung dapat memilih tour dalam bahasa Indonesia maupun dalam bahasa Inggris, dengan harga yang berbeda.
Tour berlangsung selama kurang lebih satu jam.

Berada di lokasi yang cukup jauh dari pusat kota, dengan udara pengunungan yang sejuk, emang perpaduan yang cocok untuk menikmati museum ini. Setelah berkeliling, kita akan dikasih minuman hangat yang biasa diminum para putri. Sayangnya kita tidak diperbolehkan untuk mengambil foto didalam. Boleh foto hanya dibagian luar saja.

A steep fee (100k pp) for what it is. Architecture and grounds aside, there are several rooms full of paintings, photos, letters and batik. If you are interested in the royal family, this is the place for you. However, would skip with young children.

lebih tepatnya cerita mengenai beberapa nama di kedua kerajaan itu.
sejarah kedua kerajaan pun hanya berkisar mengenai beberapa nama saja. malah nama Solo lebih banyak disebut.
bagi yang tidak menyenangi sejarah atau tidak ada minat mengetahui sejarah kerajaan Yogya dan Solo, lebih baik tidak kesini.
Buat Orang tua dan anak2 cukup seru, ditambah penjelasan tentang apa2 yang ada di museum tersebut sangat baik sekali dari tour guidenya
a good place to learn a bit about javanese history..interactive guide..good design..love the paintings

Very interesting place up in high hills. Architectonical mixture. Uninteresting exhibition about sultan family, old photos,. Some nice batics. Sculpture garden. Our guide spoke very poor english. Very difficult to understand her. Good restaurant. The place itself and the park is well worth a visit. Nice and cool after the heat at Borobodur. Nice place to come after Borobodure.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
in here we can learn more about kingdom of yogyakarta.
The good point is no one can take a picture inside the gallery.

I expected a lot of this museum from its good reviews. Having paid the Rp.100,000 entry fee, I was taken round with a small number of other non-Indonesians. The guide gabbled her English-language script so fast that only 2 of us had any hope of understanding what she said, and only because we are used to the Indonesian accent. She invited questions at the end of each room but barely paused for anyone to ask, and having given her rapid-fire and very basic information wasn't able to answer questions of any depth. There were fewer artefacts than I expected, and no labels in any language. I asked to take a photo of a wall-panel so I could read it later, but was told 'no photos', even simply of text - she said the information was there on the website (which it isn't). The main information given was of endless photos of the Sultan's family, including an entire room dedicated to a noblewoman whose main claim to fame seems to be that she turned down both former President Sukarno and the Sultan of Yogya (to whom she was closely related), who wanted her as a mistress. No significant information on the gamelan, very little on the batiks, other than the difference between Yogya and Solo styles which was interesting, and extremely little on the few poor-quality statues on display. We were hurried along with barely time to look at anything properly. There are much better museums in Yogya itself. The restaurant is quite good though.

Lokasinya berada di kaki gunung merapi agak masuk kedalam untuk menujunya, lokasi parkirnya cukup luas, konsep daripada museum ini adalah kita disuruh  berjalan perkelompok dengan dipandu dengan satu pemandu wisata yang akan menjelaskan semua selama perjalanan kaki menyusuri museum, tidak boleh memotret selama perjalanan berlangsung kecuali di akhir perjalanan wisata
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Came here with some friends and at first not really sure to visit this museum, but they have their own guide who can speak english and this service is free of charge. She is really good in telling the story so it become interesting to listen for it while observing the historical items inside this museum. Unfortunately some of the area or item is restricted to take photos but it adds the values of the place.

Pertama kali dengar tentang museum ini lewat blog dan media sosial. 
Untuk masuk ke museum ini dikenakan biaya 50 rb per orang (dewasa per desember 2017). Biaya tersebut sudah termasuk tour di dalam museum dengan durasi sekitar 30-45 menit dalam 1 grup sekitar 20 orang.
Tidak diperbolehkan memotret selama tour berlangsung.
Pengalaman baru dan menyenangkan untuk sebuah museum, karena museum dikenal sebagai tempat yang membosankan.

Its very beautifull and recomended musium. Bit ekspensive for entrance but satistaction garantie.we have keep everything in our mind for memory cause iylta forbiding to take picture .any restaurant available inside by the midle up price

Wisatawan harus menahan diri untuk tidak sembarang 'selfie' karena ada larangan tidak boleh memoto saat kita menyelusuri di 'indoor' unit. Sejarah masa lalu yang berkaitan dengan Yogyakarta dan Surakarta terutama peristiwa Gusti Nurul yang legendaris diperebutkan oleh pada Penguasa saat itu...tiket Rp40.000 perorang..

It's a one hour ride by car from the city of yogyakarta.   The museum is located in Kaliruang Resort 25 km from Yogyakarta.  It's a guided tour and the English one is available every 30 minutes. The entrance ticket is IDR40,000 and IDR100,000 for international visitor.   You will learn about the Mataram Kingdom, the musical instruments, various different of batik, the Sultans and some of the famous princesses. We ended the visit with shopping at the batik shop, a very nice collection, nicely design and finishing.  I bought one dress which i will cherish so much.  We had a late lunch at the Beukenhoft restaurant.  They serve mostly international food, the taste is to our liking, moderately price and beautiful setting, a colonial Javanese architecture.   Recommended for both local and international tourist
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Museum ullen sentelu, merupakan museum yg didalamnya kita bisa tau pada jaman dahulu di kerajaan jogjakarta. Museum ini punya tempat yang sangat adem didalemnya. Karna bebatuan beberapa tempatnya. Dan selain itu juga sangat jelas di presentasikan oleh guide yang menjelaskan isi didalam museum tersebut

Museum should organize smaller group per guided tour. It was hard to hear the guide and look at the displays with the 20++ people per trip. Varied collection — from poems by a princess, batiks, statues, paintings and gamelan set. Photo taking prohibited inside.
thwy have good guide to explain about Batik and royal family Yogyakarta and Solo, for me this is the best Museum with guide at Yogyakarta
Saya jalan mengelilingi musium yang memiliki cukup banyak koleksi. Meskipun saya merasa sedikit bingung karena tidak ada karyawan di lokasi tengah ruang musium

Good display.
Good tour guide.
Peaceful landscape.
Price is a bit high for foreigner (100k)
A place to visit if you are interest in royal.
It is interesting for me to know a different point of view about religion and practice in royal family.

Menurut saya ini adalah salah satu museum yang unik yang ada di Jogja. Karena:
1. Ada kesan mistis dan misteri di museum ini, jadi cocok bagi anda penggemar kisah misteri dan budaya jawa.
2. Manajemen di museum tertata dengan baik dan rapi, dipandu dengan pemandu yang berpengalaman.
Namun, saya sarankan anda untuk tidak ikut rombongan besar ketika tur keliling museum atau anda sebaiknya bersama rombongan anda meminta untuk dipandu satu guide saja. Karena pengalamannya akan berbeda dan lebih nyaman saja. Oh iya, kalau anda datang di musim hujan saya sarankan untuk membawa jas hujan. Karena museum yang sebagian outdoor dan pihak museum tidak menyediakan jas hujan dalam jumlah yang cukup.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I was wrong in expecting to see Javanese art, antiquities, and culture exhibits here. The focus of 90% of the museum is on the history of a local Javanese royal family. You are guided through multiple rooms containing photographs of the family, letters they wrote, furniture they owned, and miscellaneous memorabilia. The tour is done quickly and you are shepherded by the guide from room to room. If you need the English tour, call ahead and be sure you get there on time for it.  The museum buildings are architecturally interesting and eclectic, but I wouldn't make the trip all the way out to this remote location for it, unless you're already in the area.  There is a good restaurant at the museum with a varied menu of well prepared foods.
Museum milik perorangan, dikelola dgn profesional, mengenal makna motif batik, tdk boleh foto slama tour, ada spot khusus utk foto2. Bagus banget tmptnya
Tur museum yang tidak membosankan, benda-benda yang dipamerkan memiliki cerita-cerita yang menarik. Areanya luas, dibangun dengan desain yang unik dan tidak membosankan.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
When I reached, the museum from outside is just like abandoned building or horror place, lol. After get in, I am very enjoyed with the explaination by Java's language guide. She also beautiful, a compliment. Ticket is 60k IDR, but I would suggest to the administration to minimize size of group which is to entertain MAXIMUM 10 person, because the place is quite small, and if for big group, they cant focus to the guide. 

NO PHOTO INSIDE.

Curious little private museum quite a way up the Mt Merapi mountainside near  Kaliurang.  Composed of two primary buildings, one ultra modern in design and the other resembling a Bavarian style Guesthouse.  Housing a collection of paintings (primarily large oil portraits of the Yogyakarta Sultans family) some antique batiks and a range of sculptures both traditional and modern within the lush gardens.  Ticket price included a guided tour in English and our guide was fluent.  There is a rather classy looking cafe upstairs in the traditionally style buildings with nice views over the gardens.  We did not eat there, but enjoyed the best Lattes we have had anywhere in Java.  If you are in the area, it worth popping in here for a pleasant break for  and a well presented small museum for an hour or two.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Its a tour that brings you back to history of Indonesia where paintings of princess and royal family were put on display. Too bad photography is not allow during the tour as there were copyright materials. Unless you really into study of history, there is nothing much to shout about.

Bentuk museum ini memang menarik karena tidak biasa. Namun koleksinya termasuk minim. Koleksi asli hanya gamelan, batik dan beberapa arca, selebihnya replika. Selama mengunjungi museum anda harus dipandu, sehingga tidak bisa menikmati koleksi berlama-lama. Mengenai sejarah raja-raja jawa tidak ada cerita yang baru, pemandunya hanya cerita sekilas, lebih jelas kalau anda baca sejarah keraton di wikipedia. Akses kesana harus bawa kendaraan, tiket termasuk mahal (Rp 40.000 - turis lokal). Untuk mempelajari sejarah Jawa, lebih baik anda mengunjungi museum sonobudoyo hanya dengan tiket Rp 3.000 (turis lokal) dengan akses yg mudah, kolesi lumayan banyak, bisa mengamati lebih lama, dan bisa difoto.

Took us about an hour to get to museum.  The ticket is Rupiah 60,000 for foreigners plus an additional Rupiah 3,000 (tax-like) to enter the district.  Items were beautifully displayed but the place is relatively small.  Only guided tours are allowed and this is included within your purchased tickets.  The guide was in English with a rather strong local accent.  It was at times quite difficult to understand her especially when she spoke very fast.  She also took us through too fast through some sections, making it difficult to truly appreciate the artifacts, documents, paintings.  The Museum is close to Mount Merapi.  It it touted to be the best museum in Indonesia, I think.  I am not convinced that it is.  It has a boutique and cafe.  Surroundings are very tranquil.  No photography allowed within museum.

berada dikawasan objek wisata kaliurang, sebuah museum milik pribadi yang di publish untuk umum. harga tiket masuk 50 ribu rupiah dapat teh jahe dan berkeliling ditemani guide yang sudah disiapkan oleh museum. tidak terlalu luas dan dilarang foto foto didalamnya

One of the things I really liked about the museum of not allowing guests to take pictures inside, because there are several areas that you are allowed to pose. Two words for Ullen Sentalu are classic and beautiful

This museum is really good, full of information about Yogyakarta Palace. The atmosphere is so tranquil, the restaurant has good vibes. The ticket price is 60 thousand rupiah, it is worth the price.
The tour guide is also kind and patient to explain you about the museum

pertama kali ke museum ini, cukup salut dengan usaha pemilik museum, tidak terbayang bagaimana usaha untuk mendapatkan koleksi sedemikian kuno dan berharganya. kunjungan akan dipimpin oleh tour guide yang sangat menguasai materi isi museum, namun guide saya waktu itu ngomongnya sangat cepat dan kurang membaur, sehingga kalau saya dapat posisi belakang jadinya ga bisa dengar penjelasannya dengan baik. di dalam museum tidak boleh foto-foto. disediakan spot tersendiri untuk berfoto.888
I nice guided tour.  It gave you the history of kesultanan and see their batik, painting and other collector items.

It is one of the best museums in Yogyakarta. A complimentary English speaking guide is included in the price. You can understand a lot about Yogyakarta and its history by visiting this museum. The location of the museum is also very good.

I visited this place based on recommendation from some travelers in internet. The road to the museum is a little difficult and uphill, because it's located in the slope of Merapi Mountain, but it's all worth it. This museum is managed by private company who still has relationship with Kesultanan Jogja and Solo. 

The entree ticket cost 40.000 rupiah, and you'll get traditional welcoming drink in the middle of the tour. There will be a guide who accompany and explain the history about Kesultanan Jogja and Solo. No camera allowed during this tour(phone cam, any professional camera), there'll be specified place to take a photograph. 

I love the ambiance of this place, it's calm, cool-fresh air, and quiet place. This place is the perfect place to learn history in comfy way. In some of the room, there are ancient authentic  things from Jogja's royal family. You'll find the collection romantic letter from late princess of Jogja. 

Revisit?? SURE!! I love enjoying the nature while learning history.

PS: There's a classic restaurant on the second floor, you can enjoy a cup of authentic Indonesian coffee here. (but this restaurant is a bit pricey)
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: English guide provided for foreign visitor.This was interesting to walk around in the museum and listen to the lady guide explanation. They have a lot of royal family collection and batik. Worth to visit.
guide nya menyenangkan, ekspresif, banyak memberikan informasi, tidak membosankan, museumnya pun cukup lengkap. ada sajian minum jamu juga. aku suka.

A good place in the middle of the forest. They have provided English speaking guide to explain. It is a private museum with good collections of drawings and paintings, explain the life History of Solo and Java Kings. We were able to spend almost 2hours in the location.
The restaurant on top floor was very very expensive, was disappointing.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: It's a museum dedicated by a nice gentleman and his family. It shows us how the life of a real royal family in Yogyakarta was backthen. People can also learn a variety of 'batik' from the very old days. The museum provides us with a talented guides. Not to mention a traditional drink served for us.
disni disajikan cerita- cerita tentang raja- raja yogyakarta, bahkan ada beberapa surat - surat lama dari keluarga keraton, sungguh luar biasa menurut saya

Koleksi batiknya bagus dan lengkap. Benar2 dijelaskan fungsi dari motif batik tertentu. Bahkan dari warna batiknya, mempunyai arti berbeda. Koleksi lukisannya juga bagus2. Guide-nya juga menerangkan dengan jelas. Sayang tidka boleh berfoto didalam museum, hanya boleh di beberapa spot diluar museum. Sangat worth untuk dikunjungi

I wouldn’t recommend this place unless you have your own transport or you were passing by this area. I didn’t find it interesting and there is really not much to see with entrance tickets for IDR 60k for foreigners. One of my most disappointed muzium tour so far.

Jika sebelumnya mengunjungi museum adalah membosankan, maka tidak bagi museum Ullen Sentalu. Anda akan menikmati perjalanan, ditemani pemandu yang ramah dengan penjelasan yang baik, serta suasana yang asri. Semua tertata dengan rapi dan bagus.

The stuff is well preserved... if you wanna know the history of keraton yogyakarta and surakarta you have to visit this place.. they have english speaker guide... this place is closed on monday.. avoid weekend...

Every time i went to Yogyakarta, i always put Ullen Sentalu in my itinerary list. 
It was different when i visited this place back in 2016. At that time, there was construction activity going on. And this year, i finally saw what constriction was about. It was great. Though i like the old entrance better than the new one. 

The museum is about royal family heritage. There are Batik collection own by the king and queen, awesome paintings, some gamelan on the first room we visited. 
The guide has really well knowledge about the museum it self and about the history of Old and New Mataram kingdom. 

Oh ya, dont forget to buy Jadah Tempe and Wajik.

Theres a boutique at the museum. Plenty of good stuff and Batik of course. If you dont bring cash, they have credit card and debit card machine.
Went there about a year ago with my lecturer and friends from Bali. We having fun to see many rare things about the art, painting, and Batik. I also drink the Jamu they gave to us.

We visited the museum after the mount Merapi Jeep tour .
The international tour lasts about an hour .
Beautiful grounds and setting , interesting artifacts and collections of the Javanese royal family from the 15 th century on.
In the future the museum is planning on adding a section about the indigenous people of Java which will make it even more interesting .

It is a beautiful museum with so much history to hear from.  The 60,000 rupiah ticket (for foreigners) include an English guide that explains the story of whole entire royal family.   Great collection of beautiful portraits of the royal family and the meaning of the batik designs worn by them.  No photography throughout the museum and the tour finished off with a nice ginger tea before we head out for a picture to proof that you have been there :) Great place to visit.
Museum yg unik, tour guide yang ramah, museum yang wajib dikunjungi dari anak - anak hingga orang dewasa

The front appearance of this building looks like a modern contemporary musem but when you get inside, you'll get the feelings traditional javanese right away. You'll need to buy an entrance ticket, 'check in' and wait your name/your group to be called. The ticket entrance already includes a tour guide, who will tell you a history of the royal javanese family and the historical antique stuff in the museum.  The museum itself consists of indoor and outdoor area which is beautifully landscaped, clean and well maintained. During the tour, you're not allowed to take picture, record and eat. You'll understand why. The museum is filled with original, old, antique, historical stuffs therefore it's important to keep them unexposed. However, an the end of the tour, there is an area where you can take picture. Though for little kids the tour might be boring, but for adults, especially with interest of knowing javanese culture, it's a must visit museum during a visit to Jogja.

Karena museum yang dikelola pribadi, servis dan pelayanannya sangat baik, pengunjung dibeirkan waktu terbatas untuk berada di museum, pengunjung dikelompokan dan dipimpin 1 guide untuk menjelaskan apa saja isi dari museum

In this place we can understand more about a history of Jogyakarta and Surakarta kingdom. The collections are unique, mix between old and modern. The guide are very professional and they run the tour nicely. The restaurant serve an oldies style menu which is very nice.

We went there after our Merapi Jeep Tour...learn some history about Jawa Culture and the Kings..end with traditional drink given by the nice lady..and there is a nice fine dining restaurant and its not that expensive..the food is awesomeeeee...

Museum yg wajib di kunjungi untuk menambah kasanah ilmu oengetahuan tentang budaya jawa, kususnya jogjakarta dan solo. Di dalam museum banyak terdapat ornamen ornamen budaya yg membefakan solo dan jogjakarta, jjika kita mendegarkan detail penjwlasan pemandu kita akn tahu beda budayanya walau masih satu wilayah mataram

After such a tour for 1 hour, we can enjoy a variety of delicious dishes at the Beukenhof Restaurant which has gothic architecture. Some of the recommended dishes are Lobster Thermidor, Breaded Chicken Tender, and Glazed Lamb Rack. A delicious meal, beautiful place, and nature that will definitely make the show even more memorable.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Amazing place to be!

If you happen to be in Yogyakarta and you don't visit this Museum, then it is not complete. Seriously, you shall spend 2 hours here to enjoy those great stuffs inside this place because they are historical, valuable and unbelievably beautiful.

By knowing all stories behind those stuffs, you can start learning the history of Old Times on Yogyakarta and its magical stories that made Yogya is so special amongst many cities in Indonesia.

So, stop by in Ullen Sentalu
Wajib dikunjungi! Sebuah museum yang mempunyai koleksi yang beragam. Cerita cerita yang menarik. Sangat informatif
這間博物館，離市中心有點遠。但一旦你在這裡，你會欣賞它的爪哇文物 - 都是從各城市收集的。無論是在博物館內還是在博物館外，你會看到很多有趣的東西。在戶外區域，那裡有許多雕塑可以與你合影。好地方 ！相當涼快，因為博物館位於比較高的地帶。
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Avant d'être un musée historique et donc intéressant, il s'agit surtout d'un musée constitué de photos de famille et d'objets royaux. Ce n'est selon moi pas très intéressant. Je l'ai fait car le MERAPI était en éruption à ce moment là.
Saya adalah penyuka museum. Tak bisa berhenti takjub dengan museum ini. Sangat tertata,otentik dan sangat indah. Selain itu saya jadi sejarah secara detail tentang leluhur saya.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: We had hoped for more Javanese history and culture but this museum is pretty much an extension of the Kraton (Sultans Palace) in town focussing on the royal family of the past 3 sultans. Stunnin building and location, great batik textile collection, but we had hoped for more javanese history pre 18th century.
This is an interesting museum where you can learn about local culture, and the best part is one the best compounds in Yogyakarta

Museum ullen sentalu adalah salahsatu museum terbaik di kota jogja yang wisatawan belum terlalu mengenalnya. Museum ini terletak di dekat kaliurang. Museum ini bercerita lengkap tentang kerajaan mataram. Dengan harga murah anda bisa berkeliling museum dengan ditemani oleh pemandu museum. Disini dijelaskan secara detail tentang kerajaan majapahit mulai dari pakaian serta adat istiadat.
Untuk wisatawan yang ingin mengenal lebih lengkap tentang kerajaan mataram anda harus berkunjung ke museum ullen sentalu.

Museum ini bisa dibilang  merupakan museum sejarah, karena pemandunya akan menceritakan sejarah mengenai Yogyakarta dan Surakarta. Selain itu banyak alat-alat musik jaman kerajaan yang disimpan disini. tetapi yang paling menarik adalah potret nyi roro kidul di salah satu ruangan. sayang nya tempat ini sedikit jauh dari pusat kota jogja, sehingga apabila anda mau kesini,  harus menyewa kendaraan. dan untuk beberapa bagian, tidak boleh di foto.

Menjejak di Museum Ullen Sentalu wisatawan akan disambut dengan hawa sejuk yang berkisar antara 15 – 25 der4ajat celcius. Suasana hening yang menyatu dengan alam pegunungan semakin menambah damai suasana. Arsitektur vernakular yang menyatu dengan alam serta dikelilingi rimbun pepohonan menjadi tempat yang asyik untuk mengambil gambar.

Koleksi museum dibagi dalam beberapa ruang. Yang pertama adalah Ruang Seni dan Gamelan yang menyimpan seperangkat koleksi gamelan. Selanjutnya Guwo Selo Giri yang menjadi ruang pamer lukisan tokoh-tokoh yang mewakili 4 figur Dinasti Mataram. Kampung Kambang terbagi menjadi 5 ruang pamer yang mempertontonkan koleksi batik, syair, hingga album hidup GRKay. Siti Nurul Kusumawardhani. Yang terakhir adalah Ruang Sasana Sekar Buwana dan Koridor Letja Randa yang merupakan museum outdoor.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Well kept private collections. Very nice sequence of galleries. Nice landscaping too. They have a restaurant also which is quite nice to sit and relax.

Loved this little museum. The tour guide, explained everything very well. The only disappointing thing, apart from not taking any pictures in the museum, was rushing thru the museum like if  we had to catch a train. :( Super interesting museum, but can barely remember because of the speediness of the guide. 
Also the museum is not very elderly friendly.
Great museum with guides that provide good information about modern Yogya history. Definitely recommended.

Though it was a brief session, our guide Ms. Ida was able to amaze us with the history and philosophy of Mataram.

The four kingdoms, key people, values explained, and authentic artefacts; captivated us in awe and made us realize how great the Mataram was.

Great content, good atmosphere & artefacts, and also a very lively guide.

Keep up the good work for Indonesia!

Ini museum yang sangat bagus dan rapi. Di tata dengan baik dan koleksinya juga terawat. 

Koleksinya berupa item2 dari keraton jogja dan solo. 

Ketika disana, akan ada guide yang menjelaskan sejarah tentang tiap2 item. 
Guide nya sangat terlatih dan menjelaskan dengan detail. Saluuut..!! 

Kita jadi tau banyak informasi sejarah keraton. 

Saat tour selesai, kita bisa memilih makan di restaurant di lantai dua atau beli souvenir di lantai dasar. Karna saya lapar, saya makan dulu. 
Dan surprisingly, makanannya enaak.. Memang harganya cukup mahal, tapi worth kalo menurut saya. 

Kopi nya juga enak, padahal restaurant ini bukan khusus kopi. Saya coba espresso.. 

Overall, museum ini sangat direkomendasikan jika sedang berkunjung ke jogja.. Nice..!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Museum yang sangat menarik di Jogja. Lokasinya cukup jauh dari pusat kota, tapi dijamin nggak rugi datang ke sini. Koleksinya memang nggak begitu banyak, tapi koleksinya terawat dan ditata dengan rapi. Isinya tentang sejarah kraton jogja & solo, dan budayanya. Selama tur di dalam museum akan didampingi oleh guide yang ramah. 1 guide biasanya mendampingi sekitar 8 orang pengunjung. 

Tidak boleh mengambil foto saat di dalam, nanti ada spot tersendiri untuk foto-foto. Harga tiket masuk untuk pengunjung domestik Rp 30.000 (dewasa), Rp 20.000 (anak 5-16 th). Sedangkan pengunjung mancanegara Rp 60.000 (dewasa), Rp 40.000 (anak 5-16th). 

Area parkir yang tersedia untuk mobil dan motor sangat memadai. Toilet tersedia di banyak titik di dalam museum.

This museum is beautifully laid out in a sprawling mansion. It deals mostly with the Royal Family history with many photos, paintings and artefacts. The guide was excellent and enthusiastic to share her knowledge. It was a fair drive to get to it, but it was well worth the effort.  I would certainly recommend a visit.

Harga tiket masuk 30ribu/pax dan akan dibagi menjadi 1 rombongan berisi 8 orang dengan 1 tour guide. Anda akan diajak berkeliling menikmati berbagai lukisan, benda sejarah, batik maupun patung di dalam Museum Ullen Sentalu. Tour guide sangat cakap dan informatif. Pada saat anda berkeliling, anda tidak diperkenankan mengabadikan foto maupun video diarea Museum. Menjelang akhir tour, anda akan diberikan minuman khas Ullen Sentalu. Recommended!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Basically is good museum to leary about our local culture history. The place is well maintain. The guide is well knowledge to explain and to answer the question.
My suggestion, give more space/spot/ opportunity for photo spot. Because it will become promotional material on the socmed.
All over experience was satisfaction enough.

The Ullen Sentalu Museum is a excellent museum where you can find the Javanese culture. Nice collection of artifacts. You are not allowed to take photographs inside the museum. You will be accompanied by tour guide. You can get to know the Solo and Yogykarta kingdom culture.

The Ullen Sentalu museum is well worth a visit - set across a number of small buildings in a jungle setting, you will join a tour that takes you through themed rooms exploring local Javanese culture, with a special insight into the royal families of Java. The objects on show are diverse and well displayed and the architecture is especially interesting - combining modern themes with accent artefacts. Our guide was well spoken and well informed and went at a good pace for a mixed group of around 8 people.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Instagramable bikin eed IG anak muda banget, banyak lukisan dan cerita sejarah yang baru aku temui di sini. Ga nyesel deh ke museum ini.

It's not the authentic heritage, this place was dedicated for Javenese Culture. I suggest if it's during high/peak season, please contact the customer service (you can google for the website) so they will arrange the schedule for you. Because if not, you will wait for quiet some time. For local the admission is Rp 40.000,-/person. The museum is about Javanese Cultures (mostly about Keraton's families). The Museum itself very well maintain, for those of you who enjoy Indonesia cultures, I recommend this place. To get there, you can use Google Maps, during high/peak season, it'll take 1,5 - 2 hours from Yogyakarta.
No pictures are allowed inside, this is what makes it even more unique. They have nice collections and the tour guide was really nice
This museum is by far, my favorite in Jogja. Very well maintained museum. Good collection. Our tour guide (Ms Ida) is very entertaining and makes me curious and want to know more about Jogja history.
Museum that has historic objects and some photos about yogyakarta and solo palace. We are forbidden to take photos and touch when the tour guide explains and entered into several rooms.

Yang saya sukai dari tempat ini adalah kita tidak diperbolehkan berfoto kecuali di awal dan di akhir. Selama memasuki museum kita dipandu oleh guide khusus dan di temgah kunjungan disuguhi kamu. Menyenangkan sekali
Visited here with Japanese exchange student. They liked their experience to be here because it traditional atmosphere
With many museums in Yogyakarta, this place is really well maintained and the guide was explaining things in details

Visit this place with friends and it's crowded. This museum provide guide to tell the history of central java king. The guide will bring you from one room to another and tells you the story. Since that day was very packed, the guide spoke very fast and not all the audience can catch up what the guide said. 
It can be improved if only the museum provide the narrative or written story in each picture, so the audience can enjoy the museum instead in a hurry following the guide.

Nice collections of paintings and old Javanese batiks. Too bad we cannot take pictures inside the museum. The guide was also quite detail and gave a clear explanation. There are only few places where we can take picture at.

Museum keluarga yayasan sebetul nya, banyak menceritakan kerajaan jogja dan solo. Inti nya adalah penceritaan sosok gusti nurul sebagai aktor utama putri raja dan sejarah batik solo, jogja, serta ciri khas nya.

Spot foto hanya ada dua, tidak perlu membawa kamera canggih karena didalam hanya ada dua area yang boleh foto-foto. Dikarenakan suasana mistis museum tersebut.

Banyak benda dan lukisan bersejarah didalam nya.

Harga tiket masuk Rp. 40rb per orang di pandu guide yang menceritakan sejarah tersebut diatas.
Recommend sekali utk siapapun yg ingin belajar ttg historical jogja, Sangat rapih dan sangat bersih n sangat kental etnis jogja n solo nya

I must say that this place is terrific. A well informed guide with a good sense of humor, well organized tour around the area. Here you will learn the History of Old Mataram. I suggest you go here first and then after that you might go to Surakarta Palace or Jogja Palace.

1 bonne heure de route pour s'y rendre, majoritairement en ville donc pas spécialement agréable, et finalement on n'y trouve pas vraiment d'œuvres d'art, à part quelques tableaux illustratifs, et un vieux gamelan à l'entrée du musée.
1h de visite avec une guide en anglais (inclus dans le prix du billet = 60.000), des photos et quelques batiks quand-même, mais rien d'extraordinaire.
c'est bien pour voir les princesses, princes et sultans du 20ème siècle, pas grand chose de plus.
à la fin de l'expo, quelques statues hindoues, j'ai pu poser des questions sur la religion c'était très intéressant
Lokasinya ada di Kaliurang, jadi tempatnya sejuk, asri dan dirawat dengan baik. Harga tiketnya cukup mahal, tapi pas masuk ke dalamnya nggak rugi kok. sayangnya nggak bisa foto-foto didalam area nya.

the tour was very rich in culture of Yogyakarta and Surakarta Dinasty. The guide was very interesting, too. I couldn't remember the name. But she was very good looking and insightful. She was telling all the stories of both Dinasty. It was taking about 50 minutes i recalled. For those who are into history and museum, you definitely should give the tour a try.

Visited the place with a group of high school friends.  We were skeptical at the beginning, but our guide, Ms. Ida, makes all the difference.  Her abundance energy and humor makes the story so interesting, we passed our allocated time (1 hour) in a flash. Highly recommended.
the guide is very informative and bring us to know more about jogja with an interesting way ..thank you miss Ida

The Museum has many kind of variety of Javanese culture, ie, music instrument, old costume, dance, carving, history of kingdom of Mataram, the king, his queen and concubine.. 
All are explained in attractive, simple, and fun way by nice tour guide, (mbak Ida) :).. 
So.. it doesn't feel boring.. but fun..:)
Ida, the local guide, gives a wonderful insight into the Kraton life. She is witty and fabulous. Overall, an enjoyable experience

Tempatnya di pelosok Jogja, masuknya agak mahal sih, 25ribu, tapi museumnya bersih banget, kerawat, dan ga akan nyesel. Sayangnya kita ga boleh foto-foto di dalem, dan hanya beberapa tempat aja yg boleh foto.

The 4 of us thoroughly enjoyed our museum visit.  They provide a guide to walk through and explain things and it made the experience a treat.  Our guide was extremely knowledgeable and her English was very good.  Without the guide, you would not understand and appreciate the exhibits. The artifacts were donated by someone in the Sultan's family. The museum covers historical info about the area Sultans from the late 1800s to current times and also in depth explanation of the batik process and significance of the colours and patterns

Kita akan dibawa berjalan melihat seluruh koleksi oleh guide (wajib menggunakan guide, karena kmrn saya hanya berdua maka digabung dengan rombongan lain *sad*). Tidak boleh mengambil foto di dalam museum, di pertengahan trip diberikan jamu khas kraton yang katanya berkhasiat agar awet muda.

The owner of our hostel told us to go give this museum a try and I'm glad he did as it was a nice find. They offer tour guides that will take you through the halls and explain a lot about most pieces. The downside of this is that you don't get to walk around freely and you cannot stand around admiring a piece for long as the guide has a limited amount of time to take you through the museum. We had some questions and some pieces we wanted to see a bit longer due to the connection with culture in other parts of our planet and that led to us being in the same room as the group that came after us all the time.. then there were 2 guides explaining 2 different things in 2 different languages and it became clear that we had to rush on out. Nice place but we felt like we were just rushed through so they can do as many groups as possible in a day.. maybe they can think about offering a bigger tour for people with more than average interest.
박물관이 상대적으로 숲속에 위치해 있는데, 자바섬에 관한 역사를 알 수 있습니다. 영어가이드의 설명도 가능합니다.

This museum stand in the middle of tropical forest which give different nuance.We got 1 tour guide to explore this museum.Photography is not allowed during tour.Next we can enjoy Ratu Mas' wedang which already prepared by the museum.Only 40k for entrance (domestic fee include tour guide) 
I love this museum so much
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Ullen sentalu sangat bagus..walaupun pada saat datang sedang ada bagian yg direnov..banyak cerita sejarah yg didpt dari sana, khususnya tentang keraton dan batik. Suasananya juga asri.lokasi tidak begitu jauh jika dr jalan kaliurang km 7.5

Tempat ini cocok bagi anda pecinta sejarah. Anda akan dipandu dari satu ruangan ke ruangan lainnya oleh seorang guide yang akan menceritakan sejarah keraton jogja dan keraton solo melalui foto foto yang berderet di musium ini. Harga tiket sebesar Rp.25.000 untuk dewasa anda akan disuguhi minuman yang katanya berkhasiat membuat anda awet muda. Di dalam museum dilarang untuk mengambil foto ataupun video.
Incredible private museum dedicated to women of the royal family of Central Java.  Not to be missed.  Location is fantastic in Kaliurang at the foothills of the fabulous Gunung Merapi.
Very friendly staff and good tour guide. A must see museum, with nice historical heritage of the Sultan / Prince / Princess

Your experience will be determined by the tour guide since you could not wondering alone and will not have any other info except from your tour guide. If u love traditional art and wanted to learn anything about Keraton, well too bad, you will likely have to visit this place for more than theere times to fully understand and apreciate what is going on the display. The information that the guide give would be differents depends on each guide. One guide will give you all the coolest fact about Keraton, and others are only repeating themself each room. So if you want to visits here, then good luck.
Pengalaman yang luar biasa dapat mengenal sejarah kerajaan mataram. Tour guide-nya jg super detail!!!!!!

Hadir disini...amazing banget
Awalnya bingung kok datang diajak berkunjung ke sini,apa asiknya??
Dan wow...banyak pengetahuan, wawasan ttg keraton jogjakarta dan solo. Yang tidak kita dapatkan meski berkunjung ke keraton...
Datang aja ke sini di jamin asik dan amazing banget...rugi kalau gak datang
Went to this place several times with different group of friends, and we all happy with this place! Hidden gems in town with full of cultural experiences.

Museum indah dan edukatif yang banyak menceritakan sejarah dan budaya Jawa. Terdapat banyak foto dan peninggalan dari kerajaan, tampak seperti kebanyakan museum lainnya sebenarnya namun hal yang membuat menarik adalah fasilitas pemandu wisata yang menceritakan semua hal tersebut dengan apik. Waktu 40 menit terasa cepat. Berpikir untuk kembali lagi kesini jika sedang penat dengan padatnya kota.

Musium ini dikelola oleh swasta, untuk tiket masuk kita (turis lokal) di kenakan tarif Rp 40.000. Untuk tour musium biasanya akan dipandu oleh tour guide per grup. Jika anda datang sendiri, anda akan bergabung dengan orang atau rombongan lain. Rata-rata koleksi di musium ini adalah koleksi pribadi. Jadi, selama tour kita tidak diperbolehkan mengambil foto atau gambar. Secara garis besar, musium ini menceritakan sejarah Kesultanan Yogyakarta dan Surakarta. Jarak musium ini dari pusat kota Yogyakarta kurang lebih 1 jam. Dan udaranya cukup sejuk karena tepat di bawah kaki Gunung Merapi.

暇つぶしにトライバーの紹介で来た。ムラピ山方面にある個人的な美術館。
近代的な感じをうける建物だが、苔むしていて、奥ゆかしい雰囲気もある。
英語を話せるガイドがやって来るまで、30分ほどエントランスで待った後に
案内が始まったが、この地方の王族の、特に女性の肖像画と関連させた説明や
バティック等のファッション的な意味、解説がメインだ。その内容はビミョーだなぁ。館内にある石像はレプリカと本物が混ざっているみたい。でも真面目に展示されており、クラトンのテキトーに置いただけの展示内容よりはマシに思えた。館内は撮影禁止で、最後の方、外だけになるので撮影OK。なんか京都と関連しているんでしょうかね。

Tempatnya memang cukup jauh, dekat sekitar Merapi. Gedungnya yang klasik dan vintage, membuat pengunjung semakin penasaran. Saat tour, dilarang memotret apa pun dengan handphone atau pun kamera. Pengunjung juga akan disuguhi jamu rahasia yang bisa membuat awet muda.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This museum is packed luxurious and cozy. Great collections and well maintained. We are ushered around the museum by the professional guides. In the final door, we are given a typical Javanese drink. Best museum in Java so far.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: What a nice museum! Must visit this place if you keen to learn a lot about the history and traditional culture

A small museum with a really rich Javanese heritage collection. Located on the foot of Mt Merapi, the drive up to the museum goes thru some really scenic route through the paddy fields & local houses.
The mysterious aura of the museum greets you as soon as you arrive at the parking long. & instantly invites you in. Lush greenery setting surrounds the museum as you explore with an awesome guide that the museum provide to every tour group. The tip is .. just join in the tour & be blown away by the back stories of selected portraits & figurines.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Tempat yang wajib untuk dikunjungi bagi wisatawan penggemar sejarah. Museum yang dikelola oleh swasta, selalu ditemani oleh guide yang profesional, ramah dan benar-benar menguasai alur sejarah. Apa yang ditanyakan oleh pengunjung, selalu dapat penjelasan. Ditengah-tengah tour diberi minuman semacam jamu. Top deh..

Housed in a maze of rooms, this museum offers an overview of the history of royal families of Yogya and Solo. It shows paintings, photographs, silverware and private letters among other items. An English spoken guided tour is offered every half hour. Finish with a drink or meal in the stylish restaurant upstairs. Recommended!
P.S. Picture taking is not permitted.
Museum Ullen Sentalu ini sangat bagus, dari mulai tempatnya, tour guide, sampai koleksi-koleksinya top banget. Buat yang ngaku pecinta museum wajib datang ke museum ini.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
