Review Text: This is the first time I went to the museum which present cold air. It was located at Kaliurang. This museum doesn't allow you to capture as much as you want. They have rule and approriate place for visitor to take pictures. I drank herbs drink called jamu that was believed can keep me young hahaha. I love the place so much it's different. The place is extraordinary and glamour with its story Last but not least, I love its name! Ullen Sentalu, so unique! You must visit!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Museum favorit!!! Berkali kali gak pernah bosan karena museum ini bagus bangeeeeettt, yang bikin nagih kesini selain museum, itu minuman tradisional yang di siapkan untuk pengunjung rasanya enak banget 😂😂😂

Ketika mendengar kata museum seringkali yang terlintas dalam benak kita adalah tempat yang singup, tidak terawat, membosankan, monoton dan hal lain yang berkonotasi minor. Namun tidak demikian halnya dengan museum Ullen Sentalu. Mendengar namanya saja mungkin kita langsung penasaran, apalagi setelah menginjakkan kaki di tempat itu. Berlokasi di daerah Kaliurang yang berhawa sejuk, museum ini menghadirkan sesuatu yang baru yang bertolakbelakang dengan pemikiran khalayak mengenai museum. Desain bangunan, aura lingkungan, koleksi yang terawat, pelayanan dan informasi yang detail tentang koleksi museum menjadi tak terbantahkan bahwa museum ini layak disebut museum terbaik di Jogja, mungkin se Indonesia. Tak cukup menceritakan keasyikan museum ini dalam kata-kata, kunjungi saja dan buktikan.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It is a nice museum where you get a very informative tour guide. You can learn a lot about the history and culture, you can see tones of beautiful batik. It is just below the Merapi Mountain so if you go to see the volcano it is worth coming here on your way back.

Harus datang kesini! Ulen sentalu adalah museum yg sangat unik. Mengunjungi Ulen sentalu kita tidak boleh berfoto dan harus di dampingi tour guide. Didalam museum interior maupun eksterior sangat   bagus sekali. Museum ini sarat dengan peninggalan sejarah solo dan jogja.

This private-owned museum has a very unique and smart presentation that make guests enjoy the trip. The museum keeps information about Mataram royal family, the only still-reigning monarchy in Indonesia, as well as Surakarta royal family. Beside that, the museum also keeps information about traditional Yogyakartan and Surakartan batiks as well as Javanese values and fine arts. This museum is a great place to know closer about Javanese cultures!
One of the best museum in Jogjakarta, they provide a tour guide (very good guide) - we are not allowed to take photos in the first 2 areas, but definitely worth to visit.
I visited Jogjakarta several times, but it was my first tme to visit the museum. Many information about the kingdoms, the kings, the royal family, batiks, etc. The museum's guide was excellent.
Tempatnya bagus sekali,sejuk, asri dan koleksinya sangat menarik. Koleksi yang dimiliki difokuskan pada barang barang dan hal hal terkait kerajaan mataram

Had a wonderful English guide who took us through all the different paintings, artworks, photos and answered all our questions related to the history and in depth cultural understanding...our 5 year old strolled around appreciating the stories behind the paintings...letters...etc. Absolutely worth visiting
we forced to keep out camera and smartphone in bag, and enjoy the museum. so every guest can have good experience in their museum.

bagus museumnya, cara penyajiannya menarik (menurut kami ketimbang yg di kraton). alternatif utk kenal budaya jawa. 
tidak semua warga yogya tahu museum ini, modal google maps utk sampai ke lokasi.

Never get bored come to this place, second visit. It is private museum, the entrance fee around IDR 40.000 ($4). They provide guide, they have original collection, there are explanation in every item they have. They provide special spot for visitor to take picture

Ullen Sentalu is very interesting museum which explain more about Javanese Culture especially Yogyakarta and Surakarta Palace. The guide will tell comprehensive stories to the visitors. It is memorable ..

Worth the queue as this museum holds loads of historical values n also lovely batik collection, letters n poems properly kept. A great insight of jogja in the early years. A place not to be missed when u r in Jogja.

Ketika saya mengunjungi museum ini, saya teringat salah satu museum pribadi di Bangkok, rumah Jim Thomson.
Cara pembagian grup, cara tour guide menjelaskan, mirip...
Museum ini museum swasta bukan milik pemerintah.

Museum ini museum pertama yang membuat saya tidak bosan. karena kita tidak perlu membaca deskripsi barang barang koleksinya. kita cukup mendengarkan kata nara sumbernya saja.

Museum ini berisi silsilah keraton jawa, tapi lebih detail di keluarga kasunanan Surakarta, terutama pangeran Bobby dan putri Tinneke
Museum batik Jogya dan batik solo (dijelaskan perbedaan motifnya serta macam macam motifnya)
Ada replika baju pengantin adat yang dijelaskan simbol simbolnya oleh nara sumbernya.
Di akhir tour, kita disuguhi segelas minuman dengan resep ramuan Jawa yang dipercaya sebagai ramuan awet muda 
setelah itu kita sampai di penghujung tour dengan replika relief candi borobudur yang di pasang miring. (menggambarkan keadaan kepedulian generasi muda yang miring terhadap sejarah budaya jawa)
di zona ini baru kami diperkenankan mengambil foto. di yang lain dilarang....

Menurut saya kalau anda kebetulan mengunjungi daerah ini, luangkan waktu sejenak untuk mengunjunginya, supaya anda mengenal sedikit budaya jawa :)

The museum is beautiful and the collection is awesome! We can get a lot of information about Keraton history from Mataram era to Hamengkubuwono-Pakualam in Jogja and Pakubuwono-Mangkunegara in Solo era as well as the tradition and meanings behind the clothing and batik motives. The stars of this museum are the princesses and their stories, like Princess Tineke's stories and Gusti Nurul which not so popular but very interesting. The ticket price is a bit expensive if you compare to other museums but totally worth it. With Rp. 40.000 you will get group-tour guide who is friendly and very informative.
Watched sunrise here.So beautiful. Everyone is there around 4am plus (Indonesia's time). Spend sometimes taking pictures here too with lovely scenery.

sejarah jogja dan solo yang jarang diketahui kalayak umum
wajib untuk di kunjungi...spot foto di luar bagus jadi perlu di kembangkan,foto di dalam gak boleh tapi di luar bisa di kembangkan......patut di kembangkan lagi.....

Museum ini berada di kaliurang, udaranya sejuk dan tempatnya teduh.
Arsiteknya unik dan sistemnya profesional karena ada pemandu untuk setiap group yang dibatasi 15 orang. Jadi terorganisir dengan baik dan tidak berdesakan.
Tempatnya bersih. Isinya menarik, sangat bagus untuk dikunjungi.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Very nice, well explained by the guide.
Many well drawn pictures about the Javanese noble families and their stories.
Interesting even for us, who usually do not go to museums.

Ramai kebanyakan rombongan dari sekolah sekolah dan konsep daripada museumnya adalah masuk secara berrombongan sekitar 20 an orang beserta 1 tour guide yang selanjutnya akan dijelaskan sedetail mungkin mengenai yang ada di museum cocok untuk sarana edukasi

Museum ini adalah milik pribadi, dimana di dalam museum tsb ada beberapa koleksi dari sejarah kerajaan Yogyakarta dan Solo. Museum ini menyimpan koleksi dari photo2 kerajaan yang sudah reproduksi kembali. koleksi batik dan arti dari batik tsb, pakaian kerajaan Yogya dan solo dsb. Tarif untuk masuk ke museum tsb 40K untuk dewasa dan 20K untuk anak. Pengunjung dibagi menjadi grup kecil sekitar 25orang dan akan dipandu oleh Guide yang supel dan mengerti akan sejarah dari koleksi yang di pamerkan. Dan bagi para anak2 akan sangat menarik untuk explore sejarah kerajaan jawa khususnya Yogya dan Solo.
Tata letak museum sangat menarik dan tidak membosankan.
Lokasinya sendiri di dataran tinggi gunung merapi yang berudara cukup sejuk.
Hanya saja tidak diperkenankan untuk mengambil gambar.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The rooms and alleys are a bit too small, but the collection are incredible. The ticket is affordable and worth the price for such a great museum.
I went here with family group and they gave us a guide who could tell all things we need to know about Javanese History. The place was breathtaking. A very must see place

Guided tour, taking pictures is not allowed. Lot of interesting historical facts about Jogjakarta environment and society, batik, historical ties with the Netherlands. Old pictures and paintings. Beautiful interior and garden. Nice museum shop with well designed clothes and nice souvenirs.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Love every single detail of the museum. Great place to learn Javanese art & culture in 50 minutes! Because it’s a private museum, it will be more expensive than public museum but it’s worth a visit for sure.
For local tourist, it will cost 40.000 IDR (adult), and 20.000 IDR (kids 0-16 years old). Nice tour guide and free “jamu” Ratu Mas Drink during the tour (you must do the tour with a group of 25 people and a tour guide). They will open the “new group” of tour every 30 minutes and available in Bahasa & English speaking tour guide.
The museum closes every Monday.
Tuesday-Friday: 08.30 AM - 04.00 PM
Saturday-Sunday: 08.30 AM - 05.00 PM

It was a great museum to visit if you are interested on history and culture of Javanese kingdom. We have a guide for about 20 people per group. It was so fascinating to learn about javanesse kingdom and culture on how the colonialism divide and conquer the kingdoms and create the current royalties. 

There are only 2 locations allowed to take pictures. Throughout the tour, any pictures are prohibited. The museum it self is very well organised. The rooms, paintings, batiks and artistic items were displayed beautifully. 

The only drawback was the guide seems to be in a hurry, spoke very fast and skip many paintings/artefacts. Many of the visitors in the group were also seems curious but reluctant to ask because we get the feeling the guide is in a hurry and need to be somewhere else.

100% must visit! No excuse! It is the most well organized and planned out museum in Indonesia. Along with your ticket, you can join their guided tour (recommended). However, the tour only happens every 30 minutes.

Very nice place with good atmosphere, in the valley of merapi mountain, ullen sentalu is great museum to know all about Javanese culture, especially Kraton Jogja and Solo Kingdom.
Better here in the morning and if it rain, dont forget to bring small umbrella.

Kalau kalian sering mengunjungi museum di Indonesia, kalian pasti tahu bahwa kecenderungan museum disini ditata kurang menarik dan kurang terorganisir padahal nilai sejarahnya tinggi. Sementara di Ulen Sentalu ini semua koleksi desain ditata dengan cantik dan elegan. Setiap grup yang masuk didampingi seorang untuk menjelaskan karya karya di dalamnya. Kita juga dikasih minuman di akhir tour sama dikasih sesi-sesi foto setelahnya.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
A history of Jogja and Solo.

The kingdom of these city and a woman power has create here also through Princess Nurul has rejected of Polygamy.

All those thing in museum still original and ancient.

How to get there it’s almost 1 hours from city and easy to get there.

Don’t ever try to take a picture here, it means cheat !!

Intan as a local guide on this museum, explains the story very clear and recommend handle by her, keep it up Intan!

We were pleasantly surprised the moment we set foot in this museum.  The design of the building, its surroundings and its interior is refreshingly modern and attractive.  The exhibits are well-curated, presented and maintained and this is in strong contrast to the condition of the exhibits that we saw in the Yogyakarta palace.

The museum conducts guided tours and an English-speaking guide was assigned to us during our visit.  She really captivated our attention with her enthusiasm and interesting narrative of the history and culture of the Jogja and Solo kingdoms.  Contrary to our expectation of a dry session chock-full of historical facts and events, she managed to weave together an interesting presentation that brought the exhibits to life with the right blend of history, culture,  snippets of royalty lives and anecdotes on some colourful personalities in the royal families.  We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves and learned a lot about Jogja and Solo during the one hour tour.

The museum is located in the Mt Merapi region and this little gem is definitely worth a stop for those en route to Mt Merapi for their jeep tours..
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Museum Ullen Sentalu berada di daratan tinggi. Letaknya tidak jauh dari Gunung Merapi, hal ini membuat udara di sekitar museum ini cukup membuat kita sering mengusap-usap telapak tangan.

Museum Ullen Sentalu bisa dibilang sebagai museum yang unik. Karena kita akan dibawa berkeliling, menjelajahi museum dengan jalan naik-turun, berkelok-kelok seperti labirin. Saat berada di dalam museum ini, suasana tradisional khas Jawa masih cukup terasa. Mungkin karena terdapat banyak atribut Jawa dan beberapa lukisan tokoh ternama dari tanah Jawa saat itu.

Saat berada di Museum Ullen Sentalu, kita dilarang berfoto ria ya. Kita boleh berfoto ketika sudah keluar dari Museum. Dan kita akan disuguhkan dengan jamu awet muda loh, genks! Dijamin deh pulang dari sini kamu terasa lebih muda 10 tahun dari umur aslimu

When we first came to this museum, the reception looked very modern, like an art gallery. But when we were inside, we were blown away at the architecture, interior design and the organisation of the collection. We had an English-speaking guide, and her English was very good. She was very knowledgeable and answered our questions patiently. In that one plus hour with our guide, we have learnt so much about Javanese culture and the royal houses. More museums should be well-thought out like the Ullen Sentalu Museum.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: I really enjoy my visit here. There is a private tour guide available for every group of visitor without the minimum people requirement in the group. There are no camera rules while on tour, but cameras are allowed on some areas. Be prepared to bring umbrella if it's raining because the place is outdoor indoor. There's a cafe on second floor and a shop with great selection of local batik and accessories.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Nice and well informed tour guide, you will say Wow to all story and aware of keraton life...seeing vintage evidence.

Amazing! i love every single information provided from this museum. one of the best museum i have ever visited. your tour will be lead by tour guide, so dont be afraid to loose the information. everything will like a secret, becouse you are not allowed to taking a picture inside the are. if your are javannese, you will be more amazed by its secret and ambiance
english tour guide every 30 minutes

This museum is privately run and inexpensive compared to the UNESCO sites. Price includes a guided tour in English (about 50min) and a herbal jamu tea in a special room. It provides a good glimpse of the dramatic royal pasts and insights into the special royal courts and practices. A special introduction of batik is well appreciated. 

The location is rather far from the city but it's on the route to merapi. So, good to make it as part of the day trip to merapi. 

Although photos-taking is not allowed inside the special exhibition rooms, it is allowed at the garden/court yard at the end of the tour. 

It's always good to know a little of the history of the place we visit as it gives interesting perspectives into the roots and cultures of the locals

Museum yang memberikan diskripsi silsilah kerajaan mataram islam secara apik dan menarik. Dengan nuansa jawa yang kental terkesan etnik dan magis. Bangunannya mengekspos dinding batu, kayu dan beberapa arca.
Selain silsilah kerajaan mataram islam terdapat juga foto keluarga kerajaan dan beragam perbedaan corak batik serta riasan dari solo dan jogja. Petugas tiket, check in dan Guide sangat kooperatif dan komunikatif membuat pengunjung terbawa suasana di masa silam dan tidak bosan.
Hanya sayangnya kasir di restoran mohon untuk ditingkatkan keramahannya.

Particulier museum, interessant om te zien hoe ze daar in Indonesie invulling aan geven. Collectie bestaat uit instrumenten, schilderijen, brieven, foto's, sculpturen. Mijn gids wist veel te vertellen en was duidelijk opgeleid om een compleet verhaal te geven. Halverwege de tour kregen we een drankje aangeboden: een soort thee van geheime ingredienten waar je jong en mooi van zou blijven. Ben benieuwd of het helpt!
located in the merapi mountain, this is museum is describing the history of Yogyakarta from the owner point of view
Although it is quite a trek from the City Center, the museum is a fun way to learn about Indonesian royalty. I would say it was an afternoon well spent.
Great place even it is far from the city, but worth to visit I like how they explained the historical of Kranton Jogjakarta, batik collections and meaning.
one of the charming museum in Indonesia! in love with the details, the story, the pictures, and the area of the museum. so recommended for travelers who come to Yogyakarta :)
Tourist not allowed for taking a picture in a museum area. In here, the guide explaining about Yogyakarta and Solo Dynasti. Many collections about Yogyakarta and Solo in here.

Membaca sejarah yang ditampilkan di museum Ullen Sentalu adalah pengalaman menyenangkan. Segelas jamu yang disuguhkan saat hujan turun, merupakan satu dari beberapa keistimewaan yang dimiliki oleh museum ini. Wisata sejarah yang sangat fantastis!
Never regret visiting this museum. Learn about out root and culture is pleasing. This museum has beautiful architecture, path and filled with valuable heritage..
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Salah satu tempat untuk mempelajari batik, sejarah kerajaan di jogja (jawa), kisah-kisah raja dan putri kerajaan terdahulu, di sinilah tempat yg menarik. Ditambah dengan desain museum yg, menurut saya, elegan. Menikmati museum dengan metode tur, didampingi seorang pemandu yg enak cara ngomongnya. Oke banget.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
The museum provides you with a lot of information of royal family of two Kingdom in central Java, Yogyakarta and Solo. The tour guide will be provided (both English and Indonesian). Tips for the tour guide not required (include in the ticket price) but it will be very much appreciated. 

It takes around 45-60 minutes drive from  Adi Sucipto airport. The entrance cost around AUD60 for adult and half price for the kids. There are secret drink herbs provided as well, a very nice gesture. No photo or video allowed to be taken due to copyright issue.

The tour around 60 minutes, covering 1.2 hectares area of the privately owned museum collections. The tour guide really knowledgeable and answers our questions well. The collections are well preserved too. 

There are restaurant provides European food, can't give much information as i wasn't tried the food, but the place is really nice, with European architecture and very friendly staff (stayed there for more than 30 minutes since there was heavy rain, and we don't order anything).

I really recommend this place.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
One of the best museum in Indonesia. This museum is important, not just as tourist visit but also to Indonesia. 

I would call it my sanctuary place and soul finding place.

Museum ullen sentalu merupakan museum budaya jawa terbaik yang pernah saya datangi. Museum ini terletak di daerah kawasan wisata kaliurang yang sejuk dan penuh dengan pegunungan. Museum ini menyimpan koleksi kebudayaan jawa dan sejarah terbentuknya keraton jogja dan solo. Terdapat tour yang di dampngi guide yang menjelaskan koleksinya sehingga kita bis amengerti filosofi benda-beda bersejarah koleksi museum,

Nice to see a museum in Indonesia working on and preserving it heritage.  A rich heritage that should not be forgotten and lost.  I truly hope the people of Indonesia and Yogjakarta keep these traditions.

Di tempat ini kami disuguhi dengan informasi sejarah terkait dengan kerajaan Jogja dan Solo. Juga yang tak kalah menariknya mengenai batik. Disini saya baru paham mengenai arti symbol yang ada di batik. Di tempat ini akan dipandu oleh Pemandu. Harga masuk sudah dengan fee si Pemandu. Si Pemandu juga pandai berbahasa Inggris. Tidak semua ruangan di dalam museum boleh diambil gambar. Pengambilan gambar hanya dilakukan di bagian tertentu. Untuk anak-anak SD ke atas tempat ini akan menarik untuk dikunjungi. Di salah satu ruangan, telah disediakan minuman jahe hangat free oleh museum. Di akhir perjalanan kita boleh foto di salah satu replika yang dibuat miring yang mengartikan agar generasi muda melestarikan budaya lokal. Biaya masuk terjangkau. Akses menuju lokasi harus pakai mobil pribadi/sewa
pelajaran sejarah dengan melihat langsung peninggalan jaman dahulu beserta arsip-arsip nya. Nuansa museum pun sangat klasik, dan ada air abadi nya lhoo
Museum yang sangat unik ditemani oleh seorang pemandu yang sangat pintar dan mengerti betul mengenai sejarah keraton Yogyakarta
This in my first time to find the well-maintain museum in Indonesia, especially in Jogjakarta city. Great place and they have both English and Indonesian guide.

The well-maintained museum itself was very charming. The collections were dominated by paintings of the royal families. These paintings were tools to tell the rich stories of the royalties from Kraton Yogyakarta and Surakarta. However, I felt that our guide was rushing us, and we couldn't really enjoy the artifacts properly. I read some articles and reviews written by people who visited the museum , and i felt they acquired more information from their guide than i did. I really feel that I need to revisit this beautiful museum one more time, with the assistance of a different guide naturally.

I'm not one for museum but this is my second visit there. so much has changed for the better. really love it here! 

tours are always so great and interactive.
Awal kesini karena suruh survey. males banget yekan denger namanya aja museum tapi pas sampai lokasi pas masuk ademmmmmmm banget, ga ngebosenin. ada guidenya dan ngejelasinnya ga buru-buru

This museum was built by an individual with a strong interest and passion in Yogyakarta and Solo Kingdoms. A good guide will explain about the background history of the split between Yogyakarta and Solo Kingdoms (KeSultanan) and walk us from room to room with old pictures, paintings, personal items and letters which explains the personalities and love life of the members of the Palace..

This place also has a boutique which sells batik clothes. Nice collections. !
Great museum to come and visit! The exhibits are laid out in organized way. Stories of Javanese Keraton were told short and sweet, romantic stories. Love the end piece too... worth the visit.

The museum provides multifaceted venues in inspiring a romantic nuance and discovering the hidden trasures inside an encyclopedia of the ancient virtues.

You could immerse yourself in the exploration inside the Javanese myths and legends at the Historical district of Kaliurang.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
I had visited the property twice and the museum is still great. Ullen Sentalu is the abbreviation of the Javanese words and exhibit modern arts, paintings, property, and sculpture that retell Royal Javanese Kingdoms that are from Keraton Yogyakarta and Kasunanan Solo. The exhibition are of massive for what modern Indonesian museums can offer, with the price of Rp 40.000 (please kindly update from time to time), you get free guide (Indonesian or English) that will guide and explain the history and arts in museum. Photography is strictly forbidden but there's a place for it in the end of the exhibition. The unique part of this museum is that you get free Javanese potion (non alcoholic) that is believed as a key of youth and classic traditional recipe from the renown figure of Javanese royalty as well.

A historical geek must visit the place as it retells you the comparison and similarities between two Javanese kingdom and my favorite part is the room of broken-hearted girl who wrote beautiful poems to confess her feeling, unfortunately no pictures taken inside of it.

They have a tour guide that will bring you around the museum (no extra charge). The guide will explain every single thing in the museum. At the end of the tour, they provide a healthy tea drink for all visitors
Tempatnya bagus, sejuk.. Arsitekturnya juga bagus, saya suka. Tur sejam ga kerasa .. Historical Place banget :)

This museum is build to memorize the family of Java Royalty (Kingdom / Keraton). For there are so many beautiful pieces of Java Culture, the museum offer both Indonesia & English speaking tour guides to retell the story of several kings, queens & princesses. The beautiful one, the heart broken one, the peculiar one to the rebellious one... I love this museum simply because it emphasizes a lot on the culture values of javanese.

A must visit museum. The museum is beautiful and well maintained. It focused on Javanese history, especially the history of the royal family of Mataram kingdom both in Yogya and Solo. The visitor will get jamu (traditional herb) in between tour.

The history of Java was interesting but felt the guide rushed us. 
She had memorized her part and then just simply presented the spiel .

This is a private and well maintained museum. Very high culture and full of education, so it's very good if you bring your kids and family here. For those history junkie, this is also a heaven. You will know the history of Yogyakarta and the culture. They provide local guide (which the friendliness needs to be improved) and you cannot take picture during the tour.

Museum ini terletak di daerah kaliurang. Museum ini milik swasta dan tidak besar. Koleksi di museum ini tidak masif. Kebanyakan koleksinya berkaitan dengan keluarga keraton Solo dan Yogya, terutama Solo. Dengan mengunjungi museum ini kita dapat lebih mengetahui sejarah keraton Yogya dan Solo terutama kehidupan dari beberapa anggota keluarga keraton. 
Walaupun tidak besar tetapi museum ini dikelola dengan sangat baik. Pemandu di sana sudah sangat terlatih dalam memberikan informasi dan memandu wisatawan yang berkunjung. 
Setelah selesai melihat koleksi museum kita dapat menikmati kafe di museum dan menikmati sejuknya kaliurang.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Privately owned and curated, so great effort.  Interesting history and well informed guide.  Wandering through the grounds is like a labyrinth. 

The Musuem shop has really beautiful and not found pret-a-porter batik designer clothes at affordable prices.  Love it.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The organizer of the forum that I attended took us to a museum tour at Ullen Sentalu and it was very informative about the Kings of Java and Indonesia and their families.  Also the kinds of batik that the royalties wear and the golden things that they used.  There are a lot of pictures of the King's families.  The tour guide was not boring and she explained the history with much enthusiasm and humor.

I didn't expect the visit to museum would be so much fun like this. Even it is far from the city, but worth to visit. You need to pay Rp 40.000 (for locals) to enter the museum and will get an informative guide. I like how they explained the historical of Kraton Jogjakarta, batik collections and meaning. Great place, you should visit when in Jogja!

Tempatnya oke sih, tiket 40rb untuk lokal waktu tur kira2 satu jam di pandu guide didalem tidak boleh foto2, koleksi cukup menarik yang kebanyakan adalah foto2 raja beserta kerabat raja, kekurangan tempat ini adalah kalo hujan karena satu tempat ke tempat lain adalah ruang terbuka

Last thursday was my first visit to ulen sentalu museum. It’s located on the top corner of kaliurang. I travelled by motorcycle and along the way, the scenery was beautifull. The entry fee is cheap (IDR 40.000 for local people). You will guide by one tour guide (they also provide english guide every 30 minutes) who have an excellent knowledge about the museum especially the historical of kraton Yogyakarta. You cannot take a picture or video along the tour but you’ll allowed to take picture later in 2 spot. They also provide a traditional drink (jamoo) that taste good. For you who curious about the historical of kraton Yogyakarta, this place is the right for you.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Museum ini sangat tepat dikunjungi untuk belajar mengenai sejarah Kerajaan di Jawa, dimana banyak dijelaskan budaya-budaya jawa seperti musik, pakaian, dan masih banyak lagi. Lukisan lukisan yang tersedia jg sangat menarik untuk dilihat.

Good place for history of jogja and good for kids education,the people are friendly..they guide us very details about all the things and the beginning of jogja..they explain about the mataram kingdom,the war versus other kingdom and the dutch,its a great experience to go there.

Ini museum koleksi pribadi. Memang tidak selengkap di Kraton Jogja. Biaya masuk lumayan mahal. Dan mengikuti tour keliling area dg guide yg disediakan. Sekali tour mencapai waktu sekitar 30 menitan. Suasananya adem, nyaman, sejuk, bersih. Ada restoran di bagian atas museum.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Interessante tentoonstelling van beelden, kleding en andere culturele wetenswaardigheden. De gids legt alles uitvoerig uit en is bijzonder vriendelijk. Daarna gegeten in het restaurant met een Europese menukaart. Dit wat onze eerste niet-Indonesische maaltijd sinds meer dan een week

Museum yang sangat menarik dan harus dikunjungi klo ke jogja, menyimpan banyak cerita mengenai sejarah keraton, foto-foto, sejarah baju adat keraton jawa, dll. tapi sayangnya tidak boleh foto-foto mungkin krn memang kebanyakan barang pribadi

Jangan lewatkan untuk membeli souvenir di akhir perjalanan

Klo ke jogja lagi, saya pasti akan mengunjungi Ulen sentalu lagi

This museum can only be seen with a guide every half hour. 
Our guide was friendly and spoke good English.
The exhibition is almost completely on the line of recent Kings, showing paintings and photographs. If you are interested this can be worth going. Otherwise skip the long ride there.
it was a nice place to spend time and enrich your knowledge about Jogja history. they have lovely collection and good stories from the guides

Mengenal lebih jauh silsilah keluarga kerajaan Mataram,budaya dan sejarah peradaban.
tempatnya asri,hawanya sejuk.

If you are ibto history and trivia, this place is a must visit. You will know so much about the royal family of Jogjakarta.
There are also a lot of good "sate" or Indonesian skewer near this museum.
I reccomend you try Sate Kelinci or Rabbit skewer. I know it sounds awfyl. At first I was also hesitant. But turns out it was one of the best meat I've ever tried!!!
Ingin mengetahui sejarah keluarga kraton joja solo dan peninggalan peninggalannnya bisa datang kemari, terdapat pula koleksi lukisan, foto dan batik yang masih terawat baik
lokasi di komplek Kaliurang, di lereng Gunung Merapi. Museum ini merupakan milik pribadi yang dikelola dengan sangat bagus.

This museum has a homely feel, beautiful and tranquil. I love it that the guide explains the Javanese history.

I felt my 9 year old didn't understand the explanation but my 11 year old did, a little bit. 

It's a wonderful museum and well kept
Jika ingin mengetahui secara mendalam tentang keluarga keraton Yogya, datanglah kemari. Saran saya, gunakan jasa tour guide agar mendapatkan informasi yang jelas dan tepat.

Dengan biaya Rp.30.000, kita berdelapan masuk ke museum, biaya ini dah termasuk tiket masuk, guide, dan drink( jamu), di lobby masuk ada ruang tunggu yang ada patung rama shinta, kayaknya mang ruang lobby ini lagi renov dan blom jadi ya, sekitar 10 menit nunggu, guide nya datang, dan mulai membawa kita masuk ruang2, gak boleh foto2 di museum ini dan ac nya sangat dingin, jadi museum ini mengenai silsilah keluarga keraton dari pecahnya kerajaan di pulau jawa sampai sekarang, solo juga dibahas disini, agak creepy juga ya soalnya cuma kita ma guide di ruangan kecil dengan lampu2 redup, sambil ceritain kel keraton yang dah pada wafat semua, ada juga sejarah kain batik, dan barang2 peninggalan keraton, bahkan surat2 putri2 dan permaisuri, karena kita masuk jam 4 dan jam 5 museum dah ditutup jadi guidenya jelasinnya agak cepat dan ada bbrp ruangan yang di skip, sebenarnya kalo boleh2 foto2 ada spot2 yang bagus, di penghujung kita disuguhi jamu yang katanya bagus buat kesehatan, overall kalo kita tertarik ma sejarah museum ini bagus, masalahnya saya gak suka ma history jadi agak2 bosen, tapi baru tau kalo jaman kemerdekaan dulu putri2 keraton banyak yang udah sekolah ke luar negeri dengan pake jaket2 berbulu, enak ya jadi putri, keluar museum parkir dah sepi dan pohon2 rindang di sekeliling museum bikin  gelap dan merinding, pesan saya kalo kemari jgn mepet2 mau tutup ya, 2 jam sebelumnya cukuplah
Well maintained museum with a good collection and narration with an English speaking guide. The gift shop had beautiful batik, but very expensive. No photos are allowed to be taken inside.
We can learn a lot from this Museum. Especially about Kesultanan Yogyakarta and Solo. i love to hear the explanation from our tour guide. They tell us about philosophy, history, and culture.

Indeed, I was very impressed with all collections, in & out design, management and museum staff which managed to bring me in the royal palace life especially romance story of royal family. Kind of masterpiece, this museum provides a new paradigm which completely different with other museums in Indonesia. Also, technology was involved in supporting the museum objective and make guests convenience inside. You will not get bored exploring all corners
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Musium ini unik. Uniknya adalah museum ini hanya memajangkan foto-foto silsilah kerajaan Yogyakarta & Solo. Untuk masuk ke dalam museum ini kita dipandu oleh guide. Guide akan memandu dan menjelaskan satu persatu foto yang kita lihat. Uniknya lagi museum ini terbagi dalam beberapa area yang dibagi sesuai dengan temanya.

What a great place and guide 😊
Must visit place when you visit Jogjakarta..

More knowledge historical about Keraton Jogjakarta and Solo 😘

so amazed with the museum, but the tour is too short. We really had in mind to go the 2nd round tour that day because the museum was so beautiful, the architecture itself and the history of the javanese kingdom were magical. Don't forget to get lunch in the museum's restaurant, its sooo good!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
wonderful experience !! this is how a museum should be delivered.
the history lesson and everything behind it just wrap everything just perfect.

One of the best museum experience. Our guide was Ibu Ida, she was very enthusiastic, she sucks you in with her knowledge. I hope they will continue to expand their collection, so much history is lost in Indonesia, we need more museums like this. If you love history, you would really love this museum. Bring an umbrella on a rainy day!

We had a smaller tour and it was very informative.  The most information we have received during our time here.  Our driver said the museum is run by the royal family but the docent told us it is the private collection of a successful business man.  Hmm...both, perhaps? 

Regardless, check it out.  The location is also strange...in the middle of nowhere, but it was probably welcomed by the nearby families.
Visited the museum several times, I have never get bored with any of it. They have very interesting stories inside it, and good restaurant as well!

Untuk yang suka dengan sejarah pastinya wajib mengunjungi museum ini ya, museumnya unik, koleksinya lengkap walaupun lokasinya lumayan jauh dari kota tapi museum ini harus masuk agenda salah satu yang dikunjungi. Pemandunya juga ramah2 tapi memang ga boleh foto2, tidak masalah sebenarnya malah jadi fokus untuk mendengarkan penjelasan dari pemandu tentang sejarah-sejarah. Tidak akan bosan untuk ke musem ini lagi karena benar2 menarik.
Very recommended place to visit in Jogja if you want to know the begining all of the royalty in Jogja..
The museum is made alive with the interesting stories by the guide. It has well curated exhibits which shows the lineage of leadership in Jogja and their culture.

Had a toss up between this and another destination due to time constraints and chose this. Turned out to be a good decision. Its a private museum which showcases the royal lineage for the Yogyakarta and Solo region and the artefacts. The commentary was excellent and that probably made the difference if you want a good understanding of an attraction, which is uncommon here in Yogyakarta.

The tour is managed well and the guide explained the importance of the things there clearly, although the pace is a bit fast as they have to stay on schedule. 

The only time allowed to take pictures is at the end.
Keren pokoknya, tempatnya adem tdk terasa capek meski jalannya cukup lama, ada guide yg memandu sayang gk boleh foto2
Bunch of culture science and art science of Jogjakarta since its inception. If you are interested in Jogjakarta culture, especially the Kasultanan (palace), this place is must visit!

(+) : it's a 60-90 minutes interactive guided tour. Two thumbs up for the tour guide who told us about the history and culture in the museum. The museum is very clean and even smells so good. The decoration is unique and doesn't leave any creepy feeling like most museums. It has a well decorated restaurant with good view. 

(-) : far from the city centre. Can't take a picture inside the museum.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
The ticket is pretty cheap for the museum tour. Clean, original, great management. But taking picture inside the museum is forbidden.. 😞

At the exit, there are some sellers of salak. We can buy wether salak pondoh or salak madu 🙂

Good building, nice restaurant and great batik boutiqe "putri malu"
Near jadah mbah Carik .. delicious local cullinary..

Tidak banyak museum yang menyediakan tour yang menyenangkan. Museum Ullen Sentalu adalah salah satu museum yang menyediakan tempat untuk tour historis kerajaan Yogya-Solo. Sangat menyenangkan untuk berada disini. Kekurangannya adalah tidak boleh foto di sembarang tempat

A wonderful museum that's located in a nice setting with comfortable weather.  Fairly small venue,  but very focused & well curated exhibits.  Certainly worth checking out if you enjoy a bit of history & some artwork!

Ce musée est bien entretenu et très propre, le guide était accueillant, savant et amusant, leur collection d'objets d'art était magnifique. J'ai beaucoup aimé les tableaux. Le billet d'entrée n'était pas cher même pour les touristes étrangers. Et oui, c'est interdit de prendre des photos à l'intérieur mais bon, ça va. C'était une agréable journée.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Best museum so far, really like how they present it and the collection is very good. No photograph inside the museum. Not wheelchair friendly
There has an own tour guide to bring us and explain around the museum story. From here we can know more the Javanese culture.

Best museum i visited so far. It's located at kaliurang, in the pines forest area. The museum is about the history of Yogyakarta palace family. The ticket entrance is about IDR 35.000. You will be divided into a group of 7-10 people probably (i forgot), each group will be lead by a guide. The guide described very well.

This place so relaxing , i am feeling relax and so happy when visit this place on july 8 , restaurant so good for taste and  also for the  environment  , need to come back again when visit jogja or magelang

Its not that essy to get here, it takes a while but its beautiful and you get to se some art and learn about some remarkable persons in the javanese history. If you got the time and likes culture, you should get out here!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: A very nice Museum with a modern touch. the location was cool as it wasn't busy during that time. You'll be taken to a trip back in time and learning about the history of Java.

Kami sekeluarga mengunjungi museum ini libur lebaran kemarin 23 Juni 2017.

Museum swasta terbaik menurut saya. Berlokasi tidak jauh dari Tlogo Putri - Kaliurang

Dengan Rp. 30.000 / orang kami mendapatkan tour museum selama kurang lebih 45 menit dipandu oleh guide yang akan bercerita tentang isi museum. Note : Tidak boleh mengambil foto koleksi yang ada disini. 

Berisi tentang koleksi lukisan, alat musik, arca, patung, surat, foto, batik dan kesenian lain dari kerajaan Yogya & Solo. Koleksi terawat dengan baik. Lampu otomatis menyala dengan sensor gerak sepertinya, sempat mengejutkan saya. Dengan AC, ruangan menjadi nyaman untuk anak saya yang masih 1 tahun. Ditengah perjalanan ada ruangan kita disuguhkan jamu sambil kita beristirahat.

Di akhir tour terdapat spot untuk foto dan ada toko souvenir dan restoran.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Aku kesini cuma buat menikmati udara pegunungan yang masih segar. Dari arahbtugu jogja kita bisa langsung ke utara lurus terus aja kalo menggunakan motor, melewati perkampungan penduduk dan jalan 2 kampung. Kalau pakai mobil bisa lewat jalan kaliurang.

The museum is beautiful and filled with artwork and historical objects that are very precious and beautiful.

The museum is very comfortable with good groove rides, plus a guide that is very eloquent giving explanations so that every historic object and timeline can be well understood.

Every corner of the museum, interior and exterior is designed and well-laid out, blending modern and traditional elements beautifully.
A must visit museum in Yogyakarta !
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Musee privé avec un guide obligatoire (inclus dans l entrée au prix international) en anglais qui parle très bien.
On apprend pleins de choses sur la region et le batik.
Seul regret il est interdit de prendre des photos c est bien dommage quand on vient de l autre côté de la planète...

museum managed by private (not government) 
it is good that they must provide with tour guide for all visitor, so we get to know the stories. it is about the history of Mataram kingdom.
must visit museum when you got a chance to yogyakarta 👍👍

Museum yg unik baik lokasi maupun tata letak ruang dan brg2nya. Berisi sejarah klrga keraton. Sgt menarik utk diketahui anak2 sekolah. Bersih. Koleksi cukup lengkap. Guide ckp profesional. Akan lebih menarik jika ada pertunjukan live. Sec keseluruhan sangat baik. Direkomendasikan buat semua kalangan.😍

Museumny menarik, setiap pengunjung mendapat pemandu yang akan mengantar dan menjelaskan ke setiap ruangan. Koleksinya cukup lengkap tapi blm terlalu banyak. Disini kita tidak boleh mengambil foto, hanya boleh berfoto di spot-spot tertentu.

Very happy with our decision to check out this museum. A bit further up at Kaliurang area. Best to go with ur own vehicle/car rental since public transport not availavle there. Shall you go with online apps transport you can make a deal with the driver to wait for u. Once you arrives, you need to buy for ticket 1st 30k IDR per pax. Then wait for a while for one of their charming and knowledgeable guide to escort you through each rooms. Beautiful painting and history will wow you during your visit. Cute gesture from the museum was by giving you a short break while enjoying the warm traditional drink by 3/4 time of ur visit. It is world class quality museum, really worth the money n time. After your visit you can enjoy lunch or snacking at the bistro there and also maybe shopping at their boutique. Love it so much and hopefully the management keep doing a good job in maintaining the place
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Love the ambience with Javanese culture. Feels like the royalty going through the history of our ancestors.

If you like Javanese history, maybe this is one of the places you have to visit. I said 'maybe' because not much you can see or learn here. It took 1,5 to travel from other part of the city to this place and the tour only took 30 minutes. The guide brought us to see collections of pictures, paintings, documents, fabrics in glass windows from room to room and explained what's all about in a rush. That's it. You can't see the collection without guide. As we finished the tour, we realize that there are some interesting spots and statues but we don't have access to see it. Short say, this museum actually has plenty to offer but doesn't grant access to visitors to see them all. Too bad. If Kraton Yogyakarta is in your itinerary, that's more than enough, no need to go to Ullen Sentalu.

I have visited this museum 4 times and never get bored to listen to Yogyakarta and Middle Java Kingdom.
Cozy ambience and the guide is a good story teller.
The location of the museum is up on the foot of Merapi volcano. The museum is small but it has nice royal collections unfortunately some rooms are restricted for visitors
Interessante tentoonstelling rondom de koninklijke families rond Jogjakarta. Ook komt de geschiedenis van batik aan bod.

The museum is well designed and developed. Thumbs up for the artist team. It is recommended to visit Kraton Yogyakarta (Yogyakarta Palace) first before going to Ullen Sentalu, since the stories of Kraton Family told in the museums are connected one another. Thus visiting those museums will help us to comprehend the history more.

Saya datang hari ini sekitar jam 11siang..dan..rame.
Masuk langsung ketemu meja resepsionis..ada 2 mbak mbak..saya tanya isinya apa. Dijawab museum isinya barang barang bersejarah., then saya tanya knapa antri caranya seperti apa..malah dijawab..tanya sama meja sbelah sana mbak(resepsionis atau kasir?!?gajelas.)saya kearah meja yg ditunjuk n rame semua orng ngumpul, masnya datang setelah 2menit sambil ngomel nyinyir keibuk ibuk yg lg nulis waiting list by herself...ditanya ini buka jam brp modelnya seperti apa..dijawab sambil nulis..5menit sekali masuk gantian...jawaban n cara jawab ga enak bgt. 
The point is...pelayanannya ga prepare kalo banyak tamu..kurang pro...

museumnya enak, jawa banget, budaya jawa banget, museumnya nyaman tapi dilarang foto didalam museum,
harganya lumayan , 30k per person htmnya.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Worth visiting for a snapshot of recent Javanese history. Very well set up for international visitors as entry includes a dedicated language specific guide. That said, it all felt a little rushed with the guide moving us from one room to the next quite quickly.
개인 만들어 운영하는 박물관으로 영어 전문 도우미가 자세하게 설명해 주어 족자카르타와 솔로의 역사와 문화를 배웠습니다.왕족의 역사와 네덜란드 식민통치 결혼식과 왕족들의 모습을 그림으로 전시하고, 전통의 바틱에 대한 상세한 설명을 들었습니다. 지역마다 특색과 문양마다 의미를 알수 있어서 좋았습니다.
meseum yang menarik untuk mengetahui buadaya yogya. koleksi prop nya menarik. harga tiket yang terjangkau

Its quite located far away from Yogyakarta's downtown, located at the bottom of Merapi volcano the surrounding of this museums is quite cool and calm. The museum located at the end of Jalan Kaliurang (around KM 25) and its not that hard to find the way to this museum.

I thought at the first the ticket of this museum is quite expensive (Around 50.000 Rupiah/ 5 USD) for locals like me.

But i was wrong, the visit is totally worth every single penny!

No photo/video allowed, and we wil exploring the museum with a guide (a experienced ones) who will guide us around many sectors of the museum where every side of the museum has its own unque story, and the guide is very kind and willing to help to answer your curiousity! 

I was impressed by both the story and also the collections at the museum, its HUGE collections and every collections has it owns stories, with some mystical atmosphere

This museums has to be at the top list for any foreigners that visit Yogyakarta (beside prambanan and borobuddur temple), be ready to be impressed!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
In the beginning we came here because we read they have nice places to take photos as I traveled with my cousin who is an avid photographer.
Turns out this is a museum where your are required to take the guided tour. But in the end it was a nice guided tour. The guide was very knowledgeable and enthusiastic. The points that she shared were interesting points, enough to get our attention. There are only selected locations to take pictures as you're not allowed to photographed inside the museum.

Museum yang isinya sejarah keraton jogja dan surakarta. Dengan pemandu museum yg kompeten dan supel, kami serasa diajak berwisata sambil belajar. Lokasi di lereng gunung merapi diantara hutan sehingga sejuk

Just visited this museum as opined by my resourceful tour guide driver. I must say worth every cents/rupiahs that you're going to pay.

Rich in Yogyakarta Royals heritage beginnings, breathtaking structure, paintings, sculptures & ambience. To add & spice things up, my english guide (a pretty bespectacled local lady) just made our tour much more interesting and lively. Kudos to her and wish I knew her name thou.

Unfortunately, no photos and cameras are allowed once you're in due to the museum strict policy. Nevertheless, a must visit for anyone dropping by to Yogya. I'm glad I did !
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
The somewhat remote location of the museum plays a large part of the charm of the place. The lushness of the surrounding makes the area very cool, and beautiful. 

The museum is partly funded by the royal family and a large part of the exhibits are about the royal family with many items, paintings and correspondence on display. 

If you decide to take a taxi there, you will want to negotiate with the taxi driver to wait for you, since there's no place to hail a taxi around the museum. You may need to wait for a guided tours to start so it may take more than an hour to finish.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Great museum for history lovers, where you can find the sultanate history of Jogjakarta. Unfortunately we can't take photos because of some private collection inside. 
Highly recommended.
Museum ini bagus sebagai edukasi untuk tidak melupakan adat, budaya dan sejarah yang telah ada sebelumnya sebagai warisan leluhur
You will be amazed by stories told. you will learn about cultures. and differences between Jogjakarta and Solo Kingdom .
menyenangkan sekali berada disini, betah untuk berlama lama ..pokoknya museum yang recomended sekali

Well since you cannot take any photos there, the only thing you could do is follow the tour guide explaination on the exhibit. The museum however, emphasized on Javanese history and not the culture itself. The tour guide we had talk quite fast, thus we recommend to come in small group to minimize the interruption between one and other tourist. The interior was really classy and nice. On the other hand, we tought that the tour guide's knowledge and the museum was one of the best in Indonesia.

The location is in Kaliurang, about an hour from Yogyakarta. It's a private museum which shows us some of their collection about the Javanesse culture heritage. It takes about 35-40 minutes to complete the tour.

We cannot take pictures here. 
They are doing renovation to expand their collection. 

They also have Beukenhoff Restaurant at the site.

Walaupun lokasinya cukup jauh dari pusat kota, museum ini wajib dikunjungi ketika datang ke kota Yogyakarta. Selain tempat nya yang unik, asri, sejuk dan nyaman kita bisa menambah ilmu tentang sejarah keraton dengan didampingi pemandu yang ramah tentunya. Pada sesi akhir kita akan disuguhi minuman khas ullen sentalu yaitu minuman teh awet muda :)

Our mistake was trying to squeeze in too many visits--Prambanan as well--within a day, which included heavy rains. From lunch at the Beukenhof Restaurant, our group rushed to the museum and had a "quick" tour that challenged our guide to select the details to highlight in local history. She was more than up to the challenge. The museum fascinates because of the curated exhibits and the narratives that focus on women and gender relations in the past. I enjoyed the insights and even the downpour.
Its private museum. i came with my 2 kids and they got bored because we don't really know about king history, how they explain also too fast.

Museum ini memang sedikit unik . Kita akan dibawa kembali ke tengah-tengah budaya Jawa yang khas dan menarik.  Letaknya memang cukup jauh dari kota yogya bahkan di kawasan Merapi . Tapi setelah menikmati jalan2 atau Merapi tur kita bisa bersantai sambil lebih jauh mengenal budaya Jawa .
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: if you want to get a different museum, you should go there. this is private museum. They provide a guide, they explain very good

Nice museum run by non goverment, but the facility were tremendous, well run and very clean compare to goverment museum, nice group guide to, elevating our knowledge about history, we love the story about Gusti Nurul😍

I've been to Yogyakarta so many times but have never heard of this museum until my brother recommended it. 

It's a small but beautiful private museum. The location is a bit far from the city centre. We hired Grab taxi to get here and it was a bit of a hike. 

The museum told a brief history of Yogyakarta and Surakarta royal families. Our guide was very engaging and knowledgeable. She explained the different meaning of batik patterns and also told the life story of the princess. There are beautiful paintings and original photos of the royal families. It's a lovely little place to spend the afternoon.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: We enjoyed our visit to this museum and the German restaurant adjacent to it.  The museum is small but has many interesting photos and artifacts related to Indonesia's history and the free guide was very informative and spoke good English.

Entrance fee Rp50,000, cannot just walk inside,have to wait for tour guide to lead the journey.  
We wait for about 20 minutes and join with another 3 tourist then lead by staff who explain very well and showing us on each section in the museum in sequence.  The environment of each section is quite unique, and many impressive paintings of the Sultan family.

Unfortunately inside the museum not allow to take photo. 
I enjoy the history tell by the guide. Worth to come and visit.
nice place to bring your family here, you can add your knowledge about Javanese culture in here, this place have a great architecture and unique styles, a lot of photo spot..
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Perhaps, because it's a private museum, it's very well-maintained. Although the ancient goods are not that many, what was really nice is that we can learn about the Javanese kingdom. The guide was really professional, and they really know their thing (honestly, I was intrigued and am now very interested to learn the history of Javanese kingdom). They're telling stories with a help from paintings and letters. It's really great to experience a good historical storytelling!

This is a private museum. One of the best attraction as they provide English speaking guide who patiently and clearly explains. I like the batik origin tour. Romances of the royal family was nice to hear. This location is around Merapi. You are not allowed to take pictures here.
Tempatnya lumayan jauh dari pusat kota Yogyakarta tapi sangat menarik untuk dikunjungi. Penuh dengan sejarah dari Jawa

Creative and beautiful museum and quite informative. Unique Museum in the middle of the Outskirt forestry environment. Superb collection and good Tour Guide who communicate well with the visitor and have a good sense of humor. No photo taking is allowed in the museum except outside the museum.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Ini adalah salah satu museum terbaik di Indonesia. Sangat menyenangkan belajar sejarah di sini. Saya belajar banyak tentang kesultanan dan keraton Jogjakarta. Koleksinya sangat terawat, tempatnya asri rapi dan bersih. Pemandunya ramah dan kompeten. Saya merekomendasikan tempat ini sebagai destinasi wajib saat berkunjung ke Jogjakarta.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
The place is about 20  kms from the city center. It is up to the higher place so the atmosphere is very cool and fresh. It is best place to get refreshed from the terrible traffic down at the city. So if you want to learn about royal family, this place is good to start. You maybe want to stop at Warung Kopi Klotok. It is very good to taste real Java eating menu. It is located in the mid between the museum and the city. I myself came here by motorbike, so it is good place to break the trip into two rides. 
Telegram @Umi_getme
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Museum was very nice and very recommendation when visiting Jogjakarta. Her collection is very complete with a guide that explains in detail about the history of the kingdom of Mataram. It is appropriate if the visitors are prohibited from taking pictures because it's personal collection. So visitors will focus explanation of the guide that explains each photo and collections of this museum. Morning, very fit when visiting this museum.
這是一個私宅活化成的私人博物館。外國人要先註冊，票價不貴，等待免費的解說員帶領。有能說英文的專業解說（不是那些城裡景點外面想討小費的）帶你走完全程，講述爪哇王國和君主家庭和前世今生，讓我了解了很多新的知識，還會請你喝一杯特色熱飲。樓上有餐廳和cafe。是整個旅程中感覺最舒服、最值得一來的地方。
Ulun sentalu is like museum and located for approximately 1 hour from city center of Yogya. Nice place for family travel, a good restaurant and park
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Ullen Sentalu Museum is a private-owned museum, belongs to a close relative of the Javanese royals. In this museum, you can see private belongings of the royal family such as paintings, letters, even jewelries.
All about Javanese kingdom history is explained in about an hour walk through with a guide. So you don't have to worry about getting lost or confused, because the guide is very clear in explaining right from the beginning to the end of the door.
You can't take pictures in here, as all the things in the museum is private collection.
Only a few spots outside that is allowed to be taken pic of.
But i guarantee you will love the museum, the storytelling, and the experience in all.

I visited it in a rainy day. It's far away from the center, more than 60 minutes driving. But, I was interested in the way they decor this museum, so strange and mysterious. It made me feel like that I was in the ancient time. Thanks to this museum, I know more about the history of Yogya. The disadvantage of this museum is prohibiting taking photo, so pity!

This is a well-organised museum about the sultans of Jogjakarta and Solo of the early 20th century. On display are paintings in well-crafted wooden frames, photos, batik and music instruments. Every 30 minutes, a guided tour in English starts, as it seems every quarter to and quarter past the hour, which takes about 1 hour to complete. Explained are the setup of the houses, their relations (also with the Dutch royal family), their tradions, the origins of batik motives and dances. The number of visitors in the weekend is about twice the number at a working day, though completely manageable. The price for non-Indonesian adults is Rp 50k. You are not allowed to take pictures. 
The restaurant "Beukenhof" at the end of the tour is situated in a building with both Indonesian and Dutch colonial features. The menu is quite extended. Much water and many trees around that create a relaxating ambiance. Since it is on the volcano slope, the temperature is lower, around 25 degr. C.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: If you imagined a museum as a large white clean building, try this one. Visiting Ullen Sentalu museum, give me a different experience. The building architecture was quite different from common museum building. Outside decorationwas was dominated by andesite natural stone, combined with wood and some metal accents. Nice building. Inside, a tale-of-the-princes-and-princesses of Javanese (Jogjakarta) sultanate was displayed in various forms, mainly by pictures, memoirs, letters, personal belongings and so on. We enjoyed our time here. Two hours went by quickly. Recommended for family with teenage children, wishes to know Javanese culture better. PS : get some nice Ullen Sentalu t-shirts here (you wouldn't find them elsewhere) !!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: museum ini kental sekali nuansa adat jawanya, saya sangat menyukai susana yang tenang,sejuk.. guide sangat ramah dan menjelaskan sejarah dari setiap sudat museum  dengan sangat jelas.
Tiket lumayan...dan ada 2 model guide tour (pk bhs indonesia dan pk bhs inggris)..bagus banget, tertatah rapih, bersih...dapet segelas air jahe "gratis"n bisa foto2...kalo laper ada restorannya
tiket masuk resto yang cukup mahal dibanding objek wisata lain, tapi sangat bagus, profesional, dan penjelasan yang cukup jelas. Di salam ada berbagai koleksi, lukisan, benda, batik.

If you want an insight into the current culture of Indonesia and the royal family this is the place. Our guide was very knowledgable and offered great trinkets to enhance our understanding of the heritage of Yogyakarta. No photos really allowed inside, but there are musical instruments, and pictures drawn of the Sultans/Kings and their families. Each one has to design a unique dance in his rule....interesting. Well worth the stop.

This museum give you information about life of Javanese princesses.You can not wander around by yourself, a tour guide will lead you through a certain route. Enjoy the surprise of what you may see in each section of your tour and have a nice traditional Javanese drink at the end of the tour.
Sangat puas dengan koleksi lukisan disana, guide nya begitu ramah kalo kesana rasanya ingin kembali lagi

I visited the museum with an expectation that I would get an insight information of Javanese Royal Family and Culture. My first impression was excellent. The lobby is very promising with it's modern look and open concept.

However as we guided through, it turned out to be a 50 minutes of listening to a rush Guide. It's collections couple with Big Group (20 people) makes the guide kind of rushing to ensure time is not exceeded.

My expectation of being in a museum is walking slowly, enjoying the ambience while reading on the given information. Need more information tools such as audio visual.

Architecture of the place is unique with lots of rooms and corridors which disallowed us to go back to previous scenes. Would prefer to have it more open and more light to have an open ambience and atmosphere.

In summary, the museum has a lot of potential to be a much better one, considering it's collections.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Their location is far from downtown, located at kaliurang, near from merapi volcano, the atpmosphere of museum is so comfortable, garden everywhere, and we can find some statue from hindu and budha kingdom (mostly in Mataram periode) and inside the museum we can find some javanese traditional instruments such as gamelan, royal family pictures, batik material from the ancient mataram, there is a restaurant if we get hungry. Over all i feel like at home in there.. nice scenery and great treasure.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Best museum in Jogja! Love how there's a designated guide for each groups and the explanation is in English!
This museum dedicated to Javanese royal families. They also provides shop for hi taste of batiks and fashion accessories
museumnya tersembunyi didaerah kaliurang. sangat mengedukasi pengunjung, memiliki suasana yangtenang.

Ich war - und bin - nachhaltig beeindruckt von der Architektur, Ausstattung und Sorgfalt dieses Museums, von inhaltlichen Aspekten mal abgesehen. Auch die Lage am Fuß des Merapi ist herrlich. 
Ich hatte eine kompetente englischsprachige Führung, die umfassende Info zu allen Exponaten lieferte. Einziger Kritikpunkt: es kommen nur die Royals - Rajas & Sultane - vor, die normalen Bürger erscheinen nur als Diener, Tänzerinnen o. ä. Dieser Blick auf die javanische Geschichte ist natürlich sehr eingeschränkt und einseitig. Nichtsdestotrotz, ein Kulturgenuss.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: This museum has a unique architecture and unique concept, located in kaliurang complex near of merapi mountain. All the thing inside the museum telling about the kingdom of java (jogja n solo). And the interesting one, in the end of a tour, the give us a special drink, taste so good.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
It is indeed a bit far from the city, but for me personally it was really worth visiting. Being inside is like being in a journey where you learn the history in a chronological order. The guide is expert in telling the story and make it relateable (keep it up!). Content of the museum might be really simple -- which is about Javanese culture, but it was extensively arranged with a lot of visuals, so it was easy to understand the whole story.
It's strictly prohibited to take photo inside , so you shouldn't be disturbed by people who go there for leisure, sit and make noise, etc. At the exit, there is a good restaurant with nice dessert -- totally goes along with the hill view and especially when it rains.
There so many things you can learn and see in this place. Not only the historical and traditional collections are nice, the guide and the buildings of museum itself are also great.

Pagi itu kita mencari lokasi Museum Ullen Sentalu.
Tempat ini sudah sangat terkenal di kalangan wisatawan dan terutama penduduk Jogja.
Karena kita datang sangat pagi (saat itu masih jam 8) jalanan cukup lengang dan kita belum ditahan untuk membayar tarif masuk ke desa tempat museum ini berada.
Hanya biaya masuk ke dalam museum yang perlu kita bayar yaitu IDR 30.000 (termasuk tour guide+minuman jahe khas yang katanya dapat membuat AWET MUDA) ;)
Sesampainya di museum, udara dan suasananya masih sangat segar. Terlebih museum ini tertutup dengan tanaman dan pepohonan. Sama sekali tidak terlihat ada bangunan besar yang menyimpan sejarah di dalamnya. Bangunan ini merupakan contoh bangunan Arsitektur Vernakular yang baik.
Di dalam museum kita tidak diperbolehkan untuk mengambil foto terkait masalah hak cipta dan privasi dari pemilik museum. Kecuali dibeberapa tempat yang memang diperbolehkan untuk berfoto.
Tetapi justru hal inilah yang menarik, kita jadi punya sejuta alasan untuk kembali lagi menikmatinya.
Kita sama sekali tidak akan lelah dan bosan saat menyusuri koleksi museum ini. Selain itu kita juga jadi mendapatkan banyak pengetahuan dan informasi tentang kesultanan Yogyakarta dan Surakarta.
Seandainya semua museum di Indonesia seperti ini, pastilah semua orang rajin mencari tahu dan lebih menghargai sejarah.
:)
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This private-owned museum really blow my mind. The collection is in a great shape, the place is amazing, the guide is very patience for answering our question -- and she knows all of the answers! The only thing you need to note is: you can't take any pictures inside the museum, including the collections (except for a few photo spots) due to a copyright matter. We had to leave our tripods in the ticket booth area, but don't worry, the staff kept it safe. Will recommend this museum to my art and culture loving friends.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Visited this museum with some friends. This museum represented the flash back of Javanese culture, batik, and arts. Highly recommended for those who's into arts and Javanese history. We had camera however its not allowed to take any pic inside within the tour. 
The place is at the top of the hill, with nice fresh air and greens around. More visitors during holiday season, however It's still OK for visit, as the museum tour are well-organised by the management. 

It was a short visit takes around 2-3 hours. There's a tour guide who explain and answer your questions. Museum interior are modern, simple and nice. 
Worth a try.

Ullen Sentalu is a museum dedicated to the Javanese culture and art. It's located in the north of Yogyakarta.
 It has a lot of collection from the late kings of Java. The entry ticket is around Rp 30.000,00, and then they gave you the tour into the museum by devided  the visitors into small group of 10. Inside the tour they tell you the history of Javanese kingdom and the culture. They also gave us a glass of "jamu" -Javanese traditional drink-. It's not like other museum, it has a beautiful sceneary and got a very fresh weather. What makes it unique is that it's built like a cave. You should visit this museum if you want to know more about Javanese culture and art in a different way.

saat menuju lokasi ini...suasanya angker...tapi saat masuk ke museum ini...lumayan kaget dengan pelayanannya...karena kita Benar2 dipandu dari awal sampe akhir...keren tempatnya seperti Bawah tanah...jadi anyak tahu tentang keBudayaan jawa...cuma sayang tidak diperBolehkan Berfoto didalam museum ini... kalau untuk mengunjungi lagi coBa Bersama keluarga...akan leBih Bermakna..
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Dengan berkunjung ke Ulen Sentalu, sedikit banyaknya kita tahu sejarah para putri dan raja Yogya Solo. 

Pemandu cukup bersahabat, riang dan informatif. Terimakasih banyak ^^

The building, facade, and interior are representing modern, natural, and ethnic style which is very great for an art and culture museum. All the collections are still in a good shape and well maintained. Every group of approximately 10 or more people are guided with 1 personal tour guide, helps the visitors immersing Javanese viscous culture. Such a great visit and service!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
I visited this museum with my wife without any expectation. Finished with our Lava Tour in Merapi, we're looking for slow and relaxing agenda. And this museum seems to fit the bill.

And it does, and more! 

Being ran by private collectors, I think this museum is one of the best I've ever visited in Indonesia. Its collections mainly are stuffs from Javanese culture (and Jogja Empire, obviously). It has batiks, uniforms, pictures, statues, ceramics, paintings and many others. But what made this museum was very interesting was because of their guides! The guides were clearly trained to take every group of visitors to understand and appreciate the museum's collections. I am a Javanese, and lived and studied in Jogja for 5 years, but clearly my visit to this musem added my knowledge and appreciation to Jogja and Javanese culture, particularly also its heritage and relationship with Kingdom of Netherland. 

For those who loves art and history, and are looking for slow getaway and 1-2 hours visit in Jogja, this museum is definitely should be on top of your list. Not sure if kids would love this place though. 

And don't forget to stop by at the cafe in this museum complex. The ambience is nice and the food are also not bad. Recommended!

A short pictorial journey through the history of Yogyakarta. The place is built like a cave and has generous contributions of personal mementos from the royal families that form the history of Yogyakarta and nearby kingdoms
Join an English guided tour and enjoy stories from Sultans court. We liked the stories of beautiful princess who broke the traditions bravely and lived their own way.

Setelah membeli tiket seharga Rp 30.000/orang (dewasa), kami menunggu sekitar 5 menit sebelum dipanggil. Setiap kelompok akan mendapat guide, yang akan menemani berkeliling kawasan selama sekitar 50 menit.
Museum ini bercerita tentang keluarga kerajaan Solo dan Yogya. Lengkap dengan foto-foto dan barang-barang yang mewakili sejarah. Yang disimpan dalam bangunan yang berbeda, yang diantara bangunan terdapat jalan setapak dan taman. Kami tidak diperkenankan mengambil foto, selain di tempat yang telah disediakan. Sayang saya tidak menanyakan apa yang terjadi bila saat berkeliling turun hujan.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Dari beberapa museum yang pernah saya kunjungi di daerah Pulau Jawa. Museum Ullen Sentalu ini, merupakan museum yang terkeren yang pernah saya kunjungi selain Museum Sampoerna di Surabaya. Minusnya, harganya terlalu mahal dan tidak disediakan fasilitas payung jika hujan.

Ullen Sentalu is the best museum in Jogja. They provide complete family tree of Keraton Jogja and Solo monarchy. Their painting collections and traditional batik collections are awesome. You will get new knowledge about Javanese tradition and history. The museum architecture is like a labyrinth, feels like adventure, you will be amaze. Unfortunately you can’t take any photo’s here, except in one place inside the building. I have visited this place twice but I never have a change to have lunch at their restaurants. Will go there again someday
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I went via uber bike just to see if they would do it. And the driver did! We negotiated a price for the way back. You need about an hour to an hour and a half for the place and you can only do it by your. Interesting Central Java history, loved it. You walk from room to room while the guide explains a little history of the royal family. You cannot take pictures, only outside. There is a lovely theater (I believe) outdoors midst 19th and 20th century artifacts, you have ultra modern sculptures contrasting Javanese ones. Definitely worth the trek.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
This is quite a way out of the city for the amount of time you spend here. The museum itself has good exhibits but focussing almost entirely on the royal family portraits. 

The tour guide is compulsory and only every half hour so we waited 20 minutes on arrival before setting off. The guide was fine but many things were skipped or discussed too quickly, we didn't get a proper look at anything. The tour is 50 minutes long and photos are not allowed. We'd have much preferred to go at our own pace with a guide book or signs, there could easily be an hour and a half worth of exhibits.

This feels more like an eccentric folly owned by a private family than a proper museum. 

At the end of the tour we were directed to the cafe, which is expensive for the area but the only way to to make the most of an otherwise long journey and wait with a lunch in the garden. The foods and beverages were nice though.

After visiting this place 1 year ago, I returned to this place hoping to get the same level of excitement and information. However it turned out all wrong

Last year i kinda got a quality visit because the guide was only guiding the 4 of us.
This year the guide was guiding like 20 of us that i cant even saw some of the collection the guide was explaining because the pack was too crowded.

i really think this place should increase the amount of guide and limit the person that 1 guide can bring. 

I'd rather wait for the english speaking guide rather than joining the trip with indonesia speaking guide. 

shame on this place for trying to squeeze money by packing some stranger in one large group and rushing from one place to other place rather than trying to deliver a quality visit for each of the customer. 

the entrance fee was 30k IDR for local adult
Sepertinya museum ini milik swasta, maintenancenya sangat baik. Rekomended buat wisata di Jogja. Jangan lewatkan.

I am in love with th museum, it's so neat and like labirynth, about the family in the kingdom and how they grow and the philosophy of each traditional things in Yoga and Solo, I learn so many things when i came here and will never regret to come back again, this is a must-visit museum everytime i go to Yogya, the most interesting is the place where so many poets to one of the princess in the kingdom when she was broken heart. Its an amazing museum with so many wonderful story inside.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah
