Review Text: Erg goed museum, je betaald 50k per persoon entree maar daarvoor heb je ook een Engelse guide. Die heb je ook wel nodig, goede info en duidelijk gesproken door onze guide. Veel informatie en hele mooie werken en foto's van de sultans en hun vrouwen.

I was pleasantly surprised by this museum. It is hidden at the foot of the volcano area Kaliurang. A guided tour is a must and we had to wait a few minutes to wait for the english speaking guide to finish the previous tour. Ratna welcomed us and gave us a very good insight into the royal life of Yogyakarta and Solo in a witty and charming way. She is very knowledgeable and engaging. The design of the museum is unique. Picture taking is only allowed in a designated area and the tour finishes with a nice traditional hot beverage. A visit is well worth it.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
For someone who loves history, this place worth to go and wait. But of course not till 30 minutes. Highly recommended! With awesome English speaking guide.

A side note, not every Chinese looking is from china. Not every Indian looking is from India. Our guide made a slight mistake on that which sorta offended some Chinese and Indian tourists.
A beautiful private collections. Through it we could learn a lot of the greatness of Javanese culture, how it impacted the life of the people who lives in the era until now.

Museum yang berisi tentang sejarah keraton yang ada di Jogja dan Solo. Di dalam museum kita akan ditemani oleh tourguide yang akan menjelaskan masing-masing tempatnya

Fasilitas lengkap seperti toilet, restoran dan tempat penjualan souvenir.

Sayangnya di dalam museum kita tidak diperbolehkan mengambil gambar, dan merekam penjelasan tour guide'nya
Tetapi kita bisa mengambil gambar di spot-spot luar museum yang sudah disediakan penyelenggara museum

Museum bersejarah ini adalah tempat yang wajib dikunjungi jika berada di Jogjakarta. Ada guide yang menceritakan tentang seluruh isi ruangan museum, sehingga menambah wawasan kita tentang sejarah di jogjakarta

musium ini ditata secara cantik sehingga tdk membosankan buat pengunjung. pengunjung diberikan informasi mengenai kerajaan2 dan paara penguasanya secara jelas, lokasi yang nyaman dan resto yang cantik. dilengkapi dengan butik yang cantik. tidak membosankan malahan ingin berkunjung kembali
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
The whole place is amazing. An underground tunnel. A sort of canal section. A kind of roman gallery courtyard. And much more. It has a Skyrim feel to it.

The guided tour takes close to an hour, even though the guide talks at twice the normal speed (still easy to understand, very articulate). It's informative and they can answer many followup questions that you might have.

There is a restaurant inside the museum. I didn't know this and had lunch right before there. So I can't really review it but maybe you can now that you know about it.

When we were there it closed at 3p.m., so check the opening hours before you go there.

Sidenote: You are only allowed to take photos in certain areas. You'll notice that most attached photos here only display the same few places.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Hanya satu kata, benar-benar museum yang menarik. Terutama saat kita dipandu oleh guide yang oke dan atraktif banget. 

Menyusuri sejarah kerajaan Mataram yang akhirnya pecah. Juga sejarah hidup sebagian pelaku-pelaku sejarahnya. Raja-raja dan para putrinya. Seperti Gusti Nurul dll.

Juga mengulas bebatikan dan makna-maknanya. Gak boleh motret di dalam, hanya boleh di luar. Jadi yang penasaran langsung cuss aja

This museum is privately owned. It has a really interesting architecture - built in a maze like pattern. We joined the English guide tour. The Museum has interesting artifacts from 2 kingdoms of - Jogja and Solo. We enjoyed the lil trivia and learning about the history of the 2 kigdoms. 

They do not allow photographs except for a few spots. They served us tea midway - that is a secret recipe from one of the queens! 

The onsite restaurant is really nice and worth  try. You can easily spend a a couple of hours here.

The place is outside Jogja main city - so you will need transport.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Harga tiket masuknya 30 ribu rupiah sudah termasuk parkir, guide dan minuman khas museum.

Museumnya sih engga terlalu kelihatan dari area parkir, engga kelihatan sebesar apa. Namun setelah pengunjung dibagi dalam kelompok-kelompok (maksimal 25 orang/kelompok) dan didampingi oleh seorang Guide.
Guide akan menerangkan bagian-bagian dari museum dan isi dari setiap bagian tersebut. 

Kita tidak diperbolehkan mengambil gambar sembarangan untuk tujuan melindungi hak cipta.

Durasi tur sekitar 55 menit. Bagi yang tertarik dengan kebudayaan Jawa termasuk kerajaan dan keluarga kerajaan, maka museum ini wajib dikunjungi.

30km away from the city, if you love the history of the Yogyakarta kings, you have come to the right place.. We grab a taxi that cost us 80-100k from the city, bought the tickets for 30k per adult, including the entrance fee and a tour guide.

The whole tour took us a good 45 mins with lots of historical lessons about sultans, kings, queens, mistress, etc.. Most of the places do not allow photo or video taking. Overall, great if you love history. Some might find it boring. Tour guide was knowledgeable and fun.

Lovingly built and maintained by one of the old Solo royal family (apparently?), this place has a real personal warmth to it that makes the trip so compelling. The buildings and and the setting are beautiful and the exhibits all well managed. We stopped there for lunch too - largely because we just wanted to spend more time in the building - and the meal was superb. Definitely worth the trip.

One of the best museum in Indonesia
Dengan biaya rp. 30.000 kita akan mengelilingi museum dengan ditemani pemandu yg menjelaskan secara detail dari museum diantaranya filisofi batik dan pakaian kerajaan, keluarga kerajaan, lukisan 3D dan cerita tentang Gusti Noeroel.
Tidak hanya mendengarkan dan melihat potret masa lalu tetapi pengunjung juga disuguhi minuman segar yang merupakan rahasia awet muda para Ratu

The location is a bit far from Yogyakarta, it's about an hour drive heading towards the mountain side. 
The museum is pretty, well organized and well maintained. It focused on Javanese history, especially the history of the royal family of Mataram kingdom both in Yogya and Solo.
It's a guided museum where you will be put in a group of 10-15 people which will have 1 guide (Bahasa or English speaking guide will be depending on your nationality but I'm sure even tough you are local, you can ask to be put in English speaking group if you prefer it).
The guide will walk you through the collections one by one but the way they explain things is like a story teller, so you won't get bored, instead you will have questions and curiosities, and before you know it, the tour is over. I felt it was a bit too short. I guess they have to keep a certain time for each group so it won't drag too long and overlapping with the next group. 
The visitor will get a jamu (javanese herb tea) in between the tour.
There is a 3D painting inside the museum and it's pretty cool!

Tempat ini buat pengetahuan bagus
Karna cerita tentang sejarah2 di jogja
Dari kerajaan2 di jogja
Ampe ada soekarnonya
Buat yg senenk ama sejarah mesti kudu wajib mampir

It was my first time visit this place.  The local guide was okay but she spoke too fast.  I did not get chance to visit the restaurant because of the time limitation.  One of my suggestion is to let the restaurant is opened for public --does not have to enter through the museum.  Overall, it is a nice place to visit especially if you like History.

klo boleh jujur, gue ga pernah nginjekin kaki ketempat yang namanya museum atau sejenisnya. Terakhir ke museum itu pas SD, tapi sumpah ini tempat reccomended banget. Dari masuk ke dalam aja udah kerasa suasana nyaman, tentram, adem dan barang - barang peninggalan. salah satu tempat favorit gue disana adalah ruangan yang penuh dengan surat cinta buat seorang putri yang patah hati karna cinta nya ga sampe cuma karna perbedaaan kasta.

si putri yang akhirnya patah hati dan mengurung diri trus mulai kehilangan sinar harapannya. hampir semua orang bersedih waktu tahu klo sang putri patah hati, dan hampir semua saudara, sepupu dan teman mengirimkan surat berisikan surat cinta tentang patah hati dan menyemangati sang putri.

semua surat didalam ruangan masih asli dan di pajang rapi. dan ga boleh berfoto didalam museum. selain itu guide nya juga sik banget jadi ga monoton dan lebih friendly. Biaya masuk kedalam menurut gue murah banget, selain itu pemandu nya juga asik.

salah satu surat cinta sang puteri yang menyentuh dan fav  menurut gue :

" FREE ! the biggest mistake that you can make in your life is to always worry about to make a mistake" by 

"Sebarkanlah kasih sayang mu dalam lingkunganmu,  terangilah perasaan2 sedih. gelarlah selimut cinta atas dosa dan kekurangan orang lain, itulah inti kebahagiaan"

so, you guys ....
liburan ga musti keluar duit mahal, terkadang dari yang terlihat biasa bisa memberikan kesan atau arti yang lebih banyak.

This place is beautiful. Its architecture is unique n have this serene ambience. They will entertain u with their collections n stories and a nice restaurant n souvenir shop as closure will give u a pleasant feeling that lingers for quite some time.
I visited this place twice in 3 days. I had different guides in each visit. I found that the guide is the most important part in this museum. My first trip guide was an excellent story teller. She gave us information about the royals with touch of romanticism in every details. My second trip guide was... well... less fun than the first. Although she tried her best. They were all very good though. Idk, perhaps I was biased by my first trip.
Overall.... excellent museum with unique collections that will leave u a pleasant feeling throughout the visit n long after that.

Terletak di dataran tinggi Kaliurang yang sejuk. Lingkungan di dalam museum yang benar-benar menarik karena berbeda dengan museum-museum pada umumnya. Selama tour di dalam museum pengunjung akan diceritakan kisah sejarah kekeratonan secara menarik karena diserta benda-benda peninggalan yang selama ini sedikit diketahui oleh publik. Beberapa benda peninggalan seperti lukisan yang seolah menatap pengunjung ketika dilihat dari sisi manapun, surat-surat cinta di masa lalu, dan lain-lain

Saya berharap banyak setelah melihat tingginya nilai review di Trip Adivsor, tapi ternyata museum ini sebagian besar hanya berisi foto-foto dan lukisan dari anggota keraton zaman dahulu. Saya mengharapkan lebih banyak benda-benda keraton dan adanya sejarah yang runut, tapi tidak saya temukan. 

Saya senang karena tiket masuk sudah termasuk guide yang akan menceritakan setiap tokoh yang ada di foto/lukisan. Terdapat juga beberapa pakaian dan kain batik tapi mostly foto dan lukisan. Dan ada juga arca-arca Hindu yang sampai sekarang saya masih bingung kenapa mereka dimasukkan sebagai bagian dari Museum ini? Hubungannya dengan keraton apa?

Oh iya, kita tidak diperbolehkan untuk mengambil foto di dalam museum. Ga tau juga alasannya apa.
i went here for many times. and it never gives me bored. it is such a nice and cold place to visit..

ullen sentalu never fail to amaze me.
this is my third visit to what i believe best museum in Indonesia.
love their architecture and collection.
very knowledgable tour leader.
unfortunately taking pictures is only allowed at certain spot.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: jalan-jalan ke yogja harus banget dateng ke museum ini, jangan ngaku anak gaul jogja kalo belum kesini. disini banyak pelajaran sejarah yang bakal kita dapetin, dan pas beli tiket kita akan didampingi sama petugas guide dari museum nya. dan jujur, ini merupakan museum yang paling saya sukai. indah banget.
It's a museum of batik inside nice buildings in stones, the tour is cheap and quite clear. You also can eat there.

It is my second visit to the museum, the first one with my college friends, the second one with my family of 2 junior high school kids. It is an educational place for people who want to  know about history of the kingdoms in Jogjakarta and Surakarta or Solo in particular. Unfortunately photograph and video are not allowed in most of the are of the museum, only at the outdoor is. Quite far from the city, if you plan to visit this museum, it would be better to plan to do or visit other places at the same time such as Museum Merapi and riding a rental jeep to mount Merapi.
Visited the museum and loved the experience. The guided tour was very informative. Guests are grouped in batches with assigned guides. I've enjoyed the visit.
Get to know few history behind Jawa Kingdom and cultures. You will be assign a tour-guide that will explain everything about the museum.
it's so unfortunate we cant take photo inside! it is so amazing! history of solo and jogja is shown, the kingdom and so on. highly recommended!
It is if i remember correctly a private owned museum which explain why the collections are perfectly taken care of. The guide was very professional and knowledgeable.

Il museo è molto curato, la guida è carina e gentile. Purtroppo il tema è unico: ci sono moltissime foto e dipinti delle famiglie reali che si sono succedute. È sicuramente di rilevante importanza per il turista locale... non è stato coinvolgente per noi.

I like the place, I went there at least 2 times now.  The guide will help you to learn about batik in general and also the royal family batik tradition in Yogya.  The guide can speak English, which is a Plus and very helpful for foreigners.  The ticket was a little bit pricey, but it is worth to visit!

My children and I love this museum. Listening to the guide's explanation about the life of javanese royal family is exciting. The museum painting is amazing. For those who wants to know the story about javanese king and his relatives, this museum is highly recommended.

Sesuai dengan namanya, ini merupakan museum seni dan budaya. Untuk masuk ke museum ini akan dibentuk per grup biasanya 1 grup berisi sekitar 15-20 orang kemudian akan ditemani oleh 1 guide. Guide nya akan menemani mengelilingi museum dan menjelaskan seputar sejarah, budaya dan silsilah keraton. Ketika di dalam kita tidak diperbolehkan membawa kamera atau memotret karena nanti ada waktu dan spot yang diperbolehkan untuk berfoto. Setelah menyusuri ruangan demi ruangan nanti kita akan dibawa ke tempat untuk beristirahat dan disediakan minuman seperti wedang jahe yang membuat hangat tubuh.

Museum dengan suasana yang adem karena terletak di kaki gunung merapi, di meseum ini terdapat sejatah kraton Yogyakarta, dan banyak peninggalan kraton disimpan disana, sangat menarik apalagi pada saat di tengah-tengah kunjungan kita disuguhi minuman rahasia kraton untuk kebugaran badan sangat enak sekali

Ullen Sentalu in Kaliurang, nabij Yogyakarta, is een prachtig museum in een bijzonder mooi archectectonisch gebouw.Het is een privé initiatief van de familie Haryono.  Het museum is een rondleding in de geschiedenis van de Javaanse adel van Yogyakarta en Surakarta; De verschillende aspecten van de geschiedenis worden voorgesteld in afzonderlijke kamers van zeer hoge architecturale kwaliteit. De engelstalige gids was uitstekend en gunde ons al de tijd zowel voor het beantwoorden van onze vragen,  als de tijd om de voorwerpen te bezichtigen. 
Het is verboden te fotograferen in het museum tenzij op de plaatsen waar de gids toestemming geeft. 
Naast het museum is er een mooie verkoopruimte en een goed restaurant.
Het museum is aangelegd in een mooie bosrijke omgeving.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Built and managed by a renowned architect its near the merapi and about 1 hour drive from yogjakarta city. 

Amazing collection of items relating to solo and yogjakarta royalty.  The guide is excellent explaining the importance of items on displayed. 

Nestled between nice matured threes very cooling on a hot day to visit. Worth to go as its is just spectacular.

A very good guided museum that would tell you a glimpse of the life of Kraton people (Javanese noble). Their collecting are fascinating... from original photograph, painting, batik, music instrument, and even a collection of love letter from the past.
At the end of the trip they'll serve you with jamu awet muda (forever young herbal drink)...taste quiet good for me, but for some people maybe not.
Their restaurant is also a good one, but you've to make reservation first... for me it's kinda weird since they serve western menu instead of Javanese one. But the western food taste so goooddddd.
The only problem is our guide talk in a-very fast forward mode- so you cant really enjoy every little thing in there...maybe because we've to move fast to make room for next group of visitor. 
Also they've no photo taking policy inside the museum, which can "reduce" the memory of the visitor about this museum.
Overall, for (Javanese) history & art lover, this's the right place for you!

Saya rasa museum ini adalah museum yg terbaik di indonesia. Tiket masuknya terjangkau, dan  terbukti dgn penataan yg bagus konsepnya 'njawani',serta guide nya yg baik yg memberikan penjelasan2 ttg sejarah2 keraton jogja dgn detail dan menarik
Museum dengan arsitektur menarik dengan peninggalan Ilmu Pengetahuan tentang budaya Jawa yang adiluhung.

This museum is worth to visit. Can get lots of information about kraton yogyakarta background. The guide is so interactive. Just need to wait to get in during the peak season. The photo spot is very good. But the exit way to car park is need to be considered by the management.

museum ini menampilkan dan menyajikan benda2 bersejarah dgn nilai cerita dan budaya yg tinggi... pemandunya sangat baik dan menguasai alur cerita dan bangunannya berbeda dgn museum2 lainnya. Terletak di wilayah kaliurang dgn cuaca yg sejuk membuat pengunjung sangat nyaman utk berlama2 disini krn kita disajikan suasana indoor dan outdoor... sangat sayang apabila anda blm pernah dtg kesini bila pernah dtg ke yogya....

Museum milik swasta yg sangat ekslusif, terawat, koleksi yg lengkap, dan desain museumnya yg luar biasa.

Nuansa mistis begitu terasa saat memasuki ruangan demi ruangan, ditambah AC ruangan yg cukup dingin dan berbagai macam patung, lukisan, kain2 batik, foto2 bersejarah, surat dan puisi, alat2 musik, pakaian, dll 

Bila kita mengunjungi Ullen Sentalu tdk diperkenankan mengambil gambar kecuali di tempat2 tertentu.

Guide akan menemani -+ 10 wisatawan selama perjalanan, dimulai dr pintu masuk sampai keluar, guide akan menjelaskan secara terperinci isi dr museum yg seperti labirin ini.

Ullen Sentalu is a guided museum on Javanese history. Visitors are walked through the various rooms by excellent guides narrating the history of the Javanese kingdoms. A bit outside Yogya but worth the trip.

Sebelum masuk museum ini terlihat seperti rumah biasa. Akan tetapi ketika sudah masuk kedalam, seperti memasuki lorong waktu (temaram, dingin, hening dan sarat sejarah). Kita masuk dipandu oleh tour guide yg akan mengantar kita satu grup sekitar 25 orang. Peraturannya sangat jelas dan tegas : Dilarang mendokumentasikan dan memegang benda2 sejarah didalam museum walau itu anak kecil akan diperingatkan. Sangat bagus untuk menambah wawasan kita mengenai kehidupan Kraton Yogyakarta dan Surakarta.

Erg leuk verhalend over alle koningen, prinsessen! Veelal via foto's maar de gids maakt er een compleet verhaal van! Koningin Juliana komt ter sprake en ook paleis Soestdijk staat op een foto! Goed om een impressie te krijgen over ons verleden!

It is a well managed museum. Clean, tidy, and informative. I suggest to bring umbrella when it seems like it will rain because even though it is an indoor museum, you will have to move here and there. The museum staffs will not help you by offering free umbrella or rain coat. Instead, they will sell you a rain coat which is surely one of the thing to improve when it comes to customer service

When going with children to a museum i always a bit upset if theres no tour guide who can make the good story about the place. But in ullen sentalu, even my 5.5year old boy can listen to the tour guide and interesting to her. The tour guide brought us like entering a cave of movie theatre where we can see clearly what happen a long time ago with batik culture of indonesia and a princess who admired by so many great man but choosed to marry a decent soldier and end up live in Bandung. Aniway the princes just passed away a year ago in bandung. Interesting place to visit. Also they had a batik boutique with very nice dress design. Love this place a lot.

Very nice and good place to visit with family. Its 50 mins guided tour for all facilities. Expect some delay during holiday session. It was a good experiences to know more about Mataram Kingdom history following with Solo and Yogyakarta kingdom histories.
Recommend for family trip.

Visited this place due to the great reviews on TripAdvisor and it did not disappoint. The entry fee of 30k for foreigner included a guided English speaking guidr and Javanese drink.   It's a welcome relief from the inflated prices of places like Borobudur where entry for a tourist is about 7 times as much as local entry fees. 

There are a number of rooms to explore with paintings, sculptures, poetry, etc. It is a great way to understand a bit of Indonesian history and culture. The only small issue I had was that I felt a bit rushed, I would have liked to explore the poetry room a little longer. 

If you are looking for a unique gift, there's also a small gift shop on site and the leather handbags are of a great quality and are available only in Yogyakarta. 

You can also buy some local food or fruits outside the museum at a decent price without being harassed to buy anything. This is definitely worth the number 1 rating on TripAdvisor!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Museumnya kecil sebenarnya, namun guide tournya bagus dapat menjelaskan dengan detail dengan sedikit humor. Tempatnya bersih dan lukisannya bagus-bagus

Senang sekali bisa belajar banyak di museum ini. Walaupun antrian masuknya panjang, tapi ga nyesel kesini.
Museumnya bersih, benar2 terawat dan koleksinya cantik2.

I think this is the best Museum I've ever visited. It's very well maintained. I has good collections. Finally I can see the historical story of The Royal Family of Jogja. There're a lot photos of the Royal Family Members from the past time. They have statues too. 
It's worth to visit. Doesn't cost expensive, but you can learn something there. 
Love that Ullen Sentalu.

sudah berulang kali yang berkunjung ke Ullen Sentalu, dan selalu mengesankan setiap kalinya. Tahun ini saya berkunjung untuk mengantar adik saya melihat isi museum. Bagi anda yang ingin mengetahui sejarahh Keraton Yogyakarta dan Surakarta, Ullen Sentalu tujuan yang pas!
A magical underground museum.  A must see if you are in Yogyakarta and wish to appreciate the history of Java,

You can easily combine this with a Borobudor trip. This is a well - curated museum and there's a nice restaurant. You can also get a nice view of Merapi volcano. Makes a pleasant change if you are templed out.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: If you have more time for yogyakarta then this is the best option!!! You will hear lots of amusing stories about royal family and javanese traditions. Finally you will figure out whats going on about Kraton. Good english speaking guides!!!!!

Stopped over at this museum on the way back from the Merapi volcano tour and thought this place was well worth the time spent. This place is very modern in style and well designed to offer respite from the hot weather outside. The tour lasts about one hour and strikes the right balance between providing  enough information to make it interesting and informative without getting too overly detailed when describing the history of the area. Great paintings and photos of various sultans and the royal family. Also there is a very nice gift shop which has modern style takes on traditional Indonesian clothes and artwork.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Museum's guide will tell the history of Central Java Kingdoms especially Solo and Yogya. At the end you can enjoy fine dining western food style.

We enjoyed this museum and getting to know more about the history of the kingdoms, the type of batiks from Yogya and Solo, and the life as a royal family. Our tour guide was knowledgeable and fun and served a nice tea in the middle of the tour. We were lucky to arrive first thing and so enjoyed a peaceful time at Ullen Sentalu.

Tiket masuk 30.000 untuk dewasa, anak dibawah 5 tahun free. Diatas 5-12 tahun 15.000. sudah termasuk tiket masuk, parkir, guide fee dan free drink (jamu herbal). Penjelasan dr guide cukup jelas, mengenai kerajaan yogya dan solo, dan budaya nya. Recomend to visit.

Geweldige rondleiding waarin heel veel over historie van de Javaanse adel. Ook het pand zelf is erg mooi qua architectuur. In de collectie een poesie album van 1 van de prinsessesn (in het Nederlands!). Echt de moeite van het bezoek waard

If you get bored with the city, you can get away to this place. Just drove about 45min from town and you will find this greeny place.

To have a museum tour, you have to pay rp. 30k for domestic. Including touring around, a cup of jamu (traditional liquid of java).

The tour guide will give a information about yogya's royal family tree, complexion of batik (traditional java fabric).

There are about 7 room, 1 room about family tree, 2 rooms about batik, 1 room special for one princess, 1 room for wedding dress, 1 room for traditional music instruments, 1 room contain comfort letters from all the princess friends and fam.

The area is cover with trees and the design is very uniq. But too bad we can't take pictures there, for safety reason.

I feel peace and this place is serene.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
If you go to Merapi area, make sure to drop by to this museum. Located only about 15 mins from the Jeep Tour Merapi venue.
The museum has tourist guide who speaks English and Bahasa. Our ticket and time were arranged by our travel agency before, but you can just go there and get the ticket, but you have to wait for your tour time, for us, it took about 15 mins waiting time.

The museum has interesting rooms with pictures, batiks and other stuffs related to the royalty family of Jogjakarta and Solo. From this tour, I learned a lot! Oh, they don't allow you to take pics in almost the whole area of tour, only in the end of the tour.

My family and I visited this museum while we were spending our family vacation in Jogjakarta recently (on December 20, 2016). We really like the learning experience on historical facts of Javanese culture, as well as the hospitality the tour facilitator. In addition, the surroundings and the weather in this place is much cooler than in Jogja, so it was added to our enjoyment. Overall, we really glad we could visit this place!
Our guide spoke incredible English and we thoroughly enjoyed our visit. More people should visit to get a better understanding of Java!

In my view, this museum has an elegant way of treating the visitors. You must enter the museum with a guide, there is no way to enter the museum on your own. However, this is the plus point. The guide will give you a fascinating stories about the collections of the museum. 

Ullen sentalu owns less collections than what Kraton has. If I remembered correctly, their collections are mainly paintings, some are (copy) letters of some important figures in Indonesian history, batik. They also have a full set of Gamelan in the entrance of the museum. However, the way the present their collections is exceptional, which could make you amaze of what they have.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Ini adalah salah satu temat wisata yang belum banyak diketahui banyak orang. Biaya masuknya pun murah. Tidak hanya itu suguhan alam disekitarnya pun membuat mata kita tak mampu berkedip
Pertama kali kayak masuk di dalam gua gitu, trs wkt udh hampir mau selesai dpt minum apa gitu namanya lupa.. tapi seru kok, mengulas tentang jogja

Lebih mengenal budaya Jogja dan Solo plus kisah cinta yang unik dari para bangsawan keraton.
Cocok untuk semua orang umur 13+

Really amazed by the maze of art and stories that crafted beautifully into a spiritual experience.

The tour guide is friendly and really committed to her time of 50 minutes (believe it or not, we really finish exactly in 50 minutes.

sebuah komplek yang sangat menarik, terletak disisi selatan gunung merapi, diseputar area wisata kaliurang. museum, rumah makan dan lingkungannya yang tertata rapi menambah romantisme dibalut kesejukan alam

very a good place to learn Javanese culture. this museum tell a lot about kraton jogjakarta & surakarta. 

ps: camera is forbidden to this museum! 😁

Museum ini sangat keren bgt,saya baru aja berkunjung tgl 16 des 2016 bersama ibu dan ade.udaranya segar,pemandangan alamnya dan koleksi barang di museum bikin kita bangga dan terkagum2. Sayang hanya blh berfoto di belakang area museum.
This museum contains history of kasultanan Solo and Jogjakarta. It also provides traditional drink which is very delicious. A unique, interesting museum.

This is the place to see javanese culture in museum, the guide will explain everything about  javanese culture started with the royal family, local music instrument, Batik.

30 thousand for domestic and 50 thousand for Internasional guest including Free parking and welcoming drinks and Local Guide.

The museum is located in kaliurang area
i enjoyed this museum especially since I was guided. Lots of interesting info about Yogya culture (sultans, etc)

Nice museum to learn about Javanese culture, especially about Mataram Islam in the past. Going to this museum makes me feel like going back to the past. The tour guides are very friendly and helpful! Unfortunately, visitors are not allowed to take pictures except outdoor.

Ulen Sentallu adalah object wisata yang langka di indonesia. Dalam museum ini, pengunjung dapat mengenal sejarah kesultanan , khususnya Jogja. Pemandu yang profesional akan mengajak anda mengelilingi RUMAH MUSEUM yg menonjolkan budaya jawa tengah dengan lukisan2 tokoh2 kasultanan Jogja. Museum yang harus dikunjungi oleh seluruh lapisan masyarakat yang ingin budaya indonesia tetap lestari..

If you love history and culture, this is a must visit place in Yogyakarta. The entrance fee is 30K and you will get a 40-minutes-tour to the museum with a guide. I was so amazed when I entered the museum, it was very beautiful and well maintained. The walls are made by solid rocks, there are paintings and sculptures that describe the history of the Royal Family (Keraton). You are not allowed to take pictures inside the museum, there is only one space where you are allowed to. After the tour, I went to Beukenhof Restaurant to have coffee and cake. The taste was standard but the place is photogenic. It was overall an amazing experience and I would recommend everyone to visit Ullen Sentalu if you come to Yogyakarta.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Museum terkeren yang sudah saya datangi, beda dari museum-museum sebelumnya. Lokasinya berada di kaki gunung merapi. Kalau orang awam pasti tidak tahu dan tidak menyangka kalau ini adalah sebuh museum, karena bangunan ini tertutup oleh pohon-pohon besar, layaknya di hutan. Awalnya saya kesini juga heran. Adapun isi dari museum ini adalah seni dan budaya Jogja dan Solo. Tapi sayang, kita tidak diperbolehkan foto di dalam museum tersebut. Satu lagi, guidenya sangat-sangat ramah
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
I have to say this museum is 'comfortable'. It was opened at 8.30am and the ticket price is worth it. 30000idr for local and 50000idr for international tourist (adult). When you arrived, you will asked to wait while they were preparing you a guide. You will be one group with another visitors. Mine was consist of about 20 people/group. The tour took about an hour and they provide you refreshing drink in the middle of the tour. They were very informative and the place was beautiful and well-organized. 
This place is close to mount merapi lava tour point. About 5 mins away driving.

Museum ini merupakan museum swasta atau pribadi. Jadi berbeda dengan museum pemerintah. Koleksinya terawat. Pelayanan memuaskan dan bangunannya cantik. Lokasi cukup jauh ya dari kota, kira2 1 jam dari alun2. Masuknya mahal sekitar 30rb, kalau museum lokal paling 5000 saja. Tapi worth it. Tidak boleh foto2 di dalam museum jadi kurang instagramable. Ada restonya. makanannya oke. temanya fine dining jd pelayanan bagus dan harga rata2.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Cost only idr 30K, but the experience is priceless. They have many historical collection such as sculpture, painting, batik, letters, and many more. We will not be amazed cluelessly, because they provide a guide who will go along the visitors in group and explain everything about the collection.

We cannot take picture inside the museum where the ancient and valuable stuffs are stored, but we can still have memorable picture in some areas permitted. 

There is a boutique and a cafe that we can enjoy spending time unlimitedly.
Not only did we enjoy the exhibits, the food at the Beukenhof restaurant was fantastic! Try the lasagne and French onion soup. Great!

The tour guide speaks really fast perhaps due to number of visitors. I am surprised that Jogjakarta has a privately owned museum but supported by Jogjakarta monarchy. You can learn glimpse of Java history in a fun way. Don't forget to try the Restaurant😊

nice place!! cocok untuk wisatawan luar/dalam negeri... berada di daerah Kaliurang, gak terlalu jauh dari kota Jogja, paling cuma butuh 30-40 menit, Bangunannya unik banget, bentuknya seperti castle/istana. Jadi selain museum, yang terkenal di sini adalah restorannya, namanya Beukenhof Resto..makanannya enak dan juga romantis, cuman bukanya dari siang sampai sore aja, soalnya kalo malam gelapp banget..hehe. Tapi tempat ini tutup setiap hari Senin ya guys..(museum & resto)..
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: good to learn history, all the guide can tell you all history about Yogyakarta. the best way to learn. you also get warm drinks.

This is a private museum with a tour guide provided to explain each of paintings, photos and many things related to the royal family of Kesultanan Yogyakarta.
They provided an English-speaking tour guide if you need one.

However, please notice that you may not take any photograph in most places. There are only 2 areas allowed to take a picture.
The entrance ticket only cost IDR 30.000
Saya sudah sering mendengar mengenai museum ini dan baru kemaren saya berkesempatan untuk pergi ke sana. Museum ditata dengan sangat menarik sehingga membuat pengujung tidak mudah bosan.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: This central javanese royalty dynasty museum is just amazing. It's like a wonderful maze, a mix of secret gardens, courtyards, and galleries, some of them underground. It is one of the easiest place to get to know about Javanese kingdoms and it's majestic way of life of it's princes and princesses.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Went here with a big group. If you love history about the royal family and you wanna know about the philosophy behind the javanese culture (dances, batik, wedding) you should definitely visit this museum. One thing you should pay attention to, you cannot take picture inside the museum.
In diesem informativem, privat geführten Museum erfährt man einiges über die lokale Kultur und die Geschichte des Königreiches.

This is a private museum located on the slopes of Bukit Merapi and is quite a distance from Jogjakarta. The main building is surrounded by extensive gardens. The collections here showcases Javanese oil paintings and sculpture as well as batik. Admission price includes a tour guide and guests are admitted in groups. Photography is not allowed in the museum. There is an in house store selling souvenirs, books and clothes and a restaurant where you can get a nice cup of tea and snack.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: location @kaliurang tourism area, about one hour drive from yogyakarta, entrance museum fee 50k IDR for foreign and 30k IDR for local, quite nice collection of history of royal family of yogya and surakarta, beautiful landscape surrounding and dutch architecture, restaurant and fancy boutique are available.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
This is a private museum lovingly managed by someone who loves the royal family/families in the area. It's Rp50k for foreigners and Rp30k for locals but that fee includes a guide in English or Bahasa.

Because there is a steady stream of visitors, the guides appear when there are enough visitors to have a small group, which in my case was 4.

The artefacts in the museum are not of exceptional quality. But with the guide, one can better appreciate the culture of the region. 

Curiously, there are outdoor places that one cannot take photos. Which is a pity as those are among the nicer spots.

The inclined wall shows the fear of the museum owner that the culture in the area will decline. But he need not fear. If he carries on developing the museum, the culture will be even more appreciated.

There is  cafe and a shop attached at the exit area. They are both worth visiting. The shop has good quality clothes and the cafe has good coffee with a soothing foreground of green at the balcony area.

Combine this with the visit of the lava tour.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This place is where you can get explanation about Java History. It's a must visit. Better than Keraton. English and Indonesia Local Guide and it's free.
A good alternative getaway surrounded by nature & place is a 'non-government' ..Not much you can see here, but the place is worth to visit.
Sangat menyenangkan berada di museum ini. Museum jawa yang sangat unik , anda akan di pandu oleh seorang pemandu yg menceritakan sejarah museum secara rinci dan jelas.

wisata disini kita bisa tau silsilah kerajaan yogyakarta dan sejarahnya. kita akan dipandu oleh salah satu guide yg mengantar kita melihat lukisan2 dan menceritakan sejarahnya.
menyenangkan sekaligus misterius sekali

Last weekend I visited this museum for the second time! Even I don't mind for the third visit. This museum is indeed so different with other museums in Indonesia we used to see. It is very well-maintained, the architecture is AWESOME and unique, and this museum I think is perfect for those of you interested to know about Javanese culture. The displays I think are almost the same like in other museums used to be, like there are some photographs, displays of traditional javanese clothes, sculptures, etc, but one thing that makes interesting is how the tour guide explained every single thing displayed here. Been two times here, and I always got nice tour guide who could give clear explanation and not boring. Thus, when we finally reached the exit gate after around 50 minutes of tour inside the museum, we will always get some lessons-learned and inspirations because we really absorb the explanation. We're totally prohibited to take picture inside the museum, but trust me, this museum is super worth to visit. So far, this is still the best museum I've ever seen in Indonesia. Keep it up!

Not much you can see here, but the place is worth to visit. Although it's very far from the city and no public transport, Ullen Sentalu gives you fresh air and fascinate sight-seeing. Best part, they'll give us free guide and keep us on line. The restaurant were very decent, but not for budget-traveller. It's a bit sad that we're forced to buy there since there's not food stall nearby.

Not at all the same as is the traditional museums out there, i.e. big hall with boring displays, Ullen Sentalu is so intimate and amazing. They'll automatically provide you with a guide upon arrival so you know what is what as far as displays and photos go, and for farewell, they give you a cup of herbal tea! Really cool as far as museums go. Also, the restaurant attached to the museum has such a nice atmosphere to get a cuppa.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Zeer de moeite waard. Helaas mag er tijdens het bezoek aan de tentoonstelling niet gefotografeerd worden. Maar op de website van het museum zijn voldoende foto's te vinden die een goed beeld geven van dit museum.

Arrived at 2:30PM, lucky to catch the last tour of the day. Got a tour leader who explained about the whole story of Javanese royal family. Pretty much interesting for people that are not coming from Javanese descendants. Recommended restaurants and cool ambience

A nice, friendly place to see but rather for those that have extra time in Yogja. The Museum is privately held and as such is dedicated to the history of two families so do not expect to learn a lot about the history of Java. The guide is very pleasant and helpful. Overall, given the distance it is not "must see". For me it was rather boring.

Kami datang terlalu awal, setelah dr menara pandang merapi kami langsung ke musium ulen sentalu krn jarak y dekat sekitar 2,5km lah.. biaya masuk y 30rb, itu dah dpt fasilitas tour guide,oiya ada peraturannya ga boleh foto atopun selfi di bbrp tempat sbnry hampir seluruh y sih hehe.. cmn di luar y n depannya aja boleh foto y.. emmm musium ulen sentalu itu isi y keren ada banyak koleksi foto kerajaan n tari2 serta qt akan di jelaskan sejarah dr foto trsebut, so qt ky di bawa ke masa foto itu di ambil, ada juga koleksi lengkap gamelan, batik n foto2, keraton jogja n kraton solo..
A good alternative getaway surrounded by nature. This place is a 'non-government' museum that provides a series of painting about Yogya's monarchy.

Museum ini banyak menampilkan koleksi-koleksi dari sejarah Kesultanan Ngayogyakarta. Suasana yang tenang dan sejuk membuat anda betah berlama-lama di dalamnya. Ditemani oleh seorang guide dengan jumlah rombongan yang dibatasi agar menjaga tour keliling Ullen Sentalu tetap terasa private. Anda juga akan disuguhi wedang uwuh resep asli keraton di penghujung kunjungan

This museum is excellent. While entering you feel like being transfered to the era of a Javanese kingdom. The painting are so extra ordinary. The old batiks are treated so well so they can endure the time. everything in the museum is so interesting.

This place tells us everything about Javanese culture, from its history, kingdoms, kings/sultans, princesses, keratons/castles, clothes and jewellery... It's a must see tourist attraction. I went here with my 2 kids aged 6 and 9, and they loved it. 
The ticket price includes tour guide and she was nice and polite, and also very informative. The tour takes about 45-50 minutes but it felt like too fast, very interesting layout. :)
The restaurant which is placed just before the exit door also has good western food in decent price. 
Do come here when you visit Jogja.

Walaupun saya asli dari Jogja, namun baru pertama kali mengunjungi museum ini.
Koleksi yang menarik dan didampingi oleh tour guide yang punya kualitas bintang lima (sangat ramah dan punya pengetahuan luar biasa).
Menyenangkan, semoga koleksinya terus bertambah.

Seriously amazing place we went to based on a quick tripadvisor search and definitely not disappointed at all. Fantastic free guide included in price which gives a great insight into many things Javanese and from the Yogya and Solo regions- great history and artefacts. Really unexpected but fantastic as. Very clear English spoken by guide and full of info. Will recommend to all. Such a tranquil and relaxing place. Thanks
Love this museum. Learned a lot about the Javanese culture. Got an excellent tour guide. When you are in Jogja, take some time to come to this place. You won't be disappointed.

Saya di ajak oleh temen saya kesini, memang saat pertama masuk sedikit seram karena harus melalui jalan seperti hutan dan banyak foto2 tua dan patung serta arca.

Saya senang dapat belajar untuk membedakan batik2 yg mana dari Jogjakarta dan solo.
Berkunjung ke museum Ullen Sentanu yang berhawa sejuk sambil melihat koleksi budaya jawa dan berbagai historis kehidupan dinasti kerajaan mataram di masa lalu

Berkunjung kesini pada akhir oktober '16.
Museumnya antik serta memiliki nilai seni, terawat dengan baik dan demikian juga dengan barang2 yang dipamerkan didalamnya.
Kita akan dibagi dalam kelompok yg akan dipandu guide yang mengantar, mereka akan  menjelaskan dengan baik mengenai sejarah, budaya Keraton Jawa serta tokoh2 yang ada dalam museum tsb.
Tempatnya memang berada diluar kota Yogya, saya setuju ulasan wisatawan lain agar sebaiknya dikombinasi  dengan kunjungan obyek lain di Kaliurang. Harga tiket juga relatif terjangkau, dan dipintu keluarnya ada mbok2 yg jual oleh2 buah Salak.
Jika Anda berminat ingin menambah pengetahuan untuk budaya Jawa khususnya Keraton dan budaya golongan Ningratnya tempat ini layak dikunjungi.

I visited here about 2010 and 2012. This museum is quite , little bit mystic but nice. Tour guide will give you lot of information about Java history. But, different guide will lead you to different spot. Feel free to ask them wheter any place they missed or not.
don't forget to try the cafe.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Please again please add your itinerary at Yogyakarta to this unique gorgeous museum. Located at Kaliurang near Merapi volcano wait you said affraid of Merapi volcano? Please do not be, this museum located at the different slope side of Mount Merapi, as you know there are a story why King of Java settled his Palace at now because they have been that there will no flood at Yogyakarta Palace. That's why this Museum is located on different side of Mount Merapi slope as i said before.
Yup this museum you will find a very cozy and enjoyable place to visit although took a certain distance from yogyakarta. But when you arrived there due to mountain climate you feel a windy breeze, beside you will find a unique sculpture that placed at open park. Also there are guides to pamper you with information about the museum. Thirsty or hungry hmmm after enjoying a museum scene you can hope and relaxing a BEUKENHOFF restaurant that serves you delicious cuisine. If you came with a family a good choice to visit but wait not come with your lover?

This is a very nice museum that lets you soak in the Javanese culture. It would be best to avail of a guide to provide you with more information about the items in the museum. It also has a quaint gift shop where you can buy clothes and souvenir items. There is also a Twinings cafe nearby where you can get your food and drinks after the museum tour. :)

i knew it from LP, and was longing for it
when we were finally here, it was a bit different from what i had imagined
it was mainly portraits, and there WERE some music instruments displayed at the very beginning but it's full of portraits, it was before every portrait that the guide told you about everything
however, it was good, and i like the stories and the information about the royal families, especially the story about the keys in the lady's hand
the building and the yard were really beautiful, having an atmosphere of serenity, sophisticated structured, and well maintained. and you would have the feeling that it was really noble to be nobles
we waited for about 40 min for an English guide, but it turned out to be worthy
i read on LP that there should be a upscale batik store inside but no one showed it to me and i forgot it myself too
Do drop in the restaurant affiliated before or after your visit
Great place and very informative, they provide a tour guide to explain every story and detail about photos and artifacts. Such a calm place surrounded by big trees.

Ullen Sentalu adalah salah satu museum dengan management terbaik di Indonesia. Untuk budaya jawa, koleksi museumnya bisa dibilang lengkap. 
Lokasinya cukup jauh dari pusat kota, tapi bisa sekalian berkunjung ke objek wisata lain di kaliurang dan gunung merapi.

Harga tiket masuknya Rp. 35rb saat weekend, cukup reasonable, karna nanti pengunjung akan dikelompokkan sekitar 10 orang, dan akan dipandu oleh seorang guide yg sangat informatif. Durasi tour museum adalah 1 jam dan tiket udah termasuk minuman tradisional di tengah tour.

Museum ini cukup bersih, cantik dan terawat. Tapi ga di semua spot boleh foto yah. Nanti guide nya akan ngasih tau dimana pengunjung bisa mengambil foto.

Museum ini jg dilengkapi dengan restoran yg sangat nyaman dan butik batik/souvenir.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: A very nice and surprising museum. Very interesting collection of paintings and batik from Solo and Jogja. Architecture of the museum is very nice. A must see!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Mirip tur istana versailes versi mini.  Konsepnya keren bgt karena ada pemandu yg menceritakan sejarah dan filosofi budaya jawa di setiap benda yg dipamerkan. Ga bosen.. Malah kurang lama rasanya. Terakhir kesana ada rencana perluasan museum untuk menambah ruang pamer koleksi. Berarti,  beberapa bulan ke depan mesti kesana lagi buat dengerin lagi cerita seru dari pemandunya.  Mantapp
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Sayangnya waktu saya datang, guide-nya terlalu buru-buru jadi banyak yang kurang jelas. Guide saya juga terkesan kurang antusias dalam menjawab pertanyaan. Kalau ditanya terkesan asal menjawab supaya cepat selesai. 

Di museum ini bisa belajar banyak soal budaya Keraton & adat istiadat Jawa. Saran saya, guide yang membimbing pengunjung lebih baik dipilih yang antusias. Jadi pengunjung bisa lebih menikmati. Untuk bahasannya juga mungkin bisa lebih fokus ke adat istiadat Jawa & budaya dibanding membahas mengenai sultan atau sunannya.

Went to visit this highly recommended museum, it has a different kind of history to tell, VERY interesting...I am glad we did it.

We were a group of 6people (4adults and 2teenagers). She guided us in English as requested as we had foreigners in our group.

GREAT Museum, however .... 
the tour guide, Ms. T:

1. She spoke too fast.
As if was reading from a book.

2. Was not too keen to answer questions.
 (well at least it showed on her face and based on my ) 

In the beginning of the tour my brother in law and I were walking slower than the rest, as we were admiring the items and photos on the walls.

2.1. I needed to ask a question about something that rest had already passed, her reply was 'well you walked too slow and stayed at the back'(??)

Hhmmm... I was a bit taken back, I had been in many tours and never have I been told that I was very slow and should not walk at the back?? 

I think I know the manners on how to visit museum with guide, maybe if she can loosen up  a bit and speak slower, I can understand her better, and was it my fault to stay back a bit to admire the items? 
*luckily we were 6, imagine if she has 15people in a group?

2.2. My brother in law asked what is the meaning of the Javanese name of HBIX, and her replied was 'where are you from? Now, maybe the question was asked to see how can she explained depending on the nationality of the guest.

Although, at the end she explained the meaning of the name, we were quite surprised when she asked the question, and the tone she used did not come out too nice to hear.

3. Felt the tour was timed.
It felt we could not ask questions, but we did anyway...

Tea was served and was told we had only 3minutes to finish them.

4. At the end of the tour, instead of showing us the exit, she just said 'you can go straight and turn right'.

Maybe it would be nicer that she takes us out and bid farewell?
Or she needed to go fast for a chit chat with her colleagues?

My sister who was in the tour, has been there and knew there was a shop that sells beautiful batik, she did not mention it to us until my sister 'had' to ask her.

So, again...GREAT museum, worth the visit, recommend to do more training on the guides on people skills.

NOTE: Toilet at the end of the tour was dirty, suggest to use the toilet at the 1st room in the beginning of your tour.

sekitar museum ini banyak yang jual dari mulai sate, penjual buah salak. luasnya kurang lebih 3H, didalam musem terdapat banyak benda bersejarah, guide nya menjelaskan dengan rinci, setiap masuk kedalam musem dibatasi hanya 15 orang saja, tidak boleh mengambil gambar di dalam museum, karna sangat luas disarakan jangan terlepas dari rombongan karna tempatnya seperti labirin (menurut saya) hawanya sejuk disekitar musem. dan baru boleh foto2 diluar area musem (bukan inti museum)
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Guides available that speak good English and are included in the tour. Excellent collection of photos, paintings and other accessories built up into a good story. 

We liked the coolness of the place probably since it is almost like a cave.
good for people seeking Javanese heritage or traditional museum. came when it rained, wet and has to use raincoat.
Museum yang menyajikan barang barang kuno dari Kraton Surakarta dan Kraton Ngayogjakarta. Di Tunjang dengan Suasana alam Pegunungan yang segar membuat kerasan berlama lama di sini

Museum kecil dan unik..kurang cocok untuk anak dibawah 10 tahun, karena isinya sejarah tentang kraton..
Saat sesi pemandu berakhir diberikan jamu, rasanya enak..

I didn't expect this museum to be the highlight of my trip in Jogja, I came here didn't expect to be a cultural centre as from the outside it was a modern building and I thought It was a just another modern art museum. Yet this place surprised me to the core. I learnt so much about Javanese history from the very experienced guide who told us the strories in detailed about each room and collection!

saya tidak pernah bosan ke tempat ini karena sensasinya
teduh dan jauh dari kota 
kalau datang bersama lokal bakalan dapet guide rombongan tapi kalau bersama teman internasional selalu dapet guide pribadi jadi gak perlu rame-rame hee...

This museum has exceeded my expectation! They have many interesting stories and collections in it. 
Assembled beautifully in a nice building. They also have a restaurant!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Beautiful place and nice museum. Interesting fix exhibition abot the sultans and the history of Jogjakarta. they have restaurant and shop also
The cool air with variation of a satisfying meal. A suitable place for couples looking for a romantic atmosphere

Finally, a museum that can put stories and romance behind the face and the year. A must visit museum. 

You will not be able to take pictures inside the exhibition hall, so if you're visiting just for the selfies, forget it. Do not bring small children here as it'll disturb other visitors.

トリップアドバイザーのジョグジャカルタの観光No.1であったため訪れたが、正直期待はずれだった。
彫刻やレストランがメインではありません。メインはジョグジャカルタとソロの王家の先代と先先代の家族の肖像画を通じた王家の紹介と、バティック（ジャワ更紗）の紹介がメインです。
博物館付きのガイド動向での見学しか認められておらず、ふらっと立ち寄って見学することはできません。（私の場合は30分待たされました。）

The Ullen Sentalu Museum is a Javanese culture and art museum located near Kaliurang North of Yogyakarta. The museum displays relics and artifact from royal houses and kratons of Java, such as Yogyakarta, Pakualam, Surakarta, and Mangkunegaran. It's a good collection. I really enjoyed it.
Close by is a nice restaurant - Beukelenhof. Best is to rent a car with a driver for a day ca. 400.000 idr (= 27 €) to get there. No idea if there is any public transport to that place. Probably little busses called Angkots but they have no schedule. Maybe you can team up with some other tourists and share the cost for a car.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Menarik, perlu untuk datang kesini setidaknya 1x. Tiket masuk domestik Rp 30.000,- Masuknya kemarin tidak antri hanya saja mereka ada jam2 nya untuk mulai tour nya, tiap 15mnt ada. 1 group tour sekitar 10 org dengan 1 guide. Menarik karena di museum ini di ajak mengenal silsilah keraton dan banyak barang2 antik dan bersejarah di sini. Sepanjang tour tidak boleh foto atau merekam, karena ini museum pribadi. Tapi ada nanti spot khusus untuk foto2. Selesai tour sekitar 1jam, dan tiap pengunjung di kasih jamu enak sekali. Selesai tour, bisa berkunjung ke cafe dan butik yang ada dekat pintu keluar.

I was amazed by collections of King of Java (Kesultanan) at Ullen Sentalu. There are numbers of important artefacts and stuffs which inherit from The 1st King until the last one. If you love historical atmosphere you must come and visit this place. It tooks nearly an hour and a half to completing the tour. You can taste fancy menu at the restaurant.

Going to Ullen Sentalu with a public transport is a little bit hard but doable, however because of rainy weather, i decided to rent a car with driver. Turn out, its a good decision because i can go to Merapi Museum as well.

The content in Ullen Sentalu : anything about Jogjakarta and Solo King, Queen and Their Children. However its really interesting.

Our tourguide have a lot of interesting stories.
Fee : Rp 30.000 for local and Rp 50.000 for foreigner.

We can't take picture inside. Only outside.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: A very nice place to understand the culture and history about Jogja. You can feel the enthusiasm of the tour guide when they explain about the history and not forgetting a nice secret recipe drink in between the tour. Well recommended.
Really recommended for you, whether you are local or foreign tourist. You are gonna be so amazed with the stories and also the displayed sculptures, painting and many more.

If you want to learn details of the javanese history, here is the place where you should go. You'll learn the history, cultures of java especially on Yogyakarta and Surakarta sultanate. The ticket price for foreign visitor is slightly higher but worth the price as it is included with tour guide and local drinks. Make sure to ask any questions to the tour guide and they shall help you with it. You're not allowed to take pictures inside as it is a private museum. A restaurant is available inside the museum where you can visit at the end of the tour.

Love this museum especally if you love history about royal family of Java (Jogja and Solo). 

The guide is nice, full of smile and ready to answer our questions.
museum ini seru karena ada guide nya yang jelasin dgn detail. banyak ilmu yg didapat stlh mengunjungi museum ini. tapi saranku, kesini pagi  aja karena sore sering hujan.
Beautiful setting with nice restaurant. Make sure you get a guide and ask a lot, otherwise the displays mean nothing to you

Lokasi dekat dengan Kawasan Wisata Kaliurang.
Harga tiket masuk terjangkau. Trip rombongan 8pax setiap trip, akan dibantu Tour Guide untuk berkeliling ke seluruh penjuru Museum. Suasana tenang, asri dan cukup komplit untuk koleksinya. Interior menarik, perpaduan antara Jawa dan Kolonial. Disini hanya diperbolehkan berfoto dikawasan depan Museum dan kawasan peristirahatan selepas keluar Museum saja.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Suasana, Ketertarikan Fasilitas
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Want to know the history of Yogyakarta sultanate ?.  This is excellent place. You can learn about the interaction of kraton Solo, Mangkunegaran and Yogya, and you can also see the famous Gusti Nurul, famous primadonna at her time.
Museum ini unik karena milik pribadi dan hanya di spot tertentu yang boleh di foto, menceritakan sejarah dan seni keraton yogya dg harga tiket 30rb dewasa. Harus dicoba!

Saya mengunjungi museum ini dengan ketiga anak saya, usia 11, 8 dan 1 tahun. Mereka suka sekali dengan museum ini karena
1. Guidenya ramah, (guide kami bernama Hani) dan bisa menceritakan sejarah dengan menarik dari koleksi barang-barang yg dipamerkan
2. Museum ini unik karena kita melewati lorong, taman, gua buatan, dll jd tidak membosankan
3. Udara sejuk ( dalam ruangan ada ACnya, dan memang letaknya di dataran tinggi, jadi tamannya pun sejuk)
4. Museum ini bersiiiih termasuk wcnya juga bersih.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Museum yang masuk dalam daftar itinerary wajib di sleman yogyakarta! Mau tua, muda, anak-anak, semuanya sangat amat saya anjurkan untuk datang kemari.

Suasana yang sejuk, tenang, dan sangat mendukung dalam kegiatan wisata dan edukasi ini menyimpan segudang bukti sejarah dari Kasultanan Yogyakarta, Kasunanan Surakarta, Pura Pakualam hingga Pura Mangkunegan!

музей скучноватый, провели здесь не более часа, порадовало отсутствие больших толп народа, так что можно было передохнуть под деревьями в тени, мы сделали красивые фотографии на фоне каменных построек

Jika anda tertarik dengan sejarah Kesultanan Yogyakarta, Surakarta serta budaya Jawa, ini adalah tempat yang tepat untuk memulai segalanya. Masuk ke museum ini tidak hanya sekedar masuk dan melihat-lihat, namun anda akan dibagi ke dalam grup sebanyak kurang lebih 10 orang dan akan ditemani pemandu untuk menjelaskan sejarah kedua kesultanan tersebut dan Budaya Jawa, memang begitu aturan masuknya!

Bagian museum yang menarik menurut saya adalah surat-surat yang ditulis Sultan dan keluarga-keluarga Sultan, sangat inspiratif! Selain itu arsitektur bangunan membuat anda tak berhenti mengaggumi setiap sudutnya.

Satu peraturan yang tidak saya lupakan: dilarang memotret di dalam museum yang memajang benda-benda koleksi kesultanan! dikhawatirkan jika foto-foto tersebut menjadi viral, akan berbahaya bagi koleksi museum.

Sekian review saya

Lokasinya agak jauh dari pusat kota, tapi worthed untuk di kunjungi, guidenya berpengalaman dengan kemampuan berbahasa yang bagus, koleksinya juga variatif yang menggambarkan perkembangan kerajaan yogyakarta dan solo, serta menggambarkan bahwa negara indonesia itu dulu sejajar dengan raja raja negara lain
The museum is about Solo & Jogjakarta History. Story about Sultan & all his wife & children. And full story about Batik. Museum is forbidden for photograph.

We were in Jogyakarta very recently and having read the reviews of this museum on Trip Advisor, we decided to ask our guide to take us there. After an hour's drive, climbing towards the Merapi Volcano, we arrived in pouring rain. So, first tip .... be aware that there is some walking outside from gallery to gallery and you may need a brolly. The galleries were quite unique, rather like underground dungeons but filled for the most part with modern replicas of paintings and artefacts which told the story of the royal families of Jogya and Solo. So, second tip .... if you want to see the real things, go to the Sultan's Palace in downtown Jogya or even the Royal Ambarukkmo Hotel which has an interesting collection in its own right. Nonetheless, the exhibition, in my view, was comprehensive and enjoyable, all the more so since the young guide was extremely well informed and spoke very good English. Third tip ..... don't bother to take your camera because you are forbidden photos in the museum and even in most of the garden. The guide was very apologetic about this but my travelling companion was so peeved that he couldn't even take pictures outside that he dropped off the tour. Fourth tip ..... if you really want to go and see the museum, why not spend the night up on the mountain and also go and see the volcano too. It would make a good combination of activities.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: untuk menjangkaunya memang membutuhkan waktu yang lumayan lama dari kota jogja, namun saat sampai tujuan traveler akan di suguhkan nuansa museum yang pasti berbeda dari museum yang lainnya. disini traveler langsung akan diberikan guide untuk memandu perjalanan selama di museum selama 1 jam kita akan dibawa keliling museum, diceritakan asal muasal kerajaan mataram kuno, silsilah kerajaan, juga dapat melihat langsung koleksi keraton yang merupakan sumbangan atau replika dari benda-benda bersejarah di keraton. traveler juga akan diberikan minuman hangat yang pastinya membuat segar setelah berkeliling museum. disini traveler tidak boleh sembarangan mengambil foto (untuk alasan yang saya tidak ketahui) namun ada beberapa spot yang diperbolehkan untuk traveler berfoto ria.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
This is such a wonderful place! The museum is made up of several mini-houses that showcase the interlinked histories and culture between Jogjakarta and Solo.

You will get to know the sultans and their wives and children (and their numerous nannies), about differences in batik patterns and colors, and differences between brides' wedding outfits.

Tours are included in the ticket price (50,000 rupiah for non-Indonesians), just check-in and they will tell you what time the next English or appropriate language tour will begin.

About midway through, you'll get a taste of a traditional drink (I forget the name) which is some delightful mixture of ginger and lemongrass and cinnamon and other ingredients. It leaves you feeling refreshed and yet warm, perfect on the rainy day that we went for a visit.

The house and the grounds are just so picturesque! Pictures are not allowed in most areas. The guide will tell you where photography is allowed.

After the tour, my friend and I agree that this museum deserves its top rating in TripAdvisor.

Do not miss!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Museum ini letaknya cukup tersembunyi dengan pintu masuk yang tertutupi oleh tanaman merambat. Area keseluruhan museum ini cukup luas, dengan arsitektur yang cukup unik dan dikelilingi taman yang rimbun dan terkesan seolah di dalam hutan.
If you really want to know the empire of Jogja, you should visit this place. its so wonderful place. Museum in the heart of forrest
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
The guide here was excellent. She gave us information, but also helped us to think about what we were looking at by asking us questions. She was enthusiastic and friendly. We came away understanding a little more about the culture and history of the region and there were some very interesting personal effects amongst the collection that gave a human side to the royal families featured.
There is also a very nice restaurant there, which seemed to have a fair priced menu. May be worth a try, although I think they said a reservation was a good idea.
Tempat dan peraturannya sedikit unik. ada perpaduan sejarah kuno dan modern. ditambah suasananya yang sedikit romantis bila dikunjungi bersama pasangan
Berbagai koleksi yang menarik dari sejarah keraton Yogyakarta dan Solo. Patut dikunjungi. Bangunan dengan arsitektur yang menarik dan unik.

21 september 2016. Around 0900.

Pros
Good architecture
Good lighting
Good explanation from the guide

Cons
Around 2 hours from jogja
No camera
No information of each collection
Only for those who like to know Bout jogja and solo history
Rude customer service
Very rude security guy at the entrance

Will not return to this place because of unwelcome greetings from the staff.
Better to know the history of jogja by visiting kraton jogja. They are much more welcome.

Complete colection of Sultan's : story, batik, poem. The most unforgetable was a lady painting that when we saw her eyes her sight followed us hhhh i still can feel this mistical feeling. The guide explained very well. Must try the restaurant! The menu and atmosphere were special. The area museum shop has french style. Worth to visit museum

Onverwacht ingenieus aangelegd museum. Wetenswaardigheden, beeltenissen en voorwerpen van en over regionale sultanaten. Hoewel betrekkelijk afgelegen, is het te combineren met bezoek aan Merapi museum.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
ボルブドールからジョグジャ市内への帰り道によりました。
まるで時間が止まったかのようなたたずまいの博物館で、主にジョグジャのロイヤルファミリーについての紹介でした。
エントランスから階段を下りると、石造りの入口があり、まるでディスニーランドのアトラクションのエントランスのようでした。こっちが本物でしょうけど。。
博物館の周りは、林なので、ひんやりと涼しく、館内は、エアコンも完備されて、ゆっくり見学することができました。
当方は、インドネシア人、日本人混在の見学だったので、ガイドはインドネシア語でお願いしました。
もし、日本の宮内庁の博物館があるならこんなふうと思いました。
翌日にジョグシャの市内観光だったので、ジョグジャのロイヤルファミリーついて、ばっちり予習ができ、
その後の宮殿見学に役立ちました。
まさに大人の修学旅行にふさわしい博物館でした。
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Located 1 hour away from the city uphill so weather is nice and cool.

No pictures allowed almost everywhere except at the exit with the slanted carving to symbolize the current generation that is losing its culture. 

Serves wedang jahe for everlasting youth a secret recipe by Ratu Mas , wife of sultan pakubuwono X.

The museum is about the sultinates of Solo and Yogyakarta, which is quite colourfull, and especially about the princess who performed in the Netherlands for the wedding of queen Juliana and prince Bernhard. And the is quite a modern woman for her time. It's a nice escape from the heat of Yogya during the day.

Dalam bangunan yang unik ini, saya mengajak anak untuk belajar sejarah dan budaya, khususnya Jawa. Ia belajar tanpa sadar dan menyenangkan. Lingkungannya juga mengasikkan, penuh kehijauan, ada pula kafenya untuk tempat rehat setelah berkeliling.

Merupakan museum pribadi.
Berisikan berbagai budaya di jawa tengah.  Dan ada beberapa benda sumbangan Dari pihak keraton Yogya Dan Solo.

Setelah membayar ticket idr.30.000, kita dipandu oleh 1 orang tour guide selama 50 menit. Dan mendapat minuman traditional. And Ingat, dilarang mengambil gambar didalam museum.

Museum cukup bersih. Dan guide sangat ramah

Run by professional, they have guide whom will explain you the interior, batik, photo, ornament inside the museum. Mainly Jogja or solo culture. Interesting. They will provide you with traditional drink too after the tour. They have nice resto at the end of museum, however, when i ask whether it halal food or not, they cannot guaranteed it, too bad, so me and family eat outside the museum (street food), rabbit barbecue and hot tea, quite nice.

Музей любопытный: построен частным порядком, в нем рассказывается история города и султаната. Учитывая, что в Кратоне вам все равно расскажут о жизни султана, этот музей можно рассматривать как дополнение к Кратону.
Mooi museum met ontzettend leuke gids die de rondleiding verzorgde. Leuk om te leren over de javaanse cultuur.
Echt een leuk museum. Netjes, goede engelse gids. Zit in de prijs van het kaartje. Kaartje kost slechts 50000   Echt een aanrader. Duur van de tour ongeveer een uur.

Bersama kekasih saya kesini, mendapati pemandangan kehidupan putra putri kraton pada zaman belanda silam. Juga koleksi batiknya membuka mata kami akan keagungan budaya jawa. Berbeda sekali dengan kehidupan kami saat ini.

This museum is a museum built by an Individual and the individual has his/her residence just adjacent to this museum. Its better to go with a guide. The place is not very big but there are a lots of paintings, photographs in this museum. The guide explains the history of the Sultan of both Yogyakarta and Solo and the complex relations with the Dutch. There is also an exhibition and gift shop of batik on the premise. No photography allowed inside which is sad but the visit is very interesting to understand a bit of life of the royals in Jogjakarta. Its close to Merapi so do visit this place in Yogyakarta.
ullen sentalu is a well maintained museum in jogja, located near merapi mountain and quite away from malioboro.

Ulen sentalu is the best museum i‘ve ever know. You can learn history of kasultanan jogjakarta and kasultanan surakarta, but in this place you can’t take photo. they said its to protect the collection. You can only take photo in some place, and they have guide who will guide us, and tell the story.

Tempatnya indah, edukatif, tertata rapi, terawat baik, tour guide nya sangat jelas menerangkan info2 terkait isi museum. tiket masuk sudah termasuk tour guide dan minuman tradisional. kalau kita butuh informasi lengkap perihal kerajaan yogya - mataram, disini tempatnya...
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: museum nya unik, ada yg d bawah tanah, berlorong2 juga. dr museum ini ak jd tau sejarah kerajaan mataram, hingga terpecah menjadi 4 kerajaan. jenis jenis motif batik dan fungsi atau maknanya. sejarah hamengkubuwono juga komplit beserta tarian yg diciptakan. great!!

A private residence with lots and lots of photographs/paintings of royalty. A room with batik, instruments and a few sculptures. 
The most interesting looking part was the garden which was close to the public. Why close it!
Oh and no photos. 

Let down.
A must-visit place for those who want to know more about Jogja's history. Could really get close to the nature with its landscape design, very nice scenery of the nature.

tempatnya bagus, bersih, tour leadernya juga ramah, jadi nambah pengetahuan tentang keraton yogyakarta dan barang2 peninggalan sejarah lainnya, di pertengahan tur disuguhi minuman jamu ratu mas, rasanya enaaak banget.

museum ini bercerita tentang kebesaran raja jawa, bahwa dahulu kita punya raja yang setara dengan raja raja eropa, meningkatkan kebanggan kita sebagai bangsa indonesia, tersedia guide dengan bahasa indonesia dan bahasa inggris, harga tiket masuk sekitar 35K -100K, dibutuhkan kendaraan untuk mencapai tempat ini dari yogyakarta, tersedia resto di bagian belakang museum

I grew up not far from Yogya, and after visited the place, I wonder why I did not come earlier. It's a family-owned museum, yet it is manage professionally. For locals, the price ticket is IDR 30,000 (around USD 2.5) and more expensive for foreign tourists. Visitors are put into groups with one guide who will tell you all the stories about the collection. 
The collection and the stories behind them are pretty interesting. The museum is focusing on Javanese culture, so expect to see some batik collection, photographs of sultanates and the royal families, paintings and even a room full of letters, dedicated for a broken-hearted princess!
Taking pictures is allowed near the exit area. What's more interesting is, you will be served with one small glass of traditional drinks (jamu) during the break time, made of lemongrass, cinnamon, ginger, etc. This is a favourite drink of one royal family which said to be youth preserving :).

It was nice experience there was guide who accompany you around museum tour, picture are not  allowed in most of inside the museum. It was 1 hour tour including break time for free traditional drink. Try to spend time at their restaurant it is nice place and excellent food and beverage.

There is some artificial cave, next will saw a completely gamelan music instruments. Most of the place show many kind of batik design. One thing that can not forget to drink some herbal,  stay young Jamu. Javanese people usualy say jamu awet muda.

The museum is about an hour drive from Yogyakarta, on the way to Mount Merapi which you can catch glimpses on a clear day.
It is a private collection, much better curated than your average government museum. Entry fee is Rp.50,000, which comes with a museum trained guide, just as well, as the displays have no English.
The complex is well designed and blended beautifully with the surrounding. The exhibits has a strong focus on a few royal personalities, show glimpses of Javanese royal lives, and are of high quality.
This is not your average museum with glass box displays. It has charm, style, taste  and personality, which makes you want to meet its owner (who used to live next door).
Highly recommended.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
I visited this museum right after sunrise tour Merapi. The jeep which took us to the Merapi, drop us in front of this museum. The location of this museum is in the same area as Merapi, called Kaliurang.
We arrived at 8.30 am before the museum open. So, we have to wait for a moment outside the entrance. At 9 pm the locket open and we were the first customer who buy the tickets. For local tourist, it cost 30,000 rupiah for adult and 15,000 rupiah for children (5-16 yo). For foreigner, it cost 50,000 rupiah for adult an 30,000 rupiah for children. I think it's relatively cheap and really worth it for the museum like Ullen Sentalu.
After we got our tickets, the officer at the entrance asked us and some others visitors to wait for our guide at the entrance. There're some chairs so we can seat while we're waiting. After 10-15 minutes waiting, the guide came to the entrance to pick visitors. At that time, our guide took one group of 20 people. In the entrance there's a clear rules in the museum, one of them that I could remember was a ban to take a picture inside the museum.
The desain of the museum is like a maze or a labyrinth with some rooms to store a lot of stuff that show the culture of Java, like batiks, gamelans, statues and off course some of paintings and photographs of the kings, queens, and families of the Yogyakarta Kingdom. Most of the paintings and photographs are duplicated, but it just like the real ones. 
So, if you love culture and art, you will love this museum. It's so worth it and I really recommend you to visit this museum.
