Beberapa bulan yang lalu, Saya berkunjung ke Museum Ullen Sentalu. Menyimpan banyak sejarah jaman dulu. Sayangnya tak bisa sembarangan photo disana, sehingga minim sekali kenangan disana. Guide sangat ramah, dan memberikan pelayanan yang sangat memuaskan.

It is a bit out of the way but the museum has really interesting history and artifacts. You're guided through the museum by an excellent guide in small groups. Surpassed my expectations and learned a lot about Javanese history.

Old and romantic museum, I describe. The museum describes a Javanese culture, socialite life  long time a go. Mostly telling the story about The Javanese Royal Family. Their true love, style, education, power, family etc.

The place was  very good, nice, cozy and artistic. The guide was excellent. She could explain everything clearly. 

Next to museum, there was a gallery which sell hand made batiks and embroidery. Nice.....

The museum offers a look into Javanese culture and history, laid out in an interesting fashion, throughout multiple buildings. It is located in a more hidden area, so you are able to enjoy the quiet, serene atmosphere. There is a guide who takes you through, though the multiple rooms and exhibits seem a little disorienting at times. There were also numerous areas blocked off that I would have liked to have seen. Photos are not allowed inside the museum, except for certain areas.

Feel that really worth visiting this museum since the entrance ticket idr 30k for local or idr 50k for foreigner alredy inclusive of entrance ticket, guided tour and their special jamu drink.

Good edutaintment especially for those who would like to know more about java traditional from the king and their families.
Bagus untuk belajar tentang kerajinan Batik dan adat jawa. Disini bisa mencicipi jamu dan juga melihat koleksi batik dari Jogja maupun dari Solo.

Very nice concept for a museum with interconnected rooms for the different displays.

Visits are guided by very well informed guides and not photography is allowed inside.

It is a private museum and the few artifacts they have are on loan from the government and the Keraton but the display and lay out tells a beautiful story through these limited items.

Nestled in the mountains, it is a nice break away from busy Yogyakarta.

Highly recommended if you want to learn more about Javanese heritage.

Tempatnya di Kaliurang, area Gunung Merapi. Harga tiket masuk adalah IDR 30,000/person (include guide). Setelah membeli tiket, kita di haruskan mendaftar ulang ke meja dekat pintu masuk, dan menunggu guide. Kita diwajibkan menggunakan guide untuk masuk ke museum ini. 1 guide akan mendampingi sampai dengan 15orang, dan tentunya akan dikelompokkan sesuai dengan Bahasa yang digunakan.

Tempatnya sangat bagus dan terawat, kita tidak diperbolehkan mengambil foto saat tour, hanya tempat-tempat tertentu saja yang diperbolehkan. Guide kami menjelaskan dengan detail dan attractive.

Museum ini lebih menceritakan mengenai silsilah keraton Yogya, mangkubumi dan Solo. Di area museum terdapat rumah dari pemilik atau penggagas museum ini.

Museum ini sangat bagus, dan mungkin museum terbaik yang ada di Indonesia.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Let me recommend this beautiful historic museum with a professional guide and a very nice "batik" shop. We enjoyed the story as well as admire the collection. Should you wish to visit mount "Merapi", please come to this museum and the volcano museum. You will spend a day tour with full of memory!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Awesome place. Altough taking picture inside is not allowed, except in certain areas. Beautiful building with art pieces like sculptures and reliefs. A good way to know Javanese (esp. Central Java & Jogjakarta) heritage. Arranged in a tour group of several numbers of visitors, led by a guide who can speak many languages. Located in the valley of Mount Merapi makes this museum is not easy to reach by public transportation. But this is a place you must visit when you go to Jogjakarta.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Di museum ini kita membeli tiket kemudian akan dikelompokkan untuk tour museum. Sayangnya di sini kita tidak bisa berlama-lama menikmati benda-benda dan lukisan yang ada karena harus mengikuti tour guide. Tour diakhiri dengan sajian Wedang Ratu Mas

This museum placed in nice area of Kaliurang, Sleman. Building with unique design because inside the museum feels like labyrinth. Museum collection itself all related to a Sultanate of Yogyakarta but mostly paintings and clothes of king and queen. Recommended if you want to know about history of a Sultanate of Yogyakarta. A guide provides.

For me.... this place....
It's just beautiful.
I don't have any picture. Because it's prohibited in main area.
And u can take picture in the end of museum tour. There's a merchandise shop and cozy cafe

I think this museum is awesome,great location and great history for java kingdom...the best things the guide staff is very helpfull and explain all the history clearly.....if you are indonesia traveller you must visit this museum

Great job ullem sentalu
..keep moving!!

I had visited this museum years before Merapi volcanic eruptions, to my surprises they have new entry with a couple statue and background of beautiful forest. We were taken in 3 stages of visits to labyrinths displaying paintings and photos of 2 royal families of Surakarta and Yogyakarta during 16th century till at present. After went through 2 stages we took a break for a traditional drink, then followed the last stage. All labyrinths are well maintained with good interior and design. More paintings and photos are added since my last visit. Really worth to visit even for the 2nd time.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
I visited on July 2016. The museum build since 1992 and became famous on last 3 years. Inside the museum we are not allow to take pictures. Only 1 area that wa are allow. The ticket price is 30.000 (for adult), 25.000 (for student). The price includes tour guide fee for 60mins and 1 traditional drinks.
The museum is contain about the history of 4 Islamic Kingdom in Jogjakarta, the kings and their inheritance, the culture and the tradition.
Rekomendasi wisata bermanfaat, dapat senengnya dapat ilmunya. Salut sekali semakin cinta dengan budaya Jawa pastinya

Loved this difficult to reach little museum near the volcano. My personal guide took me through the museum and chatted with me about life, the universe and everything. She was amazing! Explained aspects of Javanese culture and history, discussed religion and politics with me, talked about local hobbies and habits and home life. Wonderful!
Also a nice little restaurant next to the museum for a good, relaxing lunch.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Ullen Sentalu is a museum about the history of the kingdoms of Yogyakarta and Solo. It's about the differences in the batik if these two kingdoms, about the lifestyle and the persons if the kingdom. You get a private guide who explain all to you, in a good English. The museum is in an old typical village in traditional houses. It's very informative and. It so many tourists are there. It's a must on your Yogya trip.
In the end there is like a boutique and also a resto. Worth every rupiah!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Kami berangkat pagi2 dari Hotel dengan menyewa mobil menuju Ullen Sentalu, di Kaliurang, Yogyakarta; sebuah museum seni dan budaya Jawa. Perjalanan lancar dan kami menikmati suasana desa di bagian lain di Yogyakarta.
Ketika kami datang, museum sedang direnovasi, namun suasana teduh menyambut kami di sekitar museum tersebut karena banyak pepohonan. Kami dipandu oleh seorang gadis manis yang ramah dan beliau menjelaskan dengan runtun tentang isi museum. Kita akan diperkenalkan dengan silsilah keraton raja-raja di Jawa khususnya di Jogja, Surakarta dan sekitarnya. Sebagian besar isi museum adalah gambar2 dan lukisan, dan kita dijelaskan isi2 gambar tersebut. 
Lama2 penjelasan tersebut menjadi membosankan, apalagi anak2 dalam suasana liburan bukan tour sekolah.
Ditambah lagi metode penjelasannya kurang dilengkapi sarana video atau film2 dokumenter, sehingga lebih hidup dan tidak membosankan.
Acara ditutup dengan disuguhkannya minuman khas keraton, lumayan setelah berkeliling, tenggorokan disegarkan olah minuman hangat yang mengandung jahe tersebut. 
Nampaknya, perlu dipertimbangkan lagi oleh pengelola museum untuk menyuguhkan sejarah2 tersebut dengan cara yang lebih menarik.
The place is clean and the guide narrative very loud and clear. We can learn about batik history and the royal family.

No pictures allowed.
This policy doesn't changed since my 1st visit back in 2010. Only certain spot u could take pictures.but thats fine with me.
The architecture is blend with nature. Along the way u'll see water flowing in clean drain. It came with the philosophy:all good things will come and the bad things will carry away.
Small group with 1 guide (bahasa/English).if its not too crowded,u may have spend time longer in poets room.collection owned by a brokenhearted princess.the poets are solely touch ur soul.
During the break,they will serve u with traditional drink  made by ginger.
There's a urban story that would be denialed by ur guide.but there's one painting with princess of south java 'nyi roro kidul' that dancing along with others dancers.
In 2010,i saw this painting next to a set of gamelan (traditional percussion).some people said in some nights,this gamelan will play by its own. 
And now,the painting is removed to different room,away from the gamelan.
Ask the guide,and u may not have the answer :)
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This museum is very unique and we're not allowed to take photos of the collection. We can't just wandering around without our tour guide so yeah it's like a private tour and in the middle of the tour we get a traditional drink... worth it!

This museum provide us to knowing history of Kraton Solo - Yogyakarta in perfect beautiful place. The tour guide will tell you more stories behind every stuffs and painting. You'll enjoy the secret recipe jamu at the end of the tour. Enjoy!

di museum ullen sentalu ini ada guide yang memandu dan menjelaskan tentang berbagai hal yang ada di museum, berbagai sejarah keraton, arti dari masing-masing batik, perbedaan kesultanan Yogyakarta dan Kesunanan Solo, sejarah terpecahnya keraton dan lain-lain, hanya saja disini tidak diperkenankan berfoto didalam museum, tetapi ketika tur di museum berakhir disediakan spot untuk berfoto diluar..
tempatnya teduh banget dan masing-masing trip alurnya berbeda.. karena masing-masing guide tidak mengambil tahapan menjelaskan yang sama.. cukup menyenangkan, hanya dengan membayar Rp30.000/orang bisa mendapatkan ilmu sejarah keraton dan lain-lain..

This museum located in Mt. Merapi area, so it was cool and greenny. This place is Javanese Cultural museum that explained a lot about royal life and history about batik. We will assisted by tour guide which gave many explanations about every details of painting, sculture, and statues. Overall, it was good place for teenagers to have eagerness about culture.

Lokasinya berada di Kaliurang dimana tiket masuk sudah dilengkapi dengan guide dan minuman gratis di dalamnya. Setiap koleksi, lukisan, dan ruangan memiliki makna dan arti tersendiri. 

Dekorasi yang menarik serta banyaknya pengetahuan yang dimiliki oleh pemandu membuat saya semakin terkesan oleh museum ini. Seakan akan, hanya dalam waktu satu jam saya bisa mengetahui fungsi batik motif parang, ceplok, dan lainnya. 

Cerita Almh.Gusti Nurul merupakan favorit saya. DImana beliau dibuatkan ruangan khusus untuk dirinya.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Saat pertama kali melihat pintu gerbang museum ini terasa seperti memasuki hutan karena byk pohon2 besar. Saat masuk, akan dipandu oleh guide yang akan menemani selama 1 setengah jam. Museum ini sangat luas & terbagi menjadi bbrp ruangan. Cocok untuk mempelajari seni budaya jawa Jogja - Solo. Saya beruntung mendapat guide yang menyenangkan, sehingga selama menyusuri museum tidak merasa bosan.

Located quite far from the city, but definitely worth to visit. They have great collection of paintings, transcripts, and artefacts which were very well preserved. Admission price was 30K, tour guide included, plus a glass of jamu. You will have an amazing experience during the small group tour with detailed explanation and seeing the whole compound will make you appreciate the sultanate history more.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: 屋内には近郊の遺跡で発掘された仏像などが展示され、説明書きも丁寧でした。敷地内には美しい緑を眺めながらゆったりと過ごせるカフェ兼レストランもあり、2時間程度過ごさせていただきました。雨が降っていましたが、草木の緑が映えて綺麗でした。
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: I like that museum because the museum can bring me some experience and bring us back to the past. The Guide explain all of the things in the musum. I can see collection and many things in the museum. Many history become true and so I can imagine the history about all of there in the museum. It is the place where you can learn about the past. So don't miss it and it is the recommended museum in Yogyakarta.

One of great museum concept in Indonesia. The guide can speak english fluently and explained in very attractive way. Introducing the roots of java in a very beautiful art.
My 6 y.o daughter really enjoyed her time here. She asked many questions to the guide and she answer with loud and clear answer for young children.
Some of museum "items" are not suitable for "sensitive people (babies,toddlers) they might be scared or crying. So be wise.

One of the Best museum for its collections and concept. We learn about Batik and History of Royal Family of Keraton Yogyakarta and Keraton Solo. The building, the story and history of Indonesian heritage are overwhelmingly beautiful. I love how they manage to have rules for no food and drink while on tour, it keeps the museum clean and well preserved.

A must visited place in Jogjakarta.
Definitely shares the story about Jogjakarta and Surakarta.
It also tells about batik.
The guide was very nice in telling the story and always ready to help.

I love that this museum brings us back to the past by it's unique arrangement. The outdoor area also give that relaxing and nostalgic feeling which also represent the culture of Yogya and Solo.
As we enter the museum, we will be brought circling around the areas with the friendly guide who will narrate us the story of each area. At first I thought it wouldn't be too big but it turns out that we were like entering a different dimension by dimension each time we move to other area. I love culture but personally never really care about the history, yet I can't lie that I was really interested with the way they put the history into the display.

Also we got a drink (I think it was some kind of jamu or medical herbs) that they say as the medicine to make you look younger. It has unique taste and story behind it. Love it.

We could not take a photo inside but I don't find that as a problem since I don't like to take too much photo.

Highly recommended for both local and international tourist!!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I really love to visit ullen sentalu over and over again. And I always recommend this place to my friends from outside Jogja. This museum is owned by one of the royal family if I'm not mistaken not by the government. Most of the collections are from Solo Kingdom. The inside the museum is like a maze and you will be accompanied by a guide. You're not allowed to take any pics inside the museum. The collections are well taken care and clean so it's worth the price. My favorite room is ruang putri dambaan, a room dedicated for one of the princess, Gusti Nurul. After the tour you are allowed to take pics outside the building and there is souvenir shop and a western restaurant called Beukenhof.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Excellent English speaking guide added to the wonderful ambience of the museum.  The building layout was astonishing plus the wonderful use of plants added to the attraction.  The restaurant lunch was very tasty & pleasant.  The standard of goods in the Museum shop was extremely high & not general tourist "junk"
I definitely recomend this place.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Museumnya sangat luas, koleksi nya banyak. Kalo musim liburan lumayan antri masuknya. Di akhir sesi museum saya waktu itu dikasih semacam wedang (minuman) oleh pihak museum. Tempat foto-foto juga banyak dan bagus
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Jika berkunjung saat kabut tebal atau di musim hujan, persiapkan payung untuk dibawa. Karena di ullen sentalu terdiri dari beberapa ruangan yang terpisah dan tanpa jalan beratap. Payung dan jas hujan sangat dibutuhkan saat kondisi hujan.

Lamanya waktu yang dibutuhkan untuk berkeliling museum adalah 50-60 menit. Ada pemandu yang akan menjelaskan kepada pengunjung. Dan selama di dalam museum dilarang berphoto. Yang menarik adalah membaca surat pribadi dari puteri-puteri keraton.

Di dalam museum akan diberikan segelas minuman khas yang rasanya hangat (ramuan gula, jahe dan bahan lain).

I love to visit the museum, and this one too. the history is about yogyakarta, solo, and their kings. the museum has a large area, but you won't be boring or tired because they arrange the museum in an unique way. you will have one tour guide to explain anything inside. like walk in a labyrinth, the guide will bring you from one room to another room. every rooms have a different story. and you will get a special drink that the guide told it would make you look younger, believe it or not. the guide is very friendly. too bad they forbid you to take a picture inside. the one you can take a pic is the final place. well, so far i was enjoyed so much.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
I love the way they arranged the history of Yogyakarta and Solo Keraton in neat and thorough order, with the stuffs that came from ancient times. The halls were quite small, but that way you can feel the intimate relation you will have from the stuffs you see on the wall and hallways.

The friendly tour guide will accompany you until the end of the tour. You'll get a nice Javanese hot drink on the final hall of your tour.

PS: This is one of my first date place 5 years ago where I met a beautiful caring young lady in Yogyakarta. She brought me here to sightseeing, and when we get home, we officially become in serious relationship. I don't know, but this place is magic!!

Museum koleksi keluarga yg cukup lengkap. Bisa banyak belajar budaya Jawa. Penataan yg sangat berbeda dengan desain lansekap yg oke banget. Sayangnya hanya boleh berfoto dilokasi tertentu saja...padahal semua lokasi asyik buat berfoto..he..he..he
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Ini adalah museum pertama yang pernah saya datangi. Sebelumnya saya enggan datang ke museum. Tetapi berbeda degan Museum Ullen Sentalu ini. Karena ada cerita - cerita menarik yang dibawakan oleh pemimpin tour yang membuat saya di bosan berada disini.

I enjoyed the museum so much, so I visited a couple of times, and every time there are some changes, its a mystical museum, some paintings have a heartbeat wether you belief me or not,, but you can feel and see there, old beautiful batiks, pictures of royal family and a beautifil garden, the museum is in Kaliurang, the mountain side of Yogyakarta, so, a nice getaway from town,
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
I never really care about what a museum diaplay, but I'm mostly eager to listen to and be carried away by the guide (or interpreter). This museum hit the spot, almost perfectly.

The lady guide who took me around the museum was interactive, attentive and willing to listen. She was one of the best museum guide Ive met so far. It was a bit chaotic when my group met not just one but two and three other groups that distracted the flow but theb paid off in the last stops, tho.

So I guess the idea of camera restriction in this museum was making sense: to get our senses actively perceive the experience.

Saya menyukai museum Ullen Sentalu saat kunjungan pertama saya tahun 2003. Arsitekturnya yang seolah menyatu dengan alam membuat saya betah di sana, dan tentu saja Wedang Ratu Mas yang diberikan sebagai "welcome drink" adalah daya tarik lain dari museum ini. Kunjungan ke-2 siang ini saya merasakan suasana yang berbeda, museum sudah semakin luas, dan kunjungan diatur per-20 orang didampingi oleh guide dari museum. Rombongan teralalu besar harus berjalan di selasar yang cukup sempit diantara lorong sempit tempat foto-foto koleksi museum di pajang. Penjelasan dari guide museum juga terlalu cepat sehingga saya tidak bisa menyerap dengan baik informasi yang disampaikan olehnya. Saya juga membayangkan Ullen Sentalu adalah museum batik, ternyata telah berubah menjadi museum seni dan budaya yang kurang menarik informasinya. Saya lebih menyukai Ullen Sentalu dengan cerita sejarah atau kajian antropologi tentang batik, tentang perkambangan motif batik dan perdagangan batik. Dan menganai fasilitas, toilet terlalu jauh dari ruang tunggu sehingga kurang ramah terhadap orang berusia lanjut dan anak-anak.

Tempat ini sangat nyaman, untuk masuk ke area benar2 selektif, mereka membatasi jumlah orang yang masuk, sudaya di dalam museum tidak penuh.

Sehingga kita harus antri untuk masuk, tetapi setelah kita berada didalam suasana nyaman membawa kita ke dalam jogja dahulu kala, kita akan ditemanin oleh guide selama perjalanan kita mengelilingi meseum.

Guidenya sangat informatif dan sabar, sangat cocok buat ada yg hobi dengan sejarah.
I was there taking pictures and the ambience of the museum strike me down. It is an oasis in the jungle of smelly motorbikes and cars. Very relaxing...
What a beauty. Everyone needs to come here if they visit yogyakarta. And if you want to know the culture of yogyakarta.

Thanks to Pak Haryono who build this fantastic museum... It's complete, modern, professional and authentic Javanese museum with great design layout and weather surrounding.
The tour guide lady was very friendly and smart, very well communication skill...
It's was my 5th visit and still want to re visit....
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Kalo mau belajar budaya dan sejarah Jawa dsini tempatnya...dapat jamu awet muda gratis pula..tapi dilarang menyentuh ataupun mengambil gambar dalam museum ini..blh foto tp di spot yang ditentukan

Admission ticket includes guide & traditional drinks given inside the museum. We got an excellent guide, very funny & informative. She explained the background of Javanese cultures (why they do certain behaviour) & meaning behind various Batik patterns. Very recommended for history buffs!

Bagus sekali menambah pengetahuan untuk anak-anak dan orang dewasa Dan tiketnya juga murah untuk dewasa 
Rp 30.000 & anak-anak Rp 15.000 +
(60 menit wisata, pemandu wisata, minum gratis dan parkir gratis) menjadi pilihan liburan untuk semua orang

Before going to Jogjakarta, we went to Kaliurang from Magelang to visit this museum. At the gate of Tourism Kaliurang, we paid retribution Rp. 3.000/adult, Rp. 1.500/adult and Rp. 2.000/car.

The sign to this museum truly small. Many food seller outside the museum. Admission for adult Rp. 30.000 and child above 5 y.o Rp. 15.000. The ticket including tour 50- 60 mins and a glass of herbal drink (ginger, sugar, and some other ingredients). The guide explained the history well. She was friendly and helped us taking photo groups. During the tour, no photo and video allowed, but at the end of the tour, we allowed to take pictures only in that area. The front area of this museum still renovated but it was ok.

After visiting this museum, I understand more about "Kraton" & its culture, and why Jogjakarta called Special Region(already forgot about the history lesson). I will recommend this to family and friends.

Menuju lokasi.sangat membingungkan dan jauuuhh..walo akhirnya nyampai..sunyi..sepi...sdg d renovasi bangunan depannya..saya lbh tertarik dgn gaya arsitektur bangunannya..yg info tour guide nya d ilhami dan d rancang olh putra pemilik...seperti d film2 eropa tempo dulu... penerangannya kurang terang..temaram..untung tidak hujan...bisa d jadikan tujuan wisata...utk mem foto cuma d lokasi tertentu...souvenir dan baju2 batik yg d tawarkan..juga bagus2..cuma mahalan..😊.. d area parkir ada penjual salak...salaknya manis masir..harga wajar ..boleh lah buat ngebantu penduduk sekitar
I always love art, and at ullen sentalu i learnt about our history trough javanese batik.. The meaning of every design..

This is a great place to get a grasp of Javanese culture. Though it was still under renovation by the time I came, I still greatly enjoyed my visit.
The entrance fee is pretty reasonable. Also the guide was helpful and knowledgeable.

A beautiful private museum which explain the history of the royal families of Java. English speaking guide being small group & explain on every section of the museum. No photography inside the museum. Learnt a lot from this trip. Highly recommended & worth a visit!

Melihat Jogja yang berbeda, dari sudut tampilan dan pengunjungnya, disinilah tempatnya. Pengunjung museum sudah dengan sungguh-sungguh menyiapkan diri. Mereka tampil cantik, dari kalangan beragam, secantik isi museumnya...
Tempat yang sangat rekomended untuk mengetahui berbagai sejarah antara jogja dan solo, selain untuk pengetahuan tempatnya juga sangat nyaman dipadukan dengan pemandu yang tanggap dan ramah

Visiting this Museum again after 10 years ago. Entrance fee is cheap, 30k for locals and 50k for foreigner (around 3,5 USD) its include guide and traditional herbal drink that really fresh in the middle of the tour. 

We were here during low season so no need to queue. Tour will take approximately 45 minutes to 1 hour. Rina, our guide was really good, friendly and provide us with good information during tour. at the end of the tour you can visit Batik gallery which is good but pricey. They have have restaurant in one of the building, but we didn't try it. 

We were happy and satisfied with the museum, several area is under development for more collections so should be more experience when we visited this place again next time. 

For those of you who like to take a pictures, unfortunately you may doing it only on several points, tour guide will be more than happy to help you with your camera.

It is an interesting place to learn about the history of Javanese Sultan, culture and batik. The place is well maintained and providing free guide to tell the history. In some areas there are several similarity between this place and Batik museum at Danarhadi (Solo).
To those who interest in Java culture, this museum is a must to visit. You can include this place on your itinerary to Merapi & surrounds.

In Kaliurang op de helling van de Merapi ligt dit verrassend mooie museum. Het is  vrijwel geheel onder de grond gebouwd van lavasteen. De ruimtes geven een fraai beeld van de geschiedenis van de sultanaten van Yogya en Solo op basis van schilderijen en foto's.  Tevens prachtige oude beelden uit het Mataram Koninkrijk. We worden rondgeleid door een goed engels sprekende jongedame. Zeer informatief. Je mag niet fotograferen. Er is een heerlijk restaurant met uitzicht op de tuin en het is een aangename temperatuur. Al met al een topattractie.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Museum khas Jawa yang meegulas tentang keraton Jogja dan Surakarta. Di dampingin oleh guide khusus dr pihak museum membuat pemahaman tntg sejarahnya lebih baik. Tempat rekomendasi untuk wisata yang berilmu. Buka setiap hari, terletak di Kaliurang atas bawah pegunungan Merapi membuat suasanya makin mantap.
You can see many jogja culture here with a bit magis. Many batik models and story about jogja quin and king

This museum is a refreshing break from the heat and peddling of other Jogya sights. Beautiful architecture, informative English speaking guide, and much more detail about the history of the Jogya-Solo royal families than the Kranton. The restaurant is the perfect place to end the visit, get a seat outside. Good western style food. Gift shop is pricey, but they have a good selection of modern clothes and gifts with Indonesian flair.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Museum swasta dengan koleksi yang cukup lengkap, tiket masuk sudah termasuk dengan pendamping yang sangat piawai menceriterakan sejarah benda-benda di museum tersebut. Tiket masuk seharga Rp. 30.000/dewasa dan Rp. 15.000/anak.

The trip heading towards Ullen Sentalu doesn't take that long. The destination is nestled at the end of winding country roads with the occasional Snake fruit vendor stands (must try!). 

If you want a glimpse into the rich history of yogyakarta's ruling families and the intricate shifts in power and the political landscape, take a leisurely trip there to listen to English speaking guides that the museum provides. The tour lasts around 45 minutes, and the museum is rich which mementos and memorabilia (photos, relics and other curios) 

My son and I appreciated the knowledge shared by our guide, Vella. Regardless of how many times she may have delivered that tour to countless other foreigners in the past,  you can still feel the reverence and respect she has for the features showcased at Ullen Sentalu. 

If you are wondering why you dont see pics of this place online it is because you can't snap away like we usually do in places like the Ghetty. To be honest, this is perfectly fine because you get to intimately experience what the place has to offer instead of strategic placements of selfies that wastes the meat of being at Ullen Sentalu. 

Another plus is the restaurant they have on site that catered to our palate. Western close to fine dining food that tasted good was a very welcome thing to us since we generally did not enjoy jogyakarta food. 

Clean, well maintained and with English speaking staff. A must see for those interested in being introduced to yogya culture.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
I would recommend this place to my friends who doesn't know history of Yogyakarta, or the filosofi of Javanese. Only for IDR 25.000 included tour guide. Basically, the tour guide will explain you a lot of filosofi about Yogyakarta and Keraton. 
This place is well maintained. Clean. The tour last for around 1.5 up to 2 hour. There are limited place for taking picture. 
Overall, recommended place to educate yourself for the culture of Yogyakarta.

Ullen Sentana..dua kata..di bayanganqu..yg asing..saat itu..setelah..datang..dan membuktikan...betul betul..
LUAR BIASA..
Pertama..melihat ticket masuk yg utk kami sedikit MAHAL.
Tetapi ternyata..MAHAL menurut saya...terbayar..dg tour leader yg bagus...lugas..jelas..teliti..dan runut utk..menceritakan dari detail sudut dr bilik2 yg ada...foto2...batik nan klasik...budaya yg adi luhung..dan tentu saja...minuman yg di sajikan..perpaduan rempah2..menghangatkan tenggorokan.dan badan..yg pasti pesona Ullen Sentanu..adalah destinasi budaya yg Adi Luhung...yg Harus..di lestarikan..Bravo.
Ullen Sentanu...

overrated. we purposely hire a car cost INR 400K to visit this place since it was rated no#1 place, what a disappoitnment!!!please skip this place as it is not qualified to be named as "Museum". No artifacts..only have replica and some pictures / painting of royal family. It is more like an a small gallery. Entrance fee at INR50K.
Extremely well-worth the visit. The guides will bring you through the romance and history of the Mataram empire and the dynasties of the Solo and Yogyakarta royal families.
Museum ini sangat unik dan menarik, banyak tersimpan benda2 peninggalan para raja Jogyakarta. Perawatan yang terjaga dan sedikit2 ada suasana magis disini.Perlu di kunjungi

We just follow the Guide and the very limited time with no discretion as to the other museums ... not recommended !

Regardless of what we think of a museum, especially if you've previously visited other museums around the world

Only this is the only museum that besides not allowed to take any pictures should also be accompanied by a Guide from beginning to end, it felt as though the objects that are here are very valuable (maybe all of them gold) and fear stolen, but that would be felt by visitors is when we became very limited, which is just along the steps Guide, fitting out of the museum in addition to the money that is lacking several tens of thousands to pay for a ticket then no impression whatsoever longer lasting, our Guide at that time also felt very rushed as pursued time and we really did not enjoy, we were disappointed and would not recommend this place to visit

Thoroughly enjoyed our tour of the museum and grounds--our guide had spoke excellent English and was incredibly knowledgeable on the history of Java, Jogja and Sukrakarta. The grounds are beautiful as are the artwork and collections. Do not miss this one!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: My favorite museum. It's really worth to come here although it's kinda far from downtown. But, i assure you that this is the best place for the museum. The art and the history become a beauty of old age. You will be spoiled by the richness of history, the beauty of the art, the kindness of the staff. You'll also get free drink of ageless potion, an original recipe from Yogyakarta's royal. I love it here.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It is good for the children, good knowledge. But the price is expensive. Maybe could reduce the price?

Ondanks dat het museum op een enigszins afgelegen plaats ligt, is het zeker het bezoeken waard. De toegangsprijs is IDR 50.000 voor toeristen, waarbij een gids/rondleiding van zo'n 1.5 uur inbegrepen zit. De gidsen zijn erg vakkundig en spreken goed Engels. De rondleiding neemt je vervolgens mee door de geschiedenis van de verschillende sultanaten en bijbehorende hofhouding e.d. Erg interessante en mooie verhalen!
I love how they give interesting information for visitors...not only information about royal family but also the culture of java..the guide so friendly and the place so cozy..

A unique museum that gives you the history of Yogyakarta's royal family and the development of batik fashion. The historical house, which was converted into the museum, makes the place even more interesting.

Was planning to take tons of foto with my cousins. Apparently not allowed in most of places

But the tour was very informative and entertaining 

The cafe supposed to open early for breakfast since the scenery was beautiful for breakfast or brunch

Lovely time in ullen sentanu museum

Like i said. Best museum in Indonesia. Because they can present Javanese heritage with "class". But the museum does not have an automatic playback headphone, like in Europe etc. So you have to use a guide. I forget how much you should pay them. It will be good if you go before or after mount Merapi trip (nearby).

This museum is managed by private company (not government) which makes it quite well managed. The tour inside was guided with one staff for a group of 10-15 visitors. No pictures allowed - only in certain area (garden) and the guide has the knowledge through all collections, and those were the original collections that seriously taken care of.

Ich kann mich nur den vorhergehenden Bewertungen anschliessen. Dieses private Museum ist sehr schön eingerichtet und auch spannend. Ein weiterer Pluspunkt ist, dass die FührerInnen gutes Englisch sprechen, somit bekommt man alles Erzählte gut mit und muss nicht dauernd nachfragen, deshalb geht die knappe Stunde wie im Flug vorüber. 
Anschliessen kann man noch im Shop handgefertigte Batikkleider oder sonstige Accessoires erwerben.
Das Museum öffnet jeden Tag um 08.30 Uhr seine Tore für die Besucher.

I visited this museum on the 2nd day of my tours of Jogja.  I first went on a Monday because my tour organiser and driver both forgot that museums in Jogja aren't open on Monday, so don't plan to go on a Monday.  I returned the next day and it was worth the return visit.  The museum seems well curated and our guide was very informative.  Her English was great and she was very friendly.  This museum gives quite a bit of information on the royalty of Jogja and Solo, mostly recent history.  The entrance fee is 50,000 rupiah for foreign visitors and a guided tour, which lasts around 30 to 45 minutes (although the guide says 15 minutes) is included.  The atmosphere is great - it's cool and quiet, the perfect setting, I think.  Great visit.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
We heard such great review on this place that we included into our itinerary and we are not disappointed. Entrance fee for non-Indonesian is IDR50,000 (Adult) and IDR30,000 (child) that comes with a guide.  English speaking guide is available upon request. Our guide was Nita who was sweet and very patiently explained all the exhibits and history of the Mataram kingdom. Unfortunately, we were not allowed to take pictures.  
The tour took 50 mins and a museum worth visiting.

Museum of Ullen Sentalu, located in Kaliurang.

A great museum, especially for who wants to know more about Javanese culture. Starting form the Jogjakarta Kingdom, Solo Kingdom, The Kings (Sultan), and the story of Princes and Princesses, Javanese wedding, and etc. Really great and increasing our knowledge then. One important thing, we can't take a photograph inside the museum, because of to keep all pictures, batik and whole things inside there to be in good condition.
If you love anything about history, maybe you will love some history of this Yogyakarta Palace (and also Surakarta!). The staff will guide and tell you about the story of each room.

i went there because of my friend recommendation. the ticket for foreign and national not too far which i appreciate it compare to borobudur, prambanan temple that like robe my fiancee as he pay 9 times then i did. we wait for our tour guide to ready. then she explain everything and whatever we ask she try to answer it. she speak English very well so i don't have to worry to translate it. normally everytime we visit museum in indonesia i have to try translate and try to find the answer. which sometime i don't remember anymore in history lesson from school.
in half way they will serve you ginger tea and break. we also can take picture in several places. after 1 hour to 1,5 hour you will be finish with the museum and they have nice restaurant near the exit gate. overall is the best museum i ever visit.

Museum ini terletak di daerah Kaliurang Jogjakarta, salah satu museum dengan konsep yang sangat unik. Saat masuk ke dalam museum ini kita akan ditemani oleh 1 orang guide yang akan bercerita mengenai sejarah patung-patung, lukisan atau benda lain yang ada di dalam museum ini. Aura mistis dan kesan misterius akan sangat terasa saat wisatawan memasuki museum ini, banyak sesajen dan dupa di letakkan di sebelah patung. Pengunjung di larang mengambil foto sembarangan, hanya boleh pada area2 tertentu saja, yang akan menambah rasa penasaran wisatawan. Terlepas dari itu semua, museum ini satu2nya museum yang membuat saya tidak bosan untuk mengunjunginya lagi.

Is a very interesting museum in Kaliurang, nearby Yogyakarta where you can learn the history of Java, since Hinduism, Moslem era, Batik and also the Monarchy. 

The collections are mostly from the donation of Javanese monarchy family and some of the ancient artefact are original. It was a worth of visit, especially if you are keen on history.
this place is little bit hidden but a worth to visit when you are in jogja, their collection is good and wide, the food there is also good

Saya sdh beberapa kali ke museum di seluruh dunia namun baru di museum ullen sentalu Jogjakarta mengalami keanehan, dengan membayar per orang Rp 30.000,- saya HARUS masuk museum dengan disertai guide !! HARUS ! Padahal untuk ada guide saya harus menunggu dulu beberapa waktu sampai ada guide nya ....isinya biasa saja tidak terlalu istimewa karena saya sudah beberapa kali mengantarkan tamu...karena kali ini waktu saya terbatas untuk harus menunggu guide jadi akhirnya saya kembalikan tiket dan kembali uang...saya datang Jumat 20 Mei 2016

Unique and so lovely scenery. The tour guide will give a best explanation about the Mataram Kingdom history. During the middle of trip, there are section that museum offer us to taste a 'minuman awet muda' that have being practices by the princess from generation to generation. Such a private museum actually! i love it.

This place is very unique, located in the North of Yogyakarta and become one of the must to go places from everyone who loves history and museum. Ulen Sentalu reflected the story of Yogyakarta princess and queens and also a Javanese cultures. There is also a cafe and restaurant inside the building, and its very enjoyable place to having meal over there.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Tours are very detailed and informative. it gives you an idea of how royalty is like. love the batik costumes and different meaning it portrays.
Takes about 50 minutes. Included in the ticket is a personal guide that takes you through the museum. You learn a lot about Javanese culture and history. One of my favorite experiences in Yogyakarta.

Tempat ini menyimpan banyak peninggalan sejarah yogyakarta. dengan konsep berkelompok yang didampingi private guide, yang akan menjelaskan semua koleksi yang ada di dalam museum. setiap koleksi dikelompokkan kedalam beberapa bagian, dalam ruangan tersendiri. ditengah tour, akan diberi sajian minuman rempah, resep tradisional keraton. didalam museum, pengunjung dilarang mengambil foto. pengunjung diperbolehkan mengambil foto di spot tertentu saja.

unique, good, fresh air, good view, you can expand your knowledge about Mataram Kingdom history. Educational, cultural, interesting place to visit. And you can taste the traditional drink with secret recipe from the past..

Museum ini merupakan kumpulan koleksi benda2 dan foto2 peninggalan kesultanan Yogyakarta, yang masih dirawat dg sangat baik dan dikelompokkan berdasarkan thema/periode kekuasaan Raja. Dipandu Tour Guide yg sangat fasih bercerita dan membawa kita ke masa lampau. Bangunan yg khas jawa, berwarna dominan abu2, dg cuaca dingin di lereng Merapi menambahn kemistisannya. Tujuan wisata yg tidak boleh dilewatkan.
This place provide you a guide to give all the explanation about the place for free. The have many enormous collections and amazing story behind it. Surely will visit this place again.

The place located in a quite, remote area, with beautiful scenary. You also will be taken on tour to see history of  Yogyakarta's Sultan and Yogyakarta's antique such as Batik story.
They also have western cafe, the food is quite delicious, not so many choices with beautiful scenery.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Museum nya unik. Hawanya dingin dan sejuk. Ada guide yang menemani menyusuri tiap lorong museum. Nanti saat sudah di ruang pertemuan museum,pengunjung disajikan minuman tradisional yang segar. Bagusss museumnyaa
If you want to learn about Javanese history and culture, this is the best place for you. Privately run, this tops the list as the best museum in Indonesia.

museum yang tidak bosan dikunjungi karena kepiawaian guidenya dalam menjelaskan. disini kita akan diberikan penjelasan secara lengkap oleh guide yang professional tentang sejarah , budaya jawa, dan menampilkan koleksi yang menarik dan yang untuk dilewatkan seperti batik, lukisan, gamelan dll. hawanya sejuk disekitar area sini.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
first of all, a visit here with a 2 years-old kid could be troublesome, since the stony-and-stepy architecture of the museum avoid the usage of stroller/wheelchair.
but apart from that, this is definitely the best museum in this country I have visited.. make sure to also bring raincover in case of sudden rain.

I have a moderate interest in Yogya's kingdom (Keraton) history, since I only read one book with regards to this topic (the book on Pangeran Diponegoro Heorism), but surely we can learn a lot from this museum.

this is a must try.

Aunque la colección de arte que tiene no es grande, la guía que me toco explico fantásticamente. Le hice variad preguntas y se nota la alta preparación que tiene. El museo en si es bonito.
Anda preparado para lluvia, seguro que llueve en la tarde.
Este museo y los trenes parecen ser lo único que funciona como debe en Java. 
Para llegar allá arrienda una moto, es barato y el camino es bonito. Si algún tipo trata de frenarte en alguna parte simplemente pasa de largo y no lo mires. Es costumbre acá que te paran para cobrarte. Pide ticket oficial siempre.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The place itself is located in ad remote area at Kaliurang, north of Yogyakarta, the same direction as Merapi Volcano. If you driving your own vehicle, it wont be hard to reach here. For me, i prever public transport to get there. Take a Transjogja to Kentungan shelter from any shelter in the center of the city. And then, I use another minibus, elf, it doesn't look like a public transport, but it is. You will need at least 30 minutes from Kentungan to Kaliurang Park. And walk around 10 minutes the museum. The surrounding is very good, fresh air, high trees, and its a bit cool unlike Yogyakarta because its location is on the mountain. My advice if you use public transport, when you're going back to the city, just wait for ojek on the Kaliurang park area. But it will take some times.

By default you will have the guide, they will collect until enough people to guide for local visitor. For foreigner they provide different guide based on your native language. Inside of the place you cannot take a picture, you will informed by the guide where you can take a photo. A nice place with story telling by the guide to know some history happen in the Yogya and Solo Kingdom including batik pattern story.

Sebagai kota yang kaya sejarah dan budaya, keberadaan Museum Ullen Sentalu ini seperti merefleksikan dan menyimpan memori tentang kota Yogyakarta.
Saya pernah cukup iri saat berkunjung ke Jepang, sebuah kota modern yang tidak pernah melupakan budaya dan sejarahnya, dikemas dengan cukup bagus dan menarik.
Saat ke Museum ini, saya cukup senang dan bangga, ternyata kita juga punya. Apalagi saat itu kami mendapat pemandu yang sangat menyenangkan dan menguasai sekali sejarah dan dengan lugas menjawab setiap pertanyaan dari pengunjung.
Cukup senang juga melihat anak-anak juga tertarik dan memperhatikan dengan seksama setiap penjelasan dan terkagum dengan benda-benda koleksi yang ada.
Tiket masuk sebesar Rp. 30.000,- (dewasa) dan Rp. 15.000,- (anak-anak dan pelajar) bagi saya cukup murah untuk ilmu pengetahuan dan sejarah yang bisa kita bagikan ke anak cucu kita.
Pengunjung yang ada dibagi menjadi beberapa kelompok, 1 kelompok maksimal 20 orang yang didampingi oleh 1 orang pemandu.

This museum is located 30 mins from Kali Urang just next to Merapi Volcano. Own by private with historical collection from Mataram Kingdom (Yogjakarta and Surakarta).  The name is look western bit is is an abbreviation from a Javanese phrase " “ULating bLENcong SEjatiNe TAtaraning LUmaku”, means The flame of oil lamp is direction for human being to walk and guide during their live. Its collection show the history of both Jogyakarta and Surakarta's kingdom from the beginning until Indonesian Independence,  But the highlight of all is Gusti Nurul, a Javanese princess with all traditional skills especially traditional Javanese dance.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Heb het museum bezichtigd, aangezien ik Borobodur & Prambanan reeds eerder heb gezien.

De entree voor buitenlandse toeristen bedraagt Rp 50.000, de lokale bevolking betaald Rp 30.000.
Op zich een mooi museum, waarin het hoofdzakelijk draait om de lokale koninklijke personen uit het verleden. Bij de prijs inbegrepen zit ook een gids die je begeleidt. 

Nu de locatie, ligging op de Merapi. Zeer slecht met openbaar vervoer bereikbaar. Op de heenweg kon ik nog iets regelen met de buschauffeur (Rp50.000 tot de ingang), maar terug was een probleem. Schijnt dus dat de bussen s'ochtends naar beneden gaan en s'middags weer berg opwaarts.
Hierdoor werd ik gedwongen om 9km bergafwaarts te lopen naar de dichtstbijzijnde locatie, waar er nog wel bussen kwamen. 

Denk dat dit aan te raden is als je voor een tweede keer in Yogya bent & over een auto of motor beschikt.
museum terbaik di jogja, memiliki tour guide gratis yang sangat ramah dan juga sangat informatif untuk menerangkan berbagai koleksi museum ini, rekomendasi untuk wisata edukasi bersama keluarga

It's fantastic , really nice  museum in the forest under the foot of Mt. Merapi in Central Java Indonesia. It's like a very big house in the forest . the weather is cool , very cozy for walk around . also you  will get more knowledge about Javanese culture , Batik , the Java kingdom , etc . They have nice resto in the backyard , at 2nd floor, you can enjoy nice grill and steak menu and fresh drink . A good place to visit while you stay in Jogjakarta.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Such a perfect fusion between culture, nature, and history! You wouldnt get bored just like when you visit the other museum in Indonesia, bcs all the stuffs will just get you more and more interested. Fyi, this museum also providing you a guide for free:)
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Very good place to visit..
The guide especially who's guiding me is an awesome guide but i forgot her name. She so smart, she so enthusiast explained everything about the royal history..
The price is very good..
It's including entry fee and guide..

It's good museum in Yogyakarta. We can get the complete information about Keraton Yogyakarta and off course with the complete collection. The building of museum also interesting with a great architecture in nice and quite atmosphere at North Yogyakarta. It's a place where I want and to go again and again.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
This museum is a must visit if you are in Jogja. This museum is a privately owned property with collaboration with local government. Their collection consist of batik, paintings, photos, letters, arcas. They provide 55 minutes guided tour around the facility.
The area is very clean and green, quiet and calm. There is vintage holland cafe and high-end souvenir shop available.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I visited this museum nearly at dusk. It's almost dark. The collection was well maintained. They put their collection into few groups such as batik, photographs, and gamelan. But i think they put too much stairs at first room so after awhile i already felt exhausted hehe. After the museum tour finished i went to their restaurant named Beukenhof. I ordered vanilla milkshake and it tasted good. But i couldnt stay longer at the restaurant because they only open until 6 p.m.
very nice place to stay , enjoying the view from the room, and the climate is perfect for me.  i will visit this property again later when i'm travelling to jogja.

Museum Ullen Sentalu, terletak di Jalan Boyong, Kaliurang, Museum ini menyimpan aneka koleksi menawan mengenai budaya Jawa peninggalan Kerajaan Mataram. Udara sejuk kaliurang, ditambah suasana hening yang menyatu dengan alam pegunungan semakin menambah damai suasana.
Koleksi museum dibagi dalam beberapa ruang. Yang pertama adalah Ruang Seni dan Gamelan yang menyimpan seperangkat koleksi gamelan. Selanjutnya Guwo Selo Giri yang menjadi ruang pamer lukisan tokoh-tokoh yang mewakili 4 figur Dinasti Mataram. Kampung Kambang terbagi menjadi 5 ruang pamer yang mempertontonkan koleksi batik, syair, hingga album hidup GRKay. Siti Nurul Kusumawardhani. Yang terakhir adalah Ruang Sasana Sekar Buwana dan Koridor Letja Randa yang merupakan museum outdoor.
Jam Buka Senin: tutup
Selasa – Jumat: 08.30 – 16.00 WIB
Sabtu – Minggu: 08.30 – 17.00 WIB
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Tempat historical yang bagus banget . Pas utk yang suka dengan sejarah sangat baik dan sejuk lingkungan nyaman dan guide ramah
Tapi ga ada resto ato tmpt jajan jadi masih sedikit kurang tapi so far its soo good

Museum ini menawarkan sesuatu yang lain dengan kehidupan Kraton yang lebih mengangkat peran kaum pria, tetapi di Museum ini justru peran wanita yang sangat ditonjolkan. Saya sangat menikmati koleksi puisi-puisi dan surat-surat yang ada. Properti museum ini juga sangat indah dan unik. Sangat layak untuk tujuan wisata pendidikan bagi keluarga.

In general, this place is like many other museum that offers a trip back to the past. However, Ulen Sentalu managed to make it more homey compared to the cold stereotype of museums. At the end of the trip, you are offered to have the traditional drink. And you surely wouldn't want to miss a view of some private collections that you might not find anywhere.

Museum dengan tata letak yang menarik dan desain bangunan yang asri. ada ruangan bawah tanah dan lengkap dengan guide yang bercerita dengan runut seakan-akan kita berada di masa yang diceritakan. di akhir perjalanan kita akan disuguhi minuman tradisional untuk melepas dahaga
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: This museum should become your bucket list. Located at Kaliurang area, this museum has a great taste of art. Especially for you who like Javanese art and history. The guide will tell you all the Mataram Kingdom history and the story of Yogyakarta. The interior design are so awesome, and full of philosophy. You will also get general knowledge about batik. At the end the guide will serve you with a glass of jamu, Indonesian traditional herbal.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I visited Ullen Sentalu and i was amazed by their beautiful collection of batik, old photographs, statue and even old hand writing letters by the Java princess. They all beautifully displayed and the museum management organise a very good way of bringing the visitors into the collection one by one by provide a bilingual tour guide that lead you into each rooms and collections. The tour guide on duty will tell you stories behind the paintings, photographs and everything. You will feel like you brought into a time machine and experience the history through the true stories of some members of Jogjakarta and Surakarta royal family. This place is a must to visit if you are in Jogjakarta!
inilah tempat dimana berwisata sambil mendapat pengetahuan tentang sejarah, buat yang ingin tahu silsilah kerajaan di yogyakarta.
Saat memasuki musium ini terasa suasana Mistis, banyak peninggalan leluhur yang di sajikan disini semua tertata dengan apik.Semua terawat baik

Bagi Anda pecinta wisata sejarah, jangan lewatkan untuk berkunjung ke Museum Ullen Sentalu. Museum ini terletak di area Kaliurang. Buka setiap hari kecuali hari Senin. Memasuki museum ini seperti memasuki lorong waktu. Memukau!

Ini museum kebudayaan terbaik yang pernah saya kunjungi. 
Di dalam museum ini dilarang mengambil gambar, hanya beberapa spot saja yang diperbolehkan. 
Jadi datanglah ke sana, lihat isi museum ini pakai mata, dan disimpan dalam hati.
interesting and unique museum. I don't like museum that much but this one is exceptional. but the distance is way too far from the central

I may say the best museum have ever visited. the historical items related to the history of Yogyakarta and Solo kingdom. Great guide who explains and escorting through the museum. Like the drink after the tour.

Must visit Museum in Jogja. Very Unique experience. This Museum is a private Museum own by the Jogja Royal Family. Most of the collection comes form Jogja & Solo Royal Family and it is very educational tour too. The tour guide is very friendly and knowledgeable. IDR50,000 entrance fee for foreigner and its really worth.

Must do for History lovers too.

Without a car or a motorbike, I am afraid it is a little bit difficult to reach this private museum. After nearly one and a half ride, we arrived there at 10:30 and found a long queue of tourists, mainly locals,at the entrance, perhaps it was Saturday. All of them were arranged in groups so that they were not over-packed inside the museum. With the help of an English-speaking lady guide, we learnt the history of the royal families either in Yogykarta or in Solo with many photographs and relics exhibited. For safety reason, no pictures are allowed to be taken inside it. Of course you can take photos in the garden after enjoying your free special tea at the end of your tour.

Tempat ini sangat keren. Arsitekturnya juga bagus. Jauh dari hiruk pikuk. Tempat yang sangat eksotis dengan nuansa keraton yang sangat kental. Pada akhir perjalanan disuguhi minuman jamu dengan rasa manis nanmenyegarkan.
This place is a museum build and operate by private. Most of the collections are batiks and a lot of history telling, very interesting as we can see the life of previous era.

To be honest the place gave me an eerie feeling, but that's what makes it special. Visitors are not allowed to take pictures here and I was told about how a tourist who defied the rule got sick after leaving the place. Myth aside, Ullen Sentalu is truly a magical place and you will be spellbound with the art collections that they have and how skillful the guides are.

Jeder Besucher in dem Museum erhält eine private Führung, die im Eintrittspreis inbegriffen ist. Obwohl ich alleine kam, wurde ich trotzdem durch die Ausstellung geführt. Am Ende der Führung erhält man einen traditionellen Tee. Die Mitarbeiter sind sehr bemüht und freundlich. 
Das Museum liegt am Hang des Vulkans Merapi außerhalb der Stadt. Die Umgebung und die Aussicht sind lohnenswert!

This one of must-visit-when-in-jogja, located in Kaliurang highland, Jogja. The museum displays relics and artifact from royal houses and kratons of Java, such as Yogyakarta, Pakualam, Surakarta, and Mangkunegaran. The architecture's  fine with Javanese authentic touch.

salah satu diantara tiga puluh an museum yang ada di DIY.
berlokasi di kaliurang yang sejuk dan asri.
sangat layak dikunjungi, koleksi didalamnya adalah khas jawa dan mencerminkan keraton solo dan yogya. 
dipandu petugas kita mengelilingi museum bersama rombongan kecil.
sangat menarik

This museum is located in Kaliurang which is pretty far from downtown. I suggest renting a motorbike or a car if any of you want fo go to this place. Not really far from Ullen Sentalu, you can find Merapi Volcano Museum so you can visit two museums at once.

What I like about Ullen Sentalu is, first, they provide a free guide. If you are foreigners, they'll provide an english speaker guide. Second, the museum gives pretty clear insight about the history of Kingdoms in Yogyakarta and Solo. Third, the guests will get free traditional drink that you wont find in any other places! Kekeke.. A special recipe of one of the princess :)

However, guests cannot take pictures within the area of the museum.

The ticket price is idr 30K for locals and around idr 50k for foreigners. The price, in my opinion, is worth the knowledge and the experience :)
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Have a visit when you traveling to Yogyakarta, u can learn enough about the royal history of Yogyakarta and Solo... After the museum tour, it's best to have some refreshments at the restaurant up floor...
The museum was mostly dedicated to the rulers of Yogyakarta - family line, portraits, letters, clothes and accessories. Get a guide (free) to fully appreciate the contents.

Museum tercantik dan terbersih di Yogyakarta.
Menjelaskan sejarah keraton.
Berisikan, arca, lukisan, ruang yang didedikasikan kepada Sri Nurul (surat-surat, pakaian, foto), beragam batik.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: A very sweet girl guided four of us around...all the paintings were done in the 1990's, some original photos, unexceptional replica sculptures....the drive up there was nice though! Maybe good on a wet afternoon?

This place gives us a great view of Yogyakarta's past leaders. They even put princess Diana's photo when she was meeting someone important from Yogyakarta... good collection of batik and history of batik and it's custom...

เป็นพิพิธภัณฑ์ที่น่าสนใจมาก เรียนรู้เรื่องราวความเป็นมาของยอร์คยาการ์ต้า มาชมพิพิธภัณฑ์นี้ ราคาค่าตั๋ว 50K Rp รวมไกด์นำพาชมพร้อมข้อมูลที่น่าสนใจฟรี พร้อม secret recipe welcome drink อากาศภายในเย็นสบาย แต่เพราะอยู่บนพื้นที่ภูเขา merapi ฝนจึงตกอยู่บ่อย พิพิธภัณฑ์ปิดทุกวันจันทร์ วางแผนเดินทางก่อนไป เพื่อไปเยี่ยมชมพิพิธภัณฑ์แลัวไปผจญภัยต่อบนภูเขา merapi
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: if you want to study about Batik Motive you can visit this museum and learn the kraton keep and develope the javaness wear... from the monarchy era you can see the difference motive devided by the position in kingdom... KING and queen are wearing speacial motive of Batik and you can learn at this museum... brave ulen sentalu to arrange and display all this beautiful heritage collections

Saya sudah berkunjung ke museum ini beberapa kali, dan selalu tertarik untuk datang lagi setiap ada waktu di Jogja. Walaupun museum swasta, tapi koleksinya cukup banyak dan menarik.
Jika ada hal yang perlu di improve adalah, standar pemandu museum yang perlu disamakan. Kunjungan saya sebelumnya dibantu oleh pemandu yang sangat informatif, saya merasa diberi sangat banyak informasi baru, tapi dikunjungan terakhir sepertinya pemandunya masih baru dan kurang bisa memberi informasi dengan baik. Juga terkesan buru-buru.

Ini museum budaya paling keren yang pernah sy kunjungi. Letaknya di kaki gunung merapi yang jauh di keramaian. Luasnya sekitar 1,2 hektar. Pada saat anda kesini anda akan diceritakan mengenai budaya Jawa. Terdapat foto2 asli yang sebagian dihibahkan oleh keraton dan beberapa lukisan2 yang sungguh amat sangat indah. Di tempat ini akan diceritakan mengenai beberapa kepercayaan dan real story keraton Yogyakarta yang tidak anda ketahui sebelumnya. Ada batik2 kuno dan yang sudah berusia puluhan tahun. Dan sebagai penutup anda akan disuguhkan Jamu Ratu Mas, resep jamu keraton yang tidak dijual secara bebas di luar museum yang konon katanya membuat anda segar dan awet muda
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Very refreshing place, great museum and guide.. everything is great.. the museum about Mataram' kingdom, with a lot of portrait and original letter from Mataram's kingdom.. also they have batik collections..

Beautiful museum and lovely tropical grounds, included a guide through the museum, everyone very friendly, great place to shop also, and stop at the above restaurants feels you are back in the 1930s, just lovely.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The whole concept of the museum is truly stunning.  The storyline, the history, the architecture are worthy of an Oscar.  However, when it comes to limited areas for photography, I find very scarce when comparing to major Museums of the world.

Museum ini berada di kawasan Kaliurang Yogyakarta. Berkunjung kesini jangan terlalu sore karena bisa jadi hujan dan kabut. 

Saat berkunjung kesini kita akan diantar dengan pemandu yang baik hati menjelaskan setiap tempat dan barang-barang koleksi museum disini.

Museum ini berisikan berbagai macam koleksi batik dari seluruh penjuru Jawa yang bermacam-macam.

this is, i would  say, the most interesting and communicative museum. most of the museums i have visited have no local guide, and the big museums prefer to use the audio guide, but they here have local guides explaining things there. you can ask and if they cannot answer, they will give you the email address or phone number, they will look for the right answer! they are happy to see us well informed, the view is amazing. its like a museum in the forest.
Great atmosphere, great architecture, and knowledgeable guides. This is the place if you want to know more about Batik, one of Indonesia's greatest cultural heritage.

The visit to Ullen Sentalu is always an amazing one. With a cheap ticket price (Rp. 30,000,-), be ready to be amazed by the mystique ambience of traditional Javanese culture. Either you come by yourself or with companies, there will always be a bi-lingual guide to give details on each paintings (which reach the level of surreal, as if they are alive), antique items, batik, and statues. The exterior are stunning, filled with ruins and old trees, providing a gothic aura to this place. It is divided into some underground tours, each has different emphasis on the stories told. Prepare yourself to be immersed inside it!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Ullen Sentalu museum was easily one of my best experience in Yogyakarta. Located two hours away from town by car, the entrance of the museum itself gave me the feeling that it will be a good trip. There are no picture taking allowed in the museum due to copyright issue but I definitely learned more than I asked for. 

My guide, Ambar was truly knowledgeable and was really good at explaining the history of Java. A tad bit funny too! 

The interior of the museum is so well kept that one would feel that they are walking in the hall of a palace.

Review Text: This is museum locate at Kaliurang area.  This one of good place to visit and learn about history about Yogyakarta, About Yogyakarta Kingdom, all the Leaders, etc.  The museum need entrance ticket and also Local Guide to explain many things inside. Museum milik perorangan ini menyajikan barang barang kuno dari dua Kraton yang sudah di kenal,Kraton Surakarta dan Kraton Ngayogjakarta. Di Tunjang dengan Suasana alam Pegunungan membuat Kesan yang sangat Mendalam bagi Pengunjungnya.

Review Text:
Museum Ullen Sentanu adalah sebuah museum kecil yang terletak di kawasan wisata Kaliurang. Ditata dengan apik sesuai norma budaya Jawa yang khas. Untuk masuk ke museum ini, pengunjung harus membayar Rp.30.000 per orang. Pengunjung akan didampingi pemandu museum yang akan menjelaskan secara detail seluk-beluk museum beserta koleksi di dalamnya. 
Bagian pertama yang harus dilalui pengunjung adalah lorong menurun yang dinamakan Guwo Selo Giri atau 'Gua Batu Gunung' yang dindingnya terbuat dari batu Gunung Merapi. Lorong ini dibuat menurun sesuai falsafah 'kulonuwun' dimana tamu sepatutnya datang dengan kerendahan hati saat bertamu atau mendatangi rumah orang.
Selanjutnya pengunjung diantar melihat-lihat beberapa koleksi foto keluarga keraton Kasultanan Yogyakarta, keraton Pakualaman, keraton Mangkunegaran dan keraton Kasunanan Surakarta. Ada juga ruangan yang memamerkan koleksi batik keraton dan lukisan tarian khas keraton. Salah satunya adalah lukisan tarian kreasi Sultan Hamengku Buwono IX. 
Bagian kedua yang akan dilewati pengunjung adalah lorong Kampung Kambang atau kampung yang mengambang di atas air. Lorong ini simbol dari jalan kehidupan yang berliku-liku, penuh tantangan dan kadang mengambang. Muara dari lorong ini adalah sebuah ruangan yang memiliki beberapa lukisan dari kraton Yogyakarta. Dimana salah satunya adalah foto Sri Sultan Hamengku Buwono X dan Kanjeng Ratu Hemas saat menerima kedatangan Pangeran Charles dan Lady Diana di Kraton Yogyakarta. 
Sepintas lalu museum ini terkesan hanya memamerkan foto-foto lama koleksi dari 4 kraton pecahan Kerajaan Mataram. Namun cerita-cerita di balik foto-foto tersebut, serta cerita di balik koleksi lainnya, mengandung daya tarik tersendiri. Lumayan untuk menambah wawasan tentang budaya Jawa khususnya cerita tentang Kraton dari perspektif yang berbeda......
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Sebuah museum yang dikelola swasta dengan profesional, cocok untuk wisata bersama keluarga maupun pasangan yang menyukai sejarah, dan seni. Review Text: The museum , the collection , the place very manageable, nice museum & must visit ulen sentalu if go to jogya
Banyak pengetahuan yg bisa diperoleh dengan kita mengunjungi museum ini..mulai dari putri putri keraton sampai jenis kain yang ada..di temani suguhan minuman jamu kunjungan ini terasa menyenangkan

Review Text:
The museum provides guide to explain every room at Ullen Sentalu. Every room has different story, so the museum tour will take 50 minutes.

The museum about historical stories about Yogyakarta and Solo kingdoms, their achievements, the royal dance, the wifes, the children, and the Batik pattern phylosophy. 

The guide is good, she explained clearly about it.

If you want to know more the history of Yogyakarta and Solo kingdom, this museum is the perfect place. They also have some collection of batik. The entrance fee is not so expensive, especially with that price is included guide and free traditional drink that will serve to you in the middle of the tour. But to go there, you need your own transport or you need to walk little bit if you come with public transport.
This is a heritage museum with a lot of paintings collection, very well treated. Our guide explained it very good. But unfortunately we couldnt make a picture with the collection.
museum with different presentation, accompany by museum guide for each visitor. Truly give you better understanding and story behind each of the collection displayed. very recommended

As a museum is OK and is well presented and we had a tour guide to ourself as was English which as good.

The guide was great however they do rush you through, we went on Sunday before CNY so don't know if that made a difference or not.

This was something we did as a filler however I would suggest you try to tie this in with visit to Merapi and the jeep ride as is very close by and doesn't take long.

Entrance fee was 50,000 Rupiah and taxi cost 500,0000 for four hours.

Ulen Sentalu is one of the place that we' ve planned.
We visited there in the 1st day, but unfotunetely the museum closed at 4.30.
Then we visited again in the last day before we went back to hometown.
We enjoyed the place which we saw the javanese culture, especially 'Keraton Jogja' and 'Keraton Solo' history. The museum have a lot of historical things like picture, gamelan, Photos, etc.

When we bought entry ticket, it included free guide.

After you finished with museum, you can take a picture around there, a lot of nice spot. And you can enjoyed coffee or meals in the restaurant and buy some batik tulis at the store.

berbeda dengan museum lain museum ini menampilkan koleksi pribadi keluarga bangsawan Jogja dan solo dalam tempat yang terpisah pisah dan mencapainya dengan melalui taman ataupun jalan setapak layaknya labirin. sangat mengesankan.  pengunjung akan di temani oleh guide dalam  group group kecil dan pastikan anda mendapat tiket di jam yang tepat.  anda akan salah bila menyangka didalamnya adalah benda purbakala karena justru memorabilia dan photo2 keluarga kejaan yang tampil dominan dengan segala cerita kesuksesan, romantisme dan kejayaan dimasanya.

Review Text:
Salut dengan pengelolaan Ullen Sentalu, meski mungkin sejarah keraton Jogja lebih luas lagi dari diorama yang tersedia dalam museum, tapi untuk mereka yang ingin tahu tengtang asal muasal Jogja wajib datang kesini. Guide-nya jago....bisa menjelaskan dengan rinci, bahasa yang digunakan campuran (indonesia, inggris dan jawa) serta tak lupa menyelipkan humor saat berdialog.
Jadi pengen kesana lagi.........

Tempatnya sangat bagus, koleksinya private koleksi, dari sini kita melihat orang dulu ternyata Indonesia sejajar dengan Negara Negara eropa, dan facebook itu sudah ada sejak jaman mataram, hanya saja teknologi masa itu belum secanggih sekarang

Berkunjung ke Museum Ullen Sentalu, memberikan sensasi nostalgia yang berbeda dari Keraton Keraton Ngayogyakarta Hadiningrat di KotaYogyakarta.

Letak Museum Ullen Sentalu berada di luar kota Yogyakarta, tepatnya di Jalan Kaliuran KM-25 (sekitar 30 atau 45 menit perjalanan dari Tugu).

Kelebihan Museum ini karena perspektif yang ditawarkan berbeda seperti museum-museum lain. Kalo museum-museum lain, barang-barang kenangan/memorabilia/bersejarah, dipajang a la kadarnya, sekenanya, tanpa sentuhan artistic. Sedangkan di Meseum Ullen Sentalu ditata apik, bertema, sedikit-demi-sedikit berdasarkan langkah dari pengunjung. Lay-out/Tata letak ruangan dan prencahayaan menambah keinginantahuan dan daya misterius dari kenangan masa lampau.

Koleksi-koleksi museum ini tidak diberi label. Setiap group kunjungan misalnya 10 orang, dilengkapi tour guide yang ramah dan halus tutur bahasanya serta dapat membawa kita ke masa lampau. Kunjungan ditutup dengan kejutan manis dan menyenangkan, yaitu suguhan minuman Raja dan Bangsawan khas keraton Ngayogyakarta Hadiningrat.

Sangat disarankan kepada Wisatawan Pencinta Seni Budaya dan Sejarah untuk mengunjungi tempat ini.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
We have been there more than three times, and mostly with my spouse and family. We like it because we got whole stories of Mataram Kingdom of Java, both Surakarta and Yogyakarta, in one place. We are aware that supposedly there are so many kingdoms in Indonesia, but not many left and accessible to the public. Secondly, we got to know the private side of characters presented in the museum. Some of them were amazing because the prince and princesses were able to speak more than two or three languages. I even got inspired to name my child after a character story told in the museum, Rengganis - a Sanskrit name. 

The place is homy and green. Not really far from main tourist location of Yogyakarta. It's in the northern part and it took us about one hour to get there. Better to go there after lunch. 

In the complex, there are also an old school cafe with Dutch style (if I am not mistaken) where you can enjoy the afternoon with a cup of coffee or tea, or try their signature dish. It's quite expensive for the locals but I wouldn't mind. There are also a batik boutique which I think really good and the price is right. 

When your session is over, don't forget to buy the local fruit: Salak. They got two types of Salak: Madu/honey and Pondoh. Both are sweet and addictive :) 

After going to UIlen Sentalu, I suggest you to go to Imogiri and Keraton Yogyakarta, while you are still in the city, so that you would get a whole experience and information of the Kingdom.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Saat membaca review museum ini, awalnya saya ragu untuk datang, karena begitu minimnya foto yang dimuat di berbagai referensi pariwisata. Namun, berkat rekomendasi dari teman dan informasi dari web Ullen Sentalu, akhirnya saya putuskan menjadwal berkunjung ke tempat ini.

Beruntung saya masih bisa masuk di kelompok pengunjung akhir yang berkunjung hari itu, dan ternyata kesan pertama saat membeli tiket dan staf museum yang mengatur kelompok tour, bekerja dengan sangat profesional membuat sirna keraguan saya.

Tour berlangsung hampir 1 jam, dan kami diajak berkeliling dari satu ruangan ke ruangan lain yang dipenuhi dengan banyak lukisan, foto, pakaian, dan peralatan warga keraton. So, bagi Anda yang berkunjung ke Yogyakarta sempatkan mampir ke museum ini, apalagi bagi Anda yang bermalam di Kaliurang. Anda WAJIB berkunjung ke ULLEN SENTALU!
