Review Text:
I went to this museum twice already, and never gets bored with the collection. This museum is a private museum, very well maintained, very clean, and has very interesting collection of Javanese culture.
Located in Kaliurang, the museum is hidden around nice weather and view of Merapi mountain.
All the collection are given by the family of Kasultanan Yogyakarta and Mangkunegaran Solo (correct me if I am wrong, please). It tells us all about the family of Sultan, all the way until today. Suprisingly, the information, the photos, the collection are all updated.
Now, as my second time visiting the museum, they have built another section and added their collection with some statues, pictures and there is a big giant stone carved placed amazingly on the open space.
All along the journey in the museum, a tour guide will explain all the collection in such an interesting way. The tour guide is very communicative with us, with clear explanation and giving the information you would really want to know more. Thumbs up for the guides.
As a private museum, the Hartono family (who owns the property) has high respect to the culture. Salute.
Anyway, no pictures are allowed to be taken here. Only outside of the museum is allowed.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I've came to this place once. And this place has a good concept for a new museum. They present their collection there one by one. I'd love to go there again someday.
Bagus banget dalemnya,unik. Bikin penasaran. Ditambah lagi kita dapat pengetahuan dari tour guide nya yang menjelaskan setiap sisi dari dalam museum. Cocok buat anak2 yang ingin menambah pengetahuan.

This is a smallish, privately run museum which focusses on preserving Javanese traditional culture.  It is in Kaliurang, which is approximately 45 minutes or more from central Yogyakarta, depending on traffic conditions. The grounds are beautifully designed. The small entrance fee includes a guided tour.  There are English speaking guides and Indonesian speaking guides. Having been here twice, I find the commentary by 2 separate guides on 2 separate occasions rather superficial and a tad rushed. I do understand that it is difficult to try and cover all the intricacies of traditional Javanese culture in 20 minutes. If you do your own research and reading beforehand, you will get a lot more out of this Museum. 

A big part of traditional Javanese culture is its royal houses, the repository of the finer aspects of Javanese culture. There is currently 4 royal houses (the one house of Mataram had split into 4 over centuries). The Museum has exhibits of royal customs including coronations, dances and musical instruments. It also has batik of varying design and the guides will endeavour to explain the meaning of each design or pattern. The museum has exhibits and photographs of perhaps the more interesting and memorable members of the various royal houses.

The restaurant on site serves both Indonesian and western fare. It is located in what looks like a mansion, is air conditioned, clean and very pleasant.  Food is well prepared and reasonably priced for a more upmarket establishment.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

This is anti-mainstream museum and I am really fond of its collection. While most of the people nowadays go to museums in purpose of posting their pictures to instagram, the museum does not let you to take any pictures at some parts inside of this building of this museum. This is what we need, to enjoy the art with our eyes. Good place, cool collections, and best service from the tour guide. You must visit this place!
actually little bit confused about this place, but i had a good experience here, and i will recommend it to my friend

Beautiful place, very well arranged tour, very well trained tour guide. I must say that this place is the most wonderful place I've visited during my year end holiday.

They're arrangement for visitors is so professional, amazing collections. It was like a travel through another time.

You need too see it to understand how amazing this place is.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Entrance fee: 30k idr, including tour guide.
Taking pics: Strictly not allowed, only in a few places as mentioned by the guide. 
Dress: Casual but proper. the temperatur is quite cool inside the building, so it is suggested not to wear minis. 
Cleanliness: Excellent. 
Public transport is quite limited, renting a car is highly recommended. 
Refreshment: Western restaurant is available. 

Rooms visited ( included but not limited to) : 
1. Love letters room.
2. Gusti Nurul room. 
3. Kings, queens, prince, princess, other pics room. 
4. Batik room.
5. Paintings room. 

Recommended for families with children with interests to history/nobles. 
Some stories needs adult further explanation.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Museum ini sangat bagus sekali isinya. Banyak koleksi batik, lukisan dilengkapi dengan penjelasan yang bagus. Ada juga silsilah raja Yogya. Cukup menarik untuk mengetahui budaya Yogya. Di akhir museum ada cafe untuk menikmati minuman n makanan kecil setelah berkeliling museum.

We had unforgettable experience here. The museum is unique and well organized.  They putted us in a small group of people and tour guide walked with us and informed us about the historical and javanese culture including knowledge about batik. We felt like entered a cave but inside we found amazing building with many rooms and tunnel. In the middle of session the tour guide served us a traditional drink before we continued the last session of tour.  No photo allow during the tour. There is a restaurant inside the building and rest room. I truly recommend this place as a must visit in Yogyakarta
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Ini kali ketiga saya mengunjungi museum ini dan tetap menarik karena museum ini mengingatkan betapa kaya-nya budaya Jawa. Dalam waktu 50 menit saya diajak untuk menyelami kehidupan para ningrat Jawa, terhanyut dengan isi surat-surat tulisan tangan, dan terkagum-kagum dengan kepintaran orang Indonesia khususnya orang keraton yang harus bisa banyak hal: pengetahuan, kesenian dan budaya, serta sastra. Suasana museum juga amat nyaman karena terasa 'adem'
Nice museum to visit, the guide was very informative. Love the letters collection. On the second floor they have western restaurant with decent food
This is the best museum in indonesia i've ever visited! Well managed, clean and also has a tour guide.
I was living at Jogja since high school but never been here before, its my first and don't forget to having lunch at their restaurant.
Museum bagus. Resto variasi menu baik, interior cantik, pelayanan lumayan. Tapi rasa F & B standar saja ya. Kemasan bagus sayang kurang diimbangi dengan taste.

Clean and well-kept museum with fluent English-speaking tour guide (Vifel) who explains each exhibit in arresting detail and interesting anecdotes. The room containing letters and poems written by one of the Princesses was particularly lovely. The sculpture garden also contains an excellent and diverse collection of sculptures from different regions. A trip there is highly recommended.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
It's beautiful museum, sooo clean, well organized, classic javanese interior was beautiful.
The building is like a maze so there will be a guide to guiding us inside the museum otherwise we will lost. The guide is sooo nice and spoke fluent English so it's good destination for expats. 
We can see so many of kind of keraton batik which is only for keraton members, so many old photos and paintings.
In the end we will get tradional drink "Jamu" was nice taste actually.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
This museum is a private museum about Javanese culture, especially about the royal family of Keraton Jogja, Solo, Mangkunegaran and Pakualaman.
Plus point: Friendly staffs and guide, lots of collections, clean, well organized.
Minus point: rest rooms are not too clean, the restaurant opens at 11.00

Opening hours: 08.30 - 18.00
Tickets: Rp. 15.000 for kids, Rp. 30.000 for adults, Rp. 50.000 for foreigner

Lokasinya terletak di dekat kawasan wisata Kaliurang.  
Harga tiket masuk (kalo tidak salah) Rp30000 per orang (sekitar Des 2015).
Suasananya sangat alami dan sejuk, menenangkan.
Setiap pengunjung yang masuk, akan dikumpulkan sekitar 10 orang dan akan didampingi 1 / 2 orang guide yang akan menerangkan sejarah terkait dengan foto2 dan benda2 yang berada di museum ini.  Penjelasannya sangat informatif.
Cocok untuk keluarga, namun agak kurang cocok untuk anak kecil di bawah usia balita (bisa membosankan bagi anak balita).

Museum ini terlatak di kawasan kaliurang, lereng gunung merapi. Museum ini berisi banyak benda bersejarah tentang kasultanan Yogyakarta. Kita tidak diperbolehkan mengambil foto pada saat memasuki museum ini. Ada seorang guide yang akan menemani kita saat mengelilingi setiap sudut museum ini

Here you can learn the history of Javanese Kingdom like Mataram, Solo and Yogyakarta. You will know part by part of the journey. and don't worry they have a free guide who will take you to go arround the museum.

Museum tentang budaya Jawa
Perbedaan antara kesultanan Jogja dan Surakarta
Ada gamelan, batik dan foto-foto keluarga raja-raja jawa
sangat menarik
HANYA DIPERBOLEHKAN MENGAMBIL FOTO di area tertentu, demi menjaga "eksklusifitas" museum,..
Pengunjung juga dapat menikmati minuman yang katanya bisa untuk awet muda,.. semoga beneran,... ^.^

A unique Javanese (Solo and Jogjakarta) Museum. Right place to learn the history of the creation of Solo and Jogjakarta as well as their rich culture. 
You will discover the philosophy of Javanese design on clothes, building, places.
The sad thing is you can not take pictures the collection there, but still a wonderful place.

Get to know more about the history, paintings, and artifacts. Cool building too.

It's just too far from the city.

The museum is located at the foothill of mount Merapi which gives it's chilly and mountain breeze atmostphere as opposed to Yogyakarta's extremely hot temperature. If you are in Yogyakarta and plan to go to Kaliurang, do visit this place. The museum compound's architecture is really nice, a mixture between ancient, traditional, and modern architetures. I gave 3 starts because of the above reasons.

The content though is dissappointing. I was expecting a history of Java in a longer period of time and richer content, what it turned out was a story of Yogyakartan and Surakartan royal family with mostly replicas and modern art products. For interior central javanese royal families are sacred families and part of their history, but for others, the museum needs more effort to explain why they matter. I happen to get interested in their history so I totally enjoyed it though not as wide history as I expected.

This museum is located around 45 minute drive from the city center. Had an hour of guided tour which was interesting as you get to know fun facts and details about Javanese culture aside from looking at the display. There were lots of visitors as it was the peak season, but queueing time was not so bad (20 minutes). The entrance was a bit confusing because there were no signs to the ticket booth and such. Overall it was worth discovering.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: saya sangat senang ke museum ini karena suasananya yang sejuk dan nyaman, walaupun terkesan sedikit mistis, namun tidak menakutkan. lokasinya cukup jauh di ujung Jl. Kaliurang, agak sulit kalau naik kendaraan umum. saya sarankan kesini dengan kendaraan pribadi.

We got to see Historical Goods, Batik Collection and Replica Painting from Keraton Jogja and Solo while listen to the guide explanation.
Btw I love the way she explained all thing to my group, quite entertaining

I am particularly bad wth history but even so, am very proud of this place for preserving the javanese history so well. It doesn't seem like a big place from the outside but was impressed wth the museum inside. But very keen on their giftshop although they actually have quite a good range of items. Not very well organized and bad lighting. They do have a nice western restaurant with pretty view though
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: lokasinya dekat dengan kaliurang, museumnya bagus rapi tapi nuansa mistisnya kental sekali, apalagi ketika melihat lukisan yang matanya memandang mengikuti arah kita. Untuk foto-foto bagus banget lingkungan sekitarnya, apalagi yang suka dengan nuansa gotik

When I went there its holiday season, so I need to line up to wait for the guide, it almost took half an hour to wait. So the tour started led by a guide which in my opinion is very knowledge-able and also funny that make the tour is interesting. Inside we are not allowed to took any pictures, inside of the museum we are guided to several rooms that consist of paintings, batiks, letter that told us the history of Javanese kingdom.
For me it is a well maintained museum and one of the best museum in Indonesia.
Love this place , love the explanation given by the tour guide. Need to give the clear instruction for ticketing and waiting line and need to maintain the cleanliness of the toilet.

If only all museum in Indonesia is like this. I have learned more in a museum then I have ever been. The tour guide was great but the place was awesome. Everything was made for a reason in this place. If only I have more time to explore it. Must go!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
The museum was officialy published at 1997.  Need 7 years to build the museum and house of the owner pak Handoyo. It located in one of foot mt. Merapi. It built in high land (1.2 hectare) and it's unique building. I, personally impressed by 
1. the design interior,
2. the garden and 
3. of course the collection of painting (they have 3d painting and it's quite spooky. You will know the reason once you'll visit there) , old pictures, music instruments like gamelan, sitar and old batiks. 

However the history behind it make me a bit confuse since too many name of king and queen from kasultanan jogja and solo involved. 
The owner very strict and protective, we're not allowed to take picture, smoking and having meal and drinking during tour. However at the end of tour, the owner provided us a special room to have a free drink and rest. And then we will finished the tour at the place that we can take pictures...... yeaaaay! (tours will take 50-60 minutes). 
The ticket price for local adult idr 30k, child idr 15k. For foreigner adult idr50k, child idr 25k. 
Really really worth it and our teen girls (12 and 9 yr) also love it.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Good education place for you child... especially showing them what is batik and behind the batik story.

Menarik untuk dikunjungi hanya saja bentuk museum scr fisik yang masih terus di pugar membuat kurang nyaman.

Perjalanan menuju museum juga jauh, ada baiknya sebelum atau sesudah mengunjungi museum ini bisa langsung menuju tour ke gunung merapi.

Isi museum sangat menarik, berbagai cerita dan sejarah kerajaan di jawa tengah yaitu solo dan yogyakarta. 

Di museum ini kita akan dipandu oleh seorang guide

museum ini terletak di kawasan kaliurang. Untuk masuk ditarik tiket sekitar 20.000. Museum ini koleksinya lumayan lengkap terutama tentang sejarah kerajaan di jawa. Banyak ornamen ornamen jawa yang terdapat di ruangan ini. Aura ketika masuk juga terkesan dingin dan bau bau kemenyan. Kita akan dipandu oleh seoang guide yang akan menjelaskan semua isi museum dan kita akan dikasih suguhan minuman khas jawa. Ada macam macam jenis batik dan filosofinya, mulai dari batik china, solo, dkk. Jika ada waktu luang tidak ada salahnya berkunjung ke tempat ini karena banyak sejarah jawa yang terungkap di sini.

I don't think it is necessary to waste 50k IDR on this. Our plan is to take the merapi jeep tour and pass by the museum, but we ran in the rainy season and we did not have the chance to take the jeep that day. Then we visited the museum and it has nothing much but a lot of pictures and background story of the history of Indonesia, especially about the royal family. If you are a fan of the royal family, you will enjoy the short tour, or else, don't waste your time and money.

Ullen sentalu is a very great and cozy museum. They tell us a story about Jogjakarta and Surakarta (Solo) history. They also tell us about all heritage that Jogjakarta and Solo had from hundred years ago. They also keep the museum clean and neat, so the people who come here won't feel insecure or bad when visiting with family or friends. One of the best museum I ever visited in my life.
Tempat menarik, koleksi bagus & terawat, pemandu sgt menguasai materi. Tp mungkin kurang cocok unt anak-anak dibwh 12 th
Lokasinya jauh dari pusat kota, sebaiknya menggunakan kendaraan pribadi. Museum ini terkesan mistis namun sejuk dan menyimpan nilai seni.

Located on Kaliurang area 30-40 minutes drive from city center. 

Privately owned, the museum is very professionally managed. Entrance fee is IDR30K. Visitors are prohibited from taking pictures and touch the collections. There is an open space close to the exit of the museum where you can take pictures. 

All collections tells the story about hierarchy, politics, heritage, even love life of the royal families of Jogjakartan and Surakartan. Collections are very well handled and preserved and in excellent conditions. 

Definitely must see! 

There is also a fine dining restaurant and nice boutique within the premises.
museum yang unik, menambah ilmu pengetahuan, museum mahal yang memperkenalkan budaya yogyakarta dan solo, ditambah dengan jamu racikan yang menyegarkan

Waktu yang paling pas untuk mengunjungi museum ini adalah sekitar jam 2 atau 3. Pemandu memiliki jadwal pemanduan yang pas sehingga tidak mengganggu setiap peserta tur di group lain. 

Isi dari museum ini masih berkisar tentang keluarga kerajaan di daerah Jogja dan Solo. Bangunan museum ini terlihat minimalis namun mengesankan. 

Saya juga mencoba menu di restoran Beukenhof milik museum yang, meskipun sangat enak, sedikit overpriced dibandingkan dari menu-menu sejenis yang ada di beberapa museum berbeda yang pernah saya kunjungi.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Tidak berlebihan rasanya jika predikat the best museum in indonesia saya berikan kemuseum yang terletak di wilayah kaliurang ini. Musium ini berisikan tentang berbagai hal mengenai keraton. Mulai dr koleksi gamelan, arca, lukisan, batik bahkan barang2 pribadi para penghuni keraton.
musium ini sangat tertata dengan baik. Disertai dg penjelasan yg sangat lengkap oleh sang pemandu. Membuat kehausan para pengunjung akan informasi mengenai dunia perkeratonan di jawa jadi terpenuhi.

buat yg datang ke jogjakarta jangan lupakan untuk mampir kemusium ini.

Nice small private museum located in beautiful Merapi highland. Tour guide and staff are very friendly and helpful. Enjoyed learning about the Javanese royal family history. Prices are reasonable and the layout and size of this museum is great for a family excursion without being overwhelming and touristy.

Ullen sentalu sanagat wajib dikunjungi jika kita ingin mengetahui sejarah batik di Jogjakarta dan solo. Juga mengetahui kehidupan para anggota kesultanan Jogja. Guide nya sangat menyenangkan dalam menjelaskan. Museum ini memiliki koleksi batik yang sangat lengkap.

Definitely worth a visit if you want to learn a short story and its the closest experience to Sultan's heritage. Our guide is a tough lady and clearly know her thing, her name is Ida. She seemed really experience dealing with "naughty guests" that keeps taking photos inside and talking loud. There are so many paintings that explain the history of Sultanese and my best experience was in Gusti Nurul's room where you can see all of her properties and you can totally relate why she was considered as an independent woman at that time. Goosebumps! By end of tour, you will meet restaurant and store. Visit the store, they have some rly good stuff Batik here that you wouldnt find anywhere. And once you like it, buy it! There is no online store to purchase. Have to comeback twice as i couldnt find as high quality Batik as theirs

We came here after visiting Mount Merapi on our motorcycle.

Ulen Sentalu is a museum focused on the history of the Royal Family as well as Javanese culture. We were surpised as to the lack of photos when searching for a review here but we now know that it is forbiden to take photos of the museum other than dedicated areas.

We loved the stories told by the guide and seeing artwork and photos as well as stone sculptures. If you are interested to learn about the culture of Java, you'll love this museum.

Entrance was not free but it was all worth it. There was a tour guide who will explain to you all the way from the beginning to the end. It was very educative and we receive heaps of knowledge. I would recommend you to visit this place.
Museum quite interesting and beautiful, we understand some of the noble families of the history of Java.

I was lead to believe the museum was a glimpse into the daily lives of the natives of Jogjakarta.  In reality, what I was shown was a dedication to the "greatness" of the royal families of Yogyakarta and Surakarta.  The guide was pleasant, but her English wasn't strong enough to really explain the purpose of the museum or why I as a tourist should care.  The pictures of royal family and artifacts were interesting enough, but unless you're a big royal historian, don't waste your time.
Sangat bagus museumnya..kami sangat suka ketika guidenya bercerita tentang Gusti Nurul..Amazing story. Museum terbaik yang pernah kami kunjungi..hanya lokasinya agak jauh...
30 Ribu untuk pengalaman luar biasa, tentu sangat sepadan. anda harus mampir ke beukenhoff restaurant. mereka sangat istimewa.

The Solo family palace turned museum.  It is a charming estate full of antiques and pictures of the royal family.  The tour was interesting, but felt a bit rushed, lasting around 40 minutes, and we weren't able to walk around by ourselves. Given it's very high rating on tripadvisor I was a little disappointed.  It would be worth doing if you are going to Mt Merapi, but it wasn't worth the trip by itself.

Museum ini memiliki desain yang menarik dan sejuk. Kesan museum yang membosankan sama sekali tidak saya rasakan ketika mengunjungi museum ini. Guidenya pun menjelaskan dengan ramah dan cukup menarik. Museum ini juga baik dikunjungi sebagai salah satu sarana edukasi bagi anak agar dapat menjaga warisan budaya dan mencintai sejarah.
banyak bercerita ttg gusti nurul yg baru saja meninggal...banyak kolek si batik yg kita jarang liet...tempatnya jg sangat menarik untuk dikunjungi
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Tempat ini bagus buat edukasi kita tentang sejarah kraton..dengan guide ramah yg memberikan penjelasan singkat di tiap koridor/ruangannya..suasanya yg sejuk membuat betah berlama lama di lokasi ini..sayangnya belm mencoba menu di restorannya..karna restonya sudah di full booking sama tamu rombongan lain..

Worth the small entry fee and the time to go through this interesting collection on a guided tour. Our guide was English speaking, very good command of the language but speaking a bit too fast to easily comprehend through the accent, but interesting and knowledgeable none the less.

Tiket masuk per orang 30rb untuk anak 15rb. Menarik, museum milik keluarga yg kemudian di dukung oleh keraton jogja dan keraton solo, museum ini seluas kurang lebih 1500m2, pengunjung akan dipandu oleh pemandu yg akan menjelaskan harta intangible dari budaya keraton. Mulai dari gamelan, tarian, raja dan permaisuri dan kebiasaan adat kerajaan. Pengunjung dibawa ke dalam suasana khas keraton. Setelah selesai, akan disuguh minuman khas keraton. Manis sekali

Lokasi museum ini ada di Kaliurang. Bangunannya tidak terlihat seperti museum2 pada umumnya. Memasuki museum ini akan dilayani dengan seorang tour guide yang akan mengajak kita berkeliling museum sambil menjelaskan secara detail ruangan per ruangan tersebut. Sangat informatif penyampaiannya membuat penasaran dengan ruangan-ruangan berikutnya. Sayang di dalam museum ini tidak diperkenankan untuk berfoto. Di museum ini terdapat restoran dan butik. Menu makanan di restoran tersebut enak-enak dengan harga terjangkau. Patut dicoba!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Museum ini terletak menjorok ke dalam, lumayan jauh dari jalan besar jadi saya beberapa kali tanya penduduk karena juga tidak ada petunjuk jalannya. Begitu sampai ternyata sudah penuh pengunjung. Tempatnya teduh, sejuk, penuh pohon dengan gaya bangunan natural dengan sentuhan gothik karena banyak patung-patung ala abad  pertengahan Eropa. Setelah sampai 25pengunjung, barulah kami masuk museum dipandu satu tur guide. Sayangnya kami dilarang mendokumentasikan isi museum. Tur dimulai dengan minum wedang hangat yang konon  katanya resep awet muda yang dibuat oleh Gusti Nurul. Museum ini memang mendedikasikan satu ruangan sendiri untuk Gusti Nurul kembang keraton Solo pada th 1940-an. Banyak cerita menarik yang digulirkan guide terhadap koleksi museum. Dijamin anda tak beranjak sedikitpun ketika kisah keluarga keraton Solo dituturkan. Sayang karena banyak pengunjung guide terlihat tergesa-gesa menyelesaikan tur. Banyak arca dan patung di halaman tengah yang bagus banget buat foto-foto.

Very interesting museum, not boring at all.
The collection a lot in the form of photographs.
Indonesia should have a lot museums like this.

Dari dulu cukup penasaran ingin mengunjungi Ullen Sentalu, karena katanya merupakan salah satu museum yang 'well organized' di Indo. Akhirnya kesampaian juga ke sini. Semua pengunjung akan dipandu oleh guide yang akan menjelaskan semua koleksi yang dimiliki, namun dikarenakan terdapat beberapa koleksi yang berada di lorong, sehingga ketika pergi dengan rombongan yang ramai, kami yang di bagian belakang agak kurang bisa mendengar penjelasan ttg beberapa koleksi. Tapi secara keseluruhan saya bisa acungi jempol. Keren lah. Plus dapat bonus minuman traditional di tengah-tengah kunjungan, mantap lah... So kalau sedang berwisata ke daerah Kaliurang dan belum pernah datang ke museum ini, patut untuk dikunjungi...
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This museum is so far out and away from downtown Yogyakarta! But if you manage to find the transport to go it will be well worth the time and money  (not really expensive ticket, only Rp50k). Too bad they don't allow for photo-taking within the museum but with the guided tour in 50mins we really learn much of Java's rich history and culture.

I visit here with my friends and so amaze with the decoration and every detail about the culture of java. It's a must visit place for everone who visit Yogyakarta. You'll be guided by the tour guide and they can speak english too. Unfortunately you can't take a photos during the tour. The last tour is at 16.00/04.00 p.m.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: You will be guided throughout the museum, they are well informed. The potraits and museum displays were well maintained. but above all the garden and the museum surroundings is remarkable. Go there if you have a couple of hours to spare before the Merapi trip as it is located very close to the Merapi 4wd tour area.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
At the foot of one of the most vertical mountain in the world, Mount Merapi. An old dutch style building is converted into a museum of Javanese kingdom from the Solo and Yogya clans. A guide is really necessary for this place. Explaining the batik of the empress, accessories, tools of rituals, paintings, and all the scandals and intrigues behind the walls of the Keraton (Javanese Palace). Some stories of dominant mother queen who would not let go off her throne, weak princes, naught princess who ran away to Bandung, an unfinished love telltale between the king and a woman who later becomes a successful business woman running a cosmetics empire. 
Some odd stories of the marriage of the King with the Jinn (powerful spirits ruling the underworld/ Ashura realm), legend of the queen of southern seas (ratu laut selatan), and finally arrived at a fashion shop and pleasant restaurant.

Please is really nice, and mountain air is cool.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Suasana museum yang tidak biasa, sejuk, tenang, dan tidak membosankan. Bagi yang masuk museum ini selalu disediakan guide dan diberi penjelasan mengenai museum sejarah keraton ini. Mengesankan, tiada kata bosan meskipun mendatanginya lebih dari satu kali.

Palace Kasunanan 1800-1850 BC. Gusti dear, butterfly without wings do not exist in this world. Roses without thorns rare or virtually none. Friendship without disabilities are also rare. but love without trust is a nonsense this world. I found this poem in Ullen Sentalu, Yogyakarta. Interesting...!!!

Salah satu museum favorit saya. Dengan renovasi, ruangan menjadi lebih sejuk dan elegan. Koleksi legendarisnya adalah 3D painting (lukisan 3D), dimana orang yang berada di dalam lukisan itu "seolah" melihat ke arah kita melulu.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
I love tripadvisor and I find the reviews and my experiences are normally very similar. Not ullen sentalu. It's a museum tribute to previous kings and queens. Cousin x, 2nd removed, of King s the fourth, liked to play piano, and here is his favourite piano key
I'm sure for royalist Indonesians it's very nice, but for your average punter it's not that interesting
You can get knowledge of Javanese culture in more luxurious way. totally worth to visit because its unique things shown here

Museum on Javanese culture, constructed and financed by a rich Javanese family. Specials: women of the Javanese royal families, Solo an Yogya batik. My guide was fantastic ( they give private guide to every group of visitors!) Gorgeous restaurant. Absolutely not to be missed, cannot recommend enough!

Even een stukje rijden, maar verder een leuk museum, dat prachtig is gebouwd en zich bevindt in een mooie omgeving. Tijdens de rondleiding krijg je de geschiedenis van de Indonesische koningshuizen te horen, waarbij je allerlei memorabilia te zien krijgt en ceremoniële batik etc. Dat is voor Nederlanders in het bijzonder wel interessant en grappig (er zijn ook vele brieven tentoongesteld, waarvan vele in het Nederlands geschreven). Daarna kun je op eigen gelegenheid wat rondlopen in de omgeving. Die is erg mooi en bovendien wordt er moderne kunst tentoongesteld. Echt een leuke combinatie. Overigens, de rit er naartoe was ook leuk.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: If you come to Jogjakarta (even if you are not a big fan of history and culture), a visit to this museum is a must. You'll learn about Javanese culture (mostly the intangible). One of the things I really liked about the Ullen Sentalu museum was the concept of not allowing guests to take pictures inside. That said, there are several areas that you are allowed to snap some photos.

I'm not one for museums  but this place is a definite  must when visiting Yogakarta. 
The entrance does not do justice for what is inside.
From the moment you step inside everything changes.
We had to wait so an English speaking guide was available. 
She  was excellent and knowledgeable.
The history. The culture. It is superb.
First class in presentation and delivery.
We passed through several chambers with  an interesting commentary and display. 
From the local sultans to batik.
This is well worth the 45 minute drive from the CBD.

If you are interested in history of Java's kingdom, especially those of Mataram kratons, this museum is worth a visit.
Located on Kaliurang highland, approximately 25km to the north of the center of Yogyakarta city, it display art and story about get royal family of Mataram kingdom.
Taking picture in the building is not allowed, means you can make yourself pay more attention to the museum itself than busy clicking the camera.
I suggest you to come on weekdays, also avoid holiday seasons because this quiet place is better enjoyed when it's not too crowded.

The entrance fee is 30.000 rupiahs for local, 50.000 rupiahs for foreigner - including the tour guide service.
The museum is closed on Monday.

Last, if you're serious about wanting to know more about kratons in Java, reading some books or articles prior to your visitation is recommended.

we were thinking with my wife on our trip if to go to see Gunung Merapi (forest park, lava flows) or to visit this museum. we aren't really into paintings or sculptures but because of good reviews we decided to go to Ullen Sentalu...

...and it was just perfect. I would say that mainly because of our superb museum guide Ambar - we had her only for us and she was able to answer all our questions (sometimes also offtopic questions :)). we learned about Yogyakarta and Solo region and about whole Java a lot and it was fun. I don't know if this is really best museum in Indonesia but we didn't regret our decision to go here even for one second :)

Saat ke sini minggu lalu, museum ini sangat ramai pengunjung. Banyak pengunjung baik anak sekolah maupun rombongan orang dewasa yang antri untuk memasuki museum ini. Agak menyesal berangkat siang karena antrinya cukup lama. Namun, setelah masuk ke dalam, jadi tidak menyesal untuk mengantri karena museumnya memang bagus. 

Di sini banyak koleksi menarik tentang kekayaan budaya keraton berupa kain batik dan serba-serbi dari keraton Yogyakarta dan Surakarta yang dulunya adalah satu yakni Mataram Islam. Ada banyak hal menarik tentang budaya Jawa masa lalu dan tradisi-tradisi yang masih dijalankan hingga sekarang.
Museum yg bagus.. bersih.. dan guide yg ramah menjelaskan dg rinci tentang sejarah yg ada di museum.. dan free minuman jamu awet muda..menyenangkan..tempatnya bagus
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Terus terang, sudah dua kali saya berkunjung ke museum ini dan selalu ingin kembali. Karena saya sangat mengagumi budaya Jawa dimasa lalu, terutama dalam bidang fashion nya. Apalagi setelah pemandu wisata menerangkan bahwa salah satu dari puteri istana ada yang mendesain sendiri busananya termasuk busana untuk suaminya. Hal ini sangat langka dilakukan pada zamannya. 

Dengan berkunjung ke museum ini, kita diajak kembali ke masa kejayaan kerajaan Jawa dengan segala aturannya. Misal, walau raja Jawa mempunyai banyak selir peran permaisuri masih sangat dominan. Dibuktikan dengan permaisuri yang berhak membawa semua kunci barang berharga istana.

Saya juga terkesan dengan pemandu wisata dan suasana museum yang sudah memenuhi standar Internasional. Benda-benda yang dipamerkan, pengaturan trafik para pengungjung juga tertata dengan baik, kebersihan dan bangunan terawat dengan baik.

Setelah Anda berputar mengelilingi museum, jangan lupa berkunjung ke galeri. Disini banyak ditemukan batik dengan desain yang cantik dan harga terjangkau dalam arti sesuai dengan mutunya.

Yang pasti, bila Anda pecinta budaya museum ini wajib dikunjungi. Apalagi kalau Anda bepergian dengan anak-anak remaja, ini waktu yang tepat untuk memperkenalkan betapa tingginya budaya kita.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Dit zou wel eens het interessantste museum van Indonesië kunnen zijn. Deels een spannend labyrinth door de geschiedenis van de sultanaten Solo en Yogjakarta. Vooral gericht op de hofcultuur en de mensen aan het hof. Bij bezoek is rondleiding inbegrepen door uiterst vakkundige vertellers. Mooi restaurant en adembenemend uitzicht op de Merapi als je even buiten het museum naar boven kijkt.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
museum ini sebagian besar isinya menceritakan tentang putri putri keraton Jogja dan Solo termasuk juga dijelaskan silsilah keluarga keraton Jogja dan Solo. Untuk mengelilingi museum, tour guide disana akan menjelaskan semua ruangan dan foto atau lukisan yang ada disana. kira2 dibutuhkan waktu kurang lebih 1 jam sampai selesai.
tidak diperbolehkan mengambil gambar di dalam museum, kecuali outdoor baru kita boleh mengambil foto. Di akhir kunjungan diberikan minuman ramuan salah satu putri keraton yang katanya bisa bikin awet muda. enak rasanya. Disana juga ada restoran yang  desainnya bergaya sedikit colonial belanda

Berkunjung ke museum menjadi pengalaman baru ketika ke Ullen Sentalu. Di sini kesan museum sebagai tempat dingin tak bersahabat dan pajangan benda-benda yang disusun seadanya sirna. Saya dibuat kagum dengan koleksi batik nan molek yang ditempatkan secara hati-hati dan penuh cinta kepada seni. Seusai menikmati keindahan, duduk bersantai sambil makan siang di kedai-nya membuat kesan elegan bercampur nyaman, serasai berlibur di rumah sahabat karib.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Nous avons visité Ullen Sentalu en août 2014. Nous avons particulièrement apprécié de nous éloigner de la ville afin de goûter a l'air pur et frais des pentes du Merapi.
Le musée était un bijou caché dans la verdure. Très bons guides possédant une grande culturw qui nous ont accompagnés avec gentillesse tout au long de la visite. A mon avis le musée vaux le détour si l'on reste à Jogja quelques jours.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
I have learn a lot about Jogjakarta in just 50 minutes tour in this museum.
Ulen Sentalu will provide tour guide around the museum for minimum 5 people. So if you traveling alone or least than 5, you have to wait for another to come. 
The construction of this building based on Java Philosophy. 
All the things inside the museum were preserved very well. But we cant take any picture inside it or touch anything. Too bad...
But at the open field, our tour guide would love to take our picture. 
The museum Divided into several room. And each room is as much as delighted as the other.
很好的博物館,你可以透過博物館了解爪哇人的文化,而且也可以了解他們皂傳統生活,因此希望你會喜歡這樣,好好享受一場文化享宴吧

Ongelooflijk, opeens een Museum waar alles netjes is en fraai. Tot in de puntjes verzorgd en er wordt je een interessante geschiedenis voorgetoverd van het kraton leven in de vroegere Vorstenlanden. Vergeet ook niet de kamer van de prinses Siti die als jong meisje in 1937 gedanst heeft in Nederland voor het huwelijk van Juliana en Bernard.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
I would proudly state that Ullen Sentalu is the best museum in Indonesia..

Be sure to ask question to the guide on the historical background of all the property.. It has also a wonderfuk restaurant at at end of the museum with nice ambiance and decent food

Definitely must visit for everyone visiting Yogyakarta
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: musuem yang menurut saya sangat bagus karena didampangi guide yang akan menjelaskan tentang sejarah dari jogja dan solo serta sultan sangat bagus sekali

pertama kali ke museum ini, udara disana sangat dingin terutama karena saat saya datang hujan, cara guide menjelaskan sangat menarik walaupun agak cepat, banyak sekali kain batik yang masih bagus walaupun sudah lama, dalam ruangan ber-ac jadi tambah dingin dan sejuk, sayangnya dilarang memotret diarea museum.
museum ini dilengkapi taman yang cukup bagus dan membuat suasana tambah menyenangkan, setelah keluar dari musuem ada sebuah restoran western dan toko souvenir
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Baru kali ini saya berkunjung ke museum yang bersih dengan pendingin ruangan, larangan memotret, suasana tenang cenderung sunyi, dan dibimbing oleh pemandu. Padahal isi museum hampir didominasi oleh foto. Sedikit barang-barang. Dilengkapi dengan toko busana dan restoran. Menceritakan tentang kehidupan kerajaan Jogjakarta dan Solo. Sejarah menjadi sesuatu yang menarik. Pemandu membawa pengunjung berkeliling museum sambil menceritakan kehidupan seputar keraton.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: I have visited this gem many times,visited first time during school excursion back in 1999, never get bored with this well thought museum. This museum although located in Kaliurang Yogyakarta, tells the history of two kingdoms in Surakarta/Solo : Karaton Surakarta and Mangkunegaran. You will find unique and memorable experience like nowhere else in the other museums.
Museum yang sarat informasi kebudayaan dan sejarah Yogyakarta, anda akan dibawa ke masa lalu oleh guide yang sangat menguasai sejarah Kerajaan.

Good place wih 4 different areas to explore with guide that is available in English, Bahasa and Deutsch.

You will learn a lot about the Javanese rich cultural history first hand from the private collection.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Just one word. Amazing. Ullen Sentalu menyajikan budaya namun mengemasnya lebih personal tentang tokoh-tokoh dalam keluarga kerajaan di Jawa. Dan karena lokasinya berada di lereng Gunung Merapi menjadikannya punya suasana yang asri dan udara yang sejuk.

Namun satu yang perlu diperhatikan, di museum ini banyak sekali lokasi yang dilarang untuk mengambil foto. Untuk melindungi nilai-nilai dari koleksi budaya yang dipamerkan, saya rasa. Tapi tentunya tidak mengurangi rasa kekaguman terhadap apa yang ada di dalamnya. 

Oh ya, untuk yang sudah pernah ke museum ini jangan lupa untuk selalu mengunjungi kembali. Saat saya ke sana, sepertinya ada pembangunan untuk memperluas museum dan mungkin termasuk menambah koleksi. Semakin tidak sabar untuk kunjungan selanjutnya!

It is a privately owned museum build in a property among locally grown crops. Its collections include letters of a Javanese princess, old pictures of Yogya and Solo royals depicting ancient ceremonies, batik pattern from both principalities, and many more. It is a good source of information on Javanese culture.

Museum yang unik..seolah menyatu dengan alam..
Nuansa yang tidak biasa untuk disebut sebagai museum..
Belajar budaya jadi lebih mudah dengan melihat potret, gamelan, kain batik dan lain sebagainya dan dipandu dengan seorang tuor guide yang ramah..

Lokasi ini terakhir kami tuju setelah kembali dari Borobudur. Perjalanan agak menanjak karena lokasi museum diperbukitan. Dilokasi kami lihat cukup banyak juga tamu yang datang berombongan. Biaya masuk Rp 30.000 saja dan kita diberi pemandu. Waktunya kurang lebih 45 mnt untuk menyusuri wilayah yang luasnya kurang lebih 1.5 hektar. Kita berjalan menyusuri lorong-lorong dan memasuki kamar-kamar diorama. Masing-masing ada cerita tersendiri tentang kerjaan Mataram awalnya hingga sekarang. 
Banyak koleksi yang ditemui, bahkan ada yang sudah ratusan tahun. Ruangannya selalu harus wewangian.
Selain itu juga cerita tentang batik jogja dan solo. Ternyata ada perbedaan khusus antara masing-masing Batik daerah tersebut.
Terakhir tamu diberi minuman tradisional, katanya agar sehat dan makin cantik (buat cewek) dan gagah (untuk laki).

Bagi yang suka sejarah daerah, wajib datang nih.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Salah satu museum dengan guide terbaik, guide mampu mnghidupkan suasana museum, desain dan penataan yang menarik membuat pengunjung betah didalamnya
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Saat berkunjung ke museum ini, kita di ajak untuk dibawa ke masa lalu di jaman Yogyakarta dan Solo pada jaman dahulu, di mulai dengan ruangan yang menampilkan alat-alat musik khas jawa jaman dulu, di lanjutkan dengan photo-photo para keluarga raja, bersama tour guide kita seperti dibawa menerawang ke jaman dimasa itu. untuk yang menyukai sejarah budaya khususnya budaya jawa, pasti akan sangat menyukai tempat ini.

This was our second stop on our day trip with our new German friends. There was four of us stuffed into a car along with our driver that was really made for 4 Indonesian sized people so it was a cramped trip that took us about 90 minutes each way from our Homestay. 
The museum buildings themselves are quite unique (dug into the ground and made using volcanic stone). The displays were decent (historical pictures of the various branches of Indonesian royalty, describing the inter-connections, batik, stone sculptures).
They provided our little group of 6 with our own English speaking guide. She kept apologizing for her errors but we actually thought that she was very good and it was really the information that she provided to us that made the visit worthwhile.

Saya sempat bermukim di Yogyakarta selama 4,5 tahun dan mulai mengenal keberadaan museum ini ketika menekuni profesi pemandu wisata. Saya sering membawa beberapa tamu asing berkunjung ke sini. Bahkan dalam satu trip keluarga (saya, kakak perempuan dan keponakan), ini menjadi tujuan wajib kami. Mereka juga menyukainya. Salah satu alasannya adalah karena koleksi yang dimiliki museum, nilai sejarah yang bisa dipelajari serta suasana alam yang luar biasa. Ini adalah tempat wisata yang harus dikunjungi bagi siapapun yang berkunjung ke Yogyakarta
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: it is located at north side of Yogya about 30 km. visitor of the museum can take a look at the collection of Batik with royal pattern of Yogya and solo palace .

Museum terbagus yang pernah saya masuki di Indonesia, saya sudah berkunjung ke2 kali, tiap kunjungan menemukan atmosfer berbeda dengan yg terdahulu, sangat menarik, mendengarkan guide bercerita ttg masa lalu dan sejarah keraton Surakarta dan sedikit ttg Yogyakarta. Pokoknya...must visit!
sangat menyenangkan berkunjung ke tempat ini. salah satu sestinasi wisata yang wajib dikunjungi saat berada di kota Jogja. Banyak benda unik yang fotogenic

Need to find out more about Javanese - especially central java - culture and royal history? Ullen Sentalu is surely a place you must head to. Located at Kaliurang area of Jogjakarta which has natural surrounding with lots of trees and stones. There you'll be guided by a guide who will take you in a friendly tour. 

The museum itself has a good design and the exhibits are well displayed. At the end of the tour, you'll be served with a traditional drink. 

The museum has its own restaurant and art and souvenir store. 

As far as i know, there is no public transportation available from Jogjakarta city to Ullen Sentalu. So if your travel is not organized by a travel agent, you will have to rent a motorcycle or car to get there.

(This review is based on my actual visit to Ullen Sentalu at mid year of 2013)
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I would describe this as a permanent exhibition about (and it seems also by) the four interrelated Royal families of Central Java (Solo and Jogja, two each), with an emphasis on their 20th century history.  The purpose-built buildings are very nice; the displays are less museal (relatively few genuine artefacts) than instructive. Like several other reviewers, our English-speaking party of two had a private tour guide who was really nice and knowledgeable.  Some sculptures and batik are on display also.  The mountain location is great, with magnificent air, and it is just a pleasure to be there.  It is well worth the drive if you have a car or know (or pay) someone with one; if you take some of the side roads, even the drive is very nice.  The shop has some nice items, but the textiles seemed seriously overpriced to me; the Beukenhof restaurant, however, with Dutch-colonial ambiance and Western menu, is really a steal for the quality, and a great place to make a day out of the visit (reviewed separately).
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Very nice museum with knowledgeable guides and friendly staff. The design of the museum was so clever and the exhibits were displayed well. The ticket price includes a guided tour which i wasnt expecting but was glad to have. I learned so much about the culture that i havent seen in any other museums. It is far and difficult to get to if you dont hire a car or drive yourself. But this really didnt detract from the overall experience. Ill definitely recommend this museum to everyone who visits!

A very well rounded tour about javanese culture. You must be guided by a guide who will take you through all the items they have there. They have numerous interesting items to show. You cant take any picture inside.

Museum ini adalah museum yang paling menarik yang pernah saya kunjungi karena merupakan museum ini menyajikan cara yang menarik dan tidak biasa bagi pengunjungnya untuk mengetahui tentang sejarah kraton yogya dan solo. Tempatnya bagus, sejuk dan asik buat foto2. Saya mau kalo harus berkunjung kesini lagi karena ketika saya berkunjung masih terdapat renovasi di beberapa bagian museum.
The guide was very passionate to describe the collections. No photographs allowed inside the museum. The collection were very dramatic and high value.

the only museum that i visited more than 2 times and never get bored. you'll listen different perspective from different guide, and it's interesting. I love the ambiance, the restaurant (expensive but taste delish!), and the story from the museum.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Suasana, Ketertarikan Fasilitas

Review Text:
I could say that this is the best museum in Indonesia. It's being manage by private company, you will get one guide to guiding you through the museum and explain you everything about the King history in Central Java.

I like how they explain the history in story telling mode. So you won't feel boring and enjoying the whole story like reading a book.

I go there about 5 times, taking my foreigner friends, and all of them are really enjoying the place. Do asking to be guide by Vella, she's one of the best. She could answer all the detail about the statue, the painting, the picture and so on. If she's forgot the answer, she will answer it honestly and giving you her email address. So if you had any further question, she will help you through email.

Never get boring going to this place, keep the excellent services!

ullen sentaluuu bagus bangetttt... tempat ini jadi museum favoritku.. sudah 24 kali kesana. haha... saking senangnya... 
just love the admosphere.. love the history.. love the weather.. love the story.. suka ajak temen2 kesana.. tempatnya tetep asik buat foto2.. pasti donk haha..

ini tempat rekomendasi bgt.. heheh.. harus kesini kalo ke jogja...jangn ampe kelewat.. abis itu merapi jeep tour deh

Saya pikir saya menyimpulkan sama dengan wisatawan lainya bahwa anda harus mengujungi museum ini jika sedang berada di Yogyakarta atau tepatnya di Kaliurang. Dari konsep museumnya saja sudah oke banget. Bangunan baru yang sengaja disatukan dengan alam sehingga menampilkan kesan yang eksotis dan asri. Isi museum ini mengoleksikan barang barang kraton Yogya. Tiketnya terjangkau dan jelas sudah termasuk fee guide nya. Intinya harus mampir. Bagus banget
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This is such a nice surprise.. Its up in the cooler hills around Mount Merapi, a private museum about Indonesian royalty and history. You will be guided around by a English speaking guide  as I was and it was very interesting if you like that kind of thing. The guides do not accept tips! I enjoyed. The house there is interestingly built, colonial style with beautiful gardens. There's a good shop there too, with some actually attractive batiks clothing and gifts. The restaurant is just lovely , very attractive tropical style with lots of polished timber and a great balcony. I was sorry that I only had time for coffee as the European menu  looked delicious. Lovely service . Would love to go for another visit and lunch. Takes about 50 minutes to get there by taxi, depending on traffic. Worth it!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Museum unik ini beberapa kali kudatangi dan masih tetap menarik meskipun ada beberapa perubahan untuk perbaikan.
Seusai mendengarkan penjelasan tentang sejarah budaya kraton terutama kisah cinta para putri kraton yang sangat menarik,langsung disuguhi jamu jawa yang segar sekali :-)

Thanks to the reviews in TripAdvisor, I learned about this place and arranged to visit during my stay in Jogjakarta. I suppose it was a little known place among international tourists, when we were there we were the only foreigners around!

The museum was a treasure trove of pictures and display items all through the years of the sultanate. We were attended to by a young English-speaking guide named Ambair, She spoke good English, was knowledgeable and answered all our queries patiently. As we were the only foreigners there, we had her services all to ourselves, what a bonus. 

We had enjoyed this better than the more famous and accessible Kraton (Sultan Palace) in town. Our guide's interesting commentary had made it more real for us. Excellent stuff.

If you have some time to spare, this is a worthwhile trip to make. You can visit this place after a trip to Ketep Pass to view the landscape and on your way back to either Jogjakarta or some other sights in or around town.
Unique museum in the north of Yogyakarta which tells the beauty of Yogyakarta Princess and some cultural heritage and also its provide mild atmosphere located in Kaliurang, Yogyakarta.

Museum ini berisi peninggalan dari keluarga keraton. Untuk tiket seharga 35rb, pengunjung mendapatkan 1 tour guide untuk menemani berkeliling museum sekaligus menjelaskan cerita yang melatarbelakangi benda2 dalam ullen sentalu. Di tengah perjalanan pengunjung diberi suguhan berupa minuman tradisional yang enak.

Well maintained museum. 
A must visit destination in Yogya, instead of keraton, taman sari, etc.
Friendly guide.

I have lived in Java for more than 10 years, however once I visit this museum than I realized that my knowledge on Java is really nothing.
This museum is located in Kaliurang area, so from Yogyakarta there is no really public transportation that went specificly to this place.
The entrance is not that expensive and the content of the museum is really impressive.
My most favorite part is the display of the 70-100 yrs of "batik" which are obviously stunning in design.  
By default, all the visitors will have their guide with them.
Guide can speak Indonesian and English.
In the end of tour, there is souvenir shop that also sells beautiful Javanese product.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
An amazing experience to see the story of Kesultanan of Yogyakarta and Solo. The place is very clean. and You will have your private guide. They explain everything, and they will answer anything what you asked about the story.
It's an interesting place to go.

Yes, the locals love this place... yes, the exhibits are well above the standards of normal museums, perhaps locally. The paintings, the batiks, the art... all very artistically done. Even the gardens... eventually led to the high-priced restaurant and boutique. Quite an elaborate marketing strategy, I must say.

I for one am not interested to find out about the external knowledge of the royals of Jogjakarta and Surakarta, which the museum focus on. Without prejudice, I find the guided tour quite boring. There was a room full of framed ancient letters of one of the princess lamenting about life and freedom (despite being a royalty??)

Only for the die-hard royal fans and those who are willing to travel about an hour each way to get here and queue up to get in. The guided tour is about another 45 minutes. Conducted in Indonesian for locals and English for foreign tourists.

No photography allowed (except in non-important passage way and the final exit)

Everyone i know recommends this Museum. So i decided to visit this August. 

The Museum itself is quite far from the city. Having a car or motorcycle would be helpful to reach there.

Ullen Sentalu talks about Jogjakarta, The Kingdom of Jogja and Solo, and several culture of Java such as Batik. The guides there were awesome. They knew almost everything and provide Bahasa and English guidance.

After walked about 4 Rooms, you can also enjoy the food in their restaurant. It is quite pricey, but the ambience and the taste of the food made it equal. 

In my expirience, it would be better to come after lunchtime. The ratio per guide onky 1:7 to 10. Before lunchtime the guide said she can bring up to 25 persons in a group.

This one is highly recommended!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Visited Ullen Santalu this morning.  Had originally wanted to visit the sultan palace and Malioboro but after reading some reviews on TA, decided on Ullen Sentalu instead.

We are staying at the Hyatt and booked the hotel car for 3 hours for this.  It'll  be cheaper to get a taxi but we decided to take the hotel car for the convenience. Guests Services estimated that it will cost us about IDR100k to get there and we will need to negotiate a price with the cab driver to wait for us and send us back as otherwise there will be no transport back.  The Hotel car cost us IDR300k. We were not in the mood to negotiate with cab drivers.  It took us about 30 mins to get from the Hyatt to Ullen Sentalu.  

Entrance fee for foreigners is IDR50.000 per pax and comes with a museum guide and a Jamu drink.  We were lucky to get Ratna for our guide.  She was cheerful and spoke excellent English.  The museum consisted of several rooms, each with a different focus.  There was one room with musical instruments.  Most of the rooms were filled with paintings and portraits of the royal family of Yogyakarta and Solo in history and Ratna had a story to tell for every picture.  It makes the characters come alive and you can imagine the lives they used to lead.  There were batiks of different designs on display  too, together with some stone sculptures.  We were served a delicious ginger Jamu drink at the end of the tour.

We had lunch at the museum restaurant after the tour.  My husband had the spaghetti bolognaise while I had the duck salad.  I also ordered a Virjito (virgin Mojito). I like my salad and drink a lot.  Hubby says that the spaghetti was not that great and his green tea was strange.  Service was fast and we sat outside on the veranda which looked pleasantly out to the garden.  As Ullen Sentalu is in the mountains, it is very cooling can can be slightly chilly for some.

We also browsed the souvenir shop which sold really nice and classy stuff.  Price and quality are all on the higher side.  I bought 2 lovely cushion covers which cost me IDR712,000.

All in all a lovely and enjoyable visit for us.  I'm glad we came here.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I had a mesmerizing experience in Ullen Sentalu. It was both romantic and historic. I liked that in every corner of the museum was taken care with great attention to details. Several of my questions towards the guide was not only answered through a nod / a no – but there must have been something symbolic or a remarkable story behind that. You can also see that the materials displayed are of high quality. Unfortunately, quiet in contradictory if I compared with Taman Sari. I was really impressed with how they organized the crowd, very structured and neat. It was great to go through all of that and the building was very beautiful. Everything was carefully selected and thought of. Because you can see that several of these things are of high quality. Quiet a contradiction actually after having been to Taman Sari. A really beautiful place and architecture that is lacking of recent perseverant.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Great museum with great design and collection. The owner has a very good taste and passion towards javanese history. However if you are travelling with young children, please pay attention to your kids so that they dont run around the place (the rooms are quite small so be careful not to touch or break anything, and the shape is like labyrinth so if you dont follow the guide you might get lost). Also make sure that your kids didnt make noise because it will interrupt the guide explaining the museum.
I was here long time ago with my friends from campus, but it is always special for me. Kaliurang is known for its cold weather and mysty hazy fog...

Schon nur die Reise mit dem Auto über Land ist die Reise zu diesem Museum wert. Man sieht in dieser Landschaft alles was der Boden den Mensche hergibt. Ich bin selber kein Verehrer von Ahnenkult ehemaliger Regierungen. Die sehr persönliche Führung einer von ihrer Arbeit hoch begeisterten Dame entschädigt für den sehr langfädigen Besuch der viele sehr kitschigen Ölgemälden. Witzig ist ein Schrein mit Pokalen der Regierung für saubere Toilettenanlagen !

I love this museum so much. I always suggest people who visit Jogja, to also visit this museum.

This is a private-owned museum, and it's located on the highland of Kaliurang (near Museum Gunung Merapi Kaliurang), northern part of Jogja. The weather is so great and nice, and the ambience is really full-of-nature. You should take car/motorcycle to go there. There is limited public transportation, but I don't recommend you to take public transportation to visit Ullen Sentalu.

The museum itself is designed in a special way that make you go under the surface, up above the water, and suddenly you are in the middle of little forest, during the visit. Since it's private-owned collection, you may not take any pictures during the trip. They will take you to the another open-air section where you can take pictures as much as you want.

The tour guide is also great. You may choose the language between bahasa, English, or Javanese. And they are fully trained so you also can ask anything to the tour guide beside what's they say.

At the end of the trip, they will give you the traditional royal tea with secret ingredient. The tea tastes great!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This museum is quite new.  I find it a little pricey for what it is.  Worth a visit if you have time.  We had to pay extra to access the museum as it is inside a resort.

This is a private museum showcasing Javanese culture and the royal families of Jogja and Solo.The layout of the building and the landscaping is very lush and cooling. You feel as if you are in a stately home within a tropical forest. The guide is quite informative. You will learn about the members of the royal families and their lives. The paintings of the members of the royal family are superbly done. The guide also explains the differences in the batik motives used by the royalty.

Terletak di Kaliurang, dengan hawa yang sejuk, museum budaya ini memiliki desain bangunan menyerupai rumah dengan ruangan-ruangan. 
Pengunjung akan dibagi dalam beberapa kloter / rombongan saat memasuki museum ini. Setiap rombongan akan didampingi tour guide yang ramah dan sangat aktif menjelaskan. Banyak pengetahuan yang bisa didapat mengenai Keluarga Kerajaan (Bangsawan) Jogja.

Suasana museum ini sangat mencerminkan Budaya Tradisional Jawa, dan terasa mistis.
Pengunjung hanya diperbolehkan untuk mengambil foto di lokasi yang telah ditentukan.

Definitely must visit place while you're in Yogyakarta!

Museum milik pribadi ini sangat menarik: dikelola secara modern, penataan yang baik dan menarik, serta guide yang informatif. Bila hendak mengetahui sejarah keluarga keraton serta hal-hal terkait kebudayaan Jawa, museum ini menawarkan informasi yang cukup memadai.
Museum tentang keluarga keraton. Panyajian unik. barang-barang tertata rapi. Pengaturan pengantaran tamu juga baik sekali. rumahnya sendiri asri...
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
I can honestly say my experience at Ullen Sentalu was the best Indonesian museum experience I have ever had.

The guide was knowledgeable and helpful although she did speak very fast and with a little dialect here and there. Had no issues asking her to repeat some things and ask questions - very friendly!

The exhibit was very interesting and well taken care of. I learned more about the Keraton than when I visited the actual Keraton!! Loved seeing all the batik pattern and being explained what their origins and meaning were. Learning about the royal family was also very interesting.

The whole establishment was quite beautiful and very well maintained. I assume the high level of maintenance is due to this museum being privately owned, there fore easier to manage? 

Really wished we could take photos inside or have a little brochure to bring home with us. Also wished we could stay in some of the rooms a lot longer as there were a lot to see but the guide moved pretty fast and we didn't want to lose her or hold the group behind.

However this place is highly recommended and I will definitely come to visit again when that closed off new section is finished :)
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Kalau suka dan tertarik sejarah budaya Indonesia, terutama mengenai batik dan lika-liku kerajaan Jawa, Ullen Sentalu layak dijadikan pilihan. Tempatnya begitu tradisional, tetapi terawat jadi cukup menyenangkan untuk didatangi. Restorannya memang tidak memiliki banyak menu pilihan, tapi cukup enak buat 'hang-out' sore.
Sejarah yogya selain keraron dpt kita gali di sini n apalg ending dr kunjunfan di suguhi minuman jahe

Excellent displays with free English speaking tour guide.  Getting to know about royal family of Yogya and Solo, and some interesting Javanese traditions, as well as different style of Batik.  Would be great if the museum will allow us to take some photos inside.

Koleksi dan keterangan (penjelasan guide) memberi pencerahan dan penguatan atas kecintaan terhadap budaya Jawa. "Tidak boleh memotret di dalam museum", memberi nilai tambah "kesakralan" museum ini, dan saya respek. Gambar tetap terpatri di alam pikiran.

menurut saya ullen sentalu merupakan museum paling terawat yang dipunya oleh Indonesia, terletak di kaki gunung merapi tepatnya kawasan kaliurang membuat tempat ini juga nyaman untuk dikunjungi karena suasananya yang sejuk dan segar. berisikan cerita tentang kerajaan yogya dan solo dan juga berbagai warisan dari 2 kerajaan yang masih eksis tersebut seperti kain, perhiasan dan lukisan.

The museum is current with artefacts on how the royal family lived before the Dutch invasion and how they lived under Dutch influence.
Although the guide spoke heavily accented English, I learnt more about the significance of difference designs and pattern prints on Batik than I have ever did else where in Singapore and Malaysia where batik is also easily available.

Budaya Jawa khusus mengenai kraton Kasultanan Jogjakarta dengan Kasunanan Surakarta dapat anda ketahu melalui museum ini. Selama di dalam museum anda akan di pandu melewati beberapa ruangan dengan interior yang cukup unik. Anda akan dijelaskan banyak mengenai asal usul keraton Jogjakarta dan Surakarta berikut dengan budaya yang dibawanya. Selama mengelilingi museum tidak diperbolehkan foto kecuali di beberapa tempat tertentu. Anda juga akan diberikan jamu dari resep salah satu ratu keraton tersebut. Membawa anak-anak ke tempat ini adalah sebuah wisata edukasi yang tepat.

Ini bukan pertama kalinya saya mengunjungi Ullen Sentalu. Mungkin sudah sekitar 8 kali dan enggak bosen2nya ke museum ini tiap kali saya ke Jogja. Begitu masuk museum, kita langsung diantar tour guide khusus dari museum yg akan cerita tentang keunikan2 dari hal2 yg dipamerkan di tiap ruang. Kita juga bebas untuk bertanya lebih jelas ke tour guide kita sehingga pemahamam kita tentang kerajaan2 jawa bisa bertambah. Ketika saya bawa teman dari luar negeri, mereka juga siap dengan tour guide yg bisa berbahasa inggris. Saya juga dengar rombongan disebelah saya dipandu dengan bahasa asing lain selain Inggris (kalo nggak salah Perancis). Jadi ini juga tempat yg oke banget kalau kita mau memperkenalkan budaya tradisional jawa ke nggak cuma untuk orang indonesia tapi juga orang asing. Harga tiketnya reasonable, cukup murah kalo kita itung2 dari biaya perawatan museum yg luas ini. Tapi 4 tahun lalu setika saya kesana seperti banyak tempat wisata lain di Indonesia, harga masuk untuk turus asing lebih mahal. Just info, untuk yg bawa teman turis asing, biar ga kaget. Setelah puas muterin museum, kita akan dijamu dengan minuman tradisional racikan salah satu puteri jawa (enak banget, favorit saya ). Pokoknya bagi pecinta wisata seni dan budaya, ini tempat yg oke banget buat dikunjungi. Semoga reviewnya bermanfaat.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: You will learn all about Java culture in this place. The area was tidy and clean good enough for tourism destination. You Have try to visit this place.

Museum yang sangat istimewa, berisi benda-benda yang berhubungan dengan budaya dan sejarah kesultanan Yogyakarta & Surakarta. Kita akan ditemani guide yang akan memberikan penjelasan mengenai setiap item yang ada di ruangan tersebut. Setiap koleksi terlihat sangat indah dan terawat dengan baik. Sayang tidak diperbolehkan untuk mengambil foto saat berada di dalam. Kita akan dibawa menyusuri museum dengan jalur seperti di dalam labirin, karena ada beberapa ruangan yang terdapat di bangunan yang berbeda. Bentuk bangunan dengan lorong seperti dalam sebuah kastil, menjadikannya sangat unik. Sebelum mengakhiri tour, kita akan disuguhi minuman yang terbuat dari 7 bahan rahasia yang berkhasiat membuat awet muda, Wedang Ratu Mas namanya kalau tidak salah. Sangat menikmati kunjungan ke Ullen Sentalu. Hanya satu hal yang sangat disayangkan, pada saat memberi penjelasan, guide terkesan hanya menghapal saja, berbicara dengan sangat cepat dan terburu-buru sehingga sedkit sekali kesempatan untuk pengunjung bisa mencerna dan memahaminya.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It is a museum that tell story briefly about Javanese Mataram Kingdom. The story started from Mataram to Giyanti Treaty to Kasultanan Jogjakarta and Kasultanan Surakarta and the last break up of Paku Alam and Mangkunegaran. It displays gamelan, photograph and pictures of the King, Prince and Princess of the Javanese Kingdoms. Different style of batik and historical statues are part of museum collection as well. The tour guide explained the museum history and its collection clearly. It would be good if the museum adminitrator to provide a booklet about the museum as visitor's reference. We finnaly enjoyed fine dining in its in-house restaurant.

Het Ullen Sentalu Museum in Kaliurang ligt in een prachtige (Tropisch regenwoud) omgeving, de eerste apen in het wild in de buurt van Yogyakarta. Het museum is een architectonisch staaltje van Javaanse bouwkunst. Je loopt door een nagebouwde kampong, in koloniaalse omgeving, in een kratonzaal... De museumstukken, veel schilderijen en historische foto's kun je alleen goed bekijken met een (gratis) gids die zeer goed geïnformeerd is. Zonder zo'n gids zie je nog niet de helft! Helaas mag in het museum niet worden gefotografeerd. Het museum heeft ook een heel bijzondere museumwinkel. Geld meenemen!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The tickets is very cheap for the experience i got in this museum. They will provide a free guide and giving the full explanation to the whole museum. The history explanation is easy to learn and they will give a free drinks in the middle of the journey.

Invité par une amie, j'ai eu le droit de découvrir le musée grâce à son directeur, un homme charmant qui nous a permis de faire cette visite dans d'excellentes conditions.

Les batiks sont magnifiques, l'endroit est perdu dans la nature et tout semble se conjuguer pour un moment délicieux sur les flancs du Merapi.

Un petit bémol: les photos étaient interdites mais même pas de cartes postales à acheter en sortie. Dur d'en ramener un souvenir, ce qui est dommage vue la qualité des batiks.

this place is really great if you want to learn history about mataram kingdom and the history of jogjakarta. the guide will also explain the different motif / design of batik for different purposes and meanings. Many beautiful paintings and artifact. there is no public transportation to go to this place, so you better rent a car which is not expensive in jogjakarta

Museum Ullen Sentalu sangat indah! Kita bisa belajar sejarah yang terjadi antara Kerajaan Jogja dengan Kerajaan Solo, keluarga kerajaan, pakaian adat, tradisi mereka dan bahkan perkawinannya. Untuk ukuran harga museum memang agak mahal (apalagi dibandingkan dengan museum Jogja), namun saat saya melihat sendiri, semuanya benar2 worth it. Museum ini dikelola oleh swasta sehingga terpelihara dengan baik. Sayang di dalamnya tidak boleh foto. Tapi masuk kesana benar2 seru dan menyenangkan. Salah satu cara belajar sejarah yang sangat menyenangkan (setiap rombongan disertai tour guide gratis). Selain itu di dalamnya kita disuguhi minuman tradisional Jawa (lupa namanya apa, semacam jamu yang katanya adalah minuman kerajaan-tadinya saya sedikit takut karena tidak suka jamu) yang rasanya sangat enak. Staffnya ramah sekali. Selain itu terdapat taman dan restaurant belanda. Namun jalan yang ditempuh dari pusat kota lumayan jauh dan menanjak.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Museum yang sangat tertata rapi yang menawarkan pemandu dengan tiga bahasa. Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Inggris dan Bahasa Jawa. Suasananya romantis sekali dengan koleksi museum yang memukau dan terawat baik.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Cara menyenangkan menikmati museum sejarah bisa didapatkan dengan berkunjung ke museum ini. pengunjung masuk dengan selalu ada pendampingan dari pemandu, membuat kita mengerti dan mengetahui apa yang kita lihat (walaupun koleksi tidak boleh di dokumentasikan). Walaupun milik swasta namun kualitas kemuseumannya melebihi museum yg dimiliki oleh keraton Jogjakarta. Alangkah lebih baik bila pemandu menggunakan kostum kedaerahan Jogjakarta, sehingga menambah suasana kedaerahannya. Layak dikunjungi anak-anak sampai dewasa. Bangunan tambahan di dekat resto mengesankan kastil-kastil di dongeng cerita anak-anak, kurang terlihat kalau bernuansa Jawa. Over all museum ini layak dikunjungi.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Un museo algo retirado, pero vale la pena, entenderás acá todo sobre la cultura javanesa y las guias son sumamente amables e incluidas en el precio de la entrada, sin duda un rincón que vale la pena conocer en Indonesia
Museum ini unik, karena lokasinya sedikit diluar kota Jogja. Udaranya juga sejuk, koleksi museum cukup beragam. Cuman satu hal, anda tidak diperkenankan mengambil gambar di beberapa area di dalamnya.

Belum ke Yogyakarta kalau belum berkunjung ke Museum Ullen Sentalu. Tempatnya bersih, nyaman, cara penjelasan guidenya juga enak. Walaupun perjalanan yang ditempuh lumayan jauh (terletak di kaliurang atas) tapi worth it.

Konsep penyampaian materi di museum ini tidak membosankan. Setiap orang yang datang akan dikumpulkan menjadi beberapa kelompok untuk masuk ke dalam museum. Lalu, guide akan menjelaskan di satu per satu ruangan yang ada di museum. Mulai dari sejarah kerajaan, batik, hingga sastra jawa dan belanda yang penjelasannya sangat jarang ditemui. Intinya: menambah pengetahuan tentang budaya sendiri, budaya Indonesia.

Oh ya, di beberapa tempat pengunjung tidak diperbolehkan mengambil foto. tapi jangan khawatir karena ada beberapa spot dimana pengunjung boleh mengambil foto. Dan, yang paling membuat kunjungan ini berkesan, pengunjung diberikan secangkir jamu tradisional yang rasanya, uenak tenan!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
It's a nice tour around the museum where you can learn the history about javanese royals, yogyakarta and surakarta's kings and princesses. Tickets for international and domestic visitors are different. But don't worry, for foreigners, they'll give you an english guide. Japanese also provided, and also some of other languages.
The place has a nice temperature because it was located in kaliurang, and after finishing the tour, they made you traditional drink called jamu as part of their service.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
