Setelah mendapatkan tiket kami masuk dan langsung disambut guide yang akan mengantar kami mengeksplorasi museum. Tampak depan museum ini sangat tertutup dan pengunjung yang masuk diatur dalam kelompok-kelompok. Penjelajahan museum akan berlangsung kurang lebih 50 menit. Mengawali perjalanan kami langsung disuguhkan dengan jalan setapak yang menuju ruangan seperi terowongan. Diiringi dengan gending-gending Jawa yang menambah semakin kentalnya suasana Jawa tempo dulu. Museum ini tampak begitu eksotik baik secara arsitektur dan interior dalam ruangannya. Kami diperkenalkan mengenai silsilah kerjaan Mataram Islam di Jawa yakni Jogjakarta dengan Surakarta. Yang menarik adalah kami mendapatkan jamu yang merupakan hasil ramuan dari salah satu ratu kerajaan Jawa kala itu. Namanya jamu Ratu Mas yang menurut penjelasan dapat membuat awet muda.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Museum ini hanya tutup pada hari senin. Untuk masuk ke museum anda hanya perlu membayar 30.000rupiah saja sudah termasuk guide di dalam museum, biaya parkir dan welcome drink.  Keromantisannya karena suasananya dan kisah yang diceritakan adalah kisah cinta putri keraton dan kasultanannya. Bangunannya unik, tetapi anda dilarang untuk memotret didalam museum. Anda d perkenankan memotret hanya di dua tempat di dalam museum. Di pintu keluar ada restoran yang menarik, anda dapat mengunjunginya karna restoran tersebut masih berada di dalam komplek museum. Selain restorannya anda juga dapat mengunjungi butik yang berada di bawah resto, elegan unik tapi anda juga harus bersiap merogoh kocek yang agak dalam :D. Coba datangi museum bersama pasangan :) oh iya ada jam buka tutupnya, sebaiknya konfirmasikan terlebih dahulu web addnya www.ullensentalu.com emailnya info@ullensentalu.com tel (62-274) 880158,895161 fax (62-274) 881743
"Rasa dalam hati pupuklah agar sempurna hidupmu"
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: menarik  untuk dikunjungi, guide yang disediakan pun sangat lah menjelaskan dan sangat informatif. sejarah nya banyak yang kita tidak ketahui. sangat rekomen untuk remaja dewasa. waktu tour kira2 satu jam di dalam

Saat masuk seperti mengalami aneka misteri, tetapi penjelasan yang baik dan sabar dari pendamping selama tour dalam museum ini sangat membantu untuk memahami display yang ada pada masing-masing ruangan. Sesungguhnya penjelasan yang ada pada display sudah cukup memadai untuk mengetahui kisah yang disampaikan karena memang cukup sederhana. Namun demikian kisah-kisah dibelakang-layar yang dituturkan lisan pasti menarik untuk didengarkan.

Sebagaimana pada banyak museum lain, disini juga dilarang mengambil foto saat berada di dalam.

I just knew the historical of Sultan Hamengkubuwono when i came there. My wife ask me to go there because it has a great rating at Trip Advisor. And it's True...
So Amazing, Stunning..
And makes me curious when i don't have any picture spot on google neither Trip Advisor.

The Description from the painting, the meaning of Batik, The Letter, etc
and Ullen Sentalu Team still searching rare information about Java historical and Hamengkubuwono historical.

So maybe it should be a new information if i going there 2 years later...
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: restaurant environment was nice, weather was cool. they serve french food which i found delicious but make sure to have lenient-extra time to spend waiting for the food to be served.

Jika Anda tertarik dengan babad keraton Yogjakara, Anda harus mengunjungi Museum ini. Karena Anda akan mendapatkan gambaran jelas tentang Kerajaan Mataram (asal mula Keraton Yogyakarta sebelum terpecah) adalah Kerajaan bersifat agraris yang ber-ibu kota di pedalaman Jawa. Kerajaan  ini banyak mendapat pengaruh kebudayaan Jawa Hindu baik pada lingkungan keluarga raja maupun pada golongan rakyat jelata. Pemerintahan kerajaan ini ditandai dengan perebutan tahta dan perselisihan antar anggota keluarga yang sering dicampuri oleh Belanda. 
Di sini Anda akan di pandu dengan pemandu cantik yang ramah dan berbicara dengan aksen Yogya yang kental. Guide akan membawa Anda untuk melihat koleksi koleksi asli dari Keraton serta cerita yang melatarbelakangi setiap koleksi yang ada, baik itu lukisan, foto, alat music, batik, arca, dsb.
Di penghujung tour Anda akan di suguhkan minuman herbal buatan sendiri dari resep salah satu Kanjeng Putri Keraton yang ada.

Kami berkunjung ke Museum Ullen Sentalu pada saat libur lebaran. Museum sangat ramai, sehingga untuk membeli tiket pun menggunakan sistem buka - tutup. Untunglah tidak terlalu lama. Kami dipandu oleh guide untuk setiap kelompok sekitar 10-20 orang . Museum Ullen Sentalu sangat baik kondisinya, koleksinya meskipun sebagiab besar merupakan retro, tapi dengan panduan dari guide kami mendapatkan pengetahuan yang luar biasa yang belum kami ketahui sebelumnya. Museum ini berisikan koleksi-koleksi seni dan budaya Jawa, mulai dari surat-surat, catatan harian, batik, busana kebesaran dari raja-raja di Jawa termasuk Solo dan Jogja. 

Museum ini sangat terawat, sehingga terasa menyenangkan mengikuti tour selama 50 menit. 
Museum ini patut dikunjungi jika berkunjung ke Jogja khususnya Kaliurang
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Saya sdh 2x ke museum ini....bbrp thn lalu menjelang tutupdi sore hari...nggak bosan" ksini....isinya sangat menarik,betapa indonesia sangat kaya budaya.jika capek jalan jalan bisa mampir ke cafe nya.klu datang nya sore menjelang malam rasanya penuh misteri:-)...saya suka sekali museum ini.

Tidak semua museum di Indonesia memiliki keadaan yang terawat dengan tour guide yang smart. Maka dari itu saya terkesan dengan Ullen Sentalu, karena sangat mempertahankan kualitas koleksinya, kualitas ruangan penyimpanan dan tour guide nya. Tour dilakukan setiap 5-10 orang rombongan. Tour guide akan menjelaskan 1 demi 1 lukisan/peninggalan sejarah lain secara detail.
Kita tidak diperkenankan mengambil gambar di dalam ruangan penyimpanan koleksi karena lampu blitz kamera dikhawatirkan beresiko merusak koleksi museum.
Very amazing! A museum inside of Merapi Mountain. Some mystics and amusing artifacts. Anyway, try to visit at the evening, when there are some art performance.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Museum ini menyajikan romantisme ala raja-raja jogja di waktu lalu, bahkan desain ruangan pun mendukung suasana ini. Di dalam museum ini memamerkan berbagai koleksi kuno raja-raja jogja. Jangan khawatir bingung karena setiap grup akan ditemani pemandu yang sangat fasih dan komunikatif dalam menyampaikan informasi. Diakhir kunjungan akan disuguhi karya tradisional berupa minuman yang menyegarkan. Tapi ingat di dalam museum ini, selama periode turing jangan berharap anda bisa mengambil gambar, tapi menurut saya memang sebaiknya kita fokus pada penjelasan si pemandu supaya merasakan romantisme kala itu, sangat berkesan dan ingin kembali.

I love the architecture, the vegetation and scenery here. The underground tunnel was interesting and the tour leaders are very informative. I love to see the architecture more than the content of the museum but it's for my own personal opinion. The café serves great coffee and panekoek, and has the best view. It really worth the entry fee, and it gives another feel for Kaliurang. I love this place!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
+ Very unique location it gives you magical effect
+ Numbers of collection from early years of Yogya's history

- Need to spare some times to go, location a bit far from city center
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
I  like this museum. This museum belong to private owner. The entrance look like a jungle to me, but after i entered it, i surprised, we'll walk through a stone building to the basement.And there will be several building to enter, the guide will explain about the history of Yogyakarta and the Royal family . What i'm really disappointed about this place is that we're not allowed to take any picture at all! The guide kept on warning me.

At the exit , we'll find an exclusive batik boutique " Muse" and a cafe in colonial design.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
The best museum in Yogyakarta.
Museum that provides historical story of Javanese, especially Keraton Yogyakarta. 
One guide should escort you while explaining some stories behind artifacts and pictures/paintings in the museum.
One that should be known is, you can not take any photos in the museum, you can take photos only in the end of the escort.

very happy that we have this kind of museum.
very clean and comfy.
we can learn a lot about jogjakarta history.

Every visitor to Yogyakarta and Javanese history student must visit this museum, and try to remember every detail as photos are not permitted - this oasis of beauty and storied culture will not be forgotten!

Ya, kemana lagi untuk melihat koleksi semacam ini yang tertata dan disusun rapi selain ke sini ? Menarik, memberi info bagus, point plus plus plus buat PengIdenya ! Salam buat mas Budi Hadriarso, Owner (sudah ya ..... he he)

If you want to know the culture of Java, especially Jogjakarta, you should visit this museum.
Information given there is very complete. A lot of stories about Javanese culture can be found in Ullen Sentanu. I guarantee that you will get a good impression about the service as well as about the culture of Java. Having a guided tour will be helpful, and you can get it at a very cheap price.

Setelah beberapa kali ke Yogya akhirnya saya bisa mengunjungi museum ini. Lokasinya di daerah Kaliurang dan agak sulit dicapai dengan kendaraan umum dan terlalu mahal dengan taksi jadi sebaiknya datang dengan menggunakan kendaraan pribadi/rental. Area museum harus sudah clear dari pengunjung tepat pukul 16.00 dan tur terakhir dimulai pukul setengah 4 kurang. Saya dan seorang teman beruntung bisa datang dan mendaftar di tur terakhir. Tiket masuknya cukup mahal untuk ukuran museum lokal yaitu IDR 30,000 tapi cukup layak dengan tampilan museum dan barang koleksi yang terawat baik. Isinya sendiri sangat menarik, mengenai kebudayaan Jawa dan kehidupan keluarga keraton. Pemandunya cukup fasih walau sayang saat itu karena kami dan 2 orang lainnya merupakan pengunjung terakhir dan jarum jam sudah mendekati pukul 16.00 maka tur terasa agak terburu-buru. Dari sekian banyak area museum, hanya satu area saja yang diperbolehkan untuk foto yaitu area outdoor menjelang akhir tur. Kita juga disuguhkan minuman jamu tradisional di sela-sela sesi tur. Tidak ada penjual makanan dan minuman disekitar sini, hanya ada 1 restoran saja di area ini.
History of the palace's life packed in a really nice buildings...worth to visit. You can learn about culture of central Java in this museum.
A place to understand more about the legacy of "kesultanan" jogjakarta.. nice architecture also.. worth the visit

Museum Ulen Sentalu terletak tidak jauh dari objek wisata Kali Urang Yogyakarta. Museum ini menggambarkan kebuydayaan jawa yang sampai sekarang masih tetep dilestarika. Perjalanan diawali dari pintu gerbang museum. Dari pintu gerbang ini dengan ditemani oleh seorang pemandu kita berjalan mengelilingi musuem sambil mendengarkan cerita pemandu yang mengsahkan kebudayaan jawa mengikuti gambar gambar yang terpampang sepanjang dinding museum. ditemani dengan sejuknya udara sekitar museum,.banyak kisah yang kita dapati disana. misalnya, cerita tentang kerajaan dijawa berikut turunan nya, motif motif kain batik yang biasa dipakai oleh keluarga kerajaan , dan masih banyak yang lainnya.
Setelah capek mengelilingi museum, kita beristirahat sejenak sambil dikumpulkkan di suatu ruangan (semacam ruangan pertemuan).. Disini kita disuguhi minuman teh khusus yang katanya teh ini berkasiat. sunguh sangat menyegarkan. Selesai acara kita diajak ke bagian depan museum, disana kita bisa mendapatkan souvenir atau pun baju batik yang dijual ditoko disana.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: sejak masih kuliah di Jogja, tidak pernah bosan untuk mengajak teman atau saudara untuk mengunjungi museum yang satu ini. Disaat orang lain merasa museum itu hanya bosan dan suntuk, museum ini bisa menyajikan budaya Indonesia dalam format yang sangat apik, dengan pemandu yang sangat interaktif dan dengan pembawaan "Yogya" nya, makin terhanyut dalam kisah sejarah budaya Yogya. jadi selalu ingin kembali ke Yogya :)

Beside Keraton Yogjakarta, you should come here. The place is well maintained, some room is airconditioned. Also the guide is very detail explaining each room, paintings, etc. The the end of our journey you will be served a special drink also a souvenir shop which sell very good material of batik and cheap.

this is a Museum of History, with traditional nuance and set up in natural environment.     You can get lot of information, especially all matters of Yogyakarta Keraton's family and its Royal Pedigree.   Provide Good guide woman with very good related knowledge.  Take a nice museum trip about 40 minutes, at the end of trip you can find  Batik Javanesse goods store and European Resto.   It is one of wonderful Museum that I have ever seen.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Lately our young generation not very often visiting a museum, most of them quiet familiar with a shopping mall or even theme park rather than this kind of places. Lucky there are view people who still want to make an education-entertainment place as a part of their responsibilty to the society. Ullen Sentalu located near Merapi's mountain, sometimes the area is raining during the afternoon time. The museum contains the historical legacy such as  paintings... photographs... poems letter...batik...jewelry and many more personal belongings from a famous royal Yogyakarta family. The atmosphere is so friendly. Very rare to find this kind of museum in Indonesia.

Setiap berlibur ke Yogyakarta, pergi ke Museum Ullen Sentalu entah kenapa, is a must! Tidak pernah bosan diajak berkeliling dengan pemandu yang luar biasa menjelaskan satu per satu detail sejarah. Ullen Sentalu punya atmosfir berbeda. Sangat tenang dan adem. Setiap selesai tur, saya dan teman pasti langsung menuju ke restoran ala Indische di sana. Minum kopi sambil makan cake cheese strawberry nya yang enak. Jangan lupa berfoto-foto di sana karena banyak spot menarik.

Setelah mengunjungi Borobudur, kami dibawa ke Ullen Sentalu di kaki gunung Merapi. Saat itu kami adalah rombongan terakhir yang bisa masuk ke museum. Saya terkesan dengan penataan museum yang rapi dan teratur. Para tour guide juga sangat sigap dan pintar memberikan arahan serta penjelasan sehingga tidak membosankan. Koleksi yang dimiliki museum ini sangat luar biasa. Jangan lupa kunjungi tea house untuk menikmati teh dan camilan ringan sambil menikmati pemandangan dari balkon.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I am used to give comments on restaurants and hotels, I almost never do that for 'sight-seeing'. So this an exception... We read the comments on tripadvisor and decided to come here. Although interested in modern art, photography and history... this was not our place. The guide explained millions of paintings of members of the royal families. All the names, linkages and dates shared in a hurry. We saw rooms full of batik. Almost nothing interesting enough to remember for Long, nothing for my longtime memory, nothing really inspirational. The art pieces in wild combination displayed in rooms that can only be decribed as eclectic. We wouldn't go there again and do not recommend this place.

We took quite a long journey to get to Kaliurang only to visit Ullen Sentalu.
It tells about 4 kingdoms and the Batik history, a very amazing experience visiting this amazing architecture.
Built and maintained by the royal families.. hands down this is the best way to see the amazing history and cultures.
Too bad we cannot take photographs as it will damage the preserved original batik in the complex..

also.. toilets are everywhere!..

Letaknya di bukit yang sejuk. Gedungnya di bangun mengikuti kontur bukit, artistik. Harga tiket masuk sudah termasuk guide yang sangat ramah & mengerti sejarah Mataram (Solo-Jogja) plus minuman herbal khas Kraton. Koleksinya beragam & membaut liburan berkesan...

Rasa penasaran untuk mengunjungi museum ini yang semula saya kira museum batik, terpuaskan setelah mengunjunginya. Ternyata koleksi  batik (Jogya dan Solo) hanya sebagian dari sekian banyak koleksi peninggalan kebudayaan Jawa masa lalu, persisnya kerajaan Mataram yang dimulai dari Panembahan Senopati. Kemudian setelah masa Sultan Agung terpecah menjadi 4 kesultanan : Hamengku Buwono dan Paku Alam (Di Jogya) serta Mangkunegaran dan Paku Buwono (Di Siolo). Begitu rincinya penjelasan pemandu wisata dari foto-foto dan peninggalan budaya Jawa, termasuk dokumentasi Gusti Nurul saat menari di Belanda dalam acara Ulang Tahun Putri Yuliana (saat itu) yang diiringi gamelan yang disiarkan dari Solo ke Amsterdam, menjadikan kita sebagai pengunjung menjadi terbuai mengikuti alur sejarah. Apalagi arsitektur museum yang berbentuk "gua" yang merupakan labirin membentuk suasana alam masa lalu.Apalagi di akhir perjalanan disajikan minumanjamu tradisional yang katanya berkhasiat awet muda..Sungguh merupakan museum dengan maintenance benda benda sejarah yang begitu apik, sehingga patut diacungi jempol bagi penggagas dan pengelolanya..
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It's located near Merapi volcano. Very green inside. You need buy ticket and wait for guide. Our guide was one elder woman and she told us kindly about all the royal family history and their lives in this region. Many rooms with pictures and paintings and some private letters. Her interesting talks made good time there, we could feel in culture and relax in calm atmosphere. At the end of tour she served tea for us. Rather cool air temperature there. Good place to visit from active hot Bali beach.

Salah satu museum terbaik di Indonesia, menurut saya. Terletak di daerah Kaliurang, sebaiknya Anda ke sini setelah Tour Lava Merapi di pagi hari nya (Ullen Sentalu tutup pukul 15.00, harga tiket sekitar Rp 30.000 - Rp. 40.000 per wisatawan domestik).

Anda akan dipandu oleh local guide selama 40 menit perjalanan di dalam museum, mendengarkan paparan cerita mengenai sejarah kerajaan Yogyakarta & Surakarta. Masuk ke dalam ruangan-ruangan yang unik, berjalan masuk ala labirin, dan merasakan seni Jawa yang sangat kental.

Lakukan / Bawa:
- sepatu keds atau flat shoes (bagi wanita)
- sweater (agak dingin, terutama di sore hari)

Jangan:
- mengambil gambar (take pictures), kegiatan ini dilarang di dalam museum
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Saya sudah dua kali datang ke museum ini. Museum ini sangat bagus, dan benar2 menarik. Dengan dekorasi yang sangat bagus, dan bangunan yang terus berkembang dari kedatangan saya sebelumnya. Cocok untuk keluarga yang membawa anak kecil atau lansia. Seluruh ruangan dilengkapi dengan AC, dan berada di daerah kaliurang.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
My second time been here, still it feels so great to come again. Love the surrounding ambience so natural and smell like an old java.
Beu Kenhoff (correct me if im wrong spell it) restaurant need improvement on their menu. Im indonesian but couldnt find my menu, for those who love italian food it might be perfect. The architecture so cool!
Jogja monarchy and family history museum, very unique and well maintained! Great experience to know the jogja culture, especially the royal family life and tradition

Ullen Sentalu was a surprise! Too bad photos are not allowed to be taken inside. But if you come to Jogjakarta, this place is a must-visit! The museum is just beautiful. The place is cool (since you're on the slopes of Mount Merapi). There is a tour guide included in your IDR50,000 ticket. And you'll feel that you are in a private tour of a museum. One group is ushered in while the others wait outside. It is incredible to learn about Jogjakarta and Javanese culture. Before going here, I was not really interested in batik because we also have it in the Philippines. But after the museum tour, I wanted to buy one already! Too bad the good ones can be expensive.  It was also nice to learn about the Jogjakarta royalty. It's just too far of a culture from ours so it is definitely a new wonderful learning for me. Please take my word for it and visit this place. It is really very, very nice.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Located near Merapi, we decided to stop by the museum after reading some excellent reviews - and I'm glad we did!

Entrance ticket to Ullen Sentalu includes a guided tour which we found very helpful - we had a lovely young lady who patiently explained to us about the history of Yogyakarta and its royal family, batik, various traditional customs and served us with some herbal drinks. 

The museum itself was a beautiful old refurbished building divided into several sections dedicated to different eras/royal families - I distinctly recall a beautiful central courtyard with a lone statue in the centre, surrounded by a corridor with Hindu statues

Photography is strictly prohibited within the museum except at certain parts (the guide will tell you when you're allowed to take photos)

Overall, a very informative visit
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Ullen Sentalu is such a beautiful and unique museaum. The Museum beautifully displays photos painting and artifacts showcasing this rich history of Jogja and Solo. The guide is very informative and not over the top as some guides can be. The location is very peaceful and great even just to have a rest from the busy city. Well worth the trip!

Di museum ini nanti dikasih jamu yang katanya untuk bikin awet muda hehee..
Terus pemandu nya juga baik banget, ramah, dan friendly
Di dalemnya ada restoran, tapi waktu saya kesana masih dalam perbaikan, dan ada toko souvenir gitu yg batik2
Suasananya enak, masih alami banget, cobain kesana dehhh hehee
Harus kesana yang suka batik, dan pengen tau batik apa aja namanya
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Ullen Sentalu is located on the slopes of Gunung Merapi. Its a privately owned museum detailing the history of the royal families of Jogya & Solo. Rp.30,000 pays for entrance & an English speaking guide.

If you do not like to see or visit a museum because its oldness or boring, but we will find a different point of view in this museum.

A storytelling style museum with a different point of view describing history of kingdom in Indonesia with a buildings that was designed as a old hollanders architect.

The restaurant serve an european fine dining menus, but a little bit expensive.

A must to visit place ...

Review Text: A museum with a very different concepts. The display is in different rooms which seems to be built with stones. The guide comes with the entrance fee, which is only 50000IDR. A lot of good paintings.

Ullen Sentalu is a private museum focused on the culture of eastern Java.  The primary focus is on the royal families of Yogyakarta and Suryakarta (or Jogja and Solo as the locals commonly name them).  

Most of the rooms are built into the rock.  Admission is relatively inexpensive, and includes a free but mandatory guide.  Honestly unless you are an expert on eastern Java royalty, you'll need the guide.  Tours alternate between Indonesian and English.  

You'll get an overview of the royal genealogies, portrait galleries, and a look at some  personal letters.

There are some statues dating from the Hindu and Buddhist eras.  Music is represented by a set of gamelan instruments on display and by gamelan music in the background in the garden.  A few paintings refer to dance.  A few representative sets of clothing are exhibited.  

They have some excellent batiks on display, and our guide took some time to explain how to tell the difference between Jogja and Solo batik-work.  Good info if you're planning to buy some batik while in Jogja; and that's well worth doing on Maliaboro Street.

No photos allowed inside, but I will submit two that I took in the garden.  Well worth seeing if you're headed to or from the Jeep rides up to Letsuan Merapi.  

Note however that while you'll get some respectful anecdotes and information here not provided at the Kraton, the latter does provide much more information about Javanese culture.  You can hear a gamelan concert at the Kraton, watch Javanese dance or a Javanese puppet show, and wander through the actual historic (and current) palace of the Sultanate of Yogyakarta.  The Ullen Sentatu is a pleasant tour to take in addition to the Kraton, not a substitute for it.

Dan benar dugaan saya, di dalamnya kita akan ditemani oleh seorang pemandu yang bercerita tentang silsilah raja, keluarga keraton, berbagai peninggalan kerajaan dsb. Yang paling menarik bagi saya adalah ruangan yang berisi surat cinta. Berbagai surat yang disimpan di museum ini menjadi saksi bagaimana orang tempo dulu berkomunikasi dan berhubungan.

Saat pertama kali datang kesini saya terkagum-kagum dengan koleksi museum ini. Sebagai penggemar budaya Jawa, koleksi museum ini terbilang fenomenal. Ditata dengan runtut, semua koleksi terawat dengan baik. Dan yang paling mengagumkan adalah kemampuan tour guide nya dalam memberi penjelasan, lengkap, lugas dan menarik.
Pada kunjungan kedua, saya pikir akan bosan melihat koleksi museum ini. Ternyata saya salah besar, dalam kunjungan kedua ini tetap saja saya antusias mencermati koleksinya satu persatu.

Okay, so I gave this a "4" because the tour guides are very professional, the place is cute, and the entrance fee is small. But are the exhibits really impressive? No, they are not earth-shaking.

Basically it is a history of the Jogja and Solo sultans (and sultanas). Photos, paintings, fancy batik, and also gamelan exhibits. Set in picturesque surroundings. But awe-inspiring it is not.

But what it is, is a good insight into recent Javanese history and culture (I say recent, by that I mean a few hundred years, which is relatively recent when it comes to this part of the world). It doesn't really go back so far (given the much bigger timescales of Borobudur and Prambanan). 

Also, the restaurant (which is actually quite renowned for its good food) is closed at the moment for refurbishment.

So my view is this - if you are nearby then certainly drop in. But perhaps not worth the long trip from Jogja centre. Your decision. Good value but a fair old drive (1 to 2 hours one way, maybe more, depending on traffic and start point).

Last point - it is quite close the the Merapi crater. If Merapi is kicking off then I would advise maybe not going that close. Merapi is notorious as being the most deadly volcano in Indonesia...and very occasionally spits pyroclastic clouds... So if you don't fancy being fried, check the volcano-watch website before going there.

Satu kelemahan yang jika boleh saya bandingkan dengan masa awal Museum ini yang berdiri di tahun 1997. Ada baiknya juga, pengurus Museum membolehkan pengunjung kawakan yang sudah sering dating untuk diperbolehkan touring tanpa guide sehingga dapat terpuaskan.
Oh ya, seperti Museum pada umumnya, Museum Ullen Sentalu buka setiap hari kecuali senin. Jam buka jam 09.00-16.30. Harga tiket dewasa Rp30.000,-, anak anak sampai dengan usia 10 tahun sebesar Rp 15.000,-

They recently had this ArtJog event which is a great event where artists display their works. It was a well prepared event, supported by many companies and organizations. Worth to see.
Ke JNM waktu ada ART JOG 9. Tempatnya susah di temukan karena tidak di kalan utama. Area parkir kurang luas. Tapi gedungnya besar, bisa menampung banyak karya.

Having the VIP Seats with the cushions was the best decision ever, I am sorry to everyone who was sitting on the concrete. VIP seats came with light snacks and coffee/tea. Nothing to write home about, however. Definitely get dinner beforehand. Overall, the show was amazing! So many theatrics that I didn't expect to see. The Prambanan Temple lit in the background was the cherry on top. Add this to your Jogja  Itinerary.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Being from India and also as I am in the midst of reading the Valmiki Ramayana(there is a traditional ritualistic method of reading), the Ballet experience was amazing. The narration in the form of a dance-drama was very apt in so far as the story (mind you it is a 24002 couplets story) could how well be abridged for the dance-drama to convey the essence the epic. Hats off to Indonesia for  giving a wonderful glimpse of this great work which is most sacred to the Hindus. There could not have been a better venue for this classic programme than the precincts of the mighty Prambanan Temple complex. Words are insufficient to convey my appreciation of the Indonesian Government for preserving their ancient culture and traditions despite their transition to other cultural practices'.

They had subtitles to go with the play for those who are lost abt the story. Because it’s the monsoon season the sitting was in the indoor theatre but think they could have made an exception if the weather holds up. The Prambanan temple backdrop would have completed the experience

It was a really interesting showcase. Would definitely recommend to go see it. Just take note that some periods of the year, it is indoor instead of outdoor (overlooking the Prambanan temple). Unfortunately in Dec it was indoors so we missed watching with the backdrop of Prambanan temple. It is ok if you don’t know the story prior to the show as there were slides telling the scenario in English as well so that you won’t get lost in the performance. About an hour and a half show, just nice :)

A truly amazing show, mesmerizing live music, traditional colorful costumes, a fire performance at the end and the cherry on the cake - a view of the illuminated temples in the background. We had a great time, and even though the seats were made of stone, they weren't that bad - we sat there peacefully. For people who don't know the story of the Ramayana, I recommend reading it beforehand because it may not be clear what is happening (there is no voice-over/narrator and the actors do not conduct dialogues).

Went here with my colleagues as we want to experience traditional show. The show is quite long 2 hr. It is best have early dinner before coming here. We bought the middle tier ticket and sat on a hard stone for 2 hr. It was numbing 🤣. The vip ticket there’s cushion ontop. The show is slow and long to the build up of the story. The climax was only towards the end. It is outdoor show and starts i think about 7.30pm. There is a short break in between. U can get snacks and drinks as well on the premise. Once i think is enough coming here and if you missed it, not a big deal at all.
This is ab absolute must do. The Ramayana performance is intricate and beautifully performed. It is simple to understand and there is a translation in English
Performancenya kece parah! Dan best partnya adalah latar belakang yang menampilkan kemegahan Candi Prambanan! Saya akan berkunjung kembali kalau ke Jogja!

Sejak pertama kali memasuki area pementasan saya sudah merasa suasana Jawa yang sangat kental, ada pemain gamelan dan sinden, seluruh petugas menggunakan pakaian Jawa dan segala pernak pernik Jawa menghiasi area pementasan. Lalu ada juga Photoboth dimana ada 2 petugas yang menggunakan kostum Rama dan Shinta jadi pengunjung dapat berfoto secara gratis. Pementasan tarian dengan latar belakang Candi Prambanan merupakan hal terbaik yang disuguhkan. luar biasa indah dan megah. pokoknya recomended bangeett!!! i love Ramayana Ballet!

It was not the usual outdoor but indoors but it is one of the best productions I have seen. It is important to note that for most of the people who were performing it is not about their religion. Great performane, choreography and background musical scores. Not to miss at all if you are making a trip.
Very interesting scenes from the Ramayana. Explained in English. Beautiful costumes . Good way to spend the evening after visiting the Temples!

The performance was real quality and performed by good dancers. The story was easy to follow for us as Indians and the leaflet handed out before the show helped others to follow the story. There was some great pyrotechnics at display too during the performance. 
The food was very average and small quantity. I would recommend for people to only buy the  performance package and have dinner on their own before going for the show.

I have visited Prambanan a couple times during the days. For the first time I had an opportunity to visit Prambanan and enjoy the Ramayana Ballet at 7 pm. It wasn't as spectacular as Kecak, Balinese Dance, but it is a must try tourist destination in Jogja. It represents the richness culture of Javanese-Hinduism. The stage, the seats, the casts are amazing. What I love the most is the background, The Majestic Prambanan Temple. The true meaning of beauty ! Mesmerizing ! 

The ticket price is very affordable. I suggest to get the VVIP since they provide  more comfortable seats with cushions. For the lower class, the seats are cement-made, not so comfortable for 2 hour performance.
Bener2 berjiwa seni penarinya. Saking menghayatinya sampe tatapannya kelihatan kosong. Keren dah. Mau keliling2 disini tapi udah malem. Mana sendirian lagi. Heheh
Featuring Ramayana ballet in various episodes.  In general, Javanese dance, but once in awhile there are ballet from other regions in Indonesia.

i love to watch live teater and ramayana one of that.. amazing show. with subtitle. good show about rama and sita.. love story. but maybe need improvements about stage presentation like background. 

overall i love because still maintain the tradision.
レストランを活用しました。プランバナン寺院を見ながら食べられて良かったですが、注文してからかなり時間を要しました。

The ballet is performed by either amateurs or dancers who have not rehearsed enough. The backdrop of the temple and the magical setting, beautiful costumes and a few gimmicks cannot be a substitute for a good performance.  The stage is anyway quite far from whichever part of the theatre, except the first few rows of the VIP seats. The hype about the show is misleading.  We had to endure two hours of lack lustre, out of sync, poorly executed movements. A couple of dancers ( Ravana and Hanuman) appeared to be professional, the rest may have been students with no proper training.  Being a theatre artist, I am reluctant to comment adversely about any performance, but this is just a rip off intended for tourists who may not have had any exposure to this form of dance. Do not waste your time and money.
Ramayana Ballet was interesting and colourful. We experienced it at the open air theatre and enjoyed it. The almost 2 hours show was a good way to spend the evening.

Lihat pertunjukan ramayana disini tuh asik bgt, pertunjukannya keren tempatnya juga bagus semua staffnya juga baik2 bgt...  Selain itu disini juga ada restaurant all u can eat yg sangat memuaskan, jadi sebelum nonton kita bisa dinner dulu biar waktu nonton ga laper 👍👍
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: What a great show (saw the full story). Fantastic views of Prambanan at night (and if you're lucky, the moon as well). Costumes are beautiful and show is well put together! And there's two monitors that tell you in English and in Bahasar what the scene is, so that it's easier to follow the story. We sat in the VIP seats, which are cushioned seats, very nice and comfortable although they could renew the cushions as they are not as full as they once were. But much more comfortable than the other seatsb(see photos). There's also a buffet dinner available next door.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: I’m sure that if you’re into the Indonesian culture and saga’s, this would be a great show for you. For me however too much of a culture shock, both the Ballet as well as the music. It’s the Indonesian version of an opera but hard to understand for westerners. Prepare yourself and read about the story before you attend

A wonderful theatrical production of traditional art, music and storytelling.  A bit of a stretch to call it ballet.  Nevertheless a truly interesting performance.

The stage is set at the Prambanan Temple which is illuminated for the performance, offering a stunning visual aspect.

The ballet is housed in an open air theatre in front of the temple.  The auditorium was large enough with a reasonably sized stage with professional lighting and sound.

There is a narrative projection onto the wall which helps with characters and scenes.

The tickets are VIP, Special, 1st and 2nd class depending on where you sit. I opted for 1st class and was really happy with my seat.

I don't usually go in for the performance arts, however, really enjoyed an age old story being performed in a beautiful place and surroundings.

Great evening.
Sontuoso spettacolo di danza in abiti tradizionali compreso nel pacchetto visita Prambanan, en plein air con li sfondo unico del tempio. Esperienza culturale assolutamente indispensabile.

check the weather forecast first, because the performance on the open theater. Get a sweater, comfortable shirt & shoes, also bring some snack since the show take more than two hours. Surrounding with Prambanan Temple, with a spot light lamps, this is one of the best Ramayana Performance ever...Come and see it by yourself.

kami datang terlalu cepat. tapi itu memberi kami kesempatan untuk memotret candi Prambanan di waktu malam, dihiasi lampu sorot nan indah. Kami nonton bertiga dengan istri dan anak. pertunjukkan di theater terbuka. udara cerah dan penonton banyak memenuhi tempat duduk. Duduk di kelas 1, tapi serasa di VIP karena hanya dipisahkan gang tempat lalu lalang dan pintu masuk yang berbeda. Lama Pertunjukkan yang melebihi dua jam akan terasa panjang jika anda tidak tahu jalan cerita, atau nonton sendiri atau nonton tanpa ditemani cemilan.
Salvando a los protagonistas los bailarines no son muy buenos , lo de ir acompasados lo llevan fatal. Nada que ver con los vídeos de la web y la promoción que hacen.

I have seen at least thirty Ramayana performance over the last thirty years and this is on of the best Ramayana performance for me. One of the worst is actually the highly acclaimed and commercialised performance at Uluwatu, Bali.
While Ubud has some good performances, none could compare with the atmospheric venue at Prambanan. Check the weather forecast before you come as the rain would ruin the performance.
If you are going to see only one Ramayana performance in your life, this is the one to see. The story here is slightly more complicated as there were some characters that were often removed in other performances to shorten the dance so you might want to read the story before seeing the performance.
Buy the Class 1 tickets as you get to sit beside the VIP at half the price. The Class 2 tickets are also fine as you will get a good view too. Special Class is worst value for money.

It's a good show, but very long and the seating area- 1st class is not very comfortable.  Ut might be better to do VIP or something similar. The story was not translated well in terms of the plot which was difficult to follow the characters and dance sequence
Layak untuk ditonton. Lokasi tempat pementasan sangat baik. Di belakang lokasi pementasan terlihat candi prambanan yang sangat elok.

We had luck in June 2019 to see the full Ramayana Ballet (>2hrs). The ballet was spectacular,  however, some knowledge about the plot would be advisable before visiting the show, otherwise, you could find it not understandable. 

Some explanations about the story are running on screens during the show, however, the screens are too small. This was the only drawback.

ライトアップされたプランバナン寺院と満月を背景に劇が観られて素敵な雰囲気でした。
日本語の解説の紙があるので、だいたいのストーリーをわかって見た方が楽しめます。
ただ解説は日本語訳がおかしくなっていてちょっとわかりにくいので、自分でネット検索してあらすじを見ておいた方がわかりやすいと思います。
チケットは事前にネット予約してGrabの車で行きました。帰りもGrabがすぐ捕まりました。
始まる前に夕飯を食べようとしたら敷地内のビュッフェレストランはツアー客で満席で入れず、他には食べる場所が無いようでした。
敷地を出て右に200mぐらい歩いたところにレストランがあり、そこで夕食を食べることができました。

The Ramayana story is to the Indonesians what Romeo and Juliet are to the Westerners. The ballet was more like theater than just dance. The setting is wonderful. The temple is lit up at night and is the backdrop. I took a lot of videos but do have a few pictures. Explanations are given in both Indonesian and English. We were lucky and had VIP seats, but if you don't bring a cushion like you might do going to a ball game. The best part of the performance was the last scenes before the intermission when they set part of the the scenery on fire! It was breathtaking and amazing.

The Ramayana story was well presented on a fantastic stage with the actual prambanan temples beautifully lit-up against the night sky as the backdrop. The music, commentary and the choreographed dance movements of almost a 100 artistes was enjoyable.

Far better than I had imagined. The backdrop to Prambanan, with bats flying overhead was spectacular. You don’t need the vip seats, first or second class give you a good view.  Snacks are available from a kiosk and photo opportunities with the dancers.

It was really cool and dry when I watched the ballet. You can opt to have a buffet dinner before the start of the show at 7.30pm. Best to reach the place at 6pm. Dine till 7 then take some pictures with the performers before entering the grounds. We were invited to take pictures with the main performers after the show. VIP seats include seatpads.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Prachtige ballet-voorstelling, moet je gezien hebben! Text op het scherm tevens in het Engels. De voorstelling is goed zichtbaar vanaf de betonnen stoelen. Tip: doe lange mouwen aan! Ivm de open lucht zijn er veel muggen!
Mooi verhaal, Indonesisch verhaal lijkt op Romeo en Juliet. Aan te raden om het verhaal van te voren te lezen. Mooie dans en muziek.

Il faut réserver en avance, mais ça ne sert à rien de prendre des places en VIP. L'amphithéâtre est petit et la vue est aussi belle depuis les places les moins chères.
Il faut IMPERATIVEMENT prendre à l'entrée le feuillet d'explications en français. Sinon, on passe à côté de toute la signification du spectacle. Très bonne organisation. Dommage que l'accès du lieu ne soit pas plus facilement renseigné. Très bonne organisation pour le retour en navette sur Yogyakarta, qui prend 35 mn.

sendratari yg dimainkan dg iringan gamelan, dg latar belakang candi Prambanan di malam hari. Dilengkapi permainan cahaya, api dan patung hanoman raksasa utk mendukung dramatisasi adegan. Pertunjukan sekitar 2 jam, dan dimainkan dg sangat indah. tiket seharga minimal 150 rb

In vacanza con la famiglia decidiamo di recarci a questo spettacolo di danza rituale indonesiana, in un'arena all'aperto, con lo sfondo dei templi di Prambanan. E' stata una serata magica, dove la storia, la ricchezza culturale, la tradizione si sono fuse insieme per dare vita da uno spettacolo di danza che è stato veramente suggestivo. Le musiche, i colori e la musica hanno creato una atmosfera che definire magica è poco. E' uno spettacolo che consiglio a tutti i viaggiatori che in Indonesia vogliano assaporare un pò di questa cultura millenaria.

On vacation with the family we decide to go to this Indonesian ritual dance show, in an outdoor arena, with the background of the temples of Prambanan. It was a magical evening, where history, cultural riches and tradition merged together to give life to a dance show that was truly impressive. The music, the colors and the music have created an atmosphere that is little defined as magic. It is a show that I recommend to all travelers in Indonesia who want to enjoy a bit of this ancient culture.
Sepertinya, di setiap weekend suka ada acara... Tapi sayangnya pada kunjungan yang kemarin, kita tidak sempat menikmatinya

We had an enjoyable evening at the Ramayana ballet at Prambanan after visiting the temple. The sound effects, lights, costumes, dance, performances were all top-notch.  The only issue we faced was regarding the approach to the ballet venue - it appears close from the temple premises but is actually quite far and there are not enough sign-boards for reaching the venue from the temple. We ended up walking for about half-n-hour to reach the place. Suggest taking a car or taxi instead. Also carry mosquito repellent and food - there aren't too many food stalls around.

This is a fantastic setting for a true pageant of Javanese and Hindu culture. We enjoyed the Ramayana ballet, though probably would have even more if we weren't still a bit jet-lagged.  The music and dance can lull you to sleep at times before more energetic bursts punctuate the performance. We also enjoyed the convenient buffet dinner beforehand (99,000 Rupiah per person).  As for tickets, we went ahead and purchased the VIP seats on the recommendations of others, but in retrospect, it wasn't worth the extra price. The seats are marginally better, but almost all the seats have good views. The only "extra" amenities we received were one soft drink per person.

Prambanan 사원 방문시에 라마야나 발레를 감상하는것도 한번쯤 고려해 보세요. 아쉽게도 우기때 가서 야외 공연을 못보았지만 그래도 2시간이 어떻게 흘렀는지 모를정도로 만족하면서 봤습니다. 공연은 매일있는게 아니기 때문에 홈페이지에서 날짜를 확인하고 가셔야 하구요.. 공연후에 다시 족자카르타 시내로 들어가는 버스도 있기 때문에 필요하신 분들은 이용가능합니다. 되도록이면 식사는 미리 하고 오시는것으 추천합니다.

It was a beautifully clear day when I visited Prambanan, and I decided to see the Ramayana performance that evening in the open air theatre with the temple in the background. It was a beautiful pageant of flowing color and sound. I didn't have a program so just gave myself over to the story - it was easy enough to follow. It is a bit of a pantomime with easily recognized heroes and heroines, demons and villains.  It is a two hour long performance with a brief intermission two thirds of the way through.  You may be tempted to leave at the intermission, but that would be a mistake.  If you want photos, don't do what I did and forget to bring a tripod!!  I got a 2nd class ticket so sat in the peanut gallery.  If you're big on photography, you might want to sit closer.  VIP seats run the equivalent of about 25 dollars, but the 2nd class seats cost about $8.  Although there are a lot of action scenes involving very stylized personal combat and all out war, this is not for kids or people with short attention spans - it moves at a stately pace. If you're easily distracted, it might be best for you to go back to your hotel and watch television.
Fantastic performance after hard day visiting Prambanan.Historical surraunding, direct view to Prambanan temple.exellent dinner! We suggest for all of visitor.Our guide was Darwin.

Wir haben zu unserem Hochzeitstag von Freunden das Ramayana Ballet at Prambanan geschenkt bekommen. Die Vorfuehrung des Ballet's mit dem Hintergrund des Prambanan Tempels ist einmalig. Ich wuerde diesen Event allerdings nur Leuten Empfehlen, die sich fuer die indonesische Kultur interessieren.

We LOVED the Ramayana ballet!

Seeing Prambanan and Borobudur were must sees as was the Ramayana ballet. We watched the performance from the indoor venue and sat on the front row!  Our guide had explained the storyline in advance, so we were able to follow the story.

The dancers were spectacular and the musicians were wonderful. This is a must see if you are in Yogyakarta!

私が行った日は、小学生たちがたくさん鑑賞に来ていて、平日ながら多くの人で賑わっていました。
ラマヤナ物語について、音楽と劇で語られます。約二時間、途中休憩ありです。

入り口で出演者の方と記念撮影したあとに、流れに沿って客席へ。
左右の壁に、インドネシア語と英語であらすじの字幕が流れます。……が、小さくてよく見えなかった……。
あとから気づいたのですが、日本語パンフレットが会場までの通路に置いてありました。これ見てから行くべきだったなぁと思いました。日本語訳は完璧とは、言えないですが、ちゃんと意味は通じます。

ところどころ、笑いも混じえながら、最後まで楽しめました。終わったら、演者の皆さんと記念撮影できました。
プランバナン寺院群のすぐ近くに会場があるのですが、夏はもっと近くで、屋外でするみたいです。火もリアルだそうで、楽しそうだなと思いました。

プランバナン寺院のライトアップを背景に行われる野外ショーです。
すり鉢状の会場は、とても見やすく、思った以上に迫力があり、とても楽しめました。
ラーマーヤナは、あまり内容がわかりませんでしたが、日本語のパンフレットが門の横に用意されていましたので、それを忘れずに取って、ショーが始まる前に見ておくと、あらすじがわかって、楽しめます。
ネットでチケットを入手するかホテルでチケットを予約したほうがいいです。当日、チケットを買いましたが、現地ガイドがいなかったら、時間内に買えなかったかもしれません。土曜日だったからか、大行列でした。チケットブースの人の手際の問題なのか、コンピューターの問題なのか、なかなか列が進みませんでした。
また、日によって、行われるショーが違うようです。4つみると1話完結ですが、4日間はいけないので、1日でそれぞれのハイライトを行うショーにしました。

The delivery of the Ramayana story was brilliantly done, with english and indonesian screens on the sides showing what was happening alongside the dance to aid the viewers' understanding. The setting of lit-up temples in the background of evening darkness was beautiful. There was much to be appreciated, but the play was quite long so I can imagine people getting restless towards the end. It may not be ideal for young children who may get bored.

Additionally there was a buffet outside the amphitheatre for before the ballet started (at additional cost) which was expensive but tasted decent. Tickets to this performance aren't cheap however, and it may not be that easy to travel to, so it's best suited to those who would enjoy the cultural story.

Very nice and enjoyable show. They also had a screen to explain the story of the dance. I was worried that my children would get bored to have this 2 hours performance but instead they LOVED it and they really enjoyed watching the show.
Recommended to have dinner prior this show.

Kudos to the choreographer and costume designers! A well done staging of Ramayana. The story delivery is simply outstanding. The pace of one scene to another is just perfect, easily understood. Building of character, facial expression, and the staging of intense moments well captured. A must watch if you are in Yogyakarta, visiting Prambanan temples. Posted some photos and short videos in our IG #photojourney_travels :) Two weeks later, we were in Siem Reap watching Apsara Village's version of Ramayana. It wasn't as great; so.. do not miss the one in Yogyakarta when you are there!

Pertunjukkan sendra tarinya bagus banget.... 

Harus cek jadwal dulu apakah pertunjukkannya indoor atau outdoor... sama apakah pertunjukannya full atau hanya separuh...

WE were looking forward to a beautiful performance of the story of Rama and Sita but were sadly disappointed.  First, since it was already the rainy season, the venue was changed from the outdoor theater to an indoor venue.  This somehow lost a lot of drama because we couldn't see the Prambanan temple complex in the background.  The indoor venue was also not good.  It was open and quite small and there was a cat roaming around and also lots of mosquitoes!
Secondly, the performers did not look professional.  A lot of dancers were not in step and were clearly just following the lead of the dancers in front.  There were a lot of times when the dances were not in sync!  Also, the performers were talking and giggling while performing which was very unprofessional.  The musicians on stage were also talking a lot!
The lady who sung the verses was also not good!
The show could do with more training for the performers and I suggest to get younger dancers and actors.  The performers playing Rama and Sita were clearly middle age!  The actor playing Rama had a big belly and was to believable as the dashing warrior who married Sita!
Over-all, I would not recommend this show.  For the price, I expected a much better production.

Asistí leyendo comentarios y por recomendaciones. Para conocer un poco el baile típico está bien. No vale la pena pagar VIP el teatro es chico y se ve bien casi de todos lados. 
Agarra los folletos de la entrada, hay en muchos idiomas y lee la historia antes de que empiece, la narración que proyecta esta descoordinada o solo en bahasa. 
El baile normal y música puede ser un tanto pesada.

Si cuentas con tiempo y dinero, lo recomendaría por la experiencia
This my first time to see the traditional dance, i just surprised that is very beautiful show. I can feel the atmosphere, feels like im going to the past years ago.jist amazing
Ballet is ok, but what I liked most is the music. Worth going and recommend a lower seat close to the stage.

期間限定の屋外ステージ。背景にはライトアップされたプランバナン寺院があるので一度見てみたいと思いちょうど、滞在中に公演日があるので行ってきました。
ステージ奥に浮かんでいる寺院がとても美しいのでおすすめです。
お話のすじはチケット窓口付近にリーフレットがあり日本語版もあったので詳しく知らない方でも楽しめると思います。公演前に出演者の方とゲート付近で一緒に写真を撮らせてもらえます。また公演後はステージにあがることができ出演者の方々と撮影する時間がありました。
ホテルへ帰る移動が心配でしたがホテルの車で送迎してもらいました。
タクシー利用の方だと乗っていったタクシーのドライバーさんに帰りも迎えに来てもらうように交渉しておけばよいと聞きました。

I'll admit I didn't completely understand this, but I still really enjoyed this traditional dance in a stunning setting.
Note that Lonely Planet's description of the scheduling is completely wrong! TA won't let me link to the actual schedule, but you can finding it using google - select the page run by borobudursunrise. The first two tables on that page show the schedule for the abridged version, which is what I saw. 
I wouldn't recommend seeing the full version (table 3) unless you really love this kind of dance (I enjoyed it but I wasn't wishing it was 6 hours longer!), but if you can't go when the abridged version is on try to go for just episode 3 of the full version which (judging by the 3rd half hour of the abridged version) is the most interesting part.
I had my driver book for me, more than a month in advance, VIP Class was already sold out so I had to sit in Special Class which was fine.

I guess we were spoiled by coming to see the Ramayana Ballet at Pramabanan twenty years ago.  Then, it was spectacular!  So very professional and intimate.  We were very taken aback by the 'improvements' to the site and the quality of the performance.  It is not longer a natural space, with the stage unobstructed and closer to the temple. That said, if you have not seen this before, it should not be missed.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: The setting for this, with the temple in background on a beautiful warm evening, made for a surreal atmosphere.  We were warned off going with our young kids as the dance can be quite slow moving (no twirling ballerinas here) at times, but our 4yr daughter who loves dance was enthralled from the start to the end (9yr son was asleep on our lap within minutes).

This dance performance is highly recommended to watch if you come to Yogyakarta. Just about half hour trip from Yogyakarta, you can visit Prambanan temple and the dance performance which located in the same area. The story is basically about true love based on Indian Ramayana. It involves lots of dancers with nice costume. You can read the story from the booklet or from the projector they showed during the show (it’s in English and Indonesia). We chose the VIP seat (cost around Aus$40) due to the seat as the non VIP seat will requires you to sit on the stone for around 2 hours. The temple in the background gives fantastic feeling as we enjoy this night performance. Please keep in mind that you only can get the outdoor performance during dry season, while for some other months the performance will be indoor during rain season (from November). Just browse this information and also to book ticket online by googling about Ramayana ballet prambanan. Personally I will recommend to watch this performance outdoor during full moon.

ショーとしてはとても面白く幻想的。ラーマヤナなどの歴史、宗教的知識教養があれば意味合いがもっと理解できたのにと後悔。
完成度高くお勧めです。
オープンなレストランも有り素晴らしいです。
Tempat keren, merupakan open theater dengan latar belakang Candi Prambanan yg eksotik. Ada juga open restaurant untuk makan malam yg nyaman..
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
the show: was great! i love every minute of it eventhough they were not that synchronised :P but still great!
the location : super easy to find, we wazed our way there, plenty of paid parking spaces.

We had just arrived in Jogja that morning and spent the afternoon at Prambanan, hence we were quite tired. However, the play was amazing and had some comedy intwined into it. It was easy to understand the storyline as they provided leaflets with descriptions of each act beforehand in multiple languages and also have a screen with a description of the events in the act during the play. The backdrop was of the lighted Prambanan temples and it was simply breathtaking!

The ramayana ballet in a must see event for tourists visiting Yogyakarta. The music and dancing portray a colorful story that keeps one captivated for more than 2 hours. And prambanan temple is beautifully lit up at night, making it a great backdrop for the performance. The food at the buffet restaurant is ok, not great. I recommend eating elsewhere before coming to see the show.
untuk pertama kali saya menonton sendra tari ramayana, sayang waktu itu arena pertunjukkan dalam masa perbaikan jadi kurang terlihat megah sesuai brosurnya.

What an experience to watch such talented performers with the backdrop of the illuminated Pramanban temples! The costumes were so elaborate nd a few of the dancers were beyond exceptional. Also ate the buffet before the show and it was worth the price to be able to try so many traditional foods and enjoy more of the views. Book the hotel shuttle before the show right at the ticket booth and get an easy, inexpensive ride home without having to worry about finding taxi or hiring a driver.

Brilliant – the adjective is insufficient!
An amazing performance / narration of Ramanyana, this you can’t get to see even in India. The performance were fantastic, the sets were fabulous… don’t miss the pat of Hanuman burning Lanka, WOW !!!

It was a very nice show. Nice vibrant colors, the story is written on the walls to be able to follow. I tried to purchase tickets online but couldn’t find any on the dates I wanted. Make sure to go in person to the actual show ( next to Prambanan temple but different entrance), you can buy tickets there. The best seats are the VIP special seats since they are in the front.

Les costumes sont magnifiques, la musique est agréable, le décor est somptueux.
Il est agrable de pouvoir prendre des photos avec les danseurs.
On aurait néanmoins apprécié un spectacle plsu court et une histoire moins complexe à suivre.

Dg penataan cahaya lampu, serta musik yg pas menjadikan tariannya indah, apalagi kt nonton rame2.
Untuk posisi yg bagus, ambil yg dr sisi depan panggung

It was a drag for 2 hrs. If the time duration was shorter, then it wud have been more entertaining. The dancers were quite good though & the storyline well projected. Seats were comfortable. We took the class 1 seats. They provide cushions at the entrance which u can carry n be seated on. We didnt do the dinner there so no comments on that. My kuds were very bored n we left after the half time.
We would have enjoyed it if the duration was 45-60 mins long.

Enjoy the traditional Ramayana ballet on the open stage of Prambanan Temple to become a destination which we should prioritize. artistic performances and performances with a variety of artistic creations make us enjoy it. Come and enjoy...

Gegessen haben wir in dem Restaurant direkt neben dem ballet. Buffet: Essen war nichts besonderes und dafür mit 145000IDR ziemlich teuer. Aber Kulisse des bestrahlten Tempels und Ambiente sehr schön. Scenen des Ballets werden auf screens gut erklärt, Darstellung mit feuershow und tollen Kostümen. Musik anfangs nervig später: tranceartiger Zustand ;)
Kann besuchen, muss man aber nicht.

Given that Prambanan temple shuts a couple of hours before the ballet begins, we made two trips to the temple. One in the morning to see the temple and for the history, and the second in the evening to see the ballet.

The show was really amazing. Traditional dance with incredible costumes really kept us entertained for the whole time. Useful projections gave occasional snippets of information to keep us up to date with the story.

Hanuman was brilliant and his part allowed for some comedy and touch of more modern dance/acrobatics which was especially appreciated by the school trip to our left.

I would recommend paying the extra for either 'Special' or 'VIP' seats for two reasons. One, the view. And two, comfort. Special seats come with a cushion (otherwise you will be sat on concrete), and VIP seats are essentially arm chairs.

There was a photo opportunity with certain members of the cast at the end of the show if that's your thing.

The Ramayana Ballet is set in a really lovely outdoor amphitheater with the gorgeous Prambanan Temple lit up as the backdrop.  The performance is always based on The Ramayana and is a dance theater mashup with a huge cast and lovely costumes.  You get to see a mix of classical dance and theatrical storytelling in one performance.  The form is newish but the movements and music are ancient classical forms.  It’s not at all the top professional performers (more like community theater) but still worth the visit.
Suggestion: choose 1st class tickets (not vip or special), seats just as good for much less.  See it in the full moon if you can when they do a more detailed four night version and pick one or two to see.

The story was mesmerizing and rendered all the more amazing by the fabulous backdrop that is Prambanan temple by night. Make sure you get a seat in the middle section and high to enjoy the pure magic of the backdrop. The story is entertaining and the ballet truly magnificent. Felt privileged to have seen it.

El ballet para alguien a quien no le gusten mucho las danzas tradicionales le puede resultar pesado, pero en la temporada seca el escenario de monta en el exterior y nada más que por estar admirando Prambanan iluminado por la noche merece la pena ir. Mejor en las filas más altas si quieres ver mejor el templo.
Go and watch this performance while in Yogyakarta. We went to the Prambanan temple and Ballet. Had no issues with buying ticket at the counter. Overall great experience.

Me and my partner really enjoyed that performance. The lighting stage is very good, and the talents are also very stunning.
Worth your money.

Magnifique ballet avec les temples en toiles de fond. Vivant et magnifiquement interprété le ballet permet de découvrir d'une manière ludique et esthétique l'histoire de Rama et Dira. Même les enfants s'y retrouvent pour peu qu'un adulte leur livre quelques clefsen traduisant les panneaux lumineux en anglais qui s'affichent périodiquement sur le côté de la scène et scandent le récit.

The ballet show was so great. Just with movement and dance of performers, I could understand what they want to say and convey. It was really worth to spend your time and money while traveling indonesia.

A wonderful experience all round. The show was beautiful with English storylines played on screens to the side so you knew what was happening. Although, the storyline was pretty clear. 

A must do.

Highly recommended

Spectacular performance

Not the usual indoor theatrical kind.  

Go earlier to walk around the candi prambanan and end up with this performance

It was such a good performance based on Indonesian legend, Ramayana. It was hels indoor, and not expensive for 2 hours show. Subsequently, I didn't take the dinner package though. Make sure to watch this when visiting Prambanan temple. It's worth.

Just amazing and definitely worth the price. The show started on time and staff is very welcoming.  However in between the ballet it started to rain. We all waited and soon they moved to indoor theatre and the show continued. Enjoyed it.

Nice, a bit boring in the first line of story but it turn to funny from middle until end. Ballet held with the Prambanan view as their background so it will give you nice vibes to enjoy the story. Their fire show in the end of story was awesome.
You can buy the ticket online. There is 1st class for Rp. 200.000, 2nd class for Rp. 125.000 and the VIP class for 400.000. Ramayana Ballet only held on weekend with different episode in each day.

After following all the good tripadvisor comments we ventured into the ballet, venue was quite tidy and clean, and Prambanan in the background was nice but when going to our seat we were given a 1 seat cushion because the rest of your seat is made of concrete( not very comfortable), this aside we were still optimistic! Sadly the show turned out to be what can only be described as an un-engaging, repititive dance, with dancers regularly out of sync. To put it bluntly: a local amateur theatre group could do better.

I booked "Khusus" seat 1 week previously then I paid in the day I watched the ballet for Rp300k per seat (i got free drink from coffee shop). Its such a great performance and when u visit yogya, u must watch this show (u wont regret it)! Start from 7.30 pm till 9.30 pm. I suggest to rent a car when u decide watch this ballet and have a tour around prambanan,candi boko, candi ijo and tebing breksi in the noon

The backdrop of Prambenan temple at night is spectacular. We enjoyed the story of Ramayana. It was made better because we'd been told the story when we visited the temple earlier in the day and had seen it portrayed in the carvings. The costumes were great and the dancers seemed excited. We were in the VIP section which looked to have much more comfortable seats than the rest of the auditorium.
This was a very good performance against the backdrop of Prambanan Temple.  It was helped by the story being shown in English on screens - helped to understand what was happening.

We went to see the 2nd part of the show.

Some sections are a little bit long and repetitive, but some parts are really fun to watch.

Expect acrobatics monkey, fire and more than 40 dancers + 15+ musicians.

very nice venue. not too big of a crowd. compare to the local tourist oriented venues, if you choose this one you will likely to get more comfortable seats & point of view of the stage. get the evening show ( after 5 pm ) as is more dramatic since they use live fire and stuffs. and again not too crowed usually.

if you don't have much time in bali and would like to skip long ticket queue line and traffic jams to see one in Uluwatu or tanah Lot or else, this is the place. more comfortable and intimate and kids & senior citizen friendly. 

note to the owner/organizer :improve your restrooms/toilets cleanliness! that's it

very good actors' performance. mandatory to stay until the end to see the fire dance. it's magical!

The show is absolutely excellent in terms of music, dance, culture, costume, art and theatre. The performers are wonderful! So talented and graceful. It was my first introduction to the Ramayana story and I was captivated throughout the show. I read the story in advance, it was easy to follow on stage but I’m still glad that I knew more about what was going on so that I could appreciate all the finer details. Definitely worth seeing! The Purawisata venue was very nice too, although avoid the overpriced bar - 70K IDR for a small beer!

Firstly I would like to address the issue of the length of the show. Yes it is long but such is Life. The "remote control" generation is way too easily bored as it has no patients to admire something that take far far more than 2 hrs. to prepare and maintain at the highest level of quality. This show has all those factors in it.

Second is the issue of knowing the story. This again is a none started if one is just a bit organized. Read ahead !!!!

I loved the performance. The athletic and artistic performance is on a very high level here. To do what is done in this show takes a lot of effort and patients. That was missed by many foreigners in our group that went to see this. The only things that came to many of their minds after the performance was "God it was so long.". Having practiced martial arts I could appreciate the artistry of the performers as their practice for this over the years must have been exhausting.

I say "Go and see it" as there is very little of this in our Western World.

I am sure most will not agree, but I think this ballet takes too long, nearly 2 hours, to tell the Ramayana story, and some people fall asleep while watching.

On the other hand, this is classic Javanese history, so actuelly a must see, and there is no better place than next to Prambanan, where the temples as backdrop are illuminated and give a fantastic decor.

If you go, suggest to combine with sunset at Prambanan, read other review, where you need only 1 hour. Few places to get some food outside either Prambanan or in front of Ramayana.

if you go and can afford it, book VIP upfront, about 25 euro, but these are the only seats that have normal chairs, all others is just sitting on stone ‘ chairs’ .

Performance by Ramayana Ballet at an open air theatre with the backdrop of the lighted Candi Prambanan. The dance tells the story of King Rama. Beautiful costumes, makeup and traditional dance moves. The side screen progressively displayed the storyline of the dance which was very helpful.
Udaahh dua kali sih nonton sendratari di tempat ini, tapi ga bosenin yakin 👌👌 dijamin gaa kecewa deh 😁

Set with the amazing temple in the background this is a beautiful experience. Worthwhile preparing for rain and taking something comfortable to sit on. I especially loved the monkeys who moved in such a realistic way. Criticisms of not knowing the story are unjustified - there are handouts and there is no reason not to read up on the culture and story beforehand. In fact it is the universal story, beautiful girl (princess) meets and marries handsome and talented prince. Complications happen and there is a separation and lots of fighting before a reunion at the end. The prince is not above burning his wife to death to prove she is pure...but she seems happy enough to overlook this. There should be a ban on phones and photographs in the audience. very distracting.

Great show, exciting and fun with a subtitled story so it’s ways to follow. Best way to do it seems to be to come for dinner next door and then wander over when the show starts. Can be a bit warm and the music was LOUD but a great time.

Too bad I was here on rainy season, so  the show was happened indoor. Not at the outdoor with the view of Prambanan Temples. Over all, I did enjoyed the show so much, the dancers, the musics, everything

If a vacation to Jogja, Ramayana ballet in Prambanan is a must visit tourist attractions. This attraction begins at night, and its place is in front of the Prambanan temple. This is a Wong puppet show that tells about Ramayana. The show is very beautiful and not boring because it shows the whole story well. Although the tickets are very expensive the show is not disappointed

Setiap kali ke jogja sdh pasti mampir ke sini... Ke Prambanan buat nntn sendratari ramayana...
Berkali kali nntn tapi gak pernah bosen buat nonton lagi dan nonton lagi....

Although they advertise Prambanan as the backdrop to pull people in, the ballet itself was a real treat. Surprisingly good production; set, dancing, lights and costumes made for very entertaining event. Definitely worth bringing kids and guests..
That was a good performance...great lighting..great view..great weather also..and were having dinner at Abhayagiri...nice resto and nice view tho

The show is the story about pandawa and kurawa. Better if you read the story first otherwise it would be a "boring" show. They dance beautifully.
Would be better if only the stage can be like broadway show.

The Ramayana depicts the Ram and Shinta. The show is very lively fast-paced and with live music. It will keep you entertained. I just wished it had English commentary, as the show is in Bahasa.There is an English pamphlet you can obtain with the story, this should make the show a bit more comprehensible
Pertunjukan mahal, mewah, megah. Kesini pas ada tugas dari kampus buat bikin report tentang pertunjukan ini. Untungnya dibiayai oleh prodi, jadi semakin terasa betapa bagusnya pertunjukan ini👍

This is a lost art that seems to draw only a little crowd. A shame really, as it can be quite a beautiful thing to see. The downside is that the storyline can be hard to keep track of. Still well worth a visit.

Great live performances of the epic Ramayana saga! The music, dance, drama, lighting and costumes were overall well combined and arranged professionally resulting an awesome show and memorable experience. The show lasts for 2 hours, divided into 2 sessions with 5-10 minutes break time. 
The entrance fee is different, depend on the seats position:
* in Trimurti Theater:
   - Class 2: IDR125K (160 seats available on the left and right side of the stage). 
   - Class 1: IDR200K (118 seats available on the left and right side of the stage's corner). 
   - Special: IDR300K (52 seats available right in front of the stage. Entitled to get free soft drink ). 
* in Open Amphitheater:
   - Class 2: IDR125K (668 seats available on the left and right side of the stage). 
   - Class 1: IDR200K (276 seats available on the left and right side of the stage's corner). 
   - Special: IDR300K (130 seats available in front of the stage, behind the VIP seats area. Entitled to get free soft drink). 
   - VIP: IDR400K (64 seats available right in front of the stage. Entitled to get free selected drink).
There are 2 theaters available at different close together location, used base on the ballet performances schedule:
* On January to April and November to December 2018, the show will be held at Trimurti Theater; indoor, smaller theater with 330 seats capacity. 
* On May to October 2018, the show will be held at Open Amphitheater; outdoor, open air theater with 1,118 seats capacity and Prambanan Temple as stage's background.
The 2018 Performances Day Schedule is enclosed for reference.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
meski sy mendapatkan show indoor namun performa dr para artis yg profesional sgt menghibur dan membuat cerita hdp.mgk utk beberapa efek api bs ditambahkan percikan efek lain agar lbh hidup.
regenerasi penari terlihat sekali dg keterlibatan penari berbagai usia..ikut bangga,krn dg begitu budaya kita akan py penerusnya.
saran :tulisan di layar mgkin agak di tengah.agar lbh terlihat.keterangan dilayar sebaiknya dlm bhsa indonesia dan inggris utk memudahkan wisatawan asing..
trmksh

We got good seats for IDR200K.
Though despite being in the very first row,, we found the english commentary blurrish.

Despite the fact the show runs on lots of international tourists, they had no english subtitles at all. The whole time the story line displayed on a side screen was in malay. Being an Indian myself and I understand Malay, it was easy for me to follow the play.

However, I pity those who have little knowledge of the entire story and do not understand Indonesian language. One would be lost...

Very nice costumes and beautiful casts. Hanuman was a tad too thin.

We saw people sleeping off 10mins into the show.

We lefr after 1 hour during the interval as it was just too boring by then.

All in all, it could have been better if the commentaries were clearer and the storyline was in English as well. My husband who is a non-Malay speaker barely knew what was going on.

The dancer performance is quite good and attractive. Me and family are enjoying the show. It is just misfortune for us that on the day of the performance it was raining so the show is in the theater building. If it is in the open stage that would be more pleasant.

The idea is good but many of the dancers 
were amateurs and the sound was distorted.
Costumes and scenery were beautiful and of course the site is memorable
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: An absolute must see if in Yogyakarta.  This show is a beautiful performance depicting the mythological love story between a princess and a knight who won the right to marry her.  Be sure to read the story before the show starts so you can understand what is happening throughout the performance.  Wonderful music, dancing and costumes.  Highly recommended !!  Note:  like most performances, the more money you pay for a seat, the better position your seat will be!

Pertunjukan kolosal yang apik sekali, dengan joke2 saat action terasa menyegarkan.
Tiada terasa epik ditonton sampai dengan selesai yang pinginnya terus berlanjut pertunjukannya.
This is was an amazing opportunity to see Ramayana History and outstanding characters perform by these lovely people.

Non perdetevi il balletto a yogiakarta! Gli attori fanno dei movimenti stranissimi e spettacolari, e lo spettacolo é simpatico e fatto davvero bene. C'è anche una didascalia proiettata a lato nel caso (probabile) che non capiate che diavolo sta succedendo! Adatto a tutte le fasce d'età. Imperdibile!!
Tempat ini betul2 baik utk mengenalkan dan memperdalam bydaya sendratari bagi putra putri dan keluarga kami.

Pertujukan sendratari ramayana sangat bagus, keren dengan latar belakang Candi prambanan yang sangat indah di sorot lampu. Pertunjukannya sangat memberikan pembelajaran kehidupan. Yang harus dibawa kesana adalah Jaket, Sepatu dan Minum karena pertujukannya disana dengan ruangan outdoor. Pertunjukannya berlangsung selama 2 jam.
Its a nice show but need an improvement on sound in English to be included during the dancing...to understand the storeyline better

Si vas al templo de Prambanan, tienes que quedarte a ver el show de ballet que se da a un costado del templo, aquí se te explica la historia del induismo, el mono blanco y los dioses que vivieron en esas tierras. La escenografía al aire libre con el templo de fondo y el show se unen en un solo contexto y espectáculo. Previo al espectáculo se encuentra el restorán que funciona de manera de bufete, es algo costoso, pero vale la pena comer y disfrutar de una bella vista del templo iluminado por la noche.
 
 Yo fui solo en un scooter que arrendé, quedo estacionado en la entrada del templo y no tuve ningún problema.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah
