Review Text: sudah lama berkeinginan melihat langsung sendratari Ramayana di candi Prambanan.akhirnya tercapai juga keinginan itu pada tg 2 desember 2017. pemesanan tiket lwt internet. dan kami sangat menikmati pertynjukan itu . sungguh apik sekali  walau  narasi ceritanya kurang jelas. sebaiknya tiap tampilan disertai ceritanya dg suara yg jelas .. bukan hanya di layar monitor yg singkat. .. mungkin bisa juga layar belakang dipadukan dg. jalan cerita. klu menceritakan kejadian di tengah hutan.. di layar belakang diberi gambar hutan. klu menceritakan suasana kraton , ya diberi gambar kraton. shg suasananya benar benar hidup. jadi perlu kolaborasi antara tradisional dg teknologi modern..  maaf.. itu hanya sedikit mAsukan. walau sederhana saya sebenarnya sangat bangga ada yg mau melestarikan budaya bangsa. salam rahayu wilujeng.
The art is so much. If you are the big fan of something traditional, it ia worth to visit. Try to adjust the date so you came not in rainy season and you come in the day when all episode performed.

The place has 4 different sections for seating, it goes without saying, higher the prices, better the seating and view. However you need not to worry about booking in advance as there is is plenty of seats in most sections.
The ballet is based on Ramayana, and is beautiful choreographed with Indonesian dace forms and gorgeous attires. The story-line was well paces and keeps the spectators engaged at all times. They give a short break in the mid, for rest room or a quick snake.
They also have a restaurant and bar, so in case you arrive early after wrapping up your Prambanan visit, you can relax and have something to eat before the show, they only serve buffet, but you may order some drinks if you like.
I would recommend, if the season & weather permits go for the outdoor auditorium, as it provides a grand view of pramabanan temple as the backdrop.
Very recommended activity for your jogja trip.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: My husband and I saw the Ramayana Ballet indoors since we came in December. I heard the outdoor play is way better but indoor was quite awesome! The only improvement I would say is during certain parts of the play, it seemed a bit dragged out (especially toward the end). But overall, It was an interesting experience to see this story depicted in Javanese play style. I would recommend visitors to definitely check out the play during your visit. It’s a must see!

Sendratari ramayana /ramayana Ballet ini jadi acara yang selalu ramai dan memukau pengunjungnya .. Totalitas pemain dan juga tata panggung yang apik bikin ga bosen meskipun tau alur ceritanya.. Yang bikin ga sangka itu pas adegan pembakaran alengka itu beneran banget .sampe kebakarannya nyata😁. Dan diakhir bisa foto sama pemain pemainnya...gabakal rugi sih nonton ini..

I was so looking forward to this ballet. What a disappointment. Saw a much better rendition in Ubud.

The costumes were impressive. Some of the special effects were terrific,especially the scene where Hanuman is burned at the stake. The story moved along slowly, there was a distinct lack of energy in the performance. Overall, fairly boring.

Prambanan temple is a great backdrop for the staging. However, due to stage lighting it was impossible to photograph the beautifully lite backdrop.

Get 'special' seats (IDR 300,000) otherwise, bring a cushion with you! All seats are concrete and hard on the butt even with a cushion. Admission price includes a small free drink at the snack stand during intermission.

There are show programs available in several languages. The English translation was quite stilted and hard to follow.

A dinner buffet is available before the performance go IDR 130,000.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: The stage is in front of Prambanan temple, so beautiful view at night.The performance is so amazing.
The show was held inside due to weather. so missed the light and sound effects. Story was a slightly adjusted version of the Ramayana I had known earlier.

Traditionele balletvoorstelling die het verhaal uitbeeld wat ook afgebeeld is op de Prambanan tempel. Zeker een mooie aanvulling op het bezoek aan de tempel en een leuke activiteit voor in de avond. In het regenseizoen verplaatsen ze de voorstelling van buiten (met Prambanan op de achtergrond) naar binnen. Even opletten dus als dit een dealbreaker voor kan zijn.

De voorstelling was helemaal uitverkocht. Op het moment dat ik er was, waren er ook twee middelbare scholen met een hele bups scholieren. Voor hen leek de voorstelling aan de lange kant (bijna 2 uur, met een pauze ertussen) waardoor de aandacht van het publiek leek te verslappen. Na de pauze kregen zij het niet meer voor elkaar om stil te zijn. Dat was een beetje jammer, maar ach, we zijn allemaal weleens puber geweest..

In the rainy season, the ballet is held indoors, allowing one to appreciate the inherent beauty and visual treat. The 2 hour long ballet choreographs many stories from the ancient Hindu Epic, Ramayana, into a riveting and wonderful dance and music performance. The costumes are rich and gorgeous, the dance mesmerizing and the story fresh as ever.

Outside the rainy season, the ballet is performed outdoors with the backlit Prambanan Temple as the backdrop-the most sensational stage for this wonderful dance drama.

If you are in Yogyakarta, make it a point to see the ballet.
One of the highlights of our visit. We loved everything about the show. The dance, the costumes and of course the majestic temple as a back drop.
Uitvoering zeer mooi, kwam zeker tot ze recht met de prachtige klanken van het orkest. Tip lees eerst even het verhaal, dan is het beter te volgen wat je te zien krijgt.
אמנם לא לטעם המערבי, אבל מעניין . לטעמי ארוך מדי. הסתכלתי על תנועות הידיים הגמישות ותהיתי באיזה גיל מתחילים להתאמן ...
Definitely worth it! And a very good point: they give you a paper that explain the story about what you’re about to see to make it easy to understand. And the performance is awesome.

I recently had the pleasure of attending this beautiful dance and I was enthralled- the costumes were stunning and I found the story behind this dance just wonderful, as was all the magnificent dancing. It was particularly helpful to have the plot translated into English shown on the walls by way of a projector, without which it would be very difficult to understand completely what was happening.  I was also delighted to see that the performers were of varying ages, one little boy only being about 6 or 7 years old. When it concluded, it was delightful to see all the performers joined together on stage to receive the very well deserved applause.

For those who are familiar with Ramayana story, shouldn't be a problem. But for those who don't, they can easily get lost. They provide synopsis of the story but it wasn't well communicated. If you don't look carefully around the entrance gate, you will not find it. 

The content of the written explanation during the show has 2 versions, english and bahasa. But sometime the english version doesn't match with the bahasa version or vice versa. 

Also there are some scenes that are not relevant to the whole story, e.g. when sarpakenaka came to rahwana and told him that her nose has been cut by some men.
Van de locatie, met de Prambanan tempel op de achtergrond, moet je het hier hebben. Het dansen is amateuristisch. De stenen banken in het openlucht theater een ramp.

Really love it! it reminds me when i was kid. This traditional dance with full property even the scene of burning The Alengka. You may enjoy some coffee during the show. Tip to enjoy this show, you really need to wear your glasses. Read the explanation every scene.

Amazing traditional Indonesian dance full of colour, drama with an amazing backdrop of the temples. For the best involvement, pay the extra and get a VIP seat, not expensive in US$ or AUD but you get a full on view of the temples and a far greater connection to the performance

Very good view with Prambanan Temple in the background. With the right period of the month, you will get the full moon behind too.

Long ballet performance with no dialogue, good to read up on the storyline before watching the ballet.

VIP seats are comfortable with individual sofa seat, it also comes with a free drink. As the whole performance is long, VIP ticket are worthy.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Very good Performance, amazing & good skill of dancing, based on the true Story, unique, perform @ Prambanan temple backgrpund & two thumbs up

Ini pertama kalinya saya menyaksikan pertunjukkan sendratari ramayana... 
Para penari menyajikan performance yang indah dan menghibur

We arrived at 6:30pm for an early dinner before the performance, very tasty wide ranging buffet 
The 90 minute performance flew by and was a delight to experience
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Presso il complesso dei templi di Prambanan ho potutto assistere ad uno spettacolo di danza in notturna del Ramayana Ballet, un gruppo di ballerini di Bali, nel quale è stata rappresentata l'eterna lotta tra il bene ed il male, ma illustrati con incomparabile bellezza e grazia dai ballerini. Una mirabile rappresentazione di musica e antica cultura del popolo indonesiano.Una sola parola: bellissimo.

At the Prambanan temples complex, I was able to attend a night-dance performance at Ramayana Ballet, a group of Bali dancers, in which the eternal struggle between good and evil was represented, but illustrated with incomparable beauty and grace from dancers. An amazing representation of music and ancient culture of the Indonesian people. One word only : Beautiful.

Ho avuto la possibilità di vedere lo spettacolo del Ramayana nella location più suggestiva in assoluto: all'aperto e con il tempio di Prambanan sullo sfondo.
L'anfiteatro è molto curato all'ingresso e caratteristico. Il personale è interamente vestito con abiti tradizionali. I bagno pulitissimi. Prima di entrare è possibile bere qualcosa e acquistare piccoli souvenir a tema. Il mio biglietto (acquistato in agenzia) comprendeva l'ingresso allo spettacolo, posto vip (davanti e centrale) e un drink. Lo spettacolo merita di essere visto in quanto molto curato negli abiti e nelle coreografie. Inoltre la location è davvero indimenticabile. Forse è un po' lungo e la prima parte molto lenta, ma ne vale comunque la pena. Alla fine dello spettacolo i ballerini restano a disposizione qualche minuto per le foto con il pubblico.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Die Aussicht bei der Show ist mit Abstand das Beste an dem Abend gewesen. 
Das Ballett an sich war sehr langweilig gemacht. Auch von den versprochenen 200 Tänzern haben wir nicht viel mitbekommen. 
Wir haben Tickets der Kategorie 3 gekauft und hätten und sehr geärgert dafür mehr Geld auszugeben. 
Die unglaublich gute Bewertung ist aus meiner Sicht nicht nachvollziehbar.

Au vu des avis nous nous sommes laissé tenter et avons pris des sièges en VIP. Concernant l'environnement rien a dire, les sièges VIP sont très confortable, le lieux à bcp de charme et le temple Prambanan en fond est magnifique.

En ce qui concerne le spectacle par contre, c'est spécial si l'on peut dire... De notre coté c'est surtout le côté répétitif des scènes, des danses et de la musique qui nous a ennuyé. Sans parler du jeu des danseurs que l'on a trouvé très moyen, pas de synchronisation, physiquement rien d'exceptionnel. Pour toutes ces raisons nous sommes partie au bout d'une heure.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Kaum nachvollziehbar, dass die Bewertung so gut ausgefallen ist. Wir sind extra aufgrund der Empfehlung hin gefahren und fanden weder Gefallen an der Musik noch an der kuriosen Inszenierung, die Kostüme und der Blick auf Prambanan im Hintergrund waren aber ganz nett. Es waren auch offensichtlich viele andere nicht begeistert, denn ungefähr die Hälfte der Zuschauer ist in der Pause gegangen. Für indonesische Verhältnisse sind die Tickets recht überteuert und auch die Sitze waren sehr unbequem.

Pengalaman menikmati sendra tari ramayana ini sudah lama saya nantikan terutama pertunjukkan dengan panggung terbuka. Pertunjukkan dimulai pukul 19.30 WIB dengan latar belakang candi prambanan dan disinari cahaya bulan purnama membuat suasana menjadi romantus. Tata cahaya dan tatakelola panggung yang sangat baik dan gerakan penari yang sangat luwes walau tanpa dialog penonton dapat di bawa ke alur cerita tersebut. Tersedia pula teks dalam bahasa Inggris dan bahasa Indonesia di dinding panggung. (Cerita tentang Rama yang menyelamatkan Shinta) yang di bantu oleh Hanoman. Saya sedang beruntung saat menyaksikan saat episode Hanuman Duta dimana ada adegan hanoman membakar alengka.. sungguh spektakuler. Membuat saya ingin mengagendakan ulang untuk menyaksikan sendratari ini dan bertepatan malam bulan purnama.
Penjualan tiket baru di buka jam 17.00 WIB dan pintu panggung di buka jam 18.00 WIB. Lokasi pertunjukkan dari arah jogja sebelum pintu masuk candi prambanan/(traficlight) belok kiri ikuti jalan tersebut.

Prachtige culturele ervaring, met traditionele dans en muziek. Het boy-meets-girl verhaal is even oppervlakkig als de meeste Europese opera's, maar dat maakt niet uit voor het visueel genot. Op beamers wordt het verhaal verteld, zodat je ongeveer begrijpt wat er gebeurt. Vip stoelen hebben meeste comfort en beste zicht, eerste rang ook prima zicht. Privé transport is te regelen vanaf 150K.

Makanannya enak, pemandangan background candi prambanan yang luar biasa indahnya mmbuat makan malam jadi semakin romantis. Pertunjukannya sangat bagus dan tersaji secara profesional dan bertaraf internasional. Tidak sia-sia datang ketempat ini...

La curiosité m'a fait acheter un billet pour ce ballet. J'ai choisi le billet VIP puisque c'est places ont des sièges avec coussins (les autres sont des banc en pierre). 
Plus de 200 artistes font partie du spectacle (orchestre et danseurs).
La qualité est hors pair, autant pour la danse, le gamelan, le décor et la mise en scène. 
Si vous ne devez que voir qu'un seul spectacle en Indonésie, optez pour celui ci. Pensez réserver a l'avance.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Saw this last week and liked it very much. The players are good, story gets displayed at the back in electronic display and the show is colourful/lively.
Just check the schedule before visiting, it's not everyday but almost alternate days in dry season.

Dit ballet is een aanrader voor liefhebbers van cultuur van Java. Het verhaal is vergelijkbaar met Romeo en Julia, maar wel met een goede afloop. de kostuums en de muziek zijn erg mooi. Wij hadden een goede plaats recht voor het podium (class 3 ticket) met een kussen. De lagere tickets hebben geen kussen en zitten twee uur op een betonnen rand.

Le spectacle est beau, cela ne fait aucun doute. Les costumes sont colorés, les scènes se succèdent, c'est assurément une belle entrée en matière dans la culture javanaise (Ramayana est repris dans quasiment toutes les formes artistiques de l'ile, il faut connaitres l'histoire!). Ca tourne bien, au point d'en être presque trop lisse...
Pour les non initiés comme moi, les quelques explications au cours du spectacle sont bienvenues, mais il faut avouer qu'on peut avoir du mal a suivre, particulierement sur la fin. 

Le spectacle dire un peu plus de 2h, étracte incluse.
Les sièges en classe 1 suffisent amplement, les places VIP sont un peu survendues...

A noter : il semblerait qu'il y ait un systeme de retour apres le spectacle a reserver sur place avant le spectacle pour 40000Rp. Ayant un package en agence, je n'ai pas testé, 
Ais c'est bon a sacoir pour ceux qui viendraient en transport en commun (ca parait tout a fait faisable).

We were able get tickets for Ramayana a day before our scheduled showing. The transaction is fast. Within an hour, someone delivered our tickets in our hotel (cash on delivery). Great, quick response!

The entrance of the production is a little bit far from the exit of Prambanan temples. I almost got lost but thankfully, a local accompanied me to the place an hour before the showing.

 There are stalls that sell coffee, teas, snacks, but if you really need a heavy meal, then better eat dinner before going to the place as there is only a buffet restaurant available  around the vicinity.

It rained before the production and we feared that the production will be cancelled (once it is cancelled due to weather, refund will be unavailable). It's a good thing that the rain stopped eventually.

Buses back to Yogyakarta center are unavailable after the show but Grab taxis are available after show. You may also avail the production's private shuttle service (a little bit pricier) before the show starts as booths close when the show starts.

The performance is great! Their local performance style is totally unique. The spectacles are awesome! I highly suggest that you
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: We lucked out when we went to see an evening performance of the Ramayana Ballet.  It happened to be an anniversary celebration so there were additional pre-show performances and entertainers.  We enjoyed a tasty buffet meal beforehand.  The highlight of the evening was seeing the beautiful costumes and performance, though if it was slightly shorter, I would have preferred it!  But maybe that's because we had an active day before we went!

This is a traditional ballet performance by the local artists to tell the story of the Epic Ramayana. This ballet is quite popular among locals especially school children (one of the gallery on our left was occupied by school children) and equally by the foreign tourists.
I would recommend the open air theater performance in the back drop of well lit Prambanan temple. one can buy the tickets online or through the travel agents. there are 4 types of tickets VIP, special class, first class and second class. VIP tickets have few seats right in the front of the performance and in the middle of the theater. there is a complimentary drink also. 
there are different stories on different days since Ramayana is a huge play and the schedule and the play is on their website. Some days have a complete concise story performance.
The best artist of the day was Hanuman, the monkey god and his jumps and twists & turns were fantastic and there was a huge round of applause from the crowd.  Other artists also performed well.There was a break for snacks, drinks and use of rest rooms in the middle and play was almost 2 hours. it was an evening well spent.  
One can combine Prambanan - Ratu Boko - Ramayan ballet at Prambanan on a single day and even Borobudur for sunrise on the same day, it looks hectic but can be done to save some dollars and if there is shortage of time.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Makan disini suasanya romantis,dengan pemandangan langsung candi prambanan yg indah sekali. Makanannya banyak variasinya dan menunya buffet dengan 110.000 bisa all u can eat.
Kebetulan wkt itu sy membawa grup 40 orang dan semua dr luar kota,jd pengalaman makan disini adalah pengalaman yg menyenangkan krn stlh itu kt bs lgsg menyaksikan pementasan tari rama shinta
I recommend you to visit this theater especially out door one. The traditional ballet is performed with the Prambanan temple as the background and it is fantastic.

Una rappresentazione en plein air del testo epico rappresentativo hindu e sullo sfondo, il Pranamban di notte. Un incanto! Un ritmo e uno stile di danza tradizionale che potrebbero risultare lenti, se non si conosce per niente la storia, soprattutto nella versione estesa di 2 ore. Per comprendere cosa accade in scena vale la pena prepararsi e leggere almeno una sintesi della storia (ne viene fornita una in loco).

Dans un cadre magnifique avec le temple de Prambanan pour fond, joli spectacle avec effets pyrotechniques ! N'hésitez pas à prendre les places VIP pour avoir un siège confortable et non pas un banc en pierre (le spectacle dire 2 heures).

Ini pengalaman kedua melihat sendratari ramayana, dan setiap kali saya selalu terpesona. Tarian dan cerita yang ditampilkan adalah kisah cinta Rama dan Sinta. Namun yang paling disayangkan adalah, teks terjemahan ke bahasa inggris yang ditampilkan di layar banyak kesalahan struktur dan grammar hingga merubah arti, dan penonton turis asing di sekitar saya menertawakan. Di luar itu, ini adalah pengalaman indah dan menarik.
The spectacle is average and price paid by locals is reasonable, but don't visit with the price for foreigners

The music, dancing, sets, props, and costumes are absolutely amazing. The stadium is pretty small so every seat provides excellent view of the stage. Unobtrusive written narration in English and Indonesian languages keeps you up to date with the story. Don't miss getting photographs with the characters before show and at intermission outside in the concessions area and on stage after the show.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Definitely worth to check out if you are in Jogja. All seating areas gives you equally good view although VIP seats are closer to the stage. 

However I find the show a bit lengthy. It is a 2 hours show and it starts at 7.30pm. Perhaps have dinner before you check out the show as there isnt much food stalls available there at the show. Unfortunately I was too hungry and had to left the show for food after an hour into the show.

We took the level below VIP and it didn't really matter much - The VIP is right in center so if you want clear views of the temples behind the dancers then VIP may help. Where we were sitting to the edges of the VIP seats we still had views of the illuminated temples and the dancers were still right in front of us. The show it self is great with so many dancers and wonderful costumes and music. we didn't have a projector or subtitles for some reason but had read up the sheets given before the show so knew what was happening. Some people though mid way had gotten bored and slept, so come only if you are really interested in culture and old dance forms. You can chose to pay for dinner which is before the show (buffet) or just for the dance.  Overall we enjoyed it - we'd seen the same story in Thailand and Cambodia but each place had its own way of portraying the story

nous avons été surpris des prix qui ne sont pas ceux annoncés dans le lonely planet, mais le spectacle vaut largement le détour, vous serez enfin au poil sur l'histoire de Ramayana, effets pyrotechniques et gymnastique, théâtre en plein air avec vue sur Prambanan

We came to see this last night and we were blown away by the ballet - the dancing and music were spectacular!! And with the setting it works beautifully.

The only trouble is getting back - as we didn't come with a bus and the taxi prices are expensive, so try sort something before

an excellent ballet with a majestic view of prambanan temple at the background filled with talented actors ... it's an open air teater and a bit chill , so make sure to have ur jacket together with u ... the front seating have a good view of the whole play ... it needs more prop as the teater looks empty if the actors does not use the space .. excellent usage of costume by the actors ... probably the play need to be more cheerful rather than a serious storyline ... the side projector about the play did not function as it should thru out the play , hard to understand what's going on ... overall , it was a good experience

Great story line, well executed dance choreography, and a nice outdoor setting if you're lucky. Strongly recommend you to see it around May since it's less rain. 
Middle seats also will give you better view.

I have been practicing these classical Javanese court dances in The Netherlands since I was a kid, so seeing the Ramayana ballet live was truly a dream coming true! The dances, the gamelan music and the Prambanan in the background made everything a super magical experience. I would recommend to get VIP tickets, as you are sitting on actual chairs instead of sitting on concrete/stone for 2 hours. The storyline can be a bit confusing so my advice is to read the brochure first before the ballet starts. For people who are interested in culture, history and art this is a must visit! If you don't really know what to expect look up some videos on Youtube to get an impression of what Javanese court dances look like. I really enjoyed the ballet and don't mind coming here back again!

There is plenty to do around Yogyakarta but Ramayana ballet stands out. Set in beautiful Prambanan temple after sunset, it is a magic experience. Do read the book before or after as it is going to enrich your experience.

The ballet is beautiful, and the temples in the backround are jaw-droping! It is a nice love story, but my advice is to keep track of the story (you get it on a brochure) so you could understand what's going on. They offer different seat tickets, but there is no need to spend more because the auditorium is small and all seats are good enough. The prices start with 125 thousand rupies, and there isn't a big difference in prices between Class 1,2, Special and VIP. I would reccomend for better view of the temples to get class 1 tickets at least, because the cheapest tickets are on the side of the stage (gives you the view of the stage but not the temples). Definetly a must go! Great cultural experience, beautiful open theatre. You dan buy drinks, suvenirs or snack in front.

Het is dat je het eigenlijk gezien moet hebben als je in jogjakarta bent, maar het is wel echt uitzitten. Het duurt ruim twee uur en het is niet echt duidelijk waar je naar zit te kijken. Je kan een a4tje lezen in je eigen taal met het verhaal erop, maar het is ingewikkeld met veel namen en gebeurtenissen die door elkaar heen lopen. Wij hadden plaatsen op de tweede rang, maar je kan beter iets meer betalen en vip plaatsen nemen. Stoelen zijn vele malen beter! Op de achtergrond de prambanan is erg mooi. Je kan een transport kopen voor 125.000 roepiah, wij hebben de lokale bus (1a) heen genomen voor 3500 roepiah en transport busje voor 40.000 terug ( de lokale bussen gaan dan niet meer).

Was in Jogja to see the Melbourne symphony orchestra. Simply WOW. Sitting back taking in the music and the breathtaking view of the temple- a feeling and experience to take in. The ballet was part incorporated into the music- I would do the play and any music there again. Breath taking and highly emotional experience.

El enclave es increíble con los templos iluminados al fondo, pero es lo único que merece la pena. 
Leí opiniones parecidas antes de llegar a Yogya, pero como era un plan típico, decidimos ir. 
Es una actuación aburrida y la danza es monotona y repetitiva. Decidimos irnos antes de que terminara, y no fuimos los únicos. 
Si te sobra tiempo y decides ir, puedes coger cualquier entrada porque es muy pequeño y se ve desde cualquier sitio bien. Las Vip no, y las segundas mejores tampoco.

Costumi fiabeschi in un luogo illuminato molto sapientemente, con un corpo di ballo mitico per grazia, bellezza. Musica molto lontana dalla nostra cultura occidentale, che a volte può risultare noiosa, ma che sicuramente completa lo spettacolo. La durata di quest'ultimo è di circa una ora e mezza. Poi foto di gruppo con le ballerine , molto gentili e sempre sorridenti . Biglietti di ingresso un po' troppo cari. Completa lo spettacolo una bellissima vista del vicino tempio illuminato, che lascia a bocca aperta.

I went to see the dance performance with friends.  The price you pay depends on the area of your seat assignment.  We had hoped to get seats in the middle, but they were sold out and ended up on one of the sides.  However, the whole area is not that large and I would say there really are no bad seats.  The floor stage is very large and the performance ranges over most of it.

One nice touch is that there are explanation pages available which detail the various parts of the story.  These are available in a number of European and Asian languages.

The performance area is covered from rain, but is open air so no air conditioning for those who don't like the heat.  There is an intermission and stall where you can buy drinks and a few souvenirs.

The costumes, makeup, live music, and dancing itself are all very interesting and impressive.  The show lasts a couple hours and it worth the price.  As an added bonus you can see the Prambanan temple lit up at night.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Assister à un tel spectacle dans un tel lieu est une chance à ne pas manquer. 
Les places "Spéciales" (juste derrière vip) sont très bien. 
Les sous-titres permettent de suivre l'histoire sans trop de problèmes.

Het ballet was super om te zien. De zit is wel aan de lange kant, dik twee uur. Doordat de muziek traditioneel is en de dans net zo, is het soms wat langdradig. Alsnog zeker de moeite waard om te bezoeken. Je hoeft beslist geen VIP of Special Class te boeken voor goed zicht. De eerste klas is prima en scheelt de helft van het geld. Zorg wel dat je ergens anders gegeten hebt want het dinerbuffet ter plaatsen is duur en niet erg lekker.

Hou je van cultuur? Ben je geinteresseerd in cultuur van andere landen? Dan is dit een echte aanrader voor jou. 

De dans verteld een eeuwenoude Javaanse legende uit het hindoetijdperk. De ligging van het theater, met de Prambanan tempel op de achtergrond is dan ook perfect. 

Organisatie en uitvoering vonden wij erg goed en professioneel. Wij hebben er een top-avond gehad.
Places VIP bien situées et sur des sièges plus confortables. Ne pas hésiter vue la longueur du spectacle.

Cita rasa internasional yang disuguhkan oleh bangsa Indonesia. Cukup memikat dan menakjubkan untuk ditonton. Tari tarian, permainan lampu, serta jalannya cerita membikin kita mengikuti dari awal hingga akhir.

A very nice performance with Indonesian ethnic and cultural story, love the story, the costumes, and the traditional music played. It was a little bit hard to watch the details of the performers since I got the back row seat. But overall it was a must watched show in Yogyakarta.

My partner and I took our 12 year old son to the Ramayana Ballet and were thrilled that we did. The open air theatre and Prambanan Temples as a backdrop are an idyllic setting. 

It's a simple and predictable story mad even easier to follow with subtitles announcing what's going on - though not too dumbed-down that the theatrics and emotion is lost. 

The first act did start to drag a bit but the second was better paced and Brough the show to its end within the two hour mark.  I recommend you spend a bit more for your ticket class to get padding for the stone seating.
Very nice ballet! Glad we had a piece of paper that had the story, because we wouldn't have picked it up :) I didnt have the photos on my phone so this is one on the screen of our camera, amazing!
Merupakan tempat dimana bisa melihat sendratari yang baik dikemas dengan sangat keren sehingga penonton dapat terkesima

The ballet is based on Ramayana an epic Hindu poem which has Rama trying to rescue his kidnapped wife Sita.  There are four classes of tickets for the Ramayana Ballet at Prambanan, they range from, VIP Tickets Rp 400,000 (red), Special Tickets Rp 300,000 (green), Class I Tickets Rp 200,000 (blue) and Class II Tickets Rp 125,000 (yellow).  We purchased our  tickets from our accommodation and there was no mark up on the ticket.

Before the performance started there was a slight drizzle of rain, so we were seated, given umbrellas and vinyl cushions for the wet concrete seats.  We sat there as the rain got heavier, then it eased off and people came out to sweep a copious amount of water off the stage, about half way through it started to pour and they gave up and left.  We eventually moved to shelter beneath a verandah near the ticket office with heaps of other people, it was a bit of a dogs breakfast, as no-one knew what was happening and it was 7.45pm and the ballet was due to start at 7.30pm.  Eventually everyone was seated undercover as it was still raining heavily.  These seats were pretty much the same seating arrangement as outside, which meant your more expensive ticket didn’t land you in the cheaper seats with the change of venue.  

The performance got underway at 8pm and was fantastic, incredibly colourful, the two ladies singing barely moved which was amazing, the women with their graceful movements were beautiful and there was even humour thrown in.  There was a small child who occasionally wasn’t sure where they should be and it was lovely watching the older children take the little tacker under their wing.  Garuda was our favourite character, who moved with such grace and agility.  Couldn’t quite figure peoples attitude to the performance, as the venue was full to begin with, however up to half an hour before the end of the ballet, the seats were at half capacity, as so many people had up and left during the performance.

Even if it rains and there is no Prambanan Temple as a backdrop, this wonderful Hindu epic is beautiful in itself and needs no embellishments, it more than carries itself.

The backdrop of Prambanan is the star here. The outdoor setting is sublime . The costumes are colourful and inventive , the dancers seemed a bit blasé at times but still worth seeing as it gives the Hindu myth life especially if visiting Prambanan the next day as it gives context to the fabulous stone carvings around Shiva's temple . The Javanese musicians add a dreamy ambience . All seats are good so don't worry if you don't want to pay for the VIP section 😀

Great and impressive traditional show with many dancers and but important to first read the story behind otherwise difficult to follow. 
A bit lengthy but stay, the last hour is the best

Well, to be just behind the prambanan temple its a lovely scene! A classic story that tells some of the javanese beautiful myths, I recommend to learn about the story before watching so its easier to follow. It did start rain while I watched which of course was a bit annoying.. Bring your umbrella

This ballet is beautiful and truly an experience you won't miss when in the Prambanan area. The basics of the story is explained on large screens next to the stage ... this help tremendously on the understanding. 

We had purchased VIP tickets which included the best seats (almost comfy armchairs) and dinner. 
I would recommend everybody to save their money. The food which is served before the ballet is by far the most tasteless we have had during our entire stay in Indonesia!!

Still ... don't miss the show.

we finally manage to watch the show during the school holiday.

we bought the second class tix, for 125kidr/pax. although the view is not ideal, but we, including my 8yo daughter, can enjoy the whole show.

it is located in the open air theater of prambanan temple, where we can enjoy stunning view of prambanan as the background during the show.

the place is nice, well prepared and well maintained. 

we watched the 'full version' show, which i suppose, more entertaining and compact.

please do check the schedule thoroughly and bring sweater or jacket since it can get quite cold and windy.

a must visit while you're in Jogja.

This is a beautiful ballet and definitely we recommend for children. Our toddler that did not know many words when we went still talks about the ballet and dancers, especially the monkeys! 
It is beautiful for everybody but a great chance for kids to enjoy a performance.

We went here after visiting Prambanan temples. Very interesting performance, music, dance. Story was easy to follow as the plot brochure are available for multi languages at the entrance, as well as displayed on the screens (left and right) by the beamers. Must-visit!

Definitely a must see to complete your Yogya / Temple trip. One of a kind in the world!
Read the big lines of Rama Shinta story first via internet in order to get a good context of this drama. The translation and summary provided are not so thorough.
Try to attend the outdoor version as it is more spectacular: the temples as real 3D background and fire attraction before the break. 
We bought 1st class ticket, good view and more economical but your back and butt can get sore after a while sitting on hard cement benches. 
Bring your own snack and drinks. They have a small place where you can buy it after the ticket check, the prices are rather high but not choking. Limited variety. 
Don't eat at the restaurant, ask your guide/driver to find nearby restaurant which is cheaper and has better quality.

Seen in June 2016 during our honeymoon. Maybe we were just tired from a day of traveling, but by the time we arrived at the ballet, I think we were a little disappointed by the overall show. It's visually stunning, but it won't excite you like other large-scale ballet productions.

Pros:
-Generous buffet dinner if you opt for it ahead of time
-Unbeatable setting (beautifully lit Prambanan temple in the background)
-Very affordable VIP seats (not that it was particularly crowded)
-Stunning costumes and interesting music

Cons:
-Very very very slow ballet. I'm sure it is in keeping with tradition and with the story itself, but it just felt like it needed a new director to cut down on length and repetitive dancing
-Again, it's just too long.

Overall, glad we saw it, but it is not a must-see activity while at Prambanan.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: It is indeed that the Ramayana in being played in Indonesia for the past 40years, It shows how the Hindu culture travelled from India to Indonesia, They pronounce SITA as SHINTA, however the ballet is worth watching.

Untuk seklas sendratari atau balet, Sendratari Prambanan salah satu tontonan wajib buat pecinta seni/ sejarah. Basically, performance ini ya tarian, bukan teater. So, dont expect a high tense scene or another theater stuff. Background prambanannya sih juara banget.
Found an alternative to watch Ramayana ballet with city pick up included. Show was narrated well with synopsis handed out, hence easy to follow. Thoroughly enjoyed the 1.5 hour show.

It was a great performance of ancient Epic Ramayanaya (Hindu prehistorical story). All performances were well trained for theire acts. Every day evening show near the Paranbaran temple. Its so worth to see this 2 hour show and enjoy the best Ballet performing skills of these young performances.
Berlokasi di candi Prambanan. waktu itu kesini bareng keluarga. seru. banyak bule juga yang nonton..

The well-known story of Rama and Shinta which you can also find carved in stone at Prambanan temple. That same temple was supposed to be the background of the ballet but due to rain we had to move inside. The ballet itself is wonderful; from the colorful clothing to the masks and expressions of the dansers , it all contributes to a wonderful experience.

Great open air performance, especially the short but spectacular second half after the interval. I upgraded my ticket to VIP, and it was worth it for the comfy seat and view. Don't bother with the rather expensive tours from Yogyakarta. The site is easy to reach by public bus, and you can easily book a reasonably priced shared car back to your hotel at the venue itself.

I along with my wife and two children aged 9 and 12 years had the opportunity to be able to view the Ramayana Ballet at Prambanan. It was on  Tuesday evening after our afternoon visit to the Prambanan Temple. We commenced our tour in the afternoon from our hotel in Yogyakarta. Initially visited Prambanan, then the sunset tour followed on by the Ramayana Ballet. 

The Ramayana Ballet tickets can be purchased on site or booked through your travel agent. I would suggest that you book through your travel agent so that you are ensured of a ticket. We were fortunate to get the tickets for the Ballet on the spot itself. As it was the month of April, the Ramayana Ballet was still being conducted at the indoor Trimurthi theater. The Theater is quite comfortable and gives excellent views from all the seats.

The Ballet itself is spectacularly done with the explanations being flashed in English on the large TV screens placed on the sides. The show lasts around 90 minutes, is colorful and with some variations manages to stick to the original Ramayana tale. For my children, it was a wonderful opportunity to become familiar with this classic story reflecting upon Hindu culture and heritage. 

If you are visiting Yogyakarta, do make space and time for the Ramayana Ballet at Prambanan.

O show vale muito a pena, é lindo! Nao demos sorte com o tempo, comecou a chover minutos antes. O show atrasou e acabou acontecendo na area interna. É bom ler o folheto q vc pode pegar na entrada, contando a história do Ramayana. 
Nao tinha visto muitas informacoes antes de ir sobre a opcao do jantar, mas resolvemos arriscar e foi muito bom! Nada extraordinário, mas um buffet com boas opcoes de comida. Um pouco mais caro do q a media de comida local mas valeu a pena.

Although I wasn't a fan of the storyline, one can enjoy this cultural performance for its artistic dance, music, glittering costumes, and props - all nicely performed against the backdrop of Prambanan Temples, a world heritage site. It's cheaper and easier to go for this by prebooking a ticket with an agent; and the ticket offers a drink which you can get either at the beginning or during intermission.

We really loved seeing the ramayana performed here. The costumes were amazing and you can have photos with the cast at the break. Views to the Prambanan are stunning from here. We were there in the rainy season season do the show was inside, but you could still go outside to view the Prambanan.

A most interesting ballet performance of about 2 hours enacting the Ramayana epic. Arrows fly here and there, with one aimed at the audience - beware if you are in the VIP seats in the centre. Live music (gamelan, drums, strings) and sung accompaniment; spectacular costumes and makeup. Side-titles in English and Bahasa so that you can follow along as the dialogue is in Sanskrit.
プランバナン寺院群の西側にあるシアター＆レストランです。オープンエアの劇場で、ラーマーヤーナを観劇することができます。ラーマーヤーナはインドネシア語で演じられますが舞台の横の電光掲示板に字幕が表示されるので話の内容はおおむね理解できます。ハヌマーンが街を焼き払うシーンは迫力があります。

The story, presentation and energy in this performance was breathtaking.
Highly recommend this.
The seating is good but I would suggest taking a cushion.
Show is quite long, so be sure to research the story before you go. Open air experience and quite different from most  things you encounter.Cultural, complex

I have not been to Siem Reap or Bali yet but I do not think anywhere they do something of this sort to present the story of Ramayana. The locals say that there are no more Hindus in Jogja but whatever the reality be, the group of people who perform and conduct Ramayana ballet at Prambanan are really devoted and passionate people and their effort is worth all the praise. Visitors may say that the story is short or bit amended but truly, how could one think of enacting entire Ramayana in 70 minutes. What is more important is that through amalgamated culture of ancient Jogja port town where Hindus would have landed ages ago, they have derived this unique art form whereby they play local instruments and practice a very typical south-east Asian dance style to present the story of Rama and Sinta, as they say. The act uses some of the most amazing props of Hanuman, great fireworks and mesmerizing performance by very young children.
The show starts after 7. The ticket could be booked online in advance or through your hotel or directly at the venue. When I was booking the tickets the schedule was for indoor performance but on the day of the event it was actually outdoors with lit-Prambanan temple in the background. That made the entire show extra magnificent. There are tea, coffee, soft drink and accessories/tees stall inside the venue and just near the ticket counter there is a restaurant which offers only buffet and beer at bit high price and limited menu. Since the location is far, please consider arranging your commuting options after the show by yourself.

Outstanding performance. Very classical. The traditional music a.k.a. karawitan added the ethnique feeling into it. And the story is inspiring and touching. The dancers also really talented that even the men who dominates the dancers are so smooth.
What a experience, live with life ... expressions. emotions and magical movements. The story though shortly told ...but connects everything. The memory will remain for long time.

A high recommendation when in Jogja. In April this performance is in indoors and not with Prambanan temple as backdrop due to possibilities of rains but nothing felt missing. Arists use traditional music and dance for enacting the epic Hindu tale of Ramayana. The costumes, music, dance, lighting everything was unique and fantastic. The VIP tickets are somewhat steep at 400,000 IDR but there is not much difference between the VIP and the Special one at 300k IDR, when it comes to view.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: The dancers had a 5-star dance technic and combined with the full moon and Prambanan Temple at night as background. There was also special effects used (fire, big Hanoman statue). I watched them on the open air (May to October/November; you could ask the schedule written on brochure in Prambanan Temple enterance ticket box), thus the experience might be different compared with those in theatre. Prepare yourself by reading the story in wikipedia before the show.

The 2 hour show close to Prambanan Temple is a must see show. The Ramayan has been narrated in a Dance/Ballet form. 

If you get here early, you can also have dinner at the venue.

Combine the tour of the Prambanam temple with the Ramayana ballet (both are right next to each other; a 5 min drive, though a stone's throw away). in some months, it is performed outdoor with the Prambanam temple in the backdrop and that would be spectacular. even indoors, it was fascinating. as an Indian Hindu, i found the Indonesian interpretation of the Ramayana quite close to ours and while the names are spelt differently, the essence is protected.  very well performed, my kids found it a very engaging experience and a good primer to Ramayana itself. 

one tip is that if you want it indoors, carry a fan. it does get a little stuffy inside the theatre.

My wife, our toddler and I was visiting Ramayana Ballet at our last holiday to Jogjakarta. This show is a must visit, one of the traditional dance/opera with the epic Ramayana folkstory. 

We've been told that there's 2 theaters, one indoor and one outdoor, and the outdoor one have Candi Prambanan as the background, but the weather was not good so we're watching the show indoors. 

Since the actors /actresses wearing bright/colorful clothes, my toddler enjoyed seeing the show (it is suitable for kids i think). The seats are comfortable enough and the toilets was decently clean. 

The show itself was very entertaining, and the music is, like most of the Javanese music : hauntingly beautiful.
Proud to see Ramayana epic performed with such beautiful well prepared performers. The epic last for 4 hours with a break in the middle.

Booked a ticket that comes together with a buffet dinner. A sumptuous spread of local food with an awesome presentation.

A very interesting play about the ancient times & history of love story of Ramayana & Santi.  

To top if off, there is a two way transfer if you book the package ticket(incld dinner), unsure if you get just the ticket, there is a transfer included.
The story of Ramayana performed by professional dancers. It's a good show and it is a must to watch this show.

일단 언어때매 내용도 모르겠고 티켓 가격도 비싼편
비오면 우산 주는데 앞사람때매 안보이고 같이간 외국인 친구들도 큰 만족 못했어요

I booked the seat before I start my tour to Sambisari temple. Unfortunately, I didn't get VIP seat (in center). I got seat  in side almost in corner.  I learned that one can book ticket by phone or by email to get better seat. However the seat was not much of disadvantage as actors were taking care of all audience.   The story got English subtitles for tourist to understand the storyline. Being Indian knew the story and could find it differs from original story line. Since it is not based on the books we have read but their understanding of the carvings of the Perambanan temple, changes can be due to different interpretation. 

I enjoyed the show Ramayana ballet style full of life and sound and grace.

Absolutely wonderful. Must-do experience if one visits Yogjakarta. The temple itself is lovely with some great architecture. The whole area around the temple and performance area is very tastefully done up and well-maintained.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Sebagai pecinta wayang, teater ini sungguh memuaskan. Ada unsur tari, ada unsur teater ada unsur wayang wong. Terpadu sangat Apik. Siapa saja dapat menikmat dan mengerti alur ceritanya. Ada dua panggung, teater besar di halaman candi prambanan, terbuka, dan panggung kecil dalam ruangan, yang letaknya dipisahkan oleh sungai
The sendratari told a story of Ramayana. We can watch the sendratari with Prambanan view only on July-December

The only one theater that we can see classical Javanese styles Ramayana ballet in city center of Jogyakarta. They have been performed for more than 26 years continuously everyday, they also provides a package which including dinner, very recommended while visiting Jogyakarta

Petits conseils : si vous êtes intéressé par ce spectacle prenez un pack bus (pickup à votre hôtel) + spectacle. C'est sympa à voir sur quand il se fait en extérieur avec en arrière plan le fameux temple. À voir si vous êtes sur Yogyakarta

Jika sudah beberapa Kali ke yogya coba deh ke tempat ini. Sekitar 20 menit jalan darat ke prambanan. Lokasi dr yogya sebelum candi belok kekiri. Makan buffet dengan pemandangan Candi prambanan. Gak mahal kok. Very romantic! Stl itu menyaksikan wayang orang dengan lakon Ramayana. Tamu Asing pasti suka. Sesuatu banget..

Beneran asik nonton sendratari begini. Malem2 pula makin nambah kesakralan tariannya. Liburan kental budaya. Sebelum masuk juga dikasih info penjelasan mengenai cerita ramayana dalam berbagai bahasa. Pengen nonton lagi. Nagih
before the show i enjoy the dinner and performance. love the food and performance. the story and a dancer is very talented and i really enjoy it

It was interesting to see the Indonesian interpretation of Ramayana performed by talented artists. It was artistic and graceful show of dance, light and sound. The open air theatre under the starry sky was worth it.
雖然沒有很了解這個內容, 但是有部分字幕說明演到哪裡了, 算是個文化體驗摟, 那個印尼傳統敲擊樂音還滿洗腦的, 其實我覺得少了這個敲擊樂的話這部演出會失色不少

+
worth the price. i booked the best seat and it was great! i get home with some souvenir too.
the dancers were very good. 
prambanan temple as a background view complete the experience.

-
you should come here with your own car/motorbike. public transport in this area was a bit difficult to find after the show.

Ramayana ballet style full of life and sound and grace..

There might be a few creative interpretations of the story since it is not based on the books we have read but their understanding of the carvings of the Perambanan temple
Sangat menarik untuk di tonton pada malam hari, dengan tatakelola panggung yang baik dan petugas yang ramah dan pemain yang ramah pokoknya is the best 👌👌👌👍👍👍
Was told we would be asleep after 30 minutes but we thoroughly enjoyed the dancing. All seats have a good view so little need for paying the VIP prices
在參觀普蘭巴蘭前最好先閱讀一些與爪哇文化相關的一些書籍 要不然在演出時部分內容並不是很好理解 時間約為2小時 令人難忘 但是由於天氣的緣故 經常會由室外改為室內。

I booked the seat before i went there. I got the first row seat for first class.. email for reservation to get better seat. The story got English subtitles for tourist to understand the storyline. I enjoyed the show very much

Wisata budaya yang sudah jarang kita tonton, yaitu sendratari Ramayana. Apalagi bagi saya yang jauh dari komunitas Jawa. Selain itu juga saat ini siaran televise sudah sangat jarang menampilkan kisah-kisah pewayangan sebagai budaya asli bangsa Indonesia khususnya budaya Jawa. Sempatkanlah untuk mampir ke Candi Prambanan dan menikmati tontonan yang penuh filosofi serta sangat menghibur.

With regards to which tickets you should buy. I would recommend first or second class. When we were there (low season) the place was packed, including some people without seats. You can book tickets in advance at the tourist information center. Book early and you can get front row seats.

I recommend you read up on the story. Find something with at least five full paragraphs to get a bit of the details. During the show text is displayed on the sides to indicate which scene or subscene is being performed, but it helps to know the overall plot in advance.

The location (we were indoors, rainy season) is nice. There was a whole army of dancers, including children who I thought danced well and disciplined. You can take pictures with the dancers after the show.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: ketika saya pertama kali melihat ini saya kurang mengerti akan bahasanya..akan tetapi pada akhirnya saya menikmati sekali pertunjukkan ini karena visualisasinya sangat bagus dan para pemainnya sangat luwes membawakan peran-perannya..sangat mendidik dan menghibur..

I am a big fan of Musicals and Ballets and I make it a point to visit them in every city. Most of the times the performances blew me away but that wasn't the case with this one in Jogja 

The performances were below par the actors didn't have much eye contact with audience. The main protagonists Rama and Sita were badly cast and very poor actors. The only saving grace was the ravana Character . 

Overall I would say if you're aware of Ramayana avoid this show. It's average in my opinion

Thanks to staff of the ballet office for booking the ticket just by email request. It is the best representation of jawanies culture and tradition. Light and sound effects were great and so as story telling . Play is not every night so check website and plan your visit accordingly.

Tour guide picked up at hotel and hurried to site, where we had to wait for over an hour. Beautiful backdrop of Prambanan Temple, well worth experiencing. Dancers excellent but story a bit complicated (writen brochure too much and prompter screen highlights during performance too little). Performance a bit long. Can interact with dancers at intermission and at end. Staff very polite and helpful.

The ballet itself is nice but the prompter screen and the leaflet available in the front corridor (which is not easy to spot the first time you got there) gives too little information (with really bad english as well). I myself is familiar with the story so I can enjoy this ballet but my friends seems bored and I have to explain lots of things to them. I even see some foreigners (I'm Indonesian) having difficulties enjoying this ballet (1 even falls asleep). It's a shame, I myself enjoyed it very much. The staffs seems to be oblivious about the problem and looks satisfied with their performance. If you want to watch this please do yourself a favor and read the full story on internet first. u can also read about the five pandawas if you want to better understand the culture and story. I'm more than willing to help improving the quality of the English commentaries in both the prompter and the leaflet. It would be nice if the management can print a thin brochure with the full story and lend it to audiences (to be given back after the show) so that they can have better experiences.

sebagai warga Indonesia, saya bangga banget punya atraksi tradisional seperti ini. pertunjukan tari spektakuler dengan tata cahaya yang bagus. Suasana romantis sangat terasa dengan suasana yang terkesan mistis elegan. bagus banget

The Ramayana Ballet showcases and reflects the rich culture, arts and heritage of Indonesia. The artist played it well in their colorful traditional costumes in the tune of live music and Pramabanan Temple as the background. 

Originally, the ballet was scheduled in the indoor theater but for whatever reason it proceed on the open theater. Unfortunately, it rained and the show has to stop for few minutes and we have to transfer to the indoor theater to continue the ballet. I suggest you book your tickets early on the venue as most of the students from nearby schools are required to watch the show. No need to buy the VIP tickets as every seat is good enough. You may want to consider the seats on the corner of the theater if you are on a budget. This is also one of the best spot yet affordable.

It would be also good if you knowledge on the play or at least have read the story before. They are also providing written plot of the story for your reference. Some of the artists will also welcome you before the play starts, so don't forget to have your picture taken with them ;-)

It's a beautiful show done by tallented dancers about Rama and Shinta, an excerpt taken from Mahabharata story. The story itself is about romance between Rama and Shinta and the quest of finding Shinta after having been abducted by Rahwana.
The show isn't performed daily, as it was scheduled based on the fullmoon timing, I guess. So better check the schedule first beforehand. 
The ambiance of having open-air musical, with the grand temple Prambanan at the background, under the fullmoon waaaaas amaaazing. The dancers themselves are the kind of artist that can give audience goosebumps on how they express the story through their body. My favorites were Rahwana (the vilain) and Hanoman (the white sacred monkey). They dance all the time, even only during what it seemed to be walking. No dialogues. But no worries, if you are not familiar with the story there is subtitles, both in Indonesian and English, to help audience understanding what's going on.
According to my experience it'd be best if you come to Prambanan temple first before sunset, watch the sunset at the temple, have dinner at the restaurant next to the gate of ballet stage entrance (I forgot the name), and end your day warching the show. The show itself started at around 8pm. Why I suggest you to prepare enough time to watch sunset at the temple before coming to ballet show, because the gate to temple is different from the ballet entrance gate, they quite far apart. And you should try eating at the restaurant I mentiones earlier. Only for 100 thousand Rupiah, you can have nice tasty buffet (complete and varipus kind of apetizer to dessert) with Prambanan temple view. And if it's not peak season, the restaurant is less crowded too.
If you want to save more money, you can take transjogja (a shuttle bus) from downtown of Jogjakarta to Prambanan bus stop. And from the bus stop you can walk or take ojek (a motorbike ride). The transjogja route is quite confusing. So you better ask the officer which route you should take to be able to go to Prambanan.
And if you plan to go back to downtown of Jogjakarta after watching, they provide a shuttle service, SUV car, airconditioned, that is ready to drop you in front of your hotel. Just ask for that service in ticket booth.
Seeing the Ramayana ballet with the backdrop of the Prambanan temple was a very memorable experience.  The performance itself was very entertaining.

During their dry seasons, there are outdoor performances with Prambanan Temple as its back drop, but we were watched the performance in their indoor theatre, as it was rainy season.
Overall an enjoyable experience anyway. Don't worry if you're not familiar with the Rama and Sita story, they provide brochures (available in different languages) which gives a short summary of the scenes, and there are also subtitles as they perform.
Just a note, it's not 'ballet' as what some people may understand it to be, but a dance performance. It was really interesting as they merged Javanese dance movements while telling the story of this Hindu legend.
Can easily get there by bike and an offline google map, if you don't want to hire a car; or at the end of the day after visiting Prambanan or Ratu Boko.
Something relaxing to do in the evening. Recommended for those who love story-telling through dance art!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Nice show.. excellent for culture loving people. It's a professional show with a few good artists. Audience will be attracted surely . It has been designed for both Asian and non-Asian visitors .

There are many such shows but thus was recommended. It was nice to see the temples in the background. Having seen many Indian classical dance dramas, this was a bit slow for us. The costume and the setting was good. We also had the buffet more for convenience snd the food was ok. For those who have not seen such dance programs, it will be a feast for the eyes. I wish it was a little faster.
I love ramayana ballet because the story. The story is about rama and shinta, how they get married, how they met each other and rama's effort to get shinta.

We had bought tickets to see the Ramayana ballet and were not 100% sure what to expect from it. We opted for the second tier seats at IDR 275,000 per person, which included a drink and padded seats (which are much needed). The ballet told a snippet of the story of Rama and Sita (from the Hindu religion) through dance. For those not familiar with the story a leaflet was handed out to explain what was happening – but we were all so enchanted by the dance itself there was no time to read. The production was phenomenally put together, and not only were the dancers incredibly talented (Hanuman was AMAZING) but the scenes were so well thought out – especially one particular one with the fire. This may have been the one and only time in the trip that collectively we all fell silent and watched the show intently.

The classic tale of Ramayana has always been difficult for me to remember due to the large amount of characters and sub-plots. But after watching this performance at the indoor theatre, I feel like I'd remember it for life! Very beautifully performed; they've got the costumes and make up wonderfully made. Most of the audience were locals when I watched it; so it could get quite loud at times with the catcalls and constant chattering amongst themselves. And if you happened to get the VIP seats like I did, get ready for the thousands of moths flying around you due to the stage lights. And be very fast to get out of your seats to take a picture with the lovely cast at the end of the performance because once everyone is up from their seats the whole stage area gets very messy.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
I havent seen any Ramayana show like this before. The spectacular lighting you could see the Prambanan Temple behind the set. A great scenery!very priceless view. Even my 7 years old daughter stunned by this show and keep on watching till the end.

Don't forget to bring the storysheet on the entrance to read, available in many languages. Must go if you're in Yogyakarta!

It's a little bit pricey compared to other attraction around Yogyakarta, about USD 10 TO 25, but you will get some of the best attraction. Dancers, singers, musicians, little bit acrobat, nice costume. Try to have the outdoor show, because they'll use the beautiful Prambanan Temple as part of the backdrop, check their schedule first before you visit. You can even  order online for the tickets. There also a restaurant where served Indonesian traditional and international buffet for around USD 10. Smaller children might get bored though.. :)..
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Sendratari Ramayana pertunjukan traditional yang elegan, menghibur Dan mendidik, peneran ya sangat professional, tempat ya version Dan rapi, lighting super joss
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Kerennn pokoknyaaa,  kalo yang dulu udah pernah baca cerita nya pasti paham. Dulu saya kesini sempat hujan,jadi kepotong dan sendratari ini tidak setiap hari ada sepertinya , pokoknya harus liat kalo ke jogja. Hihi

Spectacle animé, en arrière plan le temple de prambanan illuminé.
Par contre il est vrai que le spectacle est un peu long.
Sangat berkesan dengan pertunjukan spektakuler...dengan tata cahaya yang bagus...dan sangat cocok ditonton berdua dengan pasangan dibawah cahaya bulan...

The Ramayana Ballet was held on open air theatre in Prambanan Temple. We arrived at the car parking lot around 6 pm, still have plenty of time to have a family dinner at Shinta Garden Restaurant. While we were waiting for the meal service, we took several family pictures around the resto and theatre entrance. With natural lights from the sunset sky, we got some nice pictures. We entered the theathre at 7.15, about 15 minutes before the show starts. We got left wing seats at the amphitheatre. From where we sat, we had clear view of the stage. The show started on time. During the show, a full moon appeared at the back of the stage, giving a beautiful silhoutte of Prambanan Temple. We got a full episode of the Ramayana story. It was beautifully played, and our daughters was delighted and talking about the shows all the way back to Jogjakarta. We would recommend couples to experience this romantic open air show. You would not regret it.

A must seen, at least once in lifetime, or you would regret it, hehhe.. But make sure you know the plot of the story before watching, because there's some different plot from different story version.. 😊

A great  show, talented artist, great sound and lighting effect make Ramayana Ballet is a must-watch show. It is an outdoor attraction, so get prepared for cold air at night.

They provide resume of the story plot in several language: Enlglish, Japan, Spanish, and many more. There is also subtitle on two big screen in English and Indonesian, for they performed the show in Javanese.

All of the audiences can take a picture with the artists on stage at the and of the show. You can get the ticket on the spot, but on high season, it's better to book in advance.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This is a must see show. Using the Prambanan temple as background for the stage, it is simply a very beautiful dance show. Don't worry if you don't know the story of it, because every scene is explained very clearly on 2 large TV screen. Because of the high demand, booking in advanced is recommended.

On our first night in yogyakarta we went to the Ramayana Ballet. During our traintrip from Jakarta (8 hours, executive class), we planned our route and must do's/sees in and around yogya. I found this balletshow and suggested to go there. A lot of enthousiastic en positive feedback about the ballet show on the internet.

The website linked us to the site of the Ramayana Ballet, but when we ordered tickets we were linked to the website 'Eventbride' and it showed us two different types of tickets:
1. Show only
2. Dinner and show
We had to pay via Paypal, debit or creditcard. In total we paid $70 for the tickets, $35 per person. This was for dinner and the show. (In euros €68,25)

When we arrived at the location (you see a big sign nearby so you can easily find it using google maps at first) we found out we paid a lot more than necessary. In December the shows are not fully booked, so no need to make early reservations. If you want to be sure you have a spot, ask the local people of the hotel/homestay to make a call for you, to reserve tickets. You can pay at the Ballet then. Without dinner you pay around 70.000 IRD, including dinner around 200.000 IRD. It depends on the season, but it will be around those amounts. 

Dinner started at 7, it was a buffet. Delicious food, a lot of choice! Drinks were not included, you had to pay extra for it. Beer is the most expensive, almost €5. If you like sodas.. I ordered Fanta and expected "the Dutch" Fanta Orange. Instead i got a red Fanta, way too sweet, tasted like gummyballs. So do not expect the normal Fanta. 

Friendly people, not everyone speaks English but enough staff that does and can help you out. During diner they play live traditional music, a beautiful ballet dancer showed up to dance for us.

The ballet show started at 8. We walked into a beautiful theater and had great seats in the middle with a nice view. We got the story on paper, in English. In this way we could follow it as well, without speaking/understanding indonesian. The show lasted for 1,5 hour.

We aren't real ballet lovers and After 1 hour, we lost a bit of our concentration. But it really is traditional en cultural and we really recommend to see this show. It is impressive and all the ballet dancers wear beatiful traditional customes and masks. A must see at Prambanan, Yogyakarta!
Estava chovendo e foi incrível assistir o espetáculo sob a chuva. Bem feito e muito bonito, recomendo!

We went to this show the night before we left beautiful Yogyakarta and I don't think there was a better way to end of our trip, than going for this wonderful performance. Even the male dancers were so graceful. The singers were excellent, even lighting was great. The show did bring me to another place that I forgot I was watching a performance. 10/10.

Pertunjukan ini sangat menarik, apalagi jika anda penggemar budaya Jawa yang kental dengan tokoh pewayangan. Durasi pertunjukan ini mulai jam 19:30 s/d 21:30 dan dibagi dalam dua sesi.
Perpaduan tradisionalusme dengan panggung yang mordern pertunjukan ini menjadi wajib untuk anda kunjungi ketika ke Yogyakarta

We came during the rainy season so watching the Ramayana in an open air with the Prambanan temple as background was not possible. We watched it instead inside the Trimurti Theater. Although it is inside the theater,all the entrances of the theater are open and this being so,you still get the feel of watching it in an open air. There is a reason why they left the entrances open as you will soon find out if you plan to watch the Ramayana. 

The play will start with the gamelan player and from that moment on you will be hypnotized and mesmerized with the beauty of the play and the gamelan music. And if you concentrate enough,the entire show and music will transport you to the way of life of the Sultans of long ago...captivatingly beautiful!

Die Vorstellung sollte um 19.30 Uhr beginnen aber bis um 19.40 war man sich nicht sicher ob drinnen oder draussen... es hat geregnet wie aus Eimern. Dann hat es mit 40 Minuten verspätung angefangen. Es war alles wunderschön getanzt und dennoch war ich froh dass wir jemanden im Hostel kennengelernt haben der us immer wider erzält hat wer wer ist und wiso was geschieht... auch haben wir dadurch erfahren dass sie eine "Szene" einfach gestrichen haben... wohl um die Verspätung wider gut zu machen. 
Ganz besonders gut hat mir gefallen wie die Tänzer ihre Hände und Füsse bewegt haben.

I booked the show planning the temples as the backdrop. However it rained on the day and got to watch the indoor performance.  It was disappointing to miss the temples but lucky because got to sit right in the front row due to change in venue. The performers were amazing and talented of course.  The actor who played Raavana was very funny and engaged with the audience during the show. The young Hanumans were superb and full of energy. Definitely not a performance to be missed.

Do give the restaurant on site a miss. By far the worst food we had during the entire stay in Jogja and the most expensive too. The night we visited it was a buffet only which was absolutely poor quality and flavor.

I really enjoyed the show. It was excellent. Maybe the only down side is the show was in javanese, which not all the visitors understand. If they want to make this show as prominent tourist attraction, they shall considering to deliver it in English / Bahasa Indonesia
Pertunjukan seni tari yang sangat indah.. dan dimainkan oleh para muda mudi Indinesia.. terimakasih telah menjaga warisan budaya negri ini..

Since we visited in November, shows are held in the indoor theatre which means no backdrop of Prambanan temples in the background. It also means that shows will not be cancelled due to rain. This ballet is an epic tale of Rama and Sita told in a traditional dance form with lots of music, lovely costumes and a huge cast. Tickets could be pricey depending on the seating area. Best to check dates performances are held as it is not a nightly show. A cultural performance not to be missed.

The Ramayana Ballet at the Prambanan with the temple in the background was an amazing experience. The arrangement was very good with food and water options available during breaks and multiple screens in the auditorium displayed the story in Bahasa and English for everyone to understand. Lights, Music, Performers - everything was awesome & I would definitely recommend this to anyone who likes art & culture.

I was invited to visit Prambanan Temple,have dinner and watch the Ramayana Ballet for FREE at the hotel where I was staying.Tickets were represented to have been purchased and paid for, but the other party got sick.

After visiting the temple and having dinner, we drove to the area where the ballet would be shown. We waited until the gate opened at 7:30 p.m. only to find out that there was no show during our visit (Sunday, Nov 20, 2016). There would be a show on Tuesdays.

We're definitely going back on Tuesday and inquired about the show tickets already purchased. Due to language barrier, this mix-up occurred.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The ticket is pretty pricey for tourist but the show was fascinating. If it rains outside, they'll move you to the indoor stadium.

The epic story of Rama and Sita is told in the form of a Ballet. The performance is done in open up to October and in the Prembanan temple theatre during rains.There are four types of seating. IDR 375.000,-Soft drink & snack, Souvenir 64 seats ; Special Class IDR 275.000,- -Soft Drink 150 seats; Class - IDR 200.000,- 268 seats
Class - II IDR 125.000,-650 seats. Doesn't really matter which you choose  enjoy the show in any of this.

Spectacle sympathique a voir et entendre. Traduction faite en anglais pour les touristes et explication du senario dispo en français. Par contre peut être un peu long sur le temps. Le spectacle dure un peu plus de 2h.

First Up... It is not cheap.
Not when you compare it with the many other cultural servings in this city.
But is it worth the money?
Hell Yes...
IF you are into cultural shows.

To get there proved to be a challenge as the toads are not well lit and little directions are provided.

If from the city, make sure to take the slow lane just before the first traffic light nearest to the prambanan complex.

The show goes for around 1 hour with an intermezzo in-between. English Subtitles are provided so no worries for foreigners there.

I got the 250k ticket that puts me midway to the stage. With a more elevated position, this seatibg is excellent for taking snapshots at a more "grandeure" level.

Don't forget to bring a zoom lens as well if you like taking fotos as the performers have weird and wonderful poses, stances and facial expressions. 1 shot won't be enough, trust me.

This is a must see for night entertainment, google the schedule ahead of time to make sure you get the correct performance dates as this is not a daily show you can simply turn up to.

Highly Recommended. Bring a scarf as the night tends to be windy.
Voor een niet ballet liefhebber was het een indrukwekkende voorstelling. Door de schriftelijke uitleg voor en tijdens de voorstelling is het verhaal prima te volgen.

this is jogjakarta traditional dances and very interesting entertainment. supported by the great costumes, sound system and lighting, it feels very real. we can get carried away in rama shinta romance when this happens. the price they offer very cheap when compared to what we get in the event. Prambanan beautiful background complements the ambience of romance entertainment.
kesenian tradisional yang perlu dan wajib dilestarikan, dan sayang jika dilewatkan apabila berkunjung ke yogyakarta
I love the dance, the actors & actresses, the story. Please bulid the ceiling for anticipating rainy seasons.

Luar biasa, sangat bagus, tata lampu dan gerakan para penarinya kelas dunia.
Latar belakang candi prambanan membuat suasana sewaktu menonton menjadi lebih romantis.
Pertunjukan setara kualitas hotel bintang lima plus.
Saya sangat merekomendasikan kepada siapapun yang datang ke Jogja harus menonton Ramayana Ballet Outdoor di Prambanan.

The Indonesian buffet is an excellent place to try so many favorites. They have satay, corn soup, noodles and rice, beef, chicken and fish dishes as well as teas, desserts and snake fruit. The tables of 4 allow for good conversation and are located outside under a pavilion. As it is the rainy season, the performance was inside Which means under a pavilion but open at the top for bugs and birds to fly in. It is a cultural enjoyment - the dance and music are representative of some areas of Java. My only recommendation is to wear bug and insect repellant. It is about 2-1/2 hours long with a 10 minute intermission. There was one small souvenir store- only related to the ballet.

Don't let the name 'ballet' turn you off here, which it almost did for us. We do not have a cultural mindset at all and would NEVER go to a classic, european ballet performance. This actually has nothing to do with ballet and should be more seen as an extravagant theater performance. We saw the full story and can recommend this to everybody. The whole show is just amazing to see and is a good insight into Javanese artforms. 

Points for improvement would be a more clear description of the story and English subtitles of the text for tourists. We recommend to try to follow the storyline, as it will provide you with an additional layer of understanding of what they are showing you.

Other tip: book a ticket as soons as you have the chance. We recommend first class, the price is not too high and you have a good view and a pillow (which was very welcome).

We saw the full story version... yes there are different ones based on the day you book the show.

There are quite a few creative liberties taken with the story as we know it in India but none of it take away from the sheer beauty of the show. 

It is excellent through and through and was probably the highlight of our trip. We would've loved to have gotten a few pictures of ourselves with the amazing dancers since it is allowed at the end of the show but since a few hundred others did too we gave up... crowds and kids 😊 not a great mix.
