Love the performance from the dancer. The story was interesting and the background of Prambanan Temple make it excellent. But quite expensive ticket :(

We were looking forward to this show for a long time and the beginning did not disappoint us. The VIP seats are worth the price and it would have been a totally mesmerizing evening if not for the rain. The show was cancelled half way through because of rain. We were hoping it would be moved indoors or postponed to the next day, but, just cancelled. We enjoyed the one hour show - the backdrop of Prambanan temple and the showm but quite disappointed that we did not get to see the entire show.

I approached the "ballet" with some skepticism. My instinct said "tourist trap" but curiosity won over. 

When we tried to buy the lowest cost Class 2 tickets through a tour company, they said they were sold out and only Class 1 tickets or above were available. It had been raining pretty hard every evening while we were in Jogja and, knowing that it's an outdoor theater, we weren't ready to commit. We decided to think about it en route to Prambanan via the 1A. 

Once there, we went to the Info Center at Prambanan and asked point blank, "what if it rains?" We were assured that if it rains, the show would move into the indoor theater. Maybe we were too optimistic because if you look at the theater layouts, that would be logistically not-sensible because the indoor theater has much less capacity.

We also asked if we could get Class 2 tickets. The staff was discouraging of that, saying (I think) that it's far and askew from the stage, that it's not assigned seating, etc. and urged us to get Class 1. Confused, we initially took this to mean that maybe there's no more Class 2. Knowing it's low season and rainy, we thought maybe there will be a good chance for stand-by Class 2 tickets for no-shows. We said we will try to get tickets from the Box Office right before the show. As we tried to explain this, the person helping us called another staff person more proficient in English to come over. Suddenly, there were Class 2 tickets available after all, and he wrote us a purchase order. 

He also informed us that there is a shuttle service available back to our hotel after the performance for 40,000 per person, which was perfect because we worried the bus service ends at 10pm. 

After visiting the Prambana complex, we slowly made our way over to the theater, quite a long way from Candi Sewu (whew!). At the box office, we exchanged our purchase order for 2 tickets and booked our return shuttle service. The Garden Restaurant only had buffet dinner for 110,000 so we opted for just drinks instead -- very nice with a view of the temples lit at night (lots of mozzies though). 

At about 7:15 we went inside, took a photo op with the actors in costume and got seated by some nice gentlemen who also provided cushions. We were seated right, diagonal from the stage and was among the first people there. We thought the view was pretty decent! There's probably no bad seats in the whole place. And our Class 2 section wasn't full. 

An hour into the ballet (which I actually enjoyed), a drizzle turned into honest-to-goodness rain and people started streaming out. We popped open our umbrella (what's a bit of rain anyway) but after a few minutes, an announcement came saying the show would be postponed due to rain. Everyone went out to hide under tents, wherever they could. 

After a few more minutes, an announcement said the show would be cancelled due to rain, and thank you for coming. So that was it. We didn't move inside as promised, we didn't get offered another chance to come see it, we certainly didn't get a refund.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: If you're buying the vip ticket, you wouldn't regret it. It is really worth the money as you'll get fantastic stage view with real Prambanan Temple background. Vip ticket also comes with some refreshment and souveniers. The Ramayana myths performance was superb especially with the fire effect. You don't have to worry on understanding the story as you can get fliers of the synopsis and translations are prejected at the screen during the play.

Incredible performance with the backdrop of Prambanane.  There are story lines projected in Indonesian and English - altho some of the English translations are a bit confusing and amusing, but they do help with being able to follow the story.  The fire effects are phenomenal.  The fire dance at the end is amazing.  A real show!  It's worth buying the more expensive tickets for the seats and private area restrooms, plus they give you a small gift bag with a bottle of water and small memory plaque from the show.  We made our reservations through our hotel.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Abbiamo avuto la fortuna di assistere allo spettacolo riassuntivo perché se no la storia si articola in 4 serate.. che dire veramente bello e divertente..! Se venite a Yogya dovete per forza venire a vedere questo balletto tradizionale! Una bella scoperta fatta di danza, musica, scimmie, fuoco, amori proibiti.. Non potete mancarlo

Sebaiknya pesan seat VIP agar dekat dengan panggung dan pandangan lebih jelas. Dan pastikan lagi cuaca bersahabat saat memesan tiket. Pengalaman kami kemarin kami menyaksikan Ramayana sambil hujan-hujanan. Selebihnya Ramayana Ballet Dance sangat menghibur dan sangat bagus sekali. Meskipun kami tidak paham bahasa jawa tapi dari gesture gerakan para penari mudah dipahami.
Saya menonton sendratari ini bersama teman saya yang datang dari Eropa. Teman saya sangat mengagumi sendratari yang ditampilkan dengan para penari yang luwes dan kostum tari yang indah.

Theatre and stage performance lover,  this show will definitely be a fun filled. For you who do not understand theatre it is ok as there is an explanation screen which you can read and understand which part they are acting out.  Recommended for stage performance. Lover.

De voorstelling van de Ramayana in het theater met de verlichte Prambanan op de achtergrond is een fantastische ervaring. Pure dans en muziek; subtiele bewegingen en een indrukwekkende setting zijn een " once in a lifetime" ervaring. Mag niet gemist worden Yogya.
Vooraf eten naast het theater is al een belevenis.

I really enjoyed the Ramayana Ballet, although, at some point, it was difficult for me to follow the story. The Prambanan Temple illuminated as background was something magic. I do recommend you to buy the more expensive tickets, as the seats are more comfortable and in front of the stage, not at the side, as the cheapest tickets.

Magnifique spécial à ne pas rater quand vous venez sur Yogyakarta. La vue sur le monument est juste magnifique il est éclairé tout le long du spectacle.
Les costumes sont magnifique la musique aussi. La fin on peut monter sur seine pour faire des photos avec les artistes

This is a beautiful rendition of the mythological Ramayana with minor local variations which could be because of the constraints of th ballet or other Javanese cultural elements. 2 hours of pure genius with action, drama, music and English subtitles

Spectacle à 19.30h en plein air ou à couvert à la saison des pluies. 

Photo avec les acteurs devant le site avant la représentation  et sur scène à la fin.

Très beau spectacle. Haut en couleurs et plein de finesse.

Attention!!! Les sièges sont en pierre et le spectacle dure 2h (8 min de entracte au 3/4). Vrais fauteuils pour vip. Coussins pour les fesses pour cat. Nr2 (prévoir pour le dos qd meme) et rien pour les suivants. Donc prendre ses précautions au risque de passer le temps à se tortiller.
you can see the traditional performance from yogyakarta, while you also can see the hinduism temple (Prambanan Temple) being the background. Its a worth place to see in yogyakarta!

We were fortunate to see the whole ballet, rather than just an extract. There are surtitles, but most of the story is self explanatory and is well worth seeing. Our ticket included a buffet dinner - which is not recommended.
That was my first time of watching the Ramayana epic show even despite visiting Indonesia for many times. Really good!

The Prambanan temple is a surreal backdrop for the show. The performance showcased amazing traditional Indonesia dance, musical instruments and singing. 

Do walk through and explore the Prambanan temple beforehand as you will see familiar characters from the temple carvings come to real life in the performance.

Beautiful ballett open air in front of magnific Prambanan temples. Like to be back to the past living ancient culture and atmosphere. There are english explanations in side screens so it is possible to follow also the ballet story. There are different kind of tickets, not necessary to choose VIP version because the stage is very close to every kind of ticket. At counter they also organize taxy for return, cheaper than  tour from Yogjakarta. Possible to eat close to the stage or about 500meters in cheaper places.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: We went to the Ramayana-Ballett expecting it might be hard to follow, but I got completely enchanted every single moment of it. The quality of movement was amazing - so connected to the ground and light at the same time, really world class dancing. Also very enchanting music even if it is very foreign to us. It certainly helps to read a synopsis beforehand, but the show is actually very well set up with English texts projected on a screen explaining every scene. The whole setting is spectacular, with the temple in the background, beautiful costumes and a huge fire on stage. But it wasn't the kind of touristy spectacle I feared it might be but really a very touching display of ancient Javanese culture.

Le cadre est très beau, la musique et les costumes aussi. Mais c est plutôt répétitif et à la fin j ai presque dormi. J ai de loin préféré le legong ou le kecak à ubud. On a pris les places les moins chères. On voit bien mais on est bien plus loin des artistes qu à ubud. Même avec les places chères aussi je pense. Gradins en pierre et petit coussin fourni. Navette à 40 000 roupies à commander avant le spectacle pour le retour.

Biasanya ke sini mengajak tamu asing. Pada satu kesempatan, kami dapat tamu dari Asia Selatan, nah bukannya kita yang jadi guide, tapi malah mereka. Karena mereka yang kebanyakan beragama hindu sangat hafal dan paham dengan kisah Ramayana, sepanjang pagelaran mefeka sangat antusias melihat para penari dan alur cerita nya. Bahkan mereka menjelaskan hal sangat terperinci terkait makna gerakan tariannya.

the dance is an interesting one and you get to see the costumes that they wear and hear typical Indonesian music. i was thankful to receive a transcript of what was going on in the play otherwise i would not have understood any part of the story! could have skipped this as i was not too amused.

Portés par les critiques dithyrambiques au sujet de ce spectacle nous nous sommes laissés aller à l'investissement dans des places ... pas donnés au regard du niveau de coût moyen des activités en Indonésie. Si ce spectacle est effectivement riche en costumes colorés et en personnages, les danses et la mise en scène sont redondantes et très peu spectaculaires. L'histoire est particulièrement difficile à suivre même à l'aide des panneaux de traduction en anglais et si l'on en croit le nombre de personnes parties avant la fin du spectacle nous n'avons pas été les seuls déçus. La vue sur les temples de Prambanan en arrière plan est effectivement magnifique mais pour le spectacle est réellement trop long sans mettre en valeur l'immense diversité des arts javanais.

現地ツアーで寺院見学後にバイキングの夕食をとり舞踊を楽しみました。クスス席で見ました。クスス席は入場時にドリンク引き換え券を受け取りペットポトルのジュースや缶コーヒーなどと売店で交換します。一番いい席と二番手のクスス席はほぼ埋まっていましたが、他の席は結構空席が目立っていました。世界遺産をバックに舞踊を見れることもそうそうないと思うので是非お勧めします。満月の夜で寺院がライトアップされいい感じでした。

It is open air show sometime we can hear airplane above us. We got VIP ticket and it is reasonable price. The show running for 2 hour with 15-20 minutes break. This is not every day show, better check their schedule and buy ticket in advance .

Semaine de pleine lune, la silhouette du temple de Shiva offre un merveilleux arrière-plan pour ce spectacle de danse javanaise.

J'ai en tête les explications de mon guide francophone (visite de Prambanan l'aprem):
Le Ramayana symbolise la lutte du bien et du mal.
Les représentants du Bien (Rama, son frère, Sintha) se déplacent avec lenteur. La lenteur, la patience sont un signe de contrôle de ses émotions # ceux dont les mouvements sont plus nerveux, comme le roi qui convoite Sintha, sont donc du côté du Mal.
Voir aussi la différence de posture des épaules et des bras par rapport aux danses balinaise, le jeu avec la ceinture, etc.
Vous l'aurez compris, je me suis régalée -malgré de petits couacs dans les alignements des danseurs, le rythme des danses de groupe. 
La compréhension du spectacle est facilitée par un résumé (différentes langues) et quelques indications narratives défilant sur un écran (en anglais).

J'ai trouvé ça très bien, et intéressant aussi d'un point de vue historique. Le guide me disait que le Ramayana ballet de Prambanan avait été promu par Sukarno 1er président de la République d'Indonésie. Il y aurait selon lui une lecture plus politique: lutte du Bien /Mal à lire aussi comme la lutte de l'Indonésie contre les anciens colons.
Pas pu vérifier l'hypothèse mais c'est intéressant et ça fait voir le spectacle autrement que comme une sorte de romance longtemps contrariée mais avec happy end final.

El rango de precio de entrada es bastante amplio, así que es fácil poder pagar paraver al Ramayana Ballet. Lástima que sólo quien compre entrada Vip pueda pagar con tarjeta.

A parte de eso, es una buena aproximación a la música tradicionl indonesia y sus danzas y leyendas. Un gran punto a su favor: lo subtitulan a través de pantallas.

Een heel mooie voorstelling gedurende 1,5u. Het was soms moeilijk te volgen ondanks de Engelse uitleg, maar het was niet echt helemaal nodig om alles te begrijpen. Vooral het einde van de show is schitterend.

I do not really enjoy watching dances but somehow the intricate hand movement of these dancers lured me in.  I thought I might fall asleep watching ballet but I actually became interested.

It rained halfway through the show so we had to leave; the organizers said the show will resume after the rain but it seemed like everybody left when the rain started.

Ramayana has been adopted so many times in so many countries, but this one is the Javanese version. With the ancient and magnificent Prambanan as the background, the whole show is such a spectacular sight to behold. While some may say it's expensive, I would say give it a go! Especially since you're there. The middle seats are of course the best ones but they were sold out when I was there, settled with the side rows, still no problem capturing a great photo and enjoying the show. But beware, the show can be a little slow and lengthy, because Javanese performances are known for the slow but detailed movements.
The ballet was great however since the story quite long, it took 2 hours until the performance finish. However, it is nice to saw local performance that has an international quality

We managed to get full episode and feel amaze. 

We come quite early so we managed to read full story before it started. Other than bahasa, it available in many languages such as English, Chinese, Spain and many other languages. We also managed to take picture with the main actor ie. Rama Shinta and Hanuman before the show as after the show it quite crowded.

Best spot is at VIP area as we can watch at the centre, inclusive of souvenir and mineral water and also can see prambanan as background. It only different about idr 100k from special class ticket. Really value for money.

The story is about Rama and Shinta (the main actor) and their love story.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Dans un site d'exception, un ballet réglé au millimètre avec des effet spéciaux spectaculaires. Des explications de chaque tableau sont disponible en français et chaque tableau est expliqué au fil de la performance (mais en anglais). Des danseurs qui ne ménagent pas leurs effort.

Magnífico show, puesta escena con el templo detrás es preciosa. Obviamente no tiene nada que ver con el ballet al que estamos acostumbrados, pero es muy interesante verlo. Hay pantallas para seguir la historia en inglés.
Mi recomendación es comprar las entradas VIP.

Truly magical performance. They really takes you into the story described in Ramayana. The illuminated temples of Prambanan as a background definitely add to the magic.

The dance represents the epic story described in the Ramayana (which I consider fascinating) so I strongly suggest you to get at least a synopsis of the story before you watch the performance so that you understand better the dances. 

I suggest also purchasing the highest tiered ticket. It is very economic in european standards and definitely worth the extra cost.

I really enjoyed it and fully recommend it.

If you go there for the ballet, there is a high risk that you will be disapointed, the dancing skill are ok but most of the time there will be only 5 to 10 dancers on stage, except during the last 10 minutes. The problem is that the stage is designed for having a minimum of 50 persons and it is very empty during the show. If your main reason to go is to enjoy the view on the temple, then it is ok, but overall still far from what we expected.

I have visited Jogja a few times but I never got the chance to see this show. Well, finally I did attend this. It's amazing since it's outdoor and the background is Prambanan temple standing in all its glory.
The show was superb with comedy here and there. They did well for non-speaking theatre. There were stories provided by 2 projectors so I got where the story was going without having to look at the guide. But for more detailed version, they have brochures about the full story for free.
The subtitles, though are a bit tricky for foreigners because some were not translated well into English but overall, the show was awesome. It's so Javanese.

The highlight of the visit to Yogyakarta was the evening Ramayana ballet.Enacted on a very large ground level stage, with live musicians, the ballet has been well choreographed. Not a minute of boredom.

The scenery is superberb, in the background the tempels, and a nice outdoor stadium. Outdoor, so no raincover. The show is 2 hours and after about an hour it starts to look all the same.  Also people keep walking in and out, and talk loud during the show. Be sure you like 2 hours of traditional dance before you go!

Ramayana Ballet is a definite must see; esp if you're headed to do the sunset visit to Prambanan and Baku Rato (both are nearby). The play is mesmerising, as the story of Rama and Sita is told via dance, in the open air theater contrasted against the backdrop of the 3 spires of Prambanan. Its a great way to end the day for culture vultures....

Maybe it was a bad day? Colourful costumes didn't really make up for a very dull slow plot. Not helped by the rock hard seats. Many of the audience chatting to one another... Great backdrop though.....

The Ramayana Ballet was a nice play but a bit too expensive for what you get. Don't expect star players, even tough the price is. It's nice entertainment for a night out. Nevertheless  I enjoyed it.
Try to see the full episode if you can, prices are the same. We had the C-class which were good seats, at least in he open air theatre. The theater has stone benches but they give you a cushion to sit on.

We took the bus (3.000 idr per persoon) and wanted to visit the Prambanan temples before, but due to traffic we didn't make it. Fortunately the Ramayana Ballet uses the temples as a background in the open air theatre so we still could get to enjoy the temples.
They offer a buffet (100.00 or 200.000 idr per person - not sure anymore) but please be in time to enjoy the buffet. It looked pretty good but we were to late for a proper buffet diner.

The view of the ballet and the colours of the costumes are beautiful and the dancing is really interesting.  However, 2 hrs and you've seen too much. 
Make sure you take a scarf or something to lean against at you only get a cushion for you bum and your back is against rock.

The temple as a backdrop for this show was really spectacular. We had dinner before the show that was quite good. An Indonesian buffet that catered for all tastes, and was tasty. They have stadium style seating for the show and I believe you can get a good view from anywhere. However these are the differences: The VIP is front and centre of the large stage and has very comfortable seat, almost like a single seater couch. The second most expensive is just behind it and a little to the side. We had cement type seats with a cushion base. The third most expenive were the 'wings' which just had the cement seats, no cushion. The cheapest seats were on the left and right of the stage [like a side view of the show as the show is presented straight forward] which had the same cement seats with no cushion. We chose the second category tickets. My siggestion to people is to go for the 2nd or 3rd category tickets as they offer a similiar view and is fairly comfortable. 
The show itself is good and is narated in English on large screens in the front. I do think that one may find it boring if they don't understand or know the story. I can't imagine a better setting for the show, but do think it was worth the price.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
去之前，最好做点功课，不然很难看明白。
故事本身很迷人，是人类文明遗产的瑰宝，对东方文明的影响很深远。
形式也很美，印度教和印尼爪哇文化的结合。
这个景点是去日惹这样的文化古城必游之处。

Wij hebben de voorstelling gezien met het complete verhaal. Dat vond ik wel leuk en een prima invulling van de 2 uur die de voorstelling duurt. VIP tickets zijn prettig met comfortabele stoelen en frontaal zicht. Ook met apart vip toilet dus niet in de rij in de pauze.

Ramayana ballet is one of oldest show in Indonesia -- it is said first shows were during Soekarno administration. The show given remarkable dance and act from the dancers, and good effects. The show also has great views with Prambanan as it's background since it's close to Prambanan.
The dancers, the ambience, setting, plot, lighting, everything was very good. worth to see. try to get VIP seat or at least special seat.

Bagi yang belum pernah sekalipun menyaksikan sendratari Ramayana di Prambanan. Saya sarankan untuk menontonnya setidaknya sekali seumur hidup.
Tariannya sangat indah dengan durasi hampir 4 jam, dengan cerita epos ramayana.
Jika beruntung, bisa menyaksikan outdoor theater dengan candi prambanan sebagi backdrop diterangi sinar bulan. Sangat mengagumkan.
Untuk htm harga termurah sekitar Rp. 100.000/orang.
世界遺産を舞台装置として使用する屋外劇場での伝統舞踊の観劇は、そうめったにできるものではありません。インドネシアのまったりとした熱帯の空気の中で見るラーマヤナ物語は筆舌に尽くしがたいものががあります。

The show held with Candi Prambanan as the background, very beautiful. Make sure you spend enough time from Yogya to reach this place. The performance was good, they do some breathtaking tricks with the fire. Make sure you buy VIP ticket to get easy access seats, especially when you are travelling with seniors or wheelchair. We bought the 1st class seats and still have a good view.

We went on a package that gave us a buffet dinner before the performance.  The food was lovely and there was a performance of local music in the background.  The ballet itself was well done and even with limited bahasa Indonesia it was easy to follow.  However,  it's not something I would do again as it really isn't my thing but I think everyone should give it a go and get their culture on!

Our family has never been to such a show but I was surprised that my kids , in their teens , love the show. My niece , from England , loved it too. Good story , good showmanship . But they could do better with the translation on screen. I cannot follow some of the story line , I think it's the word choice used that makes it at times hard to understand.

Absoluut de moeite waard deze show bij te wonen in Prambanan, duur 2 Uur.
Vooraf is A4 tje beschikbaar met verhaallijn, ook in NL
Tijdens de voorstelling is verhaallijn te volgen op borden aan de zijkant van toneel.
Prambanan  is uurtje rijden vanaf centrum Yogha. 
Wij hadden VIP plaatsen: front row, uitzicht op verlichte Prambanan,grotere stoelen, doggy bag met oa flesje water, eigen toilet voor VIP gasten. Kosten 375.000 indonesische Rupiah.
Vooraf buffet gegeten ook met dat zelfde prachtige uitzicht. 110.00 pp
Vergeet  de muggenspray niet mee te nemen.
Jammer dat de vliegtuigen ook over tempel hun route hebben.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: This is the first time I watched traditional performing art and I was so impressed that I can stay and follow all the story. They provide screen in 2 languages, Bahasa and English so you can stil understand the acts. Before you buy the ticket, ensure you check the detail as, if I am not mistaken, they perform 2 types, short story and full. The view was Prambanan temple giving mystical ambiance to the whole performance.

To be honest I found the show quite boring, very slow and most of the dancers performed like amateurs... A much better show was on Bali - the balinese dance was quite exciting. 
I say 'don't bother'!

Ramayana Ballet Prambanan is a perform Ramayana story. And I never get bored for each performances.

This is my 2nd experience to enjoyed it, but on May 2016 I brought my kiddos to enjoyed it.

In the full moon night, ramayana ballet perform episodic, but at that moment we got the full episode show.

We bought 1st class ticket and got seat in front of stage. Ramayana ballet started at 7 pm. My kiddoz were little sleepy but when music sounded and lighting were great they couldnt be interupted and so excited enjoyed the show.

Nothing I can say except,perfect.
The other way to understand about Java culture, history and nature itself. For children, it can be a visualization of history book that they red about.

Profesional dancer and gamelan musician, great amphitheater and sacred ambience bring Ramayana story alive for 2.30 hours.

Ramayana Ballet and Candi Prambanan as background is a great Indonesia's heritage show
Great show, live music, great location with a breathtaking Prambanan illuminated image as a background. Colorful and professional!
A nice history drama/dance. This show is about 2 hours, a little too long. Beautiful backdrop. Went on a Thursday night show, the place is not even half filled.

We went there expecting to see a very nice show but we ended seeing something pathetic. The women's choreographies were good but the rest choreographies were embarrassing. We suffered every second of the show (and it lasted two hours), and we left very sad and disappointed not just for wasting our time but also wasting our money. Although you hear this is a good show, and you hear good reviews about it; it's really not worth it. Do yourself a favor and save the money from the entrance and transport.

Prepare to be sit for 2 hrs and attend a loooooong show. The show itself is quite nice and the setting with the Prambanan Temple on the background is stunning. Although we couldn't finish the ballet because it gets boring.

It is more of a cultural show then a ballet. The Rama and Sita story is a huge part of the Hindu culture. It worth going for the experience and with a back drop of the Prambanan temple is is really quite special. The show is two hours, beautiful costumes and translations so you can understand the story.

Akan menyesal jika ke Sleman tidak menonton ini pertunjukan,yang disajikan dengan profesional dan apik...
Cerita masa lampau yang diulas dengan sangat sempurna,tidak seperti sinetron kebanyakan,campuran cerita dengan tarian yang membuat kesemsem penonton. Saya orang Sleman,bangga memilikinya dan tiada bosan untuk kagum dengan Sleman seisinya
以Prambanan廟作為背景, 由於下雨關係, 以為由室外改為室內, 但天公造美, 演出前總算雨勢放緩, 因此地面濕滑, 所以最精彩的表演, 就是表演者一一滑倒, 他們非常專業, 跌倒後馬上繼續表演, 但兩小時的表演太長了, 我們看了1個半小時後, 忍不住離場去吃晚飯.

Das Ramayana Ballet mit der Kulisse des Prambanan Tempel ist sehr eindrücklich. Eine farbenprächtige 2 stündige Geschichte mit Pyro- und Lasershow. Es lohnt sich die teuren VIP Plätze (375'000 IRP) zu nehmen weil man dann in der Mitte vor der Bühne auf weichen Polster sitzt. Auch die Plätze mit 275'000 IRP sind okay aber hier muss man schauen wo man sitzt. Das Abendessen kann man auch vor der Aufführung für 110'000 IRP gleich neben dem Eingang mit Sicht auf die beleuchteten Tempel geniessen. WICHTIG ist jedoch das man ein Taxi hin und zurück organisiert ansonsten steht man nach der Vorstellung dort und findet kein Taxi. Zum Glück hat uns eine Angestellte einen privaten Shuttle organisiert.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Sunggung merupakan tontonan yang luar biasa; bukan sekedar pelestarian budaya semata, tetapi disuguhkan secara apik dan menarik sehingga tidak membuat penonton menjadi bosan. Berharap ada waktu untuk menontonnya kembali ...

Tontonan yang layak dipertahankan indah dan cantik dengan pemain yang hebat, lokasinya parkir yang luas sangat nyaman untuk wisatawan perlu penambahan toilet saja agar wisatawan lebih nyaman dan penambahan ruang istirahat untuk sopir dan penambahan ruang santai di luar parkiran

Ruim twee uur heb ik staan filmen. Daarbij was ik zo geboeid door het schouwspel dat zich voor mijn ogen en oren voltrok, dat ik pas vermoeidheid ging voelen toen ik na 2 uur de film moest wisselen. Naar schatting is dit een meer dan 2000 jaar oud ballet, dat Het is het Hindoe-verhaal over kroonprins Rama, die met zijn broer het bos in gaat om demonen te bestrijden. Nu heeft koning Janaka één dochter, Sita. Wie de boog kan spannen, die hij heeft gekregen van de oppergod Shiva, is enige die sterk genoeg is om Sita te beschermen. Dat lukt Rama natuurlijk. Dan grijpt zijn stiefmoeder in. Samen met een slavin verzint zij intriges, waardoor Rama voor 14 jaar wordt verbannen, samen met Sita en een broer. In die tijd gebeuren nog meer spannende avonturen, maar als het trio na 14 jaar terug komt bij het paleis doet koning Bharata vrijwillig afstand van de troon.Dit mag je niet missen als je naar Jogja gaat. Ik was hier de eerste keer in 1993

Just the setting of the theatre performance is something you have to see when you visit Jogja! With the backdrop being the Prambanan temples, it gives such an interesting and new experience to theatre-goers. The performance itself is more than 2 hours long but it is definitely worth it. The costumes are amazing and the story itself is touching and romantic. I like how they have live musicians and singers as well. The seats are not very comfortable though so bring cushions for your bum if you'd like. Other than that, I had such a wonderful night watching the ballet!

Op zich wel leuk om een keer de traditionele dans te zien met de traditionele kleding, maar duurde naar mijn mening te lang! Ook omdat de stoeltjes (beton met kontkussen) niet zo prettig zaten. Vooraf en na de voorstelling kon je met dansers op foto.
pertunjukan yang menggabuangkan tarian dan drama tanpa dialog,hanya mengangkat dari cerita ramayana,dan hanya di pertunjukan di prambanan

Five minutes after the show was over, I wanted to see it again.  The night was rainy and it didn't seem to be about to let up so the organisers unfortunately had to move the performance inside, so I didn't actually see the show in the open-air theatre with Prambanan as a backdrop, although I did see the set before they decided to move indoors - it would have been absolutely spectacular.  Kudos to the organisers for being so flexible and organised that they moved everyone into an indoor theatre for the show, which started exactly 30 minutes after it was scheduled to begin.  It was brilliant.  The costumes, the lighting, the skill of the dancers!  I don't know how they, especially the women, move their hands (not arms, hands) like they do, but it's mesmerising.  There was romance, drama and comedy, and everyone in the audience seemed to enjoy it, including the school kids who were in attendance.  I would watch this how again if I could.  It was well worth the 275,000 rupiah I paid (special seating price).

Performed in indoor Trimurti theatre (blame the rainy season 😆), Sendratari Ramayana (known as 'Ramayana Ballet'), as most of us already know, is a show in which drama, music and dance altogether combined. Side note: if hosted at open-air stage holding up to 1,000 spectators, Prambanan temple shined with headlights and various stage lighting is set as the backdrop.

This Ramayana's play, one of the greatest Hindu epics, is thrown out by 150 actors, dancers (most of them are university students) and accompanied by traditional musical ensemble gamelan.

So unfortunate, the indoor venue is not so wheelchair friendly. And when the break session during the play, only few food stall outside the stage serving snacks. 

P.S: For travelling back to Jogjakarta downtown upon the show ends, the organizer provides six-seated car. We could easily drop anywhere we like to - just tell the driver.

The full-length ballet is 2 hours long, tracking the very complicated Ramayana story.  Too long for most people, unless you're really into it.  Not being a big dance fan, I found the show pretty boring, to be honest. Would have enjoyed it far more if it was half the length.  Great setting though, with Prambanan Temple in the background.

Walaupun sudah yang ketiga kalinya, bagi saya pribadi pertunjukan sendratari Ramayana selalu memukau. Kali ini tercapai salah satu impian saya untuk menontonnya di Candi Prambanan.

Guyuran hujan di sore hari membuat pertunjukan dipindahkan ke indoor theatre. Penonton disambut dengan tokoh penari, Shinta dan Hanoman, di pelataran parkir. Pastinya kami boleh berfoto bersama. Sesuatu banget rasanya. Pertunjukannya seru dan profesional. Tidak heran theatre penuh 100% oleh wisatawan domestik maupun mancanegara.

Hanya saja lokasi kamar kecilnya jauh dari theatre.

I was very impressed of the whole show which had its 200 performers; including dancers, musicians & singers; performing live on an open stage; the story of Hikayat Ramayana with the Prambanan Temple in the background.
A definitely must visit!
来到日惹不可错过的印尼特色歌舞表演，全方位的展现了印尼的风土人情，非常值得到此观摩。演员的表演都非常敬业，很享受的过程。

I watched Ramayana open air theatre with family on Friday 06 May 2016 with seating at special class @ Rp 275,000 / seat.

If you want to watched with your family who use the wheelchair, you may consider the VIP class seating @ Rp 375,000, since it is the only class who got the access to the entry door which do not use the stairs.

You may also want to reserve first to the office to make sure you can watch the show on your chosen schedule. They will ask you to make your Down Payment and transfered to account bank of Mandiri Bank or BCA Bank or BRI Bank with official account name "TWC
BOROBUDUR PRAMBANAN". For the finishing payment at the venue, you can also pay with credit card, beside the cash payment.

The show started on 7.30pm until 9.30pm. The show break on 9.10pm, and while break for 5 minutes, you can exchange your soft drink coupon at coffee shop, or went to toilet.

This ballet show got the award from Guinness World Records for the longest ongoing (1961-2012) and largest Ramayana Prambanan dance in the world. 

You will be amused by the show for the live ballet show which performed the epic local show of Ramayana story, with elegant performance by their proffesional artists, gamelan (soft local music), and strong lighting on the show. It also showed the text at the big screen with English entitled, followed by Bahasa entitled.

It is a must visited watched show, when you have your holiday at Yogyakarta. Please plan your schedule to watch the show by check it at the website, and confirm your reservation plan to the office, since the show is not performed every day.

Enjoy your holiday at Yogyakarta, and I hope you got your fascinating holiday at Yogyakarta.

We do not understand the good reviews for this show, maybe we saw a show with a different dance group ? ( we went on a monday...) 
The location was very nice, we had a full moon so very beautifullk, 
the music ok, but the dance performances we saw in ubud, bali were much beter! 
The dance was very amateuristic, no coordination, a lot of mistakes and clearly unproffesional dancers ( just the main dancers) overall not worth the money, especially because it's one of the main touristical events around yogya, we were a bit disapointed..

The story is complicated and hard to follow but the dancing, costumes, and venue are most certainly worth it. If it's raining, they do have an alternate venue but it's spectacular to see it in the open air theater.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: プランバンナンの遺跡に掘ってある物語を抜粋して演じている舞踊です。劇場は2ヶ所ありジョグジャカルタの市内とプランバンナンの遺跡の隣です。それぞれ演目が違うので確認してください。私の時は市内がフルストーリーでプランバンナンの横の劇場が一部抜粋したストーリーでした。座席はクラスで分かれていて１番上のクラスのVIPが375000ルピアでした。VIP席はクッションがある席ですが安い席だとコンクリートなので2時間見ているとお尻が痛くなると思います。スタートが7:30pmで終わりが9:00pm過ぎです。VIP席だとお土産とミネラルウオーターが入った袋を入場時にプレゼントされます。野外の演場だと舞台の後ろにライトアップされたプランバンナンの遺跡が綺麗に見えます。英語とインドネシア語の場面説明が舞台横の画面に出ますが日本語がありません。しかし演劇を見ているだけで十分楽しめます。飲み物は劇場に入る前の野外で売っていますが食べ物がないので食事を済ませてから行くのがベストです。

We watched the Ramayana ballet in open air with the Prambanan Temple as backdrop. It was a cultural treat with dramatic as well as funny scenes. Very enjoyable. A must when visiting Prambanan/Yogyakarta!

It is the classical Ramayana legend where the wife of king Rama was kidnapped by the enemy and recued by the Hanuman monkey. The performance is great but what makes it impressive is to watch it at the open air theater with the ancient Prambanan temple as backdrop. There are different classes of seat and Class 1 at 200k rph is good enough for me. Joined the half day tour with Prambanan temple to watch sunset then proceeding to the Ramayana Ballet is a perfect plan. The show is not on everyday so need to check the schedule, and it moves to the closed theater in certain months too.

We are a family with 2 yr old. We brought the pushchair and were able to get an isle seat as the seating for the 200k price was not pre-allocated. Although getting to your seat early is essential to get space for a pushchair.

The ballet was great but we were only given 30 mins to stuff down the most expensive meal we've bought in Indonesia.

If you go for the meal be aware it's currently 110k per person! A beer is 75k!! And make sure your given enough time to enjoy your meal before the ballet starts at 7.30pm.

The food was nothing special at all and there was not much range for a buffet. We usually eat at street Warung's so our standards are not gourmet, just nice food would have been nice.

Other than that the ballet was very enjoyable, just tarnished but what we hoped was found to be a nice romanic meal to accompany it.

We enjoyed the show. We visited Prambanan first with a guide (surprix, super good guide, really funny) and that was good, because he explained the story of Rahma and Shinta to us (it's carved in the Shiva temple). 
Show is nice, music is a bit annoying (but maybe because we are not used to it, the women sang out of tune, though...)
evenings, this ballet comes to life, enacted by over 200 professional dancers and musicians on an open air stage that takes advantage of the Prambanan Temples as a backdrop.

Fuimos a ver el ballet en primera clase. Merece la pena, es bonito aunque se nos hizo un poco largo. Aconsejo ir cenado. Desde la primera clase se ve bien, para mi suficiente.

El ballet es al aire libre, con el templo de Prambanan iluminado de fondo. Muy original y bonito, eso si cuidado cuidado con los mosquitos que se acercan por los focos del ballet y la lluvia puede estropear el espectáculo.

Contratamos la excursión y las entradas en la oficina de información turística de la calle Malioboro.

En mi opinión merece la pena ir.

En avril, pas de représentation en plein air mais par contre toute l'histoire complète du Ramayana, dans le très agréable théätre Trimurti où tous les spectateurs se trouvent presqu'au même niveau que les danseurs. Les places à 200 000 IDR suffisent amplement. Très beaux costumes, gestes ralentis et raffinés, émotions tout en retenu, ritualisés....superbe!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: We booked a day trip to prambanan at our hostel with the ballet in the night. We really enjoy the show. Especially the fire in the middle.

It's truly worth to watch..An epic story of Rama and Shinta. The stories are easy to understand, the open-air stage is relaxing, and Prambanan Temple as a background is a jaw-dropping. Well, at least that's the case for me :)

Go try it for yourself..

Pertunjukan yang menyenangkan. Anak2 bisa menonton tarian tradisional dipentaskan dgn sangat baik. 
Bisa buffet sebelum nonton. Makanannya enak.

Pengalaman pertama menonton sendratari dan kami sangat menikmatinya. Walaupun di awal sedikit menerka-nerka jalan ceritanya.

Kekurangannya adalah toilet yang kurang bersih padahal mayoritas pengunjung adalah turis asing

I don't usually enjoy live theatre. In fact I can say I was dreading this before it started but the group I was with had already bought the tickets, so I felt obliged to go. Well, I can say I was riveted. By the costumes, the acting, the passion of the cast. And the storyline was good too. The backdrop of the temple was just icing on the cake.
Best ballet i ever seen, unfortunately i couldn't it outdoor, seperate into two parts, have a break for approximately 15 minutes long, overall we'll need about 2 hours to finish it

We ordered seats via our hotel, and got excellent front-row seats to the indoor version of the Ramayana ballet, which represented the famous Hindu epic very well. Seats were comfortable and cheap by Western standards (around $20 or so). A printed synopsis available in many languages was very helpful, and the show also included brief projected explanations in Bahasa Indonesia and English. Excellent costumes and dancing and theatrics, backed by a very large gamelan orchestra. A mid-show interval was welcome,in a two-hour show.

We are at the restaurant beforehand, with a great outdoor view of Candi Prambanan, beautifully lit at night. The food was surprisingly slow to appear (especially as they knew we were going to the theatre!) and service seemed mostly not very interested. The dishes were acceptable, but not exceptional, and we found that we needed to eat a bit quickly to avoid missing the start of the show, even though we arrived and ordered in good time. (It might be better to eat elsewhere before coming to the theatre? I assume, but don't know for sure, that there are nearby alternatives.)
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Традиционный балет на открытом воздухе рядом с храмовым комплексом Прамбанан. Сюжет известный из индуизма. Интересно в познавательных целях. Здесь же можно передохнУть в тени деревьев от просмотра храмов

Not far away from Prambanan Temples, you can watch this traditional Javanese ballet show at night at either the theatre or the open-air stage, theatre is used during rainy months and the show is less magnificent according to many. Do check the performance dates on the official website.

We went for the show in the theatre after have indonesian cuisine buffet dinner at the restaurant next door. the place is not big at all and it's actually open-air with a roof, not the typical indoor theatre where the space is sealed and air-conditioned, the stage took up most of the space and seats surround the stage in a half circular shape. the gamelan musican sat at their positions at the back of the stage and played music through out the show.

The ballet show tells the story of shinta and rama, how they met, split up and reunited again with dances and performances. You will enjoy this if you like traditional dance show and love to see traditional costumes. The show is split into two sections with a short beak in between for refreshments, it runs a little over 2 hours.

This is definitely a must-see for art and culture lovers, preferably at the outdoor stage where the visual effects are more real and prambanan temples is the background of the stage.

started with dinner with traditional menu and then took photo with stunning night view of Prambanan. It was like floating temple at night. very beautiful and then continued with amazing ramayana sendratari for 2 hours and hav 10 minutes break after 1 hour
The show was captivating and amazing in every way. Make sure to get the front row though, as it can be very difficult to listen to what's been said by the actors/actresses if you sit in the back row.

we opt for the show + dinner buffet for a group of 10. Dinner is ok. Entrance fee is vary by seating, but i personally think that all the seating is providing comfortable view. It was a rainy day and the show held indoor. The show is around 2 hours with a short break in between. The show mainly talking about story of RAMA and SITA, which our group think that is slightly too long the show.

Must be visit place in Jogja... must be!!
Bangga sebagai orang indonesia, punya tarian seindah dan sekerwn ini.
Anak2 ku saja yg gampang bosen bila nonton, kali ini bilang mereka sangat suka dan serius sekali mengikuti semua cerita sampe selesai.
2sesi selama 1,5jam tidak terasa lama.
Muaaaaanteeep!!!!

That was a great experience especially when you see Javanese Traditional Performance and surrounded by Prambanan Tample as background. It is must to see attraction when you are visiting Yogyakarta. Before you going there, make sure you looking for the available schedule for outdoor stage.

Excellent performances by the artists. Orchestra was also fascinating. The ballet does not happen daily (so check the website prior to your visit) and I think open air theatre performance starts only in May. It would also be good to book in advance, else the tickets run out sometimes. We saw the ballet inside the closed Trimurti theatre. While pamphlets are available in a couple of languages and there is a screen in the background with subtitles in Bahasa & English, the English can be improved a lot. We knew the story so could follow the ballet but that might not be the case for other international tourists. If they don't understand the story, it would just remain like a colorful performance in their memory. 

Also, the audience kept pouring in even half way through the performance, which is absolutely disrespectful. Needless to say most were busy filming the performance or clicking photos with flash on! Given that the ticket prices are high, the management should keep some ground rules for the performance. Atleast to keep the aisles clear, because the artists come and go through these aisles in between their performance. At one point there was a guy in the audience walking in the aisle talking on his phone and almost collided with an artist who was making his way down to the stage. So disrespectful.

It's a great experience especially if you can get the outdoor stage where the backstage is the lighten up prambanan complex itself. When visiting Yogya make sure to look for the times when outdoor stage is available since during rainy season the ballet is played indoors.

My first experience for a Javanese performance. interesting for me to know the characters and story line on one of the popular Indonesian folklore.
Took the ala carte dinner (not the usual buffet), couldn't comment on the buffet food.
the performance is about 1.5hrs.... Not an air-conditioned amphi-theatre.
For the performance ONLY. Prices for locals are cheaper.

Buat seluruh warga negara Indonesian dimanapun berada, wajib hukumnya buat lihat Sendratari Ramayana di Candi Prambanan
Tari wayang orang dengan latar langsung candi Prambanan dipadu pengaturan pencahayaan yg luar biasa plus suguhan makanan khas nusantara (pesanan khusus) benar benar sensasi LuarBiasa 
Jadi pengen datang lagi 
Pokoknya kereeeeen bangettt 
Maaf gak ada photonya soalnya filenya ilang T.T
Pokoknya gak bakalan nyesel datang kseini DIJAMIN :D

I watched the indoor "sendratari" at the Trimurti theatre. Although it is not as fantastic as its outdoor counterparts, it still worth to watch, especially if you never watched one. Major improvements have been made in terms of service (multi-lingual synopsis of the ballet is now available, together with clean seats and professional showmanship). The show lasted for 2 hours, with one coffee break in the middle. Prepare your camera beforehand, since there will be a lot of spectacular choreography to be captured!

Après la visite du temple rendez vous au théâtre où vous serez obligés de dîner dans le grand restaurant du théâtre. La cuisine n'est pas terrible mais ce n'est pas trop cher. Vous pouvez aussi prévoir d'emporter un casse-croûte. Le théâtre est un amphithéâtre donnant sur le temple de Prambanan illuminé. Le décor est donc magnifique et le Ramayana Ballet vraiment incroyable !

The dancers were great and the staging was excellent. There was information about the evolving story in reasonable English displayed on screens on the side.

The price is a bit high and the best seat deals are actually on the 2 close sides of the most expensive middle ones - you can see everything and pay a lot less than the center seats. You can be within 1 meter of the stage!

Menarik sekali bisa menonton sendratari dengan latar belakang candi prambanan..Satu hal yang sangat menyenangkan membawa anak2 untuk menonton salah satu kesenian tradisional yang masih bertahan hingga saat ini..namun sayang karena tempatnya didlam gedung dan tidak dilengkapi dgn layar teks untuk terjemahan, susah juga bagi kami orang sumatera untuk mengerti jalan ceritanya karena full bahasa jawa halus hehe...tetapi keseluruhan pertunjukan sangat menyenangkan...

I've been here 4 times so far, taking my friends and so far it always amazing! I highly recommend this! The location is a bit far from Yogyakarta but it is worth going. It's done professionally and beautifully.

Ramayanan dance is a very nice and amazing dance. With background a lovely and stunning prambanan temple.
But to me the ticket price is expensive enough.

Interesting Javanese ballet dance and it has bilingual language on the narrater in bahasa indonesia and english.

My daughter was very enjoy it.

I wish can watch it with prambanan temple as the background setting, believe more cool. It only have on certain date, you have to ask them when they do in prambanan.

２月の春節で家族と行ってきました。

夕方６時過ぎに行き、まず外で食事をしました。
食事はブッフェで、種類は１０種類以上あり、フルーツも置いてあり、おいしかったです。アイスクリームやジュースは横で売ってました。別料金です。

食事をしていたテーブルからは、プランバナン寺院がきれいに見えて、ライトアップされており、幻想的でよかったです。

テーブルの近くにステージがあったのですが、決まった時期だけそのステージで劇をするそうですが、行ったときは隣の建物の中で劇を見ました。

劇は、英語とインドネシア語で解説が横の壁に映し出されます。
ちゃんと練習を積んだ方々が演技をしておあられ、表現の仕方とか、独特でよかったです。
ただ、１５分ほどの休み時間を挟んで２部構成になっていますが、２時間ほどはあり、小学生の子供にはかなり退屈だったようです。

座った座席は最前列でした。
安いチケットでは後ろの方になるようで、春節の連休中ということもあり、満員で後ろの人は会場から外にはみ出ていました。後ろだと会場は狭いため見えるとは思いますが、蚊に刺されたりと大変かと思います。
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: After visiting Prambanan Temple, we went to the ballet, but first had an incredible buffet dinner, sitting outside with the temple in the background, the food was delicious, and very reasonable.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
The ballet narrates an ancient Hindu epic in Javanese style. There are two versions of this performance. The more spectacular one is held in the open air theater with Prambanan Temple in the background. However this is possible only in the dry season. The wet season hosts the performance in the nearby Trimurti Theatre. So choose your timing well to enjoy it to the fullest.

The ballet in both its versions is a classic performance. There are no special effects, no recorded music, no modern pyrotechnics, aerial acrobats or any of the things you see in modern shows. It is just as it was performed hundreds of years ago probably for the royalty. The music and sounds are live performed by musicians on a platform behind the stage and the acrobatics are natural.

The performers are dressed in colorful costumes and the movements and expressions are exaggerated for effect. The performance provides a glimpse of the classical Javanese arts. If you are interested, you can also have a Javanese dinner at the nearby restaurant.

If you are interested in Javanese culture or performing arts, this performance is not to be missed. It is only held on specified days. So check the schedule and plan your visit accordingly. Preferably visit in the dry season to see the open air performance.

After visiting the temple we went to the Ramayana Ballet behind Prambanan Park and it was very nice. There is a screen where it is explained every scene of the piece. And the traditional dance is very impressive. I recommend it.

Après avoir visité le temple nous sommes allé au Ballet de Ramayana juste derrière le parc et c'était vraiment chouette. Il y a un écran ou chaque scène est expliquée. Et la danse traditionnelle est vraiment impressionnante. Je le recommande.
Pertama x nonton ini.. kebetulan dapet yg dalam ruangan.. lightingnya bagus.. interaksi dengan penonton sangat baik...

Ini kedua kalinya saya liat pertunjukan ini dan saya sangat kagum dengan pemain nya. Cerita yang populer dan gampang di ingat. Pemain nya luar biasa dan tarian nya cantik dan busana nya sesuai dgn peran nya.
 Talent nya juga sesuai dengan karakternya yang di main kan.

Мне понравилось) балет хороший, костюмы красивые. Не согласна, что затянуто и не интересно (читала отзывы). На самом деле, довольно стройный сюжет, длится около 2х часов с антрактом. До можно поужинать за 80тыс - шведский стол - с видом на Прамбанан.

Jika Anda Berwisata ke Jogja dan sekitarnya, jangan terlewat untuk menonton pertunjukan Ramayana Ballet atau Sendratari Ramayana. Tiket kelas 2 hanya Rp 100.000/orang dan dapat dipesan melalui online. 

Pertunjukannya menarik. Bagi pengunjung yang belum begitu familier dengan cerita Ramayana, pihak penyelenggara telah menyediakan ringkasan cerita dalam berbagai bahasa (walau yang berbahasa Inggris masih banyak kesalahan gramatikal).

Pertunjukan dengan musik gamelan asli membawa cerita lebih dari sekedar tarian dan drama tradisional, mempunyai jiwa. Saya sangat suka dengan tokoh-tokoh antagonis seperti Rahwana, karena penarinya membawakan benar-benar dari hati sehingga penampilannya membawa penonton pada karakter sesungguhnya yang ia mainkan.

This is the second time I have been to the Ramayana Ballet. It is interesting, but sometimes hard to follow if you are not familiar with the story, and do not understand Indonesian. There are some English subtitles, but can be a little hard to follow. The beginning of the ballet is a bit slow, but the end is quite good. It's better to try to go not during the rainy season, so you can sit outside. We were in a covered theater, so the ending was not as dramatic as the last time I was there.

We enjoyed the performance as we were watching the Ramayana story for the first time at Prambanan temple. The dancers were graceful and the music was very mesmerizing. Even the costumes were so colourful.  
We nearly missed the show because didn't pre-book the tickets and the show was sold out as it was a Saturday.  Luckily the ticketing lady managed to get tickets for us as some people didn't turn up. So please do book your tickets earlier to avoid disappointment as many people were turned away.
Prices have been revised for 2016 and we bought the Class 2 tickets at Rp125,000. Not much difference in the seating arrangements. We could still see the performance clearly from our seats because the stage lighting was good. Do go and see it when you are at Yogyakarta!

Bersama anak-anak (klas 5 SD dan SMA klas 1) kami mengisi liburan dengan melihat sendratari Ramayana. Bulan Desember sendratari disajikan dipanggung tertutup Trimurti, dengan demikian anak-anak bisa lebih jelas melihat dari dekat gerakan para penarinya. Memang kami mesti memandu mereka dalam memahami cerita tapi overall mereka sangat menikmati cerita dan pertunjukkannya, diakhir acara bahkan mereka buru-buru kepanggung minta foto bersama. Bila saat long weekend disarankan memesan tiket sebelumnya karena peminatnya banyak. Saat masuk ke arena panggung disediakan leaflet berisi sinopsis pertunjukan dalam berbagai bahasa. Keren.

É bacana, a história, as roupas, as musicas e as dancas. Porém por ser meio longo pode ser cansativo depois de um longo dia de visitas a temploa etc.

Confesso que cochilei em boa parte da apresentação  qdo fui. Mas adorei, vale a visita sim!

For a culture vulture like myself, I highly recommend this ballet! We booked special seats for the performance (Rp 275K inclusive of a free beverage) and it was worth every cent.  Production value is of high quality and the players were simply mesmerizing.  I will watch it again if I get the chance to visit Jogja one more time.

This is one of the most beautiful rendition of Ramayana that I have witnessed and coming from India I have seen a lot. It helps if you know the background story from Indian epic - Ramayana. 

We booked ballet+dinner and loved the buffet spread. 

The only downside was that the entire performance is completed in the local language with an "almost correct" english version on the large screens for the audience.

Tips -
1) Book the more expensive seats, with the perfect view of the performance. Extra money is totally worth it.
2) As soon as the performance ends, don't hesitate to head to the stage for photographs with the actors, before it gets crowded.

Long duration, the dance and act is not that great. Seat not comfortable, especially after long day travelling around jogjakarta. The one scene that actually exciting is only when there's fire. After that is just flat with no climax. I think it is time incorporate some extra technology to make it interesting, especially for local and teenager. Foreigner maybe already intrigued enough to watch it as they never saw traditional java drama play.

Très beau spectacle en plein air, avec une jolie vue sur le temple de Prambanan illuminé en arrière plan ! Les costumes sont magnifiques et l'histoire nous est expliquée en simultané sur des écrans (un papier est également distribué à l'entrée avec l'explication de l'histoire). Le style de danse est impressionnant, j'ai été très émue de découvrir quelque chose de tout à fait différent de ce que je connais en terme de spectacle. 
Toutefois, il est vrai qu'il faut aimer ce genre de spectacle ou de découverte, sinon on peut s'ennuyer, mais personnellement j'ai été ravie d'y avoir été !!

Spectacular,.tantalising and full of vibrance and energy. The dancing was so vigorous, yet graceful. A classic Indian epic but beautifully taken over by the Javanese.
One suggestion for improvement: the English used on the slides to explain the story is ungrammatical at many points.
A 10 star performance.!!!!!!@

This is Ramayana story and it's little bit different from our Hindu story. The whole performance is good and their costume and make up are colorful and attractive. It just that personally I feel some parts are too draggy. They do story telling in English and Indonesian language. So no worries. I think the ticket price is a bit pricy for the performance. Besides that, the difference between the seating arrangement is not much different. I thought the hall will looks like opera hall but it's not. So don't waste money buy vip , or 2nd class. Can go for cheap tickets as I don't see any different. The performance finishes late and no public transport at late night. So need to arrange private car or cab.

Sendratari ramayana biasanya ditampilkan pada saat weekend dengan extra show pada saat long weekend. Saat musim kemarau, pementasan dilakukan di panggung terbuka dengan latar candi prambanan. Namun saat musim penghujan, pementasan dilakukan di dalam gedung tri murti yang masih dalam kompleks candi prambanan. Karena banyaknya minat pengunjung terutama pada saat long weekend, bagi yang mau menonton pementasan ini silahkan memesan sebelumnya.

After seeing 4 different performances of the Ramayana myth in Indonesia, I can safely say that Prambanan's ballet rates up there with stage production extravaganzas worldwide.  They have excellent sound systems and lighting. Electronic reader boards tell you the story in English.  The ticket price includes your choice of drink and a snack.  They include a bit of comic relief in the performance.  Do opt for the seats with cushions, or rent a cushion on site because the concrete bleachers get very hard and cold to sit on after an hour or so.  My two criticisms: the chanters distracted from the performance; and the seats put you fairly far away from the action on the stage.

Akhirnya bisa menonton pertunjukan sendratari Ramayana yang begitu dicintai oleh wisatawan. Epic! Sendratari Ramayana merupakan warisan kekayaan alam Indonesia yang menceritakan tentang Rama dan Shinta. Walaupun saat menonton sendratari sedang musim hujan dan harus didalam ruangan tetapi overall saya tetap menikmatinya. Wajib untuk dimasukkan dalam agenda apabila akan berlibur ke Yogyakarta.

A must do if you're in Yogya. This is a great dance performance depicting the legend love story of Rama & Shinta.

Book your tickets in advance. There were groups of people unable to get tickets when I was at the counter claiming our vouchers.

Pertunjukan wayang orang-kisah Rama & Shinta yang dikemas dengan sangat indah. Disajikan di panggung terbuka dengan latar belakang Candi Prambanan yang disinari lampu-lampu. Dilengkapi dengan layar yang menampilkan running text jalan cerita dalam bahasa Indonesia & Inggris. Tiket seharga Rp375.000 dan Rp250.000 akan mendapat goody bag berisi souvenier keren.
A very nice show! Amazing dancers, beautiful costumes, comfortable seats to during the show. When visit to Yogyakarta, this show is a must to watch! Strongly recommend!
Such a great experience, amazing dancers, beautiful costumes and background. I recommend to anyone looking for a cultural experience in Yogyakarta!

We came here on a motorcycle when it rained! But no worries, the indoor thater was available.

The show was amazingly choreographed. The synopsis of the story is available in many different languages. We really like the set up they had. Dances were beautiful and very entertaining. It was intense, funny, and made us smile with gladness in the end. I highly recommend this show.

The ticket price was 100k, 175k, and 250k depends on seating position. Show starts at 1930 and ended around 2100.

Go see it, you'll love it.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
We saw a few arts events while travelling Indonesia, but this was by far the best.
The location was outstanding, and the quality of performers outstanding.  There's comfy chairs, and nice facilities nearby.
Very recommended!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Had visited Prambanan Temple and witnessed Ramayana Ballet at Prambanan. Excellent show and very nice demonstration of dancing skills. Good lightings, music , and dance and it is cynosure for all eyes. Worth visiting to this place . The show starts at 7.30 pm and the duration of show is 90 minutes with 10 minutes break.
Please don't miss, if you are in Yogyakarta.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Karena saya orang jawa lihat Ramayana ini suka. Kostumnya ok, cerita dan tarian2 nya mengagumkan. Cintai budaya sendiri. Bagus show ramayana ini.
Jangan lupa bawa jaket. Anginnya lumayan kenceng. Ada ringkasan cerita yang bs dibaca buat yg tidak mengerti alur cerita.

We were contemplating whether or not to go for the ballet as we were had just arrived in Jogja. Upon seeing that it was a Saturday and probably the last day they would have the ballet outdoors with the Prambanan temples as the backdrop, we decided to go. They usually have the full ballet on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays. 

We booked the seats through our hotel. We got one tier below the VIP - the first class seating. These tickets are behind the VIP but are facing center.  They cost 1750000 rupiah. Comes with a free drink. These seats had cushions... if you are in second class, you can choose to rent a cushion. There were mosquitos so wear repellent and maybe bring a fan as it got quite hot. We took pictures with Rama, Sita and Hanuman before the show at the front of the theatre. 

The performance was very entertaining. The performers were amazing and the costumes exquisite. Accompanied by the soothing sounds of the gamelan and the magnificent backdrop of the temples and we were afforded a magical rendition of the Ramayana. They provided synopsis of each scene of the play so we always knew what was going on. The play started at 7 with a short 10 minute interval in between and ended a little before 9 pm. 

Definitely watch the full ballet in the outdoors if possible - only available in the dry season from May to October.

I have seen the indoor version (during rainy season) and the outdoor version (during dry season). I like best the outdoor version. My highlight would be Prambanan lit up as stage background. It would be even lovelier if go there during full moon. 

The performance itself is very good. It is about the story of Ramayana. There are leaflets summarising it provided in several languages. If you are not familiar with Ramayana, the leaflet would be a great help in understanding the storyline.

Please book your tickets beforehand as it can get very popular especially during holiday period.

Het is een leuke show duurt ongeveer 1,5 uur.

Na 1 uur heb je het wel gezien.
Dit is te combineren met een diner vooraf met prachtig uitzicht op de Prambanan tempel. Echt een topper in de avond!
walau mahal tapi kadang pertunjukan seperti ini sangat sayang untk dilewatkan, dan selalu kangen ke sana

This is a high quality performance of one of Indonesia's most classic cultural highlights.
Beautiful costumes, excellent lighting, accomplished performers in a comfortable setting makes this an excellent accompaniment to a tour of the Prambanan Temples.

Beautiful and sophisticated performance from the Yogyakarta people. Hanoman,  one of the characters in the Ramayana story,  is a attractive white monkey. Javanesse Gamelan music make this performance perfect 👌

Biasanya penonton domestik menonton pertunjukan ini secara bergrup. Harga tiket bervariasi tergantung kelasnya. Mulai dari 375.000 untuk VIP hingga yang termurah 100.000 untuk kelas 2. Saran saya sebaiknya ambil yang 1 kelas di bawah VIP (kelas khusus) karena kita jadi bisa melihat tulisan sebagai penanda adegan. Untuk BUMN dapat tambahan diskon diskon. Membawa kamera video dikenakan biaya tambahan. Tiket tersebut sudah termasuk minuman yang dapat ditukarkan di stand sebelum pintu pertunjukkan. Sebelum pertunjukkan dimulai nama grup penonton akan diumumkan oleh penyelenggara. Saat menonton dilarang menggunakan blitz. Diakhir pertunjukkan kita dapat berfoto bersama dengan para penari.

Best way to take a look into indonesian/javanise traditional dancing and gamelan music. Amphitheatre is located behind the prominent temple and the play surrounded by the full moon and the temple is a great scenery. Play is prepared professionally and I recommend it for all - dancers and not-dancers.

This ballet is showing in front of the Prambanan temple. Best seats are the special ones in the middle for 250.000 IRP, because than you have a full frontal view of the performance and the lit temple in the background. The performance is based on the local dancing style, so don't expect a classic ballet. The story is a bit complex and unstructured. Also the typical music does get on the nerves a bit after a while. But defenitely a unique experience.

This ballet performs 7 days a week.  Colorful, historic, and certainly cultural.  Sit in the open air on a hot night and feel the cool breeze as the fabled theme of the ballet takes you away.  Loved the child performers, too.  Before the performance, go backstage as the dancers and singers apply their makeup.  It's an education in itself.  Enjoy even if you're not a fan of ballet.  Don't miss this one.
We went there to see Ramayana valet for the first.  It was a great set up with prambanan Temple back ground.  The ballet it self is too slow for us.

I watch this Ramayana Ballet Open Air. 
With the Prambanan site as a background, it is amazing. 
For me, i would rate it 5 stars if only the dancer would dance more in sequence.
Because some times i saw they dance not in one rhyme. Too bad, because the dance  choreographer is good. 
As an Indonesian i am proud having such a traditional dance like it.

The show features over 200 performers, supported by a full gamelan orchestra and several singers. Some performances present the whole Ramayana story, and others present one part of a more detailed version that is broken into four parts. Words cannot do justice to the spectacle, especially including the mesmerizing chants and the music of the gamelan orchestra. This is a truly magical experience that alone is worth the trip to Jogja. There are other venues that offer the ballet, but seeing it outdoors in the shadow of Prambanam is the only way to go.

Pas nonton sendratari ramayana rasanya bangga banget bahwa Indonesia punya cerita yang divisualkan dalam bentuk tarian yang OK bgt. Alur ceritanya mudah dimengerti, ada layar yang menampilkan tulisan cerita dan terjemahannya. Dukungan tata cahaya di sana juga keren banget. Penarinya cantik-cantik hehehehe.. trs latar belakang Candi Prambanannya juga smakin menambah bagusnya sendratari. Yang paling keren adalah pas adegan Hanoman membakar astinapura, membakar jerami yang disusun seperti gubuk-gubuk...  pertunjukan selama kurang lebih 2 jam ga bakal krasa ngebosenin

We had visited Prambanan earlier to watch the sunset and had had the good fortune of hiring a guide to take us around the temple and he had explained the whole story of the ballet as we explored so this really brought the ballet to life for us.

Pagelaran sendra tari Ramayana sungguh mengesankan. Kebetulan ketika saya nonton pada saat bulan purnama dan full story. Posisi duduk dengan sudut pandang yang bagus pula. Sungguh mempesona. Tarian dan cerita yang disajikan pun mengesankan.

The soothing music of the gemalan and the graceful dancer's movement against the majestic Prambanan as the backdrop make  it  an unforgettable experience... Honestly I was mesmerised by all this.
The evening stroll is better as the weather is cooler.
Recommend taking a copy of the story to follow throughout the show - Google will also suffice. Great atmosphere and well worth watching

Ini Pengalaman pertama melihat live Cerita wayang kolosal....Seru sekali, apalagi setting tempat pas dengan Baground Candi Prambanan, serta Bulan Purnama. Ternyata Pertunjukan ini hanya di bulan tetrtentu dan pas Bulan purnama....Pertunjukan bener bener digarap secara Profesional dari mulai pemain, kostum bahkan adegan. Sempat kaget saat adegan Hanoman Obong, ternyata benar benar di Bakar miniatur rumah...terus permainan api yang menarik...Luar Biasa...hawa panasnya benar benar terasa....Belum lagi pemainnya yang luwes, and Menawan....pas banget buat Honey Moon...Romantis....di iringi Bulan Purnama and suasana malam yang Hangat....And bagi yang suka Selvie...di akhir pertu njukan penonton diberi kesempatan untuk berfoto bersama para Pemain.....Good.....

During my visit to Yogyakarta, I went to many places of interest, but missed the Ramayana Ballet dance because it clashes with other activities. Next time I'll sure make a point to watch the dance. I love jogja.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Le spectacle a duré 2h15 avec une pause de 10 minutes. J'ai dormi la plupart du temps, le spectacle me semblait plutôt répétitif (toujours le même style de musique et des danses semblables). Je ne crois pas que ça vaut la visite, surtout pour le prix. J'ai trouvé que les danseurs n'étaient pas très synchronisés.

Nous avions acheté les places à 175 000 rps par personne. les bancs sont en ciment donc pas très confortables pour la durée du spectacle. pour avoir un petit coussin sur son banc il faut acheter les billets à 250 000 rps. Pour être assis confortablement (genre de sofa) il faut acheter les billets vip à 375 000 rps. Toutes les classes donnent une bonne vue sur la scène, par contre la class II donne plutôt sur le côté de la scène.

Class II  : IDR  100.000
Class I   : IDR  175.000
Special  : IDR  250.000
VIP        : IDR  375.000

This was a highlight of my trip to Jogja. The performance is well expected with dancing that was peculiar and interesting. The costumes were great and the photo opportunity at the end was a bonus. Recommend!

Great performance, it gave us an insight about the culture of Yogya and how it was influenced by Hindu religion.

Recommended for everyone who is into culture

Балет Рамаяна показывают с мая по октябрь включительно (так было в 2015) в дни полнолуния по 4 дня подряд, эти 4 дня приближены к полнолунию, но в любом случае  включают в себя субботу и воскресенье. Сам балет состоит из четырёх частей, связанных одним сюжетом. Таким образом, в первый из четырёх дней представления в этом месяце идёт начало сюжета, во-второй – эпизод 2 и т.д. Каждая часть длится 2 часа. На входе можно взять бумажку с либретто (русского нет), там отдельно  даны описания всех 4-х эпизодов. Кроме того, слева и справа от сцены на больших мониторах (на английском – слева от сцены) дают пояснения о происходящем на сцене, но не так подробно как в либретто. В сентябре ещё заявлены представления, где все 4 эпизода вместе, но даже не представляю как это организовано: 8 часов подряд высидеть точно невозможно.
Билеты стоят от 375.000 IDR в VIP (включают в себя сувенир и перекус), 250.000 (включают напиток), они расположены прямо напротив сцены. 175.000 – места, которые расположены чуть сбоку, но всё равно напротив сцены, там не дают подушек на лавку, на которой сидишь, но видно ничуть не хуже. Есть ещё места за 100.000, они сбоку от сцены, но всю сцену видно с любого места. Они тоже без подушек. Напитки и снек продают внутри, после проверки билетов, это, а также то, что можно принести с собой, совершенно спокойно можно есть и пить во время представления. Представлению это точно помешать не может, только если ближайшему соседу, что вряд ли. Это лавки, зал не битком, всегда можно отодвинуться.
После окончания балета на центральной лестнице в конце сцены можно сфотографироваться с солистами. По этой же лестнице можно подняться наверх, чтобы сфотографироваться на фоне подсвеченного Прамбанана. Через 15 минут после окончания представления, как раз когда на этом фоне все желающие сфотографируются с солистами, подсветку храма выключают. В то же время подниматься по лестнице для съёмки храма, когда другие на этом фоне фотографируются с солистами – мягко говоря нехорошо, хотя всё равно все так делают.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
This was really one of the top highlights of my trip to Yogyakarta. I cannot recommend this enough! The Ramayana Ballet set with the magical Prambanan temple lit up as the backdrop. So so so beautiful!

Don't worry about getting any VIP tickets as the outdoor theatre is quite cozy and small-ish. You can clearly see the main stage even if you are sitting at the back rows but to be really immersed in the story of the ballet, it is still pretty worth it to get the VIP front row seats.

I can't gush over this wonderful show enough. All the dancers were so talented and the set decorations were not over the top but the performance was spectacular! I won't spoil it for you but you will be thoroughly entertained at the final act ;) And don't worry about not being able to understand the dances, there will be a free pamphlet with every ticket which tells you the story of the each act so you can follow the performance and appreciate the ballet without getting bored or lost.

Only problem was transport. We hired a last minute cabbie that was willing to wait for us until the show ended as it would be late after the show and the place was a bit remote with little taxis / tuk-tuks cruising about. So do your research and plan your transport before you go.

Apart from that, it's an easy MUST SEE in Yogyakarta. If I have the chance to go back, I would love to see this performance again.

It was my second visit to this show within two month. Many previous review shown how good the performance hence it was a fact  we enjoyed it so much. First trip was with my family and we seat in the VIP at very front. However It was bad decision, it was too close so your didnt have a good angle to enjoy all aspect, but I believe the best seat in VVIP seating is Row A because from Row A VVIP, we can see the whole of enlighten Prambanan as 
the back drop. On the second visit, the group of 20, we seat in the lower class. It still ok, but VVIP row A is the must if you can afford it. In the end of the epic story, one of my staffs rose a question why so many people died because of Shinta? Cant answer it, the story was so Epic and the performance was so stunning.
Heerlijk buffet bij een mooi verlichte prambanan tempel, en een leuke en mooie show na de hand, alleen hadden we het met de pauze wel gezien. Kwam wel meer omdat we toen moe waren na een lange dag.

Un lugar muy bello y el ballet muy bello e interesante, hay un restorán al costado del lugar del ballet, es muy bueno es un bufete sale 110.000 rp. La cena, no esta mal, las bebidas claramente son aparte. Antes de comenzar a ingresar al espectáculo, hay unos bailarines que sales para que la gente se saque fotos con ellos. Esto mismo ocurre una ves finalizado el espectáculo. Es un show que en mi parecer vale la pena al 100%
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
De setting van dit ballet is zeer indrukwekkend. De Prambanan tempels zijn verlicht op de achtergrond te zien. Bij ons bezoek was het ook nog een volle maan.

Afhankelijk van de datum krijg je een van de drie delen of het gehele epos te zien.
Tijdens de voorstelling is het verhaal ook beknopt te lezen op de schermen in engels en indonesisch. Het gehele verhaal is op de flyers te lezen die in meerdere talen bij de ingang liggen.

Het ballet is prachtig. Mooie kostuums sierlijke bewegingen en hier een daar een komische noot. Uitgevoerd door honderden dansers en bijgestaan door zangers en orkest. Wij bezochten de tweede van de drie delen en deze had een spektaculair einde.
Punt van kritiek is dat het voor ons wel korter dan twee uur (ook geen pauze) had mogen duren.

TIP1: Voordat de voorstelling begon hebben we eerst heerlijk gegeten in het bijbehorende restaurant. Een buffet met indonesisch voedsel.
TIP2: Een goede combinatie is een laat bezoek aan Prambanan met sunset, dan het buffet en dan de voorstelling.
