TIP3: Een taxi na de voorstelling is veel duurder dan op de heenweg (100k vs 200k+). Koop vooraf bij het balletloket een kaartje voor vervoer (40k pp) terug naar bijv. Jogjakarta. Dit kan echter wel een uur duren, en vrij krap zijn.
TIP4: reserveer tijdig om de beste of juist goedkoopste plaatsen te bemachtigen. Ook in Jogja is dit mogelijk. VIP betekent niet alleen beter zicht maar ook betere stoelen en een drankje.

Saya menonton pertunjukan ramayana ballet ini ketika di yogyakarta besama rekan. karena saya penasaran bagaimana pertunjukannya. ada dua pilihan tiket masuk yakni include buffet atau tidak ketika itu saya membeli tiket untuk pertunjukan saja. pertunjukan waktu itu di open air sehingga terlihat jelas pemandangan candi prambanan di malam hari yang menakjubkan tersorot lampu. bangku-bangku penonton memang tidak penuh, namun saya tetap tertarik untuk melihat pertunjukan. selama pertunjukan di tampilkan kesan saya keren. narasi di tampilakn dalam projektor dan itu sudah cukup modern. untuk tarian dan musik pengiring nya cukup bagus dan balance. saya sangat menikmatinya.

Op aanraden van andere toeristen hebben we een show van het Ramayana ballet bezocht. Allereerst is de locatie al zeer indrukwekkend;  een openlucht theater met uitzicht op de Prambanan tempel.  Daarnaast is de show groot en professioneel opgezet met schermen waarop het verhaal zowel in het Engels als Indonesisch wordt verteld. De dans zelf was prachtig en een absolute aanrader. 
Wij hadden een plaats in het vip gedeelte geboekt wat ik zeker aan kan raden,  de stoelen zijn comfortabel en gasten van het gedeelte krijgen gratis drankjes en hebben een eigen badkamer.

This is my first time watching Ramayana Ballet in Prambanan Temple. The price for 1st class was IDR 175,000. Really reasonable considering the great performance, lights, music, and stories.

The shows start at exactly 7.30 pm and coincidently with the full-moon so I can only watch the second episode of the full stories (there is 4 episodes and in full-moon, they devided the episodes into 4 days). But the second episode was actually on of the best episode because they have a lot of actions, fire, and 'war'.

You are really should pay a visit there.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Tiket menontonnya memang tidak murah, tapi cukup memuaskan dengan pertunjukan yang ditampilkan dengan latar belakang candi prambanan yang dramatis pencahayaannya. Jadwal pertunjukan juga bisa di akses melalui website karena pagelaran putdoor ini hanya ada pada musim panas. pengunjung boleh berfoto dengan para penari di akhir acara.
a must visit show in town..please check for the schedule and don't forget to enjoy the diner before the show begin. have a great evening

First of all, check their performance calendar (as it's not a daily show) to fit into your itinerary. Make sure it's not rainy season as this show it's the best at outdoor and having Prambanan as the back drop. 

If you are arranging your private tour with the local agency, ensure that they have pre-booked the VIP ticket for you as the ticket always sold out. VIP seating is highly recommended as it's located right smack at the middle front of the stage. Other classes tickets also very fast sold out or mostly booked in advance by tour group / local school group / local business or government group. 

VIP ticket cost IDR 375,000/person but it comes with brochure of the story and souvenir (glass display with molded rama sita puppet character), 1 mineral water, and 1 soft drink, and 1 paper back with the ramayana logo. Cushion seating as well for the VIP, so spend a little for great seating, viewing, and lovely souvenir. VIP area comes with their own VIP toilet as well.

This show is being run professionally from the lighting, sound system, crowd control, and the dance performance (of course). On left and right black screen, there's an English and Bahasa short paragraph which help to inform the audience the plot that being performed hence you won't fell clueless.

Show start at 1930hrs, stop 2100hrs with 10mins intermission to clear the stage from the fire show (don't miss out this fire show), so don't leave the seat because there's not much time to go to toilet and queue. The last 15 mins of the show also amazing, especially the effect for the ending (do not miss it out).
Show ended around 21:40hrs.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Both on the basis of the TripAdvisor recommendation of this show, and based on the recommendation of our guide in Yogyakarta, my wife and I decided to see this Indonesian cultural ballet based on the ancient Indian epic of the Ramayana.  We were not disappointed.  The evening starts at approximately 6:30 p.m. with a fabulous buffet style Indonesian feast, served and eaten outdoors in full view of the floodlit towers of the nearby Prambanan Temple complex.  It is an absolutely stunning location.  Then, we proceeded to the large outdoor theater, where we witnessed the 2-hour extravaganza production of the Ramayana, done in full traditional Indonesian costume, with live gamelan orchestral accompaniment and two singers.  The performers were incredibly talented.  This is not western ballet, nor is it some contemporary pop rendition.  It is a traditional Indonesian performance of the Hindu epic, which is dear to the hearts of the native Indonesian people no matter what their religion.  We were moved and excited by the performance, as was the entire audience.  And –– it's a lot of fun!

Ganz kann ich die positiven Kritiken nicht nachvollziehen. Man muss schon ein ausgesprochener Kenner der Indonesischen Geschichte sein um der Performance folgen zu können. Die Darbietung selbst hat uns nicht mitgerissen. Zu langsam zu wenig "Action" 
Super war jedoch, dass wir zufällig bei Vollmond dort waren. Mit dem Tempfel im Hintergund ist die Kulisse hinreißend.

Sendratari ramayana sangat bagus dan unik
Unsur budaya wayangnya sangat kental dan jalan ceritanya amat menarik bagi saya
Sangat cocok untuk hiburan bagi keluarga yang berkunjung kedaerah jogja dan sekitarnya

Si vous n'avez pas de moto, pas de souci, ils offrent un service de transport partout à Yogyakarta et à 40.000 roupies seulement. Ça m'a été très bénéfique car TransJogja finit à 21h et les taxis sont plus chers !

I truly enjoyed the show 
It was amazing and fun, beautiful. 
The performances are unique.

It was lovely evening for us 
We really had a good time .

Took grade 10 high school class to see this event and luckily we bought VIP seats right in front the show was amazing and the backdrop of the temples and the full moon was just mystical, would recommend this for everyone

Walking through the temple at Prambanan we had our first taste of the story of Rama and Shinta, the leads in the Ramayana ballet. With front row seats we had a perfect view and great opportunity for photographing the dancers. Descriptions of what is happening are projected on a wall periodically during the ballet making it easier to follow if you do not know the story. The backdrop is perfect, the costumes are dramatic and the dancers are very good. A very enjoyable end to our stay in Jogja.

This is by far the most amazing traditional ballet in South East Asia. The dancers are very good and their performance was without a mistake. The costumes and the props are one of a kind. I bought a VIP ticket which came along with a front row seat, refreshments and a nice souvenir. Personally, I think the small price difference was worth it, but there is no bad seat in this theater so you can't go wrong with any choice of ticket.

Ke Daerah Istimewah Yogjakarta  tidak afdol kalau tidak singgah ke Candi Prambanan, Komplek Candi Prambanan yang terletak di Jalan Raya Jogja - Solo Km 16 Prambanan, Sleman-Yogjakarta. Saat berkunjung di Bulan Juli sehingga saya dapat menyaksikan pagelaran sendratari di panggung terbuka karena apabila di musim penghujan pagelaran di gelar di panggung tertutup. Sudah pasti pagelaran dpanggung terbuka lebih menarik dengan latar belakang komplek Candi Prambanan menciptakan excotic dan magis dengan permainan tata lighting panggung membuat maraknya suasana. Lemah gemulai penari membawakan tarian diiringi iringan gamelan yang membuat terkesimah. Anak saya suka banget melihat pertunjukan ini,  sendratari Ramayana merupakan cerita pahlawan atau biasa disebut "wiracarita Ramayana mengutamakan gerak-gerak ekpresi sebagai ganti dialog, agar pengunjung dapat memahami makna cerita yang disajikan walaupun berlatar belakang budaya dan bahasa yang berbeda. Sendratari Ramayana Prambanan  digelar di bulan Juli dengan jadwal lebih panjang terutama di liburan minggu lebaran mengantisipasi liburan pemudik di bulan Syawal sehingga diharapkan pengunjung lebih leluasa  menikmatinya, dengan tarif tiket masuk   Sendratari Ramayana Prambanan Theater Terbuka Kelas dua Rp 100.000, Anak-anak saya (pelajar) Rp. 30.000, Sebagai wisata budaya juga sekaligus memberikan pelajaran kepada anak-anak untuk mencintai seni budaya daerah dan bangga dengan tradisi yang dimiliki serta belajar heroik kepahlawanan cerita Ramayana.

+many kids involved in the performance
+deer dancer was perfect- her body movement and hand dance just the best from the whole art

- nothing similar to european meaning of word ballet
- dancers were very unsynchronized
- very very very uncomfortable seatings Remember to take or borrow a pillow to seat on it.

Moreover this cacophonic music was not exacly my kind of music.

It was an evening dinner and show to entertain foreign delegates of a medical conference.
Was quite entertaining but I was distracted as many of foreign guests did as well. It was elaborated and close to 2 hours singing and dancing. 
I will advise against it if cultural dance and show is not your cup of tea.

The epic story of Ramayana which performed in 3 parts in 3 days in Prambanan Temple is beautiful yet amazing performance, the entire story is presented in a series of dance movement by around 100 professional dancers and musician who played gamelan music, they are all collaborate and enact on the open air stage and take advantage the Prambanan Temple as backdrop, feels like this is an exotic and mythical at the same time. The most unforgettable moment from this performance is the fireball when Shinta whould be burned, because you'll see the the light of the fire under the moonlight, and for me it is the most beautiful moment. 

The show is running for about 2 hours from 7.30 pm to 9.30 pm, and better if you bring shawl or pashmina, regarding the cold weather. The schedule of the performance has been arranged for Indoor (Trimurti Stage) and Outdoor (Open Theater) in each year, since Indonesia has 2 seasons (summer and rainy seasons) so please check the current weather. The location can be reached from the city of Yogyakarta about 30-45 minutes, you can ride taxi or shuttle bus from the hotel you stay. You can also buy ticket from the hotel you stay or just buy on the spot so that you might not have to pay extra for the tour service. 

The ticket price divided into:(hope this still the same)
VIP Class: IDR 375,000
Special Class: IDR 250,000
Class I : IDR 175,000
Class II : IDR 100,000
MY advice is buy the cheapest one, since you can still watch the performance in a good view, and no need to worry about running out the seat.

Sendratari dengan latar belakang candi prambanan pada waktu bulan purnama jadi pengalaman yang luar biasa.
Menikmati pertunjukan sambil nyemil snack yang di suguhkan, ubi rebus, kacang dan jagun...jadi pingin nonton terus

We were lucky enough to see part 3 of this epic story (taking 2 hours) with Prambanan Temple floodlit in the background and under a full moon. Have seen lots of eastern and western shows of all types over the years. This show is beautiful, colourful, dramatic and even irreverent and fun. Perhaps some western kids wouldn't be enthralled, but certainly the large number of Indonesian schoolchildren present were roaring with laughter at times. 

We really enjoyed this magical experience and would recommend it to all, except perhaps those westerners with small children.

It's worth paying for the VIP seats, they are large, relatively comfortable and close to dead centre of the stage. You also have access to separate toilets, we didn't use so not sure if squat or a seat.

I have been watching a couple Ramayana performances in Indonesia and this is one of the best. The background view of Prambanan temple  is just amazing. Usually when I watched a similar performance - I was ending up sleepy and bored but not this one. I book the VIP one but seeing the seat format, I think it's OK to book also the 1st class as it's in the same row as VIP but not in the middle spot. It's in the left and right of VIP. I suggest before you book the ticket check the official website because there are certain days, they will play this as part of six episodes - meaning you will see only a certain part of the story but deeper. You will not see the "fire" session as you should not miss it.

Es el broche de cierre desde el arte a la visita del templo de Prambanan tan cargado de historia. En el espectáculo nuevamente se lo aprecia iluminado como telón de fondo. Los movimientos de la danza tienen un ritmo y gracia muy particular,  típicamente de Indonesia. La música es para disfrutar. El despliegue de bailarines y trajes es impresionante. Solo una crítica, hay gente irrespetuosa que no deja de hablar durante el espectáculo. Quizás los asistentes tienen que intervenir llamando la atención.
The place was good, and because i like the story of ramayana i think the performance was great. They have translator for each scene so you can understand the ballet.

make sure you see the schedule if its perform outdoor or indoor, I personally love to see it when it perform outdoor. you can book it by phone to see if the ticket available on some dates. they also have english translation so you can understand what the show about.

Read the free synopsis available in various languages to know what's going on. The dancers were very elegant and graceful. Watched the abridged full story. Loved the prancing deer and mischievous monkeys. Dancers will pose with you after the show. The backdrop of the lit up temples is amazing.

Diciamocelo francamente: l'intero balletto è un po' una palla anche per i più stoici appassionati di pipponi teatrali intellettuali. 2 h sono troppe, ma vale comunque la pena per la location, la particolarità dello spettacolo, l'espressività dei danzatori. Il settore 1 è comodo, si vede bene, ma ricordatevi di affittare il cuscino alla biglietteria o non riuscirete a dormire comodamente sui sedili di pietra. Evitate di sedere accanto ai giapponesi che passano tutto il tempo dello spettacolo a scattare selfie e a chiacchierare. Se volete spostarvi, potete aspettare tranquillamente l'intervallo, dato che molti non torneranno. Alla fine potrete farvi fotografare con i danzatori, ma dovrete essere più veloci dei Giapponesi...impresa non facile.
It was a lovely performance with the gorgeous Prambanan in the background. The cooling weather and clear night made it all the more enjoyable. Thumbs up!
Un très beau spectacle dans un superbe cadre. Traduction en français pour suivre l'histoire de Ramayana.

Kalau kita jauh2 ke Bali lihat Kecak dan Barong Dance, maka kita wajib lihat pertunjukan Sendratari Ramayana.
Kita bisa nguri-uri kebudayaan, belajar sejarah dan sastra, sembari menikmati kegagahan siluet Candi Prambanan disoroti Purnama.

Fyi, para penari itu berprofesi sebagai guru, petani, anak sekolah, buruh bangunan. Bayaran mereka tidaklah seberapa. Untuk anak kecil sekitar 20,000 dan orang dewasa mulai 40,000-100,000. Dibayar sangat murah tetapi mereka mencintai pekerjaan mereka, merupakan kebanggaan dan menari dengan penuh dedikasi.

Tiketnya mulai dari 100,000-250,000. Jadwal dapat dilihat di website.

Yang paling penting, JANGAN LUPA BAWA BAJU HANGAT DAN OBAT NYAMUK. Anginnya kencang karena berupa panggung terbuka dan kadang banyak nyamuk.
Beautiful show with a nice story! Love the show but it was to long for mee the show was like 120 min and a break in the middle but it was worth it!

Superbe spectacle de danse traditionnelle javanaise !
Les danseurs sont geniaux et les costumes sont a tomber !!!
Les prix sont vraiment ridicules,  nous avons pris sur le côté pour 100,000rupiahs (~7chf) et c'était parfait !
Petit plus qui fait toute la différence ; la vue sur les temples de Prambanan éclairés qui rend le lieu magique !

Nous avons passé un bon moment, spectacle qui change de ce que l'on peut voir en France, avec un rythme un peu lent de beaux costumes.
Cependant c'est un peu cher par rapport au coût de la vie (300 000 roupies par personne), sans compter le prix pour arriver à cet endroit qui reste un peu loin

A wonderful experience with the breathless nightly view of the Prambanan temple as background.
We come earlier to have the dinner on site before the show. I recommend this solution cause the buffet it's cheap and nice

A great rendering of the Ramayana tale. Held in an open theater with the Prambanan temple as the background, along with a complete gamelan orchestra, it gives an authentic Javanese experience. The scene where Hanoman burned Lanka was done with actual fire so it was quite exciting. 
There are two screen on the left and right hand stage that give English narration. Though sometime it's not grammatically correct, the main gist came through so that's that.

Beautiful Performance. It was a great night and loved watching the dance with the Prambanan temple in the back ground. For an added bonus we had a full moon in the background. I recommend this to everyone.

Setiap berkunjung ke Yogyakarta saya selalu ingin menyaksikan sendratari ramayana, namun hanya sempat berkesempatan sekali bersama keluarga. ketika itu sendratari bertepatan dengan bulan purnama, Saya sangat excited untuk melihat pertunjukan ini. ketika masuk di pelataran prambanan disambut oleh ramayana, shinta dan hanoman. kami menyempatkan untuk berfoto dahulu :D . karena masa-masa bulan purnama jadi sendratari tidak mempertunjukan bagian dari cerita saja karena ketika bulan purnama cerita akan dibagi menjadi beberapa bagian per malamnya. sebelum pertunjukan dimulai saya sempatkan foto dengan beckground candi prambanan yang indah. pertunjukan ini bagus, dengan latar dan pencahayaan serta narasi yang modern. saya sangat menikmati pertunjukan sampai selesai, saya berfoto dengan para pemain sendratari kemudian saya naik ke atas panggung paling tinggi dan berfoto bersama saudara karena di tempat ini pemandangan candi prambanan di belakang sangan jelas dan indah

Ramayana ballet in Prambanan performed in an open stage. Invites you to enjoy the Ramayana legend with Javanese dance and gamelan music. The tickets start from IDR 100.000 - IDR 350.000. Lowest price to see the performance from side of the stage then the highest price mean that you can see right in front of stage with Prambanan Temple as the background. The performance was fascinating. I think with better lighting and stunning sound system would be great. Unfortunate the stage seemed really clean and flat. I wish to see some trees or whatever that they could put in there. The fire attraction by Hanoman and the monkey kingdom was very excited and entertaining. All the dancers look really great with their traditional custom. I suggest you to put this attraction on your list when visit Yogyakarta.

Good performance, good place with the great view of prambanan temple at night!
it was the best way to introduce the culture for children, they could see the story of ramayana and sinta through the ballet and the effect of lamp, very interesting the part of hanoman on fire, was burned! Used the real fire for make more dramatic!
i really enjoy this show, two thumbs up!

Saya sangat penasaran setiap ke Yogyakarta untuk melihat sendratari ramayana ballet di prambanan. Ketika itu bersama keluarga kami akhirnya memutuskan untuk melihat ramayana ballet yang digelar open air. Sangat berkesan bagi saya, ketika masuk area pelataran disambut oleh tokoh pemeran utama ramayanana : rama, shinta dan hanoman. tidak lupa pula untuk mengabadikan moment saat itu. Acara sendratari ramayana cukup spektakuler walau waktu itu masuk dalam fase bulan purnama jadi hanya dapat melihat sebagian cerita ramayana ketika shinta diculik. ramayana ballet ini sangat menarik dari segi lighting, busana, dan tata panggung. semoga terdapat regenerasi dari pemain ramayana ballet karena pertunjukan ini merupakan salah satu identitas kota yogyakarta yang sangat ditunggu oleh dikunjugi oleh wisatawan.

Ramayana sendratari/ballet was performed at open theatre of Prambanan temple. The show started at 7.30 pm and it ended about 2 hours. The non VIP has free seating arrangement, so come earlier to reserve your best view seats during peak holiday season. There was pre show danve at 6 pm for about an hour in front of the entry gate. The show was quite spectaculer about the legend of Prambanan when history came to life, presented by more than 250 artists.

A very professional production with Prambanan Temple as a backdrop...talk about authentic.  Significant confusion seems to exist between this and a similar production in Jogjakarta. Specify Ramayana at Prambanan and you will not be disappointed. Pricing even for VIP seats was quite reasonable.

After finish taking the sunset and silhouette picture in the Ratu Boko Temple, this is the place to be. They held regular outdoor performance during the dry season under the moon. It used to be more beautiful when they do it with the Prambanan complex served as the background before it is banned after the quake of 2006. However, you still can enjoy how the dancer move beautifully between scenes. Do not miss the village burning scene when they really burn huge haystack to make the scene feel real. This is what make this version more exciting than the indoor version in Tri Murti building during rainy season. You can check when they have outdoor or indoor performance here: https://www.yogyes.com/en/yogyakarta-travel-guide/calendar-of-events/
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Spettacolo con il Prambanan come sfondo.
Ad uso e consumo dei turisti viene proposto uno delle danze tipiche del luogo. Molto bello da vedere

This review will simply cover the show itself and my thoughts, nil else. I know the Indian version of Ramayana and this interpretation was fairly similar. I attended with my partner who was unfamiliar with the story and conveniently there was a display with an English narration popping up at key points! The costumes were colourful, the performers seemed really into it (on the night we went, no performer - kids included - seemed very inexperienced or distracted or bored as some reviews imply), the story was told as grippingly as it should be, and the background was stunning. Excellent value for money far as I'm concerned - we paid for Class I seats and had a brilliant view. Yes non VIP seats are concrete but its a open air theatre?! Bring a cushion or fleece to sit on, its fine :) oh and make sure to check dates either online and/or get hotel/hostel to ring for you!
Uns hat es sehr gut gefallen. Die Geschichte von Rama (Ramayana) wird getanzt und gesungen. Es wird etwas kühl in der Nacht und uns wurde es ein wenig zu lange, aber dennoch ein muss.

Pertama kali melihatnya, saya terpana. Terpukau oleh indahnya drama dalam tarian. Dengan latar Prambanan di waktu malam, pertunjukan sendratari ini sangat memukau nan elegan. Saya ke sana dengan menggunakan TransJogja menuju Prambanan pukul 6.30. Dari halte Trans berjalan kaki ke pelataran pertunjukan (tidak jauh, namun menyenangkan). Langsung bisa beli tiket. Ceritanya sangat sejarah, kisah Rama dan Sita. Yang paling menarik, ada pertunjukan api di akhir pementasan. Meksipun waktunya lama. Pulang sekitar pukul 11. Tanpa taksi, karena lupa memesan. Saya dan teman keluar menuju pinggir Jalan Solo, dan naik Bis Malam Surabaya-Jogja. Turun di Janti, baru melanjutkan perjalanan masuk kota dengan taksi. Sungguh butuh perjuangan, tapi senangnya tidak tergantikan!!! Cobalah...

It was a brilliant rendering of the epic Ramayana. Due to time limitations, a shortened version is featured; however the major story has been kept intact. It is held in the courtyard of the Prambanan temples; it is simply fantastic to view the ballet with the temple looming majestically in the background. Reminded me of the Indian classical dance festivals held in Konarak temple grounds or Khajuraho temples in India. What was stupefying is that Indonesia has managed to hold on to their tradition and the ballet was performed in perfect classical Indian dance style. All the actors deserve high praise for the beautiful enactment even though the story is complicated and long. 'Lanka-kanda' - the chapter where Hanuman burns Lanka was also enacted with actual fire! The ballet showed Ram, Lakshman, Sita, Ravana, Kumbhakarna, Hanuman - all the main characters, however we were a bit suprised at the absence of Sugreeb. The ballet is performed on specific days, so you need to plan for it. You can go for the Prambanan temple visit during the day; it closes around 5:30 PM. You can then wait and have dinner at the restaurant on the grounds and attend the ballet at 7 PM. If you are visiting with a kid who is a student, take the student id with you as there are student concessions at some attractions. You get a free drink along with your ticket. It's a open air ballet so you might want to bring a light jacket.

Spend a delightful evening watching this show ; it is very colorful with traditional musical instruments and setting ; a good authentic experience and interesting show. Recommended especially for first time visitors .

Perhaps my mind is automatically comparing with the Ramayana performance in Bali prior landing to this penning. Performance was average. Only musical without narration. Stage is quite small and lack in probes. The ramayana version of Jogja is different from the original indian ramayana version. If you know that version,perhaps you tend to do lots of comparison and rather feel bit disappointed. There are few actions n acts were merely complete repetitive and boring. Even we saw people walking out from the hall halfway. Nothing compare to Siam Niramit of Thai and Bali shows.

We really enjoyed watching the ballet.
Don't believe for a minute the advertising of 200 'professional' dancers! Some of the children dancers didn't seem to know just where they were supposed to be at times and talked to each other during the performance which was a little distracting (sorry I work in theatre so I see these things) however we were enchanted by the main storytelling and were very glad we had paid the extra RP for VIP seating - right in the centre of the front row. My pics are great!

The ballet was enjoyable to watch and a fun cultural experience. The buffet dinner at the restaurant was more expensive than average but worth the money (and still very affordable). Behind it all was an amazing backlit temple.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Wenn man die Tempelanlage bei Tage angesehen hat, muss man auch das Ballet bei Nacht ansehen! Ich war dort und kann es jedem nur empfehlen .

The setting  for this traditional night of Javanese culture  could not be more perfect, a giagantic stage assembled in the shadow of Prambaran, beautifully alluminated at night. Great buffet dinner with alfresco dining. Book VIP package for best view. I was surprised how gripping this storytelling  is, it grows on you as the night progresses, and speaks a universal language - and builds up to a dramatic climax, you won't be disappointed!

Really enjoyed this performance. Bought the VIP ticket since that was the only section left available - seats you front and center with incredible Prambanan in the background. Beautiful music, elegant costumes, elaborate storytelling. The date I visited they were putting on the episodic performance, so it was shorter than the full performance. Might be good to check the calendar in advance if you are looking for a fuller or more condensed experience. Logistically there is a time gap between when the sun sets on prambanan and when the ballet begins. It takes a while to walk there - it's just behind the temple but you have to walk around the structure along the main street. Would recommend a car or motorbike for those who don't want to walk along a major road at night. After the walk had time to have a beer at the ballet bar before the show started. They coordinate a shuttle back to jokyakarta after the performance which is very convenient.
Costumi bellissimi ed espressività degli interpreti molto accattivante. Visitando questi luoghi non si può fare a meno di vedere, almeno una volta, questo spettacolo.

An amphitheater with great background of Prambanan temple scenery at night was amazing! Ramayana story was interesting.and performance were very beutiful. However, it took around 3 hours with uncomfortable chairs (even our team have already got VIP chairs). That was too much for our group.

Waktu melihat sendratari di prambanan pas bulan purnama. Saya melihat bersama rombongan jambore anak berkebutuhan khusus. 
Hari pas kita melihat hanya adegan 1 babak saja. Tapi kita sudah seneng banget apalagi anak-anak itu. Adegan yang paling saya suka pas anak-anak kecil pada keluar menari, lucu banget.
Mudah-mudahan bisa melihat kesana lagi untuk cerita yang full.

If you like ballet dance and history you should come here while you're in Jogja. The play was hypnotizing.. 

You can go straight to the Prambanan Temple to buy ticket or you can ask your hotel to arrage it. 
But dont forget to check the schedule and time at their website..
 
There's a resto next to the theater Where you can see the prambanan temple it self standing glorius and beautifully while having dinner.

We loved the ballet, beautiful rich costumes and great commentary to help follow the story with a rich backdrop of Prambanan lit up in the background. Take a cushion as its a long ballet and the seats are concrete unless you booked first class.

With the magnificent Prambanan as the backdrop, we were truly impressed with the show. Booked the VIP seats and was placed right in the middle of the theater. Great for photographs. We watched the last of the four episodes being staged consequently throughout the week. Dance choreography, acting were good and the show lasted about one and a half hour (i think?). 

One thing though, i think the organizers should place more control on the after show photography session with the dancers. It gets kind of messy when this happens. Anyway, show is totally recommended to spend a nice evening with your partner/family/friends.

cocok untuk pasangan honeymoon. tariannya sebetulnya sangat romantis bagi yang mengerti sejarah ceritanya. sangat luar biasa, meskipun sempat 'off' karena gempa jogja di tahun 2006, namun bisa bangkit bahkan lebih indah dari sebelumnya
This is the only ballet I've ever enjoyed in my life! It was so cool. Beautiful view of the temple at night and it is about the story of Ramayana. Great.

Being a hindu, i have grown up on the tales of ramayana. I was intrigued about the javanese version of Ramanyana. The ballet does full justice to the story and particularly the back drop of the prambhanan temples makes it even more interesting. I am not sure, but use of props would have made it even better. I feel its worth a visit to get a feel of the region.
Dance and theatrical show of ramayana story. Been there with my family. And we are fully excited with the shows. One of attracting shows that we'll promote and invite our relatives to see.

pilihan yang tepat memilih tempat ini untuk menghabiskan malam liburan anda, menikmati tarianbtradisonal dengan alunan musik jawa menjadikan daya tarik sendri. Menceritakan tentang kisah percintaan rama dan shinta..belajar budaya melakui tarian sungguh menyenangkan.. satu kata ùntuk pertunjukan ini beautiful

This show has a high production quality - good costumes, music, dance, stage, etc. we were in the cheap seats (class II) and I would suggest buying tickets in class I. The views would have been much better and you would get much better photos. I think the most expensive tickets are unnecessary though - the views aren't significantly enough better to justify the high cost. I suggest arriving 30 minutes prior to the show or earlier to get your pick of the seats in the section you're assigned to.

I absolutely loved it. The dance, the dancers, the outfits, the expressions. It may also be because I know the Ramayana story so it was easier for me to decipher the acts. Its a must see if you are visiting the temple.

Not exactly a ballet but rather a theatrical dance show set to the epic story Ramayana.
However, during the rainy months, it is held indoors which is less exciting than outdoors having the backdrop of the prambanan temples.

Superb & awesome show!! My 5yr old kid enjoy watching though he dnt understand the javanese language.
Nice n outstanding backdrop n costumes..kudos to the performers!!

訪問した日がたまたま満月の夜で、大変幻想的で奇跡のような舞台でした。身ぶるいしたほど。
前日に見たバリのケチャックが消し飛ぶほどの感動。
スピーカーなどの設備もきちんとしています。
一見の価値あり。
Worth a visit for sure. Great location: prambanan temple itself. The dancing was not of a high standard, seen better in Ubud, and the benches were uncomfortable.

First of all, try not to club the Borobodur with Prambanan. Take your time at the Prambanan temple, get a guide and then head over to an early dinner to the restaurant that is set with the backdrop of Prambanan, followed by the beautiful Ramayana Ballet. The story of Ramayana is etched onto the temple walls and that's why it makes it so much more important to go watch the ballet after. 

The show runs 3-4 times a week and narrates the epic Ramayana through Javanese dance form and performed along with the Gamalan music. We went in February and saw the show indoors but during the dry season (May-October), the Ballet takes place outdoors against the backdrop of the Prambanan temple. 

There's usually english narration that is projected on the screen next to the stage so that you can follow the story.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
what a good show. orang Indonesia harus melihatnya. sebuah pertunjukan yang diangkat dari kisah Ramayana yang sangat terkenal dan diiringi musik Gamelan Jawa lengkap dengan nyanyian sinden Jawa. pertunjukan berlangsung selama 2 jam. untuk menonton pertunjukan ini sebaiknya duduk di kursi bagian tengah, agar terlihat setiap adegannya. sangat menarik dikarenakan tidak ada dialog antar pemain, namun cukup jelas digambarkan melalui tarian dan gerakan para pemain.

catatan:
sebaiknya menonton pada saat musim kemarau, agar panggung yang dipakai berlatar belakang Candi Prambanan yang diterangi lampu.

Прекрасным фоном к балету служат подсвеченные храмы Прамбанана (шоу проходит на открытом воздухе), а апогеем балета становится художественное сожжение соломенных хижин на том же фоне. Яркие костюмы, древняя история любви Рамы и общая атмосфера скрадывают впечатление от невысокого мастерства актеров. Стоит включить в программу поездки, наряду с посещением храмового комплекса (при покупке билетов можно заказать ужин перед балетом на открытом воздухе с видом на прекрасно подсвеченный Прамбанан).

Opinión rápida. 

No te lo pierdas. Echa un vistazo a algún vídeo en Internet y te convencerás.

¿Estás en yogyakarta?

Minibus de lujo 50.000 IDR
Entrada mejor relación ubicación/precio: la de 175.000 IDR

(seguramente sea mejor en la estación seca... Que es al descubierto con templos de fondo) Si vas en la húmeda podrás sacarte fotos muy guapas al fondo del restaurante que hay al lado de donde se hace la representación.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
マリオボロの観光案内所で訊いてみると、雨季（2014年11月～2015年4月）には火曜、木曜、土曜に屋内劇場で開催しているこの公演が、2014年は12月25日から2015年1月1日まで屋外で特別に開催されるとのこと。チケットは屋内の場合と同額で、正面の一番指定席（KHUSUS)が250,000Rp.、1st class（その両側で自由席）が175,000Rp. 、2nd class（舞台の横から見る自由席）が100,000Rp.でした。

案内所の人が、トランスジョグジャで往路は行けるが、7時にトランスジョグジャは終わるので帰りはタクシーなどを使わないといけないことを教えてくれ、往復の送迎プランが一人50,000Rp.で利用できるというので、それも合わせて申し込みました。劇場のチケット（1st class）も購入し、レシートを両方もらいました。（現金のみ）詳細はパンフレットの写真をご覧ください。2015年の公演予定も書かれています。

送迎はパンフレットには18時と書いてありますが、マリオボロのホテルで17：30ピックアップと言われました。マリオボロ周辺は渋滞がひどいので、実際に迎えがきたのは18時をかなり回っていました。（レシートには連絡先がありました。ちなみに催行したのはKresha Tourでした）空いていれば30分くらいのところ、1時間以上かかり、到着が19：30、ちょうどはじまるところでした。ドライバーさんと終了後の待ち合わせ場所を確認して、入口のトイレに行ってから入場しました。
入口に各国語で書かれたあらすじが置いてありますので、手に入れてから入ることをお勧めします。ステージの両脇にインドネシア語、英語で簡単な説明が流れますので、だいたいの筋はわかりますが、登場人物が増えるごとに名前と関係を覚えるのが大変です。

1st classのエリアで空いているところに自由に座っていいということで、開演直後くらいでしたが前の方に空いていた席を確保できました。すり鉢状になっており、よく見えました。ただ、石段にじかに座るのでおしりが少し痛くなります・・・指定席はクッション、飲み物もあったようです。

舞踊はもちろん、コメディタッチあり、アクロバットあり、大掛かりな火を使った場面ありと飽きさせませんでした。英語でRamayana　Balletとなっているのは、セリフのない舞台だからかと思います。PanasonicのLEDでライトアップしているそうですが、遺跡を背景にした素晴らしい公演でした。

終わる30分くらい前に一度休憩があり、終わったのは22時近かったと思います。アナウンスがあり、希望者は出演者と写真を一緒に撮ることもできました。時間が遅かったので私たちは参加せず、待ち合わせ場所へ。行きとは違う二組と一緒に車に乗って、ホテルまで送ってもらいました。帰りの交通手段の心配がないので、送迎も頼むことをお勧めします。
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: pertama kali ini saya melihat pertunjukan ini yang sangat luar biaa mulai gemerlap perpaduan cahaya, dan pemain yang begitu total memainkan perananya, jadi ini sangat menarik disaksikan baik untuk wisatawan lokal dan mancanegara.

Pertunjukan yang sangat istimewa diselenggarakan di tempat terbuka dengan latar belakang candi prambanan yang dihiasi dengan  lampu LED pada saat malam. Pertunjukan berlangsung selama 2 jam. Pilihlah tempat duduk diarah kiri atau tengah agar lebih menikmati latar belakang candi prambanan.

My wife and I took in the meal followed by the ballet. We probably don't eat enough to get our money's worth but the food was good and accompanied by live traditional music that was not intrusive. The ballet was interesting - even if the written explanation and the announcements can be difficult to follow. It only lasts about an hour but is colourful, the moves interesting and might even keep children's attention. The cast is limited - the show at the temple is supposed to use 100s of dancers and has the back drop of Pambranan, but we still enjoyed what was a more intimate show.

Prachtige hindoetempel. Het ballet met de tempel verlicht in de achtergrond is ook zeer mooi en leuk om te volgen. Ook het voorafgaande dinner was lekker en verzorgd. Had dit op voorhand geboekt via Yogyakarta.nl en alles was prima geregeld(vervoer van en naar hotel., tickets voor tempel, dinner en  ballet).
Ook via Yogyakarta.nl hebben we de Bodoburur temple bezocht. Ook ptachtig en ook prima geregeld.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: В классическом понимании - это, конечно, не балет. Но очень красиво!!! Если есть возможность, то очень рекомендую сходить!!! Во время посещения Прамбанана, мы зашли в туристическую информацию и поинтересовались, какие есть свободные места на этот вечер. Девушка связалась по телефону с кассой балета, мы выбрали места, оплатили их в этой туристической информации, и нам дали чек об оплате. Уже перед началом балета по этому чеку в кассе надо получить сами билеты. Балет начинается вовремя, так что не опаздывайте!!! В сезон дождей балет проходит под крышей в отдельном здании, а не на фоне подсвеченного Прамбанана, но так как были рождественские праздники, то выступление перенесли на открытую площадку. Мы взяли места в VIP за 350 000 рупий (под открытым небом на фоне Прамбанана). И немного боялись, что сцена будет на возвышении, и нам придётся задирать голову наверх. Напрасно боялись! Сцена внизу, так что спокойно берите первый ряд VIP и голову не придётся поднимать. Всем гостям в VIP зоне выдавали подарки - сувенир со сценой из Рамаяны, по дождевику (на всякий случай) и горячие напитки с десертами в неограниченном количестве. После окончания спектакля можно было остаться на территории и поужинать в кафе с видом на подсвеченный Прамбанан. Ужин - шведский стол по 77 000 рупий на человека. Наверное, можно туда просто приехать поужинать с видом и без посещения балета. Парковка у балета стоит 5 000 рупий.
The performers was outstanding! The story was interesting. We can take a selfie with the performers at the end of the show. It was worth every coin for such a show.

Pertunjukan sendratari Ramayana di Candi Prambanan sudah dimainkan sejak tahun 1961, namun pesonanya tidak pernah pudar sampai sekarang. Dalam sendratari ini, kisah Rama dan Sinta secara lengkap dipersembahkan dalam bentuk tarian berdurasi 2 jam saja. Tidak hanya menarik perhatian para wisatawan mancanegara, bahkan bagi wisatawan domestik pun pertunjukan ini sangat menarik. Umumnya sendratari ini dimainkan di ruangan tertutup, namun saat cuaca cerah di musim panas atau masa liburan, sendratari ini akan dimainkan di open air stage dengan latar belakang Candi Prambanan.

The Ramayana epic is well portrayed by the professionals at this theatre. Well choreographed and educating. Not to be missed by all Ramayana enthusiasts. These people appear to have brought it to a different level in portraying the epic. Well done!

Nonton sendratari Ramayana di malam hari dengan background Candi Prambanan yang eksotis menambah warna penampilan para penari. Karena pertunjukan tari ini sangat di minati oleh wisatawan asing maupun local.

Saya merasa beruntung karena dapat menonton sendratari ini. Seluruh pemain selalu menampilkan performa terbaik mereka pada pertunjukan yang mengisahkan drama percintaan Rama dan Shinta. Meski harus membayar mahal, penonton merasa puas dengan keseluruhan pertunjukan. Ada banyak penjunjung, baik dari dalam negeri maupun luar negeri yang menonton pertunjukan tersebut.

Very good show to see.
Get there early or book seats in the front row.
Disappointing that so many tourists have to take photos or try and video the whole show, very distracting and inconsiderate to other people trying to enjoy the show.

Jika anda berkunjung hanya ingin melihat candi...itu kurang lengkap. Candi Prambanan menawarkan lebih dari sekitar situs yang eksotik, namun juga pertunjukan budaya kolosal yang dikelola secara profesional....Sendratari Ramayana....pastikan anda melihatnya.

Was unfortunate that the ballet was held indoors as it was the rainy season(during the month of november and december).  But the ballet made up for it.  The dance and music was mesmerising and the costumes were beautiful.  The whole show took 2 hours but the pacing was perfect that you wouldn't notice the time passing by.

Highly recommended

Being an Indian, it was amazing to see Indonesian styled "Ramayana"  performance by excellent artists. It was very calming and nice time that you spend there. excellent location- Prambanan temples in the back. Story telling was also nice.

Saya rasa ini adalah salah satu pertunjukan yang paling spektakuler di dunia. Sendratari yang mengangkat kisah Rama dan Sita, ditampilkan di teater terbuka dengan latar belakang Candi Prambanan. Ini kedua kalinya saya menyaksikan sendratari ini dan digelar di gedung pertunjukan Tri Murti yang masih satu lokasi. Saat ini musim hujan, sehingga sendratari digelar di teater tertutup Tri Murti, dan banyak adegan yang dipotong seperti Hanuman yang membakar atap jerami saat menghancurkan taman argasoka.

Kisah epik Ramayana dibawakan puluhan penari yang sangat terlatih. Musik gamelan yang mengiringi tidak kalah fantastis. Sangat cocok untuk wisata edukasi keluarga atau untuk kencan setelah menikmati makan malam romantis di restoran Candi Prambanan.

The great Hindu epic is performed very well as a ballet, with Candi Prambanan as a backdrop. Spectacular as the sun is setting. The performance can be preceded by a buffet meal in the garden, for which the food was not as bad as buffets often are. Bintang beer also available (rather expensively, by Javanese standards). The outdoor stage is large and well lit, but unfortunately on the night we went, the rain started just after the show started. Outdoor seats are concrete and thus pretty hard, although the best seats were padded and down the front. Worth investigating if budget permits? We all moved to an indoor venue, adequate enough, and well lit, but it felt a bit smaller (however, some might think more intimate ...)

A printed guide sheet is available free in various languages, and is worth reading beforehand and during the show if you are unfamiliar with the story (not the case for locals, of course, although they are probably Muslims and not Hindus. Javanese culture seems to have enveloped this Hindu element, and you will see key figures in many theatrical places in Java, such as Wayang Kulit.) Indoors, there was also an abbreviated projection screen in English that helped keep track of the story.

Dancing was good, I thought, as was the large gamelan orchestra (although I profess expertise in neither of these art forms). Spectacular costumes And lighting in particular,and I loved the way that occasionally archers shot actual arrows long distances across the stage.

The Ramayana in full takes many hours, but the abbreviated version was sufficient to capture the essence. We went on Saturday night, but I advise checking the details of the performance on any particular evening (to avoid misunderstandings and to make sure you know what to expect).

Overall, a good night out, capturing lots of the richness of this cultural icon.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Kalo selama ini Anda hanya tahu cerita Ramayana dari buku atau film, saatnya Anda kunjungi Sendratari Ramayana Prambanan untuk melihat fragmen Ramayana secara nyata. Anda akan berdecak kagum melihat pertunjukan sendratari kolosal dengan kualitas tata cahaya kelas internasional. Disini ada 2 panggung yakni panggung indoor dan outdoor. Untuk menikmati panggung outdoor dengan latar belakang megahnya Candi Prambanan, Anda perlu memilih waktu di antara bulan Mei-Oktober karena cuaca sangat mendukung. Yang menarik adalah ketika adegan Anoman Obong dimana rumah-rumah bambu benar-benar dibakar didepan mata Anda. Pertunjukan ini tidaklah semahal yang dibayangkan, Anda cukup mengeluarkan biaya mulai 100 ribuan untuk menikmati sendratari legendaris ini.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: I'm very lucky to have a chance see ramayana ballet in open theater (it supposed to perform in their indoor theater on that day) and it was fabulous! Prambanan temple as the background is an amazing view and the lightning was perfect. The players dance very beautiful and the fire effect was cool. There's no dialogue in this performance but dont worry there will be a running text in the stage (both in English and Bahasa Indonesia) and you'll be given a summary story of the play. There are some class of tickets depends on the seat position and of course the best seat cost higher fee. The tickets are around 100-350k/person. Make sure you check the schedule and make a reservation before see this beautiful performance

We had VIP front row seats with excellent view of the performance.  Nice setting with prambanan shill outed behind.  The story itself is a little Difficult to follow but brief English explanations are projected onto side screens however the English was occasionally confusing!  A mild interesting way to spend an evening.

Сезон показа Рамаяны под отрытым небом начинается в первых числах мая - по окончании сезона дождей. Мне посчастливилось (с трудом) найти билет на самое первое представление сезона. Впечатления самые сказочные - вечер, необычная музыка и танцы, каменные сиденья, за день нагретые солнцем (есть и не каменные, но они дороже)). В лучах света над головой мелькают летучие мышки. Атмосфера - волшебная. Спектакль идет долго, рекомендую покушать перед посещением.
menyaksikan sendratari ini dengan latar belakang candi, dengan harga 150.000-350000 jadi kita tidak rugi menyaksikan pertunjukan ini hitung hitung menambah wawasan budaya kita.

We were lucky to see this Ballet outdoor as rainy season was delayed. Rains were due and we were told that Ballet will be moved indoors by first week of November. Cloudy weather, distant thunder storm and stunning backdrop of Pambanan temple could be enjoyed only outdoor.  
In indoor version you will also miss “Lanka on Fire” scene, where real & huge fire is lit. Our local guide told us that Ballet is not shown twice a week. I do not remember exact days but suggest visiting www.tourjogja.com for show dates. 
Ballet is approximately two and half hour story of Ramayana. English & Bahasa text displayed on either side of the stage tells you about the act being played out. In addition, Presenters will give summary at the beginning and between the acts. This, in my opinion, should be good enough for even those who do not know Ramayana. Nevertheless, little reading on Wikipedia would help.
Show started at 7:30 in the evening and we had enough time to reach this place and relax after watching the sun set over Pambanan. There is a restaurant at the entrance of theatre but it was fully booked. 
For the ballet, VIP seats are available. These seats are right in front of the stage.  VIP pass holder is given a small but nice souvenir. Drinks and light snacks were also provided in the interval.
Pembanan and Ballet will take most of the afternoon from 3PM and well into the night. When we got back to Hotel it was almost 10:30PM. It will be prudent to plan your dinner before leaving for Pembanan & Ballet.
I will recommend Ramayana Ballet as ‘must see’ in Jogja itinerary.
Superb and magnificient performance.  If you like cultural performances, this is something you must not missed.

ada beberapa pilihan seat mulai VIP sampai tiket biasa II,harga mulai 100.000 - 350.000,ada juga tiket untuk mengambil foto dan video,pagelaran ini seminggu 3kali perform,yaitu senin,kamis,sabtu. acara mulai pukul 19.30 dengan 2 babak,dan diakhiri pukul 10.00 malam.tata cahaya yg menurut saya sangat bagus,tersedia juga subtitle dlm bhs Indonesia dan bhs Inggris,tentunya bagi pengunjung yg belum mengerti jalan ceritanya,disediakan pula sinopsis cerita yg akan dipertunjukkan dalam 2 bahasa.secara keseluruhan pertunjukkan yg luar biasa,wajib untuk ditonton.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: It's a typical indonesian ballet based on a local legend. Very beautiful costumes. Maybe too long ...

The show begins even before the performance starts : taking our seats and admiring the view of the floodlit Prambanan temple (which we had just visited) providing a remarkable backdrop to the stage.

The ballet itself is a wonderful representation of the Ramayana epic, with fabulous costumes and evocative dancing. Despite having already had a very long day, both our young children (5 and 7) absolutely loved it, stayed awake to the very end and still remember every detail. (They both fell asleep about 30 seconds into the journey home!)

An essential part of the Yogyakarta experience, and definitely worth every penny. Ideally, combine with an day/afternoon visiting the temples at Prambanan. Watch the sunset then 15min walk round to the ballet venue. NB: although there is a gate behind the temple on the ballet venue side, this was closed, so we had to go back to the car park and round the outside of the temple complex instead.
大きな舞台で後ろにプランバナンの遺跡がみえます。舞踊は多くの出演者がいて本物の火を使用した大掛かりなショーでした。ホテルに予約を頼んだら送迎してくれました。

The Ramayana Ballet, held on a stage with the fabulous Prambanan temples as a background, is a must-see cultural show in the Yogyakarta area. 

Upon payment of the ticket, I was ushered into the venue, past a small gamelan with a lone female singer coiffed in formal Indonesian style. What struck me was that there were so many people - the overwhelming majority are local tourists. This must be a genuinely popular thing with Indonesians, and not something put up for the consumption of foreign tourists. The MC even called out cities by name, their respective citizens cheering loudly upon hearing their cities' name.

This traditional Javanese performance is unlike Western European plays where characters have speaking parts - rather, a single female narrator does the storytelling while certain characters make growls and exclamations (like Rawana). Also very prominent were the stylized gestures and the graceful footwork. The costumes were also very intricate and very well made. Some concessions to modernity were the special smoke and lighting effects. The highlight for me was the burning of the city of Alengka by Hanuman - complete with an actual burning of two thatched-roof structures onstage.

There was a merciful intermission for a leak and perhaps some food and drinks. A souvenir shop is also open.

Altogether the Ramayana Ballet is a must-see in Yogyakarta and offers a great experience of Javanese dance as well as a glimpse of the survival of Hindu elements in modern Indonesian culture.

По вечерам у подножья храма Прамбанан устраивают представления, где выступает национальный балет. Зрелище интересное, если есть свободный вечер, то обязательно посетите. Это дополнительная программа в Джокьякарте, но она стоит внимания. Стоила около 500000 рупий, на сколько я помню.

Prambanan遺跡群の近くで、オープンでの舞踊を、週に３〰４回夜に行っています。インドネシアでは、有名な物語らしく、学生も最初は一生懸命見ておりました。日本人にとっては、わからないので、必ず、見る前に、入口に日本語のパンフレットがありますから、読んだ方が、見ていて分かります。っていうか、読んで見ないと、何が何だかわかりません！そして、１時間半ぐらい舞踊があります。一番良い席が３５００円ぐらいでしょうか。一番安い席が１０００円ぐらい。インドネシアでは結構高いですよね。正直、途中、眠くなりましたが、一応、見たってことで。。。。席は１７００円程度を取りましたが、サイドの一番前で、良い席でした。満席で、たいしたもんだと思いました。

Untuk menonton pertunjukan ini maka kita harus mengunjungi Candi Prambanan. Letaknya +/- 30 km ke TImur dari Yogyakarta. Pertunjukan ini hanya dilaksanakan pada Bulan Purnama, sehingga sangat terbatas waktunya pada setiap bulannya. Pertunjukan dilaksanakan pada malam hari +.- pukul 09.00 setempat. Cerita yang dikisahkan adalah mengenai roman Ramayana yang dibagi dalam beberapa bagian. Jika beruntung ada edisi full story nya. Pertunjukan kolosal ini menampilkan atraksai seni tari yang luar biasa.

Review Text:
Love this performance! The best part is -- it is staged in front of the Prambanan temple!
With all the beautiful costumes, colorful performances, staged with the world heritage temples as background - it is very impressive indeed!
The music might not cater to everyone's interest, however, I still believe that most should give it a try -- especially after viewing the Prambanan Temples and after listening to all the stories of Rama and Shinta!

The show is nice, very interesting, and it is great to see the traditional dances in such a beautiful spot (in front of Prambanan temple enlightened). 
Depending on the evening you go, you'll see one episode or the full story. The full story lasts 2 hours - just be aware of that!
You can buy your tickets and arrange transportation (back and forth or simply back after the show) through the tourist info in Jogjakarta.

У Прамбанана в хорошую погоду устраивают танцевальное представление. Вообще-то и ужином накормить могут. С мест первого класса нормально видно. Первый ряд - вип, у них еще отдельный туалет)) танцы неплохие, вполне можно посмотреть. Тут как "ляжет" на настроение.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Anda wajib melihat pergelaran sendratari ramayan di Prambanan yang outdoor, itu sangat luar biasa indah!

è stato strano..balli e musiche mai sentite. Un po'noioso nel complesso ma mi sento di consigliarlo perchè l'atmosfera è favolosa.
Chiaro di luna, anfiteatro all'aperto con lo sfondo più bello che io abbia mai visto..il Prambanan illuminato di notte.
Vale la pena solo per questo!
Non male anche il ristornate all'interno dove con 70,000 rp hai un buffet a tua disposizione prima dello spettacolo..e non dimenticate di chiedere al momento del biglietto il transfert per tornare a casa altrimenti siete nei guai perchè i bus non passsano più quando lo spettacolo finisce!

Our fourth time to see the Ramayana Ballet at Prambanan (thrice, including this time, in the outdoor theatre, which is the only place you should really watch - not so impressive in the wet season when it is conducted indoor). The burning of Lanka is of course the highlight. We took the 25K seats, which were really nice. It rained after three quarters of the show, and the rest was abandoned (there's fine print that says that there will be no refund if more than half the show is done). We took the buffet dinner next door to the ballet, before the show. Costs ~75K/adult, traditional Indo food, and a great way to kill the time between the closing hours of the temple and the opening time for the show.
A great show of the Ramayana on stage...a must for visitors to Yogyakarta...it will truly be a memorable experience

滞在したポエリデファタホテルで席を事前予約して屋外劇場で観劇しました。

If u come to jogja u must put this show at ur itinerary, u will not regret to see it.
Great ballet, beautiful cast & costumes, perfect background. The full moon makes it the more ideal & romantic setting.

Review Text: This may look a bit touristic and folkloric in the brochures, but it is well worth going.  The dancers are skilled, the backdrop of the temples is splendid, and the gamelan music is excellent.  Worth getting a VIP seat for comfort.
Nonton pertunjukan Sendratari Ramayana dengan background panggungnya Candi Prambanan Yang super duper Megah itu bener-bener WOW Amazing..!

I was really looking forward for this play and I thoroughly enjoyed. Most importantly my 4year too understood and enjoyed the ballet. Imagine at night With the backdrop of beautiful prambanam temple with big night spot light and the play being held in a open theatre, just spectacular. The performer did justice with the character and performed really good. The lights ,music dance , costumes were just awesome.

After the show you can go and click pictures with the performers.

Spectacle permettant d'appréhender le folklore indonésien et son culte des ancêtres sur fond des temples de Prabanam. Un excellent moment.

in the Evening, you can visit Prambanan and watch Ramayana Ballet Perfomance with Prambanan Temple as a Background. It's Just simply wonderful and awesome experience for me. So if you visit Jogjakarta, don't forget to watch the most magnificent experience in your life, Ramayana Ballet at Prambanan.

Is not a necessary to add into your schedule if you are not that interest in performance. The background is nice cause is prambanan temple. Emm, actually kelas II or class 2 is good enough to watch it. I watched the show at open theater, is a bit cozy.

The performance of the Ramanaya story, with Prambanan as a backdrop, was absolutely spectacular.

You are provided with an overview of the story when you enter and there are English and Bahasa Indonesian "subtitles" explaining what is happening throughout. 

The performance itself is amazing - stunning costumes and brilliant dancing, accompanied by a great gamelan orchestra.

We paid 175,000rp for first class seats. We had a perfectly good view, only about 1m away from the more expensive tickets (although they did have cushions!) - personally, I don't think spending an extra 75,000 to 175,000rp per ticket is necessary as our seats were very good. 1st and 2nd class is non reserved though so get there a little earlier than 7.30.

Absolutely beautiful Javanese dance performance depicting the Ramayana epic. The auditorium is nicely built, with huge spotlights and two screens on either side to display text to help you along with the story (both in Bahasa Indonesia and English). The gamelan ensemble sounded amazing, the dancers were phenomenal, and their costumes were absolutely gorgeous. All the characters had obvious and subtle differences in the way they moved, and it was a delight to watch. And throughout the performance, you are treated to the view of the illuminated Prambanan Temple in the background.

If you come earlier and haven't had dinner, there is a buffet on site and it's only 77k rupiah, which is a steal for the selection of food available (including satay!) and the view. I also had the best ginger tea (teh jahe) there! We were lucky to have gone on a beautiful night with clear skies -- be warned that the performance can be cancelled due to rain.

Review Text:
I attended the Ramayana Ballet at the open air theatre.
We had front row seats - which while pricey by Indonesian standards was good value. The view was excellent, we received a free gift and refreshments during the interval.
The show itself was long but spectacular.

The Ramayana ballet next to the Prambanan temple is a great performance.  We had first class tickets and we had a good view at the stage and nice cushions on the concrete seats. The dance and music were good, although the children (playing monkeys) were not synchrone dancing as it should be. The leaflet with an explanation of the Ramayana story was good, but the english text they displayed next to stage, really needs an update by a native speaker!

Having trip to Prambanan would not be completed without this live show. This is not actually a ballet show but rather than a dance and theatrical show, equipped with fantastic stage effects (real fire and smoke), gracefully choreographed dances, detailed wardrobes, huge stage with Prambanan temple as its background setting.
The story shown was about the love life of Rama and Shinta from Ramayana book. If you haven't read/familiar with the story, better find out before you watch this for your better understanding.

Review Text: L'histoire de Ramayana est à priori un classique de la culture hindoue. Si on passe par Yogyakarta, il est dommage de ne pas aller au complexe de temples de Prambanan et de ne pas assister au Ramayana Ballet qui y est donné le soir. Derrière la scène, les principaux temples sont éclairés et constituent le décor en toile de fond, c'est somptueux. Le spectacle de danse est expliqué sur une feuille disponible à l'entrée. Les costumes sons sympas. Je ne suis pas un amateur de danse, mais le spectacle est typique de cette culture, rien que pour ça, c'est très intéressant. Les places les plus chères permettent de s'assoir juste en face des temples, les moins chères sont de côté.

Ramayana is a javanese legendary story. They offer you the best performance to tell the story usung a theatrical ballet/ dancing. They have English speaker so tourist can also understand the story. When full moon, they performs outdoor, under the brightness of full moon and the beautiful prambanan temple as the background. Just beautiful the way it is.

Of course, the backdrop of the Prambanan Temple is quite remarkable; and the ballet, itself, is very enjoyable. I enjoyed watching the dancers movements; and there were some spectacular scenes--particularly one with dramatic bursts of fire.

I went there earlier this month... and bought frist class ticket whoch gave me perfect angle to take shot .. although only with my mobile camera. The dance is beautiful..although rather slow.. if you like dance with a lot of movement. But is the beauty of Javanese dance..slow and smooth.The light was perfect under fullmoon. That time the theme is Shinta obong (?)..I have wathed another theme which was Hanoman obong.. a long time a go in 2002, where at the end the dancers walk on real fire.. there are 4 themes...Can't remember the names of two other play. La prima serata a Yogyakarta prosegue al ristorante Purawisata.

Ci è stato riservato in tavolo per apprezzare da subito la cucina indonesiana: una tipica cena a buffet con ogni ben di Dio, dal riso alle verdure, dal pesce al pollo, sino agli spiedini di manzo: il tutto innaffiato dalla birra locale Bintang.

Fantastico! La cena si svolge in una atmosfera pregevole ed armoniosa, sotto una seducente luna piena ... a dire il vero l’apice del suo splendore e della sua grandezza la luna lo raggiungerà fra 2 giorni, ma per Noi va bene così.

La prima serata del nostro Viaggio è perfetta ed inoltre stiamo per ammirare lo spettacolo teatrale sulla base di brani dello antico "Ramayana".

Il Ramayana, uno dei 2 poemi epici indiani più importanti, più volte da me citato nel corsi dei miei diversi Viaggi in India e Sri Lanka, ma mai veramente descritto ... ecco quindi che qua a Giava vi è l’occasione giusta per accennarvi qualcosa sulle vicende narrate nel Ramayana .

All’interno dell’anfiteatro Purawisata a Yogyakarta abbiamo finalmente l’occasione di ammirare la storia, le movenze ed i pregevoli costumi dei figuranti.

Il Ramayana merita particolare attenzione perché, oltre a essere il più importante poema scritto in sanscrito, è stato ispiratore di innumerevoli opere d'arte, rappresentazioni teatrali e danze.

La trama del poema, seppur alquanto complessa, soprattutto per la mentalità e cultura occidentale, posso cercare di descriverla in maniera sintetica, ma ricordatevi che una intera rappresentazione può durare anche oltre 6 ore.

Alle 20.30 dunque, dopo una lauta cena, entriamo nell’anfiteatro per vedere lo spettacolo del Ramayana Ballet. Lo spettacolo dura poco più di 1 ora: la serata è calda, ma ventilata. Si sta benissimo rispetto al tempaccio di questa anomala estate milanese.

Barbara rimane beatamente estasiata ad ammirare i costumi che gli attori indossano, mentre IO vengono quasi ipnotizzato dal lento cadenzare della musica suonata dagli orchestranti di Gamelan.

Grazie al foglio informativo consegnatoci all’ingresso (ovviamente tradotto in inglese, francese, tedesco, giapponese, ma non italiano), che illustra la storia del Ramayana, tutto è più semplice rendendo divertente la recita: sappiamo in anticipo cosa succederà, così da permettere anche a Marina e Carlo di seguire le vicende epiche di Rama e Sita.

Ci divertiamo ad assistere alla recita anche grazie, non solo ai costumi, ma alle movenze degli attori, soprattutto a dei bambini che raffiguravano le dispettose scimmiette che nel corso della storia aiutano Rama a liberare Sita da Rawana.

Grande storia epica delle battaglie tra la giustizia e l'ingiustizia, che culminano nel "salvare" la bella prigioniera, cioè Sita.

D'altronde anche da noi per secoli le opere d'arte ritraevano quasi solo scene di storia sacra e immagini di valore e contenuto religioso, o poi dall'umanesimo anche scene da miti e leggende profane... con episodi e personaggi universalmente noti.
Been in Prambanan Temple before but first time seeing this performance. What a lovely performance! All dancers play their roles very well and Prambanan Temple as background makes it perfect.

Pertunjukan balet berbasiskan cerita wayang Ramayana yang dikemas dengan standar internasional dan teatrikal. Pertunjukan yang menunjukkan profesionalitas para pemainnya.  Dilengkapi dengan latar belakang landscape Candi Prambanan yang diberi pencahayaan yang menarik. Ditambah dengan beberapa kelas penonton yang menunjukkan posisi tempat duduk. Terakhir, diberikan panduan jalan cerita dalam berbagai bahasa; seperti Indonesia, Inggris, Prancis, Jerman, Cina, dan lainnya.
Minus : panggung outdoor, siapkan jaket atau mantel serta berdoa agar tidak hujan sebelum dan selama pertunjukan.
Himbauan: pastikan jadwal pertunjukan merupakan pertunjukan yang penuh atau full show, karena ada 2 versi pertunjukan, versi penuh dalam satu malam selesai atau versi potongan cerita dalam beberapa malam untuk selesai.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
