Review Text:
The setup comprises of a number of building set in what could be considered a square area. Though there is some walking to do, it is not too much.
The architecture of the buildings and the mannequins displaying the period costumes were about the best part of the visit.
Was rather disappointed to find that there were not many artifacts.
Also, rather disappointed with the upkeep: more could be done to restore/maintain the structures.
To benefit from the history of the place, it is necessary to engage a guide (they are available at the gate) as there is little in terms of descriptive plaques.

Visiting this palace with my friend and this   is one of our highlights to add on more knowledge and learning the social culture of java and of course enjoying few more activities inside this palace.. keep it up!

although it's not like I was used to go there around 18 years ago, but they added a room that we can see video that shown about some ceremony.
last 18 years ago, I sill have chance to saw and touched the room that king & queen's bed room, any plates, bowl and any interesting treasures, but right know you just can see the statues that using traditional cloth, 3 old cars, the pictures of kings
宮殿の複合施設で、影絵のショーをやったりとか、王関係の博物館がある。別に見る必要はないかな。10分あれば周り終わる。
Tiap ke jogja mampir ke keraton...tiap kali ke keraton tiket masuk naik terus...sayang kalo mahal nanti banyak orang tidak mau lagi datang...

Came here to see som culture, was not disappointed, mostly outdoors and very hot!
The guards were interesting to see.
The ladies making the Batik were amazing to watch. To walk the whole palace was only a few hours but well worth it.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Jogja memang gak asing..tapi semakin hari semakin maju banget ini berkat Raja yg arif banget dan mengerti akan rakyat jogja nya...
Tetap nyaman tinggal di jogja...

Tapi yg terpenting jangan lupa jogja punya kerajaan yg di sebut keraton....di sana bisa melihat foto para raja turun temurun sampai raja yg sekarang.

Ada kereta kencana berlapis emas

Kereta u pemakaman keluarga raja...gamelan...

Pokok nya sangat akan kangen ingin melihat kembali keraton....abdi dalem.yg menjadi gaet setiap pengunjung yg datang juga ramah banget...
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Bagus tempatnya, sayangnya terlalu banyak pedagang di luar pintu masuk kraton nya.. jadi makin sempit

Well coming from India, we are use to huge palaces and forts, so on that front its nothing extravagant but its important part of Indonesian history and is also linked with India as in past kings were Hindu and had learning from Indian men travelling the globe.

If your nearby and have time, one can visit it.

It will take 1-2 hours to visit all

The Palace is not a Palace as one would expect, at least what you are allowed to see. There is a large covered area with replicas, few tecas with historical costumes, few painting (?)/prints and/or pics of the rulers. A couple of American cars, two roosters in cage. The guide was friendly and nice but he also did not suggest we visit the attached museum, in short...not worth a visit. The nearby Water Palace is nothing extra ordinary but way better.
Great place to visit if you want to learn the history of Jogykarta. Very educational. Lots of local people visit here and only 10000 for entry.

Not much as palaces or museums go..more about the life and belongings of the 10th ruler. 
The gamelan performance is good.

C'est une visite incontournable , le royaume de Mataram la fondation de Yogyakarta , le rituel de Saparan en rapport les guerres javanaises ,le sultanat de son altesse HamengBuwono , les liens avec la deesse des mers du Sud Ny Rokh Kidul , tout est la approchez vous du Banyan sur l'alun alun vous serez la selon la mythologie javanaise au centre du monde
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Unfortunately this place is not kept well. What a pity that such a historical site is neglected. The only thing that was of any value were the various examples of royal era dressing.

Il Kraton, o palazzo reale, del sultano di Yoghiakarta, che tuttora ci abita, è una infinita sequenza di cortili, padiglioni e di edifici da visitare andando a caso senza guida, lasciandosi trasportare dalla curiosità e dalle casualità del percorso. simpatici venditori di oggetti tipici, spettacoli di musica e teatro, incontri e sale allestite con oggetti della corte, animeranno la vostra visita. Un modo facile per entrare in contatto con la cultura e la mentalita giavanese.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
現在もジョグジャカルタの王族が暮らす王宮「クラトン」。広間では曜日によってガムラン演奏やジャワ舞踊などが上演されています。金曜日は詞の朗読のようでした。
小さいですが博物館もあり、王宮の伝統文化を感じることができます。
One of the best memories of the past glory, history, culture and archetecture of the people living in that beautiful land. Not to miss.

Cocok apabila liburan bersama anak kita ajak ke keraton Jogja.
Ada nilai wisata sejarah sebab kita dan anak jadi tau sejarah berdirinya Keraton Jogja serta nama nama sultan yang pernah bertahta.
Mengetahui nama dan bangunan yang ada di keraton dengan di pandu oleh petugas.
Tiket murah pengetahuan bertambah.
selamat berkunjung.
マリオボロ通りを通り、取り敢えず往訪。子供連れな事もあったが、特に見るところもなく一周して終了。特別な興味が無ければ、微妙かも‥。
Makan siang di the house of raminten, makan malam gudeg tugu, minum di tugu cafe, mbak mie kadin, makan es gelato tempoe dulu
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Visited the Sultan’s Palace as a part of our tour. Well worthwhile and we were so lucky with our lovely guide Sri. The gamelan music and dancing were highlights.

Actually there are so many nice tourism destination Jogja can offered. But unfortunately most of them, and the city itself, need to be more maintenance bt the government because most of them looked  gloomy, unorganized and dirty. For example, the Sultan palace and Tamansari pool. I think if these places get more proper maintenance, more cleaner and well painted, I'm pretty sure it will be more interesting. And also, too many souvenir street vendors everywhere. Why don't Jogja learn from Bali to manage their tourism?

this is great place, it presents so many dresses, pictures, but it is like only the terrace...the real palace is the middle one...near to Museum Kereta Keraton..so after you visit this place, you can walk along the street beside this place, visit the Museum Kereta Keraton, continue to the middle palace (must visit) and Taman Sari...
Eine Palastanlage der anderen Art: nicht sehr gross aber mit Charme. Und, hier lebt noch ein Sultan. Malerischer Platz, inclusive der Wachen mit ihren Dolchen und ihrer altehrwürdigen Tracht
Actually there is nothing much to see inside the palace, as not all the place is opened to public, but the architecture of the building is beautiful.

The entrance tickets include a tour guide to the palace. The tour guide will explain briefly the display in the palace. But our tour guide only interested to quickly bring us through partial of the building then lead us to the "Royal batik school" 200m away from palace. The "school" sells batik artwork and they are trying to ask us to buy the batik.
Too short time at the palace and don't evening have enough time to take photo. Besides, we have to pay additional Rp2000 if we carrying phone camera

Ci rechiamo al palazzo del Sultano, troviamo una guida ufficiale che parla molto bene inglese ed è preparatissima. All'ingresso possiamo ammirare un concerto tradizionale. Iniziamo la visita vera e propria, ma purtroppo una buona parte del palazzo è in rinnovamento. Peccato, ci rimane un po' d'amaro in bocca. Comunque val bene una visita.

A must see when in Yogyakarta, but there’s not a ton to see in the building. The main attraction and what makes it worthwhile is the gamelan performances and native dancing. Really soothing and beautiful. Check out the times for the performances before you go.
If you want to know the history of Yogyakarta and what distinguishes this region from the rest of Indonesia then this place is worth the visit.

Was a bit underwhelmed with this specific tourist site. It is fine to visit first thing in the morning, then the water castle/Tamansari before heading off to Prambanan temple. I would not go out of my way to see this place specifically.

クラトンまでタクシーで行けばよかったのにいつも歩くので距離を見て歩きました。
王宮の中は灰色の砂が敷き詰められていて、日本の神社のように歩き難かったです。
色々な部屋があり、覗きながら歩いていたら足裏をマッサージしているおじさんがいました。
入り口にガイドをしてくれる人がいましたが、私たちが日本人だからか声をかけられませんでした。
Berwisata ke Keraton Yogyakarta adalah hal yang amat menarik, karena kita menjadi menerawang masa lalu yang penuh kedamaian dengan kearifan lokal yang membanggakan indonesia

I know its a cheap price to get in (like 1 $CAD for 2 adults), but just don't visit this place, it sucks. Even just strolling by is unpleasant because of all the taxis and people selling crap to white people. Avoid it.
While visiting the city it's good to pop in, though it is not overwhelming. Only 25% is accessible for public.

Visit the Keraton in the middle of the day which is freakin’ hot, the guide was informative and talkative, really fun having all those knowledge about the Yogya Royals. 

Tips: ask for a guide! Give them tips because they deserve it. The guide will give you information and you can ask anything you want (as long as its related with the kingdom)
Warisan nusantara yang perlu dijaga keasliannya, dimana kita juga penting untuk menghormati dan melestarikan budaya jawa yang sudah mulai langka di jaman modern ini.

王族のドレスや日用品など様々なものが展示されています。入場するとスタッフの方に話しかけられガイドはいらないか？と聞かれました。最初、いらないと答えたのですが、無料だよと言われたのでお願いすることに。
英語なので半分くらいしかわかりませんでしたが、詳しく解説してくれました。
Schöner Palast mit einigen Erläuterungen. Als wir da waren (Sonntag), wurde auch eine Parade Übung von verschiedenen Gruppen durchgeführt.
Sober paleis. Hadden wat meer grandeur verwacht. Rondleiding door museum niet erg informatief, gids niet erg gemotiveerd

Tempat bersejarah di jogja. Seperti nya memang banyak museum dijogja yang menyimpan barang barang yang sangat unik dan memiliki nilai sejarah yg tinggi. Yang paling bikin betah tempatnya bersih dan asri
Mieux à faire ailleurs Réservez vous pour les temples de Prebanan et Borubodur Attention ferme à 13h30
热，然后实在没什么好看的，如果不是对这个实在兴趣大的不行的话，还是不要去了。。对面的博物馆倒还不错。实在想不起来里面印象深刻点了，可能都是遗迹了

Good and quick visit.
The typical dance are nice and included in the entrance ticket.
It in the centre of the city

Auf dem Rückweg von der Tempelanlage Prambanan haben wir einen Stop am Sultanpalast eingelegt. Nachdem man über einen großen Innenhof gegangen ist, wurden wir von einer Führerin in Empfang genommen, die uns durch verschiedene Räumlichkeiten führte, in denen eine Auswahl an verschiedenen Geschenken anderer Staaten ausgestellt waren. Die Informationen dazu beschränkten sich dann entsprechend auf  "das ist dies-und-das von xy". Zur Geschichte Yogyakartas, der Sultanfamilie oder dem Palast haben wir nichts erfahren. So blieb die Führung genauso unspannend, wie es auch die Ausstellungsstücke waren. Zumindest solange man kein enthusiastischer Porzellanliebhaber ist. Insgesamt ein netter Reiseplanfüller, mehr aber auch nicht.

現在もジョグジャカルタのスルタンが暮らす宮殿の一部が公開されています。
敷地内には、ジャワ伝統建築の建物が並び、その一部は博物館となっていて歴代スルタンの調度品や衣類、海外からの献上品などが展示されています。
また、私たちが訪問した時間には儀式の間でガムランが演奏されていました。
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: lots of artifacts but little english explanation. artifacts not well maintained hence the place looks like old junkstore. for the cheap ticket considered very worthwhile
op bezoek in Yogyakarta het paleis bezocht. viel een beetje tegen, was meer een uitstalling van wat er allemaal aan persoonlijke bezittingen aanwezig was. een beetje overdreven

그늘 아래만 시원하지 딱히 볼 것이 없습니다.
그나마 영어 가이드를 대동하면 괜찮을 거에요.
그냥 가면 인니어로만 설명이 되어있어 무엇인지 잘 모르겠는...
가이드를 꼭 대동하십시오

We hired a private guide to take us round Yogyakarta highlights. The first stop was Kraton Palace which is called Yogyakarta Palace on TripAdvisor, they are in fact one of the same.
It was explained in detail the history of the Place and the ten Sultans that have lived there. An interesting tour.
Kedua kalinya kesini, gak ada perubahan sii, masih bersih, asri, tenang, so far so good sih, good job!

I walked around this palace not really a worthwhile place to see. Only good thing is the cheap price to get in. Then people will try to take you to a batik shop. Which I decided to look at when I went outside. Nice paintings but I'm not interested in buying and you will need to bargain if you want one. One thing about this city I'm sick of is these touts all over town trying to drag me into these Batik shops. Even in a royal palace you are not safe from them.
Bangga bisa wisata kesini, banyak sejarah tentang sultan hangkebuono, kemudian ada diorama macam macam upacara adat, barang barang sejarah, tiketnya juga murah. Berkesan sekali

Nice budget place to visit. Cheap ticket IDR 7500 for locals and IDR 15,000 for foreigners. Additional IDR1000 for taking photos with your camera. Old palace building suitable for those who are interested in history. They have free tour guide to bring you along to explain to you. Just have to give them a small tips upon completion.
grabであっちだと指差された方向に歩くと，周りの人に入り口はあちらと教えてもらったところに入場しましたが，手前にあるのは北宮です．こちらは正直見るものはほぼなく，すぐに出て左に行った所にある南宮へ．入り口でよく写真で見るカーラが出迎えてくれ，ちょうどガムランの演奏が行われていました．王宮内は帽子はだめ．庭でもかぶってはいけないと注意されました．

Vale un po' lo stesso discorso fatto per il Castello dell'acqua: noi occidentali siamo ben abituati coi palazzi reali quindi il palazzo del Sultano può risultare per certi aspetti deludente.
Alcuni ambienti belli e curati ci sono, spesso si possono vedere anche processioni e persone che suonano, sicuramente non c'è la ricercatezza e la bellezza della nostra architettura. Ci sono molte stanze con i cimeli della vita del sultano e sulla sua figura, non mi è sembrata particolarmente interessante.

This palace is actively used by the sultan as his residence. So most parts of the palace are closed. If you are lucky, you might catch the dance performances at the courtyard. we went on a Sunday morning and we caught it around 11AM. There is another courtyard behind where there is another group practicing. Thats free to watch as well. There are small museum like buildings showcasing clothes, utensils used by the sultan. But most things are written in jawanese/ Indonesian with no English translations. So without a guide you may not understand much.

The palace itself is fairly interesting. I wouldn't recommend if you are hard pressed for time.
ガイドの運転手さんのお勧めでしたが、正直今一つでした。一通り見学し、王宮の歴史は勉強になりましたが、丁度修学旅行のような学生が多々おり、落ち着いてみれませんでした。演奏時間も外してしまいちょっと残念！

Visiting this palace of the sultan was part of a city tour, otherwise I probably wouldn’t have found it. The palace itself is more like a small village containing a couple of different buildings. The main house of the sultan is not open for visitors but the majority of the other buildings are. Make sure you have a guide to explain the history, property and other facts you might otherwise miss out on

Keraton Yogyakarta, kalo kesini harus pakai guide yang merangkap abdi dalam disini. Semua akan dijelaskan, dan jika ira bertanya pasti akan dijawab. Setiap yang ada di keraton memiliki detail yang tidak sembarangan. Sri sultan hamengkubuwono I yang membuat keraton benar benar memikirkan semuanya hingga keturunannya yang sekarang. Ingat sejarah bahwa Yogya dengan ikhlasnya memberikan apbn pertama bagi Indonesia di masa kemerdekaan.

Interesting info provided and many nice displays 
The “ palace” could do with a serious renovation and clean up. The museum is “old style” and not interactive which is a pity
All said and done still enjoyed the glimpse into another world

Bij de tour die we geboekt hadden zijn we ook bij het Sultan paleis geweest, de driver heeft kaartjes voor ons gekocht en ook een gids geregeld, zonder gids mis je de details en zit je alleen maar naar foto’s en voorwerpen te kijken. We hadden een zeer leuke Indonesische mevrouw die goed en rustig engels sprak en super goed alles kon uitleggen en nam ook rustig de tijd voor alle uitleg.
Een aanrader in de stad.

I believe the section opens to the public is only the front court yard of the palace.It is not well maintained. Just a few empty pavilions and one-storey buildings with photo displays of past and present royal family and 2 old cars of the sultan. Not worth the time to make a special trip for it unless you have time to spare.

The overall area/compound is massive. Being inside it is enough to understand the Javanese culture. Considering the area is big, it is not enough to visit all the sites in a day. Overall, it is a great place to visit
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: 想像より広く、移動が面倒だった。王宮というので過度な期待をしてしまっていた。  展示は色々あったので興味深かった。演奏などしている時間帯を狙っていけばもっと楽しめたと思う。

Actualmente tiene zonas en restauracion. Tiene distintas estancias donde ver vestimentas tipicas balinesas, mobiliario y antiguedades. Lo mas interesante la exposicion de batik, donde puedes ver a unas mujeres como confeccionan estas prendas. Curioso ver a los empleados con sus vestimentas tipicas de yogyakarta.

Well worth the visit to see how the Yogyakarta royal family lived, or even lives, today. The palace is small so easy to do in a morning, but make sure you visit the less well known leisure palace which is quite beautiful, a very short drive from the palace. Informative guide.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: L'antico palazzo in cui hanno vissuto il re e la sua famiglia, centro della cultura giavanese, costruito alla metà del settecento , si sviluppa su un solo piano occupando una vasta area della città , diviso in due aree : il padiglione d'orato e il castello d'acqua.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
È la sede del sultano regnante di Yogyakarta e della sua famiglia
Forse perchè eravamo atterrati da poche ore e quindi ancora con la stanchezza del volo ed il jet-lag, forse perchè la giornata era grigia, ma non mi è piaciuto molto, l'ho trovato piuttosto insignificante, a parte il padiglione principale con bellissimo pavimento e soffitto.

Entrée 1 dollars 💵 soit 15000 roupies 
Pour celui qui a l habitude de voyager , il dira rien d exceptionnel .
Quelques pièces avec des vieux vêtements , du vieux matériel , des verres etc ... 
Des statues .
A faire mais très loin d être un incontournable. 
Le temple ferme à 15 h tout les jours sauf le vendredi à 13 h

Interesting place and cheap to go and local guide will be provided at no cost to us. The funny talking lady guide made the history more interesting about their royal family background. Of course you will also get to know the ancestory of royal family at ullen museum but it is a bit far from jogya

Nice place to visit. The guided tour was very good. Schedule about hour to hour and half. Lots of artifacts. 

Recommended!

Met onze 3 kids hier geweest (entree 10 k Idr p/p). Wel een kleding voorschrift...geen hoofdbedekking en mannen mogen niet zichtbaar een singlet aan. In het Paleis zie je een en al foto’s van de huidige en vorige Sultans van Jogyakarta.  Zelfverheerlijking.  Niet mijn ding en de kids hielden het na een kwartier voor gezien. Ach...leer je toch iets over de geschiedenis van yogjakarta
入口が北側と南側の二つに分かれており、中ではつながっていないので、両方見るには一回出る必要があります。現在も、実業家としてのようですが、スルタンがいて王宮横に住んでいると聞いて驚きました。南側の方が、ワヤンクリ（影絵）やスルタンの楽団の演奏が楽しめて良かったです。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It is nice to see but not very impressive. Be aware of people who will point you to the batik school. They will guide you into a shop where they want to sell you something. There is NO batik school nore museum in Jokja!! Do not let them fool you....

Or you pay for a tour guide or you will wonder around the place without really enjoying it, as you won't really know what it is all about. The explanation is all in Indonesian and no English. The palace itself is enormous 1km square. The pieces on display are nice and we'll preserved. It helps you to understand their history a bit better. But just sad that I didn't get everything out of it that I wanted.

Part of our second day tour, very cool history lesson provided by our excellent guide. Interesting points of view and several spots for photos.  There were also some shops within the pace that produced local art and goods which were rather nice.

Ok place with some interesting elements but will take just over 30mins to wander round.
Interesting display of outfits and gamelan instruments as well as images of how things have changed in the different reigning Sultan’s.  
7k each to get in plus 2k for a photo permit.

Location is incorrect on TripAdvisor - this is  further south - check google maps
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It's king's palace. You can see the history from the first king until now history and name. There are also a parade of showing cultural events. It's still a palace where the King stay.
Ok to visit. Expected a little more. It takes about 40 in to visit the whole place. Not much to see. A private guide will provide additional information that may enhance your experience.

Cette visite nous a semble personnellement n offrir aucun interêt. Ne vaut selon nous pas le détour. Les bassins d eaux du sultan sont plus sympas à voir. Peu de choses à voir, triste bâtiment avec quelques costumes, deux voitures de collection vétustes, quelques coqs en cage, quelques bas reliefs.

During my last visit here 25 years ago, there was a Ramayana performance on the palace grounds that was permanently etched in my memory. Commercial Ramayana performances in Bali could not compare with this authentic experience. Sadly, the grounds were empty during my recent visit. There is little to see and you can be done in less than 30 minutes.

Dieser Palace vom Sultan ist unterschiedlich geliedert; einerseits wohnt er dort auf der anderen Seite gibt es dort viele Räume für offizielle Treffen etc. Es ist auch die Historie sehr gut ausgestellt

È un bel palazzo del sultano di Java, la guida italiana che ci è capitata era una vecchina simpaticissima. Storia spiegata molto bene, forse un po' troppo incentrata sulla figura del sultano e meno sul palazzo.

As many said, it was a sad, horrible place to be. Nothing to see except quite a few cages in hot sun with one rooster in each with no water or food, simply suffering. Crumbling, relatively new buildings with used pots and pans and fading photos. It was very cheap to enter (about 0.50 USD) and that was possibly the only positive aspect.
Keraton yogjakarta yang berada ditengah kota, mempunyai daya tarik tersendiri, dengan bangganya kami memperkenalkan sejarah pada anak2

Es un lugar interesante, amplio, con mucha historia, fotografías y atuendos de sultantes anteriores; historias exclusivas de sus costumbres. Disfrutamos del show de marionetas, típico de la región; vimos un salon muy lujoso, con lampara de swaroski; le hace falta aseo, hay mucho polvo.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
It is very interesting spot in Jogyakarta to be visited.
I really suggest if you visit this place please using voluntarary guide who can explain clearly and completely about the content and the meaning of this spot.
After finishing you can give the guide small money e.g.AUD 5.00 as a token/gift.
There is no rule for the amount at all,it is really based on our kindness
One of the main attractions in the city center. Admission is around IDR 15.000,00. The vibe is cool and the palace is good to wander around.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Merece la pena ver pero esta bastante dejado y hay mucha suciedad pero como digo merece la pena. Saludos viajeros
とても広い宮殿ですが、掃除が行き届いていて、とても綺麗でした。入場料の他に、写真撮影をする場合、追加料金が発生します。中の施設には多くの展示品が飾られていて、見るだけでも、結構な時間がかかります。私たちが行った時は、ちょうど、音楽の演奏がされていました。
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Esperienza poco entusiasmante. Veramente poco da vedere. Qualche foto di carrozza, e un paio di cadillac.

宿泊したHotel Tentremから南へ、電車の踏切を越え、繁華街のマリオボロ通りを通って約40分程歩いた先の広場の奥に有りました
塀やゲートは有る物の警備は特にされて居らず、王宮と言われてもぴんとは来なかった。

Jasa angkut dan pengiriman barang dalam kota dan luar kota "FICH TRANSPORT JOGJA" melayani berbagai pengiriman barang:

Melayani dengan sepenuh hati.
Only a small part of the palace is open to visitors. But for such a small entrance fee (about US$1), it is definitely worth a visit and to cross off the bucket list.

Interesting architecture and culture. Various gifts from all over the world presented to the sultan were on display. Intricate Batik were also on display. Do note that you are not allowed to take photos of the Batik that is used by the sultan. Quick and enjoyable tour. There is also a traditional javanese live music at the end of the tour.
Experience Jogja's unique heritage in Keraton, or castle. It stores many history of Jogja's monarchy since the 1st generation. Very good for educational trips with your young ones.

It was so bad that is was so sad. There’s nothing to see except for a few old buildings. Indoor is very stuffy. Old pots, ceremonial stuff, and shirts. Do yourself a favour and give it a miss. It was so bad that I didn’t take any photos.
No vi nada interesante, creo que cada vez están restringiendo más los lugares de visita. No volvería.

I expected more from this. The two cars at the entrance were nice, but the rest was poorly maintained. If you have limited time to spend in Yogyakarta, I suggest to skip the palace and move directly to the watercastle which is very close.

Make no mistake about it, the palace is interesting and for most people it is definitely worth seeing. However, if you are able to do it on your own - go for it. As a group we had to have a palace guide, our own guide was not allowed to guide us.
The local guide was a sweet man in an interesting costume. He probably knew the history well, but he was especially focused on the line of ruling sultans that had lived there, their children, numerous important years, as well as exact measurements of ‘every object’ in the palace. Our group members strayed to observe what they were interested. We did not even get to visit the gift shop. It was hot, it was slow, it was boring- it was painful.

Leuk om hier geweest te zijn maar het ging meer om het idee dan dat er daadwerkelijk bijzondere dingen te zien waren. Een paar vrijwel lege ruimtes, een paar oude auto's. Wellicht waren er ruimtes niet voor bezichting toegankelijk in verband met de ramadan of zoiets dergelijks? Anyway, had er wat meer van verwacht.
It's a nice and peaceful place to visit. A guide is okay, but don't expect too much. As there is not too much to see in Yogyakarta you can just walk in and enjoy the silence.

I visited Yogyakarta when I was in high-school. Since then, Yogyakarta had changed, and history had been written. The King's Palace had shown how old is the city. The culture remains and history continues adding for more years coming. Our tour guide was amazing. He explained well of the history of Yogyakarta. Makes me appreciate more and proud being part of Javanese culture.

Groot complex met ruimtes waarin je niet mag komen, waarin je wel mag komen zijn ingericht als museum, waarin veel te zien is over sultan 8 en sultan 9. Rondleiding door een gids is facultatief, maar wel aan te bevelen.

Prachtig gebouw. De mevrouw die ons over het gebouw  en de gebruiken vertelde,waren erg interessant.
Zeker de moeite waard.
Goed bereikbaar en erg vriendelijke mensen.
Niet een heel bijzonder paleis. Niet echt schoon, een paar museum gebouwen en een Nederlandse gids. Niet een paleis om extra voor om te rijden.
Heel mooi paleis, je ziet nog heel veel pracht en praal van vroeger ! De gids, plaatselijke, wist alles goed te vertellen. Er zou alleen eens grondig gepoetst moeten worden !

To get to the inner palace proper you need to find the correct entrance which is located at a side street near the Clock Monument (Tugu Jam). Set this as your destination if you are using Grab or Gojek to book a car. If you set Keraton as your destination you will end up at the entrance near the North Alun Alun which doesn't lead you to the inner palace and museum.

Once you get pass the archway there is a building on the right where you can find a palace guide collecting Rp 15000 per visitor for admission and Rp 1000 per camera. Ask for a guide which is free though donation is highly encouraged, which is well worth the money because these guides are palace staff and they are well versed with the history and architecture of the palace. Beware of touts trying to get you to go for a ride around the palace ground with them.

The palace is quite small but give an interesting background of the Sultanate which remains the center of Javanese political and cultural identity and well respected by people in Jogja region.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Nice palace with some rooms displaying items of historical significance. We visited with our own guide but if you don't have 1, there're many on standby outside the palace you can hire. Not a very large place, so a short visit will suffice.

كان القصر يستخدم لإقامة القصر الملكي. الآن تحولت إلى متحف. كان من المثير للاهتمام أن نرى كيف تبدو التصميمات الداخلية للمبنى الملكي السابق ونقدر العمارة الإندونيسية. لا شيء خاص ، وإذا كان لديك القليل من الوقت لمشاهدة معالم المدينة ، فمن الممكن أن تفوت فرصة زيارة القصر.

Der vordere Krönungspalast mit angeschlossenem "Kutschenmuseum" (ein Raum mit 10 Fotos) ist absolut uninteressant. Es werden Kleidungsstücke ausgestellt und man sieht zwei Autos.
Dieser Teil befindet sich direkt hinter dem großen Rasenplatz, der auf einigen Bildern zu sehen ist.

Wenn man dann allerdings um das Gebäude herum geht, darf man nochmal Löhnen und sieht die weiteren Gebäude und Ausstellungsstücke des Palastes. Mitsamt schönem Innenhof, Bildern, ausgestellten Batiken und alten Möbeln.

Hier gibt es tatsächlich dann auch Beschreibungen auf Englisch und man kann sich einige Zeit hier aufhalten.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: 从酒店打了的士过去，进去不仅要买门票，每部相机还要买2000idr的门票才能拍照。里面没什么看的， 一会就出来了。 原来想走去水宫，没想到在后面看到一景点。一问，这 也是皇宫。于是又买人机门票进去，里面的东西更像皇宫。到现在也没搞清两者的关系，也没兴趣去搞清楚。

Yogyakarta merupakan salah satu kota dengan banyak peninggalan warisan budaya di Indonesia. Berkunjung ke Kraton Yogyakarta merupakan hal yang wajib jika kita berwisata di kota ini dan kurang lengkap tanpa singgah di tempat ini. Keraton Yogyakarta merupakan tempat tinggal Sultan dan tempat diadakan upacara adat khas Jawa. Tempat ini terdapat koleksi lukisan anggota keluarga, gamelan beserta perabotan lainnya. Kita dapat belajar sejarah dan ragam budaya yang luar biasa. Sangat menyenangkan berkunjung ke tempat ini.

Budaya dan tradisi yang masih tetap terjaga di era modern. Suasana nyaman dan tenang sangat terasa ketika memasuki lingkungan keraton.serasa kembali ke masa lalu, ketika pemandu menceritakan bagaimana kehidupan para raja-raja yang bertahta dan berbagai peninggalannya.

Wir haben mehr erwartet und waren deshalb von der Fuehrung im Palast etwas enttaeuscht. Ausser, dass der Palast von Schulen besucht wird, hat es auch nicht besonders viele Besucher. Die ganze Fuehrung wurde auch auf ein minimum reduziert, man braucht hoechstens 15. Min. um das ganze anzusehen.

A place to learn a little more about the history of Yogyakarta. Not what I expected, as it is more a museum than access to the palace. Strongly suggest getting a guide, as  there is no way to learn about what you are seeing. Our guide definitely added to our experience. 
Additional payment, to entry ticket, is charged for taking photographs.
After the tour, our guide took us to see ' how batik is made'. The shop spent 2 mins talking about batik making and moved to a hard sell of the merchandise. You are taken through a maze to get to the shop (hard to find your way out on your own), so if not interested, tell so to the guide as soon as you finish the tour.
Wandered round the Palace after strolling along Jalan Malioboro.  Pleasant place on a hot day, though nothing particularly memorable.

Since this is still in use today it is in perfect condition. It is really important to get a guide because without one you will not understand what you are seeing. The guides are free it’s a donation only. There is music and a dance program almost everyday from 10 am till noon.
There are several museums that are interesting. 
Including gifts received from foreign nations and a batik museum.

Whilst I’m sure this place is revered by locals sadly we found it lacking. We hired a guide inside the palace which gave additional information but there was very little to see. Sadly I wouldn’t recommend a visit.
Disini Kita dapat mengetahui proses pembutaan keris, sejarah sejarah Jawa Dan kebudayaan, tiket masuknya juga murah

An interesting place to spend an hour or so, but limited information boards in English meant that there wasn't a story to tell about the sultan and his influence (or lack of?) In the special administrative area of Yogyakarta.

The buildings are pleasant enough and the entrance fee (IDR 15k) was good value.

Palace sits on a large plot of land and portion of it is in use by the ruler. Very open and airy design and simple construction. Large area for viewing music and dance performances. Definitely worth a visit.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Another disappointment visit. 
I was expecting to see a lavish and royal Palace fit for a King, but it was sad and empty.

We paid 7000IDR per person. There was a guide, but to be honest I don’t quite understand what he was saying especially at the start. He kept on insisting to take photos, which I’m not keen much. 

At the end, he brought us to a batik store about 5 minutes from the Palace. I supposed he gets something from the store owner if the people he brings buy there.

After a long walk to the end of Malioboro street, you will find Kraton, the sultan's palace. You enter from the side entrance paying 7000rph with a free tour guide. 

The area is wide but there is not much to it. There are some rooms(gamelan room, classrooms) which are almost empty, Even the guide ran out of things to discuss with us. If not for the sudden rain showers, we would've exited after 10 minutes.

After the tour, the guide brought us to a batik house after passing alleyways just to sell us souvenir items. It is fine at that moment as we haven't bought something to bring back home. I just don't feel like it is a nice way of selling your goods.

The hotel I stayed has more historical items on display than this palace. Seriously!
Nothing really interesting, a lot of school kids visiting but there is nothing really to see worth going there.

Another major disappointment! I was expecting a royal palace presenting similar opulence to the one in Bangkok or Phnom Penh but what I saw was a sad, grey, dirty, rundown place that used to be a symbol of sultan glory. I would never go there again but the quality of this place is similar to the Water Castel and this is Yogya not Bali. The guide was sadly incomprehensible. Bad experience.
Als je even cultuur wilt opsnuiven, dan moet je hierheen met een gids. De gids kan je alles laten over het Sulanaat en op zondag is er vanaf 11u een Javaans optreden (gratis) te zien

人力車ベチャで行きました。入口がわかりにくかったです。
チケットはカメラのチケットも必要でした。
いまもスルタンの子孫の方が住んでいるとのことで、敷地がとても広く、炎天下の中、点在する建物を見て回るのは大変でした。王族が使った日用品、食器、家具、衣装、馬具などが展示されていました。
宮廷の踊りが行われるので、時間を調べていくといいです。私が行った時は11時からでした。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: tempat yang sangat klasik, jawa banget...jaraknya gak seberapa jauh sama malioboro...paling enak kesana sore2 sih...gak seberapa panas

It feels a bit mean being less than enthusiastic about a Presidential Palace (as I understand it the President of Indonesia is automatically the Sultan of Yogiakarta  -  probably got that wrong) however, it has to be said that there is not a huge amount here.  
Having fought our way through the wild circus of street hawkers around the entrance there's a pretty impressive puppet theatre which we were encouraged to sit down in front of and, after twenty minutes of inactivity encouraged to move on again (presumably for the second house), the Sultans kitchens and ....... that's about it.
Oh yeah, there's a very British looking bandstand.  Evidently the current Sultan enjoys a bit of jazz and blues of an evening according to our guide.
Pleasant enough but not a lot to detain you for long.  Perhaps there are important parts that we missed.
日惹的蘇丹皇宮確實保留了很多古物，見證了歷史與文化的傳承。從整個展示間可以看到近代皇室的興衰與世界的接軌。當然也看的到與中華文化的交流，算是規劃較好，保存維護較佳的博物館。

Most people check out the Yogyakarta Palace to understand more about local culture. The place has been maintained nicely, with puppet show just after the entrance. The different sections show different era and artifacts. Make sure you have towel and bottled water with you because the place is pretty hot especially at noon.

Wisata budaya kesultanan yogyakarta yang murah meriah, bayar tiket masuknya cuma 5.000/orang, ditambah 2000 untuk foto dari hp/kamera. Ada tambahan lagi jika pakai pemandu yang akan menerangkan setiap sudut keraton. Suasananya berasa kembali ke tempo dulu, bangunanya sudah tua dan kurang terawat.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: As pointed out by others here, there isn’t really much in this “palace”. As long as you go with suitably lowered expectations it’s a pleasant way to spend an hour. Just a couple of rooms of dusty photographs, an area where the coronation took place (but couldn’t even muster up a copy of the throne) and a couple of cool cars the Sultan drove around in in the 1960’s. The guide is included in the Rp7000 entrance fee which is a bargain. Our guide was pleasant but had little real information to impart. At the end he led us out of the palace and down a narrow alleyway to a house selling batik wares. All included in the palace entrance fee he had told us at the start of the tour. At the batik house they went through the theatre of inspecting our tickets carefully before proceeding to try and sell us batik pictures. As we left someone else popped up and offered to give us a tour of “the second palace”. We politely declined and made our exit.

Visiting Jogja always arouses enthusiasm, because in this city there is still complete remaining how a kingdom is run. Buildings may be eternal, but the most memorable is culture and humanity that still exist until the 21st century, a legacy that is very valuable to human beings, both now and in the future.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Keraton Yogyakarta adalah tempat yang menarik untuk dikunjungi. Kita dapat mengetahui sejarah dan pengetahuan tentang Yogyakarta. Tempat nya mudah untuk dijangkau karena dekat dengan malioboro. Tempat ini sangat luas dan menarik untuk dikunjungi.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Der freie Zugang zu den Räumen die als Museum ausgewählt wurden ist limitiert.
Die Ausstellungsstücke könnten besser beleuchtet werden.
Als Attraktion hat man ein Restaurant im Annex etabliert, Buffetstyle. Sehr vorsichtig zu genießen.

Wij hebben een rondleiding met een Engels sprekend gids gedaan’ hierdoor krijg je veel meer van de historische mee en zeker van de Nederlandse invloeden. 
Ook de muziek en welkomst dans vonden wij mooi.

My husband and I had read the reviews on Trip Advisor and knew that this wasn't going to be the most amazing site we've seen. The reviews here are pretty accurate. There's not much information in the actual palace so there's not much context to what you are wandering around looking at. 

However, there are shows held for about two hours every day. Some days there's a wooden puppet show, others are shadow puppets, I also saw dancing on the schedule. We went specifically to see the wooden puppets. That was a great experience. The music was really enjoyable to listen to and had instruments we had not seen before.

Mengisi waktu luang menunggu waktu keberangkatan ,jalan pulang ke rumah .saat itu dari Cilacap menumpang kereta pagi menuju Yogya,rencana dari Yogyakarta naik pesawatmenuju Makasar ,sambil menunggu waktu keberangkatan ,saya sempatkan diri untuk jalan jalan sepanjang Malioboro ,dan belanja berbagai sovenir dan kueh pia yang terkenal di Yogya ,dan berkesempatan mengunjungi candi Prambanan ,yang sangat fantastis

A ridiculous obstacle course of liars, scammers and con artists who will lead you to the wrong entrance and then try to sell you overpriced batik sold by their mates. Taxi drivers also in on it. Still no idea whether I saw the real palace or not and if not what I actually paid to see. Indonesian authorities need to sort this out if they want people to ever come back/recommend it to others.
A bit disappointed- no grandeur. I would not go there again. There are loads of vendors outside trying to sell stuff. Bargain hard

In front of the Sultan Palace (Kraton) of Yogyakarta is a field of grass and cobberstone ground . Along the way , under the shady Banyan trees, street peddlers and hawker stalls go about doing their business.

As we enter into the Palace, we took a pamphlet which illustrate in both Indonesian & English language on this  complex . Inside the Kraton, it has a series of luxurious halls, spacious courtyards and pavilions.  

At the hall , on the fine marble floor are displayed of vintage cars, inside the museums are gamelan instruments, old horse drawn carriages, the royal family tree including old photographs of grand mass weddings & portraits of former sultans of Yogyakarta. Beside this, there is a special memorial museum dedicated to the last sultan of Yogyakarta with display of his photographs and personal effects.

Its interesting to see old traditional costumes housed inside a pavilion which has top roof separated from the bottom. It is said this is a museum for traditional fashion show. This building was formerly used as the waiting hall for warlords to report or receive orders from the Sultan.  

This Kraton has daily performance included in the entrance ticket price to keep visitors entertained starting from 10am.

The Palace is only partly opened to the public, as the other part of the palace is still being occupied by the royal family. From every artwork & artifact displayed , the  living museum that honors its Royal line & history, even though the Sultan Palace did not inspire much , it is certainly a time well spent to understand Javanese Culture and the royal lineage of Yogyakarta !!!!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Our guide had bad breath & it was like he was regugitating his script. Zero descriptions in English, after 5 mins my friends & I wanted to leave already. Bad lighting & stuffy rooms did not help its case. It was a total waste of time.

Deze residentie van de sultan bezocht. We zijn met een gids rondgeleid welke in rap jengels uitleg gegeven heeft over het tentoongestelde. Poppen met de juiste kledij. Verder waren de gebouwen leeg met foto’s wat de sultan allemaal in het bezit had gehad. De troon in het midden was het enigste zichtbare stuk.
Interesting but not outstanding . Guide was helpful. Interesting learning about role of sultan. Hall of gifts was interesting

The sultans palace consists of a number of low rise buildings. The buildings themselves are moderately interesting being a mixture of javanese style architecture and Dutch touches.
The artefacts on display relate to the current sultan's father and are probably not so interesting to western eyes as they consist of a lot of western items (eg his interest in cameras or horse riding) or rooms of gifts he received from overseas (a lot of porcelain etc).
For many Indonesians, however, given the key role he played at the time of Independence in 1940s and subsequent political life, they regard the whole place with extreme reverence.
It is place you will probably go to if you visiting the tourist sites in Yogyarkta, it has its own place in Indonesia history, but do not expect a "palace".

Fui al palacio del sultán con mi guía de habla hispana, se llama Oriza. Si quieren hacer tour con ella, pueden enviarla mensaje por WhatsApp: +6281223344831. Es una gran guía, amable y simpática. Le gusta mucho la cultura de america latina, si eres latino/a merece la pena conocerla. Les aconsejo visitar Palacio del sultán en domingo a las 10 0 11 de la mañana. Porque cada domingo hay baile tradicional muy chévere. 
Saludos desde Colombia.

丁度良いタイミングだったのか、それとも何時ものことなのかわかりませんが、訪問時にガムラン演奏が行われていました。時間の関係でゆっくり座りながら演奏を楽しむことは出来ませんでしたが、そこそこの観光客はガムランの調べに聞きほれていました。ここでは王族の所有している宝物なども展示されていますが、やはり昔はオランダの植民地であったためか、それに関連しているものが多いように思われました。古都、ジョグジャカルタの雰囲気を知るには良い場所かと思います。
The monument is still in excellent condition. The crowd in and around is awesome. The grass park and fast food restaurants add to the glory.
Ada beberapa tempat berbentuk rumah untuk kita singgahi dan melihat budaya-budaya Keraton Yogyakarta.Ada gamelan, patung2, dll.

For a palace we really weren't amazed, while our guide was not as helpful as could be (clearly mainly after tips - and seemingly obsessed with repeating several key facts over and over). The price is not expensive and if you're in Yogyakarta do see it, however, you won't leave awed by the experience.

- rich in history
- this palace is known as a place of the sultan of Jogja
-  rich in authentic culture of jogja with hospitality as part of the daily manner
- this is a must place to visit in jogja
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
歴史好きな私は妻と訪問しました。私が写真を撮るため妻と離れた際に、妻は足が悪いので他の訪問客と同じくある建物の床に腰掛けていました。そこは座ってはいけなかった処らしく係員に排除されました。
でも排除するだけでなくて、不自由な観光客を他に座れる場所に誘導するなどの気遣いがあってしかるべきではないでしょうか。妻も入場料を払っている観光客のひとりです。

The palace itself as a monument is not very interesting. There are a few ornate rooms to be seen but as a whole the structure is not impressive.  What is interesting, are the objects on display from the various sultans.  Some are quite trite, such as old cameras or polo gloves, others quite ornate such as porcelain.  What is most interesting is to learn about the various sultans through these displays and the transition of Indonesia to a republic.  While we were there, there was in one room a reading being performed of classical Indonesian poetry.
족자카르타 시내에서 금방 갈 수 있는 좋은 위치에 잘 보존되어 있는 궁전이라 이곳저곳 돌아다니면서 시간 보내기에 좋은 곳이었습니다.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: 족자에서 관광객이 제일 많이 방문하는 관광지 중에 하나입니다. 넓은 궁전을 보고있으면 과거의 화려했던 문명의 힘을 느낄 수 있어 좋았습니다.

You’re forced to take a guide with you if you wish to make sense of the place. The only signs tell you not to walk on the tiled, shaded pathways. You have to walk in the hot dust, or depending on the weather, the mud instead. Lots of very pushy guides, salespeople and so on. Not much maintenance here, the place keeps falling apart.
The only good thing about this place is the restaurant. Good food, nice menu featuring sultans favourites. That is worth the hassle.
Reviews sounded interesting but what a let down. Would not recommend you spend time here. Very rundown and not that interesting
Di Kraton Jogja ini anda bisa melihat bukti sejarah yang nyata yang masih ada di kota Jogja. Peninggalan-peninggalanan sejarah dan adat kota Jogja seperti busana Kraton, Kereta, dan Bangunannya.

It may not take more than 90 mins to visit this palace. The current sultan and governor of Yogjakarta stays in this palace which is out of bound to the visitors. It's better to get a guide to bring you around so that one can understand better. Places like this should not only be visited, but must be understood as well. It's well kept and they also have a museum that exhibits collections of past sultans.

Tidak jauh dari Malioboro. Kita bisa belajar tentangsejarah keraton jogja. Tentang bangsal siti hinggil, pakaian kerajaan dan mobil yang dimiliki Raja Hamengku Buwono IX. Jika menyukai lukisan batik kita akan dipandu untuk mampir ke sana

My wife and I visited the palace during December, 2018. We were guided by a palace profesional female guide and enjoyed a lot both, the place and her explanations. Even though there are areas closed to visitors because the sultan and his family still live there, what we were able to see and experience was worth the visit

There is not much here and there are scams running with guides. Very little to see and not worth the entry.
If you do go please do not buy the camera pass as there is nothing worth taking photos of.
Kembali nostalgia ke sini, tetap terawat dan ramai pengunjung. Tetap berpakaian sopan dan tidak membuang sampah sembarangan ya

Yogyakarta terkenal dengan warisan budayanya. Salah satu warisan budaya tersebut adalah kraton yogyakarta. Kraton yogyakarta sendiri merupakan tempat tinggal sultan dan sekaligus sebagai tempat diadakannya upacara upacara adat khas kerajaan jawa. Ketika saya berkunjung ketempat ini suasana budaya jawanya masih kental. Abdi dalem (pegawai keraton) masih lalu lalang di dalam area kraton mengerjakan tugas sesuai dengan keahliannya masing masing.

This palace have a great history. all of the servant is good and friendly to tourist. The construction of palace king of Special Region Yogyakarta is unique and luxurious. Come and enjoy the destination.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: 來到這裡、可以學習很多東西、學習一下跟大開眼界他們的傳統生活跟文化。很棒。不過記得要穿正式的衣服褲子跟鞋子。沒有的話他們不會讓逛逛客進去

Glass displays outside with local costumes, a small museum inside, hardly any furniture, not many explanations, we were in and out in 20 minutes or so. The building itself is the most interesting. Only if you've never seen a sultan's palace you should have a look inside.
Quite run down and nothing much to explore. No explanation. Not worth a visit. We did not enjoy ourselves there

Berkunjung ke kraton ketika di Jogja adalah hal yang wajib karena kita dapat melihat indahnya budaya jawa yang tercermin dari bangunan kraton beserta isinya. Di Kraton ini kita dapat melihat pendopo beserta gamelan2 yang biasanya dimainkan pada acara2 khusus. Di sini juga terdapat koleksi lukisan- lukisan anggota keluarga kraton beserta perabotan lainnya. Untuk yang bawa kamera dikenakan biaya lagi, seingat saya dikenakan 1000-5000 rupiah lagi.

Very poorly maintained! Museum dusty and dirty. No English explanations provided. Area overrun by local tourists taking photos. It’s really a pity as the artifacts and palace could have been displayed beautifully. But I would really suggest not wasting your time by visiting.
I did not enjoy touring around this palace for a couple of reasons : it was packed with noisy students and tourists. Secondly, this palace looks like a run down building .

Yogyakarta Palace of Kraton is het koninklijke paleis en de residentie (Keraton ) van de sultan van Yogyakarta. Het complex bestaat uit een binnenplaats, hoofdgebouw en bijgebouw, de architectuur met Nederlandse invloeden. Er zijn gebouwen waar dingen zijn tentoongesteld, oude foto’s en gebruiksvoorwerpen en geschenken van allerlei landen.Regelmatig zie je oudere mannen zitten in klederdracht, gekleed in een batik sarong, een zwart jasje en een batik hoofddoek

Lite märkligt med ett i grunden intressant ställe men med en känsla att ingen bryr sig. Dammigt, lerigt och dåligt skyltat. Mycket personal som kallas vakter men som inte förefaller ha någon uppgift. Vi hade guide vilket var helt bortkastat. Man får läsa på själv för att få reda på något intressant om byggnaderna. Det finns ett litet misskött museum med dammiga montrar med gåvor till sultanen och prylar från den tidigare sultanens liv. Displayen är så dålig att det blir ointressant. Det saknas en sammanhängande historiebeskrivning som sätter saker i sitt sammanhang.

The keraton is definitely a must go for family with teenagers. Guide is a must. Lots of knowledge we can gather from this trip. My boys learned a lot and the guide also told us spot to take pic and the history of every inch of the palace include the pictures and the things display. 

The guide pay is voluntarily. The entrance to the palace is 10.000 rupiah for local. 

Enjoyed it and immerse yourself with the history of the palace.
Saat masuk lokasi ini s3dih rasanya. Tampak berdebu, lantai seperti tdk disapu sampai pasir banyak sekali, ruangan tampak aus...

The grounds and architecture are nice, if a bit crumbling.  There is a real lack of signage, especially in English, so not sure how much we got out of it.  There are guides there, some are very avid to help, others are asleep at a table.

A historic place to remember the glorious days of the kingdom of Yogyakarta (The Sultanate of Yogia). Though the 'King' is still living in this Palace, but with a different entity; traces of the glorious days are still visible. An eye opener for visitors.

Melihat lebih dekat dari sisi yang berbeda tentang Kraton Jogjakarta,tentang budaya dan keragaman yang ada di masa lalu maupun sekarang.
Belajar sejarah tentang Kraton yang luar biasa dan penuh dengan misteri yang pantas untuk dilihat dan dipelajari
Probably the only palace we have visited of residing king. The palace may not be the best in the world but worth a short visit.

Catch the musical programme, check for timings. About 30 musicians, many old and gracious, make beautiful music from instruments not commonly seen. The hall, the pictures - all speak of a gracious culture.

Used to touring Presidential palaces in every place I visit in Asia, touring the Kraton was disappointing.  The place looks rundown and lacked the grandeur of a palace.  I expected more!  The exhibits in the buildings were not good.  I recommend that the government look into improving the exhibits and the over-all upkeep of this place.

wegens een feestdag is  het erg druk  in en om het paleis.. Het is niet  veel te zien van

En Yogyakarta lo que hay q visitar son los dos templos grandes que están a las afueras, el resto no merece la pena, así que haz en un día los dos templos y vete de allí,  esto es el templo del sultán, que es un palacio viejo, sin mucha gracia la verdad, en el que ves los trajes que ha usado el sultán, la vajilla, etc... vamos un auténtico rollizo a evitar en Indonesia donde hay mil cosas que hacer! No pierdas el tiempo!
Sangat mengesankan jogjakarta istimewa buat liburan saya di jogja, aneka makanan dan berbagai oleh oleh lengkap tersaji di semua lini

Well maintain palace of Sultan Hamengku Bhuwono complete with incredible collection of historical artifacts in its museum. Make dinner reservation for the restaurant at the palace. Your dinner prepares and serves by the palace staffs. Try the famous gudeg Jogya and sauteed papaya leafs.

Truthfully it's not so many things you can see here. I kinda disappointed because it said this is must visited place but it's just yeah ordinary. But at least they have those Indonesian clothes being displayed.
For indonesian tourist you pay 2k

So expect some photo and interview requests where you need to shake the hand of everyone afterwards - that was a fun experience. If you are nearby you can stop to check it out but I wouldn’t make it a special trip.

well maintained guide available  nice museum puppet show  on some days

Review Text: D'après ce que nous avons compris, il y a deux entrées (payantes chacune) à ce palais. Nous avons visité la première partie, où il n'y a pas énormément de choses à voir. Un guide gratuit (travaillant bénévolement une fois par semaine pour le palais) nous a proposé de faire la visite avec nous. Ses explications étaient très intéressantes. Après il vous emmène dans les petites ruelles a côté du palais pour vous montrer la fabrication artisanale des batiks. Cela est très intéressant, même si on vous pousse un peu à l'achat après.

Review Text:

王宮の中は衣装や行事の様子、歴代の王様の自画像など展示されています。

Sultánův palác je tvořen specifickou architekturou....je v něm hodně mramoru a malovaných sloupů a stěn... navštívili jsme ho v době ,kdy v něm probíhali slavnosti a místní sultánovi sluhové chodili v  tradičních krojích a hráli loutkové divadlo za doprovodu živé dobové hudby....

Review Text: 日惹在印尼屬於特區，是目前法律上仍由當地蘇丹統治的地區，日惹皇宮就是統治者的居所，有部分區域開放購票參觀，實際進入後其實有點小失望，沒有想像中皇宮般的奢華，反倒有點樸素
Visitei o palácio com o acompanhamento de uma guia local que contou curiosidades sobre as gerações do sultanato. Ela mesma uma descendente da oitava geração de sultões.

I’m sure this used to be good when you could go inside the palace but visits are restricted to a small area with little to see. We paid for a guide who explained the costumes on display and answered our questions but it seemed like we were just there to make them a bit of money - something to do on a quiet day if you have the time

Lonely Planet is correct in telling you that there are two sections, only one of which is worth seeing, but is completely wrong in its description of how to find that one! Basically, the wrong one is the one in the picture at the top of this page - if your taxi driver leaves you there, walk around the block until you find a gateway with a clock on it, go though it and you should find yourself in a courtyard packed with school groups, push your way through the groups to the ticket booth.
Once you do get inside the right section, you'll see a great free performance (if you're there at the right time - for the day I was there, the times listed in Lonely Planet were correct), some interesting architecture, and various dusty displays with few English captions.
Try to exit the way you came in - if you follow the exit signs you'll end up in some alleys that are unmarked on Google Maps, and touts will know that you're lost and will try to lead you to shops (that actually worked out well for me though, I was led to a really interesting shop!).
This is definitely not a must-see, but you might as well visit if you have time, it's very cheap to get inside.

berkunjung kesini di hari minggu ada pertunjukan tari sekitar jam 10.00 wib.
ohya. ada banyak abdi dalem keraton masih menggunakan jarit / pakaian jawa

ジョグジャカルタの王族が住んでいる王宮ということで、今も王様が住んでいるということです。（知事をしているとのことです）
そこまで華美ではなく、シンプルな感じの建物で、地元住民の方や小学生がのんびりと見学していてのんびりとした雰囲気でした。
ちょっとした博物館もあり、銀食器や焼き物、家具などいろんなものが展示されています。日本からの贈り物も展示してありました。
近くのタマン・サリと一緒に回るといいと思います。

Review Text: An absolute waste of money and time. Old facilities, no signs at all and bad preservation of the place. Does a Sultan really lives there??

Tampak pada gambar pintu gerbang tertutup.
Saya beberapa kali ke pintu gerbang tersebut tapi kondisinya sering tertutup digembok pagarnya.

Informasinya melintas dari pintu lainnya untuk masuk, tapi karena rada jauh ke pintu yang dimaksud dan juga kendala parkiran mobil yang agak susah bila pindah parkiran lagi, akhirnya saya cuma sekilas visit Keraton Jogya tersebut dan ambil foto dipintu Gerbangnya saja.

Besar harapannya pintu gerbang tersebut dibuka dan ada PIC yang menjaganya rutin.  Terima kasih.
This was a guided tour. The guide was knowledgeable and spoke reasonable English. Spent approximately 3 hours touring the Palace and the King's residence. Well worth the time spent

A good place to understand the history of Yogyakarta’s royalty as well as the city’s traditions. You must have a guide for it to be worth it - only a couple of dollars extra to make it a good way to spend an hour or so. Our guide, Dave (if I remember right) was very friendly, interesting and spoke good English. The tour makes you appreciate the heritage of the city a lot more.

As a bonus Dave showed us to the Sultan’s batik school for free, where the process was explained by the teacher and he shared how to tell if one is fake (worthy tip)! Some incredible batiks on sale... ofcourse.

Overall really nice morning spent at the palace... definitely recommend a guide as well.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Kraton Yogyakarta dikenal dengan (The Sultan Palace of Yogyakarta). Kraton adalah sejarah peninggalan kerajaan Mataram yang sekarang ini masih berdiri kokoh di pusat kota Jogja.

This palace is full of interesting things and sights. The attendants wear daggers and outfits from the past. There is music and a puppet show. The museum is very interesting and there is a lot to see.

Review Text:
Our country had have a king before the independence day,and this museum capture the history. 
The museum mostly tell about Sultan Hamengku Buwono IX who has great contribution for Indonesian independance event and also after as a man and as a king. He is a very honorable and humble person. Respect him a lot.

Salah satu objek wisata yang wajib dikunjungi kalo berwisata ke Jogja. Lokasinya strategis karena di tengah kota, tiket masuknya juga murah. Bagusnya datang pagi hari sekitar pukul 10 atau sore sekitar pukul 4 biar gak terlalu panas.

It is amazing if u are interested in the history of the palace & reign of the Mataram Sultans or u simply love ancient architecture & the back story of it, otherwise u will not "find what u seek"
Spacious compound with multiple back stories to explore & each exhibit tells a different parts of the palace history. 
The palace is open frm 0830am to 2pm local time. 
Tickets are 15k/pax & 1k for photo permit. 
Do hire the local guide who is just hanging around near the admission gate as they will feed u with some of the incredible back story of the palace. Some that is too sacred to be written into any history book.

中に入るといくつかの建物があり、それぞれに展示物がありますが、どれもすすけていていました。これといって見所はありませんが、現在も実際に使われているというのは面白いです。

Review Text: We visited this palace with the golden pavilion being the most exquisite part (beautiful marble floor). The collection of the old sultans are interesting but nothing exceptional. Count about an hour to see it all.

De entree was bij ons 10.000 roepia, daarna konden we naar binnen en zei een man dat we ons ticket goed moesten bewaren voor het tweede deel. Het eerste deel was echt niets bijzonders te zien, je loopt een klein rondje en je ziet wat overkappingen met versiersels. Er is nog een tweede deel, waarbij je echt weer een heel straatje doormoet (vraag naar de ingang met de grote klok). Ze proberen je eerst naar een art gallerie te krijgen, maar trap daar niet in :). Toen we daar aankwamen lieten we onze tickets zien en zeiden ze dat we kaartjes moesten kopen van 15.000 roepia. Normaal prima, maar nu was er gezegd dat we met de kaartjes die we hadden naar binnen konden, niet dus. Dit deel was wat groter, je kon huisjes naar binnen voor de geschiedenis van het paleis en de sultan. Ook hier vonden we niets aan, voor ons was het niet boeiend genoeg, dus snel weer weg gegaan. Kan me wel voorstellen dat het voor mensen die echt van geschiedenis houden, wél de moeite waard is.

The "Keraton" or palace is a living museum where one can see historical & cultural exhibition, and at the same time surrounded by attendants who are the servants of the royal family. Their presence indicates that the palace is a living museum where visitors not only can take a peek at the rich tradition, but also through the conversation with the attendants.

Fa un effetto incredibile entrare in una cultura totale te differente da quella occidentale, palazzo di magnifica fattura e molto ben tenuto, adatto a famiglie anche con bambini. La visita dura circa un'ora e mezza/due.

Review Text:
This place would validate why and what made you visit Yogyakarta and Indonesia as a whole. 

With Rp 15,000 entrance fee and Rp 1,000 ticket charge for your camera, you will have a knowledge of the past, that would make you understand their today.

There are english speaking guides that will explain to you the history. Prepare to be amazed of their traditions and culture, the life of Sultan and their people. Plus a captured visual and material that made a distinct characters of the life of Rama and Sita.

There are also puppet shows playing but in Bahasa.

As a respect they will ask you to remove Hat/Caps (should you be wearing one) before entering.

I might be biased, but I have deep interest in this kind of thing. 
This place was very cultural and has deep history in it. Yes, few areas are closed but that's because the king (Sultan) and his family still live in there. If you fond history, especially South East Asian history, you need to go to this place

Palacio del Sultan es de las cosas que te puedes saltar en la ciudad,salas y salas llenas de polvo y de regalos de otras epocas no tiene ningun interes ni  arquitectonico ni paisajistico La guia que nos toco hizo que nos durmiesemos literalmente si vais verlo por libre, o  mejor ni entrar.
Huye si puedes,las tiendas de los alrededores estan curiosas para comprar recuerdos.En la entrada hacen marionetas tipicas con la musica estridente local ufff ,fue de lo mas duro del viaje.

We were told not to miss this place, so, we went and to me it  was kinda disappointing. It cost 15,000IDR per person to enter and if you yo u wanted a guide, the establishment will provide you one and for a fee of your choice. Most of the places are sealed off and you can’t enter. With all that much people, you can’t really fault them for doing so. We spent an hour and there is a restaurant that serves lunch but it is another tourist trap. Loads of school kids during our visit. Honestly, could have given it a miss.

No volveríamos. Quizás sí vas con un Guía que te explique mejor que los letreros que hay, pero realmente no nos llamó nada la atención

Bagus, tiket masuk murah.
Bisa lihat pertunjukan yg ada jadwalnya.
Lokasi gampang dijangkau dgn taksi online.

Malgré les mauvais avis de tripadvisor, nous y sommes allés et avons demandé un guide francophone à l'accueil (gratuit) et la visite a été très intéressante autant pour le palais que l'histoire de Java. Nous avond laissé un pourboire sans regret vraiment.

Poussiéreux. On y montre une fourchette, un chapeau, un couteau et quelques sièges. Des photos pour illustrer une partie de l’histoire. Peut être que si nous avions eu un guide l’expérience nous aurait parue meilleure. Pour un incontournable de yogyakarta il n’est vraiment pas mis en valeur.
