Il palazzo reale di Jogya o anche chiamato  Kraton é una struttura dove risiede il sultano della città con la propria famiglia e tutti i loro "dipendenti". Inoltre é sede di un museo della varia oggettistica e vecchie foto di proprietà del sultano. Lasciato un po' a se stesso non é una struttura invitante ed inoltre la maggior parte delle spiegazioni scritte sono in lingua indonesiana, quindi non comprensibile se non sei a conoscenza di tale lingua.
Oltre che a girovagare nel cortile interno e visitare il museo non c'è altro da vedere e da fare. Peccato!
Une visite ne vous prendra pas longtemps le seul truc sympa c'c'est le guide francophone qui est drôle, pour reste si c'est dans votre parcours ça passe 1h
Belajar sejarah dengan cara menyenangkan. Hindari jam istirahat saat kesini karena di jam tertentu ada pertunjukan gamelan ditengah-tengah keraton.

Sangat cocok untuk wisata sejarah. Banyak turis mancanegara yang berkunjung kesini. Biaya masuknya per orang 8rb, kalau membawa kamera dikenakan biaya tambahan 2rb kl tidak salah. Untuk jam2 tertentu ada pertunjukan seni gamelan.

Mudah Mudahan Dapat Jodoh di JawaTengah.
Cita2 Yg BelumTerwujud : ke Borobudur.   ke Masjid Demak.  ke Tugu Putih Jogja.

The interior is beautiful crafted n engraved wh lots of history to offer. 
~ Get a guide to know about e history better.

Tickets were cheap at Rupiah 15,000 plus another Rupiah 1,000 if you want to take photos.  Make sure you also get a guide (additional charge) if you don't speak Indonesian as most of the items on show are not labelled in English.  They are in Indonesian, so it would make it a challenge to appreciate what is on display if you can't read what they are/mean.  It was relatively interesting to learn about the different designs of batik and where/what events they were for.  Also you get to learn more about the current and previous Sultan's of Yogyakarta.  Most of the artifacts were not properly maintained (dusty) and lighting was quite bad.  There is a traditional gamelan show at certain parts of the day/days but we missed it.  I think that would have made the trip more worthwhile.

Maybe if you have a guide it could be ok, we did not have any. Nothing at all was written in English, no one to help (like in many places). There are no dates on any of the goods displayed so it is hard to understand (there is even a place where you can find plastic spoons of a famous T.. brand). Many of the goods are full of dust and there is no light is the room so hard to see some of the things displayed. It is a pity, a bit of explanation and movements on the site would be great as we are sure there are lots of things to learn.

El Kraton es el palacio del rey de Jogyakarta y es un espacio realmente bonito. Las estancias y jardines visitables son muy bonitas. Es probable que al terminar la visita se acerque un hombre para llevarte a un espacio artesanal para mostrarte como se hace el café de civeta (que no deberías ni comprar ni probar porque implica abuso animal), como se hacen las marionetas wayang y como se hacen los batik.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Rien de bien spécifique à voir. L’histoire reste flou sur ce bâtiment. Allez y seulement si vs avez 1 journée à perdre pour la balade. Vous pourrez vous attardez dans les rues arrières au monument avec ça multitudes de commerçants.

The Kraton is quite nice and a must see in Yogyakarta.  However, there is much shabbier section of the palace with a separate entrance that a branch of the royal family opened to skim some tourist cash.  It is a significant discount in the real thing, 5,000 vs 12,000 rupiahs, but a scam and not worth the time.

No ci sono particolari luoghi di riferimento in città per cui é fondamentale un passaggio per capire le dinamiche storiche e politiche locali, possibilmente con una guida. I prezzi sono estremamente bassi e il luogo è abbastanza fatiscente ma merita una visita, dintorni compresi, se non siete strettissimi con i tempi.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: We were very excited to visit this palace but were actually disappointed if its status. Dust everywhere, all the pictures inside are in Indonesian only. I would have appreciated it if there was an English translation. The palace itself is nice but definitely would benefit from some extra care and maintenance
Its located in centre of yogyakarta.  Its good place to visit if you wanna know the history and palace of sultan yogyakarta
Perjalanan yang menyenangkan untuk  mendidik anak... Tiket masuk nya juga murah 5.000... untuk yang mau pake guide disiapkan...
Worth visiting, to get to know about the history of the Sultans. The music in the central courtyard , adds interest and is entertaining.

We thoroughly enjoyed to visit to the Palace. The tour guide that we had was very knowledgeable about the Indonesian history behind the Palace and we learnt a lot about the history behind this wonderful country. Can highly reccomend a visit to the Palace.

We spent an hour visiting and thoroughly enjoyed it. We got a guide and we are glad we did as there was limited information in English and you get details about the palace you would miss otherwise. Some beautiful buildings and two gamelan performances going on while we visited and it was great to get an experience of this as part of the visit.

Als je Yogjakarta aandoet moet je dit toch wel gezien hebben.
Het complex is best groot en mooi om te zien. Ook het volk - buiten de bezoekers gezien - dat er rond loopt.

If you want to know the History of Yogya. Here is one of the must visited place.
The palace tell the story about history of Yogyakarta Kingdom.
From the first Sultan. How they live. How is the ceremony amd so on.
Be sure to ask guide to accompany you. They will tell you about the story.

The information given for all the property there are not enough because it's in Bahasa. The property looks not quite taken care. Some property are rusty.

But however still this is a good place

Der Palast ist eher wie eine kleine Ranch und bietet nicht viele Sehenswürdigkeiten. Es ist nicht allzu teuer und es war bei uns nicht überfüllt Samstag morgens - also ok mal vorbei zu schauen... man sollte meinen Palast erwarten...
Saya harapkan wisatawan berpakaian sopan kalau kesini. Menghargailah karena masuk area keraton. Ada guidenya yang menerangkan saat tour keraton.

Un guide francophone est indispensable pour obtenir les explications indispensables car "de visu", rien de bien extraordinaire. Intéressant de côtoyer les serviteurs du sultan qui travaillent à vie (pas de retraite)
Un lugar bastante normalito que no deja de ser la residencia del Sultán donde te cobran por entrar. Desde mi punto de vista no merece la pena a no ser que te interese la historia local
Были там под закрытие, ничего интересного там нет. А вот рядом и про марионеток расскажут и кофе предложат за 75 000 idr чашка

Esperábamos quizás un poco más de infraestructura, pero se compensó con la actuación del mediodía de los músico tocando música tradicional y una bailarina con danza javanesa. Con una hora entre visita y espectáculo fue suficiente. Pero merece la pena. Recomendable ir temprano por el calor.

Il palazzo è molto affascinante e merita assolutamente una visita. L'essenziale è acquistare un biglietto completo, che permette di visitare tutti i padiglioni e, cosa imperdibile, i vicoletti dove vivono gli inservienti del palazzo. Ci sono all'interno botteghe incredibili di batik, di caffè ecc. La visita è da completare con il taman sari.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Non mi aspettavo nulla di che, ma è stato peggio rispetto alle mie aspettative. Carino solo lo spettacolo della ballerina con musica indonesiana. Se si hanno pochi giorni consiglierei di andare fuori Yogyakarta.

Aunque la entrada es muy barata, la parte que se puede visitar es muy pequeña y nada bonito, un patio central con una maqueta y apenas dos salas más.
Como siempre en los alrededores hay gente diciendo que está cerrado por uno u otro motivo y que se ofrecen a  ayudarte a buscar un tuk tuk para que te lleve a mercados o a talleres donde comprar pinturas.Todo mentira ,está abierto siempre pero no merece la pena.

Es muy económica la entrada pero realmente a nosotros nos ha sobrado está visita...
Porque teníamos tiempo de sobra...sino, es perder el tiempo
No hay explicaciones de nada, bueno si, pero en su idioma...
Con todo el espacio que tienen podrían poner más cosas o más representaciones
Non mi ha particolarmente entusiasmato ma rimane comunque da visitare per capire quello che rappresenta l’autorità da queste parti. Il sultano ci vive attualmente.

The best thing with  this little palace is that the Sultan of Yogyakarta, Hamengku Buwono X, still residences there! After 2 pm everyone had to leave the area because it was his time then. There were pavillons and museum with personal items as lamps in art-deco style and cameras. Most things belonged to the popular sultan, Hamengku Buwono IX.

But the best thing happens around 10 am when different Gamelang groups performs and a shadiwy puppet show, Wayang Kulit is shown. Around 12 daytime.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This palace must be visit when you are in Yogyakarta.  You can see many stuff at some rooms all about the Sultan.  Its interresting. You can hire guide for only IDR 50.000 and he Will explain you all things.  Recommended

Local de visita interessante pois relata a vida de todos os sultões de Jogjakarta até aos dias de hoje, inclusivé é a actual residência do Sultão.
A visita deverá ser feita com um guia para uma total compreensão dos diversos pormenores da vida da realeza de Jogjakarta.
Poco da dire. Il complesso, seppur particolare, non mi ha mosso nessuna emozione. La descrizione enfatica della guida mi aveva generato una diversa aspettativa. BOH

Visited the Sultan’s Palace and learned so much about the Royal Family. However you must hire a guide as without a guide you will just be looking at stuff not knowing what you are looking at. Also, all the information boards are only in Indonesian. But with a guide which is only 50 0000 irp it’s totally worth it as he or she will explain everything. Also, I went on Sunday and between 11 am and noon there is a traditionnal dance show included in the price of the entrance ticket, which is very reasonable at 15000 irp.
Vergane glorie, zonde van de tijd. Mooiere en interessantere bezienswaardigheden buiten Yogyakarta, Borobudur en Prambanan en (veel verder weg) de Bromo vulkaan.

This site was the most boring from our trip in Indonesia. I think it is not worth your time if you do not have plenty of it. Do not buy extra ticket for camera, you will certainly not need it (nothing interesting to take picture). Horrible toilets. Spent your time elsewhere.

Neem vooral een gids als je deze plek bezoekt! Dan pas zie en voel je deze plek met andere ogen, namelijk die van de Indonesiërs die diep respect hebben voor de sultan en zijn familie. Het hof leeft hier! Veel mensen werken vrijwillig voor de familie in ruil voor status en een kris. Dichterbij de javaanse hofcultuur kun je niet komen!
소박하고 볼 거 없다는 평을 듣고 왔지만 지나치게 소박하였습니다. 왕궁이라고 하는데 지붕이 슬레이트 양철 지붕이고... 바닥도 너무 허술해서 왕궁이 맞나 싶기도 했습니다. 시간이 없으시다면 굳이 방문하지 않아도 될 것 같습니다.

One of those places that you just tick off because you happen to be in the vicinity! It is a fairly interesting palace with some character, lots of artwork and various carriages on display. Entry is cheap and shouldn't take more than an hour or so.
Siamo rimasti perplessi.. pensavamo di vedere il palazzo ma in realta’ non c e’ molto da vedere.. per 50 rupie si puo’ anche fare ma non aspettatevi molto!

Devo dire che per comprendere qualcosina della cultura del posto due passi all’ interno si possono anche fare ma non vi aspettate un granche’, lo spazio e’ interessante ma la narrazione figurativa ( a meno che prendiate la guida , in quel caso anche parlante) e’ veramente lasciata all abbandono e di scarsa qualita’ espositiva.
Le fotografie che raccontano la storia del paese sono in condizioni pessime ( il bianco e nero e’ un verde e verde) , pero’ la cartellonistica pubblicitaria e’ stampata bene ( mhmm qualcosa non va ).
I manichini  vestiti con abiti tradizionali hanno un non so che’ di inquietante in quei due vetroni cupi ( la cadillac fuori poi e’ proprio locale) .
Insomma se siete in zona e non sapete che altro fare , potete investire 20 minuti ed entrare .

Interesting palace from another culture... we so far from Versailles! 
The architecture, but also the dancing spectacle was really interesting (everyday around 11:00)
A few room show the history from the beginning to the dutch colony to the 70’s.

Worth a 2:00 visit
panovník, ktorý vraj nemá mužského následníka, tak si zreje presadí ženského následníka, obsahuje múzeum panovníka IX id plienok až po hrob ... pekne ale nudné

It's very interesting. Tops 20 minutes to see everything. Even with a guide.

Cultural very interesting.

Ce palais est un incontournable de yogyakarta. Les édifices s'enchaînent et sont tous très beaux,dans un superbe style colonial, du moins pour ceux qui sont restaurés.On peut, sur place, prendre un guide qui améliore nettement la visite.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The buildings are not very exciting and if you should be very interested in the history of the sultans to visit this place (and have a guide with you), rooms with presents are not very interesting ..
Keraton Yogyakarta tempat paling besejarah di Indonesia,,banyak peninggalan2 bersejarah dari masa penjajahan yang masih tersimpan rapi...akses yang langsung dari malioboro...
Not bad but not enough info in English, and a lack of imagination to make this museum appealing. Free music and/or puppet shows without enthusiasm, a bit embarrassing.

We hadden meer verwacht van het kraton. Wat gebouwen, muziekinstrumenten en kleding, eigenlijk was dat het. Om aan onze zevenjarige uit te leggen dat dit echt het paleis was, lukte bar slecht. Zelf hadden we ook andere verwachtingen.
Niet bijzonder.
No tiene mucho que visitar, pero ya que es el único sultanato que hay pues no está de más visitarlo, además el precio es prácticamente regalado.

If you are interested in the history of Indonesia, this is for you. There are several exhibits housed in several buildings and there are gardens. I particularly didn't find it spectacular but entertaining.
Not much to see and it closes at 2 pm. A few relics and some pretty good stories but other than that, was disappointed in the whole experience.
Zespół pawilonów sułtana nieco zaniedbany. Najciekawszym miejscem są pokazy tanca przy tradycyjnej muzyce oraz biuro sułtana bardzo ładnie zdobione.

We went to the Kraton around 11am, when the Gamelan performance was on. That was an intriguing performance where we got to see the puppeteer & musicians hone their craft. We also paid for a guided tour, he was highly entertaining and provided some historical context to the area. It was a pity we couldn’t enter some of the areas. Overall not a bad stop!

Check the schedule before you go to the tour visit more wisely. We got there around 8:30am so just saw lots of photos, gifts, clothing, etc. of the royal family that weren't very engaging. Had we arrived 9am or later, we would have been able to see and hear the royal gamelan orchestra perform at 10am.  That would have made for a far better experience.
yogyakarta terutama di kraton yogyakarta pasti akan berkunjung kembali ke tempat ini..keluarga senang semua..
Way way....  Saya sangat suka di jogja,,, indah sekali.....  Tpi sayang hotel yg saya kungjungi tidak sessuai espektasi saya... Saya sangat suka dengan pembandangan kota jogja

Not much to see really. The golden pavilion is nice, but the museum with personal belongings, decorations, gifts of the sultan is not very interesting. We only had 2 days in Yogya and regretted waisting our time here.

Hier haben wir gute 40 Minuten verbracht. Es hat Spass gemacht umher zu laufen und die Anlage zu erkunden. Wir hatten Glück und das Palastorchester hatte gerade noch ein Stück gespielt als wir dort waren.

Akhirnya bisa mengajak anak-anak ke Kraton Yogyakarta untuk menambah wawasan dan pengalaman khususnya bidang sejarah.
Disini memang seharusnya sewa pemandu jadi kita bisa mendapatkan informasi dan pengetahuan tentang sejarah Kraton beserta keluarganya jadi bukan hanya foto2 saja disana. 
Untuk HTM terjangkau dan tempat strategis juga banyak tempat makan serta oleh2 disekitarnya

Diri ini seolah seperti kembali ke masa lalu, sebab melihat gaya bangunan dan arsitekturnya yang sangat berbudaya jawa yg kental, sehingga ketika berada di sana seperti memang berada di suatu kerajaan pada zaman dahulu

ジョグジャカルタの王宮には北と南があるようですが、南にだけ行きました。
王宮内では帽子をかぶっていてはいけないとのことでした。

入場料を支払った際に、日本語ガイドを勧められました。値段を尋ねると、IDR50,000とのことだったので、頼むことにしました。

博物館内でパティックの作り方やバティックの柄が身分や行事によって異なることの説明をしてもらったほか、現在は第１０代の王様であり、今もジョグジャカルタの知事を兼ねていることや、王女が５人いるが、王子がいないので、後継問題があることなどを教えてもらいました。

なお、行ったのが月曜日の午前中だったので、民俗音楽の練習を聞くことができました。聴衆用の椅子も用意されていましたが、しょせんは練習であり、座って聴くほどのものではないように感じました。
Vond dit achteraf geen bezoekje waard. Ok, prijs is laag en misschien moet je dit gezien hebben, maar je mag alleen van afstand kijken.

Disappointed in visit to the palace. Not much information with displays and no translations. Displays are in need of a good clean, and facilities are dirty. Water palace was more interesting but again not much information provided and water fountain which is the feature was green w algae. Could be so much better.
Zou deze geen tweede keer dien. Enigste leuke was dat er traditionele muziek werd gemaakt en gedanst.

A primera vista, nos pareció decepcionante visitar apenas una sala y un patio. Luego regresamos para ver el baile tradicional del mediodía y nos encontramos con varias otras salas lujosas y dependencias que narran la vida de la antigua realeza de Yogyakarta. Con un poco más de explicación en los carteles mejoraría enormemente.
No se pierdan las danzas.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Puedes ver muy poco de las instalaciones, está todo muy sucio.
Hemos tenido guía y nos explicaba todo y eso lo ha hecho mejor, pero si no sales igual que entras, pero eso sí, con menos dinero porque hay que pagar hasta para echar fotos.
Os pongo fotos de todo lo que se puede ver.

Went there with a lot of expectation. After paying for the entrance i went in and realised only a small part of the palace is allowed for viewing...I turned back dissappointed and stopped by a souvenir shop on my way out...checked about the limitation of the areas and was told by a staff at the souvenir shop that the palace has been divided into a few parts and each part has its own entrance and fee.  So, i went to another part, paid and went in but did not find anything extraordinary...but liked the live wayang kulit performance held there.

Cheap entrance.. they have english speaker guide.. you can enjoy javanesse life music on the hall... this museum displays the previous king's relics such as clothes, dinner set, old camera, etc. but not well preserved and dusty .. if you want to go to a more interesting museum preferably to Ullen Museum

Place of the king , to carry out ceremonies and work events and meet with his people
And carry out the goverment
Always fascinated by the kingdom of Java and ts long history. The sound of Gamelan played at the Palace is soothing to my ears..a place to visit

Tempat bersejarah yang tidak boleh dilupakan sedikitpun,tetapi perlu harus dibudayakan,dilestarikan dan dijaga keberadaannya agar dapat di kenal oleh generasi penerus bangsa sebagai tempat yang mempunyai nilai sejarah tinggi bagi terbentuknya negara kesatuan republik Indonesia.

We were a bit disappointed with what we’ve seen at the Kraton (palace). I was expecting an older looking palace, but I guess it was not old enough to look ancient, the building looks like a modern but not so new building. Lots of beautiful Batik to look at he Batik museum though. I guess I set my expectation too high.

Interessante da visitare, specie con la guida (prezzo ingresso + guida irrisori), si scoprono cose interessanti circa la residenza reale, gli oggetti esposti e la cultura dei cittadini. Non entrare dall'ingresso in Maliboro street (provano ad accalappiare turisti), ma da quello laterale: prendete la guida all'interno, non quelli che si offrono per strada.
Pas terrible. On a fait le tour en 5 minutes. Rien d'impressionnant. À faire uniquement si vous avez du temps à tuer

全体的な印象としては、ちょっと残念。展示物の前にせめて英語での説明書きや看板でもあればいいのですが、そういうものはありません。入場券を買った際にくれたパンフレットもかなり質素で簡単なものでした。それでもジョグジャカルタの歴史を少し感じられたのはよかったです。
入り口で日本語ガイドを勧められ、最後に60,000ルピア請求されましたが、料金はかなりグレーです。ネットでは「キモチでいい」と言われたという人もいるので、事前に確認した方がいいと思います。

sangat luas, membutuhkan 1-2jam untuk melihat semua yang ada, mulai dari pakaian raja, silsilah keluarga, kereta, perabotan kecil semacam gelas dan hiasan kepala, juga perabotan besar semacam baju dan sanggul semua ada disana.

bisa menyewa giude untuk mengelilingi kraton sambil mendapat penjelasan tapi sayangnya abdi dalemnya ga bisa bahasa inggris jadi untuk turis luar pasti akan kesulitan mengerti.

Review Text: Encore un attrape touriste... on paye pour rentrer ; 30 minutes a l'intérieur... le batiment se voit très bien de l'extérieur et la visite n'a rien à ajouter !

Keraton Jogja menjadi saksi sejarah dalam perjuangan rakyat Indonesia untuk merdeka, bahkan tidak.sedikit kontribusi bagi terbentuknya Republik Indonesia. Disini kita masih dapat melihat silsilah, adat istiadat serta suasana yg ada dalam keraton, dan juga Gedong Kuning sebagai kediaman Sultan Hamengkubuwono X sekarang ini dari kejauhan. Di dalam terdapat cerita & silsilah mengenai keluarga dari para Sultan, ruangan tempat mereka belajar & bertumbuh serta juga terdapat lukisan2 dari Raden Saleh yg berteknik 3 dimensi. Sangat menarik untuk dikunjungi, disediakan pula guide2 ramah yg dapat membantu kita lebih mengenal tentang keraton Jogja
Nice palace. Not a reason to visit jogja, but when you are in town it is worth some of your time. Took us 1 hour.

We came here on the afternoon and it is not overly crowded. With not many people around, we are free to walk around and see what attractions available before one old guy stop my mom and I and gives us some tour around the palace and gave detailed explanations to both of us. The tour became meaningful as I understand what's the palace is all about. Good time spent there and the old guy in the end didn't ask for any charged at all. However, my mom and I gave him tips for his voluntary service as we feel he deserved it after giving us a very good explanation and meaningful tour.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: 暇だったので行ってみました。人が沢山います。周りにはお土産屋さんや食べ物屋さんもあるのと、入場料も安いので暇潰しにはいいと思います。
tempatnya bagus, kebersihan kurang, masih bnyak sampah di mana2,letak strategis, agar di tingkatkn lg
Banyak terdapat cerita masa lalu dan sejarahnya dulu. Ada biaya masuknya juga tapi tidak mahal. Banyak alat musik dan kendaraan zaman dulu yang di pajang.
You have to go here! It helps to unlock the culture of Jogja. You can hear the gamelan or see the dancing. Totally must happen!

Me and my gf stopped by one morning as we had some time to kill and had seen a lot of the other big attractions in Yogyakarta.  The temple itself was ok.  Be careful as there are two entrances.  One of them is 7000 / person and it really just a small walk around with nothing particularly interesting.  It was as we were walking out that the entrance guy said "go see the other palace, its more interesting.."  WTF?  So we walked around the back and sure enough there was another entrance, we paid 15,000 per person and went in.  Men must have a shirt with sleeves but women can wear tanktops (seemed kind of opposite from other temples we have been in) but they rent shirts for 15,000 if guys have a tank top.  

Inside the palace is pretty cool.  We saw a puppet show which was nice but all in Bahasa so we couldnt really understand what was happening, but the music and puppets were cool.  Then walked around and saw a bunch of relics, however most of it was in Bahasa so if you are not from Indonesia you will have no idea what a lot of things say.  You had the option of hiring a guide but we just walked through.  Nothing spectacular but not a bad way to spend a few hours.  Also within walking distance of a lot of hotels. Dont expect anything on par with Borobodur or Prambanan however
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Bardzo ciekawe miejsce , pomimo tego, ze nie udało nam się usłyszeć oprawy muzycznej.Miejsce tchnące tradycja, zwyczajami i historia wyspy.Trzeba po prostu zobaczyc

Der Sultanspalast zeigt auf eindrucksvolle Weise die unterschiedliche Kultur und Geschichte des Landes. Die angebotene individuelle Führung hilft, die Räume und Ausstellungsstücke zu verstehen. Sehr interessant!

Visiting Keraton Yogyakarta is a must thing to do when travel to Yogyakarta. It was a palace and historical, a huge area both outdoors and indoors. It needs around 2 hours minimum to get to know this place. There was a tour guide who will explain the history of the palace, and yes I always give an extra tip for the guide apart from the entrance fee. Bring an umbrella during the rainy season or you might get wet. Such a good place to visit anyway.

This is probably the most famous attraction in Yogyakarta besides the two main temples. In Yogyakarta, the Sultan rules the province as governor. Built in 1757, the Kraton or the Palace serves as a home for the Sultan and his family and they still reside here. The grand complex showcases old Javanese culture and architecture. Bright gold painted ceilings and intricate designs from halls to floors are classic examples of fine luxurious architecture.

There are various halls such as waiting hall, justice hall, eating hall and so on. Guided tour is available upon arrival and guides speak good English. Centrally located, the palace can be reached by taxi, becak, andong or by public bus.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Palace viel een beetje tegen. Niet heel veel te zien en nergens staat iets van informatie als je er rond loopt. Ook maar klein oppervlak wat je kan zien en dit is redelijk vervallen. Wij vonden het geen top bezienswaardigheid.

這是一座非常漂亮的宮殿，仍然是當前的日惹蘇丹的住所。與中國不同的是，中國皇帝不歡迎老百姓親近它們。但這裡向人民和公眾開放的地方很多。它們是通過建造大型接待大廳和涼亭，為了貴賓，訪客，老百姓共用。在宮殿內部，有來自外國的禮物與收藏品。此外，還有一個畫廊，展示家庭的繪畫和照片。這裡，我看到一位爪哇公主的照片，的確漂亮和引起了我的注意。除了收藏品之外，我喜歡這裡的建築設計 - 混合了西方和爪哇的風格。這再次表明當地的王國是現代的，並且接受了外面的知識。有一件事：這裡很少有解釋展品的標誌。所以，你必須通過你的眼睛走過，並欣賞它們。在宮殿外面，我看到周圍有很多房屋和商店。三輪車司機說這實際上是宮殿的外部部分，居住了蘇丹的現任和前任僱員及其家屬。

To see here are about 6 or 7 small museums (or up to 10 if you count like two adjacent rooms with an outside walkway between them as two museums) where you'll learn about the past sultans from displays of big painting portraits (of the sultans & their wives), old photos & their household items (some beautiful dining wares & I believe also crystal items to be seen); there's also a room (with glass walls all around) where there are like two or three stone tablets with inscriptions of some documents (maybe proclamations or such) written by the country's first president Soekarno & the sultan of this palace at that time.  Just do keep in mind that all these museums (except just one if I recall correctly) are on the east side of the palace grounds, so be sure to "turn left" once you're at the "inner area" of the palace grounds after entering from the north side where there are also some displays of musical instruments (which are like right inside the entrance).

And once after exiting from the south side, I suggest to go a short distance to the left where you'll see these "lovely cars" from like the 1960's (and there's 'I love Jogja' on one of them for a great photo-op!); and then there's Tamansari Water Castle (with a big bathing pool, a tower beside it that you can go up & like an ancient mosque a bit further from one side of the castle) just a 10-minute-or-so walk from this palace (the way is to the right from the exit so you'll have to walk back from those classic cars as just mentioned).

If taking the transjogja bus, the best stop I can think of is the one right in front of Fort Vredeburg on the south end of the "shopping street" Jl. Malioboro (a great stretch of about 2 km to buy souvenirs or just to hang out) and the numbers that I know of arriving at the stop are 2A, 2B & 3A; it's really a walkable distance from that bus stop to the palace entrance on its north side, but I would suggest to take a rickshaw or a horse-drawn buggy due to the "labyrinth" of narrow streets leading to this palace so it may not be so easy to walk to get here.  And yes, after getting off the bus, you might want to first do Malioboro shopping street & Fort Vredeburg (where there's a museum inside with displays of the Independence movement including many of these great "diorama scenes") because it's a "long way" to get back to those two after exiting from the south side of the palace (when the most convenient next stop is Tamansari Water Castle as mentioned above).

The palace was the official residence of the sultan of Jojakarta. While it is not, in my opiitnion, a "must see" attraction, it holds some appeal particularly for history buffs. 
Within walking distance there is an additional palace, named the Water Palace, which I did not visit but was enjoyed by my friends. In the same area several shops where batiks are made and sold can be found. In the evening, the square adjacent to the palace comes alive with lighted pedal cars, food stalls and music.

Yogyakarta palace (locally Kraton), was the main seat of the Yogyakarta sultanate in Java. It was officially completed in 1756, and is now a cultural centre and museum.

This palace is definitely worth checking out. It is easily walkable from the bottom end of Jalan (road) Malioboro. Entrance fee for foreigner (2018) costs 15,000rp (~AU$1.50) which includes a photo taking pass. Not sure why they bother including that, no complaints. The cost and location are already a huge selling point.

The complex itself caters to almost everyone. If you're not there to just take photos of a beautiful and traditional palace, you will be spending about an hour looking at the artefacts, paintings, memorials, and statues that remain from the stay of the various sultans. Some exhibits are a bit dusty, but in general the museum sections are well kept and organised.

The best part is that every day of the week a cultural show is held in nice outdoor gazebos within the palace compound. 

Showtimes:
Gamelan w/ classical javanese dance performance: Sunday, 10.00 - 12.00

Gamelan w/ karawitan show (full orchestra?): Every Monday and Tuesday, 10.00 - 12.00

Gamelan w/ wayang golek menak (Javanese puppets): Every Wednesday, 10.00 - 12.00

Gamelan w/ macapat song: Every Friday, 09.00 - 11.00

Gamelan w/ wayang kulit (leather puppet): Every Saturday, 10.30 - 12.00

These shows are all free to attend, and last on average 2 hours. It's a huge bonus, as the gamelan instruments are very beautiful to see and hear. I went on a Wednesday, and watched the puppet show. It is narrated in Indonesian, which despite making it difficult to follow, I accept because tourism should be catered towards locals firsthand. It would probably sound horrible and awkward in any other language anyway. You can hire a translator for your tour of Kraton if you want a deeper understanding of things. I did not hire one, so I can't quote a price or review on their effectiveness.

I went at 9am, wandered about for an hour, then caught the show. It was a good time, and not too packed on a weekday. I imagine it can get quite busy on weekends.

Summary: 5 stars because it is so cheap and offers so much. Nothing to regret if you had a poor experience, which I doubt you will.

The “museum” was pictures of cars, the sultans, and a case of a newspaper article and a small trophy. The price is about $5 USD for 3 adults. The palace has many closed areas. You can see the “sultans soccer field” which barely has grass. In all I recommend doing something else. They offer many things in center square.
Tempat untuk menambah pengetahuan tentang Yogyakarta, memakai tour guide lebih di sarankan karena mereka bisa menjelaskan tentang di dalam kraton

きらびやかだったり、荘厳な雰囲気を醸し出していることを想定していましたが、正直な感想は、権威付けされた公民館を見ているよう。ロイヤルファミリーの様子や、ここでかつて行われていた行事や政治を想像するにはいい。
ガイドを頼んだのだが、王宮チケットにはバティック製作現場の見学がセットで含まれているというようなことを言われ、バティックを購入するように迫るお店に連れていかれるという、後味の悪い思いもさせられました。気の弱い人だと、買わされてしまうかも。気をつけて。

quand on connaît les palais de séville on est forcément déçu par ce "palace", qui ressemble plutôt à une villa au style ordinaire, mais délabrée.
juste de quoi en apprendre encore un peu + sur les derniers sultans.
7000 roupies, 30 minutes en prenant son temps. groupez avec le taman sari (pas terrible non plus), le sonobudoyo museum (déjà mieux) et malioboro street (très sympa). tout ça en 1 journée tranquilou
이 지역 술탄의 궁궐로서, 아담하다. 입장료가 7,000 루피아로 저렴한 만큼 볼거리가 다양하지는 않다. 조선왕릉 입장료 1,000원이 큰 반대급부를 제공해준다는 생각이 들었다.  그러나 여행자 거리와 가까워서 동선에 추가할만 하다.

The palace was fantastic and we were lucky to get a guide which has a family history serving the sultan. she was very knowledgeable. 
There are many items from the sultan's personal belongings on display as well as his family tree.

Not much to see there, unless you are very interested in the history of Indonesia and feel like looking at portraits of sultans..
There was a guy standing at one of the gates (opposite the entrance gate) who told us he’ll show us how the Indonesian dolls are being made. It’s outside the palace and not a part of the visit so I assume he tried to take us to his shop to sell us stuff). I’m not sure if you’ll be allowed back in the palace once you leave with that guy.
It’s just a nice space with big trees, birds, roofs and tiles; without guides or explanations it won’t take much time to enjoy it. At that time (Sunday) it was open till 2pm

Not really to visit palace but a empty place with small houses hosting exhibitions. The museum is badly maintained, and glasses and not cleaned for ages and you barely can see what is exhibited inside. For the price this is what you get, but you overall lose by wasting your precious time

Palazzo in discrete condizioni di conservazione , con al proprio interno una miriade di negozietti, abitazioni, orti e così via. Numerosi volontari presenti di cui non si capisce la funzione . La guida ci ha illustrato tutte le varie articolazioni del palazzo , compreso il posto dove alloggiava il corpo di guardia. Belle le fontane e le vasche. Ma la parte più bella è data dal cortile dove su marmo bianco di Carrara siedono i musicisti che suonano musica  locale.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Lokasinya terletak diantara alun-alun utara dan selatan. Didalamnya ada berbagai peninggalan bersejarah seperti buku. Jangan khawatir, ada penjelasan mengenai masing-masing peninggalan tersebut jadi anda tidak bingung. Mau kesini berapa kalipun juga tidak akan bosan

A few hours in this wonderful palace, out of this world. The architecture, the Javanese culture that oozes out of every part of the palace, it was a wonderful experience. When in Yogyakarta again, certainly will go here again too.

Ini tempat buat belajar seni, adat adiluhung, sejarah, dan melihat langsung legenda keraton yang masih hidup sampai sakini... Tapi itu jadi tempat menarik bagi para penggemar seni, sejarah dan sosiologi.  Kalau yang sukanya hura-hura kongkow di mall dan shoppee shoppee, tempat ini bisa jadi boring, kata mereka no matching Bro!

Kraton meaning palace in Jogjakarta is one of the interesting place to visit. Situated next to ALun ALun located in the middle of  the city.Surrounded by hight wall the palace built using local materials and artistic design.We can explore the kraton while looking at antics artifacts and learn more about ancient majapahit kingdom.There is a minimal fee at the entrance and you can pay the guide to assist you for more information
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Wisata edukasi yang murah meriah dengan membayar tiket masuk sebesar 5.000 rupiah untuk pengunjunh domestik dan 10.000 rupiah untuk pengunjung asing.

There really is not much of interest here.
Its pretty much just a historic large covered meeting area.
Its dull, not very well maintained, not very clean & stinks of bat urine!
However ... it doesn't cost much (Rp3000 local - Rp5000 tourist) so you're only wasting time!
Sangat bersemangat sekali kesini, suasananya Jogja sekali. Menambah wawasan, cocok untuk wisata edukasi. Hanya saja saya kesini saat hari Senin sehingga tidak dapat melihat orang Keraton.

Highlight was definitely the performances that go on between 10 and 12 everyday. Interesting collections, some great tinted glass and marble floors. But many explanations only in Bahassa . Tour guide recommended.
Endroit incontournable de la ville mais sans plus. Prenez un guide, c’est indispensable et agréable.
Very informative visit to this royal palace. Most areas still well-kept and provides a glimpse into life in an Indonesian palace. Do not miss the performances.

If you arrive before noon, you can hear the welcoming music and see the traditional orchestra with amazing instruments. Architecture is beautiful and be sure to find out the meaning of every single detail. Friend and I went there with JavaBali Trips and Ardi was my guide (I've already been with him on other tour). He is very detailed and interested to share with you a lot. Because there is a lot of history there, it's essential to have good guide with you. If you are detailed, you'll probably spend around 2 hours there. There are also souvenirs around the place. If you want to understand local history, this is definitely must.
with very polite local tourism guide , want to know about Jogyakarta in past this right place to start
Interesting to learn about the history of the sultan and the bloodlines.  The museum with the many gifts was also interesting.
Destinasi wajib juga nih buat para wisatawan luar Jogja. Kenapa? Karena kaljan akan melihat kentalnya adat dan budaya Jogja di temoat ini.

En el día visitando Yogyakarta fuimos a los templos budistas de pranamban y luego al palacio del sultán .Nada especial muy sencillo pero es algo que deben visitar ,le falta una mantención pero es una alternativa de conocer

Lokasinya terletak di sebelah selatan malioboro. Sangat dekat sekalindengan malioboro, alun alun utara, dan maajid gedhe kauman yang sangat bersejarah. Saya menyarankan untuk anda berjalan kaki saja karena memang sangat dekat sekali. Untuk HTM yaitu Rp5000, disini juga disediakan tour guide yang siap membantu anda untuk menjelaskan semuanya. Di keraton ini anda dapat melihat berbagai baju adat yogyakarta, serta berbagai baju baju prajurit jaman dahulu. Selain itu juga terdapat berbagai senjata jaman dahulu. Ada juga foto foto dari sultan pertama hingga yang sekarang. Ke jogja tidak lengkap jika belum tau asal sejarahnya serta budayanya yang mempesona
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Nothing much to visit except great covered areas with pedestals, some with local music instruments in it. Most had decorated columns. There was a building with old dinnerware sets and bowls presented by various countries to the Sultan. Also some old brass ware to view as well. 
A disappointment after having seen Mysore palace
Senang sekali bisa berkunjung disini. Rasanya tak akan bosa berkeliling dengan guide warga keraton asli yg memberi keterangan detail tentang apa yg terjadi disana beserta benda2 bersejarahnya
王宮（クラトン）は北側と南側、それぞれ別々の建物に分かれていて、それぞれ入口があり、それぞれ入場料を払わないといけない。私の印象であるが、北側はしょぼい感じである。南側の王宮がすごく沢山の展示品でお腹一杯になる。しかし総じてあまり期待ぜずに、暇つぶし感覚で見た方がいいかなぁ。
Keren banget tempatnya, klasik khas keraton. Lumayan tempat foto dan disarankan untuk tidak ribut disana

Yogyakarta Sultan Palace (Kraton) is one of the icons of Yogyakarta. You can see Sultan's rooms, a collection of stuff such as weapons, portraits, various kind statues around the palace.The complex is large. 
Cheap reasonable entry fee.
I recommend a guide.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
施設の見学だけでなく、ジャワ舞踊や影絵等のプログラムが充実しています。日替りなので好みのプログラムを調べて行くといいと思います。
私はジャワ舞踊の日に行ったのですが、メインの舞台を見た後に施設の奥に行ったらもうひとつ舞台があり、男子の踊りの練習？を見ることが出来ました。先生らしき人に直されながら汗だくで踊る姿は素敵でした。
中の展示はかつて使われていた施設そのものと、写真や衣類、道具等の博物館のような展示もあり見ごたえがありました。
ただエアコンは効いていないのでうちわや扇子があるといいと思います。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Okay, not much to see. Pricing wise not so expensive given places like Borobudur cost a hell lot of money.
Belum ke jogja kalau belum ke keraton Jogja. Tempat bersejarah jogja dari jaman dahulu. Cocok dikunjungi apalagi untuk yang pertama kali datang ke Jogja

This is not Rooms  full of furniture and beautiful paintings as one might expect of a Palace. It does however give you an idea of the wealth of the Royal family and of the social structures of the time.

Having visited before and had an excellent guide I felt confident to take the in-laws and impart key facts I had learnt. Favourite bits that appealed to us is the room full of batik where you can see each of the key batiks and what they symbolise. The family tree portrait gallery where you find pictures of trees for each king showing fruit and leaves for each wife and child. Can you spot the one for Sultan with 28 wives!  New sultan is a one women man who has had 5 daughters and also the region have decided the heir will go to his younger brother not to break tradition and go to eldest daughter.  Check out the beautiful women at the rear making royal batik and selling it. We got a 3 pattern batik for 1m = £52 uk and had it made into a batik Friday shirt for work for 200000 = £11.50.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: tiket masuk terbilang murah, ada guide juga, banyak yang bisa dilihat. deket pusat kota sehingga tranport OK

Sebuah tempat bersejarah yang masih aktif hingga sekarang, Kraton Yogyakarta, abdi ndalemnya sangat setia dan mereka rata rata memakai pakaian khas budaya yaitu memakai Kebaya dan Batik, adat istiadatnya serta budayanya terasa masih kental. Dan pengabdiannya begitu mengagumkan. Istilah Kraton adalah identik dengan kerajaan.

Когда-то в нем жили султаны. Экспозиции представлены фотографиями. Рядом,  если пройти направо будет продолжение за 30000, где можно попасть на интересное представление под музыкальное сопровождение достаточно интересное. Здесь же находятся помещения в которых представлена мебель, посуда, оружие.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Keraton Jogja is clean, well maintained, and very pretty. We use a tour guide so that we can understand the whole story of the building.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
The palace is a one big site with a few areas comprises the palace where the current king (10th king of Yogyakarta) resides in, museum of the 9th king, rooms that display various gifts received by the kings from other countries such as China, Japan, Holand, etc, places that display various batik motives worn by the royal family and relatives, etc. 

It was very interesting to see items and stuffs from a few decades ago and to relate them to the current age. I get to understand a bit more about Yogyakarta by visiting this place.

Tips: foreign visitors need to pay an entrance fee of Rp15,000 each to get in. You are also encouraged to hire a tour guide with a small token (we paid around Rp50,000 - our guide requested this amount) for the visit. The guide will help to explain the areas and items inside the palace area. The history and info shared are also worthless in my view.

Acudimos al palacio del Sultan con muchas espectativas en la visita. La realidad es que es totalmente prescindible. Durante el recorrido te hablan de la vida del sultan y de su familia y antepasados. Muestran también los regalos de diplomaticos al sultan. Poco interesante

It is a big complex of buildings. It is nice to wander around, they have some performances that are interesting to watch. It is more less it - nothing too exciting or extraordinary. If you are in Yogya then it's worth having a look but don't plan to spend too much time here.
Keraton jogja yang masih exist dengan kebudayaanya, dan sangat terjaga, dan sangat ramah orang2 nya, jogja istimewa

Make sure you enter by the big clock entrance. It is confusing because there are two entrance and one nearest to the square is just for the public buildings within the Palace. The access by the big clock entrance is for the museum and this is much more interesting.

This is a must visit site when you visit Jogja. The building is full of historical story. There are also a lot of souvenir shop outside of the Keraton. The palace was quiet and cool when I visited it in the morning
The charm of old palaces , a bit ageing but nice place to discover the local culture and history. Nice collection of portraits of ancient rulers
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Pas d’explications en anglais, site très petit visité en 10min, pas cher certes à 7000 rp mais ne vaut pas le déplacement. Quelques costumes présentés, des portrait de sultans et des anciennes carrioles et c’est tout. Peut-être avec un guide est-ce mieux…

This place wasn’t originally on my must sees for Yogyakarta but I was glad I went. We spent the 50000 IDR ($5 AUD) and got a guide who was great. It was a very insightful and interesting without being a long tour into the life of the Sultans of Yogyakarta.
I have been to numerous palaces and very few of them are actually ALIVE like this is. We joined a funny lady tour guide who shared interesting stories inside the Palace...
The besttttt, pemandangan yang indah yang belum pernah saya lihat sebelumnya.. Harus bisa sering2 main k yogyakarta

One of the good visits of a real palace in Java. There are guides in English. Everyday between 10am-noon, there are performances of the gamelan orchestra, shadow play, or singing. On Sunday's 11am-noon, there are excellent classical dancers performances. Most Sunday's at 10am-noon, in an inner courtyard, you can watch classical dance lessons.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I would definitely recommend taking a guide to stroll through the expansive Keraton with all its history and beautiful artifacts that were gifted to the Sultans. A must-visit in Yogyakarta.
Tamansari is here too. The water castle with the beautiful stone carvings and the underground mosque

This inhabited palace was more like a museum and the people (tour guides and even the various “palace guards” were extremely friendly, to the extent that they weren’t chastising some tourists for disrespectful behaviour - something I would expect at other countries. As a personal touch, the Sultan gives you a token of he is unable to meet you and encourages you to come back again. The Sultan is also the governor of this special region, so this is definitely “open governance”!
Nice place.  Beberapa benda2 peninggalan sejarah ada disana. Selain kamu berwisata jika kalian kesini kalian akan merasa lebih dekat dengan yogyakarta.
tempat yang sangat bagus tepat dimna sejarah indonesia pertama kali mempuyai ibukota negara dan menyimpan sejuta sejarah
如果到日惹，一定要到蘇丹皇宮遊覽，在皇宮內可以看到以前印尼宮廷人士的衣著及擺設。如果有幸，可能可以見到蘇丹的待從，他們會穿著傳統的衣服出沒在皇宮內。不過皇宮在下午1時許關門，所以要趁早遊覽。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Walk there via back streets and say hello to the friendly locals as you pass their houses. Kraton is only going to take up an hour or so and is an easy walk just beyond southern end of Malioboro. I took photos of the caged chickens, mainly. Quite exotic. Walk back to Malioboro area through another set of back streets. Friendly grandmas sitting out with grandkids saying hello. Best part of the journey.

The Sultan Palace is a residence the actual Indonesia Sultan where have a many places for visit inside the Palace with a good views for take a pictures! Have a Indonesian instrumental show inside the park!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
This place used to home of Kesultanan Yogyakarta, until HB IX. And this place still used and open for public. If you are the first timer traveler to Yogya, I recommend you to visit here. Just ask a official tour guide at ticket counter, and you will be guided to see the Kraton collections.

There are Batik Museum, consist of royal member collections. Also, Gallery of many old painting where you can found sultan and his royal families portrait picture. Also,  there are Sultan HB IX Museum, where you can found all his items, from his hobbies, uniform, until orders badge with its certificates.. There also a place where collection of antiques, and tabbleware of Keraton. You can see a antique teapot used from the first until the eight sultan. 

If you like an historic sites, this place should be on your list! You can find a very rich of history and traditions of Yogyakarta Sultanate.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Semuanya bagus hanya saja banyak terkunci padahal sepertinya bisa dilewati, sehingga terlihat seperti kecil lingkupnyaaa

The residence of the Sultan of this area.  The Sultan still had political power:  he is the governour of the province nowadays.
His father is adored almost like a god:  he proclaimed the Indonesian Republik, so very popular with the local people.
You can see some nice ornaments this Sultan used to use in his life.  Don't hesitate to take a local tour-guide, because you learn so much more about this place.
Our tour-guide was even a descendant of the 8th Sultan!  Her father was one of the more than 70 children of him.  
You can visit some pavillons and rooms in the palace, but it's a palace not to be compared with western palaces.  
It's much less sophisticated.  But interesting to see!  Did you know that in the palace-walls more than 1 million people live together in the small illegal houses
build there?  It had a population density of about 1 person per square meter!  Unbelievable...
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
進入皇宮有嚴格的衣著 
遊客參觀前要注意
皇宮面積不大  無咩金碧輝煌的裝飾
係一個好樸素的皇宮
皇宮展覽不同時期君主的用品 
令人從而理解日惹市的歷史

People in this palace still using Javanese (Yogya) traditional clothes. Sometimes you can see a traditional Javanese dance performance. It's more like a living museum. In the front of this (north) palace, there are a field, usually used for Sekaten (market or bazaar to commemorate Islamic new year). It is better that you enter this palace from the second gate (southern of the front palace).
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Imponente kratong che va visitato per lo meno dall’esterno. Palazzo del Sultano quando non si trova nel Palazzo del Governo. Facilmente raggiungibile dopo una passegguata per Malioboro.

毎日午前中にジャワ舞踊やワヤンクリッなどのプログラムがいろいろあるようです。私はジャワ舞踊が見たかったので日曜日に行きました。
大きな舞台に大勢の楽団がいて、その日のダンサーは女性４人でした。美しい衣装をまとい、派手さはないものの中腰でつらそうな体制で長時間踊っていました。
その後奥の博物館エリアを見学していたら、奥にも同じような舞台があり男性ダンサーの稽古風景が見られました。
展示品も多く見所満載なのでぜひ訪れてみてください。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Memulai perjalanan dengan membeli Tiket yang sangat Murah.. kami masuk ke dalam di dampingi dengan 1 Abdi Dalem yang sangat Baik, Pak Toni namanya. Kami diberitahu kisah2 tentang Kraton dan Sultan-Sultan tentunya dan kisah2 lainnya.. 
Jika ada kesempatan silahkan mengunjungi Kraton Yogya, krn kita bisa mengenal lebih banyak Tentang Kraton Yogyakarta.

Terima kasih.

Nasza wizyta była połączona z pokazem tańców indonezyjskich. Było to bardzo szczególne doświadczenie. Początek oglądały tłumy po godzinie zostali najwytrwalsi. Polecam pawilon z instrumentami, bronią i zdjęciami rodziny królewskiej.
Palace open only up to 1 pm, we came to this palace by pedicab. The palace is mostly open air and old structure. We did not have a guide so, maybe did not appreciate so much.

Keraton jogjakarta, tempat wisata yang menyediakan pengetahuan tentang sejarah kerajaan di jogja, kawasan ini dekat dengan pusat jajan malioboro jadi ga terlalu susah buat datang kesini, oia pastikan baju yang kalian pakai sesuai peraturan ya, soalnya waktu saya berkunjung kesana dilarang memakain celana pendek ole guide tournya. jadi buat jaga" saja kalian pakai celana panjang atau rok panjang. kalo ke jogja jangan lupa mampir ke keraton jogja ya kawan.
kalau di jogja wajib ke kraton, deket dengan alun alun utara sama malioboro, hanya jalan kaki saja sampai ,

Wisata di kraton Yogya terbagi menjadi 3 lokasi, pagelaran, kraton dan tempat penyimpanan kereta kuda.  Sangat menarik dan bermanfaat sekali untuk pengetahuan anak-anak. Sebaiknya menggunakan jasa guide agar bisa tahu lebih banyak tentang sejarah keraton.

The location not too far from malioboro, you can walk, use becak or delman. They provide a tour guide  in the location  if you want to know history  of Keraton. The location need use ceramic floor to avoid dusty.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Kann man sich getrost sparen .
Gibt nichts Weltbewegendes zu sehen.
Leere Räume, Baustelle, diverse alte Sachen des Sultans 
Eintritt und Fotoapparat Gebühr 8.000

There really is almost nothing to see.  The main area has many birds and smells strongly of urine.  It's also really hot.  The ticket includes a visit to the "batik school."  It's just a gallery selling batik.
Nothing grand here, a good place to walk around though and marvel at the architecture and read on the monarchy of Java.

Kraton mungkin jadi hal biasa saja bagi sebagian orang, tapi kraton memiliki sejarah di dalamnya. Sejarah yang bisa membuat siapapun terpukau ketika mendengarnya. Ya, Kraton Ngayogyakarta Hadiningrat membuat saya terpukau akan cerita-ceritanya.

Kraton Ngayogyakarta Hadiningrat dibagi menjadi 2 pintu masuk. Pintu pertama berada tepat di depan Alun-Alun Utara bernama Tepas Keprajuritan dan kedua bernama Tepas Pariwisata (berada di belakang pintu pertama).

Untuk tempatnya sendiri, Tepas Pariwisata lebih ramai dikunjungi wisatawan. Di dalamnya juga lebih luas dan banyak pengetahuannya.

Bagi yang ingin berwisata ke Yogyakarta, kayaknya destinasi ini wajib banget deh untuk dikunjungi. Sayang bukan kalau pergi ke suatu kota tapi nggak tahu tentang sejarahnya?
A very good place to explain and show your children to appreciate what they have nowadays and catch up some memorable history of Yogyakarta.

Este tem sido o “quartel-general “ dos sultões que comandaram esta região. A cidade é tida como capital cultural da Indonésia de hoje e Yogyakarta tende a manter as tradições.
Neste local reside o Sultão, mas você só poderá visitar a parte mais externa. 
Nas redondezas, você encontrará museus interessantes.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: a section of the place is converted to a museum for visitors and tourist to sample the lives of Indonesian royals while the rest of the place still serves as home for the King of Yogyakarta and his family. Boots a lot of artifacts from royal heritage, good place to visit while in jogja.

Kraton yang berada di antara pemukiman penduduk sudah menggambarkan betapa seorang raja begitu dekat dengan rakyatnya.
Bentuk bangunan yang masih terpelihara dengan baik dan masih berfungsi sebagai pusat pemerintahan di daerah khusus jogyakarta.
Berbagai peninggalan masih dapat pengunjung dinikmati dengan guide dari abdi dalem yang begitu ramah.

I was a bit saddened to read all the negative comments by previous reviewers, such as "unbelievably boring," "ugly," "nothing impressive," and so on. IMHO it shows an ignorance of Javanese culture and does not reflect well on the reviewers. For roughly US$ 0.36 (or € 0.31) you can get yourself a guide who can explain what you are seeing and experiencing. Or do a little reading up on your own before you go. This isn't Buckingham Palace, so lower your Western standards and expectations and enjoy the Sultan's palace compound for what it is.
 
In essence, the Kraton (or keraton) is a walled city with a population of 25,000 people who live, work, and worship inside this compound. There is a market, there are shops, schools, art and batik studios, and mosques. At the heart of this city is a group of buildings (Kraton) where the sultan and his family reside and where ceremonies take place. The sultan's residence is off limits, but the other buildings consist of halls, courtyards and pavilions, with the great reception hall in the very center. Students of architecture may appreciate the Javanese architecture dating from the mid-1700s. The complex was constructed based on ancient Javanese mysticism and spiritual beliefs and symbolic meanings. The Kraton is also the seat of protection of Javanese culture. The sultan subsidizes artisans and artists, musicians, dancers, archers, and others to keep the culture alive. The sultan even subsidizes the becak (rickshaw) drivers. If you come at the right time, you may see a wayang (shadow puppet) show, hear the gamelan orchestra on the antique instruments, watch wax being applied to the batik fabrics. 

The people of Yokyakarta are very proud of their Sultan and of the Kraton. That was evident when I visited the day before a big holiday and spoke with many young people who were practicing their English. They all knew their history and recited it for me, starting with the two kingdoms (sultanates) of Yokya and Surakarta. 

I also had the privilege of speaking with one of the gamelan masters who explained some of the intricacies of the instruments. 

Yes, many of the displays are rather old and ratty-looking, but that in itself has a certain charm. In one of the rooms I enjoyed the somewhat dated but quite educational video of the construction of the Borobudur. 

Go with an open mind and read up on the Kraton in advance so you won't be one of "those" tourists who had no clue what they were looking at.

De Kraton, deze "must-see-atractie" in het centrum van Yogyakarta is in opdracht de Hamengku Buwono de eerste gebouwd van 1756 tot 1790 is nog steeds de residentie van de huidige Sultan van Yogyakarta.
Alhoewel het gehele complex voor de Javanen zelf nog steeds vol is met specifieke symbolische betekenis en er een traditionele javaanse sfeer heerst, is het voor de toerist een bezienswaardigheid.
Naast de door twee zilveren "grijnzende" reuzen bewaakte toegangspoort is met name de "gouden troonzaal" met zijn fantastische plafond zeer de moeite waard zowel als het museum en de "schatkamers" met alle geschenken waarin veel zaken herinneren aan de tijd van Ned. Indie alsook aan de periode na de souvereiniteits-overdracht in 1949 aan de nieuwe Republiek. De meest bekende sultan was wel Hamengku Buwono IX (geliefkoosde bijnaam:"Henkie") die leefde van 1925 tot 1992,  invloedrijk en belangrijk voor de samenwerking met Nederland.
In de Pagalaran, de audientiehal, gebouw met 64 pilaren worden regelmatig zang- dans- gamelan en poppenvoorstellingen gehouden en iedere namiddag, als het complex gesloten is voor toeristen, worden door een groepje dames in traditionele kledij volgens origineel gebruik, de pilaren "gereinigd". 's'lands wijze, s'lands eer!

Palais du Sultan situé en cœur de ville, en bas du boulevard Maliobo. Entrée payante puis circulation libre mais pour ne rien rater des détails historiques ou des informations sur les expositions, il est préférable de louer un guide, en précisant sa langue d’origine, que l’on rétribue à sa guise. Le matin il y a toujours une danse traditionnelle et un orchestre d’instruments originaux, programme plus étoffé le dimanche. Musiciens, gardiens, guides, ont des uniformes spécifiques. Nombreuses salles relatant l’histoire, la vie du sultan, son éducation et son parcours politique, la généalogie, des vaisselles, des habits de cérémonie ou de loisirs, des photos anciennes ou plus contemporaines, des meubles, des collections… Certaines peintures murales sont défraîchies. L’ensemble est instructif mais ce n'est pas Versailles non plus. A voir quand même si on n'a pas vu la réplique à Solo.

Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The only interesting thing was the photo galley. The only interesting thing was the photo galley. It is hard to find anything to say when there was so little to see.

Der Palast bzw. das was davon übrig ist ist eine der wenigen Sehenswürdigkeiten in Yogyakarta. Am Eingang kann man einen Guide mieten, der einige recht interessante Hintergrundinformationen geben kann und ein bißchen was zur Geschichte erzählt.

Etwas interessanter bzw. sehenswerter ist das eigentlich zum Palast gehörende Wasserschloss.

For its price, I wouldn't expect spectacles or more. The entrance fee is cheap to begin with. On a positive note, it's nice to walk freely from one building to another and be warmly greeted by their guards along the way. However, the items showcased in the palace lack proper curation. I would pretty much be more interested in those showcases if there were signs, trivias, and other information (audio guides, etc.)
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Un endroit chargé de souvenirs où se mêle symbolique du lieu et histoire. A faire pour découvrit l'histoire de l'Indonésie quelques battisses très jolies avec de nombreux instruments locaux

Интересное место с точки зрения истории Индонезии. Не могу сказать, что дворец величественный, но место довольно красивое. На территории несколько небольших музеев, в которых хранятся вещи султана, большая фотогалерея, рассказывающая историю правителя и его семьи. Можно увидеть слуг султана, которые целый день ничего не делают, курят трубку и развлекают гостей. Ничего сверхъестественного или впечатляющего, но чтобы составить полно впечатление об Индонезии, можно и посетить.
Tiket masuk kesini cukup murah, kraton juga lumayan bersih ya, disana kita bisa liat pertunjukan gamelan, terus juga bisa liat abdi dalem yang jaga disana, cocok juga buat wisata bawa anak-anak.
Nice shopping at Malioboro street and UNESCO historical site Borobudur and Prambanan. There is Sultan Palace with underground mesjid and Water Castle.

Anton, nuestro amable chofer durante nuestra estadía en Yogyakarta, nos llevó temprano a conocer el Kraton o palacio real, donde aún reside el sultán. Sí, aunque Indonesia es una democracia, los pobladores de Yogyakarta votaron por seguir bajo la tutela del sultán, quien representa un símbolo de unión y tolerancia para las tres religiones que predominan en la provincia: musulmana, budista e hinduista. Él Kraton es sencillo, hasta modesto, pero alberga muchos símbolos ancestrales de su cultura. Lo que más me conmovió fue la exquisita música del Gamelan, grupo de instrumentos musicales tradicionales, interpretada por músicos ataviados con su vestimentas tipicas, los hombres portaban en la cintura una daga ondulada, el Kris. También me gusto mucho la danza cortesana javanesa realizada por una bailarina preciosamente peinada, maquillada y ataviada, que danzaba con gran delicadeza y maestría. Admirable el manejo de pies y manos y la expresión del rostro. Un recuerdo, como dije, inolvidable.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Part of our city tour and worth to visit. Inside the palace you can walk freely and spend as much time as you like in the museum areas. Around 11 was a traditional show with music and dancing. Would recommend the palace and the show
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: 10k per person. There's a guide who took us around while explaining (similar like teacher of history) 😁

The palace is big but don’t look very grand. You may want to get a guide to bring you around the place. On top of entrance fee, you need to pay small amount if you bring a camera or mobile with camera.

Lokasi keraton yogya ini merupakan salah satu yang bersejarah di jogja, lokasi luas anda dapat menikmati suasana jogja pada jaman dahulu, ada tour guide yang dapat semua bahasa asing jadi tidak perlu hawatir, tiket masuk tidak terlalu mahal

The Sultan Palace or also known as the Kraton of Yogyakarta is a palace complex that used to be the main seat of the Sultan of Yogyakarta and his family. Now it serves as a cultural center for the Javanese people where shows such as gamelan, cultural dance will be performed at certain times of a day. It is also a museum that displays the Sultanate's artifacts. There is also a building that showcase on the making of the batik, the famous Indonesian textile. You need a guide in order to enjoy and understand the various buildings and artifacts that are located in the complex.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: If you have really, really, really nothing to do then go here otherwise stay away. Even the low price it’s not worth the money. Spend tour money on a beer.

A must-see place in Yogyakarta. A perfect place to know and learn about the whole history of the city, the development of Islam, Javanese culture and philosophy. Located in the heart of Yogyakarta and it's very accessible. You can see the sultanate's pictures and artifacts dispalyed. Great destination for family vacation or even couple.

Historische plek, met veel memorabilia uit het koloniale verleden van Indonesië. De thee ceremonie, dagelijks om 11.00 uur is aardig om te zien. Het wajang spel duurt 2 uur, goed om gezien te hebben. Het gamelan orkest is groot; een hele andere wereld.
Love the javanese culture and history ..  the kereta kencana , the dance , and Japanese gamelan .. much meaning and history

It was nice to see the palace, but not really impressive organisatie something. 
Everything is a little bit old and not super big. But it is a tourist atttaction, so ok to see.

Wij dachten we gaan per becak naar het paleis dit was echt super leuk.

Daar aangekomen weer de wel bekende kraampjes langs waar iedereen wil verkopen.
Daar binnen gekomen verwacht je pracht en praal en ik weet niet wat je verwacht maar wij hadden meer binnen verwacht.
Wij hadden wel een goed sprekende Nederlandse gids.
Legde ook veel uit alleen je ziet alle dingen alleen maar van buiten. Binnen kom je niets te zien.
Er wordt wel traditionele dans en muziek gemaakt. Wat wij wel weer erg leuk vinden.

Openingstijden zijn tot 12:00 uur daarna wil de sultan zijn paleisje terug😁

Wel mooie dingen gezien maar het viel ons eigenlijk best wel tegen. Daar de voor verhalen erg lovend waren.

Wij komen hier niet speciaal voor terug.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I didn't enjoy the visit : nothing really beautiful to see, old palace without any fantasy. Maybe with a guide it would have been more interesting.
Worth a look around. Cheap to get in and worth paying for the guide. Main palace under renovation so disappointing.

We really liked this place but feels sad that it's neither well maintained nor there's adaquate information available like no maps to browse through the big palace grounds, half of the items on display either do not have any information or just Indonesian. 
They could have done far better for such a rich cultural place.
Overall the palace was in good condition, equip with historical information. There are performance held inside but it is based on schedule.

It is nice, you will have a view of the Sultan family and palace but it's not a big deal.

We went there because we did have anything better to do and it worth the 30/40 minutes we took to visit it... but dont make a priority for your visit.
Visited this palace those who love history... you should go with a guide to understand the history better...the palace still used by the current King and his family until today...
Sotto le attese questo palazzo che brilla solo per la dimensione e poco più . Ambiente poco illustrato e solo in lingua locale. Apprezzato solo grazie ad un amico indonesiano che ci ha accompagnato.
There are many other things to do in Yogyakarta, I would skip this unless you have time to kill.....

A pesar de ser el Palacio del Sultán, y ser el Único sultán con poder político en la isla de Java, hemksnde decir que se trata de un palacio sin muchos lujos. La visita se hace una guía que es familia del sultán, ya que no dejan entrar guías externos. 
No es que sea muy bonito, pero te sirve para conocer un poco más la historia de la ciudad y el modelo político que siguen.
Th 90an kudapati kesan magis ketika memasuki pintu Kraton itu tapi skrg suasana itu sudah tak ada.. Masuk melewati bangsal besar di depan, terkesan tak terurus, kotor berdebu.. sayang sekali
Intéressant sur le plan historique mais aurait besoin d'un rafraîchissement. Le kraton situé derrière (la seconde entrée est beaucoup mieux).

Très joli monument, on apprend l'histoire du Sultan avec des anecdotes et des souvenirs de vêtements et autres objets. Le manque de signalisation du parcours est gênant car ce dernier est en plusieurs parties mais les locaux sont présents pour nous indiquer le chemin  avec le sourire. Prix d'entrée raisonnable

Kraton Yogyakarta ini merupakan salah satu daya tarik utama orang berkunjung ke Yogyakarta,ada yang mengatakan jika anda sudah di Yogyakarta namun tidak mengunjungi Kraton anda bisa dikatakan belum ke Yogyakarta.Di dalam Kraton Yogyakarta ini anda dapat melihat peninggalan benda benda Kraton jaman dahulu,seperti lukisan,gamelan,foto-foto,dll.Tempat ini buka mulai jam 9 pagi sampai jam 2 siang,dengan tiket yang hanya sekitar 7000 rupiah untuk wisatawan domestik serta 15000 rupiah untuk mancanegara tempat ini sangat wajib anda kunjungi.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Certains diront que ce palais n'a pas le faste des palais chinois, coréens ou japonais. Qu'importe! Si vous etes là pour decouvrir la ville et vous impregner de son ambiance, allez-y.
Je l'ai fait sans guide, pour etre libre de deambuler tranquillement dans ses batiments et allées. En ce mardi matin : concert de Gamelan dans la première cour, inclus dans le billet d'entrée, à voir!

Prix du billet d'entrée : 15000 Rp + 1000 Rp de droit photo

De todo lo que vimos en indonesia, lo primero que descartaría es este "palacio". Está prácticamente 100% enfocado al turismo local indonesio, y todo son exposiciones (horrorosas por cierto) de trajes, menaje antiguo, carruajes, etc...sin mucho interés, y sin explicaciones en inglés además.
Puedes entrar a ver un "documental" en una sala de proyección, donde verás la impactante escena del sultán lanzado monedas a sus súbditos en alguna de las festividades que celebran en ese edificio...todo muy del siglo XXI vamos.
Lamento profundamente no haber leído previamente las opiniones que hay aquí reflejadas, puesto que me hubiese ahorrado la entrada que pagué.
Hal yg luar biasa berada di tempat wisata Jogja .Suasana nyaman dan menyenangkan liburan di Jogja tahun ini. Suatu saat akan kembali ke kota ini.

A truly interesting place to visit, the Kraton on Yogyakarta shows me the rich culture of the Javanese people in Yogyakarta and the importance of the Sultan uniting his people together. The layout of the Kraton also shows how it is connected and linked to Yogyakartans' daily lives and true meaning of life. The rich culture and heritage preserved shows the identity of the people of Yogyakarta and how they have evolved to keep up with modern times without compromising on their tradition.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Grosse déception. Nous étions 5 et 4 à avoir trouvé cette visite vraiment ennuyeuse, et une qui a trouvé ça à peu près correct...
Le prix de l'entrée est franchement modique et on a compris pourquoi. 
Il y a des choses à voir, mais il faut s'accrocher car le cadre n'est pas vraiment celui auquel on s'attend quand on parle de "Sultan Palace" : l'architecture est par endroits jolie mais certains bâtiments sont tellement mal entretenus que les salles sont délabrées. 
A faire si on est vraiment passionné d'histoire ou si on n'a rien d'autre à faire.
Apparemment il ne faut pas y aller le vendredi (comme nous l'avions fait) car il n'y a pas d'animation (musique?), peut-être cela aurait amélioré notre expérience?

Het is een groot complex met veel traditie er in. We zijn er zelf door heen gelopen, dan mis je alleen wel veel uitleg door dat er enkel Indonesische informatie beschikbaar is... De wajang poppen voorstelling was voor 5 minuten best bijzonder, maar vooral om even de sfeer te proeven, het is lastig te begrijpen zonder achtergrond kennis. 
Maar we hebben het gehad en kost niet veel :)

The location is really doing a disservice to itself by not providing better English training to its guides. The museum and palace are ripe with history and explanations that are not transmitted beyond Indonesian. If you go here you are required to get a guide, but they will most likely speak in broken and limited English. As a couple, one of us being a speaker of Indonesian- we were able to take a full tour and ask questions and spend 5-15 minutes at each designated spot. Likewise, I saw a German couple who spent less than 30 seconds in the same spot due to the lack of communication.

Very disappointing for us as well were the supposed cultural shows which did not happen at the published time. Seems very unorganized to be honest. 

The guides will take you to a batik store after the tour. There is no pressure to buy. This I think is really wonderful idea but obviously the idea IS to sell the art. There is no scam and the batik location is funded by the sultan. I liked going but it did seem a little sketchy at first. Don't worry.
Ke Jogja tanpa ke Keraton bagaikan minum kopi tanpa air. Ini adalah pusat budaya dan objek Utama Jogja. Penuh dengan peninggalan budaya yg lestari dan terjaga hingga kini.

Review :
1. Kondisi Bangunan Masih Bagus
2. Lingkungan didalam kraton bersih dan Rapih
3. Ada Bapak - bapak pemandu, bagi yang ingin mengenal tentang sejarah Kraton
4. Cocok bawa anak - anak yang sudah sekolah, untuk memperkenalkan seni budaya
5. Banyak spot bagus buat foto
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: 日惹皇宮是日惹市區最重要的景點，皇宮本身並不大，裡面有一些模型，旁邊還有一座博物館，最特別的是皇宮的4個角落都擺了一個籠子 裡面都有一隻公雞。

Di sini kita bisa belajar tentang masa kepemimpinan dari Sultan Hamengkubuwono pertama hingga kepemimpinan setelahnya juga serta peninggalan-peninggalan dari beliau. Tidak hanya menikmati arsitektur dari bangunannya saja tetapi juga bisa belajar sejarah dan melihat koleksi-koleksi dari lukisan, kain batik, ataupun barang - barang antik.
Salah satu keunikan Yogyakarta adanya komplek keraton yang masih terjaga dengan baik dan sering mengadakan kegiatan besar antara lain upacara adat yang bisa disaksikan jutaan pasang mata.

Toen we binnen kwamen vroegen we ons af: waar is het paleis nu? Je ziet een aantal bungalow achtige gebouwen met een eeuwenoude collectie ( inclusief spinnenwebben)
Nergens Engelse vertalingen dus je kunt er zonder gids niks lezen.

This place is pleasant enough without reaching great heights. Mostly it's a series of open air pavilions. It's well maintained and peaceful. There were gamelan players entertaining when I was there and it added to the atmosphere. The entry fee is IDR 15000.

Dans le centre de Yogy le palais nous donne l'impression de vivre avec le prince et ses épouses
Attention aux faux guides qui vous font visiter sans rien connaître ni de l'histoire ni de l'anglais
Mais bon cela fait des souvenirs
Très franchement, si vous êtes pas loin visitez le. Ne vaut le coup que pour les spectacles de danses et les démonstrations de gamelan le dimanche matin.
Kota romantis dengan sejuta kenangan, bersahabat, murah, dan ramah. Banyak warung lesehan, bisa nogkrong dimana saja..

Non perdete tempo e soldi. Soprattutto in vacanza. Non ne vale assolutamente la pena. Sembra la parodia di se stesso. Nulla di interessante. Ammasso di cimeli dei sultani, ricoperti di polvere. Niente di valore, di particolare...il nulla e per di più mal tenuto. Una delusione assoluta.
Tempat tinggal raja HB, kalau berkunjung kesini sebaiknya di temani guide/pemandu lokal supaya mendapat informasi yang lengkap

A nice leisurely traipse around the grounds to gain an understanding of how the local royal family functions. The pavilion is the main focal point and with a guided tour, I gained an insight into the costumes, genealogy and court life.

We visited the palace on our own, without a guide. Almost all of the explanations are in Bahasa Indonesia, so we didn't really understand the exhibits. There were forks and other everyday objects, which was a little confusing. The puppet show was ok.

Een kijkje in en om het verbijf van de sultan van jogjakarta.Veel oude pracht en praal,vooral de oude mannen met hun ere baantjes zijn vriendelijk.Mooi om eens gezien te hebben,de terugreis per becak was leuker

Dit paleis stelt niet veel voor. Alle uitleg (als die er al is) is in het Indonesisch, dus je snapt er niet veel van. De Nederlandse gidsen zijn bijna niet te verstaan. Het was voor ons een grote tegenvaller, maar gelukkig was het niet duur

Jika berkunjung kesini disarankan menggunakan pemandu lokal yg ada di dalam keraton. Sehingga penjelasannya lebih rinci. Harga tiket masuk keraton depan Rp. 5000 untuk wisatawan lokal. Dan setelah bertanya ada juga keraton bagian belakang dan keraton khusus kereta kencana. Kunjungilah keseluruhannya supaya mengerti keraton itu seperti apa.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: You are required to purchase tickets and tickets for the camera when carrying the camera. There are some area that should not be photographed.
Worth a visit. Beautiful decor. Need to spend at least 40 minutes to explore the grounds. Beware of freelance guides offering to show you around though.

Architecture du site pas très jolie, objets exposés dans les bâtiments sans intérêt, tous à la gloire du sultan local (ses chaussures, ses chaussettes,  ...). 

Derrière le palais il y a cependant un quartier sympa.
Palazzo poco interessante e mal tenuto. stanze semivuote e qualche foto. a mio avviso nulla di rilevante. Costo del biglietto inferiore all euro

The palace is a beautiful, clean oasis in this bustling city. The grounds and buildings are impeccably maintained. The tour was pleasant. The artifacts presented are beautiful. It is definitely worth a visit while in Jogja.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
