Review Text: Located in the exact between Merapi vulcano and the ocean the sultans palace can be visisted every day. Use a guide for usefull information. Unfortunate the costume display is behing glass and very difficult to see. Learn about the history from sultan 1 until the current sultan 10.
This is one of the "must visit" place while in Jogja. It tells you the history of the Jogja Sultanate

Se avete terminato il.vostro tour e vi avanza del tempo potete dedicarvi alla.veloce visita del.palazzo reale.
Alcune parti sono tenute bene e degne di attenzione ma per la maggior parte si tratta di un.percorso dentro stanze semi vuote adornate con qualche foto della dinastia sovrana.
Il.biglietto costa 1euro.ed eè inclusa una guida che vi spiegherà cosa state.vedendo.
Excellent avec un bon guide. N'aurait eu aucun intérêt sans guide. Nous vous conseillons Santosa, excellent Francophone, poétique et passionnant !
Masih sangat terawat tempatnya,siapin fisik karena kita akan mengelilingi kompleks istana yang cukup luas,buat backpacker bisa menolak guide tour/ abdi dalem untuk menghemat budget.

une partie du Kraton était en travaux lorsque nous l'avons visité, l'édifice global est en bon état, on peut se rendre compte de la vie qui se déroulait dans ce palais, une des annexes est très jolie, l'intérieur recense simplement des peintures, de la vaisselle royale, des photographies etc 
tous les jours il y a une activité au sein du palais : le lundi c'est concert de gamelan mais ce n'est vraiment pas le meilleur endroit pour apprécier ce style de musique!

Dit Paleis is van de Sultan. Er is veel te zien. Het complex bestaat uit diverse gebouwen en achter het Kraton is er ook nog een Paleis tuin. Als je in Yogjakarta bent is het de moeite waard om hier even naar toe te gaan.
Great location on jogja u must visit...very historical location which used by sultan to rule joga city,traditional building,nice employee,great location !!!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
der sultanspalast ist nicht bemerkenswert schön. eintritt ist 7'000 IDR, weitere 2'000/fotokamera, am eingang warten "official guides". einer hat uns dann in den palast geführt und ein paar dinge erklärt, das war ganz ok, aber nicht überwältigend. der palast tönt imposanter als er ist, ein flaches eher farbloses gebäude. das farbigste sind die eingepferchten hähne... als unser "guide" uns zur batik-art academy locken wollte, haben wir uns verabschiedet, dies hat er eher verärgert zur kenntnis genommen und wollte trinkgeld (mehr als wir ihm gegeben haben). 

ACHTUNG: guides die euch in die kunstschule des batikens locken, wollen euch in hinterzimmern billige fälschungen für viel geld verkaufen, dies ist ein trick von dem wir vor der reise im internet gelesen haben.

I was dissapointrd with this museum. The palace has not been maintained with the exception of the glass room with magnificent gold ceiling. Everything else is  not too exciting. The photos on the wall are extremely faded. We had a guide from the museum and his English was poor so he was hard to understand. I would say this is not a must see...save your momey.

Se vi avanza del tempo ok buttateci un occhio se no lasciate perdere.
Non riesco nemmeno a descriverlo.
Gewoon gaan zien. Dit paleis is niet te missen en herbergt genoeg geschiedenis. Op een kleine 3 kilometer van de meeste hotelletjes. Een taxi of becak is zeker een aanrader.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It wasn't a really good place to sightseeing. The buildings are really old and not fancy at all. I know that the Sultan and all the Kingdom already moved to another place, but at least this old kingdom should be taken care enough. I still like the education that they gave (museum of carriage, costume, Sultan's portrait, etc). It was nice to know the history of this palace after all.
This place was not well maintained. Dust everywhere. It could have been better as it was a really nice place to visit. Had some interesting displays too.

Keraton Yogya selalu menarik untuk dikunjungi. Cerita sejarah dan pemandangan tempat tinggal Sultan yang selalu bisa mencerminkan kekhasan Yogya. Cocok untuk edukasi anak, area yang luas dan sejuk. Pemandu yang selalu penuh antusias mendampingi berkeliling dengan sejuntai kisah sejarah.. Always glad to back here.

Eccomi, vi posso dire che il posto non mi ha entusiasmata
Il palazzo è tenuto bene, ma forse mi dedicherei a visitare i tempi...
Decisamente belli

Het paleis in yogyakarta is wel aardig om te gaan kijken als je tijd over hebt maar niet echt bijzonder.
Pak geen Nederlandse gids. Het zijn oudere heren die heel slecht Nederlands praten. Ze zijn bijna niet te verstaan en als je iets vraagt begrijpen ze het niet en geven een niet passend antwoord.

The only reason I am giving a 3 stars is because I personally liked this glass building with nice ceiling. Other than that, I am not sure what I walked into. There was no English translation for anything other than "NO ENTRANCE". We walked into every single museum and there were lots of photos and furnitures without lighting or translation, so I had no idea who used what or who was who. Hence, I am not sure what I saw. Just for comparison to the Forbidden City in Beijing, Sultan's palace would be the bathroom.

Mit einer kompetenten Führerin erfuhren wir viel interessantes über die Geschichte Der Familie des Sultans. Trotz vieler Touristen gibt es hier Stellen der Ruhe, wo man die Eindrücke gut auf sich wirken lassen kann.

We were a bit disappointed by the palace. You expect a fancy decorated architecture, instead you visit slightly old buildings with a lot of old pictures of the sultan and plenty of glass collections in dusty cupboards. We had a guide so it was interesting to get some facts about the sultan's family and history but overall it wasn't that spectacular...

Bangunan-bangunan disini lebih terlihat bergaya arsitektur Jawa tradisional. Di beberapa bagian terlihat sentuhan dari budaya asing seperti Portugis, Belanda, dan Cina. Tiap-tiap bangunan memiliki kelas tergantung pada fungsinya termasuk kedekatannya dengan jabatan penggunanya. Kelas utama misalnya, bangunan yang dipergunakan oleh Sultan dalam kapasitas jabatannya, memiliki detail ornamen yang lebih rumit dan indah dibandingkan dengan kelas dibawahnya. 

Kalau mencari guide usahakan cari guide yang sudah agak senior (mohon maaf, tapi biasanya berusia lebih tua). Mereka jauh lebih menguasai baik sejarah maupun perkembangan keraton. 

Harus kemari kalau ke Jogja,

L un des rares monuments à visiter à Yogya. Pas grand chose à voir malheureusement.
"Musée" qui n expose que des photos jaunies des sultans de Java avec un éclairage faiblard.
Le tout n est pas désagréable mais en 30 minutes, c'est vu !

My parents and me visited the palast yesterday. It was a huge shock and we waisted our time. Mom and dad were there 20 years ago and they insisted on the fact that nothing has changed since they were there. The only thing that you can see there are pictures which aren't interesting at all. We went in there and 5 minutes later we left the place because it was just boring. I even wouldn't go there if it was for free. But you learn from your mistakes and that's why I wouldn't recommend this place to anybody.

Zonder gids bezocht. Dan is het vooral kijken maar alle items die staan uitgestald, maar snap je er niet veel van. Er was een zang en muziek optreden, deze zijn meestal tussen 10 en 12. Groot complex.

Ganz nett anzusehen, absoluter Touristen-Hotspot. Kein Must-have!
Sanierungs- / renovierungsbedürftig

L'entrée est certes peu chère pour avoir accès à une grande partie du palais mais Il reste sans grand intérêt. Un enchaînement de plus ou moins jolies salles avec des objets appartenants aux sultans, explications seulement en indonésien. Je n'en ai pas plus appris en ressortant de cette visite!

Sofern man den richtigen Eingang erwischt (nämlich NICHT den am großen Platz mit den beiden Bäumen sondern den mit der großen Uhr seitlich Rechts dahinter), wird man nicht enttäuscht werden. Man findet eine liebevoll hergerichtete Stätte und interessante Details zur Geschichte des Sultans von Yogyakarta (der übrigens gleichzeitig der Gouverneur des Bezirks ist). Sehr sauber und sehr ordentlich.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Vous payez l'entrée ... pour rien ! 
Ne perdez pas votre temps à venir visiter cet endroit qui ne présente aucun intérêt. Encore moins si vous décidez de ne pas prendre de guide!
this is an old palace which is now preserved into a museum. can take your own pace of use the services of a tour guide.
Nothing special but some interesting exhibits, there seems to be little order to the exhibits but bearing in mind it's still the abode of the sultan it's still quite an interesting stop

The famous keraton yogyakarta is one of must visit when you come to jogjakarta. Keraton is the place or house where the king and family living there, and still use until now. Yogyakarta people very proud to their keraton. There  are some special moment when keraton open house and celebrating the holy event of java calender. When that happen, you can see a lot people come to keraton and can see king and his family in keraton. On the normal day, keraton only open just the front area i guess. Ticket entrance is 7k idr for local(plus camera). For foreigner 12k idr(plus camera fee). Opening hours is 9am - 2pm. But if you want to watching the traditional dance you should come by 9am every morning.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: We booked a 25 minute guided tour of the Royal Palace and that was more than enough to get a good look and feel for the place.
Het paleis heeft een enorme verzameling van hele veel verschillende spullen. Hier en daar wat onsamenhangend. Maar toch erg leuk om een rustige tijd door te brengen

Si tienes un rato libre en Yogyakarta y ninguna otra cosa que hacer, entonces vale la visita. Lamentablemente en malas condiciones. Lo mejor: puedes optar por un guía privado, en inglés, sin precio fijo -el pago es opcional-.

The palace is a nice distraction for an hour, but nothing more than that. Maybe we were a bit over tours by this point, especially as we'd been up at 3am for the Borobudur sunrise. It tells some interesting history of the Sultans of the region, and has some nice pieces on display, which i guess for the money is fine, but, coming from the UK with castles and palaces galore this was a little poor by comparison. 
The musicians were a nice touch upon entry and the staff and guides all dressed in traditional batik also added to the atmosphere.
One or two comments- it can get very hot there, especially as the ground is volcanic sand, so make sure you dress accordingly. We were told no hats (although this didn't seem to be enforced) so sun cream is recommended if it's a sunny day. Also the exit signs seemed to send you to a car park, with no other signs directing you anywhere. This leaves you at the mercy of 'touts' trying to send you off to various stalls that they purport to be part of the palace but aren't. It's far easier to just go back the way you came in. Look out for the hawkers too, they are very persistent.

Its nice to see but not very spectacular. It is nice to ask for a guide because with a guide you can learn something about the history. Without I don't think you will like your visit. So if you decide to go, ask for a guide!
Si vous êtes à Yogya, ça vaut la peine d'y passer mais sans plus. C'est joli, des guides sont disponibles mais coût supplémentaire.

Le palais est un enchaînement de cours. Des guides proposent leurs services à l'entrée en échange d'un don et d'un passage dans les boutiques du quartier.
La visite meublera quelques heures avant ou après les visites de temples.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Kraton Yogyakarta merupakan pusat pemerintahan Sultan Yogyakarta sejak zaman dulu sampai saat ini sebelum dijadikan obyek wisata. Menampilkan perjalanan Raja-Raja Kesultanan Yogyakarta dari zaman dulu sampai saat ini serta peristiwa-peristiwa penting yang terekam di sana. Kraton Yogyakarta terletak di tempat yang strategis, obyek wisatanya luas dan terawat. Harus dikunjungi jika mengunjungi Kota Yogyakarta.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Pada sisi selatan Kraton, ada alun-alun yang unik yaitu terdapat dua pohon beringin yang umumnya kita tidak bisa melewati jalan antara 2 pohon beringin tersebut

Should be visited if passing through Yogyakarta. We took an Uber from the Phoenix hotel . Cost less than £2 for a 15 min ride - traffic is hideous . Used a guide to show us around . In that respect it make it more interesting as he explained the history and what each area was used for . If you wander around yourself there is very little to see . Some of the areas are dusty and tired looking, run down which is a shame really as the palace is still in use for ceremonies . The area where the Sultan is still living is out of bounds so really all you are viewing is the outer courtyards /halls and a museum room 
Visit , avoid the street hawkers , use a guide (INR25,000)  , take a few photos
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Uno dei più insignificanti e scialbi palazzi reali mai visitati nella vita. Davanti al palazzo reale si trova un prato trasandato con spazzatura e dove i bambini giocano a calcio. Il palazzo dentro è spoglio e senza nessun tipo di arredamento o decorazione particolarmente degna di ammirazione. Le sale sono vuote con delle foto che se non fosse per la guida non ci avrebbero detto nulla di che. Se si vuole dare un senso alla visita consiglio di prendere assolutamente una guida locale perché almeno si ha la spiegazione delle foto appese e dei manichini in vetrina con i costumi tipici.
Only go here if you have a lot of spare time on your hands. It's not particularly attractive or interesting!

Una veloce visita con guida locale parlante inglese. La visita è necessariamente molto veloce perché gli ambienti sono pochi e piuttosto spogli. È abbastanza interessante la mostra fotografica e qualche gruppo di cimeli. Consiglio caldamente di prendere una guida perché aggiunge diversi particolari che altrimenti sarebbero persi. A noi hanno chiesto minimo 50000 rupie, che vale assolutamente la pena. È interessante chiedere della situazione politica attuale e del ruolo politico del sultano e dell'amministrazione della città. L'edificio in sé si presenta abbastanza bene ed il livello di manutenzione è sufficiente. La visita si articola molto velocemente perché non c'è molto da vedere o di cui parlare. Rispetto ad altri palazzi "reali" ad esempio in Vietnam o in Thailandia c'è molto meno materiale. Consiglio la visita ma senza avere grosse aspettative.
Dentro del palacio no se puede ver nada en especial. No merece la pena pagar la entrada ni el parking.

Entrati abbiamo la sensazione che le persone vaghino senza un percorso ben definito ed effettivamente é quello che  succede anche a noi. Il palazzo é un gruppo di cortili uniti tra loro con passaggi corridoi e piccole stanze contenenti cimeli del re ma il tutto a mio parere é molto mesto. Più che un palazzo reale sembra lo squarcio di un vecchio ospedale. Nn mi ha coinvolto. Interessante é stato lo spettacolo con suonatori e marionette caratteristiche anche se nn ho ben capito che cerimonia fosse.

L'ingresso costa 7000 IDR (circa 0,45€) ed il permesso per le foto 2000IDR ma in realtà sono comunque buttati.
Metti che se tenuto meglio potrebbe valere qualcosa ma così sporco e trascurato proprio nn dice nulla.
Ci sono 2 padiglioni molto grandi con manichini vestiti con l'abbigliamento boh credo tipico delle varie epoche, dico boh xe nn c'è manco una didascalia, manco un foglietto, niente di niente che spieghi cosa cavolo sono! 
In pratica secondo me vale la pena solo X dire "ci sono stato!"

in this palace you can find all of the building with a lot of philosophy. every carving and detail have deep meaning from its maker. you can learn the history of the palace and see all outfits, furniture, building, tradition that used inside the keraton (Palace) for special occasion/event. you can also visit museum kereta keraton which show old royal carriages through years until now.
Not much to see here but the price is right. Try to time your visit with one of the performances. Only open until 1 or 2.
王宮は、ジョグジャカルタ王朝が誕生した翌年の1756年に建造された。現在では、第10代スルタン（王）のハメンクブオノ10世が、クラトンの奥で生活そしている。建物の一部は博物館となっており、歴代スルタンの肖像や家具調度品や日本との友好関係を感じさせる資料などが展示されている。ラーマヤナのワヤン・クリッ（影絵芝居）がガムラン演奏で見れた。暑かった。
La ballade à travers les différentes cours du palais permet de profiter du calme mais on passe surtout beaucoup de temps à écouter le guide officiel dire tout le bien du sultan et de ces ancêtres.

We bezochten deze plek zonder gids en dat was wellicht niet zo slim... zeker omdat we zelfs geen reisboekje bij de hand hadden.
Het is een groot mooi gebouw, maar niet zo impressionant als je van het paleis van de sultan zou verwachten.
Er hangen hele reeksen portretten van sultans met wat uitleg in het Indonesisch, jammer, we begrepen er niets van.
Hier en daar staat een paviljoen met een heleboel instrumenten, je mag het paviljoen niet betreden. Hier hoort ongetwijfeld een interessante uitleg bij rond het doel van deze platformen.
Zonder gids zou ik een bezoek aan dit paleis echt niet aanraden. Het wordt waarschijnlijk pas interessant dankzij de sappige verhalen.
Jammer dat er geen Engelse uitleg voorhanden was. Ze vroegen ons bij de ingang ook niet of we een gids wilden. Ik geloof niet dat het hen interesseerde, hun focus lag op het innen van het entreegeld, waarbij weinig enthousiasme of hartelijkheid te bespeuren was.

Il n'y a rien à voir. Cela doit être sympa lors d'une cérémonie mais franchement, il n'y a pas de quoi exalter 
Très décevant
Das Wasserschloss ist klein, aber schön anzuschauen. Ringsherum sind ganz kleine Gassen in denen man kleine Künstlergeschäfte findet.

Il Palazzo non offre alcunchè di interessante. Si tratta di una serie di padoglioni mal messi privi di qualsiasi fascino o interesse. La guida illustra le varie stanze e i vari arredi e supellettili tipo la bilancia rotta del nono sultano, la sua grattuggia, i suoi stivali... tutti oggetti per niente interessanti mal tenuti e mal riposti in mobili polverosi. Non vi è niente di sfsrzoso o davvero artistico ed è solo una grande perdita di tempo. Lo spettacolo canoro con l'orchestrina risulta altrettando triste tra mugugnii e suoni poco armoniosi.
Evitate!!!

Interessante e gradevole, con poche migliaia di Rupie si ha l'ingresso per questo "museo" a cielo aperto.
Si trova alla fine della Malioboro strett
In un ora e mezza lo so visita tutto
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Zur Zeit ist es eine große Baustelle. Man kann aber an Hand vieler ausgestellter Bilder eine Menge von der Geschichte der Sultane sehen
Assez banal, que des commentaires en indonésien ... nous avons bloqué une journee en plus dans la ville (car attention le palais ferme tôt le vendredi!) et nous n'aurions pas Du...

El palacio fue la primera de las paradas en esa visita a esta bella ciudad y de no ser por los otros templos la decepción hubiera sido muy grande. La riqueza arquitectónica del palacio es muy baja y la mayoría de las estancias se resumen en fotografías del sultán practicando diferentes actividades. No lo recomendaría a menos que sea un día lluvioso...hay mejores cosas que hacer en yogya como visitar el TamanSari al lado

La visite est intéressante dans le palais du Sultan. Ceux-ci sont musulmans depuis le cinquième sultan. Environ 3000 personnes travaillent pour le sultan qui aussi dans la région de Yogyakarta est Gouverneur. Un/une guide francophone très sympathique est incluse dans le prix de la visite qui coûte un euro. Un pourboire est à laisser. Belle balade d'environ 1 heure.

Palazzo dove ancora vive parte della famiglia del Sultano , sito in una zona di piccole case dove vivono i quasi 10000 laboratori alle sue dipendenze. Attualmente mi dicono che il Sultano faccia politica attiva e governi questa parte di regione della Indonesia. Il Palazzo si presenta con un ampio giardino all'ingresso e poi un insieme di stanze, passaggi, tutti a piano terra. Non vi aspettate il tesoro di AliBaba. Molte vecchie foto della sua famiglia e sue, vecchie uniformi, e pochi oggetti. I tesori ci sono perché si dice che sia ricchissimo.......ma altrove
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Siamo stati molto delusi del palazzo del sultano, inanzitutto perché vengono dimostrate cose dei precedenti sultani come bicchieri, coltelli e quadri. La guida purtroppo sapeva poco inglese e quindi non siamo riusciti a capire tanto. Era davvero molto noioso e se tornassimo indietro, non ci andremmo più!

Je moet het paleis een keer gezien hebben, maar eerlijk gezegd is de buitenkant het mooist. Verder weinig te zien, en veel verval. Wellicht klink ik te veeleisend- maar het was niet echt bijzonder. Als Nederlander vond ik het nog interessant omdat er veel info staat over wat "we" hier hebben gedaan- maar vond het nog steeds maar matig boeiend.

Il palazzo del Sultano, ancora presente come governatore, è un grande complesso , visitato da gruppi numerosi di turisti, ma andrebbe
valorizzato meglio. Tutto sembra accatastato e le scritte sono quasi tutte in lingua locale, con raro inglese. Sembra più dedicato all'orgoglio locale , che ad una promozione turistica. Fuori una orgia di piccoli negozi.
Le persone sono comunque sempre disponibili

I have been to the palace or Kraton three times.  It is an interesting place and full of history.  The entrance fee is moderate and once inside you can stay as long as you like and wander around.  You can hire a guide which is recommended as most signs and information are only in Indonesian.

Much of the palace is an open air courtyard and you go into smaller buildings scattered around the grounds to view various artifacts. The collection from the various Sultans is wide ranging.  I only wish some of them were better protected from the heat and humidity.

If you plan your visit to line up with some event on the calendar, you may be lucky enough to see the musicians and dancers performing.  There may be a schedule for the performances, but I am not aware of it.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Keraton Ngayogyakarta Hadiningrat merupakan tempat yang direkomendasikan bila ada di Jogja. Menikmati kesenian Karawitan oleh para Abdi Dalem Keraton, serta bisa melihat berbagai benda-benda milik keraton

Om de echte Indonesische cultuur te proeven is de Kraton van de Sultan(voorheen Maharadja) een aanrader.
Als toerist zijn er twee verschillende delen te bezoeken waar ook apart voor betaald moeten, maar de prijzen zijn laag.
De plek van de inauguratie is zeer de moeite waard, als ook de museum stukken die inzicht geven in de geschiedenis van dit Sultanaat, is in de tijd van de Nederlandse overheersing op Java
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: No está mal la visita (una media hora más o menos), con un/a guía que no informará adecuada y amablemente, aunque no es un lugar que nos dejara impresionados.

Par rapport aux autres centres d'intérêt que la ville offre, le palais apparait aussi vieillot  que les guides!
Donne quand même une idée de l'adoration que portent les javanais au sultan!

This is a nice palace with small collections of portraits, utensils, clothes, musical instruments etc. but the display is poor. In the displayed items I found only musical instruments are really interesting. If you are short of time, you may give it a miss.
We visited this palace 3 days ago. We got an gala dinner invitation for Indonesian Neurologists Association's biennial meeting. This palace is very historical.

The palace is a few interesting areas, and but overall is pretty run down and needs some revamping. It could be a really beautiful space.

You won't need more than 30 mins here
...but when in Jogja, you have to see it, because of historical value. But running out of time? Don't go there, skip it.

Oke, 15.000 roepia is dan niet veel voor een kaartje, omgerekend €1,- maar daar is dan ook alles mee gezegd. Oud, vervallen en lelijk dus van een "palace" verwacht je wel iets meer. Zeker als je bedenkt dat hier een belangrijk stuk geschiedenis heeft plaats gevonden en de oude sultan in 1932 zelfs in Haarlem studeerde. Succes!

There are small collections of royal family's portraits, furniture, kitchen utensils, and clothes they used wear inside of the palace. In fact, to me these are not that impressive. There's really nothing much to see inside and the spaces visitors could see are also limited. 
However, it is a historical place where the royal family still lives. The most impressive thing was lots of kind volunteers inside of the palace. They were trying their best to ensure everything's going ok with visitors and to keep clean of the palace. It seems like they truly love their king. Traditional  costume they wore was beautiful. I loved to see their culture and dignity. Had a good time to stroll along the trees inside of the palace.
This is the old and actual residence of the sultan: check before the timing of the dance/theater show, is very interesting!

Dommage, la
Moitié du site en construction / rénovation. Ne vaut pas forcément le déplacement.
Expo / musé un peu pauvre en collection.
Si vous avez une heure à passer, pourquoi pas.

Si  bien,  se habla mucho del gran palacio...  No es nada del otro mundo, solo cuartos con retratos y al medio una especie de cuadrado de ceremonia..  Lo bueno es que para el turista es barato...  Ojo!  Cobran por las fotos!

We arrived at Joja just after lunch so we headed over the the palace.  We had met friends so we did not have to drive, but if you do taxi service is quite reasonable.  The Palace was interesting with a colourful history.  Even though the day was hot and humid the palace was cool with a nice breeze flowing through.
As the sultan still lives here, only two yards can be visited and there is really nothing special to see, as it's been reconstructed many times. Not really worth the visit.

Il palazzo va visto, più che per la sua bellezza, per la sua storia e anche perché è un luogo dove conoscere contatti per tour ed escursioni dell'ultimo momento "soprattutto se non ve le siete organizzate"

Er was echt niets te zien, geen Engelse omschrijvingen.. Wellicht als je een gids hebt die wij blijkbaar gemist hebben (was niet duidelijk). Let op voor scams! Bij onze wandeling erheen kwamen we een man tegen van een zogenaamd toeristen bureau die vrij was en zijn zoon ging halen. Hij adviseerde ons om eerst naar een batik winkel te gaan omdat het pas later een dansshow zou zijn in de palace. Hier werden we na (eerlijk gezegd wel leuke info) erg onaardig (agressief) werden behandeld toen we niks wilden kopen.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The palace its quite big for the exibition when we went inside the guide who was a old lady told us about the history and incredible person and great English skills she told us about  the palace is quite big there a old item of each of the royal family of jogjas and there a family tree and picture and its worth to come to here

En ombygning/renovering trækker lidt ned.

Reelt set et sted man bør se, men så føler jeg heller ikke at det er mere interessant endda.

Var dér også en varm dag, så motivationen til fordybelse lå også et lille sted.
Des salles presque vides où l'on peut voir de la vieille vaisselle sans intérêt et des portraits mal éclairés. Quelques belles pièces de batik.

Not really a palace in the sense of a single great building but a complex of mostly open sided structures housing various artefacts from the history of the family. A few other enclosed buildings with portraits of previous Sultan's and family, some crockery, military items etc. Not comparable to even minor palaces of Europe and India for example but there are quite a number of buildings to see, and all for what, just €1 plus 7 cents camera fee.
Kraton Yogyakarta ini benar benar menjaga jati diri jawa yogyakarta sangat terawat dan banyak lho turis mancanegara yang santa kagum dengan kraton yogyakarta ini
Het paleis bezocht. Niet te vergelijken met een Nederlands paleis. Stoffig en niet mooi onderhouden. Met gids eea uitgelegd gekregen. Nice to know. Geen bijzonder uitstapje!

The palace itself is not very impressive except for the golden pavillon. It is quite run down and the exibition is a bit random in its choice of the things on display.
However, we were lucky enough to get an amazing guide, an elderly woman, who was an incridible storyteller with great english skills. Because of her the palace was definetely worth it.
This palace isn't that special, but worth a visit. It displays a lot of pictures of the sultan and his family giving you a feeling of how important this family is for the Jogjas.
It has interesting history of the Sultans, but nothing much to see.. Values great, but worth only for a short stay (one hr at most).

Wat een drama en echt helemaal niks bijzonders. Als je er toch bent kan je even binnen lopen en voor het entreegeld hoef je het niet te laten. Maar dat ze hier nou niet iets leuks van maken en op zijn minst een beetje bijhouden. Jammer.

te lo enchufan junto al palacio de agua no merece la pena perder el tiempo en llegar para ver ninguno de los dos... parece que es el peaje que te hace pagar el sultán por visitar su ciudad... una perdida de tiempo hay mejores cosas para ver.. estan descuidados y sucios....

Kalo mau tau tentang seluk beluk keluarga Kraton , disini bisa ditemui banyak sekali hal yg kita ga tau , misal ttg putri raja yg akan menikah , tentang raja yg terdahulu hingga sekarang , bahkan sampai tempat dimana sang raja berpidato tanpa menggunakan mik , tapi suaranya bisa menggema

Cheap entry here (c.15k IDR), although you definitely need a tour guide who will take you round and explain all the different artefacts you see - you would be lost without them! They are free but it is custom to give them a small top for their services. 

Interesting for 1-2hrs, with lots of history to learn.

Not much of a palace,more a badly laid out museum.Information mainly in Indonesian,so couldn't even read up on the history.Lots of hidden charges for entrance,camera,video etc. Men must wear sleeved shirts,but women can wear what they like. As with all things in Indonesia the staff are really friendly and helpful,the only plus point about it.

ジョグジャカルタでは定番の観光地です。

暑かったから、ホテルからベチャに乗っていきました。
王宮は南と北があり、それぞれ入場料がかかります。
南の王宮では午前中でしたのでガムランの演奏をしていました。

ジョグジャカルタのいにしえを感じる事が出来ると思います。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
My friend and I went to the Kraton on our first day in Yogyakarta. It's difficult to find your way in, since there are only a few entrance points to the walled city. The Kraton itself is mostly museums. Nothing particularly interesting.

Also: watch out for batik and puppet scammers! They'll try to tell you that the palace continues in another area or that your ticket includes a batik or puppet workshop. Don't believe them!

So I think this one gets a lot of mixed reviews because many tourists only go to the front part of he palace, the 7IDR area. They do not find the next section, the 15IDR area. 

My recommendation is to skip the front area. Head directly south (see pic) for 5 minutes and go to that part of the palace.

Nada recomendable visitar esta atracción turística. Parece las caballerizas de una granja escuela, no tiene nada de especial y además te cobran por entrar. Casi cualquier actividad es mejor que visitar el
Kraton
ジョグジャカルタの王宮です。午前中に行くと曜日ごとに伝統舞踊やガムラン演奏、人形劇などもやっていました。

Few explanations and nothing interesting to see. Lost time. 
So focus your days on Borobudur en prambanan. Shopping mailoboro.

a full day wont be enough to explore this Palace. For someone who happened to be history geek like me, one day is never enough, however I planned myself to go back again and exploring more every inch of this Palace. 

I went in from the North Gate,there are two museums in this north Palace, they are Clothing/costume museums and photograph museums. I learned lot and acknowledge more about the palace from the Abdi Dalam who gave the explanation during the tour (well you can ask their help on the informations desk and it was free, but since I got someone beyond informative and experienced, little tips for them would be nice).

I finally met the Iconic Roof and Gate. For now I cant say more because, I need to explore more the Palace from difference entrance, because there are so many attractions I can not see on my visit day.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Ik had hier meer van verwacht.
Het kraton was wel groot en indrukwekkend maar ik vond het niet de moeite waard om te bezoeken.
The air is very hot, crowded people, trap parking price. I parked in front of keraton mosque and charge 20,000 rupiahs for 1.5 hours. Such parking area seems controlled by local gangster guys.
This is a must visit site when you visit Jogja. The building is full of historical story. There are also a lot of souvernir shop outside of the Keraton
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Ähnlich wie beim Besuch des Wasserpalast Taman Sari waren wir sehr enttäuscht. Es gibt eigentlich nicht viel zu sehen, die Mitarbeiter/Guides wirken sehr uninteressiert und gelangweilt. Unser Guide hat während unserer "Führung" unentwegt telefoniert und seine Nachrichten (auf 2 Handy's) gecheckt. Die Anlage wirkt leider nicht sehr spektakulär und gepflegt, obwohl sie teilweise ja noch bewohnt ist. Kein Must-See!!!

Keraton Yogyakarta merupakah tempat yang mendapat gelar 'must visit' ketika berlibur di Yogyakarta, sayangnya julukan ini membuat tempat ini menjadi terlalu ramai oleh pengunjung. Mungkin sebaiknya dibatasi untuk jumlah pengunjung perhari/perjamnya jadi pengunjung yang datang bisa lebih leluasa dalam menikmati salah satu tempat wisata sejarah yang iconic di Yogyakarta.

Kraton in java language means Palace. It was a great experience for us to visit kraton where you could learn and understand the culture of the java king heritage and history. To get more infirmation on this you can engage a guide there who is well verse about the history, he will bring you around the kraton while explaining and just pay him a token after the kraton tour. Its worth for any one to visit Yogyakarta especially its kraton. You will love it and i have already visited 9 times to Yogyakarta just to be wirh its culture, food and everything.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Kunjunganku kali ini untuk wisata dan sekaligus sowan utk halal bi halal (krn saat berkunjung moment abis lebaran). Karena aku suka tentang kebudayaan di indonesia, dan terutama budaya Jawa. Tak lengkap rasanya jika pulang kampung tak mengunjungi tempat ini. selalu ada yg dikangenin di tempat ini, keramah tamahan, suasana dan makanannya yg bikin pengen terus berasa di kota ini. Jika kalian ke Jogja jangan lupa singgah sebentar ke Kraton ya guys...tiket masuk only rp7500 :) .
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: If you want to understand the history of Yogya, you just have to visit this place. Once a week they also have traditional dance that is nice to see!

For once the entrance between locals and foreigners is not so huge, i paid 7k to visit and 2k to take pictures.
The visit himself is quite despiting, you see old buildings not well maintained and without explanations even in indonesian. Even the miniature is full of dust and really old.
At the end you are just walking among old buildings and the real palace is hiding behind a huge door.
There is really a huge potential to do something great but like often in indonesia they dont try to do more...
Anyway if you are close and dont know what to visit you can go it is still not bad.

But take care of the people who are trying to show you a batik shop...it is not good and because my friend is indo we avoid to use the "guide" to go but it is often a way to ask you money later for nothing...especially when it is more painting than batik.

Palais du sultan actuel de yoyogarka!qui habite une partie de l'édifice, le Kraton  n'est pas très grand. La visite est intéressante avec un guide car tout est expliqué en indonésien. Heureusement, au guichet, on vous propose un guide parlant presque correctement français qui vous explique la dynastie et les objets présentés, curieux mélange d'objets personnels ( le sultan aimait faire la cuisine et photographier) et d'objets plus officiels ( cadeaux offerts par les différents États)
Peninggalan bersejarah ini,  sangat menakjubkan selain dapat menjadi tempat wisata,  juga dapat menjadi tempat pembelajaran untuk anak anak.  Tempat wisata yang harus di kunjungi jika ke yogyakarta
Berwisata ke keraton Yogyakarta tak lengkap bila tidak ke Keraton yang megah ini. Biaya masuknya juga sangat terjangkau. Fasilitasnya lengkap, bangunan dan kebersihannya terjaga

Super édifice à visiter. 
C est vaste il a l ouverture 9h00 nous n avions presque personne.
Le guide est compris dans le prix.

Attention cependant le guide va essayer de vous emmener dans une école de Batik qui n est ouverte bien évidemment que le jour de votre visite du Keaton afin de vous vendre des toiles 8 fois le prix.
매우 화려하지는 않지만 조용하게 현재의 왕궁을 관람 할 수 있습니다. 하지만 들어갈수있는 구역이 제한적이고 박물관의 물건은 영어로도 씌여있지않아 외국인에게는 다소 불친절한 장소입니다
Every guidebook told us that it was something to see but we were very disappointed when we arrived there.. it wasn't magical at all..

The architecture and details are beautiful, especially the patios and gazeboes with stained glass and art nouveau details. Lots of pics opportunities.
The guards and caretakers are so warm and friendly. 
The collection inside is cute but it is the outside the gem , check the pavillions roofs and the woodwork on the carriages.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Sad to see how dirty and low maintenance of this once very nice and beautiful palace. I dont know how the local government that mainly and basically the royal family just closed their eyes on the necessity to keep this national heritage in good condition. Dont blame the local tourist that mostly peasant comes from other corner of the island. It is the duty of the management to educate the tourist while keeping the place clean and beautiful and stays attractive also for international eyes. Really really hope n wish anybody from the government also aware abt this.
Aku kesini, bener2 jadi tau banyak tentang jogja. Emang dasarnya aku suka budaya2 jadi ini tempat yang menarik buatku. Tempatnya gak susahlah dicari, dan tiketnya murah

Not as I imagined, the palace should look luxurious and elegant, but it was so unkempt, dirty and boring. Many leaves in the yard, dolls look unkempt and spooky, not much to see, just empty buildings with little photographs of history.

Yogyakarta has hot weather in general, but the palace is cooler as there are big trees in surrounding and you can feel the wind blow. Very beautiful palace is glorious with a lot of history, however we can only enter several rooms of the palace as the Sultan and family live there and it is forbidden to enter their rooms. We can even walk around the building complex and find interesting buildings or objects. While you are there you can enjoy the rickshaw ride or the cart pulled by horse to sightseeing around the palace.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: We visited Kraton Yogya 2 days before our trip to Kawah Ijen Blue Fire Flames. Many beautiful point we can witnessed here. Like the exhibition of the Batik, coming inside the Kraton it was very amazing and beautiful Java Palace. The performance of Java dance and many other rituals that happen everyday at the palace are all very interesting and amazing. If you come to Java this place is highly recommend.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Berharap seperti istana-istana yang bebas dikunjungi turis di negara lain, cukup kecewa melihat keraton ini. Kotor, banyak sarang laba-laba di berbagai ruangan, tampilan yang kusam. sangat mengecewakan

Inside the palace, we only see dioramas(mannequin) and photos of the kings from the third king until now, other than that there is only a large field, but for those who like to take pictures, this place is great

Even so, you should visit this palace, if you go to yogyakarta city because it is one of city icon

Kunjungan ke keraton yogyakarta 28 juni 2017 bersama keluarga dan anak laki2. Lokasinya rindang dan teduh. Barang yg dipajang kurang perawatan dan jenisnya hanya patung 2 dan kereta yg banyak. Sebaiknya ditambah dgn benda 2 pusaka sprti keris maupun senjata berupa meriam pedang dll maupun foto2 perjuangan jaman dahulu dan silsilah keluarga sultan dari awal sampai yg saat ini menjabat

Walau sudah sering ke Kraton yogya tetapi setiap berkunjung selalu memberi kesan.  Tiket masuk wisatawan domestik 7500 sedang untuk asing 15 000.

Museum batik museum kristal , pameran lukisan dll nya memberikan gambaran lebih lengkap tentang peran Kraton yogya dalam melestarikan budaya Jawa .  Kita juga belajar tentang keistimewaan yogya di Kraton ini . Wajib bagi wisatawan

As the palace is also the house of current Yogyakarta Governor (or Sultan), there is no eery feeling that you may find in other museum which exhibit ancient things. The local guide will be there to tell the story if you wish to.
Get a guide.  If we had walked around on our own, we would have been in and out quickly.  The guide provided context and brought a lot of what we saw to life.
Disini banyak menyimpan cerita dan pengalaman hidup seseorang di jaman dahulu nya, tentu harus kita lestarikan sebagai salah satu sejarah indonesia..

1 kata "terpukau"..
Disini saya banyak belajar tentang tradisi dan budaya kraton yogyakarta.
Tempatnya luas,, dan banyak ilmu yg kita dapat.
Klo datang lebih cepat,, bisa lihat pertunjukan seninya ..
Vonden het niet interessant. Alles van hetzelfde. niet duur entree en er kan ook een gids mee gaan. Wel schoon

So I had been to Solo earlier this year and in some ways this Keaton reminds me of the one in Solo as well. There is a big open field in front. The 10th king still stays here. They have an open place where young ladies still dance: the also have rooms of stuff which have been given to them by visiting dignitaries. It's a nice slice of Indonesian culture and also a reminder of the ordinariness of everything.

Kami -untuk kesekian kalinya - mengunjungi Kraton Yogyakarta, karena anak-anak merasa selalu menemukan hal-hal baru di sini.  Kunjungan kali ini membuat anak-anak belajar banyak hal, selain soal sejarah.  

Sebuah lokasi peninggalan sejarah yang luar biasa.

Mainly the bechak ( cycle rickshaw puller ) was a highlight..the ride up til here ..or else entrance is cheap..and the venue is very local and average considering international tourists drop in..found the upkeep low ..nothing to talk about after all the magnanimous monuments and museums u see world over .

Just an extra bit for u ..if u have time and are killing time frankly ..
Kraton is erg mooi om te bezoeken.   het dansen en gamelan muziek op zondagochtend is geweldig.  Jammer dat de uitleg niet in het engels is .

A parte de que no tiene ningún atractivo concreto, es interesante comentar que los hombres (sólo los hombres) deben llevar pantalón por debajo y de la rodilla, y hombros cubiertos por camiseta de manga corta, dato importante que desconocíamos...

Great tour in english. Interesting, and timed about right for 1 hour. 
Our guide was helpful in answering questions about Indonesian life
Good sightseeing

Balade sympa mais aurait été plus intéressante avec un guide. Il n'y a aucune information traduite en anglais. 

Attention sur certains guides on peut lire que le prix d'entrée est de 12 5000 rps il est en réalité de 15 000 rps. Il faut en rajouter 1000 pour pouvoir prendre des photos.

Nous y sommes allés pendant le ramadan. Pendant le ramadan, le palais est ouvert mais il n'y a pas de spectacle comme il y en a normalement le matin. Pour être sûr de l'ouverture du palais, aller voir à l'office de tourisme sur la Jalan Malioboro et n'écoutez pas les locaux (ils vous diront que c'est fermé pour vous emmener dans une de leur nombreuses boutiques de Batik).

Le palais est assez vide, peu d'objet à voir sans grand intérêt (la passoire du sultan...) mais bon ce n'est pas très cher non plus (15 000 idr par personne). Le quartier autour du palais est sympa pour les balades, mais le palais n'a pas grand intérêt, surtout s'il n'y a pas de spectacle.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Helaas was het pronkstuk van het paleis gesloten vanwege renovatie werkzaamheden. We hebben dus het mooie gouden plafond moeten missen. Verder een interessante rondleiding gehad met een goed beeld van geschiedenis van de sultan en zijn familie.

If you have any interest in Indonesian history you may find this interesting. However, a local guide is a must or you have no idea what your looking at. It's cheap to enter and you can request a guide for no extra charge, however the guides make it clear a tip is expected.

We were there late (after a morning visit to Borobudur Temple), so we had only one hour to see the palace. However, one hour might as well just enough.

It is modest size but not all areas of the palace are open, Those that open have various exhibition of the royal family of Yogyakarta. There are many pictures and paintings of the family. Unfortunately, almost all exhibition descriptions are in Bahasa Indonesian only. I found it is difficult for foreigners to understand the history and current situation of the family.

I had read a lot about Kraton and was sceptical. Unfortunately my scepticism was even exceeded. Kraton is a boring collection of pavillions (the main one is under renovation, which did not help) and old photographs. The free tour guides do their best (or so) to make the 15min less painful. Head to Taman Sari as soon as you can.
Da passare a visitare il kraton nel caso in cui si abbia tempo... l'ingresso e' pressapoco un euro percio' si puo' fare!

À ne pas manquer lors que vous êtes à Yogyakarta . Des guides francophone vous font la visite. C'est fort intéressant, ponctué d'anecdotes mais aussi d'informations sur la vie de Java et son histoire.

Keraton Yogyakarta, mengenalkan secuil sejarah Jawa Tengah untuk anak2.

Sayang tidak bisa melihat seluruh koleksi maupun bagian2 bangunan istana
にぎやかな市場を通り抜けた中心部にあります。王族の民族衣装などが展示されていて、在りし日のジョグジャの王宮の様子が感じられます。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Przyjechaliśmy po 12 godzinie by zwiedzić Kraton. Ale jak się okazało z okazji Ramadanu, pracują tylko do 12 i koniec. Słabo... Co ważne trzeba mieć długie spodnie i zakryte ramiona.

Como aun reside el sultan alli es poco lo que se puede visitar sin embargo es muy imponente y amplisimos parques, lugar para fotos con los guardias a caballo, tambien estaban los guardias en general ancianos con impomnentes dagas muy dispuestos para las fotos, Hay salones que ofician de museo con la historia y fotos de los distintos sultanes
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Wij bezochten dit als onderdeel van onze tour. Museum bestaat uit verschillende gebouwen. Leuk om even doorheen te lopen maar wij hadden het na een half uurtje wel gezien.
We went around the palace, into the exhibit rooms and that was it. It was alright but the experience would've been better I think, if we'd hired a guide.
Se recorren distintos edificios. Todos llenos de fotografías y objetos históricos. Un poco decepcionante.
Saya kesini menggumi arsitektur bangunannya yang sangat indah, tiket masuk yang murah juga menjadi alasan kenapa saya mengunjungi tempat ini.

This is a reasonably interesting place to spend a few hours, but do try and get there so that you can see the show at 11am that is included in the ticket price. Each day is a different art form. The day i went was puppets backed by a full gamelan orchestra. The music was great and i loved the artistry of the puppeteer, Punch and Judy this is not.

Rien de transcendant dans cette visite. Des pavillons, des deco assez simples, des objets de vie courante dans des vitrines peu mises en valeur...
Photo payantes et interdites dans les endroits un peu interessants...bref pas top.

Take a tour guide to explain everything to you as all explanation panels are in Indonesian. There are a lot of kids on school trips there. Beware the unusual opening hours: it's closed in the afternoon.
Tempat yang bagus Anda kunjungi ketika berlibur ke Yogyakarta. Disini Anda dapat melihat tentang seni, budaya dan sejarah. Bermain sambil mengenal budaya yg ada di Indonesia :)
Tiket masuk nya murah. Kalau mau dipandu juga bisa oleh pemandu petugas kraton. Hanya saja waktu kesana kraton terlihat agak kotor. Ke Yogyakarta kalau ga kesini kurang sreg ☺

We always think that sultans are living in gorgeous palaces full with luxury but this one is very modest. There is not so many to see in this palace (maybe except many peacocks - symbols of sultan's power), but it is very good cool place to retreat and hide from the heat in a daytime. Also entrance fee is quite symbolic - about half a US$.
Enjoyed our time with a very knowledgable guide about the royal family of Jogjakarta. The people of Jogjakarta are very proud of their royal family.
It's something that you can get run in your visit to Yogya. You have to pay for something no interesting. It's bored

Sommes arriver en plein Ramadan du coup les avis divergeaient quant à savoir si le lieu était ouvert. Le mieux a été d'aller voir nous-mêmes.

Comme tjrs une première entrée ne spécifiant pas qu'on est au bon endroit. Du coup on ´sest fait avoir ... visiter le premier puis finalement trouver la vrai entrée du kraton.
Joli à l'intérieur et pas mal de trucs à voir

À faire donc !!

First thing to mention: I got into it through the right entrance - and not the fake scammy one (much more easy to find! - do they know it??) - so I'm sure I visited the Kraton Palace. It was in really poor conditions, so not really enjoyable... all you could see was the gardens really, that were nice, while the internals were dark and with no air conditioning, too. The issue with that is that there was stuff to see (pictures and related texts to read...) about the Sultan, that couldn't really be read. To sum up, I've got to say that I expected more in that occasion.
O lugar em si não é nada de especial, mas tivemos a sorte de pegar um guia maravilhoso que fez tudo ficar muito interessante! Nao deixe de fechar com um guia caso visite esse lugar.

Als je in yogjakarta bent, moet je natuurlijk ook even zien waar de sultan woont. Helaas een beetje vergane glorie en geen uitleg beschikbaar. De gouden zaal was onder constructie, en het was lastig wijs te worden wat we zagen en welke mannetjes bij het sultanaat hoorden, en welke er je een scam probeerden te verkopen door je mee te nemen naar buiten voor koffie of "waterpalace"

I along with my family visited the Kraton Palace at Yogyakarta in the last week of April in 2017. This was the first place which we visited on our tour around Yogyakarta. 
Our Van driver, Anton was a friendly and helpful driver. He doubled up as a Guide too as he could speak good English too. The Palace was a bit of disappointment. Maybe, our expectations were higher. The entrance fee per person was 15000 IDR. There is an extra charge for bringing in a Camera. Do not understand this charge as tourists will always like to take pictures at the places that they visit. If you are an Indonesian, the charges are very very low. This discriminatory charging is to be found all across Indonesia.
Upon purchasing a ticket, an English speaking guide is supposed to be provided free of charge. We had an Indonesian lady who spoke good English but had a totally bored expression and seemed to be uninterested in her job. She confessed that she had been doing this job for years. At the end of the tour, she insisted that we pay her some amount. I politely refused as it was meant to be free but she kept on insisting. I just managed to walk away without any issue. 
We selected Sunday to visit the Kraton as there is a Dance scheduled on Sundays. The dance starts at 11am. Make sure that you are in place by at least 1045am as he seating is limited. The Palace itself does not seem to be well maintained with dust, waste paper strewn at many places. Keeping the place clean would certainly leave a better impression. We were probably expecting bit more to see as members of the Royal family still occupy one portion of the Palace (this is naturally out of bounds for tourists). All in all, if you miss seeing the Kraton Palace - you have not missed much!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Price for foreigners is IDR15000. Can request for English-speaking guides. The Kraton is technically the castle and some parts had been transformed into museum, displaying the items of the royal family. Average time to spent: 1.5 to 2 hours.

Palace is a must see in Yogya, it's small and more of an open space. But it has Royal family memorablia, pictures and paintings. History fans should go visit as well as it is a natural thing to do when embracing a new culture.
This is billed as a must but in fact it is disappointing and the palace rooms are poorly displayed with little information or guidance - worth a very quick visit but the Water Palace is better

Als je in Yogyakarta bent is het leuk om een bezoek te brengen aan het Kraton. Het is aan te raden om een gids te nemen, die kan je er een hoop over vertellen.

Toegangsprijs Kraton: 15.000 IDR, fototoestel: 1.000 IDR, gids: naar eigen inzicht te belonen (onze chauffeur zei dat 25.000 een gangbaar bedrag is).

Keraton bagus. Tapi rasanya sangat tidak terawat dan tidak dikelola dengan baik. Tempat parkir jauh. Petunjuk parkir hampir tidak kelihatan. Petunjuk apa saja yg dipamerkan tidak ada. Jadi kalo tidak sewa guide disana ya Tidak tahu apa2.
Rode the scooter down Malioboro to the palace and was immediatly greeted by tour guides who come free when you pay for an entrance ticket. A great educational day.

Basically dedicated "museum" to last sultan. Lots of recent history here- boy scout uniforms, belt buckles, suits. But there are some nice photographs and furniture. Not a mjor investment for admission, so I'd say, sure, go, and if possible bring someone along  who knows the stories.

On s attendait à voir un beau palais de sultan ! Dans les faits, ça n a rien d exceptionnel, cela ne vaut pas le détour. Possibilité d avoir une visite guidée de la part d un guide francophone de 45 minutes.

The story of sultan palace is very well documented but you need a guide. We got an excellent one who was up in her years. She was telling the stories that young people cannot in the same way.  The artifacts are many but i believe many of them you can find in Holland as well. If you want to wander a little outside the palace and into the narrow streets you find the old city. worth a visit.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
The Kraton is the King's palace and still in use so not all areas are open to the public. We had a guide from the Kraton show us around. Nice cultural show with musicians playing the gamelan. Then a walk through several rooms detailing mostly the history of the 9th King - pictures, gifts, some of his clothes etc. 
Not a real 'wow' factor, but pleasant enough and passed an hour.
ジョグジャカルタのスルタンの宮殿の一部が一般向けに公開されています。スルタンに縁のある物品いろいろと展示されています。私が訪れたときはワヤンクリ（影絵芝居）が実演されていました。普通の影絵芝居と異なり、影絵のスクリーンの裏側の様子を見ることが出来面白かったです。
在有限時間的拜訪日惹,故重點式的看了幾個指標性的景點,日惹皇宮要看得並不是建築,而是每天都不同的藝文表演,拜訪的那天(周四11點)看的是舞蹈表演,雖然我不太明白為什麼已經是穆斯林為主的日惹,舞蹈卻都是印度神話,但我還是看得很開心,背景音樂使用傳統樂團搭配人聲吟唱,時間雖然短,卻看得很開心,因每天的表演不太一樣,實在非常希望可以網站上預先看到每天表演的時間跟內容.

Tempat yang sangat bagus untuk memberi pengalaman dan edukasi pada anak. Tiket masuk cukup murah, hanya Rp 7500,- dan tambahan Rp1000,- untuk yg membawa kamera. 
Saat berkunjung ke sana kemaren kami juga menikmati pertunjukan tari2an yg digelar di pendopo.
Berada di keraton ini (yg penuh dg barang2 kuno) membuat kita seperti kembali ke zaman dahulu kala.
Wisata Kraton Yogyakarta mengenalkan kita terhadap sejarah bangsa Indonesia dan juga memperkenalkan budaya lokal

Es gibt wenig interessantes zu sehen. Im Eintritt ist ein Guide enthalten, welchen man aber nur bekommt, wenn man nochmal aktiv nachfragt. Mit Guide wird es etwas interessanter.
Ansonsten geeignet um die Zeit um die eigentlichen Highlights herum (die beiden Tempel) zu füllen.

Maybe because the day was very hot and the humidity very high, but the visit to the Sultan's palace was far below my expectations. The facilities do not have much appeal, except for a patio where the coronation ceremony is located, The rest, really, is not worth it.

Firstly thank you to the lovely lady who guided us thru the complex and who was most patient with our continual enquiry and interest whilst going around the Royal palace.
Her passion and respect for the Royal family was so evident. I am just so sorry her name escapes me. She even made sure we purchased Batik Tulis "genuine" from the palace handicraft people inside the palace grounds. It was a gift to a very special Balinese friend we have who could not afford real Batik Tulis. 
The grounds and cabinets where items are on display do need a touch up here and there and some maintenance but we believe we're very tidy and historically so very interesting. 
The rest of the family preferred Borobodur and Prabanam temple sites but I just love history.
There were many people there so best to be early. Thank you again. 
In closing a good couple of hours is needed. 
Hormat Saya
Pak Gede Johnson

Tempat unik dan terawat
Cocok membawa anak-anak untuk mengetahui sejarah asal muasal berdirinya UGM serta sejarah keraton Yogya
Hanya saja bau kotoran kelelawar sangat menyengat sekali...(masukan bagi pengelola keraton agar dapat diminimalisir)

lokasi tidak jauh dari malioboro, Guide sangat ramah, Sangat Kejawen dan saya sangat suka, apa lagi pas ada pertunjukan gamelan. anak saya pun antusias, sehingga saya sebagai keturunan orang jawa, tidak lupa asal usul kita.

The Sultan Palace of Yogyakarta is more for local people, or for the visitor that like to get deep in a country's history and past. For us it was a really interesting place that was full of things we knew nothing about.

That aside its a lovely place, full of Indonesians looking to get their photo taken with the foreigners. That in itself was was really good fun, as the Indonesians are such lovely people, they really are. Walk about and look at the exhibitions, then if you lucky (or unlucky) you get to hear the traditional music. Its interesting but to be honest you can only take so much.

Great, interesting place but be warned, its so, so very hot.

If you are first time to yogyakarta you must visit this palace. This is unique and beautiful heritages in yogyakarta. Just buy the entrance ticket and you can see the palace with local guide they will assist you during palace tour.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
We went to the sultan palace which was built by the current sultan hamengkubuwono ancestors. You would able to see the palace guards whose are dressed in Javanese costume. It gives the Javanese culture and the collection of the past sultans' collections.
At the point, the palace guards were playing the gamelan with Javanese music and song.

Es una zona muy mal conservada y sucia. Nos llevamos una gran decepción. El Kratón como tal es ahora un museo sin ninguna gracia y el Palacio del agua  es quizá lo mejor, pero es totalmente prescindible...

The Sultan's family story is fascinating. Make sure you learn it before visiting. Historical and full of wonder. Leave time to really ramble but be aware it gets very hot and if there are lots of Indonesians there they will want a photo with you. A cheap place to visit but it can also get very hot. Good markets outside.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Ho visitato il Kraton durante il mio soggiorno a Jogja. La Lonely planet lo indicava come tappa obbligatoria, nel complesso concorso sul fatto che sia da visitare ma come palazzo è un po' spoglio quindi non abbiate grandi pretese.

While it is important to showcase the history and culture of the location, particularly if it has one but considering that the province is still governed by the princely lineage, I think more effort and investment should have been done in developing Kraton Palace.The fee from foreigners is decent but the museum areas from inside appears to be far less maintained than it should have been. Guides are necessary for foreigners to understand more but I do not know why we were never offered one. As a result our cruising through the palace was a dry run. We could not understand much relationship and developments in the royal family's lineage. The place is cultural seat of Jogja with training imparted to traditional dancers, both males and females. If you will see Ramayana ballet at Prambanan, you will realise that those performers are perhaps trained at Kraton Palace. The artifacts, otherwise most of it, is in poor state of upkeep. It may be high-time that the management could elevate the status of this tourist place by turning it into more organised and well maintained historical center. The palace without guide could be completed in less than an hour but might need an hour or more if guides explain the importance and relevance of everything you see.

It's a must-go site if you visit Yogyakarta. You can learn a lot about the Javanesse culture heritage from the guide. It's a sultan's residence and collection from many years. It closed at 3 pm before Sultan will go back to its residence from his office as governor. 
You can visit here by becak and the ticket is very cheap. 
 
When we visit, there is gamelan and dance performance fromthey who maintain the traditional culture to be alive
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: L'unique intérêt de la visite est les costumes. Les guides sont gratuit, par contre ils vous emmène dans quelques boutiques ensuite (sans obligation d'achats)
kesini cuma pengen liat kayak apa sih keraton itu. ternyata keren bgt. orang jawa itu keren, adat jawa juga keren lho
Disini kita dapat belajar mengenai sejarah bangsa kita,khusususnya di daerah yang istimewa ini. Keren....
A good place to learn about the royals that once ruled Jogja. The family tree, heirloom, artifacts, etc are found here. Cultural dances are performed here too.

We were having doubt whether to visit this place due to the largely mixed review, but went on since we had the time and we were definitely not disappointed.

For people visting do note that they are TWO entrance to this place, which visit different part of the palace. We visited both area and paid entrance ticket twice. The front area (which faces the two big trees) is a really small area which charges 5,000IDR, this i believe is where the complain and negative reviews comes about as they merely shows you some traditional costume and a hall where royalty goes to during special occasion. This is also where the guide tends to trick you into thinking they are bringing you to a royal school of batik, which in actual fact is just a small shop which sells batik. 
The other entrance, the main entrance(within 5 min walk from the other entrance) (15,000IDR) is where it is worth a visit. Hire a guide as this place is huge, filled with diplomatic treasures from other countries, belonging of royalties, special occasion musical instrument and much much more. Definitely worth a visit and most importantly there isn't any force sales here by the guides.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Partie du palais du sultan, quelques explications sur leur vie et leurs traditions. Assez petit ( tour en moins de 25 min)

Une fois trouvée l'entrée officielle (attention il y en a deux: face aux bâtiments, prendre la rue tout à droite des bâtiments)
L'ensemble est relativement plaisant à visiter mais peu mis en valeurs, notamment vis à vis des étrangers car rien n'est traduit. Par ailleurs, en dehors des bâtiments, peu de choses à voir.
Suivant le jour de visite, il est possible d'assister à un spectacle différent.
Pour notre part, nous nous réjouissions de pouvoir assister à un spectacle de marionnette. Las, au delà de l'ensemble musical très agréable, les marionnettes traditionnelles n'ont bougé qu'à de très (très) rares occasions en 20min. Revenus 30min plus tard, rien n'avait bougé, et toujours les mêmes incantations vocales. Bref décevant (au moins pour les non initiés comme nous)

C'est une visite à faire une fois, mais qui laissera un goût de déception.
Siapa yang ga tau tempat ini..  Wisata malam nya begitu mempesona...  Apalagi pas berkunjung ada pasar malam disini..  Begitu luar biasa kesan yang di berikan oleh jogja
Lack lustre building, nothing is in it's original form, they try to guilt trip you into buying batik wall art at the end, saying it's for a homeless children's charity.
You can go here if you have nothing else to do. Not much to see anyway. Do not take photography ticket. 5k is somehow ok. But I wish I did not spend 30 min there.

Main ke jogja jangan sampai melewatkan tempat satu ini. Keraton jogja memang layak untuk dikunjungi. Harga tiket cukup murah. Jika kita membawa kamera maka kita akan dikenakan biaya tambahan dan memakai semacam id, bukan id juga sih sebenarnya. Mungkin mirip penanda gitu. Di sini kita akan menemukan berbagai macam hal tentang adat istiadat jogja. Ada orang2 yang memakai baju adat dan disebut dalem. Bangunan khas jawa tengah yang sederhana dan besar serta halaman yang luas jadi pemandangan yang kita lihat disini. Banyak juga para turis ganteng yang tertarik main di keraton. Keraton ini cukup luas, usahakan membawa air minum dan makanan ringan. Jika merasa kelelahan kita bisa duduk di sekitaran bangku yang disediakan. Ada banyak ruangan berupa museum, dari batik sampai lukisan bisa kita temukan. Rasanya cocok sekali mengajak adik yang masih duduk di sekolah dasar atau bagi yang punya anak kecil bisa juga diajak ke sini. Dengan begitu adik atau anak2 akan belajar banyak hal dan melihatnya secara langsung. Bagi yang penasaran dan juga pecinta musik klasik, jangan lewatkan untuk menikmati musik klasik jogja. Alat musik disini ada banyak banget dari gamelan, yang mirip piano sampai gong besar yang mirip drum. Ibarat kata Keraton itu seperti masa lalu yang ada di masa sekarang. Dari keraton jogja kita bisa menelusuri masa lalu jogja dan jogja saat ini.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: masuk kraton murah, banyak dapat ilmu baru tapi sayangnya kurang terawat, kurang variasi, suasana nyaman

Staf keraton ramah,tutur katanya lembut sekali. Harga tiket masuk murah tanpa guide jadi langsung masuk saja,keliling sendiri. Suasana keraton keueung kata orang sunda mah,hawa dingin "mistis" jadi ga lama2 disitu.

Главная достопримечательность Джокьи. На территории султанского дворца получится увидеть всё, чем гордится Ява. Можно сказать, что это несколько музеев, собранных под одной "крышей". 
Попав туда, вы полюбуетесь представлением театра ваянг, под аккомпанемент гамелана. Увидите, чем сопровождался быт монаршей фамилии, узнаете какие орнаменты и цвета батика считаются классическими, а какие уже нет, и с какой причёской следует идти на аудиенцию к правителю.
Уважение и признание заслуг знакового политического деятеля постколониальной Индонезии султана Хаменгкубувоно IX выражена в индивидуальной экспозиции, посвященной его насыщенной жизни. Судя по всему, это был настоящий денди!
Любителей исторического портрета, не может оставить равнодушным галерея образов царственных особ. Особенно выразительна картина, изображающая коронацию одного из султанов в 19 веке. Живописец весьма ярко изобразил ещё латентный, но уже давний и непримиримый конфликт между представителями колониальной администрации и индонезийцами. Достаточно только взглянуть на выражения лица султана и представителя Нидерландской власти.

Upon arriving here, I was brought back to the old days. The staff are still in their uniform and it seems you are separated by the modern world outside the palace wall.
Just mesmerizing this place

I went here with my 2 children ( 8 and 10 years old). They like the stories about the Kraton/Palace and all the things that was displayed there. 
It is a good place for them to learn about history of part of Indonesia.

Mendalami seluk beluk jogja tak komplit rasanya kalau belum kesini, merasakan hawa arwah arwah kerajaan yang rasanya menjamu kedatangan saya sebagai salah satu keturunan kerajaan, turis nya juga banyak kesini.. Monggo
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Ondanks dat het Kraton nog bewoont wordt viel de staat van het Kraton ons eigenlijk best tegen. Ik zou graag meer entree willen betalen als het geld gebruikt zou worden voor het (beter) restaureren van dit paleis. 
De vloeren, muren en plafonds incl de vele details zijn toe aan een grondige opknapbeurt.
Het valt op dat de makkelijke bereikbaarheid van het Kraton en de vele bezoeken van toeristen er niet toe heeft geleid dat er meer borden zijn met Engelse uitleg, als je meer wilt weten neem dan een gids mee of lees je van te voeren goed in.
Tijdens ons bezoek was er ook een poppen / muziek voorstelling gaande echter bestemd voor de lokale bevolking dus allemaal in het Indonesisch.
Not well maintained and not much to see around inside the palace compound. They have two rooms full of mannequins dressed in local Indonesian attires - worth seeing.

with my local friend visit this place either invited for party this place need to be see and cannot be missed great area still active one of the glory of the city and history....  will be back and seed friends again.

No volveria. Es pobre de conyenidos. Esta muy abandonado y sucio.
No es un buen ejemplo de la ciudad que si tiene otras visitas intetesantes

Honestly you don't need a guide or anything to see this place -end of main street -but nothing much to see -just a "`tourist trap" -go see Bourbadour ( Buddhist) and the other temple ( Hindu) -sorry dont remember its name both superb world heritage sites
時間帯によっては演奏会やってます、展示品の中に寛永通宝を中国の通貨として紹介してました。非常に古いバティック（ろうけつ染）の展示などが見学できます。

The Kraton is the epitome of a bygone feudal era. The size of the complex, the number of buildings and the exhibits therein show the wealth of the former rulers. The retired palace guards still live in their housings and you can see the sitting outside and watching tourists.
In addition in a designated area at scheduled times Gamelan music will be played and during our stay a puppet theater performed (but of course in Bahasa and with a typical Indonesian story set). But you have not to stay for the entire performance but can leave if you feel saturated.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The palace has beautiful architecture. You can spend a good one to two hours here. Inside you'll find mainly paintings and images. Because of its cultural importance a must see when you're in Jogjakarta. I really liked the (elderly) attendants in traditional clothing.

I recommend don't waste time go to this museum. Need to pay Rp15,000 entrance fee + Rp1,000 for photograph and video permit 😒
Inside nothing much to see like a museum.
I recommend don't waste time and better move forward to other Museum. I recommend go to Ullen Sentalu Museum more worth my time.

If you have ever been to Surakarta Palace, then this place is an addition to some of the history from surakarta. Worth for a visit and there are more things to see and experience. Crowded during the weekends or holiday due to local tourist and also students visits.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Dit paleis wordt nog gebruikt door de sultan met zijn vrouw. Bewakers in traditionele kleding. 
Traditionele muziek en poppenspel uitvoering is er regelmatig.
Nice to see if you are around. It was a bit difficult to found the entrance, also the took took were not really helpful.
if you want to know Yogyakarta and the story. Please come to keraton or in english Palace. where sultan stay,
Lots of historical things we learn during our visit to this palace, The place need to be improve on the condition but it was a great experience to know the Sultan empire during those days.

Nothing much engaged me on my trip to the kraton.  So many notices forbidding entry here or touching there gave me the sense that tourists were not really welcome and only tolerated because of the revenue they generate.  Little attempt has been made to give explanations of the various exhibits.  Altogether an eminently forgettable experience.

Nett, es sich einmal anzusehen aber keine beeindruckende Architektur und kaum etwas zu sehen.
Die Anlage könnte etwas mehr gepflegt werden und Infotafeln sind bislang meist nur auf indonesisch vorzufinden.

Sprawling campus with some interesting collections and nice architecture. The buildings could use a little tlc, but it's really nice to see such a historic place still in active use aside from the tourist side of things.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: The museum is very interesting, I learned some interesting Indonesian history. Most interesting are the performances (no extra charge). Check the website before visiting for the performance schedule & pick the one that interest you. Each day has a different performance (but not all days of the week). I picked the traditional dance & play and really enjoyed it - really well prepared and professional. Entry ticket is cheap as well. If you want to find out more about Indonesian culture and history and will definitely enjoy it.
건물도 매력적이고 넓어서 볼거리도 많지만 강추하고 싶진 않은 곳입니다 시간 여유가 된다면 추천합니다

Es un lugar vacío, sin nada para ver, sin nada para hacer, sin nada de historia y sin nada de objetos de museo. Espantoso, sino tienes absolutamente nada que hacer y quieres ir podes hacerlo ya que es barato, pero no te esperes nada. Te cobran un diferencial para sacar fotos, el cual pagué y es tan feo que no saque ni una!
Pengalaman yang menarik untuk bisa mengunjungi kraton Jogja. Sering dan banyak yang membicarakan tentang tradisi kraton Jogja. Hope we can back again. Thanks Commlife
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Tiket ijin kamera sangat terjangkau, lokasi sangat strategis, ada tempat peetunjukan gamelan dan wayang dipendopo. Petugas dan abdi dalem sangat ramah dan sederhana. Budaya jogja yang harus dijaga dengan baik. Saya merekomendasikan berkunjung ke kraton yogyakarta....
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: 門口人流較雜，內部樸實折舊了，但仍有一定的歷史內涵，建議找個人解說（哪怕付點小費），不然就是走馬觀花。感覺最有收穫的是在入口處不遠的涼亭閣下的音樂舞蹈表演（據說是週一周五十點開始，週末十一點），看了包括Ramayana史詩經典片段在內的三段舞蹈，十分驚艷。宮內還能見到很多舊時的僕人和守衛，他們十分友善。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Guys, there is a lot of amazing stuff in Yogyakarta. This place is certainly not among that stuff. If you really have nothing else to do, go here. I have been to this place twice and been disappointed both times. One was several years ago and one recently. It is not really a museum or have anything displayed that is incredible.
If you want to see culture this is a really good place. Please watch out for scammers though they tried to rip us off once or twice there.

Voor een gezin met tieners en na een bezoek aan het prachtige waterpaleis vonden we dit wat minder interessant. Vooral veel relikwieën van giften van andere koninkrijken. Het is geen hoge entree, dus een snel bezoek kan nog de moeite zijn, maar als je moet kiezen ...

Kraton Yogyakarta is a Javanese royal palace, where the real kings and queens and princes and princesses lived for centuries up until now. The current king of Yogyakarta is now served as the governor of Yogya - appointed by the president of Indonesia.
Kraton held so many historical legacy, the music hall, the weapons, jewelries, etc.
If you get inside, you will meet a lot of abdi dalem (royal household servants) and you will need them to guide you to know which way to go, and the story behind every corner, every painting and every song you'd experience in the palace.
Keep in mind that the palace is closed for public during Indonesian Independence Day (August 17).
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Good place to visit when you are already in town, but not worth a longer trip. There are much more impressive places near Yogyakarta, namely the fabulous temple in Borobudur.

Sebagai pusat budaya dan kekuasaan di Jogja, Kraton menyimpan segudang artefak dari abad 18 hingga saat ini peninggalan Sultan HB I s/d HB IX. Perubahan budaya didokumentasikan dalam berbagai diorama dan museum yang ada dalam kompleks Kraton. Semua bangunan dipertahankan seperti aslinya, sehingga menggugah rasa imajinasi bagi penikmat sejarah dan budaya khususnya Jawa.

Quick history of Indonesian path to independence. 
A walk around reveals defense tactics of this old Dutch fort.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Akses lokasi yang pass karena dekat malioboro, cukup memuaskan untuk para pengunjung dan wisatawan, jadi banyak mendapatkan pelajaran soal kesederhanaan dan loyalitas melihat sosok para Abdi dalem Kraton. Toilet kurang memuaskan bagi para wisatawan karena kebersihan dan perawatan.

We went to museum at recommendation of hotel. Entrance fees is 15,000 IDR per persom If you have seen museum in any palace in world you can not stand it. There is hardly anything to see or display. Some crockery, musical instruments, armory,clothes and picture of sultan and family. Large campus is being used but no planning. Even in washroom you don't have any kind of soap and place to wash hands.
I don't recommend this place.

We were escorted to the front entrance by our Indonesian friend, where we paid 15,000 IDR each plus 1,000 camera fee (there were 2 of us who both had cameras) - so the total cost was about $3.25 Canadian for 2 people.  An English speaking guide was assigned to us by the ticket seller.  We had been told that the guide was free, and that a reasonable tip for 30-45 minutes was 50,000 IDR.
