The guide was worth the tip!  There is minimal signage, all in Indonesian.  While there, we saw a performance of Gamelan music (@10 am) and traditional dance (@11 am).  Fascinating to learn about the Sultanate and how the Sultan fits in to a democratic country.  The 9th Sultan is considered a national hero, due to his war efforts and contribution to the independence movement in the 1940s.  Definitely worth a visit.

We are a family with 2 young boys (age 7 & 5). 

The palace complex is massive, but the area open for public is only 30%. When we got there, we were accompanied by a local guide. He explained to us about the area briefly, since my kids were easily bored (hehe). The dioramas were a bit rundown, we could see a thick layer of dust on them. Too bad..

Next, he guided us to a batik workshop where we were expected to buy some batik painting. But we didn't buy any. 

After that, he offered us to the next destination but we politely refuse, because we had had already another plan. And he was also very polite, he didn't insist us to buy anything.
The place is nice and has been managed better for tourism than my last visit. The guide has been included when you buy an entry pass, but it will help them if you can spare some money for their tips.

I visited Kraton, because I wanted to know a lot about Sri Sultan Hamengku Buwono III, as he is my ancestor from my mother's line.  Kraton Jogja is a must site to visit when you are in Jogja.  From this place you can see and learn about Javanese Kingdom and Javanese Culture.  When the time is perfect, you can see some dance performances.  Good for children, and this is very educational site.

I'm all for history, especially outside of my own country...

I see this unfortunately over a few more years depleting in anything historic...

I found this boring and uninformative...

Maintenance isn't up to standard if you compare with the Candis around the area... 
any memorabilia is slowly fading away..

There is an outside forecourt which seems to be the dumping ground...

And the toilets... wow....

Respect the history if you are to showcase this to the public...
Don't make this an excuse to make money no matter how cheap the entrance fee.

Terus terang, saya dan anak TIDAK SUKA wisata keraton di manapun. Jadi penilaian saya sangat subyektif. Mohon maaf. Yang jelas, keraton Jogja ini cocok bagi Anda yang suka wisata tempo doeloe. 

Buat anak2 sepertinya kurang cocok.

It is a good place to know the javanese (especially Yogyakarta) culture. You can stroll around this Kraton (palace), while the guide tells you about the historical background. The entrance fee is only IDR 5K for locals, include guide. We can also take a walk around the area, or use 'becak' (tricycle) for better experience (pay around IDR 10k), you can visit some places to see the process of making 'batik' or artsy painting.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Dit is z'n ding waar je heen gaat omdat iedereen er heen gaat en vanwege de naam, maar eigenlijk is het gewoon saai museum. En sta klaar voor scholieren die voor Engels jou hun huiswerk laten doen.

Le palais en lui même peut paraître quelconque mais c'est son histoire qui est intéressante et l'organisation sociale interne qui y régnait, voire y réside encore. Et pour cela il vous faut un guide hors pair! Le notre s'appelait Santoso, véritable sosie du grand James Brown, cultivé, plein d'humour et doté d'une philosophie de l'existence et de la coexistence entre groupes ethniques qui ferait pâlir nos ultra religieux de tous poils sur la définition de la tolérance!!

This is an excellent sample of Javanese Keraton / Palace, the architecture was absolutely beautiful, full of symbols at every corner, the palace guides were very well trained and able to speak multi languages

Hallo yang lagi di jogja, pasti tau kann Kraton yogyakarta tmpt tinggal raja,/sultan HB ix, dan sebagai gurbernur yogyakrta, kraton ini tmpt yg cocok untuk edukasi anak" dan kunjungan"dari sekolah di luar jogja, di sini kita bisa lihat"koleksi" peninggalan sultan" yang sebelum nya seperti keris pusaka, kereta dll reecomend tmpt yg wajib di kunjungi di jogja harga tiket nyaa sangat terangkau hanya 10k
The place gives you a flashback of the time when Sultanate is evident in Yogyakarta. However, foreigners and locals' entrance fees vary.

Went here last year. Keraton yogya is Yogya's Grand Palace (to compare with Thai's).	
This is where Yogya's Royal Family (Sultan) live.	
Entering this place, you have to pay ticket (i forgot how much). Cheaper for locals and more expensive for foreigners.	
And when you enter, there won't be much to see. Only traditional houses and antiques (Keris, Painting etc).	
I onyl stayed here for 30 minutes. And i spent most of my time watching wayang performance in the middle hall.

We saw the traditional dance and the royal museum is truly enchanting.The palace is well kept and most of all is the fact that they preserve their culture.The museum will tell us the history of their royal family.
Una tappa che non può mancare..da abbinare se si riesce a qualche iniziativa musicale che organizzano tutte le settimane.
Nous avons visité le Kraton avec un guide francophone.  Ceci vaut la peine pour bien comprendre l'histoire.

Our visit was a bit rushed. It was a field trip as part of our language course.  The guide spoke good englihs, however was very softly spoken. There were times she was in another room talking about something and the group were still attempting to view the previous area. Worth a visit, an hour is not long enough.

I go at least twice a year to Yogyakarta, and whenever I´m there I always go to the Sunday dance performance within the Kraton (Sultan´s Palace), at the Sri Manganti stage at 11 o´clock. It is free of charge, but you have to pay a small entrance fee to the Kraton+a trifle for ca camera.

The dances are Javanese (Yogyanese) court dances accompanied by a Gong orchestra. The costumes are very beautiful and the dances are slow (as opposed to Balinese dances which have a much quicker tempo) and thoroughly elegant and exquisitely performed. I can´t say I understand the stories they depict, but I am always mesmerized by the sheer experience. Highly recommended if you are interested in Javanese culture.

Fell in love with the exhibits and various batik prints worn by the royal family.

The guide was so helpful and explained to me about the exhibits.

If you have about  2 hours to spare while in Jogja, don't skip Kraton tour.

In the heart of the City, it costs just 15,000 rupiah to enter (about £1) plus an additional 1000 to take photos (whether you have told them you want to use a camera or not!). It is a series of pavilions and court yards, some with rather dusty looking exhibits.  There does not appear to be any fixed route and there is little explanation in English.  Alas, the couple of rooms which did have some photos with interpretation made little sense to me, but appeared to relate to various cultural practices.  I would have liked to have known more about the history of the building, its inhabitants and the system of sultan rule.  There are guides which I assume you can hire but the system was very unclear.  There was a nice gamellin orchestra playing upon entry.

Visited Kraton Yogyakarta or Yogyakarta Palace, and got a great history and current affairs lesson.

Built in c.1755, Kraton Yogyakarta is the main seat of the Sultan of Yogyakarta and his family. Yogyakarta is designated as a Special Region, and was the capital of Indonesia from 1946 to 1948, after WWII and after the fall of Jakarta to the Dutch. Yogyakarta and the Sultan's support was crucial to Indonesia's struggle for independence under Sukarno during the Indonesian National Revolution from 1945 to 1949. After gaining independence, Jakarta allowed the Yogyakarta royal family to retain power as recognition for the sultanate's support in the fight for independence. Yogyakarta's Sultan is thus the only monarch who not only has a ceremonial role, but a political one - the Sultan of Yogyakarta is also the Governor of Yogyakarta. The current Sultan, His Majesty Sultan Hamengkubuwono X has only 4 daughters, and has in recent years courted much controversy when His Majesty signalled that he wishes for his eldest daughter to become the sultanate's first female monarch after he leaves the throne. If it happens, this will upset hundreds of years of tradition. Sets the stage for a bitter feud between the Sultan and his relatives, with gender equality and modernity as the backdrop.

Review Text:
Kraton of Yogyakarta (formally known as: Keraton Ngayogyakarta Hadiningrat) is a palace complex located in the city of Yogyakarta, Yogyakarta Special Region, Indonesia. The palace is the main seat Sultan of Yogyakarta and his family. It serves as a cultural center for the Javanese people and contains a museum that displays the sultanate's artifacts.

It is guarded by the His Majesty's Kraton Guard Regiment (Prajurit Keraton Ngayogyakarta Hadiningrat).

Despite it still being used by the sultan / governor, the palace has a strong sense o yesteryear that is actually really charming. It's not done up or modern in any way but its space and calm are very striking. The huge yards are a pleasure to stroll through - giving you a great sense of what old royal jogja must have been like in its prime.

地元ガイドさんにすすめられて、いざ王宮（クラトン）へ！ところがお決まりの渋滞プラス駐車場満車、ガイドさんが駐車場を探す間、家族３人でクラトンへ。年末は学校が休みになるので、色とりどりの制服を着た中学生ぐらいの子供たちが大勢見学にきていました。入り口で日本語ガイドさんを頼みました。一見日本人のおばちゃん？と思いましたが、現地の方で、日本語がとても上手でした。丁寧な説明をききながら、約３０分ほどで宮殿内をゆっくり見て回ることができました。一番印象に残ったのは、歴代の王や王妃の肖像画が展示されている建物の中にかざられた、王とその家族を示した図。枝が王妃を、青い葉っぱが王子を、赤い葉っぱが王女を示していました。何と！中には、10数人の王妃と、70人近くの王子・王女の葉っぱを繁らせた、幸せいっぱいの王様の木もありました。現在の王様は、４人全て王女で、すでに皆さん結婚されているとのこと。ガイドさんは「次の王様は誰が引き継ぐのかわからない。日本と同じね。」と日本の皇室のことも心配していました。ガイドさんの話しぶりから、現在も王室が、ジョグジャの人々の尊敬を集めていることがよく分かりました。クラトンを見学するなら、是非ガイドさんを頼んむことをおすすめします。

Review Text: the place that we can learn the culture of Javanese and the empire, in the begining the land of Yogyakarta belong to the King of Java

This huge complex in the centre of Yogyakarta (Jogjakarta) is the heart of the city - literally and metaphorically. It can be crowded with school tours any day of the week, as well as tourists. But there's space to explore. Go just before 10am and head inside to the open canopied 'hall' just to the right of a huge wall-gate. You'll notice it as there will be chairs. This is where a cultural performance takes place, Every Day (including weekends). One day it's singing & gamelan (traditional musical instruments that you can walk to the back to view), and the next could be traditional dancing. Even if you are late, don't fret as the performance (one a day) is from 10am-12pm. And the inside word is, some of the performers (singers or musicians) are older members of the royal family! The court officials are dressed in traditional gear - just ask politely and you may have a pic with them. Be respectful as it is a working palace (yes the king, HB10 as he's known as lives & works there) and there are parts where you can step on or take pictures. Do visit the museum and gallery of ancient kings. Don't skip the Batik Museum either! It is lovely with old fabric and stories of how batik is made. You can also buy batik at the palace shops and these are made by palace staff.
Tip: Buy Batik at the palace shops and this is unique as the designs are traditional and produced by the palace.
Weekend palace shows are more colourful and grand.

Saw some dancers in training on a Sunday morning from young age to older. On the other side (the outter hall) the real dancers beautifully performed dances in distinctive costumes and coreography accompanied by Gamelan music.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Baru pertamakali ke tempat ini, tiket masuk dan tiket ijin kamera sangat terjangkau serta guide yang seperti keluarga sendiri. Sangat menakjubkan dan istimewa.

memberikan sebuah pengetahuan tentang sejarah perjuangan kota jogja dan membuat saya tau kebudayaan yang merupakan warisan leluhur kota jogja dan juga bangunan yang sangat tua yang unik serta koleksi foto foto yang menarik

Saat mengunjungi Keraton Jogja beberapa puluh tahun lalu.Saat kembali lagi,seakan memutar kembali kenangan bersama mbah.Sempat salah masuk pintu gerbang,namun menjadi pembelajaran berharga.Nuansa kearifan kental terasa.Kami harus menuntun kendaraan dan tidak menyalakan mesin ketika melintasi pekarangan keraton.Namun,siang itu kami dibuat kesal,warga yang membawa turis naik motor dengan kencangnya melintasi halaman Keraton.Yang kami sayangkan pemandu turis,seharusnya memandu itu ditanamkan juga bagaiamana mengarifi budaya yang berlaku di suatu tempat.Setelah itu,akhirnya kami memasuki gerbang pintu masuk,kami disambut abdi dalem yang ramah.diberi 2 stiker keraton...makin senanglah kami.Memasuki keraton kami melihat pertunjukkan wayang kulit.Tak terasa air mata mengalir,mengingat kenangan bersama Mbah.Memasuki halaman dalam Keraton,kami merasakan begitu tingginya budaya bangsa Indonesia.Abdi dalem yang setia dan penuh tanggungjawab melayani keluarga Keraton.Ada sepenggal lagi kearifan budaya,yang sebaiknya kita taati,terdapat tulisan di larang duduk atau menginjak lantai bangsal keraton.Tapi tetap saja ada yang nakal,menginjak dan foto di bangsal keraton.Sempat juga ada angin kencang di dekat bangsal Keraton,sehingga papan peringatan jatuh,refleks saya menegakkan kembali,dan yang membuat saya kagum,salah seorang abdi dalem ternyata hendak menegakkan mengucapkan terimakasih ke saya,karena saya yang terlebih dahulu menegakknnya.Sebuah gambaran betapa abdi dalem sangat menjiwai setiap tugas yang diemban.Walaupun dengan honor yang tak seberapa di terima setiap bulannya.Memasuki ruang lainnya.Tambah kami kagum....dan dalam hati kami berjanji akan mengarifi dan menjaga budaya bangsa Indonesia yang adi luhung.Dan semoga kesejahteraan para abdi dalem diperhatikan Keluarga Keraton.Jadi...yuk arifi kebudayaan bangsa kita dengan senantiasa menjaga,mentaati,dan melestarikannya.Jogja...kita banget.

If you are very interested in history may be of interest. Went on a Sunday so was packed with locals. Nothing if great interest. Saw the son of the sultans palace which is empty because he had 5 daughters. The hall was a beautiful building as was the prayer building. Both had great wood carvings.
We were convinced to take a cyclo ride around the main sites for only 20,000 Rp. It was a good way to get around but apart from the sons palace there wasn't much to see. The rest of the time they tried to take us to artists or batik makers or puppet makers for the usual hard sell.
Tiketnya relatif murah untuk memasuki wisata di kraton jogja.  Dari sini ke musium kereta juga dekat.  Jadi sekali berkunjung lanhsung bisa 2 tempat dan gak perlu bolak balik parkir
Not a very special palace. Lots of tourists. The rooms wit antiques are not very well preserved. They have to clean the antiques.

For a Royal Palace, we were honestly expecting some royalty in the grounds... The attraction is a bunch of poorly maintained buildings and photos, where there were no information in English.

There is not much to do there, but it is cheap and can help kill some time if you have nothing else to do. We didn`t took a guide, but maybe that could add to the experience...

Wish someone had advised me to skip this place. It was unoriginal, boring and a little shambolic in its organisation. It's almost like someone ran out of ideas for tourist attractions so cobbled this place together. A personal 'favourite' part for me was the cabinet which included ice cream scoops and cheese graters. Talk about scraping the barrel. Wouldn't go back if you paid me to go in. Never mind me paying to get in.

This place is a museum of local heritage. You get to learn about local history. It's your usual run of the mill tourist attraction. But if you keep a keen eye and ear, you might learn something new...

Masuk ke kraton, langsung terasa kearifan budaya lokal. Lokasi bersih terawat, pertunjukan ada tiap hari, mulai pukul 10.00.

Tiketnya 5000/orang, klo mau bawa kamera tambah biaya 1000. 
Bila ingin pakai guide, antara 15-25rb.

Untuk yg pertama kali ke Jogjakarta, wajib mangunjungi Kraton Yogyakarta Hadiningrat ini.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: it is very interesting to know about the past. There was a lot going on in the past in Yogya but as anywhere in Indonesia the people here have no real sense to present it and make it special what it really is.like everywhere in Indonesia ............

インドネシア人の友人と行ったので、問題なく観光できました。でも貸切のドライバーさんに、偽ガイドがいるから完全無視するように言われました。確かに怪しい感じの人が出口はこちら、と手招きしていました。出口は逆の方向でした。
クラトンとバティック博物館、王家の資料館などジョグジャカルタ観光の1番のポイントで外国人にも十分魅力的です。バティックを今回の旅行の目的にしていた私にはまさにツボでした。さらにワヤンという人形劇も感動しました。ガムランバンド、台詞の祝詞、パペッティアが一体となって、1時間程ストーリーを奏でます。しかし！ストーリーについてパンフレットもなく、説明もなく、すべてジャワ語！インドネシア人にもジャワ語は理解できませんでした。このワヤン劇は週1回、私が訪れた時期は水曜日10:00からで入場料に含まれています。1時間見たのは私達ぐらいで、他の観光客は途中退席していました。遠目でしか見れないし、ストーリーも分からないからだと思いますが、戦いのシーンなどは、シンバルとパンチがしっかり一致していて、練習の成果だと思いました。クラトンの別の部屋では練習風景も見学できます。王家のバティックコレクションで本当のバティックを見れば、お土産物屋さんの、なんちゃってバティックは買えなくなります。素晴らしいジャワ文化に触れる入り口として、クラトンは存在しています。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: sudah bertahun-tahun sy tidak mengunjungi kraton, trakhir ketika saya kuliah sekitar 17 th yg lalu, dan perubahannya sangat nampak skali, sayanganya skr kraton tdk selengkap dlu, dlu kereta kraton mash dipamerkan skr tidak ada sama skali hanya gambar-gambar saja, sayang skali tempelan2 informasi juga di buat asal2an tdk tertata dgn rapih, banyak etalase yg kosong .... :(

Kraton Yogyakarta is famous for tourists from many countries, that is why many foreigners visit it today. The ticket price is cheap, only IDR5000 with additional price IDR1000 if you wanna take pictures with camera or phone. For foreigners, the ticket price is IDR12500.
Lokasinya mudah diakses, tiket masuk cukup murah (tidak sampe 10rb) petugas dan abdi dalem ramah bgt.very nice 😊

The tour guide also will guide you to souvenir shop, probably the tour guide get some fee if you shop there.
There were few rooms need more proper care like putting some air conditioners.you could learn some of java's history there.able to watch gamelan orchestra too..

Di Kraton ini kita bisa melihat dan mengenal benda - benda yang digunakan saat acara pernikahan yang mereka tampilkan di kraton. Kraton Yogyakarta ini sendiri masih terasa sangat kental dengan kebudayaan Jawa yang khas

Entstehungsgeschichte und derzeitige Nutzung des Palastes durch den ( aktiven ) Sultan nahe zu bringen - und zwar in Deutsch ! Vielen Dank für die kurzweilige Führung !
You get some insights into the Yogya 'royal' family, but it's all very limited. They show a film of the inauguration, but didn't bother to offer commentary in English.

It was  nicer compared to Keraton Solo. We got a tour guide at the gate. Pak Imam was abdi dalem (Keraton staff) and no charge only tips. He was very friendly and knowledgeable. We learned a lots about Keraton history and Yogya culture.

saya paling suka melihat pertunjukan gamelan bersama tarian. tempat ini menyajikan wahana kebudayaan yogyakarta yang masih kental. Banyak sekali benda benda peningalan raja raja jogja zaman dahulu. Kraton ini sangat di gemari para bule dari luar negeri karena ke khasan budayanya.

Dari luar bangunan sudah nampak gagah..dan memang saat kami masuk ke dalam kraton , kami sempat termangu karena ada barisan duduk abdi dalem . Memasuki ruangan demi ruangan sangat menarik, belajar mengenai sejarah kraton , setiap ruangan dan alat peraga lengkap dengan keterangan , juga bila ingin sejarah kraton yang detil dapat menghub guide . 

Bangunan terjaga dengan baik , sangat menarik bisa berkunjung ke sini

Review Text:
The Sultans Palace is a complex of buildings in the Javanese style in southern Yogyakarta. Entry for tourists is 12,500 Rupiah with another 1,000 Rupiah for a photo permit. 
The buildings are interesting with some beautiful detailing. 
Several museums dot the grounds. These are disappointing with faded photographs, poor lighting, and exhibits that are dusty and clearly not looked after. 
Visitors expecting an experience similar to Bangkoks Grand Palace would be dissatisfied. But those looking to learn more of the Sultanate and java's history will find things to enjoy.

This is really place you need to visit if you like to know about history.The atmosphere is peaceful on the crowd (when we were there was full of visitors) we watch nice performance of Wayang golek and listening Gamelan it was marvelous,we watch how the woman painting on batik and we bought some batik from there (Not recommended to buy batik over there too expensive) cause finally I found another batik with better quality in another shop in Malioboro.Our Guide was nice his name is Harto he is funny and telling jokes many time as long we make trip around.I am satisfied to visit Keraton Yogyakarta and my friends too
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Visited on 23/12/2016 - as the Palace of the Sultan it  was very disappointing. The building is nothing great to look at and there are no artefacts on display inside. They charged a 'photo' fee if you wanted to take photos inside, but after paying I discovered there was nothing to photograph. Would not visit again and would not recommend.

Surrounding area was so beautiful spacious style pavillions spread over a serene. The museum part is pretty bored but it was ok just wander around quietly, soaking in the atmosphere and admiring the architecture.  One thing should remember please bring your own water or something else and the seller sold the drink 3x normal value

Untuk tiket masuk membayar Rp. 5.000. Untuk yang ingin berfoto membayar tambahan Rp. 2.000. Lebih baik berkeliling dengan ditemani guide yang tersedia di sana. Biayanya Rp. 50.000. Kita akan dijelaskan seluk beluk seputaran area depan keraton dari Pagelaran sampai Siti Inggil.
Untuk memasuki area tempat tinggal raja, kita harus membeli tiket yang berbeda lagi.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Memasuki obyek wisata ini seperti memasuki masa lalu. Kita disuguhi benda-benda peninggalan raja-raja Ngayugyo Hadiningrat. Antara lain Kita dapat melihat foto-foto para Sultan Jogja dengan segala pernak-perniknya. Kain-kain batik sebagai hibah dari para keluarga kerajaan. Disuguhi juga pertunjukan gamelan yang ditabuh secara apik. Jika anda ingin mengetahui sisi kehidupan kesultanan Yogyakarta, sudah tentu saya merekomendasikan untuk berkunjung ke keraton Yogyakarta.

Want to know more about javanese culture, especially yogyakarta, you have to visit here.

This is the palace of yogyakarta, where the king and queen lives. Everyday it open for people to see what inside the building and what kind of life they have.

A lot of historical things there, from painting, ceramic, music instrument, batik collection etc.

I enjoy spend time there and i admire their treasure.
Nothing extraordinary but traditional music and wayung puppet shows were pretty good, being unable to understand a single word since they used local language.

Keraton atau istana kerajaan mataram atau kesultanan Jogjakarta yang masih terjaga baik dari segi historis maupun bangunannya, Belum ke Jogja kalo belum ke keraton Jogja, keraton ini punya nilai historis yang sangat besar bagi Indonesia, tanpa kerajaan ini indonesia mungkin tidak ada. 

Dari segi bangunan sangat terawat, karena sangat didukung pemerintah setempat untuk melestarikan keraton ini,

The place was rundown, dirty and full of guides trying to rip you off.
We entered the palace and were greeted by a guide; he showed us the palace (beautiful) which is a Javanese style building (this goes for people complaining about the place not being a palace).

After showing you the palace, guides try to make you buy batik stuff (overpriced) near the palace. If you want cheaper batik go to ORI GALLERY instead.

Sarò stato sfortunato io che nella fretta non ho capito cosa vedere e dove andare nonostante il mio amico parli indonesiano però penso che il giardino di casa mia sia meglio curato e più interessante.

보르부르도사원과 뿌남바란사원을 제외하고 시내에서 가볼만 한 유적지. 이곳이 아주 좋아서가 아니라  족자카르타 시내유적지는 아주 빈약함. 특별한것은 현재 슐탄이 거주하는 곳으로 이곳 주민들에게 대단히 존경받고 있다는것을 직감적으로 느낄 정도임.

공연을 보면서 느긋하게 쉴수도 있음.
as this is all together, part of the tour if royal palace, good to see inside , tell the ild time history.
Very interesting and historical palace within jogja city. Definitely worth a visit here if you are in jogja.

日惹机场顺着人流走就到了坐公交的地方，墙上写的是坐公交3,600盾，在公交站台上付费，等A1车来时工作人员会让你上车。
我和负责报站的小伙说我要去日惹皇宫，让我在距离最近的时候下车。
下车后走了800多米去日惹皇宫，google上给的正门，但实际是不开的，要去靠右的侧门才能进去。
日惹皇宫门票7,000盾。里面可看性不大，印象最深的是皇宫有点像国内的亭子，但放大了十倍的版本。
攻略上提到有看舞蹈表演的地方，但实际是没有的。反而是一个门票12,500盾的地方，旅行团专用景点，人暴多，可看性据说还不如日惹王宫（我没进去，听小伙伴说的）。

op zondag morgen worden er traditionele dansen vertoond wat erg mooi is.
kom op tijd dan zit je goed vooraan om goede foto,s of opnamen te maken.

Le palais en lui-même n'a rien d'exceptionnel. Le plus intéressant est l'ensemble urbain de maisons et ruelles dans l'enceinte du palis où vivent les serviteurs. Flânerie agréable et pittoresque, gens charmants.

Visite très étendue, peu d'indications voire pas du tout , l'Anglais peu utilisé?
Du coup avec la chaleur torride, le soleil, cela devient vite usant...
Mal entretenu, peu propre par endroits, incompréhensible tout de même.
La priorité n'est pas là.
Du coup sans guide, sans indications valables, la visite devient vite galère et des points sont  oubliés, donc difficile de se fair une idée précise de ce lieu.
Par endroits les maisons des particuliers sont très proches, dommage, pas mal d’échoppes, de manèges pour les enfants...cela gâche pas mal le côté historique du lieu...
A la fin, dur dur pour avoir un taxi.
Ces derniers ne se voient pas facilement ici, le mieux c'est d'avoir un numéro de taxi à appeler..
Tempat ini bagus dayangnya kurang terawat sehingga banyak koleksi yang berdebu dan tidak dibersihkan

I have been many times over the years but last month took some friends for the first time. Right at the end of the main street of Jogjakarta abscess to get to... Just dissapointed in the upkeep with so much history involved.

Mengunjungi keraton adalah melihat budaya Jawa di masa lampau, disini bisa dilihat museum Hamengkubuwono IX , juga pusaka sultan sebelumnya seperti kereta kuda, dan lainya

Review Text: Although there is nothing very spectacular about visiting Kraton. It is the current Sultan of Yogyakarta's residence / palace, and understandably the living section of the palace is not accessible for the public visitors. It serves as a cultural center for the Javanese people and contains a museum that displays the sultanate's artefacts.
Better to do a self guided tour because the guides don't give you enough time to take in the many things to see which are all fascinating.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Interesting old palace with weapons, costumes , coronation dais , finished in Gold leaf , sufficient to give one an idea of the culture in previous times

Palace of Yogya sultans is a nice place to spend some time in the morning as it closes the gates at 1pm or 2pm depending on the day of the week. Built in 18th century it’s actually more than a palace – it’s rather kind of a small walled city inside a bigger city. Golden Pavillion seems to be the most interesting part of Kraton. Many exhibits in the palace buildings, including one dedicated to the most beloved sultan. Some of the Kraton’s residents wear traditional clothes. Palace continues to be used for important ceremonies.

Entry fee was something like 1 euro including photo permit. There are also some performances at the entrance courtyard – no additional fee.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: This place was part of the history of small kingdom. Mansions of the King and Royal family at the past,
Tempat yang sangat bersejarah untuk mengetahui keturunan dan silsilah raja2 di Yogjakarta serta bisa memperkenalkan sejarah Kraton kepada anak2

Well, you havent gone to jogja if you dont come to keraton. The best time to visit is in the morning and they offer free quide. My guide was a well spoken english. be careful with cheat trishaw! They are everywhere. There are free performance everyday at 10 am

Review Text: Es gibt nicht viel zu sehen, ich würde es gar als langweilig bezeichnen. Man verpasst nicht viel wenn man. Icht da ist. Als wir da waren gab es noch ein Schattenspiel welches für kurze Zeit interessant war jedoch haben wir das Interessa auch ziemlich schnell verloren da sich die Puppen nicht gross bewegt haven und der die Geschichte nur in der Einheimischen sprache presentiert wurde.

Kraton is  a  palace  where  Javanese Royals, the  10th King  Hamengkubuono  and  his  family  lives.   If  anyone interested  with  Javanese  Culture  and  its  royal  family,  better  read  about  them  first.   Because  this  place  has  a short  opening  hours,  from  08.30  to 13.30.   A  visit  to  this place  does  not  take  long,  if no one interested in  its  art  and  culture,  this  place  can  be  sauntered  in  less  than half  hour.  

Of  course  local  tourism  board  try  to  keep  guests  to  stay   by   providing  Javanese  music  performance, which  guests  normally stay  only  for  less than  10 minutes, unless  you  understood  and  enjoy  Javanese  music.

But  at  the end of exit  door,  there  is  a resto  called  Bale  Raos.  We  heard  that  the  dishes prepared  is  of  what the  royal  family  had.  My  friend  and  I  just  have  coffee  and  dessert.   It  was  excellent.  

I ordered Perawan  Kenes:  grilled  banana  buttered  with  coconut  extract, as you  can see  in the  picture.  

Oh  try  their  royal  traditional  drink too,  its superb.  Many  of  the  drinks  are  a  mix  of  herb.   Its  written in  English  on the  menu.  I  had traditional  Secang  herbal  tea  with  real lemongrass  as  the stirer.

Keraton Yogyakarta terletak tidak jauh dari kawasan Malioboro. Di Keraton Yogyakarta, terdapat kawasan yang dibuka umum untuk wisatawan. Kawasan tersebut dibuka mulai dari pukul 09.00-14.00. Tiket masuk juga relatif murah, Rp 5.000. Di sini kita dapat mengenal sejarah Kerajaan Mataram lebih dekat dan menyenangkan. Kita bisa secara langsung melihat benda-benda bersejarah Kerajaan Mataram. Jika beruntung, Anda juga dapat menikmati pagelaran-pagelaran budaya jawa seperti tari tradisional dan upacara tradisional di pendopo keraton.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: No brochures available. Not open late enough and also poor communication from staff.  They seem to want to force you to pay a guide or do a walking tour to find out info. Most all museums have very little English translations. Also check days and times for programme offered during day. There was only music there and I was told they have a free puppet show daily which was not true. There is a chalkboard behind ticketing agent so you can find out what is going on that day. I will try to attach a photo I took. Very few staff speak English here. Grounds are nice but not many places you allowed to enter and thick poor painting on some of doors windows and buildings. Looks caky. Batik museum room is good with some English translations available. See samples.

Siapa yang tidak kenal dengan kota jogja, salah satu daerah istimewa yang ada di Indonesia. Pemerintahan di kota ini juga masih memakai sistem kerajaan. Salah satunya tempat tinggalnya raja adalah di kraton jogja ini. Teman-teman bisa belajar budaya jawa di kraton ini, peninggalan sejarah pada masa kerajaan dahulu dan di kraton ini juga masih kental adat istiadat jawanya. Mulai dari alat musiknya, keramah tamahan masyarakatnya dan masih banyak lagi hal yg menarik di kraton ini.
Tempat yang dikunjungi kurang banyak dan sebagian tempat rusak dan bau... sayang penataan kurang maksimal...
De traditionele dans was bijzonder, het complex zelf viel behoorlijk tegen. We waren zelf meer de attractie, gezien het grote aantal fotoverzoekjes.

Si vous ne restez que peu de temps dans la ville Yogyakarta, le palais ne fait pas partie des sites incontournables à voir. On y apprend peu de choses et l'architecture est plutôt simple. Cependant, au sein de cette "ville" dans la ville - plusieurs milliers de personnes y vivent et/ou y travaillent - il se passe apparemment de nombreuses choses donc il peut être intéressant de mieux se renseigner sur ce qui s'y passe chaque jour. Si vous vous y rendez, ne manquez pas le concert donné par l'orchestre de gamelan, l'atelier de fabrication de marionnettes où l'on vous montrera très gentiment toutes les étapes de fabrication (vente non obligatoire en fin de visite), ni le petit café où vous pourrez acheter le mondialement célèbre kopi luwac, le café de civette. Pour les amateurs de café, ce café est incontournable! Vous y verrez aussi la garde du sultan ; ceux qui surveillent les salles d'exposition sont tout à fait disposés à vous donner quelques explications dans un anglais rudimentaire mais rempli de bonne volonté.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Unless you have a deep interest in Indonesian history I would not bother. The best part is getting away from the plethora of vendors outside. When inside there is not much to be seen. Lots of parts are closed to the public, the setting is pleasantly green and clean, that's about it. Don't be fooled by the picture.
If you love culture it's one of the must places to visit while you in Yogyakarta. The dance was so cool!

This is the Sultan's palace and which the present Sultan still resides in. A large part of the Kraton  is now a museum. This palace has one of the finest Javanese palace architecture with luxurious halls and spacious courtyards and pavilions. Exhibits include static displays like old photographs and gifts from European monarchs, Royal family heirlooms and gamelan instruments. There are cultural performances like puppet shows, gamelan and classical dances which are included in the ticket. This is not a must visit but something to consider if you have the time.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It is unusual to be able to tour around lived-in royal palace grounds. The only section we could not visit was the area with the houses the royal family actually live in. Plenty of historical artefacts to give you a good background to the family and history of the area.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Keraton.. tmpt para Sultan jogja, tempatnya luas, bersih.. gak terlalu banyak yang bisa dilihat kecuali ada even atau acara khusus.. lumayan untuk melengkapi perjalanan di jogja melihat foto2 para Sultan yg pernah memimpin jogja, menikmati udara di pelataran kraton.

Entrance fee is 12,500 rupiahs plus 1,000 more for using one's camera. During my visit, I was the only one requiring an English speaking guide so I had him for myself.

My guide speaks perfect English, explaining highlights of the exhibits of the various buildings we entered. He gladly answered my questions and suggested places where I should pose for my pictures. He also talked briefly about the history of the Kraton.

Our tour ended at the pavilion where I watched a musical dance presentation.

Tip: Use the FREE guide to better understand and appreciate the Kraton and its exhibits. Highly recommended!
Het kraton in yogja is leuk om naar toe te gaan maar het is geen must see. Veel van hetzelfde en niet erg indrukwekkend.
入口は、ちょっとこじんまりとして見えます、金ピカの仁王像の様な物が置いてあります。中は、結構な広さで、全部は公開されていないのですが、展示室内は、エアコンは無く、暑さと共に歩き疲れます。

Perlu perbaikan dari segala lini,  kebersihannya juga lebih dijaga, toiletnya perlu perbaikan, tempat nya banyak melihatkan sejarah keraton. Supaya kelihatan lebih menarik bagi wisatawan manajemen perlu diperbaik ih.  Trma kasih

Basically its the sultan's palace, a fortress like thing with open gardens, large halls and many artifacts. Unless for the enthusiast, I don't feel there's much to adore. There are cultural performances on most days at 10 am, but none mesmerizing meriting a stare at them for more than 10-15 min. I guess this would be a 1-2 hour visit, just because you came to Jogja and would find it a miss if you didn't come here. Atleast the ticket price is cheap.

Mind you there are hawkers near the gates to take you to show the making of leather puppets and batik. They will say it is included in your entrance ticket and it is free. However, they take tourists to those places so that they may get a commission from a purchase you may buy from the craftsmen. They are not at all aggressive if you do not buy into them, but if you like the adventure, follow them and witness making of the puppets and batik. It's an interesting find. If you don't feel the need to purchase a puppet or batik design, you are under no obligation. Just smile, say thank you and go along your way.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Jogja yang identik dengan keratonnya memiliki daya magis untuk selalu menyempatkan singgah sejenak demi menguak sejarah. Berkeliling di keraton ini banyak sekali benda koleksi kerajaan yang dapat kita lihat. Selain itu ada juga abdi dalem yang menggunakan pakaian jawa. Ini merupakan aset bangsa yang harus selalu dijaga.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Would just see if you have some free time as it does not have a palace feel. A poorly detailed history of the Palace is displayed, as it's in Indonesian. No effort to display the history in english, so as a tourist we come out feeling disenchanted.

jalan ke jogja blum sah kalo blum liat kraton jogja, tempat ini populer di kalangan turis lokal atau mancanegara. arsitektur unik khas keraton dengan terdapat museum di dalamnya. pas untuk mengetahui sejarah tentang keraton jogja ini.

Ondanks een goede gids (waarvan de familie al generaties voor de sultan werkt) is het resultaat matig: de gebouwen zijn oud, wit, groot, en over een ruime oppervlakte verspreid. Maar tegelijk is het net niet genoeg onderhouden, en zijn er veel schilderijen, vazen, medailles... die eens afgestoft mogen worden. Hetzelfde voor de gebouwen: oerdegelijk (wegens het gevaar voor aardbevingen): maar schoon is anders.

Bij een verblijf in Yogyakarta mag een bezoek aan de Kraton of Keraton zeker niet ontbreken. Vooral niet vergeten dit te doen met een gids. Trek zeker enkele uren uit voor het bezoek. Wij waren in de gelukkige omstandigheid het complex met een Indonesische vriendin te bezoeken die goed kon tolken. Zodoende ook heel leuke gesprekken gehad met leden van de hofhouding die overal in het complex rondlopen of zitten.

Jogjakarta sebenarnya seperti rumah kedua saya karena seringnya saya berkunjung kesana namun baru kali ini saya masuk kedalam keraton. didalam keraton ditemani dengan guide keraton saya memperoleh banyak wawasan mengenai keraton Jogjakarta dari era HB I. saya bisa memperlajari silsilah, saya bisa mengetahui sedikit kehidupan didalam keraton. Tak Heran julukan Jogja Istimewa benar benar istimewa bagi saya

As foreigners, we were assessed (modest amount) and assigned a personal English-speaking guide.  She was knowledgeable and with a wonderful sense of humor  - - - it really made the tour well worth the hour.   The display are static - - i.e. pictures and models, but our guide added stories and narratives that brought it to life.

It was said it is a must see while in Yogya, but to be honest there is nothing special about it. All you see is some furniture, pictures and other stuff. Everything is written in their language, so don't expect to understand any description next to the items. Entrance fee is 12.500 and another 1000 if you want to take some pictures. So at least it isnt expensive.
Luaaas, banyak pertanyaan dari anak sy,padahal sy juga masih blm puas bertanya dan ga cukup seharian buat berkunjung ke kraton Jogya..banyak hal.yg perlu diketahui

Kraton Yogya ini merupakan tujuan utama wisatawan yg datang ke Yogya setelah Malioboro, sehinggan bisa dibilang kraton identik dengan Yogya, Yogya identik dengan kraton, ini karena kemasyhuran kraton itu sendiri. banyak hal yg dapat dimaknai di Kraton ini :  sebagai tempat pusat pemerintahan karena Raja Yogya ada di sini, sebagai pusat budaya luhur karena sejarahnya yg luar biasa menurut sumber didirikan thn 1755 dan tentunya sebagai pusat rekreasi di Yogya karena khususunya di Indonesia Kraton Yogya ini yg paling terkenal dan paling fenomenal. Lokasinya yang garis lurus dengan Malioboro merupakan paket wisata yg pasti harus dikemas saat berwisata ke Yogya. Tentunya bagi pecinta sejarah, berkeliling di tempat ini merupakan kepuasan yg luar biasa,  banyak disuguhkan benda benda antik-kuno sebagai warisan luhur jaman dulu yg usianya puluhan tahun bahkan ada yg ratusan tahun, sejarah raja-raja dari Sri Sultan Hamengku Buwono I s/d Sri Sri Sultan Hamengku Buwono X. Bangunan Kuno khas kerajaan dan Abdi Dalem (staff-staff kerajaan) dengan seragam adatnya merupakan aset budaya yang bukan hanya dimiliki oleh Lingkungan Keraton Yogya saja, atau aset kota Yogya saja tapi juga merupakan aset budaya Indonesia yg bernilai tinggi.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The Kraton is the Sultan's palace, but it is not very impressive..  The batik exhibit shows a variety of styles and indicates the importance of batik to the Jogja area.  The historical artifacts and photos might be of interest to a local history buff, but didn't make a big impact on us.  There was a free gamelan concert with a very large orchestra, but they made this exotic form of music seem a little dull.

It isn't really possible to travel around the Kraton by foot without being harassed by touts trying to either; sell you something, get you to ride in a motorbike taxi or take to you a shop or function. 

Unfortunately, like Thailand, many people will lie and give you wrong opening hours in order to get you to somewhere else where they will earn commission. Their tactics are to be nice but quite forceful, and if you say no they can be a bit defensive. 

Anyway, don't fall for it, just ask the opening hours of attractions at you hotel if you plan to walk, or rent a motorbike to travel quickly through!

You should ask for local guide inside the Keraton to fully experience the visit, because many historical events happen in the Keraton, and every small details have its meaning.
The price to enter Keraton is cheap, the site was clean and airy. Maybe need a little improvement on the museum.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Heel mooie ervaring om door gedeeltelijk bewoond paleis te lopen. Heel veel foto's, schilderijen en een enthousiaste gids die goed en duidelijk verteld en ook nog redelijk in het Nederlands. Ook veel gedeelde historie met Nederland. Een aanrader om te bezoeken!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Hay que entrar por la puerta principal al lado de un reloj grande que cuesta 13.500 idr. Está mal señalizado e indicado y existe otra entrada más accesible a la vista que enseña una parte de los jardines por 7000 idr, pudiendo hacernos pensar que el palacio tan sólo es eso.
Merece la pena dejarse llevar por la gente autóctona, tampoco se ofenderán si se les rechaza su invitación a guiarnos.

Tras leer el resto de comentarios, personalmente me cuesta entender cómo alguien que viaja hasta Indonesia puede sentirse tan defraudado con la herencia cultural del país expuesto este palacio. Qué rigidez europeocentrista.

if you really interesting in history this is a good place for you, as they also have guide that can lead you to explore the Keraton and completed with their story. One thing that I like from this Keraton is their batik collection, it was really rare and beautiful. And you also may see the new creation of the some building inside Keraton.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Keraton Yogyakarta sangat luas. Jadi ada 2 bagian, bagian depan keraton yaitu bagian depan nya saja, saya juga kurang tau seperti apa di dalamnya karena saya langsung masuk ke bagian 2 yaitu bagian dalam keraton. Harga tiket masuk keduanya sama 5k untuk local dan international berbeda 15k. Untuk yang ingin berfoto dikenakan biaya tambahan 1k - 2k tergantung jenis camera nya. Sangat sangat murah menurut saya. Untuk masuk ke dalam keraton harap memakai pakaian yang sopan tidak memakai celana pendek, topi, tank top, dsb. Begitu akan masuk keraton disana ada abdi dalem keraton. Keratonnya sangat luas, disana juga ada jasa tour guide tapi saya kurang tau tarifnya berapa. Untuk yang ingin berkunjung kesana saya sarankan untuk menyewa jasa tour guide karena didalamnya banyak sekali sejarahnya. Begitu juga dengan barang-barang kerajan dari ratusan mungkin ribuan tahun lalu. Sangat bersejarah.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Kraton jogja menjadi salah satu tujuan utama saya dalam mengantar dosen saya untuk liburan di Indonesia. di kraton ini oleh guide di jelaskan bahwa bangunan kraton ini penuh dengan simbol dan makna filosofi jawa yang menjadi kebanggaan bagi masyarakat jawa. Keramahan para abdi dalem yang menjadi guide tour kami serta penjelasannya yang mudah di mengerti. akan tetapi belum bisa menjelaskan secara logis dari mistik yang ada disana.
Chi hagià visitato i palazzi reali Thailandesi rimarrà profondamente deluso. Gli interni sono molto spartani e non ci sono cose particolari da visitare. SI visita velocemente.

Kraton Yogyakarta adalah tempat yang sangat bersejarah bagi bangsa Indonesia. Menyimpan banyak cerita di dalamnya dan menjadi saksi bisu perjuangan bangsa ini terutama di Yogyakarta. Kraton Yogyakarta mempunyai bentuk yang unik dan menarik menjadikan bangunan ini menjadi sebuah mahakarya yang harus dijaga keberadaannya.

We visited here in the hope to see some traditional dancing but unfortunately seemed to pick the one day when there was nothing on!  Regardless we wondered round and got a guide to explain what we were seeing which was definitely worth it to get the most from your visit.  Going rate is about 30-40,000 per guide.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Better than water castle. Historical king castle and worth the visits. Experience traditional "wayang kulit" show during weekend. Best and energetic guide.

it doesn't make sense if you come to yogyakarta but donnot visit the kraton here....it's not bad to have a look if only the sultan was not so cruel.... visitors are not permitted to wear hats or take a umbrella even when the sun is burning everything....we could not wait more to run away out

Open only in the morning. Guide can be obtained only with payment. But they say the amount is up to you. Good for group, the visit can be more meaningful with explanations and history. A women guide speak better English, we came across few man guide speak with local slang, although in English but not easy to understand. Camera/phone add 1000 idr. Entrance 12500 idr. Like most places in yoga, no brochure and maps...

Most places without air conditioning, only a few room with mild air con.

Musical performance in the central court, the music is nice, the team is not very well organised.

Will not go again, but good to take a look as it is nearby Jalan malioboro, just around 10 mins walk.

Kraton ini adalah jantungnya Yogyakarta. Berbagai macam kearifan lokal, benda-benda seni dan peninggalan bersejarah ada disini. Sangat menyenangkan belajar sejarah sambil dipandu oleh tour guide yang multi bahasa.

Took family from overseas to visit the Kraton. Oh my.....nothing to show that is original anymore. Display pictures is poor. Display room is very hot without proper ventilation. Clean ground and helpful guide though.
Het paleis van de sultan die daar samen zijn vrouw ook woont. Op zijn privé vetrekken na is er veel te zien, vooral alle kamers met geschenken van over de hele wereld.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It wasn't that special. Nice to go through but expect lots of people who want to sell you something. Also the nice people on the street who will try to help you don't do it for no reason! Water palace is disappointing

This is the Sultan's palace. There are numerous buildings with interesting local and other influenced architecture, as well as a series of museum displays. I found the room with portraits was interesting. Get a guide - English speaking ones available - ask at ticket booth. Each morning a performance at 10am with a gamelan orchestra.  We saw dancing which was good.  Different days have different performances.  It is worthwhile. Give yourself time with guide either before performance or go and get one afterwards.  Ours drifted off when we went to performance and it would have been good to have a guide through museum rooms.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Kraton is where the King & family living and for that reason opening hours is only up to 2:00pm. As Sultan (king) in Yogya is also a Gabenor the selection of next Sultan is consider as critical to ensure Yogya progression. In Kraton all history of Sultan from the first till 10th (current) are well documented. Meet the workers and ask them all you want to know from the admin affairs up to how they wear the batik sarong and how to diffrentiate them... it is interesting to know how details all those being crafted become a culture in Kraton.
A bit boring museum. Not much interesting to see. A bunch of old pictures, that's pretty much it. Expected more from a palace.

トゥクトゥクで入口まで行き、チケット購入したところで日本語ガイドを雇いました。
同じタイミングで入場した日本人の方たちと2組同時にガイドすると言われましたが、値段は変わりませんでした(その時は何も考えてなかったとゆうのもあるが)。
あまり期待せずに行きましたが、案外楽しめました。ガイドさんがいたおかげで、色々と細かく説明も聞けて勉強になりました。
その日はクラトン内で伝統舞踊も見れる日だったので、舞踊も見て帰ることに。
地球の歩き方に書いてる時間に合わせて席に座ったが、まぁーーーーーいくら待っても始まらない。ずーっと伝統音楽を奏でている人たちがいるだけ。
かなり待ってやっと始まったとゆうかんじで、地球の歩き方に記載されている時間はあてにならないのでご注意を。

Auf jeden Fall morgens hingehen, wenn dort auch Programm statt findet.
Ansonsten ist es relativ unspektakulär und man muss es nicht unbedingt gesehen haben.

1euro l entrée mais vraiment sans trop d intérêt car pas de vie juste des chenapans habillés en tenues traditionnelle pour surveiller les touristes et quelles objets appartenant aux sultan vraiment rien d extraordinaire à mon goût !

ガイド役が付いてきました。説明は丁寧でしたが、途中、絵画の店へ立ち寄り、購入することを勧めてきます。
宮殿と言っても、それ程ビックリする内容では無いので、オススメしません。
水の宮殿もガイド役がいて、同じ目にあいましたが、見るべき施設かと思います。

Sangat menyenangkan berkeliling didalam keraton Jogya ini sambil mendengarkan penjelasan dari pemandu tentang sejarah dari ruangan dan benda-benda yang ada.
Berbagai macam koleksi pakaian anggota kerajaan, benda-benda bersejarah yang unik koleksi kerajaan, foto-foto keluarga dan peristiwa di jaman dahulu.
Lebih enak berkunjung di pagi hari.

Kraton Yogyakarta is a symbol of this lovely city. It's good place to get to know the history of Yogyakarta and see the heritage in here. You can see many heritage like the cars that Sultan use, the potraits of Sultan, gamelan, etc

To see
To learn
To admire 
To proud becoming indonesian
Bring own mineral water incase hot weather
Not allow using hat
It is nice to visit although not really a must. If you don't have much time, this is one of the places that can be missed without regretting it later

Nous avons visité le kraton car nous avions un peu de temps avant de reprendre notre avion. Mais cette visite n'est pas indispensable ! Le site n'a rien d'extraordinaire, il n'y a pas grand chose à voir et il n'y a quasiment aucune explication en anglais.

The place is not impressive. The shows they offer neither. There are no explanations about the puppets and pictures showed in the rooms. You better save your time and visit other places. The waterpalace was more beautiful.)

The Kraton is a nice place to visit with loads to see. Pictures, clothes, paintings  and a lot more. To fully understand the history and see everything in a good order it is advice to take a guide. Ask for the price before!
Hier is toch ook nog een beetje van de bijzondere relatie tussen beide landen zichtbaar. Laat je rondleiden door een gids die je wat van deze historie kan vertellen.
Erg mooi om te zien. Je krijgt echt een indruk van het leven van de sultan. Er wordt op verschillend pleinen muziek gespeeld.

The entrance for tourist visitor is on behind the main building. The entrance fee was very cheap, and for you who bring camera, you just need to pay additional cost 1k only. There are also nice guide available who ready to explain you about all parts of this Palace.
Assez grand mais avec des petits bâtiments avec pas grand chose à l'intérieur. Jai ete déçu par le peu de choses à voir malgré l'étendue du site
It's worthed to walk around if you are in the area.  There is a Sultan palace, water castle and some others places that royal family used. It's good for a cloudy day activity.
Tempat yang menarik untuk dikunjungi sambil menambah wawasan dan pengetahuan sejarah jaman dulu tentang berdirinya kraton dan stafnya juga ramah ramah benda benda sejarah dirawat dengan baik

The Sultan's palace, also known as Kraton, is a journey through time in Jogjakarta. I went there with a Golden Bird taxi arranged by my hotel. My ticket included a fee for a local guide who accompanied me throughout the visit. Outside the Palace Near the entrance I saw a few very old trees that were still in good shape. The palace has many open air areas which were used for various purposes, including official receptions for heads of state and dignitaries visiting the Sultan, a musical lounge with Gamelan instruments, a school for the Sultan's children and other uses. Some buildings used as sleeping quarters were unfortunately not accessible by tourists. There were lots of pictures and articles from the times of several Sultans and some of the Batik items were extraordinarily beautiful. However, the main character here was Sultan no. 9 who was an important figure in the city's history. I was mesmerized by the knowledge and attention to detail of my delightful guide who must be in his 70s. Since I love history, this visit was a must on my Jogjakarta trip. I combined it with a visit to the Prambanan temple in one half day. Bring a bottle of water and make sure your ticket gives you the right to use your camera inside.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Tempat sejarah yang wajib di lindungi kelestarian dan keasliannya, Sehingga anak cucu kita bisa melihat bukti sejarah yang masih otentik tidak terkontaminasi oleh kepentingan Politik. Biarkan Ngayogjakarta tetap Istimewa dan terus Istimewa sampai akhir jaman

Pretty average museum. Nothing extraordinary. The batik room n traditions room was the only one i found interesting.

We went there to try see the traditional Jawa dance however it was on a different day so missed it. 

They have a 2 hour show daily 10-12am the dance, traditional music and wayung puppet shows. These were pretty good, being unable to understand a single word (it is in old jawanese) takes the fun out a bit, but still lovely experience. There are also supposed to be some classes in evening we however couldn't go for these.

Berkunjung ke keraton yogyakarta mengingatkan kita kepada sejarah dimana kerajaan berdiri, di era moder dan kekinian menurut anak muda dan gaul berkunjung ke Keraton membuat kita bisa banyak belajar mengenai sejarah dan budaya.. satu tempat favourite dan wajib dikunjungi ketika ke yogyakarta.
Wisata yang menarik, dengan adat Keraton yang kentara.. orang-orang yang ramah, dan sejarah yang menarik..

Warto obejrzec,zupełnie odmienna architektura .Właściwie zespół pawilonów..Część udostępniona do zwiedzania,część zamieszkała przez sułtana z rodziną..Imponujący Złoty Pawilon..Można posłuchać koncertu gamelanu.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Dopo aver pagato gli ingeessi e un piccolo extra per la macchina fotografica entriamo nell'ampio cortile pieno di padiglioni (alcuni non accessibili). Il grande padiglione centrale costituisce il palco delle esibizioni che si svolgono solo al mattino. Nei padiglioni laterali sono presenti esposizioni di oggetti, quadri e tessuti batik. Peccato per le descrizioni quasi completamente in indonesiano.

Heureusement que ce n'est pas cher.. Voilà notre verdict un peu sévère mais réaliste de la visite.. 
Ce qui nous a finalement amusé a été d'observer la restauration des plafonds et autres peintures par le personnel.. 
Sinon la visite se résume à une succession de salles avec de vieilles photos, tout est en indonésien.. Nous avons vu des gens avec des guides.. Pour ce qu'il y a a voir.. 
Je pense qu'il y a d'autres excursions bien plus intéressantes à faire ..

Mooi stukje cultuur en geschiedenis. Geniet van de sierlijke dansvoorstelling van de dansers onder de klanken van het gamelanorkest. Maak een praatje met de bewakers van de Sultan die nog steeds in  traditionele kleding ( sarong met dolk of kris)  rondlopen en over de eigendommen in en rondom het museum waken.
Visite intéressante à condition de la faire avec un guide.  Belles collections de  cadeaux royaux et intéressante démonstration de musiques traditionnelles
They hold Grebeg Syawal festival every Ied  day. People will gather in the city square before the Keraton for this festival. The Keraton people will bring 'gunungan' to give it to the people.
Surrounding area was so beautiful with rich Indonesian architectural design. A lot to see in Kraton Palace

Kearifan budaya yang masih terjaga, tapi masih minim tempat edukasi budaya buat pengunjung, mungkin sebaiknya di buka kelas buat pengunjung untuk belajar budaya keraton agar kecintaan terhadap keraton lebih mendalam

It is the palace of Yogyakarta. Quite interesting. We parked the car and walk a little to the site. Bring your own drink because you 'll need it. it is hot. And the seller sold the drink 3x normal value

The Sultan of Yogyakarta is also the governor of this region. Somehow the Sultans of Yogyakarta managed to integrate their Sultanate into the newly independent Indonesia with out loosing too much of their power. In being able to do so they were so much more successful then their Northern cousins from Surakarta. The Sultan of Surakarta is now a Sultan in name only and has to make his living as a businessman. The Kraton of Surakarta shows that clearly and sadly. Hamengkubuwono IX of Yogyakarta (please forgive me if I err in the numeration) even became Vice President of Indonesia.
If you enter the palace you can feel the mystical connection the Sultan has to the Queen of the ocean living in the waters at Parangtritis and to Gunung Merapi. Try to read up on how Raffles conquered the Kraton after 1815. Drive through the little streets near the Kraton within it's outer walls, look at the neat little forts and gates with their white-washed walls and you will catch a glimpse of the ancient powers and myths still present.
By the way, legend has it that Hamengkubuwono X will be the last Sultan. Could become reality since he has no son and if he succeeds in making one of his daughter first female Sultan. Rumors have it that not everyone within the Sultan's family are all that happy about it.😉
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Kraton of Jogyakarta is a palace complex which is  located in the city of Jogyakarta. It is a Javanese architecture and it serves as a cultural centre which contains a museum that displays the Sultanate's artefacts.

Come spiegare questo posto?
Prima cosa è un punto pieno di vita, con bancarelle dove si mangia dove si compra magliette argenti souvenir giocattoli di tutto di più.
Poi è un punto di incontro di tutti i turisti e locali che frequentano questa area più che un punto singolo, in gran parte fatto dal palazzo reale. Sarebbe però diminuito tipo riferirsi al Kraton semplicemente a un posto definito. Centro culturale centro artistico, comprende diversi edifici, alcuni usati per mostre e manifestazioni, altri assolutamente privati e inaccessibili. Colori profumi incredibili. Fondamentalmente rinchiuso tra quattro mura con delle porte enormi e accessibile con la sedia a rotelle da tutte le parti. Che dire, se andate a Yogyakarta la prima cosa partite con il Kraton. A me diverte soprattutto la sera quando è veramente pieno.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Davvero, niente di che. Se potessi tornare indietro non ci andrei, il mio consiglio è di andare direttamente al Water Castle

Keraton adalah istana tempat raja tinggal dan memerintah kerajaannya. Saat ini keraton telah menjadi museum yang bisa dikunjungi oleh wisatawan. Keraton Yogyakarta sendiri dibagi dua yaitu bagian depan atau pendopo pintu masuknya sendiri dari depan, dan bagian dalam pintu masuknya dari samping. Masing-masing bagian harga tiketnya 5000 Rupiah untuk wisatawan lokal dan 12500 Rupiah untuk wisatawan mancanegara. Untuk berfoto dikenakan biaya sendiri, 2000 Rupiah untuk pendopo dan 1000 Rupiah untuk bagian dalam. Kita bisa dibantu oleh pemandu atau jalan-jalan sendiri.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: A visit to Kraton helps if you can speak Javanese or Bahasa as the guides are very knowledgeable and allow you to fully appreciate the experience. Interesting and historic.
Ce palais a mal vieilli et aurait besoin d'être mieux entretenu. Il ne présente pas un grand intérêt même si l'orchestre de gamelan et ses chanteuses essaient de dynamiser le site.

First, to anyone who read this; there are 2 entrances, one that costs 7000/person and the other for around 12500/person (plus additional 2000 for photography)

So Google Map drove us to the WRONG one - there is really not much to see, so I am not going to upload photos because this is the wrong entrance and i dont want to promote it+ you dont get to see anything from the palace, just a very poor museum, some clothes and wax-figures of sultan and his children.

So at the door ; a guide with a batik shirt and a badge told us he is OFFICIAL guide (his name was Iman) and pointed to his badge. Of course we didnt understand what it was saying on it, so we trusted him because the ticket-counter was very close and you would think at so famous attraction the scammers would not be daring to approach you so close to the official staff - wrong! Probably they all work together.

So the guys said that for only 50000 rupiah he will explain everything we want to know about sultan and the palace. So he was telling us stories how his wife os emplyed as a chef at sultans palace and how he is playing instruments at the orchestra and he was traveling Europe and so on and so on..

At the end, we visit another batik gallery that was surprisingly open only on Tuesdays (and guess which day it was) and also that the owner there is a teacher for a government-sponsored program that teaches free workshops for batik, that lat up to 3hours. But they just finished. 

Also they told us that 60% of the profit goes to orphans and 20% to government for keeping up the school and that the guy at gallery doesnt get any money, because he has two other jobs as teacher and he just is making paintings as a hobby. Boy! He was so full of ... of course we didnt believe him and we didnt buy anything. 

First : if you want to see the palace, you want to hire official guide - tourist board of yogyakarta should make sure you are able to do so.

Second: if there are two entrances and at the wrong entrance you dont get to see anything, tourist board/sultan/ government or whoever should make sure that tourists get to the right one!

Third: this experience was so disappointing (after we got home and realized we didnt see the real Kraton nor the mosque and tunnel at water palace) that we cancelled 2 extra days at yogyakarta-disappointed of how this city is treating tourists - and we have been in Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur and other cities around SE Asia.

If you go to Yogyakarta, go visit Borobudur and Prambanan; perhaps Ratu Boko and the famous Ballet performance-it qill cost you quite some money but these are the things that are worth it. As long as they wont charge you even more (prices are changing almost monthly, lol)

But really dont bother with other things as long as they will let scammers to screw tourists around. Perhaps later in time they will realize that this is not the right thing and will change that. But as long as the things are as they are go somewhere else instead.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I learned much hope about Java the island and the people from my visit. This place is like a living museum. The downside are the becak drivers, and other hawkers that constantly assault visitors.
There is a free guide available upon request and there are some music performances that i didnt see but building itself is nothing special.
cukup menarik wisata kesini. tidak ke jogja kalau tidak mengunjungi keraton. aksesnya juga dekat malioboro
The Kraton is a must see and we really enjoyed the visit. Make sure to take a guide with you (available upon entering) in order to get more details.

Wij hebben hier een snel rondje gemaakt, maar het kon ons allemaal niet zo boeien. Pas toen we in het waterpaleis een gids mee kregen was het iets beter. Zonder gids zou ik dit niet aanraden, met kan het leuker zijn.

Мы посетили дворец в воскресенье, на территории в двух местах выступали местные фольклорные коллективы. В разных помещениях дворца демонстрируются предметы одежды, мебель, посуда. Имеется много портретов султанов и членов их семей. Выставка будет интересна любителям истории Индонезии.
内部のスルタンの家具や調度品も見ものだがなんといってもの南側王宮で午前中に行われる伝統芸能が見ものです。練習生を教えているみたいな場面もありましたが、おもしろかったです。

This was my first time to have 2 hours tour conducted by one of Abdi Dalem which he sooo polite. We are also very antusias in Introducing the historical places like Keraton to children. Welldone and salute!
cocok untuk mencari informasi tentang asal usul Jawa, kerajaan Mataram,silsialh keluarga kerajaan,dan tentunya sejarah & budaya Jawa secara khusus.
Antigo complexo (murado) de palácios. Muito movimentado. Não é impressionante mas faz parte da cultura de Yogyakarta. Pode ter a sorte de ver alguns espetáculos neste complexo.

月曜日の午前中、駅からマリオボロ通りを歩き、まずは北側から入場しました。入場口では外国からの観光客にはガイドが入場料に含まれていると説明され、ガイドと1対1での見学が始まりました。確かに北側はそれ程見所はないのかもしれませんが、ゆっくりとた英語は分かりやすくとても熱心に説明してくれました。
次に、バティークの工房が月曜日だけ公開しているということで案内されました。王宮に勤める人達の住居街の中の方へと進み、現地の人達の生活ぶりを見ながらカーテンで閉ざされている幼稚園の横を通って工房の中に入りました。そこには、生徒さんや先生の作品が沢山並べられていています。料金を尋ねると料金表を持ち出し熱心に購入を勧められました。どうやら外国人だけを、そこの工房に案内している様でした。小さな作品を購入したのですが、出口で待っていたガイドからは「子供たちへの寄付をありがとう」と言われました。現地の物価から考えると少し値が張っていたかもしれません。
住居街を通り抜けた所でガイドと別れ、その直後に今まで一緒だったガイドの友達と名乗る人達が数人現れましたが、すべてお断わりし、自力で南側の門へと歩いて行きました。
南側の方が入場料が少し高く、ガイドは別料金だとの事。ガイド料を尋ねるとあまりにも高額なことを言うのでガイドなしで入場しました。こちらはいろいろな展示品があったり見所は沢山ありました。時々他の人のガイドさんの説明を聞くこともできましたし、1人で回っても十分でした。
2箇所見学し終えた時は、どっと疲れが出ました。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Wat een prachtige en Praal om hier doorheen te lopen. Bijzonder om te zien wie daar gewoont heeft. De dans en gamelanvoorstellingen die er gegeven worden. Je waant je in die tijd als je dat ziet
Sengat cocok untuk menambah wawasan dan mengen lebih dekat budaya kerajaan keraton. Khusus nya mengenai sejarah
Prima om even rond te lopen maar niet enorm bijzonder. Lees je van tevoren al een beetje in of neem een gids want zonder voorbereiding is het allemaal vrij onduidelijk.
Tidak dapat disangkal Keraton merupakan peninggalan budaya yang harus dilestarikan. Saat ini ada beberapa perbaikan, namun seyogyanya Keraton dapat lebih terawat, lebih bersih sehingga lebih menarik.
Intéressant ... mais je l'ai fait sans guide et sans explications et du coup je pense que j'ai loupé un peu l'intérêt de la visite. La succession de cours et de bâtiment rend la visite agréable.

This place suppose to be Jogjakarta main tourist attraction, but I was rather disappointed. Most of the rooms/areas are not accessible, there is hardly any information in English about the exhibitions. The only highlight was a traditional music performance. 

If you have seen colorful palaces in the other SE Asia countries before and you are on a tight schedule,  skip this one together with the water palace. You want miss anything really.
Su visita con guía de habla española permite iniciarse en el conocimiento de las diferentes generaciones del Sultán de Yogjakarta.

Sebagainya wisata budaya lokal, ada kegiatan-kegiatannya di dalam nya yaitu latihan tari khas yogyakarta, dan juga museum-museum barang berharganya. Tiket masuknya 5.000 rupiah dan tambah kamera 1.000 rupiah.
Si volviera a Yogyakarta no perdería ni un minuto en visitarlo, no vale para nada la pena y creo que es mucho mejor visitar otras atracciones mucho mas interesantes de la zona.
If you dont have any expectations you can go, however, I wouldnt stay for a day to see it. It was dirty, and from my point of view no impressive at all.

Me defraudó bastante ­este palacio, y eso q­ue fue la primera vis­ita que hice al llega­r a Yogyakarta. No es­ un templo demasiado ­bonito, sin embargo e­l bajo precio de la e­ntrada hace que, si t­e sobran 10 minutos, ­pues le eches un ojo.
Nosotros tuvimos suer­te porque al entrar e­staban haciendo un te­atro de sombras y pud­imos disfrutar del es­pectáculos, que es ba­stante curioso.
I learnt manything about Jogja here. The people were so welcome and friendly. Very easy to find Keraton Jogja. I like the culture.

Il prezzo irrisorio lo rende sufficiente.. Non vi è molto all'interno, solo una serie di oggetti sparsi qua e là, senza/con poche guide che parlano poco inglese e che non consiglio.. Alcune cose sono molto belle da ammirare ma sarebbe bello saperne qualcosa, ma ovviamente è tutto scritto solo in indonesiano, ma comunque senza nessuna descrizione.. Va bene se vi avanza tempo, un'oretta di giro è più che sufficiente!

Le quartier est très typique avec ses petites rues. Le palais vaut quand même le coup d'être vu car c'est ici que le Sultan Gouverneur reçoit. A noter que le Prince offre un repas pour une somme modique pendant les mois d'été
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This palace, kraton, i have been visiting dor more than 10 times over the years. Every time i am pleasantly surprises bu ita surroundings, magic touch, history, its people and rhe museum set up
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Visite très instructive... Et guidée (guide francophone) 
Plusieurs pièces sont accessibles au regard des visiteurs, les pièces privés réservés au sultan et à sa famille ne se visitent pas.... 
Quelques antiquités encore présentes comme un palanquin et des chaises à porteurs...
Un très bel endroit: incontournable !
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
L'entrata costa poco (9000 rp con l'ok per le foto), ma non c'è molto da guardare!
Forse la parte migliore è proprio vista dall'esterno!
Zondagochtend heb ik het kraton bezocht.  De dansvoorstelling op traditionele muziek droeg er aan bij dat ik het de moeite waard vond. Het paleis is niet echt boeiend verder.
Bardzo zaniedbane. Z uwagi na małą ilość atrakcji warto wspomóc za 7k Rp renowacje tego obiektu. Dużo cienia sprawia że można odpocząć od upału.

The only part of the castle that was really beautiful was closed for public, the rest was rather primitive and not that interesting or beautiful. I would skip it and instead go see the temples and then leave again. Other parts of inodnesia or way more beautiful

The cost of entry was low and it was worth it. The palace is a bit tired and there was not much to help non-Indonesian speaking visitors with understanding the location. We elected not to employ a guide, but really there was not a lot to see. The scale model which gave some idea of what the layout looked like was hard to find and would have been useful to see before entering.

Entry fee was 12 500 IDR plus 1 000 for using a camera. My opinion was that it wasn't worth it. You get to see a few of the buildings and there is a really dusty museum with pretty average crockery on display, and another with batik cloth and some portraits of some of the sultans. It wasn't very interesting, or even particularly pretty.. There was also hardly any english explanations offered, so it's a very boring experience overall.
Come per altri siti anche questo è da vedere se si ha tempo. Se avete poco tempo vi consiglio di focalizzarsi sulla visita di altri siti o semplicemente passeggiare per le vie di Yoga.

El lugar en si no tiene mucho que ofrecer, pero nuestro guía nos contó la historia de los Sultanes y de la revolución contra Holanda y esto fue lo que nos gustó.
Si vas sólo sin nadie que te explique no merece la pena como monumento.

日本人グループで行きました。
最初は日本語ガイドはいらないと思っていましたが
ガイドをつけなければならない？ということで
女性のガイドさんがつきました。
（これは去年の話なので、いまは分かりませんが...)

結果的には、そのガイドさんがいたお陰で
自分たちで見るだけではわからなかった情報を
たくさんもらえたのでよかったです。

王宮の都ジョグジャカルタにきたからには
一度は訪れておきたいところだと思います。

Il pessimo viene dato da me in caso di truffa pericolo scippi, informazioni errate ecc.
Per questo posto il punteggio è scarso. La mia media è va dall'eccellente al molto buono, sono cioè di manica larga. Quindi capirete quanto poco interesse mi ha suscitato questo posto. Probabilmente dovuto al fatto che avevo solo mezz'ora per vederlo e la mia guida era una vecchietta sdentata che a parte parlare male, sputacchiando, in inglese pessimo e muovendosi alla velocità di 10 mt al minuto mi ha solo condotto alla porta d'ingresso e detto 3 cose in croce che non ho capito e che nemmeno ricordo. Il posto è vasto e dispersivo, una parte è la dimora del sultano se non erro mentre l'altra è il museo. E' un museo privato del re, ci sono le sue foto da bambino all'adolescenza ai giorni nostri. Ci sono i suoi quadri e mobili preferiti la sua scrivania, tutte cose poco interessanti. Degno di ricordo solo la sala (sembra uno sgabuzzino) in cui si trovano tutti i quadri dei Re di Yogyakarta con la data di inizio reggenza e di morte che coincide con quella della reggenza del successivo. Interessante perchè si nota nei vestiti, acconciature ecc il passare del tempo e delle mode. C'è poi una sala dove si vede la lungimiranza del sultano che è una sorta di sovrano illuminato della indipendente Yogyakarta che ha viaggiato in europa, in questa stanza ci sono i tre simboli delle tre religioni, islam, buddismo e induismo,  che il sultano (per non far torto a nessuno) appoggia in pari modo.
Il resto sono spazi aperti dispersi e poco curati, stanze con oggetti vari (i classici vasi vasini vasetti) di poco interesse.
現在も王様が住んでいる場所。敷地内では日替わりで舞踏やガムラン、影絵なども披露され、地元の伝統文化に触れられます。建物自体も素晴らしいのですが、歴代王様の肖像画や写真、縁の品、世界各国からの贈答品を展示したコーナーが良かったです。日本とインドネシアの繋がりを感じさせる展示物もいくつかあり。

This the part of old Yogya kingdom. The Kingdom is still alive but the this particular is the old one. It was mainly use by the old family. Just visit to get a better idea of how Yogya was back in the old days.
Nichts besonderes, da man vieles nicht sehen konnte oder dafür extra einen Guide brauchte. Muss man nicht unbedingt gesehen haben.

I don't know whether I've visited a completely different thing from the enthusiastic reviewers here or maybe I just missed a whole section of palace (definitely possible). But I was not impressed. The palace was only a collection of buildings with old photos. The main attraction here seemed to be us, as we couldn't move a muscle without being asked to take a picture. Funny but not our purpose. 
So I guess I would mostly recommend looking into which part of the palace you're going to visit before you make my mistake ;)

Si vas a Yogyakarta y te sobra el tiempo.....vale date un paseo, pero si no preocupate de ver Borombudur o Prambanan antes de perder el tiempo con la ciudad. Es el palacio del sultan y no tiene absolutamente nada, un recinto de columnas de hierro antiguas limpio y poco más.

Belum ke Jogja kalau belum ke istana raja Jogja. Wajib dikunjungi oleh para pelancong yang mengunjungi Jogja sebagai wisata budaya. Di dalam Keraton tersaji benda-benda dan  atraksi kesenian yang bernilai sangat tinggi. Para pemandu wisata yang siap untuk menceritakan seluruh sejarah keraton sejak dibuat hingga kini. Disarankan untuk aktif berinteraksi dengan pemandu sehingga kunjungan Anda tidak membosankan.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Nous avons pris un guide pour cette visite. Au début, il a rendu la visite intéressante en nous fournissant plein d'explications. Nous serions passé à coté de la visite sans avoir eu recours à ses services. Mais au bout d'une demi-heure, après la 100ème photo, le 50ème costume, et la 20ème même explication, nous avions juste envie que ça se termine. Le Palais n'est pas majestueux mais cette visite nous a tout de même permis d'en connaître plus sur l'histoire de la famille Royale et de Yogyakarta. Bref, ce n'est pas une visite indispensable.

Arrived at 08.25 and they said it will open in 5 mins but i have to wait almost 30 mins.
I asked about operation hour and it should be 08.30 but the staff is not come yet.
So better arrive at 09.00 - 09.30.
You will need a guide to explain the whole thing, no fixed price. My guide said he can speak 4 languages: English, Japanese, (not remember 2 languages)
It serves like museum of Yogya's monarch. Not much to see when you don't use local guide, except for creepy looking dolls and statue-like-rooster, which seems elegant.
入場料は１人７０００ルピア（約５６円）でした。建物や人形がありますが、それほど特筆すべきものでもありません。

Kraton is a great place. But be careful where to enter. There are two entrances because of a schism in the ruling family. Take the entrance with the big clock!!!! The other entrance is of little interest. 

In the Kraton, take a guide. They work for tips, no fixed guide price. The guide helps to understand what's presented, as there are no English subtitles. 
Be sure to see the batik collection and learn what real batik is and how it is produced. It saves you a lot of money, because you can then skip all the fake batik in Marlioboro jl. 
Be sure to arrive during presentation time (11.00-12.00), so you can see Javanese culture, like dance and music. 
The museum closes at 13.30.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Un passage obligatoire soins disant...très déçus par cette visite, rien de très intéressant pour moi, un site mal entretenu et sale, à voir si vous n'avez pas le choix sinon passé votre chemin.

I don't usually comment about the attractions because I think that each city shown as much as they have, but in this case I can't avoid writing and hope that in the future this changes
