The palace is only a little garden with four or five rooms around it with a few photos and old objects; the visit takes you around 20-30 minutes (no more), because the exhibition is very small, rooms or areas are closed or you are not allowed to entry   and finally (and this the most uncredible and ridiculous), the explanation of all the pieces exposed is in perfect Indonesian, therefore, is impossible for a foreing to understand what the photo is representing or why the piece is important, beyond that the object is old.

This is the sultan's palace! and it has hundreds of visitors each year, at least all the explanations must be both in Indonesian and English. 
It might be usefull to take a guide which could give some explanation, otherwise you'll understand not much.

The sultan of Yogyakarta still lives here are receives foreign dignitaries. You can do a tour with a guide, which is free. However, they will appreciate a voluntary donation. 
The palace is impressive and has a great art collection. The guide will provide you with funny stories and anekdotes.
Menyusuri setiap sisi keraton dengan disambut para abdi dalem. Disini kita belajar kesederhanaan dan kerendahan diri.

Kraton Jogyakarta is a wonderful place to visit and give you time to relax and learn how a king live. Located just in the city centre, make this palace easy to find. prepare your camera and also a sun cream .
The sultans palace has beautiful courtyards and friendly staff. The displays aren't great. Definitely fun to see but no need to plan to spend much time here.

I really went here to experience the live Gamelan and I wasn't disappointed. I went on a day that they were doing a puppet show, and it was such a great experience. The rest of the palace is quite quiet, with some exhibition rooms, but many areas that you are not allowed to walk on. Heading out the back, you enter the local community where I was able to see some of the shadow puppets being made by hand, as well as some Batik. A definite place to visit when you're in Yogyakarta.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
The former palce of the sultan will only be interesting if you visit in the morning and with a guide able to explain what this place and this part of Javanese history is important. Also don't miss the dance show (one awesome dancer) at 11 am.
If you have a limited time in Yogyakarta, this place can be passed though.

We visited this Kraton on a Sunday, mainly to see the traditional dancing taking place. 
The Kraton is very old but in my opinion not very well maintained. Definitely not a highlight of the trip but a good time filler if you have a couple of hours to kill.
takes no more than 15 min to watch around the castle. nothing special..couldn't feel it was a castle..

This palace is still in use due to the efforts of the royal family to secure independence for Indonesia allowing them to keep their royal position when the country became a republic.  The guides speak good English.  The palace is spread out over extensive grounds since the buildings are one story pavilions due to the tropical weather.  There is a small museum which houses the heirlooms of the royal family as well as paintings and memorabilia.  If you are lucky you will be able to watch a rehearsal of the gamelon orchestra and dancers practicing on the compound.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Sultan Palace also known as Kraton Yogyakarta is an old place where Sultan in yogyakarta resides. This is also a place where they held activities such as wedding and prayer. Not so nice place, sturcture is old however, i like the display of artifacts inside this palace.

Passate pure oltre..non c'è nulla da vedere..e yogyakarta offre ben altro..
È tutto scritto in indonesiano quindi semza guida non si capisce una mazza..
It's not so an special place, go only if you don't have something better to do, the ticket it's very cheap.
I agreed with other travellers, the palace is indeed disappointing. There is no much to see there... but I really liked the surrounding area.

Wir sind abends mehr durch Zufall hier her gestolpert und haben uns recht amüsiert eine Zeit lang dem bunten treiben hingegeben. Treffpunkt für verliebte einheimische und Familien. Absolutes must do eine Runde mit den tretautos die wild leuchten und blinken.

Saltatelo pure o al massimo dedicateci 1 ora per vedere il ballo delle danzatrici javanesi che si esibiscono in tarda mattinata. Per il resto niente di bello. Non permettete alle guide di obbligarvi (come è successo a noi) a rimanerci tutta la mattinata.

The tickets were cheap (7000 each), but I find it hard to believe that they can charge anything at all, since there really isn't much to do or see in the Kraton. 

There are a couple of open air "buildings" with nothing really in them, as well as a few houses with photos of the sultan and his family on display. None of the signs are in English so they don't make much sense.

We had read that there were supposed to be free guides around, but we didn't see them. Instead the grounds were teeming with annoying tuk-tuk drivers. 

By all means, if you have time to kill in Yogya, go ahead and spend half an hour here. If not, stick to the volcanoes and temples : )

A bit disappointing as a lot of it was closed for repairs, still pleased I saw what was on offer, out guide was a wizened up old man of 88 years of age, knew a lot of the history of the building and its past occupiers.

Het oude paleis van de locale sultan. Leuk om gezien te hebben. Ze hebben allee bewaard van ijsscheppen, tot oorkondes. Van historische foto's tot batikapparatuur. Ik zou zeker een gids nemen, dan is het waarschijnlijk een stuk begrijpelijker en leuker

Passage obligé à Yogyakarta mais bon rien de très très folichon...
Des portraits de sultans, des vitrines hors d'âge avec des objets pas très intéressants...
À faire si vraiment il ne vous reste que ça à faire!

Honestamente me esperaba más. Lo bueno es que no se emplea mucho tiempo en completar la visita, por ello no está de más acercarse y verlo, pero sin tener grandes pretensiones. 

Precio: 13000 rp
Se trata del palacio del sultán pero no tiene mucho que ofrecer. Se visita en 15 minutos ya que solo hay edificios anexos.
Jogya is an interesting city and the Kraton its main attraction. They could work on the landscape to make it look nicer. It is a bit rundown. The guides are good. Quite knowledgeable.

Je voyais le lieu comme incontournable même si j avais bien compris que ce n étais pas Versailles mais passer votre chemin.

Frais supplémentaires pour les photos (j en ai fait 2...).
Un guide vous tope des le départ.  Pourquoi pas. Toujours intéressant. ..
Euh bah non. Pas de son fait mais 2 vitrines de costumes, un trône en rénovation. .. bref clairement faites une photo de l extérieur ça suffira bien...

You can feel the magic of the city and how the Jogja royals live in this palace. Location is in the city center, cheap tickets and good and english speaking guides are available. Must visit if you are in Jogja.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Große Anlage, ohne Guide nicht zu empfehlen, da es an den spärlich ausgestellten Exponaten zur Geschichte der Herrscherfamilie keinerlei Beschilderung gibt.

Zudem empfinde ich die in winzigen Käfigen, die in der Sonne hängen und in denen jeweils ein Hahn sitzt als überholte Tradition vergangener Zeit.
Kami datang menjelang siang hari. Tak banyak yang bisa dilihat. Hanya halaman depan istana, pendopo, museum berisi foto, Dan sedikit akses menuju gerbang yang digembok.

Se siete a Yogyakarta e avete una mezza giornata di tempo libera vale la pena visitare il palazzo reale del sultano. L'edificio non è nulla di che: grandi spazi e molto ben curato ... ma nulla di particolare.
Molto bello assistere alle rappresentazioni che si svolgono all'interno: concerti con strumenti tradizionali e danze.
le palais du sultan n'a rien de particulier, si ce n'est le guide d'une grande culture et parlant un français académique

Nè ricco nè maestoso come altri complessi asiatici, ma sicuramente uno dei palazzi più belli di Giava e il più significativo di Yogyakarta. Un bel tuffo in mezzo al turismo, ai suoni del gamelan e alla raffinata corte del sultano
Interesting enough if you've nothing better to do. Personally l found it a little drab and featureless.
Very cheap entrance. Palace itself is okay  to walk around and see. But sadly very little is done showcase the place and tell, what i assume, would be it's interesting history.

El Palacio del sultán está al final de la famosa calle comercial de Malioboro, en la explanada justo enfrene del Kraton puedes ver a primera hora de la mañana a los estudiantes haciendo sus ejercicios obligados de educación física antes de entrar a clase. La visita dura alrededor de 45 minutos, tienes varias exposiciones de vestidos tradicionales, carrozas y regalos recibidos por el sultán. Algunos días hay actuaciones musicales y de danza que son interesantes. Si vas muy justo de tiempo es una visita prescindible.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Il kraton è il palazzo reale del sultani, un tempo era la residenza, ma ora è principalmente un museo con gli oggetti del passato. Abbiamo preso anche la guida, in inglese, che spiegava le cose che si vedevano, le divise, il compito delle persone un tempo, o i rituali. Alcune cose sono interessanti altre meno.

Allora non prendere la guida, i biglietti costano 12.000rp a testa appena entrati soffermatevi nell'atrio dove fanno danze e musiche tipiche Indonesiane, il resto del palazzo non ha nulla di che sono solo stanze con reperti "storici" del sultano quasi Messina descrizione è inglese. Le guide è meglio evitare perché con l'inglese hanno problemi.

Abbiamo pagato per entrare nel cortile antistante il kraton, convinti che fosse l'ngresso principale, mentre invece gli ingressi sono due (e si pagano due biglietti distinti).

I prezzi di entrambi si aggirano sulle 10000-20000 rupie, quindi circa un euro, ma c'è una piccola maggiorazione se volete l'autorizzazione a fare foto all'interno (in realtà non c'è nulla da fotografare).

Siamo rimasti delusi perché da vedere c'è poco: nel primo ambiente lo spiazzo che si intravede da fuori più qualche edificio con dentro delle vecchie foto (niente di imperdibile) e un portico con tanti vestiti tipici indossati da dei manichini, mentre il secondo biglietto ci ha permesso di entrare nel vero e proprio kraton, dove a parte tantissimi tessuti realizzati con tecnica batik e anziani guardiani ligi al loro lavoro non c'è molto da vedere.

Alla mattina in questo spiazzo si può assistere ad un concerto di strumenti tipici, noi lo abbiamo perso per pochissimo mentre stavamo nel primo spiazzo, e c'è davvero dispiaciuto!

La visita può anche essere seguita da una guida in loco che vi accompagnerà raccontandovi delle abitudini dei vecchi abitanti e sicuramente permette di comprendere meglio cosa si sta guardando.

Il tutto termina un po' nel nulla, abbiamo proseguito il percorso finendo in una strada dove si possono trovare i laboratori di batik (vi spiegheranno senza obbligo di acquisto la tecnica) e di marionette. anche qua vale la pena ascoltare tutta la filosofia che ci sta dietro! Infine in alcuni negozi vendono il famoso "caffé di luwak", il più costoso al mondo!! non vi sto a spiegare perché..

Infine visita al Taman Sari. Non aspettatevi molto... è un cortile con una vasca/fontana. Tutto qui.

Morale: passateci se avete tempo, ma non soffermatevi qui. C'è di meglio da fare e vedere.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Leuk om een beetje in de sfeer te komen van de stad als je pas in Jogjakarta begint. Verwacht geen historisch museum met pracht en praal.
Wel woont de sultan er en kan het zijn dat hij eens naar buiten komt

Kraton yogyakarta atau istana raja yogyakarta ini sebenarnya tidak banyak yang bisa dilihat, hanya terdapat beberapa museum tentang kesultanan dari pertama sampai sekarang, di sisi lain juga terdapat sebuah pameran museum pakaian adat jawa kerajaan. Jadi tidak perlu berlama lama disini

Moderadamente interesante. Si no se dispone de tiempo, se puede prescindir de la visita. Lo más interesante pueden ser las actuaciones de gamelán y danza, aunque hay que informarse bien de los días y horas.

Aunque no es comparable a la belleza de templos de la ciudad es muy recomendable verlo. Cuando fuimos había unas mujeres cantando y tomando instrumentos lo que hacía que la visita mereciera la pena. Muy bonito el kiosco de música. Ves también batik original y cosas relacionadas con la vida del sultán
La visita a este palacio no me parece que ofrezca un interés especial. No merece la pena el gasto, salvo que se trate de la primera visita a un palacio de un sultán.

bagi anda yang butuh info perihal kerajaan, akan lebih terpenuhi keingin tahuan anda jika anda pergi ke ulen sentalu. keraton tidak banyak menyajikan foto atau ulasan perihal histori tentang dirinya. Tiket masuk cm Rp 7000. Tempat terkesan berdebu, sayang sekali

As a local, I felt  a bit disappointed to see that nothing is written in English when I took my friends from Europe there. I mean, there a lot of people speaking English in Yogyakarta, can't they do something about this? I'd be glad to complementary help this place to improve hehe :) It's just sad because no one will understand what are the stuffs displayed there unless you have a guide with you! And like many other places in Indonesia, it has different prices for local tourists and foreign tourists. When one of my friend asked if she could get a discount for students, one of the ticket officer laughed and mumbled "It's already very cheap!" would be nice for the students to get same price as the locals though.
Si può tranquillamente evitare la visita. Non c'è nessun particolare di rilievo o interesse. Nel palazzo un percorso con qualche foto e oggetti dei sultani tipo stivali, posate etc.

If you want to see "a little" about Yogyakarta sultanage, you could visit Kraton Yogya. But since the Kraton is still used by the Sultan until now, there are some area that forbidden for tourist to enter, so I suggest you to hire a local guide near the entrance of the Kraton, because you will get nothing if you just look around by yourself.

Monument sans grand intérêt. Pas d'explications, peu de choses à voir: quelques tableaux ou tenues, .... Il parait que c'est plus beau lorsque se joue les spectacles sous le hall, c'est à dire le matin.
Non merita il viaggio ma semplicemente una visita, interessante ma solo se ti trovi nei paraggi, non lo consiglierei come destinazione ma solo come tappa.

banyak tulisan yang boleh dibaca dan ruangnya juga luas untuk dilawati. bagus sekali. penjaga poenjaga kraton masih lengkap berbusana tradisi lengkap blankon dan sarong. juga tidak lokek untuk bergambar.

Partiamo dal fatto che quando ti fanno pagare un surplus per fare le foto, già mi girano. Gradevole la visita, dove potete trovare anche dei santoni, disponibili a farsi fotografare, ma non sono rimasto particolarmente colpito, anche se devo dire che è la cosa più bella vista a Yogya
Big grounds with a few interesting exhibits. Unfortunately there are areas you can access because the Sultan is still staying there.

En passant, quelques jours sur Yogyakarta, vous irez voir les temples Borobodur & Prambanan, le volcan Merapi (je vous le souhaite) et Yogyakarta. Le palais du Kraton, basique, rien d'extraordinaire, les magasins de Batik partout, Malioboro le soir,  des magasins, un mall, des chevaux, des jeunes qui profitent de leur centre ville, ça c'est cool. Le Kraton, si vous avez pas le temps, pas de soucis.
南北それぞれ入場料とカメラ持ち込み料を支払います。北から見学したのですが、こちらはあまり見どころもありませんでした。南は王宮らしい見どころも多いのでおすすめです。北はさっと流して南でゆっくり見学するのがお勧めです。また、午前中に南で伝統芸能が見れるようです。
Not only being the home of the "king" it gives a view on the culture and history of Java the ancient, old as well as te younger generations of royal family.

Se fate un giro della città non potete prescindere da una visita al Kraton...il prezzo è contenuto (20.000 rupie se non sbaglio) e non vi ruberà parecchio tempo. Resta comunque uno dei simboli e dei luoghi di maggiore interesse della città e se avete spazio nel vostro programma direi che vale la pena di inserirlo. Detto questo...non è di certo una delle cose più belle che abbia visto a Jogja! Nota: quando uscirete vi diranno che nel prezzo è inclusa la visita la museo dei batik...il mo consiglio è di cercare una delle tante scuole e accademie di batik (basterà chiedere in giro o stare fermi ed aspettare che qualcuno venga a proporvele :-))...ovviamente sono dei negozi/gallerie più che delle accademie e lo scopo è quello di vendervi qualche pezzo...i prezzi sono contenuti e restano comunque tra i migliori souvenir da portare a casa!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
We enjoyed our visit to Kraton...but what was disappointing was that you have to visit the outer Sultan's palace separately and the inner compound seperately, and take 2 different guides, plus pay entrance charges seperately. 
As the Sultan stays in the palace, it is well kept, and the architecture is interesting.

There's not many attractions in the centre of yogya and the water palace is probably the best.

The palace lacks any charm or any interesting sights inside. You can get a rickshaw to the water palace.

Tip: go early as it gets really hot.

Overpriced entrance ticket. Be aware of the trap of free guide. Guide is included in ticket but will invariably demand money. Can be pushy. Provide little by way of useful information. Go if you have time to kill and no better investment for money!

Wat als 'paleis' te boek staat, geeft die indruk niet echt. Het is klein en biedt weinig vertier. Er is een (stomme (=geen gesproken woord)) film en enkele kledingstukken. Maar ach, de entree is slechts Rp 10.000, dus met je bezoek help je een beetje met het instandhouden van cultuurgoed.

Il primo giorno a yogyakarta abbiamo bighellonato per la città e cercato cosa fosse particolare. Tra le prime cose indicate c era il palazzo del sultano, così ci siamo andati.. Da fuori secondo noi la visita è più che sufficiente, non per il costo del biglietto che credo fosse 20000 rupie o meno ma perché davvero c è molto poco da vedere. Attenzione alle guide che si proporranno di descrivervi ciò che vedete.. Sono gentili ma poi finiranno per portarvi a vedere qualche esposizione di batik.. Anche di qualità, ma magari non proprio nei vostri piani. Ecco per quelli cercate le scuole e università delle arti che offriranno sicuramente prodotti di migliore qualità. Invece se siete in zona visitate il water castle e il suo quartiere, quello credo possa meritate qualche ora e qualche buona fotografia

When we come, it show us how friendly people around there and the song was so wonderful. Besides that, the palace was full of so much historical things, the story of the king (Hamengkubuwono IX) and some princess. It recommended place to go actually.

Parmi les curiosités de la ville, le palais du sultan tient une place particulière dans l'agenda des routards. C'est effectivement une entrée en matière déterminante dans la compréhension des enjeux politique, culturels et religieux propres à l'île de Java d'hier et d'aujourd'hui. Afin d'en saisir la portée nous vous conseillons vivement de faire appel à un guide : la nôtre parlait un anglais très limité mais suffisant, mis à disposition gratuitement mais rémunéré par vos tips. Cela vous aidera à faire un effort de projection pour dépasser la simple balade au travers des collections d'objets poussiéreuses et comprendre ce que cela représente pour les javanais. Le bâtiment n'a rien de sensationnel mais cela reste un ensemble architectural typique de l'île. Visite intéressante mais pas cruciale non plus !
der Kraton fühlt sich an wie eine Reise in die Vergangenheit. schon beim Blick auf die Palastwächter scheint die Zeit stehenzubleiben. Ein Muss für Yogya-Besucher.

belum dianggap datang ke jogja kalo belum pernah mampir ke kraton jogja...kerajaan nusantara yg diakui eksistensinya dalam kerangka NKRI. disini anda bisa belajar tatakrama, sopan santun khas jawa, pengabdian tulus abdi dalem kepada sang raja, mendengarkan lantunan gending gamelan jawa atau bahkan sendratari. sejarah kraton, silsilah kerajaan, kereta kerajaan, senjata dan naskah kuno bisa dilihat disini.

Onze eerste activiteit bij aankomst in Indonesië, maar niet de meest memorabele. De gamelan-concerten waren zeer aangenaam om bij te wonen, maar het verdere bezoek was niet meer dan een formaliteit. Wij namen geen gids en dat zorgde niet bepaald voor veel extra context (beschrijving op bordjes enkel in Indonesisch). Leuke sfeer, maar gebouwen voelden niet historisch antiek, eerder oubollig aan. Geen absolute must, maar nu ook weer niet je reinste tijdsverspilling. Als je naar het toilet moet gaan, ga je best elders.

Kraton in Yogya is an interesting place to visit for about an hour as there are not many areas visitors allowed to enter. I didn't find it amusing but the people wearing traditional clothes should be allowed to interact with tourists as I thought their presence made the Kraton more significant. I believe going to museum would be a better option if not for the rave of visiting Kraton.

Zeker de kraton palace danses op zondag ochtend van ongeveer 10-12 uur. Javaanse dansen origineel en professioneel.  Kost inclusief entree een paar luttele centen. De performance is echt de moeite waard het complex zelf is enigszins verwaarloosd maar dat mag de pret niet drukken.

Les guides prevenaient que certains pouvaient être déçus du palais du fait du manque de faste... j'étais quand même très loin de m'imaginer un lieu aussi déprimant voire sordide par endroits !
Aucun entretien, tout est vétuste et la propreté laisse vraiment à désirer.  En plus, presque rien n'est en anglais.
Par ailleurs nous avons été alpagues par des faux guides pour voir des ateliers de marionnettes...

No visit to Yogyakarta is complete without a visit to the Kraton (Sultan's Palace). If you don't want a guide, look up its history and significance on Wikipedia beforehand. There are regular performances of traditional music (gamelan), dances, puppets (wayang golek), and shadow puppets (wayang kulit).
Siamo stati fortunati e abbiamo trovato una ragazza indonesiana che ci ha accompagnato e letto la spiegazione delle esposizioni (solo in indonesiano). Nel complesso ci è piaciuto!

We went on a Monday- puppet making day. This was the highlight as the chap who owns and paints the puppets spoke to us at length about his craft, their production and symbolism, thanks mr widodo! And all at no extra charge or insinuation that you had to buy anything.
入り口で日本語ガイドさんを頼みました。ガイドさんが話してくれなければ、さっと通り過ぎる展示品などを説明してくれました。土曜日の午前中には、本格的な影絵を上演していました。ただ言葉がわからないし、なんの解説もないので、長くは見ませんでした。夜にやっているのと同じということで、夜の上演に、わざわざ行かなくてすんだのは、良かったです

Visited the sultans palace with a couple of others, if you want to know anything about it then get a guide because nothing is written in English understandably. Would rave about going but if you need to kill some time or have a particular interest in the history of Yogyakarta then go for it.

We were disappointed with the general upkeep and displays at the Kraton... Not only were they mostly in dusty cabinets, the descriptions (for displays which actually had them) were in Bahasa Indonesia which kept us guessing. Also, there's a ridiculous 'camera fee' which while it wasn't expensive we honest three paid up anyway, but there isn't anyone who actually checks. Nonetheless having paid the entry and camera fees we tried to appreciate the exhibits as best as we could.

Actually can not enter the palace because already late at nite when i come. There's a yard in front of the palace. An old beringin tree also available. Many of seller were display their food to be sold. From black hoy coffee, javanese noodles and a lot of snack available.
移動日に見学したのであまり時間が取れず残念でした。前日午後四時頃訪れましたが閉館、改めて次の日の午前中に拝見しました。日本語ガイドを雇ってゆっくり観賞したかったのですが？宮殿は豪華さや歴史を感じることはあまりありませんが瀟洒な感じで親近感を覚えます。もう一度ゆっくり訪れたいと思います！
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Wir fanden die Palastanlage wenig spektakulär, sie ist nicht so prunkvoll, wie wir gedacht haben. Es sind auch reichlich Artefakte von den ehemaligen Sultanen. Ein Guide ist hier empfehlenswert, da kaum Erklärung zu einzelnen Stücken zu finden sind.
We hadden een leuke vrouwelijke gids die deze familie persoonlijk goed kent. Ze sprak duidelijk Engels en kregen een leuke rondleiding. Mooi paleis, maar niet zo heel erg groot.

Je krijgt een gids bij het binnengaan maar de onze was niet verstaanbaar dus opteerden we om het te bezoeken zonder. Veel viel er niet te zien, behoudens de steigers voor renovatiewerken. Dit was een bezoekje van een 20-tal minuten. Het waterpaleis achter het Kraton hebben we op aanraden van landgenoten die er buiten kwamen, niet meer bezocht.

If you've visited palaces like the Forbidden City then you may be disappointed but, considering the much longer cultural aspects China has, we can be a bit more forgiving.
Yes better organisation and explanations in English will be helpful but, they do have guides, at affordably price.
Some buildings are run down but the grounds are generally beautifully laid out and serene. The displays are not extensive, but they do offer a sense of how their royal once lived.
Not recommended for the very well travelled but, if you're interested in history and culture and come with no expectation, you won't be disappointed.

On s'attendait à un palace qui valait le détour, en fait cela ressemble plus à un vieux musée où chaque pièce est un empilement de vieux objets sans intérêts à la gloire du sultan. Nous confirmons qu'il n'y a pas vraiment de traduction eng

Concernant le palais, il y a quelque belle pièce à l'air libre mais rien d'extraordinaire. Le problème est surtout que l'on ne peut voir les belles pièces que de loin.

À faire si vous avez du temps de libre.

La visite du palais permet une bulle d'air dans la ville de Yoga. Le palais en soi n'a rien d'extraordinaire et manque cruellement d'une remise en forme et de commentaires en anglais. Le kraton de Solo et sa visite sont nettement plus intéressantes mais comme il n'y a que peu de choses à faire dans le centre de Yogya, autant en profiter pour visiter le kraton et le Taman Sari !

Le palais du Sultan de Yogyakarta est un havre de paix et de fraicheur. Nous avons eu la chance d'assister à des répétitions de Gamelon et de danse en fin de visite. Important et rare en Indonésie : ils ont des guides francophones et le notre était très bien.

Visite intéressante pour en connaître un peu plus sur la région, ses traditions et surtout le sultan.
Endroit calme et reposant.
Jolie architecture.

Entrance fee 12500idr. First of al a complaint: if foreigners have to pay more than locals, why don't they do the effort of making signs in English....? Again a trap for tourists to force them to take a guide. You also have to pay 1000idr for taking pictures. We don't like guided tours so we read about about the building on the internet.
the place is not so big, but has many tiny museums inside. You can have a look around, but nothing is explained in English. The building is quite nice and here and there you can find some objects as a chariot, an old bell,.... At 10am there is a music preformance.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Nulla di che, se proprio ci si trova in città (dato che non offre molto) una visitina la si può anche fare, magari alle 10:30 del mattino per assistere all'esibizione dei monaci che suonano le campane
Le palais n'est pas somptueux mais il a un certain charme. Les shorts sont autorisés contrairement à ce qu'indiquent certains guides de voyage.

Si vous êtes sur place, faites un passage au Kraton. Mais n'organisez pas vos vacances autour de sa visite, ce n'est pas nécessaire. L'endroit est joli mais rien n'est traduit, même pas en Anglais donc c'est peu compréhensible. 
Attention à entrer par la bonne porte (celle avant la grande horloge), car nombreuses sont les arnaques (on vous dira que le palais est fermé  aujourd'hui pour vous amener voir des fabrications de bakits )

Mooi paleis, met een goed overzicht van het leven van de sultan in het verleden en heden. Onze koning Boudewijn is er ook geweest. Wij hadden een gids die aandoenlijk Nederlands sprak en zijn betoog met een vrolijke noot presenteerde.
There is nothing much to see at the palace museum. The artifacts are not impressive and many areas are not accessible to visitors. Will not recommend this to others visiting Yogyakarta
Istana resmi kesultanan Yogyakarta ini merupakan kediaman Sultan Yogyakarta. Arsitekturnya sangat khas Jawa dan menarik serta sering ada pertunjukan seni dan budaya di pendopo, sangat menarik.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: You pay a ticket (not expensive) for every palace but everything is so not cared of and disappointing.  maybe the most interesting things are the old servers of the sultan dressed in original and classical dresses. Everyday there is a different show from 10 am to 12 am but they're not all so interesting. It's not an experience I will remeber in my life except for the boring, sorry of this.
Si no hay nada que hacer y tienen tiempo en yogyakarta,  pues se puede visitar el palacio del Sultán, a nivel cultural es interesante (por decir algo) pero nada más.

Cet ensemble de bâtiments, nullement impressionnants par leur taille ou leur majesté, est surtout passionnant à visiter pour ses informations concernant la vie javanaise, de la cour du sultan avec ses rituels au petit peuple des fonctionnaires. Les guides locaux francophones sont parfaits et passionnants.

Kraton Yogyakarta, ofwel het paleis van de Sultan, is mooi om doorheen te lopen. Maak gebruik van een gids, wat beschrijvingen zijn niet in het Engels. De gids kan daarnaast nog veel meer vertellen en hij/zij weet de bijzondere plekjes te vinden. Een deel van het complex wordt nog bewoond door de huidige sultan.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
This was one of the places I was really looking forward to visiting in Yogyakarta, however I was left disappointed as there wasn't much to see or do. 

Lots of artefacts/museum type rooms but all of the signs were in Indonesian with no English translations as you usually get at tourist attractions.

You could hire a guide to take you round which I'd recommend otherwise it's a waste of time going in. 

Also it's full of people trying to lead you to their shops/restaurants etc. Not a good experience.
We hadden een goede en leuke gids die ons het een en ander over de Sultans verteld heeft. Wij vonden het zeker de moeite om te bezoeken.

Tempatnya nyaman, sarat dengan budaya Jawa,
Dihari2 tertentu ada penampilan2 dari kebudayaan Jawa, gamelan atau tarian..

Visite intéressante à faire avec un bon guide mais malheureusement guide imposé à l'entrée qui bâcle la visite dans un anglais peu compréhensible et qui réclame un gros pourboire à la fin (alors que cela devait être inclus dans le tarif d'entrée) 
Intérieur pas incontournable ....

Alle vitrines en gebouwen zijn voorzien van Indonesische tekst en uitleg. Nergens is ook maar enige uitleg in het Engels waardoor het onbegrijpelijk is wat waar gebeurde of voor diende. Dat is echt jammer want dat zou deze attractie echt interssant maken. Nu was het vrijwel oninteressant door gebrek aan uitleg.
à visiter si on reste qqs jours à Yogyakarta:  l'ambiance est agréable et calme. Des musiciens le matin.

De rondleiding met gids gaf ons zoveel informatie over de huidige sultan en zijn voorouders. Een heel vooraanstaande familie met veel geschiedenis zowel tijdens de kolonisatie als tijdens de onafhankelijkheid.

I always love this palace since I am a kid....eventhough it is not a grandoise palace nor a castle with soaring towers.., it has all the horse carriage displays, majestic royal paintings and keris (indonesian traditional daggers) on display. I brought my 2 daughters here and  I can see that they enjoy the same. Apart of the nostalgic feeling, I can't help but filled with pride that the Javanese customs is filled with so many stories and philosophy behind it.  Like the water palace, it would be best to have a guide to walk with you and explain the history and the story behind the exhibits but on this visit we walked around by ourselelves and do just fine.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Groot complex, entree niet duur (12.500 rp) en vooral de heren moeten deze keer op hun kleding letten. Blote schouders mag voor hen niet, voor de dames vreemd genoeg wel. Als je geluk hebt speelt het gamelanorkest wat de boel wat verlevendigt. Ook kun je vanuit het Kraton naar een wajangpoppenmaker, de leren poppen die gebruikt worden voor de schaduw voorstellingen. Het interieur valt wat tegen.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: There is not a lot to see and this attraction is good for a short visit if your in the area.  Try to make it on a Sunday as there is a cultural show which is interesting.  A few displays and some interesting historical photos in a few smaller rooms aside from the main coronation hall.  The English speaking guide is only a few dollars and will greatly add to the visit.

Het kraton mag je eigenlijk niet overslaan, maar we vonden het nogal teleurstellend. We hadden een gids van 84 jaar die erg vriendelijk, maar onverstaanbaar was. Bovendien was de uitleg zeer beperkt en probeerde hij ons vooral naar een van de vele batik fabriekjes te begeleiden. 
Voor de toegangsprijs hoef je het niet te laten, maar laat de gids maar zitten want er is niet veel te zien.

Entrata a prezzi stracciati (1euro più qualcosa se hai la reflex, ma non c'è nulla da fotografare). Dalle 10 alle 12 in alcuni giorni possibilità di assistere ad un concerto tipico. Per il resto ben poco da ammirare sotto il sole cocente

It is a place for royal family. The place is not big, more like a local rich people's house. The wall is not tall and normal local people live outside, which is the interesting part. Generally the place has nothing much to offer and boring to me.

De kraton van Yogya werd gebouwd na de vrede van Giyanti (1755), nadat het Mataram-rijk definitief in verschillende sultanaten uiteen was gevallen. Tot op de huidige dag is het de woonplaats van de sultan, die ook nog steeds politieke macht heeft als gouverneur van Yogya en omstreken. De verzamelingen binnen tonen de verschillende eigendommen en families van de sultans van Yogya. Ook is het hof nog steeds een centrum van ritueel en ceremonie rond de sultan, en worden er gebeden gelezen, traditionele dansen uitgevoerd etc.

No information whatsoever available go tourists. You need to pay for a guide so they can explain the history and culture behind the palace. Full of vendors trying to sell you sunglasses, drinks and pretty much everything else. 

I'm sorry to say that it is a pointless visit unless you speak Indonesian or hire a tour guide which again will be ten times what the locals will pay!

Nur mit einer Führung von Locals empfehlenswert.
Nachdem wir etwas verwirrt waren, was jetzt so sehenswert ist, hat uns (Gott sei dank) ein Local angesprochen und uns dann durch den Bezirk geführt.
Nur so konnten wir das Batikhandwerk und die "Puppenmacherei" kennenlernen.
Er führte uns durch viele schmale Gassen und glänzte mit Wissen.
Natürlich zeigte er uns auch den Watertempel und das Prinzenhaus...
Ohne ihn, hätten wir diese Ecken vermutlich nicht gefunden.
Also einfach drauf einlassen, wenn ein Local einem etwas zeigen möchte ;)
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Dit stond niet bij ons op de planning, maar we kwamen er toevallig langs.
Niet bijzonder, het gebouw zelf is wel goed onderhouden maar alle spulletjes die je kunt bekijken zien er stoffig uit. Vind het geen aanrader
Fuimos recomendados por la lonely planet, nada del otro mundo, menos mal que no era caro. Lo mejor las fotos que los locales querían hacerse con nosotros.

If you someone craving for history, this is the right place for you.
U can pay for guide to tell u everything u want to know. It's kinda worth it because keraton is sooooo big and it divided into 3 part of museum
(Sorry... theres me in every photo. Because the rest still in my camera T.T)

Creo que esta sobrevalorado, "la casa del Sultan". Esta buena para visita corta, poder ver la arquitectura del lugar y los objectos que están en el museo. 
Es barato, y cerca de la ciudad. 
Ojo con los timos yendo hacia el lugar, hay mucho chanta que alega decir que la casa del sultan esta cerrada para llevarte a comprar Batik.

Pésimo, no vale la pena perder el tiempo en este lugar, fuimos porque nos entraba en el tour, y por educación a los 2 minutos no le dije al guia que terminara la visita. Lo peor que vimos en Jogyakarta.

Als je in Yogyakarta bent, is een bezoek aan het Kraton eigenlijk verplichte kost (als je de reisgidsen moet geloven). 
Vanaf ons hotel met een becak naar het Kraton, dat is op zich al een leuke belevenis. 
Het Kraton is mooi hoor, maar ook wat vervallen. We konden we een traditionele Javaanse dans en muziek bekijken. Dat hebben we toch weer mooi meegepakt.
Wel degelijk een mooi gebouw, eigenlijk een ministad. Ik zou het echter niet een top-bezienswaardigheid durven noemen.

It's the palace of the Sultan and you would expect it to be in great condition. 

However it does seem a bit run down. The exhibit were poorly curated. However, there are live performances and they are great. The performers are more than willing to take photos with you. 

However if time is an issue, skip this attraction.

Au delà de l'importance historique du sultanat de Yogjakarta, le bâtiment ne présente aucun intérêt. On n'a pu s'empêcher de rire devant certaines vitrines d'ustensiles de cuisine, comme une louche ou une passoire qu'on pourrait retrouver chez Ikea...
Vraiment pas incontournable, sauf si vous avez du temps à tuer!
Hanya sempat mendatangi alun2 kidul yang masih merupakan komplek keraton, aktivitas malam dengan mobil gowes yang dihiasi lampu warna warni..
Een flinke tegenvaller. Het Kraton is sterk verouderd en is niet meer dan vergane glorie. Weinig interessants te zien naar mijn mening. Helaas!

i always love to come here each time I go to yogyakarta. This palace always offered a classy classic moment at each corner. Kraton yogyakarta is a place when you can see some traditional attraction such as gamelan, wayang and so on.

There is a wide range of museums inside the Keraton. This is definitely the place for you to look closer on Jogjakarta's etnic and cultural. If you happen to go to Jogja, you have to visit this place at least once!
Es un lindo paseo para conocer parte de la historia y cultura de Yogya, es fácil de ubicar y llegar. Vale la pena la visita solo si es guiada.

Bezoek aan de Kraton geeft een aardig beeld van de afgelopen paar honderd jaar in de regio vanuit de verschillende sultans. De gids vertelde veel, soms wat teveel details. Een beetje onderhoud zou geen kwaad kunnen.
Pas de détour particulier à faire. Des bâtiments blancs avec des gens qui essayent en permanence de nous rabattre sur les boutiques de batik.

Wij waren hier en hebben met een gids rondgelopen.  De sultan staat duidelijk nog steeds in hoog aanzien hier.  Achteraf is een gids niet echt nodig tenzij je echt heel erg geïnteresseerd bent in geschiedenis.  Mooi gebouw met leuke attributen.  Jammer dat je ziet dat sommige spullen zoals kleding en foto's nu al in slechte staat zijn.  Niet alles mag je fotograferen en filmen is verboden.

To me there is a huge difference between visiting a place empty  and having it filled in with locals. This is what you will get on Sunday morning. This also means you will also have all the foreign tourists but it is ok. The reason is that every Sunday the Kraton hold traditional dance rehearsals which you will enjoy during your visit while it will give you a taste of Java peaceful atmosphere. Go by 09:30 or 10, until 12pm. The ranking an other day of the week would be only 2 out of 5.

Interesting to look at the buildings, free dance exhibitions and some paintings
Only needed about 40 minutes to wander.
Quite relaxed and only 12000IDR to get in so for the price it was ok

Easy to get to . Interesting. Gamelan orchestra played and a traditional dancer performed in an outdoor pavilion. I loved the antique batiks and rooms with lovely objects and old photos. My driver waited and took me to water tower .  

Jogjakarta offers temples  and this  pleasant morning! Jogjakarta is a great destination if you choose your hotel well and an onward train journey on the Maliboro Express adds to this fantastic experience if old Indonesia.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Really enjoyed the fact that locals take priority and you are part of a small number of foreigners . Not a huge amount to see but soak up the local atmosphere before exploring the surrounding areas.

The Kraton has 2 entrances and only one of them is the correct one. The easier-to-find entrance is near a wide open grass field and charges around 7,000 IDR. This is the WRONG one as there's nothing to see here. To the right of this wrong entrance, there's a small side street. Follow that street for about 5-10mins and eventually you'll see a big clock at a corner. To the left of that clock is another small street that leads to the CORRECT entrance. Here, they charge you 12,500 IDR + 1,000 IDR for a camera license. Make sure to ask for a tour guide as you won't appreciate/understand anything inside without one.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Posto veramente brutto, sconsigliato da vedere se siete a yogyakarta. Non sembra nemmeno un palazzo, ma solo un inutile riproduzione con tanto di museo creata per turisti perditempo. Non vi è assolutamente nulla di particolare da vedere. Farsi questo inutile giretto sotto ad un sole cocente non è proprio il caso.

There is a Wayang Performance, its a dool drama presentation made from animal skin, will leaf by a dalang follow by full traditional orchestra (Gamelan) its more like a story telling but with interisting traditional history. 

Inside the keraton there are a museum present all collection and heritage of the royal family including gift from others countries. 

Its also present the royal family tree and collection of Sultan H IX who was a former of Vice President of Indonesia

We went there because it's one of the things you can do in Yogyakarta, but it's not really worth a visit unless you are a fan of the late sultan and his family. Boring displays (discriptions only in Indonesian) and palace buildings nice but not impressive. If you insist on visiting, do so in the morning when there are dance or puppet shows and it's not too hot. Take the tourist entrance on the east side of the palace.
We had a bad experience with one of the guides in the room with dusty cups and teapots. He touched our 13-year old daughter in inappropriate places while we were taking a photo. She was scared and only told us afterwards.

Met onze 4 tieners naar paleis van Sultan Yokyakarta geweest. Vroeg in de ochtend was het nog redelijk rustig. Een hele oude dame met mooi ouderwets Nederlands was onze gids. Prachtige locatie, wat teveel aandacht voor de voorlaatste sultan Nr IX. Paleisstad hetgeen Kraton eigenlijk is, is ruim, ontspannen en relatief koel. Mooie cultureel uitstapje van ca 1,5 uur. Het waterpaleis is echter vervallen en niet echt de moeite waard, moet je wel toegang voor betalen 15000 rph per persoon. Relatief duur ivm prijs toegang paleis van Sultan.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The Sultan of the city still stays here. If you don't have a guide its hard to make sense of the palace grounds. Also, its not very "fancy" as you might expect for a palace. It worth a walk around and there are puppet shows in the course of the day [I didn't see the show so cannot comment if its good or not]. The exhibitions inside the palace are not in English so its difficult to understand much about it.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Come dicono tutti, Yogya è un'ottima base per visitare i templi Borobudur e Prambanan, però per ogni tempio basta una mezza giornata, e se decidete di fare le cose con calma Kraton andrebbe visto. Io purtroppo ho visto solo una parte perché durante il Ramadan il palazzo apre solo di pomeriggio e sulla guida questa cosa non c'era scritta. Avevo già prenotato le visite ai templi, ambedue di pomeriggio alle 14 con l'autista, e tra parentesi, vi consiglio di fare lo stesso, c'è meno gente e poi vi godete il tramonto. Kraton secondo me è da vedere, la parte che ho visto grazie al custode, gentilissimo, e a gratis, era interessante. Nelle vie intorno al palazzo ci sono anche le botteghe degli artisti, interessante vederli al lavoro. Tutti molto gentili e disponibili. Consiglio la visita di Kraton, ma ricordatevi di controllare l'orario delle visite!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Ok for an hour but don't expect a wonderful interesting site. There are such things to see as the royal egg whisk, the royal tea cup.etc. You get the idea.

I found this place a bit bored and inside the Keraton nothing much that interesting. They have a few wings/area to display the potrait/painting, old batik, etc. We didn't ask Keraton Tour Guide to join us but heard from my relative that they are quite good when explained the history of Keraton/Jogya. You can look for them around/inside the Keraton.

We were there with friends from Yogya so we had the priviledge of them translating for us. The price of the entrance fee and tour guide were resonable so we took a guide as well. 

Thr guide was an older gentleman whose explanations of details in the palace were very interesting and fun. Certainly made the visit much more exciting than just walking around without undertstanding of every detail (and there are a few).

However, at the end of the tour (cca 1h) the guide offered us to visit the Palace batik school and even try to make our own.

Of course, it turned out to be a back ally gallery with "art" batik where we were almost hasseled into buying at extreme prices - have it not been for our local friends.

Our local friends were extremely embarrased by this and I want to stress out that 99.99% of experiences and people in Indonesia are nice/fun/great.

So - definately visit while in Yogya and spend 1h with a guide but don't go to the batik "school" (the first "fishy" thing you will see is that the guide is walking you to a back ally OUTSIDE of the Kraton palace).
Not much to see and re tour guides are a rip off. They don't want to do anything,  explain anything and just ask for bigger tips and try to extort money.

Een bezoek aan het Kraton hoort we natuurlijk bij in Yogyakarta. Een gids inhuren is wel de moeite waard om net dat beetje meer mee te krijgen over deze plek en z'n bewoners. Iedere dag wel iets traditioneels te zien, dans of muziek.

Beberapa kunjungan terakhir ke keraton Yogya saya lebih tertarik untuk menyaksikan pertunjukan-pertunjukan yang digelar keraton di pendopo depan. Selain itu pada hari minggu saya sangat senang ketika melihat para penari yang sedang berlatih di pendopo sebelah dalam.
A visit to the Kraton is a nice activity when you are in Yogja. Make sure you get a guide because they tell you a lot of interesting information for a really cheap price.

We went here after realising it was very close to where we were staying we bought a ticket to what we believed was Kraton but when we went in there was virtually nothing to look at apart from some pictures on a wall which none had English or any other language translations so we found it hard to understand. After quickly leaving this place we walked a little further and found another entrance which we were told we'd be able to get into with our tickets however we were soon stopped and redirected to another ticket office. We bought the tickets and went inside and realised it was the actual palace. 

Honestly the palace doesn't look like a palace it just looks like an abundance of courtyards with small building within, a bit underwhelming. Pictures on walls with no translations again. Honestly for 2 20-21 year old female backpackers there wasn't much to excite. 

Go if your really interested and know a lot about this sort of thing but don't expect to learn a lot or have a life changing experience.

Las atracciones de yogjakarta más recomendables se encuentran en los alrededores y ninguna de la ciudad merece una visita para ello. Eso si estando de paseo porque hace ya carta la entrada merece la pena porque es barata aunque por nada más.

We hebben een rondleiding gedaan met een gids. Het paleis van de sultan is erg mooi, erg leuk te zien dat veel oudere vrijwilligers als: bewaker van de sultan, gids, of wayang voorstelling actief zijn. Ook zie je er veel contacten met Nederland.

Zunächst betraten wir den Haupteingang (ca. 1 €): Es gibt wirklich ABSOLUT NICHTS dort zu sehen. Jeder Schulhof in Deutschland ist interessanter. Jeder Provinzmarktplatz hat mehr zu sehen als hier. Völlige Zeitverschwendung.
Dann ging es weiter zum Seiteneingang, wo man wieder bezahlen musste (ca. 1 €): Wir hatten Glück, denn es gab zwei Gamelan-Darbietungen, wo wir gern zuhörten und mitfilmten. Aber alles andere, was es dort zu sehen gibt, ist an Belanglosigkeit nicht zu überbieten: einige schmucklose, hässliche Häuser, in denen quälend langweilige Bilder der Sultenfamilie zu sehen sind.
Fazit: Da auch der nahegelegene Wasserpalast nur im betrunkenen Zustand als "Sehenswürdigkeit" zu benennen ist, ist der Aufenthalt in Yoyakarta völlig überflüssig.
You won't need neither expectations nor imagination. Just go there, pay all fees and observe. It's precious by itself.

Salah satu tempat wisata sejarah yang wajib dikunjungi, tempatnya sangat terawat dan luas, di dalamnya banyak peninggalan sejarah yang bisa kita ketahui dan tentu saja banyak view yang bagus untuk foto-foto :D
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Als je in het centrum bent, wel even de moeite waard. Is niet bepaald grandioos maar oké. Je zietde traditionele klederdracht en vervoersmiddelen van vroeger tot nu. 
Je bent er echter wel snel door. 
Entree 7000r
this place is a Palace of the Javanese Kingdom Hamengkubuwono, this is a great palace to see the best  heritage of Javanese culture from the past..
Tempat yang bagus buat foto2, ngajarin anak tentang kraton. Buat jalan2 sore mantap, recomended dah. Nyesel kalo ga kesini pokok nya

Het paleis van de sultan is meer een museum dan een paleis 
Een grote verzameling is er te zien van allerlei giften en geschenken van bevriende mensen (staatshoofden, presidenten enz) van uit de gehele wereld.
Verschillende foto's die er hingen waren gemaakt in Nederland 
(de sultan heeft met koningin Juliana in de zelfde klas gezeten in Leiden op de Universiteit)
De Nederlands sprekende gids wist dit en nog vele dingen meer tot in de puntjes te benoemen
Overzichtelijk. Veel fotos van de sultan en familie Vooral het Gamalan orkest was erg leuk.om.te beleven.

So you do have to visit the kraton and it is totally worth it, as long as you choose the right entrance. The one with the big clock at the entrance road costing around 12500 is the right one, the one near the big grass field is the wrong one. 
The difference is that the wrong one has a disappointing collection and the point of the compulsory guide is to get you into the 'sultan's batik workshop', obviously to make you buy batik. It's a well orchestrated scam. 
The right entrance will give you access to much more of the sultan's palace, you'll get to see amazing historical artefacts, many of the sultan's staff, a gamelan concert and much more that's very worth your visit.

We visited both because our driver, whom we trusted, dropped us off at the wrong entrance. We went in and were disappointed. We then chose to explore and 'found' the other entrance. 

Be warned and enjoy!! This is also part of Java's mystery ;)

Erik and Karine.

Nous nous attendions à quelque chose de plus impressionnant. C'est surtout une exposition des différents batiks que portait chaque membre de la famille du sultan ainsi que leur vaisselle, des peintures les représentant etc mais rien d'exceptionnel. Les salles sont petites donc peu d'objets exposés. Nous avons tout de même eu la chance de le visiter le jour d'une représentation d'un spectacle d'ombres chinoises.

Поехали сюда после Водяного дворца и подземной мечети.
Вход всего 7000идр. Зашли на территорию, шли по указателям "Вход" и все ждали, и ждали когда же увидим дворец Султана...
Так и пришли минут через 6 к выходу. Пустая трата времени!
Если Вас не удивить манекенами за стеклом, кафелем под навесом, троном вдалеке и за стеклом,скучными репродукциями - бегите в другие места! Пожалейте силы и время! Даже язык не поднимается назвать это достопримечательностью.

Kraton ini merupakan tempat bersejarah dan dikoordinir dengan sangat baik. Untuk pengunjung yang membawa kamera diwajibkan membayar dan itu sangat masuk akal. 

Usahakan menyewa ahli sejarah agar dapat bercerita kepada kita, apa yang kita lihat beserta sejarahnya.

Nous avons eu le plaisir d'assister au spectacle de marionnettes. Les musiciens sont impressionnants.  Le lieu est agréable. Les pièces de musée en revanche sont décevantes et le bon goût n'est pas toujours au rendez vous !
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Zoals iemand hier al eerder zei, oogt het Kraton meer als een museum dan als een paleis. Het is een complex van een vierkante kilometer met allerlei gebouwen, waarvan een deel nog gebruikt wordt. We hadden een oudere gids die nog Nederlands sprak, over een enorme feitenkennis (m.n. jaartallen) beschikte en er een duidelijke mening over de sultan en Soeharto op na hield ;-) Als je even snel het Kraton door wil, moet je deze gids niet hebben want hij neemt je mee langs iedere foto en voorwerp. Als je echter graag meer wil weten over de sultan is deze gids zeker een aanrader.
インドネシアの王族のことが分かる施設です。日本のとのつながりも強く感じる展示物もあります。伝統芸能をやっているときなら良いですが、展示物の見学だけだと。。。

Kraton Yogyakarta merupakan salah satu daya tarik yang ada di kota Yogyakarta. Berisi puluhan ribu peninggalan sejarah kota ini maupun negeri ini. Kraton Yogyakarta memiliki dua tempat dengan loket tiket yang berbeda, satu ada di depan alun-alun utara dan satu ada di belakangnya. Tetapi saya lebih memilih untuk mengunjungi kraton bagian belakang karena lebih banyak "ikon jogja" yang bisa dikunjungi. Harga tiket masuk untuk wisatawan mancanegara yaitu Rp 12.000 sedangkan lokal cukup Rp 4.000 saja. Jika kalian ingin menyewa guide untuk mempermudah perjalanan disana, kalian dapat menikmatinya dengan bayar sukarela ke guide itu langsung. Biasanya saya memberi mereka tip sebesar Rp 50.000 untuk sekali tour 😊
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Went there with my 6y.o with becak tour (becak guys will take you go around kraton area tour : bakpia,tShirt shop,kings picture museum,train museum and last kraton). U can skip some of them (the kings picture museum turn out was small gallery of batik painting not some museum or whatsoever *i almost hope it was ulen sentalu other sister..failed!)

Went for kraton and asked for guide. Not so much to see, the condition was not that "good". Went to kraton dalem (or the palace) where the king lives. This area was more interesting than the kraton luar (near alun2). 
But still not in that good condition. My expection gone wild after went to ulen sentalu and when i went to kraton its not even near my imagination. (Maybe i shoul went to kraton first then ulen sentalu)

Not a must visit place. But if you really want to visit kraton please do visit both kraton (the palace and kraton luar). And please ask for guide so you can hear the complete stories about the building and the kings
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Was not worth the walk to it, not much to see.   There was no concert that day (end of Ramadan?)  Of course, it's cheap.  Water Palace on the contrary is nice.  
Indications for walking to the palace were poor.

Okay to visit. I paid IRP 7k. Most marketsellers outside will try to keep you out saying that it is 'closed' which is not. The palace of the Sultan is worth a visit. Count all the chickens that are caged for decorational purposes ;)
pas aku lagi jalan jalan ke jogja ma temen-temen, aku mampir keraton. keratonya bagus, bersih, juga ada pemandunya baik dan ramah
Ce qui semble plus sympa est le quartier car le Kraton est un peu pauvre en explication et l'intérêt limité. Plusieurs pavillons mais celui qui semble intéressant n'est pas accessible au public !!

The old sultan's palace and ajacent museum is a pretty enough place and has some interesting buildings. However, except the gamelan concert (daily from 10 to 12) there is not much to see here. An hour was enough for both places (palace and museum). The gamelan concert is included in the entrance ticket and is well worth listening to! We paid 20,000 rupiah each, which gave us access to everything. Cheap! :) Remember to get the photo license also.

Lors d un passage à Yogiakarta le Kraton est un incontournable. 
Le matin (du moins le dimanche) l on peut aussi y assister à un spectacle de musique et danses traditionnelles. 
Sans une visite guidée c est peut être un peu fade car il n y à pour ainsi dire aucune information exploitable pour les touristes.

The palace should be visited with a guide. Also visit the museum opposite it. As we did not have a guide we found it pretty boring. The toilet is in a terrible condition.
There s also no toilet paper or even a proper tap after use.
Bangunan yang sangat indah jika dilihat dari jaman dahulu. saya merasa terhormat bisa masuk ke kraton. sangat luas.

Bellissimo, da vedere per forza.
Però regaz,  io dopo 10 minuti a vedere chincaglieria dentro a delle teche mi sfracello i cosiddetti.... voi, regolatevi sui vostri gusti

If you have nothing to do and think of a place to visit, I still think a cuppa around the city is still a better place to spend your time than going to Kraton. It's sparse exhibit is not worth your time.

Kraton Jogja harus banget dikunjungi, objek wisata must do item. Saya lupa sebutan untuk pegawai di dalamnya. Mereka ramah ramah dan kadang ada beberapa calo yang menawarkan jadi guide. Di dalam beberapa area akan ada view bagus untuk berfoto, tetapi di dalamnya beberapa anda tak boleh memijak area tsb. Ada pertunjukan kadang bila mau mengikuti jadwal tayangnya.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Kraton, czyli pałac jest sam w sobie ciekawy, bo zupełnie nie pasuje do naszych wyobrażeń o pałacach. Jest to zespól pawilonów, na ogół bez ścian (naturalna klimatyzacja). Być może nie jest to Wersal, ale jest to też inny kraj. Ale największą atrakcją jest sam sułtanat będący autonomicznym regionem Indonezji, będącej od 2 wojny światowej republiką! Sułtan Yogyakarty Hamengku Buwono X, który ciągle mieszka w pałacu ( w części zamkniętej dla zwiedzających) jest liczącą się postacią w życiu politycznym Indonezji.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Diverse gebouwen zijn er te bezichtigen, uitgezonderd de prive gebouwen van de Sultan. Toegangsprijs 12 euro. Absoluut de moeite waard om hier heen te gaan.
Sultan neemt belangrijke positie in. Ook connectie met NL is/was nog altijd aantoonbaar.
Keraton menerangkan tentang sejarah keraton jogyakarta dari mulai raja yang pertama sampai saat ini, dengan pemandu wisata yg ramah

The Keraton Yogyakarta is a beautiful royal palace with well maintained grounds, serene courtyards and great museum. Only some parts of the palace are open to public, however, those that we can see are quite amazing. Each visitor/group is assigned a free guide, they are actually Abdi Dalams (palace employees who work for very minimal salary, dependent of visitors' generosity, and part of the royal households) so their knowledge of the palace and royal family is quite extensive. We were lucky as we had a very friendly and cheerful guide who liked to make jokes and made the tour very interesting for us. The whole tour took around 1 hour, depending how many pictures you take and how long you take shopping at the gift stalls. I strongly recommend a visit to Keraton Yogya when you visit the city. The best time to visit is early morning before it gets too hot and crowded.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Enjoy your eyes with traditional Javanese architecture and history. You can travel alone, or with guidance the guide tour around (they did not set rates).
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Mengajak anak" berkunjung ke Kraton untuk membuka wawasan anak dan mengerti akan sejarah lampau kebesaran Kraton Yogyakarta, kami ditemani oleh seorang ibu yang menjadi pemandu untuk menerangkan bagian bagian bangunan Kraton dan benda bersejarah lainnya yg ada di dalam Kraton, ibu ini sangat friendly dan sdh sedikit sepuh, menjadikan pengalaman yang baru buat anak anak mengisi libur
Extremely crowded, entry fee, you jeed to boom a tourguide if you want to understand something. There is nothing in english!

We came fully ready for a dance show at 11am. The show wasn't on though, due to the end of Ramadan holidays. We spent an hour or so wandering around the complex, which was Ok, but nothing special. It all depends i guess on your expectations. We've seen a lot of temples and old historical sights and this one, unless you are javanese or have a particular interest, will not impress so much.
Interesting and informative place, loved some of the architecture. Vast area. Loved the rambling around and checking out the whole place
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: We took a beca ride around the palace and visited Taman Sari, batik shop, art shop and cookies factory. They only charge IDR 20000 for the 1hr experience. Overall good.
A hidden place that has nothing much to see unless you have a strong knowledge of cultural background of locals. Only a building with some cultural decoration. Admission fee is required.
I wasn't very impressed by the palace. I visited during the month of Ramadan though so there was no performance. I guess it might be worth a visit any other time
À faire pour les salles extérieures de réception mais bon, pas vraiment indispensable pour les voyageurs pressés. Le plus : guide en français.

We expected more from this, its more of a museum. We were walking and suddenly we were outside of the complex. We saw nothing noteworthy. Water castle is a better choice, watch out for the people wo say its closed till 3pm or something like that, they want to lead you to some puppet shops!

Very interesting grounds, and a very large Gamelan orchestra, but they mostly talk, with some very limited playing. The buffalo skin puppets were all set up and ready to got, but they were not being used.

Since it is listed as one of the attractions, we went there and explored the grounds which were interesting.

After some of the mild reviews I read, I wasn't sure we would like the visit there, but as it is one of the main landmarks in Yogyakarta, we thought we should do it. 
We took a guide in French and really enjoyed the tour. The day was really warm and walking amongst those different buildings in the shade was very nice.
You will learn a bit about the royal family, especially about the so loved king the 9th.
Make sure you come with your shoulders covered as it is a Muslim palace in a Muslim country
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Das Museum beinhaltet ganz anschauliche Austellungstücke, der Palast ist eher weniger spektakulär, da die meisten Flächen nicht zugänglich sind.

Если есть пара свободных часов в Джокьякарте, то дворец вполне достоин того, чтобы их заполнить. Единственный момент - свободное время должно быть с утра, т.к. закрывается дворец довольно рано. Мне место показалось интересным: своеобразная архитектура и орнаменты, небольшие соединенные друг с другом дворики, веранды, где выставлены музыкальные инструменты и предметы дворцовой утвари, кованые скамейки, несколько маленьких музеев. Во дворе проводятся представления традиционного театра теней, сопровождающееся игрой на местных музыкальных инструментах. Глобальный недостаток один: какая-то общая запущенность территории. Здания и помещения местами явно требуют ремонта. Но, возможно, это просто национальная особенность и местные не обращают внимания на такие мелочи :-)
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Once i tapped my step here, i felt the difference of atmosphere. I can feel combination among culture, glory and romance inside this palace. the visitors will be entertained by traditional dance performed by "abdi dalem keraton".

Yogyakarta ha poco da offire e anche il kraton non è niente di speciale.
Yogyakarta serve solo come base per visitare i vari templi nelle vicinanze

In Djokjakarta staat dit Paleis. Het is een groot complex. Dit huis van de sultan wordt nog steeds bewoond en is de moeite waard om even te bezoeken. 
Het is er wel druk.
사실 뭐 역사적인 면으로 봤을 때는 가볼만하지만, 그냥 구경을 하러 갔을 땐 볼 게 1도 없다. 특히 라마단 기간에는 비추천 한다. 우선 안에는 초상화가 가득한 박물관, 찻잔세트가 있는 박물관, 옷들이 걸려져있는 박물관이 가득하다. 그 뿐이다. 그리고 라마단 기간에는 공연도 없다.

Si es que no tienen nada más que hacer vayan porque es barato, pero no tiene nada especial. Es donde vive actualmente el sultán, pero solo un ares está abierta al público que muestra la historia de los anteriores sultanes a través de fotos.

This place is where the King of Jogja lives since forever so it is very important to visit this place. It is very wise to have a guide with you during your visit as there are a lot of symbolic things and places in which requires deep understanding to understand the Yogyakarta kingdom in advanced. 

This place is also in the heart of the city so it is very convenient to visit Kraton. However, bear in mind that this place only opens until 1 pm.

Le Kraton où réside toujours le sultan de Yogyakarta se visite moyennant 12500 IDR, soit moins d'un €, à l'heure où je tapote ces lignes...

Quelques jolies pièces...Un magnifique kiosque à musique, une superbe salle de réception notamment...

S'ensuivent des salles consacrées à la gloire de la lignée de sultans successifs, qui vaut plus par le témoignage d'une époque que la qualité intrinsèque des pièces...

An sich ist das Gelände schon schön und auch die Gebäude sind sehr beieindruckend. Uns hat der Wasserpalast einfach besser gefallen. Der Sultanspalast ist ja eher wie ein Museum. Aber auf jeden Fall sehenswert.

The palace was well maintained. But visitors only allowed to enter certain area of the palace. It was closed at around 1 pm, so better go there in the morning. When you enter the gate, you will be accompanied by appointed guide. 
The most interesting part for me was the section that dedicated for Sri Sultan Hamengku Buwono IX. Many relic related to the Sultan were displayed.

This place is the sultan or King of Yogyakarta residential  palace. 
If you have 2-3 hours extra time in Yogyakarta then this is worth visiting. 
It tells the story of the Sultans and you get a glimpse of how affluent these people are before.

It's a living palace, part of which is open to the public. A guide would be helpful. 
A good time would be to visit around 10 in the morning when they have Gamelan.
We can see the history of jogjakarta here...and also the old stuff from the kingdom...and see more picture before jogja grows till now

I had an English speaking guide who took me through the palace at a good pace and explained much of the symbolism and history. She was very kind, although I wasn't sure if she expected a tip or not so I gave her a small amount at the end and she accepted it. A bit annoying since you get a guide without requesting one. But that's my only complaint. Bit of a living museum as the Sultan still lives there. Worth a visit.

jika anda berwisata di jogja, selain melihat kuliner dan tempat yang menarik lainnya, 
ada baiknya jika kita melihat ke obyek wisata sejarah seperti keraton jogjakarta,
masalah aksesibilitas, 
kraton dapat dijangkau dari malioboro dengan jalan kaki, 
disini anda dapat melihat bukti kekayaan dan kejayaan bangsa kita di masa lalu,
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Pas liburan anak, dapat kesempatan liburan ke Jogja dan disempatkan untuk mengunjungi obyek wisata keraton Yogyakarta.
Datangnya sdh kesorean. Bersyukurnya ketemu dengan abdi dalem yang agak longgar waktunya, sehingga bersama beliau yang sdh puluhan tahun mengabdi, kami jadi tahu sejarah detail tentang raja-raja dan cerita yang berhubungan dengan keraton Yogyakarta. Anak yg sebelumnya kurang minat menjadi antusias mendengar cerita beliau yang kocak, tp mengena. Lebih banyak ke filosofi...bagaimana abdi dalem dengan gaji hanya beberapa rupiah, tapi sdh berhasil menyekolahkan 2 anaknya sampai S2... angkat jempol buat keikhlasan Bapak dalam mengabdi.
Trimakasih pak...sayang kami lupa nama bapak...
Kapan-kapan kami datang lagi untuk tanya kabar kesehatan beliau...

Be there during their cultural show dance, based on the scheduled provided. May start at 9am or 10am, for the dances. 

Offering you a colours and understanding about Yogyakarta's sultanate. Worth visit, cheapest because there are  lot of information about the heritage of sultanate, whom still  the ruler of Yogyakarta. Its just took a couple of minute from Tamansari, as both beside on each other.
Sultánsky palác, ktorý je jedným z najzachovalejších na Jáve si zaslúži pozornosť, je však potrebné aby vám sprievodca viac vysvetlil o meste a čo sultán pre mesto znamená.

Teníamos un día libre en yogya , y decidimos entre otros lugares visitar el kraton pero podríamos haberlo evitado. Desde mi punto de vista no tiene nada de otro mundo, es más no tenemos ni fotos ya que no nos llamó mucho la atención, aunque también es verdad que en yogyakarta no hay muchos monumentos que visitar y si tienes un día libre a algo hay que dedicar el tiempo.

It's amazing building with a very strong cultural taste of Javanese and strong historical background. The guides were so friendly and they conducted Javanese' real hospitality. He told me about the histories of Kraton, which was made by Hamengkubuwono IV. There's these rooms which shows traditional clothes for royal family, for common people, and also traditional ceremonies such as khitanan, gerebeg, etc. There is also this room which shows the pictures of traditional soldiers (500 people) and also the pictures of horse-drawn carriages. Recommended!

日惹王宫（Kraton of Jogyakarta）为日惹苏丹的王宫。这里的苏丹，跟历史上的苏丹古国并没有什么关系，“苏丹”只是对国王的称谓。
        王宫，由日惹苏丹国首任国王哈孟古·布沃诺(意为宇宙位于我的膝上)一世设计并修造的，于1756年建成，距今已有近250年的历史。印尼独立后政府允许原王族一家继续住在宫内，宫中所用仆人仍着古时服装。现住宫内的是哈孟古·布沃诺十世苏丹，其父哈孟古·布沃诺九世过去曾任印度尼西亚共和国副总统。
Such an eye opener place. A very historic place to visit and please do not miss out this humongous castle when visiting Yogyakarta.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Um antiguo enclave murado no meio da cidade onde vivia o sultão é o Kraton. A informação sobre os deslumbrantes palácios, templos e tesouros do recinto é deficiente sem guias e se quiser tirar fotos tem-se que pagar (ainda que um valor irrisório) por uma permissão. Mas achei a minha visita satisfatória.

We went to the Kraton during our city tour of Yogya; they will give you one of the Kraton guides (no other guides are allowed) and she/he will show you around. Our guide Mia was incredibly funny and professional, she explained us everything we could possibly want to know and the visit was a real pleasure!
這裏是認識日惹蘇丹王朝的好地方，最好你帶一個導遊來，他能夠為你解說這裏的各種歷史，介紹所有的建築物，讓你好好認識一下這個仍然由蘇丹管治的特別行政區。

The palace is huge. In general there was very little information provided in English and the display wasn't very sophisticated. It was a pity as the portraits of the sultans really did trigger my interest and the visit turned into more of a stroll around the grounds. I hope they will find some funds in the future to make their history more accessible to all of us.

Unless you're keen on history then it's pretty boring. It's not really a grand palace as such, and there are some museum-type rooms in with some interesting artefacts and small descriptions (some in English too). Nice grounds though. If you're there for the history it might be worth getting a tour guide. 

Entrance 12500IDR
這是日惹的行政中心是蘇丹的王宮, 又稱為日惹王宮, 這博物館記載了9個皇帝的點滴, 因為時間不足, 所以我們只是走馬看花的參觀一下.

This place could be avoided as it only takes about 20 minutes to see. The only open part to public is a working part of the palace where sultans are proclaimed. It has a small, not so great museum within it.
even though its ramadan there was some entertainment which was recommendable. was not too hot so the nice stroll around the ground was good.
Ik had een mooi en statig paleis verwacht dus dat viel erg tegen. Als je van musea houdt dan heeft het Kraton wel wat te bieden. Veel oude spullen (kleding, sieraden etcetera) worden tentoongesteld.
sangat mengapresiasi sejarah jaman dulu. kerasa bgt kentalnya adat jogja pas kesini. tau sejarah2 nya juga. yg suka sejarah wajib bgt kesini

Though the current Sultan's residence is not allowed to enter, the front portion is avail to public with a small entrance fee. 
Look out for the 2 Banyan trees at Alun Alun Utara which have been there since the beginning of the Sultanate - which is a couple hundred years old!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
The tricycle guides will try to hijack your visit and take you to the so called Sultan's puppet maker, cake shop, batik artist, Lewak coffee shop, and other things. This is a waste of time and the guide will get commission on any sales.
You need make sure you get the official guide to the Sultan's palace and museum and not be duped by the informal tricycle drivers.
If you wish to see the other stuff do it afterwards but my guess is there are better things to do.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Ein geschichtsträchtiger Palast der noch von der Sultan Familie bewohnt wird. Wir hatten einen lustigen Deutsch sprechenden Guide der uns den ganzen Palast erklärte. Grundsätzlich wäre er im Eintrittspreis inbegriffen (nachfragen) aber ein kleiner Zuschlag ist bei einer guten Führung angebracht. Für den Rundgang sollte man ca. 1 1/2 Stunden rechnen. Am Sonntag morgen gibt es ein Gamelan Konzert.
来到日惹必须要了解曾经辉煌一时的爪哇国历史。日惹皇宫就是最好的展示。这里保存了很多当年的历史古迹，虽然皇宫的规模和故宫没法比，但也对了解历史有很大帮助。

Keraton Yogyakarta merupakan bangunan istana resmi Kasultanan Ngayogyakarta Hadiningrat yang didirikan pada masa pemerintahan Sultan Hamengku Buwono I. Keraton Yogyakarta berada di Jl. Rotowijayan Blok No. 1, Kota Yogyakarta, Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta, untuk menuju ke keraton dapat menggunakan kendaraan umum karena lokasinya berada dipusat kota akan tetapi bisa juga menggunakan kendaraan pribadi. Di dalam keraton terdapat beberapa patung dan lukisan yang menjelaskan sejarah pada masa lalu, tidak hanya warga lokal yang dapat mengunjungi keraton akan tetapi wisatawan mancanegara pun tidak sedikit yang berkunjung ke keraton. Keraton Yogyakarta biasanya direkomendasikan kepada murid-murid sekolah untuk melakukan study tour karena dengan berkunjung ke Keraton Yogyakarta mereka dapat belajar tentang sejarah. Disekitar keraton terdapat kios atau toko yang menjual makanan, pakaian dan oleh oleh khas Yogyakarta lainnya. Berkunjung ke Keraton Yogyakarta sangat direkomendasikan untuk semua kalangan.

this is a very old fashion restaurant it's big has a nice ambience the people is friendly it's had Javanese. Indonesian and western food. 
it's pintoresque hepl you to understand the old ways of dinning.

If you have an hour to spend in jogja this place is nice and cheap to visit.
Make sure you ware a shirt with sleeves (as a man).

Saya kesini melihat berbagai aktifitas keraton masih tetap terjaga, para abdi yang sedang khusuk dan para penabuh gamelan yang melantunkan tembang merdu, pelayan yang ramah siap mengantarkan berkeliling keraton
This is a good place for us..for the children also..to learn about the history, the culture in Jogja.

Local guide was okay but a bit pushy asking us to pay at the end (we think just asking for a tip, but that's not what she said), when we had already paid. Nothing remarkable about the palace, the timeline of the various Sultan's and their families was interesting but beyond that we didn't pick up too much.

Une visite à faire. Le lieu est agréable et calme. si vous y allez le matin, vous pourrez certainement écouter des chants traditionnels, voir des représentations. Attention, durant le ramadan, le programme change (juste les chants).

A typical visit comes with a guided tour (although I've heard of people skipping this).  I personally recommend it since my guide helped me learn about Javanese traditions and history (even though I was already on a guided tour at Ullen Sentalu the previous day, I still appreciated the reinforcement of information and the new knowledge).  

There are typically performances from 10 a.m. - 12 noon but since I visited during Ramadhan, that was not so (and I didn't realize that before I came).

Tiket masuk murah, arsitekturnya indah, banyak sisi yang menarik untuk dijelajahi, bangunan dan budaya keraton masih dijaga keasliannya. Manajemennya pun profesional, dijamin gak ada tourist scam di sini, kecuali salah masuk keraton.

Jadi, keraton Yogya terbagi menjadi dua, bagian depan yang persis bersisian dengan alun alun utara, dan bagian belakang, yang lokasinya persis di belakang keraton depan namun beda loket dan pintu masuk.

Keraton depan gak terlalu menarik, cenderung kecil, dan gak banyak yang bisa dilihat. Pengunjungnya lebih sedikit, dan pegawai keratonnya pun hanya beberapa. Begitu membayar tiket masuk, kita bakal disambut guide yang seolah-olah aturan di sana, wajib memakai jasa guide. Saya pernah kena tipu oleu guide keraton depan yang mengatakan bahwa tiket masuk keraton sudah termasuk tiket masuk ke dua tempat wisata lainnya.
