Salah Satu peninggalan Keluarga Sri Sultan yang sangat eksotis, cocok untuk hunting foto, dan kalau kalian ingin mengetahui sejarah Taman Sari ini ada banyak guide yg siap untuk menjelaskannya dengan senang hati
Nice stroll at the water temple, where the admission fee also allows you to  visit the ruins on top of the hill of the 2 first sultan's  as well the underground mosque.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Didnt have much to do so took a grab here, its pretty centrally located near malioboro. The place is well constructed, apparently where the houses are used to be a lake which disappeared after the 1960’s quake. Most part of the huge complex was destroyed as well except the underground mosque and bathing area. I didnt take a guide but was pretty lost as to how to get to the mosque and other buildings as its surronded by homes now. An elderly gentleman offered his services (told him i do not want a guide lol) and he brought me around to all the places and gave him 30k (he didnt request for any payments as he lives there and just wanted to help). Weather was extremely hot so was drenched. A normal cap doesnt do the trick, better to bring a large brimmed hat. Overall not a bad way to spend an hour. Was especially interesting to see the effect of the volcanic eruption had on its surrounding areas.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The water castle is only the main attraction which is very well maintained and beautiful. Within the compound, there are many more other historical sites, such as the gates, royal kitchen, tunnels, underground mosque, building on top of a hill, etc. The compound now resided by the locals and the lanes are quite narrow and misleading like a spider web, thus, please follow the map closely. To visit this place, i would advise to spare more time as it will get quite crowded with tourists sometime, and you need to walk a lot to visit those ruins. Open: from 9am till 3pm daily, admission fees: Rp 15k for foreigner and Rp 3k for camera.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
We completed a tour of the ruins on a Saturday afternoon with our 5 & 8 year olds. We had the good fortune of Pak Aton guiding us through and he was very genuine, kind, and knowledgeable. (Guides seem to mill around and just offer their services for whatever you want to give).
Pak Aton was able to guide us to places we wouldn’t have found on our own, such as the underground mosque, and was able to guide us back to our starting point when we’d had enough. 
An inexpensive afternoon’s entertainment with cultural history.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Als wir dort waren wurden gerade Arbeiten durchgeführt, d.h. kein Wasser im/um den Tempel. 
Generell war ein großer Andrang (Sonntag).
Keine wirkliche Wegbeschilderung (vor allem gegen Ende), man kann sich also in den Gassen leicht verlaufen. Es war für mich auch nicht wirklich ersichtlich was nun öffentlich zugänglich ist und was nicht, zum Glück war meine einheimische Freundin dabei.

This place is fully enjoyable and feeling romance inside your heart. Many couples came and visited this water castle. In history, water castle was a place for Princess (Javanese Kingdom) to take a bath. The ticket was affordable and you can go around the area and feel the authentic romance Kingdom of Java. Fully recommended touristic place to visit.
Niet erg imposant, waren snel uitgekeken. Verhaal er achter wel aardig. Geen absolute must see. Gangen stelsel niet meer geheel toegankelijk
Jika anda datang kesini carilah waktu terbaik untuk foto, karena sangat ramai pada hari libur. Datang lebih awal atau mendekati jam tutup lebih baik untuk mencari foto terbaik.

When we entered the attraction, we were approached by someone who told us he was an official guide at the compound and the guided tour was free and part of the entrance fee. Unfortunately we believed him. And missed many key attractions at the compound. Coz after showing us a swimming pool or two, he led us straight to the shops. As we declined buying anything from him or the shops (we had enough souvenirs already having spent almost a week in the city), he then led us to the exit. We gave the guide a small tip just before we left. We thought that was all at the water castle— the swimming pools. After reading a bit more, we learnt there was so much more to the castle, esp the parts that were “under water” and where the staircases converged, which we had missed out on. Such a pity!
Hence my advice to tourists would be to get a visitor’s brochure from the ticketing booth so u know what are the key attraction highlights (they dont always offer u the brochure. So ask for it if you are not given one). Also be wary of the supposed free guided tour of the compound.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Contrairement à ce que disent les guides dont Michelin 3 étoiles ++++Effet apaisant pièces d eau Même billet à prix modique pour la mosquée souterraine et village d art
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Don't come here unplanned, low battery gadget, at noon, on Sunday if you only hunt for instagramable pictures...just don't. Otherwise you will only get pictures with bad angle, bad light, crowded with people, like we did.

But we enjoyed this historical place and fascinated with the history, especially the architectural and civil construction. Also learnt about the Javanese philosophical background of this place.

We hire a guide, his name is Pak Bambang. He was very helpful, well informed, he also brought gadget to play animation that shows us what this place looks like in the old days. He also gives us a tips and trick if we want to get a good picture.

tempatnya bagus buat foto-foto dan sangat instagramable, tiket masuknya kurang lebih 5rb-10rb akan banyak warga yang menawarkan untuk jadi guide, bila punya uang lebih gunakan jasa mereka untuk memajukan ekonomi warga sekitar tp kalau budget pas pas an jangan sedih area bisa ditelusuri tnp guide tinggal cap cip cup jalan mana yang mau dipilih

Incontournable comme le palais du Sultan,  endroit magnifique et photogénique. 
Il y a plusieurs Bassins avec une décoration splendide 
A faire sans hésitation
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
La partie du palais dans là qu’elle se trouvais les bassins était très jolie. 
Le reste était surtout des pièces vides mais j’ai eu la chance d’être tombé sur un monsieur qui connaissait très bien l’endroit et qui parlait français. Il a fait office de « guide touristique » ce qui a rendu la visite plus intéressante. Sans cela il n y aurait eu aucun intérêt étant donné qu’il n’y à aucun explication nulle part sur le site...
Par contre ce monsieur a bien évidement demandé de l’argent à la fin (ça aurait été trop beau sinon...)
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Tempat ini semakin terkenal setelah tampil di salah satu music video penyanyi yura yunita. Tempatnya jauh berbeda dengan kunjungan terakhir saya, semakin bagus dan nyaman. Jika Anda membawa kamera digital atau semacamnya akan dikenakan biaya dan tidak diperkenankan membawa tongsis.

The Tamansari is nestled away in a little neighborhood, making the entrance blend in like many other attractions in Jogja. 

The entire complex is quite small, but beautiful. Very pretty fountains good for a photo opp taking a few minutes to cool down in the shade before moving on. 

Worth a stop, but it will be a quick one 👍
L’endroit est sympa mais le prix de l’entrée de vaut pas le contenu ! Cela pourrait être moins cher !

It's more of local attractions, which is okay to miss if you have less time. The entry fee is 15000 IDR.  We hardly saw foreign tourists here. The place is not well developed and needs more restaurants and amenities. 
A guide is a must for understanding the history of the fort.

Quick visit very instructive.
The palace is nice .
Included the mosque very atopic interest to see .
Nice place to visit with guide explaining history of the place. Takes at least an hour to see all sights and most of all taste good Luwak coffee. Be warned it is expensive though.

Vielleicht liegt es an einer etwas unglücklichen Übersetzung und der sich daraus ergebenden falschen Erwartungshaltung. Aber unter der Bezeichnung "Wasserschoss" hätten wir etwas anderes erwartet. Vor dem Besuch sollte man sich klarmachen, dass es sich hier im Grunde um eine königliche Badeanstallt handelt. Es gibt verschiedene Pools, die sich alle jeweils in einer Art Innenhof befinden, zu besichtigen. Vielleicht wäre der Besuch interessanter, wenn man den einen oder anderen Raum hätte besichtigen können. So aber blieb es nur bei den Pools und damit blieb der Eindruck weit hinter den Erwartungen zurück, die wir mit der Besichtigung eines Schlosses o. ä. verbunden hatten. Ein Besuch tut nicht weh, muss aber auch nicht sein.

現在もスルタンが暮らす宮殿近くの離宮跡です。
昔スルタンに仕える女性たちが水浴びをした石造りの入浴場があります。
なぜかサウナ跡が撮影スポットとなっていて、インドネシアの女性たちが順番待ちして記念写真を撮っていました。
水の宮殿と呼ばれているそうですが、タマンサリの意味は花園だそうです。
Hier is niet veel te zien.De naam doet anders vermoeden.Tevens moet er nog veel onderhoud gepleegd worden om het een beetje interessant te maken.
rustic looking water castle not that impressive. cheap entry ticket. advised to visit on wkdays to avoid crowd
かつてクラトンの女官達が水浴びをしたというプールのような大きな浴槽と、それを囲む四方の建物群はもちろんですが、小径を進むとある地下の不思議な構造物もこの入場券で入れます
What a beautiful place, friendly and nice tour guide. The ticket a little expensive but it's not a big problem 'cause you will feels satisfied what's in the inside especially the history
Het is een leuke historische plek waar een paar baden zijn speciaal uit vroegere tijden. toch wel leuk om te zien, dat zoiets heeft bestaan

By the time I reached the place, it was closed. So, while I cannot share a review of the interiors, let me share a review of the vicinity. Nice mosque, good paintings at various spots and a quick walk to Alun Alun.

Istana air tamansari merupakan peninggalan bersejarah disekitar keraton jogjakarta. Masih disekitaran keraton, sangat disarankan untuk datang di pagi hari atau hindari wiken karena tempat ini akan ramai pengunjung.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Terkesan kecil dari luar,tapi setelah ditelusuri begitu luasnya. Beruntung akhirnya memilih untuk dipandu oleh tour guide,kalau tidak kami tidak akan tahu letak-letak ini dan itu dan apa saja yang harus dikunjungi. Tempat yang luas dan membuat lelah tp sangat epic karena kuno
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Do not come in the weekend, bunch of teenages so loud and they made picture in every step, and other tourist didnt seem want to give you time even 1 second to make picture, seemed they also wanted to part of your memorable pictures.. but somehow I managed to get a pic without anyone but without me in it hahaha... 
The place not really clean, too bad because thats a historical place of Kesultanan Yogyakarta.
水の宮殿タマンサリ、ただし正確に堀や塀でキッチリと囲われているわけでもなく、民家や商店、そして宮殿とかなり混じりあう状況で混在しています。このエリア内は迷路のように入り組んでいて、かなりわかりずらいですが、それを楽しみながら身をゆだねるのが良いと思います。水場はとても綺麗で行く価値はあると思います。

Great when you get there, but can be hard to find on foot. Best to find a guide to show you round as it’s not obvious where everything is. One found us at the gate and was very informative. He seemed happy with his 50000 rupiah tip after an hour and a half showing us round but didn’t expect a certain amount of money
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
We hired a private guide for a walking tour of the historic part of the city for the day, which proved great value for money (although quite draining as it was 34c). Stop No 2 was the Water Castle which for me was the tour highlight.
There is quite a lurid history to this place, the three bathing pools and whom the Sultan "entertained" there.There is also an underground mosque and an entrance to a tunnel(since boarded up) that stretched many miles to the beach. There are numerous arts and crafts shops located within the grounds that have an eclectic mix of items for sale.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Rame banget plus panas bgt. Tp ya ok lah buat foto2. Dibanding situs boto, tamansari lebih estetik dan ada airnya.
Solo la recomendaría si tienes un buen rato libre. Es mas un palacio al aire libre que un castillo con unas piscinas inmensas

Better to get a guide as some areas are not openly visible to tour, esp the mosque. Interesting history to the place with sultans and earthquakes, river that disappeared, passages below water level. The place was a bit small though.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: No es una visita obligada si vas a la ciudad pero es muy curiosa y merece la pena si te sobra tiempo (en 30-40 minutos se puede ver).

Nos dirijamos hasta esta atracción cuando se nos acercó Tono, un hombre mayor de la zona, en principio fuimos reticentes en que nos ayudara, pero luego fue la mejor opción, es cierto que básicamente se nos acopló pero el hombre es un encanto, nos hizo fotones y además es un gran guía, él no nos pidió nada pero lógicamente le dimos algo de propina, si os lo encontráis dejad que os acompañe!! Gracias a él conocimos la historia de este sitio y pudimos ver los diferentes lugares de interés.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It's very close from my home, only 5 minutes by scooter. This place so affordable, cause not so many things to be done here. Located in the city center, you could get here by walking from malioboro.
tempat unik untuk hunting foto, lokasi yang sangat strategis, untuk lokasi sih seru yaa banyak titik dan kita harus berjuang mencari. dan pastinya ada tempat rest area :)

Tiket masuk murah, jika membawa kamera harus membeli tiket kamera 2000 rupiah, pertama kita akan sampai di kolam, setelah itu jika ingin ke tempat lain seperti sumur dan gedung peninggalan lainnya, kita harus melewati rumah warga. Jika baru pertama kali, lebih baik pakai jasa tourist guide, bayar seikhlasnya, saya waktu itu 20rb. Nanti saat masuk ke pemukiman warga, akan ada banyak tourist guide lokal yang menawarkan diri dan mereka memang resmi. Mereka juga dengan sukarela menjadi juru foto untuk kalian :)
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Went there few times and always discover new spots. pay extra for your camera. the best spot is quite hidden. so not only the water ponds, explore further more to the previous underground mosque ... somehow its always busy with instaphoto hunters

Dit is een kasteel van een van de voormalige sultans van Yogjakarta. Wij hebben een gids gehuurd (ongeveer 70 000 rupiah) om toch een beetje uitleg te krijgen, zodat we wisten naar wat we keken. 
Entreekosten zijn niet zo duur, maar je moet wel bijbetalen voor foto’s te mogen nemen (met een fototoestel), terwijl iedereen binnen gewoon met zijn gsm foto’s neemt, ook al hebben zij niet bijbetaald. Bij de toegangskosten zit ook al de toegang voor de onder water moskee. 

Fijn om eens gezien te hebben!

Non è certo il top di Jogya: per noi occidentali che siamo abituati ai palazzi più belli del pianeta, per noi italiani che abbiamo Venezia, oggettivamente questo palazzo sembra più una masseria pugliese che altro.
Noi lo abbiamo visto dopo i templi di Borobudur e Prambanan, forse questo l'ha penalizzato.
Se avete tempo, un giro si può fare è comunque un luogo gradevole.

Tempatnya bagus, banyak spot bagus untuk berfoto juga disana, harga tikenya juga murah (untuk turis lokal, beda harga untuk turis asing). Usahakan jangan kesana saat weekend/hari libur karena terlalu ramai.
pengen lebih explore lagi tempat ini siihh. kemaren kesini kesorean. waktu yang tepat kesini dari pagi siih biar bisa explore setiap spot foto yang ada disini
I arrived here on weekdays morning (not a holiday), so it is not very crowded. There are some cool places to take a picture on. But I did not, haha. There are brochures in English too. Don't worry.
bagus dan indah, semoga tetap di rawat terus, jangan lupa liat masjid bawah tanahnya di kampung belakangnya, coba sewa tour guide penduduk setempat supaya tau cerita ceritanya (bayar seikhlasnya)
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: JOGJA.. emang ngga ada habisnya Kalo kita wisata ke jogja. Taman sari Salah satu tempat bersejarah, yg mana memiliki kesan dan masih alami.. aq yakin kaliann bakal senengg jalan" kesini..berkesan dech pokoknya..

Sicuramente più interessante del Kraton, il Tamansari era il giardino del sultano di Yogyakarta. Non è facilissimo da trovare perchè le indicazioni non sono molto precise e si trova in una zona della città piena di vicoletti e case molto vicine l'una all'altra. La zona però è molto interessante, sicuramente uno dei posti più belli di Yogyakarta, se escludiamo i vicini templi di Borobudur e Prambanan.

L'entrée n'est pas très chère donc ça vaut le coup. Néanmoins nous étions un peu déçus par la visite. Les bâtiments ne sont pas bien entretenus du tout et un peu en décrépitude... Très touristique évidemment...
Tempat wisata yang lumayan rame bahkan hari biasa juga rame. Ga cuma tempat foto yang bagus tp banyak nilai sejarahnya
最初は入口がわからず他の観光客に着いていきました。まるで洞窟の中の迷路で沢山の方が写真に興じてました。お風呂には水はなかったのですが、一番の撮影スポットになっていました。

Je n'avais pas prévu de le visiter ayant lu pas mal de commentaires négatifs mais le palais etant fermé nous voulions quand même visiter quelque chose. J'ai donc été agréablement surprise. Les bassin sont assez jolis et agréables, et la vue en haut de la petite tour sur les bassins également. Il est dommage que l'intérieur des bâtiments soient vides. Le taman sari était plus grand que je ne le pensais avec différentes parties, il y a également des ruines et des petites ruelles dans lesquelles vous pouvez vous balader. Le tout pour 15 000 par personne cela reste raisonnable.

Dulu dibuat untuk tempat mandi para putri putri kerjaan, terdapat tempat beberapa sedang yang memang benar digunakan jaman dahulu, pembuatannya yang sangat otentik, dan memikirkan masa depan. Belajar sejarah disini sangat bagus.
Vonden het erg tegen vallen het was vreselijk druk, via onze driver begrepen dat het badhuis cq zwembad was van de sultan

Het water castle gedaan omdat het een onderdeel was van de reeds besproken toer en onze driver vertelde al zie je zo...... je loopt er echt binnen 15 minuten doorheen en dan heb je de oudheden die er nog waren zoals een vergane fontein en een half bed wel gezien.
Mocht je het willen bezoeken neem geen gids je bent er zo doorheen..... en letop de deur openingen zijn zeer LAAG.

Über die Anlage kann ich kein schlechtes Wort verlieren, denn sie ist sehr schön. Allerdings wird man von den Touristen bei einigen Plätzen zum Teil ganz ordentlich zur Seite geschoben aber wir haben mit den meisten gescherzt und dann macht man gegenseitig 1-2 Fotos und dann geht es wieder ^^. 
Den Eintritt haben wir in Ordnung gefunden und man hat auch einiges zu erkunden. Wenn man in Yogyakarta ist sollte man Tamansari nicht auslassen (außer es wird renoviert).
水浴び場から出ると3か所見る所があると出口の係員が案内してくれた。英語のパンフレットでは写真の順番と見る順番が違うらしく、順番を教えてくれた。 1ヶ所目の道順を教えてくれたが細い路地で民家などが密集していて分かりにくく、露天商や地元民に聞いてやっとたどり着けたので、ガイドがいた方が良い。

Taman Sari Water Castle: era il giardino reale del sultano di Yogyakarta. 
C'è un lago artificiale con isolette e padiglioni, un complesso di bagni e piscine, una moschea, harem.
Luogo piacevole e di relax.
Da qui si può accedere ad una zona di vicoli a case adiacenti.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: This is a really nice palace to walk around and observe. Attended on a day where VIP’s were attending believed to be Malaysian PM so higher security than normal. Great way to while away an hour or so and some very scenic spots for photos - well worth seeing.

Masuk ke istana taman sari terasa aura keraton raja jaman doeloe. Tembok tembok yang tebal dan lorong lorong menginspirasi keadaan jaman itu. Sayangnya bangunan ini sebagian tidak utuh lagi. Memang petlu biaya perawatan yang tinggi

Una de las visitas imprescindibles si estás en Yogya. Por 15.000 idr si eres extranjero, tienes acceso al recinto donde el sultán se bañaba con sus concubinas.
Interesante pero no me pareció espectacular. Con una hora de visita, máximo 1,5h tienes tiempo más que suficiente de verlo.
Nell'area di Taman Sari, la moschea sotterranea del pozzo gommato , una sorta di atrio servito da gallerie, i passaggi simboleggiano i cinque pilastri dell'islam. Particolare.

Well if you have time to kill it can be an option otherwise not worth the stop '
There is a lot of person visiting.
Not easy access with baby trolley

Quelques bassins d eau avec fontaines .
Sympa mais rien de transcendant .
Mosquée en sous sol , atypique mais laissée à l abandon
Nous vous conseillons de vous balader entre les maisons dans le quartier adjacent. Lorsque nous y avons été il n’y avait pas d’eau dans le bassin ce qui enlève un peu du charme de l’endroit.
クラトン見学を終えた後に来ました。他の方のReviewにもるとおり、入口を過ぎるとガイドが現れたので、解説があった方が良いと思い、案内してもらいました。この場所自体はこじんまりしていましたが、家族の写真撮影をしてくれたり、場所の説明をしてくれました。料金も問題なく楽しめました。

It is a lovely setting with beautiful pools, but absolutely not a jot of info anywhere. So it is worth going to see the wonderful architecture but don’t expect to understand it! It’s a very cheap ticket and the staff were friendly. Make sure to visit all areas, the underground tunnels and castle itself are hard to find and not signposted. I would recommend going early, or you’ll find all areas crowded with hordes of tourists posing and taking selfies and spoiling the view - quite annoying.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Im Zusammenhang mit dem Besuch beim Keraton muss man sich auch diesen „Palast“ anschauen.
Man kann sich zwar die einstigen Schönheit vorstellen, leider ist diese aber schon sehr abgebröckelt.
The place is beautiful but unfortunately the fountain was turned off. Still the surrounding is very nice and absolutely worth a visit if you also plan to visit the Sultan Palace.
Not really explained nor indicated. It is a pity, as the castle is nice. But I had the feeling I was missing out on loads.
Lieux de photos Instagram comme un peu tous les lieux touristiques. Plus d'histoires, plus de folklore, juste des jolies photos. Triste

This is the nearest attraction to our hotel so we visited. It was ok but it is not a must see. A good glimpse of the javanese history but you won't learn anything as there is no explanation posted anywhere.

It used to be a palace for the sultan of yogyakarta...

Lots of things you can find here, such as a undergorund tunnel, bunker, etc...

Some place was too spooky to be entered... but it’s cool

Nice place...

Come here at 9 am, not so many people in the morning...

Extra charge for professional cam
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: This place is one destination to know Yogya's culture specially Sultan's daily activities. This water castle was for the family of Yogya's Sulthan

It is 15k each to get in here and there are some nice spots near the water.  However, the rest of the castle is just empty rooms with no explanation - perhaps the guides you can hire would add more.
The additional tunnels near by add a little more to this attraction.
Ok overall.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Luogo assolutamente deludente. Si paga il biglietto di ingresso e nonostante questo non viene fatta nessuna opera di restauro o mantenimento. Al limite dello squallido, circondato da catapecchie che si affacciano sulle mura del "castello" (più che altro un paio di edifici con fontane/piscine e un harem tristissimo) che rovinano l'insieme.

Pensábamos que era otra cosa pero vamos...no vale nada. Si os ofrecen guía...ni os molestéis. Cómo es barato entrar (15K), id pero salvo que llevéis la cámara de fotos (que pagareis por ella 3K) no digáis que lleváis móvil y así os ahorrais ese importe porque a nadie le importa luego si hacéis fotos o no.
規模は小さいですが、周辺はちょっとした迷路のようで、宮殿の庭園は美しく、張られた水が綺麗で涼しげです。

A nice royal pool from the past.
But unfortunately too many visitors at july, when the school holiday is on. Not really enjoy my moments there

This is the palace before where the king live. Taman sari itself is where king and queen and 'selir' and daughters take a bath it has 3 pool which all of them has a different usage. Go and check it out.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Unser Besuch war recht interessant. Ein Guide vor Ort hat uns viele interessante Sachen erzählt, somit hat es sich der Besuch auch gelohnt.
Endroit à faire si vous passez par Yogyakarta mais à mon goût pas incontournable. L’entrée coûte 15 k par pers. Le tour est assez vite fait.
We were lucky and we had the chance to discover it with Regina, an apprentice guide, who explained us many things about the building! Fascinating building!!

Un bonito sitio para visitar y hacer unas fotos mientras disfrutas de las fuentes y piscinas y la agradable compañía de la gente del lugar. Entrada económica (entre 1 y 2€) que incluye también acceso a la Mezquita Subterránea, que está en otro lugar y hay que saber encontrar!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Nice castle in a really interesting neighborhood in Yogyakarta.  Not to be missed! Plenty of cafes and restaurants nearby.
Ok to visit. Expected a little more. It takes about 20 in to visit the whole place. I reccomend for a quick visit.

Des bassins d eaux claires cernés de murs, lieu de jeux et de galipettes par le passé avec des favorites. On déambule quelques minutes. Sensation agréable de la vision de l eau. Quelques pièces vides, des rabatteurs qui veulent tous vous amener aux magasins de Batik mais on connait la stratégie.
Visita guidata in italiano, abbastanza frettolosa...in effetti c'è poco da vedere. Bello ma non particolarmente emozionante. Un peccato aver saltato la visita della moschea interrata al palazzo.

Hawa yg kerasa masih kental dengan nuansa jaman keraton (mase ada merinding merinding nya getuh). Kebayang klo jadi keluarga kerajaan saat itu gmn,sukaaa❤. Untuk menuju lorong yg bawah tanah,harus melewati pemukiman warga dlu.dan sepertinya klo yg baru pertama kesana,ga akan tau kecuali pake pemandu taman sari (kmrn ngintilin yg lain ajah rame2). Tiket murah meriah.Byk spot foto (klo terlalu rame pengunjung ,aga susah dpt foto bgs)diakhir pintu keluar ada yg jualan dawet,pelepas dahaga syeger.
Più cose da vedere, tute interessanti. conviene farsi accompagnare da una guida locale. Non avevamo molto tempo ma abbiamo apprezzato il sito
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: L ensemble est vaste, caché dans la ville, au sein des quartiers. On le découvre en se perdant un peu: mosquée souterraine, maison de repos du sultan, bains privés: beaucoup de charme et intéressant même si très mal entretenu

Een aangename sfeer, een aanrader. We hadden geluk dat de lokale gids ons zeer interessante informatie gaf. Aan te raden is het bezoek  af te sluiten in het Water Castle restaurant, we hebben er zeer lekkere lassis gedronken.
Merece la pena ir pero la verdad que está bastante dejado, bueno como casi todo en indonesia pero no deja de merecer la pena ya que tiene su encanto. Saludos viajeros

No water in the pools, just pile of rocks. The place is under construction, in ruins, and not worth to visit, trust me, skip this place, there's nothing to see. Better spend your time to other places in Jogja. Plus, waste of money, aside from the Entrance Fee, there will be an additional charge for your DSLR, what a scam!
大きくはないですが、とても綺麗な宮殿でした。入場料は一人1万5千ルピア、それに、写真撮影をするのであれば、プラスグループで3千ルピアが必要です。
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Un paio di parchi, qualche foto carina, nulla di eccezionalmente entusiasmante. Comunque da farci 2 passi per quello che costa..
Nice touch to an Indonesian royalty. Can be added to bring a complete trip to Borobudur. I loved the view and would recommend
joli château à faire lors des déambulations dans les anciens quartiers. beau plan d eau encadré des murs du château

bersih, tertib dan teratur, kesana terakhir 2012 masih belum dibersihkan seperti skrg, masih blm ada tiket masuk, skrg sudah dibersihkan dan ditertibkan, bagus sih klo kesini pas siang jangan lupa bawa topi karena panas, dan rencana ada pembangunan lapangan di belakang semoga tambah bagus
The watercastel as well as the underground mosque is really nice and interessting. Unfortunately there where so many people (already at 9am) that our visit was not really enjoyable.

Last time I was here in December 1979 the pools were not yet restored. They look as amazing and one csn just see the Sultan looking down to make his choice ... then proceeding to his private bathing area. The underground temple has incredible atmposphere; other highlights are the two buskers on the way out (why aren't they world famous?) and the amazing hand painted batik clothing for sale in the surrounds. I highly recommend a pre-booked batik workshop if you have the time. The only reason this isn't five stars is because of the July crowds. If you can, avoid the school holiday madness.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Istana bagus, nyaman dan indah. Sewa guide dengan tarif se ikhlasnya dan mendapatkan sejarah tentang keraton. Ditambah bisa dapat sunset

Suatu tempat yang berada ditengah kota yogyakarta. Banyak sekali nilai nilai sejarah ditempat ini. Harga masuknya murah dan luas sekali tempat yang bisa dikunjungi. Bisa menjadi acuan untuk berwisata bila ke yogyakarta
Passez votre chemin, il n'y a rien à voir. Les bassins sont vides. Les pièces sont vides. Aucun intérêt. Aucune information ni explication.

This place was not big. 

The pool was under repair, hence no water. Most of the buildings are dilapidated and pretty much nondescript. Even there was a guide to explain the significance of those buildings, much of that information would probably not stick in my head.

Interestingly, or surprisingly, for such a tourist attraction and cultural heritage, there were many households living in the compound. 

Several times, I almost ended up in someone's house!

It was quite confusing as to what was part of Taman Sari water castle and what was not.

Finding the way was another challenge. It was by way of a small path going pass several houses.

I am not sure why some people disliked this place , as I thought it was beautiful, even in its somewhat dilapidated state. It is very atmospheric and on a hot day, you can imagine how lovely it must have been to bathe there. As I had read up about it, I knew there was an underground mosque nearby, as no one would have told me otherwise that it is included in the ticket price. I managed to find it and had an interesting chat with a local man while I waited for it to open. The little streets around the Tamansari are very quiet and green and cars are not allowed. The people who live there are only allowed to leave their houses to their children, not to sell to outsiders, as they were once the gift of the sultan. The underground mosque is interesting too.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
If you can manage to get through this place without a guide, then please let me know how you did it. Extremely penetrant and giving you advise that is useless...my experience. and they will try to lure you into a SPECIAL Java coffee place or where 
they fabric these dancing puppets....and there was not a drop of water apart the stuff
in my drinking bottle...thank you
We were so disappointed when we get there. The place was under renovation and nothing really worth to see.

Solange das Water Castle renoviert wird, macht es absolut keinen Sinn, es zu besuchen. Wir waren sehr enttäuscht und die herumsitzenden "Guides" waren zum Teil so herablassend und unverschämt. Wir erklärten einem ganz normal, dass wir keine Hilfe benötigen und wurden dann mit einem "Go to hell!" verabschiedet. Ist uns sonst nirgends passiert.
Quite a small attraction and the pool was under repair when we visited. Good for a few photo shots and that is about all.

Di kunjungan ini saya melihat bangunannya sedang mengalami renovasi , untuk suasana tempatnya sangat rapih dan bersih tapi sedikit mengganggu banyak yg memfoto tanpa ada aturan.. kurangnya petunjuk untuk ke masjid bawah laut. Dan petunjuk yg lain.jika kita jalan sendiri tanpa guide lebih baik bertanya pada penduduk lokal disitu mereka baik semua. Klo punya uang lebih bisa sewa guide
Tempat yang cocok untuk berkontemplasi, membuat sketch, melemaskan kaki, dan foto-foto. Asal jangan pergi di hari libur besar, kalau mau menikmati suasana di sini.
Instagramable banget sih ini, tapi lahan parkir yang sempit jadi lebih sulit untuk jangkau ke pintu masuk mesti harus jalan kaki. Overall si wisata ini asyik harga masuknya juga murmer

Es sieht super aus und man kann sich gut vorstellen wie es fertig wieder aussieht.  Leider gerade unter Renovierungsarbeiten, das große Becken war wohl am auslaufen. Wir waren während Ramadan dort und konnten uns in ruhe relativ alleine umschauen :)
It’s not very big, but it’s really worth it. If nothing else it will at least result in some nice pictures. The village next to it is also nice.

Lokasinya tak jauh dari keraton YK. Tempatnya luas, cantik dan klasik.
Tempatnya juga cukup terawat, banyak spot foto.

Waktu berkunjung kesini masih ada sedikit pemugaran disana sini. Tembok ada beberapa dicoret-coret oleh tangan² jahil. Ga rekomen dengan guide jika bawa anak² di awah umur. Karena ada kisah masa lalu yg tidak cocok untuk konsumsi mereka.

Deze Tamansari ziet er niet (meer) zo uit als op de foto's op het internet, ziet er zo vond ik armoedig en gehavend uit. Jammer want op zich zou het een hele leuke attractie kunnen zijn, vermoedelijk is het dat voorheen ook geweest. Een half uur en wat foto's is het echter nog zeker wel waard.

And I would not take a guide again.... there were not really a lot of information... can imagine that the place would be nicer if all the renovations are done. But as there is not too much to see in Yogyakarta you can just walk this 10 minutes from the Palace

Biaya masuknya murah. Tempatnya bagus dan terasa suasana bangunan keraton nya .karena ini tempat pemandian, ada banyak kolam" yang kebanyakan sudah kering. 
Saat saya berkunjung sedang ada renovasi, semoga kedepan nya akan lebih bagus
Disana banyak yang menawarkan jasa tour dengan biaya seiklasnya
Saya sarankan untuk pakai jasa tour nya agar lebih mengetahui cerita sejarahnya
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Esta bien el palacio donde las mujeres del sultan se refresquaban y curioso el metodo de galerias para el agua

Nothing interesting. The colour of the water was greenish. There’s a spot good for taking photos where all the steps are linked together. The place was under construction and there wasn’t really much to see. Was done with it in less than 15 minutes.

Salah satu tujuan wisata di Yogya yang tidak boleh dilewatkan adalah Puri Air Tamansari, karena tempat ini merupakan bagian yang tidak terpisahkan dari sejarah Kraton Yogyakarta.
Dikolam ini kita bisa melihat kemegahan tempat pemandian dan istirahat putri2 bangsawan pada jaman dahulu.
Lokasinya terawat cukup baik, dengan fasilitas umum yang memadai dan spot foto menarik.
Komplek warga abdi dalem kraton disekitarnya juga merupakan rute walkin yang seru, karena kita bisa belanja cindera mata dan juga kesenian khas Yogya.
Wajib dikunjungi ya....
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Under renovation, in very poor condition, nothing to see. We did not understand why we need to buy entrance ticket to see nothing

因為是日惹的名景點，所以來看看。水池規模不大，來訪時裡頭有水，保存也還好。據悉是蘇丹沐浴之處。附近看到puppet master在做puppet, 很有意思。
若時間不夠，婆羅浮屠和普蘭瑪巴寺（外加Merapi 火山）即可，時間充足，可來晃晃。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Water castle was under renovation during our visit so it was messy. We only walked around a small section of the castle. Place was not well maintained with paint peeling off, etc. The rooms are mostly empty. Only 1 room has a "bed" which is just some wooden planks put together.

قصر الماء هو اسم الدافع الخفي. على أراضيها هناك عدد من حمامات السباحة. أنها تعطي القصر منظر خلاب. أتذكر أيضا الجداريات على الجدران. لقد صنعت قبل عدة عقود ، لكنها لا تزال رائعة. هذا ما تعنيه المدرسة القديمة للرسم!

Den Besuch dieses verschimmelten Areals kann man gut mit dem relativ uninteressanten Kraton verbinden, da die beiden "Sehenswürdigkeiten" nicht weit voneinander entfernt liegen und fußläufig erreichbar ist.

Eingang einfach zu finden, einmal rein gegangen, umrundet und wieder raus aus dem eigentlichen "Wasserschloss" binnen 10 Minuten. Im Anschluss kann man dann noch die unterirdischen Gänge und die einstige "Unterwasser-Moschee" bzw. Die Gänge die geflutet werden konnten, ansehen. 

Hier sollte man den Touristen mit Guide folgen. 
Schilder sucht man nämlich vergeblich und die dort wohnenden Menschen haben eher Angst vor den Touristenmassen. 

Alles in allem "ganz hübsch und kurzweilig".

Derzeit übrigens UNDER CONSTRUCTION und somit sieht man leider nur ein Schwimmbecken mit Wasser gefüllt. Das andere ist voller Bauschutt.

Sagt einem vorher natürlich Niemand...
水宫不是我们的重点，所以没做太多功课，只是随便看看，拍两张照。因为在维修中，很难找出照片中的美样子。里面好像也比较混乱，走着走着，好像就进到民居了。而且，里面还不许走回头路，不知道是不是维修的原因。
When we visited (in April), there was no water as the place seems to be under renovation. Not worth visiting till the renovation is completed.
Die Geschichte dieses Wasserschlosses, Entstehung und auch ihre unterirdischen Katakomben sind wirklich interessant. Eine Sehenswuerdigkeit, die sich lohnt.
Durante nuestra visita, la verdad es que no encontramos grandes estímulos, gran parte del complejo estaba en obras y lo que vimos tampoco nos pareció de gran interés.

Berpusat ditengah kota Yogyakarta sangat mudah sekali untuk disinggahi, untuk biaya masuk pun termasuk murah. 
Lebih baik menggunakan guide lokal untuk lebih mengetahui lokasi lokasi tertentu dan tidak ada petunjuk arah yg jelas. 
Tempat sungguh unik dan seperti jaman dahulu, ada temple dan juga tempat bawah tanah.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Nothing special. If you find yourself with free time than go but you won’t miss anything by not going. The water is not on in the pools. The buildings look unkept. It’s small. The only worthwhile thing to see was the mosk.

Well, as others write, a bit of a scam that they don’t mention at the ticket booth that it’s drained from water and under renovation now.
Anyhow, we enjoyed it, especially by sneaking out on the backside and walking the small pathways out towards Bale Raos. That was a great experience, Water castle not, but we didn’t regret it anyhow.
The Grab car had no idea about the place even after showing picture and of course indication on the app. Remember to have "Taman Sari" written down to show.

I have visited this place in 2001 for the first time, in 2019 for the second time. Renovation works 18 years ago, renovation works now, you expect to se a pool filled with water, as the name suggest, you will se an empty pool with workers instead. The whole place is very bad conditions, nothing has been done to improve it, which is very disappointing, suggesting that as long as they know tourists will come, they don't bother investing some.money at least to fix the alleys connecting the buildings. It has good potentials, if properly managed. On top of this all, if you are a Permanent Residence Permit (KITAP) which means you share the same rights and duties of an Indonesian citizen, except the right to vote, you are still charged the fee for international tourist, instead of the local fee. Not a big deal, just 5000IDR extra, but UNESCO beauties like Borobudur and Prambanan apply local fee, the Sultan's Palace applies local fee, the local taxation office applies the same rules as for locals, except Yogyakarta's Taman Sari. One reason more to stay away if you are a long term resident.

The site is under construction

No water at all

Tatally disappointing！

A lot of people as we go there during public holiday
I came to this place yesterday and this is the real scene. It is under construction, messy and crowded. Waste of 15k IDR ticket.
So many people, but okay place to visit. We went during repairs of the pool so unable to look at it beautifully

I believe they are renovating - well overdue by the look of it. It should be closed as ponds are full of green slime, walls dripping with discolouration and really not worth any effort, let alone expense to see.

Taman Sari merupakan situs bersejarah di Yogyakarta yang dibangun pada pemerintahan Sultan Hamengku Buwono I yang terdiri dari kolam pemandian, gedung, danau serta pulau buatan beserta lorong bawah air, kanal air dan beberapa jenis bangunan lain. Gaya arsitek yang unik memadukan antara arsitektur Jawa dan Portugis sehingga menjadi daya tarik utama Taman Sari Yogyakarta. Tempat ini dulu dipergunakan sebagai pemandian istri Raja Yogyakarta. Bukan hanya sebagai tempat rekreasi tapi jaman dulu dipakai sebagai benteng pertahanan dari serangan musuh.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: とても美しいですが、なんと工事中でした。写真の奥側のほうでは作業員が水はけをよくするための工事をしていました。さらに奥には専用の浴場ですが、やはり水がありません。中にはサウナの跡もあります。

My husband and I visited Tamansari expecting to see old but beautiful pools/bathing complex, but this was a ripoff! All we saw were men doing constructions and some rubbish around. 

Ticket office didn’t even bother telling us the current situation of the place.

Don’t waste your time!

Frustrating experience going to this place. They are currently renovating it but still kept it open. At least inform the visitors of the current situation before selling entrance tickets. 

You will not see anything here except for people working on the construction. 
We paid 30000RPH for two, and visited for 10 minutes. I know it is not a lot of money but still a waste of time and money.
No water was in the pools, just pile of rocks ! Was a very nice building and architecture ! Cost 15000.rph I think (1.5$ Canadian)

You will need a guide if you would like to learn the history and have some explanation of this place. Otherwise, it is just strolling around the area trying to figure out what activities were done here in the past.
They sell ticket although it is still under the renovation. It is totally different from the brochure. The complicated place with too less directional signs made us lost.

Tempat ini sebenarnya dulu dipakai untuk mandi para istri" Raja Yogyakarta. Sekarang dibuka untuk umum. Tempatnya bagus, apalagi buat foto pre wedding . Banyak sudut bersejarahnya ... mungkin perawatanya yg perlu di mantabkan lagi

What a disappointment! On photos around the net you can see a lovely place with water everywhere and looking really inviting. However when you actually get there the place is in ruins. Totally run down. It was used during the first and second sultan only last time about 200 years ago. After that it was just running down. I wouldn’t recommend that place at all but then again in Yogya this is basically the standard of tourist attractions. Only the two main BIG ones are worth a visit I’m in opinion. Sorry about that.

Het was ooit groots, maar nu echt niet meer. Bijna alles is gesloopt omdat mensen er moesten wonen. Het is eventjes leuk om met een gids er doorheen te lopen. Echter krijg je constant hetzelfde,  dit was ooit .... maar nu wonen er mensen.

Like many things in Indonesia, this is another overrated place. I don’t know if it’s been like this for some time, but point is, we went there and it’s just rubbish. When you get in there’s 2 pools, one was full of broken concrete blocks, gumboots and other stuff. The other one was just empty. It is so frustrating to go and see stuff and pay 3 times more than locals and then it’s just a massive disappointment. I’m sure it looks nice enough when it’s all sorted but can’t someone just put a notice of the actual conditions of the building? Of course not, cause otherwise they wouldn’t make any money isn’t it. Just don’t bother going or if you do, ask someone weather or not it has been restored.

歴史ある建物として、訪れるのは良いと思います。どんな風に使われていたのかを事前に少し知っておくと、また見え方が変わってくると思います。

水場だけでなく、良い写真が撮れる場所もあります。

近くに、ルアック・コーヒーを飲めるカフェもありました。
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
プールを囲むように立つ宮殿で、きれいです。見どころは、ここと、少し先のドーナツ型の建物ですが、それを探すのにガイドがいないと苦労するかもしれません。どこからともなく、ガイドのおじいさんが説明しだしました。
「ガイド？いくら？」と行くと、「あなた次第」という回答で、首からライセンスのようなものを下げていました。実際、お礼を渡したあと、高額請求されることもなく、行きたいところに行けて良かったです。
この周りは壁に絵が絵が描かれていたり、アート的な要素が多かったです。小さなカフェ、ろうけつ染めのお土産屋、Tシャツ屋などがあったり、蝋を作っているお宅やカフェがあったり、街歩きするには楽しい所でした。
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
I am quite shocked to find
So many of jogjakarta’s most important tourist sites are closed 
So early the kraton especially .
I was whizzed through because 
It was closing at 3 pm .. but with extra tips I got to stay another hour 
... I found it stunning especially on a rainy day .. in my heart wondering all the time how long can this building last for .. I actually prefer the baths at Kota gede .. as someone rightly puts it modern use from an ancient past ... it was amazing to see people bathing ... at Tamansari you have to visualize and use your imagination
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Place is not very large, walk for few minutes. Buildings are not in very good shape, generally nothing special to see here, but if you have time try to stop by.
此為日惹蘇丹的後宮，妃子與太子們住在這裡。蘇丹常在此洗浴休憩。整個後宮不算大，中心圍繞著一個大浴池，加上一入門的小花園，後方的一個小廣場，可以逛逛的區域不算大。

It was an okay way to pass the time on a lazy Saturday afternoon but I can’t say there’s much to do here. The water doesn’t look too clean either and we spent most of our time in the attic quarters of the house. The entire thing can be completed within 10 minutes

We spent a couple of hours at the Water Castle and Gumuling Well. The buildings and baths are beautiful and understanding how the Sultan had once flooded this area to form an artificial lake was fascinating. We had some difficulty finding Gumuling Well. We now know the secret is that when standing at the entrance road to Tamansari head down the road to the right, follow it round a left hand turn and there is the entrance to a tunnel that takes you to  Gumuling Well. Found this a far better experience than the Sultans Palace.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Water castle in Europe means something different, but still great architecture building to visit if you are in Yogya, Indonesia. 

3 pools for 3 different purposes, the best one is of course when the Sultan throws the rose in the 2nd swimming pool and that woman who catches it, goes with him to the private pool (the 3rd one).

I came inside from a side which was for free, but I have seen that the other entrance is charging the entrance fee. Really weird, but that is Indonesia. 

Recommended.
It’s a beautiful water castle except lots of tourist but don’t miss the underground, it’s very interesting building and lots of history in it.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
This is the second time to visit the site after 20 over years. The place looks same except more tourists. It was rainy day and bit troublesome to walk aound because of puddles everywhere. 
This is still the interesting site to see as the historical spot.
It is better to avoid weekend as it should be quietter and not so squeezy.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Tamansari dengan kemegahan dari masa lalu memberikan kita kisah dari setiap sudut-sudutnya. Kita dapat membayangkan para putri dan istri serta selir raja bermandi bercengkerama di kolam. Sedangkan Raja penuh wibawa memperhatikan dari bilik pribadinya yang terletak di atas. 
Tamansari tidak hanya sekedar lambang pemandian kerajaan tapi juga menyuguhkan sisi spiritual dan simbol-simbol keagamaan.
Keindahan tamansari dapat dijadikan latar belakang foto yang indah dan terkesan "magical".
Apabila Anda mau berkunjung ke Tamansari, akan lebih baik menggunakan jasa tour guide dengan biaya jasa seikhlasnya, para tour guide akan memberikan penjelasan sejarah dari Tamansari dan menjadi fotografer kita. Untungnya, saya mendapatkan tourguide yang memiliki kemampuan fotografi yang mumpuni walaupun beliau sudah cukup berumur.
Untuk tiket masuk domestik ke Tamansari adalah Rp 5.000,-/orang, dan ada biaya tambahan apabila anda membawa kamera profesional dan kamera digital.

Sayangnya, apabila anda berkunjung saat weekend, maka pengunjung akan banyak dan sedikit pengap, untuk berburu foto yang indah pun jadi kurang nyaman karena terlalu banyak orang yang berburu foto juga. Namun, bagusnya orang-orang tetap mau antri dengan sabar untuk foto di spot tertentu.

Spot foto favorit adalah di tengah-tengah kolam pemandian pribadi raja, kolam pemandian para putri, gerbang pintu, water castle (ala-ala reruntuhan), tangga membentuk 5 sudut.

Akan lebih enjoy kalau datang pada waktu hari kerja, pagi hari (biar nggak panas banget), dan bukan musim liburan.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The most surprising part of our tour of the Taman Sari Water Castle was the underground tunnels. We would have missed if we had not strayed into a side path to look at a luwak (civet cat) named Louise, belonging to a Luwak coffee joint. After failing to persuade us to try the luwak coffee, a man standing by the cafe “offered” to bring us to view the castle’s underground tunnels, which is covered under the ticket. The access was through several alleys forming part of an interesting cluster of single storey buildings comprising a mix of shops and residence. The whole visit exceeded my expectations as I didn’t expect much since it wasn’t commonly listed as one of the top things to do in Yogyakarta.

Waktu sampai di tempat ini, depannya ada tukang bakso murah, juga jajanan lainnya. Masuk ke dalam bayar 5000 kalau tidak salah, tpi ada pemandu yg ramah mau jelasin tentang ruangan² di dalamnya. Pemandu tidak minta bayaran, namun kebanyakn orang kasih tips. Mau bantuin foto²
tempatnya kurang tertata dengan rapih dan kebersihannya kurang, waktu saya kesana juga airnya kering semua sehingga tidak ada kolam, kebersihan dan penataan harus bisa lebih diurus lagi.
One of the visiting destinations in Jogya that offers Old Javanese Flavors. In this place you will feel in the past. For young couples, this place becomes a dream as a wedding photo location

The grounds were pretty (flowers and architecture), but there wasn't any information about what we were looking at. It was mainly guesswork and imagination. I wouldn't recommend spending too much time here. It is nice for a quick, unique stop on your way to other sites.

„Taman Sari“ als Wasserschloss erbaut 18 Jh, ua. Badekomplex des Sultans. 
Nach einer gut gelungenen Renovation eine absolute Sehenswürdigkeit. Der inmitten des schön gestalteten, nach oben offenen Badepalast, befindet sich ein mit Wasser gefüllter Pool. Hier kann man sich so richtig zurück versetzen in die Zeit der vergangenen Sultanate. Über Stufen und durch Torbögen gelangt man in die geschichtsträchtigen unterirdischen Gänge. Ein Laubengang über den Dächern der Altstadt führt zurück ins Alltagsleben. Die Zeit sollte man sich aber gönnen um den speziellen, etwas verborgenen Coffee-Shop zu besuchen. Dort kann nebst entsprechender Illustration, die Luwak-Katze leibhaft besichtigt und Luwak-Coffee probiert werden.
Sigi, Februar 2019
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Salah satu spot yang wajib di kunjungi ketika kita berada di Yogyakarta. Tempat pemandian para ratu kala itu. Arsitektur yang indah ditambah sejarah masa lalu membuat kita wajib untuk kesini.

Sadly, this site has not been well-maintained. The small garden area was unkempt, though it could be lovely. There was a pile of plastic bottles there  and the shrubs and grass were not manicured. See the three swimming pools but don't expect a "palace". It's a bare bones place.

Tamansari is located near the palace. It has a rich history and is filled with local people interested in their own history. There were many many many freelance (and persistent) local guides on site and we were advised by our driver to ignore them. True enough, they were sticky and offered their services voluntarily. Review Text: this place is really beautiful. this is the first time my family and I have come here. really a very recommended place if you are on vacation in Yogyakarta

Located within walking distance from the Sultan Palace is this Taman Sari Building, the Taman Sari Water Castle. With a combination of eastern & western architecture build by a Portugese, the building is adorned with numerous Javanese ornaments, its old grandeur still could be found within its ruins.

Walking through a walkway of trees and garden, 3 swimming pools inside the complex comes into our view. From our guide, we learned  this interesting and historic place used to be the Sultan’s retreat, where he would watch his concubines bathe from building above. Surely an interesting perspective on how the royalties live there. It is also interesting to walk through the kampung , to see their dwellings complete with old wells, and wayang kulit murals on the walls.  At the Art Village , there are amazing galleries and unique batik shop as well a gift shop selling souvenirs, titbits and beverages and a Café.

Heading through the old tunnels , albeit eerie to walk through, I stumbled into the underground  prayer place, deserted and dark, it is  hauntingly stunning with a niche in the wall of this building was used as a mihrab. The central area of this building is an elevated platform where four staircases meet, and then from the platform, one staircase reach the first floor. On the ground level of this platform is a small pool that was used for Muslim ritual ablution. Its like in a maze which took me awhile to exit out from here.

At the rooftop, it is a vantage point for views over the surrounding areas which attracted many visitors to do their selfies and welfies !!! 

This was definitely worthwhile to see and experience. We would highly recommend it.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

This water castle is very near to the Sultan Palace.

It was mentioned that this water castle was built for the Sultan's wive(s) to take bath. The whole tour in this place should not last more than 30 minutes unless you really want to take photo in every angle.

I heard a lot about Water Castle Taman Sari, yet this is our first visit, so we decided to use the service from a guide. 

The guide first shows us around main area, which is behind the ticket sales. It has pools for bathing of Sultan's wives (Hamengkubowono I has 19 wives), their children, and a separate one for the King himself. 

As a recreation center, this wellness place is equipped with traditional spa and ratus, bed for massages, as well as dance performance, complete with 4 gazebos that housed 4 sets of gamelan that accompanied the traditional dances. 

The compound is also connected to underground mosque that symbolizes Islam movement when the rest of the society is still embrace Hinduism. 

The underground tunnels also lead to a ford surrounded by water, and an escape route as long as 27km to south sea. 

There is also a meeting place between the Queen of South Sea (Nyi Roro Kidul) and the King (Sultan) that comes from the myth that every Jogja ruler shall marry the Queen that rules South Sea on return of protections of all Jogja citizens from disasters. 

The guide also brought us through the village behind Taman Sari that was supported by Mark Zuckerberg, and now known as Kampung Cyber. It offers feee Wi-Fi for public, free.

Review Text: This place is suppose to be one of the best attraction sites of Yogyakarta. Most of the visitors were local people. It is not a problem to find it. You receive a leaflet at the entrance, but it shows no maps at all; only snapshots! A posted map indicating your location will really help a lot. Most of the signs are not in English. Many offer guided tours but in Bahasa. There was an extra fee for using a photographic equipment, but did not notice whether I paid for it or not. This site could gain a more adepts if a few changes are made. For instance, why this place is so important in Yogyakarta. What about its history. Remember that the site closes early on Fridays.
