Hemos visitado la mezquita pero no es ninguna visita obligada porque el estado en el que se encuentra es bastante pobre, el agua de las piscinas está sucia y huele mal, podrian arreglar el jardín.
I would give this place a miss as I did not enjoy it. We only went because it was our 1st day and we were a little stuck (in terms of time) so we agreed for our driver to take us around.

Saat Anda berkunjung ke Taman Sari, Anda akan diajak untuk kembali ke "masa lalu" dimana bangunan kuno yang artistik, kolam tempat para putri raja dan selir berendam dan bermain air dalam suasana yang teduh dan adem. Indah, walau masih perlu banyak perbaikan disana sini.

There is a small entry fee that gets you in to 3 places. The water garden, the hidden mosque, and a courtyard. 

When we were there the pool was emptied of water for cleaning. 

The mosque was interesting conceptually. 

We enjoyed strolling about. 

Not as grand as some of the other monuments around town, but worth a visit.

Visited the place in December 

Very run down and hardly any water in the pools so don't go by the pictures on the pamphlets 

Small place and you can get lost in the back alleys
Enjoy it to see the place,  nearby were very clean place a long to visit the hidden cave,, good place to see while in yogya
Disini byk turis luar jg yg dtg.tmptny keren jg bwt foto2,wlwpn gk tlalu menarik.dsni ktny tmpt mandinya raja-raja jaman dlu.klw aq sih ksni cm 1jam,keliling2 fto tts ktmpt lain

Tempat bersejarah yang cukup menarik untuk dikunjungi. Di dalamnya ada tempat pemandian sultan/raja, permaisuri, tempat tidur raja, tempat spa, dll. Alangkah lebih jelas jika menggunakan jasa guide. Krna saya gak pakai guide sehingga untuk detil informasi yang saya dapatkan kurang jelas hehe. Kalau kesini pada siang hari, bersiaplah untuk membawa payung karna panasnya luar biasa.

Tempat bersejarah ini menarik untuk Anda kunjungi karena bangunan kuno yang ada masih cukup terawat dengan baik. Dengan berkunjung ke sana, Anda bisa merenung sejenak dan membayangkan betapa para pendahulu kita sudah memiliki desain lanskap yang amat baik dan indah. Kita bisa membayangkan juga tatkala para sultan bercengkerama dengan permaisuri dan keluarga mereka di pemandian ini.
Di sekitar bangunan induk ada perkampungan yang di antaranya terdapat rumah-rumah yang difungsikan juga oleh para pemiliknya sebagai galeri lukisan, tempat penjualan suvenir, sanggar untuk belajar membatik, dll.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
他の方の口コミにもあるように、もう少し掃除して綺麗にすれば良いのにな…と思います。
場所の歴史を知って行く上では面白い場所だなとは思いますが、せっかく入場料とってるならもう少し苔を取って欲しい！笑

While in Indonesia we were keen on visiting the Water Castle of Tamansari. Located in Yogyakarta, this is definitely a must visit place. However, it is worth visiting only if you have a good knowledgeable guide. Lots of stories from the glorious past are attached to this place. Also there are few architectural wonders. Thus, ensure you have a good guide and then you can enjoy the real beauty of this place.
不得不说, 水宫拍出来的照片比实物要好看.虽然叫宫殿,但现在除了几个池子外,旁边的建筑都是空的, 真的只有四面墙壁而已. 而我们最大的遗憾是竟然错过了可以俯瞰宫殿的露台,还有一个寺庙,真的不知道在哪条路上的,就这么华丽地没了缘分.

Udah ga asing lagi kalo tamansari ini jadi tujuan wisata banyak orang kalo ke jogja.. Tiketnya yang murah dan banyak spot foto yang instagrammable banget dsini.. Bangunannya tua namun ckup terawat dan bersih ..
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Very poor maintenance since 5 years! The entrance fee is a complete ripp off compared of what you get.
I would suggest to get a guide to help taking around the place and give some explanation on the history of the place.  It has underground mosque.  Recommended to visit if you are in Yogyakarta.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
only 5K, but you can learn the whole history about the history of kesultanan Jogja. I don't know that this area is larger than what I expected. I saw a good pre-wedding photo of Mr. Jokowi (President of Indonesia) 's daughter , Kahiyang Ayu and her fiancé. I expected to have such a great exposure for Taman Sari Water Castle, since I come on holiday season, I can't take any good photograph in this castle. At least I can get few nice pictures here.
For some foreign people, it's good to hired local guide on location, it has lot of tunnel and alleyways, it's really complicated for newbie.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Kalau kesini lebih baik parkir di pasar, agak bingung untuk lokasi-lokasi karena tidak menjadi satu walau berdekatan, dan kalau kesini lebih baik hari weekday biar bisa foto tidak bocor. Apalagi pas di masjidnya juga tidak bocor.

Read up on the history of the place before you visit, lots of material online. I can imagine the splendor in its glory days but now inhabited by residents who are trying their very best to keep the commune safe, clean and charming. 

I hired a local guide on location and he took me through various alleyways, well worth.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
actually this castle cover area larger than what we ussually see in the picture. if you have long time to explore, you should also go to Ruang Meditasi (meditation room), Masjid Tangga Lima / sumur gumuling (Mosque with 5 floor) and the water castle- ask the local about the location, because it also merged with civilian houses

the local sometimes offering the tour service, they will tell you more about the detail
visited the area after the rain, with too many tourist inside, barely taking a good picture.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Terletak tidak jauh dari keraton jogya, kolam air yang dulunya dipakai mandi permaisuri dan putri raja, kini dapat kita saksikan dari dekat dan dapat kita rasakan.
Bentuk bangunan yang bercorak eropa, cina dan jawa menjadikan taman air ini tempat untuk berselfie ria dan wisata sejarah

One of the best city tour in jogja. Letaknya gak jauh dr pusat kota. Biaya masuk 10rb. Bisa milih pake guide atau ga. Istana air ini konon katanya tempat permandian bidadari. Dulu ini juga tempat tinggal raja, jadi para selirnya mandi di kolam ini, rajanya bisa melihat dari bentengnya dan memilih yg selir mana yg menemaninya dgn cara melempar bunga. Gitu sih kalo gak salah, habis kitanya masuk gak pake guide sih 😂😂
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Pas masuk kesini saya merasa terkagum-kagum, terutama dari segi arsitektur bangunannya. mikir keras gimana jaman dulu ngebangunnya. terutama yang lorong-lorong panjang, gimana dulu bikinnya. terus membayangkan semisal di filmkan dengan serius pasti kita bisa melek sejarah, kayak sejarahnya korea =))
If you are around, do not skip this palace which was a "hiding" place for the former sultan and his wife . It's also nice to make pictures, but you wont be the only one :)
This is the former royal garden of the Sultanate of Yogyakarta. Aside from its history, it's an interesting place to meet locals.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: You can take lots of pictures with the beautiful background of Tamansari "Water Castle" . The best part of this place is the swimming pools well maintained and clean. It's a showcase only. The rest of Palace are run downs and nothing to see. If wanted to know more about the history of this place. You can consider engage a local guide with a fees.  We only spend 45 mins walking around the palace grounds. Entrance fees for foreigners is IDR 15k pax.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
술탄이 40명의 여자를 거느리고 향락을 즐겼다고 하는 곳
 현지인 입장료보다 외국인 입장료가 약3배정도 더 비싼데 그만한 가치가 있는지는 모르겠다...
 근처에 있다면 가겠지만 멀리 있다면 찾아가지는 않을것 같다

Istana pemandian raja dan permaisurinya. Terdiri dari beberapa bangunan dan kolam. Bangunannya kurang terawat. Banyak tour guide yang bisa kita mintai tolong untuk mengantar kita. Selain kolam, kita bisa masuk ke Sumur Gumuling, sumur ini sekarang sudah kering. Taman sari awalnya adalah danau seluas 12 ha yang sekarang sudah menjadi perkampungan sebanyak 3 kelurahan. Jika datang saat hari libur, maka akan sangat ramai dan kita tidak akan bisa menikmati tempat ini
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Guided tour is preferable here. You only pay 5K per person, paying for a guide should not be a burden. Since it was a very beautiful vast property with a lot of stories to be told. I thought the property was not big, I was wrong... it was grand and also contain a village. Beautiful alleys of houses, underground mosque, mysterious waterpark in such a humble property. It was neat and humble. Strollers were not recommended, too many stairs and low doors.
The parking was quite a headache though. Preferably going there by becak or Grab. And the mosque in front was unique too. The soko tunggal mosque, a mosque with only one pillars. Wish to comeback but with history lovers friends, it's hard to really appreciate this unique place with toddlers on your hip :-)
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Beautiful but expect lots of people here. Guides offering services but it's best if you do your own research

As other reviewers have suggested, read about the water palace before you go especially if you will not be engaging a guide.

The pools themselves are intriguing and beautiful. Unfortunately, the entire complex is not properly kept up. No map is provided for exploring the adjacent buildings. Follow the crowd. There is an fascinating underground mosque nearby. Not recommended if you are claustrophobic.

Be aware of the many young people who are taking selfies all over the place without regard to their own safety or that of others.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Como he dicho en el titular, es un sitio con encanto pero le falta mantenimiento, es una pena que esté todo sin pintar, a pesar de ello puedes hacerte una idea del uso que le daban a las instalaciones,de las mejores cosas de la ciudad de Yogyakarta.

Jika anda ingin mengunjungi wisata ini pastikan anda mengunjungi istana keraton terlebih dahulu agar anda mengetahui semua kebudayaan kesultanan secara keseluruhan. Semua bagus hanya saja perlu dilakukan perawatan secara menyeluruh agar bersih dan terawat.

Tamansari is a very interesting sight. I recommend to hire a guide. Without a guide you will miss the important details that give you an impression of the ancient beauty of this palace for the concubines and the children of the sultan.

Ce château est édifié avec des remparts abritant des bassins, des cours et des jardins. Certes un peu défraîchi mais assez original, sans atteindre les fastes architecturaux des cours européennes. C'est agréable de faire le tour du bassin, de passer des remparts aux cours intérieures. L'ensemble est plutôt reposant. Un bâtiment avec accès souterrain inclus dans la visite est situé à l’écart. Il faut traverser une zone habitable, accès par le souterrain. Notez que ce dédale de rues est très enchanteur, les maisons sont peintes avec une grande liberté, ce quartier regorge d’artistes et de créateurs en tout genre, et on y circule à pied, au mieux quelques scooters mais c’est fermé le soir par des grilles.
Zeker een van de toeristische hoogtepuntjes om gezien te hebben als je in Yogya bent. Je haalt het meeste uit je bezoek als je een gids neemt.

クラトンへ行った時に立ち寄りました。
「王様が水浴びをする女性たちを窓から眺めていた」。そんなエピソードに惹かれて、窓から沐浴場を眺めて見たり...。なかなか楽しめました。
日本語のできるガイドが頼んでもいないのに案内してくれたので、気持ちとして50000ルピア(500円程度)払いました。必要ない人は事前に「ガイドはいりません」と伝えた方がいいでしょう。
Not suitable for wheelchair travellers.  Hardly any signage so do take a guide with you.  Seems more like a village now rather than a castle except for the facade.
Great way to spend few hours.  We found a tour guide and he was great, made the experience much better.

untuk menikmati tempat wisata ini saya sangat merekomendasikan untuk menyewa private guide yang banyak menawarkan jasanya di daerah ini.
pintar2 lah mencari guide yang tulus, hehehee...

kenapa harus pakai guide? karena tempat wisata ini terbagi menjadi beberapa bagian yang letaknya agak berjauhan, dan sayang sekali kalau kesana tapi tidak mengetahui sejarah lengkapnya... selain itu, ya untuk berbagi rejeki dengan penduduk setempat lah, hehehe... menghormati kearifan lokal :)
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Das Water Castle ist kein wirkliches Schloss. Es ist eher ein verwinkeltes alternatives Viertel, teilweise mit tollen Grafitis einigen Ruinen und einer imposanten alten Moschee. Auch die kleinen Lädchen überzeugen man hat zwar keinen Überblick über das Gelände, aber es ist ruhig und man kann neugierig herum schlendern ohne dämliche Verkäufer, die einem ständig was andrehen wollen. Ein Besuch lohnt sich wirklich.

Taman sari adalah komplek peninggalan sejarah keraton yogyakarta. Terdiri dari benteng, tempat ibadah dan kolam renang yang dulu merupakan tempat rekreasi keluarga keraton. Lokasi dekat dengan keraton yogyakarta, tepatnya disisi barat antara alun-alun lor dan alun-alun kidul. Lokasi taman sari saat ini terdapat diantara rumah-rumah warga, yang secara khusus di design sebagai kampung wisata. Ada banyak cerita sejarah di masing-masing bangunan yang letaknya sedikit terpisah-pisah walau masih di satu kawasan. Tanpa adanya peta pada brosur yang diedarkan menjadikan pengunjung perlu bertanya dimana letak beberapa bangunan didalam brosur tersebut kepada petugas. Namun apabila pengunjung ingin lebih dalam memahami tentang sejarah taman sari, ada baiknya menggunakan jasa guide yang banyak tersedia di pintu masuk lokasi.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Na miejscu warto zapytać o darmowego przewodnika, w przeciwnym razie pracownicy próbują namówić na płatnego :) miejsce ciekawe, na miejscu można kupić pamiątki.

We made three in one - Kraton,  Tamansari and Sumur Gumuling. Between sultan palace and water palace (Tamansari) we took a Rickshaw . From Tamansari to Gumuling well it is just 200 m walk. It was nice and we were happy to be there.

Karena wisata prambanan, dan malioboro sudah pernah ibuku kunjungi. Akhirnya aku putuskan ngajak ibuku ke tamansari ini. Tiket masuk 5 ribu rupiah, kalo bawa DSLR tambah 3 ribu rupiah. Kemarin aku kesana pas weekday siang. Tapi tetep aja rame. Jadi mau foto kolam airnya secara eksklusif harus sabar banget. Oh ya, kalo main kesini harus rajin rajin tanya atau nyewa guide. Soalnya gada arah/ tanda panah yang jelas menuju objek objek lainnya.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Wenn man in der Nähe unterwegs ist, lohnt sich ein Abstecher durchaus. Witzig fanden wir vorallem, dass man durch das Wasserschloss durchlaufen kann und hinten in den Gassen des Quartiers wieder rauskommt. Dort kann man rumschlendern abseits des hektischen Stadttreibens.

the location is so hard to find, it is located in the middle of the citizen's houses. you must walk down the narrow alley and ask some citizens to arrive. some citizen will be your personal tour guide if you want them to.
관광지인데 더럽고 볼것도 딱히 없고 가이드해준다고 호객행위하는 아저씨들도 많고 근처에 있는 연결된 관광지들도 찾기 어려워서 여기만 가는건 비추합니다. 왕궁이나 알룸알룬에서 멀지않으니 겸사겸사 한날짜에 둘라보세요.
We hebben de oude stad met 2 gidsen op de scooter bezocht. Een unieke ervaring. Heel veilig door het drukke verkeer en dan een goede uitleg. Een aanrader om het op die manier te doen.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This attraction reminded me of Bath, England. It is slightly over-rated and the castle is not very well-maintained. It is definitely rich with history and definitely a good place for some nice photo shoot. The entrance fee is negligible, less than USD 1 per person.
More nicer than the keraton closeby. Its near malioboro also a must visit. The city trip is for in the morning until 3 oclock

Taman sari adalah kompleks taman rekreasi dari Sultan Jogja,  dan terakhir digunakan oleh Sultan HB III, dengan luas lebih kurang 8 Ha, tapi sekarang kompleks tersebut hanya tersisa taman sari berupa kolam air dan sumur gumuling, serta sedikit dari istana air.
Ciao, il sito è sicuramente carino e suggestivo ma non è nulla di eccezionale. Sicuramente è consigliata una guida che possa far apprezzare i segreti e gli aneddoti del sito.

Wisata sejarah kerajaan keraton Jogjakarta. Terdapat kolam air yg konon katanya tempat pemandian selir raja, apabila sanggup berjalan kita bisa menemukan lorong bawah tanah yang tembus ke masjid kuno. Namun sayang sudah padat penduduk abdi dalem Jogja, sehingga kita perlu menerka tiap lokasi tatanan bangunan kerajaan Jogja pada jaman dahulu
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Just an old abandoned king's pool place.. Old brick wall and abandoned pool.. Might be nice for artistic photoshoot, but thats all..

Joli édifice mais délabré : aucune information (comme souvent à Yogya). On ressent la splendeur passée à travers l'architecture du lieu mais rien de mirifique. La ballade dans les vieilles rues alentours permet de se perdre gentiment et de visiter la mosquée souterraine.

Kesana pas jam 3 kurang, ternyata ga bisa masuk ke pintu lima (itu yg hits.hahaa). Mungkin karena udh sore jg, sedih siiii. Tapi msh bisa poto ditempat lain yg view nya oke, kaya di kolam pemandiannya. Sayangnya disana kurang petunjuk, dr satu tempat harus ketempat mana.
Tp ada guide lokal, kalo mau ditemenin keliling. But i prefer jalan jalan sendiri 😄
Hier wordt geen toegangkelijk gevraagd. Het is om dit ook mee te nemen voor een bezoek naast de kraton.

Tamansari di komplek kraton Jogja, adalah situs bekas taman istana Keraton Ngayogyakarta Hadiningrat.

Taman ini dibangun pada zaman Sultan Hamengku Buwono I (HB I) pada tahun 1750an, luasnya lebih dari 10 ha, dengan sekitar 57 bangunan baik berupa gedung, kolam pemandian, jembatan gantung, kanal air, maupun danau buatan beserta pulau buatan dan lorong bawah air. 

Dari seluruh komplek, saat ini yang tersisa dan jadi tempat wisata bagian Taman Sari yang  berada di barat daya kompleks Keraton saja

Dan darii kompleks maupun bagian yang berada di Istana Air Taman Sari Yogya ada pemandian Umbul Binangun yang masih terlihat dalam keadaan utuh.

Konon katanya tempat ini pada zaman dahulu kala dijadikan tempat pemandian untuk sang ratu, putri-putri raja dan para bidadari raja. Banyak cerita beredar entah benar entah mitos.

Tapi membayangkan tahun 1700-an ada taman dan "spa and wimming pool" seperti tamansari, sungguh kehidupan putri-putri keraton yang luar biasa.

Ada rasa bangga, 
Ada sedikit terenyuh 

secara wisata, tentu nikmat
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Nice place but with rich history but very neglected by locals. Would be nice if they do something more than put few cocky guides at the entrance and sell as many tickets as they can.

Bangunan peristirahatan raja jogja yang masih tersisa, kolam air dan taman yang masih terjaga dan sumur gumulingnya, istana air banyak yang rusak karena gempa, sayang sekali, tour guide cukup baik menerangkan sejarah dr taman sari,lokasi dekat dengan keraton  bangunan sejarah dan suasana mistisnya  yg layak dikunjungi klu ke jogja

Unfortunately, the castle it’s not really good conditions. The places is running down with no maintenance at all.  Good spot to visit for less than one hour - you can find the information as history of the castle on Wiki travel for free

If it were cleaned up and maintained properly it would be really nice. But the water was quite dirty and stagnant looking, and the structures were empty and underwhelming. The catacombs and the locals were the best part by far.

It is a must to visit this water castle if you are in Yogyakarta. This is an absolute combination between history of culture and the amazing modern photo trend.

There is a hidden spot called "Sumur Gumuling" it is very near from this water castle you should ask locals around (or email me instead :D). If you can manage visit in weekdays it will be nice so that not so many people will appear in your photo
Palacio del Sultán con piscinas pero que tienen mantenimiento deficiente y por lo tanto no es unas visita recomendada.

Tamansari terkenal dengan pemandian para raja yang terletak ditengah2 kota Yogja disni kita bisa menikmati tempat sejarah kerajaan masa kejayaan mataram dan bukti nyata dunia kerajaan yang sekarang ini sangatlah jarang ditemui diberbagai daerah di indonesia. 

Bangunan dengan nilai seni tinggi dan sangat kental dengan kearifan lokal, selain itu terdapat masjid bawah tanah yang sekarang difungsikan untuk objek wisata, berfoto disana sangat bagus nyesel kalo gak mampir kesini
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It's a pretty nice place to visit! However, the highlight of the Tamansari is quite a walk away from where you first enter and we spent some time trying to locate it. Go at non-crowded timings for photos!

Die Anlage ist ganz okay, man kann schöne Bilder schiessen und die Ruhe geniessen (es gibt nicht sehr viele Touristen). Leider wird die Anlage nicht wirklich gut unterhaltet, weshalb es zum Teil etwas verdreckt und alt / heruntergekommen aussieht (man könnte echt viel daraus holen!). 
Ist nich eine empfehlenswerte Sehenswürdigkeit, wenn man aber genug Zeit und Lust hat, würde ich einen Besuch empfehlen. 

TIPP: in der Nähe gibt es ein Künstlerviertel, und beim Künstlerviertel gibt es eine "Underground"-Moschee, welche man unbedingt besuchen sollte (wenn man ja schon da ist).

Disini better pake tour guide, supaya tauk tentang history bangunan, sampai mesjid bawah tanah tsb. Kalo ndak pake tour guide ya bgt aja hanya untuk foto2 gth. Tenang soal fee tour guidenya seikhlasnya kita aja ko. Trs karena kemarin lagi agak ramai disini kita gak terlalu lama, untuk foto kita gak dapet yg ok. Krn bapak tour guide kurang bisa (alesan hihihi)dan antri untuk gantian foto. So far tempatna oke, puas jadi tauk cerita ttng bangunan tsb, trs untuk yg mudah lelah untuk ke mesjid bawah tanah itu agak jauh, tapi sepanjang jalan menuju ke mesjid bawah tanah kita bisa liat2 warga2 sekitar, bisa beli oleh2 juga (kaos, lukisan tangan), dan tips satu lagi disini WAJIB nunduk2 hehe... Ini juga ada history nya. Makanya dateng dan pake tour guide
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Sebaiknya lebih diperhatikan lagi kebersihan walaupun bangunan tua kalau perawatannya bagus jadi terlihat lebih layak.
Tempat wisata sejarah yang menarik untuk di kunjungi di Jogja , merupakan kawasan petilasan pada zaman dahulu.

Este es uno de los sitios de interés en visitar; la entrada es barata; un pequeño edificio con varias alcobas donde se alojaba el rey en sus ratos de ocio. Dos estanques y poco más. Mal conservado. Para pasar un rato, sin más.
its really run down. although you could get a couple of good pictures from certain angles. overall dont expect too much.

Taman sari merupakan istana tempat mandi putri keraton. Di dalam kompleks istana ada tamanair yang indah dan terjaga keasliannya sejak jaman dulu. Setelah mengelilingi komplek kolam, anda harus menyusuri perkampungan untuk ke situs tangga 5 yang indah. Wajib di kunjungi dengan menggunakan guide biar tahu sejarah dan filosofinya
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: delabre , mal fleche tenant du jeu de piste pour arriver a l endroit ou les 4 escaliers en sous sol se rejoignent , bonne activite a faire par temps pluvieux , sinon pour etre honnete ca ne vaut pas le deplacement
Siang hari ke taman sari lumayan panas.. tiket masuk yang cukup murah tidak melebihi 10 ribu rupiah, kamu sudah bisa masuk ke dalam wisata istana air taman sari.

We went here after visiting the Sultans Palace. It is very close :-). One of the locals guides asked if he could be our guide and we accepted. He was very usefull! Told us a lot of interesting things and showed is a lot of interesting places. He was also great at taking pictures. The water Castle had a lot of hidden places not so easy to find on your own. Back then when it was full of water, it must have been amazing! Nice architecture! The guide didnt have a fixed price, you give him what you think he's worth. Of you have some spare time in Yogyakarta, would definitly recommend going here
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Ramen Sari of het waterkasteel dateert uit 1758 was vooral een recreatie en bad gelegenheid voor de Sultan en zijn familie bij het complex hoort ook Sumur Gumeling een ondergronds stelsel van gangen

walking inside Tamansari is magical, you enter into another world where is nice to take some pictures, relax walk around and trying to have an idea of the comfort they had inside this huge building ! if you are in Jogya is a MUST see place to spend about 1 hour!!!
Wisata sejarah paling keren kalo kita pake guide jadi gak sekedar jalan dan foto aja. Asli banyak keuntungan kalo pake guide. Banyak tempat yang bisa di explore.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: If you're curious what this place is, hmm.. Just keep your curiosity there. Visit this place if you have no other place to go in Yogyakarta.
It's a nice spot for photo and has an interesting and unique history where the Sultan (King) can observed from a tower on his wives taking a bath in the pool, before he chooses one of them.. 🙄

Nice building, but pretty dull. 3 not maintained pools, walls about to fall and not much story around it u less you are with a guide who can tell more.
The area around it though is really nice: narrow little street with little shops.

After visiting the Kraton, the Tamansari palace is logical next sight to visit, as it is at walking distance.  However, the only two reasons to go are the courtyard with the pond (which you see in all the pictures of the palace) and the underground mosque.  Apart from that, it's a maze of shabby houses, many of which act as little shops to attract the tourists coming there.  As a distraction after visiting the main Kraton, this can make sense, but it's not a "must see".

The place is interesting but in all honestly it’s poorly maintained, somehow dirty... overall, we were not impressed but were glad we quickly stopped by before our trip to a different archeological site.

Tempatnya masih terawat.
Bagus. Tapi sayang, untuk exit dari tempat ke tempat parkir, masih membingungkan.

This is a must see but I couldn’t stop thinking how much better it would have been if it were better preserved/maintained. Talk to a guide before you hire, you may not be able to understand him, mine rushed me through.

Solo vale la pena si te sobra tiempo en Yogya. Esta sucio, descuidado y solo hay un estanquillo a medio llenar con un chorrillo de agua. Solo visitar si te pilla de paso o realmente no tienes nada mas que hacer.

Tempat peninggalan sejarah Kraton Yogya. Didalamnya terkesan agak kurang terawat dan suram. Ketika agak mendung jadi terasa mistis. Masuk kesana kita juga diarahkan untuk berjalan2 di area kampung sekitar taman sari. Baik untuk menambah wawasan tapi pemeliharaan perlu ditingkatkan agar taman sari terlihat apik resik dan segar.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
It’s a complex of multi purpose aside from a religious place and bathing, it’s also a defense area and a shelter. 
Worth the tour and a must visit place. Get a local guide and a minimal tips will do for a 30 mins tour.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Not a must do but something to do once you've seen the other temples and are just looking to walk around the city.

Ik vond het minder mooi dan verwacht. Je moet er heen om je er een voorstelling van te maken maar ik vind de staat van het gebouw een beetje jammer. Er ligt geen rotzooi ofzo maar overal zit smeer op de
Muren enzovoorts. Het viel me een beetje tegen.

Tickets cost 15,000 entry and the ground were very nice to walk around. 

It was mainly pretty buildings with the lake, which made for good photos. There were many people doing lots of photo shoot selfies - a lot of people were there. 

It was enjoyable though, I would recommend it.

Jalan menuju ke sini agak macet. Terdapat perbedaan harga antara turis domestik dan internasional. Tempat yang bagus untuk foto, ada di dalam lorong dan di sekitar tangga. Cuma mesti sabar antri untuk foto di sekitar tangga, karena ramai sekali yang mau foto di spot itu.

Visto il Kraton non avevo molte aspettative anche per questo sito..infatti non c'è molto da vedere , e poi vi abbiamo trovato un sacco di gente. 
Più affascinante la parte della cisterna sotterranea un pò distaccata dalle vasche, molto fotogenica e particolare..

Hired a guide for IDR50k but he didn't do a great job. Perhaps just because my friends and I are unlucky. He didn't bother explaining every single building/spots of interest, rather he tried to sell us batiks and even brought us to his brother's T-shirt shop! Although the shopping stops are fine, this is still not a great place to carve out time for.

Wir haben uns einen Tag genommen um uns das Zentrum von Jogya anzuschauen. Dabei waren wir auch im Waterpalace. Die Gebäude sind sehr imposant und interessant, aber der Zustand und die Sauberkeit lassen sehr zu wünschen übrig. Vieles könnte viel schöner präsentiert werden.....daher gut mal zu sehen, aber nicht wirklich empfehlenswert

My husband and I asked to be dropped off here by our private driver we hired to see Borobudur.  When we arrived, we spent half an hour meandering around, not really knowing where to go.  The site is somewhat sprawling and signage is quite lacking.  We ended up finding some of the bathing pools, and tried our best to navigate anything, until a random guide (not sure if official) approached us and offered to show us around for a reasonable "donation".  He was quite informative and friendly, but he did take us to a Luwak coffee place that he likely gets some kind of commission from.  The buildings and history turned out to be very interesting, and the experience was overall pretty good, but that first 30 minutes of trying to understand what was where was such a headache.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Most tourists visit Yogyakarta for Borobudur Temple and Prambanan Temple, Water Castle may be the next best before you leave. The design of this attraction is unique so it is well worth the time during city tour. It's a few minutes' walk from Sultan Palace. The two attractions could be visited together on a fine day. If you are keen in history, it has so much to offer.
The main pools are beautiful under strong daylight even it could be hot for some. Entry ticket is required but it's cheap comparing to the temples'.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It's a old swimming pool of yogyakarta's sultan. The architecture very unique. No one place in indonesia like this.
Petit tour sympa à l'intérieur et si vous avez le temps perdez vous dans les ruelles derrieres vous trouverez la mosquée souterraine.

The water castle itself is nothing much, but many come to the water castle seeking the Gumuling well. There are no signs showing directions and you will need to walk to the streets (from inside the compounds of the castle). I just follow the crowds and come upon the entrance by chance. 

Once at the well, everyone have to wait for their turn to take photos. As i am a solo traveler with no guides, its hard to take photos by myself.

Zinder voorstelling op aanraden van onze gids hier naar toe. Als je niets voor ogen hebt kan het alleen maar meevallen. Het was een bijzondere plek die dringend opgeknapt miet worden maar wel de charme van het verleden heeft. Zeker even bezoeken, zoals alles is de entree hier ook goedkoop.
以前蘇丹國王的住宿，建築物壯觀拍照很美，門票不貴，價格較親民，周遭也有不少咖啡廳和小商店可以逛街，買紀念品。
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Interesting story around how the earthquakes and volcano eruptions have destroyed so much of the original structures partially restored by the Portuguese, we never found the underground tunnel to the sultan’s palace
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Not worth the time and fees. A boring structure . One safely spend much more time at the nearby Kraton and its performances.
Maklum kunjungan sy hari Minggu, peak level, berdesak2an dong...byk sampah, jgn harap nyaman seperti di foto2nya
Richtig viel zu sehen gibt es hier nicht. Das eigentlich zum Sultanspalast gehörende Wasserschloss bietet jedoch einige schöne Fotomotive. Von daher lohn sich ein Besuch.
It was nice to see the buildings and the pool, however be aware of the numerous scammers hanging around.
Datang kesini rasa stres langsung berkurang, suasana asri dan nyaman ditambah lagi lokasinya yg Instagram mabel banget buat betah ambil poto2 bagus
Objek foto banyak vintage, cocok banget dgn identik jogja, sejarahnya nyangkut banget, pokoknyaaa keren, jaman dulu bisa kebuat kolam mandi raja permaisuri dan selir, ada masjid di bawah tanah keren
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The place is very big (not just the pool area). The history about this place makes me want to stay longer.

Pak Wisnu, has provided us with good service especially recommended us to visit Mt Merapi ground base by jeep to see the village damaged during volcano eruption, it is good experience for us to view the destruction caused by it.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Berjalan jalan di situs peninggalan, pesanggrahan sultan yang sudah hampir tak terlihat karna dijadikan pemukiman oleh warga, namun keindahan dan legenda tamansari tidak hilang dari sejarah dan destinasi wisatawan...memang agak sulit mencari jalan untuk melihay situs situsnya kalau kita tidak ditemani pemandu, apalagi kalau masuk melalui pintu belakan dari arah malioboro...
Buat temen temen yg mau jalan jalan ke taman sari sebaik nya banyak bertanya dengan pemandu supaya mendapat cerita sejarah yg lebih utuh...
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Ehemaliges Lustschloss des Sultans. Schöner Ort zum Träumen, wie das damals wohl war. Man kann schöne Fotos schießen. Interessant ist auch das Künsterviertel unmittelbar hinter dem Palast.

Visit during weekend will be a bad idea.. so many people.. you can not have a clear picture when taking photo's. The site maintenance is very bad.. local authorities really misfortune the huge potential of this historical property.. don't know what to say more....
王様のプール、沐浴場との事ですが、壁も水も汚れていて残念でした。建物は観光地としては充分価値があると思いますので、管理？、というか清掃ですね。ちゃんとして欲しいです。
Iets minder (Europese) toeristisch dan de standaard plekken, meer Indonesische toeristen. Leuk om even doorheen te lopen als je wat tijd over hebt!

Tempatnya luas banget. Disana banyak tempat yang bisa dikunjungi dan bagus buat foto2. Ada 2 pintu masuk. Bisa lewat gerbang utama. Atau bisa lewat pasar. Kl yang lewat pasar, tidak terlihat jadi harus tanya2 k orang sekitar
During our city tour it was part of it. We didint spend much time there, paid the entrance walked around and left. You can take some pictures there but it's not a hot spot of Yogya.

The King in a watch tower watching princesses taking a bath and choosing who he will sleep with seems like an unlikely co-location with an underground mosque. Made me feel sad at the lack of care in the maintenance and frustrated with the people that wanted millions of photos of themselves at every possible spot but still worth a visit.

There is a big pond the moment u enter the water castle. It’s a nice place for photoshop. The place not too big. The door is pretty low as I bang onto one as I didn’t realised it was that low. Hahahaha.

Ditempat ini sangt direkomendasikan jika anda kuat berjalan kaki karena akan berjalan sekitar 1km untuk dapat masuk kearea bawah tanah yang menjadi spot paling bagus di komplek taman sari ini, jangn hawatir diarea parkir terdapat kios penjual minuman dan makanan ringan

I was really surprised to read that this is allegedly under consideration for UNESCO status. It's okay, but when you're in a city which boasts the likes of Borobudur and Prambanan, this is insignificant and, to be honest, quite run down. 

As I exited the grounds I got talking to a family who were making batik and they showed me the process of how it is made which was far more interesting than the Tamansari and the underground mosque.
Waaahhh kesini tak bisa dilupakan keren dan unik buat photo" wisata nambah pemahaman tentang kraton dan ikut kesuasana jaman dahulu ...
Geeft goed beeld van het leven van de Sultan en zijn vrouwen. Zwembaden, bijgebouwen, alles is vrij toegankelijk.
Un incantevole palazzo con degli scorci meravigliosi da fotografare e farsi fotografare. Dedicate almeno un'oretta alla visita ne vale davvero la pena!
Liked it a lot ! I found a guy there that was very great and show me the different aspect of the palace.

Ancient and traditional water castle in Yogya Heritage

Traditional road of Abdi Dalem Yogya

An unique landscape with underground Mosque
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
If you are in Yogyacarta witn nothing to do, you might consider a visit here but it's not that good. 

Very small, not that prety...

I did not take a guide when i went there. maybe it would be inzeresting to know something about the history.. but anyways, this place is just beautiful. sad thing about it is (but its like everywhere you go in Yogya) foreigners pay muuuch more than indonesian/asian people. Still worth to go there. Its like a holiday from the big-city trouble

To understand the place better, you should get a guide...they are local people who are volunteer to be the tour guide but if you want, you can give them some tips...I would suggest our tour guide, Pak Yuni.... he is very good in explaining about the compound and you will be attracted towards the story especially the late of King-9...
À visiter situé dans le Kraton jolis bassins, vaut le détour, avec le Palais du Sultan à côté , ouvert seulement la matin jusqu'à 14 h.
Yoi! Belum lengkap bgt kalo ke Jogja gak mampir ke Taman Sari. Apalagi ada spot yang nongol di iklannya Agoda jadi makin familiar tempatnya.

This place only about historical story of place Kesultanan Yogyakarra. First come u must buy the ticket and also better rent the guide so u will know the story about that place from the guide.  Each things of there fully moment of the event was. Carefully of your wallet,  cause there is thief, better keep your bag front of you. Nice place to take picture in every spot. If you come to Jogja,  don't missed for coming to this place!!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: A pesar de que según nos contaron había sido remodelado, la verdad que podrían darle una capa de pintura y tener las limpias las piscinas, que para eso son piscinas y no charcas. La verdad que porque la visita que contratas incluye tanto el palacio del agua como el palacio del sultán, pero sinceramente no merece la pena su visita.

If you're in a rush, don't visit.
It only costs 10.000 idr. Really cheap and it will maybe take you an hour to get through. There are no signs about the different things, so you will have to read it from the paper you get at the entrance. 
Really nice if you have the time.
Lieu à faire bien évidemment, toujours ce manque d'informations mais on peut se débrouiller sans guide. Prix raisonnable
Place wasnt very special; we got there rigjt before closing (which was quite early/surprised us) but not too much to see in the 'castle'.

1st time kesitu dan langsung jatuh cinta..Tempat ini sangat indah, kebayang dlunya pasti lebih indah lagi.

Menurut cerita penjaga, kolam yang diluar buat mandi selir, dan kolam didalam yang ada di foto saya itu buat mandi permaisuri dan anak-anaknya..saat masuk ke kolam permaisuri saya berasa dejavu spt pernah melihat tempat itu sebelumnya (padahal itu pertama kali saya kesitu)

It was our last day and since we had time to spare, we decided to visit the water castle and tour the place on our own. The attraction is unlike a museum, it does not have self-explanatory exhibits or boards so nothing made sense to us. Get a guide if you're really interested to learn more about its history.

Ich würde eine 3,5 geben. 
Die Wasserbecken sind zwar ganz nett angelegt, aber das Wasser ist schmutzig und man hat auch in 10 Minuten alles gesehen. Es war nichts atemberaubendes.
Trotzdem ganz schön und die 1,50 €schon wert.
Un site historique qui vaut le détour. Les piscines sont magnifiques, le cadre pittoresque. Juste à côté du Palais de Sultan, il faut le visiter.

沐浴場で沐浴している乙女を塔の上から王様が品定めして、気に入った女性に花束を投げて一緒に床を共にしたり、沐浴したりしたというロマンチックというか、エロチックな伝説の残る王家の沐浴場。実は地下通路があって要塞としても使えたらしい。
今はなぜか結婚式スポットになっているらしく訪問時も一組の新婚夫婦が結婚式を挙げていた。それなりに清涼感はあるものの施設は古いので、伝説を知らないとただの池と古い建物で終わってしまうかも。

Un endroit trèc calme, loin du tumulte, que j'ai visité un jour de grosses chaleurs (donc apréciable!).
C'est une visite sympatique mais sans doute pas indispensable (je l'ai faire sans guide, peit etre une erreur?).

Prix de l'entrée (aout 2017) : 15000 Rp + 2000 Rp de droit photo

Yo no gastaría ni un minuto. No me gustó nada.
Muy agobiante con los tuc tuc.
Es curioso.  Pero vamos q creo q no merece la peba

Este sitio tiene dos "entradas"..una de pago y otra no. Más bien, tiene una entrada de pago, donde están todos los puestos en la calle, los taxis, etc...y luego tiene la salida, en el lado contrario, por la que puedes entrar con toda normalidad sin que nadie te pare, y evidentemente sin pagar.
Aunque como construcción es interesante, la verdad es que no tiene más que cuatro detalles decorativos y las piscinas. Es mucho más interesante la zona colindante.

This, I suppose, is the Yogya equivalent of UK's Roman Bath. Unfortunately, this place is dirty and not well-maintained. I'm not going to complain since the entrance fee is cheap. Additionally, despite its lack of maintenance and cleanliness, the place can look Instragram-worthy (even without filter). This can be toured for an hour or less. Learn how to say no to those persistent tour guides as the ticket booth can actually give you a brochure about the place.

족자카르타에서 대중교통 버스 타고 가볼만한 곳입니다. 바로앞까진 버스가 가진 않지만 근처까지가니 굳이 택시타고 갈필요없어요.
다만 표시가 잘되있질 않아서 길찾기가 조금 힘들었어요. 벽화들이 그려진 마을을 지나 수무르  구물링이나오면 바로 근처에 타만사리가 있습니다.
입장료와 카메라요금이 따로있습니다.

Lasst euch von einem der Locals ruhig anquatschen, auch wenn im Nachhinein ein Batikgeschäft ansteht, muss ich für unseren Führer ein dickes Lob aussprechen. Sehr charmant, witzig und überhaupt nicht aufdringlich. 
Man merkt, dass in diesem Viertel Künstler Leben, die versuchen, sich mit ihrer Kunst über Wasser zu halten.
tempatnya tidak jauh, harga tiket masuk murah (sekitar 20rb sdh include kamera). banyak guide yang akan menawarkan jasa di pintu masuk.
Ja het 'kasteel' is ok. Even rondneuzen prima. Maar de parel ligt eigenlijk rondom deze konings spa. Het oude dorp, de moskee, de straatjes en de sultans ruïnes (worden nu opgeknapt). Fijn uitje!

Eerst het paleis bezocht en daarna het water paleis. Het stelt misschien niet heel veel meer voor, maar je kon nog wel zien dat het ooit erg mooi is geweest. Vonden het fijn dat we dit gezien hebben! 
De beeldhouwwerken dito er staan, zijn erg mooi!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Fomos sem grandes expectativas e gostamos muito do passeio. A construção é rica em detalhes e conta com cômodos muito interessante onde se pode tirar boas fotos! Além disso, é possível conhecer um pouco mais sobre o artesanato da região junto aos vendedores de Batik. Vale a pena conferir!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: 水上城堡就在日惹皇宮旁邊，通常逛完日惹皇宮後就會順便到水上城堡，當地人通常會熱心幫忙帶路，不過其實是想賺嚮導費。

This place is pleasant enough without reaching great heights. Don't miss the underground tunnel and complex, included in the entrance fee. It's not obvious so make sure you ask. A ticket costs IDR 15000 and gates open at 9 am.

To be honest, I will shamelessly admit that this place is a great place for IG-worthy shots! If all you ever wanted were pretty instagram shots, this place has to be it. You have dilapidated-looking buildings that make for a hipster-ish vibe IG photo. The underground mosque is a common spot for wedding photos and the water pools itself make gorgeous backdrops for photos. 

It's also located in the city and you can easily waste an hour in this spot to take your photos 😆

I've added some of my "IG-worthy" shots  to give you guys a rough idea 😂
Non perdete tempo dietro a questo e al Kraton. Poco interessante e ancora meno da vedere. In Indonesia c'è molto da vedere, ma non qui!
Passes half an hour, wasn't quite the most interesting or cared for temple. We ate some good pancakes from a stall near the back entrance!

Tempat ini bagus. Tiket masuk perorang 5.000 rupiah. Saat saya mengunjungi tempat ini ramai sekali. Mengunjungi tempat ini pun tergesa-gesa karena tutup jam 4 sore. Satu hal yang membuat saya tidak suka dengan staff yang kurang ramah.

I belive that this place was beautiful way back when.
However when we visited, it was dirty and not well-maintained. There was lots of garbage laying around. The buildings looked almost-abandoned. And there was a lot of messy food-stall outside of the complex.
It will look good in pictures, but other than that, I dont feel like this place is anything special (travelling-wise).

No es nada del otro mundo.. un palacio semi destruido con piscinas viejas. Es tan bajo el precio que vale la pena en 10 minutos lo tienes visto. No pagues más y menos por un tour! no os dejéis engañar!

We really liked our visit to the Water Palace, more so than our visit to the Kraton. We booked a guide at the entrance for 50.000 irp, and he told us a little about the sultan and his concubines. He also lef us to the underground mosque, but we had to stop at his batik shop first. There was no pressure to buy anything though, and we didn't. All in all a nice visit.
nice restoration but less maintenance, it should be maintain properly due to number of tourist who would like to see the Royal Heritage

Pertama kali memasuki taman sari, saya langsung kagum dengan keindahan tempat pemandiannya,, tapi setelah itu saya bingung mau kemana lagi, situs menyatu dengan perkampungan, tidak banyak keterangan dari lokasi ini. Membingungkan, berkeliling tanpa arah yang jelas, bahkan untuk keluar dari lokasi inipun tidak ada petunjuknya.saya berkeliling cukup lama supaya bisa keluar dari lokasi ini.  Sebenarnya situs bersejarah ini sangat bagus, sayang lokasi dan penataannya kurang.  membuat bingung wisatawan.

Dit is een mooie plek om gezien te hebben. Het waterpaleis is wel vrij klein qua oppervlaktw dus je hebt het zo gezien.
Wel goed te combineren met de ruïne die vlakbij ligt.

Entah saya yg salah parkir dari awal atau memang papan petunjuknya kurang saya juga bingung. Dari loket ke tamansari pertama memang dekat namun ke yg kedua itu sangat membingungkan karena tidak ada papan petunjuk. Kita harus memasuki gang gang rumah penduduk. Harga tiket masuk Rp. 5000. Sepadan dengan yg didapatkan.
It's just too crowded on the weekend. I suggest to Visit on weekdays, so you can explore peacefully.

To understand Water Castle, you must get a good guide to take you around. It is important to know the history before you can really imagine the entire Water Castle concept because the lake around the castle has been filled with lots of residence.

場所自体はそれほど大したことはなかった。
洞窟モスクの場所が分からず少しさまよっていたが、
親切なおばあさんがタダで案内してくれた。
1ヵ月ほど日本に来てたことがあるらしい。
小さな屋台をやっていたので、ジュースくらいは買ってあげたけど、感謝。

Visit Taman Sari early in the morning. It opens at 08:30 but if you go there at 08:00 and find a guide to take you through the old castle. Without a guide you miss much information like the old lake and small harbour which was used by the sultan.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Ruim opgezet paleis waar je een half uurtje rustig kan doorbrengen. Het was wel vrij druk toen wij er waren.

Wir sind - nicht wissend - außerhalb der Öffnungszeiten dort gewesen . Wir haben netter weise eine privatführung von einem Herren bekommen der dort wohnt . Wir sind mit ihm durch die Gärten spaziert und er hat uns die Geschichte näher erläutert . Wir haben dann einen Blick auf den Innenhof werfen dürfen . Es war nicht recht sauber aber interessant zum anschauen . Es hat einen Shop dabei , die Bilder die es zu kaufen gibt sind günstiger als in der Stadt da die Leute dort Steuerbefreiung genießen.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Bonito lugar con jardín, excelente comida Internacional, Indonesia y Española con muy buen precio
Excelente trato de los dueños Javier y Diana gran cocinera
Una sorpresa encontrar un lugar así en Indonesia
The place is beautifully decorated and well maintained. Because of time constraint, we only spend less than an hour here

While it once was a great hang out, now its a poor maintained place. 
Avoid going here as you won't mis anything at all. Even taking a nice photo it not worth it or even possible
Es una visita corta pero que merece mucho la pena. Precioso. No olvideis sacar foto desde dentro de la ventana hacia la piscina. Está cerca de Malioboro pero hay que desplazarse en mototaxi.

Sinceramente non sono riuscita ad apprezzare questo luogo in quanto manca qualsiasi riferimento o cartello che ne indichi cosa.si sta vedendo e quale.percorso seguire.
Abbiamo.anche perso la.strada perché i cartelli fanno uscire per una stradina secondaria in mezzo a piccoli ristoranti e negozi di souvenir.
A faire avec un guide pour rendre le site plus intéressant......... Pas trop cher, on a obtenu un guide francophone pour 30 Rp
seru banget keliling disini dari permukaan atas, sampai ke gorong gorongnya bagus buat foto foto. sayang kalau kesini ga bawa kamera yg proper untuk foto low light.

la visite n'a rien à voir avec les belles photos que vous verrez un peu partout, deux entrées, une mosquée souterraine, des bassins d'eau sans ornements particuliers, état d'entretien très moyen, la ville gagne peu à peu l'intérieur du temple ce qui laisse un sentiment de perplexité
Il n'y a pas des tonnes de choses à visiter a Jogja (dans la ville meme), parmi les endroits où je suis allée ce palace est celui qui a le plus retenu mon attention. Bel endroit.

Pese a ser la segunda atracción de la ciudad, no merece la pena pues no es más que un palacete con piscinas abandonadas y fachadas desconchadas.
Se ve en 20 minutos pagando 1 euro.

The original buildings are now in the middle of a kampong which is interesting too, for a tourist but not what you would expect when visiting the the water palace. Like many of the sights in Indonesia, very busy with domestic tourists in August.

I was very underwhelmed by this site. It has not been well maintained and is not spectacular in any way. If they are going to charge and bring tourists here at least clean up the water in the pools. To me, this is not a must see site.

Fun and nice place for learn about javanese culture, architecture, and history of Jogjakarta Sultanate. The ticket is cheap. There was guide who willingly tell the story and walk you around the water castle, and even help you to take the picture 😁
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Mengunjungi tempat ini akan membayangkan keindahan dan kemegahan Kesultanan Jogjakarta pada masanya. Honestly saya senang disini karena tempatnya yang artistik dan dipenuhi sejarah. Untuk para wisatawan yang ingin mengexplore Jogjakarte wajib kesini, karena instagramable banget

The place was not well maintained and I felt that it could have been better. Pool had green water and some fountains were not working. I have no idea why the management would charge for this place. Honestly, I would not recommend this place to my friends. No picture worthy spot either.

Tamansari merupakan destinasi yang menyenangkan untuk keluarga. Pemandu disana benar2 menceritakan dengan lengkap historis Tamansari secara lengkap dan menarik. Kisah para sultan dan selir yang dikemas dengan apik oleh pemandu, bentuk bangunan asli yang nampak rusak beberapa karena erupsi merapi menceritakan kisahnya sendiri. Bangunan lawas yang penuh cerita, spot foto etnik, serta penduduk sekitar yang sangat ramah. Salah satu destinasi wajib di Yogyakarta.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It was a nice place and cheap, 5k for locals. I was alone and It's not a good choice believe me. I need sign 😭 like where should I go if I want to go to the tunnel, etc

its fun & excited been here especially when you hear the story telling from the guide.
suggested you walk around the castle with guide whereby he could explain & tells the story about it. 
its cost very low for the official guide(standby at the entrance with uniform) or unofficial guide(standby inside the castle with name tag).
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Als fester Bestandteil unserer Rundreise stand die Besichtigung der Überreste des Wasserschlosses Raman Sari auf dem Programm. Mit ein bisschen Vorstellungskraft kann man erahnen, wie zur Blütezeit die Damen des Palastes sich hier erfrischt und vergnügt haben. Ein wenig Farbe und eine Grundreinigung der Becken würden dem heutigen Besucher ein viel schöneres Bild bieten.

We zijn er geweest, maar als we het van te voren geweten hadden, waren we niet gegaan. Mag een stukje geschiedenis hebben, maar is nu toch een wat onderkomen gebeuren met veel groen water. Een opknapbeurt zou op zijn plaats zijn als je dit een attractie wilt blijven noemen. We hadden hier geen gids genomen, maar dan kom je ook niet veel te weten, nergens enige aanduiding of dergelijke
Bello è una scoperta nella scoperta oltre la vasca bellissima ma non tenuta bene ci sono anche le cisterne sotterranee da non perdere bellissimo girare in mezzo alle case
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: This place is inside The Kraton. Your heckled in here. Fantastic local batik artist display for sale at good prices. Disappointed the pools were filthy with rubbish and green slimy water. Fantastic history.

Worth the visit if you have some time left in yogyakarta but it's not that spectacular. A lot of tourists and the place is not very well maintained. They explain if they was the bath of the sultan but it has lost its glory...
Although very brief, I enjoyed my visit. I got a bit turned around, but I still enjoyed seeing the architecture and history associated with the castle.

Comme pour le palais, ça se visite mais ne vous laissera pas un souvenir inoubliable ... 
Juste pour la ballade.

Nice and cheap visit, but there are so many tourists. 
I liked the water basins and the architecture. Definitely a place to visit in Yogya, very central.

Обязательно берите гида! А то будет ничего не понятно, а половину вообще не найдете. Раньше постройки Водного дворца были островками в искусственном озере, а теперь там везде кварталы старого города, где черт ногу сломит - для этого-то гид и нужен. Вам будут впаривать батик и кукол ваянг. Я купила куклу за 40€ - подозреваю, что это чрезвычайно дорого. На просмотр час-полтора достаточно.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Wel aardig om gezien te hebben. Wij hebben zonder gids rond gelopen en dan is er niet veel aan. Met gids is beter denk ik! Vervallen staat.

Hierher lohnt es sich zu fahren. Das wunderschöne Wasserschloss ist zwar schon reichlich in die Jahre gekommen und hätte eine Renovierung dringend nötig. Aber man kann den Charme noch spüren, den das Schloss einst versprüht hat. Und man kann die Damen und den Sultan förmlich sehen, wie sie das Wasser genießen. Arg groß ist es nicht. Aber eben wunderschön.

Rushed down here after trip to Cave Jomblang. Managed to find my way to the castle (thanks to the local guide who bring along while he guiding his group). The castle mainly a ruined castle, overheard was destroyed by the earthquake. It supposed to be covered by water (now become village). Hence, can't really know how to appreciate the beauty of it as it looks to me a complete ruined building

We had read a few reviews before and unsure whether to go or not. We decided to go as going to a restaurant down the road for lunch. Entry is cheap at 15,000 although tried to charge me 100,000 for having a camera rather than give me change for 50,000. I stated I did not have a camera (as I didn't) and to give me my change. 

We enjoyed a brief walk around and it is a nice spot for some pictures but only a little bit of water in the fountains, although they are still very beautiful to see.

If your interested in history then this may be more to your liking but for us it took less than 30 mins to make our way around. This may have been as we were up at 3am to do the sunrise tour at Borobudur and tired but unlikely to have spent more than an hour at this sight otherwise.

My advice if not interested in history then it is worth a visit if passing otherwise can give it a miss.

Tamansari or water castle is one of famous atraction in jogjakarta. Close to kraton jogjakarta around 1,5km distance. Ticket entrance about 5k idr for local, and 12k for foreigner. If you bring your camera you need pay extra about 2k idr. Hmm well, in the begining i didn't feel special about this place. But the story behind it intereting for me. From entrance you will see a normal pool not really pool actually, but surrounding by unique staff. In the past time, tamansari is one of the favorite place for family of kraton to spend the day. There is a praying place, a pool, tower, castle, and tunnel. Something make me interesting is when i can't find the famous instragamable tunnel, actually the tunnel a lil bit hidden somewhere of the castle. If you want find it quickly then better you hire the tour guide, because they will show you the tunnel with show the direct way. But , if you are an adventure person like me, try not to hire the guide. Just follow the street surrounding the castle then i am sure you will find it. It was hard but not really hard to find it, just interesting and fun like play in the maze. Then when you find it, be happy and be patient wait until your turn to take a pics, always a lot people come there. 👱👱
Although it is on the list of places to visit when in Yogyakarta, it is not very impressive and quite deteriorated; It really is unfortunate because it actually could be quite spectacular.
Erg verstopt in één van de kampongs. Te bereiken via kleine straatjes. Leuk om de geschiedenis achter dit waterpaleis te horen en de streken die de sultan daar uithaalde.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Solo entré porque tenía la mañana libre. Se cobra entrada que, aunque para un occidental sea económica, no vale más que para tomar un par de fotos y retirarse. Lamentablemente muy mal conservado...

This was a nice enough way to spend an hour or two, wandering the ancient buildings, but there was little variation in each stone room. A simple leaflet is provided to explain the layout but other than that, information to enhance the walk around was limited. We were hoping to see the Sultan's palace as well but we were saddened to hear from a local that it would be closed until the afternoon due to the army training there. As we had an afternoon tour booked, we were disappointed that the walk ended here. Be careful of helpful 'locals' offering to show you to a free exhibition of art from the local art school...the quiet roads they try to walk you down are slightly suspicious and there is a warning in a local art shop that there is no exhibition so not sure where they were trying to lead us.
Petite visite incontournable au coeur de Yogyakarta, à deux pas du palais du Sultan. Ensemble de bassins servant autrefois aux princesses Javanaises de Yogyakarta, lieu rafraîchissant et calme.
We went there on July with our teenager daughters and surprisingly we saw lots of interesting things inside it. Thanks to our friendly local guide.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Visite tres simple mais charmante de ces bassins ou le sultan se baignait avec l'une de ses 21 femmes
On s'y croirait !
Plutôt cool après la visite du palais un peu décevante et vieillotte

We visited Tamansari early morning in order to avoid big groups and young "selfie-stick-soldiers" trying to gain followers on Instagram. The story behind Tamansari is interesting, however most of it needs to be restored (planned 2018) in order to show its full beauty. So currently it does not need that much time to walk through and see what can be seen. I assure there are more beautiful and interesting places to visit here. 

Enjoy!

Liked this place. But you need a guid, that will cost you 50.000. He will tell nice stories that will
make the place come alive!

Don't expect too much in terms of historical details or information about this place, as it is quite "abandoned" and there does not seem to be a reliable guide service, but the beautiful decadence  you can admire is fascinating...
Cool pics as well. I would keep one hour maximum for this place.
Visited this cafe a couple of times during our three days in yogya as they offer great value for money and attentive service. The nasi goreng there is delicious!

Berkunjung ke Istana Taman Air Taman Sari itu mempunyai pilihan. Bisa lewat Yang Gratis atau lewat yang Berbayar. Untuk yang berbayar kita diharuskan membayar retribusi 5ribu dan kamera yang dibawa 2ribu

Credo sia la peggiore attrazione culturale mai visitata in vita mia considerando che sono 4 mura rotte senza uno straccio di cartello che ne descriva la storia. È possibile prendere una guida locale a pagamento ma è rimasto ben poco da vedere della struttura originaria. Assolutamente NON lo consiglio.

As others have said, I actually enjoyed my visit here more than I expected! It's prettier than the pictures suggest. We managed to find areas of the whole complex with a guide. If you have some free time, give this place a go.

Sconsiglio visita se ci sono alternative migliori, non è difficile. Ora è praticamente un rudere ed è poco manutenuto, tanto è nascosto che ho fatto fatica a trovarlo nonostante abbia chiesto indicazioni due volte. È un peccato che un monumento del genere sia trascurato a questo livello. Quel poco di restauro che è stato fatto non ha assolutamente migliorata la situazione siamo praticamente a livello di completo abbandono.
Worth visiting! Is a pretty place and has some interesting history  My advice is to take a guide there, otherwise you will not know much about the place!

This place is well worth your times. It's interesting to learnt about the usage of each rooms and the structure of the place is just like a maze. I found the place quite crowded with locals as well. Keep your ticket with you as there will be various point-check by guard. Tour guide is available at point of entry and certain places inside the castle. Just walk away if they start to follow (tour) you or gently say no to them. Toilet outside of the castle are charged per entry so make sure you do your business while you're still inside.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Niente di che! Può interessare la storia di questo edificio ma di per se il tutto é molto deludente. Necessita di molti lavori di restaro e manutenzione. Nn mo ha colpito per nulla. Mentre lo visitavo il mio primo pensiero era:" ma quando esco da qua?"

tamansari watercastle is an old building that used by princess. you can find a lot of beautiful building with detail carving. you can also find underwater mosque called sumur gumuling. its better to hire a guide becaus eyou can learn all the story behind it. the route a little bit tricky and confusing. because its in the middle of village and you walk between to reach other spot.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Tempat wisata di tengah kota Yogyakarta, cocok buat traveller yang hanya wisata kota. Tempatnya tidak jauh dari pusat kota dan sentra kuliner gudeg. Biaya masuknya juga murah, hanya saja untuk berkeliling di wisata Taman Sari kita melewati gang2 perkampungan, kalau kita tidak memakai jasa pemandu wisata, bisa agak tersesat, tapi ikuti saja wisatawan yang lain...hehehe...bangunannya kurang terawat
Raise the price of admission and devote the money to maintenance. It would look so much better if the water was clean, the walls were painted and there was some greenery.
El castillo en si no vale mucho, pero es muy recomendable pasear por todas las callecitas estrechas que hay alrededor y que se pueden empezar a recorrer desde la salida del propio castillo.

If you want to know about the stories behind the place, getting a guide is the only option. Lots of people go there just to take pictures but I think having a guide that explains about the place will complete the experience.
Coincé au milieu de la ville l'endroit est extrêmement calme et donne l'impression de voyager de par ces murs blancs. Les couloirs sont autant de dédales qui invitent à la balade sans réel but.

Hier valt vrij weinig te zien: enkele kege gebouwen en baden.
Het meest interessante is nog de dame op de koer die batik handwerk verricht.
Dit is noch de tijdsinvestering, noch de 15.000roepie ingangsgeld waard wat ons betreft.

The castle is nice and small and it was very interesting to hear stories about it from the local tour guide who you could hire on the spot as they were always waiting for tourist near the entrance area. The tunnel and the little prayer place (surau) are what worth the visit. However it was very sad to see most of the walls of the building are vandalized by irresponsible individuals.

A faire dans le vieux Yogyakarta, le palais est très beau, et laisse entrevoir à quoi pouvait ressembler le site à l'époque du sultan. Il est vrai que le lieu n'est pas très entretenu, mais je trouve au contraire qu'il apporte un certain cachet. 
Visite complémentaire à la mosquée souterraine, le ticket donne accès aux deux. Et laisser vous perdre dans les ruelles de la vieille ville, à l'abri du trafic et du bruit de la ville moderne.

Listen to the story of the guide as it will bring you to imagine the old time where the King climb up to the watcher tower to watch the princess taking bath in the pool and throw the one that he wants to spend time with using Kantil flower. Once he picked the princess, they can move to the private pool or enter the bed chamber under the watcher tower. The unique thing is the design of the bed, where the heat come from under the bed just like a stove.

Als je toch in de buurt bent moet je wel even gaan kijken. Maar ik vond het geen historisch hoogstandje. Het is een slecht onderhouden heel toeristische attractie geworden. Verhaal door de gids is nog wel vermakelijk en de winkeltjes op t terrein zijn leuk om te zien. Maar we hadden deze ook prima kunnen missen.

Il Tamansari ha sicuramente vissuto momenti migliori quando il Sultano la utilizzava come bagno privato. Il water castle dopo varie vicissitudini dopo solo un 250 anni sembra non aver più molto da dire, ma la colpa non è della Struttura, la quale comunque conserva ancora il suo fascino, ma di coloro che ne hanno la sovrintendenza che non riescono a valorizzare una piccola gemma di Yogyakarta. Va comunque visitato, per perdersi nelle piccole vie e visitare i bagni sotterranei.  
Consigliato

Explication du guide nécessaire pour apprécier le lieu et avoir des explications.
En visite sans lui on n'aurait pas compris grand chose.

This attraction is interesting for history lovers, especially Kasultanan (Palace) followers. This place offers the history, as well as the beauty itself. 
P.S: Don't forget to walk through the village to reach the ruins of an ancient fortress and go down to see a basement mosque, where you can take a lot of photos!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Belle balade intéressante et historique. Vraiment sympa. La visite coûte un euro. Mais ne pas hésiter à prendre un guide pour 3,5 euros, qui vous fait visiter également la mosquée souterraine et vous donne de belles explications.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: La piscina è semplice ma viene molto bene in foto.Se avete tempo potete visitarlo per una foto ricordo senno si può anche saltare
Struttura poco curata sia all'esterno che all'interno, acqua molto sporca. Io non ci andrei più, forse anche un po per colpa della mia guida che non sapeva nulla.

Paar delen CH waterpaleis mooi, redt niet bijzonder. Jammer dat het nog niet opgeknapt is. Zou het veel aantrekkelijker maken. Verder is er niet veel in yogya, dus ga hier in ieder geval heen zou ik zeggen. Entree heeeeeel goedkoop -iets meer dan 1 eu.

Het is allemaal een beetje vervallen, maar een locale gids vertelt veel over de achtergrond, en die is best bijzonder. Zonder die uitleg snap je er denk ik niet veel van, en mis je in ieder geval veel. 
De sultan, zijn 20 vrouwen, de ondergrondse gang voor de vrouwen en de kano tocht voor de sultan, privé-zwembad, leuk om te zien. Je hebt er wat verbeelding voor nodig, maar zeker de moeite waard.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Deux grands bassins construits pour un ancien sultan de yogyakarta. Aucune explication sur place. Cette visite ne vaut pas forcément le coup à mon avis.

The water palace itself is nice, but also visit the castle, the round underground mosque, the tunnels, and the whole neighborhood. The mosque has a great stairs set-up in the middle, with the big problem that everyone wants to take a picture of their friend standing in the middle. In other words, little chance to see the stairs pleasantly, without people in silly poses thinking they are more interesting than the mosque itself.

The neighborhood is also fun to wander through, but it is difficult to find your way. Also the entrance to the underground mosque is not easy to find.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Nice for a wander round. Very pretty. Earthquake a few years ago did some damage but you can see where repairs are ongoing. 
Lots of workers live in the complex who can help with directions and are happy to have a chat with you. One showed me around for a bit - not for money. 
You get a leaflet with your entrance ticket but there's no map to help you work out what it's talking about. No signs to explain. If you want to learn more you really need a guide or a friendly local. 
Worth the trip, preferred it to the other sights in the area like the Kraton. Not as busy as I expected.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Bien sur il aurait été plaisant de voir ce bassin encore utilisé par le sultan!
Mais même encore aujourd'hui le charme opère et l'on se prend a imaginer le sultan et ses 21 femmes dans les bassins!
 Belles photos souvenir assurées.
We went there since we had free time, the water castle is nice but not really well maintained. They can for sure do better!

Jolies ruines dans cette ville qui offre des joyaux bien plus jolis.
Le site en lui-même ne vaut pas le déplacement mais le "village" qui entoure le château est magnifique. 
Ne vaut pas forcément le prix de l'entrée - conseil: à faire dès 14:00 car le château est fermé mais accès gratuit au village. 
Arrêtez-vous au Castle Café - c'est des plus typique, nourriture très bonne et ambiance chaleureuse.
N'hésitez pas à demander les services de chauffer pour visiter le Burubudur et Prambanan - prix très correct
Old sultan's water palace (19th century), not very well preserved. Two pools and some empty rooms. Not always easy to find the ticket office.

Erg leuk om te zien. Wel erg slecht te vinden, vooral de ondergrondse moskee kostte wat tijd. Maar zeker waard om te bezoeken.. Let wel op scams! We kwamen iemand tegen die ons eerst naar een batik winkel stuurde waar we, toen we en niks wilden kopen, erg onaardig behandeld werden.

Tempatnya bersih, cocok untuk para turis yang ingin mengenal bangsa indonesia juga sejarahnya. Hanya saja disini kurang ada sign system untuk penunjuk arah. Harga tiket masuknya juga terjangkau tidak terlalu mahal.
王家の水浴場跡。かなりの住宅密集地にありますが（あとから家がたったため）、そこだけとても清々しい雰囲気で、当時はさぞやいい場所だっただろうと想像できました。王家のかつての生活を垣間みられる、よい観光地です。

I must admit to not having great expectations for this site from previous comments and photos but we were pleasantly surprised. It may have been because it was a major local public holiday but the bathing pools were filled with a few feet of water with the fountains bubbling if not actually spouting. So the overall effect was quite pleasant and easy to imagine in its prime aa luxurious pools for the Sultan and family. Only R15000 entrance.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Istana air taman sari ini terkenal dengan wisata airnya,  jaman dulu istana air ini hanya untuk kerajaan sekarang istana air ini salah satu cagar budaya yogya
worth a visit if you have enough time in jogja. guides are provided and there is a batik shop and a few other shops.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Tamansari was probably something which we expected to be more than what it actually was. Probably its one of those monuments that is well known but has little to offer. I would say its an okay place to visit while you are at Jogja but dont expect too much out of the place.
Lokasi nya dalam kota sehingga cocok untuk dikunjungi di sela-sela kegiatan libur. Kawasannya cukup luas dan indah. Paling tepat dikunjungi pagi atau siang hari.

Review Text:
Taman Sari/Water Palace, (Tamansari means perfumed garden) is lovely now even if it is a little lacklustre, in its prime it would have been stunning.  Built 1758 and divided into four sections, to the west a large artificial lake with island and pavilions, a bathing complex in the middle, to the south pavilions and to the east a small lake, the grounds included 18 water gardens.  The years have not been kind to Taman Sari, both nature and primarily man have aided in its destruction.  With the British Invasion of 1811 destroying much of the complex, then more damage suffered during the Java War of 1825-1830.  Wars took their toll and earthquakes inflicted more punishment on the complex.  Eventually urban sprawl finished off what was left, filling in pools and absorbing the complexes buildings.  In the1970’s there was an effort to restore Taman Sari, with only the bathing complex surviving, the rest has been lost.  

The bathing complex is split into three sections - Umbul Kawitan, pond for the Sultan’s daughters and sons - Umbul Pamuncar, pond for the concubines - Umbul Panguras, pond for the Sultan.  There is a story the Sultan liked to ‘hunt’ for concubines from the tower.  He would watch the women in the pool below and throw a flower, whoever caught it was the lucky/unlucky woman.  Another version is he just selected them from the pool.

A comprehensive brochure is given on entry.  Be prepared to be hassled relentlessly by people wanting to be your guide on the way to the ticket office, then again when entering the grounds and while walking around.  

Don’t forget to visit the Sultans private underground mosque, Sumur Gumuling, it is out of the palace grounds and worth looking for.  You don’t need a guide, just exit out the back of the grounds and wander the maze of streets, asking the locals as you go where to find it, they are very happy to help.  See Sumur Gumuling for separate reviews on Tripadvisor.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

This ancient bathing pool is part of the Yogyakarta Palace. They do not use it anymore, but it used to be the princesses bathing pool. Just imagine the atmosphere back then when the princesses taking a bath while they laughed and sang together. There are big flower pots around the pool just hoping they keep planting flowers there so our imagination become more perfect. There is a small window on top of the building, it was mentioned the prince used to look out the window and chose which princess to accompany him that night. It is definitely worth to see.

This is a hidden gem and perhaps the most mind-expanding place I have ever been. Perhaps I need to visit more royal pleasure palaces. My Javanese family and friends had likewise not known of it and were amazed that it was their legacy. It explained many aspects of Javanese culture that to me had previously been unclear. 

I completely agree with other reviewers, however, that a guide is essential, primarily for the stories not only of the historical function of the place but also its contemporary life. 

Given that not much remains of the original pleasure palace with its lake, various follies and gardens, it is mostly now a place of the imagination. The tale of the various attempts to restore it to something like its former glory is educational as a microcosm of the myriad of conflicting forces at work in contemporary Indonesia. Wikipedia has a good entry on all of this. 

So, as the other reviewers have pointed out, don't expect a Disneyland display of the pleasures of an 18th century Javanese royal court but rather an opportunity to expand your mind and dream of different worlds that offer other possibilities.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah
