Review Text: It might look small from the outside yet when you go inside there's two or three major pools which were used for the Sultan and his wives and also his daughters and it spans around 10 hectares. I highly suggest to get a guide so when you enter the building, you'll get to know the story behind each pool, each chamber, and their uses. And some of the other places to be seen are outside the main building, so if you don't know where to be heading, one might get lost or doesn't know there are other places which can be seen visited other than the pools. There's also no map provided so if any of you doesn't want to get any guide make sure you informed yourself beforehand or at least ask some people/locals to give direction to the other buildings/places. And make sure not to lose your ticket! There are about 3 or 4 places which can be visited around the main building.

Review Text:
Site petit, joli mais à l'abandon. On peut y faire de jolies photos.
L'entrée n'est pas chère donc si vous êtes dans le quartier, n'hésitez pas à y faire un tour. Le quartier autour du palais est sympa pour s'y balader.

Is an ancient Sultan's family pool. Is not a big pool like today's pools but is worth seeing. If you are lucky, you may get a good story behind this temple from a local guide, otherwise look at the lonely planet book.

The kids will get very bored with this one. Some adults may find interesting, but be sure to take a guide or you are just looking at old walls and a unused swimming pool. After the tour the guides will take you through a lot of art shops and will be a bit put out if you don't buy anything and keep asking you why your not buying souvenirs.

I was charged 70,000rp when it was only supposed to be 15,000rp for foreign visitors.  My driver that I hired for the day told me after I was done with the visit.  He was going to take me back to ask them why they charged me so much, but I didn't bother.  It's $5 usd for me, which is nothing, and I believe in karma, so the lying ticket salesman will surely get what's coming to him one day.  I have traveled all throughout Asia, and I know people trying to rip you off is common, but I've never had it happen from a ticket sales agent working at a royal compound.  If it was a taxi driver, or street peddler selling something ,then that's expected.

As for the water castle itself, it is a run down complex.  At least when I went today there was water in the pool.  Many visitors have stated that there wasn't even water when they went.  I would definitely advise visitors not to waste their time here.  If you've got time to kill and in the area then maybe drop by, otherwise you have many other options to visit in Yogyakarta instead.

À faire si vous êtes dans le coin... ça ne prend pas énormément de temps.

Attention il y a tjrs bien qqn pour vouloir vous guidez puis ensuite se faire payer.

Really really nice. Definitely worth a view. Unfortunately, and that's why it doesn't get a 5, it's not in the best conditions. I have seen it in winter and so there was water in the pools and that was really cool to see. It's nice to take some pictures. Bad rating for the attraction leaflet which missed of a map and missing indications all over the place were really annoying to me.
Used by royalties for bathing. Not well maintained. There isn't blue water or water in the pool. It was filled with green moss. Nothing much to see snd can give it a miss.

Um lugar bem interessante pra aprender mais sobre a historia do sultanato em Yogya. Rendem boas fotos o local, e nao deixe de ir até a mesquita. Tivemos uma certa dificuldade de achar, mas os guias de la sao atenciosos e solicitos, nos indicando o caminho.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
I along with my family visited Taman Sari or Water Castle on 23rd April 2017. Being a Sunday, it was crowded. We visited the Taman Sari as part of day tour around Yogyakarta. The ticket cost for foreigners is IDR 15,000 with extra charges for bringing in a camera. Ticket rates are discriminatory as locals pay a nominal amount. 
The concept of bathing place is good but nothing very special about the place. Place is not that very well maintained. I felt it was a bit drab too. Maybe, in its heyday, it must have been a good place to visit. The Water Castle was essentially a place for the Royals to bathe and relax, especially in the hot times of the year.

You can probably spend like 1 hour here. Not much to see plus the place is not properly maintain. There's different charge for local & foreigner & you need to pay a fee if you bring camera. 

Its easier to get help with tour guide (but not sure if need to pay or not) as you might get lost walking from the water castle to the hidden mosque. But it was a nice breeze walk along local house (the called it Kampung Cyber - Cyber Village) and you can enjoy free WiFi.

Ticket price (April 2017) : IDR15000. This water castle is known as the "bathing suites" for the royalties. Unique architecture, a little bit rustic, perfect for photography sessions. To avoid the crowds, it is advised to come early for a good photo-taking-spots and long queue.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Tempat yang tepat untuk hunting foto bertema urban. Masjid bawah tanah juga bisa jadi spot foto yang keren karena arsitektur bangunannya yang megah dan menarik.

Peninggalan keraton Jogja pada jaman dahulu yang masih terawat dengan baik.

Tempat ini selain bersejarah , juga pas banget buat ngabisin weekend bareng temen-temen, keluarga dan pasangan.

Tips : jangan lupa bawa air minum ya dan charge HP mu sampai penuh! Karena banyak banget tempat selfie dan wifie yang ga boleh di lewatin disini!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: It was a hot day when we visited this place. Watching the cascading waters, we wish we could take a dip in the pool. Overall it was a lovely place to soak in the sight.

Architecture is stunning, very pretty. Being by the water pools it's refreshing on a hot day. Castle tower offers amazing views over gardens and many cute passage ways entertains you throughout. Very well worth a visit, and they also have a nice cafe to rest by the end of your visit.
Much better than the Kraton and a hidden underground mosque which is pretty cool lots of shops and stalls to explore too

Past the main pool area into the open yard. I thought the palace was just that. Most of the side doors from the yard looked liked they were leading nowhere (due to the castle integrated with shacks and houses). A guide approached me and asked if I wanted to visit some of the other sites listed on the brochure given with the entry ticket. I wasn't sure where to go and decide take up his offer as he mention minimum pay amount was 20k rupiah. 

This was a decision I did not regret as he brought a whole new perspective for me on the history of the castle and how it was affected by earth quakes, mount merapi eruption and the religion. Could not have imagined the whole place was a lake a few hundred years ago and was turned into solid land due to lava from the volcano. 

Like the guide, most of the folks still staying in the castle compound had ancestors working for the palace. They stayed on even after the royal family moved to the new Kraton. 

There's a couple of instagram worthy areas in the palace such as the main palace complex with the broken roof and the underground mosque. Definitely worth a visit.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Its architectural design is simple yet beautiful, walking around the are feels really good.
From the gate to the walk to the underground part of the establishment feels like you're exploring a well preserved tomb, fun and mysterious at the same time.
很一般 小小髒髒的，如果從皇宮後門走過去很近。但我們繞了個大圈，曬死了！算是在居民區的一個景點。時間多可以去看看
Leuk om gezien te hebben, maar niet heel bijzonder. Bij de entree betaal je overigens 15.000 IDR, terwijl je er vanaf de andere kant gewoon in kan lopen.
Bagus pokoknya,sayang waktu itu musim liburan jadi rame bangett.kalau ke jogja wajib ke sini ya gaesss..
Ooit zo mooie zwembad van de sultan, kan ik me nu indenken. Nu verwaarloost en erg vies. Geen tijd aan besteden!

I visted it because I had some time over and didn't want to go to far away. We don't pay entrance because my friend know a place where you can have a good look inside. At our visit there where no water in the baisin, so I was happy not to pay for. The small alleys around the waterpalace is quite interesting.
When you visit Yogyakarta, This place is one of most peoples visit for photography. Many castle architectural you can see
Another one of those historical places that is a must visit in Jogja. Dont forget to go down the secret escape tunnels

Ne vaut pas le détour, bâtiment en mauvais état, les bains ont très peu d eau, et le peu d eau est une eau stagnante verdâtre. La seule chose qui sauve un peu la visite est la mosquée enterrée : atypique mais pas renversante.
Bersepeda ke taman sari bersama istri tercinta disela-sela liburan menjadi kegiatan yang menyenangkan, menikmati indahnya istana air taman sari, terbayang kerajaan Mataram tempo dulu

Ke tamansari bersama teman, kami dipandu oleh orang lokal karena takut kesasar, hehe. Tempatnya lumayan luas. Bagus untuk lokasi foto-foto. Dari bapak2 yang memandu kami, kami jadi tahu kalau bangunan awal tamansari tidak memakai semen. Lalu ada lubang yang terhubung dengan keraton, kata bapak tersebut. Memang tamansari pada jaman dulu adalah tempat pemandian raja.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Lots of nice graffiti art on the walls of the alleyways connecting the different parts of the complex, wish I had photos to show but my phone decided to die on me. 
Wonder around and marvel at the centuries old architecture.

Sayang hujan ketika saya datang kesini, rasanya kurang puas datang kesini karena terbatasnya waktu. Patut banget di explore tempatnya. Lebih baik datang weekday karena weekend atau tanggal merah, tempat ini luar biasa penuh.

I expected water features and nice gardens but the reality is quite different.  The pools had little water in them and it was dirty and covered in algae. The paint was peeling and it felt neglected. Our guide said there had been a festival, and as a result the pool was being by drained and refilled, but it will take more than that to get it looking nice. 

The Water Castle is part of the King's Palace and a lot of the land has been built on, so instead of ice, open spaces, there are a lot of dwellings and shops. There's a strange, round the tunnel area in the middle which apparently was used for prayer. 

Lots of graffiti, and a neglected feel - I was disappointed.

jika kesini hal yang wajib adalah berfoto, karena latar belakangnya sangat khas. untuk masuknya sempat mengalami kebingungan. kunjungan pertama berhasil menemukan kolam yang menjadi ciri khas tempat ini, namun kunjungan kedua saya berada di tempat lain, mungkin dibelakang taman sari karena hanya panggung terbuka yang saya temukan. saran untuk yang ingin mengunjungi taman sari, jangan pada hari libur panjang, karena tempat ini akan sangat ramai dan kita tidak bisa leluasa untuk berfoto.
This is a must see, at least for me. Located in the heart of Yogyakarta, this site is very easy to reach. For the better experience, ask for a tour guide.
Wen man noch Zeit während seines Aufenthaltes in Yogyakarta hat, kann man mal vorbeigehen. Man verpasst jedoch nichts, wenn man es eben nicht macht.

Eintritt 15.000 pP und viel mehr würde ich auch nicht zahlen. Das sandsteinfarbene Gebäude ist nicht besonders dekoriert, der ganze "Palast" besteht aus zwei Höfen. Der erste mit Wasserbecken, der zweite nur aus einem Platz mit Verkäufern.

中央にある水浴場（プール）に美女（妻？）を泳がせおく→プールの横にある建物の最上階からスルタンが品定めをする→気に入った美女がいた場合には，花を投げて知らせる→別室に移動し，一夜を過ごす　といったことが行われていたそうです．王の安全を確保するために，元々はこの宮殿は池の中につくられた島の上に立てられており，王以外の島へのアクセスは船に限られていたそうです．この宮殿にある地下通路は，王が島へ行き来するための専用通路として建設されたそうです．
入口から入って地下通路まで行くのは簡単なのですが，地下通路から出口までのルートがすごく複雑．密集した民家の間の狭い入り組んだ道を何度か曲がってようやく出口にたどり着きました．庶民の生活が垣間見られて面白かったです．
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Old jogja kingdom castle, there used to be a lake around the castle hence the water castle. Please ask tour guide

Interessanter Ort mit ein wenig Geschichte. Sobald man in die Nähe kommt wird man von irgendeinem Guide angesprochen und in ein lockeres Gespräch verwickelt und bevor man sich versieht hat man diesen dann für den Rest der Tour durch die anlage, inklusive Führung durch das umliegende Viertel und die hiesigen Geschäfte die vorallem Kunst und Kaffee anbieten.wer das nicht möchte, sollte jeden von dem man angesprochen wird konsequent ignorieren. Das castle an sich ist nicht besonders gross aber man kann es sich auf jeden Fall anschauen wenn man gerade in der Nähe sein sollte.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: So, if you look at the picture you have pretty much seen all there is to see. Found the 'sites' of Jogyakarta a but disappointing - but you're really there to see Prambanam and get to Borobadur, so the city was worth a visit for a couple of spares hours, but not worth a trip on its own

kesini cuma sebentar aja, pas liat di foto2 orang kayaknya pada bagus2, cuma saya nggak menemukan seperti yang di foto2 kebanyakan itu, ditambah kesana pas weekend jadi rame sama rombongan luar kota yang mau melihat tamansari juga, next mau explore lagi dehhh ..
Would advice to have the visit with a tourist guide. else, you wont found anything interesting with the castle.

This is very crowded and there is not much to look at, the massive pool is interesting but its over in 10 mins. Plenty of history here but lots of empty rooms and nothing much else.

Pop in but don't go out your way.
Nothing much, just a few pools. Please make sure you have your trishaw or taxi drop and pickup as very hard to get transport there.

Taman Sari is a former royal garden of the Sultanate of Yogyakarta it is also means an area of a beautiful garden adorned with flowers. It has a sauna place also. A tunnel once a hideout of Sultan from his enemy. And you can buy a batik painting for a souvenir. Full details indaydora.com
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Pas la plus belle chose à visiter à Java mais si vous êtes à Jogja cela mérite tout de même d'y faire un détour.
Le prix de la visite est dérisoire.

Bersama teman saya mencoba berkunjung ke Istana Taman Sari yg Asri dan Sejuk, pemandangannya bagus dan didukung guide yg baik menjelaskan suasana tempat. Murah kok tiket masuknya hanya Rp 5.000. Sayangnya banyak penjual didalam.
Este pequeño castillo está muy deteriorado, pero quizás es lo mejor de todo el Kratón. Está muy sucio y el interior está vacío. El único interés es algún encuadre de foto bonito.... Y ya.
Interesting story and buildings but nothing special and pools now a very nice hue of green. The palace area is very hot.
Everyone should visit this place too... all about the history. Love the guide who explained everything to us about the history of this place and we'll said.
Can imagine the number of concubines bathing in the pool and the King looking down at them from the upper floor!

Taman sari tempat yang asri..lorong dan bangunan membuat taman sari mempunyai nilai yang sangat bersejarah...kami juga mengunjungi jg gedung tertinggi setaman sari. Gedung kenongo namanya dimana ini merupakan tempat terakhir yg sangat indah menikmati sunset..

We are not the real history buffs, but this place has stories to tell and would be a shame to miss. We enjoyed the great photo opportunities, but do not go on weekends as its crazy busy.
Only 15K Rp. to get in. Take water. But you can buy coconut water inside for 5K.
We spent 1 hour here. The girls loved the photo opportunities. You receive a pamphlet with good info on it.
We were glad we made the effort to visit this historical place in Jogja.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: nah untuk kalian yang ingin kesini, saya saranin pakai topi, karena mataharinya sangat panas sekali,untuk wisata kesini saya sarankan untuk kuat berjalan kaki dan naik tangga, karena objek wisata disini letaknya berjauh2an, dan untuk tiket masuknya cuma 5rb kok

We didn't really know anything about the place nor did we take a tourguide which is probably why we didn't enjoy this place that much. There is not point in going here without a guide, the entrance fee is very cheap but there isn't a real reason to go there. The underground/secret mosque is not that special either yet there's a buch of people queueing up for a picture.

It's a complex for Sultan and keraton family member to spend holiday. There are some pools for mistresses, sultan's meditation place and the mistresses' dorm. You better visit here with the guide who can tell you a lot. It is a huge area and still there are some site that are not exposed (renewed) yet.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Salah satu tempat bersejarah yang sangat indah. Tempat ini dulunya adalah pemandian para raja dengan desain bangunan yang sangat cantik
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
"Сад наслаждений" - ровесник кратона. Был построен ещё Хаменгкубувоно I для своего гарема.
Павильоны, бассейны, лабиринты построек, где прекрасные одалиски наряжались, интриговали и наслаждались всеми прелестями жизни в "золотой клетке", подчинённой одной главной цели - победе в борьбе за внимание и благосклонность султана.

Tamansari merupakan salah satu tempat yang wajib di kunjungi saat berada di Yogyakarta. Selain terdapat kolam pemandian Raja yang sangat terkenal (dan instagramable), di Tamansari juga terdapat beberapa ruangan dengan fungsi yang berbeda yang sarat dengan nilai sejarah. Letaknya tidak jauh dari komplek Kraton Ngayogyakarta dan alun-alun kidul, jadi berkunjung ke tempat ini bisa dilakukan dalam satu kali jalan. Kalau kamu tidak memiliki kendaraan pribadi, kamu bisa naik becak dari arah Malioboro (bayarnya cuma 10.000 saja, itu sudah termasuk keliling ke Kraton dan beberapa pusat oleh-oleh).
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Much have been mentioned on this. But I don't really find it that fantastic. Make sure to cover the Sumur Gumuling together to make this visit worthwhile.

Beberapa kali berkunjung, tapi tidak pernah bosan.
Taman air yang indah dan sangat sejuk.
Sangat bersih dan indah.
sayang sekali tidak bisa berenang hehehe
Istana Tamansari bisa menjadi salah satu tempat wisata budaya sekaligus romantisme keindahan masa lalu. Berbentuk kolam dan air mancur ditengahnya, menambah keunikan tempat wisata ini.
Kalo kesini cocoknya kita untuk berfoto, selain karena memiliki nilai sejarah yang tinggi, murah untuk kita masuk nya juga dan fotonya pun bagus banyak spot spot yg bagus disana
Très jolie bâtisse, malheureusement pas assez bien conservée à mon goût. Typiquement indonésien, j'adore !

I was there once with my family, then I did the second times with my friends. I was there like around 1.30pm and luckily the weather was nice. Paid 5,000 IDR for each adult for entry tickets and actually it was cheap for local tourists. You will be offered to use guide for your visit, but we decided not to take it.

You'll be surprised once you get there. It was like traveling back to years ago, during the old Kraton life. You can explore the Taman Sari sections and take some pictures. After that, you can continue your journey to Sumur Gumuling Sites by walking through Kampung Cyber, the first cyber village that use wi-fi for the entire village. This place is so Instagram-able that every spot is just beautiful. Once you get to Sumur Gumuling Sites, get in, and enjoy that famous mystical dome. Don't forget to get into the next dome to find another photo spot. Such a hidden gem at the heart of Jogjakarta that you should not miss.

This place has a lot of history but you will probably need a guide to share the background behind it. 

Nice place for some photo taking however it can be quite crowded. 

It is worth going though!
mampir kesini untuk sekedar berfoto karena selain tempat ini kalian bisa langsung menelusuri tempat lainnya yang masih menjadi 1 komplek dari taman sari ^_^

Salah satu tempat wisata yang sangat terkenal di Jogja, tempat pemandian para selir-selir Raja. Tempatnya bagus sekali, tapi memang dibutuhkan effort yang lumayan tinggi. Dan kalau kesini, sebaiknya menggunakan guide karena kalau tidak bisa tersasar di kawasan ini. Karena tempatnya ada di beberapa titik dan menyatu dengan rumah penduudk. Jalanannya pun tidak ada petunjuk yang jelas dari satu tempat ke tempat lainnya. Agak riskan kalau tidak bersama Guide. dan saya kesana saat jam 11 siang dengan cuacanya yang sangat panas, Tapi cukup puas dengan wisata yang ada., semoga review ini membantu :) Jangan lupa untuk menggunakan baju panjang dan topi agar tidak kepanasan saat berjalan jalan di tempat ini
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Being from India, castle means something big to me. This is like a rich persons home with some swimming pools. If you are a tourist and came this far, do not waste your time here. Rather get a nice nasi goreng in that 17k you would have paid for ticket and camera.

pertama kesini sempat bingung karena tidak pakai pemandu tapi setelah berjalan menyusuri perkampungan sekitar dan bertemu sekerumunan pengunjung barulah ketemu istana air yang konon katanya dulu dijadikan pemandian selir-selirnya raja
Salah satu tempat yang wajib di kunjungi saat berada di Yogyakarta. Letaknya tidak jauh dari komplek keraton dan alun-alum kidul, jadi berkunjung ke tempat ini bisa dilakukan dalam satu kali jalan.

Absolutely a must if you stay in Jogja. As others say you can feel a touch of history over here but it seems as no one cares about the condition of the buildings and pools. Really a lot could be done to preserve and present these magnificent and charming buildings. If there werent other organised groups I'm unsure whether we'd find all the main sights. Such a shame... Entrance ticket 15K per person.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It was known as the Sultan's pool where his majesty relax and for recreational purposes in the ancient time. Stayed for 30 minutes here.

Went here with the family during our holiday in Yogya. Beautiful place for taking picture.Better visit this place early in the morning or when its bit cloudy otherwise it will be very hot. Not really recommend to bring the baby since there's a lot of step and very humid. Worth for visit if you around.

We went there and we did not know what to see until we decide to hire a tourist guide to let us for 50K. He explained a lot of history of the place and history of the sultan, and he was the one who lead us to Sumur Gumuling. I was permitted to get to the attic to capture some photos. It might be seems that it was left without maintenance since it had not been used anymore, but nice for instagram anyway.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The place was full of history. We could really feel how things were then and how peaceful the place is.
Get a sense of how the Sultan lived in the older generations. 😂 opulence and extravagance personified.
wisata disini sangatlah indah sebuah peninggalan yang tidak pernah dikecewakan oleh masyarakat jogjakarta dan terus dilestarikan
Beautiful castle and you will definitely love if. Please walk deeper, you will able to find some interesting place.
Tempatnya sangat bagus, banyak pengalaman menarik tentangs ejarah yg saya dapat. Cocok untuk foto2 dan selfie. Dan menambah ilmu pengetahuan

Saya termasuk orang yang suka dengan wisata sejarah. Tapi Tamansari termasuk wisata sejarah yang beda dari yang biasa saya datangi. Lokasinya agak membingungkan. Dari 1 tempat ke tempat lainnya melewati rumah rumah penduduk. 
Saran saya buat yang baru pertama kali ke Tamansari, Wajib pakai guide.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: berada di pusat kota yogyakarta, kita bisa naik becak atau ojek online jika tidak membawa kendaraan pribadi, tempat nya luas dan bersih, kita bisa menyewa tour guide untuk menjelaskan fungsi dari bangunan yang terapat di area Kampung Wisata  Taman Sari, ada banyak penjual di dalam area Kampung Wisata Taman Sari sehingga jika kita tidak sempat berbelanja di tempat lain, kita masih bisa membeli oleh oleh di tempat ini..
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: It was a happy trip and you will really appreciate the rich history and culture of the place. Love to come back again

Stelt niet veel voor. Vergane glorie en dermate veel achterstallig onderhoud dat de souveniertoeristenaftroggelstraat aan het einde als enig positieve van ons bezoek jan worden gezien. Een gids kun je welgevoeglijk overslaan aangezien deze geen toegevoegde waarde heeft.

Gemericik air, keelokan arsitekturnya yang "jadul", dan pemandangan yang eksotik membuat Taman Sari sangat mempesona. 
Lorong-lorong dan bangunannya menjadikan TamanSari terasa penuh rahasia yang akan terus ingin dikuak.

Taman sari merupakan situs peninggalan sultan. Terdapat istana2 yang sudah tua disini. Dan di tempat ini pula ada sumur gumuling.  Masuk dengan harga Rp. 5000/org untuk wisatawan lokal dan Rp.2000 untuk kamera. Dan harga tersebut sudah termasuk tiket ke sumur gumuling.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This place was so beautiful. If you in Yogyakarta, don't forget to visit Taman Sari. This place full of history and we can get a beautiful view for take a picture
This place is very nice, and I got a lot of history stories from here. I advise you to visit here 😊😊😊

If you come here, please get a guide.im not sure if they have English guide.( I am Indonesian and we got indonesian guide.) You will get to hear much more interesting history than reading the brochure. The tour could be 2 hours and more depend on how much you would like to know  more about the history on different sites of the place.
The place is open and exposed to sun so bring umbrella or wear sunblock and bring water bottle.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
My wife and I are suckers for architecture, history etc. and were looking forward to visiting. We have travelled the world looking at archeological and historical sites. This one was not worth the little effort it took to visit. It consisted of a few dirty pools surrounded by some mostly nondescript whitish walls.
Most of the Yogyakarta city tours seem to visit it. If you have a private car, give it a miss and go to a couple of very interesting and very under- promoted temples; Candi Ijo and Rato Boko; instead.

It's not easy to access - you have go through lots of narrow lanes to get to it. Not much to see there and whatever exists isn't well maintained at all. Exit is amidst small houses next to the palace! If you are here at a short visit - this can be skipped.
Nice place for take a picture and also to learn about history of Yogyakarta Kingdom at the past. Very humble tour guide too.
This is national heritage, but the way they maintain the site is very poor, lack of maintenance, should be clean and good looking site

one of the worse and dirty place in the world fare from the indonesian image but part of the culture with very bad maintenance reapect of the historie this generation focus on profite and visit but totaly forget the future generation and Historie of the country so sade to see that......never back again and definitly not send other to see this desaster.

If you love traditional places, this place might be recommended. Inside you will see an ancient building with a water garden inside also you might visit the underground oldiest mosque. Many people take pictures there and put it on instagram. As I mentioned before this place is good for ppl that enjoy an ancient place.

Taman Sari Water Castle was originally the private place for the princesses of Jogjakarta sultanate. I visited this place a long time ago before it was renovated. Seeing what it becomes now, I think I prefer the pre-renovation condition. Feels more original and the building told you many stories from its imperfect condition. Anyway, the post-renovation Taman Sari was cleaner and more vibrant, so I said, a good spot for pre-wedding photo shoot. What I like most when visiting here, was sitting at the balcony facing to the pool, imagining the Sultan of Jogjakarta sipping his tea there and looking down at the beautiful princesses in the pool. Wow. PS: this place offer unusually interesting spots for nice, historical photo hunting.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Sekitar tiga sampai empat kali saya ke tamansari. Pertama kali saya baru mencoba ke tempat wisata ini dan langsung didatangi bapak-bapak guide lokal dengan baju batik rapi menawarkan jasa mengantar jalan-jalan di dalam tamansari dan memberi cerita tentang sejarah tamansari, saya pikir bolehlah paling cuma 10.000-15.000 biayanya secara yogyakarta terkenal kota yang apa-apa murce. Tanpa saya tanya dulu berapa biayanya. Lalu kami mulai bayar tiket masuk lalu diantar guide tersebut berkeliling. Memang diceritain sih tapi toh habis itu saya lupa, dan lagi guide tersebut jalannya cepat sekali, tidak menawarkan foto-foto. Bodohnya kami, kami ikutin saja itu jalan cepat juga. Ketika selesai, saya tanya berapa biayanya, dia minta 60.000 duh alamak, sudah gak seru dia ceritanya (tidak membuat semakin ingin tahu), malah bikin cape karena tidak bisa istirahat sambil menikmati pemandangan yang ada di tamansari (btw ini adalah lokasi wisata yg isinya bangunan tua raja jaman dahulu beserta para premaisuri dan selirnya), mahal lagi. Sungguh tidak worth it. Setelah kami sampai diparkiran motor , eh ternyata banyak yang lewat belakang (pintu dimana saya keluar yang notabene tidak pakai htm). Alhasil besok-besoknya kalau saya ke tamansari lagi, saya lewat pintu belakang dan tentunya TANPA GUIDE. Asal ngikutin jalan aja pasti gak kesasar kok. Ikutin tamu-tamu lain hehe. Soalnya memang ada tempat yang harus lewat pemukiman warga sambil lihat-lihat kerajinan yang mereka buat seperti lukisan dll.

Review Text: Other than the castle pool itself, the underground mosque and the ruins of the palace is a must-visit.

It was a last minute place to visit since I wanted to escape visiting any museums in Yogyakarta. The first impression I had was this is not big place and I will not spend longer time here, but I was wrong. This palace is huge and added an element of surprise, it has like a tunnel down which I dont expect that at all. 

I went there around afternoon and it was almost to their closing hour but I think I've explored most of the palace by the help of my local guide. Yes, you definitely will get lost as its like a labyrinth but keep it positive by following the crowd. This palace is surrounded by a village. I went out from the palace, in order to go to the other section and I found beautiful murals along side the walls.

Just keep your ticket, in case you need to get in again. There will be someone who will guard the door and he will be checking if you already paid for the entrance fees or not. Ive been to the top of the palace where some parts were damaged from the eruption of Merapi. I was lucky to meet few kids were playing their kites up there. From there, you can see the whole village (basically its all rooftop).

Since the place is good for photo, you might easily get annoyed with people who are occupying the walkway. Overall, do come to this place when there is lesser people in there.
Kraton içinde sultan ve ailesinin özel kullanımına ait bir havuz. Dinlenme ve seyir yerleri, çay odaları ilginç.
We wandered around here one afternoon. The narrow alleys, random shops, and street art is a neat atmosphere to stroll in.
Nice place. To learn about the past kings lives and to see the village houses within the palace complex. They could be the descendants of palace officials

Tamansari has 5 main places you should check. I think morning is the best time to visit, before it gets crowded and you can not take a picture because you have to queue for the good spot and photobombed everywhere!
I only go to the 3 places in tamansari because its already late, some already closed. Tamansari open till 3 pm. You can still explore after 3pm, but you can not enter some places.

When you enter the main gate, some locals will approach to be you guide, first time i think its a scam , so i ignore them, but when i walked further, i just found that im lost! its a huge area and the way to get to that 5 place are like a labirin. you can go there without guide when you willing to ask every other people on the way every 3mins. and i think its so annoying, so on the half way i choose to ask some locals to guide us. you can give them fee about 30k . they will show you the way and tell you the story behind the building since its a historical building.

when you get there, its so great!! btw, it was so hot there, you can bring an eletrical mini usb fan if you have one, and dont forget to bring cold water before entering the main gate
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Ternyata ada masjid bawah tanah untuk ibadah para selir dan abdi dalem yang tinggal disitu. Rencana tempat ini kelak akan dipugar secara bertahap untuk dikembalikan kondisinya seperti aslinya. Review Text: Taman Sari (a.k.a. Taman Sari Water Castle) is housed within the grounds of Kraton Yogyakarta. It was built c. 1765 and used until 1812, when an invasion of Kraton Yogyakarta led by Stamford Raffles destroyed much of the complex. Debate is still ongoing as to whether the architecture is pure Javanese, or if there was European (Dutch, Portuguese or German) influences Only the Sultan and females (wives, daughters and concubines) were allowed to enter the bathing complex. Over the years, squatters began inhabiting the site. Restoration work has been patchy with only the bathing complex having been restored.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Very nice architecture and area to walk through while you visit the sultan palace. Make sure you visit the underground mosque.

Review Text:
This should be one of the main draws of the Kraton, but it could use some renovation here and there, and maybe some signs with explanation of what everything is and means.

The pools are nice to see, as is the underground mosque, but it's lacking context a little bit. 

(We paid a English student who came up to us 20.000 to tell us something about all the sites, and that turned out to be a pretty good solution for this lack)

An approximately 10minutes walk from Malioboro Street (you can take an ojek but make sure to negotiate price). A man in batik approached me outside the entrance and claimed that he's the sultan's family and offered to bring me around. Feeling hesitant at first, I decided that it was not a bad idea overall to have a guide to better slow me to understand the history of the attraction. 

After finished touring the water castle, he brought me to his 'home' to look at the batik arts (and of course convince me to support his family business). Thereafter, we also went to the kopi luwak (civet coffee) shop to sample the locally produced coffee (Rp 125k rupiah). 

Overall, it was a pleasant visit but try to be there early as there were already a lot of visitors in the late morning.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

My family went on a Saturday morning which is the public holiday. 
We were dropped by a becak to that place. One guide spotted us and volunteer to bring us around. But he spoke very limited English .  So we declined. But he kept following us and brought us through alleys and houses and tunnels. Initially I thought there is free entrance due to public holiday. Finally he led us to the ticket counter where we bought tickets as international tourists for 15,000 rupiah per person. 
With our limited understanding of Malay and his limited spoken English we manage to see the retreat palace of the olden King , Queen and the princes and princesses. We saw their bedrooms, kitchen, dining, bathing area and even the so called "pier" area.  
Truly one need a guide to appreciate this water castle and not just wander from area to area.

Review Text: Taman Sari tempat pemandian bagi putri keraton jogja,merupakan salah satu tempat yang layak dikunjungi.Melewati jalan perkampungan dengan ciri khas tembok.memberikan kesan tersendiri.Di parkiran,menuju tempat penjualan tiket,kita bisa menikmati dulu es beras kencur ataupun es kunir asem,ada juga beberapa jajanan lainnya.Ketika memasuki Taman Sari,aroma bunga menyapa kita.Ada tanaman bunga cempaka yang sedang mekar,membuat kami merasa seperti dibawa ke masa lalu.Memasuki halaman belakang,kita bisa melihat seniman khas Jogja yang sedang membatik ataupun membuat wayang kulit,ada juga pedagang yang menjajakan kacamata,es dawet(yang maknyus rasanya).Keluar dari pintu gerbang belakang,kita akan melewati deretan rumah penduduk yang menyajikan kerajinan khas Jogja.Dari kaos,baju batik,ataupun wayang kulit.Taman Sari...Jogja banget!
The tour guide told us it's bathing spot for Sudan's imperial concubine. I think is a nice place to visit, you can see the history and the structure is special.

Finally, got a chance to visit this Water Castle !! after all the reading.. this place is usually being skipped on my previous visit to Yogyakarta. Only after seeing a picture of white-colored wall and clear water in one of the website then I decided to come and give a try to this location with my family. Here are several information that might be usefull for those who plan to visit. 
1. Get a tour guide. This have been proven very powerful media to get the details of this castle and you can develop imagination on what was it like in the past. Unique thing is the payment will be voluntary for this tour guide and they will never ask for certain amount, trust them on this and feel free to prepare as you prefer.
2. Be ready for round the area walking. This will be a little physical, very contrary with my previous guess when first step on the site.

I am not going to share the story of this place, I will not take away the job for the tour guide. but here are some reviews in overall visit for this place. As a start, an entrance fee will be charged (Rp 15.000 per person - for domestic tourist). You can find the detail in most of websites.

1. Very interesting background story of the building (make sure you listen carefully on the story from tour guide). Understanding how the king were treated during that times and how the people respected him highly. And ask question about the meaning of each drawing on the wall in each room you visit, they are full of symbol and the guide should be able to help you digest the meaning of it.
2. Very huge complex actually, and one can imagine the greatness of the design and plan for this place. Something that might come as a surprise to those without deep knowledge, (thanks to the help of the tour guide). As a clue, make sure you stand in both side of the pier that used to be the King's pier to start crossing the lake, then you can feel what I mean by the size of the complex.
3. This place also surrounded with many art-house (local resident that using their private house as art gallery) from souvenir, t-shirt, artwork, etc. Don't rush, just enjoy each house and ask as many questions to generate more respects to this locals. 
4. A secret Mosque underground is a must to see. The design, the Imam place, Wudlhu area, and the background of its development will be a very fascinating story to tell. Which also happen to all my children (9, 11, 15 and 17 years old).

In general, this place is beyond expectation, and I did admire the full story of its history. Worth to visit, for both adult or young travellers. and Again, use the tour guide service to help you, and support the local people for sure.

Regards

Bambim
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The Water Castle or Taman Sari brings you back to the times of the sultans in the 18th century and was build as a relaxation complex. The part that is preserved is what used to be the bathing house area and with a bit of imagination you can see the sultan watching his concubines in the baths from his tower. The place is popular with tourists but it is the whole area that is worth exploring with underground passages and old walls, gates and narrow streets

Berkunjung Tgl. 31 Desember 2016 pagi hari. Memang musim liburan jadi ramai. Tiket masuk murah tapi yang mengagetkan adalah adanya tour guide yg tanpa menawarkan diri langsung mengambil tiket kita dan basa-basi asal kita darimana, hal ini yang sebenarnya tidak diidnginkan, tapi karena saya juga ingin tahu sejarahnya maka, ya udahlah kita ikuti saja, tapi tipsnya mereka tidak mematok. Bagi yang tidak ingin didampingi tour guide maka harus waspada pada saat penyerahan tiket masuk. Menyejukkan dab mententramkan bagai oase di tengah kota yang bising. Bagaimana waktu jaman dahulu yang masih dikelilingi tanaman2, asri sekali kelihatannya. Tapi yang agak disayangkan adalah tempat ini seperti seonggok bangunan yang tidak terawat kalau saya bilang karena selain cat yang mengelupas dan berlumut juga adanya pedagang2 didalam yang tidak ditata dengan rapi. Mungkin seharusnya pihak pemerintah kota dapat lebih memaksimalkan perawatan maupun pemugaran sehingga terkesan lebih elegan. Mengenai pedagang2 yang ada didalam mestinya dapat ditata lebih baik lagi. Sayang karena Istana Air Taman Sari merupakan peninggalan sejarah yang perlu dilestarikan.

Peinture écaillée, graffitis, saletés... C'est désolant de voir qu'un lieu présenté comme historique est si peu entretenu. Si seulement une fraction du prix d'entrée était consacré à son entretien, ce lieu pourrait être très beau.

Located about 2 km south within the grounds of Kraton it has several entrances to gain access into this tourist spot. Tamansari divided into four areas which are the artificial lake, bathing complex, garjitawati pool and magangan complex. Avoid visit during weekend and public holiday cause it's gonna be full with local and tourist since the ticket is very cheap why not come and have a visit to this historic palace.

Review Text: Dateng kesini karena dari dulu penasaran banget liat foto" orang di sosmed. Waktu dtg kebetulan banget lagi momen liburan jadi nya ramai. Spot foto yg paling bagus di kolamya, sama di tangga" dalem goa.

Beberapa kali mengunjungi Jogja, baru pertama kali ke Taman Sari dan ternyata keren...
Lokasi masih disekitar keraton dan alun-alun selatan so sayang bila dilewatkan. 
Berjalan santai selama hampir 2 jam menjelajahi Taman Sari dan Masjid Bawah Tanah (Sumur Gumuling) bersama pemandu seperti mendapat pengalaman visual dan audio, asyik.
Dan jangan lupa mampir rehat untuk sholat di Masjid Soko Tunggal, masih disekitaran Taman Sari dekat lokasi parkir.

Review Text:
I think it would be nicer to have a local tourguide when visiting this place, so we know the history. That time when I visited Taman Sari, the guides were all booked and we didn't really see much. However, the price is really cheap so I guess it's okay if you wanna come back next time.

Remember to keep the tickets if you'd like to visit the well (it's underground).

Untuk sebuah water castle (taman sari),menurut pandangan saya agak kurang terawat. Bangunan dengan cat yang berlumut dan terkelupas, terlihat seperti bangunan yang "kumuh". Menurut sejarah yang diceritakan guide kami,seharusnya tempat ini adalah tempat relaksasi Sultan dengan para selir. Tempat yang indah dengan taman bunga, namun hal ini tidak nampak pada masa sekarang.karena kami hanya melihat bangunan tua dan cat yang sudah kotor. Mungkin sedikit peremajaan cat dan pemeliharaan taman yang baik dapat memberikan citra Taman Sari pada masa kejayaan nya dahulu. Bangunan bersejarah tidak perlu identik dengan cat yang kotor,berlumut dan spt tidak terawat bukan?
Nice place to go to wenn you are in Jogjakarta. Besides the castle it is nice to explore the streets around the castle.
Entry prices were decent. There were many Indonesian tourists visiting while I was there making it a bit crowded.

Went there on weekdays, and it's open at 8:45 a.m. The entrance fee is Rp. 5K only for Indonesian.

Found the beautiful sceneries inside the complex. So, you better have a guide, who can help taking photos if you come alone, and sharing its historical story. It's really a huge complex.

There are souvenirs or batik shops surrounds. And, I found a unique local cloth shop, named "Voice of Jogja", selling bamboo fabric of cloth. Buy some as souvenirs for friends or relatives.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: After queuing for the tickets, and looking at the outside, I was surprised how beautiful it was, when you first walk in through the arch, and down the stairs. You are met by a lovely pool and everybody crowding to get a photograph on the stairs. There are plenty more photo opportunities elsewhere in the grounds. There is lots of little hiding places to find, with the help of the leaflet we received, with our tickets. Make sure to find the underground mosque, which is very busy, but definitely worth a look around.

Um, ok so I guess it was an improvement on Kraton. I still wouldn't exactly call it cool/exciting/fun/worth it. The guided tour was interesting enough, to find out how the sultan lived and what some of the traditions were. But it was just a little bland. A few swimming pools and some staircases. But if you're looking for a time filler it wasn't awful 😊

Kereeenn..  Rasanya seperti terbawa suasana kraton gitu,  apalagi saat diceritakan kisah raja dan putri2 di zaman itu. Jadi semakin bangga deh dengan indonesia.  Harga tiket  masuknya juga amat sangat terjangkau.  Letaknya ditengah kota juga menambah nilai plus dari tempat ini.
Un bel giro al Water Castle è d'obbligo, noi lo abbiamo fatto con un ragazzo molto preparato e coinvolgente che ci faceva da guida e ci è piaciuto molto!!!

Imagine the life of the old sultan residing in this beautiful old water castle.  It has been restored and has a lot of ancient charm.  A perfect place for photographs and to pretend to be an old member of the Javanese court.

Review Text: My friends and I visited this place when holiday season and it was very crowded. And I love the experience and the architecture.
Kemaren (1 jan 2017) dateng kesini pas rame bgt krn libur panjang.tiket masuknya murah only 5rb. Pemandu wisatanya nice bgt :)

Di tamansari kita bisa mengetahu dan melihat seperti apa kolam renang atau pemandian para putri dan juga raja. Lokasi lorong yang di lrwati untuk sampai ke tempat pemandian raja cukup jauh dan panas melewati rumah penduduk setempat, tempat ini membuktikan bahwa jaman dulu banyak ruangan bawah tanah yang ada di setiap istana atau keraton. Tempatnya menyenangkan.

Review Text:
Taman sari ini areanya luas sehingga membutuhkan tenaga yg cukup utk berjalan kaki pindah dari ruangan satu menuju ke ruangan lainnya serta bangunan lain yg terpisah melewati perkampungan yg lebih dikenal dgn kampung cyber. 
Kalau liburan ke Jogja sempatkan waktu berkunjung ke sini. 
Lokasi istana ini dekat juga dengan pasar Ngasem, Malioboro, pendopo dalem, alun2 Utara dan Selatan serta Keraton kesultanan Yogyakarta.
This place is a 'must'. It gives some insight into the lives of sultans of the past. Three baths, for wives and concubines, for kids and for the king himself. Weird, but beautiful.

Like everywhere else in Yogyakarta it is usually crowded, but in a good day the pools are really very beautiful 

To call it a castle is a little grand. Certainly it does not have the scale of a European castle or chateau. And a lot of maintenance need to be done.  

The history is fascinating. And it gives a good cultural experience

In de ochtend bezocht, toen al erg veel toeristen vooral uit Indonesië. Ticket kost 15.000 rp voor je camera moet je extra bij betalen. Net als bij veel andere attracties staan er bij binnenkomst guides die je willen rondleiden, en op het einde kom je langs verschillende winkeltjes.
Leuk om eens te bezoeken, probeer dit wel zo vroeg als mogelijk te doen.

Review Text: Good place to get oldies kind of picture. Take the tour guide they did pretty good and helped to take pictures for us. They didn't put fix price for the service so it is up to us to give freely to them. Very friendly.

Hanya kata mistis yang mewakili suasana di Tamansari. Membayangkan jaman dulu Sultan Jogja main ke Tamansari dan "memilih" salah satu istrinya untuk menemaninya di kawasan indah ini.
Kok enak ya jadi Raja di jaman dahulu.
It's a great experience, but try not to go at peak hours or on a holiday as it will be full of tourists. Could do with a bit of signage to inform which buildings are which and a decent bathroom

It does get very crowded but the Water Castle has some interesting history and some great photo opportunities in the underground mosque. Much more interesting to visit than the Kraton or Malioboro street.

Review Text:
Sorry , not an interesting place. Sorry enough. We are not keen to see royal  palace.
Not an interesting place.

Visited on 23/12/2016. It was a garden for one of the old Sultans, but has now fallen into disrepair except for the main pool complex and the underground Mosque. A great place to explore as a whole village community has grown up in between the buildings that are still standing. Many photo opportunities and worth a visit.

Taman Sari merupakan situs bekas kebun istana keraton ngayogyakarto yang dibangun pada masa Sultan Hamengku Buwono I.

Woho, sudah lama sekali ya.. eits namun bangunan tua itu masih saja membuat saya terkagum-kagum. Pada awal desember lalu, saya dan teman saya yang merupakan orang asli jogja namun bekerja diluar kota menyempatkan datang ke taman sari.

Perlu kalian ketahui, kompleks taman sari ini dibagi jadi 4 bagian. Bagian pertama yaitu danau buatan selanjutnya bagian pemandian umbul binangun lalu bagian pasarean ledok sari dan kolam garjitawati lalu terakhir bagian kompleks magangan.

Bagian dalam taman sari tidak akan saya ulas semuanya ya. Disini akan saya ulas tempat yang menjadi favorit saya saja. Pertama yaitu danau buatan. Saat pertama masuk di kompleks taman sari, anda hanya perlu lurus mengikuti jalan dan tidak lama kemudian anda akan menemukan pemandangan eksotis yang menyegarkan. Kedua yaitu sumur gumiling yang dapat dijangkau melalui terowongan bawah tanah. Sumur gumiling pada waktu itu digunakan sebagai tempat peribadatan sultan yaitu dimaksudkan sebagai masjid. Satu lagi yaitu menara di dekat pemandian air, tempat yang sangat tepat untuk melihat  pemandangan biru nya air yang menyegarkan di danau buatan.

Hanya dengan membayar Rp. 3000 (lokal) dan Rp. 7000 (mancanegara) + 1000 (bawa kamera) (kalau tidak salah) anda sudah dapat menikmati keindahan istana pemandian taman sari. 

Pesan untuk semua pengunjung untuk selalu menjaga kebersihan dan keindahan. Karena saya menemukan banyaknya coret-coretan di dinding bawah tanah dan menara pandang. Ayo lestarikan tempat bersejarah ini dan jangan sekali-kali melupakan sejarah! Terima kasih.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Tempatnya keren buat foto foto...

Review Text: The water castle is bog but there are only a couple of places you pay for, one is where the pool is (like one big outdoor room) and the other is the underground mosque.  The pool was nice enough for a few photos but that was all and the mosque can get quite crowded.  There isn't that much else in Jogja city area so this is ok to visit just don't expect too much.

The entrance fee & guide were next to nothing. He was a lovely old chap who spoke very good English & made the visit much more worthwhile. 

I learned a lot about the Sultan.

호텔에서 가까운 곳이라 구글지도를 보며 찾아가는데 주변에 친절을 베푸는 현지인들이 너무 많아 성가실 정도였음. 현지인 중년남자가 자기도 가는중이라며 마구잡이로 우리 부부를 데리고 가는데 으슥한 골목을 이리저리 끌고가 당황스럽고 불안했음. 그런데 이 골목이 유명한 따만사리골목길이었던 것 같음. 끌려다니느라고 정신이 하나도 없었음.
따만사리 매표소 앞에서 본격적으로 가이드 해주겠다는걸 억지로 뿌리침.
따만사리는 정말 사진에 나오는 슐탄의 풀장과 탈의실 건물만 달랑 있었음. 땡볓속에 있다가 풀장을 보니 시원해지기는 했지만 조금 속았다 하는 느낌도 들었음. 족자카르타 문화재가 있는 관광명소가 거의 대부분 빈약함.  짧은 일정 의 여행자라면보르부도르사원과 뿌남바란사원만 보고 나머지는 사진만 봐도 될듯.
참고로 우리 부부는 족자에 일주일 있었음.

place was looks so old, and feel like history all there, remind the king who rule the area. many waters, recommend bring umbrella when rainy season. guide is available, need one for the first time, so that will be usefull ti explain.

The location is near from Ngasem traditional market. The entrance ticket is only 5,000 IDR and plus 2,000 IDR if we bring camera (documentation permit). The architecture of this building is influenced by European architectural style. Cleanliness of the building is quite well preserved, even though the paint buildings are a bit dirty because of the moss. Overall, it is a nice place to visit.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Taman sari use to be a magical place for me but today is just an ordinary place for tour or sight seing.  I spent half an hour wondering around but all I can remember is place of people offering things to sell such as shirts and wooden art. No self guidance either on the sites. It has lost its magic....

A follow up visit if you do intend to visit Kraton Palace which is not far away from each other.

There are few directional signs to guide you around. You can still get around well by asking the friendly and helpful locals and visitors there. A guide is helpful but not essential. 

The pool water is not as clean as what appears in web site pages. Buildings appeared not maintain.

 Some interest points are hidden with no directional signs at all. Do feel free to ask for directions so you do miss out on them.

Some parts of the underground walkways are dark and have pot holes. A torchlight would be helpful to avoid tripping or spraining your ankle.

Likely in about an hour one should be able to  cover most of the point of interests.

因为缺少对水宫的了解，有点走马观花。
ปราสาทที่ลึกลับ และความเป็นมาที่น่าสนใจ ผู้คนที่เป็นมิตรที่นั่น  ยินดีที่จะพาเราไปเที่ยวโดยไม่คิดค่าใช้จ่าย ตำนานที่โรงแมนติค ของสถานที่แห่งนี้ อาจทำเอาคนตกหลุมรักมันได้ง่ายๆ

Review Text:
午前中しか入場出来ないとの事なので、こちらを先に見て午後にプランバナン寺院へ行ったが大雨に会ってしまった。
雨の確率の低い午前中を潰してしまってでも見る価値は無いのかな、と思った。
schön und gepflegt. Es lohnt sich den Weg Keraton bis dorthin auf sich zu nehmen. Der Eintrittspreis ist okay.

Saya kesini mengantar teman, dan saya agak kecewa dengan keadaan Istana Air Tamansari saat ini. Lebih baik berkunjung saat jam buka (saya sarankan pagi sampai siang hari), jangan kesini saat sore hari, setelah jam 15.00 ke atas, karena loket tiket sudah tutup, dan anda akan masuk dengan bantuan pemandu. Pemandu terlalu sering mengantarkan kami ke toko-toko sekitar Tamansari, meskipun kami kurang tertarik untuk berkunjung ke toko. Tamansari juga terlalu berdekatan dengan rumah penduduk, sehingga nuansa situs sejarahnya berkurang. Harga pada toko-toko di sekitar Tamansari juga terlalu mahal dibandingkan dengan di Malioboro. 
Istana Air Tamansari ini juga terlihat kurang terawat, banyak bekas perbaikan yang belum dibereskan. Amat disayangkan.

Review Text: You can imagine that you were the king and you walk into the pool with a thousand of beauties. What you can do is just imagination. The building is still in good keep. However you have to buy a ticket for entry.

yogyakarta has many beautiful place to visit, the one is tamansari water castle complex. for the history lovers i think you must visit this place, and for photography lovers this is a good place to make a vintage concept. the complex consist of 3 pool (sometimes dirty green water but sometimes clean water), underground mosque, and pulo kenanga site. the ticket is cheap, and this location is near keraton, alun-alun, and malioboro

"Tamansari is one of the historical buildings of Sultan Palace or Keraton Yogyakarta.
Tamansari means "A Beautiful Garden". Built by Sri Sultan Hamengku Buwana I in the year of 1684 Javanese Year (1758 A.D.), Tamansari was a recreation and a royal bathing place and also a retreat place for Sultan of Yogyakarta and his family. It has become the symbol of The Glory of Mataram King.
Tamansari which is known as water castle has the value of architecture and the uniqueness of the slope of the building and the filled waterpool.
This water castle was surrounded with Segaran or an artificial lake where an artificial island covered the fragrance of flowers lay in the middle." (Tamansari Ngayogyakarta flyer, 2016)

Taman Sari Water Castle is a site of a former royal garden of the Sultanate of Yogyakarta.  Taman Sari can be divided into four areas. The first area is the artificial lake Segaran located in the west. The second area is a bathing complex in the south of the Segaran lake, called the Umbul Binangun bathing complex. The third area, now completely gone, is the Pasarean Ledok Sari and Garjitawati Pool, located in the south of the bathing complex. The fourth area is the east side of the first and second area, which extend far to the east and to the southeast complex of Magangan. The second area, the bathing complex, was not the focal point of Taman Sari, however it is the best preserved area in the complex and is currently the most popular tourist attraction.
There are two gates that lead to the bathing complex, the western one called Gedhong Gapura Hageng and the eastern one called Gedhong Gapura Panggung. Both gates are decorated with ornaments of stylized birds and flowering foliages. The west entrance, the Gedhong Gapura Hageng was formerly used as the main entrance to the bathing complex. The east facade of the gate is still visible today, but blocked by settlements. The east entrance, the Gedhong Gapura Panggung is still functioning as a gate and is now the main entrance for tourists.

Umbul Pasiraman is a bathing complex for the royal family. The bathing complex is an enclosed space surrounded by tall structures. It consists of three pools decorated with mushroom-shaped springs and large flower pots.

Today, the area around the Taman Sari castle complex is occupied by a settlement called Kampung Taman with 2,700 residents. The community is known for their batik and traditional painting craft traditions. 
A must-see attraction in Yogyakarta!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Dans 5 ans, environ, le Sultan du territoire de Yogjakarta va déplacer le kampung encore actuellement autour des restes du château d'eau, pour rénover et agrandir le site et en faire un lieu plus adapté au tourisme de masse. Et ce kampung fait intégralement partie du magnifique monument en question. Car ce lieu appartient d'abord et avant tout à ces gens de condition très modeste dont la plupart d'entre eux sont des descendants de serviteurs des Sultans passés...

Les actuels habitants de ce kampung seront selon leur choix soit dédommagé soit relogés sur une colline en dehors de jogja.

Le kampung, c'est encore aujourd'hui ce village fait de charmantes petites venelles et de petites maisons habitées par des gens humbles qui connurent par leurs parents le passé exact de ce lieu magique, jouèrent enfants dans ce lieu enchanteur lorsque le tourisme de masse était encore un mot inconnu.

Encore une fois; comme pour Borobudur et Prambanan, prenez s'il vous plaît un guide !!!! Combien de touristes manquent l'essentiel, passent à côté de ces 5 lieux ( nous incluons ici le kraton et le cimetière des Sultans) pour X raisons...

Le coucher de soleil depuis le point culminant du lieu est saisissant et loin du tumulte sonore incessant et de la pollution  de cette ville  ( dont nous attendons que les autorités interviennent au niveau de l'émission des gaz d'échappement 😧 des motorbike d'abord et avant tout en termes de normes antipollution car elle dessert son propre revenu, le tourisme ), discrétion et respect des habitants exigés.
