Kita bisa melihat2 tempat pemandian putri dulu, ada pawon/dapur dalam bahasa jawa.
Dan ada bbrp spot2 yg bisa dijadikan objek foto.
Uniknya tempat ini sambung dengan pemukiman warga, jd pd saat mau ke tmpat lain kita melewati rumah2 warga.
Dan beberapa warga disana yang menyediakan jajanan seperti snak atau minuman segar. Jd sambil jalan bisa sambil jajan.
Ada juga sbagian warga yg menyediakan toilet umum, di bagian pekarangan rumahnya.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Sehr schöner Palastteil, der den Prunk vergangener Zeiten eindrucksvoll Wiederspiegelt. Dem Restaurationsaufwand ist der etwas erhöhte Eintrittspreis geschuldet, die entspannte Atmosphäre entschädigt aber vollkommen. Sehr zu empfehlen sind die umliegenden Gewölbe und Gebäude, welche frei zugänglich sind.

Paling hits akhir - akhir ini adalah berfoto ditaman sari karena arsitekturnya menarik dengan mengenal kebudayaan jogja pada jaman dahulu yang nyaman dan bangunannya terlihat pendek tidak terlalu tinggi
Remember to go to explore the lower half located at the left hand side of the castle. There is some hidden beauty...

pertama kali masuk ke water castle ini dibuat terkagum-kagum dengan arsitektur kuno yang sangat menakjubkan sekali. Ornamen bangunan khas jaman kerajaan membuat pengunjung berasa kembali ke jaman kerajaan Mataram. Sangat recommended buat yang suka foto ala vintage
Posto nel cuore della cittadella è un esempio elegante nell città di Yogya. L'aspetto decadente lo rende un pò spento, ma si tratta di una delle cose sicuramente più interessanti da vedere sul luogo
El sitio no es muy espectacular y se difumina con casas aledañas y no queda claro lo que hay que ver,hay gente a la entrada intentando cobrar entrada,no lo hagais,es gratis!
If you have time,it is nice to see,entrance ticket is cheap,15000 rp. But if it is not on your way you are not missing anything.
The water palace itself is a pretty quick walk but make sure you make it to labyrinth of streets behind it and don't miss the underground mosque. Many nice coffee shops and lots of murals/graffiti.

It's a huge place. For local tourist, you need to pay Rp. 5000/person + extra Rp. 2000 if you bring you own camera. Maybe you need a tour guide, because this place is a little bit tricky. If you have a map of this place, just go by your self. If you're not, try to follow another tourist or you'll get lost. Because this place located within local houses. But I can say this place is a good place.

The Water Castle is location that a typical tourist can skip. The structures and walls are pretty old and walls are not very well maintained. I visited the location at 1400 hr and found the place not worth visiting.

You need to have good sense of direction to explore around at this historical place as it is lack of direction but it's kinda good cause you'll get to explore with more adventurous feeling. You need to explore the garden till you reached kampung cyber (if i'm not mistaken), you'll find other places such as underground mosque.

Tempat bersejarah warisan nenek moyang bangsa Indonesia...
Tempat wisata cagar budaya yang menjadi kebanggaan orang Indonesia, khususnya masyarakat Jogjakarta...tapi sayang sekali tempat ini kurang terawat.

E' esattamente quello che c'è da vedere. Un palazzo con di fronte una vasca d'acqua in un cortile. Ed è pure a pagamento (seppure costi circa un euro).

Non vale assolutamente la pena.
To begin with, no proper direction (no map provided and no signage). We easily got lost trying to find our way out. Poor maintenance of one of the tourist attraction.
사진에서 보이는 물의 정원은 그동안 다녔던 곳들과 달라 신비롭고 멋지고, 아름답습니다. 그런데 이 정원 말고는 딱히 볼 거리가 없어서 아쉽습니다.
Es un sencillo palacio con piscinas donde iba el sultán con sus concubinas. No es de esos sitios que te dejan con la boca abierta pero es recomendable si visitas la ciudad
Me decepcionó un poquito, quizás porque cuando lo visitamos no tenía agua. Lo más interesante, el pequeño mercado local que hay en los alrededores.
Secondo me vale la visita molto bello, noi quando siamo andati era pieno di gente locale che lo stava visitando. Consigliato!

Nice heritage form the kingdom relic..
The water castle location near by sultan palace of jogjakarta...
If you stay arround maliboro street you can by becak 10 minut only...

Pertama kali masuk taman sari bener2 exicited....walaupun bangunannya sdh berabad-abad,tapi suasana jaman kerajaan nya masih sangat terasa,apalagi kalo kita masuk ke salah satu kamar raja dan permaisuri nya rasanya kayak kembali ke jaman tersebut.Pemandunya juga dengan detail menjelaskan setiap sudut ruangan dan termasuk kolam pemandian nya...

Jalan dari satu tempat ke tempat yang lainnya lumayan jauh banget, karna udah banyak orang yang dateng kesini jadi susah buat dapet spot foto, bangunannya keliatan udah tua banget tapi masih kokoh, paling suka foto di bangunan paling atas serasa kaya di luar negeri.
Mi ero fatta un'idea diversa, le vasche non sono cosi grandi come mi aspettavo e sono tenute malissimo, oltre al degrado pure la sporcizia e la ruggine.
saat ku pergi tiada guide jadi tidak ku tahui kisah disebalik taman sari. tapi bangunan cocok skali untuk bergambar walau tidak banyak untuk dilawati

Nella delusione di questa città, rientra anche questa visita, che al di là di 2 piscinette, non offre assolutamente niente, se non i soliti mercatini e negozietti che si trovano ovunque per far spillare soldi ai turisti più ingenui. Certo che se si è a Yogya per qualche giorno, ci si capita per forza.

Pretty interesting place to walk around. Exploring the surrounding areas was probably the highlight for me. You get to see hidden gems in that area. One of the streets outside the Tamansari has a lot of colourful street art.
Interesante la visita a los estanques y restos del palacio, y más interesante el paseo por las callejuelas de lo que fue el recinto del palacio, incluyendo la visita  la mezquita subterránea.

Il water castle merita assolutamente una visita, più del palazzo reale che si può sicuramente evitare.
Consiglio di fare la visita con una delle "guide" che si trovano all'ingresso.. Alcuni parlano anche in italiano ma attenzione: chiedete subito il prezzo!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Bezoek Kraton en drie verschillende delen van sultan paleis. Mooi en representatief voor Yogyakarta. Vroeg in ochtend beste tijd.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Despite the fact that the place was crowded with Sunday national tourists (that were as exited with me with this visit) the place certainly preserves his past charm and has a lot of information to share. I regret not getting a guide, since the information around its not widely available. Since its connect with the surrounding kampung, it brings that extra to the visitor, and plenty of small shops to walk in. I wish I planned more time for this visit. A must see
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I visited here with my driver/guide who told me about the history, one pool was for the wives one for daughters and then the sultan was I'm a different pool spirited.  He would climb the tower and throw a flower down and the lady who got it would get lucky that night. This attraction is reasonably priced. If you visit without a guide local English speaking  guides are available if not quite instant but a firm no will let them leave you alone. It is reasonably priced and worth seeing.

Voila, les photos sont parfois flatteuse, car en vrai, nous ne sommes pas à l'apogée du lieu. C'est moyen, comme le Kraton si vous avez un peu de temps, si vous avez fait la Monkey Forest (ou pas comme nous, pas envie de voir des singes fous dans un parc)/ Breg c'est Yogyakarta, heureusement c'est qu'un étape.

入場すると声をかけてきて案内をはじめました。周りも私達と同じような感じの人が多くいたのでここはこういうシステム??などと思いながら特別断りもしませんでした。主人は最後にチッブを渡しましたがとっても簡単な片言英語で短時間・・・なんだかすごく損をした感じがしました。狭いところでそんなに説明をすることもないので、短時間に稼げる場所なのでこのような人が多いのでしょう。はじめにはっきり断ったほうがいいですよ。
It is easy to combine the visit with the Kraton Palace. After that make sure to also take a look at the living quarters Kampung Taman.

We had read that that was one of the must visit places in the city tour of Yogyakata, but we felt it was highly over-rated. You could give it a miss. We had a guide too, but his command over the language was not good, so he was unable to do justice 
It is not maintained well either.

Bangunannya tua tapi bagian dalamnya masih terawat. Ada satu bagian yang ada di tengah perumahan orang dan jalannya kecil2. Harus tanya2 sama orang sekitar biar ga tersesat. Tapi bagus utk mampir sebentar kalo ke jogja.

Quite photogenic with 2 nice courtyards. Yes it is small but there's not many other great attractions in the centre of yogya.

Tip: from here you can get a Rickshaw to the kraton/palace although the palace is rubbish.

Definitely a must see place, where you will be amazed by how people from the past built this place. It also has an underground mosque which is very fascinating as well, called Sumur Gumuling. A tour guide is a must for this place to know more about this attraction, if I'm not mistaken the entrance fee is included with a tour guide.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Not worth spending money for entrance ticket and also time if you have other things to do. A small water pool with a designed lay out for smallish gardens. Overall, injudicious investment of time

Come da recensione sul kraton, il water castle e' più interessante è merita senz altro un po del vostro tempo. Attenzione alla sua dislocazione perché il suo sviluppo non è proprio chiaro o ben indicato sulle cartine disponibili. Noi abbiamo avuto la fortuna di essere seguiti da una guida volontaria che gratuitamente ci ha condotto alla visita descrivendoci che cosa via via stavamo osservando. Credo che senza guida tutto sarebbe risultato meno chiaro e interessante. Se vi capiterà la nostra stessa fortuna anche se non richiesta lasciate una piccola mancia per un servizio completo ed esaustivo.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Arsitektur bangunannya bagus untuk objek foto plus banyak banget nilai sejarahnya. Hanya lokasi didalam area perumahan penduduk jadi agak sulit dicari

At first, me and my friends didn't know about this place till an old man told us about it. He told us to buy a ticket first, then we can go anywhere around taman sari. He guide us and said water castle was a great one of historical building. We just need to pay him around $1 for guiding us for the path which is look like an old hallway. As we reach the water castle, I only can say it worth and nice carved building and old building too. I like this place.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Geschichtlich eigentlich einMuss, aber es gibt nicht mehr allzu viel  zu sehen. leider nicht in sehr gepflegtem Zusstand.
this place was beautiful. traditional, unique, instagramable, we had amazing experience there and the kids can learn more about the history

Si il vous reste du temps pour y passer , les bassins sont agréables à  voir. 
De petits marchands nous ont permis d'acheter des noix de coco fraîches dont nous avons siroté le jus. 
Nous nous sommes faits photographier en tant qu'européens exotiques !

This is one of the heritage place of Jogja. We need to spend IDR 5000 for ticket and extra charge if you bring camera. This location is wide and it's surrounding by housing. If we want to know about the history, we should rent a guide.
王宮から何台ものベチャが「タマンサリ」と言って誘ってきますが結局歩いていきました。割と簡単に行けました。王様が水浴びする美女を眺めたということですが、これだけ暑いなら私だったら美女と一緒に泳ぎたいところです。プールの底が汚れているのがちょっと興ざめです。

Blij gezien te hebben, maar meer dan een halfuurtje spendeer je niet aan dit minimale watercomplex. Niet al te best onderhouden, maar dat maakt het net charmant. Pal in het centrum, de leuke rit met de becak krijg je er als extraatje bij.

18.yüz yıla ait bir tarihi eser jokjanın yaklaşık 2km güneyinde mimari ile suyun muhtesem kompinasyonu insanlara eşsiz bir manzara zevki veriyor.Eski krallığın bahcede oluşturduğu bir nevi meditasyon ve dinginlik alanı olarak kulandığı bu yapı gercekten insanı o anlara götürüyor.havuzlar hamamlar yapay gölle desteklenmiş bir komplex,gercekten herkesin burayı görmesini tavsiye ederim,yaşandığı dönemin mimari ve estetik zevkinin yanında   insan ruhuna huzur veren bir tarafı var sanki..

Le prix de l'entrée est assez faible, le lieu a un certain charme et se visite rapidement : pourquoi ne pas y faire un tour si vous êtes à proximité ?
Attention aux faux guides qui essaient de s'imposer.  Autre bémol : un vrai dédale de rues pour le trouver !...
Ambiente rilassante costituito però solo da due vasche enormi di acqua azzurra! Il resto della struttura è inesistente e mal tenuto, potrebbero ottenere molto di più!
The central bathing area is the only well-preserved part left of a much larger mid-18th royal garden complex largely destroyed by an earthquake in 1867. Beautifully restored.

A very short visit is enough. Don't worry about a guide!
Got lots of batik to sell, and a place to show you how batik is made.
Not realy impressive. Place is in a bad shape.
地元の人がポーズを取って、写真を撮っていました。昔の沐浴場は、水があってキレイです。私はあまり興味がわきませんでしたが

Most beautiful place. Period. 

Tamansari is a leftover of Jogjakarta'a ancient kingdom's bathing area + river + castles + underground mosque all in one. Although you can't see the river nowadays (it's turned into a local village), you just need to get a capable tour guide to be able to understand its amazing history.

I happened to find one tour guide that would take our pictures in the most amazing angles. Contact 081804202498 (Bapak Yadi) for reservation, and I'm not paid for this. He's one great guide with views not only about the place & photography, but also about life. 

Be immersed in unnerving views & I suggest coming here not during holidays, to take everything in. The Rp 5.000 entry fee is far far too cheap.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The 'castle' complex itself isn't as vast as one would think if compared to the castles in Europe. The main attraction is the pool in the middle of the courtyard where the King would watch his concubines (?) bathe. You can hire a guide here who will tell you the basic history of the place - there is no fixed price so you pay him what you think is suitable. We paid ours Rp50,000 which is slightly more than the price of the entry ticket. He showed us an underground mosque and an 'IT Village' which Mark Zuckerberg himself visited and officiated several years ago.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: We had one more day to spend in Jodja and we decided to visit the water castle and the Kraton.  Fortunately,  we decided to take a guide with the Backstreet academy. Yulia has plenty of knowledge on the history, all the sultans.  More over,  visiting the water palace without explanations would be really so-so. But with Yulia,  we visited a lot of hidden parts,  tunnels... And a lot of hidden stories.  This palace was a great place but with almost no renovation during 100 years,  everything disappears slowly.  It's sad because it's part of Indonesian history that will be forgotten.  Yulia is really helping to keep it alive.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Devo dire che la visita al Tamansari è stata un po' deludente. La struttura non è proprio ben tenuta e le sale interne sono spoglie e prive di qualsiasi interesse.
Abbiamo preso una guida all'entrata che oltre al Tamansari(che consiste in 3 piscine ed un edificio centrale con le camere del sultano di cui resta solo una specie di letto) ci ha fatto fare un giro per gli altri edifici del vecchio kraton diciamo. La visita non vale molto la pena, una serie di camere spoglie di cui restano solo le pareti...

Wir hatten das Glück, dass uns eine Studentin, die ihr englisch aufbessern wollte eine kostenlose Führung gegeben hat. Man kann auch auch einen Guide am Eingang anheuern, kosten +/-10€.
Grundsätzlich ist die Anlage recht unspektakulär und leider nicht wirklich gut gepflegt. Das interessanteste an der Führung waren die unterirdischen Geheimgänge, die aber ohne fremde Hilfe nur schwer zu finden sind.

Fazit: war ganz okay, aber ein Must-see ist es für uns nicht.

Une visite rapide dans un endroit qui devait être intéressant à l'époque mais délaissé et en décrépitude avancée. Il est agréable de se promener dans les ruelles derrière le temple où beaucoup de gens vivent.

The most interesting part was the free vestiges. The paying part was uninteresting. The pools are green, haven't been cleaned in years and their visit last about 5 minutes. Much better things to do in Yogjakarta but worth the walk from Kraton if you have the time to spare.
徒歩で訪れた為時間がかかりましたが迷わずに辿り着けました。白い壁沿い（王宮の反対側から）です。中は予想通り（写真通り）であまり感動しませんでしたが時折当時の王族の風景を感じさせて頂きました！ガイドがいればもう少し感想が変わっていたかも？
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Visit if you want to see something different from the usual temples, intricate carvings, artefacts....
Recommend reading up on background before so you can connect the use, meaning, and style of the buildings.
Don't expect too much and you may be pleasantly surprised.
Even een bliksembezoek gebracht aan het waterkasteel.  Niet heel bijzonder. Te veel souvenirwinkels en te weinig cultuur.

Forse un tempo era un luogo da visitare e per il quale conveniva dedicare del tempo. 
Oggi e' poco piu che un ammasso di macerie e pareti diroccate.
Per chi ha tempi stretti non credo debba inserire questa location nei luoghi da visitare.

Petit moment de calme dans une ville envahie par le parc de moto.
L'endroit mériterait d'être restauré et entretenu un peu.
Cela reste un endroit sympa et à voir.

Palazzo carino, niente di particolare ma interessante con la guida che gratuitamente vi accompagna e spiega i vari dettagli! Per la guida chiedete all'ingresso se non ve la offrono. 30 min per girarlo tutto. Molto vicino al Karaton palace.
There is really nothing special about the Water Castle, not too sure why it's a tourist attraction. Its a waste of time.

Most of the whole reviews are about the great and incredible palace. But it's worth to visit it on non-public holiday or peak season.
And don't miss the Kampoeng Cyber in its surrounding area.

The place is a bit hard to find. There are a couple of signs that lead you to the main building, but there are also parts that are scattered amongst the houses. You have to wander around a bit and if lucky, you stumbel upon them. Entrance ticket (15.000) seems to be valid for two sites: the main building with the ponds and a round building which you have to reach trough an underground passage. They won't tell you that when you buy the ticket. Other remains are for free, but for how long....(they are under construction for the moment but you can go in to have a look)
We read about the history on the internet because there are no signs with explanations. Otherwise you have to take a guide.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This place has some pretty negative reviews but I thought it was worth it. It's a much more chilled place than Borobudur and easily walking distance from the main city area Malioboro. The charge today was 15,000IDR not 7 or 10 as other reviews say. There are loads of people trying to take selfies and also people that will start a tour without your consent and then demand money (so be careful)...BUT, if you ignore that the place itself is stunning and there are some peaceful side roads to explore on your way out .
The main part (paid)  seems to be nice. Some buildings and tunnels are outside the compound and can be visited free, but there is no water.
入場料15000ルピア。入ってみるといがいと広い。お手軽な観光スポット。マリオボロ通りからベチャで行くのもジョグジャカルタらしくていいかも
Sympa à voir mais pas non plus extraordinaire. À faire si on a un peu de temps sur Jogja! La visite se fait rapidement mais cela reste assez agréable

Mengunjungi tempat wisata taman sari harus memerlukan seorang guide karena setiap sudut atau tempat dilokasi taman sari tidak terdapat literatur/penjelasan mengenai area tsb. Seharusnya, setiap sudut diberi papan petunjuk atau keterangan mengenai tempat dan kegunaan lokasi tersebut pada masa lalu. Contohx ruang mesjid atau musholla yg berada dibawa tanah, dipintu masuk ruangan dpt ditempel berupa tulisan yg memuat keterangan singkat soal musholla tersbt, dimana imam berdiri, tempat shollat wanita dan pria, dan beberapa keterangan tambahan lainx. Atau lokasi tempat permandian istri sultan/ raja, dgn memberi sedikit keterangan bahwa, ditempat itu raja biasax akan melempar sebuah kembang/ bunga ke tempat permandian, dan salah satu istrix yg mendapatkan bunga/ kembang tsb akan diberi ijin utk mandi ditempat tertentu yg terletak dibelakang gedung ruang ganti raja ( keterangan yg kami dpt dr salah satu guide yg mengantarkan kami mengelilingi lokasi taman sari). Dengan demikian, tanpa seorang guide pun kami dpt mengerti dan membayangkan kegunaan tempat atau lokasi tersebut pd masa lalu.

There is nothing special about the Water Castle and it's a tired structure that needs some restoration, especially since it's a tourist attraction. However, I loved Sumur Gumuling, which is just steps away, so just a quick visit to take in this site is all that is needed. If you're short on time in Yogyakarta, it's not essential to come here.
Bueno...si estás por la zona y has visto el kraton (es la misma entrada) está bien para darle una costilla.
There is not much to see at this tourist attraction. Will not recommend this to other tourists to Yogyakarta - spend your time on other things that are more worthwhile
Tempat unik dan bersejarah bagian dari keraton Jogya yang terkenal, sayangnya kurang terawat, kebersihan kurang dijaga.

Fue el templo del sultán, se puede observar que en su época sería espectacular con grandes piscinas. 
Pero ahora necesita una restauración, debido a que está medio derruido y las piscinas están vacías.
En mi opinión es mejor ir con guía para que te pueda explicar la historia ya que es interesante.

Es un "castillo" con varias piscinas. Todo muy descuidado.
Las historias del sultán fueron entretenidas. 
Quedarse en yogyakarta sólo para ver eso,  pues no vale la pena.

Different from other attractions in the city, the site is well preserved with locals and artisans living in and around the area, making it a nice place to walk around. The architecture is quite unique, though the pool area itself was a little underwhelming. The site itself and surrounding community was overall an interesting place to visit, especially as it did not seem like you were in the middle of a bustling city.

Come per ogni cosa..entrata a pagamento e questo non spiega proprio lo stato di abbandono di questo palazzo che è bellissimo. La visita dura una decina di minuti ma cmq ne vale la pena se siete nei dintorni.

I'm not sure how it works but my ticket seem to come with a guide. He was brilliant and ver knowledgable. Telling stories of the Sultan and his antics. The water palace is beautiful and very peaceful inside - I just sat by one of the polls for a while.  Make sure you also go to the underground mosque. I almost missed it (possible because I went back to spend more time in the water palace after my guide was finished his informative however very quick tour).
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Het huidige water castle is slechts een deel van wat het complex vroeger was. Wat er van overgebleven is nog erg mooi, maar een locale gids is nodig om je de mooie plekjes te laten zien. Op het oude complex is inmiddels een wijk gebouwd, het is leuk om daarin rond te lopen. Je kunt daar onder andere nog zien hoe Batik gemaakt wordt.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Tamansari kemudian banyak disebut sebagai Istana Air (water castle) yang karena nilai arsitektur dan keunikan pada lekukan bangunan dan air yang terisi dikolam kolam. Dalan sejarahnya yang disampaikan oleh beberapa orang yang menjadi guide Istana Air Tamansari menyebutkan bahwa Taman ini dipergunakan oleh Raja Mataram (Jogja) untuk melakukan mandi pada bulan-bulan tertentu.

I like how the local government continued to preserve the site with local residences still around. The building sites are still well maintained and this type of ancient architecture is indeed unique. Javanese style mixed with hinduism and Islam is hardly found anywhere else. The underground mosque is also unique compared to standard mosques in Indonesia. History, architecture lovers must visit this place!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Well worth the effort to see as it is free. 

However, it needs a makeover to bring it back to former glories and some information would have been helpful.
Je moet hier echt wel heen, maar er zijn zeker mooiere plekken. Je kunt nog heel ver door dwalen een soort wijkje in. Best leuk.
If you're gonna visit this place, dont forget to explore the underground. The mosque is really unique, it is a must to take photos there.

This compund use to be sprawling in size and filled with the beautiful princesses and royalties back in the days. Get a guide to explain the historical and cultural significance and let your mind roams....

Taman yang mendapat sebutan "The Fragrant Garden" ini memiliki luas lebih dari 10 hektare dengan sekitar 57 bangunan baik berupa gedung, kolam pemandian, jembatan gantung, kanal air, maupun danau buatan beserta pulau buatan dan lorong bawah air.

Untuk berkeliling ke 57 bangunan ini alangkah baiknya menyewa Tour Guide karena kalau tanpa Guide akan kesasar ke kampung. 

Ada bangunan di bawah tanah yang sangat cantik untuk berfoto ria.

Happy Holiday.

Per noi italiani il posto non è pieno di storia e arte quindi non aspettatevi nulla di che', né giochi di acqua come lascerebbe intendere il nome né effetti speciali due piscine nelle quali soggiornavano di giorno le concubine del sultano che dall'alto le osservava e poi ne sceglieva una per passarsi il
Pomeriggio con stanza annessa. Posto curioso.

Het is even zoeken waar het waterkasteel precies ligt en de eerste indruk is een matige. Een gedeeltelijk gerestaureerd gebouw waar niet bijster veel aan te zien is. Er is veel schade aangericht tijdens de aardbeving van 2006 en er wordt nog gewacht op geld van Unesco om de boel te restaureren. We worden aangesproken door een gids die geen geld vraagt voor zijn begeleiding. Hij is de derde generatie die voor de sultan werkt. De man is zijn geld dubbel en dwars waard, geeft veel informatie en laat ons alle plekken van het uitgebreide complex zien. We hadden de helft niet gevonden zonder zijn aanwijzingen. Het complex is indrukwekkend in zijn eenvoud. Wij vonden het een 'must see' als je in Yogya bent.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
The castle is beautiful on the pictures, but that's it... It has nothing much to tell, just a pool for royal family, altho it has mix style of architure of hindu, islamic, europe etc, but not very impressive at all.

I wouldn't spend the time here if I am on a tight schedule.
Koster kun 15.000 IDR at besøge stedet er lille og charmerende men turen er hurtig overstået, så sæt kun 15-20 af til dette sted.

Tamansari shows reflection of grander days, when sultans ruled and with it some of the more extravagant ways one could relax in a warm climate. The pools for the women and children, his own private pool and of course his "love nest" tower for viewing and relaxing. A marvel of water works. It must have been a real garden of paradise in its day.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
We were walking about and walked toward Tamansari. A guide approached us, though we didn't realize he was a guide at the time. He just struck up a conversation then started showing us the underground mosque and the water temple, Tamansari. There are a couple of guides at the entrance hanging out, so you will likely be approached. 

The Tamansari tour included requisite tours of the batik co-op and store with encouragements to buy from the artists. This was followed by a trip to another store, the tour guide's "brother's" store. I bought a batik print as a souvenir for home and think I paid 100,000 rupiah for a medium-sized print. Maybe expensive by local standards, but a good price for buying a memory to have on the wall at home ~$8 USD. 

In any case, Indonesia is so refreshing after India, because if you don't want to buy something, you won't be harassed. That's nice.

Tamansari is a pretty place to take pictures and learn a little about the sultan's family and how the water temple structure reflects religious tolerance with architecture reflecting Muslim, Hindu, and Christian influences.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Visite à faire avec un guide. Elle vous paraîtra plus sympa via les petites anecdotes qu'il aura à vous raconter. 
Bref à faire
Posto carino, prezzo del biglietto molto contenuto. Lo si visita un venti minuti. Sa vedere se si soggiorna in yogya per più giorni.
Betonnen bak met water entree is hoogtepunt water vijvers zwak binnen alleen kale ruimte kunt beter iets anders bezoeken

Vond dit de moeite waard om te bekijken. Het is niet heel groot, maar leuk om even door heen te lopen. Ziet er erg mooi uit, romantisch met dat water.

Leuk stukje cultuur.
Taman sari water castle one of beautiful place in Jogja. I've been waiting for the big renovation on this castle(guide said)

Voor een waterkasteel was er erg weinig water. Hier wsl via de achteringang binnen gekomen en een rondje gelopen. Het stelde in onze beleving niet zo veel voor. Niet echt iets om speciaal naar toe te reizen.

L'endroit est beau mais ne vaut pas nécessairement le détour, l'état de conservation du site est médiocre et les restaurations de mauvaise qualité. L'entrée est un peu cher pour ce qu'il y à avoir. À l'entrée vous allez avoir un responsable qui va insister pour être guide contre un don, ça peut valoir le coût, "l'arnaque" c'est qu'il va insister pour vous apporter à un café de Kopi Luwack, heureusement le café est une bonne expérience pour le prix.

Untuk masuk ke dalam istana harus membayar tiket. Harganya sangat terjangkau. Di sini kita bisa melihat taman yang dipenuhi dnegan bunga serta kolam air yang besar dengan airnya yang segar dan membuat kita ingin menyelam saja. Tentu saja hal ini tidak mungkin dilakukan. Kolam air menjadi tempat yang cantik untuk mengambil gambar. Apalagi dengan background istana yang klasik dan kokoh berdiri. Yang paling menyenangkan adalah bahwa bangunan sejarah satu ini masih terawat dengan sangat baik dan bisa kita explore. Ditambah lagi lokasi perkampungan yang sangat menarik serta penduduk yang ramah.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Would be pretty if renovated.
This used to be part of the palace and was connected by a canal (now gone). It was only for the use of the sultan and his wives and daughters. The sultan would sit in the tower over looking the two pools. The one closest to the tower was for his wives, the further one for his daughters. All swam naked. The sultan would throw a flower from the tower and which ever wife caught it, would join him in the third poll on the other side of the tower. They would then go to the sauna and spend the night together.
Online use for about 30 years and takes about 20 mins to look around. Cheap entry (Rp. 10000)
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I go here with family several times in past few years,last visit on may this year many improvement happens ,nice guide tour,clean place and good tshirt shop inside...amazing place.

Lucky I'm ordering the tour guide in this place he/she will guide you through the trip and take your pictures. I advise you to take it. they said that their service price is up to you. But Please pay respectfully. 
You can visit this place if you would like to know, how it's feel to be a king in the past. 😊

Het paleis was hier echt prachtig. Het paleis was nog in goede staat en alles was zoals het vroeger was vertelde de gids. De gids was ook heel aardig en hij vertelde veel over het paleis en het verleden van Indonesië.
Wenn man in Yogyakarta ist, sollte man es sich unbedingt ansehen. Es ist nicht groß, strahlt aber auf jeden Fall einen heruntergekommenen Charme aus und ist ein schönes Fotomotiv.

Very cheap entry ticket but give you amazing feeling like a royal family stayed there. You could imagine how fancy the life of Sultan with his concubine. They have marvelious bathing pool! Even the pool bigger than any room in the palace. Sultan had an artificial lake and island for resting and meditating. Sadly we just could see the remain of Cemeti and Kenanga Island (because the resident built houses on Tamansari complex when it neglected in 19th century).
But you can still go up there and see the beautiful scenery of Jogja from the height. The best time to visit Cemeti Island is early morning and late afternoon to see the sun's colour transformation.  You have to visit the underwater Mosque 'Sumur Gemuling' too. This place is underground and humid so you will chilly a lil bit.

That places are stand apart because of the settlement. You have to walk in narrow street. Along the way u will find many stores selling the traditional stuff like Wayang, painting, souvenirs, etc. Very recommended to take a tour guide for 1st visit.

Everything just soo fabulous there. I wish I could see the whole of Tamansari complex :')
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
写真は南欧を彷彿とさせるかんじですが
私が行ったときはくもっていたせいか、そんなに明るいイメージはなかったです。プール部分をきれいにして水もきれいにしたらよいのにと思います。でも、宮殿周辺は、民家がいりくんでいてそっちの方がたのしかった。
Very beautiful and cool castle. The different parts are really amazing and I love the reflective water that the castle is built around. Definitely should visit.

Ingang is vrij moeilijk te vinden, dus het is aan te raden om je te laten brengen. Bij de ingang moet je een ticket kopen om naar binnen te mogen, deze kosten 15.000 IDR. Bij de ingang staan oudere mannen die rondleidingen verzorgen, deze vragen alleen een donatie. Die van ons sprak erg goed Engels en een klein woordje Nederlands, echt als een meer waarde ervaren. Hij had erg veel te vertellen, niet alleen over het paleis en het water kasteel. Maar ook over de moslim cultuur op Java. Zonder gids en een verhaal over de Water Castle, zou ik er persoonlijk weinig aan vinden. Met gids is het erg interessant!

My driver took me on to this place after Kraton. Streets are interesting. The attraction is fairly quick to see and pleasant. Knowing the background history would help. An easy and pleasant morning out. Perhaps combined with markets and lunch or go early to beat the heat...
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Very interesting and impressive monuments in the centre of the city. Worth taking your time to explore and then delving into the old town.

This place is difficult to find and even more difficult to navigate without a guide because its once empty spaces and surrounding areas are now filled with public houses. Make sure you have a guide (a legitimate guide!) when you visit Taman Sari so that you won't get lost and also so that someone can explain the significance and purpose of the different parts inside the water castle. Your tour guide is going to make or break your visit here.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Entrance Fee is 15K for adults. At the beginning of the visit an mostly english speaking Guide came by, offering his Tour for free as he is in Training. He explained the buildings to me, but wanted to go through a little to quick. The place of course is not so perfect as on the pics, but of course worth a visit.

This more like a castle consist of two big pool for the royal ((Sultan) family of Yogyakarta, this site was build 1758 M, said this palace is for Queen and concubines to take a bath. History said that all will gather in the pool and King will throw a flower to the pool from second floor and who get the flower will sleep with the King for one night. 

This became a ancient sites since alrady aged more than 250year but still in good maintained. Before visiting here you can go to the Keraton first( Sultan Palace)
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Done.This is a subsidary of photographs taken for your reference of Water Castle in Yokyakarta which I had given review earlier on.

We visited Water Castle on July 18th.,2016(monday), we found that the frontage still remains the Historic Sign of the Landmark and it is still attractive whereby interior left all the broken stones and darkness of the scene which are not maintained properly to attract the tourists.We feel pity it is mentioned as world unesco but it is not taken care off by the state government at all.As you go inside the ruined building is just like a simply normal waking tour in and out of the garden where you can pass by a few normal village resident houses.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Tempatnya bagus, kemudian untuk parkir lumayan mudah, disarankan untuk hari besar atau liburan sekolah memakai motor saja, karena rame sekali

We had some extra time before our flight, so we decided to visit this palace. It's not kept very well and is a bit small. It was the palace for the Sultan's concubines. There is another section, with an underground mosque, which we didn't go to see as it was extremely hot and we didn't want to walk anymore.
Seriously, is this even a thing to see. Best thing is to look at the hip lane ways just outside the 'castle' , cool little shops etc.
Niet duur en zeker een bezoek waard. Charmante uitstraling. Niet erg goed onderhouden (alg), maar dat hoort bij de ervaring.

Interesting enough building, but the guide mostly pointed to things and then stayed in the shade saying "you go walk there, climb that, I'll wait here". Buy a ticket, do some googling but don't bother with the guide.

Kayaknya belum lengkap ke Keraton gak sekalian ke Tamansari. Istana air ini pada zamanya menerapkan teknologi yang luar biasa pada zamannya. Kawasan ini kini lebih baik daripada beberapa tahun yang lalu.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: bagus untuk belajar dan mengetahui sejarah, harus pakai guide biar terarah penjelasannya, tapi hati2 guide nya sembari jalan suka ngarahin untuk beli lukisan atau pakaian untuk souvenir (harganya jauh lebih mahal) klo ngerti barang sih mungkin bisa beli/ga, klo saya suka ga enakan udah masuk toko apalagi klo udah ngasih harga nya turun drastis jadi kasihan deh, klo ga pake guide susah ga ngerti harus kemana lagi karena ada ruang bawah tanah, klo pake guide enaknya ga perlu tunjukin karcis pintu masuk utama (yang kadang klo udah muter muter suka lupa taruhnya apalagi klo udah selfie)
If you have limited time in the city and wants to visit as many heritage sites as you can, then you must visit this.

Nice visit to understand how Sultans picked one of there wives to enjoy swimming with him. You climb the tower like the Sultan and trow a flower to one of the bathing wives. The invited wive could than cross over to his private swimming pool. Enjoy the dream.

Moet geweldig zijn geweest wanneer het kasteel nog omgeven was door een meer; spijtig genoeg is het nu volledig ingekapseld tussen drukke steegjes.

Gidsen zijn op basis van vrije gift, maar ze proberen je wel van alles te verkopen onderweg.

Meest interessante is waarschijnlijk de speciale (half ondergrondse) moskee.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Se trata de una atracción que no goza de un cuidado a la altura. Se trata de un castillo con unas piscinas tipo spa o termas pero que realmente no tiene mucho encanto. Porque el caso es que Yakarta lo que es la ciudad tampoco tiene a mi juicio grandes visitas excluyendo las de los alrededores.

Es gibt hier ABSOLUT NICHTS zu sehen: Ein schmuckloses Eingangstor (zu einem Abstellschuppen), eine Untergrund-Moschee, wo selbst der hässlichste U-Bahntunnel in Berlin noch pitoresker ist, sowie ein ungepflegtes Wasserbecken, das nur auf Postkarten etwas hergibt, und das durch jeden Provinzbrunnen in Deutschland an Schönheit überboten wird.
Fazit: Da auch der nahegelegene Kraton nur im betrunkenen Zustand als "Sehenswürdigkeit" zu benennen ist, ist der Aufenthalt in Yoyakarta völlig überflüssig.
Some nice fountains and pools but nothing really spectacular. It is worht while, if you are visiting other things in Jogja also, but not as a stand-alone trip.

Mate, not worthy, just because you stranded here taking a short walk leaving the sultan palace.

But, get a coffee or sultan drink at the crazy artist's house inside. Lovely!!!
Bangunannya masih terawat meski sudah sangat tua, banyak spot indah untuk dijadikan objek foto, lokasi perkampungan yang unik.

Tempat yang sangat menarik untuk dikunjungi karena mengandung nilai sejarah dan unik..
Masuk2 ke perkampungan juga..walaupun lelah apalagi saat itu kami sedang puasa...mesti jalan jauh,panas dan naik2 tangga..tapi pemandangan yg kami dapat sungguh membuat kami senang berkunjung kesitu..
Bangunan nya masih asli...dan seperti terbawa ke masa lalu..membayangkan seperti apa dulu tempat2 tsb masih digunakan...
Menyenangkan!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Entah ekspektasi saya yang terlalu besar atau memang tempatnya kurang menarik,
menurut saya tidak banyak yang bisa di eksplore disini selain foto-foto, itu pun spotnya tidak banyak (menurut saya).
tiket masuk kesini tidak mahal, tapi pelayanan penjual karcisnya tidak ramah, kecewa banget sama pelayanan dikarcisnya..
in ancient times this place is used as a Bathing palace for Keraton Princess...so this place has a magical mysterious attractiveness to visit
palace complex consists of several kinds of buildings ( not all buildings are in the water ) location is also still in the area of Kraton Jogja

Selection of historical buildings in Yogya is so limited and they are not that overwhelming. If you want to visit this place try to come in late afternoon,but dont be so late as they are closing after 5pm. Also depends on fact when you will visit this place-during the dry season the is no water in the pool.

Dari segi bentuk bangunan dan nilai historis, bangunan tamansari ini sangat luar biasa. Bagus untuk yang hobi photography karena tempatnya sangat "Instagramable".
Harga tiket masuk yang tergolong murah baik wisatawan lokal dan mancanegara tidak ada perbedaan dari segi harga.
Namun, bangunan tampak kurang terawat seperti kolam yang dijumpai lumut ada beberapa bagian tembok juga tidak terawat atau dipugar padahal sangat potensial sekali sebgai tempat pariwisata.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
The real wonder of the water castle is not the pools itself (although they are very photogenic) but what unfolds if you take one of the little stairs or alleyways outside the pool complex: you'll enter a magical maze of alleys, underground halls, an Escher like underground mosque, and beautiful ruins, all surrounded by hip t-shirt shops, cool weird cafés and little dwellings inhabited by very friendly locals. What an amazing experience to wonder around and let yourself be guided by new discoveries around every corner!

A great setting for a film!!

Erik and Karine.

Wat verloederd. Mits een beetje onderhoud zou dit prachtig kunnen zijn. 
Entree geld is wel niet super hoog (15.000r ) dus nog wel een bezoekje waard. Als je in Jogja bent.

There's two entry to go this place.
The gate and short cut from local houses. From the short cut,you will come through underground mosque. 
The water castle was surrounded by tunnel and king's room. A local guide will help you to understand the background for its  structure.
The local guide may cost you 50-100k idr.no fix charge,its based on your willingness. 
The tour takes 30-45 mnts.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: bangunannya terawat meski usianya sudah sangat tua, dan banyak guide yang dapat menjelaskan sejarah bangunan di kompleks tamansari ini dalam bahasa indonesia maupun bahasa inggris. tips terpenting mengunjungi tamansari adalah simpan selalu tiket masuk karena akan ditanya ketika memasuki area kampung tamansari dan jam paling baik untuk mengunjungi kompleks ini adalah saat jam buka (08.00-09.30) karena masih sepi dari pengunjung lain.
Its great place to come, its in the city and especially for Indonesian can learn our history.... Hidden treasures definitely

Джогджа не так щедра на достопримечательности как хотелось бы. Так что выбирать, куда пойти в городе особо не пришлось. Птичий рынок, Малиборо, Картон и Водяной дворец. Вот, пожалуй, и все радости туриста.
15000идр и мы входим внутрь. Два бассейна, белые, видавшие виды стены, и писания маркером башня, узкие улочки заполненные батиком и туристическими булавки могут легко преобразиться, благодаря Вашей фантазии и знаниям - было бы желание! Здесь же находятся подземная мечеть и различные коридоры/катакомбы. Казалось бы, вот-вот и проникнешься духом эпохи... Но нет, чуда не происходит, идём дальше.
Если честно - не впечатлило, и от того даже раздосадовался на себя самого. Ведь так хотелось увидеть дворцы Султана... А вместо этого чувство недосказанности и растерянности.
Лучше увидеть, чем не увидеть - это точно.
Но особо не рассчитывайте на удовольствие - лучше потом приятно удивиться, нежели не получить ожидаемого.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Nous avons eu le plaisir de faire la visite accompagnés d'une guide. La jeune fille était étudiante en anglais et faisait des visites bénévolement pour parfaire son anglais. Le bon plan ! Une gratification est bienvenue mais sans aucune insistance de sa part. Nous avons passé un très agréable moment.

Die sultans hadden het goed bekeken: een groot privezwembad en een kamer met uitzicht op de zwembaden van hun vrouwen en kinderen (van beide hadden ze er veel). Maar dit gebouw was niet alleen 'voor de leuk'; het diende ook als schuilplek wanneer het paleis werd aangevallen. Door de hoge muren was het namelijk goed te verdedigen.
Het waterpaleis is wat vervallen, maar oogt nog steeds charmant. De moeite waard om even een kijkje te nemen.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: يروي المكان قصة تاريخ اندونيسيا المسلمه العريق .. لابد ان تقرء قليلا عن تاريخ المنطقة و القصر قبل الذهاب هناك .. لعدم توفر المعلومات فب الموقع.

Bagus tapi kurang terawat..
Bagus tapi kurang informasi..
Bagus tapi kurang petunjuk arah..
Bagus tapi kurang mengesankan..

This is a hidden gem in Yogyjakarta. Espescially the direct area of 'the water castle' of small streets, local people and more (old) walls and buildings. Don't get misunderstaken by guys and signs of an old ruin that is wrongly presented as Water Castle, because it is not. The real Water Castle has....water.

Also wenn man eh in Yogyakarta ist und noch Zeit hat kann man sich das Schloss ansehen. Aber keine extra Tour dafür buchen. Am Eingang sind nette Guides  die einem den Palast für ein kleines Trinkgeld zeigen. Wer gerne fotografiert findet dort auf jeden Fall die ein oder andere schöne Kulisse. Der Eintritt kostet übrigens 15.000 Rph.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Un dédale à ne pas manquer ! Laissez-vous guider prévoyez intuition pour l'exploration. 

En profiter pour visiter la mosquée enterrée. 
Belle atmosphère. 
Un moment fort du séjour.

It's a nice place to visit just to take a look but don't make it the attraction of the day. It's cheap but with too many people. It's very pretty to see all the water bath but you will make the whole visit very quickly.
Wajib dikunjungi kalo ke Jogja apalagi kalo suka sejarah. Banyak yang bisa dijelajah, dan bagus juga untuk foto-foto

This is my second time visiting Tamansari Water castle in Jogjakarta,still amazing as my first feeling visit 8 years ago.
The guide was very friendly sharing the knowledge & history.

All memories like a movie in my head when the guide explained the history of water castle,this place you must visited on your holiday in jogjakarta..only need about 45 minutes to turn around on the wide area.

Je kunt je bijna niet meer voorstellen hoe dit eruit heeft gezien, omdat het een woonwijk is geworden waar tussen je de oude elementen ziet. De vijvers zelf hebben we enkel vanachter een muur gezien, want dat was gesloten vanwege t einde van de ramadan. Je kunt er wel een tijdje door heen dwalen.

Un must a Yogyakarta.
Ingresso costa una manciata di spiccioli, c'è da girarlo per un paio d'ore.
Non perderdetevi i sotterranei
Taman sari tempat mandi nya anggota kerajaan. Sangat sejuk..namun sangat tdk terawat. Sana sini perlu pembenahan yg bagus agar terliat terawat.

Trip erheen met taxi was leuk... zie je ook wat vd omgeving zonder daar al te lang over te doen!
Waterpaleis zelf interessant en zeker leuk om te bezoeken.

En 4 semaines d Asie c est vraiment la première fois que nous sommes tombés sur un monument sans le moindre intérêt. 
Le prix est très bas mais vu ce qu il y a à y voir c est assez. 
Peut être aurions-nous dû nous intéresser plus à la partie historique et aurions nous mieux compris sa valeur intrinsèque. Mais là bof bof
Visit this place when weekdays.. Coz so many spot i want to take pictures but so many people in this place.. And also they should gave us a map of this place
Pleasant,  pretty structure. Boring if you don't hire a guide to talk you through and take pictures.  Cheap to enter,  great photo ops and nice history but not something to fill a day

Istana Taman Sari Jogja adalah objek wisata yang buagusssss.... sayang bila kebersihan pemandian kurang elok (kurang bersih). Berhubung datang saat musim kemarau dan banyak pengunjung jadi susah dapet parkir dan agak ramai di dalmnya. Siap siap basah dan pakailah sepatu atau alas kaki yang tidak licin agak anda tidak terpeleset karena ada beberapa kawasan yang berlumut.

Sans commentaire
Il n ya rien là dedans
C'est mal entretenu et limite sale.
J'ai été décue de la visite
Nous étions en groupe et c le ressenti de tt le monde

We hadden hoge verwachtingen door de foto's op internet. Toen we er waren bleek echter dat het lang niet zo mooi was. Veel mos en alg. Niet alle delen zijn authentiek en nergens staat Engelse informatie. Erg jammer .
Cocok buat yg pengen prawedding, tempat nya gampang djangkau dan dekat dengan objek wisata yang lain contoh nya keraton.

Sebelumnya saya tidak tahu mengenai objek wisata yang satu ini, saat lewat di depan jalan rayanya saya tiba-tiba membaca tulisan objek wisata ini, dan saya mengajak istri saya untuk mampir.

Begitu masuk dari jalan raya seperti masuk ke dalam komplek perumahan. Tiket masuk pun sangat terjangkau. Begitu masuk biasanya langsung ada pemandu wisata yang menjelaskan sejarah tamansari ini, tetapi apabila anda merasa tidak nyaman, anda dapat menolak pemandu tersebut secara halus.

Ada cukup banyak ruangan yang terdapat di objek wisata ini selain kolam mandinya, menjelang pintu keluar pun kita akan menjumpai kios-kios atau rumah-rumah yang menjual barang kerajinan lokal.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Tamansari, dahulu merupakan taman tempat mandi istri para Raja,  konon dahulu bangunannya terletak ditengah kolam air, sehingga diberi nama Istana Air Tamansari, hingga kini terdapat lorong menuju keberbagai tempat di Yogyakarta, termasuk Kraton dan Pantai Selatan, namun karena usia, dan berbahaya, maka saat ini ditutup.

Sangat cocok untuk kunjungan keluarga, lokasinya agak masuk, sehingga mungkin sedikit sulit untuk menemukannya, namun sudah banyak yang mengetahui lokasinya, bila menanyakan ke warga di Yogyakarta.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Zien hoe een sultan met zijn vrouwen van een zwembad heeft  genoten is altijd aardig om te zien. Ondergondse gang van paleis naar Taman Sari is niet meer in gebruik.
Slaap- en kleedkamer van Sultan en vrouw(en) kunnen nog bekeken worden.
Idillisch en relaxe omgeving.

Water palace (Taman Sari) is such a beautiful and romantic place nestled just beside Keraton Yogyakarta. Our guide was very friendly, kind, fun, patient and knowledgeable. He explained the history of the place, took us to the underground tunnels and helped us take many family pictures. He also took us to the cyber village behind Taman Sari where there are many shops you can get authentic Yogya souvenirs from. Taman Sari is well maintained and clean. It is a must-visit when you are in Yogya
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: We visited the Kraton, an area in Yokyakarta with three different places in July (and you have tompay three entrance fees). Unfortunately the palace side was already closed. We paid 100.000 for a guide to get more insights. Definitely worth it (no idea if the price is fair, but we liked it).
Feel back to the era of the kingdom of earlier times. Easy to find, i prefer rent a becak to have tour at central Jogja.

Uang masuk murah Utk wisatawan lokal hanya 6000,Utk turis internasional 12000.klo kesini lebih baik saat tidak libur dan tidak panas krn perpaduan antara panas dan ramai itu nggak bgt..tp nilai historis dan budaya Tmpt ini Bgs bgt..
lokasinya tidak jauh dari keraton jogja. disini anda akan melihat kota / kompleks ditengah air. sangat mengagumkan.
History, beauty and magic. Part of the exquisite Tasman Sari complex. Make the extra time to go, you won't be disappointed.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This place must have been a fun one way back when...lots of rooms..huge area..interesting architecture..the Sultans holiday haven....some really intriguing areas, kitchens, bath rooms, 1 loo..must have been a busy one...
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I had a good touring around taman sari with the guide. There are rooms that haven't opened for public yet so I'll make sure to visit here again!

The water castle is a nice place with an interesting history. Be aware of the openings hours. We were there after opening hours when a nice came to us. Maybe a little naive, but he showed us around. He showed us the water castle and all shops where we were expected to buy something. Afterwards the guy, offcourse, expected money for the tour.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It is just a ruin building with a pool that not worth for visiting. It required an admission fee with no proper sign board. You might get lost inside the building and is quite far from the Malioboro street

Menuju lokasi tdk sulit..utk parkir bs langsung k halaman tujuan..byk yg menawarkan tempat parkir tp ternyt jauh dr lokasi...tiket masuk murah banget..kalo d pikir2 tdk sepadan bila d gunakan utk restorasi..bangunan nya tdk terawat..walo mash layak d kunjungi..baiknya sewa guide dgn biaya sukarela agar dari tamansari bisa langsung ke lokasi sumur gumulung yg jalannya berliku melewati rumah penduduk dari kampung cyber  hingga abdi dalam..dalam perjalanan "napak tilas" ada penduduk yg membuka lapak seperti kaos lukis..bagus2 dengan harga kisaran rp.200 rb an..ada juga lukisan...dan semuanya itu bawa payung..untung tidak hujan..sebaiknya dalam meningkatkan PESONA WISATA INDONESIA ..pemerintah menaruh perhatian utk tempat cagar budaya begini.. d pugar perbaiki..d cat ulang..di beri penerangan..
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
For first-timer visitor, its quite easy to find the location. Its historical and cultural heritage from Jogjakarta's sultanese. If you want to learn or explore the place, you better ask tour guide, because the place is very huge and not centralised, thus you need to ask to local resident to find each part.
Ensure you go there with your own car/motor or you have to take 'becak'/trishaw to reach the city.
But this place is very nice and instagramable 👍👍
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Went there with a local guide, the place had some interesting architecture and was not expensive to go in. There were not many people around when we went, good to go before the place is swamped with people
It isn't spectacular, but better than main Kraton building. We got a guide who showed us a little more of the backside. Good if you have a day to spare in Yogyakarta, not much time is needed.

We visited the Water Castle on a prerry hit day, and it was very nice, quiet and relaxing to do. All this water makes you want to jump and swim, but it is a nuce break from the crowd and horning outside 
A bit expensive for what you see though.

Hier muß man sich den geschichtlichen Background vor Augen halten, sonst wird man zu arg enttäuscht. Die Anlage ist gerade nicht im Sanierungskonzept der Regierung, deswegen sieht sie etwas heruntergekommenen und veraltet aus. Nepper und Schlepper gibt es überall,  nicht nur hier. Ein einfaches No Thank You bekommt doch noch jeder über die Lippen, oder?

Небольшой комплекс зданий и бассейнов, когда-то предназначенный для купания султана и его гарема, расположенный в старой части Джокьякарты. Так что к впечатлениями от дворца добавляются впечатления от прогулки по узким кривым атмосферным улочкам прилежащих кварталов, с граффити на стенах, маленькими магазинчиками. По дворцу и району (и даже до подземной мечети) мы с друзьями ходили с местным экскурсоводом, который предложил свои услуги около официального входа. Думаю, без его рассказов было бы не так интересно, т.к. каких-то поясняющих табличек и указателей во дворце нет (или я не заметила).
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The water castle is not that special, but worth a visit if you have some time left. A place where you can walk into small streets and get lost easily. The entrance price is 15000 IDR.

A unique place & easy access because near keraton (sultan's palace). There are a lot of beautiful spots to take photograph. I love the curves inside the mosque. But this place needs to be more clean because some places inside smells not good.
그냥 생각보다 볼만한 것은 많이 없다. 하지만 나름 아름다웠고, 예뻤다. 물이 차있는 수영장 비슷한 곳? 그래도 이 전에 갔던 크라톤 보다는 훨씬 볼만했다.

Estas piscinas son donde el sultán se bañaba tiempo atrás. Hay tres piscinas, una para los niños, otra para sus señoras y la otra para el. La construcción es linda pero es solo eso 3 piscinas y una torre de la cual el sultán miraba a sus señoras y elegía a la que quería llevar a su piscina.

從日惹搭公車需要注意，下車地方根本不再水城堡附近。
最後很幸運靠當地的學生帶路抵達目的地！！

需要購買門票進入(很便宜)，入口有當地導遊詢問是否需要介紹(會一直巴著你不放)。水城堡周圍有很多圍繞的村莊，有些建築非常的特別，還有一些古遺跡留下的水道碉堡，非常有意思，非常值得參觀。
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Le lieu est bien entretenu. L histoire peut vite nous faire imaginer plein de choses sur ce roi et sa cour féminine lol ! Il y a des petits recoins un peu secrets. Il y aurait un passage souterrain secret vers la mosquée sous terre ? On ne l'a pas trouvé, on est passé par la surface. Sinon derrière le Water Castle se trouve un quartier aux rues étroites avec de chouettes tags, des jolies petites maisons... C'est bien d'y flâner

suasana asri, indah , menyusuri lorong gelap, melihat tempat mandi keluarga kerajaan, seru, serasa balik ke masa lalu, untuk pengetahuan bagus banget, masuk nya harus lewat kampung2, sayang kurang terawat
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Will only entertain you if you are interested in visiting the making out place of the ancient kings with his concubines.

I came here because as a pianist, I'm playing Godowsky's "Ruined Water Castle at Djokja" and I needed to see it.  It was indeed a ruined water castle, so don't keep your hopes up.  I had to see it but think that other people could skip it.

If you are interested in History and the lifestyle of kings in the past then this place is worthy of a visit. Ensure that you engage a guide (comes free of cost). But you have to buy tickets to visit this castle.

We were there on a gloomy day unfortunately , with some drizzles. The castle is well unkept. The pool area and surrounding stairs , columns and structures make for very characteristic photos. Spent lots of time here framing shots.

One of the many historical sights in Yogyakarta is the Taman Sari Water Castle is located at Jalan Taman, Yogyakarta. Taman Sari is located very close to the palace Ngayogyakarta and only took about 15 minutes from the square north of the palace. This place was once a place of recreation for the royal family as well as the fortress was built in 1758-1765 by Sri Sultan Hamengku Buwono I. Now, Taman Sari Water Castle is one of the cultural heritage of Yogyakarta, which has become a popular tourist spot in the city's
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Von außen sieht das Schloß eher heruntergekommen aus. Bedenkt man aber, dass das Schloß das riesen Erdbeben überstanden hat, sollte man nicht unnötig meckern. Wir hatten einen Guide (der gleich am Eingang stand), den wir auch unbedingt empfehlen würden. Der hat uns sehr ausführlich und liebenswert herumgeführt, viel über die Geschichte und die geplante Zukunft erzählt und in alle verwinkelten und versteckten Ecken geführt. Beindruckend, wie gut auch vor hunderten Jahren schon geplant wurde!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Tempat ini namanya Sumur Gemuling. 5 anak tangga ini ternyata filosofi dari 5 rukun Islam. Syahadat, sholat, puasa, zakat dan naik haji bagi yg mampu. Ke empat rukun pertama diartikan dgn 4 anak tangga yg menuju tengah2, sedangkan 1 anak tangga lagi yg menuju ke atas mengartikan naik haji bagi yg mampu. Dulu kala, di tempat ini juga dijadikan tempat sholat berjamaah. Di lantai kedua ada 4 jendela yang menandakan arah mata angin. Dan sebagai tanda kiblat, di lantai 1 ada lorong sempit yg masuk sebagai tempat imam sholat. Lorong tsb dibuat menunduk terlebih dahulu sbg tanda penghormatan kpd nenek moyang.

Nice place very much in the center of Jogja, not too far from the Kraton.
Found it interesting, makes for good pictures, an hour should be good.
Nos decepcionó mucho, para empezar nos costó encontrarlo y una vez lo encontramos estaba todo en bastante mal estado y sin más.
Actually this site was beautiful, but not well maintained. Moss on the wall and we should walk around narrow and dirty street to explore the place

Luas area situs dekat Keraton Yogya ini awalnya 38,6 ha.(59 bangunan) tetapi sekarang luasnya tinggal 12,6 ha.(21 bangunan) saja. Kita pertama kali akan masuk lokasi melalui Gapura Agung lalu ada Gapura Pagelaran didalamnya ada pelataran/halaman Kamandungan yang luas dan ada Gapura Panggung,Gapura Umbul sampai ke Segaran Pulo Gedong berupa kolam dengan air jernih,juga ada Gedong Sekawan, Masjid Bawah Tanah,Sumur Gumuling dlsb. 
Taman di area Umbul Binangun ini direhab tanggal 22 Agustus 2004 oleh Yayasan Calouste Gulbenkian (Portugal) dan diresmikan oleh Gubernur DIY Sri Sultan HB-X & Mr.Jose Blanco.
Selain lewat pintu utama,taman ini juga bisa diakses melalui pintu/lorong bawah yang tembus ke hunian rumah penduduk dibelakang, tapi banyak simpangan lorong bila tidak tahu arah bisa kesasar/tersesat.
Bila pemukiman tidak dibendung dikhawatirkan situs bersejarah ini akan hilang...
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The water castle is leaving by the jogja king for long time ago...need more caring to this tourism object to make people excited...too bored
Fair and ok to see this place. But is not to convinience because very close with private house. Newd more attention to make it clean and comfort

Ingresso 10.000 rupie ossia 0.66 euro
Nulla di eccezionale davvero, si può evitare tranquillamente
Da visitare solo in caso si abbia tempo da perdere a Yogyakarta

Awalnya sangat exited kesini,, tapi setelah datang gak nyesel kok,, cuman untuk nyari Masjit bawah tanah agak binggung soalnya udh tertutup rumah penduduk, dari niatnya gak pakek pemandu akhirnya makek pemandu karena sudah tersesat, dan pemandu yang jago banget ngerayu,,

We went there on Saturday morning. Had a chance to walk around the Tamansari, accompanied by one of villager. We went thru all the 'caves' and all the story telling related to it. Gave Rp20000 for tips
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This place is wonderful and it's nice to get a culture hit when you're in a place. A great Palace that's well preserved. Word of advice wear loose clothing as it gets unbearably HOT in here. But definitely worth the trip.
Kurang lengkap kalau sudah ke keraton Jogja tidak mampir ke Istana Air Taman Sari yang tidak jauh dari keraton Jogja. Kita bisa jalan kaki atau menaiki kendaraan roda 2 atau roda 4.

The water palace was a really beautiful place, and we were lucky with the weather - best to go when it's sunny and the pools will look their best! I wouldn't return though, as their wasn't much to see apart from wandering through the palace. 
Don't be tricked by the tour guides waiting to take your ticket as you enter - they are not employed by the palace! We simply followed the man who took our tickets, and he did a brilliant tour but then took us off to show us lots of his friend's artwork which he tried very hard to make us buy.

The castle has nice beautiful pool for royal family, architeture is mixed with european,java, chinese, also decoration of hindu and islamic. That is quite intersting.

But still, to me it wasn't something splendid but as you are here, it is nice to pay a visit.

Saat itu saya jalan jalan ke Tamansari Jogja hari Sabtu siang sekitar jam 1.
Saya mengantar saudara jalan ke Tamansari.
Sampai sana foto - foto.
Banyak wisatawan lokal & turis mancanegara.
Tidak lama kemudian turun hujan.
Saya duduk berteduh & mendadak suasana menjadi seperti masuk di kehidupan masa lalu.
Saya merasakan tempat bersejarah dan memiliki cerita yang sangat menarik untuk di ketahui.
Bagaimana caranya pada jaman dahulu membangun bangunan Tamansari ini dengan penuh ukiran hiasan dinding yang bagus.
Sangat luar biasa & layak untuk di kunjungi.
Sebuah kolam tempat permandian selir selir yang indah.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Beautiful place to photograph. Guides tend to hang around the front door looking for a paying customer. There are also guides who hang around inside but I didn't get attached to one for long in fear that they'd want a tip at the end of our conversation. Otherwise it was nice.

We visit Taman sari during our tour in Yogyakarta. This Castle was very small and I expect more than it was. The place was used by king as water castle where he relaxed with his family and wifes. Place was simple and withou any arthefacts. It was nice stop, but nothing really special.
There is pot hole everywhere , also insufficient information regarding the place . However the entrance fee is cheap and is located nearby others attraction , could visit if you have the spare time .

We went there during late of morning. Hot and dusty watercastle. But, still you can feel their beauty of castle. You can follow a guide (if they were there!) for free. We took a trishaw from Malioboro street as it cost us only IDR 30, to watercastle and Keraton Yogyakarta.

Das Wasserschloss ist ein guter Platz um sich einen Eindruck der Planung, Komplexität und Umsetzung der gesamten Anlage zu machen. Es ist in einem einigermaßen gutem Zustand. 
Im Innenhof kann man auch entspannt etwas Zeit verbringen und sich das Treiben anschauen.

We had a guide to tell us the history which isn't much. Entrance fee is IDR15000 and the area isn't big. The guide asked if we wanted to visit his home which also sells batik but we declined as we are not into batik at all.

It was a great place! The guide was so friendly and he knew everything about Tamansari. Some parts of Tamansari had been renovated since the original one wasn't made from bricks and cements but from eggwhites, but there's still a few part which is still the same with original one. There are 2 pools which were used for Sultan's wives and his daughters to take a bath. The water haven't stopped since the beginning because there's a watersprings there. And the water is clean. It's recommended for you while in Yogyakarta!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Such a huge place. The history of this place is so interesting and never did i expected how it was before. Stop by to quench the thirst with the cool coconut drink at the compound. So yummy.

A casa de banhos do sultão é um passeio interessante, ainda que a visita seja relativamente rápida: Eu vi tudo em 30 minutos. Depois pode escolher andar por dentro do complexo que é realmente grande, algumas lojas ao lado de varais me deu a entender que tem até gente morando lá dentro. Pode-se até perder-se nessas ruelinhas

We visited this place as it was listed as one of the recommended places to visit on Trip Advisor, however, we personally felt it was not worth the visit. There are many other good places to visit than this. There is no water in the water castle and isn't well maintained either. The access to the place is very complicated and some of the sign boards can be very confusing and misleading too.  
Not recommended .
這裏是昔日蘇丹王朝的私家浴場，據說蘇丹王會在這裏，讓妃嬪們在浴池中沐浴，他就站在高高的塔樓上面，挑選一個心儀的妃嬪陪他到過那一晚。後方還有一個比較小的浴池，是皇帝家屬們專用的。有時間的話，到這裏一看也無妨。

Taman Sari adalah tempat wisata yang sangat fotogenik, menurut saya hasil fotonya jauh lebih bagus daripada melihat bangunan aslinya. Tempat ini berada dikelilingi berbagai toko kerajinan dan batik penduduk desa wisata. Sebaiknya datang pagi-pagi supaya tidak terlalu panas atau ramai. Penduduk setempat umumnya bersedia jadi guide, jangan lupa beri tip yang sesuai.

I wouldn't go out of my way to go here again but I did think the architecture was very cool. The place is In need of a clean but the story behind the place itself is interesting. Avoid a tour guide, just Google about it before or after.

Once you get through the walls to see the fountains, they look fairly pretty, albeit very old & neglected (e.g. pinkish walls stained grey at places -- supposedly there was a fire that had historically burnt this place, but it was supposed to be in the 1700s...).

There was also no written info on the architecture, history, indeed even the previous dwellers of this place. None.

There were, however, plenty of touts posing as guides. And at one point one overdid it by trying to lead me to shops around an area of narrow alley housing. Good thing it was a bright sunny morning. Have a little respect for tourists -- they know better than to walk down a narrow alley with you or go into shops to buy things they weren't looking for but had instead budgeted this time to see the Tamansari... If a person repeatedly said one wants to see the Tamansari and had not left time to do shopping, then this is probably what one truly meant... It is not a bargaining technique to get them to lower the price of their batik (or whatever it is that they are selling) when one had not even see their wares yet... 

Would only suggest visiting this place if one had plenty of time. Otherwise, for sights stick with Borobudur & Prembanan, and for shopping stick with the malls & shops on the commercial streets.

Very pretty
Not huge so doesn't need too much time to see it all. 
15000 IDR for entrance 
There were tour guides available but we didn't get one
Wished there was somewhere to take a photo from a height

Tempat yang sangat lumayan bagus, nuansa memang agak sedikit membuat merinding. Karena di beberapa bagian dari Tempat ini masih mengandung mistis. Disarankan apabila berkunjung kesini kita harus menjaga sopan santun, dan tidak melamun.
本來打算沖沖走走, 因為導遊帶領下, 我們逛完水宮後, 沿着後面小屋的一條小路, 到達水宮底下秘密隧道 ！ 因為隧道較黑, 所以有點探險的感覺, 在裡面說話時聲音回蕩, 像是進入迷宮一樣, 值得一看!

A place worth visiting. It's not expensive...it costs more to tip the guide (who does not even ask you if you need one). But it's ok-nice to hear some history. And of course! you are taken to a few shops which are on site to buy some souvenirs. Just be firm and buy nothing if you don't like it or if it's too expensive (bargaining is a tradition here ;). Nice views on a sunny day. A few nice pictures that you can take there.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: A very nice place to visit and see/hear how sultans in the past have enjoyed their lives. It is good to take a guide to hear about the living in old times. It also has an underground mosque attached to it.

Het is redelijk kleinschalig maar wel erg leuk om te zien. Jammer dat het niet al te goed wordt onderhouden. Je kunt er met mooi weer prachtige foto's maken. Een aanrader in het centrum van Yogyakarta.

Tempat ini menarik banget, kita bisa berwisata sambil mengetahui sejarah dari taman sari ini.. 
Tiket masuk nya murah cuma Rp 5.000
Kalau kita mau sewa guide juga ada..
Spot foto banyak.

Reminded me of the old Roman Bath in the UK. Worth a visit just to look around and admire this almost surreal piece of architecture. The place is quite small and you should be able to see everything under one hour. Foreigner ticket is IDR15,000. I did not see any cafe. Take lots of pictures. I couldn't imagine how it would have looked in its heyday.

(ngayogyakarto)

Review Text: Katanya, taman sari merupakan tempat mandi raja dan para selirnya. untuk bisa masuk hanya butuh uang 10ribu saja per orang, jika ingin ditemani guide untuk menjelaskan tempat sejarah ini hanya cukup membayar 20rb. keunikan tempat ini dengan khas nuansa jawa masih terasa dan terawat dengan baik.

Our Destination Asia guide was great for this one, he knew all the stories of the palace and swimming area with little bits of info that you wouldn't get yourself, would recommend going with a guide if possible.

Après la visite du palais du kraton, nous sommes allez au water Castle. 
Nous avons trouvé facilement grâce à Google maps sinon, pas facile vu le peu d'indications. 
L'entrée pour 2 est à 30000 rp, soit plus cher que le palais, pour une visite qui n'a rien de fantastique. On pourrait croire que le lieu est abandonné tant il manque d'entretien.
keberadaan taman sari ini menunjukkan sisa2 kemegahan keraton di zaman nya. arsitektur taman sari sbnrnya sgt indah.. ckp menarik sejarah dan mengetahui latar belakang pembuatannya

You should get a tour guide or else you wouldn't be able to appreciate any of it. I probably won't be coming back though just because one time is enough in my opinion - not really the top places to visit in Jogja.
Sang guide bercerita mengenai sejarah istana taman sari ini "Kolam pemandian di area ini dibagi menjadi 3 yaitu  Kolam untuk putra-putri Raja, kolam untuk para selir, dan kolam untuk Raja.

Gak lengkap rasanya kalau jalan jalan ke jogja tanpa mengunjungi area keraton termasuk taman sari ini. Bangunannya masih terawat dan terjaga keindahannya. Kolam dengan air berwarna turquoise berpadu dengan dinding bangunan bernuansa klasik, terlihat unik, serta sangat bagus untuk berfoto ria.

Cuma suka agak terganggu dengan tour guide yang agak maksa untuk menggunakan jasanya.

The architect of this area is awesome. They have used already aroma therapy. The underwater mosque is also very good

Monument assez  sympa, mais peu d intérêt pour nous. C'est un visite à faire dans yogyakarta, mais il y a mieux à faire.                                                Que dire d'autre..
