bangunan yang sangat menarik, unik dan bersejarah.
tempat pemandian raja yang indah.
cocok untuk foto-foto dan mendengarkan cerita jaman dahulu saat bangunan masih berfungsi. 
jika bepergian siang agak panas...

Taman Sari Water Castle ini bangunan yang terletak di tengah pemukiman padat penduduk. Sayang kolam dan juga dinding-dindingnya sudah agak kotor. Di menara raja juga banyak botol-botol bekas minuman yang menumpuk.
It was just an average attraction, going up and down the stairs.  There was nothing in its ground that was particularly memorable, perhaps only the street food offered.

Taman Sari exudes a regal, bygone charm of a past era. The castle was an old quarter for Javanese princes and princesses to bathe. Today, the pool is no longer used but it is still maintained and blue. I had the privilege of meeting the daughter of one of the royal servants of the castle. Mingle with the locals staying near the castle and perhaps they might take you for a personal tour and tell you the history and anecdotes of the place.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Istana air Taman Sari merupakan bangunan yang keren menurut saya. Didalamnya ada banyak seklai lorong-lorong menuju beberapa tempat di Jogja yang fungsinya untuk melarikan diri kalau ada bahaya yang mengancam. Sayangnya banyak lorong yang sudah ditutup.

Kalau mau masuk kesana kita cukup mengeluarkan uang Rp 5000 untuk tiket masuknya. Kalau kita ingin lebih mengetahui mengenai sejarah dari bangunan tersebut, kita juga bisa menyewa jasa tour guide disana, dan tidak dipatok biayanya, jadi seikhlas kita saja, begitu kata tour guide nya.

Disana terdapat tempat dimana Sultan sering melakukan shalat berjamaah dan juga bersemedi. Tempat ibadahnya tidak memakai pengeras suara pada zaman dahulu, tapi suara imam masih bisa terdengar walaupun jaraknya cukup jauh, jadi disana, bangunannya itu di desain agar suara bisa terdengar nyaring. Keren deh pokoknya.

Di dalam sana juga ada pemandian untuk Sultan, selir, dan juga anak-anaknya. Pokoknya jangan lupa untuk datang kesini kalau ke Jogja. Lokasinya cukup strategis dan juga berdekatan dengan beberapa tempat wisata di Jogja
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I want my 15,000 rupiah entrance fee back.  Of all the things I did during my 4 wonderful days in Jogja, this was the absolute worst.  The place is so run down, it looks like no-one is taking care of it.  On top of that, there really isn't anything interesting to see.  But the thing that I disliked was the bait and switch that takes place.  You pay your money at the ticket office and walk inside, where a guide introduces themselves to you and takes you through this unattractive attraction, at the end of which he informs you that it's time for you to tip him.  Say what now?  The money I paid to get in wasn't even worth what I saw, count on top of that the guide's English was terrible and I understood maybe 20% of what he said, then for him to TELL me to tip him?  I gave him 5,000 rupiah as I was leaving and called it a wasted 20 minutes.  Oh, and be warned that this is really a way to get you into the place to try to sell you overpriced batik art and other items.  They put the hard sell on you when you get into the back of the place.  In my opinion, Tamansari is not worth your time; it certainly wasn't worth mine.

Tempat yang sangat menarik, khususnya untuk pecinta seni, budaya, dan sejarah. kita dapat mempelajari sejarah tentang tempat bersantainya Raja dan para selir-selirnya. di samping itu, desain tempat ini sangat menarik dan instagramable

Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Usually I'd google the history of the places I want to visit hence no need for me to hire any guide, however, I suggest you to get a tour guide to tell you things about this historical Taman Sari since not many people know the enchanting stories kept in each corner of this old building (we learned a lot about the legend, the impact of the earthquake, the vision of the current Sultan and were surprised that many people rent this place for weddings!) 

Pak Adi, the warmest person in Yogya welcomed us with interesting facts about the plants around the castle. From there, he told us the story from A to Z which we enjoyed so much, not sure if he can speak English though. At the end of the mini tour, we gave him Rp 50.000. 

If you plan to visit the Keraton Yogyakarta, make sure you pay a visit to this place too.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: If you went in with the local guide from the water castle they will tell you interesting stories at every building for what purpose the king built the area for. The dancers were dancing while the king picked his favourite to swim in his private pool with for that day. There was area designed for sauna, area for incents to create romantic ambiance, flower to provide fragrance to the dancers etc. Proceed to the underground mosque and the castle which was unfortunately destroyed during different earthquakes, good thing is the Jogja government got funding from Unesco to restore the area and hopefully they will restore its glory like what it was in the king's era after 2-3 years! Note: entrance ticket is 15k for foreigner and 2k for camera. The guide might want to bring you to buy batik or souvenir but you can reject politely and give him a small tips as gesture to thank his good explanation.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

At 5000rp(local) and 15000rp(foreign) entrance fees, taman sari is pretty cheap to give a visit. highly advisable to hire a local guide which will cost u around 30-50k Rp otherwise the whole place will not make any sense to you other than seeing a swimming pool in the middle of an ancient 'playmate house", yeah this place used to be an avenue for the prince to netflix and chill.

yogyakarta banyak tempat wisatanya.. salah satunya tamansari...  angan terbayang ketika tempat ini masih berfungsi sebagai pemandian putri kraton...  spot foto yg bagus buat prewed atau yg lain

Very interesting history. My second visit here. The last time was 7 years ago. The guide this time could have offered more information but did a good job of answering questions and taking photos for us. The tour included information about the adjacent village . We enjoyed seeing and talking with the batik artist and the puppet maker. All in all, worth the time and money.

A ticket costs only about 10,000Rp, and its well worth a quick look as the arcitechture and history is fascinating, however it can be hard to find! 
The small streets are like a maze, and there are plenty of locals around asking tourists where they want to go, and they'll be happy to show you where it is....but at a cost, people don't generally do nice favours for nothing around these tourist hotspots! One guy showed us where it is, not telling us he would request a fee until at the end when he asked "you going to give me something?", we didn't give him anything.

Wir wurden von mehreren Seiten eindringlich gewarnt dahin zu gehen. Wasser sei eh keines im Schloss und das Wasserschloss dient eigentlich nur Schleppern dazu, eine Tour zu beginnen, die immer bei einem "einzigartigen" Batik-Kunst-Shop endet!

Hier bitte erhöhte Vorsicht walten lassen!

I'm usually not an advocate for guides in Indonesia as they are not very good. A guide basically started to take us around on his own without asking us for money, so I tipped him at the end. I can't say that the guide is exceptional but I will say that because Taman Sari has no explanations, and there are parts of it that is hard to find because it used to be a much bigger complex and now some parts of it are interwoven with the local village, the guide is helpful just to get you around.

The main part you will see are the pools where the sultan's many wives or harems would bath. The tower is where he used to throw a flower into the pool and the one that received it would be invited into the private pool. 

There is a whole section of underground tunnels that likely you will miss if you didn't have a guide to take you. They are interesting to see.

All in all though, the palace is not well taken care of. And while it is beautiful, it lacks intricate details often seen in other historical palaces, which means if you have seen a lot of historical sites, you might find this one disappointing, especially when what is actually there is poorly explained. 

I think still worth a visit none the less.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Went there with friend. If you plan to walk from the Kraton, it is actually quite far. You might want to consider taking the trishaw (p/s: negotiate the price before riding). Ketika berkunjung ke jogja, tempat wisata inilah yang menjadi penutup perjalanan saya di kota jogja, objek wisata yang tidak jauh dari keraton jogja, memang sempat kesulitan mencari lokasi objek wisata ini hanya berbekal petunjuk arah via handphone, namun keramahan masyarakat jogja membuat saya tiba di lokasi yang saya ingin singah. selain tiket yang murah, objek wisata tersebut juga masih terawat dengan baik, bagus dan menarik pastinya cocok buat kita yang suka berfoto selfie..

Un pequeño castillo del sultán con piscinas y salas.

El castillo es muy pequeño, pero es bonito. La entrada es barata por eso en conjunto creo que si se tiene tiempo libre en la ciudad merece la pena acercarse un rato a verlo. Se ve en 30 minutos.

Como el castillo estaba un poco alejado, cogimos las bicicletas con motor para que nos llevará al castillo. Son baratas y es un viaje bonito.

Recomiendo su visita si se tiene tiempo de sobra.

The entrance fee is cheap, but apparently for a reason. There's not so much to see and the state of the building is dramatic. No explanations at all. Around the site, there are some tourist shops. Spend your time better, skip this place.

The actual water castle itself is nothing really to behold, however, combined with the beautiful surrounding streets, narrow alleys and small 'batik' shops, the hour or so we spent walking around was really nice

We were intrigued about this water castle upon our arrival to Yogyakarta and put it on the list of things to see. Honestly it was cool and pretty, you can get a good picture but there wasn't really much to see initially. There's also a bunch of men hanging around trying to be your guide. They claim it's free but it's the usual "this is my family's shop take a look around". It's kind of a nuisance really but it ended up working out in our favour since we were short on time and were interested in finding the underground mosque quickly before a flight. All in all it was something interesting to see but don't expect too much!
Its a heritage place, not much of a sceneric view. its just ancient castle and a tour on how it looks like.. There are better things to look at in Jogja if u have only a short time there!!

We wouldnt have enjoyed this if it wasnt for the guide we bumped into at the entrance.

We were quite weary at first as we wouldn't know how much the guide will charge us etc. Turns out he was quite patience with us and is very enthusiastic.
His English wasn't that great, but great effort put in to explain the history of Jogja lineage, their downfall and the dutch involvement. 
Just a tip at the end of the trip will suffice.

Also, without a guide, we wouldn't have found our way to the ruins of their other towers , the underground tunnels and a mosque. He did a pretty good explanation why these werent' salvage etc. 

Great to include this as part of the city tour !
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Noch so schön anzusehen und genügend Motive für etwas andere Fotos. Trotzdem nicht so überwältigend. Aber schön. Wir wurden vor Guides gewarnt, die auf Abriss aus sind. Wir wurden auch vor Taschendieben gewarnt. Es ist aber nichts passiert.

Niat banget ke taman sari dengan cara backpakeran atau malah terkesan nggembel hehhe.
bersama 1 teman cewek yang berasal dari sidoarjo. Kita titipkan baju ganti dan tas bawaan di terminal, dan hanya membawa uang saja. naik bus trans jogja yang murah menuju taman sari. memang tidak ada bus yang langsung sampai di taman sari, jadi kita di turunin di dekat saja. Bilangnya si tinggal jalan kaki 5 menit sampe, ternyata lumayan juga jalan hampir 15 menit atau sekitar 200 meter dari halte bus trans jogja hehehhe. sampai di pasar bingung deh mau kemana lagi, ternyata taman sari di belakang pasar, kita di anter sama anak kecil yang lagi main. masuk ke jalan-jalan kecil sampailah kita di pintu masuk kolam mandi raja. jadi kita tidak bayar tiket masuk, malah tidak tau bayar tiket masuk di mana hehheh (rejeki nggembel paling nih ). masuk kesana kemari dan foto disana dan disini hehhe.
tempatnya sejuk, padahal jogja panas looo heheh. bangunan masih bangus, tapi ada beberapa yang sedang di renovasi.

No longer used as a bathing place, locals also come to shoot photos around the pools and gardens.  We were lucky to see a number of really beautiful ladies in their native costumes and have our photos taken with them!

kejogja tidak lengkap tanpa berkunjung kesini,taman sari merupakan salah satu destinasi wajib jika berkunjung ke jogja dengan tiket masuk yang murah bisa belajar tentang sejarah dan berfoto sepuasnya. Jika cuaca sedang panas disarankan sekali membaya payung karena sangat terik. ada guide yang siap membantu, dan souvenir juga tersedia di area taman sari. akses yang mudah menuju tempat ini.

Tak lengkap rasanya jika traveling di Yogyakarta tanpa harus mengunjungi Isatana Sang Sultan. Istana ini merupakan banguanan istana resmi kesultanan yang didirikan pada masa pemerintahan Sultan Hamengku Buwono I. Kraton ini sangat ramai dikunjungi oleh para wisatawan.

Kraton ini juga merupakan pusat kebudayaan, dimana terdapat berbagai gagasan yang ada disini seperti pemikiran, filosofi, dan mitologi dalam pembangunnannya. Selain itu, masih ada tradisi yang masih dijalankan sampai dengan sekarang yang menjadi daya tarik wisatawan diantaranya Upacara Sekaten, Upacara Siraman Pusaka dan Labuhan, Upacara Grebeg dan Upacara Tumplak Wajig.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
The entrance fee is 30000 IDR.
Inside there was not much too see some empty pools were the concubine used to swim. Dressing room poorly equipped.

We got a guide which spoked very poor English. So if you want a guide try to speak to him first if he's not understandable refuse him!! ( just takes a lot of time)

This is where the sultan used to check out his women and choose his partner for the next evening. It is quite a special place if you have the imagination to see what happened here. Close is the mosque and the escape corridor. And all around is the village that now occupies what was once the garden. That village is very nice to stroll through. All in all, worth the visit.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Istana air taman sari mengingatkan kita saat zaman kerajaan dulu. Bagaimana kondisi pemandian para putri2 raja. Kalau zaman sekarang bs dibilang tempat spa zaman kerajaan. Suasananya sangat bagus sekali. Dengan ornamen2 khas kraton jogya. Serta mulai gerbang masuk tampak tembok yg berlapis2 dan ada tempat2 penjagaan para pengawal. Yang menandakan tempat ini dlu begitu rahasia dan tidak sembarangan org boleh masuk

mengunjungi taman sari bersama anak2 menambah wawasan tentang sejarah dan budaya lokal, kalau terlalu siang sebaiknya membawa payung, karena cuaca sangat panas, mejelajahi tamansari seolah kembali ke masa lalu dimana bangunan dan cerita dari tempat itu sendiri luar biasa untuk jamannya
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: "Geboekt" met gids zodat je wat informatie krijgt over het hoe, wie, wat, waar. Is geen groot complex dus redelijk snel weer buiten maar toch interessant om gezien te hebben (en omdat het dichtbij het Kraton ligt, gaat het in 1 moeite door).
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Actually this place has several places to see, without the guide it will become hidden or missed place. Rent the guide to know better, I rent Pak Bambang, the man with the glasses who stand in the inside of the tower, turn left when you come from the entrance, hope you can find him. He guide and give a lot of useful information about the place. Including Sumur Gemuling which actually is mosque, and other thing/place surrounding taman sari.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It's ok to see this place only if you have time. Place is old and not taken care of. Pool is dirty and was not maintained properly. Nothing to see except empty rooms.

Ensure you get a guide to talk you through Tamansari - we found it so informative and really interesting. The life and customs of the sultan and his family in the past was brought to life by the guide - most informative. A real step back in time.

当時のまま残っており説明を聞きながら回りましたが、よくパンフレットなどで見る水の色とは大違いでちょっとガッカリ！プールの中の清掃ぐらいしても歴史に傷などつかないと思うけどどうなんでしょう。
あと、勝手に着いてきてひつこくガイドをし帰りにもめてる人たくさん見ました。
最初からきっぱり断らないと気分の悪い観光になってしまいます。きっぱり断れば
嫌なことは言ってきたりしませんし。

Manca di manutenzione ,non è un posto eccezzionali ma lo definirei più una curiosità!
Erano le piscine in cui la famiglia del Sultano si dilettava con famiglia e annessi!! Serve un po' per capire la vita di questi signori del passato. Attorno le solita bancarelle e ambulanti,ma è inevitabile!

Disini tempat para selir dan raja mandi. Kalau cuaca sedang terik,panas bangett. Ada tour guide jg yg siap mandu dan kasih tau ke seluruh lokasi tamansari jd kita tau sejarahnya. 
Overall nice place tp agak panas karena lokasi yg terbuka ya
A few pools inside the building. Recommend to get a tour guide to guide us tour around if first time visit this place
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Ini merupakan tempat pemandian raja raja jaman dulu. Makanya  tempat pemandiannya berupa kolam dengan alam terbuka. Kebayangkan kalo jaman sekarang ada yang mandi di tempat seperti ini.. hehehe.. Suasananya penuh dengan nuansa tradisional. Saya datang pada siang hari, dan cuaca cukup panas. Sayangnya tidak banyak pohon yang bisa meneduhkan disini. Namun cuaca panas membuat saya terhiburkan dengan kolam air yang terlihat sejuk dengan tembok berhiaskan  nuansa tradiosional yang eksotis.

Komplek wisata ini sanagt luas. Saat samapai tempat wisata ini. Kita akan langsung diajak beebinjang sama mas" dengan baju batik menceritakan tempat ini. Tanpa kita minta, sara saya tolak saja kalau tidak membutuhkan itu. Karena nnati mereka meminta bayaran. Untuk masuk ke komplek utama yakni yang ada kolamnya. Tiket masuknya Rp. 15.000 untuk wni dan wna 30.000. Oya jika penjaga mereasa kita WNA dia tidak segan" menanyakannya. Seperti yang saya alami. Penjaganya berkali" menanyakan ke saya "Apakah anda dari malaysia?" Berulang ulang. Mungkin karena logat saya tidak seprti orang" di pulau jawa.

Esto es más chulo que el Kraton, y más difícil de encontrar. La gente te manda de un lado a otro, así que mejor patear hasta que tengas la suerte de encontrarlo. Te puedes perder por callejuelas adyacentes y ver algún bonito rincón.
Leuk bezoek als je een toffe gids hebt, de onze was super, leuke uitstap ervaring op een mooie plaats. Mooi om foto's te maken...

It was largely due to the guide we bumped into at the entrance. at first we were wary of strangers offering to bring us around but kinda let our guards down on this one as he seemed so genuine and it was the best decision ever. I dun think we would have enjoyed the water castle as much as when he explain, we can imagine what it would have been in the olden days and that made it memorable and he wasn't pushy and accepts whatever we were happy to give him at the end
Lugar muy agradable para ver, dispone de varias salas y tiene arquitecturas propias de la zona, el precio no es muy elevado se tiene que pagar por uso de cámara de fotos, unos 10 cts.

Review Text: This is the water place where the Sultan having fun in the two connected pools long time ago. There is also the third smaller pool for selected people only chose by the Sultan. The pools are not function today as it was during those time but worth the visit to see a part of old Sultan's living style.
A small structure, it's worth a quick visit given entrance fee is not that high. But nothing much other than the swimming pools
Very cool, we especially like the feel of the neighborhood.  We arrived after it was closed but found s very friendly and helpful local guide.  I hope the can do some more restoration.

The Sultan private palace , our expectations was high. Not up to the mark.

This castle is located very close to the Keraton in Yogja, primarily used by the sultans to relax near water fountains. Good for a very brief visit of this poorly maintained attraction.

Tenuto male,

Intorno è pieno di ambulanti e il posto è maleodorante.

taman sari. sebuah nama yang indah untuk tetirah raja. kolam renang dan istana kecil mengelilinginya. kabarnya tempat untuk raja melihat calon selir yang mandi dan di ajak ke kolam sebelahnya :)

Review Text: It is nothing much there to see, apart from some walls, tiny emty rooms, small pool, handmade crafts and an avocado tree. It hasn't got the glory or a feel of a castle

In de afgelopen jaren goed opgeknapt.
Was vroeger een klein verwaarloosd complex maar is nu na grotendeels hersteld te zijn een atrctie van formaat geworden. Loop met een gids hier doorheen voor het verhaal.
We been there and the place was beautiful and suitable that been name by a royal garden. The architecture of the building is amazing. Beautiful history about the place and area.

This used to the the royal garden for the sultan of yogyakarta and the uniqueness of this attraction is the water pools which used to be bath places for the royal family. The place is quite run down and not very well maintained, but hiring a guide will give you some background on the royal family.

Unfortunately, very little to see here. The building is not a ruin but doesn't seem to be getting protected or maintained either. Must have been a lot more opulent in its heyday, but there's scant evidence remaining of that now.

The water castle as a whole was nice and kinda refreshing in a way but the guides can be quite tricky as they are only interested in bringing you to souvenir shops for you to buy things! Love the architecture and history behind this castle though.
说实话这里已经衰败了。不过可以看到之前的辉煌。白墙都很旧了。门口有很多清闲的本地人，倒是有个人在制作短袖很有意思。

...si on a du temps devant soi.

Begitu menawan, datanglah dan kunjungi tempat ini di Yogyakarta. Saya sangat merekomendasikan tempat ini untuk tempat yang wajib anda kunjungi.
tempatnya indah dan asri. bangunannya juga sangat terawat. hanya satu yang kurang, transportasi menuju kesana kurang.
If you have to spend, you can visit this castle, but there is nothing spectacular about it, except maybe the blue water pool.
letaknya tidak terlalu jauh dari pusat kota, banyak guide yang disediakan disana. Untuk tiket masuknya sendiri juga tidak mahal.
Tamansari or the Water Castle has a very interesting history as well as the whole are surrounding it. It could be better kept. The water level was too low when we went so it looked unkept.

Visit Tamansari if you're into history and architecture or just simply to take a series of nice photos. It's generally well maintained. The biggest highlight of Tamansari is the surrounding area of the castle. There are plenty of small alleys that cuts through many local houses before reaching the castle.

Review Text: Taman Sari merupakan tempat yang menarik untuk dikunjungi dan venue yang tepat untuk berfoto, Banyak warga Jogja berfoto pra-nikah disini karena kontras warna dari bangunan kuning dan air biru atau awan putih.
Bangunan brrsejarah yang letaknya cukup mudah di jangkau dari pusat kota. Tiket masuk yang murah. Tempat yang unik karena bangunan yang sudah berumur. Banyak spot yang cukup cantik untuk diabadikan

Leuke plaats om te bezoeken, jammer dat je er niet mag zwemmen. Als Sultan had je het niet zo slecht. Een zwembad voor jezelf en een vrouw die je uit her vrouwen zwembad koos nadat je ze goed bekeken had.

Review Text: Moderately interesting site in significant state of decrepitude. Desperately in need of big bucks restoration. In the meantime, grimy and turgid. Curious to know how they dealt with pool hygiene back in the day with the Sultan's 150 children pre-chlorine.
水宫真的是一个没有什么意思的地方，不大，但是为什么说是很有趣的体验呢，是因为我们在买门票的时候，有一位工作人员安排了一群会说简单中文的小孩子给我们做导游，我们不太搞得清楚状况，以为这些小孩子有可能会带我们去买东西还是什么的，但是我们一边跟着他们一边和他们聊天，他们带我们去呢很多自己去肯定找不到的地方，虽然这些地方也不是太有意思。他们只是一群想联系中文的小孩。

Review Text: A historical castle with amazing view, nice guide and meaningful historical back-story. we learnt a lot during our visit there about Water Castle Taman Sari. :)
Tempat oke, parkir luas, tapi sangat panas. Tiket masuk 5rb per org, jika ingin ada guide nambah 20rb. Worth-visiting bagi traveler yg bosan dengan candi borobudur.

I've done the water palace 5 times or so, and am shocked to read the negative reviews. The architecture, maze like neighborhoods, active street life and light make it a total highlight of Jogja, if not Indonesia. 

Best is to approach any side and just wander. Pay a local guide 30,000 or so to narrate if you want (although avoid the washy fake artist type, as in all of Jogja). Don't even need to go inside the palace itself...go in the late afternoon and watch the kids home from school, the light move across the colored walls, and climb up on the roofs for better views of it all. And the underground mosque is fantastic for photos!

Don't think of it as a destination. Rather, a walk through an enchanting little neighborhood with a stranger than usual history. They will recommend stores...just say you already bought batik or whatever.

Walau sudah berkali" ke Yogyakarta utk berlibur, entah dengan teman, sodara, keluarga tetap Taman Sari tidak pernah absen dari jadwal jalan".

Pd saat kunjungan kemarin, kebetulan gedung sebelah kiri dari pintu masuk diperbolehkan dikunjungi.Sejarahnya tempat ini merupakan tempat pemandian bagi sultan, istri dan anak"nya..Dan dibagian selatan ada kolam lagi juga untuk sultan mengamati putri dan selir"nya mandi.Walau sudah tampak kurang terawat, dan cat"nya sdh banyak berlumut dan lembab tetap saja Taman Sari menjadikan objek wisata yg melegenda dan menarik banyak wisatawan utk berkunjung. Bahkan juga utk objek pendidikan.

Alangkah lebih baiknya apabila cat nya diperbarui, kolamnya diisi air jernih,bersih dari lumut" yg menjauhkan dari kesan kusam pd bangunan dan kolamnya.
Agar tetap menjadi tempat wisata dan bangunan bersejarah yg terjaga kelestariannya.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Well it was in one of the places of attractions.  So fave it a visit. Turns out it was so so average. Dirty pools but water is still blue. Historical visit.

Unfortunately, Sultan's Pool seems to lose its glorious days. It seems no maintenance has been done and the things have been done, not have been done that nice. You can just shoot some photos and prove that you went there. That's all. We love Jogja, but visiting this place is not worth it. Streets around the Water Castle are much better.

Lokasinya cukup "njelimet". Kami harus masuk-masuk gang, melewati depan rumah orang, tapi sangat menyenangkan. Karena lokasinya yang sangat tidak terjangkau mobil, jadi parkir mobil cukup jauh dari objek.
Setelah sampai di sana, pemandangannya bagus sekali.
Selain tempat pemandian juga ada bangunan tua yang masih sangat kokoh.

Saya mengunjungi pas banyak wisatawan yg berkunjung kesana, jadi suasanyanya sangat hiruk pikuk. Jalanan menjuju erowongab sangatlah ramai dan penuh dengan tongsis dimana-mana. Berbeda sekali ketika saya mengunjungi tahun 2008, sangat dapat ttg cerita historik nya. Dan view nya bisa dinikmati.

Review Text: baru baru ini ke jogja dan mapir ke keraton dan istana taman sari, sayang taman sari menurut saya kurang terawat padahal punya nilai sejarah yg tinggi, bagus dtg di siang hari ato sore hari

Water Castle (Taman Sari), which was an intrinsic part of Palace life, a garden with waterways and hundreds of flowering trees. It was also built as a fortress as well as a place for worship. There is also a small mosque at the Sumur Gumuling. Taman Sari consists of The Sacred Room, which functioned as a hermitage place for the Sultan and his family. The Bath pool, a pleasure place for the Royal family where the king’s wives will have their swim while waiting for the king to select his partner for the night. Kenanga or Cemeti Island, this area compounds with buildings and underground passages. This pool is no longer used by the royal.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I visited the place for a business occasion, it was nice and it also had a painting gallery with affordable price if you want to buy it, but it did not give me that "wow" feeling.
Beautiful and interesting. A slow walk round the ruins of this bathing area. Guides informative and helpful.

Cité ancienne, maintes fois détruite 
Les jardins et le lac d'antan ont depuis longtemps été colonisé par de modestes sujets dont la culture est à découvrir
Les piscines du sultan restent magnifiques et chargées d'histoire
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I always wanna go here and look around. So when I have spare time on my business trip to Yogyakarta, I chose to visit Tamansari. We have to pay entrance fee and there are some tour guides ready to guide us if we want. But we didn't hire one at that day, I should hire later if I come back there again tho. The first building we saw is the bathing complex for sultan and the concubines. There is another spot for the princess too. I really like the architecture, it's clean but it has a lot of amazing details. We saw another part of it by walking few minutes through Kampung Cyber. There are a lottttt of beautiful murals there, the walk is really enjoyable. The 2nd building we went is in circular form, was built for war purpose. It has amazing structure! I cant believe it was built long ago. It's really amazing. There's another part of it but we didn't have enough time to visit. Will come back next time.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Not far from Keraton, i visited this place with my 7 years boy. In the past, Sultan, King of Yogyakarta used this place for rest, swimming or meditation. It' s like a villa to them. Still in this area, you can also visit their palace (now just the ruins, damaged because of the volcanic earthquake). Prepare your shoes, caps or umbrella because It's very hot by noon. In this place, I found many angles for my phonecamera. 
After looking around, walkingn, we were very thirsty, we drank a coconut water, "Kelapa Batok", for only Rp.10.000. It's delicious. Try it.

Tamansari is situated closed to the city centre & Kraton area. The castle is supposed to be a second / recreational home to the sultan. the place consists of under ground mosque, this recreational house, under ground water ways from where the sultan could escape in case of any invation.

The place is still being restored and is expected to be completed in 2020. However its worth a visit when in Jogya.. 

Suggest you take a guide's help who will be able to explain the story behind all the place. It should cost you about 20K IDR which is about 100 indian rupees
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Unik sekali untuk menemui tempat bawah tanah seperti ini. Kita harus berjalan melewat keraton dan skrg ada bberapa berubah jd perumahan warga. Wisata budaya yg menyuguhkan pemandu untuk bercerita ttg sejarah.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Untuk tiket masuk pengunjung terbilang sangat murah. Sangat ramai dikunjungi wisatawan terutama saat weekend. Banyak wisatawan mengambil foto di tempat ini karena memang benar tempat ini sangat unik untuk dijadikan lokasi photoshoot. untuk mencapai satu titik ke titik lainnya kita harus berjalan menyurusi pemukiman warga, sebaiknya dengan guide jika tidak ingin tersesat atau melewatkan lokasi unik, atau jika anda suka tantangan anda bisa menjelajahi sendiri.
It only takes a short time to go through and worth the visit, but not the highlight of the city. Since it is in the city, it is easy to get to.

Entrance is only 15,000pp. It's quite small and run down but can be worth seeing if you have time. 

It's close to a kings palace that seemed more like a cultural village. Take a rickshaw ride for around 15,000 to the next location. 

You can finish this within 2 hours. If you don't have and taxi/car waiting for you...you'll need to walk out to the main road to get a taxi (15mins walk). 

You need a hat as there is little shade walking to the main road.
its just a simple yet elegant water castle, love the wall color, it give u a really romantic and peaceful feels... Just do a simple and casual trip here if you at the city of Yogyakarta

I stopped by the place since it was not far away from where I stayed and it was a good half an hour visit. Some great angle for pictures but it would be nice if the history of the place is explained more throughly.
Antigua alberca privada del sultán. Muy interesante edificio e historia en relación a este lugar. Impresionante lugar para la fecha que fue construido

The history behind the structure is interesting. Unfortunately, it looks like just a building with a pool on it. Also, the exit is confusing since you have to pass by residential houses and alleyways.

Located near Kraton Jogjakarta, you can go there through Aloon Aloon Kidul

It's really beautiful and amazing place. Wonderful water palace.

Whether the story of the place or scenery for taking photos.

Please come in the morning,because at 15:00 this place already closed.

Please ask guide help so you can visit Sumur Guling also.

Entrance ticket around 15.000 IDR for domestic tourist

Enjoy and don't forget to take a selfie :)

Taman sari adalah salah satu objek wisata yg cukup menarik. Tempat ini dulu digunakan sebagai tempat mandinya para istri/selir sultan. Sekarang tempat ini bisa dijadikan objek wisata bagi masyarakat umum. Letak taman sari ini bisa dibilang strategis, tepatnya di tengah-tengah kota dan dekat dengan keraton. Tapi untuk akses menyusuri ke Taman Sari-nya kita mesti masuk ke gorong-gorong pemukiman penduduk dulu, apalagi tiap tempat di taman sari ini terpisah-pisah letaknya. However, walaupun harus cukup perjuangan menyusuri taman sari ini, dijamin gak bakalan bikin nyesel. Karena bener2 tempatnya sangat bagus dan bernilai sejarahnya. Apalagi bagi para fotografer, Taman Sari ini sangatlah fotogenik. Tiap sudut Taman Sari bisa saya bilang semua spot terbaik untuk lensa kamera. 

Pokoknya salah satu objek wisata yg harus dikunjungi nih Taman Sari, bener-bener keren tempatnya walaupun kuno.
Cantik, tapi agak terlalu ramai dengan pengunjung mengingat tempatnya yang ternyata kecil. Agak sedikit kurang terawat juga.
Tempat yang cocok untuk foto-foto dan pengetahuan sejarah. Tempat yang tidak cocok untuk nongkrong ya gaes karena tempat ini suci.

There are few swimming pools in the castle. Nothing special about it. Since it is near the Kraton, we just go by becak after visiting Kraton as it appears nothing much to do over here in yog.......

Places are full of kids from schools.

tempat nya bagus untuk berfoto, sebaiknya datang lebih pagi karena sore sudah ditutup. banyak Tour guide yg memanfaatkan untuk mengajak berkeliling setelah tutup, namun tidak bisa ke dalam taman sari, melainkan hanya diputar di perkampungan sekitar,
Der Wassertempel in Zentrum von Yogyakarta ist relativ schnell zu erreichen und auch schnell besucht. Achtung schon um 15 Uhr schließt der Tempel.

Beautiful place of an open bath. The year built represented by the unique paintings on the wall. Combining all religions during its remarkable years: Hindu, Buddha and Islam; can be seen all around the Water Castle. It's considered the private place for the Sultan and his family including the concubines. The idea of an underground tunnel for women showed the Sultan's concern of safety first and at the same time keep his family away from public. If it is not because of Merapi, we could see the beautiful architecture in the middle of a lake.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: di tempat ini bagus sekali untuk berfoto dengan mengandalkan cahaya yang ada, namun jika berkunjung kesini disarankan membawa kipas karena sangat panas dan juga harus tanya2 orang untuk menemukan gedung bawah tanahnya karena tidak ada directionnya

This was my favorite place in all of Yogyakarta.  The fascinating Hindu architecture, the beautiful and peaceful pools and a helpful tour guide  (included with ticket but do tip) made for a lovely hour. Lots of great photo opportunities too! We had a delicious lunch at one of the food stalls just outside the palace. Tasty and inexpensive!

Review Text: Wij vonden het wel een bezoekje waard. En het is makkelijk te combineren met het kraton. Rondom vind je batik shops waar de mensen je al te graag iets willen verkopen.
The private pool for the king and their family. But not maintained as Kraton Palace. Just we can see how the King enjoyed his leisure time.

Entrée à 15000 rp
Attention ça ferme vers 3:00 pm

Un type m a accompagné sans me demander si je voulais de son aide pour visiter ou non, mais il n a pas oublié de me demander son pourboire à la fin.

Il m a fait traversé les lieux à folle allure, de temps en temps il s arette pour me dire : prends une photo.
Certe il m a expliqué le rituel, mais bon... ca casse pas trois pates et un canard. 

Sinon le monument est délabré.  Si vous avez vue des photos sur internet : vous avez tout vue.

Ça ne vaut pas le détour à mon gout.

A must do if you are in Yogja, this place is beautiful and not so expensive. the monument is still in is original materials. Don't forget to go look for the underground passages that are also interresting to see.

Tempat ini duluanya adalah pemandian. Anda harus menggunjungi tempat ini dengan didampingi para guide yanng banyak ditemukan disini untuk mengetahui sejarah dan filosofi dari tempat ini. Bagi anda yang gemar fotografi tempat ini sangat cocok , karena memiliki view yang indah.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Tato památka uprostred města podle nas nestojí za návštěvu. Vstup je zbytečně vysoký, památka zanedbaná a nic k zajimaveho k viděni.

The first impression is that the architecture here is done by a Westerner architect.  And I was proven right by my guide who stated that the architect of this place was a Portuguese and he was engaged by the First Sultan here to do a recreational place for him and his circle as a playground (no different from Hugh Hefner and his Playboy Mansion).  History also had it that the Sultan also used to hold meetings there too.The pools here were delightful and the Castle made for a nice casual stroll.  I was pleasantly surprised by my time there (less than an hour though).

Review Text: Taman sari adalah cagar budaya yang harus terus dipromosikan karena keindahan taman sari yang sulit ditemukan dalam wisata ditempat yang lain, taman sari adalah komplek yang digunakan oleh raja terdahulu untuk bersantai dengan kerabat yang lainnya, namun sayang karena gempa yang sempat melanda Yogyakarta membuat sebagian komplek taman sari menjadi rusak namun walaupun demikian tetap memiliki keindahan yang harus dinikmati

Review Text:

Найти их, также как и подземную мечеть, непросто, хотя они находятся в пешей доступности от дворца Султана. Перед самым входом надо быть осторожнее - там просто нет тротуара, а движение очень лихое. Review Text:
Lokasi yang wajib dikunjungi saat liburan. Bangunan cukup terawat dengan baik, namun disarankan menggunakan jasa guide yang ada disekitar Tamansari agar tidak tersesat dan bisa mendapatkan cerita sejarahnya.

Bel endroit, les alentours sont sympa... dommage qu il n y ait aucun entretien et que ce soit laissé un peu a l abandon... On pourrait faire qqchose de magnifique !

This is a place that i like it so much.  If we understand the history and you already go arround actually this water castle cover very big area.  Here you need to pay entrance ticket which is not expensive and if you need more infomation, usually there are Guide that can explain many thing about the Water Castle, but you need to pay extra for the guide.

According to the historical story that i know that this water castle is a place for Sultan's Concubine to take bath.  When you enter the area there are 2 Pools and according to the story the sultan will be at the 2nd floor of this building to  have a look which Concubine that sultan interesting with.  When he find the "one" he will throw a flower to her and she will spend the private time with the Sultan.  Very nice to visit even now the palace looks like lack of maintainance but if you know the story, this area will feel very nice.

Review Text:
Good place and worth to visit. You will be needing freelance tour guide (at the entrance) to explain and bring you around this big compound.

Review Text: Was convinced by my friend that this castle looks pretty (from google photo). However when we visit, i dont find it pretty. The place looked like it lack of maintenance. Still need to pay entrance fee.
外観・内観共に綺麗でした。もう少し水の豊富さがあると更に良かったと思います。メイン通りから外れると、迷路の様で、同じところを何度も行き来しました。袋小路も多い。
Sebuah Petilasan Kraton Lawas dan tempat Pemandian para Istri Raja Kraton Ngayogjakarta yang wajib di kunjungi utamanya bagi pecinta Sejarah. Juga bagi para pengemar suasana Spiritual.

This is a little gem in the bustling city that showcases one of Yogyakarta's most beautiful historical landmarks. It's well maintained & very picturesque to take photos - worth visiting despite the heat!

It is one of those historical places in dire need of restoration. On display is the lavish lifestyle and harem of the former king, but only the water baths have been restored. You can also buy some batik artwork here.
PS: The place is surprisingly very well ventilated!
Although nothing much you can do here except for taking photos, it is still worth visiting especially for a history/architectural lover. However, it can be pretty crowded during weekends.

Istana Air atau Water Castle, letaknya dekat dengan kraton Jogja. Kita kesana naik becak dari Jalan Sosrowijayan. Di Taman Sari terdapat tempat pemandian raja dengan para selirnya. Ke Taman Sari sebaiknya mengunakan tour guide karna akan di jelaskan secara mendetail mengenai sejarah bangunan Taman Sari beserta fungsinya dan bayarannya pun sukarela tidak di patok harga.

Review Text: I thought this place looked very boring from outside, but I found it magical inside.  Lots of pools from natural spring and some tunnels leading to a central prayer area.  I definitely recommend it.

Review Text:

C+

Didn't really know much about this place but oir driver said it was close to the Sultans Palace so we went along to look.
Really neat place! And you're allowed to dip your feet in the water and take lots of pics, it was quiet on the day we went along and a local man took us around and explained the different uses and history.

Review Text:

Review Text: Taman sari tutup pada pukul 2 siang jadi apa bila kita sampai setelah itu kita tidak dapat masuk ke dalam kolam pemandian istana. hanya bisa melihat dari pintu samping saja.

塔曼纱瑞水上城堡（Tamansari Water Castle）：是苏丹王一世和二世休闲娱乐的地方，已有300年历史。塔曼纱瑞意为香园。用现代角度看，规模并不大，但建筑结构在当时是很先进的。历史上水上城堡周围是大片绿地和花园，现已被民房团团包围。参观时一位工作人员一直陪着我，直到看完“水上”清真寺为止。他说：苏丹王共有40个妻子，每周从王宫来这里同40位妻子戏水休息。期间苏丹王在顶楼上（照片4）观察、挑选一个喜欢的带入后面的泳池（照片3）和房间，最后带回王宫。其他妻子只好等待下一周的宠幸机会。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: kann man anschauen ist aber nicht speziell interessant .  Es gibt einen einblick wie der Sultan  mit seiner Familie früher gelebt hat

涼しかった日だったので王宮から15分くらい歩きましたが、スマフォのGPS機能で徒歩で行けました。ベチャも安くて良いですけどね

This is place is beautiful. I don't remember paying any entrance fee, so it should be free.  

When you get there, you just have to walk along those white walls that should lead you to some tunnels that will take you to different places of the castle, like the underground mosque where the late Sultan prayed with his family, the secret pathway that the Sultan took to meet Nyi Roro Kidul and gave her offering to keep safe of Yogyakarta (Queen of South Sea) - for those superstitious and mystic lovers, and to this water castle where the sultan and his family and mistresses take a bath / swim together.  

The story is that these 3 swimming pool (baths) are differentiated by the usage. The first swimming pool (near the offering place) is for the Sultan's children.  The second one is for the mistresses (royal ladies or they call them "blue blood family" from all around the regions).  The third bath, which is located just behind the "peeping" tower, (used for the Sultan only, to choose one of his mistresses to stay the night with him) is for the Sultan and the chosen lady to bathe together.  This bath area is closed after 4 pm (due to some superstitious reasons).

There are many souvenir shops including beautiful paintings around those area.  If you'd like to purchase, a good bargaining skill is required.

The Taman Sari in my opinion is one of the top places to visit while you are in Yogyakarta. To be fair if this "Water Castle" would be placed in any European city, it would not be anything special. In Yogyakarta is a nice break between all the temples sightseeings. 

WHAT WILL YOU SEE
It's a bathing complex with pavilions and pools builded with an European architecture style. It has been build around 1760 from first sultan of the Yogyakarta Sultanate. Originally it was a large complex of distinct areas: a large artificial lake with islands and pavilions located in the west, a bathing complex in the centre, a complex of pavilions and pools in the south, and a smaller lake in the east. Today only the central bathing complex is well preserved. All the other areas are gone because local people occupied the area building houses. 

AREA 1 (The Segaran lake area)
It was the main complex at its time with a large artificial lake and islands. Now you can't see anything but the Kampung Taman settlements, very bad. Anyway the area was builded with underwater tunnels, which are now underground after the water had gone they still exist and can be visited. 
As you can see from many pictures about the Taman Sari here you can find the elevated platform inside Sumur Gumuling where the four staircases meet in the center. I think this is the most characteristic picture you can take. It's like being in Escher painting, Relativity. 
FYI the building it was a mosque.

AREA 2 (The bathing complex)
The second area is actually where the entrance is. Here you buy the ticket to access and here you find the guide who try to cheat you by offering free service which you have to pay at the end. The bathing area is the best preserved area in the complex and is currently the most popular tourist attraction. It has been renovated in 1970 but trust me, it needs another renovation.
The rooms you will see in this complex are resting and changing rooms for the sultan and his family. 
The main tower was used by the sultan to observe his daughters and concubines bathing in the pool. Ta that time only female and the sultan can access to the pools.

AREA 3 (Pasarean Dalem Ledok Sari)
This are is completely gone. You can't see it anymore. It was considered a meditation area for the sultan (or also a meeting place for the sultan and his concubines). 

AREA 4
Also this area is not visible any longer except for a former hanging bridge and remains of a pier. 

SURROUNDING 
As mentioned the area around the Taman Sari is occupied by Kampung Taman with over 2500 residents. Here you can fine a lot of small shops known for their batik and traditional painting craft traditions.

The most famous one The central area of this building is an elevated platform where four staircases meet, and then from the platform, one staircase reach the first floor. On the ground level of this platform is a small pool that was used for Muslim ritual ablution

Few The entrance of the Water Castle is not hard to find, despite what other writers say. It's just next to the Kraton.

Review Text:
Taman Sari used to be the Sultan's private playground where the Sultan used to swim and relax with his wives. There are two public interconnected pools on one side of the building and a private pool on the other side where the Sultan would relax with his chosen companions.

There are other rooms for relaxation including a room with a heated bed - the equivalent of a Sauna, rooms for the wives, changing rooms etc. Incense burners are placed in the corners and were used to burn incense and create a pleasant atmosphere. A room at the top of the Central tower provides views over the entire complex.

The building is like a time capsule and provides a glimpse into the luxurious private life of Yogyakarta royalty in the old days.

Worth a visit if you are in Yogyakarta.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
