Review Text: Very different than other buildings.  Streets nearby are nice to wander around. Quiet place but pretty small

Tamansari merupakan suatu tempat bersejarah di lingkungan keraton jogja. Terdapat kolam yang luas dan bagus yang dahulu digunakan untuk mandi putri raja. Terdapat beberapa ruangan-ruangan kecil bekas kamar. Sering digunakan untuk upacara adat. View nya bagus untuk foto.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Tamansari is very pretty...if there is water in the pools. 
They don't clean it however, so the pools are slimy and there are piles of trash in corners throughout the compound. 
Besides that, it's very cool to walk around and see how people used to live in this maze of buildings and tunnels. 
Worth a visit, especially for low budget travelers, but don't expect to be alone as it is a central attraction.
View nya bagus dan unik cocok yang suka fotografer. Kalau kesini jangan lupa ke masjid bawah tanahnya.

El castillo se ve lindo en las fotografías por las albercas y algunos relieves, aunque es una construcción antigua con poco mantenimiento. Es confuso el camino al castillo y en la salida de cualquier construcción se topa el visitante con pequeñas casas habitadas y callejones sin salida. La señalización es poca y en indonesio, los guías locales cobran a discresión y tratar de llevar a los turistas a las tiendas de artículos batik. 
Ir solo si no tienen otra cosa que hacer.

There wasn't a great deal to see at the Water Palace itself. It's pretty but not well kept up. At least some of the fountains are still running. 

However, only a small portion of the original palace is used now as a cultural site. An extensive village had been cobbled together in and amongst the ruins of the greater part of the palace and it's more worth seeing than the palace itself. Fascinating that people are setting up living rooms in what was once a concubine's quarters or a guard house. The village is very green, lots of gardens and little homes and a warren of narrow walkways. It's delightful!

We went to Tamansari after it had closed and had a local give us the behind the scenes tour. It was great. We enjoyed this way more that Kraton. No charge and got to mingle with the locals, see the underground mosque, the pools from the neighboring rooftops and watch the traditional puppets being made. Go there!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It's historical site built in 19th century as like swimming pool for royal family. Need more improvement like make the fountain in the pool work and make the small area along the pad with flower etc etc so it's look more attractive
This place is amazing, kids were amazed with its beauty and old history. We went to kings chamber and underground mosque. Fantastical journey through the past.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: sampai kesini diantar penduduk yang menawari jasa mengantar, ternyata tidak jauh dari alun-alun, namun cukup membantu jika kita memerlukan jalur cepat
Good to see when in Yogyakarta. Water Castle (palace) used by ex sultans. Quite attraction no as many people as in other attractions.
オプショナルツアーで行きました。個人では行けない場所にあります。プールの水はあまり綺麗ではないけど壮大で歴史的な建物です。観光客も多くなかなか経験出来ない雰囲気で是非オススメの観光地です。

this place is pretty much historic. the building was good for having photos.
this place providing tour guides for us wandering around the building.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I found this site and headed to investigate the area. It's the most interesting place to visit. True it is a shame it's run down for some reason but well worth the visit. Its a must do in Yogya.

Q: How much should I tip my guide? A: between 20k and 50k. My guide took me around the palace and into the surrounding neighborhood to look at shops. On a tip from a friend, I asked to look at the underground tunnels - otherwise he wouldn't have taken me there. Definitely go visit the tunnels and the shops. I had extra time after my guide left to wander the village and it was beautiful and peaceful - it's a really beautiful neighborhood, with colorful houses and an abundance of potted plants. Much of the village seems devoted to producing crafts. You can pick up some batik, some art, or some souvenirs.

Ketika datang kesini, suasana kental jogja jaman dulu terasa, dimulai dari gerbang masuk taman sari yang kokoh dengan bentuk yang khas menambah rasa penasaran ingin menjelajahi tempat ini, rekomendasi saya lebih baik anda menyewa orang untuk menceritakan tempat ini, karena bakal banyak cerita yang dapat kita ketahui selain menikmati indahnya taman sari ini. tempat utama yang saya tuju, ialah kolam pemandiannya, tempatnya indah, bagus buat yang suka fotografi, selain itu masih banyak bangunan didalamnya yang bagus-bagus.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Keren, tapi sangat disayangkan kurang perawatan, padahal bagus dan unik, apalagi tangga masjid bawah tanah, lorong2 nya tekesan pengap dan apek.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: It's a must if you happen to be in Jogja. The surrounding is well kept so worth the small fees charged upfront.
I like the old buildings. If u like to take pictures with friends, this is the right place to visit. Dont come near 4.30pm because some areas are close already.

Personally, I found the actual feature ok but not mind blowing. However, I really enjoyed the backstreets with colourful artwork/ grafitti and dead friendly locals milling about. Take some time to explore the area around the actual water palace.

Op bezoek in Jogja en u heeft tijd? Zeker doen! En ja, maak gebruik van de gids die u natuurlijk ook graag wat batik en souvenirs laat kopen ;-) U stapt namelijk zo maar honderden jaren terug in de tijd. In de koloniale tijd konden uitsluitend de vorsten en enkelen deze ruimte betreden ... 

Dit water paleis kent een geweldige mystiek. Wie daar gevoelig voor is, zal dat zeker beleven. Iedere becakrijder kan u er naar toe brengen.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It's quite beautiful with the water. But also really packed with tourists! It's not too expensive to get in as a foreigner, so I'd probably recommend it if you are looking for things to do in Jogja. But I wouldn't come to the city just for it.

The building itself already got my attention.. when I entered the castle, it gave me an incredible blue view from the top..
The sky was blue, the pool filled with water that reflect the sky.. Great view to captured..
But, that's all u can do here.
Mmmh...  I expected more. It's a nice castel but there is not a lot to see. Basically it is a pool surrounded by high walls. The castle is not well maintained.

Taman Sari ialah kompleks pemandian yang berada di dekat kraton Yogyakarta Hadiningrat. Kompleks ini dahulu berada di pulau terpisah yang dikelilingi danau besar. Taman sari sebenarnya bukanlah pemandian umum, karena hanya digunakan khusus untuk acara-acara seremonial. Salah satu acara yang melibatkan taman sari ialah prosesi pemilihan permaisuri semalam raja. Para selir berendam di sekeliling kolom dan memperlihatkan keayuannya kepada Sultan. Sultan yang menggunakan racikan emosinya kemudian melemparkan bunga kepada sang selir terpilih. Selama prosesi, sultan hanya mengamati para selirnya dari sebuah menara. Selain terdapat kolam dan menera pandang, terdapat pula trowongan yang menghubungkan kraton dengan pemandian ini. Sultan kadang  berkunjung ke pemandian ini menggunakan perahu ataupin trowongan
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Taman Sari merupakan tempat pemandian Raja-Raja Mataram (Islam) pada masa silam. Konon di sini para Sultan berendam dengan ditemanin para selir mereka. Petirtaan Taman Sari merupakan Cagar Budaya yang dilindungi Pemerintah. Pengunjung tidak diperkenankan berenang dan hanya boleh foto saja. Air kolam bening karena selalu dibersihkan namun Bangunan tampak kusam dan retak karena faktor zaman dan usia.

As most of the attractions in Indonesia there is no or hardly any explanation. You can get a guide, they will find you, and get great information. At the end however they will try to sell you stuff.
The water castle is very interesting with lots of nice details and stories.
Nice place. You can actually don't pay entrance fee and go from around it. Ask your taksi driver about it
The place is very pretty and inside a complex but there is not much to do here. We checked out the palace in like 10 minutes and then we did not know whet to do there...

biaya masuk untuk wisatawan lokal 5.000, Menurut saya tempat ini cukup indah, rasanya ingin merasakan berendam dikolamnya, dan disekitar komplek taman sari juga ada pemukiman warga, cukup menarik mengelilinginya, tidak lupa dekat taman sari terdapat Sumur Gumuling yg bisa dikunjungi dengan gratis.
Sesuatu yang berbeda, mestinya pasir hitam tetap ada di dalam kolam, namun sayangnya pemugarannya seperti belum sempurna seperti Lawang Sewu di Semarang.
Would have been a jewel in its hay day but due to lack of care and negligence its lost its glamour. Time spent better elsewhere. Busy and crowded by law cals smoking everywhere. Not impressed at all.

Tiket masuk ke tempat wisata ini murah sekali hanya Rp 5.000,- Jika kita menggunakan jasa tour guide, maka kita akan mendapatkan penjelasan mengenai sejarah tempat ini. Beberapa sudut juga menarik untuk menjadi tempat mengambil foto selfie. Kita juga dapat berbelanja oleh-oleh dari beberapa toko di area pemukiman penduduk di sekitar tempat wisata ini, yang memang sengaja diperuntukkan bagi pengunjung.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Ini kunjungan saya yang keempat ke situs sejarah ini. Kunjungan saya di tahun 2004 paling berkesan, karena tempat pemandian atau istana mandi ini telah selesai dipugar. Tapi kunjungan saya di akhir 2015 ini membuat sedih dan dan marah.

Area situs ini sudah diransek (diserang) oleh pemukiman. Betul mereka adalah warga abdi dalem istana, ttp seharusnya bisa diatur dengan baik sehingga dapat dipisahkan antara istana air taman sari dengan pemukiman abdi dalem tersebut.

Saran kunjungan: Masuk melalui pintu utama, jangan masuk melalui Pasar Ngasem, karena bisa membuat anda tersesat, kecuali ditemani oleh pemandu.
If you know the history of this place you would be able to understand more about this water castle. Nice building indeed!

this is a great building to tour for. but if you didn't hire a guide, you will just touring around didn't know the story of the building. you just have to give them a few tips and how the story telling will impress you. they really good at explaining
The water is the only thing that is well kept. All the rooms are empty and not furnished. No signage or any information about the place.
I went here with high expectation based on the recommendation of the locals. This place is basically an olden days palace.the visit will give you an imagination of the king's life style. Nothing else

About 15 minutes motorcycle ride from Malioboro. Beware that they closed at 4pm. I was arrived at 4.05 pm, the gate was closed but a local tour guide find us a way to get in. We paid IDR 5000 for him. Worth the money because we can took pictures freely without any other guests. 

Becareful with the local tour guides, they offer you service even without fee dealing at the front. Tips: politely ask them to leave if you don't need them. Or, bargain the fee before you enter the gate.

ジョグジャの市内観光に来たら真っ先に出てくるだろう。

池の水はボウフラが発生するのを防ぐために入れたり抜いたりよくわかりません。

歴史わかった方が楽しいので、自称ガイドを頼むのも有りだと思います。
Not exactly a spectacular tour; however it gives good insights of the Kraton history. Be there with a local guide so that you can understand each pitstop better.

Saya sudah 3 kali menginjakan kaki di situs cagar budaya yang eksotis bernama Taman Sari ini, kunjungan pertama saya terasa biasa saja karena  mungkin sedang lelah.
Namun, kunjungan kedua adalah kunjungan yang luar biasa, hampir 2 jam lebih saya menghabiskan waktu di taman sari dan beruntungnya mendapatkan guide yang sangat baik dan friendly menceriterakan semua kisah tentang istana raja jogja ini, tips saya bila berkunjung ke taman sari adalah mulai jam 14.30 sampai menjelang sunset, kemudia hati-hati dalam memilih tour guide, lebih baik terbuka dan dibicarakan diawal tentang harga guiding dll, kemudian hati hati dalam bertutur dan bertindak, ya bagaimanapun ini merupakan cagar budaya peninggalan kerajaan jogja, seyogyanya kita menghargai seluruh komponen dalam situs cagar budaya ini, someday i'll be back again here.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
This place is an ancient royal bath-house both for the family of the king as well as his concubines.

From this place towards the underground mosque, be sure to stop by at the local tshirt shop called the 'Voice of Jogja'.

ジョグジャカルタの王様の別荘・・水の離宮です。
白を基調とした建物はエキゾチック。「王様が水浴びする女性を云々」の逸話が有名な場所です。いにしえの王様の暮らしを彷彿とさせるロマンティックな建物はもちろん素敵ですが
周囲の旧市街地の街並も必見スポットです。
ただし周辺の地域は昔ながらの街並・・。
びび家はカーチャーターの日本語ガイドさんに案内されて歩きましたが・・「道？庭？」と言う感じの路地なので個人で歩くにはちょっと大変かもしれません。
周囲の散策・・そして地下通路・地下モスクへもぜひ！

Anche se difficile da raggiungere con i mezzi propri, il palazzo è affascinante, vasche, piscine, stanze, finestre... prendete una guida per farvi spiegare i retroscena che renderanno la visita ancora più interessante.

Mampir ke depan istana . Nyaman banget tempatnya banyak kursi banyak pohon dan minim kendaraan karena jalannya ditutup gx tau sih permanen atau gak dan lokasinya dekat dengan jalan malioboro dan kraton
This is a lovely place to visit, just a shame you can't swim! From the water castle if you ask directions you can walk to the old mosque, which is well worth a visit also.

Alrighty then.... Looking for stuff to do in Jogya we decided to find the Water Castle. Firstly it's not a massive site and if you really want a guide ( you don't really need it), they're everywhere you look ( in the 'low season' there were more guides than tourists!). This place was actually built for Royalty, basically a pleasure palace where the local dignitary and concubines bathed and took their leisure. The place looks a little tired and like a lot of Indo sites needs some TLC- maybe some of that gate fee they charge could be used?? You can get around this place in under 20 minutes but overall it's an interesting diversion and not too far from the Kraton either....
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This temple was beautiful. I visited it for 3 times. But it's quite hot. It will be more beautiful at sunset or at night. You can enjoy the Ramayana show. Not only prambanan, but you have to visit ratu boko also
Voor mij vooral interessant vanwege te mooie muren en schimmels die zich daar door de jaren heen hebben gevormd.

One of nice historical place to visit in Yogya, would've been better if they put information signs around the place (with English translation as well) so people could learn historical background of the place without relying on hiring guide.
Kom hiernaartoe en leer samen met een gids meer over de sultans ... Niet echt speciaal. Maar een leuke uitstap als je tijd hebt.
규모는 작지만 예전에는 화려했을 것 같더군요 방문했을 때는 관광객이 많지 않아서 좀 쓸쓸하기 까지 했습니다.
jika mengunjungi tamansari baru pertama kali disarankan untuk menyewa guide, masjid bawah tanahnya sangat unik sebagai latar berfoto, menambah pengetahuan tentang raja-raja jogja
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It was goos visiting this place, you will know the history of the building about King and his families, about the kingdom under the lake, and under water mosque with all explanation.

Utilize a guide, and you will get more out of your visit. Even if you say no, the guides will follow you anyway, and you will soon discover that there is so much more going on than meets the eye. If I had not had a guide, I would have missed 70 percent of the Tamansari. There are pretty little pools, refreshingly shady gardens, winding paths that appeara to lead into the neighborhood (but they are just different parts of the complex) and many stories about the function of what you are looking at. Without a guide, you will miss too much. Worth a visit. I only allowed myself 40 minutes, and had I known how much there was to see, I should have allowed more time.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The castle is very nice. Looks really good. There is an underground mosque also, which is very close to the castle. We were on a rush and had just one hour to see the place. Took a guide there. He asked for 30,000 rs first, then we bargained and made it 15000. 15000 is a good bet. The entry ticket was about 26000 per person. I feel in that short amount of time, we would have missed the underground mosque if it werent for the guide. He explained quite well too and spoke good English. There are not much taxis around the place. Atleast we did not find any. You might need to take a rickshaw (bicha) to go to a taxi stand.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
C'est sûr, l'endroit est loin de tout, n'est pas vraiment glamour, mais il est riche d'histoires et d’anecdotes amusantes.
Seule solution : un guide. Les livres ne vous aident pas et l'endroit est trop complexe de toutes façons pour être visité un livre à la main.
Pas besoin de chercher, ils vous harcèlent dès que vous approchez et vous pouvez même en trouver qui parlent français. Le prix, si on le ramène à l'euro, n'est pas si cher, finalement.
Un guide vous permettra de faire de la visite de cet endroit sympa mais moyen, un moment intéressant, et instructif.
Sans guide : oubliez.
Tempat pemandiannya masih sangat bagus, terawat. Sejarahnya sangat memukau. Arsitekturnya mengagumkan. Terutama mesjid bawah airnya.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Pity that when I visited the pools were empty. This is a fantastic attraction in Yogya, lots of fun to visit, and pleasant to just walk around.

prambanan,borobudur 같은 감흥은 없으나 안가면 아쉬운 곳... 시간이 없다면 패스해도 무방하나 시간이 충분하신분은 한번쯤 갔다 오시는 것도 괜찮습니다. 족자 근처에선 므라삐,보로부두르,프람바난, 라투보코가 최고고 나머지는 그냥 시내 관광입니다. 시간에 따라서 위 네군대를 관람하신후 시간이 남으면 다른 장소들을 초이스 하시길...

blog.naver.com/voangoan
Taman Sari adalah komplek pemandian sultan Jogja, sudah berdiri ratusan tahun yang lalu dan sangat bersejarah serta cocok untuk foto foto, sangat mudah diakses karena lokasi nya di tengah kota
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Piacevole visita al Water Castle, nelle immediate vicinanze del Kraton Palace di Yogyakarta. La struttura non è un granché ma risulta essere una visita piacevole nel caldo assolato di una giornata d'agosto a Yogyakarta. Bella la piscina nel cortile interno del palazzo ma tutta la struttura è molto spoglia e alla fine non c'è molto da vedere. Ingresso a pagamento, all'esterno trovate molti locali che si prestano per farvi da cicerone.

Sebuah bangunan yang sangat megah terletak di antara pemukiman ini sangatlah ajaib. Saya sangat mengagumi segala sudut dan lekuk dari bangunan ini , masih kokoh dan bersih terawat, semoga terus dirawat kebersihannya dan dijaga kelestarian sejarah di Yogyakarta ini. 

Harga tiket cukup murah dan anda bisa menikmati sudut masa lalu dari Yogyakarta, harus membawa kamera karena banyak sudut untuk bisa difoto.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
В действительности этот памятник архитектуры выглядит чуть более изношенным, чем на фото в путеводителях и брошюрах. И тем не менее очень интересно погулять по комплексу и прикоснуться к той жизни. 
Экскурсия будет более интересной, если Вы сможете найти хорошего гида, который знает историю, тогда Вы действительно сможете проникнуться духом и жизнью того времени.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Membawa anda ke masa lalu dimana saat para selir mandi di kolam di tamansari. tiket masuk murah, lokasi nya bersih dan dekat dengan alun alun kidul.
Great for a quick wander and photo ops. Very beautiful even with the faded colours and derelict feel of the complex.

Tempat unik karena saya baru tahu kalo ini kolam dipakai untuk raja mandi dengan selir - selirnya yg banyak itu..tempat cukup terawat. Bagus buat foto-foto.. Bikin kita melihat masa lalu karena ada banyak Yg masih dipertahankan bentuk aslinya.sejak pertama dibuat.
This place is beautiful and historical for the Queen of Yogyakarta and nice to look around and know more of the different part of this building
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: クラトンから少し南に行ったところにある、ジョグジャ市内観光の定番スポットです。いくつか門をくぐると水色のプールがあり、水は緑色に濁っていて、あまりきれいではありませんでした。
Melihat tempat permandian putri-putri raja jaman dahulu, jika kita berjalan agak masuk ke dalam kita akan menemukan mesjid bawah tanah yang sangat unik.
Taman ini masih tersisa kemegahan dan keindahannya serta tentu saja nilai sejarahnya karena didirikan oleh Sultan Hamengkubuwono I sehingga cukup menarik untuk dikunjungi bila ke Yogya

Without guide,you'll be lost. We couldnt even located the underground mosque aa its located near the locals houses. Tamam sari used to be one big area and connected between one another. But now, locals have been resided near areas and changed the entire site. Our guide was really young (in 10th grade!!) but shes quite knowledgeable and has been a guide since the 3rd grade. She explained and showed us parts of Taman Sari that connected to the South Lake and the port that Sultan put their boats. However, you can no longer see it as its now changed to local houses. Get a good guide,otherwise you might got lost and wouldn't find the underground mosque. And careful, not every guide can speak English properly. I suggest you to search about the history first to avoid the disappointment if you couldnt find an English speaking guide.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Nothing much to be seen. Small complex. Its the rest 'entertainment center' of the royalty.Cheap entrance fee. Worth the visit although not a main attraction

at this moment (but it's for a long time), the swimming pools are very dirty.  The total complex is much more bigger than the place where you pay entrance fee.  For tourists it's good to go with a guide, to find the different buildings and places

Berısı Kolam kolam aır yang dulu dıgunakan untuk tempat pemandıan sultan dan keluarga kerajaan . Bangunannya cukup luas dan bagus untuk spot pengambılan gambar, dı tengah harı cuaca cukup panas jadı usahakan pagı atau sore harı. Dısını juga ramaı dengan pengunjung. Terutama harı lıbur nasıonal
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Kami mengunjungi tempat ini pada pagi hari sekitar pukul 08.00 karena kami membaca di website yigyes.com bahwa tempat ini buka pukul 08.00 sampai 14.00 namun ketika kami sampai di sana, semua pintu masih tutup. Kemudian datang laki-laki separuh baya mengatakan pada kami untuk lewat belakang karena pintu depan baru saja dibersihkan. Saya sudah mulai curiga dan saya langsung mengatakan tidak mau mengikuti dia dan ingin menunggu saja. Namun sepertinya bapak ini tidak menghiraukan dan tetap mengoceh kepada pasangan saya (yang warga negara asing) dan tidak memberikan saya kesempatan untuk memberitahu pasangan saya. Kemampuan komunikasinya sungguh luar biasa! Ketika melewati sebuah pintu, ada petugas kebersihan di sana sedang menyapu, beliau kemudian mengatakan kepada saya untuk memberikan uang kebersihan (apa-apaan lagi ini?). Akhirnya saya berikanlah bapak ptugas kebersihan ini uang, tidak banyak, namun haruskah begini caranya? Baru datang sudah digiring masuk ke perangkap seperti ini, membuat saya kecewa dengan objek wisata ini. Selain itu di sekelilingnya banyak sekali rumah penduduk, bahkan ada pengemis di dalam objek wisata ini. Memalukan! Di akhir  bapak ini meminta uang jasa 50.000! Dibandingkan dengan bayar tiket di loket yang 7.000 untuk WNA dan 3.000 untuk WNI, saya jadi bayar 5x lipat ditambah ke bapak petugas kebersihan 10.000 rupiah! Semoga hal ini didengar oleh pihak pengelola pariwisata Jogjakarta. Supaya Kecantikan tamansari ini diimbangi dengan pengelolaan yang bagus.
Its worth visiting here and imagining back in the past. The structure, light and shadows are very interesting.
Bangunannya banyak yang bagus dan menarik untuk difoto. Mintalah seorang guide (dengan tips Rp 30.000-50.000) untuk menunjuk tempat-tempat yang bagus dan menceritakan isi di balik sejarahnya.
Everyone goes to Yogyakarta for Borobudur but if you have the time this is worth a visit.  It is beautiful.

This place is very closed to the city center and other tourist attractions and very good for getting away from heat. In order to go here, we pass sumur gumuling, go through small street and a local market with very good street food. This place is quite small and mainly for ceremony. The big front water pool is for king, the smaller one is for queen. They came here to take a shower as a part of purifying ceremony. I think it is not well maintained; therefore, it quite dark and a little bit messy.
A mi pareja y a mi no nos gustó mucho,  son paredes y techos solamente,  nada espectacular,  pero seguramente cargados de historia. La entrada es barata,  no llegan a la de euros,  lo único bueno
After visiting Borobudur and Prambanan a bit disappointing. If you have the time, it's OK, otherwise just skip it.

일단 골목길에 들어가 소박한 집들의 화분, 벽화, 고양이와 마추칩니다.
이런 곳에 있을까 싶은 곳에 지하 계단으로 내려가니 있더라구요.
조용하고 좋았습니다. 게다가 공짜.
전통 사원이 이런 민가 사이에 있고 
또 사원 밖으로 나와보니 펑키한 벽화들까지 섞여 있더라구요.
모두 잘 어울렸습니다.
추천요~
Comparing to all the other places you can visit in Yogi it's not very interesting.  If you have time to spare take bus 1A and go to the zoo instead.

We really looking forward to visit this place, unfortunately it was closed when i arrived. We dont really have much time too. But still i got a chance to sneak in from the rooftop to look whats inside so i only saw pretty much around the fountain. The surrounding area look beautiful.

Ternyata kompleks Taman Sari cukup luas, yang terkenal dari tempat ini ialah kolam pemandian dan masjid bawah tanah. Make sure, when you going to water castle, there are have water in pool. Tanpa air didalam kolam, berasa kurang total jadi pemandian. and, di masjid bawah tanah, pastikan di 5 tangga itu bersih dari selfier kalo pengen dapet foto edgy!
the people there are nice. I want to visit again. they explain a lot about the history of Yogyakarta,,, I loveeee it!
Very close to the Kraton, the Water Castle is very small and it's not a must do if you're short on time.
王様の離宮ということですが、事前に由来について勉強していったほうがいいと思います。そうじゃないとなんてことない建物に見えてしまうかも。。。内部にカフェなんか作るといいかなと思いました。

Unfortunately there was no water when we visited, we were told that the fountains were in the process of undergoing some cleaning but looking at empty holes was a bit disappointing.
On the other hand, it is quite interesting to see the tunnel and underground mosque so look for them as it is not easy to spot them.
日惹皇宫出来，不需要自己找，包车的小伙带我们去的！面积很小，10分钟就走完了，刚进去，直着走看到的池子在维修已经没有水了，旁边的那个有一点点水！没觉得这里有什么特别，门票很便宜，就算到此一游吧！

Taman sari ini dulunya tempat tinggal para sultan. tapi semenjak sultang yang ke 9. tempat ini sudah tidak di gunakan lagi dan menjadi situs bersejarah di jogja. tempat ini banyak tempat menarik yang cocok untuk mengabadikan gambar. bagi kalian yang sudak dengan tempat bersejarah, taman sari nin bisa menjadi tempat yang tepat ketika anda berkunjung ke jogja
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Menuju kemari sangat mudah,naik becak,andong,taksi bahkan berjalan kaki pun oke.Naik becak kemari disinggahin ke toko oleh2,pengrajin batik dan lukisan.Boleh beli boleh tidak,tidak ada paksaan.Sampai di taman sari,bisa kita lihat tempat mandi selir2 raja pada masanya,kamar tidur,tempat makan,dapur,bahkan toilet raja dgn sistem perairan dr gunung.Jangan lewatkan utk berfoto sebanyak mungkin,dan berikan tips untuk guide yg ramah2.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Went here to look for sengkalan. The entrance fee was 5k, a bit more expensive than other cultural spots in Yogyakarta. The complex was small, but for us the best part was the surrounding area. Certainly a must-visit in Yogyakarta.

The place is not up to the name.  When  i visited, there was not even water around the pond and the place looks a bit run down.  Anyway can just pay a visit to see the place that the Sultan lived.  Visit if you have time, if not can skip this place.
Masuk kesini dan menyewa tour guide jadi diceritan tentang asal usul taman sari, seru juga si jd belajar sejarah, tempatnya juga adem.

Tempat ini bagus megah.
Cuma hati hati sama tour guide sana. Sering minta lebih sampe gk masuk di akal tipsnya. 
Kalo pemandangan ok buanget

A very interesting add on to the main Tamana Sari temple tour. Some amazing surrounding areas of the old temple that is now occupied by locals, walking through the maze of lane ways and tunnels, have your camera ready

A bit dissapointed because there are no water here. But the nice guy, who guide us to see around told us that this place change too much after the earthquake in 2006. But still learn many thing about this place. Also there are under ground tunnel and mosqeu. A good place to learn about history and myth.

Dari keraton ke taman sari saya berjalan kaki, cuaca sangat terik. 
Tapi semua terbayar begitu sampai di sini. 
Sangat indah, setiap sudut sangat menarik. 
Hanya saja kawasan perkampungan tidak begitu menarik. Saya hanya membayangkan kalau kawasan ini betul-betul direkonstruksi sesuai dengan zamannya, begitu sangat mengagumkan tentu.

Kebanyakan wisatawan hanya mengeksplor kawasan pemandian taman sari yang terdapat kolam utama. padahal kawasan ini sangat besar dan kita bisa masuk kedalam terowongan bawah tanah yang mengagumkan. Coba cari pemandu, dan kita akan diantarkan 'blusukan' masuk kesemua kawasan taman sari.
If you are walking through Yogyakarta you should visit, the entrance fee is close to nothing and it's fun to see how the sultan lived with his family and children. Give it a try
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Kolam renang mewah etnik tempat para raja dan ratu Yogyakarta sejak jaman dahulu ini wajib dikunjungi. Design kuno Jawa yang begitu megah sangat memperlihatkan betapa mewahnya pemandian ini. Terdapat pula tempat selayang pandang dimana Raja dapat melihat langsung ratu-ratunya mandi. 
Anda dapat berfoto bahkan mencoba air mandinya raja dan ratu yang seger banget. Terdapat goa seperti lorong yang terhubung dengan pelataran keraton
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
The 18th cen. Tamasari Water Castle is the vacation house of the Sultan of Yogyakarta. It's is divided into 2 divisions with big pools and mountains. The place is quite nice but disappointing due to numerous vandals.

When you happen to be here, do not forget to visit the underground mosque - not a common knowledge to all tourists.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: If you're going there without having a basic research/information, you might easily feel clueless as the information/signage there to explain each of place/rooms are very minimal. Hire a guide at the entrance (tips: minimum 25,000IDR) and they will show and explain to you from Water Castle to Masjid Sumur (underground mosque). Be prepared as Masjid Sumur's location its a bit far but worth to visit. spend hours:45-60minutes
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Etwas verwilderte Anlage mit einmaligem Flair und einer tollen Geschichte. Wenn man etwas mehr Zeit in Yogia hat unbedingt zu empfehlen!
setelah dipugar Istana Air Taman Sari jadi super bersih, tertata dan makin banyak spot untuk foto-foto. semoga selalu terjaga kebersihannya.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: As soon as you get to the door, at least one person will follow you with the excuse to be your free tour guide around Taman sari. They take you around the temple, which doesn't have water because it's in renovation, so it looks like an empty swimming pool. The house of the guide is always near the palace and he will take you there in order to convince you to sell you batik. They will tell you their batik is the best and that there are people trying to sell fake batik everywhere. Oh and the entrance fee for foreigners is 12000 which was a lot for nothing.
Ganz nett anzusehen wenn in der Nähe ist kleine Anlage , einige Fotos das wars durch fehlende Wasser nur knoechlhoch nicht unbedingt spektakulaer

A historical heritage. This place have a lot of story. Please make sure that you walk on this place with local guide. When you enter this place and buy a ticket, you will see a local guide around this area. They will explain to you the story behind this place. I love the story behind this place. I feel peacefulness at this place.
Beautifully built water castle has separate ponds for sultan and queens.it also contains changing rooms and spas.
And old time historical heritage, a good place for taking art picture. Many people made their pre-wedding picture there...

Wajib kesini!! 
Keren pake bgt. Katanya ini tempat mandi para raja Jogja jamam dulu dan ada masjid bawah tanah juga.

Lokasinya strategis, terletak di tengah-tengah Kota Jogjakarta dan berhampiran Keraton. Kalau ke sini sebaiknya pake jasa tourguide supaya bisa lebih mengerti fungsi taman sari ini. Seni binanya cukup unik, menarik, cocok sekali buat mereka yang hobi fotografi. Disini ada dua kolam, satu untuk putri, pi=utri keraton dan yang satu lagu untuk permaisuri dan selir-selir sultan. Dahulunya selir akan mandi disini dan sultan akan melihat dari atas tower khas. Dari tower itu, sultan akan melempar bunga untuk memilih selir.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: E' una ex residenza estiva del sultano, non è niente di particolare ma se si è in zona merita una visita. Il prezzo di ingresso è irrisorio. Se facessero però un pò di manutenzione e riempissero le piscine d'acqua e mettessero in funzione le fontane diventerebbe molto più affascinante.

The water castle is part of an old complex where the King used to choose his concubine by watching the harem swim in the swimming pool next to his. There's still quite a lot to see including the swimming pools, the ahem bed chamber, the underground passageways, the private mosque
Great
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Really like the view of the castle, we can see all the building area form the balcony.
Maybe the management should pay more attention to cleanliness of the area.
Overall, it really worth the price to go there.
It is located near to Kraton. When we were there, the pool is empty so the place lack its charm. Overall, nothing much to see here.

sitio que no  merece desplazarse para visitarlo a no ser que os pille de paso, valga la pena decir que este sitio no había ni una gota de agua y no tiene nada que ver con la foto que aparece en pantalla, si estuviera lleno de agua sería más lindo.

When I came to this ancient water Castle ,the pool was empty due to dry season , it has 2 pool for the adult of royal family and pool for the children, around this water castle you can find some leather puppet maker , batik shop, T shirt shop.

kecewa ketika berkunjung ke taman sari sekarang yang banyak sekali perubahan dan tidak seindah dulu dan itu yang membuat pengunjung pun berkurang karna ketidak layakan nya untuk dikunjungi, semoga kedepan nya Istana Air Taman Sari semakin diperbarui dan menjadi objek wisata nomor 1 di Yogyakarta
Tamansari is part of Kraton Yogyakarta. In my view it is not a castle. It is the place for King and the Royal family to take bath. Thre are shops inside.

Salah satu tempat yg wajib dikunjungi bila sedang di Yogyakarta. Tempat ini merupakan bangunan prasejarah dimana konon merupakan tempat pemandian para dewi-dewi. Selain itu jg ada bangunan yang dahulu digunakan sbg masjid yang letaknya di bawah tanah
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Je kan je goed inbeelden hoe het er vroeger aan toe ging. 
Dit is de plaats om batik te kopen. Er is een coöperatief in het gebied.

The Taman Sari really lies somewhere between average and poor. The reason being that while it sounds absolutely amazing (a water palace!), but the reality is that it's a cluster of a couple of architecturally nondescript buildings with most of the poops that make it a "water palace", lying bone dry. It's a poor distant lame cousin of water palaces that you can find in Bali and Lombok. Avoid if possible, but if you are already close by, meh, might as well tick it off right?
Het is prima  ik had geen gids, misschien is het met gids leuker, maar ik vond het niet zoveel voorstellen
Place that the king and royalty family take bath. Its a nice old palace. Near to the Taman Sari is the Keraton (Palace) of Yogyakarta and batik shops.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: istana air ini selalu menjadi tempat yang menarik bagi wisatawan dalam dan luar negeri. sayang sekali pemugaran pulau kenanga belum selesai. jika sudah selesai, tentu akan menjadi lebih menarik. Ingin sekali mendapat informasi yang lebih lengkap tentang sejarah istana ini, sayangnya sumber informasi tidak tersedia di lokasi.

Je hebt iemand nodig die er iets bij verteld. Anders is het gewoon een slecht onderhouden paleis.
Raad het niet aan.

It closes at 3pm.
We went there to have a quick look... its like a house? Nothing to see.... The pools were empty (no water)

Again we arrived, paid entrance and got a guide appointed. He didn't speak or understand english. We also found out you could just enter for free if you don't take the main entrance. The water castle itself had no water due to the dry season. There are entrances at all sides seen there is a village built right around it... probably you can enter for free. Request to see the mosque under water, it's not directly at the water castle, but near and hidden between the houses. That one was an unexpected find between te houses.
王様がプールで水遊びする女性を選んで遊ぶ場所です。特になにと言うことはありません。もっと庭も広かったそうですが、今は民家がすぐそばまで迫っています。

Water Castle !!!
Water il était donc sensée y avoir de l'eau ?
Euh ! Il n'y avait pas une goutte d'eau ....
De plus Défraîchi, j'ai trouvé cet endroit sans intérêt 
Sauf peut être la petite boutique de batik, où nous avons vu une personne faire cela à la main.....

this water castle is superb. it gives you a glimpse of how royalty enjoy their leisure back then. the building is very unique and has many pools. from the story i heard, in this compound, there is a bathing pool for the Sultan concubine, this is where they would took a bath and waited for the Sultan to choose one of them. essentially this castle hold very interesting story. 
since this castle is very large, i recommend you to get a guide so that you would not be lost and get the whole story of this castle.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The water castle built for the sultans is an interesting structure but not well documented. The pink building itself looks just like it is baking in the sun. The tanks/pools were mostly dry when we went which certainly detracted from the effect. There's very little to describe what it is but it does not come with enough attractions to really warrant a guide. But wander around even after you are done with the main building. The side chambers and ante chambers are actually the most interesting. Though without a guide we missed the subterranean mosque. Rambling building and interesting though not because of intricate carvings or artwork. Close to the Kraton but ask where it is otherwise you can get lost.

Near to Kraton Yogyakarta, nice place to see Unique and better you company by local guide to explain the history of that place.
Imaging long time ago this place is for princes big pool
interessante visite qui permet d'apprehender la vie des anciens sultans! on visite les anciens bains des courtisanes et les appartements du sultan
Leuke tempel om te bezoeken als men toch door de stad Yogja loopt. Niet enorm spectaculair. Ligt in een geinig wijkje waar een hoop te zien is.

The real interesting fact is that the complex is spread much beyond the main buildings. So roam around a bit, and you will find how the older buildings have merged with newer lived-in houses in the heart of the city. Make sure you explore a little.

Está muy cerca del Kraton. Fuimos en tuk tuk por 10.000 IDR unos 0.70 € y tardamos 5 minutos. La entrada cuesta 12.000 IDR, unos 0.80€. En su interior puedes ver piscinas, sauna de aquellos tiempos, jardines, donde el sultán se relajaba. Caminando un poco accedes a una mezquita subterránea muy original.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This was an interesting but I wouldn't recommend going out of your way. It would be good if you go to the Palace first but it was closed the day we went. It's worth springing for the guide but know that they will take you through the shopping area in hopes of getting you to part with your money for some of the local art.

The Water Castle is an interesting attraction and is attractive since it opens at 9 and the Kraton does not open until 11 most days. However it is a labyrinth and so you do need a local guide, however much you detest using such people. Mine told me little but at least got me from where the becak drops one. 10k seems a suitable tip.

Tamansari is one of the most original place with remembrance of ancient java heritage. I really enjoy hanging around in this place and feel the sense of ancient times passed!!. As heritage building, they really tried hard to keep the original form, including the courtiers.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Satu lagi tempat yang bersejarah yang dijadikan tempat pariwisata. Dahulu nya adalah tempat pemandian para raja/sultan beserta keluarganya. Tempatnya cukup luas dan bagus. Dulunya di kelilingi oleh taman. Bisa dibayangkan keindahannya. 

Untuk masuk di tempat ini, cukup membayar Rp. 12.000 per orang. Yang bagus sekarang ada petugas yang bisa menerangkan kepada kita tentang sejarah tempat dan asal usulnya. Pada dasarnya tidak perlu membayar lagi, hanya memberi tips sukalrela apabila mau. 

Ada beberapa bagian bangunan yang retak/rusak karena gempa. Disekeliling taman sari ini sekarang adalah rumah penduduk. Ada beberapa yang berjualan kerajinan batik, wayang dan kaos. Juga terkenal dengan nama kampung cyber (yang pernah dikunjungi Mark Zuckerberg).
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Wie schon in den letzten Bewertungen zu lesen, war auch bei unserem Besuch kein Wasser in den Becken, ansonsten ist das ganze eher trist uns karg- ich würde diesen Ort definitiv nicht auf die "Must-have-seen" Liste setzten.
Nothing to shout about, really. I don't any water in the pool area. Since it's part of the itinerary, so I just go along with it.

Définitivement un endroit à découvrir !! Hormis le harcèlement des "guides" à l'entrée qu'il fait repousser poliment mais fermement,  Tamansari est un bonheur. J'adore la finesse de son architecture, son énergie, ses couleurs ... Le point d'orgue pour moi est la mosquée souterraine. J'aime y méditer dans les couloirs frais et calmes. Le quartier de Tamansari est également très charmant, n'hésitez pas à prendre un peu de temps pour le visiter!
Es mono, sin más. Está centrico por lo que puedes ir dando un paseo y disfrutarlo durante 20-30 min.
Pretty average place. It's called Water Castle, but there's no water in one of the pools. It's just odd. But it's a good place for photography, much better than the Kraton.

I am sure back in the days this place was magical.. Unfortunately the maintenance was soo poor that we can see spider webs everywhere.

Hopefully full scale restoration will be done to rejuvenate the water castle again
We do hope that this an other places around this heritage marvel will be much better preserved and maintained.

Tempatnya besar dan terawat bahkan hingga kolamnya yang selalu dibersihkan, hanya saja tidak terlalu menarik buat saya hanya melihat bangunan yang biasa saja dan sedikit membosankan bahkan saya hanya membutuhkan waktu 10 menit untuk mengelilingi tempat ini, dekat dengan rumah penduduk di belakang dan samping istana air ini yang kebanyakan adalah abdi dalem keraton jaman dahulu.

Este lugar es encantador pero por su historia y vecindario, si no llevas guía en serio que pensarás que es aburrido y feo pero cuando atraviesas las calles y cada rincón mientras te cuentan la historia del sultán seguro que todo cambia.
También encuentras batiks muy tradicionales y lindos.
Mi mejor experiencia en toda la ciudad fue en este lugar porque incluso un local me invitó a almorzar gratis! Y siempre las personas te sonríen, me sentí en casa
Al principio entré sola y estaba aburrida pero un guía se me fue uniendo y yo no tenía dinero sin embargo el continúo conmigo siendo paciente, tomándome fotos y mostrando el vecindario, las fotos y su familia
No tiene un salario fijo y habla inglés nivel medio pero si no fuera por el no sería mágica la historia
Su nombre es Mr.Tono (081391434377) y si lo contactas dile que Laura de Colombia lo saluda, lo recomiendo.

Otra cosa: lleva sombrilla porque es bastante soleado 
Para comer es sencillo porque hay tienditas
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Dont forget to visit Taman Sari when u go to Yogyakarya. Its a bathroom form as nig pool for king and all his wives, off course the pool doesmt functiom anymore.we went here when the sun really rise up above our head, around 1-3 pm, then we get clear blue sky for taking pictures. ots very dramatic, hehe. there also round footstep underground tamansari, that its must visit.

Situated in a labyrinth of little streets, this attraction sounds interesting at first...until you get there. There is not much to see, not too many tourists around, just a couple of cafes and little shops around it.
Aparently, the water temple was nothing special for us. But it is for free and if you are walking through yogya it's nice to visit

Untuk masuk ketempat ini cukup membayar 5000 IDR saja per pengunjung. ada beberapa view yang bagus untuk berfoto. Hanya saja ketika kami berkunjung ketempat ini pada tanggal 10Oct15 air dikolam depan kosong.Konon tempat ini adalah tempat mandi para raja

Benar, saya kagum melihat situs ini. Sebetulnya pantas untuk "dijual" layaknya situs-situs dunia lainnya. Saran saya sebaiknya dikelola lebih profesional. Dibentuk kelompok dan didampingi seorang guide. Sayang banyak tangan jahil yang mencoret-coret dinding. Banyak pengunjung yang duduk duduk saja di tangga, beristirahat. Hal ini mengurangi nilai keindahan situs. Selayaknya ditertibkan.

Good view, so old fashion and so very homey if u come from village with big culture...
But I really disapointed because I came in here at 3 pm but this place closed. . . Yeah may be bacuse Friday. .

But I really thankful with cs in there to gave me opportunity to come in some place. .

Over all,,, I love this place..!!

#ARNK

Taman Sari is also known as the King's water castle. Entry fees was Rp10000. By now it would have been increased. The place was so peaceful. If you want to visit this place, please take a guide, so he can show you the inside of this castle. There are many secret doors and hideouts. Don't miss it.

Pertama kali datang tidak ada tour guide yang membuntuti tapi untuk yang kedua kalinya kita didatengin tour guide lumayanlah jadi tahu sejarahnya. Ada beberapa spot yang bagus-bagus untuk dibuat foto. Tidak menyesal dan tidak pernah bosan mengunjungi tempat ini.

I was ill informed coming to this place. I thought I was coming for one place alone. I was wrong. 

I came by foot, on my own, with no guide. I am glad there was a guide who was not invited but 'voluntarily' gave a guided tour. This place is a huge place that in its former days has a man made lake. The lake and the connection to the river is no more there and it takes a bit of imagination because over the lake village houses are build. 

So, beside the obvious palace, visit the port where the Sultan suppose to arrive from the river. Third, the mosque. Fourth the house (Pulo Kenanga) that used to be in the middle of the lake. Fifth is the Sultan's residence south of the water castle.

Visit all of them to get a feel of the scale and understand the connection between each place. It really is magnificent.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

The so-called Water Castle was built by and for the local sultans of Yogyakarta to house their concubines, and as a place where the sultans could "get away from home" and enjoy the company of those pleasure ladies.  We visited it only because it was on the itinerary of the tour we were taking.  If you are on your own in Yogyakarta, I would save this as a possible excursion if you still have time after visiting Borobudur, Prambanan, the actual Sultan's Palace, and a few other sights in town.  The Water Castle is kind of run-down and somewhat small.  However, on a nice day, if it isn't overrun with other tourists, it can be charming and enjoyable.  I know we enjoyed it.  Although not a top sight in Yogyakarta, it is still worth seeing if you have the time and inclination to see what an old sultan's "playboy mansion" looked like.

Hidden in the heart of a residential area near the Kraton, the Water Castle is a fascinating place to visit, and is especially beautiful on sunny days when the reflections in the green pools are at their sharpest.

Many areas of the site have become neglected over the years – flaking paint, litter on surrounding rooftops and damp, empty rooms are common – but it's easy to imagine how opulent this palace would have been in its prime (and speculate about the naughtiness the sultan and his cohorts may have got up to…).

As with all Yogyakarta tourist attractions, a forest of selfie sticks and packs of visitors with little regard for those around them are common – but by the time you reach the Water Castle, you'll have become accustomed to this! And while you may be pestered by aggressive guides at the entrance, some of whom will block access to a public balcony near the entrance with great views over the local area, you don't need any accompaniment to find your way around this compact site.
