Review Text: I feel disappointed with institution who taking care of historical place like this. I found so many hand writing in every single wall, both inside and outside building. Staff who work there became paid-guide and this is such as NORMAL. They should take care of small thing like wall or visitor who wash their feet in pool. Visitor littering wherever they want as well. Makes this place very terrible.
Ist ganz interessant anzuschauen. In den vielen kleinen Gassen kann man die Ruhe genießen, da hier kaum ein Roller fährt.

따만사리는 크라톤에서 그리 멀지 않은 곳에 있는 곳입니다. 내부에는 몇개의 수영장이 있는데 각 수영장마다 이용할 수 있는 신분이 따로 있었다고 합니다. 왕은 수영장 위에 있는 방에서 아래를 내려다보며 후궁을 골랐다고 하네요! 따만사리 자체는 그리 크지 않고 보는데 큰 시간이 소요되지 않습니다. 하지만 따만사리 못지 않게 볼만한 곳이 바로 따만사리의 뒷골목입니다. 서민들이 살고 있는 그 뒷골목에서는 많은 것이 이루어지고 있습니다. 특히나 아기자기한 예술품들을 만들고 있는 모습을 보면 몇개 사고 싶은 마음이 절로 들곤 합니다. 또 하나 따만사리의 뒷골목을 돌아다니다 보면 그리 크지 않은 지하 궁전이 하나 나옵니다. 큰 볼거리는 아니지만 이왕 이곳까지 왔으면 한번 들러보는 것도 괜찮으리라 생각됩니다.

menurut petugas resmi yang memberi makan ikan di dalam gua, dibagi 5 wilayah, karena sudah banyak rumah penduduk didalam lokasi taman sari, Sebaiknya memakai jasa pemandu, tempatnya sangat luas tak ada petunjuk ke arah / bagian mana selanjutnya. 
izin foto bayar Rp.2000, izin foto prewedding bayar 25 ribu, ketemu sepasang pengantin dan rombongan selesai foto prewedding dari dalam gua. 
masih disekitar taman sari, ada kampung cyber yang terkenal.

Sultan ve yakınları için yapılmış . Savaş zamanlarında saklanacak yerleri mevcut . Giriş ücreti 10.000 rp civarındaydı . Görülebilir havuzlar biraz dikkat çekici . İçerideki binalar depremlerde çok hasar görmüş bakıma ihtiyaçları var.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Sepintas lalu obyek wisata ini terlihat biasa-biasa saja. Beberapa bagian bangunan di bagian belakang tampak kurang terawat. Air di kolam permandian juga kelihatan kurang jernih. Namun di balik itu semua, Water Castle atau lebih dikenal dengan istilah Taman Sari merupakan bagian dari kawasan Keraton Yogyakarta yang memiliki sejarah dan falsafah yang menarik. Bagian utama Taman Sari adalah 3 kolam permandian. Dimana kolam paling utara adalah tempat permandian putri-putri Sultan. Kolam kedua adalah tempat permandian istri atau selir Sultan. Sedangkan kolam yang paling selatan adalah kolam permandian Sultan bersama istri atau selir pilihannya. Itulah sebabnya, kunjungan ke Taman Sari sebaiknya dipandu oleh seorang guide setempat. Untuk jasanya memandu wisatawan ke seluruh kompleks wisata Taman Sari, wisatawan bisa memberikan imbalan secara sukarela. Tiket masuk hanya Rp 5.000 bagi wisatawan domestik dan tiket parkir Rp3.000.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Not worth entering unless you really have a lot of time to spare. Poor upkeep of the place. I suppose that if jogjakarta were to maintain this place well, it will be a great place.
Like many Indonesian historical sites, this is run down but it's definitely worth a visit when you're in Jogja. Fascinating history.

The water castle was an interesting afternoon out however it is a little run down and the pools were nearly empty. The best thing we saw there was the underground mosque to the side of the castle - really different and worthwhile seeing.

Tamansari Water Castle or Istana Air Tamansari is one of Yogyakarta's many heritage site, Tamansari itself means 'Beautiful Garden' which dedicated by Yogyakarta's Sultan as  a place for the royal families to retreat and relax. It has many pools which was used by the royal families as well. This place was also used as meditating venue, royal dance lesson ( Bedoyo and Serimpi). What interest me the most of this site is the tunnel, it has deep tunnels which have some mystical stories behind it. I found the guide was really good in explaining all the rooms and history. I must admit that they are all still very devoted to the royal family, which is great and rare these days. However, I think that overall the sites needs just a little extra cleaning, because it is situated in the middle of a  crowded housing. It was a good experience, one of a must visit place in Yogyakarta. Oh yeah, and make sure that you don't bring your own car, parking site was terribly small.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Great place, but the water not clear at all. And sometimes there's no water at all they said. If you come to jogja, i suggest you to visit this place as can relaxing you a bit..

More like a museum..not much to see though but the pool view is beautiful.
More to historical building..

Today my partner as I did the walking tour that was suggested in my Lonely Planet book and was pretty disappointed with everything that was on the list - but mostly the Water Castle. You have to pay for entry, and although it is cheap, clearly none of the money goes towards the palace. It is a dump. I am usually one to take lots of photos of everything we do but I did not take a single one here. It was not worth the space on my memory card. 

The walls are dirty and graffiti covered, the pools are full of algae, the palace is tiny and there is no information on any of the history. It also appears people are living there and are chickens wondering about. It is all outdoors apart from some dark rooms that you cant see into at all, so I personally couldn't see what it was that they were calling a "palace". Maybe we would have appreciated it more with a guide but I didn't want to spend any more as I was already annoyed you had to pay to enter an area like this that only took 2-3 minutes to walk around...I also by this point did not trust the locals 'working' in these places after a long day of them trying to con us into buying fake batiks!!

Tepat wisata ini adalah teraktegori sebagai tempat wisata sejarah . Yang erat kaitanya dengan Keaton Jogjakarta . Merupakan kolam air yang dipergunakan pada sama Nya untuk mandi para putri Keaton. Pada Saat saya datng kebetulan kolam sedang tidak be risi air, mungkin Karena sedang di bersih kan.keingginan untuk berfoto foto di tempat ini terus ok oleh banyak ya pe mandi wisata yang berusaha dengan semi me maksa untuk me mandi wisata wan , Hal ini cukup menganggu kenyamanan wisatwa.

Taman Sari is located just a bit near Kraton. The place showed age but it was well maintained and preserved. A lot of tourists come here and I'm not surprised why. The tour guide we hired was good in English so we fully understood the story behind this place. Watch your head though... some tunnels are a bit short.

Sudah sejak lama saya ingin sekali mengunjungi situs yang satu ini, berkali-kali ke jogja baik untuk urusan dinas maupun wisata belum juga terealisasi. Sampai akhirnya bulan April 2014 yang lalu saya berkesempatan berkunjung ke situs ini. Awalnya saya dan rekan belum tahu lokasi situs dan kami mencoba untuk bertanya pada bapak-bapak tukang becak yang katanya lebih mudah dan enak melalui sebuah pasar kecil di jalan Taman. Kita mengikuti saran tersebut dan ternyata saya dan rekan masuk melalui belakang dan tanpa beli tiket :D. Jangan ditiru ya travelers, kami memang tidak tahu akan hal itu jadi itu diluar kesengajaan kami :D
Jadi alangkah baiknya jika anda masuk melalui Jl. Wahid Hasyim, jangan melalui Jl. Ngasem atau Jl. Polowijan sehingga kita masuk dengan membeli tiket masuk. Dengan harapan dari uang tiket yang kita bayarkan akan membantu operasional perawatan objek wisata ini.

Bangunan Taman Sari ini begitu megah dan luas, tapi sayang sudah banyak yang runtuh atau tidak terawat. Belum lagi bagian dari situs yang mungkin sudah menjadi pemukiman warga, sungguh sangat disayangkan. Bangunan Taman Sari yang bergaya campuran antara Eropa, Hindu, Jawa, dan China menjadi nilai tarik tersendiri. Ditambah dengan adanya taman air yang membuat suasana berubah menjadi sejuk meskipun dalam kondisi panas terik. Bangunan Tamansari juga terhubung dengan Masjid bawah Tanah atau biasa disebut Sumur Gumuling, karena bentuknya yang mirip sumur terguling. Kedua tempat ini memang sarat akan sejarah dan sangat menarik bagi siapa saja yang memiliki rasa ingin tahu terhadap sejarah.

Hanya saja, kedua tempat bersejarah ini sangat kurang terawat. Sebagian besar bangunan depan tamansari sudah berupa reruntuhan. Menurut saya hanya pada bagian kolam saja yang terlihat agak rapi, mungkin memang fokus perawatan hanya pada satu spot itu saja. Petunjuk jalan yang memudahkan para wisatawan saya kira juga sangat kurang, banyak wisatawan yang bingung untuk berjalan ke arah mana karena minimnya papan informasi. Ditambah lokasi situs juga sudah berbaur dengan pemukiman warga, hal ini menambah kebingungan pengunjung apabila tidak didampingi pemandu wisata. Mungkin kedepan perlu adanya perbaikan pada hal-hal tersebut demi kenyamanan pengunjung.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The atmosphere of this place is excellent! We stumbled in via the labyrinthine alleyways to the north of the castle (which had some awesome locals, and neat shops), to find a large open area with some cool architecture. If you go into the area with the pools, you'll find high walls that serve effectively to block the sun. There's a small spire you can climb to get a bird's eye view of the pools. Some people taking wedding photos, and local teens taking in the view completed the experience.

A good attraction to visit if you are in Yogja city (there really not a lot to see in the city). There are different courtyards and small alleys within the premises. Theres also huge water features in some of the yards that is worth a photo or 2.
Great place,but still need to re-manage the place... Too many residence around this place... And just hear from the guide, UNSECO will rebuild this place...

I agree with other reviewers- I saw this place without a guide and could tell it was rich in history, but there were no signs or placards demonstrating the significance of the palace and like many Indonesian historical sights was poorly maintained. The pools were drained and there were graffiti on the walls. I'd recommend haggling with the guides outside the entrance to make sure you get a fair price to make this sight worth the visit.
就是去看2个水池，后门联通居民区，小巷子进来都不用买票没人管，小心头不要碰到门洞有点低。不过门票很便宜也算良心
the place was not well maintained. very small castle and only ten percent water in the pool. full of local people stick to us wherever we walked in order to get some money from us. disappointed.

... doch nach dem großen Erdbeben vor einigen Jahren nicht mehr so sehenswert. Interessanter die nahe Underground Mosque (Tipp!)   und das Schwimmbad der Sultane.Danach unbedingt einen Drink oder Lunch nehmen im ehemaligen Restaurant des Prinzen “nDalem Ngabean“ Jl. Nachwiesen No. 6. Tolle Lage im Park, teilweise mit balinesischen Live Musik.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Taman sari berletak diujung jalan malioboro kearah keraton.tempat ini sangat unik dan indah..bangunan tua,tempat raja jogja mencari selir sekaligus tempat menemui kanjeng ratu.taman sari jogja dijadikan istana ke 2 selain keraton.dan tempat ini memiliki kolam renang,sebagai ajang sayembara utk memilih selir dgn cara melempar bunga dr puncak menara kearah dayang dayang yg sedang berendam di air.bagi yg haus akan sejarah..silahkan mampir ketempat ini.dan akan mendapatkan kepuasan tersendiri...

We all loved the Water Castle, but only because we had a good English speaking guide who could give us a detailed history of the water castle and the adventures that the Sultan got up to.
Without a guide it would be a quick visit, but witha guide the whole castle comes to life and you can ask as many questions as you like.
We had people tag along behind us who were overhearing the salient information.
Guides are reasonably priced, so hire a guide for IDR 40,000 (be generous!) and get good value for money. Guides are friendly and informative so support the locals.
If only the Govt would put some money into restoration - this place is steeped in history!
It also helped that we went after a very good rain so there was a lot of water and you could get a sense of the decadence and indulgence experienced in your very own outdoor amazing pool!
What a life!!

Tempatnya memang sudah cukup lama, dan menurut saya kurang terawat, kolamnya pas kesana kotor dan sedang dibersihkan. Untuk Gua masjidnya memang terpisah dari kolam bekas pemandiannya dan harus jalan dulu sekitar pemukiman penduduk, yang belum tahu ga bakalan ngeuh kalo engga nanya. :). Lumayan untuk foto-foto karena bentuk bangunannya yang unik.

Lokasi dekat dengan Keraton Yogyakarta. Sewaktu masuk kami ditawari oleh local guide setempat untuk diantar. Beberapa local guide berdiri di pintu masuk menawarkan jasa dengan ramah.

Local guide menjelaskan dengan sistematis mulai dari depan sampai ke dalam termasuk menjelaskan sejarahnya maupun arti dari ornamen-ornamen yang ada.

Kita jadi mengetahui secara menyeluruh kolam pemandian ini. Menurut hikayat: Konon Sultan menggunakan tempat ini untuk memilih para dayang-dayang yang akan dijadikan selir. Ternyata tidak semua dayang-dayang dijadikan selir. dengan mendengar penjelasan ini kita bisa membayangkan ribuan tahun yang lalu bagaimana kemakmuran Sultan.

Kunjungan ke Taman Sari ini, dipadu dengan kunjungan ke Kraton Yogyakarta adalah wisata sejarah. Lebih tepatnya, membayangkan kemakmuran Kraton Yogyakarta di masa jayanya. Lokasi ini berisi bekas bangunan kolam renang raja, yang di masa itu tentu sebuah kemewahan. Saat ini, bangunannya cukup terawat, tetapi pelestariannya sangat memprihatinkan. Kompleks yang seharusnya terlihat mewah dan agung pada jamannya, saat ini dipenuhi dengan rumah penduduk, sehingga kemewahannya menjadi pudar. Lokasi ini sangat mudah dikunjungi karena termasuk di daerah kraton.

Berada tak jauh dari Keraton Yogyakarta, Taman Sari layak dikunjungi. Taman Sari adalah taman yang terdiri dari kolam-kolam pemandian, yang dulu nya adalah kolam pemandian Raja dan selirnya. Worth it menyewa jasa pemandu untuk mendapat detail histori dari lokasi ini, tak hanya yang ada di taman pemandian tapi juga di perkampungan sekeliling taman. Buka dari jam 10.00  hingga 17.00, pilih waktu yang tepat saat matahari tak terlalu terik.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Without a guide, this place is just like any other old building and we would be in and gone in under 45 minutes. With a guide, we were able to imagine the Sultan aka King and his harem of 30 concubines swimming in the pool and how the Sultan would throw a stalk of flower at his chosen concubine for the day. This and all the other interesting details of the castle made the visit memorable and meaningful.

As you make your way, there is an interesting shop selling t-shirts from recycled products at less than USD20.

The guides work on tips and are generally not pushy and very friendly. Ours even went all out to help us retrieved a bag which we left behind. We paid him IDR20,000.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It is a beautiful and interesting collection of semi-ruins that for some reason doesn't seem to be swarming with visitors. You can actually get into some of the back areas of it and have them pretty much to yourself. It is shady and cool on a hot and humid day. Make sure to go to the "underground" mosque, which has fantastic light with which to shoot pictures - great for portraits. The walk to the mosque through Kampung Cyber is also very interesting for its murals and little cafes.

The palace is old and dirty. Not much to see and many locals try to hassle you. even with a guide its not worth it. Its sad to see how they let this once fabulous palace turn into ruins run by locals.

As others have said, don't expect too much as the water palace is in disrepair and lacks water.  Go with a guide (who works on tips) who can show you around and take you to the underground mosque.. That was the most interesting part.  If you go to the batik and wayung kulit shop make sure you bargain.  We came home with 2 lovely shadow puppets at a good deal.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Melihat tempat pemandian raja dan selirnya.
Datang pagi atau siang agar tidak terlalu panas, dan bisa mendapatkan pencahayaan untuk berfoto yang bagus.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: When we visited no water was there in the 2 swimming pools. One swimming pool was with dirty water with mosquitoes. Nothing much to see.
Disaat kunjungan disambut dengan guide dan biaya tiket masuk pun murah.Masih diperlukannya perbaikan di istana tersebut demi kelestarian budaya jogja
Hampir 8 tahun di Jogja, kuliah, tapi nggak main kesini. Mainnya malah pas udah merantau. Yah, yang agak berproblema tentu saja vandalismenya. Sisanya sama sekali nggak ada masalah.

Carino. Fuori c'è un mercatino tipico dove potete incontrare qualche locale che vi fa da cicerone come è capitato a noi. Con la guida è molto meglio perché per esempio ci sono più piscine ognuna con la sua funzione. Da lì potete andare uscendo a comprare il leggendario batik non vi fate fregare con i falsi. Noi abbiamo visto il maestro all'opera è solo dopo si va a contrattare nn spendete più di 30€ o 500000 rp
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: taman sari is really beautiful and mysterious,  you can also walking around and find art shop. it will really enjoy eyes. the art it reall fantastic. don't forget to visit this place.

Het waterkasteel sluit aan op het Kraton. Hier vind ik het de moeite om een gids te nemen. Deze geeft uitleg over de gedeelten die vroeger onder water stonden en waar de aanlegplaatsen voor de boten waren. Dit is nu een dorp waar de werknemers van de Sultan wonen en waar allerlei ambachten te bewonderen zijn. Het waterkasteel zelf is niet meer te bezoeken wegens vervallen.

This water palace was designed by a Dutch architect back in 1758.  Though a large part of the original building was destroyed but you can still see it.  Be sure to take a guide with you to give you the history.

Leuk paleis om te bezoeken en makkelijk te combineren met het Kraton paleis dat vlakbij is. Hier is het aangewezen om een gids e nemen, deze brengt je naar delen van het paleis die je anders nooit vind, zoals ook een reeks ondergrondse gangen en de bij het paleis behorende woningen.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Saya mengunjungi Taman Sari pada weekend, banyak spot foto yang bagus. Tidak heran jika lokasi ini sering dijadikan sesi pemotretan pre-wedding. Pemandu wisata juga sangat ramah dan sangat detail menjelaskan tentang riwayat sejarah pemandian para selir dan putri raja ini. Sangat direkomendasikan untuk membeli buah tangan dari kampung seni yang berada di sekitar Taman Sari, terdapat lukisan, batik, dan wayang yang terjangkau harganya. Sangat saya rekomendasikan bagi yang mampir ke Yogyakarta.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Historical and classic white rocks all along the castle. This area separated into several sections, but I only got a chance to explore the entrance and not too far from there. We took photos for fun because the view around was amazing, I can see cloud like in a frame because the square of its rock are symmetrical. Be here if you want to have some 'me' time and be silent.

Try to get a guide with you, otherwise, you don't know what you are looking at. Visit the local artist inside of Tamansari, he makes beautiful pieces of local gods, I really forgot the technique he uses, but it is a must buy piece. Go to the rooftops to see the neighbourhood and try the allies that lead directly to peoples homes who live next to Tamansari. I was even more amused with a little glimpse of their everyday life, that was offered to me through the open doors of their houses.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The place was quite dirty when I was there, there were rubbish in the pool and the water looks like contain toxic waste. Nonetheless the place was worthy as tourist attraction. It was easy to find, and the admission price was cheap around 3.000 if I am not mistaken. There is old mystique atmosphere and rich history about the place. It is very good for sight-seeing as you wandering around The Water Castle.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
If you're not following any tour, it would be best to hire a guide. There will be some people at the entrance who would offer you their service, it's free but of course they expect some tips. I gave IDR50k for 30 minutes tour because I was pressed for time but I would gladly give more had I not been too rushed. 

Granted, the place is a bit smallish and you may feel that you won't need one but if you don't, then I think you'll miss some of the attractions outside. My guide took me to see an old underground mosque (used to be a hiding place from the Dutch) and surrounding village (called Cyber Village) where Mark Zuckerberg gave some donations to improve internet connectivity there. The village is full of nice murals/painting on the wall and if you're lucky, you could see people make large batik outside of their house. I like it because it gives you a glimpse of the locals' daily life. My guide mentioned that the village would be relocated next year because the government wants to expand the Taman Sari area. So, go there as soon as you can. 

If you're an art lover, you could buy some nice arts sold in the village or inside the Taman Sari compound. Otherwise, you could impress your friends with some nicely designed t-shirts made from bamboo.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Talvez no passado tenha sido algo que merecesse o título de palacio. Infelizmente, esta mal cuidado e exige do guia um esforço enorme pra torná-lo interessante.
Vá se estiver sem nada pra fazer.

Taman Sari merupakan objek wisata lainnya di Jogja yang wajib dikunjungi. Lokasi Taman Sari tidak jauh dari Kraton Yogyakarta sehingga kebanyakan orang berkunjung ke Taman Sari setelah bertandang ke Kraton. Taman Sari dibuka mulai pukul 10.00 sampai 17.30. Jangan lupa membawa kamera karena banyak sekali spot unik dan keren di tempat ini.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
The place itself is not that amazing, but rather the history. Ask locals about the water palace, they are always willing to give information. 
I visited the place twice. The second time was with my sister, we came late, it was already closed, but the employees allowed us to see from behind, showing the way and providing to us a lot of interesting historical facts. 
The small village behind the Water palace, is very interesting to see. This is the village, where all the employees of Sultan palace live. Walk on those narrow streets, look at local people, take a lot of pictures, and never forget!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Tamansari, or the Water Castle, was once used by the former Sultan as a holiday home where he would have taken his many wives for a weekend of watery fun. However, these days it is open for public access and you'll be given entry for quite a nominal price and a great historical tour of the palace. You'll be able to admire the beautiful white walls which give the castle the feel of a Moorish palace. There are some great pictures to take here and some sights to cherish. Besides the main castle, there is also a nearby batik art store where you can admire and, if you manage to successfully practice the Indonesian tradition of bargaining, purchase one of the many beautiful works for sale.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: è stato un po difficile da trovare il luogo in motorino, qst parte di Yogyakarta è un labirinto. L'ingresso mi è sembrato un po caro 13000 rp, la giuda Lonley Planet segnalava 7000 rp. Il posto non è organizzato per niente nessun cartello ne didascalie. Praticamente dentro a parte le piscine nn cè niente.

This place is average at best and doesn't really justify the effort to visit. Lots of graffiti inside the tower. The baths aren't anything special. A quick visit is all that is needed before you move on to have a quick look at the nearby mosque and Sumur Gumuling.
This building has so many interesting stories. You have to explore all the stories reflected by some buildings there.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: need to have a guide in touring Taman Sari as there are a lot of confusing twists and turns along the way. Plus a guide will help you  get to your ideal place right away. actually, it was just our Becak driver who was kind enough to guide us. we just showed him the pictures to where we wanted to go, and he enthusiastically brought us to each place with stories , just like a tour guide would do. The place is now full of houses from people working at the palace, so it is quite confusing if you venture out on your own. but all in all, I can just imagine when it was still at its heydays, with water everywhere! Especially right inside the tunnel with the stairs, it was still a great place for taking souvenir photos.
Compact building with a very intriguing background, Bot very touristic. Gives a good idea how the sultans lived
Water castel is historical building, mysterious and actually beautiful, but they need to take more care of this building. It is surrounded by art shops. You will enjoy many kinds of art.

If you visit Water Castle, don't forget to visit places surrround the water palace..
Like wayang kulit workshop and store, batik shops (include contemporary batik design), kampung internet (this village was visited by Mark Zuckenberg last year).. and Pulau Cemeti.

This must have been used by the Sultan of days gone passed to escape the hot weather of Yogyakarta.  Today it's a monument of historical significance but currently in disrepair and nothing to really write home about.  If you have time to kill, stop by.  If you miss it, you didn't miss much.

Came here April 2014

- the entrance fee still affordable
- it has historical story about Jogjakarta Palace
- better walk with a guide so you can understand about the place 
- take much pics if you came here :D
- if you walk out from here dont hesitate to visits ancient mosque and princess palace which already bombed by the war *cmiiw
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: A hot day and a walk from the sultans palace around the back lanes and a palace that was in need of some restoration and some water

Istana Air ini merupakan peninggalan keraton dulu yang patut dilestarikan. Sebenarnya tidak ada yang 'wah' dari wisata ini. Tapi nilai historisnya patut dihargai. Saat ke sana, ada beberapa bagian yg sedang dipugar, jadi agak susah utk menikmati (terutama foto2, hehe). Ini tempat yang perlu dikunjungi kalau ke Yogyakarta, tapi utk selebihnya tidak ada yg lain..

This is one of good historical place in Yogyakarta. There are tour guides who waits in front of gate. They will guide & introduce you about the history of this place. Don't forget to give him tips if you already finish to visit this place. But if you want come inside and walk around the water castle which is located in the middle, you should go before 3 p.m because it is closed at 3 p.m.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Het waterpaleis behoort tot de kraton. Het is de afgelopen jaren gerenoveerd en de moeite van een bezoek meer dan waard.

Beautiful building, with an incredible history to go with it. My one piece of advice would be to avoid the masses of people at the entrance who offer to show you around. They're persistent even if you tell them that you don't want to be shown around. To be fair, the man who showed us around had a wealth of knowledge on the palace which made looking around a lot more enjoyable, he then led us in to a batik shop at the end, where the gentleman inside put a great deal of pressure on us to buy something stating that the government allowed him to stay there but paid him 20,000idr a month. We ended up getting royally mugged off (British for screwed over) and paid £11 for a small batik (although very beautiful, not justified in the price), however this was our first day in Jogya and our first real day out in Indonesia, so I guess we were naïve! Oh well, you live and you learn! 
There are many becak drivers eager to cycle you back to your hotel waiting outside, so you should have no trouble making your way back!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Leeg waterpaleis. Niet meer in gebruik. Wel bijzonder om een kijkje te nemen. Zeer lage entreekosten. Je wandelt er in een half uurtje doorheen. Het ligt midden in de stad. Leuk als je nog wat tijd over hebt.

This site may not be on all tourists list of things to see in Yogja, but it should be.  The faded map at the front shows how huge the facility use to be.  It was a summer / holiday palace for the Sultan and his very extended family.

What is still left, some of the main baths and grounds are very impressive and offer a glimpse of what royal life would have been like.  If you use one of the guides, which are pretty inexpensive, they will lead you into some of the back areas you would not find on your own.

A great site for photography.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Gue paling suka di bagian bangunan bawah tanahnya. Begitu kokoh. Tampak jelas dibangun sebagai bagian dari pertahanan masa itu. Dingin, gelap. Sinar matahari bisa menerobos dibagian atas lorong, menyoroti beberapa bagian dinding yang ditumbuhi lumut. Dibagian pemandian kurang begitu asyik, terlalu banyak perombakan yang dilakukan. Susah untuk melihat sisi sejarahnya :(

Very near the Keraton, the Taman Sari or Water Castle used to be the king's swimming area - the  history of how he chooses who to sleep for the night with, from his many concubines is pretty interesting. 
Its basically empty rooms, unused swimming pools and quite unkempt gardens. Unfortunately when I visited, there were just too many people there and the fact that its not very well kept (peeling paint/mould etc) made me feel a little short changed and idisappointed. 
Like some other reviewers say, visit if you have the time but don't make it a priority on your Jogjakarta trip.
A high expectation for an ordinary place.. And if you have KITAS, there is no special price. The entrance fee is only for Indonesian or International..
Fuimos y las piscinas estaban vacias y todo sucio y descuidado...las paredes agrietadas, etc...una perdida de tiempo
Yes worth seeing but not at the expense of other sights.  Definitely need transport to see this one as it's very difficult to find.
O palácio está mal cuidado, e a localização para quem vai a pé e confusa. Fomos porque tínhamos tempo sobrando mas não é nenhum lugar que vale a visita, para mim foi uma decepção.

Il giardino acquatico Taman Sari si trova nel dedalo degli interessanti vicoletti che circondano il Kraton, il palazzo del sultano. A farci strada nel labirinto di questi kampung (letteralmente villaggi) è un simpatico ragazzo che parla un po' italiano, naturalmente con lo scopo di venderci qualche batik alla fine della visita. Il "castello d'acqua" risente di terremoti ed eruzioni anche recenti del vicino vulcano Merapi ed è piuttosto fatiscente. Le stesse piscine, separate da una torretta dalla quale il sultano godeva la vista di mogli e concubine, sono attualmente prive d'acqua, sembra per qualche guasto dovuto a movimenti sismici. Considerato il contesto urbano in cui si trova, nell'insieme vale comunque una visita.

The old gardens and swimming pool of the sultan's palace that became disused long ago after one of Mt Merapi's eruptions, this site does provide insight into how the sultan used to live. There are no longer any real gardens, mostly just the swimming pools and some batik shops. The guides (working on a donation basis) come from the generations that have served the sultan and live within the complex and the explanation did add some interesting insights. Not somewhere I would want to go back to but probably worth the visit if you are in Yogyakarta and have an hour to spare.

interesting place to be knowing the history behind it (from the guide).
The pool and building outside is well maintained, but not the interior especially on the tower. A nice repaint would make the place a much better place.

Menggunakan pemandu dengan bayaran sukarela
Dibawa mengelilingi dan dijelaskan mengenai sejarah
Dibantu berfoto dan penjelasan singkat mengenai toko-toko yang ada di sekeliling
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Tamansari offered you eye-catchy beautiful ruin from outside.  This place was once part of the main palace in Yogyakarta, but now people started to use the ruins as their settlement. The entrance is free but you might need to hire a guide to get around. Expect to enjoy the sight of children playing in the ruin, houses just next to underground tunnel entrance, and a dried up bathing place.

It was such a waste that this place now become a ruin, nonetheless, imagining that the rusty gate that we stepped by was once the entrance of kings and queens of Ancient Java, definitely it will pique your creative side.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: To find the water castle is not so simple.  The adventure is half just getting to it!  Loved the tunnels and underground mosque.  The pools were almost empty when we arrived so it wasnt so beautiful but a very unique experience for my friends and I and one I will not forget.  Highly recommend:)

You could see manythings. Underground tunnels, ruins, sultan's queen and concubine bathing place in the past, sultan's round mosque in the past.
When i went here, unfortunately it was rain a bit and crowded, so not so much comfortable to take any photos outdoor.

If it is your first time, better to use a guide there, because the place took a place below and between people houses and no sign.

But if not, you could just follow people who used guide there :p
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: als je wat tijd over hebt, kan je er een kijkje nemen. het is een leeg kasteel wat pas in gebruik wordt genomen als de huidige sultan zich als regerend vorst terug trekt.

Hanya bangunan lama bekas tempat mandi para selir raja.
Bangunannya kurang terawat, meskipun ini bangunan sejarah seharusnya sedikit dirawat.

Jika anda pecinta objek wisata budaya atau peninggalan sejarah, maka Istana Taman Sari merupakan salah satu objek wisata yang tidak boleh anda lewatkan. Bangunan di Istana ini penuh nilai sejarah dan memiliki cerita maupun mitos yang menarik untuk kita ketahui.
Lokasi Istana Taman Sari masih berada di dalam komplek Keraton Yogyakarta. Jadi sangat mudah dijangkau oleh para wisatawan yang ke Yogya.

Mungkin ini kunjungan saya ke 4 atau 5 kalinya, setelah renovasi, mungkin baru 2 kali, suka saja liat bagian taman air, dengan membayangkan suasana tempo dulu, di mana ada Sultan berikut dayang2nya, yg siap mandi dan bersenda gurau bersama, mungkin di jaman ini tidak bakal ada lagi, bangsawan Indonesia yg melakukannya, hehe...ada guide, lebih baik memakai jasanya, supaya bisa tahu kisah di balik bangunan ini, unik dan berkesan...! Oya jangan ke sana hari Senin, tutup.
Should visit this one. Touring with guide will helpfull to know better about this place. Gladly theres an old man there whom willing to help give better explanation for us.

Menikmati keindahan tamansari, tidaklah cukup hanya dengan melihat-lihat. Sebaiknya, kita gunakan saja jasa pemandu wisata yang rata2 sangat ramah. Mereka akan mengajak kita napak tilas istana air ini, dan menceritakan secara detil bagaimana romatisme cinta yang indah yang dilakukan oleh para raja Yogyakarta di masa lalu, penuh keadilan, kebijakan, dan sangat menjunjung tinggi martabat dan budaya jawa di masa lalu. Tempat ini sangat fotogenik, di sudut manapuin kita dapat mencari posisi objek kamera yang sangat menakjubkan
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I can imagine how beauty it was long time ago, but they don't take care in the perfect way, so many dirty part and smels of urine. It was continued building until the cemeti island, but yeah..is old and so many broken part, but really.. is beautiful and can be more when the government take care more seriously
They should fill the pool with water, and written information regarding the place. Or it is for benefit of guides ?

istana air taman sari di yogyakarta berada di tengah perkampungan penduduk. di sekitar istana terdapat gua buatan yang terdiri atas lorong-lorong yang sengaja dibangun sebagai benteng.
seperti bangunan tua pada umumnya, ada cerita mistis di balik bangunan ini. termasuk cerita-cerita bagaimana kolam air dimanfaatkan oleh leuarga kerajaan.
bila ke yogyakarta, sempatkan untuk mampir ke obyek wisata ini, karena menjadi salah satu kekayaan budaya nusantara.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The water castle is a nice side trip, but not one to choose over Prambanan or Borobodur.  Go here if you have extra time.  Also, the value you get from the visit depends on the guide.  Saving on a guide may work against you if you visit on your own.

Admittingly Yogyakarta is a crowded and busy city. I had fancied Malioboro street, but so much has changed from the old street that I quickly lost interest.
 On the contary I made a guided visit to the Kraton with dances, the hidden mosque with its sober but beautiful architecture and the waterpalace. Beautiful quiet spot with a rich almost sensual history
 Certainly worth while visiting
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Taman Sari terletak masih di dalam kompleks kraton Yogyakarta,  Kompleks yang dulunya merupakan istana air yang terdiri dari beberapa kolam untuk pemandian para putri dan juga selir sultan ini masih cantik hingga saat ini.

Apalgi dulunya terdapat pulau-pulau buatan yang kalau nantinya dapat direnovasi kembali maka kita akan dapat menyaksikan seperti pada masa jayanya lebih dari dua abad lampau.  Kalau mampir ke Yogya, maka wajib hukumnya untuk mampir kesini
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: yak..lokasi hotel tempat saya menginap yaitu cavinton hotel emang dekat dengan area keraton, malioboro dan taman sari. tinggal pilih saat cuaca cerah, naek becak 15 ribu berdua dengan istri ke arah taman sari, jalanan model jogja sangat khas, dengan pinggiran Gapura beteng keraton, terdiri dari 4 bagian utama yang terpisah dari area keraton jogja. jangan lupa bawa kamera.

If you come alone or just with friends, you'll meet local tour guide. They didn't give you the exact rate for their guide (my experience).  If you feel satisfied, you  can give them more money. 

I met my local tour guide and he can explain every little thing, every question that I asked perfectly and also being my photographer! He can give good spot for my boyfriend and I int he photoshoot. Hehe

The history also good to learn. At the end of the journey, he guide us to a local clothing shop (but worldwide) named "The voice of Jogja".

The t-shirt really good. It's really recommended place to buy good wuality t-shirt.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Without a guide, Taman Sari will make little sense. (On the other hand, the chances of you making it here without a guide following you are slim.) Intended to be set over several acres, the various buildings are now in various states of crumbling disrepair, from the ruin on the hill that affords a beautiful view of the city, to the underground mosque (as curious an idea as it is in execution), the warren of tunnels and the Sultan's "swimming pools", which were clearly once a baroque, rather risqué waterpark for concubines and wives (and the Sultan) and are now looking a little sad and sorry. Only the last of these three charges and entrance, but expect no signage, explanations, history - anything to put it into context. Thankfully, the uninvited guide who had followed me was very informative and I happily paid him for his time.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: If you haven't much time, skip this. It's only three tanks, nothing more. But, the underground mosque is interesting.

While, old, this location is in poor repair.  There are no indications of what you are seeing, and a guide's explanation is essential.  The walls are crumbling and the water is not clear.  It's hard to imagine it being a place of pleasure.

With just IDR 5.000 entrance fee for locals (I don't know about for foreigners), Tamansari is such an interesting place. It is a place for Sultan's bath, and some guides said that Tamansari is also a villa for Sultan. To me, the building is like that from ancient Greek era, and that's the cool point from this attraction. 
There are two pools for some women/princesses to take a bath, then Sultan will choose one woman from each pool to take a bath with him. There is also spa or sauna place for Sultan, kitchen, and an underground mosque.
On the front gate, there may be some people willing to explain you about tamansari, that may be the guide and I think the guides are not official. However, it worths a try because I think I know a lot better about this place when I hired a guide.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Worth a walk for a quick look, 1/2 more than enough to see it all. Not far away is the underground mosque, an amazing place to visit.

My best recommendation would be to get a local guide (they are available on-site for a minimal fee) who would be able to tell you more about the King's lifestyle in the past and the history of the place. The castle itself whilst a little rundown, is actually really beautiful. Take a walk around the castle grounds with your guide and be able to imagine how much more beautiful the place was in the past. 

Pro-tip: Ask your guide if he/she would take also you to the underground mosque which is actually part of the Castle complex. It is a short walk away but worth the visit. Walk down the old underwater passage that leads into and out of the mosque and feel its haunting beauty.

Pro-tip 2: On the way to the mosque, you might pass by a tiny Tshirt shop called Voice of Jogja. If you like quirky bamboo Tshirts and want to support local talent, pay the place a visit. We ended up buying a few Tees that made good unique souvenirs (instead of the usual keychain and magnets!) for our friends.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I visited this place several times, but still got confused and lost because there is lacking proper signage. Beware that visitors could end up being lost in local village instead of sightseeing the Water Castle. A hired guide is recommended, especially for foreign tourists.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This is a lovely example of the sultans private baths. There are two areas, one for the sultan and children in one pool and an adjoining pool for the wives.  Then another area for the wives and sultan alone with private bedroom for the "chosen" one.  It is in need of repair as there is no water in these pools.  I believe the recent earthquake did some structural damage so there is a green slime to the few inches of water in the bottom of the pool.  If you use your imagination this would have been quite a stunning pool.

Het waterkasteel is een mooi 'paleis', waar de sultan en zijn harem vroeger baadde. Al was het wel ff zoeken voordat we het gevonden hadden, de bewegwijzering erheen hebben wij niet gezien. Een gids laat je het complex zien, deze zit bij de prijs inbegrepen. Voor je bezoek met gids heb je een uur nodig. Er mag wel wat aan onderhoud gedaan worden.
Il s'agit d'un ancien chateau qui ressemble de nos jours plus à un squat qu'à un monument historique. C'est sale et très laid.
I would recommend just a quick visit to the water castle to see what it is like. But it will not take much time and be aware that the complex is in a state of disrepair. Even so, worth a look
This used to be the pool for the Sultan. The design is beautiful, but it would be nice if they upkeep it a little better. The building and pools need a good clean.

As it was part of the tour, we stopped and see the place. It would be good if you can google the background before going as some reviewers suggested but I was lucky as the guide did give a good run down of the place.

Like the title I wrote, it was a private bath for the royalties and their families long time ago. If you are into history, yeah.....you can have something to write about. Still, it is worth to see the architecture.

Worth a visit if you are a history student or just love history. Always good to do some pre-reading. Doesn't take much effort to google some information about it. You will find it a bore if you have no inkling of what the place was supposed to be in the first place. 

There's the usual entrance fee. A small sum to help preserve the area. No uniformed, official guide to bring you around which was not the case for Kraton Jogjakarta. 

However, you may be approached by residents of the vicinity out to make a quick ten of thousands rupiah or so. But it's a small price to pay if you are lucky enough to have a really good guide. Their English is alright but don't expect them to be like a native English-speaking professor of history. After all, English is not the native language of the Indonesians. And we have to acknowledge that there are other languages in the world too. 

The guide i had was really good. The information he shared was similar to what I've read in the net, and more. Quite pleased with his explanation and stories. However, the only thing we didn't like was when he brought us to one of the home industries near Taman Sari selling traditional handicrafts. Although there was no pressure to buy, we bought something eventually. 

And yes, at the end of the tour, you ought to give him a tip for his effort. I guess it's better this way as you are giving them some support to their livelihood.
not much to see here. many people come here and musicians playing. it has a history so pls read about it bfr you will visit it. as i can remember it was free of charge.
Saw Pranbahman temple first. This is very boring and not much to see. Didn't bother with a guide....

Many tourists visit just only pool and then make a conclusion that it is a boring place with nothing to see. But there is a super cool underground mosque! Don't miss it! Also don't miss those narrow streets near the mosque. It is a really nice walk.

すぐ近くまで民家が入りこんでいます。美女を品定めしたプール、
近くには「家来の家だったのかな？」と思う遺跡もあって昔の
宮廷生活を想像しました。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
水の離宮の名の通り、水をたたえたプールと取り囲む建物が素晴らしいです。
メインのプールと建物を見るだけでなく、脇の小道に入り幾つかの古い建物も見ることをお勧めします。
私の場合、本来なら有料と思われる英語ガイドの方が、無料でガイドしてくださり、
脇の小道に入り一番奥の建物（写真）にて、
仏教・イスラム教・ヒンズー教の3宗教の造形物が混在している説明を受け、
象徴である水の離宮の名より、3宗教の歴史に強い印象を受けました。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: 就是一个日惹王和众后妃，娱乐的地方。几间石造房屋。特色不明显。除了门票，相机也收费。但是手机不收费。可以安排顺路在小王宫--大王宫之后参观。参观水宫后坐人力三轮到火车站1.5-2万印尼卢比。
Interesting to explore and entrance pretty cheap, but won't take up much of your time. I wouldn't recommend travelling here just to see it.
Leuk om te bezoeken. Jammer dat het niet goed onderhouden wordt. Jammer dat meer bezienswaardigheden in Indonesie slecht onderhouden worden

Saya dan suami baru saja menikah dan kami memutuskan untuk melakukan honeymoon trip ke Jogja. kami memilih Taman Sari karena keindahan kolam pemandian Permaisuri dan Putri Sultan. Berhubung kami hanya berdua, kami cukup kebingungan untuk melakukan pengambilan foto berdua. Beruntung ada Bp.Bambang (Abdi Dalem Sultan) yang baik. Beliau tidak menawarkan jasa seperti guide2 yang lain namun beliau langsung menawarkan bantuan untuk mengambil foto kami dan sambil menceritakan sejarah pemandian Taman Sari tersebut secara lengkap dan detail. Beliau juga mengantarkan kami mengelilingi seluruh Istana Air Taman Sari tersebut. Pengalaman yang cukup luar biasa dengan harga yang murah. :D
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I really tried to enjoy this place but i just found it way too overrated.Didn't think it's worth my time and effort.

Известно, что это дворец. Можно представить как здесь жил сам принц, как сюда приходили вельможи и солдаты. Место уникальное, сам принцип построения сооружений, не большой, но просторный двор, бассейн. Посмотреть интересно, но надо в комплексе, пройтись пом магазинам и рынкам рядом, зайти во дворы за дворцом, там бегают курицы, кошки и проходит жизнь как и , можно представить, в те времена. Хорошее место для фотографирования.

The map shown at the entrance is not updated, we tried to walk around the castle and find the antique, however some of the areas are being occupied by inhabitants!  Totally destroy the meaning of keeping this castle as one of the tourist attraction.

We are told by the tour guide that Water Castle is the place for the Emperor to keep his women...and his way to choose whom to be with him for a night...

Well...i can't imagine it was ever a nice swimming pool...
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Ambiance feutrée, on s'y croirait...
J'ai adoré, le palais est entouré de petites échoppes de toutes sortes, de bars, de restaus

Walau sering kesini, tp tetap aja buat kangen ingin kembali lagi.
Pemandian ratu" mengandung sejarah.
Kolamnya memang kuno tp tetap saja auranya keren.
Nggak kan ketinggalan selalu absen kesini tiap ke jogja >.<
Skip this and spend more time at the Sultan's Palace or shopping on Malioboro Street.  Nothing but half empty algae-filled pools from a long-past period.

Tamansari yang disebut juga istana air letaknya di sekitar kraton.sayangnya pada waktu kesana turun hujan shg kami tdk dpt masuk ke istana airnya.tapi kami bisa berkeliling disekitar istana air ini.mengelilingi kampung tamansari,tempat bertapa sultan,penjual lukisan batik,tempat perjamuan makan untuk selir,dan melihat dr samping istana air..takjub dgn keindahan istana ini.pd jaman dahulu arsitektur telah berkembang pesat

Водный дворец расположен рядом с Кратоном - резиденцией правящей династии Индонезии. Очень симпатичный комплекс, но нуждается в реставрации - местами очень облезлый. Зато там прохладно, что очень актуально после окружающей жары. Жаль, в бассейнах запрещено купаться...

Precioso y mágico lugar. Visita obligada 100%. 
Las piscinas impresionantes y el palacio aunque un poco descuidado era precioso
great place with a pool inside the palace compound with interesting stories from the guide. the walk through the staff quarters is quite long
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Beaucoup de monde pour voir peu de choses. Le plus intéressant: se perdre dans les petites rues qui entourent ce palais

Taman Sari terletak tidak jauh dari Keraton Yogyakarta atau mengarah ke bagian selatan. Arsitekturnya tergolong unik , perpaduan Jawa dan Portugis. Kalau dari alun alun utara Yogyakarta bisa dicapai dengan berjalan kaki. 
Pada jaman dahulu taman sari merupakan kebun kerajaan yang didalamnya terdapat kolam pemandian yang diperuntukan untuk raja dan keluarganya. 
Taman sari ini merupakan satu bagian Istana yang digunakan untuk menghormati istri istri sultan yang sudah membantu pada jaman peperangan. Disekitar taman sari ini juga terdapat lorong lorong bawah tanah yang akan menghubungkan ke bagian lain taman sari. yaitu menuju sumur gemuling, dan gedung kenongo ( gedung tertinggi di taman sari ). 
Jam buka senin - minggu 09.00 wib - 14.30 wib, sebaiknya menyewa pemandu untuk mencapai seluruh bagian dari taman sari , tarif masuk juga murah.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
The ticket entrance is very cheap, you can also visit sumur gumuling from this taman sari area. 
It's better for you to take the guide with, so you not only got the beauty of the park and also the stories with you.
You can explore every detail of the room including sumur gumuling ( an undergroung mosque ). Many students also visit the park in their spare time and there are graffiti in some of walls inside, this is bad and poorly maintained. This attraction is not a main attraction in Jogja, but i think you can spent a few hours when you are around keraton.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: My students found it a bit boring. It was alright but once you've seen one you've seen them all. Not the biggest highlight of the trip.

Tempat ini merupakan tempat bersejarah, dulunya adalah tempat pemandian ratu dan selir-selir Keraton Yogyakarta. Saat membeli tiket masuk, ada seorang tour guide yang menawarkan kepada kami untuk dipandu memasukinya, kami mengiyakannya karena kami belum tau sejarah tempat ini lebih banyak. Selama berjalan memasuki dan melihat tempat di dalamnya, kami diberitahu tentang sejarah pemandian ini serta berbagai filosofi bangunannya. Cukup mengejutkan bagi kami karena tempat ini memiliki makna filosofi yang cukup banyak. Areanya cukup luas dan memiliki berbagai kegunaan/fungsi di zamannya. Tempat ini merupakan salah satu tempat bersejarah yang patut kita kunjungi saat kita ke Jogja. Saya sarankan anda untuk menggunakan jasa tour guide saat berkunjung, supaya lebih mengerti akan sejarah dan filosofinya.

It's not a wonder like the ancient temples or other impressive indonesian places but it's actually a nice visit. In particular it is nice to walk on the surrounding streets, with the city open market and the nearby mosque.
Istana air taman sari ini masih terjaga kelestariannya. sangat indah. disini dahulu dijadikan tempat pemandian bagi putri keraton. sampai saat ini masih terawat dengan baik.

Очень красивая часть бывшего королевского дворца в Джокьякарте. Был сильно разрушен, внутри два больших и один поменьше бассейна. Хоть он и не сильно восстановлен, но обязательно посетите, он намного краше самого королевского дворца.
Er mag wel wat meer aan onderhoud aan worden gedaan dan zal het wel ook drukker worden bezocht door de toeristen. Het nadeel is de doolhof om er te komen ..
Não é imperdível, mas vale uma visita se você estiver com templo sobrando. Há uma galeria de arte simples, mas com belas obras a venda dentro.

La plupart des guides présentent Tamansari comme un passage obligé à Yogyakarta ce qui est loin d'être justifié. La majorité des piscine était pratiquement vide lors de notre visite et très peu d'explications disponibles si on n'embauche pas un des guides payants qui vous harcèlent à l'entrée.
La visite n'est justifiée que si vous vous trouvez déjà dans le secteur du Kraton; à éviter sinon.

positifnya adalah disini kita bisa mengetahui sejarah, namun negatifnya adalah disini jika jam 3 sudah tutup, seharusnya bisa sampai jam 5. saya kesini sangat terpesona karena ada pemandian seperti ini di zaman dahulu kala. untuk tips guide, rata-rat 50rb untuk menelusuri semuanya
This is a wonderful glimpse into Jogjas rich cultural history. Since our first visit 15 years ago they have completed renovations and the site is the better for it. Definitely worth the visit!

Одна из основных достопримечательностей непосредственно Джокьякарты. Дворец лишь частично восстановлен после землетрясения в середине 19в. Мы обошли все за пол часа.  Рядом торговый район батика, сувениров и т.д.

a mio avviso è una delle "attrazioni culturali" che merita di essere viste a Yojakarta 
Non è niente di eccezionale ma un salto veloce va fatto almeno per farsi raccontare la storia del posto e i rapporti tra il popolo e il sultano

Do go if you are around and you have time but it is not something amazing. You see the rooms of the king and the pools, some of which have water. Not very well maintained but still it helps understand how the king lived. You need approx 30mins to see it.
Be aware that at the entrance a guy approached us and introduced himself as guide. He actually did show us around, explaining what we were seeing which was very helpful as there is hardly any sign or explanation. At the end of his "tour" he took us to his batik shop trying to sell us things. Do use these people as they are harmless and not very pushy, even helpful guides but be aware of the shop trap and do not buy anything.
nice to visit while in town, I wouldn´t go there explicitly if I´d have other plans. Don´t miss the temples wich are around yogyacarta.

Review Text: This Water Castle is a place not to miss when you visit Yogyakarta. Entrance ticket is very cheap. The water pond is very clear and beautiful. Bring your sunglasses, hat and use your sunblock as it can be quite hot during the day.

Ingin tahu tempat keluarga kerajaan Yogyakarta jaman dahulu?? Tamansari tempatnya. Disini Anda bisa melihat sisa-sisa peradaban masa lalu Kraton Yogyakarta dalam bentuk istana air. Tamansari adalah sebuah kompleks yang terdiri atas tempat pemandian keluarga kerajaan jaman dulu dan sebuah tempat meditasi Sultan jaman dahulu. Tamansari juga menawarkan berbagai spot fotografi yang menawan. Bangunan kuna masih menjulang tinggi sebagai bukti sisa peradaban yang tinggi. Dari bangunan utara Anda bisa menyaksikan Gunung Merapi dari kejauhan nan cantik bersama Kota Yogyakarta. Rasakan sensasi elegan masa lalu di Tamansari.

Review Text:
kawasan ini cukup terawat meski banyak pengunjungnya. Kebanyakan pengunjung datang untuk foto-foto berlatar kolam biru. Bagusnya hampir tidak ada corat-coret pengunjung yang lazim ditemui di banyak kawasan wisata di Jogja.

Jangan coba2 mengelilingi Taman sari hingga ke bagian bawah tanah pada sore hari, karena informasi pemandu menjelang magrib suasana cukup mistis
It is quite hard to find and not very near the Palace. It is however worth the visit and we would recommend the Water Castle café for its interesting host and hostess.
入場料10,000ルピア、カメラ持込料2,000ルピアでした。有名な高みの見物ができる櫓とプール以外に、後ろ側には王や女性が使用した寝室や瞑想室やトイレ、キッチンなどがあり興味深く見学できました。

Tempat permandian raja dan selir di jaman dulu. Tempat tidak besar, kami diantar oleh abdi dalam penjaga tempat ini. Sayang sekali dinding banyak coretan coretan spidol. Tidak perlu meluangkan waktu yg banyak untuk berkunjung ke tempat ini.

I would have enjoyed a few hours here and the surrounding area more if it wasn't for the constant approaches of the would-be guides.  I began to get quite frustrated after a short time with the persistence of one in particular which spoiled my overall impression of my visit.   I found Yogya overall an annoying place for a solo female traveller with several of the men being very forward.  I did however have a fantastic plate of gudeg from a hole-in-the-wall place in the surrounding streets.

Kunjungan kali ini adalah kunjungan kedua saya. Kali ini begitu selesai membayar tiket, saya dipandu oleh pemandu wisata. Saya kira semuanya seperti itu, tapi ternyata tidak. Tapi tak apalah, saya bisa mendengarkan kisah yang komplit tentang Taman Sari ini. Taman Sari sendiri menyimpan kisah romansa ala kerajaan zaman dahulu, dimana sang raja mencari calon permaisurinya (terdapat beberapa versi cerita, tapi menurut pemandu wisata saya yang sudah bersertifikasi, cerita yang dia sampaikan adalah versi yang benar). Sayang tempat ini masih kurang terawat.

Lokasi mudah dijangkau dan berdekatan dengan perkampungan abdi dalem.  Biasanya wisatawan ke sini setelah berkunjung ke Keraton Yogya.  Objek wisata ini cenderung sepi.  Dulunya tempat ini pemandian para puteri yang sangat megah, namun saat ini beberapa bagian rusak dan kurang terawat.

地図を見るとたどり着きやすそうに見えるけど、なかなか道がわかりにくかったです。　交通量は多いし、歩道は整備されていないし、蒸し暑いのでイヤになりました。遺跡自体は想像していたとおりで、沐浴場を眺める櫓や見初めた相手と楽しむためにベットなどがあります。　敷地は広くなくて、定番スポットなので観光客が多くて、のんびりはできませんでした。水は涼しげで、足をしたすことができました。　奥の方へいくと、食堂やお土産屋さんなどに抜ける小道がありました。

i like it because we are learning about history, and the uniqe thing is there used to have a sauna room but it's more traditional and there is a pool for king and queen took a bath

We stumbled across the Water Castle after exploring all the little back streets around Yogyakarta. It is an interesting place and a good location for some pretty photos. We didn't get a guide as we were a bit of sick of people trying to scam us into buying batik - but it would have been interesting to have one.
You can skip if you want but if you are curious, no harm in trying as the fees to enter this wisata is quite cheap.

We arrived through the old bird market area to find the locals setting up for a festival in front of the castle. Having read reviews online we weren't expecting much and were just passing sometime.

This maze of local houses resembles narrow alleyways found in Venice, open doors with people chatting away, very friendly! As we started to walk a local started to walk with us, we were trying to follow the signs leading to the water castle but him (& others around) said not to follow the signs, but to follow him!? We were very apprehensive as you can imagine but it turned out for the better. As we followed him through this maze he was telling us some history, passing little shops & graffiti walls . There is no way we would have found our way!

He said it closed at 3pm, it was then 5pm so I think we avoided entrance fees & were kind of sneaking around. He led us to a tiny gap beside a batik gallery & told us to jump up on the wall! It was beautiful , we were standing on the wall over looking the sultans pools, no one else around & amazing evening sky.

I think if you go when closed the locals take it upon themselves to show you it anyway. He showed us another way we could climb to the top and watch the sunset. He even showed us inside where he lives.

I loved the experience of walking around the alleyways and would definitely recommend this way of viewing it!

Bagi saya sejarah harus selalu dijaga dan salah satunya dengan mendatangi tempat bersejrah tersebut dan berfoto unik di dalamnya. Waktu itu saya seperti biasa foto loncat berlatar belakang air mancur. Pas beruntung banget kesana di saat kolam berisi penuh. 

Jangan lupa singgah sampai ke tangga bagian atas sekali (tangga lingkar lantai tiga) karena dari sana bisa lihat pemandangan seolah-olah dirimu pangeran yang meyaksikan para dayang mandi. hehe

Iniziamo le nostre visite con il complesso di Taman Sari, conosciuto durante il regime coloniale olandese come “Castello d’Acqua ”. Era un tempo, uno splendido giardino reale, nato appunto per il suo diletto. Costruito alla metà del XVIII secolo, ha rivestito diverse funzioni, come luogo di riposo, centro di meditazione, laboratorio e nascondiglio.

Originariamente era composto di quattro aree distinte: un grande lago artificiale con isole e padiglioni a ovest, un complesso balneare nel centro, un insieme di padiglioni e piscine a sud e un piccolo lago a Est.

Lì ci sono le piscine dove le donne si facevano il bagno mentre il Sultano sceglieva dall’alto quelle che gli piacevano. La guida ci racconta, divertita, che il Sultano poteva anche sceglierne diverse nella stessa giornata!

Oggi, il complesso balneare centrale è quello meglio conservato.
Il nome Taman Sari deriva dalle parole javanesi taman che significa “‘giardino”’ o “‘parco”’ e sari che significa “bello” o “fiori”’.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: プールが掃除されていて、水がたくさん張ってあればもっとよかったのに残念。クラトンから歩いて向かったのですが、途中頼みもしないガイドまがいの人にいろいろ迷路のような街中を連れまわされ、やっとたどり着きました。道が明記されているちゃんとした地図がないと自分で探すのが大変だと思いました。観光地にありがちなことですが、頼みもしないのに声をかけてくる人を信じてはいけませんね。
its good if you have lot of time to go and see it, but there are better places around yogya to see. nothing special here

one of the nice place to visit after the palace. part of the royal ground, this is the royal bath house! many people miss this, but After you enter from the ticket entrance, you can climb the entrance arch to the top to have a view of the village and the ruins. You can find the steps on either left or right of the arch. 
Moving further in, walk down the steps and you will see the swimming pools! The left side has a high viewing tower where you can enter into a smaller pond. walk around the side of pond and you can get some nice pic from that side of the viewing tower and pond.  you can climb up the steep stairs to the top to get nice pic and enjoy scenery of roof tops. I wonder if this was used by the king to peep and select the consorts? :) 
going out from the ponds, there is another arch that can climb up too. you can take the right exit and walk out to the village that will join to the entrance of ruins and also the underground mosque. it is really hidden with no signage, ask around to locate the entrance.

Review Text: Das Wasserschloss selbst ist relativ klein, jedoch liegt direkt dahinter der Bezirk Tamam Sari, ein "alternatives" Künstlerviertel mit engen Gassen und ohne Autoverkehr. Sehr ruhig und wunderschön zum schlendern.

Si se visita Jogyakarta debe visitarse este lugar. El Palacio del Agua conserva parte de su esplendor pasado, aunque precisa de restauración y mejorar las labores de conservación.
     Casi tan atractiva como la visita al Palacio, es recorrer la zona aledaña, llena e pequeñas casitas y negocios de artesanos (aunque quizá demasiado dirigida al turista).

We arrived too early.... So glad we did. Walked away and just down the road, turn left ,follow the road (2 mins walk) to the village gangs at the side of the palace where parts of the castles alleyways and catacombs are. A maze of steps, underground tunnels await your eyes. Walls of paintings, a slice of medieval village life to get lost in. Although the small water palace was a delight to visit for a small fee, the highlight of this tour is the surrounding area that is not to be missed.well worth the visit. The best thing we discovered about the city of Jogya for free.
hat sicher mal tolle Zeiten erlebt, der Glanz bröckelt aber erheblich. Wenn man in der Nähe ist, ganz nett zum ansehen, aber nicht extra hinfahren...

Ci sono un paio di piscine in cui il sultano portava le sue mogli per aggrovigliarsi.
Alle spalle un villaggetto abbastanza carino, ma nulla più.

Insomma è evitabilissimo.

Sebuah peninggalan sejarah yg sangat mengagumkan, terbayang kemewahan masa lampau. Namun sayang ada beberapa guide yg sedikit memaksa untuk menjelaskan sambil ngikutin kita, jadi berasa kurang nyaman.
I could only imagine how it looks like when it wasn't so run down. Beautiful photos to be taken here!

Was great to go see, much better than sultans palace. Interesting history & some great photo opportunities. Really reasonably priced, This complex is unoubtedly unique in archetectural as it applied the combination of portuguese + javanese + arab architectural styles.This was built around 1760 with the Portugese architecture and was used by a Sultan who had 30 wives.

Review Text: Sarat sejarah namun akan lebih baik jika ada perawatan yang lebih. Objek bagus untuk mengenal kehidupan keraton Jogja dan objek edukasi untuk kita dalam mengenal kebudayaan Jawa

D'une architecture quelque peu antique, se palais est d'une remarquable beauté. Je vous conseille vivement de prendre un guide à l'entrée ou de vous laisser abordé par un guide non officiel à qui il conviendra de donner une contre partie de l'ordre de 50000 Roupis soit 3 euros. Le palais est très grand et il vaut mieux se laisser guidé par un local à l'intérieur pour ne pas rater des passages et histoires du lieux incontournable. Le palais à été victime des tremblements de terre suite au Volcan et une grande partie à été rénové. A visiter + que le Kraton.

Kekaguman saya bertambah kepada Jogja saat memasuki Kampung Wisata Taman Sari yang berisikan Istana Air Taman Sari. Memasuki pintu masuk (Bukan pintu masuk utama tetapi pintu belakang) kami disambut guide dengan ramah...Satu persatu bangunan baik kolam mandi untuk selir, tempat sauna, tempat ganti pakaian hingga dapur kerajaan kami susuri. Guide memberi pemaparan dan penjelasan yang cukup detail. Sontak saya menjadi kaget karena Istana Air Taman Sari sebenarnya berada di tengah danau buatan (Water Castle Taman Sari) tapi karena berbagai hal keindahan sebuah istana di tengah danau tinggal cerita...Sedikit puing bangunan menjadi saksi. Ada satu hal menarik yaitu saat memasuki mesjid bawah tanah yang menurut saya nuansanya begitu sakral ditambah desain masjid yang sangat unik...Begitupula saat menyusuri kampung wisata ini yang dihuni oleh para abdi dalem yang konon digaji 27.500ribu perbulan namun kesetiaannya pada Keraton Jogjakarta luar biasa. Bertambah lagi kekaguman saya. Sayangnya ada beberapa bagian bangunan yang sudah rusak termasuk ulah nakal pengunjung...
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Не смотря на то, что сейчас этот дворец полузаброшен(часть помещений разрушены, часть заняты местными жителями), он все равно производит впечатление.  Построенный в середине 18го века, Водный Дворец просуществовал лишь сотню лет и окончательно перестал использоваться после землетрясения 1867года. Сейчас полностью восстановлен лишь банный комплекс и частично подземная мечеть. 
  В районе вокруг море мастерских по изготовлению батика и кукол для театра теней...и плюс и минус, т.к. интересно, но местные постоянно будут отвлекать вас предложениями что-нибудь купить
 P.S. В самом дворце берегите голову, т.к. очень много низких дверных проемов(чтобы гости все время кланялись султану) и зазевавшиеся туристы регулярно проверяют их лбом на прочность ;-)

It isn't breathtaking by any means, but it's still a fairly interesting site to visit in the city. It is in relatively good shape.
If you are a foreigner, chances are you get someone who wishes to guide you around the place. Those 'guides' definitely have some interesting facts to tell you and can take you to some places you wouldn't find on your own, but of course have ulterior motives as well. Mine ended up dragging me along to his house where he had some paintings to show me that were apparently made by his brother. They were pretty nice, not sure about the authenticity though. The guy never really became annoying, so in the end -quite surprisingly- I quite enjoyed his tour.

Sekeliling taman sari terdapat rumah-rumah penduduk "abdi" pada Kesultanan Jogjakarta. Banyak dari mereka yang berdagang kesenian disini. Diantaranya kerajinan batik tulis, lukisan, sampai dengan kaos maupun baju.

Review Text:
I've read some of the history before visiting.
I've read that most parts were in bad shape and inhabited by locals. This is true, but the parts that are still in a decent shape are really worth the visit.

It was said that Water Castle is a place for Sultan and his empresses. It was interesting to explore this building. I just can't believe how people used to live at that time. I walked through a wide underground alley to go back to the first place.
 
PS: Many places are hidden in this place. Sumur Gumuling is a beautifuI place which was used bv Sultan's family to pray. There are many tour guides' service but of course you should pay them. It's about IDR 25-35k. so, Try to ask the guide! Happy Exploring!

Review Text: Lokasi sekitar Kraton. Tempatnya sekarang lebih bersih dan terkelola dengan baik. Masih ada corat-corat tak berertanggungjawab disekeliling tembok gardu. Namun pemandu wisata mengatakan bahwa sekarang orang-orang lebih peduli dengan kelestarian tempat ini. Pemandangan di sekitar kolam menarik dan air juga lebih jernih. Bagus sekali untuk objek foto di pagi dan sore hari. Sayang rombingan kami tidak sempat menelusuri lorong, karena waktu yang terbatas.

В Джогью мы с друзьями прилетели с Бали. Поскольку на вечерний самолёт у нас уже были обратные билеты, мы не стали заморачиваться с геройски-самостоятельным исследованием острова, а прямо в аэропорту на стойке бронирования такси оплатили машину на весь день (стоила она 500 тысяч) и покатили куда глаза глядят, доверившись нашему пилоту. Надо сказать, что выбор достопримечательностей в Джокьякарте не велик, и, выяснив, отмеренное нам авиационным расписанием время, водила повёз нас по давно накатанному туристическому маршруту. Первой остановкой на пути к буддийской святыне Боробудур и был Водный дворец, расположенный на территории Taman Sari, парка построенного в середине XVIII века португальцами по просьбе местного султана.  Водный Дворец, который был значительно поврежден в ходе войн и землетрясений, представлял собой сложный комплекс бассейнов, каналов и подземных ходов, соединявших его с главным Дворцом. Как оказалось, в этот дворец, султан приезжал блудить. Перед входом в покои, куда допускается только семья султана, есть небольшая площадка -  Gapura Panggung. В этом месте, повелитель слушал музыку и наслаждался танцами местных артистов. К его приезду в огромной бассейн, находящийся во внутреннем дворике и с четырёх сторон закрытый высокими стенами (подале от посторонних глаз) загоняли султановых жён  и заставляли их беззаботно плескаться и синхронно плавать, изображая русалок и сирен морских. В это самое время, правитель восседал в башне, возвышающейся над этим аквариумом и наблюдал за резвящимися девчушками.  Если одна из них ему нравилась, он бросал в воду розу в знак своего выбора (ишь, какой эпикуреец!), и девушка должна была подняться в его покои. Покои собственно представляли собой широкое каменное и холодное ложе, находящееся в небольшой полутёмной каморке. Вообще весь Водный дворец производит какое-то удручающее, но в то же время мистическое  впечатление. Если бы не стены из белого камня и орнаменты, придающие некую средневековую гламурность этому сооружению, было бы совсем уныло. Изюминка всего этого аквапарка заключается в том, что он только с виду выглядит как дворец. На самом деле это серьёзное оборонительное укрепление со множеством туннелей, предназначенных для разведки в случае военных действий, а так же для  побега венценосной семьи в случае опасности.  Говорят, что время от времени находятся отважные смельчаки, пытающиеся разгадать тайну подземных тоннелей, но самые настойчивые пропадают в них бесследно.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Sebaiknya kita ke Tamnsari tidak pada saat hari libur panjang karena pasti ramaiii sekali. Susah juga untuk hunting foto atau menikmati pemandangannya karena penuh dengan orang.

Taman Sari is a nice way to cool down and kill an hour if you're in Jogja for the day (admission is only $1, so you might as well!).  It has interesting carvings and is a good place to take photos, but it's mostly just a bunch of white buildings and some water.  I probably would have enjoyed it MUCH more with a tour guide!

王宮の近くにあります。

Viel al met al toch wel tegen. Veel mensen zullen het leuk vinden, maar wij vonden het minder.Kwam misschien omdat we ver moesten lopen.

We had a guide (which seemd obligatory..?) but we didn't regret because learning about the pools for womes and kids and the private one for the Sultan, and how he picked his wife for the night etc made it all even more interesting.

Really??! This is listed as a destination?  The place is poorly maintained, the pools had a foot of water in them, and the bottom is covered in green algae.  Absolutely nothing to see here.   Don't waste your time.

You should not feel bad about missing out on this one. The place is not well maintained, the paint which had been put there after the 2006 earthquake has become aged and the pools probably weren't cleaned in a year. Our guide, without whom the entire visit would have been totally in vain, said that UNESCO has plans to renovate it starting 2015. Hopefully some of the old glory will be restored.
Try to visit at the early morning (at 10am), or near the closing time (2pm) to get some space. Very cowded and can't capture some photos. This place also cheap to visit, so it's recommended.
I can see a big signage information related the museum, but I can't bring suitable brochure for some colleague in my office. For sure I will suggest them to come and see

If you are ink ove with all things Yogyakarta then you must go to Taman Sari. It is always in need of restoration, even when it has been down. This is due to the perils of acidic rain when the volcano is very active. Even so, it is beautiful and interesting. A wander through the streets nearby is also well worth it. Get away from the hustle and bustle and see the most lovely little gang lane ways and homes which must be titled through inheritance only. These families have been in the Sultans employ for generations.

positifnya..kita bisa melihat bangunan yang menceritakn kegiata Raja raja dan keluarganya jaman Dahulu, negatifnya....kurang terawat dan terdapat di dalam pemukiman...jika pemukiman di pindahkan dan dibuat taman...i believe this place will be fantastic

One guy offered us to be our guide for free, so he could improve his English. We thought it was okay so he gave us some extra information. 

But as many other things in Indonesia, nothing is what it seems. He ended up taking us to the batik shops in the back of the castle where they tried getting us to believe the student scam. 

When we came back to the entrance and still wanted to give him a fee, he became mad at us because he thought it was to little, it was about 10.000.

If you want to go here I suggest try to avoid noon because it could get very hot. Many photographers came here because you can take so many pictures from a lot of angle. Theres a guide who will offer you their service. Not official guide from Taman Sari.

simple place with history.
explanation given by guide on exploits of sultan in water pools.
