Review Text:
tres beau et impressionnant, à faire et recommander!
bémols: le site est en restauration donc perd de sa grandeur et le prix est tres élevé (400k par personne). Si vous allez aussi visiter Borobudur, il existe des tickets pour les 2 temples qui vous permettront d"économiser, mais ils ne vous seront pas proposés si vous ne demandez pas.
Salah satu objek wisata candi Buddha yang wajib di kunjungi. Plaosan sebagai candi Vajrayana yang masih menyimpan banyak misteri dari keindahan seninya.

バリ島からオました。現地ツアープショナルツアーで行きました。壮大な景色でし価値はあります。
た。ちょっとハードなツアーだけど
Todos los templos en Yogyacarta son preciosos y apeló san es uno de ellos. Los hay budistas (con Stupa) e Hindúes. Su estado de conservación y de restauración es muy bueno gracias a la UNESCO.
salah satu tempat yang sangat bagus untuk dijadikan objek hunting foto,semua orang tahu tentang spot yang bagus untuk dijadikan moment

The Plaosan Temple were not given much attention compared to Borobudur and Prambanan. There is actually no entrance fee but you are encouraged to give a token donation which helps to maintan the temples. Opens daily from 9.00am to 5pm. Certain smaller temples are under construction and renovation. No big crowds at these temples 
The temple is divided into two parts Plaosan Lor ( which is the North ) and Plaosan Kidul ( South )
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Smaller complex with a lot of work to be done judging by the amount of stacked stones in the area. 2 identical temples with a pair of interesting large statues in front.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: 這廟很難找到，是位於農田間，當時去的時候一個遊客都沒看到，但景色真的美，廟宇非常漂亮，旁邊盡是倒塌的石塊，有種寧靜蕭瑟殘破的詩意。沒有太多人會來這，但在去過另外兩大世界奇蹟後，這邊仍令我讚嘆，悄悄走過一堆又一堆石塊進入廟宇，神聖莊嚴的雕像，頓時體悟到空靈的佛法。

The temple is much smaller than the nearest temple around "The Prambanan". Seems like there's no obligation to pay for the entrance but just need to give a "donation" to the security. There's no legal parking for car not motorcycle, but the people around is friendly and it should be save just to park near the streets.

After our visit to Pramaban we headed over to try and find the Plaosan Temple site on the motorbike. It wasn't too difficult to find and there it was protruding above the rice paddy's.

In comparison to Prambanan it is much smaller, but nonetheless well worth a visit. There are two main large temples with many smaller gate entrances. But the overwhelming impression is that someone has dismantled the complete area and strewn all the components around. Then it has become one giant jigsaw puzzle in trying to re-assemble them. It's a monumental task and what has been completed so far is incredible.

It was virtually deserted when we visited in the early afternoon at 2:00pm and despite its size, we still spent an hour there.

There is another small complex across the road and down aways, but it's not worth visiting as it's just a building site really

I found Plaosan fascinating.  It is a buddhist temple complex that is a couple of miles away from Prambanan.  To be sure, Prambanan is magnificent and there is no comparison between the two complexes.  Plaosan is excellent, Prambanan is amazing.  Neither are Angkor, but what is?

Much like Prambanan, Plaosan has built structures and a number of structured piles of rubble organized to be compiled at a later date.

What I found fascinating about Plaosan was the process that they are undertaking to put everything back together.  In the rubble piles, I could detect a number of carvings that will clearly comprise parts of a reestablished structure.  Also, in the back of the complex, there is a building which houses statues of sitting figures (buddhas?) that look like they have been taken from the site.  

In addition to the two major temples already built and the smaller buildings located directly behind them (to the East?), there was what I believe may be the base of another building established to the back of the complex (from the entrance) which has approximately 10-15 statues in place.  I wonder if this will be the site of another building in Plaosan some day.

This site would be a wonderful opportunity for an archeology class or team to help put everything back together.  It looked like they needed the manpower, as well as the expertise in building technology the ensure that it is constructed safely.  It definitely looked like a "humpty dumpty" project, ready to happen.

Admission cost (if there even is one, perhaps it was just a suggested donation) was 20,000 rupiah ($1.50 US) for the four of us.

I wish I understood more about what I have seen, as it was definitely interesting and beautiful.  

There were, perhaps, three or four other people there during the time two hours or so that we were there, and absolutely nobody trying to sell us any souvenirs.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Candi ini sebenarnya kurang terkenal di mata turis asing ataupun Indonesia, padahal candi ini mempunyai bentuk yang unik dan indah dengan detail yang menakjubkan. Namun sayang ketika saya kemari, candi sedang di revitalisasi karena efek gempa bumi tahun 2006 silam yang meruntuhkan beberapa bagian candi.

Este pequeño pero bello complejo se encuentra muy cercano a Prambanan así que una visita en conjunto es mas que conveniente. Es mas pequeño y seguro resulta menos espectacular que los otros, quizá porque no tiene ni de lejos su altura, pero restando eso sus trabajos en piedra y diseño son muy loables. También es un trabajo budista y les destaca las originales estatuas enormes que tiene en las entradas al complejo
Lovely and calm spot, very spiritual, explore and enjoy. Sit and meditate! Basic toilet facilities, I would visit again. You can stay until sunset.

The small Plaosan Temple complex is located about 1 km from the Prambanan complex. Eerily quiet, it does not have as many visitors.

If you are in the area, it is worth a visit, and then move on.

Candi Plaosan merupakan candi yang sangat romantis sekali. Jika di India punya Taj Mahal di Indonesia ada Candi Plaosan. 
Berbeda agama akan tetapi tetap saling menghormati, menghargai dan mencintai. 
Memang belum sepenuhnya selesai di pugar. 
Candi ini termasuk salah satu candi favorit saya dan suami :)
dua buah candi kembar yang ada di komplek candi plaosan, keduanya terawat baik dan membuat wisatawan bisa mengeksplor masing masing candi.
Если Вы бюджетный турист, можете ограничится посещением данной и других достопримечательностей. Цены намного ниже. А главное, людей очень мало. Просто спросите местных или водителя.

Like: History and concept
Dislike: Maintenance can be better with more information boards 
Can see the efforts that the government is trying to merge the missing and damaged puzzles by the past earthquakes

We did Prambanan and Plaosan on the same day and the Prambanan was crowded with other tourist and school kids there on class trips. Had a more pleasant time at Plaosan, which although smaller was not crowded at all.
Very nice and old hindu temple in central Java. its very close to Prambanan temple. if u guys go to Prambanan, please visit to this temple too. not very far from prambanan. very historic temple.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Plaoson Temple isn't big, it consists of two towers, the North and the South Tower. Many of the areas are still undergone repair works. As compared to Prambanan and Borobudur, this historic place is lesser tourist and thus it's more tranquil.

Go there to see a sitting buddha,This style to depict buddha is unique. The temple is small and since its on the way to Borumbudur, Its worth a stopover. Beware of the vendors in the area though. They just make you go crazy.

Nous avons pris un tour depuis yogayakarta pour faire prambanan et borobudur dans la même matinée ce qui est bien pratique et les deux sites sont magnifiques!
Cependant en arrivant sur le parking du premier site (borobudur), le chaufeur à demandé de l'argent à tout le monde pour l'entrée des deux temples! Nous savions qu'il y avait un combo à 30$ pour les deux temple et il nous à dis oui en nous donnant un prix en roupies qui était plus cher que 30$. Là il nous a baratiné en nous disant que le taux de change à changé... Nous avons insisté pour prendre directement nos billets à l'entrée de borobudur et nous avons eu raison car en fait il arnaquait chaque personnes de 50 000 roupies sur les entrées... Après que nous ayons pris nos entrées pour les deux sites pour 30$ par personnes (le vrai prix) le chauffeur est venu nous voir discrettement pour nous demander de pas dire aux autres le vrai prix!

Donc un conseil si vous voulez faire les deux sites prenez le conbo à 30$ (valable sur 2 jours) et exigé de le prendre vous même à l'entrée de borobudur pour payer le vrai prix.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: プランバナンのガイドが「絶対に観に行くべき」と勧めるので、帰りぎわに寄ってみました。歴史的背景もさることながら、崩れ行くい遺跡の現状を目のあたりにし、今、観れたよろこびを感じました。夕方、早い時間に閉まってしまうので、じかんを計画的に組みましょう。

プランバナン遺跡を訪ねるついでに、行ってきました。
マリオボロ通りから1Ａのトランスジョグジャで終点に行き（3600Ｒｐ位だった）、そこから馬車でプランバナンとプラオサン寺院を周ってもらいました。別に同じ馬車に乗るつもりはなかったのですが、毎回降りたところで待っていたので、3万Ｒｐづつ払って移動しました。
ジョグジャで、ポロブドゥール・プランバナンに続く、3番目に素晴らしい寺院だと聞いて行ってきたのですが、その通りでした。プランバナンに行くのであれば、是非足を延ばしてみてください。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Wegen dem starken Tourismus und den vollkommen übertriebenen Preisen von Candi Prambanan und Borobodur haben wir uns für Candi Plaodan entschieden. 

Hinweg: mit den Bus von Yogyakarta aus für 3.600 Rupia 
Schöner Fußweg, an Reisfelder vorbei zum Candi Plaosan 

Eintritt: kleine Spende. 

Die Tempel sind wunderschön! Zwar sind durch ein Erdbeben ein paar Tempel schon zerstört, aber das gibt dem ganzen erst den natürlichen Reiz. 

Auf der ganzen Anlage waren vl 5 Leute, man kann sich also in Ruhe die Tempel anschaun. 
Nur zu empfehlen!
Profitez-en pour aborder les gens sur le site et pour parler avec eux. Nous n'avons jamais rencontré une telle gentillesse de la part d'autochtones. Une vraie richesse

Besides Prambanan and Borobudur, I think Sewu temple and Plaosan temple are two spots that you ought not to skip on your list. Stones are scattered everywhere as many buildings are in ruins and the donation is required for further restoration. The temple is divided by a road and surrounded with houses side by side. You can even see some locals are in idle. During our visit, only two visitors were seen. The main temple is full of carved reliefs, very impressive. If you are a lover of architecture, I am sure you will not be disappointed. As the temperature is too high at noon without any shelter nearby, it is better for you to visit it early in the morning or late in the afternoon.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Me encanto. El lugar tiene una energia especial. Templo budista. No es tan visitando como prambanan pero segun mi opinion mas especial. La entrada es a voluntad. Realmente lo recomiendo. A unos pocos kms de prambanan. Excelente.

I arrived after a visit to Prambanan, and it was probably 445pm on a Friday.  There were hardly any other visitors there, which made for a very peaceful visit.   The sun was just beginning to set behind the rice fields that live next to the temple.  Made for gorgeous photos!  

On the other side of the road, the temple reliefs continue - it was less impressive as the main temple, however, the road was lined with houses, so it was nice to see locals living peacefully next to the temple.  

I may have enjoyed Plaosan more than the other temples because it was much less structured, less people and seemed to be the temple that is closest and most present amongst local life. 

Note - access to the temple is 'free', although if you come with a driver, there is a small parking fee.
Superbe site comprenant plusieurs édifices dédiés aux principales divinités hindou. Les bas-reliefs sont fascinants.

This temple has so many ruin which still on a big pile on the front side, but in the main Temple, once you go inside of it's stone wall, the combination between the green well-treated grass along to the temple will cacth your view and won't let your camera off from your hand.
This place is better to visit in the afternoon after 15.00, so the sun is not too hot but still give enough to make your picture cool.
Quite, less crowded and shows much more culture than the big site like Borobudur or Prambanan
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Prambanan tapınağının karşısına düşüyor. Depremde bayağı hasar gören yapılar var içinde. Evlenecek çiftlerin çok rahbet gösterdiği bir yapı . Giriş fiyatı 10.000 rp civarıda . Büyük tapınak ve yanındakinin tadilatları bitmiş . Ben beğendim.

Prambanan est classé au patrimoine mondial de l'humanité par l'UNESCO. Il vaut donc le détour. C'est un site magnifique et assez bien conservé. Il y avait 240 temples shivaistes et aujourd'hui seule une poignée de ceux-ci subsiste. Tout autour du site, on peut voir des ouvriers occupés à restaurer les temples endommagés. À l'intérieur du temple principal, on trouve des scènes de combats entre le Bien et le Mal... et bien sûr, des représentations de Brahma, Shiva, Vishnu, Ganesh et bien d'autres divinités. Les reliefs sont en bon état. Enfin, si vous prenez le petit train, vous pourrez voire le Candi Sewu aussi et le Candi Bubrah.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Quite n less crowded. Lots of ruin temples but worth seeing apart from prambanan & borobudur.beautiful  carvings and sculptures

Mengunjungi candi2 di daerah Jogja takkan genap tanpa mengunjungi candi ini. Tidak begitu jauh dari Candi Prambanan tidak sampai 5 menit dengan mobil. Begitu dekat memang hanya berjarak tidak sampai 2 km.Candi bercorak Hindu dan Budha ini begitu indah sekalipun kita hanya bisa menyaksikan sisa2 bangunannnya yang sementara di restorasi. Candi ini bagi saya sungguh menakjubkan sekaligus unik. Oh ya sunset ditempat ini apabila cuaca cerah cukup indah terlebih kawasan ini dikelilingi persawahan..Luar biasa,,,,
While Prambanan and Borobudor are the areas highlights, Plaosan is on the way back from Prambanan and definitely worth the stop.  Very quiet, with virtually no one else around as you explore.

This temple is also beautiful but is great to visit because there are not the crowds associated with other sites.
We paid an entry fee / donation because I hope it goes towards restoration work for the site.
Some of the structures are in ruins on the ground, so I believe it is important to rebuild and fix.
We walked around and had many of the cultural aspects explained to us by a local.
Go inside where you can and see the amazing statues.
If these building were in Europe you would not be able to touch and climb on them like we were able.
Treat them carefully as they are gorgeous.
Well worth the visit.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: You can really see that Plaosan was heavily damaged during an earthquake as the bigger part of the complex is still not rebuilt. The existing temples, however, are quite impressive and totally worth a visit. The entry fee is rather low compared to Prambanan.
bagi pecinta heritage, alangkah baiknya datang ke tempat ini, spot juga bagus untuk para fotografer buat hunting, saya termasuk sering datang kemari

After prambanan and sewu we weren't overly impressed by Prambanan, maybe also because it was raining, alot, when we visited. Still impressive and beautiful. Very quiet and if you are in the Prambanan area I see no reason not to drive by. Free entrance :)

The area is small but it was quite a nice place to vist, we were required to pay a minimal fee at the entrance by the security guards. We went there during a drizzle and that makes the view more beautiful.

First time arrive arrive there, i got very good feeling. This temple is not to big but very beautiful. They have 2 complex of temple. The entrance is not to expensive. You can pay or not pay is OK. But I still give some money to help the people there keep the temple in good condition. The monumen and statue inside is interesting. Its more impressive than mendut and pawon temple i think.

A smaller temple, the larger three buildings and a few of the smaller ones are rebuilt, the rest is in ruins. 
Lovely. 
When we were there (sunny afternoon in rainy season, mid. December), there were only about 20 other people in there.

mungkin lebih tenang dan sepi di candi ini,disini bisa duduk santai sambil menikmati sunset yang indah,mungkin lebih dipromosikan lagi objek wisata candi plaosan,krn kebanyakan yang datang turis manca negara

Smaller and certainly less busy than the main temple at Prambanan, Plaosan Temple is still worth visiting on a day visit to the area. There are 2 parts to the complex, although one side is significantly more impressive than the other. Soak up the tranquility and enjoy the absence of hordes of visitors. Entrance by "donation".

Candi yang Indah dengan ribuan reruntuhan bertumpuk di halaman candi. Di seberang jalan kita masih bisa menemukan bebatuan candi yang berserakan di persawahan warga.

Sangat cocok untuk wisatawan pencinta situs sejarah.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Candi Plaosan is not as big as Prambanan, but is still beautiful, quite and worth to visit. We didn`t pay any entrance fee. We just had to register at the entrance and that was it. I would recommend to go to Candi Plaosan before you go to Prambanan. It´s not hard to find and you can reach it easily with bike and google maps.
Frequently overlooked, but certainly one of the most beautiful temples in Yogyakarta and Central Java.  Getting there is half the experience, with beautiful pastoral villages and fields all around.

Один из красивейших храмов Джоджи обязателен к посещению. К счастью в этом храме не очень много народа, поэтому у Вас будет уникальная возможность походить в спокойном темпе с фотоаппаратом в руках и сделать много замечательных фотоснимков без людей.

Candi ini hanya berjarak 1,5Km dari kompleks candi prambanan Namun suasana kompleks candi ini sepi dan jarang ada wisatawan yang berkunjung. Padahal candi ini tidak kalah megah dengan candi di prambanan, Menuju ke candi ini kita akan di suguhi pemandangan sawah yang indah. Akses jalan yang mudah & parkir yang luas, 
Terdapat dua kompleks candi yaitu bagian utara & Selatan. 
Jika anda suka mengunjungi candi dan kurang nyaman dengan suasana yang ramai, candi ini cocok buat anda. dan pemandangan persawahan & perbukitan yang indah disekitar candi menjadi daya tarik tersendiri. 
Mungkin kurangnya promosi di kompleks prambabanan sehingga candi ini kurang ramai oleh wisatawan. 
Mari berkunjung ke candi ini karena tempat ini sepi & menyenangkan.

Мы заехали сюда специально перед посещением Прамбанана, чтобы впечатления не были смазаны более величественным Прамбананом. На входе нас спросили кто мы и откуда, записали в амбарную книгу, взяли с нас пожертвования (по 5 000 рупий на человека) и пропустили. Фишка этих двух храмов: один из них буддийский, а другой - индуистский. Причём на наш непрофессиональный взгляд, они совершенно одинаковые!!! Перед каждым храмом (ещё перед оградой) стоят по два стража с двух сторон от дороги. А если стоять лицом напротив храмов, то слева будет площадка со статуями Будды по периметру с трёх сторон - это бывшая буддийская школа. Место, действительно, хорошее и спокойное, без толпы туристов. Так что, если есть возможность, то рекомендую.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Visited in May 2014. Was very quiet when we visited so plenty of opportunities to relax in the grounds & as well as explore the temples. The site was not as a large as first expected, but still of historical significance. 
** Be careful searching for it on Google maps as we got lost for about an hour trying to find it...

A large portion of the site consists of piles of collapsed temple structures but what remains is truly magnificent. No crowds, no guides, no buses.  You have to sign a register at the entrance. The man on duty tried to ask us for a "donation" but we refused and walked off and he didn't insist.

Jika Anda mencari obyek wisata selain obyek wisata yang sudah terkenal, Candi Plaosan merupakan alternatif tujuan wisata yang patut dipertimbangkan. Terletak di perbatasan antara Provinsi DI Yogyakarta dan Jawa Tengah, Candi Plaosan merupakan kompleks candi Buddha yang dibangun oleh Rakai Pikatan dari Wangsa Sanjaya yang beragama Hindu, sebagai persembahan bagi istrinya Pramodyawardhani dari wangsa Syailendra yang beragama Buddha. Ciri khas candi ini adalah adanya 2 bangunan utama yang identik, yang jika dilihat dari bentuknya diperkirakan berfungsi sebagai biara bagi para biksu. Kedua bangunan utama tersebut dikelilingi stupa-stupa kecil dan candi-candi perwara yang sebagian besar sudah runtuh, namun beberapa sudah dipugar sehingga pengunjung dapat melihat bentuk candi perwara dan stupa tersebut. Selain melihat bangunan candi, pengunjung juga sekaligus dapat menikmati suasana sawah dan pedesaan.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
C'est une visite à recommander et le temple est encore intacte au niveau des reliefs.
C'est une plongée dans l'hindouisme javanais du 14eme siècle.

Plaosan adalah kompleks candi Buddha yang luas. Terdapat candi kembar yang merupakan candi utama. Di samping itu, banyak terdapat candi-candi pendamping yang berukuran lebih kecil. Ada beberapa stupa, arca, dan relief-relief yang cukup cantik. Candi ini masih cukup sepi, sehingga pengunjung bisa lebih menikmati. Kebanyakan pengunjung menikmati candi ini pada saat matahari terbenam. Sayang, pada saat kami ke sana, cuaca mendung kemudian hujan.

Wisatawan yang berkunjung ke candi Plaosan dapat melihat langsung semangat toleransi dan saling menghargai dengan gambaran cinta kasih yang penuh.  Rakai pikatan dari Wangsa Sanjaya yang beragama Hindu membangun Candi Buddha untuk Pramodyawardhani dari wangsa Syailendra yang beragama Buddha yang sekaligus menjadi istrinya yang sangat dicintai. Di Candi ini dapat dilihat 4 Dyani Buddha. dan Pradnya Paramita versi Jawa. Ada relung yang dapat digunakan untuk Samadhi (meditasi). Betapa indahnya kerukunan, betapa indahnya toleransi, kesemuanya membawa damai. Wisatawan yang berkunjung dapat merasakan aura kedamaian dan cinta kasih serta kasih sayang.

Its slightly difference architecture style compare to prambanam temple , and its quite a distance from prambanam. Unless you still energetic after visit Prambanam and sewu temple, you might wanna think of hire a trishaw to send you there. But beware of the entrance fees , there didnt stated clearly for the entrance fees , most probably is free , but the guard might try to make some money for their own. So its up to your own to bargain about the entrance fees. I have been cheated to pay 200k Rp for 3 person. End up , some post mention they just paid for 1USD as donation.
nous sommes tombé sur un guide parlant très bien français nous en raconté l histoire du temples et de ses bas reliefs tout en théâtre c était super

Candi Kembar sebutan lain dari candi plaosan, letaknya tidak jauh dari Prambanan, tapi sayang sekali kurang ramai, akan tetapi candi ini mempunyai pemandangan yang indah, karena terhampar sawah yang membuat mata sejuk, dapat ditempuh dari candi prambanan kira kira 1 km

The area of Plaosan Temple is not large as expected, the height of temples are not tall, it's another style of temples i found in Chiangmai.  

Many parts of the temples were on maintenance, the renovation was not perfectly matched with the original but it's acceptable as it shows the difference of artificial and authentic historical stuff.

Entrance fee (actually named as donation fee) is very flexible, can simply pay USD 1 per person.
Este sitio es espectacular, merece la pena visitarlo. Además su simbologìa es muy curiosa. Volvería sin dudarlo.
Еще один красивый храмовый комплекс Джогджи. Не столь впечатляющий, как Прамбанан, но зато гораздо менее посещаемый, так что удовольствие от осмотра вам никто не помешает получить.
ストゥーパの残骸に取り囲まれて雰囲気がいいです。残っている仏堂の中には脇仏があります。中央の仏像は盗まれていてありません。ヒンズー教と仏教が共存していたと聞きました。

Как уже писала, это один из множества храмов Джокьякарты, и если есть водитель, то его вполне можно попросить туда заехать. Народу, когда мы прибыли не было совсем, что сильно улучшает впечатление от просмотра. За вход платишь немного, бесплатно не пускают.

I went there with a guide. he told me history about this temple. Something that  made me interesting is about the history of the temple. First, He said that the temple was built in Hindust and Budhist architecture. Because a long time ago there was a couple Prince and Princess who wanted to marry each other. But because of they have different religion, princess asked prince to build a temple. Then Prince built a temple. This temple was made with two architecture both HIndu & Budhist!

Храмовый комплекс не ограничивается одним Прамбананом. Местный водитель-гид показал нам это местечко. Народу практически нет. Можно спокойно погулять и пофотографировать. Нет четкой цены за вход, только пожертвование. Среднее в размере 5 000 индийских рупий против цены 216 000 Прамбанана.

I went here during the afternoon(Around 2 pm) and was surprised that there were only 5 other people there, they were always in a different spot so it was like having the place to ourselves.
You pay as you like, so a donation. Our local driver told us 20 thousand rupia was fine for 3 people.
It was a very nice experience as we were pretty much alone and just having fun taking photos. 
We did not know the first day, but Plaosan is pretty much right next to Prambanan so I recommend doing both after each other.

Visited this truly wonderful place last October 18, 2014 in the late afternoon. There was no entrance fee - unlike the rather steep price for a one-day visit to Borobudur and Prambanan - but a donation is expected. 

What immediately struck me was that this place, comprising two main temples, one for the king and another for the queen, with many satellite temples in varying stages of ruin or restoration, had very few tourists, so me and my guide essentially had Candi Plaosan to ourselves. The sense of isolation, the increasingly low angles of sunlight and the glorious yellow-orange tint that it gave to the old, old stones of Plaosan, and the afternoon breeze all contributed to a truly magical afternoon. 

What made these places even more remarkable was the presence of intact statues inside them. One would expect that these statues would have been moved to museums but the fact that they were retained in situ makes the temple even more genuine. Each temple had a main room with three - reduced to two - statues bathed by direct sunlight from the door. The room has two levels of niches and windows, although there was no second story. The main room opens up to two rooms, one on each side, each with statues just like the main one. There were high reliefs on both the interior and exterior walls of Plaosan, all of high quality and remarkable as a window into the lives of ancient people in Java more than a thousand years ago.

A file of satellite temples line up  the rear of the main temples, unfortunately most of the other temples are in a state of ruin.

Definitely, Candi Plaosan is highly recommended!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Plongée dans l'hindouisme de java.
Excellente visite avec guide permettant d'appréhender l'hindouhisme javanais du XIV siècle.
Le prix est un peu exagéré mais c'est un incontournable. Ne pas hésiter à manger dans un des Warung qui cotoie le site. Les gens sont très hospitaliers et bonus souriant

Na het bezoeken van de Borobodur tempel werden we gecharmeerd door de verfijnde afwerking van de Prambanan tempel. Een bezoek aan deze tempel mag zeker niet ontbreken als je een bezoek brengt aan Java.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
6th.Sept. Straight from the airport we went to visit Plaosan Temple near to the Prambanan Temple. Reached about 12.30pm. Driver says No entrance fee, but a donation for the restoration works is expected. Signed at visitors book and donated 10,000 IDR/head. Do wear hat/umbrellas, bring water along.
Restoration of the temple is still ongoing, stone carvings reveal massive wear and tear. Took 40mins to walk around. Noticed that the top of the temple resembled Megatron Head. Could be he visited the temple and left his mark.!!
A nice quiet place to visit while eating time to visit the Prambanan Temple. For lunch the driver took us to a nearby village for local food, situated at the foot of a bamboo "forest" named "Legian Garden Restaurant". It served both european and Local food. Prices are reasonable and tastes good. There is even a Wayang kulit stage next door. After lunch we started off for Prambanan Temple 15mins away.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Prambanan nous a beaucoup plu, même si après avoir vu les temples d'Angkor, la magie est un peu moindre du fait de certaines ressemblances architecturales. Ne pas rater le musée gratuit à la sortie du temple!
Borobudur quand à lui nous à littéralement émerveillé, quelle magie de pénétrer dans les jardins menant aux premières marches du temple dans la bruime matinale...Pensez à disposer du temps nécessaire à flaner entres les différents étages présentant tous des frises remarquables et à absorber l'ambiance des lieux...

Combiné au temple de Borobudur pour la modique somme de 30 $ ce temple vaut la peine d'être visité : mais ne pensez pas qu'il est dans la démesure ! une grande partie du temple à été détruite lors des tremblements de terre suite au réveilles du Volcan... Pensez qu'autant qu'étranger et dans le prix du billet vous avez accès au petit train qui vous emmènera visiter les autres petits temples de l'aire. A voir mais ne passez pas une journée pour les 2 temples !!!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Magnifique temple hindouiste.  L'endroit est calme, bien entretenu. Il y a des guides si vous le désirez. Pas trop de mde fin aout, nous en avons profité un max! Beau panorama. Possibilité de se restaurer sur place. L'entrée est ,je trouve, un peu cher. Prenez votre carte d'étudiant: grosse reduc'!

Its a good thing after lunch we went straight to Plaosan before Prambanan, at least you can have a good stay here for 30 min to 1 hr before give more time for the Prambanan visit, 
The 2 main temples are quite restored, from afar you could see the distinct java Hindu architecture, around the temple you can see the old beautiful carvings they matched up from the restoration, even the inside chambers are very nice to see, some statues and carvings are still intact. 
But around its still looks like a big debris mound,there still many restoration works here and there during my visit, anyway it still adds to the ancient restoration atmosphere you originally intend to visit.
Dont forget to visit this site if you're going to prambanan.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Un temple magnifique. Nous avons eu la chance de visiter avec un guide francophone et avons pu profité de la visite.
Nous avons été surpris car certains indonésiens ont souhaité prendre des photos avec nous (européens) mais tout cela très bon enfant.

A unos 3 km de Prambanan esta este templo menos famoso pero no por ello menos atractivo. No hay casi turistas y para entrar das la voluntad. Aunque queden partes por reconstruir los dos templos principales estan muy bien restaurados. Por fuera son muy bonitos aunque no impresiona tanto como Prambanan . En cambio Por dentro es mucho mejor ! 
Vale muchisimo la pena visitarlo !
Para llegar utilizamos un chofer que nos llevaba desde el centro de yogyakarta pero si vas a prambanan vimos sitios que alquilaban bicicletas ( y no se tiene que conducir con todo el trafico ! )

Located inside the vicinity of Prambanan Temples.   Poor shuttle service management as they did not take off base on time but its base on number of pax...that's 10pax and above.  However if you can walk....its like a km walk.  You will pass by a few Candi however the condition of the candi are only ruins and work to reconstruct is still on going.  Same goes to Plaosan temple, only the main temple has been constructed wheres you can see lots of ruins still waiting to be reconstructed.
Weather was hot, do bring a hat or umbrella.  Lastly, entrance fee for foreigners are at USD20/pax, which i consider quite expensive.

According to our guide, this temple was built by the Hindus for the Buddhists.  It is evident by the stupa shape at the top.  It was rather quiet place.  Except for a wedding couple having their photos taken, we were the other people around.  The "fee" did not seem official as we just paid it to two officials manning the booth, as directed by our guide; no receipt was issued.

It's great history behind this temple which is close to Prambanan temple. It's good place in the evening to do meditation in the area of Complex Jago inside the Plaosan temple sites.

Richness of your soul and mind and get inspire with meditation when there is no crowd in the evening of tourist visit in Plaosan temple.

Para visitar este monumento se recomienda madrugar mucho, ya que sí se llega algo tarde nos encontraremos con grandes cantidades de turistas. Nosotros salimos del hotel con nuestro guía a las 7 de l mañana para llegar allí a las 8. La mejor hora. Muy recomendable la visita con guía, que nos explica la historia del monimento.
Visita obligada.

(I just finished traveling around Indonesia and Vietnam for two and a half weeks with extended family consisting of 26 people - 13 adults and 13 kids, including my 4 month old)

After having just been a little disappointed by the Prambanan temples, this place was a pleasant surprise. Like others said, we stopped here in the late afternoon during "the golden hue." No one else was there so our large group roamed around for about a half hour.
Tempio non lontano dal Prambaran , ma con volti meno turisti . Circondato da macerie dall'ultimo terremoto, ma più interessante negli interni del Prambaran

I went there with my uncle and cousin in the late afternoon. It was really nice because there's no tourist here. The temple was like dedicated for us hahaha... It's small but not too small. The temple could be seen from the road nearby. Of course it was worth to visit. If you go to Jogja and get bored with Prambanan or Borobudur temple, Plaosan Temple is a nice place to visit.
This temple is near the prambanan site but has no tourists and no entry fee! Be sure to include this site on your itinerary if you plan visting prambanan

Worth the 2km walk from Prambanan to reach this peacful place, don't miss it. The interiors of the temples are exquisite, some of the best I think I've seen. Photo ops are abundant due to this place being a little off the beaten track. So glad we went the extra mile to see it.

Nous y sommes allés à 9h trop tard, trop chaud. Il faut vraiment le faire tôt la matin.
C'est un très beau temple. Abîmes par les intempéries. Mais Certains monuments sont en cours de rénovation. 
207000idr soit 12,80€ assez cher pour ici
Sortez par le nord (à droite de l'entrée de ce temple) et dirigez vous dans le parc pour une petite promenade : temple de Lumbung puis Bubrah et enfin Sewu (1000 temples) 
Profitez de la promenade
Hier ist deutlich weniger los als in Prambanan. Die deutlich kleinere Anlage befindet sich ein paar Autominuten entfernt und hat interessante (bau)historische Aspekte  zu bieten.

À visiter le matin de préférence à la fraîche et en semaine. Le week-end le lieu est envahi de touristes locaux.
Attention, ne vous énervez pas si on vous demande "Mister photo" c'est le jeu national et pas seulement sur ce lieu. Prêtez vous au jeu ou dites seulement "Tidak"[non] avec le sourire. 
Même si l'entrée est plus cher pour les boulays, le lieu est splendide.
We gingen hier met een kennis naar toe. Die had moeten weten dat het in onze ogen één grote ruïne was. Bevelen het ook niet aan.

I like this temple because
1. quiet
2. remote
3. less tourist
4. nice scenery
5. sacred with pilgrim "feeling"
I visit this place twice in my trip cause I have time and almost finish explore Yogya attractions, I like to come here for "meditation".
Most of temples around are ruined by earthquakes. This beautiful temple survived and shows history. Very well arranged garden. Very big and tall tree which was motivated to the movie Avatar.

After visited all the big and small temples in yogya, plaosan temple is my second favorite (first is ratu boko which need~10USD entrance fee which is expensive) to come for enjoying the peaceful surrounding.

Un endroit qu'il serait dommage de manquer quand on passe par yogjakarta. Ceci dit, il existe de bien plus jolis temples. Beaucoup de restauration nécessaire, d'ailleurs la structure centrale la plus haute était fermée lors de notre visite. Endroit sympa à faire en tout début de journée ou au coucher du soleil, pour éviter la foule.

Smaller than Prambanan temple but equally as amazing. Not fully restored yet either which gives a different perspective of the work that was involved in building these amazing temples. Great for photos as there are no tourists here and they just as for a donation rather than an entry fee.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: You can still see the sands within some of the stones piles (the surrounding stupas or temples actually), some of them without the sands, some of them already halfway reconstructed. You can also see 10ish statue on a pendadop, with different levels of reconstructions. The reliefs on the two main buildings also differ but require a close eyes
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
pertama kali saya kesini saya berpikir akan jauh, ternyata tidak, lokasinya sekitar 15 menit dari lokasi candi prambanan, kata guide yang mengantar kami memang masih diarea candi prambanan. sehingga tidak terlalu jauh untuk saya melihat candi ini.

area candi tidaklah sebesar candi-candi yang terkenal lainnya, tapi untuk ukuran candi yang masuk kedalam jalan-jalan kecil sangat lah besar, sayang pada saat saya datang pemerintah sedang melakukan sedikit renovasi dibagian depan, sehingga agak mengganggu banyaknya turis yang hendak datang melihat. 

struktur bangunan candi sangat unik seperti sebuah rumah yang ditempatkan ditengah-tengah candi-candi kecil mengelilingi,  untuk biaya masuk sangatlah terjangkau.  disekitar area candi ada warung tradisional,
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: A simple Candi that is accessible, Worth a few pictures. Require to pay to enter, and there another temple few meters away!

Not far from Prambanan, but we were the only visitors on a Saturday when Prambanan was packed.  Just spectacular, even if smaller.  Two nicely restored large temples with nearly 250 smaller ones surrounding the site.  Peaceful setting that you can enjoy while taking some beautiful photos.   Don't miss it.
Interesting stop on the way back, worth the 15mn detour to get there. And it is quite quick too, so no need to take a guide or stay long if you are tired (it usually comes at the end of the day...)

Not really far away form Prambanan temple ,more quiet and you can more enjoy the place, learn more about story of this temple very interesting also,better visit in the morning, the weather not to hot.
This temple also still nice to visit, almost same like Prambanan but I think more quiet, not lots of seller, so u can visit slowly temple by temple.

I have said this about Prambanan also. If you have seen great temples around Asia, this isn't going to cut much ice. But at the same time its quite spiritual and very old. It is also largely wrecked by earthquakes. 

So if you visit Prambanan, then its worth at least a drive past (its very close) and by all means if you have the time, pay the small entrance fee to see it up close.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: There were amazingly few people at this temple, which made it one of the best we have been to. Obviously not only for that reason, the structures themselves are incredible as well.
This temple is quiet and not on the main trail. It's a very small place, and has a great vibe. Spent 4 hours here in the rain meditating in various sections all alone :)

It is a temple near the famous Prambanan Temple .  May be people all go to Prambanan Temple and I could have chance to visit awesome temple peacefully and quietly..  There were only 6 people including us when we visited it.   It let me have the mood to see all the tradional Indonesian style statuess of the temples slowly.  Frankly speaking, it was really well preserved..  Defintiely worth to take your time to visit this too when you visit the famous Prambanan Temple.
J'ai adoré cet endroit, baigné dans la lumière, les formes douces des stuppas. Un très agréable souvenir. Y aller tôt !
This temple is unique because it is located below ground level. The whole area is well maintained and can be visited in a short time.
農家をしていた方が土を掘り返した時に石に当たって見つけたそうです。現在はこの広さで整備されていますが、周りを掘るともしかしたら遺跡が出てくるかもと思うとロマンがあります。
Candi kecil yang terletak ditengah pemukiman penduduk. Tiket masuknya murah, hanya Rp.5000 saja. Tempat wisata yg bagus dan terjangkau. Kl ke Yogya sempetin mampir deh ke candi Sambisari

世界遺産プランバナン寺院群の構成資産のひとつでヒンドゥー教の寺院遺跡です。
周囲の地面よりかなり低い位置にあり、11世紀頃にあったとされるムラピ山の噴火によって埋もれていたものが発見されたのだとか。横にあるインフォメーションセンターに発見当初の写真など展示してあります。広々とした公園状となっており気持ちの良い場所です。リンガとヨー二が祀られ、ガネーシャが壁にいる典型的なヒンドゥー遺跡です。
プランバナン遺跡の１つだが、こじんまりしている。農作業中の農夫が見つけた寺院で、地上から少し下がったところにあり、神秘的！
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: ボルブドゥール寺院遺跡とプランバナン寺院遺跡意を巡るオプショナルツアーで巡ったヒンドゥー教寺院遺跡でプランバナン寺院の手前にあります。９世紀前半に建立された寺院で1966年地下6.5ｍに埋もれていたのが発見されたそうです。ボルブドゥール寺院遺跡もそうですが全て火山の大噴火で埋もれたようですね。遺跡寺院は二重の塀に囲まれて大変美しい姿を見せてくれます。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Historical place, sambisari have great architecture. A lot of tourists come to here, young people up to older and local tourist until foreigners comes. This is small temple in Jave actually in Yogyakarta but this temple has a interesting value for everyone. In this temple we could see the best of sunset.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: lokasinya bagus, murah meriah, bisa bebas jalan-jalan dan menikmati suasana. ditambah dengan taman yang terawat

E' un tempietto vicino al monumentale complesso di Prambanan: nulla a che vedere con la bellezza del famoso sito vicino, tuttavia, se il tempo è a sufficienza, un salto lo farei perché il vantaggio di questi siti "secondari" è che sono un po' meno belli ma molto meno affollati e quindi la visita può acquistare veramente tanto.

I was visit this place many times with group, it was lovely place and very quite. We curious about 'Lingga Yoni' state inside this temple. If you looking place for pre wedd, this temple should be in you list. very beautiful

Nice to come to this temple which isn't as popular as the others which actually adds to its beauty - it has real history here and is very interesting and nice to just spend a bit of time chilling out in a zen environment! We went late-morning/early afternoon and really enjoyed being only 1 of 2 groups there!!! Was nice and quiet and just felt really relaxing with great culture to see. There may be more information available on this with a guide but we were personally fine just experiencing a bit of culture, reading up in advance a bit online and reading the info board when there :) Worth a visit and worth avoiding the bigger names
We had a good time visitng this temple with our guide. I reccomend you hire a guide for information.

Candi ini ada di pemukiman warga...
Kebersihan candi perlu ditingkatkan oleh warga sekitar agar candi terlihat indah
Disarankan jangan datang siang jari karena sangat panas....

E' un piccolo tempio simile a tanti altri che si trovano in giro per la zona!
Ci si può entrare e fare un giretto attorno al grande giardino.
La cosa più interessante è la storia di come lo hanno scoperto: un contadino mentre zappava si è imbattuto nella punta più alta del tempio che era completamente sotterrato! Pensando fosse un sasso ha continuato a scavare finchè non ha visto che si trattava di un tempio!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This Sambisari temple is Adisucipto airport so it became my first place to visit after landed at Yogyakarta. Although this temple is not as popular as other big temple in Central Java/Yogyakarta, it was unique. It was an underground temple. It was buried underground until emerged by local farmer in 1966. It was small one but well maintained and neat. The entrance fee is very cheap. Good to take some pictures specially in morning.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
een mooi  klein tempel complex. gesitueerd onder her maaiveld. Bestaat  uit 1 grote tempel en 3 kleine in een rij.
Het is ern siva temple  waar de linggam als hoofd thema is.
Small and very nice temple, small entrance fee. Well maintained, very relaxed atmosphere. Go here before Prambanan temple.

Patut dikunjungi...tidak seperti biasanya, until menuju lokasi Candi ini Kita mesti menuruni anak tangga karena Candi ini terletak di bawah.
Pastikan mampir kalau ke yogyakarta
this temple was uncovered by a farmer after it was buried in volcanic ash. it is beautiful but not worthy of too much time. don't go here after borobudur or you will be disappointed.

Candi kecil yang berada dibawah permukaan tanah sekitarnya ini sangat indah dan saat matahari mulai tenggelam akan ada cahaya - cahaya indah yang bagus untuk diabadikan dalam foto. Bahkan dilihat mata saja sudah cukup untuk mengucap syukur kepada Tuhan karena begitu besar dan indah setiap karyaNya. Untuk masuk candi ini tiketnya murah (bahkan sy tidak bayar tiket masuk karena tidak ada penjaga/pengelola ketika sy dtg berkunjung, hanya parkir saja 2000 untuk motor) dekat dari candi ini ada tempat makan yang rekomen banget yaitu SOTO BATOK bisa setelah / sebelum ke candi untuk mampir dulu ke soto batok harga murah dan enak!! Lets check this out ;)
candinya tuh seperti candi dalam tanah. jd bentuk nya legok gitu.. maaf bahasa jawa. tp isinya cuman candi, tidak ada hal lain yg ditawarkan disini.

candi sambisari....wajib dikunjungi....menikmati candi dengan suasana yang asik....dan tak lupa menikmati saoto bathok yang letaknya dekat dengan candi ini....super rasanya super harganya ( enak dan murah )
tappa obbligata da fare anche senza guida emozionante al tramonto prendete il trenino gratuito per completare il tour del comlesso
ごじんまりしていますが良い場所です。嘘っぽくなくて落ち着いて楽しめます。ただ小さな場所なので一瞬で見終わります。
The Sambisari temple is under the ground which is different from the other temples in Yogjakarta.   Place is well preserved and worth a quick visit.
火山灰や土で埋まっていたのを発掘されたそうで地上より低い位置に遺跡があります。飾られているのは男性のシンボル。台座が女性になっていて溝がきってある先に子供が宿るとガイドさん説明。火山灰の影響で石は少し黒っぽいです。

Ini merupakan candi kecil, tp unik, karena berada di bawah tanah...
Apalagi kalau sore, makin cantik...
Penjaganya juga ramah...
Gratis.. gak bayar tiket masuk...
The Sambisari temple is the different temple type if you compare with others temple in Jogjakarta. Recommended to visit if you want to explore temples in Indonesia.

Sangat bagus pemandangan candi nya kalau kita liihat dari atas karena berbeda dengan candi candi yg lainnya karena candi ini terletak di bawah tanah jd kita harus menuruni tangga tiket masuk cukup terjangkau hanya 5rb rupiah untuk wisata lokal dan 10rb wisata asing. Yg saya salut dari tempat ini kebersihannya cukup terawat kalo wisata ke tempat ini jangan lupa mampir ke soto bathok yg tempatnya tidak jauh dari candi sambisari

Terletak tidak jauh dari Bandara Adisutjipto, Candi ini konon dulunya terkubur material gunung merapi yang meletus pada awal abad ke-11. Diberi nama Candi Sambisari karena terletak di Desa Sambisari.
Kompleks candi ini tidak besar.
Tidak jauh dari lokasi candi ini, ada kuliner yang terkenal yaitu Saoto Bathok.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: We were surprised to find this big difference compared to all the other temples we have seen. It was obviously digged out, it is well preserved and there was many statues absolutely complete.
berada dikawasan kalasan Yogyakarta, tidak terlalu besar tapi berdiri diantara rerumputan yang hijau sehingga sangat bagus untuk berfoto pilihan tepat jika sudah bosan dengan candi prambanan
tempio indu molto partiocolare, non maetoso ma con importanti rilievi esterni di ganesha, ad esempio. colpisce che sia sotto il livello stradale.
Been here for few times and it always amazes me. The temple itself is not really that big but it is below the ground.

The complex of Sambisari temple is situated close to the Yogyakarta Airport. It consists of one main temple and three supporting temples.  The guide told us that the main temple building is unique since it does not have shoe basement like other temples in Java. Worth of visit!

Ketika saya ingin menikmati sunrise yang dekat, langsung terlintas Candi Sambisari. Tempat ini tidak jauh dari pusat kota. Area candi bersih, sehingga cocok untuk menikmati udara pagi. Meskipun kawasannya tidak cukup besar dan tersembunyi, namun selalu ada pengunjung yang sekedar jalan-jalan  pagi di area ini. Candi ini memiliki view merapi di bagian utara. Sangat disarankan untuk mampir ke Soto Bathok setelah dari Candi ini.
If you are on the way to Prambanan temple, the Sambisari is worth visiting. Not a must do but it's a nice stop.

Um pequeno templo que embora simples está muito bem cuidado e com um enquadramento fantástico pois encontra-se num desnível de 5 metros. 
Segundo consta foi encontrado em escavações após uma erupção do Merapi.
Vale bem a pena a visita.
Ein sehr gigantisches Bauwerk, noch dazu bedenkt man die Geschichte! Es besteht aus mehreren Anlagen und ist durchaus empfehlendswert!
Lokasi candi mudah dijangkau dan berada disekitar pemukiman warga. Candi Sambisari berbeda dengan candi pada umumnya dimana posisinya lebih rendah dibandingkan lahan disekitar (dahulunya terkubur).

Sambisari was submerged in meters of ancient volcanic ash and became a padi field when the farmer hit a rock while ploughing his field. From this they found the lost Sambisari temple and perhaps many more will be unearth..what an amazing finding.

Known this Sambisari temple for a long time, but visited only once last month. I guess the renovation has been completed, although I think not everything has been evacuated. It is easy to find this place and it is in the middle of a kampung, although it covers rather wide area. The most impressive to me is the thickness of the walls, which could be the style at that time.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: 地面より下にある寺院です。観光客がまばらで落ち着いてゆっくり見ることが出来ました。敷地は広く、芝生がとても綺麗です。
muy linda experiencia entre todos los templos que recorrí ese día, hay algunos que son más imponente que otros, pero todos exquisitos!

It's rare to see a temple being built underground and they had discovered this site by accident, there might be a lot more according to archaeologists. 
Went on a national holiday the guy at the gate says just go, it's free for you (not sure if that's true or not) but anyway it is much cheaper than visiting the big 3 (Ratu Boko, Prambanan and Borobudur). Come if you have time!
a beautiful ancient temple...carvings on the stones are beautiful. Place is well restored and gives insight into the olden golden age of Indonesia

Candi Hindu dengan tiga candi perwara ini berada di Desa Sambisari, Purwomartani, Sleman. Candi tambun ini dulu tertimbu abu dan tanah letusan Gunung Merapi sedalam kurang lebih 6,5 meter sebelum ditemukan seorang petani yang sedang menggali sawahnya. Seluruh bangunan candi  dari abad kesembilan Masehi ini dikelilingi pagar batu. Di dalam bangunan utama, terdapat lingga yoni.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Worth to visit. It was buried 8 meters below the ground and unearthed during 1970's.  This clearly indicates the ashes/sands from Mount Merapi covering such historical sites, layer by layer over many hundred years.  So there may be many such buried temples underground and Mount Merapi would left for us...
It is nice see the holistic view... this site is like a small snack for photography hungers. Nice to see old shiva linga statue, Ganesha and Sage Agasthiya.  Indonesian temples and Sage Agasthiya some relation!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
It was off the beaten track and close to the airport. We had to literally trek down to this recently excavated temple. It wasn't overrun with tourists, so we had the temple to ourselves. 

Very quite and peaceful.

Bersih..itulah yang terlintas dibenak saat melihat peninggalan yang Candi yang satu ini, dan anehnya candi ini kayak 'tenggelam' alias pengunjung harus turun untuk mencapai ke lokasi candinya...Terima kasih pada pengelola yang menjaga kebersihan dan keindahan Candi Sambisari ini,,,

Very unique and beautiful temple.  The location is so close to downtown of jogja. Entrance fee is very cheap. 

Enjoy your time here,  relax. 
Best time to  visit is in the morning.
Salah satu candi di jogja yang murah tiket masuknya. Cukup dengan dengan bandara adisucipto. Bersih dan terawat.

1) Letaknya di tengah kota sehingga aksesnya mudah (lihat maps), walaupun ditengah kota namun tempatnya nyaman dan tidak riuh, cocok untuk anda yang penat namun malas bepergian jauh
2) Tempat parkir dekat sekali dengan lokasi, tidak perlu berjalan jauh
3) Tiket masuk sangat terjangkau (5000 untuk wisatawan domestik, 10000 untuk wisatawan asing)
4) Pemandangan yang elok

Salah satu candi yang ada di jogja...bagus untuk foto foto...rerumputan nya hijauuu..berada di purwomartani pinggiran jogja...masuk kawasan candi gratiss alias tidak di pungut biaya.cocok untuk kunjungan keluarga ataupun..dengan teman.bagus untuk melihat sun rise dan sunset.di sana sering di pakai untuk observe historic..prewedding photo shoot..

This temple is close to the airport, and is not as easy to access as Prambanan, but for me it was worth the trip. The temple is 3.5km away from the airport, where you can get by a bus. From there on, you can try and find a taxi. I have no bargain skills whatsoever, and when i asked they offered a price that was 6-7 time bigger than the approximate uber price in the app. I thought it was ridiculous for a ride that would take 5 minutes, and eventually I just walked. It's very easy to find, you just find the right street, and then walk 3km straight down the road. There are plenty of local people on motorbikes going in the same direction, and a couple of them offered a ride for very little or no money at all, just being nice. But even without it, it didn't seem like such a long walk. 
The temple seems pretty empty, I wandered a bit trying to find some sort of a ticket booth, but everything was empty. I found some sort of information booth and asked them about purchasin the ticket, but they just waved me in.
The Temple itself is quite interesting. There are no guides, but I suggest you read a bit about its history before you go there, it will only make the visit more interesting. I really liked the way it was discovered, and I liked the serenity of the place. There are very few people there, but I liked that temple more than any other I saw in Yogyakarta, because it was so unexpectedly different, for me it really stood out.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Находится в углублении, восстановлен. На территории есть небольшой музей, который интереснее храма. Стоимость 10000
Candinya kecil hanya satu tingkat tapi tiketnya murah tidak sampai 20.000 rupiah, lokasinya di komplek perumahan suka ada yang jual salak manis dan murah

With the reviews and photographs, there is some confusion about which temple is which. There's (I think) a Sari Temple and a Sambisari Temple. Some of the photographs and reviews posted on the Sari Temple listing actually belong over where in the Sambisari review spot. I first encountered this problem when I showed our hotel staff photographs posted under Sari Temple and she said, "No, that's Sambisari." This is the temple that is located below ground level, which is quite unusual for a Hindu temple anywhere. In short these photographs are accurate listed here.

Situé à 20 minutes en scooter du centre ville, ce temple hindous du 9eme siècle, d’un roi ou d’un noble, est bien mis en valeur par son environnement verdoyant. Il y a cependant très peu à voir hors de sa vue d’ensemble et les 3 statues de dieux hindous, Ganesh, Durga, Agastya.

Salah satu destinasi favorite indonesia selain bali adalah yogyakarta. Yogyakarta terkenal dengan kota pelajar, tetapi di jogja juga kita bisa menemukan banyak sekali tempat tempat wisata yang wajib kita kunjungi. Ada pegunungan, pantai dan candi.
Candi yang sangat terkenal di jogja adalah candi borobudur dan candi prambanan. Namun tahukah kalian selain kedua candi tersebut ada banyak candi candi lain yang tidak kalah menarik dengan candi borobudur dan prambanan.
Candi sambisari salah satunya. Candi sambisari terletak di daerah sleman yogyakarta. Kira2 12 KM sebelah timur kota yogyakarta ke arah kota solo atau kira2 4 KM sebelum komplek candi prambanan.
Saat itu saya dan suami berangkat dari kota jogja menggunakan sepeda motor. Jarak tempuhnya tidak sampai 1 jam karena pada saat itu keadaan lalu lintas lancar.
Uniknya candi ini letaknya lebih rendah dari permukaan tanah sehingga jika berkunjung kita menuruni beberapa anak tangga.
Saran saya kita kalian berkunjung ke candi sambisari ini jangan lupa membawa payung karena cuaca agak panas.
Jangan lupa setelah lelah berkeliling melihat2 keindahan candi sambisari ini kalian bisa mampir untuk makan soto batok sambisari. Soto nya sangat recomended guys. Enak tempatnya juga adem dan murah meriah, 1 porsi soto seharga 5.000 tapi jika membeli soto sambisari ini kalian harus siap untuk antri karena tempatnya rame.
Sekian penjelasan saya tentang candi sambisari. Sampai bertemu lagi dalam ulasan tempat2 wisata lain nya. Semoga bermanfaat.terima kasih

This temple is very unique, located below the land (you have to go down through stairs to reach the temple) makes the temple look beautifully from above. I think, best view is in the morning during the sunrise. Many people do some exercises in the morning looking for fresh air.

Terletak di tengah pemukiman dan hamparan sawah daerah Kalasan. Candi Sambisari dikelilingi bentenng batu, terdiri dari candi utama yg utuh dan 2 reruntuhan candi yg hanya tersisa bagian dasarnya. Sekitar candi terhampar taman berumput yg asri. hanya saja jika cuaca cerah terasa sangat panas. sebaiknya datang sore hari.

Candi yang tidak terlalu besar, akan tetapi pemandangan di sekitarnya sangat indah, tetapi pada saat musim kemarau, rumput-rumput menjadi kuang bagus karena menguning. Terletak di dekat pemukiman penduduk.
menuju candi sambisari ini kita disuguhhkan pemandangan sawah sawah yang indah dan melihat gunung ,tempatnya pun luas dan cocok untuk yang suka membawa grup atau keluarga

Candi ini tidak akan terlihat dari jalanan kalau kita tidak mendekat secara langsung, candi ini terletak didaerah purwomartani kalasan, candinya bagus, wajib dikunjungi dan dekat dengan akses kalau mau ke bandara

The Sambisari Temple is a 9th century Hindu temple very close to Yogyakarta. It was a relatively recent discovery with archeological excavations and reconstruction completed in 1987. 

The Temple is not expensive, even for tourists, and kids are free. 

It would fill in a pleasant hour exploring the grounds and ruins.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Tempatnya unik, di bawah permukaan tanah. Konon sebelumnya candi ini terpendam tanah letusan gunung merapi. Candi yang bagus, buka jam 06.00 pagi. Harga tiket murah Rp 5000
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Apart from Prambanan and Borobudur, Yogyakarta has a lot to see. One of which is sambisari temple. It is just amazing that an earthquake prone zone has so much which is preserved well and attracts tourism from across the world
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This temple is several feet below the present ground level. Few tourists. Like all the Candis this is well maintained. Worth visiting.
11月の昼間行きました。インドネシアの歴史を知るためでもありました。日本製の車で案内され運転手の名前もある動物さんでした。

Different from the tall massive temple complex you will normally see at Yogyakarta. This is below the ground level and flatter. Wont have rush and very cheap entry fee. Buy yourself fresh coconut water to refresh right outside the entrance

The temple was so nice, because it like 'underground' temple and it was in the centre of the area. The important thing is, the toilet not so far.. And also you must use something to covering your head from the sunlight

Beautifully restored temple near airport. It's worth visiting on the way to prambanan. Architecture is bit different and it's kinda sunken or below ground level. Like any place in Java, visit early or later in the day rather in the noon. That way you will beat the heat and get good sunlight exposure

Berkali-kali datang kesini, anak-anak tidak pernah bosan. Tamannya yg terawat rumput yang hijau membuat candi ini terlihat cantik. Apalagi kalau datang pada saat pagi atau sore hari, saat matahari hendak datang atau pergi, makin syahdu pemandangannya

It is very accessible from the airport and you can drop by to this temple, as it is along the way to Prambanan. One thing I like about this place is, it is more serene, not so crowded, actually there are more chickens than people and great for photoshoot. Entrance fee is 10k IDR.

周りを堤防で囲まれた正方形の敷地に、ヒンドゥー寺院の遺跡があります。ムラピ山の噴火で一度埋まり、掘り起こされて立て直されたそうで、一部まだ崩れたままになっています。建てられた当時はどんな姿だったのかと、誰も知らない光景を想像してみたり。
不思議な雰囲気の寺院です。静かなところで観光客もかなり少ないので、シバ神やガネーシャの像などをゆっくりと見て回れます。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
The Sambisari Temple is a 9 century Hindu temple. 

It was buried by lava after a Mount Merapi eruption centuries ago and discovered by a farmer in 1966 who bumped his foot in to a piece of carved rock. 

If you are in the neighborhood you should make a stop here.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Great architecture and history, not crowded so you can see it at your pace. A Hindu Sivalinga still exists through no prayers. Read the history before visiting. Great for photos

Candi ini terletak dibawah permukaan tanah,dalam cekungan....jadi nggak keliatan klu dari luar...nggak seperti candi candi lainnya...tapi nggak kalah cantik...unik malahan.
Ditemukan di tahun 1966 oleh salah satu petani,cangkulnya kena puing candi...dan dipugar 1986...jadi belum terlalu lama dikenal umum...belum ramai...ini merupakan candi Hindu.Aa candi utama yang diapit 3 candi kecil...
Tiket masuknya murah...tapi area candi terpelihara...sangat menarik jalan jalan kesini.
Karena masih relatif sepi...di depan pintu masuk candi ada warung bakso...kita jadi bisa berinteraksi dengan masyarakat lokal...

Review Text: ジョグジャカルタからプランバナンへ行く途中を曲がるとあります。芝生が非常に綺麗で観光客も少なく非常にゆっくりできました。

candi sambisari lumayan jauh dari jalan raya kota, jadi udaranya masih bersih dan nyaman. kalau datang saat musim hujan rumput sekitar candi akan berwarna hijau, karena candi ini terletak dibawah, kemungkinan candi ini dulu tertimbun tanah, kemudian berhasil ditemukan setelah penggalian sehingga kalau mau ke candinya harus menuruni tangga. cukup nyaman untuk wisata keluarga ataupun dengan teman-teman.
Visit this one first, before going to Prambanan, as it's smaller and less impressive. It won't be crowded though. There were more chickens than people when we dropped by.

I along with my family visited the Sambisari Temple at Yogyakarta, Indonesia on 25th April 2017. We visited this place in the afternoon en route to Prambanan Temple (as the two places are close by). The tickets are also very affordably priced, approx USD 1.5 per person.
The Sambisari Temple occupies a large area and surprisingly very well kept. The temple was accidentally found some years ago following a natural disaster. Upon excavation, this beautiful ancient Hindu temple was dug out. The temple today seems to be actually below the ground level, which is pretty unusual. The temple is dedicated to lord Shiva. You would probably need about 30 to 45 minutes to explore the place and take pictures.
If you are a lover of ancient temples and heritage sites, then the Sambisari Temple is a must see place. Very well maintained and a true gem!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Mało ciekawa świątynia. Może dlatego taka moja uwaga ponieważ wciągu kilku dni zwiedziłem kilka świątyń.

Once you are visiting Pambanan Temple, it is a good stopover.  Sambisari temple  is not properly restored may be due to lack of government willingness but still it is worth visit. You can appreciate the glory of the past. Twin temple symbolise marriage of Hindu kng and Buddhist queen. Out of two temple 1st from entrance is better renovated and has some attractive sculpture of woman in different posture on its outer wall.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: In compare with other temples in Yogya, this place is rather small but it's extremely attractive me with the location (near the center) and the way they reserve it. It's quite, peaceful and clean

Jika dilihat candi ini dahulu terletak didalam tanah, dikarenakan letak candi yang lebih dalam dari tanah di sekitarnya. Candi ini juga bagus sekali untuk berwisata meskipun udara sekitar lumayan panas.
这座寺庙非常与众不同，他告诉我这是一座与世隔绝的寺庙，可能还是马塔兰王朝修建的最后一座寺庙，被发现时位于浓密的火山灰底部，保存的很完好。始建于公元9世纪，是一座印度教寺庙。所以它现在呈现出来的感觉好像是在地下，要下一段长长的台阶。而且感觉这个寺庙也是保护的最好，开发的最好的一座寺庙，旁边的草坪上还修剪出了寺庙的名字。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: letak yang strategis memudahkan para wisatawan untuk menemukan candi sambisari ini.namunapabila berkunjung di siang hari saat terik, panasnya luar biasa. areanya juga tidak terlalu luas, jadi jika jalan-jalanpun tidak terlalu melelahkan

We found the temple by accident after having breakfast while seeing through the map. The place is absolutely awesome and very clean. The entrance ticket is very cheap, 2k IDR only!

This is a smaller temple here in Yogyakarta. It is unique because it sits under ground level. If you want to watch our YouTube review, search "Martin Johnson Sambi Sari Yogyakarta". We enjoyed the peaceful atmosphere. :)

De tempel van Sambisari is prachtig. Aan de ingang van het complex ligt een klein paviljoen met een tentoonstelling over de ontdekking en restauratie van de tempel. De tempel ligt in een mooi onderhouden tuin en is prachtig gerestaureerd met mooie beelden in de nissen. Het duurde 21 jaar om het tempelcomplex herop te bouwen. Voor de tempel staan drie kleinere gebouwen. Op de site vindt je nog elementen van het tempelcomplex die niet zijn gebruikt tot op heden.

A well preserved Hindu temple located near the airport in a residential area. The temple is below ground level with steps leading all the way down. It had been buried under the earth for hundreds of years before being discovered and excavated.  Its off the beaten track but worth a visit.

The temple dedicated to Lord Shiva is a very old temple built out of stone. No worship is held in The Temple but it gives glimpses of the golden era when it was built. It also introduces the culture of the time like a true representation of the time.

Objek wisata acndi sambisari ini sangat direkomendasikan untuk dikunjungi. Bentuknya tidak terlalu besar jika dibandingkan dengan candi prambanan apalagi candi borobudur. Namun sejarah yang tersimpan di candi sambisari ini tidak kalah menariknya. 

Candi sambisari merupakan candi bawah tanah. pengunjung harus turun melewati tangga terlebih dahulu untuk sampai persis ke depan candi ini. saat saya berkunjung ke candi ini, lokasinya tertata rapi dan bersih. ada taman - taman yang bisa dijadikan tempat berteduh dan sekedar duduk menikmati hembusan angin dan melihat candi dari kejauhan. 

tarif masuk ke lokasi candi sambisari tidak mahal, sangat bersahabat di kantong wisatawan.

Review Text: located in the middle of residentials (outskirt sleman yogyakarta), this temple is one of those not-so-touristy spot to visit. even thought the ticket is very cheap, this temple is pretty well-preserved.

храм обязательно стоит посетить, на небольшом участке собрано очень много предметов старины которые можно посмотреть тут же в музее, посетителей много так что мы приехали сюда заранее, необычные ощущения

wir waren schon oft in Yogjakarta und haben so ziemlich alle Tempel durch die man sehen kann, der Sambisari fehlte jedoch irgendwie.
Wir nahmen also ein Taxi und der Fahrer hatte große Mühe den Tempel zu finde (2 x verfahren - kein Fake, wir hatten Festpreis). Am Ziel angekommen die Ernüchterung, der Tempel (die Tempelanlage) war doch kleiner als erwartet.
Egal, die Anlage war sauber, gepflegt und das Wetter war perfekt. Für ein paar Fotoshoots und "mal da gewesen sein" war es absolut ok. Wer mehr sehen will sollte auf Borobodur und Prambanan zurück greifen und wer noch mehr sehen will muss nach Kambodscha fliegen (Angkor Wat).
Was ich jedoch nicht so ganz nachvollziehen kann ist der Eintrittspreis. 2000 indon. Rupiah, also ca. 14 Euro Cent. Warum nimmt man nicht von Touristen 1 Dollar/Euro um mit den Mehreinnahmen kulturelle Schätze / Weltkulturerbe zu erhalten und zu pflegen ?
1 Dollar/Euro tuen bestimmt keinen Touristen weh.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: На мой взгляд, это самый интересный храм их небольших храмовых комплексов Явы, если не брать в расчет такие жемчужины, как Прамбанан и Боробудур. Поэтому не соглашусь с теми, кто пишет, что посещение опционально. Он находится по дороге к Прамбабану, и вполне можно выделить полчаса на его посещение. По архитектуре храм напоминает прочие храмы - это, по сути, ступенчатые пирамиды с рельефами, но находится он на глубине котловины, отчего почему-то навевает мысли о Мексике. Плюс он неплохо восстановлен и выглядит аутентично. Стоит и обойти его кругом по верхнему периметру, выбирая самое красивое место для съемки (зависит от времени суток, как солнце падает), и спуститься внутрь. Вход копеечный, что-то в районе 2 тыс. рупий.

The temple is indeed well preserved, and intimate because it's not crowded with tourists (we were about the only people there during our short visit). Well worth the affordable ticket price (2,000 IDR for adult).

Minor note: Have exact change ready at entrance. I handed over a 10k note for entrance fee and the guard insisted I paid with 5k (even waving a 5k note at me). It was only 5k so I didn't argue with him (it wouldn't go anywhere anyway), but I don't like scams either. Suggest to have exact change ready when you enter.
Based on story the Temple was found when a farmer dug the soil for rice field. Entrance ticket not cost much but the area are well maintenance.

In het oosten van Yogyakarta liggen verschillende kleinere Hindoe-tempels, en dit is een van de grotere en mooiere. Interessant hier is dat heel duidelijk te zien is hoe diep de tempel ligt - het hele gebied is sinds de bouw van de tempel in de 9de eeuw bedolven onder materiaal van de vulkaan Merapi, dus deze tempel moest echt uitgegraven worden.
Deze kleinere tempel stelt weinig voor als je hem vergelijkt met de nabijgelegen Prambanan-tempel, maar het bezoeken van enkele van zulke kleinere tempels is een leuke aanvulling.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: При храме Самбисари есть небольшой музейчик, который гораздо интереснее самого храма. Интересно, что этот храм был найден крестьянином у себя в огороде.

Another beautiful temple in Jogja. Very beautiful and no crowded at all. The temple is buried by Volcanic eruption before found by farmer in 1966 which is the reason why the temple is very unique and you need to walk down to view this majestic temple.

Go first to the information room locate just behind the Guard house where they have number of information about this temple.
Just IDR2000 for entrance and IDR10,000 for parking as We brought kind a big car to park. But its really worth as this temple is really amazing and beautiful.

The Sambisari temple complex consisted of a main temple and a row of three smaller guardian temples in front of it and there is huge Lingga statue in the main temple.

Review Text: I find this temple intriguing since it was formerly buried under lava. In fact, only the main temple area has been excavated for the public to explore. Other than that, not much to see if you compared it against Prambanan or Borobudur.

Review Text: A small place in a middle of village near Prambanan Temple.  Entrance fee RP3,000.  Not crowded. Very peaceful, little shops selling drinks and souvenir shop.  This temple was discovered by a farmer who by chance knocked the tip of the temple while digging the ground.

Candi Sambisari ditemukan tidak sengaja oleh Petani yang sedang mencangkul, yang kemudian dilaporkan kepada Pemerintah Daerah setempat. Ternyata setelah dilakukan penyelidikan dan penggalian oleh Dinas Purbakala, merupakan Candi Hindu. Candi terletak 6.5 KM di bawah permukaan Tanah dan kemungkinan besar tertanam akibat lahar Gunung Merapi yang meletus pada abad silam. Bangunan ini mempunyai Candi Utama dengan didampingi oleh 3 candi perwara (pendamping). Pada bagian luar dinding bangunan utama di sebelah utara terdapat relung yang berisi patung Dewi Durga - Isteri Dewa Siwa, relung bangunan sebelah timur terdapat patung Ganesha - Dewa Pendidikan, dan relung bagian selatan terdapat patung Agastya (sebelah selatan). Di sebelah barat terdapat dua patung dewa penjaga pintu: Mahakala dan Nandiswara. Candi cukup terawat karena sudah dipugar oleh Dinas Purbakala.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Inexpensive entry fee, nearby parking, cold drink and and snacks for sale, not crowded, no tour guide hassles, easy to explore, unique, and takes less than an hour to walk all around - how's that for a perfect cultural tour stop?
