This is a small but not big temple. It is located lower than the road level and this can be easily missed. Simple buildings in it that can be covered in less than half hour. Despite all these, it is still a temple worth visiting and discovering. It does invoke its own wow and wonder factor.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: 時間が余ったので、ついでに行ってみました。プランバナンと比べると、遥かに規模も小さく、見ごたえもないですが、本堂の内部がここだけ明らかに違いました。何ヵ所か寺院に寄りましたが、ここは独特で面白かったです。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: 9.Yüzyıla ait bir hindu tapınağı gerçekten görülmes gereken yerlerden biri zaten jogjaya yakın 8km mesafede her sekilde ziyaret edilebilecek bir tapınak..
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Posisi Candi Sambisari terletak 6,5 meter di bawah permukaan tanah, candi hindu ini terletak di daerah Purwomartani, Kalasan, Sleman. tiket masuk hanya 2K rupiah, parkir kendaraan di luar area candi di depan warung jajanan. jangan khawatir apabila anda berkunjung siang hari, karna di warung ini juga tersedia sewa payung dengan harga 3K rupiah.
candi ini sudah cukup terjaga kebersihannya, jadi apabila anda berkunjung tolong ikut rawat kebersihan candi ini.
karna musim kemarau, rumput di area candi tidak hijau lagi alias gersang, tapi tidak mengurangi wisatawan yang datang.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Dinamakan candi sambisari karena terletak di daerah sambisari, jogjakarta.. biaya masuknya hanya 2rb perak per orang, candinya cukup bagus dan luas dan letaknya dipermukaan tanah, bagus untuk dijadikan objek foto.
yogyakarta'da küçük bir hindu tapınağı,diğer gösterişli tapınaklardan sonra biraz sönük kalıyor ama yinede tarihe ve hindu kültürüne meraklı olanlar için önerilir.

The temple was accidentally found by Padi farmers years ago when they prepare the field for cultivation.
But many believe it was at ground level at the of building based on the drainage system but was buried after years of volcano activitis plus possibility of ground movement as well.
Unique as it's own right. It's far from prambanan temple but it's nice if your tour guide can 'squeeze' out an hour to visit this temple.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Candi ini termasuk salah satu candi yang unik. Soalnya dibangun di bawah permukaan tanah. Untuk masuk ke areal candi, kita harus menuruni tangga. Luas areal Candi Sambisari kurang lebih seluas lapangan bola. Bentuknya sangat sederhana, tetapi terkesan berwibawa. Candi ini dikelilingi 2 pagar batu. Pagar batu terluar setinggi sekitar 1,5 meter. Sedangkan pagar batu bagian dalam setinggi kurang lebih 2 meter. Di tengah-tengah terdapat candi Sambisari sebagai candi utama dan 3 candi pendamping. Di dalam bangunan candi utama, ada ruangan kecil dimana terdapat lingga dan yoni. Candi ini cukup indah bila dipandang dari atas.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Candinya unik karena letaknya di bawah tanah, melihatnya ke bawah bukan ke atas seperti candi umumnya

This is a tiny Hindu temple set not far from Prambanan.  This temple is a complete waste of your time.  Spend an extra half hour lounging poolside instead of taking the time to see this tiny structure.  In comparison to Prambanan, this place is an afterthought.  It’s not worth the effort to come here in the dry heat of Yogyakarta in the summer.  If the locals are worshiping here, you will not be allowed a peek inside the temple anyway.

For entering this site, you didn't need to pay anything. it's free, but if you want to add some money, that'll be nice (and the number is up to you). the uniqueness of this site is that it is located deep down so for reaching this site you have to take stairs down. This happened because it was found buried under paddy field.
Wij gingen met de fiets richting Prambanan. Even een kleine afslag genomen en dat was zeker de moeite waard. De tempel is in uitstekende staat en het kostje slechts Rp. 2000.

Quite far from the main road but if you have time, worth to check this temple out. It's quite small but the surrounding area is quite big. The uniqueness of Sambisari is due to it being 'underground'. Of course, the soil has been excavated leaving an open space with the the temple. Nice to come during the evening.

Tempat yg sangat bagus, pokoknya keren banget nih, berada di dekat pusat kota, tiket masuk pun murah meriah, kalo sore2 ga ad kerjaan mending saya sarankan dateng aj kesini, pokoknya keren ga kalah sama candi2 lainnya.

Tiene pocas visitas y se aprecia con poca gente este templo hinduista que es precioso. No dejar de visitar. Fue descubierto por un agricultor que supo descubrirlo ya que se encontraba bajo las cenizas y tierra. Múy sencillo y bonito.

La storia di questo tempio è interessante.  È stato scoperto per caso da un contadino che ha trovato la sommità del tempio sporgente dal terreno. Gli scavi sono cominciati e il tempio è spuntato e infatti si vede che è più basso di 6metri rispetto al livello del terreno. A me è piaciuto tanto, non è grande nè imponente ma è suggestivo nella sua collocazione; inoltre si trova in un villaggio dove i Javanesi appena vedono un turista vogliono fare foto con te. Non sono abituati e mi fanno tenerezza. Popolo meraviglioso
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
This is the first temple we visited when we arrived. Is in a village, not much people, no entrance fee, but free to donate. Have a small room which describe about this historical relic. 
The most interesting about this temple is, is not at the higher ground( which usually can seen by people from far), but lower than the ground around (no underground too).
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Candi yang tidak banyak orang tahu. karena memanga agak "mumpet" dan kurangnya publikasi.
Tempatnya memanga agak kecil. namun bentuknya yang unik dan berbeda.
il mérite le détour; cela ne prend qu'une 20 de minutes mais il mérité d'être visité .. ;) il est agréable de tranquilité
５０年程前に火山灰の中から発見されたと言われるように遺跡自体は高くなくこじんまりした印象です。ヒンドゥー教の寺院ですが、プランバナンと比較するとはるかに小さく発掘されていないところもかなりあるようです。暗いため本堂の内部は見づらいですが、シヴァ神ではなくシンボルが鎮座されていました。空港に近いため時間に余裕がある方は是非立ち寄られたらどうでしょうか？
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This small temple is very well preserved and the garden around it is extremely well kept. You won't be able to spend hours here but in my opinion this place is worth a visit!
layaknya candi-candi kecil lainnya, candinya terletak dibawah dan kalo sing panas banget... kalo punya banyak waktu sebelum ke airport boleh mampir sebentar buat foto, tiket masuk cuma 2000 saja
This temple is superb small, and yet the environment is nice and quiet as there is not many tourists.
無料で観光できる割には、他に観光客が居ませんでした。農夫が発見した、と言う事は以前畑だったと言う事がなんとなく分かるような、広々した場所です。プランバナンからは結構離れていますが、リンガやヨニは他の遺跡では見られなかったので、結構来てよかったです。

If you go to Yogyakarta for sightseeing, Borobudur and Prambanan are two attractions that you must pay a visit. But for Candi Sambisari, it seems to be optional. No entrance fee is needed, only an up- to- you donation is required. This underground site was unearthed by a farmer by chance, fortunately he did not covered the temple with mud.  Frequently, the government  may turn down any development immediately and declares it as an archaeological site. You must walk down twenty steps to a large green lawn, and there is only one single temple, well-preserved below the surface.During our visit, no visitor was in sight. Perhaps it is still another option for you to visit if you are not in a hurry.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Voce que vai a Pranabhan, não deixe de ver este templo! Muito proximo, com uma arquitetura simples, mas totalmente magico.

あるガイドブックに、歩いているとおじさんが寄ってきて、ガイドを申し出る、みたいな記事があった。入場券のパンチを入れた親父が、韓国人か？と聞くので、日本人と答える。するとついて来いという。少しして、勝手にガイドし始めた。そこで怪しいと思ったので、なぜあなたは私だけにそんなに親切なんだ？お金が目的か？と聞く。すると、俺はこの王の子孫だからみんなに歴史を語りたいといった。まあ怪しいと思ったけど、案内させた。「水の宮殿」だけでいいと思っていたら、あちらこちらにいろんな施設があり、本当によく知ることができた。途中、店にも連れて行かれたが、すぐに断った。なんだかんだ１時間ほど見て回った。別れ際やはりお金を要求してきた。１００円くらい渡して分かれた。かえって、いい観光ができた。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Candi ini lokasinya tidak terlalu jauh dengan kota jogja, lokasinya bisa ditempuh belok kiri arah ke Utara setelah pertigaan bandara Adisutjipto
Komplek candi ini tidak terlalu jauh dari Jalan Raya Jogja-Solo (Sekitar 2,5 km) dengan jalan aspal yang lurus dan tidak belok-belok.
Komplek candi ini tidak terlalu besar, hanya saja lokasinya berada agak di bawah, karena dulunya tertimbun oleh tanah dan dilakukan penggalian
Dulu lokasi di sekitar candi ini tergenang air, tapi sekarang sudah dilakukan perbaikan drainase dan permukaan tanahnya bisa dikeringkan.

Bagi yang ingin mengunjungi objek wisata yang tidak mainstream, tempat ini bisa anda jadikan tujuan wisata.

I regularly pass by sambisari and every single time i'm perplexed by this underground complex. Its no angkor wat or borobodur but its worth a visit if your staying more than a week in Jogja. And best of all its fairly inexpensive and located in a nice neighboroughood not far from where I live :)
While Prambanan and Borobudor are the areas highlights, Sambisari is on the way to Prambanan and definitely worth the stop.  Very quiet, with virtually no one else around as you explore.
Sebelum ke bandara, sempatkan ke candi sambisari. candi peninggalan, aku lupa hindu atau budha. dan banyak pasangan membuat tempat ini sebagai view untuk foto prewedding

Candi biasanya terletak di tempat yang tinggi (di atas bukit), tapi candi ini terletak di bawah permukaan  tanah (di bawah tanah). Lokasi candi berdiri lebih rendah dari pada rumah penduduk. Terpendam sedalam 6,5 meter di dalam tanah dan sebelumnya lokasi ini merupakan area persawahan.
Candi ini ditemukan secara tak sengaja oleh petani saat mencangkul sawahnya.
Candi ini terletak di desa Sambisari, Kalasan, tak jauh dari lokasi Candi Kalasan. Jalan menuju ke sana terbilang bagus dan masuk kampung (karena kurangnya penunjuk jalan, disarankan untuk bertanya dengan warga sekitar).
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Unique temple.
Serene surroundings.
Do not need a guide as complex is not that big.
Its off the beaten path so to speak.

Candi dengan nilai sejarah yang luar biasa bagi anda para pecinta budaya dan alam, candi ini merupakan salah satu ciptaan leluhur kita yang patut dilestarikan, dan tentu saja bagi anda pecinta fotografi tempat ini cocok dijadikan tempat hunting

We took a smaller temple day on a motorbike and sambisari was our first stop. A very well kept area and the temple is small but it was very nice to walk around in the garden and the design of the temple is different from the other temples we went to. Go if you have time and a cheep way to get there.

This temple is distinguished by being built on a level below the ground level of the surrounding area. The temple structures are fairly small and not that impressive, but from above the whole complex looks pretty good. I had to rush my visit here as there was a major storm approaching, but ideally 20 minutes would have been good to enjoy it more fully. There didn't seem to be a fee to get in.

Ее один храм в Джодже, к сожалению осталось от него не очень много, но впечатление общее составить можно. Мы в него заехали по дороге в Прамбанан и много времени на его осмотр не потратили, тк ниего особенного мы в нем не увидели
Not worth going out of your way to see this but as the last known temple of the vanished kingdom it is relevant. There is a tiny museum near the entrance.

Candi unik ini belum lama ditemukan oleh petani pada saat mencangkul sawah dan terkena batu, kemudian dia coba cangkul ke area lainnya ternyata sama, dengan dibantu warga sekitar situ mereka coba mencangkul di area yang lebih luas lagi, dan akhirnya melaporkan ke balai konservasi untuk melakukan pemugaran dan restorasi candi yang berada di bawah tanah. Tiket masuk cukup murah hanya IDR 2,000 baik turis mancanegara maupun domestik, terbilang masih sepi dan belum banyak yang tahu karena berada dipemukiman warga
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Candi unik karena berada di bawah tanah, berada di pemukiman warga, tiket masuk cukup murah hanya 2000 rupiah baik turis mancanegara maupun domestik.

Sebelum mengunjungi tempat ini, saya sama sekali tidak tahu keberadaan candi ini. Candi ini adalah candi Hindu, ditunjukkan dengan adanya arca Durga, Agastya, dan Ganesha. Simbol lingga-yoni juga ada di candi ini. Di dalam kompleks candi masih ada tiga bangunan pendamping selain bangunan candi utama. Cukup unik, karena bangunan utama candi terletak lebih rendah dari permukaan tanah di sekitarnya. Yang disayangkan, informasi mengenai sejarah candi ini kurang.

Membangun candi pada umumnya di puncak ketinggian diatas tanah, namun untuk candi Sambisari justru kebalikan. candi ini dibangun di kedalaman tanah yang dibuat seperti kolam sehingga jika benar benar berisi air maka candi ini seperti bunga teratai (padma) yang mekar diatas kolam) Lahan yang luas mendukung tampilan candi menjadi indah, kanal air sekeliling masih utuh, pagar pembatas batu candi sangat terawat.

Это один из известных храмов острова, но второстепенно. Если берете водителя на день, то обязательно заедьте, если нет, то прицельно в него ехать не стоит. Вы увидите типичный храм, которых много на острове. Нам понравилось, обошли очень быстро и поехали дальше.
.. because it is built in some kind of a basement. And an attraction close to the main hotels a little off the road to Prambanan.
Еще один храм стиля Прамбанан. Песок и гравий. На этом храме мы выдохлись и решили, что хватит с нас. Входная плата как пожертвование.

Saya pertama kali kecandi ini, kesan pertama wowwww banget dan saya berfikir, betapa kaya nya Indonesia akan peninggalan kebudayaan, sungguh takjub, tapi setelah saya berkeliling dan melihat ruang informasi ternyata yg kurang itu rumputnya, karena saya lihat di fotonya ada rumput Jepang yang hijau, coba masih ada, dan masih banyak fasilitas yg kurang disana, 
Saya akan kembali lagi ke sini
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Surrounded by a hug lot of sand and gravel, the temple resembles a playground more than a heritage site. There's nothing much to see here but sand and stones.

There is a saying - for you to experience the place, travel like a local. Grabbing the opportunity to look around Yogyakarta, I joined a bike tour offered by the hotel. The way was mostly ok, we passed through a lot of rice paddies and quaint houses built with heavy java inflences.

The temple by itself is quite small but is sorrounded by a wide lawn. There is also a museum at the side so u can appreciate the cultural artifacts which were found on the site. It was a fine experience. Enjoyed the bike trip too!!

Menarik pastinya dengan simbol Lingga Yoni didalam candi ini. Candi yang berada di Desa Sambisari ini bersebelahan dengan pemukiman penduduk, tampak jelas dijaga kelestariannya. Rumput yang bertuliskan Sambisari merupakan salah satu bukti bahwa situs ini dirawat. Tapi sangat disayangkan, arah penunjuk menuju candi ini begitu minim bila sudah memasuki Desa Sambisari...Semoga pemerintah lebih memperhatikan hal demikian

空港からほど近い場所にあるマイナーな寺院です。入場料も無料です。寺院の位置は現在よりも少し低い位置にあります。なんでも農夫が農作業中に発見したそうです。どこかで聞いたようなフレーズですが・・・福岡飯塚市にある王塚古墳も似たような経緯で発見されましたのを思い出しました。意外とこの王塚古墳も装飾古墳としては日本の頂点に位置しており、あの高松塚古墳よりも多くの色を使っているんです・・・と話は道を外れてしまいますが、とにかく遺跡です。

他の遺跡に比べると小さなものですが、観光客がほとんどいないのでゆっくりとみることができます。中心の堂の中には男性器を模ったリンガと女性器を模ったヨニがあります。触ると後利益があるそうです。

堂の外にも丸い台のようなものがありますが、それもすべてリンガを立てるところだそうです。かなりの本数が立てられそうでした。

まだ修復していたりしますが、比較的整備が行き届いているのでゆっくりとみることが可能でいいと思います。時間が取れるならぜひ見に行きましょう。

2014年8月11日訪問
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Petit temple assez original sur la route de Prambanan. Si vous avez un peu de temps n'hésitez pas à vous y arréter. Peu de touristes.

First time I went here was with my Uncle and cousin in 2013, but in July 2014 I decided to visit this temple with my friend to spend the time before breakfasting or "ngabuburit". The temple was same as I visited last year, it didn't change at all. The temple is located below the land because it was found by the farmer many years ago when he was digging. It's totally awesome because I think there's no temple as this in Indonesia. The temple can't be seen clearly from the far, but if you take a closer look you'll be able to see the temple. Although it's just a small temple, but the atmosphere is great. It's surrounded by residents houses and sometimes the children who live near the temple play at Sambisari Temple. There's no fee or ticket to see and enter this temple. You just need to write down your identity on visitor book at the security office. Jogja is not only Prambanan or Borobudur because there are still a lot of hidden and small historical temple around Jogja. Don't forget to visit Sambisari Temple if you go to Jogja.
If you dont have enough money to visit some temples in Yogya, try this place. Only Rp2rb (USD 0,1)! Hidden temples are underground

Le temple est atypique par rapport aux autres il est sous le niveau de la terre. Un des derniers découverts dans la région (1966)
Il est tout petit avec peu de touriste. Mais sympas 
Gratuit donation possible !!
Der Tempel lag wie Pompeji unter eine Schicht vulkanischen Ergussmaterials. Man blickt ähnlich wie dort auf den Hafenbereich vom Rand auf das darunter liegende freigelegte Gelände.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
This small Hindu temple is quiet, un-touristed, and lovely.  Be prepared for steps, since the temple is sunken.  The site consists of one, lovely, restored main temple, and several unrestored side buildings.  Climbing the steps to the main temple brings you to the sacred "linga" area.  Other lovely statues are inset into niches on the outside of the building.

Since Sambisari Temple is located quite near the better-known Prambanan Temple, it would be easy to include it if you're in the area.

I really liked this temple. A little off the beaten track but very close to Yogya airport. It was so much more peaceful than the over-rated Prambanan. This is the most picturesque temple we saw in Indonesia, including Tanah Lot.

I went there by motorbike. At first I cannot find it, cause it is "underground", but a small sign seems to show me that I have reach, so I stop and ask the people if this is the place. This temple really surprise me. Very peaceful, quiet temple in a village setting.

Another beautiful temple in Jogja, found when a farmer was ploughing his land to put in rice fields. Has been well restored and there is a small little museum that has great before and after pictures so you can see the work involved. Also very peaceful as there are very few tourists.
Sambisari Temple (free ticket), you just need to record your information in a record book then straight go in. Opens from Mon-Sun 6am-5:30pm。This is an underground temple in a beautiful garden.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Thanks for the reviews.  We put this on our list and thoroughly enjoyed the visit.  A lovely green setting frames this little jewel of a temple.  Nicely restored since well over 60 percent of original material was identified.  Very few visitors and in that way more charming than the larger temple sites.  Well worth the visit and not far off the main road to Prambanan.

Terlihat dari jauh tidak ada tampak kalau ada situs candi. Namun setelah semakin dekat, ternyata lokasinya dibawah permukaan tanah. Bisa dibayangkan bahwa yang menemukan candi ini pasti ketika sedang mencangkul tanah, dan menemukan batu arca.
Ketika saya masuk, tidak ada fee, alias gratis. Saya tidak tahu kenapa, mungkin karena dikira orang lokal.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The temple is cool but if you are not satisfied walking around the temple, you can enter the information space. there, you can see pictures of the excavation, reconstruction, and the relics of the temple and bronze statues are now in the Archaeological Heritage Preservation Hall.

not even my guide and driver found the way immediately, and I was the only guest at this temple. its not far away from kalasan and prambanan, and definitely worth the 10 detour and 15 min walk across the place. cost 2000 IDR and was maintained exceptionally, very clean and a friendly guy at the entrance.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: A must see for historians. Hard to believe it was buried for so long. Small entrance fee and great information room. Bilingual information.

火山灰に埋もれていたものを発見された寺院遺跡です。その為、遺跡は周囲の土地より低くなっています。ここは無料の施設のようですが、私達が行ったときは他に観光客は誰も居なくて、ゆっくり鑑賞できました。但し、日陰になるものがないので、かなり暑いです。
寺院の中にはリンガというヒンズー教のご神体があります。火山に埋もれていただけあって、保存状態はいいと思います。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The temple is a shiva temple it is well maintained and I was wondering why prayers are not conducted. Although the majority of Indonesians are muslims I salute their openness in preserving thier cultural heritage. I have been to many temples all over the world but I have postive vibes when I touch the lingam in the temple. definitely worth a visit.

The entrance fee for tourists is 15k rupiah which is much cheaper than other temple attractions. (This is about a 20 minutes drive from Ratu Boko).
This temple is located up a hill and we were treated to an incredible 360 degrees view of the landscape! There is 1 big and 3 smaller structures and we are allowed to explore inside the structures. I highly recommend.
Very pretty, nice view and reasonable price. Only 15 thousand for foreigners which is way better than Prambanan. May as well go for that price

This is the highest temple in Yogyakarta. Located on a green hill around 45 minutes from Yogyakarta, on the same direction with Prambanan Temple. This is a good spot for sunset. There are 17 structures here and some statues. If the sky is clear we can see Mt. Merbabu and Mt Merapi.

Lokasinya di timur (dekat candi prambanan). Masih satu komplek dengan tebing breksi, akan tetapi lokasinya masih di atas lagi (karena jalan berbukit). di sarankan untuk berkendara, karena cukup memakan waktu dan jalurnya yang naik.
Yang perlu diperhatikan jika datang di musim kemarau adalah sedia payung/topi dan kaca mata hitam. Karena cukup terik, untuk kegiatan hunting foto cukup bagus. Beberapa candi saat saya berkunjung kemungkinan masih tahap penyusunan kembali. 

Tempatnya tenang seperti savanah

This Hindu Temple complex contains 17 structures divided into 11 terraces ,
the first terrace is the yard to the entrance and  on each terrace stands the 
building structure, the highest terrace stands the most sacred.

From the tour guide, we learned Ijo Temple was built 410 meters above 
sea level, thus it is known as the highest Temple in Yogyakarta. This place 
do not collect entrance fee, but just record our name on its guest book, 
or visitor could leave some tips for its maintenance.

Due to its height , not only one could visit the Temple, but also enjoy the
natural view below such as terraces of agriculture land and valleys with its steep slope. 

Now we understand why the Temple is named Ijo , it means Green . The Temple surrounding view is all green and scenic landscape is indeed tranquil and exudes a sense of peace & calmness.

As it was around 5pm, many visitors had climbed up , sitting around the terrace edge to enjoy the natural view while waiting for the sunset.

Too bad the skyline is too overcast & cloudy, thus we decided to take a trip back to Hotel and did not catch the sunset vista.

Review Text:
It is hard to believe it now, but just 15 years ago these temples were unrestored piles of collapsed stones which only archaeologists were interested in. With a number of temples now restored to something approaching their original beauty, Candi Ijo is now one of the most impressive Javanese temple sites and a must-see for tourists to Yogyakarta. That said, restorations are still ongoing here and the total of six restored temples may eventually be added to.

The main temple, or candi induk, is a remarkable structure which features kudu heads, kala niches and a truly gargantuan yoni. Its three satellite temples are also in condition and one of them shelters one of the most perfect Nandi statues in all of Java. 

It is also worth mentioning that this temple has sweeping views of the Prambanan Plain being situated at a height of 420 metres above sea level. Entrance costs 10,000 rupiah for foreigners.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Setelah menempuh perjalanan yang cukup panjang selama kurang lebih 8 jam dari Kabupaten Pangandaran Provinsi Jawa Barat, tibalah saya di salahsatu kota yang setiap sudutnya berisi romantisme dan kenangan yakni Kota Yogyakarta.

Tepat pukul 16.00 WIB saya tiba di terminal bus Giwangan, Yogyakarta. Dari sinilah saya mulai bertanya kepada diri sendiri hendak kemana sore ini. Kupegang gawai, lantas kemudian kucoba mencari apa yang menarik saat sore hari di Yogyakarta melalui search engine di smartphone.

Lantas kemudian munculah beberapa pilihan tempat yang asyik dinikmati saat senja. Satu diantaranya Candi Ijo, salahsatu bangunan bersejarah dengan corak hinduisme yang konon dibangun pada abad 10-11 masehi ini merupakan salahsatu spot favorit untuk menikmati sunset.

Selain sunset, dari candi ijo yang terdapat di ketinggian sekitar 375 meter diatas permukaan laut (mdpl) di Dusun Groyokan, Desa Sambirejo Kecamatan Prambanan, Kabupaten Sleman Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta.

Ini bisa digapai dengan jarak sekitar 21 KM dari terminal Giwangan dan waktu tempuh diprediksi mencapai 31 menit. dari sini juga bisa menikmati landscape kota dan hilir mudik pesawat di Bandara Adisucipto.

"Secara, ini zaman sudah serba digital, tinggal klik maka semua informasi bisa dengan mudah didapat,".

Tidak kurang dari 20 menit, saya terus mecoba mengumpulkan informasi di handphone, dari mulai cuaca, jam matahari terbenam sekaligus estimasi biaya untuk mencapai Candi Ijo.

"Setelah dicek, ternyata jam yang pas untuk melihat senja pada tanggal (11/12) yakni sekitar pukul 17.49 WIB dan kebetulan cuaca diprediksi cerah,".

Tak mau menunggu lama, saya langsung bergegas membuka salahsatu aplikasi penyedia jasa ojek yang bisa mengantar ke lokasi. 

Meskipun dengan harga ojek yang relatif mahal sekitar Rp 56 ribu dari Terminal Giwangan ke Tebing Breksi dan tiket masuk sekitar Rp 5 ribu, ini bisa terbayar dengan keindahan yang akan didapat.

Namun sayang karena demi keamanan, sekitar pukul 18.00 WIB, Candi Ijo ini harus bersih dari pengunjung. Kalaupun mau mengambil gambar dimalam hari dan menerbangkan drone, wisatawan wajib menempuh izin kepada petugas.

"Ya saya harap pemerintah setempat bisa segera membuat regulasi khusus mengenai transportasi setiap kawasan wisata, ini supaya pengunjung bisa dengan mudah menjangkau karena tidak semua wisatawan menggunakan kendaraan pribadi,".

This really is one of the most beautiful temples in Yogya, apparently built for the princess of the royal family of Ratu Boku. One of my favouritem though as more and more of teh complex gets renovated it goes down further and further in my esteem

The current Indonesian government approved temple renovation style tends to obliterate any of the meaning and spiritualism of a place and leave it as a neat and manageable tourist attraction, very much as an Islamic dominated though tolerant government thinks it should be. Sadly so much meaning and depth is lost in the process, and gone are the days when you could sit amongst the ruins under the stars and meditate without being bothered by guards and bright lights. 

Still, standing on teh edge of the temple as the sunsets, and you see the ancient meridian line of Jl Solo lit up off into the distance, you can easily imagine what this once would have been as pilgrims trudged their way up the hill to make offerings. Well worth a visit, and a great day trip if you add in a few of the other magical temples around it. Talk sweetly to the guards and u may enter at night or stay late to watch the sunset, even more sweetly, and enter at midnight with some incense sticks to experience what it once must have been, for so many people, for so long
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Сам храм меня не впечатлил, однако виды, которые открываются с края обрыва, невероятные, на десятки километров простирается долина, в которой расположена Джога. Стоимость 10000. Стоит посетить только из-за панорамных видов.

dengan tiket hanya Rp5000 saja kita sudah bisa masuk ke area candi ijo, memang tidak besar tapi karena berada di dataran tinggi pemandangan menjadi sangat bagus terutama sore hari. cocok untuk yang suka fotografi.

If you searching for alternative temples to visit, I personally recommend you to visit this temple and Plaosan temple (in different area)

First, this temple is not 'commercialized' yet, so the entrance fee is so cheap (cost 5-10K rupiahs) compared with Prambanan, Borobudur and Ratu Boko (which cost 40K rupiahs for domestic/ 13 USD for foreigner for each)

Second, usually not too crowded in here, so I found it more enjoyable.

To reach it you should use motorcycle or car, because no public transportation nearby.

This temple located 410 meters above the sea level, so better to visit in the morning to get the 'blue sky' background for perfect pictures.

ブランバナン寺院を見学してからボコの丘に行きサンセットを見ようと計画していましたが、渋滞のために予想より時間がかかり、ボコの丘に着いた時にはゲートクローズでした。そこで私が残念がったところドライバーさんが気を利かせて連れて行ってくれました。
驚くほどの急勾配の道をかなり登ったところにあります。寺院そのものは規模が小さくがっかりというクチコミも見かけましたが、そこからのサンセットは本当に素晴らしいものでした。連日雨が降っていたのに、その日は朝から快晴で本当に本当に素晴らしいサンセットが見られました。
寺院というよりはサンセットがオススメなのでぜひ夕方に訪れてみてください。

Terletak di dataran tinggi menjadikan candi ijo menjadi candi tertinggi di jogya.
Bentuknya kecil jika dibandingkan candi yang lain,  namun dicandi ini kita bisa menikmati sunset yang mewah dan pemandangan yang luas dan Biaya retribusi pun tidak mahal
One of the best place to get best view of sunrises and sunsets.it is located near Ratu Boko and Prambanan Temple. You can also see airplanes take off from Adisucipto International Airport
The temple itself is not special but the views especially at sunset are absolutely spectacular. A very romantic place.

Ketika kami mengunjungi obyek wisata tebing breksi, pulangnya kami akan ke Goa Maria Sendang Sri Ningsih yang berjarak hanya 2,8 Km saja. Ternyata perjalanan melewati Candi Ijo. Candi ijo biarpun situs kecil tapi suasana n view disini ga kalah dengan yang lain, sunset yang syahdu apalagi kalo pas sepi suasananya .. hihihihi ...tiket murah meriah, bersih. MANTAP JAYA!

Candi Ijo nampaknya kalah pamor dengan candi-candi lain di Yogya. Namun setelah anda mengunjunginya, sebenarnya ini adalah suatu permata yang tersembunyi. Dari candi ini, pemandangan ke bawah sangat luar biasa. Karena tidak begitu banyak pengunjung, maka kita juga dapat menikmati ketenangan alam yang begitu damai disini. Pastikan kendaraan dalam kondisi prima, karena tanjakan yang curam menuju candi ijo.
I have to admit to way up here was a complete struggle, but compared with the view nothin beat it. There a tons unsolved puzzle scatter in the ground.
Alternatief voor de duur geworden Ratu Boko zonsondergang. Maar de zon moet wel schijnen. Het is behoorlijk klimmen om het plateau te bereiken.

Tempatnya agak jauh dari pusat kota ya, waktu itu kesini buat liat sunset dan sekalian hunting foto sama temne kantor. Biaya masuknya jg murah, 5 ribu kalo ga salah. Lebih direkomendasikan kalo kesini pake kendaraan pribadi.

Instead of heading to Ratu Boko, you can come here to watch Sunset. Amazing non-block view. There's a counter to collect small fee, however, we reach around 30minutes before the sunset and the man told us to just enter without paying any fee.

it was great time enjoying the view from Ijo Temple far away from the hustle and bustle of Yogyakarta city. It is one of the 10 famous temples in Yogyakarta, with very stunning view. we combine this visit with nearby attraction Breksi Cliff and also Ratu Boko Temple (Palace), a 4 km area from Ijo Temple. Imo, the best way going around combining these places is by motorcycle. from Yogyakarta downtown is around 18 km. 

as far as I know, not easy to reach this place by public transportation. I suggest, if you’re solo travel or duo, just rent a motorcycle from so many rentals in Yogyakarta city, then you can easily combine with other interesting attractions. it is not difficult to fine this place as there is clear indication from the main road.
Saya jogging dari sawah bawah ke candi ijo.. Capek ga terasa setelah sampai atas karena pemandangannya yang indah
Jalan nya lumayan menantang. Tapi sampai tempat semuanya terbayar dengan indahnya Yogyakarta dari ketinggian. Lebih ciamik lagi kalo sampai sana pas matahari tenggelam. You will never leave there...

Seru dan Menarik, itu yang bisa saya ungkapkan, perjalanan kesini dibilang lumayan ekstrim, jalanan nanjak dan bahkan kalau untuk kendaraan yang tidak kuat nanjak dijamin akan bermasalah, tapi sesampainya diatas akan dibuat takjub dan kagum, keindahan candi dan keindahan alamnya tiada dua nya.

We were told that this is the highest place in yogyakarta (Jogja) and hence worth visiting for the sunset. Since we missed the borobudur sunrise we went to this place for sunset which was a good experience.

Another temple in jogjakarta, the location still the same are with breksi cliff, about 3minutes from breksi cliff. The temple is not so big, only 1 big temple and 3small ones. When i came here the entrance fee is free because it's august, normaly you only pay 5k idr for entrance ticket. The area is on the mountain or hill so you can see a nice view from the temple. Nothing special on this temple but still if you love photography you will like it, you will have a nice photo shoot over there.

Quite expensive at 10000 rupiah to enter compared to the much more impressive Plaosan at 3000 or Taman Sari in Yogyakarta at 15000 but then you realise its still less that $1. Not a lot here, a few temples but more importantly on a clear day a good view of the surrounding countryside.
This place is popular among tourist because of the sunset view. I got there at 4.30 pm and I could get the view of Yogyakarta city from above.

Sangat suka dengan candi ini....karena letaknya paling tinggi diantara candi lainnya di jogja,terletak di 410m diatas permukaan laut...maka udaranya sejuk..di parkirannya ada lereng Ijo,yang mempunyai spot photo menarik.

Bila menghadap ke arah barat dan memandang ke bawah, anda bisa melihat pesawat take off dan landing di Bandara Adisutjipto. 
Dari sini anda juga akan melihat Candi Prambanan di kejauhan, serta candi Boko
Setiap detail candi menyuguhkan sesuatu yang bermakna dan mengajak penikmatnya untuk berimajinasi ke masa lampau membuat perjalanan wisata tak sekedar ajang bersenang-senang, tetapi napak tilas sejarah babat jawa.
Banyak terdapat hasil karya pahat batu di masanya yang sangat mengagumkan, jika di lihat ada perpaduan antara Candi Budha dan Hindu.

This temple is one of Hindu's cultural heritage in Indonesia. I guess it's worth to see every relief in the temple and understand the meaning and know the history.

Other temple's nearby is "Candi Ratu Boko" or Ratu Boko temple.

This is one of thousand Hindus tample in indonesia i am immpress for this heritages, beautiful view on the top of ijo hills and we can see yogyakarta and sunset here but when i visited this place the sky was cloud. I will be back again.

Located in high places so we can see Yogyakarta city from above, also Adi Sucipto runway (if the sky is clear). They've been renovating the small temples to complete the site. But it still can be visited to get a good photoshots.

Ijo temple is a hidden gem, well off the beaten path, but so worth seeing it. Judging by the complete lack of foreign tourists, I'm guessing not many tours includes it on their map. 
It's best you hire a bike or some other transportation because it's a shame to miss it. The temple itself is not much, but the journey itself is breathtaking.
Ijo is perched on top of a hill, and as you go up you'll get a taste of Indonesian countryside, with people working the fields, green rice paddies and lovely small houses. It's real Indonesia, the way anyone interested in local culture would like to see it, away from the noisy and crowded cities.
You can make as many detours as you would like on the way, to get a closer look at people working in the rice fields and go about their daily lives. 
Highly recommend it ( too bad I can't post any pictures, as for some reason the trip advisor app doesn't recognise my photos )

Candi ini tutup jam 18.00. Pemandangan di candi ini sangat bagus. Kita bisa melihat bandara dan kota Yogyakarta dari Atas. Jika tidak mendung, sunset di Candi ini juga sangat Indah. VERY NICE PLACE with the cheap price
I went here last month with my friends and the ticket was cheap only 5.000 per person. you can take a beautiful picture here but I'm so upset cause when I arrived there's rainy

salah satu objek arkeologi bermazab Hindu yang dikelilingi percandian bermazab Budha terletak di ketinggian, memerlukan waktu dan tenaga untuk mencapai tempat ini sekitar 30 menit dari pusat kota Jogja. Review Text: This Hindu temple is on a hill a couple of kilometres from Ratu Boko Temple. From the temple you can see the surrounding countryside and the city as well as the airport. Ijo Temple was built in the 9th century. Entrance is free and it is an alternative spot for viewing sunset.

Bagi pengagum wisata sejarah, di candi ini juga dapat ditemui karya yang masih menyimpan misteri yang tercantum pada sebuah prasasti.
Prasasti itu terletak pada teras ke-9 yang bertulisan Guywan atau Bhuyutan yang berarti pertapaan.
Prasasti lainnya yang terbuat dari batu berukuran 14 cm dan tebal 9 cm tercantum mantra-matra yang diperkirakan berisi kutukan “Om sarww­awinasa, sarwwawinasa” yang bertulis berulang hingga 16 kali.
Hingga kini masih belum terkuak peristiwa apa yang berhubungan dengan prasasti tersebut.
This is also a group of temples located on the hill top where from you get panoramic view on all the sides. The temples are approached through a flight of steps.

Ini candi terletak diatas bukit.. dari sini kelihatan pemandangan yg indah, dan sorenya kita bisa lihat sunset.. luar bisa.. benar-benar istimewa... Salah satu tempat wisata yang wajib Anda kunjungi jika ke Jogjakarta.

This temple is built in the 10th century. The temple compound is located in Groyokan hamlet, Sambirejo village, Kecamatan Prambanan, Sleman Regency, Yogyakarta. The temple's name derived from its location, the Gumuk Ijo hill. It is located 4 kilometers southeast from Ratu Boko archaeological compound. The temple has got great views and this place has great views of the sunset. This temple is a temple of Shiwa and Nandi and rest of the temple is in ruins but a must visit for anyone to Yogyakarta.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Sangat sukaaa sm tempat ini. Lokasinya dekat dengan tebing breksi.
Salah 1 candi paling tinggi di yogya krna letaknya berada di atas bukit.
Tiket masuknya pun seiklasnya. Tidak mematok tarif.
Krna tidak terlalu banyak yg datang kesini, tempatnya masih sangat asri, sangat bagus viewnya ketika datang sunset.

Situé au sud de Prambanan et de Ratu Boko (à environ 15mn de voiture de ce dernier), ce petit temple attire peu les touristes non indonésiens (De fait nous étions les seuls). Il est cependant extrêmement mignon et en très bon état car restauré il y a peu. D'autres parties sont d'ailleurs en cours de rénovation.
Situé en haut d'une colline, il offre une très belle vue sur les environs (pas sur Prambanan malheureusement) et mérite définitivement le détour.

Terletak di ketinggian 375 dpl, cukup sejuk, belum terlalu ramai pengunjung. Ada 3 candi kecil dan 1 candi utama yang besar. Pemandangan cukup menyejukkan mata, lingkungan yang bersih, dan suasana yang damai.
Outre le fait que ce temple vaille le coup d'oeil, la vue depuis le site sur   les environs, la quiétude du lieu fréquenté par les étudiants du coin font qu'il ne faut pas hésiter à grimper la côte!

Review Text: при посещении этих храмов дул и завывал ветер, становилось немного страшновато, сам храм находиться в плохом состоянии местами даже зарос мхом, но в целом нам понравилось.

Review Text:
La guida ci ha consigliato di vedere il tramonto da questo tempio anziché dal gettonatissimo Candi Prambanan.
Ve lo consiglio sopratutto per la vista e per il fatto che sarete forse gli unici occidentali...

Nice place to see the sun sets.
I came here twice. First time with my friends, second time with my boyfriend. 
I quite like this place because of its view.
You can see jogja city from up above.
three small and one big temple, really nice view from here, suggest to come here in the morning before 11 am

This temple view is just jaw dropping: 0 It is popular to the locals and mainly bit crowded. It is located up on the hill behind or across the Prambanan temple (you can't see the temple). The view overlooks the Yogya province with green ricefields, high hills, the jogja city and many more. No fee is needed here, just write name on the security counter at the entrance and you're good to go :)

This temple is not big, but the view is superb.
When i go there, there's no ticketing fee. Only fill the guest book.
It will be better if you go there to see sunset.
This relatively modest classical Javanese temple is refined in its details, but is most popular with the locals because of its great view across the central Java plain.

По дороге в этот храм единственный раз за всю поездку нас прихватил настоящий экваториальный ливень. Повезло, что длилось это недолго - примерно полчаса, мы как раз взобрались в горку, и храм был как будто свежеумытым. В верхней части холма расположен один храм побольше и несколько мелких, откуда открывается вид на долину и леса. Чуть ниже (можно спуститься по лесенке) - нижняя часть комплекса, где еще ведутся раскопки и часть ступ восстанавливают в режиме реального времени (там осторожнее, потому что прыгать по узким доскам надо умеючи). Нам с мужем также показалось, что есть еще нижняя часть комплекса, но она покрыта лесом (руины угадываются среди деревьев), наверное, потом и до них руки дойдут. В паре минут на машине чуть ниже по холму есть еще бывший строительный карьер, где на скале постоянно кто-то позирует на фоне видов (так себе) и флага Индонезии (при нас там был школьный класс, который оглушительно визжал).

We were recommended to visit Candi Ijo instead of Ratu Boko and we had no regrets! We went there after going to Prambanan. The view of Yogyakarta was amazing as well. No admission fee as of March 2016.

If you have plan to visit Ratu Boko temple, do not miss this temple. The location more higher than Ratu Boko and the road is narrow and rough. No ticket fee just give donation. The view is breathtaking you can see the part of Yogyakarta city.

Very hazy day, but sunset would have been great if it was a clear day. Counted twenty stone masons working on repairs to structures on property. Road to the temple is in need of serious repair. Saw 7 temples on the day and this was least favorite. Paid 10,000 rupiah for entry.

This temple is set on top of a hill that provides amazing views over the valley and is worth the drive just for the photo op.  Beautiful scenery all around make this small temple worth and hour of your time for a visit.
The road is a little bit narrow and rocky, but once you reached to the temple, the view is just breathtaking. The sunset is so beautiful. It makes you feel like you're among the clouds.

My driver took me up to Candi Ijo on the 3rd day of my 4 days in Jogja.  I was looking for a spot to watch the sunset and he recommended this place.  It's absolutely gorgeous.  The temples are in pretty good condition but it's the view that's the draw for me.  You can see all of Jogja spread out below in the valley.  The rain was coming so I regrettably didn't get to see the actual sunset but I'm still glad I went up the hill to Ijo Temple.  Go, you'll love the view.  Plus, IT'S FREE!!

Ijo temple is one of the hidden secrets known only to the locals (no entrance fee) to view the evening sunset by the Prambanan area, which is even higher in elevation than the famous Ratu Boko; which charges a high entrance fee.
We enjoyed the peace and quietness around the temple; watching planes taking off & landing on the air strip while waiting for the magnificent sunset to appear.
The temple itself is stunning and there are restoration works going on  at the moment.
Highly recommended, ask the locals on how to get there.

Un rendez vous des jeunes qui viennent admirer le coucher du soleil sur les montagnes et se photographier les uns les autres.
Bon, pour nous, pas de coucher  de soleil car trop de nuages ce soir là. La route mériterai une bonne remise en état. L'entrée est gratuite, juste son nom à inscrire sur un registre, mais pourquoi, mystère...
Par contre, le retour à Jodja, bonjour les embouteillages.
À vous de voir, c'est le cas de le dire.😜

If you go to Ratu Boko, you should pay unexpected high admission fee, therefore Candi Ijo perhaps is an ideal place to enjoy sunset without paying any except the parking fee of your vehicle. This Hindu temple is on a hilltop that there is no hindrance for viewing from all directions. Without a motorbike for a bumpy ride, I am afraid you cannot easily reach your destination; it is because the road is too steep. If you walk on foot to its top for hours, you may definitely out of breath. After four o'clock at noon, the temple is usually full of local tourists, and most of them are students. They are sitting on steps for at least two hours in order to wait for the sundown. As the area is too huge that there is no feeling of sardine-packed with people. Inside the  temple, you may find a linga as well as a bull-like stone, but the room is typically dark indeed. With paddy fields and scattered houses under your feet, the fresh breeze is also a bonus.
Jika berkunjung ke bukit breksi jangan sampai terlewatkan objek yang satu ini, kawasan wisatanya sangat sejuk hawanya, selain free tiket masuk kita bisa juga melihat pemandangan jogja dari atas candi

Nice place to enjoy the view of Jogja and the sunset or sunrise :)
More quiet than the other temple ^^
Many beautiful ancient temples, but the best is the amazing view that you can see from there and it is not full of people like the other temples.

Candi Ijo letaknya paling tinggi dkbanding candi lainnya  berada sekitar 410 m dpl. Wisatawan tidak hanya menikmati bangunan candi saja tetspi pemandangan alam nan indah. Ragam bentuk seni dan rupa dijumpai sejak pintu masuk candi Hindu ini. Tepat di pintu masuk dijumpai Kala makara denga  motif kepala ganda dan atributnya ini juga ada pada candi Budha berarti ini menunjukkan bahwa candi ini menggabungkan unsur Hkndu dan Budha.  Wisatawan apabila menghadap ke barat dan memandang ke bawah bisa melihat pesawat di Bandara Adisucipto. Panorama di sekitar ini memang sangat indah.
temples location is very unique because it's on the limestone's hill, the layout is not like solar system, the temples hegiht medium. took 1 hour from the downtown, and the entrance was FREE

This temple is located on the Ijo Hill and the location is really amazing as the view from the temple is really beautiful and scenery. Went here after Visit Ratu Boko. Entrance is free and only paid for parking, IDR5000 so this is a must do for everyone visiting Jogja.

Ideal place for both history lovers and Nature lovers.

Review Text: ini adalah candi yg letaknya paling tinggi di jogja, diarah yang sama kita juga bisa jumpai tebing breksi, sebuah destinasi baru di jogja..tidak terlalu mengesan tapi lumayanlah

I visited Chandi Ijo for to watch the evening sunset. It was towards end of March and there was showers daily in the evening so i was not sure if would be able to catch the sunset however i went ahead with my plan.

To my surprise, this was one of the better evening i had in Jogya though i could not have a clear Sun set..

The place itself so serene and beautiful and had very little people visiting here, hardly any tourists (atleast outside of indonesia). 

I took the opportunity to chat up with the locals who had come from Jogya and surrounding villages, Posed & took photos which students who were visiting Yogya, Slept beneth the sky as long as i could, walked barefoot in the surrounding gardens, got soaked in the rain a little bit, saw the glorious sky colours after dusk and had discussed the theory of earth being flat & how the landing of the moon was a conspiracy by US govt with by brother

Some of the best things in life are free, so have i heard and this was probably is one of then and only in Jogya.  No entry fee :-)

Overall, a great evening & couldn't ask for more

If you went to Ratu Boko temple, you have to visit this temple too. It's located in the east of Ratu Boko temple. Here you can see the beautiful sunset and the plane while take off from the airport. Really great view and it's free.
Schitterend uitzicht over de stad en omliggende gebied. Ze zijn de tempel nog aan het restaureren wat erg interessant is om te zien. Entree van de tempel is gratis, ze vragen om een vrijwillige gift.
While the temple is pretty average and not very big, it's worth taking a trip up here to see the sunset over the whole of Yogyakarta

как обычно, интересно полазать по развалинам, но постоянно фотографирующиеся с селфи-палками индонезийцы начинают раздражать немного, хахха

на закате вид очень хороший!
To reach ijo temple need some effort. I traveled with motorbike to get to the place. You will find good view when you reach the temple. Some of the temple are repaired when i was there

candi ijo memang belum banyak diketahui orang, letaknya berada di tinggian/bukit. meskipun kalah pamor dengan candi2 di sekitarnya, seperti ratu book, namun pemandangan disini tidak kalah cantik. sangat cocok jika ingin hunting foto sunset. untuk masuk ke candi ini tidak dikenakan biaya retribusi, hanya biaya parker kendaraan saja

We found out about this hindu temple through the internet and decided to visit since it was our fourth trip to Jogja and we had already seen the other main temples and tourist sites. We were a group of 10 and traveled by van. Candi (temple) Ijo is about 18km from Jogja and is located on top of Gumuk Ijo hill which is the highest point in Jogja. Go in the evening to catch the beautiful sunset and witness an amazing event. Beware of the ride up the hill though, it's bone-shaking ! The narrow road weaving through the dusty villages is very bumpy and we were almost thrown out of our seats ! Entry to the temple is free, donations are accepted. A short staircase climb and we were in the temple area. It was not as crowded as Prambanan, mostly students and young couples were around. The environment was cool and peaceful with good views of paddy fields and surrounding areas. There are a number of temples here, most were empty except for the bigger temple which housed a huge lingam and yoni (Shiva & Shakti). The temple is quite dark due to the high layered pyramid like roof. Directly opposite and facing the temple is a smaller candi housing Nandi, (Shiva's vehicle, the bull). The sun sets behind the Nandi temple, but the rays of the setting sun somehow fall directly on the base of the lingam. As the sun goes down, the rays travel upwards on the lingam and light up the entire temple brightly. A beautiful moment lasting maybe 5 minutes. We felt blessed and awed by the amazing skill of the people who built the temple. The authorities have discovered a lot of temples in the immediate vicinity and so this area will likely become more famous and crowded soon.

This temple is under renovation but still open for public.
Ijo means Green, but don't know yet the relevancy .
Its nice to see but be careful of the bricks.

I know I came in a bad time around 11am when it's super hot and muggy, but hey! At least this place is free to visit. The site is fairly far from prambanan/ratu boko, and it is located on top of a big hill. The path on going up is crazy with a lot of holes and super steep road. The site itself consists of one main temple and three small ones. Inside on of them has a cute sitting cow inside. That was literally the highlight if my visit. The rest just have some reliefs inside and well kept arcas. Maybe this place would look a lot better on a sunset setting.

Candi Ijo tidak setenar candi Prambanan atau candi Borobudur. Terletak agak jauh dari candi2 tersebut. Candi ini berada di perbukitan yang jalanannya pu  masih rusak dan belum ada biaya masuk untuk berkunjung ke sini.

Kita hanya akan dimintai nama dan asal kita. Komplek candi ini memiliki 4 candi, 1 candi utama dan 3 candi kecil. Sepi sekali di sini. Ketika saya ke sana hanya ada 6 orang yang sedang duduk santai memandangi kota jogja dari atas bukit.

Selain menikmati budaya sejarah di sini, kita juga bisa meneropong jogja dan daerah sekitarnya. Karena letaknya yang tinggi, udaranya cukup sejuk dan anginnya kencang. 

Semoga ke depannya para pengunjung tetap bisa menjaga kebersihan candi Ijo.

The way to Ijo temple is a long steep way uphill
Is very interesting and u can see a long the way local people and their houses
From Ijo  temple to view sunset is very unique ,free and beautiful because can view on the yogyakarta airport and all the plane will seems like fly thru the sunset makes the picture more attractive
