Von diesem Tempel kann man den Prambanan Tempel sehen, schön bei Sonnenuntergang. Allerdings sehr weit weg und inzwischen wurde vor den Prambanan eine moderne Markthalle gebaut, die den Tempel teilweise bedeckt und das Bild vom Ratu Boko aus verschandelt. Der Eintrittspreis ist sehr hoch (so hoch wie zum Prambanan), dafür gibt es wenig Interessantes zu sehen. Kann man sich schenken, lieber eine Stunde mehr im Prambanan verbringen.

Candi yang indah, khusunya waktu sunset. Tersedia juga restoran dan beberapa spot foto. Lokasi yang luas dengan rerumputan yang menyegarkan.
Historic & esthetic.
If you come here, i would suggest you to coming for sunset. Because the atmosphere so romantic especially when sunset
This temple is very auspicious and famous among the local people and they usually visit this temple everyday in the morning.

Tiket masuk candi ratu boko bisa dibeli sekaligus di loket candi prambanan (harga paket). Jadi kita akan diantar pake mini bus dari prambanan. Jalanan menanjak bikin deg-degan. Setelah sampai wow amazing.. Bersih, sejuk dan terasa sekali nilai sejarah nya.. Banyak spot keren untuk foto disini..

This temple appears to be privately owned and charges foreigners eight times more than locals.

It gives Indonesian tourism a bad name
Deze tempel in niet te vergelijken met Prambanam of Borobudur, maar heeft toch iets bijzonders. Wij hadden het geluk de tempel tegen zonsondergang te bezoeken, hetgeen een bijzondere ervaring was
Visited this place and felt like a total rip off. With US$25 entrance fee there's nothing much to see here. For sunset you can go to Candi Ijo instead.

Dont be afraid to bring your baby here.   Ratu boko nice view just a litle hot but its ok buktinya anakku 23 bulan bahagia banget running on field at ratu boko tanpa sendal or sepatu. Hahaha 

Btw. Yg ga gt suka sejarah mungkin bosan tp sy suka sekali. Its very beautiful here candinya udh ga utuh seh tapi pemandangannya indah... 

Apalagi sunsetnya makin sore pengunjung makin banyak hahahaha.. worth it seh.. its the most beautiful sunset here .. hehehe next u must visited ratu boko.

We went to Ratu Boko at the end of the day in order to see the sunset.  We walked around the grounds beforehand...some interesting places to see but overall not as nice as other temples in the area.  We waited for the sunset....and then there were clouds!  So we didn't get to see much.  Still, it was pretty so see the sun peeking out behind the temple gate before we headed back.
This place now (9/2017)charges 325K rp for foreigners, the same as borobudur and prambanan temple although its standing is far from on par.

Ratu Boko (Ratu Boko palace) is just 3-4 kms from the more popular Prambanan temple complex. Generally tourists both foreigners and locals visit for the beautiful sunset. 
its better to visit Prambanan and then visit this palace ruins for sunset. A few steps leads to a well maintained garden and then the large main gate leads to the ruins of the palace complex. One can find  a local group singing at the entrance.Turn left and climb to the highest point of this site for the best views.There are many archeological ruins at this level of the palace complex and still restoration work is going on.
Its not a must visit on once itinerary but if u have time between Prambanan temple visit and Ramayan ballet show then u can find some time for this site visit.

Salah satu spot yang bagus dikunjungi selain karena ada nilai sejarah, namun juga karena tempat yang bagus untuk melihat matahari terbenam (sunset).
Lokasi diatas bukit yang wajib dikunjungi sesudah melihat Candi Prambanan karena berdekatan. 
Meskipun bekas istana sudah tidak ada, namun petilasan dan sisa-sisa bangunan masih bisa dilihat, diantaranya bekas pintu gerbang. Justru lokasi bekas pintu gerbang ini sangat banyak disukai oleh fotografer untuk lokasi pemotretan.

jujur saya kesini karena melihat film aadc 2 :) hehehe candi nya kecil tapi bagus, masih dalam proses pemugaran dan perapihan, tetapi utk biaya masuk nya termasuk mahal menurut saya. Fasilitas musholla dan tempat makan tersedia didalam candi, tetapi kebetulan ketika saya kesana cuaca sedang panas sekali.

Gak rugi menelusuri Reruntuhan Candi Ratu Boko atau Kraton Ratu Boko di siang hari. Meskipun panas menyengat, namun terbayar oleh bayangan kemegahan Kraton Ratu Boko.
Konon katanya, saat yang paling bagus menikmati reruntuhan Ratu Boko adalah saat Sun-set.

Saat memasuki tempat ini, saya terkagum karena tempat ini dahulu adalah kompleks istana raja yang luas. Entah dari kerajaan mana Keraton Ratu Boko dibangun. Banyak sekali puing reruntuhan. Saya harap ada penelitian lebih lanjut tentang kompleks keraton ini.
this place have a great view, especially in sunset time, have a good acces from the main way, n any good employe in this place is so friendly, i sugested this place for family or romantic vacation

Lokasi Keraton Ratu Boko ini tidak jauh dari Candi Prambanan, waktu itu saya menggunakan bus shuttle yang berangkat dari candi prambanan paket gitu dari prambanan nya bayar 100rb ke 4 tempat dan tujuan terakhir nya di kraton ratu boko, kalau biaya masuk nya aja di ratu boko itu sekitar 45k, jarak dari tempat masuk ke komplek ratu boko ya luar biasa jauh dan harus menaiki anak tangga,, capek banget sih kalau kesini tapi tebayar ketika melihat sisa-sisa peninggalan sejarah ini , untuk berkeliling kesemua tempat disini butuh tenaga ekstra sih kalo menurut saya, karena luas banget tempatnya,,
Candi ratu Boko ini akan lebih nyaman jika dikunjungi saat sore hari atau jika beruntung pas sunset, maka kita akan mendapat foto yang keren.
Istana Ratu Boko or Ratu Boko Temple is one of the boring place to visit in Jogja. For me there is nothing interesting in here.

Lokasinya tidak jauh dari komplek Candi Prambanan. Candi Ratu Boko berada di perbukitan dan meliputi beberapa objek. Pemandangan sangat indah di sore hari dan cocok untuk melihat sunset. Ada restoran yang dapat dipilih untuk menikmati senja.

We had a rough day starting from borobudur to merapi to prambanan and then to ratu boko.

I thought ratu boko is just next to prambanan and I was wrong . 

You could actually buy cheaper tickets by combining prambanan and ratu boko. The combined adult tickets can be bought at prambanan. If you want half price for kids, you need to buy separately in ratu boko and prambanan 

I don't think it's worth it to visit ratu boko. Maybe because we visited too many temples in one day and my 9 year old preferred to be in the guide's car than to follow us to ratu boko. My 11 year old was ok

In short, if you have time to spare, it's ok to visit ratu boko, but if you're too tired, don't worry because you're not missing a lot

Sempet jalan ke candi ratu boko, ya krn berangkatnya dah sore dari hotel yg di prawirotaman walhasil kesorean, padahal driver dah ngebut bgt, tetep gak keburu, dengan harga tiket masuk 35 rb yang kita masuk dah jam 5 lewat dan jam 6 dah hrs keluar, kita miss sunset nya, cuma dapet meganya aja

Jika anda ingin mendapatkan sunset ditempat ini maka setidaknya anda harus tiba ditempat sekitar pukul 16.00 sehingga 1 jam untuk mengelilingi candi ini dan ketika pukul 17.00 anda berkumpul di gerbang candi ijo untuk mencari spot terbaik mengambil gambar sunset. Luar biasa indah! Sangat direkomendasikan kesini disaat liburan.

Nice and great improvement of developing the park.
Short visit but was nice..very recommended to visit, soecially with some cabanas and chaurs to sit and relaxed after walking in the heat.
Good place to take photographs of sunset. Do take note that it's very crowded with tourists though so take the perfect picture will not be easy.

This is a must-see while in Jogja. This is an enormous archaeological site, brilliantly curated and beautifully presented. They are early in the restoration process and archaeological work continues but it is already spectacular. Not only is the location itself spectacular but the views are as well -- especially sunset!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Saya mengunjungi Candi Ratu Boko pada sore hari dan cuaca saat itu gerimis dengan menggunakan transit bus dari Candi Prambanan dengan membayar tiket terusan. Dari mulai masuk saya sudah di suguhi anak tangga yang cukup banyak, komplek ini cukup luas ,pemandangannya sangat bagus, salah satu situs yang menarik buat saya yaitu tempat pembakaran mayat. tidak terbayang kalau di lobang yang cukup besar itu sudah banyak mayat yang di bakar. satu hal yang sangat disayangkan dari tempat ini adalah fasilitas penunjang yang tidak di jaga, toilet disini sangat kotor bahkan tidak ada air yang mengalir.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The ruins are nice, and it takes a nice walk to look around. We did not have a nice sunset due to some clouds and afterwards we were too late to take the Prambanan-Ratu Boko shuttle bus :) I think the sunset should be beautiful though! If you have enough time, it is worth it!

Masih di dekat komples Prambanan ada peninggalan sejarah yang cukup baik dengan puing-puing yang sebagian bisa ditata kembali. Pemandagan cukup bagus, walaupun sebaiknya membawa payung kalau ke sini, karena jika panas atau hujan akan susah mencari tempat berteduh
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Waktu kesana sayangnya lagi mendung jadi sunsetnya kurang bagus. Tapi pemandangan disini benar2 indahh 😍❤
Ngga jauh juga dari pusat kota
Después de visitar Candi Prambanan este templo queda un poco apagado... en realidad solo tiene la curiosa puerta por el que ver un bonito atardecer

Tempat ini memiliki daya tarik sunset yang luar biasa.
sayangnya hari itu saya tidak mendapat kesempatan karena langit berawan. tapi overall tempat ini luar biasa.
Went to east Jogja driving scooter around and found the biggest temple called Ratu Boko. Still Expensive but was having great walk, keep going down after and you will find many hidden temple around.

Kawasan Candi masih dekat dari Candi Prambanan. Dari puncak pun bisa mengambil gambar Candi Prambanan.
Sangat disarankan untuk datang di sore hari. View sunsetnya sangat mempesona.
Kalau langit cerah, Gunung Merapi bisa terlihat dari sini.
Dari halte TransJogja, bisa memakai andong/delman dan perjalanan melewati rel kereta dan sawah yang menggugah selera.
Siapkan air minum karena akan menaiki banyak anak tangga.
Atau kalau mau, di dekat pelataran ada penjual kelapa muda.

Ratu Boko is about 15 minutes away from Prambanan temple. Ratu Boko isn't really a temple, but a it was believed to be a palace for the king (ratu means queen). The main gate is an Instagram-worthy spot. Again, get a local tour guide as this area comes with some history and story which can be quite interesting. After scouring through the area, relax at the restaurant while waiting for sunset as the restaurant gives you the best spot for sunset.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Pourquoi payer autant (325 000idr/per) pour si peu...
Rien à voir avec les deux autres temples autour de Yogyakarta et pourtant... Même prix!
C'est tout simplement du vol...

En plus, ce n'est pas un temple Mais des ruines de palace...
Ok c'est propre et La balade sur le petit m'ont est agréable... Mais c'est vraiment tout...

Un conseil, ne perdez ni votre temps ni votre argent...

Pour essayer de compenser ce prix exorbitant, ils offrent un "repas" au restaurant... Riz et thé ? La blague continue... Et pour couronner le tout, faut payer Le parking...

Lamentable!!

Prix exorbitant pour un semblant de temple.
Autant Prambanan et Borodorur peuvent (à La limite) prétendre un prix similaire mais là c'est du foutage de gueule!
Je déconseille à 100%

First i came and see this temple i was surprised, because i never thought that the temple can be very big, i am sure the temple was very big on the past. The entrance ticket is 40k idr for local, and 25usd for foreigner. There is a hmm look like a gate which is very nice and instagramable. Specialy if you take a picture during sunset time. From the gate temple you will see a beautiful sunset. For suggestion, if you visit this temple you can make it as a package, which mean you can visit ijo temple, breksi cliff, ratu boko temple, and last is in prambanan temple and catching sunset, or you can switch whatever you want. Happy travelling.

Ratu Boko famous for it's sunset spot, if you lucky enough you will see the sun framed around the gate of the temple. They have a nice restaurant with mount merapi view. The food selection is vary, tastes quite nice. I Recommend you to visit Ratu boko in afternoon on weekday, bring some good books and sit under the tree on top of the temple. You need to have a stronger vehcile to go up the ratu boko temple because it's a bit hilly ride

Ci siamo capitate per sbaglio xe volevamo vedere il tramonto da Prambanan ma qui il sole tramonta alle 17:30 e prambanan chiude alle 17:00🙈
Comunque su consiglio del tassista che ci ha accompagnato siamo venute a vedere il tramonto qui...carino anche se pieno di gente quindi impossibile da fotografare ma caro all'inverosimile per quel che offre!
Un bel parco enorme e 2 ruderi di tempio in croce X 325000 IDR (circa 21€) secondo me è un ladrocinio! Ah dimenticavo nel prezzo ti offrono un caffè o un the 😏 grazie tante....
Candinya bagus apalagi kalau kesni sore hari, pemandangannya bagus. Buat yang suka fotografi, tempat ini cocok, viewnya bagus.

Awesome view of sunset. A guide is recommended if you want to understand the place fully as most of the place is not there anymore. Restrooms are very far from the attraction but you can buy some drinks along the way.

llegamos a Ratu Boko antes del atardecer y nos hicieron pagar en una caja solo para extranjeros. El precio abusivo unos 20 euros!!! pero bueno, nos dijeron que incluia la cena.. y accedimos a pagar.

Estuvimos viendo el templo, que por cierto lo único que merece la pena es el atardecer, porque el templo o ruinas en si es muy poca cosa, NO pagaría por ello de nuevo, aunque fuera mas barato.

Llega el momento en que vamos a ir a por la cena y llegamos al restaurante, nos dicen si queremos café, te o refresco y pedimos refresco. Nos sientan en una mesa y nosotros esperando, no vienen, les llamas y nada... Ya pasado un rato nos levantamos y vamos a hablar con el camarero y nos dice:
que como hemos pedido refresco, no hay cena!!! que nuestra cena es ese refresco!!

Nos quedamos estupefactos, les pedimos que nos dieran hojas de reclamaciones porque en ningún momento nos informaron de que si cogíamos refresco nos quedábamos sin cena... y como hoja de reclamaciones nos dieron un folio en blanco. Les dije que eso no era una hoja de reclamación oficial y tras una larga y acalorada discusión en la que les pedimos que nos devolvieran el dinero correspondiente a la cena (cosa a la que se negaron en rotundo), nos dijeron que si queríamos que nos sacaban algo de cenar que ya tuvieran cocinado por la cocina, pero no nos daban lo que nos correspondía!!!

ESTAFADORES!!!

En fin, que nos fuimos muy enfadados y por supuesto no aceptamos su "cena de sobras".  tener muchísimo cuidado con este tema!!

Es el único problema que hemos tenido en un viaje de 16 días por Indonesia (Bali, Gili, Flores (Komodo), Java y Singapur... y queremos advertir a todo el mundo de lo estafadores que son en Ratu Boko, las triquiñuelas que se traen para no ponerte la cena que compras con la entrada.

Por suerte luego nos fuimos a ver el ballet Ramayana en Prambanan y se nos pasó todo el enfado, porque nos encantó!

MUCHO OJO CON ESTO!! SON UNOS ESTAFADORES!!!

A 350 000 roupies par personne ça ne les vaut pas du tout nous avons acheter les billets à Prambanan et avons pris la navette pour y aller . Quelle déception pour le prix il n y a que les portes à l entrée du temple qui vaillent le coup. Après il reste le calme de l endroit et la vue sur Prambanan .

The grab driver recommended that we visit this place and even stated that it is much better than the prambanan temple. We paid like 8-10 more than locals and it was just average. Wasn't much to see for the money we spent. 

Verdict: there are other attractions - e.g. Zoo

These palace ruins are much less impressive than Prambanan and Sewa in the neighborhood, but the space is nice and the location on a hilltop gives great views (also of Prambanan). The entrance fee appeared very high to us, but we still decided to visit (archaeological sites generally need money). It turned out that the entrance fee of 325,000 included a dinner at the local restaurant, which we could not use. Disappointingly we could not get entrance without getting the dinner too. If you go, be aware of this bad practice of combined sales. We made very clear at the ticket office that such sales are bad style. They just smiled and apologized....

El sitio es increíble, su puesta de sol bellísima, merece la pena desviarse unos kilómetros a la vuelta de Prambanan para admirar el Ratu Boko. El único "pero" es que los extranjeros pagan en otra taquilla y el precio es exagerado (para ser Indonesia) y todo porque te incluye una cena quieras o no...no hay opción de entrada sin cena. Total que dos personas 650.000 rupias (40 y pico euros) y la cena decepcionante, te dan a elegir entre Arroz Frito, Fideos fritos y platáno frito. Todo podría ir directo a la basura, no está ni siquiera bueno...
Aún así, por lo espectacular del sitio volvería a pagar e indignarme por el precio jeje.

On est arrivé ici le matinob se disant qu'on allait pas commencer la journée par le meilleur temple (Prambanan). Arrivé ici, billets à 325000/adulte !! Depuis le 1er Mai d'après la personne de l'accueil. Aussi cher que Prambanan ou Borobudur! De qui se moque t'on ? Pour un site bien moins intéressant... Du coup on est reparti à pied, comme on était arrivé, sans le visiter. Ils nous prennent vraiment pour des vaches à lait. On veut bien payer plus cher que les locaux, surtout pour des sites incroyables comme Borobudur. Mais pour un temple mineur comme celui ci il ne faut exagérer.

Tempat ini terletak di pinggiran kota Jogja dan berada di ketinggian. Katanya tempat ini bagus untuk melihat sunset. Kami datang sudah malam hari karena terkena macet, sehingga tidak menikmati sunset. Namun kami masih bisa menikmati pemandangan kota Jogja dan Candi Prambanan di waktu malam.

Mungkin disini cocok ketika ingin melihat matahari tenggelam atau yang mau mencari angel foto yg bagus banyak spot uang bisa dimanfaatkan. Hanya saja harusnya ada tanda atau beberapa tempat yang kurang terawat.
Candi ratu boko,  walaupun tidak seluas candi prambanan dan candi borobudur tapi candi ratu boko ini juga gak kalah bagus

Siapa yang suka berburu sunset ? disinilah tempatnya "Candi Ratu Boko" cocok untuk para pecinta fotografi. Kompleks Ratu Boko ini sangat Luas, saran kalau keisni siang2 bawa payung atau pakai baju panjang. soalnya panas banget :)

Candi ini berlokasi dekat dengan Candi Prambanan sehingga ada baiknya dikunjungi setelah dari Candi Prambanan. Tidak banyak reruntuhan yang tertinggal, tapi terdapat spot-spot terbaik untuk mengambil foto dan sepertinya lebih baik dikunjungi sore hari saat matahari terbenam.
Tempat yang cukup bagus berada diatas bukit tempatnya luas bagus dateng di pagi hari atau sore hari, jangan di siang hari karena lumayan panas

The place is good taken care of.  Be sure to bring your camera for sunset capture.   Good for people looking for historical site tour.
The only cons is the place is getting dark after sunset.   Hopefully they prepare  more lights so after sunset we still have enough light to go. Ack to car park
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
地○の歩き方にも載っている観光地のようだが、チャーターしたドライバー曰く、５月に料金の値上げがあって、広くもないエリアなのに15ドル近くの請求でコスパがよくない。
地元の人が行く近くの丘(ijo temple)に連れてもらっていった。行ってないのに言うのも申しわけないが、見晴らしもよく何ら遜色はないと思う。そちらは入場料は１万ルピアだった。（ジョグジャカルタはボロブドゥールとプランバナンが鉄板だが、それらの入場で50ドル近く）。

Letak nya cukup lumayan jauh dari kota jogja. Sekitar 18 km. Namun tidak begitu jauh dari candi prambanan.

Awal pertama masuk kesini. Yang di perhatikan adalah berapa HTM nya. Cukup mahal, 40 ribu rupiah.

Untuk harga yang demikian, bagi saya candi ratu boko kurang worth it. 
Ukuran candi tidak begitu besar. Hamparan halaman candi tidak seluas prambanan dan borobudur.
Bahkan, lebih bagus candi palosan dan candi sewu jika anda ingib mencari objek foto candi.

Nanum, candi ratu boko menjadi spot foto yang sangat bagus pada saat sunset.
Kesini lah saat menjelang sunset.
Anda akan mendapat kan objek foto yang bagus. Sambil dapat menikmati sunset dan menikmati city light kota jogja dari halaman ratu boko.

Fue el primer templo que visitamos en Java. Habíamos estado en otros lugares y aquí llegamos. Aunque las nubes no nos dejaron disfrutar de la puesta de sol que habitualmente regala a todos sus visitantes.Nos conformamos con la magia de visitarlo,y una bonita charla con nuestro guía en el césped.
18 euro per persoon voor deze plaats is mij echt te gortig. Helemaal als je weet dat de lokale bevolking 3 euro betaalt.
It is an interesting place to reach to begin with. Feels great to be able to come here, the wide place, wide sky can be enjoyed by everyone. It is also exciting to see for the sunset.

Ratu Boko #palace is one of the best sunset spot at #yogyakarta. It's located on hill, so that we could see amazing view of yogyakarta from up high. Btw, the entrance ticket for "sunset time" is way more expensive than reguler one.  There's also a restaurant here. You can have your candle light dinner while enjoying the citylight of yogya.
Suggestion : better not to visit on weekend or holiday, there's a lot of people that you couldnt take good picture of the sunset and temple

First of all, thia temple is good for sunset view. But the sunrise is also good. If you did not want to buy the expensive ticket, you could opted to cone here to watch the sunrise. You could ask for a local to guide you because you will need to enter through a different entrance. You could enjoy the temple by yourself, because there were still a few people come here by morning.

This was sadly the first time we have felt ripped off in Indonesia. There were many prices floating around online for this place, we had to paid 325,000 IDR which was £18.95 for each ticket!

That did include a dinner (which was a tea/coffee or a water and a choice of 3 dishes, we plumped for a very tasty chicken rice dish with salad. One of the other dishes was an interesting one of cheese bananas! There was no ticket option without dinner.

We had read that this was a good place to view the sunset and see the sunset over Prambanan. Prambanan is quite a way in the distance (as you can see from my photo - which is zoomed in) and the sun sets in the opposite direction, so I'm not sure how that is possible! 

The site itself was still beautiful, but there was only one part of the temple that was still standing. 

Nobody was managing the crowds of people and it was pure luck that I managed to get a shot of the sun through one of the temple openings. 

There was an information plaque by one part of the structures, but not a great deal if information about the site. 

The site did in no way justify the huge price tag, which was the same price as Prambanan!

This temple is about 8 times as much for foreign  tourists than locals . Very sad we didn't see it . The restaurant close by was disappointing too drinks were way too sugary and food came was nothing like the photos on the menu . I would say don't bother except the panoramic view is lovely .

Sebelumnya saya tidak berencana untuk mengunjungi situs ini dan memilih untuk pergi ke Candi Prambanan. Ketika di loker tiket, saya ditawari pake untuk tike masuk ke Candi Ratu Boko + Shuttle dan tiket masuk ke Candi Prambanan. Untuk selisih harga yang di tawarkan tidak terlalu jauh dengan tiket masuk ke Candi Prambanan saja.

untuk shuttle nya saya menunggu sekitar 15 menit, karena masih pagi, saya memutuskan untuk mengunjungi Candi Ratu Boko terlebih dahulu kemudian balik lagi ke Candi Prambanan..

Perjalanan ke situs ini sekitar 5 - 10 menit dari Candi Prambanan, shuttle nya sendiri menggunakan minibus. Sesampainya di Candi Ratu Boko, suasana masih sepi, masih  pagi. Suasana yang tepat untuk menjelajah situs. Selain tidak terganggu dengan riuh pengunjung yang biasanya semakin ramai saat siang, cuaca di pagi hari juga tidak terlalu panas jadi tidak ada halangan untuk explore situs Candi Ratu Boko yang lumayan luas.
Fantastic view of not just the sunset but the various attractions from afar. Watch out for Mt Merapi as you stroll up. Its fantastic view. See my photos.
Mengunjungi candi ratu boko merupakan tujuan yang ga akan salah dimana kita bisa menambah wawasan dan sejarah kita
Mejor ver las vistas desde el restaurante justo al lado izquierdo de la entrada principal al templo. Tiene una terraza con mejores vistas que arriba y bebidas por 10.000rp

Memerlukan waktu 30 menit dari stasiun tugu utk sampai ke candi Boko menggunakan motor, menurut saya harga tiket masuk Rp. 40rb agak mahal tetapi situasi terbayarkan dengan view yang ada di dalam lokasi, lingkungan sekitar candi bersih, banyak spot utk berfoto, jika datang siang hari sebaiknya membawa payung karena panas

Historical areas that must be visited in addition to Borobudur and Prambanan temples. Should be accompanied by a guide available at the door counter with the tariff that has been determined, so that we get the understanding and knowledge intact and complete.

In Ratu Boko Palace complex is available restaurant with beautiful view towards Prambanan Temple, with delicious food and reasonable price.
Overall the area is neat and clean.
Beautiful and adds to the knowledge.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: candi ratu boko memang bukan tempat prioritas utama kunjungan wisata, dibanding prambanan(candi sewu atau borobudur) tapi jika kita coba untuk datang dan dapat menarik pengunjung dengan begitu candi ini dapat di perindah dan percantik seperti candi besar lainnya

It's actually a palace, wide area. You can find the ruin, the foundation of their building. Though not a complete building but you can still imagine hows the life back then. Beautifully stand before mountains. 
Definitely great place to take picture especially if you're fond of photography

Cautious for sunshine since less of trees in there. Be prepare to bring hat or umbrella
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Pada waktu ada konferensi di Jogjakarta tahun 2015 lalu, beberapa teman mengajak untuk mengunjungi Bekas Keraton Ratu Boko dan Candi Dieng. 
Setelah sampai di lokasi sehabis mendaki bukit maka sampailah di kompleks keraton. Saya tidak menyangka bahwa komplek keraton begitu luas dan berada diatas bukit dengan pemandangan yang sangat indah sekali. Hanya sayangnya pada waktu kesana matahari pas berada diatas kepala jadi betul-betul merasakan terik dan panas siangnya hari, bukan kesejukan. Alangkah baiknya jika saat ini banyak ditanami pohon sebagai peneduh, tapi mungkin juga bisa menghalangi pemandangan yang indah dari atas bukit keraton??.
Menurut teman yang tinggal di Jogjakarta untuk menikmati pemandangan kompleks keraton seharusnya pada waktu sore menjelang matahari terbenam, pada saat itulah keindahan sebenarnya dari pemandangan kompleks bekas keraton akan tampak. 
Kompleks bekas keraton memang hanya tinggal puing-puing yang belum di restorasi semua, mungkin agak susah untuk mengembalikan seperti keadaan pada masa lalu, bisa karena tidak ada data atau mungkin juga dana??. 
Akhirnya ya seperti saat ini keadaannya. Bagaimanapun juga tetap kelihatan bagaimana kejayaan Keraton Ratu Boko biarpun pada saat ini hanya tinggal puing saja.
nah kalau kalian tidak terlalu suka di pantai untuk melihat sunset nah di jogja ada salah satu tempat yg indah untuk melihat sunset yaitu di candi ratu boko

Saya sengaja ke candi ratu boko untuk menikmati sunset.. karena banyak review yang menyarankan demikian..di sana banyak sekali spot untuk foto juga bersantai sebelum menaiki candi.. setelah naik ke atas candi kita juga masih dapat bersantai duduk direrumputan sambil menikmati sunset.. disana mulai sunset sekitar jam 5 sore..

Visited this temple in October 2016. Have to walk through upstair. It's very tiring and hot. But the view on the top of hill was very wonderful. Beautiful view of Jogja's mountain & ricefield combinated with beautiful temple. I also see Prambanan temple from here. Better you come to this temple after 3 PM to get best lighting if you love photography.

The location of the temple is up in the hill, estimate one hour or so from the city. The complex is mostly ruins but it offers a wonderful in the peak.  Hire the guide to get a better picture and information about this temple.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: 夕陽の名所として地元では有名だそうです。残念ながらその時間には行けませんでしたが昼間でも地元の方も多く来ておられて賑わっていました。ピクニック感覚でした。

entrance fee for domestic 30K, 
a good place for enjoying sunset in jogja,
not recommended visiting this place at the weekend.
waktu terbaik datang ke ratu boko adalah saat sore hari dan pastikan langit cerah, karena matahari terbenam disini sangat menarik dan indah

Lokasi mudah, keasrian lingkungan sekitar yg alami tapi tertata dengan rapi dan bersih, sehingga nyaman di kunjungi. Dengan fasilitas pendukung yg lengkap dan baik. Cocok buat wisata bersama keluarga. Disamping itu, kita juga bisa mendapatkan sejarah bangsa kita. Karena di sini kita bisa mendapatkan informasi yang lengkap dari pengelola candi ratu boko.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
I'm in love with this place. Simple architecture. Not much to see but oh, once you get to the top and finally catch the mighty Sun sets and it's peeking through the temples you will realize how lucky you are. Gorgeous. I recommend to come around 4.30 or 5 pm, though it's not really crowded, less touristy than Prambanan temple or say Borobudur temple. But the surrounding, the setting, it's grassy, lots of trees here and there. Come to sit on it. It feels like a warm, big open garden. 
A bit reminder to future visitors: if anyone wishes to see Ratu Boko temple and Prambanan temple, make sure you come as early as 1 pm to buy the bundle tickets!  They have different ticket counter for the bundling ticket. You could buy the bundle at Prambanan temple. It comes cheaper but as I told before, just make sure come early. At the ticket counter it IS written and that service for the bundling tickets for Prambanan and Ratu Boko closes at 2.30 pm, and I came at 1.45 pm yet they had already closed! When I asked why, the woman at the Prambanan ticket counter had no explanation to give. That was truly disappointing. But again lesson learned. So make sure for future visitors to come early if any of you wants to get the bundling ticket.

This area is historical site of Java 8th century kingdom. The remaining structure are very less, the main attraction is the entrance gate and the huge complex.

This area has restaurant where we can sit and wait the sunset while enjoying a nice coffee.

The walk inside the complex is quite tiring because it's a large complex although not as large as Borobudur Templet
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: tempat yang sangat bagus untuk melihat sunset dan spot bagus untuk fotografi. sejuk dan banyak tempat untuk bersantai. ada warung yang menjual makanan seperti mi instan.

We had great time here. Came here around 4.30pm, step barefoot on green grass, sitting, chilling with my loved one while enjoying sunset that decorated the temple. The ambience boost up by javanese songs that sang by traditional music players at the stage near the temple. It was just perfect. Price for 2 tickets with 1 car parking cost 90k rupiah.

Un beau parc, les Bâtiments ne sont pas aussi exceptionnels que Borobudur ou Prambanan mais vous pouvez facilement vous projeter dans les ruines de ce qui devait être une  spectaculaire demeure. 

Je me demande encore si les bassins (pool) sont profonds, mais je n'ai pas osé plonger. 

Ce n'est pas incontournable, mais une fois sur place vous respirez et vous vous poser loin de la frénésie de la vie indonésienne
지금은 없어지고 뼈대만 남은 유적지인데, 불교와 힌두의 영향을 받은 곳으로 석양이 최고라 알려 있습니다. 아래로 보이는 족자카르타의 경치도 멋지고, 프람바난사원이 멀리 보입니다. 한가하게 산책하면서 유적지와 석양을 구경하면 몸과 마음이 편안해 집니다.

Nilai plus (+):
- Komplek Candi Luas (Butuh 1 - 2 jam berkeliling disana)
- Ada penjual kelapa muda antara komplek candi depan dan candi belakang
- Bisa melihat Prambanan dari candi ini
- Dekat pintu masuk komplek candi ada restoran untuk makan romantis outdoor cocok untuk saat teduh
Nilai minus (-):
- Sulit mencari tempat berteduh pas panas terik menyengat (Jangan lupa bawa payung)
- Bukan Candi tinggi menjulang, sehingga banyak yang terkecoh cuma sampai bagian depan saja, padahal komplek candi luas kebelakang
- Antrian transportasi dari candi untuk balik ke Prambanan tidak diatur sehingga harus berebutan siapa cepat dia dapat

Kami mengunjungi candi ini dari komplek candi Prambanan dengan membeli tiket di loket candi prambanan, disediakan transportasi pulang pergi dari komplek candi Prambanan.

Awalnya saya kira ini Candi kecil seputar tempat pembakaran saja dimana banyak orang melempar koin disitu, tapi ternyata sampai jauh kebelakang ada kolam keputren yang cocok untuk difoto-foto.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: mengunjungi tempat ini setelah dari candi prambanan. Tempatnya sejuk, indah dan sangat cocok untuk menikmati matahari terbenam disini.

Salah satu tempat terbaik untuk melihat sunset di Jogja. Pastikan cuaca sedang baik dan tidak mendung. Letaknya di ketinggian membuat pemandangan sunset semakin spektakuler. Ada puluhan anak tangga yang harus dinaiki untuk sampai ke lokasi situs yang memakan waktu sekitar 10-15 menit

Best to go in the evening and great place for couple. There are two route, take the one which need to travel across a village cause that the main road. Great scenery for a top the hill. Historical... nothing to mention as the site literally almost empty(compare to Borobudur and Prambanan). Information on site has been updated with signboard. Camping Ground available for sunsets and sunrise enthusiastic but need the sky to be very clear. Many couples turn up during the evening time.

プランバナン寺院の帰りに寄りました。2017年5月1日から入場料が値上げされており、外国人ツーリストだと1人25USドル（当日のレートで325,000ルピア）。
15時以降の入場だと少し安くなります。プランバナン寺院とボコの丘のセット入場券が発売されているようなので、プランバナン寺院でチケット購入時にきちんと確認すればよかったと後悔したくらいの入場料の高さです。
中に入ると確かに眺めはよく、お天気が良ければサンセット鑑賞に最高のスポットですが、その点を除くと遺構を眺めながら昔の王宮の暮らしに思いを馳せるだけの場所です。
入場料の高さを考えると再訪はないです。入場料はインドネシアの物価上昇以上に毎年値上げされているものと思われます。ご留意ください。

Tempat ini cocok dikunjungi pas sunset.. panorama kota jogja juga terlihat fenomenal diatas bukitnya.. 
Banyak spot selfienya dan hanya berkendara kurang dari 30 menit dari pusat kota jogjakarta.. tiket masuknya lumayan terjangkau.. sekitar 40rb diluar biaya parkir
Tempat ini bagus sekali untuk berfoto. apalagi kalo mataharinya pas banget. seperti berada di istana kerajaan jaman dahulu. untuk foto preweding juga bagus banget.

Ratu Boko palace (temple is a misleading word since it's not a place for worship) is a stunningly beautiful historical site. Unfortunately there's only small information regarding the real facts about the site, and no tourist guide available

There are plenty great sites to take pictures, especially the tamansari (the pools)

Do bring sunscreens, hats, umbrellas, abd drink plenty of water since it can be really hot there
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: ジョグジャカルタの南側にある標高２００ｍの丘です。この丘には広大なヒンドゥー・仏教遺跡が存在し、史跡公園として整備されています。これらの遺跡は、プランバナン寺院群とともに世界遺産に登録されているのですが、プランバナンと比べると知名度は高くありません。丘の上にあるボコ遺跡からの夕景夜景は一見の価値があります。

Gak worth it banget dengan kenaikan harga tiket masuk 40rb, yang dilihat hanya candi kecil. Sunset?? Sunset nya juga biasa biasa aja, yang di foto foto google udah editan semua. Gue datang pas lagi cerah cerah nya tapi menurut aku biasa aja. Mending juga lihat sunset di pantai atau pinus pengger.

It is worth noting how well maintained are the areas of the archeological places from Indonesia in general and this is no exception. The value of the temple is ssecond, the really outstanding experience is to presence the sunset.It is a wonderful and even exhilarating experience where the sun seems to ask permission to enter through the temple gates. Well worth it.

Pertama masuk dari pintu depan sempet urungin niat buat masuk karena anak tangga yang lumayan banyak, tapi begitu disaranin sama penjaga parkir masuk lewat pintu belakang, akhir nya kami putar mobil lagi untuk cari jalan belakang, ternyata jauh lebih enak masuk lewat belakang. Kalau cuaca lagi terik, hawa nya lumayan panas disini, tapi disediakan gazibo2 ga jauh dari pintu masuk. Disaranin bawa kacamata hitam sama topi.
it is very beautiful scenery, but very minimum explanation about the history, we need to have it before go there
Sunset in ratu boko was breathtakingly amazing. i dont think that i ever watched that kind of view. really amazing.

Tempatnya bagus, jangan lupa membawa kacamata hitam dan topi jika datang tengah hari karena panasnya cukup menyengat
Berada di ketinggian dari tempat ini kita bisa melihat pemandangan yg sangat bagus termasuk pemandangan candi pramabanan dan gunung merapi di kejauhan.
Nothing much to see during mid afternoon. But sunseti saw from pic was so beautiful. Not far from Prambanan park.
Tempatnya bagus,pemandangannya indah .saran aja klau k sana bwa payung atau topi karena cuacanya panas sekali....semakin sore semakin bagus .tempat yg pas buat berburu sunrise dan sunset
Candi ini tidak terlalu besar namun sangat cantik. Apalagi ketika sore hari, matahari tenggelam terlihat sangat indah dari candi ini.

If you are into historical place, this is your place. Placed over the hills, great views, and a very interesting ruins to look at. Visit them during sunset to get a gorgeous shot, avoid middle of the day because it'll be incredibly hot.

Visited this place to catch the sunset. I love Jogja because they have so many temples. The ticket price  is Rp 50,000 per person and Rp 10,000 for car parking. 

I think you have to know the story behind this temple. It's not a temple actually but it is a palace. Just a suggestion, please don't walk to far if the sun already signed out.
Ratu boko is one of the temple at yogyakarta area. It's famous for its sunset spot. Too bad I don't have a chance to see the sunset myself. But ratu boko in noon is still worth to visit.

wisata candi ratu boko sendiri masuknya bayar tiket 40rb/orang, kalau terusan prambanan - ratu boko sekitar 75rb/orang. untuk di candi boko ini saya sarankan membawa topi dan air, karena disini cuacanya sangat panas, tapi kalau sore diatas candi sangat bagus kok pemandangannya

Sunset view at Ratu Boko is a crowd puller. Most of the tourist end their day-trip usually at this ancient hindu temple ruins. The location of Ratu Boko is outside Jogja town and almost 180 degrees to Prambanan temples. That said, the way to Ratu Boko gets curvy in last kilometer. There are 2 parking lots. The entry closes by 5 pm. The entry fee includes tea-coffee from a nearby restaurant. When we visited, there were local artists playing songs starting from Indonesia to Malaysia to India. We were pleasantly surprised. Perhaps we were the only Indians that evening and when these artists saw us, they started singing Hindi song. Sweet! The entrance of the monument gets crammed with people hunting for best location to get clear shot of sunset with the gates in silhoutte. The compound altogether is large and one could spend an hour or more to traverse around. We went at the end of the day and did not have much time. Watch beautiful sunset and then if you are lucky and the sky is clear then you while returning, watch to your right and you might be able to see the mighty Merapi mountain.
Kompleks cani ini menjadi sangat populer setelah muncul dalam film ada apa dengan cinta. tempat nya sangat luas dan agak panas, tapi terbayar dengan pemandangan yang indah

Ancient Hindu temple and recommended for a sunset view. after the sunset you can enjoy the dinner at the restaurant, it has an amzing veiw of the vally at some point you can even see the prabanan temple.

If one is not able to visit this place ..there is no loss. Good place to see sunset. We rushed to this place but the evening was cloudy and thus it was just walk through. Lot of stairs avoid if have knee problem.

Beda dengan candi yang pernah saya datangi.
Kebetulan berlibur dengan pasangan.
Sangat emnarik untuk adventure short trip.
Sebaiknya membawa pelindung tubuh saat musim panas, seperti payung atau pashmina.

2017/5/1から値上がりしました。
ここのサンセットがどうしても見たい！という人以外は、行かなくてもいいかなと思います。確かに見晴らしはいいけど遺跡は大してないし、コスパ考えたらうーん、そんなにおすすめはしないです。

Ratu Boko is best enjoyed with a rented bike, as you climb through small hills peppered with rice paddies, small houses, cows and sheep grazing happily all over - a very picturesque trip no doubt. Once you reach the top, there is this restaurant with an amazing view of the valley, where you can just sit and admire it over some food/drinks. Now if you also want to buy a ticket for the temple itself, do not bother I would say. For one person they charge 350,000 IDR, which is a complete rip off considering that only the gate of the temple is still standing, and there's nothing to that gate itself. The amount is the same with what they charge at Prambanan, and there's no comparing the two.
I would strongly suggest you go to the top for the journey itself and for the view, but skip the temple, it's not worth it.

pergi kesini untuk mengejar sunset, karena seperti yang direview orang-prang bahwa sunset diisni bagus dan magis sekali. 

datang kesana pukul 4 sore, dipikir hanya bangunan kecil sjaa ternyata luas sekaliiii... pemandangannya bagus dari atas. walaupun saat kesana mendung dan tidak mendapatkan sunset yang seperti dibayangkan, tapi cukup puas untuk mengitari kawasan Candi Boko ini.
Good temple complex where you can find some ruins of the temples. May not be as popular as the Borobudur or Prambanan, but not as crowded as those two as well.

Ratu Boko could be accessed directly or you could go to Prambanan Temple and buy both ticket, then used the shuttle located in Prambanan. Ratu Boko. It was really huge and as time goes by, the restoration was continued and more sites you could see. Information boards were there, but it was not enough to describe what the site was. It was really hot so if you can't handle the heat, bring your own umbrella. Several ladies also sold iced coconut water there.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
It's a huge site. This site is a must-see if you go to Yogyakarta. The management is already better than the other temple. 

You better use a guide in order to learn about this site.  The 'iconic' photo is only the gate of the temple. People usually visit at nearly sunset to get the panoramic view from the gate of the temple.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Situs Ratu Boko merupakan reruntuhan bekas istana. Tp terpelihara, tertata, bersih dan resik. Tiket masuk bisa terusan dari Prambanan Rp 50rb atau khusus ke Ratu Boko Rp 30rb. Kalau dari Prambanan ada shuttle ke Ratu Boko. 
Sebaiknya kunjungan dilakukan pagi atau sore sekalian melihat sunset. Jangan tengah hari. Terlalu panas. 
Yang ngga kuat jalan, jangan khawatir, banyak tempat duduk tersedia.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Ratu Boko Temple area is actually the Palace of Ratu Boko built in the 8th century, the building is the grandest building at that time.
This tourism location will be much better enjoyed during the sunset, because the beauty of Ratu Boko temple more radiated at sunset. Here are also many instagramable spots. So this is one place that SHOULD BE VISITED.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This site is filled with mystery and you will be in awe as to how the ancient people of Yogyakarta practiced their richculture and tradition.
We are there about 2pm and its a hot day. Not much to see except waiting for sunset by the temples. and they have special price for sunset view.
Disini bagus bangat kalau buat liat sunset, semoga anda datang kesini pas dapet lihat sunsetnya, Ajak kerabat atau teman anda untuk menyaksikan bersama.

After seeing other temples in Yogyakarta, not much new to see here for the temple. The view of the city is beautiful from the top. We went at the time of the sunset - the view is nice. The ticket includes complimentary meal at their cafe - the food is good.

The temple is high above. You can reach the temple by climbing the stairs up for about 10 minutes walk. After that you gave to pay entrance fee and walk again to go up to the temple. The temple is not big but the scenery  from above is excellent. Take some pictures for you memories. It is best visit at sunset.
Klo kita dapet sunset dsni bgs bgt mirip ky yg di aadc, mslhnya kita ga tau kapan itu sunset bisa pas kita dsna hahaha, krn saya 2 kali kesana tp belum dapet juga itu sunset
We came to wait for sunset but the weather was cloudy. We just relaxed there for an hour after long day of going around Yogyakarta.
This is another site well worth seeing in Jogjakarta.  Borobadur and Prambanan are the most beautiful but this is nearby and worth the trip.

Borobudur-Prambanan-Ratu Boko are the trio of World Heritage in Java though the latter two are not as well known as Borobudur.  There is a free shuttle from Prambanan to Ratu Boko if you purchase the package entrance tickets. Ratu Boko is a big place to roam but unfortunately under maintained.

Beside Borobudur Temple and Prambanan, I highly recommend you to put this  Keraton ratu Boko in your 'Must Place to Visit' List in Jogjakarta. The Templa palace is not far from Prambanan and many people visit the two as a packagee. 
According to legend, Keraton Boko was the palace of Princess Loro Jonggrang and the setting of one of Java's most epic love stories. 
Is you are student or post graduate student, bring your student card and get special discount for ticket price. 
If you visit keraton Ratu Boko, you must try Ratu Boko's restaurant and enjoy Javanese tea and rock candy, while it served with beautiful views of Mount Merapi and Prambanan Temple. You won't regret it :)
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Semakin sore semakin ramai pengunjung dikala cuaca cerah, mereka degan segala perlengkapan photo, dengan hp. Berburu sunset dengan bangunan candi yang menawan menambah cantik suasana. Rameeee bangetttttt. Ada yang pacaran, ada yang dengan rombongan ada juga yang melakukan prewed. Seru, pengen kesana lagi

Letak Candi Ratu Boko ini masih berdekatan dengan Candi Prambanan. Saya datang ke candi ini ingin melihat sunset yang kata orang bagus. Tetapi cuaca kurang mendukung kala itu. Jadi saya tidak mendapatkan sunset yang bagus di sana. 
Tetapi untuk dari segi candi itu sendiri, keadaannya bersih dan terrawat.
Candi nya di atas kita bisa liat sunsett kalo lagi cerah gituu tiket masuk okelahh buat view nya juga, asyikk

It is some really impressive structures, but if you have been to Angkor Wat you will be disappointed. Also, the ticket is way too expensive. So expensive that even though I hadn't been to Angkor Wat then, i was disappointed anyway. Didn't try public transport so I don't know if you can do it diy. Nice to go if you have free time but not essential.

Candi Ratu Boko ternyata sebuah komplek yg cukup luas, disana ada bermacam-macam situs ada Gapura, Pemandian, Istana dan Goa. Letaknya di atas bukit dengan view yg bagus utk foto2.

Anak2 disini bisa lari2 di halamannya karena luas.

Waktu yg jadi favorit utk kesini pas menjelang malam, jam 5 keatas, karena banyak yg ingin menyaksikan sunset.
Tempat yg bagus, pas cuaca lagi cerah, tambah sip pemandangannya, fasilitas jg lengkap dan bersih 👍

Tempat ini adalah destinasi utama saya, saat kembali ke Candi Prambanan untuk kedua kalinya. Pada kunjungan pertama, saya terlambat karena shuttle bus terakhir dari Candi Prambanan telah berangkat.
Jika diperhatikan, candi ini sudah tidak utuh atau berupa peninggalan saja, Namun masih dipelihara dengan baik oleh pemerintah setempat. Terdiri dari beberapa bagian, kompleks candi ini memiliki luas yang lumayan. Wisatawan biasanya datang kesini untuk berburu sunset, termasuk saya.
Saat di perjalanan menuju ke candi ini, cuaca masih sangat mendukung. Matahari masing terik - teriknya. Hal ini bagus karena tujuan utama saya kesini adalah untuk hunting sunset. Akan tetapi, setelah menunggu 1,5 jam lebih, maka cuaca pun mulai 'berulah'. Langit tiba - tiba mendung, dan awan gelap perlahan menutupi matahari. Hmmm, pertanda buruk.
Masih berharap awan gelap akan segera bergeser, saya masih menunggu. Akan tetapi, tepat saat jamnya sunset, awan malah semakin gelap dan gerimis mulai turun. Untung saat masih terang tadi, sudah sempat mengabadikan tempat ini dalam beberapa, kecuali sunsetnya.
The temple is interesting, the location even better - great views. There is a new cafe at the bottom of the complex as well.
The sunset view is amazing. Ratu Boko Temple area is very large. Although only fragments of stone, but its historical value is priceless.
menikmati sunset di candi ratu boko,, menenangkan hati.. melihat rumput hijau dan suasana sunset yg indah.. Di dalam candi penataanx sangat rapi dan di jaga dengan baik..

Ticket price is 110, 000 which i thought was a bit pricey - i made it for sunset so didn't explore all the palace grounds.

The ticket gives u a complementary drink (tea/coffee) and a snack (rice, noodles or banana fritters) at the restaurant which also has a reasonable view.

这边需要买门票，票价也不便宜，大概13美金左右。这个地方真的是没什么可逛的，我来的时候是最晒的时间，还要一步一步往上爬，真的是差点儿中暑。据说这里是马塔兰王国曾经的皇宫，建在山上，很空旷，也许很早以前是很辉煌，但是如今只有残垣断壁。完全看不出一丝当年的风范。一看到有这么多的台阶，我的心就凉了半截儿。不得不说，这里游客还是相当多的。上来以后就是各种空旷的草坪和石块。大门外有一处可以赏景的平台，我坐着歇了好一会儿，落落汗，顺便欣赏一下日惹的景色。

I visited Ratu Boko on the way back from Prambanan. The foundations of the old palace, as well as a couple of structures like the gateway, remained and were interesting to walk through. The remains of some old pools still exist as well. However, almost everything besides the bare foundations of the palace is gone. The site is mostly simple walls, raised platforms, flat slabs where structures once stood, etc. There aren't any enclosed buildings, much less artwork such as the statues visible at Prambanan. As such, I didn't find this site to be as interesting as other historical sites where more of the original buildings remained intact. 

One other issue: the complex is large, the only way to get around is on foot, and the site (at least when I went) can get hot and unpleasant to be hiking around in. There are some drink stalls set up throughout the complex, but it still be uncomfortable.

All in all, it's a decent stop on the way back from Prambanan, but I wouldn't recommend making the trip out of Yogyakarta just to see Ratu Boko on its own.

The history behind Ratu Boko Temple is interesting, so make sure you get yourself a tour guide during your visit. The vicinity itself is at the very top of the hill, so you need to hike a little bit from the upper parking/entrance (if you park at the lower parking lot, the hike to the entrance is quite burdensome).

Consist of several sections, Ratu Boko Temple complex boasted the beautiful ruins of the past ruler's and his families' living quarter, well-placed among the manicured lawn. Although not all components are well-preserved, but the ones present there now are good enough as a mean of storytelling. The complex is photogenic enough for you to have several iconic landscape photos.

There's a sunset viewing spot quite separated from the complex, also a historical cave.

If you wanna drive on your own to the upper parking lot (main entrance), be sure to drive safely as the road is kinda steep with quite a lot of bends and turns. But the view to the main entrance is worth it though, taking the backroad from the other side of the hills and going through village road surrounded by paddy field. As of December 2016, the access road at the hill was being repaired. So it should be good now.

We understand that the fee is set high for conservation and preservation, but in the end this is just fleecing the tourist. 
We decided not to visit the temple, instead to make the most of the wonderful view from the restaurant outside the entrance. An overhaul on the management of entrance fees please. Same to with Angkor Wat.

Review Text: We love how the horizon turn yellow when its sunset..the gate temple is very beautifull to take a picture in the afternoon..the green grass yard is nice just to sit around there with your fams waiting for the sunset. A bit crowded when holiday off course.

Ratu Boko is very interesting p place to visit , the historical site was really epic ! Not to mentoin Ratu Boko has a very wide area that very very good organized , I was there just before sunset and I think that was a perfect time to visit !
Definitely a very worth vist !

I love the atmosphere in this area. It feels like we entering the past. The sunset was amazing. It's located in a highland, large area, many unique spot should visited. If you want to enjoy sunset in a city of Jogja, dont have to go to a mountain or a beach, here's a perfect place.

So many people have written down about this location to enjoy the sunset. I will be one of that after you read this .. for sure. But, let me try to summarize some key tips and reviews for this location.
1. Make sure you arrive when the weather is bright and no Rain. The weather above is perfect with wind and convenient temperature to stay.
2. The Candi is located above the hill and government have managed to develop the parking area as good place to start. With restaurant, rest room, and other supporting building that will help you preparing the small trip up to the hill.
3. You will also appreciate the tidy and clean track moving up to the hill. The distance is close and you can use all the rest place along the track. Very good also to see some tap water to wash hand or face. I am not sure whether we could also order some food there ?
3. Once you reach the top, there will see the big gate the welcome the guest. Nothing special on this gate anyway.
4. Move further up and you will see a huge grass field that created a rectanguler form with the size of football field. Children  will be happy to run around and enjoy the surrounding.
5. You can move further up to the top of a stone platform which used to be place for religious ceremony (or sacrifice ?) by the King or respected Leader. This is a good place to take family picture, sitting on the edge of platform enjoying the view of sunset of towards the grass field below.
6. Or you can follow the natural track to a place higher to have a beautiful view of Merapi Volcano and whole complex of RatuBoko.
7. Turn your view back to the gate from all the places above and you will then see the direction where the Sun will set. Make sure you don't miss the timing and take the perfect shot with your camera.

In averall this place is amazing to relax and have a short getaway from city of Yogyakarta. 

Yogya, 3 January 2017

Candi Ratu Boko adalah salah satu obyek wisata favorite saya di Jogja. Sangat historical,  lokasinya enak dan nyaman untuk dikunjungi, fasilitas untuk pengunjung sudah cukup bagus. Dan sangat bagus untuk dijadikan obyek foto!!

A huge temple area with spacious garden. When it is dusk, it claimed to be one of the most beautiful twilight scenery in Yogyakarta.

Hot season will be the perfect time to visit this place because you will enjoy the sunset clearly. In rainy season, the cloud will hinder the sunset view. However, you won't regret even if you're not lucky to get the sunset view. The garden is enjoyable to spend with friends  or just being alone finding solitude.

For foreigner, the perfect time to visit is before 3 p.m because after 3 p.m foreigner will be charged IDR 100K per person for entry ticket. Local visitors are only charged IDR 25K. This place close at 6 p.m.

The Queen's Palace is a shadow of its former self as time and elements has wrecked most of its structure. Nonetheless, some parts like the entrance gate and the princess quarters ground are intact and the massive pool/bathing area of the queen and the princesses. 

Explore its vast ruins to get a glimpse of the rich history of Medang Kingdom. There is an area near prambanan temple entrance that offers a coaster ride for a reasonable price. It can be reached from prambanan by the coaster ride in 15-20min then its about 10min and the complex can be explore in 60-90min. 

There are refreshments along the complex but due to the extensive ruins, this is an activity best for a sunny/ clear day.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Archaeological site from 9th century part of Mataram Kingdom. There are many site at the area to see. The best part is the Gate, visit this area between December - Maret for best Sunset experience and don't forget to bring your camera, it worhty to captured it. It is only take 2-3 hours visiting this place, start at 3.30 pm while waiting the sunset you can walking around to see other part of this Temple.

Harga tiket relatif mahal (parkir Rp 10 ribu & tiket masuk Rp 25 ribu) yang buka jam:06.00-17.30,sampai ke atas kami celingukan mencari candinya koq nggak ada seperti lokasi situs candi pada umumnya,yang ada hanya bangunan seperti gapura,tangga, selasar saja & puing-puing candi di sekitar kompleks (gua,pendopo,keputren dll) yang sebagian masih progres renovasi; tetapi rasa kecewa terobati dengan suguhan lanskap yang luas dengan view panorama yang indah,ada taman & air mancur,jalan setapak diantara hamparan rumput hijau,bangku untuk tempat duduk-duduk melepas lelah sambil menikmati makan-minum dibawah rindangnya pohon & semilirnya angin...ingin rasanya kami berlama-lama di sini
Ada fasilitas penginapan,kantor/lobby & bus shuttle/antar jemput wisatawan yang dikelola oleh PT.Taman Wisata Candi meliputi candi Borobudur-Prambanan & Ratu Boko.Sepertinya habis ada event "Ratu Boko Festival 2016-Boko Tempo Doeloe" tampak dari gerbang bambu ditengah jalan menuju candi. 
Dekat loket ada 'souvenir shop' & peta lokasi Keraton Ratu Boko dan bagi yang ingin berfoto dengan back-ground tulisan "Keraton Ratu Boko" bisa berfose di depan lobby sisi kanan. Selamat menikmati indahnya candi yang penuh sensasi ini.........

Ratu Boko is located in Bokoharjo, Yogyakarta. It is suspected a palace in the 8th century. To get here you can buy a package Prambanan & Ratu Boko trip at the entrance of Prambanan Temple. Just get inside Prambanan and you will see a car which will bring you to Ratu Boko. 

The place is nice and neat. You can walk around here and enjoy the relics of history from Medang Kingdom. Because it is located in 196 m above sea level you can feel the breeze. 

There several small huts alongside the path. You can take some rest and enjoy drinking coconut water for IDR 10,000 -  15,000.

This temple is located at the top of a hill is an ancient half Hindu destroyed temple complex. It must be very popular for sunset as there is a sunset ticket which includes dinner. It is an enormous complex with half destroyed shrines that are in the process of reconstruction. When we arrived an hour before sunset, crowds of people had already placed their cameras at strategic locations waiting for the sun to set.The view of the sunset from the hill top is something really special and we spent more than an hour just sitting in the field overlooking the doorway of the complex in quiet contemplation. Definitely a great place to visit.

Berkunjung ke Candi Ratu Boko harus memiliki stamina bagus karena bakal melewati banyak anak tangga dan kompleks candi ini lumayan luas, sekitar 25 hektar. Candi ini seperti istana berbenteng lengkap dengan kolam mandi, pendopo luas, ceruk goa pertapaan, gapura, paseban, serta keputren alias tempat para putri. Di candi ini ditemukan Prasasti Abhayagiri Wihara (792). Selainitu, candi ini sering menjadi tempat pertunjukan dan pementasan. Lokasi ini juga relatif dekat dengan Candi Prambanan dan Sojiwan.

-Like most visitors, we enjoyed taking snapshots of silhouettes against the setting sun with the ancient grand city entrance structure as the backdrop. 
-Don't get carried away by the silhouetted postures of happy visitors. Remember to take a short walk to the back of the estate where you will find a small cave purportedly used for meditation during its heydays. Towards the southern sides you will find some ancient structures that modern archaeologists are still guessing to what purpose the buildings served. 
-On the northern side nearby the spot where people take silhouette photos is little knoll. Follow a footpath up some stone steps and you will find a Hindu shrine. Below and beyond that cliff you will see a Football field. A local Soccer match was playing with players in respective colourful jerseys. Live commentary was clearly audible via loudspeakers in the Football field. The commentator's voice added much excitement to 
the air. I bet that there must be a wager or two on the ground.

Review Text: Поскольку у нас было полных 4 дня на исследование окрестностей Джогджи, то в первый день мы не стали торопиться и бежать в Прамбанан или Боробудур, а посетили несколько храмов на окраине города и дворцовый комплекс Рату Боко. В принципе, если времени мало, вы можете посмотреть его в один день с Прамбананом, потому что между ними всего несколько километров. Билет на посещение дворца стоит около 10 долл., принимают карты. В стоимость билета входит, кроме посещения руин, еще и ужин (на выбор из нескольких блюд). В разное время суток стоимость билета разная: до обеда она чуть выше, вечером (просмотр заката) она пониже. Это не храмовый, а дворцовый комплекс, хотя, как в любом дворце, храм т комплексе, безусловно, был. Целых построек почти не осталось, но посмотреть все довольно интересно. Особенного заката бы не увидели из-за облачности вечером, а когда стемнело, пошли ужинать в кафе с верандой, откуда неплохо видно Прамбанан.

This site is around 20 minutes from Prambanan, up the hill. The name 'temple' might be misleading as the structure is more 'flat'; beautiful nonetheless. Power tip: come closer to sunset as the air is nice and windy and the view breathtaking.

Review Text: Looking for the sunset in here. Eventhough it is not really a place that i expected but it is still good and amazing!! Its a bit far from the city, so i suggest to get there earlier before it is too crowded

Ratu boko memiliki pemandangan yang indah. Ratu boko adalah canfi untuk perabuan arau kremasi bagi raja raja kala itu. Lokasi krematoriumnya masih terlihat sampai sekarang. Lokasi ratu boko berada satu garis dengan prambanan merapi dan borobudur. Ketika cuaca cerah kita dapat melihat garis imajiner tersebut. Sunset disini sangat cantik. Menelusuri seluruh ratu boko membutuhkan waktu tidak sebentar karena sangat luas dan masuk ke kawasan perkampungan penduduk lokal. Cara paling mudah untuk kesini adalah membayar tiket terusan candi prambanan dan ratu boko. Kita akan mendapatkan fasilitas free shuttle. Tidak ada batasan kuta harus kembali ke prambanan dalam waktu berapa jam. Selama masih dalam jam operasional kuta bisa ikut shuttle untuk kembali ke prambanan. Sayangnya shuttle tidak sampai sunset. Padahal itu pemandangan terbaik dari tempat ini.

I went there with a scooter from the city center. The last traffic light right before Prambanan, made right turn to Jl. Piyungan and just go straight for about 4 kms. (Don't follow the first sign that said "Ratu Boko" because that's only the parking lot for buses, instead just go straight until the second sign of Ratu Boko), and then make right turn, follow the small streets uphill and you'll be there. Entrance fee for foreign tourists is IDR 110.000 + parking fee, and for the local it's just 25.000 + parking fee. The ticket includes free meal for at the end of your visit. You can choose a snack (fried banana with tea) or meal like nasi goreng/mie goreng with 1 drink. The food is delicious. So, the temple itself is very popular for sunset view. There's not much you can see inside, beside the ruins and this hole which they used for burning deceased king in the past. When the sky is clear, the sunset view will be very stunning. Everyone would wait behind the main gate to get the best shot of standing in the middle of the gate with back facing the sunset. When you're going home after the trip, the downhill part could be tricky so make sure you have working bright head light.

Рату Боко расположен в 3 км от Прамбанана на возвышении около 200 м, отправиться туда можно с целью увидеть Прамбанан, на который открывается прекрасный панорамный вид, или полюбоваться пейзажами долины, окрашиваемыми в красные оттенки в лучах заходящего солнца, с величественным вулканом на фоне. Я поехала туда, чтобы еще раз взглянуть на Мерапи на закате, к сожалению, небо затянулось тучами и пошел дождь, поэтому никакого вулкана, как и практически ничего остального, разглядеть было невозможно. Ехать туда только ради развалин могу посоветовать лишь в том случае, если вы ну очень любите подобные места или у вас в запасе много времени и хочется досконально изучить окрестности Прамбанана. Об истории и функции Рату Боко известно не так много, даже в правильности его названия сомневаются. Но ученые сошлись в заключении, что это был все-таки не храмовый комплекс, он вообще не был связан ни с какими религиозными целями,  а вероятно это остатки дворцового комплекса, с оборонительными сооружениями, укреплением стен и поселениями.  

Входной билет в Прамбанан стоит 18$, в Рату Боко на закате (c 15:00 до 18:00) - 110000 Rp (около 10 $). Билет в Рату Боко можно приобрести с 15:00 до 17:30, в его стоимость включены чай/кофе и легкий перекус. Если вы заранее уже решили, что посетите и Прамбанан, и Рату Боко, лучше приобрести сразу пакет на обе достопримечательности за 25$ с услугой трансфера между ними.

Candi Ratu Boko ini terletak kurang lebih 3 km dari Candi Prambanan Jogjakarta, bahkan ada shuttle bus nya untukmengantarkan wisatawan dari Prambanan ke Ratu Boko. Ini pertama kali saya berkunjung ke Candi Boko, walaupun sudah berkali-kali maen ke Jogja. Ternyata fasilitas yang ada di Candi Boko ini sudah modern, bersih dan sangat terawat, salah satunya adalah Toilet yang bersih dan harum, akses jalan masuk yang sudah lebar dan bagus, fasilitas penunjang seperti restorant, kursi taman, gazebo dan taman yang terawat dengan rapi. Namun demikian untuk tiket masuknya agak lebih mahal dari yang saya perkirakan yaitu 25rb untuk tiap pengunjung. Saat yang tepat berkunjung ke sini adalah saat Matahari terbenam, dimana saat kita masuk sore hari tiket masuknya menjadi 70rb termasuk dinner & melihat sunset di Resto Candi Boko.

This place is located about 17 kilometers east of the city of Yogyakarta and 2 kilometers south of the Prambanan temple. The best time to visit this location is in the afternoon. You 'll find an incredible sunset, sunset over the city of Yogyakarta. FYI, this site is located on a hill, so you have to walk down the stairs from the gateway to the central site. This location is one of the best places to see the sunset in Yogyakarta

suasananya disana enak banget, apalagi wwaktu sunset, indah banget. lokasinya ada taman yang cocok untuk bersantai, tapi kalau hujan ribet banget mau berteduh. candinya berbentuk reruntuhan ada kolamnya.

Lokasinya sebenernya berada di antara perbatasan antara provinsi yogyakarta dan provinsi Jawa tengah. sangat saya rekomendasikan anda berkunjung kesini karena bisa melihat candi prambanan dan candi lain dari ketinggian.

We are here for the sunset view. From a certain location you can see Prambanan Temple.
It has magical view.
It was the home of Loro Jongrang, the lady who initiate the creation of Prambanan Temple.

You need to climb several stairs before you actually see the temple. Breathtaking views, fresh air and all. Very lovely, calming, a perfect spot to take pictures as well. You could use the public transport from Prambanan temple to go here. So there's 2 place already that you could go to.

Its near prambanan temple if you want to visit Ratu Boko Temple. Actually, along the way, you may find several signage of others temple of cave that can be explored. One of the best view that we can have in candi boko is sunset. The temple is quit big, but we cant see the whole building. Only several remain of it. But when you walk on it, feels like entering a kingdom. Its really nice to see this temple.

One of the world cultural heritage site in yogyakarta. It is not far from the prambanan temple. It can be visited in combination with prambanan temple in Combo package which is cheaper and easy because they provide free shuttle van transfer.

prima di tutto no e un tempio ma un palazzo, il posto gode di una bella vista sulla vallata, l'area e grande con qualche rovina e alcuni templi ma risulta dispersivo e dopo aver visto Pranbana e Borobudur il posto risulta evitabile
i took thousand photo there, even the weather was so hot when i was there, but it did not destroy my spirit to explore all the angle of this temple.

Arrived late afternoon trying to catch the sun set... Even with very small rain drops, the sun set was still amazing.

A bit of climbing is expected, those with physical limitation may need to reconsider visiting this place.

Entrance fee with car is IDR 35.000,- (1 car + 1 person)

Istana Ratu Boko Located in the hills where exactly located in the village of Samberwatu (Sambirejo Village) and the village Dawung (Village Bokoharjo) Prambanan subdistrict, Sleman regency, Yogyakarta province. Istana Ratu Boko encountered many archaeological relics like the gate of the palace, combustion chambers, bathhouses, and statues.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I brought some of Malaysian tourists to this temple. This temple located up on the heel and we had to climb up with hundreds of stair above. I remember some of the people were terribly tired of climbing (walking). What i suggest you before coming here is: to bring a hat/cap to protect you from the sun, an umbrella if possible, some bottles of water, and small towel/changing clothes for sweat. Happy trip for every visitors around the world. God bless you

Saya penggemar sunset, tempat ini merupakan salah satu tempat paling istimewa. Reruntuhan candi membuat tempat ini agak dramatic. Dari atas juga kita bisa menyaksikan kemegahan candi Prambanan. Datanglah sekitar pukul 4, jangan terlalu malam, saksikan langit yang mulai memerah dan nantikan matahari tenggelam diantara kotakan candi2. Siluet pengunjung membuat tampak istimewa.

Akses : Anda bisa mengambil paket kunjungan dengan candi prambanan. Anda akan diantar saat sore tiba dan akan diantarkan kembali ke prambanan jika sudah selesai.

Jika menggunakan kendaraan pribadi, dari arah jogja beloklah ke arah kanan jika sudah menemukan terminal bus prambanan,Ikuti petunjuknya.
I got no luck to witness the marvelous sunset from Ratu Boko Temple. If weather is not good, do forget about the sunset tour.

Amazing place heritage from our great ancestor,our pride as a Indonesian citizen to have Ratu Boko's temple.
Nice well manicure garden,great view on sunset and so much thing I can not describe it.
for traveller to Jogja please don't missed this place.

Er is bij de ingang van het paleis weinig te zien. Je moet even doorlopen naar achter waar er iets meer te zien is. Er zijn bijna geen toeristen. Over het algemeen minder spectaculair dan andere tempel complexen in de omgeving van Jogja. In verhouding met wat er te zien is, is de prijs aan de hogere kant.De omgeving en het uitzicht is wel erg mooi. Overdag erg warm en weinig schaduw.

suasana yang sangat menarik saat matahari terbenam.

This temple/palace is very nice and worthwhile visiting although is just partially restored. It is fantastic to see sunset from it. A meal and a drink are included in your entry ticket.
i love to enjoy the sunset from this place. the temple on a top of the hill, so you can enjoy the city from the top. nice view, cozy and quiet. dont forget to bring your cap, very hot at noon.

Paket tour candi boko dengan Prambanan cukup membantu, karena kita tidak perlu memikirkan akomodasi dll. Bisa langsung naik shuttle dari Prambanan. Sebaiknya berangkat dari pagi, biar bisa merasakan ademnya...
Very beutifu place for knowing about story of ratu boko in yogyakarta and you can enjoying sunstet time with restaurant, the point place is near of prambanan temple.

Candi Ratu Boko, adalah lambang kejayaan Nusantara pada masa lalu, memiliki keindahan yang eksotis dengan pelataran yang luas dan hijau, terletak di atas bukit. Waktu kunjungan terbaik adalah pagi hari ketika kabut pagi masih menyelimuti bumi kita dapat melihat ke arah Gunung Merapi dan Candi Prambanan dan pada sore hari ketika senja keemasan tepat di balik gerbang utama candi, sungguh pemandangan yang luar biasa
Keren untuk hunting sunset. Tapi sayang, sewaktu saya datang lagi ramai anak2 kampus dari bandung. Jadi susah buat dapat foto. Dan mendung, jadi susetnya ga bagus.

Tidak jauh dr prambanan , plaosan , sambisari .

Ke candi ini karena demam film Ada Apa Dengan Cinta 2 (AADC2), sesuai dugaan, tempatnya ramai di akhir pekan. Sebenarnya pemandangannya indah, karena candi terletak diatas bukit. Tapi karena banyaknya orang yang datang, foto sunset jadi tidak maksimal.
HTM 25 ribu perorang, tutup jam 6 sore

It was not what I expected and I could not see the hype. The ruins were unrecognisable and no discernible shape to what it might have looked like in its glory days. To me, it looked like a bunch of debris. Use plenty of imagination, I suppose.

Foreigners had to pay an extortionate price. The place was overcrowded. Overall it was unpleasant. It may be tough to access this site if you don't drive or motorbike.

More accessible by private vehicle, the road to the location is rather small and less the directions, better use your GPS. The place is very wide and a little bit over the hills should prepare comfortable footwear. A beautiful place to see the sunset. If the weather is clear we could see the city of Yogyakarta.
Di Candi Ratu Boko anda bisa melihat indahnya Kota Yogyakarta, karena lokasinya berada di dataran Tinggi Yogyakarta. Tidak ada kata lain selain INDAH

Ratu Boko, is one of the great place in Jogjakarta. Long time ago, it was a kingdom. Now, we can see the ruins of Ratu Boko. Including the bathing pool. The sunset there, really beautiful and can make you stop breathing.

I went to Ratu Boko at around 3pm and it was sunny, so it is recommended to bring sunnies and wear easy clothes. You will have to walk up from locket at the parking area to the temple at the top, it's around 15minutes walk. However it was worth it. The complex is large and there are a few buildings that you can explore, some are already ruins, still nice though. Best time to visit is at 5-6 pm so you can see the sunset, too bad i couldn't see it myself. If you drive, parking lot can be reached by car, so no worries there. Just prepare your GPS and ask directions to locals.

The ticket was 13$ per person. But if you go from 15 to 17 pm  the ticket will be 110.000rp  /8.15 $/.  No one will tell you, that this price INCLUDES welcome drink that you must take BEFORE you enter the temple and after you pay your ticket. You can choose between water or juice.  To get it, you have to go to the restaurant. The palace is VERY beautiful. A lot of weddings go there just for their photo sesions. Definitely worth seeing. You have to take big water and a hat with you, because the place is huge and you don’t want to miss anything!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
