This is a small temple!!! But it's perched on top of a hill with lovely foliage that is particularly charming at dusk. Please don't waste your money on the sunset dinner as the weather will likely be too hazy for you to see an actual sunset.
Very fascinating place. Not many people here, and so could get some great photos. Not much shade, so best to come late in the day or early to avoid the heat.
There is nothing really to see, not a "real temple", and the price is very high at sunset time. The sunset spot is difficult to find, and the view to Prambanan was really poor.

I can say that Ratu Boko Palace is not really famous as Prambanan Temple or Borobudur Temple. But, please do visit this place!
You can find the beautiful temple with wide green park, many big tree, and great great view. It quite difficult to reach this palace, so I suggest to buy Prambanan- Ratu Boko (one package) and you can go Ratu Boko by shuttle services that provided in Prambanan Temple.

Ratu Boko Palace also great to visit when sunset, but the ticket price is higher than before.

This is supposedly older than Borobudur and Prambanan. It is nice to see but you can't really tell anything because all you can see is foundation stones as the parts above, which were built using wood or other less durable material and have all gone away. 

All in all some interesting history and good for some pictures.

Comme mon titre l'indique, c'est un Palais Royal qui se trouvait là. Ce n'est pas un temple. L'histoire raconte qu'un roi avait une fille et qu'un prince voulait épouser la fille de ce roi. Ce dernier refusant, le prince tua le roi et perdit la princesse qui refusa de se marier à l'assassin de son père.
Du palais il ne reste que les bases des bâtiments, les structures s'étant effondrées suite à un terrible tremblement de terre.
Mais le cadre est fort beau et l'on peut imaginer sans peine la dimension de ce palais et de ses différents bâtiments.
Nous avons aimé.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Tempat yang indah untuk pasangan yang .terdapat banyak spot dengan view yang bagus untuk berfoto.. Apalagi di sore hari ketika sunset terasa romantis..

Ratu Boko is one of the lesser-known UNESCO world heritage sites in Yogya and may often be overshadowed by Borobudur and Prambanan. But visitors should definitely stop here for a visit. The site rests atop a hill and has stunning views of Yogya city. You'll see a lot of ruins but just walking along them is quite an interesting experience. The atmosphere is serene and almost other-worldly. Be sure to stop at the restaurant just below the site - food's OK but you'll be treated to an incredible view of Yogya while you sip your coffee.

This temple can be access from prambanan temple, so there's a package to visit prambanan and ratu boko.
Ratu boko temple is located on top of a hill, and to see sunset from this temple is amaaazingg! 
Problem is..shuttle from prambanan only available until 4
So the best is to buy package only for prambanan and drive by urself to ratu boko. Also there's a nice resto called abhayangiri ☺️🙃
selain prambanan dan borobudur jogja juga punya candi yaitu candi ratu boko situs arkeologi yang beda dari situs-situs serupa. tempat ini cocok sekali jika ingin melihat sunrise

dianjurkan beli tiket paketan di prambanan karna lebih murah 
dan kalo langsung bli di ratu boko dan diatas jam 3 sore harga tiket jadi 2 kali lipat mahal nya..
We gingen er heen voor zonsondergang. Helaas was het gedeeltelijk bewolkt. De tempel/paleis zelf is weinig bezienswaardig. Het is ook nog aardig duur.

datang ke sana sore-sore, setelah menyusuri perjalanan lebih kurang satu jam dari Jogja.
sayangnya sunset sedang tidak bersahabat. awan mendung. tapi itu bikin bayar tiket jadi lebih murah. tetap tiket reguler Rp. 25.000/orang. kalau misalnya sunset, tiket yang harus dibayar 110.000/orang. padahal saya berburu sunset, karena katanya sunset di sana spekta. ya, belum rejeki. next time ke ratu boko lagi deh...

Great place with great view. Ratu Boko Palace, is located at high ground, at the first step as we enter the area, we found a restaurant, and we can see Candi Prambanan from this spot very clearly. 

When we enter the palace area, we were stun by the wide green park, and it more wonderful after we pass some stairs from this park area, we can see the structure of gate of the palace standing high and very strong. 

You will need many times to spend here, because this place is so big, and the view is so amazing. 

If you want to get here, try to rent some vehicle in the city, because no public transport will reach here. Very hard to get here, but its worth an effort.

Ratu Boko temple is believed a palace in a Kingdom.  The temple complex are big and located in a hill with a flat top.  You can get into this place by your own car or take a shuttle from Prambanan Temple.  It takes 30 minutes.  This temple site is still on renovation or rebuilding.  In a good clear day with a blue sky, the view in this temple is amazing and fascinating.  Excellent for photo hunters, either nature or models.  The restaurant in this temple is provided traditional entertainment and the view from the restaurant is so beatiful.
Komplek candi berada diatas bukit pemandangan nya bagus lokasi tidak jauh dari candi prambanan. Ada restoran nya yg view nya juga kere. Biaya masuk menjelang sore harga tiketnya jauh lebih mahal

Walaupun akses ke Ratu Boko itu agak susah (menurut gw) tapi worth it banget. Pas gw kesana lagi ada acara nikahan gitu..ternyata bagus juga buat acara nikahan. Banyak spot-spot untuk foto atau sekedar duduk-duduk santai.
Pokoknya ga nyesel jauh-jauh ke Ratu Boko.

Note : tapi sebaiknya jangan pas musim liburan biar puas fotonya

Candi Boko yang terletak tidak jauh dari Candi Prambanan merupakan sebuah tempat yang sangat eksotik. Area Candi yang cukup luas ini memiliki banyak titik/spot yang menceritakan sejarah di masa lalu. Tidak hanya itu, Candi Boko memiliki banyak pemandangan yang sangat indah. Bagi Anda yang suka fotografi, tempat ini wajib dikunjungi.

Review Text: Waktu itu ke candi ratu boko pake tiket terusan cuma bayar 50ribu kita udah bisa jalan2 liat 2 candi sekaligus (prambanan+boko) , view nya luar biasa bagus,sejuk,bersih juga pengelolaan yang cukup baik, kita bisa juga liat sunset di sana. . . candi ratu boko memang menawan
Another temple in Jogja that is very unique. It is located in a high land that is a must see. It is well maintained for tourist to appreciate the value of the temple.

在普兰巴南正门口，看到一个“Ratu Boko”字样的指引牌，上面写了看日落的绝佳位置，跟着Google地图的指示，来到距离普兰巴南不到5km的一个山丘。
这里以前是一片庞大的印度教宫殿，曾经是马塔兰王国的皇宫，现在都只剩下了建筑的地基和一些残墙。我们去的时候有很多当地人都在那儿拍照，这里非常适合照剪影。从小山丘也可以远眺普兰班南寺庙。
开放时间为：6:00-15：00，看日落就要再买15:00-17:30的门票，110,000印尼盾。日落的门票是包含了晚餐的，有一道主食（印尼炒饭或炒面）加饮料，在餐厅还可以看到日惹的夜景。
门票：成人13美金，儿童7美金。也可以买普兰巴南和博科皇宫的套票，成人25美金，儿童12.5美金，套票包含了两个景点间的免费巴士，当天有效。
交通：从普兰班南寺沿JI.St.Prambanan搭车前往。
如果天气好的话可以看到日落从这个门中落下，非常壮观，但是我们去的时候是阴天，连个太阳影子都没看见就天黑了。所以去的时候最好避开11月到次年4月的雨季。
Weather was cloudy so we didn't get to see sunset but landscape was nice it's a very spacious area, you can still feel the grandness. I can imagine how amazing sunset would be here

This is one of the temples/boko that should be in "THE MUST VISIT".

The view is stunning and the structure and the landscape is so gorgeous

If you are in Yogyakarta this temple is a must see. So clean, tourist friendly and divine! The lawns are well kept and the view is simply magnificent. Very interesting to walk about and see the wells in the back of the ruins which are fed by springs all year round! A sense of peace prevails in this place.

jika anda mengunjungi candi prambanan, maka bisa membeli tiket shuttle terusan ke candi ratu boko ini, domestik : Rp.50.000,- tetapi wisatawan mancanegara Rp.300.000,- waktu yang paling baik berkunjung ke prambanan adalah siang hari sehingga pada sore hari  bisa melihat sunset dari gerbang candi yang berada di ketinggian

If you love history this site is great fun, you can explore the large site and enjoy the ruins and different areas such as the caves and pond and different buildings. Beautifully kept like all the other sites we visited in central java { take note Myanmar } it was a pleasure to visit with full facilities and well set up for foreigners.

Review Text:
If you enter this site after 3pm, they will charge you IDR120,000 which include for Sunset fee and simple meal at the restaurant which i find really worth.

The view from Ratu Boko is simply amazing. You able to view the Prambanan temple and the paddy field and Majestic Mount Merapi. Very beautiful and amazing. Its rain for a while and even the rain creates some of the amazing View from this hill.

Careful with the pavement as it can be really slippery and the site is quite big to cover. SO take your time and enjoy this beautiful Ratu Boko.

Tempat yang memang benar-benar bagus untuk menikmati sunset jika waktunya pada musim panas dan langit sedang cerah. Maka pada waktu menjelang matahari terbenam, mataharinya seolah-olah masuk dalam pajangan tengah-tengah gerbang candi Ratu Boko. View malam juga indah.
Stunning for sunset and great for dinner. Please come at least 5PM to Ratu Boko to get a perfect sunset

The Ratu Boko Temples is not as grandiose as Borobudor and Prambanan. But what makes a visit here truly worthwhile is witnessing the sunset. And that setting sun behind those ancient structures is what makes this site unbelievably stunning.
tempatnya bersih, toilet jg bersih, pemandangan yg bagus dan bisa foto foto heheheee, lebih bagus lagi jika dtg di pagi hari dan sore menjelang matahari terbenan

Review Text:

this temple is different compared to other temples in Indonesia that I know; at least with the one in jogya and surrounding. The Temple area is large enough for walking, but not too large so that you still can enjoy your walk. It is a part of an ancient royal palace where you can see some area of palace for princesses, another area for princes; an area for royal ceremony etc but all are in open spaces; you can build your imagination of the past in this King Ratu Boko Palace. A cafe is built next to the entrance; a very nice location since it is on a hill where you can see and enjoy the panoramic view of Jogyakarta including Candi Prambanan far away. It is very nice to sit and taste local coffee or tea and fried banana or cassava while waiting for the beautiful sunset. Sunset in the Ratu Boko Temple is extremely beautiful, especially if you are good at taking pictures; wait until the sun is down and it is positioned on top of the ruins.......this is the only such picture in the world !

Ratu Boko is one among many ancient temples that scattered around Yogyakarta. This temple located on the top of the hill close to the famous Prambanan temple. Unlike the Prambanan, there are no large temples in the vicinity of Ratu Boko area. Instead you will find walls, gates, and a very large stone 'pendopo' on the highest hill of Ratu Boko area. There are not many thing that you can do here, except taking pictures, relaxing and picnic with your friends or families, or simply enjoying the sunset. As I came from the old parking lot, I'm not sure whether people can order a guided tour to know more about the history behind the Ratu Boko. But you can also ask the staff or the information center near the entrance gate whether they offer the tour or not.
.
To have a good experience here, I suggest people come here around 3-4 PM so there are plenty of time to explore around and finding the best spot to view the sunset. 
.
I don't really remember the entrance fee but I will said it upfront, the ticket price for local and foreigner is different (the foreigner ticket is more expensive).

Ratu Boko is actually a complex of temples or palaces ruines, and other functionalities building/s or public utilities such as pool. This must be a beautiful place or even city when it had been built thousand years ago. 

The site is situated on hills, 190 meters above sea level, so the surrounding views which includes mountains, valleys, rivers is quite interesting. Prambanan temple could be seen from here. Renting car or bus is the best thing to reach this place. Ratu Boko is situated in Prambanan, Sleman, near the city of Yogyakarta. 

Referring to the souvenir book, purchased by my wife at the Ratu Boko's Souvenir Shop....the place was dated around 1000 years ago ( during Mataram Hindu Kingdom Period ), there are some indications that the site was used as pilgrimage, settlemet, or even residences of royaltoes. There were also remains of pools which indicates complex arrangement of water management intended for daily needs or for ritual purposes....
There are no complete reconstructed temple in Ratu Boko, so you'll be slightly disappointed if you expected this, but the place still offers interesting hints of mystery and glorious place arrangement/lay out for anyone interested in history. 

Best visited on late afternoon in sunny day, so you could see sunset ini this place. But the ticket after 3pm is quite expensive.

A restaurant and a decent souvenir shop is available. Not recommended for elder people pr people with wheelchair. 
They have to walk through stony stairs, and the the site is situated on several "platforms". 

Dresses: Sunglasses and sunblock ( on daylight visit), light dresses, umbrellas ( for rainy days), sneakers, bring your own drink, dslr with lens hoodie is suggested. Used wide or tele lens.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Kraton Ratu Boko or Ratu Boko's Palace is located on a plateau, about 3 km south of Prambanan temple complex.  The local inhabitants named this site after King Boko, the legendary king mentioned in Loro Jonggrang folklore. In Javanese, Ratu Boko means "Stork King". The site covers 16 hectares in two hamlets (Dawung and Sambireja) of the village of Bokoharjo and Prambanan, Sleman Regency. In striking contrast to other Classic-period sites in Central Java and Yogyakarta, which are remains of temples, Ratu Boko displays attributes of an occupation or settlement site, although its precise function is unknown. The site was probably a palace complex of the kings of Syailendra or Mataram Kingdom that also built temples scattered across Prambanan Plain. This site is located 196 m above the sea level, on the highest point in the site, there is a small pavilion from which one will be able to see a panoramic view of Prambanan temple with Mount Merapi as the background.

As a heritage building, King Boko Palace is different from other inheritances. Most of other buildings are in the forms of temple or shrine, while this place - as the name implies - shows characteristics of a dwelling place. This can be known from the wooden poles and roofs, even though we can only see remains of stone building. Investigate the palace in more details and you will know more. One of them is the beautiful scenery when the sun is setting in the west. An American tourist says, "This is the most beautiful sunset on earth."

Review Text:
Candi ini terletak di tengah perbukitan. Kompleksnya sendiri terdiri dari gapura, candi pembakaran, kolam pemandian, alun-alun dan beberapa area lagi yang saya tidak begitu ingat. Areanya sangat luas, karena saya diburu waktu jadi hanya meng-explore gapura dan candi pembakaran saja. Relief candi kurang terlihat megah tidak seperti Prambanan maupun Borobudur, mungkin karena Candi Ratu Boko ini didirikan pada abad 7 SM termasuk candi yang pertama dibangun di area Jogjakarta.
Di area candi ini terdapat area pandang untuk melihat pemandangan lembah dan kota jogjakarta dari atas, dan dari tempat ini juga terlihat candi Prambanan karena jaraknya relatif dekat.
Saya ke tempat ini dengan membeli tiket paket Prambanan-Ratu Boko dimana dari kompleks Prambanan ke Ratu Boko menggunakan mobil shuttle yang sudah disediakan yang memakan waktu sekitar 15 menit perjalanan.

I have no idea where the place's good reviews come from, but different people like different kinds of stuff, and what turns me off turns other people on.  This is a ruin site, transformed into a slick archaeological park, and I do not find this especially appealing - it drives any ambiance away, but many will appreciate the cleanliness.

We were there during the day, no sunset, so maybe this is nicer - this time, it was only hot, as the site has hardly any shadow.  It is a good drive for non-buses, and the road is unpleasantly unsafe (just for the tires, but still).  Tickets are outrageously, bizarrely, unjustifiably overpriced - 185,000 rupiah (yes: onehundredeightyfivethousand), while Candi Sari, a much nicer site, is - 2,000.  (It says here this includes a meal - in our case it sure didn't, or at least we were never told, which would be even worse.)  They brag about their UNESCO world heritage status, but do not honor UNESCO cards for discount.  

Then you walk along hot paths and up hot stairs to basically knee-high ruins; the famous gates one sees on all the pictures are rebuilt and would be a nice photo-op would they not be so crowded by other tourists, but that is pretty much it.  The nice wooden pavillons along the inner ascent are occupied by food hawkers trying to lure them to their nearby dives.  But I think the sanitized grounds ruined the atmosphere the most for me.

The highlight was clearly the souvenir shop - great items, well-designed and well thought out, for reasonable prices.  Unusual, Western-style selection.  Unfortunately, the Ratu Boko was nothing I especially want to be reminded of, and so I didn't buy anything.

There are many great smaller sites in addition to the tourist magnets of Borobudur and Prambanan, such as Candi Sari and Candi Mendut; I would recommend those over this place.  But if you want infrastructure, Ratu Boko it is.

Review Text: came for the sunset, and it was amazingly beautiful! the temple is near Prambanan, if you arrive before 3pm you can take the shuttle from Prambanan to Ratu Boko temple.

Masih perjalanan traveling di Kota Gudeg Yogjakarta, setelah beberapa hari perjalanan wisata edukasi untuk anak-anak saya kali ini   mengunjungi komplek Candi Ratu Boko yang berada disebelah selatan Candi Prambanan. berada di wilayah dua Dukuh, yakni Dukuh Dawung, Desa Bokoharjo dan Dukuh Sumberwatu, Desa Sambireja, Kecamatan Prambanan Kabupaten Sleman. Keberadaan Candi Ratu Boko sebetulnya bagian dari istana kerajaan, disekitarnya terdapat benteng dan parit sebagai unsur pertahanan. Selain itu sisa reruntuhan tempat tinggal juga terdapat dalam komplek tersebut. Keberadaan Candi Ratu Boko tidak lepas dengan legenda rakyat setempat "Loro Jonggrang ". Bangunan secara keseluruhkan menyisakan peradaban masyarakat penganut agama Budha namun terdapat pula beberapa unsur agama Hindu diantaranya Archa Durga, Ganesa dan Yoni di dalamnya. Dengan mengelilingan komplek percandian seluas sekitar 25 hektar, anak-anak bisa mempelajari arsitektur dan peradaban masyarakat  dari bangunan situs yang tersisa.  Sekitar 3 jam saya berputar mengelilingi lokasi Candi dengan dibantu pemandu wisata lokal dari Yogjakarta yang juga sahabat saya sangat beruntung sekali. Sehingga anak-anak saya bisa dengan leluasa menanyakan setiap detail sisi bangunan dan legenda rakyat yang berkaitan dengan keberadaan Candi Ratu Boko dengan Loro Jonggrang.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
We visited Ratu Boko after going to Prambanan.  Did a half day afternoon private tour as we wanted to time our visit with sunset at Ratu Boko.  Our entrance ticket to Ratu Boko included a drink (coffee or tea) and snack at the restaurant.  As we did not want the snack, they allowed us to pick fruit juice instead.

The sunset at Ratu Boko was beautiful.  Sitting around waiting for the sunset was great.  The place was breezy and everyone was just sitting on the ground waiting for the moment.  Definitely have to time your visit at sunset.
The location of this temple, high on the ground, makes it a good place to take sunrise photos with the temple as the foreground. Come visit on weekdays to avoid the crowd.

We arrived on the back of two motorcycles, and parked up. I managed to get  the locals price because we have been living in Jakarta and Bogor, and gave the ticket office the addresses. 

Once we had got the plastic ticket which looked like a credit card, we took this to the entry machine and started the long walk up the hill to the temple. Almost immediately the edifice was apparent, in front of us about 1/2 a Km away the first wall and gateway of the building and site presented itself.

On the pathway up were various gazebos in which people could rest, however we were in a hurry to discover history and in particular the Hindu history of this place ! 
The temple and Palace are easy to understand, however after the devastation of the past, its going to be a long job to get all the stone back to the way that it was ! 

There are three layers going up the hill and each layer is a story in its self. The top layer of the temple / Palace includes the rock pools that the men and women would have bathed in ( Seperate pools ) The final Ramparts and walls of the Palace would have been an imposing view for others to see from the opposite side of the hills. 

Frankly I think a day spent here would be too short and we chose not to go to Parambanan. Instead we spent most of the day in the temple grounds and then left to head down the hill to the town of Prambanan to have a late lunch and some welcome respite from the sunshine on the Hill !
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: In my opinion, I think Ratu Boko is a truly a great place to see sunset. You can take photos or simply just relax and watch sunset.

Since the entry ticket price for the Prambanan temples includes entry to Ratu Boko (and a shuttle service from Prambanan to Ratu Boko every 20 to 30 mins or so - but I was told the last shuttle departs RB for Prambanan at 3.30pm), one might as well visit RB together with Prambanan, which, in my humble opinion, is well worth a visit on its own.

Though the sunset at RB is much raved about, I did not manage to witness that scene as I had to head back to Prambanan by 3.30pm. Still, set against a blue sky and greenery, RB in day time is still very much a beauty in its own right. There is very little by way of signs and explanations - for that you would have to get a guide (which I did not, as I was there mainly for photo ops). However, there are general signs telling you what stands at which area (e.g., the palace, or a cave). All in all a nice stroll with decent photo ops and worth at least an hour and half strolling around.
Dengan suasana sore hari bisa melihat sunset dengan jelas dan bagus ditambah halaman yang luas dan alam yang indah
Candi ini secara umum berupa gerbang. Banyak candi yang tak utuh di sekitarnya. Jalan menuju candi ini cukup menyenangkan banyak ruang terbuka.

going here by the last shuttle bus from prambanan at 2.30 pm cz wanna see the sunset. but to go down, no public transport so must take ojek (ask to the ticket booth) at 6 pm for 15000. 
its not a temple, its more like a palace ruin. the spectacular is the pool which is still unknown how it fill the water. 
because its weekend, the sunset is not the best. better visit in weekdays and rent motorbike :)

The temple or more like a ruin doesn't stand out if compare to prambanan or Borobudur. But is a great place to see gunung merapi, best view from the restaurant dining area. We only found out this after the sunset.
Amazing place, and the view is like a dream, the sunset is great and if you are intophotography, then get your camera ready for a view you will never regret

Candi Ratu Boko ini cantik banget jika senja hari.....dari lokasi parkirnya cukup jauh tapi jalannya enak...sudah dalam area kompleks...jika capek bisa duduk duduk dan berphoto ria.
Area candi terawat,bersih....saya suka dsini...enaknya datang sore sore menjelang senja...

This temple is on a hill not far from the Prambanen temple area. There isnt very much in terms of historical ruins here, but this is an excellent place to view the sunset. After an easy climb up to where the temple gate is, you get to a plateau that is covered in well maintained grass turf. Try to get here a good half hour before sunset. You need to position yourself well so that you will be able to see the sunset take place as viewed from beneath the temple gates. 
The only irritating bit is that many tourists there are just interested in taking selfies at the temple gate, and they obstruct the view of the sunset. If you want to take a nice unobstructed shot, you can just request these people to move aside for a few minutes. Most will oblige !!

Review Text: Tempat yang menarik untuk membayangkan aktivitas para putri di masa lalu.  Area sekitar candi bersih dan terawat.  Ada restoran tempat kita bisa melihat pemandangan dari kejauhan termasuk candi Prambanan.  Sesekali, kita bisa melihat kereta api melintas nun jauh di bawah sana.

8th century Ratu Boko also called as Kraton (palace) Ratu Boko is located at hill plateau three kilometres south of Prambanan temple complex, near the airport 196 meters above the sea level. It is probably named after the king Boko, descendant of Shailendra dynasty. It was probably a fortified palace complex rather than a temple. The other theory is that it was called as Abhyagiri Vihara (peaceful hill), built for spiritual life free from danger. It was accidentally discovered by a Dutch researcher Van Boeckhiltz. 
Landscape is dominated by two huge gates for three terraces, lots of stairs and a crematorium (Candi Pembakaran). There are few Hindu & Buddhist shrines in the complex. There are few pool areas too & women quarters. 
It is quite a favourite place for younger generations. Gardens are well maintained & thronged by boys & girls busy with taking selfies & gossips. I was there in Ramadan days, so this was the place to enjoy after breaking the fast. It is a great place to see the sunset on a clear day. Abhyagiri restaurant is located at the front gate & gives a lovely view of the city. View of the Prambanan is not very great. They also offer tasty refreshing welcome drinks to the ticket holders visiting Ratu Boko. There is a lot of walking in a very humid weather specially after long walking & climbing at Prambanan adds up to the fatigue yet the stunning sunset view is rejuvenating.
Untuk mendapatkan View Prambanan yang indah dapat dilakukan dengan berwisata di tempat ini, sambil menyantap hidangan di restorannya

Candi Ratu Boko sebenarnya adalah istana Ratu Boko. Yang cukup besar untuk dilihat ialah gerbang utama dan istana yang berada di paling belakang. Jalan kaki dari depan sampai ke belakang membutuhkan usaha yang cukup besar. Membawa anak kecil sedikit sulit. Istana yang di dalam cukup menarik.

Review Text:
I loved this place...

To get here you should get a taxi/rental car. It on top of a hill and hence the view is awesome. There are many structures which look like ruins of some old structure and will leave you spellbound. 
The door is specially mysterious. There are many spots where you can sit and spend good time. 

Best time to visit-
late Afternoon till sunset. The sunset is particularly great event. You can see the sun between the giant doors. It was kinda nice. Also the breeze is better in the evening. On you way back you will be able to see nice light trails of vehicles down the hill which is also kinda nice. 

Clicking pictures-
Visit there in the late afternoon opens you up to a picturesque view. There are many great clicks to capture from the top of hill. Don't just stop at the main gate but venture a little further and you will find many spots to sit calmly and click great awesome pictures.

What to do-
Just sit there and relax and feel the breeze. On entry/exit there is a restaurant which gives you chance to dine on top of the hill overlooking an awesome panorama.

Fee-
We had a bit of confusion about the fee. Our hotel staff had told us a very small sum of money but that is actually just for Indonesian. Just like most of the places in Bali and Jogjakarta the fee for foreigners is higher (much higher).

Food and other facility-
Like I mentioned there is a restaurant at the top and you can buy some packaged food and carry it with you while you visit the main temple. There are toilets everywhere there, so quite convenient to spend 2 hours or more.

I find Ratu Bokor is excellent place for those who like Beat-Off yet easy ride. I took the package entrance ticket with the Prambanan which include the shuttle bus, but if you have energy and time you should bike or motorcycle uphill, it passes peaceful villages.

Many tourist will only take the main gate pict and felt bored after that, Thank GOD they left the treasure further off the path, just follow the path 5mins max of walking downhill, you ll be in another ruins with small natural ponds. Walking further are quiet scenery and bird singing rhyme.

La entrada cuesta USD15 (incluye una bebida) y para mi no valió la pena pues lo que queda de las ruinas del palacio no es muy interesante.  Al estar elevado tiene buenas vistas del entorno, arrozales, la ciudad de yogkarta. Muchas van solo por las vistas al atardecer.
An ancient temple in the top of hill which best for taking shot in the afternoon and has magnificent views.

Is a historical relic, not really much to see, but has a good view point for sunset and the Volcano if the sky are clear.
Strongly recommend go there around sunset time. There has a restaurant at the entrance , can enjoy the volcano n sunset view while having dinner or a cup of coffee too.
PS: No student price for this place.

The Ratu Boko Sunset starts from 3pm to 6pm. Likewise the tickets office opens during that time.The fee is inclusive of a light snack and a drink at the Resto. There is also a show performance. You can look up the entrance fee at
the following website for Ratu Boko - ratuboko@borobudurpark.co.id
Tel : +62274496510

The price is quit steep and what is visible is not that impressive. We visited many temples surrounding the prambaran ( wikipedia prambaran complex shows a good map of all the temples) which were all gems! So rent a motorbike and go around which cost around 2000 rupiahs per temple.

Ratu Boko temple is one of beautiful temple in Yogyakarta, it near Prambanan temple.
Landscape is very beautiful, and looks more beautiful when sunset.
Ratu Boko temple has a wonderful place and it saved history a kingdom in Indonesia.

And dont worry about food, there is restaurant in front of gate.

If you want to travelling to Ratu Boko temple, i suggest you to visit this place in afternoon and dont missed to see the beautiful sunset. Maybe in afternoon look hot but trust me it will paid by beautiful scenery and fresh air around there.

Ratu Boko Palace is a temple located in hill with nice view. First I went the Prambanan Temple and buy packages for prambanan and ratu boko (Rp 50.000/person for local tourist) they provided the shuttle bus every 15 minutes. We went to ratu boko first and the weather is really hot with the blue sky (dont forget to bring sunglasses, umbrella or hat)

The place is nice, clean and they have a restaurant with a good view, you can see Merapi Mountain and the city! The restaurant open until 9 pm. After visit this place i went back to prambanan and we back to ratu boko by ourself to see the sunset. This is the best place to see sunset from above. If you want to see the sunset only, the ticket is Rp 110.000 (after 4 pm)
We went to the hill to see the landscape view with the stairs and we just feel the silent when the sun goes down with the wind blowing my mind. Lucky us, we can see the airplane fly when they want to landing in Adi Sucipto airport haha

I may came back again next time and eat in the restaurant at night.

You keep climbing and walking in the hope that you will see something. The views of Prambanan Temple from here are not great either. Please do not waste time and do not buy a combined ticket for this and Prambanan. It is a farce.

Candi ini merupakan Kraton Ratu Boko yang sudah tidak utuh lagi... Tempatnya terletak diatas bukit sehingga dapat melihat Candi Prambanan dari atas... Candi Ratu Boko sendiri memiliki nuansa yang sangat indah dengan batu-batu alamnya yang besar-besar.
Not to spicy for expatriate, served well and not too expensive. The surrounding is excellent, where you will see the sun down and Prambanan Temple on the same sight.

Candi yang dibangun di dataran tinggi ini menandakan keagungan serta kemakmuran pada masanya, sisa-sisa kemegahan tampak nyata, jarak yang cukup jauh dan panas terik matahari dibanding dengan candi-candi lainnya tidak menyurutkan langkah untuk mengetahui. Banyak yang mengatakan bahwa keraton Boko adalah keraton Hindu, tetapi dilihat dari sejarah dan bentuk-bentuk Stupa, Ciri-ciri lain Vihara/candi Buddha ini juga terdapat lingga, yoni dan arca Ganesha. keraton ini dibuat oleh keturunan Raja Syailendra yang beragama Buddha, memang pada masa itu agama Buddha dan agama Hindu berdampingan dengan damai. Keraton ini bernama Abhayagiri Vihara yang secara harafiah dapat diartikan sebagai Vihara yang berada di gunung yang jauh dari marabahaya (Gunung yang damai).  Dari pelataran awal menuju pintu candi juga terlihat kemegahan candi Prambanan dengan latar belakang Gunung Merapi. Menakjubkan

Review Text: The sunset view from the Ratu Boko Temple is what attracts most visitors here. Grab the camera and get ready to take some stunning shots of Yogyakarta from the ancient palace-temple ruins. This place can be skipped if time is of the essence.

just a miles away from Prambanan temple, almost similar in its content but more wider space to lunch and dinner gathering activities, since Boko have unique restaurants with special taste

istana ratu bilqis itu berada di deket prambanan, yang dikenal sebagai candi ratu boko.
terlalu dihubung-hubungkan siy... tapi asyik juga kok buat pengetahuan. jadi bekas candi ratu boko itu cuman tanah hanya tersisa gerbang indah. tanpa ada batu atau tembok tersisa. gak percaya?? coba deh berkunjung ke sana

Recommended to visit if you like history and culture. Don't forget to wear hat or sunglasses and SPF if you visit at noon. The place is not cover with tree shades and the sun will burn you.

Sisa reruntuhan yang tersisa juga terawat, beberapa bagian patung juga masih utuh. terdapat cafe untuk menikmati matahari terbenam yang cukup indah disini.

Review Text: akses menuju candi ratu boko bisa menggunakan transportasi yang disediakan di area candi prambanan. Namun kita harus tahu jadwal kapan bis berangkat dari prambanan dan kapan bis pulang dari candi ratu boko agar kita tidak ketinggalan, mengingat lokasi candi ratu boko sepertinya cukup jauh dari akses kendaraan umum. dari candi ratu boko kita bisa melihat view kota jogja termasuk candi prambanan dari kejauhan, kalau nasib sedang bagus, kita juga bisa melihat view gunung merapi sebagai latar belakang. Saya sendiri masih penasaran untuk menikmati sunset atau sunrise dari kawasan candi boko

Kami naik Bus Transjogja dari malioboro, cukup murah karena hanya dengan 3k kami sudah sampai di halte Prambanan. lalu perjalanan menuju Candinya sendiri bisa berjalan kaki, atau naik "betor" (Becak Motor).

Kami membeli tiket terusan Candi Prambanan dan Candi Ratu Boko. dan dari Prambanan menuju Boko, sudah disediakan shuttle bus "gratis" bagi pengunjung yang nantinya akan antar jemput dari Prambanan-Boko dan sebaliknya, jadi tidak perlu khawatir untuk tidak bisa pulang.
Extraordinary Views and Enchanted Panorama from top. Please go in afternoon before dark time, you'll see nice sunset.

Saya dan beberapa teman menyempatkan diri berkunjung ke Candi Ratu Boko akhir Januari lalu. Dari Jogja, terdapat beberapa alternatif transportasi ke tempat ini. Yang relatif murah (namun agak sedikit effort) adalah menggunakan transjogja. Dari halte terakhir bisa disambung dengan taksi. Pilihan kedua adalah langsung menggunakan taksi dari Kota Jogja. Perjalanan kurang lebih 30-45 menit (argo one way taksi kami sekitar 100-120 ribu, saya agak lupa). Pilihan ketiga adalah sewa mobil sehingga lebih fleksibel apabila ada banyak tempat yang akan dikunjungi.
Waktu itu kami tiba agak sore, sekitar jam 16.30 dan mulai gerimis. Cukup disayangkan karena salah satu tujuan kami adalah mengejar momen sunset. Namun, overall kami cukup puas menikmati kunjungan ke ratu boko. Sungguh takjub membayangkan bangunan-bangunan candi dan reruntuhan kuno ini adalah peninggalan beberapa abad lalu.
Untuk anda yang sedang traveling/kebetulan dinas ke jogja, tidak ada salahnya menyempatkan diri mampir ke ratu boko!

Clean
Easy to reach
Nice restaurant with splendid view
Clear direction instruction
Lovely sites overall.

Although not a lot is left of the palace/establishment, it leaves anyone to imagine what the place might have looked like back then - and of course remembering Prambanan and Borobudur to remind of the advance architecture built during the same period. One must imagine the path the Kings and Queens had to take to go to either Borobudur or Prambanan in the ancient days.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
景色が綺麗だとの書き込みを見て、行ってきました。
でも、実際はわざわざ行くほどの価値が有るとは思えませんでした。
先にプランバナン等を見てしまってからでは、よっぽど興味がある人以外は行かなくても良いのでは？

Nice & comfortable place, no so much people compare with others famous attraction. Some upgrating construct work is on going. Sunset ticket come with snack & drink. Just wonder mostly of the tour guide will suggest no to visit.

Candi Ratu Boko menawarkan pesona candi jawa yang magis dan memukau. Pastikan anda mengenakan alas kaki yang nyaman dan kondisi tubuh yang sehat karena di sini anda akan banyak berolahraga jalan dan naik turun tangga. Lokasi yang cantik, menentramkan dan fotogenic membuatnya bikin kangen untuk datang lagi dan lagi.

I went here by buying a tour ticket in Prambanan Temple, just adding another USD 1.5 from normal ticket to Prambanan, and i get free shuttle bus to Ratu Boko.
Located around 20 minutes drive from Prambanan, Ratu Boko is an exotic temple, but there are contruction undergoing there, restoration.
Not much you can do here, because most of the statue is broken or gone.
Good to know this place.

Ratu Boko is another temple besides the famous borobudur and prambanan. But for me Ratu Boko is a very exotic one. The best view can be taken when it is sunset. It is so exotic and beautiful. This place is recommended for those who wants to take a pre-wedding photograph. Trust me it'll be so worth it. Unfortunately, the temple is a bit slippery especially after raining. So, you should watch ur self out and wear a comfortable sandals or shoes.

Mengunjungi Candi Ratu Boko tidaklah sulit...Bila berkunjung ke Candi Prambanan dapat membeli tiket yang satu paket dengan Candi Ratu Boko. Bila ingin mengunjungi terpisah, petunjuk menuju tempat ini dapat ditemui dengan mudah disepanjang jalan dari Candi Prambanan menuju Candi Ratu Boko. Baiknya bila mengunjungi tempat ini pagi atau menjelang sore karena bila disiang hari bertepatan dengan panas yang begitu terik, bisa membuat lemas. Saat saya mengunjungi kembali keraton ini di bukit yang berhadapan dengan Candi Prambanan telah berdiri petilasan yang didalamnya terdapat Patung Dewa Siwa. Keraton ini banyak menyimpan misteri karena dulunya merupakan pusat pemerintahan Kerajaan Mataram kuno. Dilokasi ini juga tidak perlu kuatir tersedia warung baik di dekat taman hingga dekat keputren.. Bila ingin melihat pemandangan Jogja sembari menanti matahari terbenam, bisa mencoba hidangan di Restoran Ratu Boko. Sejujurnya saya menikmati Soto Ayam, dan secangkir teh. Harga yang saya bayar terbilang murah bila mengingat lokasi dan tempat yang bagus ditambah makanan dan minumnya lumayan enak...Tidak ada salahnya meluangkan waktu setelah menikmati keindahan Candi Ratu Boko dapat singgah menikmati hidangan direstoran ini. Sungguh tidak mengecewakan...

This is a Temple on a quite big area, old history and nice place to visit and spend some time.
It is on a top of a hill with a nice view too.

It is an educational visit, on the place there is also a nice restaurant with local food very good one.

Enjoy your travel.Claudio

Ini tempat keren meski belum di create maksimal. Lahan yg luas jadi potensi untuk mengenalkan budaya Jawa. Semoga di kemudian hari bisa diisi pertunjukan tari maupun event berkala. Lokasi yang tidak terlalu jauh dan bisa mampir ke kampung teletubis. Jogja istimewahh

When we arrived the temple, it was 5 minutes past three, nobody was there except us. Then I found the admission fee was very high as I compared it with other attractions. From 10 a.m. to 3 p.m., the charge is US$13 for adult and US$7 for children; and the sunset ticket is IDR110,000. Should I wait for another two hours something simply for the sunset in a ruin, I certainly gave it up because it was not worthwhile.

I was lucky at Ratu Boko, it was the end of the day, the sun was setting, storm clouds were gathering and I was all alone. The experience was eerie and brilliant. As an archaeological site this lttle understood place consisting mostly of foundation platforms and a few walled enclosures isn't the bees knees but a very good place to end a day of temple exploriation. There is an affordable restaurant (which even had their gamelan orchestra going for me alone) with a great view of Mount Merapi.

Lokasi diatas gunung menjadikan keraton ini sangat tepat untuk melihat pemandangan sekitar. Sayangnya masih banyak yang belum tahu lokasi ini, namun sekarang sudah ada paket dari prambanan kesini. Untuk sejarahnya memang masih perlu studi lebih lanjut.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
menuju kesini sebaiknya, membeli tiket terusan diloket candi prambanan seharga rp.45 ribu, tiap 15 menit sekali ada bis sedang ber-AC mengantarkan kita pergi pulang, prambanan-ratu boko. mulai pagi hingga sekitar jam 4 sore, 
pemandangan perjalanan adalah persawahan, 
di area candi ratu boko, sedang dalam tahap perbaikan dibagian taman
cuaca sangat panas, disarankan bawa air mineral, meski ada restoran kecil dan warung kecil diarea dalam candi.
lebih baik pakai topi lebar dan kaca mata hitam, daripada berpayung ria, sungguh merepotkan. 
semakin jauh masuk ke area pemandian dan gua, suasana semakin mistis, dan sangat tenang. jalan masih banyak ditumbuhi lalang menuju area ini, 
ketemu ular panjang langsing warna hijau rumput, menelusup dari arah gua ke arah tangga, kuputuskan tidak naik tangga terakhir, tempat diatas, ada patung alat kelamin pria & wanita .

Candi ini terletak tidak jauh dari Candi Prambanan. sekitar 3-5 km selatan Prambanan. Lokasinya di atas bukit, sehingga pastikan kendaraan anda mampu menanjaki jalan yang lumayan terjal ke arah candi ini.
Konon katanya candi ini adalah istana Ratu Bilqis pada jaman Nabi Sulaiman, walaupun kebenarannya masih belum bisa dipastikan.

Panorama di Candi ini karena terletak di atas bukit sangat indah, terutama untuk menunggu Sunrise maupun melewatkan Sunset di sini. Hamparan kota Jogja akan terlihat dari atas bukit ini. 
Recommended untuk foto-foto di sini waktu sunrise dan sunset..

Candi ini memiliki ketinggian sekitar 300 meter dari permukaan laut. Tiket masuk candi ini dikenakan Rp25.000. Ada layanan antar-jemput gratis bila pembelian tiket dilakukan bersamaan dengan tiket masuk Candi Prambanan. Udaranya cukup sejuk serta tersedia tempat makan dengan pemandangan yang sangat indah dan fantastis. Pesawat terbang banyak yang melintas di wilayah candi ini. Sangat fantastis.

Breath taking view of the scenery.
Not much to see but the sceneries..the surroundings with mountains is beautiful..

Ratu Boko Temple is one of unpredictable treasure, that I'd found during my journey about one month ago. It's coincidentally suggested to substitute the visit to Prambanan Temple. Yes the place is near the Prambanan, but we have to take a hill side route a little further. The ticket cost was 5 USD. And there's a beautiful small cafe with spectacular scenary of mountain and valley. If you like a touch of mistery, this temple will suit your curiousity. And it has a very strong ambient of grace. And somehow you almost can hear ancient prayers singing by the wind blows. Touching every gracious statues and some holy corner. Ratu Boko supposed to be a kingdom once in megalithikum era. Ruled by a queen with many daughters. So in that place inside, down the hill, you can find ancient pools where the princesses and their servants taking a bath. And there's also two caves, where the queen used to concentrate her meditation.
You will be amazed by the scenary and will have some precious personal experience like a miracle. Enjoy this place by take a walking, may be with your love one, or your teenage kids, slowly and relax. You will love your new experience. Happy journey!

Nothing much I can say here but this temple's completely awesome with its wide and green area, along with the ruinings which are still remaint. We could get such wonderful sunrise and sunset views over the Yogyakarta city and mountains from this place. The night view's very very spectacular, especially when you spend more time for dining and enjoying the instruments played in its popular roof top restaurant. Candle light dinner? Yes, they have it for you!

Its near Prambanan, just outside the Prambanan premises. A bus (shuttle) will take you to it if you get the joined tickets. Its worth a visit during sunset. Do note that its under renovation now so your pictures might not come as good. on asked about when would the renovation be complete, I didn't actually got a clear answer. But definitely wort a visit.

Actually we didn't plan to visit this temple at first, but the ticket officer at Prambanan Temple suggested continuous tickets [including bus-shuttle] to visit this temple. We thought it was a tempting offer, so we took it. And we were not disappointed at all!

Ratu Boko Temple is located uphill. The scenery is breathtaking indeed! We saw ruins of the castles, and I could not hep myself imagining the beautiful princesses sat and played in the Keputren while their maids were silently waiting for their commands. We saw the deserted pool which certainly was  beautiful once. It was all so fascinating!

Candi Ratu Boko merupakan sebuah situs purbakala yang berada di atas bukit. Untuk menuju ke lokasi kita dapat naik bis Trans Jogja dengan tarif Rp.3.600 saja untuk sekali jalan apabila anda menginap di pusat Kota Jogja, seperti yang saya lakukan. Akan lebih mudah apabila berkunjung kesini dengan membeli tiket terusan dari candi Prambanan, hanya Rp.45.000 saja untuk bisa masuk ke dua situs bersejarah ini. Saya rasa harga yang ditawarkan sangat sebanding dengan pelayanan dan fasilitas yang tersedia disini. Shuttle Bus dari Prambanan yang bagus, petugas yang ramah ditambah penataan lokasi yang begitu nyaman membuat kita tidak akan menyesal. Sebagai sebuah reruntuhan peninggalan, Istana Ratu Boko memiliki keunikan dibanding peninggalan lain. Jika bangunan lain umumnya berupa candi, maka sesuai namanya istana ini menunjukkan ciri-ciri sebagai tempat tinggal atau pemukiman penduduk. Itu ditunjukkan dari adanya bangunan berupa tiang dan atap yang terbuat dari bahan kayu, meski kini yang tertinggal hanya lantai atau batur yang terbuat dari batu saja. Telusurilah reruntuhan istana ini, maka anda akan mendapatkan lebih banyak lagi, salah satunya pemandangan sunset yang sangat indah. Kita akan betah berlama-lama di tempat ini, sekedar untuk menikmati suasana yang begitu tentram. Banyak tempat duduk yang berada disisi taman yang bisa kita gunakan. Jika anda muslim dan ingin sholat, jangan kuatir, tersedia masjid di dalam kompleks candi yang bisa digunakan bahkan saya sempat ikut sholat jum'at berjama'ah di tempat ini.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Traveling to Ratu Boko Temple made me close to wikipedia and google. There is only limited information which also only describe about technical information, like size, approximate usage, location, etc. There is no historical background or anything which can make us think of this temple in depth. The signpost is also unclear. We had no idea where to go and what we're actually seen. 
It will be nice if the tourism department/ministry take a good care of such tourism places, so that curious visitor will be well informed.

Review Text: ngelihat sunset di candi boko itu paling keren..ke candi boko mending beli ticket terusan prambanan-Boko cukup murah 45rb dibanding beli secara terpisah. ngga usah bingung nanti ada shuttle yang mengantarkan kita dari prambanan ke boko PP. candi yang cantik dan menawan apalagi kita bisa menikmati sunset dari atas candi.

Baru pertama kali kesini saat membeli tiket 1 paket masuk ke Candi Prambanan.
Untuk menuju kesini akan diantar oleh shuttle bis dari Candi Prambanan, tetapi bisa juga menggunakan transportasi pribadi.
Candi ini terletak di atas bukit yang memiliki pemandangan indah. Sepanjang jalan dari pintu masuk menuju candi terdapat kursi2 yang bisa diduduki apabila pengunjung lelah.

Kita jadi mengetahui hal-hal apa saja yang biasanya dilakukan oleh seorang raja, kawasan yang sejuk dan indah serta masih alami membuat kita semakin betah untuk berada disana, apabila sore hari kita dapat menyaksikan matahari terbenam

Tempatnya keren, Candinya terpisah-pisah dan lokasinya sangat luas. Pada senja hari suasana menjadi romantis. Lampu-lampu ditengah gelapnya Candi, plus citylight kota Jogja sangat indah. Di sini juga kita dapat melihat Pesawat yang akan landing dekat dengan kawasan Candi di bagian atas.

Candi yang memiliki panorama pemandangan candi prambanan dan gunung merapi yang segaris lurus sungguh luar biasa. 
Suasana mistis dan serasa terbang ke abad 8 bila menghabiskan sore tanpa melewatkan sunset di candi ratu boko

akankah tersibak?

Review Text: Amazing,. bisa liat merapi dan juga candi prambanan dari ketinggian..sayang saat kesana Gunung Merapinya sedang tertutup kabut. Cocok buat yang suka Hiking :)

Yes, yes, yes, the sunset (and sunrise) are presumably awesome. And if you feel that paying $13 USD to simply watch the sun go up or down, then why not? But there are many places to watch that for free. (And FYI, this places uses the double-price system for "foreign-looking" people).

Despite the price I enjoyed strolling the grounds. Do not expect anything similar to Prambanan etc, and you might enjoy it too. In fact, if you have time, do this on a different day entirely, and perhaps before you see the big sites nearby.  It's a fairly small complex (in comparison) but still could take 2 hours to walk around. Only a few of the ruins have been restored, which forces you to use your imagination - which is not a bad thing at all. Take your time, stop at one of the snack stands to chat with a resident of the area, chat with the roosters, etc. :-) 

I have read that there is a combo ticket with Prambanan for $20, including transport between the two temples. That sounds like a better deal - but we did not see it offered at Ratu Boko. 

Photography note: "Catch the sun set over Prambanan" might be a bit misleading unless you have a long lens. The temples are a bit far for a phone camera, etc. But you can get some nice  photos overlooking the landscape (on a clear day you can see Merapi). And the Boko gate is quite attractive too. 

There is not much protection from sun or rain, so be prepared.  If you have a private car or motorbike, consider not using the main parking lot (you'll climb many stairs!), but to go to the "back" where you can drive up the hill to a parking lot (space permitting). 

PS; Your admission ticket includes one "welcome drink" but you must first exchange the coupon for another ticket before going to the restaurant! LOL.  And the restaurant servers completely ignored us, so we decided not to eat there after all.

I visited this place last month when I was in yogyakarta on family holiday.  we are charged 500K IDR as an entry fee for 2 Adults and 2 Children which was completely rip off. There is nothing much to see for the cost you are paying. There are only ruins and when I asked to officer he said that renovation work is under progress.

I would say big no if any one planning to visit this place.

Candi dengan nilai sejarah yang luar biasa bagi anda para pecinta budaya dan alam, candi ini merupakan salah satu ciptaan leluhur kita yang patut dilestarikan, dan tentu saja bagi anda pecinta fotografi tempat ini cocok dijadikan tempat hunting

This spot seems tailor-made for sunset views over Mt. Merapi. And I must admit, the view is stunning. But, consider going up at sunrise, if you can. The advantages, I found were many:

For example, you will have the place to yourself and you still get an incredible view of Merapi (if it's a clear day).

Also, I might suggest going in by the back gate. The quiet village roads seem like they rarely see visitors.

Bulan Agustus 2014, saya dan teman teman SD-SMP mengadakan kunjungan ke Candi Ratu Boko dalam rangka reuni. Pertama tama saya hanya mengira situs ini tidak lebih baik dari candi-candi yang telah saya ketahui sebelumnya, seperti Prambanan dan Borobudur. Ternyata saya salah sangka. Setelah mendengarkan penjelasan pemandu wisata di dalam Candi Boko ini, ternyata kisah dibaliknya tersimpan cikal bakal candi-candi besar lain dari Kerajaan Ratu Boko (Kerajaan Syailendra) saat itu. Ada cerita legenda mengesankan didalamnya, kisah Bandung Bondowoso dan Roro Jongrang berasal adalah berasal dari Candi Ratu Boko ini...! Di dalam situs candi ini, kita juga bisa menyaksikan sisa sisa kejayaan Kerajaan Syailendra saat itu, seperti adanya fondasi fondasi Keraton yang sangat tertata sesuai kepentingannya masing masing, ada sisa sisa tempat permandian para Puteri Raja dan disekat untuk para keluarga kerajaan lainnya, dlsbnya.. Bila sudah berkunjung ke Candi ini, kita akan lebih menghargai bagaimana kisah sejarah masa lalu Kerajaan kerajaan di Jawa khususnya dan Indonesia pada umumnya, dan berupaya untuk melestarikan nilai nilai luhur adat ketimuran kita.. Semoga bermanfaat.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Ke candi ratu boko karena ambil satu paket sama candi prambanan. Dan lokasinya kirain deket, ternyatah sodara-sodara, naik turun gunung, tapi seru sih. dan pas sudah smpe disana juga kita masih harus jalan lagi. Candinya si kecil, objek fotonya sedikit, tapi ktnya c bagus kalau mau liat sunset.

Kompleks candi yang tiketnya bisa dibeli satu paket dengan tiket masuk Prambanan, nanti ada drop/pick up service dari dan ke Prambanan setiap setengah jam sekali. Reruntuhan kompleks candi ini jauh lebih luas dari Prambanan. Berkeliling kesini , seolah-olah kita dibawa terdampar ke 300 tahun yang lalu dengan pemandangan dari atas Bukit. Salah satu candinya ada Candi Pembakaran sekali memandang langsung ke areal persawahan di bawah bukit.
Kompleks Candi Ratu Boko ini tak pernah bosan saya kunjungi. Luas sekali dan masih diselimuti misteri. Selalu membuat saya mencari referensi terkini dari para ahli.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I went there when it's raining :( so i can't see the sunset. But i think this place is good because we can see the ancient live just from the temple such as Pendopo, cave for 'semedi', burial place etc. Dont forget to have some meals here while you enjoying Mount Merapi view.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Древние руины, к сожалению, осталось не очень много и не получается сформировать точное представление о там как это было в те времена. Очень часто гиды туда возят на смотреть на закат, но нас он сильно не впечатлил. Специально я бы туда не поехала, но если будете проезжать мимо, то конечно остановитесь

I say this because if you do it after the two majestic temples, then you are bound to be underwhelmed. It's not that Ratu Boko is any less beautiful but expect a lot of space with a scattering of things to see. Considering the price that you pay for foreigner entry fee (USD15), you'll probably end up bickering about that too. So, do yourself a favour and either visit this place first or skip it altogether.

PS: If you intend to visit Ratu Boko, take advantage of the cafe at the foot of the hill. It has a gorgeous view of Yogyakarta.

sepanjang perjalanan saya sangat takjub dengan pemandangan dan keindahan sisa sisa peninggalan umat hindu, walaupun sekarang sudah menjadi puing tetapi sisa kejayaannya masih nampak seperti melasti kerajaan. Jadi sangat berkesan melihat sisa sisa kemegahan kerajaan umat hindu.

candi ini dekat dengan candi prambanan, selain itu saya kemarin mengambil tour dr candi prambanan dan ratu boko, sepanjang jalan kita disuguhi pemandangan sawah nan asri, setelah sampai disana kita bisa melihat sisa sisa kejayaan umat hindu, juga kita bisa melihat melasti raja, dan sisa sisa bangunan zaman dahulu.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Mengunjungi Ratu Boko untuk kedua kalinya, mengambil paket prambanan ratu boko, menggunakan antar jemput dari prambanan. Mengunjungi tempat ini memang tidak membosankan, selain pemandangannya yang indah, sisa-sia bangungan istana candi yang megah. selalu membayangkan bagaimana dulu megahnya istana ini zaman dahulu. Tahun ini kok masuk tidak pakai kain khusus ya padahal tahun lalu pakai, hmm entahlah dan rusa-rusa jg sudah tidak ada. Sudah banyak improvement fasilitas di ratu boko, seperti sudah dibangun jalan conblock menuju ke bagian bangunan dibawah/belakang. untuk jemputan terakhir jam 15:00 jadi mendingan klo ambil paket prambanan-boko mending ke boko dulu baru ke prambanan. 
Masukan adalah pengelola menyediakan restaurant yang harganya lebih sederhana, karena saat ini hanya ada restaurant yg sepertinya harganya diatas rata-rata. dan lebih dikelola untuk penjual mie/minuman yg ada diarea ratu boko.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: There's not much to see other than some foundations of old buildings. It was raining while we were there which didn't help our appreciation of the site. The reception gave a leaflet explaining the site/palace although little is known about it. The view from the neighbouring restaurant is amazing although the accompanying karaoke with lunch was not so good.

初めに、プランバナン寺院群から近いですが、歩いて行くとそれなりにあります。

Even though it is called a temple, it is actually a palace immortalized in the legend of Rara Jonggrang. Unfortunately, the only things left of the once magnificent palace are the foundations, walls and floors. The pillars and roof apparently were made of wood and thatch and have rotten away long ago.

Still, the mere expanse of the palace is impressive. The expansive grounds on top of a hill overlooking the nearby town of Solo give an impression of the size of the palace. The ancient palace had bathing pools (something like modern swimming pools) which still survive. Slightly away from the palace is an ascetic's cave.

Other notable items in the palace complex are the remains of a temple, well and crematorium.

The magnificent entrance to the palace is well preserved and gives an idea of its grandeur. Also well preserved are the ancient walls of a hall.

Probably the best things about the remains of the palace now are the views from the top especially the sunrise and sunsets.

Entrance to the palace includes lunch at the nearby restaurant. The restaurant is built on the edge of a steep cliff and offers beautiful views of the city and the neighboring temples - probably the best thing after enjoying the views from the palace is to relax at the restaurant and enjoy the views over a cup of coffee.

Best times to visit are sunrise and sunset. The views are magnificent especially on a clear day.

Definitely worth a visit if you are in Yogyakarta / solo.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Located high up a hill with commanding views of the Prambanan Plains and of the main towers of the Prambanan Temple itself, Ratu Boko is an interesting secular, rather than religious, remnant from the Hindu-Buddhist Era of Indonesian history. Comprising a series of gateways or gopura, the approach to the now largely vanished palace complex is a study in architectural grandeur. The complex was much larger than I thought, as it stretched far from the gopura which is the popular image of the temple. Passing through the second gopura, a path of newly-laid stone leads to a sloping wall with an ancient flight of stairs. One goes down, and then up again, to the walled pendopo, or audience hall. Inside the wall lay the stone base, the pendopo itself having rotten away a long time ago. Beyond this lie another platform, with three petite shrines no higher than a human waist. Further beyond, down yet another ancient flight of stairs, lay circular pools, gateways with a kala head as an ornament, and an old cowherd, tending to an archetypal cow with a bell. 

Despite the lack of astonishing reliefs, grand architecture (beyond the entrance gates), Ratu Boko leaves one with a feeling of loneliness and solitude which is nonetheless beautiful, even exhilarating, as the scenery is quite great and the setting sun splashes the tumbled ancient stones with its yellow-orange light. Get yourself a corner of Ratu Boko and it can be a relaxing opportunity for contemplation.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Candi Ratu Boko begitu orang populer menyebutnya. Saya berkali-kali mengajak ke-2 anak saya kemari. Anak perempuan saya sangat menyukainya. Di Istana Boko kita bisa menikmati sejarah, arsitektur kuno, trekking dan sunset. Pemandangan susensetnya adalah melihat kota Yogyakarta dan Prambanan dari ketinggian. Sangat indah.

Seperti kebanyakan bangunan kuno di Indonesia, sejarahnya perlu direka-reka. Secara populer dinamakan candi. Dibangun sejaman dengan atau sebelum Prambanan atau sebelum Borobudur. Sebagian ahli berpendapat Ratu Boko adalah istana atau keraton dari Kerajaan Medang atau Mataram kuno. Sebagian ada yang berpendapat sebagai biara Budhha.

Kedua saya, setelah berkali-kali mengunjunginya punya teorinya sendiri. Menurut mereka Ratu Boko adalah istana Raja Agung Medang, Mataram kuno. Sang Raja adalah pembangun dan pemilik kompleks Candi Prambanan dan kesukaan Sang Raja dan keluarganya adalah memandang Prambanan di waktu matahari terbenam atau bulan purnama dari istananya.

Most tourists go for its sunset. Don't bother. We went in the morning, hardly anyone there. Just ruins and ponds. But having been to the Mayan temples on the Yucatan, it renders a   Sentimental feel that is open to ones imagination. If you are fit, get a taxi to drop off at the bottom of the stairs to this lovely heavenly place on top of a hill. On clear days there would be great views.

The Ratu Boko Temple was called Keraton (Palace). Maybe the area also functioned as the palace in the past. The area is huge and well taken-care of. Clean with a bit uphill maintained path. Unfortunately no wheel chair lane. If you buy the ticket from Prambanan, then you'll be shuttled by free minibus to and from the area.

The main ruins are at the top of the hill about 200-300m from the parking lot and a bit steep walking along the path. The top of the view point offers north to northwest view of Prambanan. If you bring binocular, try to locate Adisucipto International Airport on the north west side.

The view from the front restaurant is also spectacular. Having coffee and watching sunset in front of your very eyes just give you the chill for you nature lovers. Unfortunately my initerary was not in sunset, so I'd visit this place back in the future for that one.

I visited Ratu Boko twice. The first was around 2000, and the second was this June (2014). 14 years showed me that the management had made various efforts to make this place more comfy for tourist, and easier to explore. During that time, the exploration continued, and more elements found in this ruin. Quite unfortunate that during my last visit, this place was under restoration. But still, the complex itself is as amazing as before. 

However, I don't recommend this place for older people, since there are lots of ups and downs if you want to discover this place thoroughly.
