Review Text: One of the main sites in Central Java. Fantastic stone carvings that depict mythical Hindu tales. Temple date back to 900 AD.

Waktu itu di penghujung tahun 2019 saya bersama dengan pasangan ada berkunjung ke candi Prambanan, tidak di sangka dan tidak di duga tiba-tiba ada hujan turun dan kebetulan utk posisi kita pada waktu itu berada di sekitar Lokasi candi, maka secara sepontan kita bersama dengan orang orang yg lainnya berhamburan untuk mencari tempat berteduh sambil sekalian mencari persewaan payung dari orang orang yg ada menyewakan jasa payung di dlm lokasi candi. Harapan saya ke depan yaitu agar supaya diberikan byk tempat semacam shelter di sekitar lokasi candi agar bs di gunakan sebagai tempat beristirahat sekaligus sebagai tempat berteduh jika tiba-tiba ada turun hujan ketika pd saat berkunjung, Terimakasih.
sangat terawat akan lebih baik bila mushola juga diperhatikan dikarenakan mukena sebagian sudah tidak layak dan kotor sungguh sangat disayangkan

amazing well preserved architecture of hindu temples in indonesia. totally different than the balinese style hindu and than what found in india.
still massive in size, well preserved and really worth visiting for sure.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
This is 9th century massive Hindu temple and is even 1 century older than Angor Wat. Amazing architecture and size of this place will blow your mind. People aware of Indian Hindu culture would probably will be surprised with the kind of statues built in such early period of human kind.

The statues of Shiva, Brahma and Vishnu are so incredible and smooth.

A must must visit for history lovers.

Much walking is required during visit to this temple, so be prepared. Have water and umbrella.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
This is the first temple we visited from 3 temples. It was a great experience to see and witness the greatness of mankind in the 7-8 century. 

The temple was huge but the sides of the temples were already destroyed in earth quake. Overall, they still preserved the place and well kept.

Visited this temple with my guide Frenky, who again shared his great knowledge of the history and explained all the details. I was very impressed by the visit and took loads of pictures. Can mention as well, when I was flying from Jakarta to Yogyakarta, I saw this temple clearly from the sky. It's very big!

Full of people but Amazing place to see! 
Foreigner ticket 300K and local 50K. As a foreigner you get ticket with you picture and water or tea. Unfortunately it started raining soon and didn't have time to try the swing and food areas.

Ompared with Borobudur, Prambanan is the lesser known but equally beautiful temple. It is a Hindu temple and the architecture reflects the pointed domes and carvings similar to those at Angkor Wat. The main temple is walking distance from the entrance. The others are fairly far, with a long walk. We took a golf cart from the gardens beyond the main Prambanan temple and did a brief photography stop at Sewu temple. Another tip is to collect your complimentary drinks right after entering. We wanted to collect these after the visit but the exit is at a separate location and do we had to leave sans our freebies 😔 also whilst buying tix, take the Prambanan and Borobudur package. If is cheaper and valid for two days
プランバナン寺院群の中心的寺院ロロ・ジョングラン寺院は古マタラム王国により、８５６年に建立されたとされ、ヒンドゥー教三大神（ブラフマー神、シヴァ神、ヴィシュヌ神）が祀られています。中央のシヴァ聖堂は高さ４７メートルを誇り、空高く燃える炎のような形が印象的です。夕暮れ時になり、寺院のシルエットが浮かび上がり、幻想的な光景が広がります。

Insieme al Borobudur, il sito di Prambanan costituisce una meta imperdibile per chiunque visiti l'Indonesia. Lo sanno all'agenzia governativa che ha fissato prezzi d'ingresso astronomici (per l'Indonesia) ai turisti stranieri (solo a loro). Coevo e simile al complesso di Angkor Wat in Cambogia, Prambanan costituisce l'esempio più imponente e raffinato della scultura religiosa induista non solo in Indonesia e risale davvero all'VIII secolo d.C.
Purtroppo è assediato da migliaia di turisti e, per quanto il sito sia grande e dispersivo, vale certamente la pena venirci la mattina molto presto evitando l'afa e le tante comitive indonesiane. Belli ma in rovina come molti, a causa del tempo e dei danni prodotti da recenti terremoti, i templi minori che circondano anche a diversi km, i 3 templi principali. Non male ed abbastanza economico il ristorantino interno al complesso di monumenti, prima dell'uscita (cercatelo chiedendo ai locali)
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Small but beautiful Temples and dont forget to try this swing near the food area on the grass. Lovely area and plenty of photos to be had.

I enjoyed these temples more than Borobudur. There are several temples grouped together and a little way off there is an area with some temples that are partly in ruins. I really enjoyed strolling through that area.

There is a free train that takes you there so don’t miss it.

Sangat Berpuas Hati bisa liburan ke jogyakarta menggunakan jasa tripAdvistor yang mempermudah kita untuk mendapatkan fasilitas Hotel yang harga nya terjangkau,dan letak hotel dengan pusat wisata sangat dekat.untuk liburan hemat pastikan pesan penginapan lewat tripAdvistor.Suasana Liburan anda akan semakin indah apabila anda mendapatkan fasilitas yang baik.
Não há como deixar de sentir a energia do local. Um complexo que mistura hinduísmo e budismo, cheio de história.  Sensacional. Um ponto turístico imperdível para quem vai à indonésia.

We arrived from Jogyakarta by car with a rented driver.Being in Java you have to see it. Expensive tickets. Complex of Hindu temples.It is worth booking an afternoon for sightseeing. The area is big. You can see that they are gradually rebuilding it after the earthquake. Outside the main complex, the other temples are in the park where it is worth strolling and hiding in the shade of trees.after a full day of sightseeing, my legs hurt ;-)
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
It was neat to see these grand monuments, but I wish I had done more research and had known there are elephants&animals on display/caged up at both temples. This is unnecessary. It would have greatly affected my decision in going there. It was around 600k to do both Borobudur (not sunrise) & Prambanan - which is a bit steep in my opinion (this does not include a guide at the parks, nor did it include the other 140k I spent on tour transport to get there)
At Prambanan they also force you to go through a rather large tourist market to get out afterwards. 
As it is during the holidays, both places were quite packed with people.

Sejarah peradaban jawa kuno terungkap dalam candi hindu yanga ada di wilayah Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta.
Destinasi wisata ini yang menjadi Icon Jogja wajib di kunjungi saat berlibur ke Jogja.

More accessible than Borobudur for those staying in the city, we were awed by the loving effort to restore the temples and their ornate carvings. Wear comfortable shoes for walking and climbing lots of steep steps. The grounds are beautiful and good for walking. Remember to bring your shades or umbrella, and to slap on suntan lotion. 

You get a photo of yourself on your ticket as a keepsake as well as a welcome drink. We hired a local English speaking tour guide at the premises for 50K rupiah. He was entertaining and gave interesting insights, though not quite accurate in his account of historical events in this region. You will feel transported back to some Jumanji-ish land of ruins nestled among jungles to imagine how Prambanan was when it was discovered a few decades ago before it was rebuilt (if my guide was telling the truth). The brochures told the legend behind why the temples were built.  

You might feel indignant though when looking at how society then discriminated how and where people worship based on social class. But history helps us appreciate the journeys we have taken, toward a future that is more hopeful.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Selalu ada nuansa "tak biasa" ketika berkunjung ke Candi Prambanan, salah satu World Heritage yang dimiliki Indonesia. Kali ini saya dan istri sengaja datang pukul 6 pagi, sesuai jam buka candi, untuk hindari kepadatan pengunjung (pada akhir tahun) sambil berharap bisa dapat spot foto dengan cahaya bagus. Eh, ternyata kesampaian juga!

Silakan buktikan sendiri sejauh mana pikiran Anda bisa disegarkan lagi, tak cuma dengan melihat kumpulan bangunan bersejarah, tetapi Anda juga bisa merasakan ademnya suasana sekitar candi yang sangat hijau.

Harga tiket per September 2019 menjadi Rp. 50.000, siapkan kocek juga untuk beberapa spot foto berbayar, juga bagi Anda yang ingin berkeliling candi dengan "mobil khusus" atau sepeda. 

Saran saya, cobalah datang jam 6 sebelum kepadatan menyerbut terutama pada akhir pekan dan holiday. Jangan lupa beli oleh2 khas nuansa candi seperti pakaian bergambarkan candi, cinderamata berbentuk candi, dan masih banyak lagi ketika Anda akan keluar kawasan Candi Prambanan.

Cobalah! :-)
We have done Angkor Wat, Bagan, and many other temple sites in Asia - this was probably the best!  Go at sunset. It was magical.

Interessante Anlage - es lohnt sich ein paar Stunden einzuplanen, um nicht nur die drei Haupttempel zu sehen, sondern auch noch Muse für die etwas abseits gelegenen Überreste zu finden. Lohnt sich, da es dort viel ruhiger zu und her geht und man auch mal ganz alleine ist.

ロロ・ジョングラン寺院はプランバナン遺跡群のなかでも規模も美しさも知名度も最大のヒンドゥ寺院であり、王家の墓でもあります。シヴァ・ヴィシュヌ・ブラウマーのヒンドゥの３神をつかさどる3つの巨大聖堂の壁は、ラーマーヤナのレリーフをはじめとして見事な彫刻でびっしりと埋め尽くされています。
約30年ぶりに訪れましたが、その間にあった2006年の大地震で相当な被害にあったことはニュースなどで見ており、その後よくここまで修復されたものだと感心しました。（公園内セウ寺院のようにまだまだ修復されていないところもあります。）
夕日に浮かぶシルエットは今回は時間の関係で見ることはできませんでしたが、本当に美しいのでお勧めです。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Ini merupakan 1 paket tujuan wisata ketika berlibur, 
Setelah mengunjungi borobudur tidak lengkap apabila tidak berkunjung ke candi prambanan. Dengan menempuh waktu lk. 60 menit dari candi borobudur atau 30 menit dari malioboro. 
Di dalam area candi prambanan masih banyak yg sedang di renovasi dalam rangka memperindah lingkungan seputaran candi. 
Kegiatan aktifitas yg bisa dilakukan selain menikmati dan mempelajari sejarah adalah fotografi, karena banyak spot² foto yg bagus. mungkin kedepannya ketika tahap pembangunan taman dan area yg lain di seputaran candi makin banyak spot foto dan kegiatan yg akan di lakukan. 

Yg harus di siapkan :
1. Kacamata hitam
2. Sunblock
3. Topi
4. Air minum

Untuk pembelian tiket terusan ( borobudur dan prambanan) bisa di lakukan di salah satu counter tiket di objek yg di kunjungi.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Masuk candi Uda ngga sabar banget pengen keliling komplek candinya,setelah berkeliling candinya memang bagus dan Masi terawat dengan baik.harga tiket masuknya pun juga terjangkau,ngga kecewa liat candi Prambanan ya..

Paid same amount of entrance fee as Borobudur temple but Prambanan temple is only 1/3 of the size of borobudur. I won't recommend this place because of its expensive entrance fee, small temple. We paid for a tour guide which only need 1 hour story telling to cover whole temple, hear the same story as we are at Angkor Wat. I won't recommend this place.

Visitar Prambanan fazia parte do nosso tour por Yogjakarta. Foi um tour cultural, histórico e religioso. O guia nos explicou a importância e o significado de cada templo. Entramos nos principais dedicados a Vishinu, Brahma e Shiva e em todos os outros menores. Alguns foram total ou parcialmente restaurados, outros estavam em ótimo estado de conservação. Andar entre os monumentos é uma verdadeira imersão na religião hindu, através destes templos do século IX dC. Imperdível!

We took the public bus, Trans Jogja, which is only cost Rp 3,500, and short walking distance from the Prambanan bus station to the side entrance (opposite the mosque). It was a Sunday morning, and really crowded with school children. I would advise to visit this place on a weekdays early morning. Furthermore, the weather gets very hot after sun rises and the direct heat from the sun is really no joke. Please apply sun lotion, use hat or umbrella and of course enough water. The temples are wonderful with fine sculptures on the walls.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This hindu temple is as worth as Borobudor to visit in Jogja. Equally crowded as Borobudor but thanks to wide compound that it seems not so congested. Better bring hats, wear light and comfort. Should take more than two hours if you want calmly wandering around the site as it's not only one temple there.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This is on par with the main temple of Angkor Wat (not the entire complex). I am shocked to see the reviews are not more skewed towards 5* as there is nothing short of fabulous here. If you time it right, and show up at end of day, the sunset view is best from where you initially entered (actually outside the temple confines). Depending on the time of year, you will need to adjust your spot accordingly to angle it such that the sun sets between two of the stuppas.

The temple was built in about nine century. It's area is huge. The magnificent stone temples and statues are impeccable architecture wonders of ancient time. This is out side of Yogjakarta city; a day tour by car or tourists bus is fine. The premises are well maintained, clean and serene. There is museum in the premises.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Honestly, it's not really worth the price (around CAD$35 if a remember correclty), except if you're attempting to get Instagramable shots. The main temple is nice, but the other smaller ones are much nicer. What made me really sad about the Temples is that people (and especially the Indonesians) are not respectful of the area. They are treating it as a tourist spot so they can make the tourist pay and take a couple of nice pictures, but disregard the spiritual aspect of the place.  Just to support this, there was an Dahuiatsu employee party on the grounds the same day as we visited; extremely loud (even for Indonesian standards) music booming right next to the main temple all day.

Not exactly what we had in mind when thinking of visiting a temple.
世界遺産登録の仏教とヒンドゥー教の寺院群遺跡。バリ島からオプショナルツアーでボルブドゥール寺院遺跡とプランバナン寺院群遺跡を巡りました。ジョグジャカルタから東方にある寺院遺跡で空を突くような仏塔が印象的です。メインのプランバナン寺院の周りは綺麗な遺跡公園になっていて気持ちがいいです。仏塔の中にはヒンドゥー教のヴィシュヌ神が祀られています。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Nice place to see the historic constructions.

A combined ticket for Prambanan and borobudur is 630k ( only prambanan costs 350k).

Can reach using public buses from Yogya city.

the facilities at the location is good.

Visit when in Indonesia!

Mengunjungi candi prambanan seakan tidak pernah bosan oleh keindahan dan sejarah yg ada di balik terbentuknya candi. 
Fasilitas di kompleks candi lengkap, terawat baik dan rapi. 
Parkir luas, mungkin ratusan kemdaraan bisa parkir sekaligus.

4 of us thought we could complete Borobudur and PRAMBANAN TEMPLE IN THE MORNING AND EVENING. we made it but we had to cut corners at Prambanan temple . This is unesco heritage and you really need to spend more than half a day in this Hindu temple . We entered the temple around 3.30 pm and learnt that the temple closes by 5 pm . We saw there is battery operated car is available and will help us to take a quick tour , but  fortunately we decided against it as the Guide explained to us that this battery car takes you around the periphery and not  in to the temple where we should go . We need to pay Indoenesian Rupiah 150000 to the guide ( USD 11 for one hour ) Since i need to have a wheel chair for my wife i went to the exit gate and on giving the photo ID they gave wheel chair and said they would close by 5 pm and i should return the wheel chair to collect the ID ..
The Guide has extensive knowledge of the temple and we realised that why taking golf car .  The temple was not far off and the path is not easy to push the wheel chair . 
From one particular level to where the wheel chair go i took my wife and she had good view of the temple from there and we started to go further .

Rura Jinggrang Temple as the main complex of Prambanan compound is 9th century Hindu temple in central Jawa . It is dedicated to tirumurti , the  creator ( Brahma) ,Destroyer ( Shiva) and Prserver ( Vishnu) .
In orginal form it had 250 large and small temples around the central temple . The temple compound was added succesive  Mataram kings and was abandoned after they moved to east Java.The temple collapsed during major earth quake in 16th century .

The temple is constructed as per the agama shasatra (   a collection of ideas that lays down the rules for worship, temple building, spirituality and rituals, has for long been a guideline for many people of the Hindu faith).
i was able to make ot to the shivan temple and there are number of steps to climb and they are bit height to climb . It is really worth the climb as we saw siva about 10 to 12 feet high with full figure and we saw the same from the back side it was in the shape of Yoni( linga shape ) . This temple has Nandi , Ganesha , agastyar ( the sage ) and durgai  , you need to go around the pragaram ( around the temple ) to see al these deities .

The temple is adorned with panes of Ramayana and Bhagavata Purana , Ramayana was in detail depicted and one need to spend lot of time to go through .
As the time was nearing 5 i decided to go back and take my wife back to the gate and surrender the wheel chair and take the ID .

We moved to visitors lounge air conditioned meant for the foreigners and we were also told to move out of that place as it was 5 pm . Then we came and sat at the entrance  of the place where there are chairs , the people came with us had beautiful view of the sun set and visited the other temples and came out and said it was brilliant.

One must visit this temple for the architectural  brilliance and hinduism in a place far from india and how it was built by then as temples were built in southern part of india .
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
The temple Prambanan is beautiful and definitely worth a visit, even thought it’s very pricy and for us it was not as impressive as Borobudur. The parc surrounding the temple also doesn’t have as much to offer as the Borobudur parc. 

I would give the temple 4 stars if it wasn’t for the animal cruelty going on on the side. There’s goats and birds trapped in cages that are way too small for them and the rabbits, who had a bigger enclosure, looked ill and neglected which really ruined the otherwise beautiful and impressive temple for us.

Wij bezochten Prambanan na Borobudur en waarschijnlijk door de indruk die Borobudur maakte, vonden wij Prambanan mooi, maar rommelig. Er zijn meerdere tempels, veel steenhopen en een groot park eromheen. Zeker de moeite waard om te bezoeken ondanks de hoge entreeprijs voor toeristen. Een combiticket, voor 2 opeenvolgende dagen is wat voordeliger dan twee aparte tickets. Er rijdt een treintje die een ander deelvan het park én andere tempels laat zien. Ondanks het feit dat wij niet zo van deze toeristische dingen houden vinden we het een aanrader. Bij vertrek natuurlijk volop winkeltjes, maar ook leuke tentjes om wat te drinken ( samen met toch een aanzienlijke hoeveelheid “locals”. Wij bezochten in de avond het Ramayana-ballet met de verlichte tempels op de achtergrond en hebben hier erg van genoten. Voor €25 boek je een VIP-ticket: eigen ingang, drankje, plaatsen voor het podium: meer dan de prijs waard als je van de Indonesische cultuur houdt.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Came to Prambanan after going for the borobudur sunrise and mendut temple visit. The tickets are pricey but well worth the price since they are putting in a lot of money and effort in rebuilding the temples. Many of the smaller temples have been destroyed by earthquakes but the main ones are still there and the towers have been reconstructed.

From the time you walk in from the the entrance, you will be in awe. The towers seems like they were plucked from a fairy tale settings. Take your time going up the temples as the view of the other temples from there are amazing. You can even go around the temples halfway up, but its a tight squeeze. The steps are steep and high but manageable, just be extra careful when coming down. Only vishnu, thurga and shiva statues are there and the rest are missing. But its a very calm place, try to go earlier or later in the evening as it can get very hot.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Candi yang indah penuh cerita ini sangat memukau letaknya di pinggiran kota jogja ini banyak diminati wisatawan asing maupun lokal. Tapi apakah anda tahu ternyata banyak cerita yang dipercayai oleh warga lokal bagi anda yang belum menikah sebisanya jangan dulu datang kesini karena berakibat bubar ini masih cerita terserah kita percaya atau tidak konon katanya candi ini terbentuk atas dasar seorang pria sakti terhadapa seorang wanita yang meminta syarat dibangunkan 1000 candi dalam waktu 1malam.dan ternyat si pria sakti hampir menyelesaikan candi tersebut karena melihat itu si wanita pun berlaku curang dengan membangunkan ayam.hingga berkokok padahal jam untuk berkokok sebenarnya masih lama sehingga si pria murka karena tahu dicurangi dan sebagian candi jg sempat dihancurkan sang pria sakti . Cinta pun kandas.. itu dongengnya jadi hindari aja balik lagi kalau sudah resmi menikah. But dibalik dongeng.itu candi ini wajib dikunjungi jika anda sudah sampai jogja.p
Candi yang bagus dan menarik untuk dikunjungi,patung rorojonggrang berada di dalam candinya,sangat recommended

We come in the morning so have enough time to explore the temple. This place more nice that Borobudur since a lot of trees around, public transport with rent available in a strategic spot and they also have the playground. But the toilet was poor, stinky and dirty.

ジョグジャカルタから市内バスに乗って向かいました。バス降り場から、また少し歩いて到着。公園内は広いので、歩いて回るとそれなりに疲れます。
建物はとても大きく(高く)、壮大でした。

Biaya masuk yang tidak terlalu mahal bagi pengunjung.sungguh indah viewnya,walaupun panas tapi ada persewaan payung didepan pintu masuk.candi2nya walapun sudah sangat lama tapi masih terawat dan alami.
Candi prambanan peninggalan sejarah yang masi bisa dinikmati,sebagai edukasi untuk anak,refresing,foto bareng dan kumpulan piknik  acara keluarga  topp

Kombi-Ticket (2 Tempel) kosten 630k IDR (45 USD) für zwei aufeinanderfolgenden Tage für Touristen. Meine Freundin (local) zahlte je 40k für ein Jahresticket zu den zwei Tempeln. Absolute Abzocke und rassistisch. Nach und nach vergeht einem die Lust auf Asien durch solche Aktionen. 

Generell ist der Tempel sehenswert mit guter Beschilderung aber wenig Erklärungen. 
Habe zwischenzeitlich den Tempel in Angkor Wat (Kambodscha) gesehen (welcher je nach Ticket teurer ist, allerdings auch mehr zu sehen) und würde den Tempel Prambanan nicht mehr besuchen bzw Reisenden, die bereits solche Tempelanlagen gesehen haben, abraten.

This is the first time I revisit Prambanan temple since 1990s. It's an amazing and grandeur place to visit. What impress me is the fact that those temples are built without using modern technology is an engineering marvel of bygone era.
I also like the fact that the temple complex is now surrounded by great garden landscaping.

The minute you reach to the front of the temple, is so grand and it was wow factor. Need to take your time to explore each monument and walk around each platform. Is very small area, tight on each temple. The temple itself hold Shiva which lack of light to see clearly, (should install some Led lights). 

The beauty of this temple is the compounds and the structure of temple, every corner is different. Don't rush and take your time to explore, will come again for sunset and spend more hours here. Plan your journey and itinerary well - need more than 4 hours top finish whole compound. We were rushing as need to be Ratu Boko for sunset. Wear sensible shoes, hats, sunglasses, sunblock as lot of walking.

I wish have more time here, will come again that for sure.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah, Merencanakan perjalanan

Review Text: Pemandangannya cqntik untuk foto foto walaupun agak panas. Kalo ke jogja pasti kesini lagiiii. Top banget
The temple complex is confusing without a quide.  All temples have main deities in them.  Reminds you of other areas in Southeast Asia and India.

I will not review the temple per se as many before me did that.
But I would like to comment on the price and the official tourist guide for the temple.
1) Price: 25 USD (which is more expensive than Taj Mahal, but not even close to the grandness of Taj Mahal). We bought a combo tickets (Prambanan Temple +Borobudur for 45USD (as of Nov 2019) and valid for 2 days). So slightly discounted but still unreasonable for what it is. Klook has also slightly discounted tickets and (depending on the country I assume) you might get an additional discount via a particular credit card. In addition Klook might have some promotion as well. I think 1.5h there (with taking all the pictures is enough). If on budget I would skip Prambanan temple I just visit Borobudur. The latter being (in my opinion) superior in terms of architecture and views. 
2) We took an official guide (you buy the "ticket" for the guide at the entrance: 150k IDR for 1h) to show us around. Before taking the guide we had a short chat and his English was reasonably good. But his presentation / explanation of history,  significance of buildings, hindu mythology had no flow/no organization what so ever: oo and this is this god and this are the characteristics, and then in this part we have this god and these are the characteristics....at the end we really did not get much (if anything) out. It would be more useful just to read about the temple/ on Wikipedia. During our stay in Yogyakarta we had 3 different guides for 2 temples and one palace and only one was great and informative. The other two guides were waste of time and money.

プランバナン寺院はジョグジャカルタ特別州にあるヒンドゥー教寺院です。プランバナンは土地の名前だそうですが、プランバナン村は敷地に隣接していますが中央ジャワ州になります。
インドネシア最大級のヒンドゥー教寺院であるプランバナン寺院（別名ロロ・ジョングラン寺院）を中心にプランバナン史跡公園が整備され、広大な敷地内には他に３つの寺院がありますが入場料が別途必要です。
公園内にはイベント広場があり、休日にはイベントが開催されているそうで、訪問した日も音楽フェスが行われていました。
世界遺産の「プランバナン寺院群」はこの公園の外にもあり、ヒンドゥー教の遺跡だけではなく、仏教系の遺跡も含まれているそうです。
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Prambanan temple complex was badly demolished in a major earthquake for about ten years ago.
The main temples are raised and beautifully restored, while a vast amount of buildings still lie in heap of stones. 
Nevertheless, this place has power to it. The Prambanan temple complex still emits the beauty and skills of no vanished culture, being among one of its kind in the World.
Prambanan temples of holy trimurti: Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva still emits a beauty and celestial power. 
Please do visit!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Prambanan Temple in Yogyakarta was claimed to be erected in 850 AD. Comprising the remains of some 244 temples, World Heritage–listed Prambanan is Indonesia's largest Hindu site and one of Southeast Asia's major attractions. 

Main highlight is the central compound with eight main and eight minor temples assembled on a raised platform, the high note of which is Candi Shiva Mahadeva.
In the centre is the main attraction – the three large temples dedicated to the gods Shiva the destroyer, Vishnu the keeper and Brahma the creator… and the three slightly shorter temples for the ‘vehicles’ of those gods, Nandi, Garuda and Hamsa, respectively. The main spire soars 47m and the temple is lavishly carved. Candi Vishnu touches 33m and sits just north of Candi Shiva Mahadeva. The temple's impressive reliefs tell the story of Lord Krishna, a hero of the Mahabharata epic, while a four-armed image of Vishnu the Preserver crowns the inner sanctum.
Candi Brahma is Candi Vishnu’s twin temple. South of Candi Shiva Mahadeva, it is carved with the final scenes of the Ramayana. The spectacular mouth doorway is noteworthy and the inner chamber contains a four-headed statue of Brahma, the god of creation.

All in, one needs most likely a day tour of the park surrounding the temple complex.
My only grouses is the ticketing. Very expensive for foreigner compared with local ticket prices
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Prambanan temple is best suited to visit around sunset. The temple complex is huge but you can visit three main temples. 
The temple is around thousand years old and a part of our restored recently. It's very different than Bali temples. 
Entry fee is very high (350k IDR) for foreigners and you don't get a lot of amenities. Do hire a guide else you won't get to "see" much. 
Spend around two hours here. 
Well suited for families. 

Tip: Do carry your water bottles.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Beautiful temple, definitely go at sunset! We went during off season which was really nice because it wasn’t as busy 😊
言わずもがなの素晴らしい遺跡ですが、街中に近いせいかボロブドゥールの幻想的な雰囲気は少ないです。その分トランスジョクジャA1で簡単に行けます。ただ、バス停から遺跡入口までが、車ブンブンな大通りを20分近く歩きます。バス停にはバイクタクシーが沢山たむろしているし、遺跡にはGrabのミーティングポイントがありますので、上手に活用すると快適に観光できると思います。

Los templos Prambanan son preciosos por lo que la visita es obligatoria. 

La entrada cuesta 337 mil rupias.  El recorrido te llevará sobre hora y media.
個人的にはボロブドゥールより見た目のインパクトがあって良かったです。ボロブドゥールだけではなく、こちらもオススメです。

Similar to Borobudur, the admission ticket is expensive. This is a large hindu temple with 1 main structure, and several smaller ones inside the "park". We were for sunset, and was able to witness the red ball of fire setting in 2minutes or so. recommend to stay around for a little longer to witness the sky turn pinkish and red, which we felt was the highlight of the sunset.

Candi Prambanan, salah satu icon wisata yang berada di D.I. Yogyakarta, Candinya lebih kecil jika dibanding dengan Candi Borobudur tapi untuk Komplek Candi Prambanan sangat luas dan banyak tempat ramah keluarga untuk bersantai, lahan parkir cukup luas dan keseluruhan area candi prambanan sangat bersih. Banyak tersedia jasa photographer dengan alat yang cukup profesional untuk mengabadikan momen wisata di candi prambanan.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Unsere Java Rundreise führte uns am ersten Tag direkt zu einem absoluten Highlight: wir haben die alte Tempelanlage Prambanan besucht. Wir waren zeitig im Hotel gestartet (08.30h), so dass wir ziemlich früh am Tempelkomplex angekommen sind. Daher waren außer einer indonesischen Schulklasse nur noch ein paar wenige andere westliche Touristen dort. Die Anlage wirkte so bei bestem Wetter noch ein wenig friedlicher. Die Architektur ist wirklich beeindruckend und zum grössten Teilen sehr gut erhalten. Wer hinduistische Tempel aus Indien, Sri Lanka oder Malaysia kennt, wird hier vom monochromen Erscheinungsbild vielleicht zunächst überrascht sein. Aber was vermeintlich an Farbe fehlt, wird durch unzählige, detailreiche Darstellungen im Gestein der Anlage wettgemacht. Uns hat Prambanan von der ersten Minuten in seinen Bann gezogen. Unserer Tochter (8 Jahre) hat es ebenfalls sehr gefallen.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Kegiatan family gathering dilaksanakan dipelataran ataubtaman disekitar candi mebuat kegiatan dapat dilakukn sekaligus dengan edukasi untuk anak anak dan remaja sekaligus mengagumi kebesaran Nusantara dan  peninggalannya di masa lalu. Kekuatan magis terpancarvdari indah dan artistiknya CandibPrambanan membuat orang berfikir bagaimana orang saat itu membangun bangunan yang begitu tinggi , begitu indah, begitu detail tanpa adanya informasi mengenai alat alat bantu yang sudah ada saat itu sehingga yang munculnya hanya kekaguman dari orang orang yang memandangnya saat ini.

Spectacular! The majestic temples at Prambanan are beautiful and awe-inspiring. The temples are architectural marvels, with the unique advantage of being huge as well as intricate. Gives you a unique insight into the cultural heritage of ancient times. A must on any tour of the Yogayakarta region - you can pick the combo ticket for Borobodur and Prambanan at either place.
So many temples in Yogyakarta. So many history were born from there. And the one of hindu temple is Candi Prambanan. Looked so beautiful,wide places eventhough feels arid
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

I went about 4.30pm and there was good daylight to visit and climb into each temple to see the statues and look at the bas-reliefs.  The templesat sunset are beautiful.

Review Text: I visited the temple In September. I travelled there by the trans Yogya route 1A for only 3500. I actually walked about 10 minutes to the entrance. The locals say it's over 2km, but don't believe them. The entrance with Borobudur is 630,000 for foreigner, but if your in Jogya, it's a must. I took a guide here and he was so informative. It cost US10 for the guide. I thought this temple is stunning. I loved my time there. Highly recommended.

Review Text:
Prambanan Temple is another great place to visit..... to understand the history of the temple, you need to visit the museum to see all the efforts put in by the government to restore Prambanan Temples... Amazing for a muslim country to restore Buddhist Temples. Be prepared to walk around and climb up some steps though not as tough as Borobudur. Bring lots of water and have a cap to protect yourself from the sun. There are a few temples spread all over, so you need some time here
The only setback is to exit you have to walk through all the shops and all the peddlers selling you souvenirs. Otherwise a great visit.... Not to be missed
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Von der buddhistischen zum hinduistischen Tempelanlage.
Nicht ganz so eindrucksvoll wie Borobodur, aber auf jeden Fall sehenswert.
Ohne den Sonnenaufgangsandrang kann man sich hier sehr frei bewegen und in Ruhe alles ansehen.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: When we visited this complex,  there were many children running around that were not really interested and using this historic and holy place for hindus as if they were in Disneyland.  Furthermore there was a nearby concert/dance going on with heavy bass sounds that can not be good these constructions. Maybe its time that authorities reconsider the use of this complex for other as museum and religious activities. It would be really a pity if the buildings colapse by these vibrations and uncontrolled visitors.
遺跡群を歩くとわかりますが、地震の崩壊で修復しきれていない場所が沢山有ります。これらが全て、元の状況だったとしたら、どのような状態なのだろうか？と想像しながら見ると面白いです。外周を一周するとかなりありますが、それでも回る価値はあると思います。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: A really interesting site. Very easy to catch the bus to the temple (Rp 3.500, Route 1A) and then just a short walk to the site. As you pass through the gate directly in front of the temple there are a number of trainee tour guides. They offer you a free tour so they can practise their skills and their English. It's all legitimate and my guide was excellent, and very keen for feedback. At the end he somewhat reluctantly offered a small amount of money that he insisted I give him. The guide was really useful in helping me to understand the site, including the additional two Buddhist temples.

The love story of Roro Jonggrang and Bandung Bondowoso attracted us to see the eternal love site at Prambanan Temple. We deliberately went there in the afternoon to be more romantic. Sure enough, entering the Prambanan temple area is gentle breeze as if pulling a step faster approaching the building is worth the legend of love. Come one time still interested, two you are more interested, three times still interested. Now it's the turn of the readers to prove!
サンセットツアーで訪れました．インドネシアの他の島の人も沢山訪れていました．塔の中に入ることができるのですが，いちいち上っていると結構足が疲れます．サンセットは出口あたりで待っていると，遺跡の後ろに太陽が見えて，綺麗な写真が撮れます．
Candi yang bagus, dengan keindahan alam yang bagus, cocok untuk liburan keluarga, mantappppp sekalii

E' un complesso di templi induisti patrimonio dell'UNESCO situato leggermente fuori jogya nella zona est della città.

Per la maestosità il sito lascia a bocca aperta e mi ha colpito moltissimo la stupenda simmetria dell'architettura dei templi che va a multipli di 3 per via della trinità (Brahma, Shiva, Visnù).

Se si è di buona volontà sarebbe molto interessante prendere una guida per conoscere ed approfondire la storia del luogo. Ma anche senza la guida il posto è bellissimo e si possono fare tantissime foto da molte prospettive.

Il sito è visitato per lo più da turisti non europei e secondo me il momento ideale è il tardo pomeriggio o il tramonto. Noi siamo andati alle 11 e, oltre al caldo, il sole alto non è l'ideale per le foto a causa delle ombre.

Il sito ha molti altri siti minori, molto meno conosciuti però carini e girabili senza nessuno vicino
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Amazing temples. Similar to Angkor Wat. Many destroyed from earthquakes, alot of rubble from the fallen temples. Still stunning. inside the temples are different buddahs. Steps are very high to climb. Not your average steps.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Candi yang bersih banyak turis, sangat bersih  suasana yang nyaman di candi ini, bagus untuk piknik keluarga

Beautiful place and less crowded than Borobudur. We went in the afternoon so we could see the sunset. I liked that there's more temples to see and that you can walk around for a bit. Lots of places to sit too. We also went to the buffet dinner and Ramayana ballet on the other side at night, would recommend doing this as well!!
昼前後のかなり暑い時間に訪問しましたが、暑さを忘れ、ボロブドゥール同様に壮大な寺院でした。観光客がかなり多かったのが玉に瑕ですが、有名であることの証明でしょう。折角なのでメイン観光スポット以外も歩いてみましたが、これまた別の情緒を感じることができました。ありがとうございました！帰り道のお土産屋さんが思いのほか広かったです。

Vildt flotte og imponerende templer. 

Meget anderledes stil, sammenlignet med Borobudur. 

Et helt klart "must-see" hvis man er i Yogyakarta.

Review Text: Different religion and different style of tulle and definitely less famous, but the Prambanan temple is at least as beautiful (in my opinion at least). Unfortunately a lot of Restauration still need to take place (from the 224 tempels in the outer circle, still more than 200 need to be rebuild). The complex is quite large but easy to traverse. Some steps are require but even for elderly people still manageable. If you want to climb want of the temples, the steps get very steep and harder to climb (no hand rails to grab on to). Bucketlist item and must see when in Java
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
We came here once we touched down and enjoyed the sunset. There was a umbrella festival over 6-9 Sept and we totally enjoyed the place and the festivals. See pics. 
We took a guide at 150k/hr and well worth it as he brought us to each site and explained each carefully. We even found the best place to see sunset. 
The best shot we took was after dark and the whole place looks real mystical, like a scene out of LOTR. See my pics to feel the energetic feel. Best place to come in Jogja!

I am Indonesian and my partner is foreigner, we visiting prambanan 4 days ago and quite shock with the price for foreigner $.25 and for domestic $4 , as an Indonesian I can’t quite figure it out why there is such big different on price , I think it’s ridiciloilus ... when we walk around there is no one or brochure what so ever that explain the story behind the tample , so we rely on google to dig some information. Obviously the don’t hv a F as long they get the money already. Really sad .... 
I don’t really recommend this place , better visiting taman sari the ticket not that pricey but u get more story as there is always people to guide you along with the story . As travel blogger the service in prambanan very disappointed.

This temple is not heavily advertised and is overshadowed by its counterpart in Borobudur.   By itself, this Temple is a Wonder of the World in itself.  Most of the temple complex has been preserved, with the complex having atleast five temple.  One each dedicated to Brahma, Visnhu, and Shiva.  The Temple of Shiva is the main one.  Many tourists came to visit and Sunset, with the light receding is a good time to visit .  The temple grounds are huge and well maintained.   There is a shutlle bus to drive you around to a couple of smaller temples located on the grounds.  Located just outside are area with small restaurants and gift shops.  Parking is ample and give yourself a few hours to visit the temple.   The entrance fees for non-citizens is pretty high.

Review Text: 세계 3대 불교 유적지가 있는 도시에 뜬금없는 힌두 사원. 하지만 그게 중요한가. 아름답고 훌륭한 건축물을 볼 수 있는게 중요하지. 힌두 사원들이 보통 화려하긴 하지만 이곳은 유독 더 화려하게 느껴진다

Prambanan Temple is an excellent place for a visitor.  The temple compound is open and extensive.  The UNESCO world heritage site is must visit when in Yogyakarta.  Unless here on business or family , I would imagine you are likely to be here for Yogyakartas rich historic past - which would include Prambanan.

Set in an extensive area of gardens which include 3 other nearby temples in the ticket price.  The star attraction is undoubtedly Prambanan.

A visit will take approximately 2-3 hours.  Ample parking and amenities are at the site.

Try and make a little effort and go to the other nearby temples.  Treat yourself to some nice photos.  The other temples are much less busy and should be visited when on site.

A combo ticket is a good option if you also want to visit Borobudur.  It will save you money.  It must be used on (no more) than 2 consecutive days.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Es un complejo de templos asombrosos y muestra del arte y religión hinduista. Patrimonio mundial por la Unesco desde 1991. Hay zonas donde se ven bastantes bloques de piedra derrumbados, debido a uno de los terremotos que hubo hace años. Hay tres templos principales dedicados a Shiva, Vishnú y Brahma. Fuimos sobre las 10 de la mañana y ya hacía mucho calor y había bastante gente. Quizás es más recomendable ir a primera hora de la mañana o ya más hacia el atardecer.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Ga in de ochtend. We waren bijna alleen bij de tempels. Temperatuur is dan meer dan prima. We hebben ervan genoten. Mooie oude tempels, ze liggen wat uit elkaar maar prima te lopen. Zeker bezoeken! Aanrader!!!!

 いくつかの遺跡が集まっているので敷地内の周遊バスで回れたのでよかった。外国人料金で入場した人はバス無料です。

Buat yg ke jogja blm lengkap kalo blm ke prambanan, objek wisata 1 ini ngga jauh dr pusat kota cm perlu beberapa menit, disamping viewnya yg indah dan berbeda dengan candi2 lainnya mitos pembuatan candi yg cm dlm 1 malam ini jg menarik utk para pencinta sejarah akses ke lokasi jg ngga sulit kalo ngga bawa kendaraan cukup pesan taxi atau via online sampai ke lokasi

Review Text: Es de las visitas obligadas de yogyakarta. Con los ultimos terremotos hay muchas zonas en construccion.Me recordaron los templos de Angkor (camboya). Review Text: Definitely worth the visit. Did this for sunset and Borobudur for sunrise. You can get a combined pass and use it over two days if you want. Beautiful temples. Worth the price.

These Hindu temples are on a large site so give yourself enough time to visit each one. They are very well maintained and visually beautiful. Whilst very popular with loca;s and tourists, it does not feel crowded as there are so many to visit and enjoy. A MUST SEE attraction.
Dichiarato dall'Unesco Patrimonio dell'umanità, un complesso di templi indù e abbiamo detto tutto. Se Borobodur si fa all'alba, Prambanan è meraviglioso al tramonto.

Prambanan è un complesso di templi induisti che si estende per chilometri, situato nell'isola di Giava.
Sorge poco lontano dal colossale tempio buddhista chiamato Borobudur
Dichiarato patrimonio dell'umanità dall'UNESCO nel 1991. 
Ha subito parecchi terremoti nel tempo, l'ultimo nel 2006.
Alcune parti sono ancora da ricostruire.
Veramente colossale, molto bello e suggestivo come sito. 
Consiglio una guida che vi accompagni nel giro.

Review Text: komplek candi prambanan ini sungguh luas sekali dan sangat menakjubkan, tidak hanya ada 1 atau 2 candi. namun ada beberapa candi yang berdiri kokoh di hamparan tanah luas. saya merekomendasikan untuk wisatawan agar datang di pagi atau sore hari guna menghindari terik matahari di komplek candi ini.
ジャワ島中部にあるヒンドゥー教の寺院です。伝染病の流行により遷都した後、大きな地震によりかなりの部分が崩壊したそうです。裏の方に回ると崩れて落ちた残骸の山になっています。それでも中央部にある塔は修復され中に入れます。シヴァ神、ビシュヌ神、ガネーシャのそれぞれの塔は階段を登り中に入ることができます。インドネシアのヒンドゥー教寺院としては最大級だと言うことと、建築物としての見応えは十分にあります。

Review Text:
Quels beaux temples, ils sont tous sublimes surtout celui tout en haut à ne pas manquer 
Dans de nombreuses années quand tout sera restauré ce sera grandiose

Toerisme is overvloed, waar wij inderdaad ook aan deelnemen. Het is echt wel een gave view, verder is er echt niks te doen. Het is een behoorlijk stuk rijden vanuit de Borobudur. Voor de liefhebber schitterend!

You have to admir ancestors' wisdom  and creativity. the story on the wall is very interesting and I would suggest you hire a guide. Ticket is a little expensive considering local PPP, however it worths! You can buy combination ticket of here and Borobudur.

Review Text: I’m repeating others here but the temples were just beautiful! Stunning and peaceful. Worth a visit, I think. However, I can’t give it 5 stars. There are a few factors; firstly, the appalling cages filled with ill and unhealthy looking rabbits, goats and deer were so upsetting. Why are they there and treated so badly? The other factor is the huge entry fee for disgusting toilets, up-selling aggressive stalls just about everywhere and no information to explain anything. A bit of a shame really for a world-class heritage site.
Tempio induista ben conservato. Consiglio di prendere un guida per arricchire la vostra visita. Tutti consigliano di andarci al tramonto, forse per il caldo perché non l’ho trovato così suggestivo.

Splendido tempio induista.
Tour fatto con la guida "Topo", bravissimo, che ci ha illustrato tutto il sito e ci ha fatto fare una marea di foto.
Consigliatissimo da visitare.

Compter 2h pour faire les 4 temples. Commencez par celui du fond et revenez pour finir, au coucher du soleil, par le plus beau / grand.
Beau point de vue photo / coucher de soleil à gauche de l'endroit où "tout le monde" se prend en photo devant les lettres "Prambanan"

After visiting Borubudur at sunries last month, I must see the Prambanan temple on a sunset. We got there around 5PM and that was perfect. Not a lot of tourists and there was some sense of quiet around which is how I want to experience this moment. 
As soon as the sun turns orang the silhouette of the temples came to life. I'm no architect but I think the sculpture  of the Prambanan was more intricate than that of the Borubudur. Though both are equally stunning.
As usual, I really appreciate that the place is well kept and maintained. The entrance fee was quite steep but I'm sure the tourists didn't mind because you can see how clean and orderly the place is. 
A few minutes before 6pm and the park security was blowing his whistle to remind us it's time to leave. It's short but nevertheless a memorable afternoon. 
Btw, in Jogja and I think in Jakarta, you can ride a Grab and rent it for a minimum of 4 hours for only 300k Rupiah. The drivers are almost always very helpful and polite.

I decided to go to Prambanan temples to refresh my memory on the temples.  As a kid, almost every Indonesia have to go there, but it has been ages since I came here and I decided to go to the temples by myself.  I enjoyed the 2 hours stay at Prambanan temples.  1) Hire a bike;  2) go to ALL the temples around Prambanan:  Candi Bubrah, Candi Sewu, Candi Lumbung.  Stop and try to enjoy all the temples.  Prambanan is magnificent, but other temples are also equally good.  Stop at the Museum and watch the video - pay some money there, it is a nice way to cool off after biking around the complex.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
An excellent piece of history that must be seen whilst in Java (I would recommend with Borobudur).  We bought a joint ticket for both places at approx 630k each as international tourists - this allowed us to see Prambanan today and if we wished, Borobudur tomorrow.
The site is expansive and we spent a good hour and a half exploring the different temples as part of the whole experience.  It is also lovely see to the restoration work taking place. It is overall amazing to see and beautiful in its stone work.
A great mornings visit together with a free welcome drink.  It is also good that the  locals selling tourist items is at the end of the visit rather than in the way in like many Bali temples.

Review Text:
Frankly speaking, I had no idea before I visited here.But I love there after I came. It was an old Indian temple area with large field in the midddle Java in Indosia. There are around 240 temples here including sound architecture or not. There are six main buildings in the field which live three main Gods of Hinduism  named Siwa, Wisnu and Brahma and their vehicles. I love the ancient and historical atmosphere during visiting every corner of every temples. You can choose a guide to introduce every details story about a statue or a emboss or take photos with good posture from sunrise to sunset in these temple buildings. I think you can enjoy the time staying here if you own a well foot force without acrophobia a little bite.
對於這裡，其實不得不承認是一無所知的。只知道要來印尼中爪哇島要造訪一個位於日惹(Yogyakarta)的印度神廟。但是真切地走過一回後，打從內心認為這個譽為最美、最大的印度神廟園區實在值得一遊。
        普蘭巴南神廟（ Candi Prambanan）在1991年被納入聯合國教科文組織世界文化遺產（UNESCO)。她由三座主神廟與三座副神廟組成。但其實這個區域有多達240座神廟。主神廟從方位南至北分別供奉著印度教的三位主神：梵天（創造神 Brahma）、濕婆（破壞神，Siwa)和毗溼奴（保護神，Wisnu) 。他們分別主宰著這個世界的起承轉合。每座神廟的入口都是朝向東方且登上後可以四處繞行，在步趨神廟的平台間可以看到兩旁由火山岩石塊精巧堆砌的石壁上有眾多石刻浮雕，主要是在描述著印度史詩《羅摩衍那》（Ramayana），光用眼睛看到這九世紀留下來的人類文明就夠發自內心的驚嘆連連了！
攀登神廟上下的階梯陡峭，大概這樣你必須低著頭恭敬的登高朝聖，體力也是要耗費不少的。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Moment fantastique à Prambanan à la tombée de la nuit. Le site est chargé de spiritualité mais malheureusement beaucoup de monde en ce jour de week-end.
Fantastisch mooie Hindu tempel. Zeker bezoeken in de namiddag zodat je tegen ‘s avonds de golden hour verlichting kan zien. Echt de moeite.
A beautiful place to visit and take some pictures. Even the markets close to the exit were nice to visit.

Da es ein fester Bestandteil der indonesischen Kultur ist, sollte man sich den Tempel auf jeden Fall anschauen. Wir fanden ihn schöner als Borobudur, allerdings kann er landschaftlich nicht mit Borobudur mithalten.

Tout d'abord, il faut l'avouer, les temples sont beaux à voir, même si la majorité est réduit à l'état de ruine. Dans le parc de Prambanan, seuls 4 temples sont visibles, parmi l'ensemble des temples des alentours. Mais le plus grand (et le plus visité) se trouve dans le parc. 

Seulement, nous sommes sortis du parc en ayant réellement l'impression d'être tombés dans un piège à touriste. Tout d'abord, le prix est vraiment élevé pour ce que c'est. 25 USD (350 000 rupiah) par adulte (sans parler de la différence de prix entre locaux et touristes). Ensuite, l'ensemble du parc est aménagé comme en parc d'attraction : une buvette, des cages avec des animaux, un parc avec des jeux pour enfants et la possibilité de se prendre en photo avec le corps de Spiderman ou d'Ironman. 
L'aspect religieux du lieu est complètement bafoué par l'appât du gain (et par la musique insupportable qui passe en fond).

Note pour la fin : il n'est absolument pas nécessaire d'acheter un Sarong pour visiter les temples. Ceci est affirmé par les locaux et fait l'objet d'une vaste arnaque puisque tout le monde prévient "gentiment" les touristes qu'en pantalon ou en short, il est nécessaire d'avoir un sarong pour entrer dans les temples. 

A voir tout de même !
I believe it’s a must-see temple in Indonesia. You can see different god and goddess. Easy to visit and please hire a professional guide for further information.

I was disgusted to find, that I had funded a really poorly maintained zoo. It upsets me that I funded such cruelty. I definitely wouldn’t return again. After visiting the temple (which was not that spectacular and incredibly expensive) we found caged animals in a poor state. There were deer in a pen with no grass, some of the deer had untreated open wounds on their backs. There were other animals in incredibly small cages looking sorry for themselves. Please don’t fund this cruelty!

Review Text: My wife and daughter decided not to enter the temples as they feel that it is too expensive. So I only brought my son in. After going in I realized that I have actually visited this temple about 25 years ago but it did not leave an impression and I have totally forgotten that I have come here before. so I will say that it is not worth visiting this place for the exorbitant price. Actually it is sufficient to view it from outside. The cheapest and most "bang for buck" way is actually to see the temples together with the Ramayana dance at Rp125,000. I have seen maybe at least 30 Ramayana dances in Indonesia over 30 years and I would say this is one of the best if not THE BEST Ramayana performance I have ever seen. The Ramayana dances in Bali has gotten so commercial that it has become a disappointment to me. The dance here is authentic and fast enough. Some authentic Ramayana dances are so slow that nothing actually happens for ten minutes. All the dancers are highly professional and passionate about the performance.

Dieser Besuch lohnt sich sehr, denn diese drei Haupt-Tempel und drei Nebentempel sind sehr  sehenswert. Die Abendsonne und die Lichtverhältnisse sind grandios. Auch die eigentliche Besichtigung ist super spannend, denn die genaue Arbeitsweisen an den Reliefs sind herausragend.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
The temple has a very long history and is quite beautiful with respect its architecture and beauty. The amount of detail is crazy, you can walk around for hours and admire the majesty of the place. 

Three main temples are Brahma the Creator, Vishnu the Keeper, and Shiva the Destroyer. Shiva is the biggest one and has 4 different chambers for 4 different gods: Shiva, Durga, Ganesha, and Agastya.

Each temples has a tall stone stairs to climb, so bring little kids might not a good choice. The weather keep changing, from mild to hot, and repeat. Bring water, sunglasses, and hat is recommended.

A must see attraction when in Yogya, and the perfect moment to learn more about the history of the Trimūrti.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Although heavily damaged as a result of an earthquake in 2006, Prambanan is well worth seeing. The main temples, which are close to the entrance, are a must-see, but the other temples, which cannot be entered are also worth seeing. They will be much less crowded but also involve some walking to get to them. Be sure to take water! I took a Grab car, SE Asia’s equivalent of Uber, for 60,000 Rupiah (or about US$4.25) from my hotel In Yogyakarta. There is a Grab booth at the exit, so it is very easy to get a return ride.

Die Kasse schliesst um 17.15 Uhr. Es lohnt sich so um halb Fünf dort zu sein und auf den Sonnenuntergang zu warten. Südwestlich der Anlage versammelten sich die Fotographen. Sich beim Schliessen der Anlage nicht hetzen lassen 😜

Ci siamo stati oggi e lo abbiamo trovato estremamente bello, ben curato e ricco di fascino, specie al tramonto. Considerate 2-3 ore per la visita e almeno 1 ora da jogyakarta. Conviene fare il biglietto combinato con l’altro sito.

We arrived to the Prambanan Temple on the public bus 1A, from the Malioboro street in Yogyakarta. The ride took 45 minutes and the bus was not crowded at all; the buses run every 15 min and the one way ticket price is ~4K IDR; the tickets are sold by the bus company staff at the bus stops. From the terminal it was a 15 min walk to the temple. The directions to the temple entrance shown on Google maps were not accurate but it was easy to figure out where to go. The foreigner price for a combined 2 day ticket (Prambanan and Borobudur temples) was $45. The two temples are unique, I would highly recommend to explore both while visiting the Yogyakarta region.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Untuk kesini tidak begitu jauh dari pusat kota yogjakarta, tiket masuk standar bagus untuk foto-foto😍

Review Text: Zeer mooi tempelcomplex. De moeite waard om te bezoeken. Jammer dat toeristen 337.500 IDR moeten betalen voor een ticket, terwijl de locals voor 40.000 IDR klaar zijn. Dit is bijna 8,5 keer zoveel. Wij hebben de dag ervoor ook de sunrise tour van de Borobudur gedaan. Daar wilden we een combi ticket halen voor Borobudur en Prambanan. Dit bleek echter niet te kunnen. Dit kan alleen als je na de sunrise tijden de tempels wilt bezoeken. Zo waren we voor Borobudur sunrise 475.000 IDR kwijt en voor Prambanan 337.500 IDR , samen 812.500 IDR. Dit komt neer op € 52,00. Bij de Prambanan kan je met een treintje afgezet  worden bij de Sewi tempel. Deze kun je ook bezoeken en zit bij de entree prijs van de Prambanan inbegrepen. Daarna kan je weer terug met het treintje.

Review Text: We visited the Prambanan temples in the morning (not for sunrise), the next day after we visited Borobudur (we bought the combined tickets). It was worth it to pay for the 1-hour guide (we found a French speaking guide inside the temple for 150k/hour). Count 2 hours in total.
