Review Text:
Mooi park , aanrader om een combi ticket te nemen en vooral je studenten pas mee nemen 👍
Wel veel lopen maar is zeker de moeite waard
Entering the temple around 4 pm gives you enough time to enjoy the temples and with a bit of luck you can enjoy the sunset. Its an amazing temple, highly recommend this.

Unlike Borobudur, which is a Buddhist temple, Prambanan is  Hindu. The stairs are steep to enter the temple and you really need a flash light since it is dark inside. I was not that impressed. the exterior carvings are interesting but if I had to do it all over again, I think I would pass.

とても素晴らしい遺跡群です。敷地がとても広いので、2万ルピア払って、園内を回るバスを利用することで、短時間で回ることができました。チケットは外国人は別な場所で購入することになっていて、値段も少し高め、私はボロブドゥール寺院と一緒のチケットを購入しましたが、90ドル。園内には一箇所食事をするところがあり、ビュッフェ形式で、一人6万ルピア。料理の種類はそれほど多くなく、味も美味しいとは思いませんでした。

We visited the Prambanan temple site in the evening around 5 pm. In the morning we had visited the Borobudur temple and had at that time bought the combo ticket (for both Borobudur and Prambanan) . The weather was comfortable and we entered the premises without any wait and walked to the temple site. The sight of the multiple temple spires was truly inviting. As we neared the temples the orange / red hues of the setting sun behind the temple spires was scintillating ! The site had apparently been struck multiple times by earthquakes and thanks to some astounding restoration work we still are able to enjoy this astounding heritage site.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Candi Prambanan atau Candi Roro Jonggrang(Hanacaraka: ꦕꦤ꧀ꦝꦶ​ꦥꦿꦩ꧀ꦧꦤꦤ꧀ , Candhi Prambanan) adalah kompleks candi Hinduterbesar di Indonesia yang dibangun pada abad ke-9 masehi. Candi ini dipersembahkan untuk Trimurti, tiga dewa utama Hindu yaitu Brahma sebagai dewa pencipta, Wishnusebagai dewa pemelihara, dan Siwa sebagai dewa pemusnah. Berdasarkan prasasti Siwagrha nama asli kompleks candi ini adalah Siwagrha (bahasa Sanskerta yang bermakna 'Rumah Siwa'), dan memang di garbagriha(ruang utama) candi ini bersemayam arca Siwa Mahadewa setinggi tiga meter yang menujukkan bahwa di candi ini dewa Siwa lebih diutamakan.

tyank nak Bali
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Et meget smukt tempelområde. Hvis man kender lidt til hinduismen, vil man nok få mest ud af det, men ellers nyder man bare området. Det er ikke så stort som Borobudur, men ligeså fascinerende og velbevaret. Det er absolut et besøg værd!

01 Juni 2019 mengambil paket wisata Candi Prambanan plus Candi Ratu Boko, setelah berkunjung terlebih dahulu ke Ratu Boko sampailah kembali kami di Prambanan. 
Lanjut berkeliling dan berfoto, menaiki 1 Candi yang ternyata didalamnya sedang ada Umat yang beribadah. 
Karena sudah cukup lelah berkeliling di Ratu Boko akhirnya kami langsung memutuskan menuju pintu keluar yang ternyata sangat jauh dan luas juga. 

Sampailah di pintu keluar dengan berbagai macam toko souvenir, kebetulan adik saya mampir untuk membeli gelang yang harganya sangat murah yaitu Rp 1.000/pc 
Setelah itu kami langsung pulang 

Dan keesokan hari 02 Juni 2019 kami kembali datang ke Prambanan hanya untuk berburu souvenir yang murah meriah, karena kemarin tidak puas belanja. 
Akhirnya kami langsung masuk pintu keluar lalu berbelanja dan kembali pulang.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
We went here as part of the 2 day package you can get with Borobudur. This means you get 1 ticket for both temples over a 2 day period. 
Arrived early but was still fairly busy. The temple is so good to visit. Thankfully we didn’t have too many locals wanting to take your picture with you so we got more time to do our own thing. 
The area is huge where you can see multiple temples rather than the main ones so you get away from the crowds a bit. There is also a “zoo” type place here where you can see a few animals, a bit odd to have here but all the animals look well looked after. At the exit you go though a market where you get harassed to buy stuff. Finally when you reach the end you are dumped somewhere in the car park with no direction of where to go to find your vehicle. 
Great temple let down by other factors. 

Top tip: drop a pin on google maps so you know where you left your vehicle. 

For more, follow us on Instagram @twopennybackpackers
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Candi prambanan tempat bersejarah yang harus di jaga dan dilestarikan agar anak cucu kita nanti bisa menyaksikan betapa hebatnya nenek moyang kita

日曜日のため、地元の人が多く詰めかけていました。外人専用入り口から入ってしばらくは見えませんが、突然木々の先にHindu寺院が見えて来ました。３、３、３と配置された建物群。当時の人は足が長かったのか、段差の大きな急な階段を登った先に像が置かれていました。触ると頭の回転が良くなる像と、奇麗になると言われる像は大変な人気で混み合っていましたが何とか触って来ました。この寺院の周りに有ったとされる、小建物群は修復されない様で、石だけが残されていました。見て圧倒された遺跡でした。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Semplicemente meravigliosi. Qui vi do solo un po’ di informazioni pratiche visto che se avete deciso di visitarli già sapete di cosa si tratta. Dal centro di Yogya, sulla Malioboro, prendete il bus 1A alla fermata Halte Malioboro 1 (ma va bene anche 2 se il vostro albergo è un po’ più giù) e scendete direttamente al capolinea. Costo 3500 INR pari a circa 20cent di euro. Un consiglio, andate presto, già alle 6.30 così da arrivare per le 7.30 perché dopo il sito si riempie. Una volta arrivati, uscite dalla piccola stazione, attraversate la trafficatissima strada e andate a destra sempre diritto per 3/400 metri fino all’ingresso. Calcolate 2/3 ore per la visita dei templi. È possibile noleggiare una bicicletta al ridicolo costo di 10000 INR pari a meno di 1€. Per il biglietto vi consiglio di fare quello combinato Borobudur/Prambanan che costa 610000 INR, così risparmiate anche qualcosa. Unica pecca è che quello combinato è in vendita solo a Borobudur ma tanto il primo tempio che su visita è proprio quello😉. Per gli stranieri c’è un ingresso separato molto ben segnalato. Insieme al biglietto c’é una utilissima bottiglietta di acqua fresca inclusa nel prezzo.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
I've visited Borobudur twice and expected Prambanan to be something so so as what I know it was a set of small temples in a complex. Big mistake, it wow's me from the moment I saw the temples from afar. It wow's me more when I was standing right besides them. 
Okay Borobudur is huge, but Prambanan is tall, really tall. How did people manage to build them with minimum tools, no crane, no heavy lifters, nothing hydraulics or pneumatically assisted, lost my words. 
It's like sitting in the middle of a magical land surrounded with amazing temples. Must visit once in your life!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: ジャカルタからジョグジャカルタに飛行機で1時間。そこから車で30分ほど。ボルブドゥール寺院とセットで入場券を買うと630,000ルピア＝6,000円ぐらい。一生に一回は見たいね！最高でした。

This is one of the main reasons why we came to Yogyakarta. This temple is amazing. We hired a guide from WithLocals  because we wanted to be motivated to get up early. It would have been just as easy to hire a driver. We ended up at the temple about 4pm as we kept getting side tracked doing other things. I wish we would have come earlier because it was so hot but we ended up seeing the sunset at the temple so that was a bonus. All-in-all, this is a must when in Yogyakarta.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
These spectacular Hindu temples have been damaged by earthquake and are in the process of restoration. They are in a very large compound, but the temples are in small area. They are not very big, certainly nowhere near the scale of Borobudur.

The entrance fee of about US$25 is rather expensive to see the temples, of which only 3 are really worth a closer look. These are temples dedicated to Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.

There is a museum as you make your way to the exit. Entrance is free, but all the explanatory notes are in Bahasa Indonesia.

Prambanan is a wonderful temple complex, not far from Yogjakarta. I went there on the back of a scooter , which I arranged through ViaVia. I had a great young woman driver , and we went through back ways and villages , which took a bit less than an hour. I would not advise combining it with Borobudur, as it’s in the opposite direction and traffic is the worst I’ve seen, which would make for a long and stressful day. The complex is quite spread out, and it is worth walking to the other smaller temples nearby, as they have fewer people. The main complex has temples dedicated to Brahma, Shiva and Vishnu and some have statues inside. It was a madhouse when I was there, as it was the annual Eid holiday, but would probably be more peaceful at other times. You need about 2 hours at the site.
The temples are beautiful but why is there a mini zoo? The animals and birds are in tiny miserable cages. :(

Candi Prambanan atau Candi Roro Jonggrang adalah kompleks candi Hindu terbesar di Indonesia yang dibangun pada abad ke-9 masehi. Cadi ini menjadi Salah satu tempat Yang wajib dikunjungi.memiliki banyak spot2 yg bagus untuk berswafoto. Ada jasa foto & sdh termasuk cetak. Hanya 20rb saja/ foto + cetak.

Beautiful temple site yet over crowded with local tourist at times. If you are an admirer of historical site, try your best to visit really early morning, or at close to sunset (around 4.30 onwards), i would recommend to come close to sunset as most of local tourist left already and the view can be breathtaking and more serene situation. But size wise it's nothing compared to borobudur or angkorwat, but still a must visit if you are in the area. Don't bring drones as it is not allowed, although you can just fly them by the parking lot.
The entrance cost is different between foreigner and local, it's  around usd 2.50 for locals, i don't know how much for foreigner.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: 昼頃に着きましたが、すごく暑いです。駐車場から寺院までは結構な距離です。帽子屋日傘があった方がベターです。遠い分だけ遠くから遺跡が見え徐々に大きくなっていくので神秘的です。周りは崩れた遺跡の修復中？（地震で崩壊した？）ですが３つの寺院は大きく荘厳です。

Very cool temple compound. It was an even better experience than Borobudur. There’s so many things to see and you can choose your own mode of transport from walking, buggy, cycling and so on. I had fun walking through the ancient ruins and visiting all the different Temples and intricate structure from the past.
I visit this place many times since Elementary school and never bored to visit this over and over. The problem is this place not a stroller friendly like in Borobudur.

voor de 2e keer naar de tempel prambanan.
 Het is een prachtige hindu tempel complex.
Deze keer zijn de ruimten in de tempels leeg.
 Werd mij verteld dat  de beelden van de tempel worden afgehaald om het te reinigen voor een prosessie.
 Is een machtig  panorama  van de zonsondergang te zien tussen de pieken van de tempels

saya mengunjungi Candi Prambanan menjelang senja. ternyata keindahannya semakin nyata seiring mentari turun ke peraduannya.. siluet candi dg latar belakang langit jingga sangat indah dan syahdu... setiap candi memiliki arca yg berbeda2 dan semua terawat dg baik. wiata sejarah, budaya dan teknologi arsitektur nenek moyang.

It was a miserable hot afternoon and we had just finished a very satisfying lunch with a cold local beer. Not a good beginning for sightseeing. However, the 9th century Temple complex was definitely worth a visit. There are a total of 240 temples, large and small within the compound. It is considered the largest and the finest Hindu temple complex in Indonesia. If you are in Yogyakarta this is a site not to be missed.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
If you are in the Yogyakarta / Surakarta area the ancient Hindu temples at Prambanan are a must see. 

The temples are about a 1,000 years old and reflect Java’s pre-Islamic Heritage. 

The exit is lined with vendors selling all kinds of touristy rubbish, but it’s all part of the fun. 

Plan to spend 3-4 hours. 

If you are foreign to Indonesia, look for the ticket center reserved for foreigners. The lines are much shorter and you can buy your tickets in air conditioned comfort there. The ticket prices are about 5 times higher than the locals pay. 

Unless you can pass for Indonesian, you will have to buy your tickets in the entrance reserved for foreigners. 

I found Prambanan more interesting and impressive than Borobudur.

If you've seen Angkor Wat, skip this.  If you haven't, save the money to see it instead.  This is a rip-off (of foreigners; locals pay 1/10.  True at Borobudur also and everywhere else in Indonesia but none as bad as Prambanan and Borobudur).

A really nice temple, but it can get very crowded on public holidays, so try to avoid those. A must visit though. About 1 to 2 hours should do it. If you want to stroll through the surrounding park you will need more time.

So good in there. I love it❤️. Natural. Mungkin tambahan aja pembangunan jalan nya supaya tidak terlalu berpasir saat di sana. 
Penjaganya ramah” 
Tiket harganya relatif sekitar 20-70 ribu rupiah.
Rekomendasi untuk liburan bareng keluarga.

Hindu temple with main God is Shiva .. the center Candi is for Shiva, and the other two on the sides are for Vishnu and Brahma .. while Candi across these three are their rides, Angsa for Brahma; Garuda for Shiva and Nandi for Vishnu .. a complete temple complex for three main Hindu Gods .. if lucky enough to visit it on a quite season, enter the main chamber of Shiva and you still can feel its calming vibes .. a very must visit temple in Jogja region
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: 最近の修復で埋めたであろうコンクリートが生々しくわかりました。やはりボロブドゥールの方が手をかけて修復されている印象でした。さりとてキレイなレリーフも多くあり、お堂は荘厳にそびえ、見る価値は大いにありました。

kami berkunjung ke prambanan pada saat lebaran hari kedua, jadi bisa dibayangkan wisatawan yang mayoritas pemudik memadati kawasan ini, 2 km perjalanan membutuhkan waktu lebih dari 1 jam untuk sampai ditempat ini, kami memilih waktu yg kurang tepat juga untuk berkunjung yaitu siang hari, begitu panas menyengat walaupun dilindungi dengan payung. secara umum tempat wisata ini sudah terkelola dgn baik namun msh perlu edukasi kepada pengunjung untuk membuang sampah pada tempatnya dan bagi pengelola agar menyediakan tmpt  sampah lebih banyak di area candi.

Shadowed, in the methaphorical sence, by Borobodur, but worth a visit!!! Just be prepared to do some walking, if you don't want to wait for the shuttle. Good idea is probalby to walk one way, and return for the most far away point.
Candi yang menjadi tempat untuk mengenal peninggalan sejarah ratusan tahun lalu yang masih berdiri kokoh sampai saat ini

Sebuah mahakarya anak manusia 
Candi prambanan tempat wisata untuk edukasi bagaimana pada zaman itu manusia bisa merangkai batu ini menjadi sebuah bangunan yang kokoh dan indah

Ein kleines Angkor Wat - toll. Natürlich hat die Anlage sehr wenig mit der großen, weitläufigen Tempelanlage in Kambodscha gemeinsam. Aber Ähnlichkeiten sind erkennbar. 

Der Preis ist in der Tat wirklich sehr hoch. Dies rechtfertigt jedoch in keiner Weise eine 1-Sterne Bewertung, wie sie hier zum Teil zu finden sind. 

Wir haben insgesamt 3 gemütliche Stunden in der Anlage verbracht. Die hinteren Tempel werden überhaupt nicht von Touristen besucht. Sie lohnen sich aber auch - vor allem weil es so ruhig ist. Wer schon immer mal Segway fahren wollte, kann das hier für 1-2€ machen. War ein Erlebnis wert.

Het Prambanan tempelcomplex maakte alle verwachtingen waar. Op de Borobudur na de mooiste en gaafste attractie die ik in Indonesië bezocht. Indrukwekkend, heel bijzonder en uniek (ja OK alles is uniek ;-). Niet veel bezoekers op het einde van de ochtend toen het loeiheet was. Moet je echt bezoeken als je op Java bent, topattractie.
불교 유적지인 보로부드르 사원과는 다르게 프람바난은 힌두교 사원입니다. 예전에 보로부드르를 들러본터라 이번에는 프람바난 사원을 둘러보고 저녁에는 라마야나 발레를 관람했습니다. 우기때 방문한터라 날씨가 조금 좋지 않아 아쉬웠지만 가이드 분이 열심히 설명해 주셔서 좋은 구경을 했습니다.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Wonderful Hindu Temple Site.  Very interesting historical site and a great place to spend an hour or two.  Worth a visit.

First of all, thank you to UNESCO who has been restoring the temple from the damage of the previous earthquakes. It is still a long way to go yet, but it is amazing to see that this temple was built without any sophisticated heavy-duty machinery. 
Our tour guide was amazing. He explained very well about the temple and its history. 
Highly recommended and a must visit. 
Don't forget your sunblock.

Large ancient Hindu temple set in delightful gardens. Make sure you take a guide to learn the full history of this amazing place.  Mid week visit very quiet so felt like I had the place to myself. Local handicraft markets here as well.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Went there with kids. Lots of open spaces around but need to watch kids. But a must see if you are in the area or visiting Indonesia

Hele mooie tempel! Hebben een Nederlands sprekende gids gehad. Vertelde veel over de tempel en de planten er omheen. Voor mooie foto’s loop even naar de achterkant dan heb je niet zoveel last van tegenlicht.

ヒンドゥージャワの美しい寺院。
壁に刻まれるラーマヤナのレリーフも
とても美しく、壮大な尖塔、奉られた
ヒンドゥーの神々に心奪われます！

Very impressive temple complex, amazing architecture. We loved it.
Located in well maintained park with many other attractions.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Стоит посетить, цена ~25 $ . Близко от аэропорта, можно сразу, если мало вещей, но не пешком, лучше автобус. Много местных школьников, когда там был, было что-то типа школьного бойскаутского лагеря из разных частей Индонезии. Местные любят фотографироваться с иностранцами. На территории есть прогулочный (платный) транспорт.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It was a compound with around 10 temples and looked so beautiful though the area was not so large. Recommend to spend an hour or more here!

東南亞有許多印度廟的群落，但這兒的規模並不小，且頗有看頭。雖然許多因時間而崩壞或待修，但不影響它的可看性。細細品味，仍能找到感動點。婆羅浮屠外，另一個必須造訪的世界遺產。錯過等於沒來此地。值得。
園區可好好走走。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: المعبد الهندوسي لا يحظى بشعبية مثل المعابد الأخرى في جميع أنحاء المدينة. لكنني أنصحك بزيارتها ، خاصة أنه من السهل جدًا الوصول إلى المكان الصحيح. مجمع المعبد رائع. إنها كبيرة وجميلة ومصممة بشكل فاخر. لقد رأيت العديد من المعابد في كمبوديا وتايلاند ، لكن معابد إندونيسيا أعجبتني كثيرًا.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It’s our third time here, and it still takes our breath away everytime. Borobodur is much more famous but i find Prambanan much more beautiful. There are less people in May largely due to fasting season. Please note that there are different rates for local and international tourists. Also suggest to take the tour train after touring Candi Prambanan so you can see all the other temples in the complex which you probably wont have energy to do so by foot.

Sehr schöne Tempelanlage mit verschiedenen kleineren Tempeln und dem Haupttempel auf einem relativ großen Areal verteilt.

Wir waren nachmittags hier, es war sehr entspannt und man könnte den Sonnenuntergang beobachten! Sehenswert!

Natürlich (wie alle großen Sehenswürdigkeiten hier), überteuert, aber trotzdem sein Geld wert! Ein Getränk im Eintritt inklusive.
Parken Roller 3000 IRP.
Von Yogyakarta in 15-20 Minuten erreicht.

Man sollte innerhalb der Anlage den richtigen Weg gehen und nicht (wie wir), falsch herum laufen (wir haben beim Sewu angefangen), da die Security-Leute nicht flexibel sind und einen aus dem "internen Exit" (völliger Schwachsinn einen eigenen Ein und Ausgang innerhalb der Anlage zu machen) nicht herauslassen und man somit unnötige Kilometer läuft um den selben Weg wieder zurückzulaufen. Nervig.

Nicht für gehbehinderte Menschen geeignet, da die Steintreppen sehr hoch und steil sind!

Punktabzug für die Sauberkeit in den Toilettenanlagen und die Unfreundlichkeit der Angestellten. Der Ausgang geht durch gefühlt Millionen kleine Shops, die allesamt Wellblech-überdacht sind und somit eine sehr schlechte Luft dort herrscht! Einfach ignorieren...

Candi dengan legenda kisah Roro Jonggrang dengan Raja Bandung Bondowoso. Konon, Raja Bandung Bondowoso yang membangun 1000 candi atas permintaan Roro Jonggrang. Letak candi Prambanan berada diantara 2 provinsi yaitu Jawa Tengah dan Yogyakarta.

ボロブドゥールと同じ時代の異なる宗教遺跡としてセットで見ると興味深いです。いろんな所でコラボしているのがわかる。レリーフはこちらの方が綺麗に残っている印象でした。
ジョグジャカルタからはトランスジョグジャで一本で行けるので便利です。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: We visited the Prambanan Hindu Temple in Yogyakarta. This is 1150 years old temple and was damaged in the year of 1006 and 2006 due to massive earth quakes. Some part has been restored and work is still continuing. The main three temples are of Lord Shiva, Lord Vishnu and Lord Barhma. There are temples of other God and Goddesses. Statute of Goddess Durga was still standing tall. It is worth a visit if you are in this area. Its a huge temple complex.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: 专门挑了下午去的，希望看到日落。可惜云层太厚，只能看到晚霞。本来还想看 Ramayana ballet，但是当天没有演出，又留下一个遗憾。寺庙的浮雕很精美，也保存得很好，真的值得一看。看了Borobudur再来看Prambanan, 发现他们的神有着相似的坐姿和手势

Largest Hindu temple in Indonesia,and the temple compound is an UNESCO heritage site. The skill in building and re-building it (as it was affected by natural disasters) is amazing.By far one of our favourite destinations on our visit to Yogyakarta.  

Get there early - we were there by 8.30 am and it was already very crowded and also very hot.If you are interested in the history of the temple, suggest getting a guide (200K IR for two hours) - although expensive, the insight provided by our guide Micco, definitely enhanced our experience (plus the information boards are not in English).
If time permits,take the opportunity to visit the other temples in the compound (included in the entry ticket). We visited Sewu - although smaller, it is beautiful (and lot less crowded).
Exit is via a market place and you are able to come back to the entry point,to meet with your transport.
Although an expensive visit (350K IR entrance + guide 200K IR + gratuities) , well worth including in your visit.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: We arrived her late in the afternoon as the crowds were beginning to diminish so we could have a good look around and take some good photos of the temple itself and not have to worry about being slowed down by human traffic.

This was 350000 rupees each for an adult ticket. Its too much for it and when locals pay 30000 rupees it feels unfair. I don’t mind paying more but not that much more. If you are going to charge such discriminately high prices to foreigners then information in the museum should be translated into other languages. It’s about the same from memory as I paid to get into Angkor Wat which while it is beautiful it is not on the same scale as. Also it’s a lot of walking around to see everything inside. Again if you have charged so much to get in then you shouldn’t have to pay on top for bikes or golf carts to get around these should be part of such a huge ticket. 
The archery is fun. 
Goats and deers kept in much too small an enclosure for no discernible reason. You are forced to walk through a lot of souvenir tat shops to get back to the car park.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Tempatnya luas,bersih dan nyaman.
Untuk harganya paket 75 ribu dimana kita bisa menikmati prambanan dan keraton ratu boko ini. Jadi ada transportasi dari prambanan ke keraton, transportasi bakalan ada per 15 menit ke keraton dan balik lagi ke prambanan. Untuk 75 ribu jika kita ambil paket ya, tapi kalau mau lihat candi prambanan aja 40 ribuan.

Beautiful and serene Prambanan, we really really  enjoyed our visit here. My husband, not into cultural sights preferred Prambanan over Borobudur and was surprised that he actually loved the whole experience. 
We arrived about 9am leaving Yogyakarta on motorbikes at 8am. It was still busy but as the site is quite large it can handle crowds better than the temple at Borobudur. We loved wandering around the ruins probably more than the actual temples, and we were really interested to see the renovations being undertaken by local craftsmen. 
The whole place and experience was memorable and truly wonderful.

There were very few westerners there and we were politely but excitedly asked for lots and lots of photos with the locals, especially children on school trips. We accepted all requests with smiles and thoroughly enjoyed the fun we had with the locals. This was just another facet that made the experience wonderful for us.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Sangat indah
 Di sana sangat bisa membuat saya senang karena keindahannya itu sangat luar biasa , saya jadi ingin kembali ke sana lagi
Jangan lupa membawa topi, sunblock, payung pada saat berkunjung karena area nya outdoor.. Panas banget jika berkunjung saat siang hari
Meski sudah sering ke sini namun tetap ingin datang kembali, suasananya tidak jauh berbeda dg 2 th lalu..., Cukup menyenangkan bisa kembali berkunjung ke sini.

We headed here in the afternoon and still had to wait until the sun hide behind the towers, in order to get any useful pictures.
We drove the scooter here from downtown, the main road there is pretty terrible so took the backroads back, and that was nice.
We combined Borobudur and Prambanan the same day, the worst doing this is really the road in between, next time we do it on separate days.
It’s a bit large steps to get atop the main temple, especially for our 4 year old, but doable.
The combination tickets are bloody expensive now (Borobudur and Prambanan) 630000 RP for adults (10 years old and above) and 378000 for children 3-10 years, tickets valid for one entrance each, over two days.
Scooter parking was easy.
The entrance and exits are far away, we hassled a bit with the security guards to let us through out the entrance, that was almost impossible, but a crying infant did the trick. If not it was really a long trek from the exit back to the car/scooter parking area.
The temple areas are very beautiful! Take your time, we spent 2h. Remember to bring a lot of water and isotonic drinks as it’s dusty and hot.

La mayor construción, o más bien conjunto de construcciones, del complejo histórico arquitectónico de Prambanan, impresionante a pesar de estar en reconstrucción. Lo peor, la masificación de visitantes, tanto turistas como nacionales.

We had an amazing time first visiting this ancient Hindu temple and later watching one the most well choreographed ballet I have even seen. A guide will help explain the 3-god temple with Lord Shiva at the center and biggest of them. Undusal to find a brahma temple (ask any Hindu) anywhere but here you have one. We guide explained why this reconstruction project is “ever lasting”.
Best part was the finale - the Ramayana ballet - took a VIP team (worth it for 2 hrs) and of course Gado gado salad
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Visiting Prambanan will be even more enjoyed if you are a art lover and are able to truly appreciate the beautiful carvings and sculptures. If you are a selfie junkie, you will probably be better just stayomg in the beautiful surrounding  park and enjoy the shade. 
The visit can be very hot in plain sun. 
However the beauty and amazing detailed carvings on lava stones are a wonder and really call for admiration and humility. The rooms inside the temple are small so with big crowds of misbehaving tourist , it must be really unpleasant at times. We were lucky to go on the day before the elections and there were very little people. 
Steps are very very steep - not accessible for disabled or limited mobility .

The temples are glorious vestige of the past, although quite demolished.
What outrages is the ticket price for foreigners that is 10 times higher than that for the locals.

Прамбанан-комплекс из нескольких храмов. Посвящён Шиве. Хотя считается триединство Богов ( тримурти). Трое как единый бог. И каждому ( Брахмы, Вишну и Шиве) есть своей «дворец». Перед ними маленькие храмы для возничих Богов. Но сохранился только Нанди-бык.
Внутри маленького помещения храма статуя и темнота. Чтобы ничто не мешало молитве.
Храмы сделаны из вулканического камня. 
Место оставило глубокое впечатление и масштабом и атмосферой.
The discovery of the temple took place in 1800. A surveyor stumbled.like Borobudur , Prambanan is a UNESCO world heritage site.the temple attracts several visitors, like me ..jejeje
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Candi yg cantik dengan nuansa ciri khas yogya, kawasan candi bersih, dan sangat puas mengunjungi candi disini...

Tempat ini merupakan salah satu candi yang terletak di Propinsi Yogyakarta dan candi Hindu terbesar di Pulau Jawa. Saya berkunjung ke sana saat cuaca cerah dan terik matahari. Harus sedia kacamata dan payung agar tidak dehidrasi. Jalan dari gerbang masuk menuju ke Candi Prambanan tidak terlalu jauh dibandingkan perjalanan ke candi Borobudur. Area di sekitar candi sangat bersih dan tertata rapi sehingga sangat nyaman bagi pengunjung. Selain itu juga terdapat pedagang yang menjual souvenir dan pernak-pernik khas prambanan sehingga memanjakan para wisatawan. Banyak juga area untuk mencari spot berfoto selfi dan merupakan candi bersejarah bagi bangsa Indonesia.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
We purchased a tour which includes visits to Borobudur and Prambanan temples

Entrance fees were already paid by the tour. Arriving at the site, ticketing office provided us with a cold bottle of water which is perfect as it was a very warm day.

The area is huge, with several temples(both Hindu and Buddhist). Although it is walkable, it might be a challenge to visit all the temples on a warm day. Good thing there are rental transport within the vicinity as an option.

Some temples are being restored but overall, you can still enjoy visiting them and taking photos. 

There is a museum in the area but unfortunately, the information is only in Bahasa language which is not very helpful for foreign tourists. That is my only concern.

I recommend this site as one of the places you shouldn't miss to visit when in Yogya.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Apart from the cut-throat aka over-priced foreigner visitor fee (I paid around $60 which is about 10 times more than local fee), I will recommend a visit to Prambanan. Please ask for a guide as he/she will enrich your visit. 

My friend and I had an awesome guide who enchanted us with historical background and also engaged us with many light-hearted jokes and myths. 

As the evening approached, you could witness the awesome sunset against the majestic temples. 

Do note that this is not quite child friendly as there are many steps to conquer so be prepared to carry your baby/toddler. 

P.S. We forgot the name of our guide but he stayed in Germany and States for a number of years. Ask for him!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: We went hear at opening time (6am) and we basically had the whole place to ourselves! We got some fantastic, tourist free shots and took our time to walk around and read about all the temples and their respective histories. This was my first visit to a Hindu temple complex so it really was amazing! All the staff were lovely and personable as well :)
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
修復する前とされたものがあります
歴史の長さを感じられました
圧倒される建造物でした
昔の石と新しく使われた石に白い丸の小さなしるしがあり見ていてわかりやすかったです

Candi Hindu terbesar di jawa. Begitu megah , sebagian masih di renovasi karena gempa beberapa tahun yang lalu . Jangan lupa bawa payung , karna panas sekali . Sayang nya di tempat ini pengunjung harus berjalan kaki jauh sekali untuk keluar, harus melewati lorong pedagang oleh" ... sebenarnya bagus juga buat mendorong ekonomi warga , tapi harusnya ada jalur alternatif buat pengunjung yg sudah lansia atau yg memang harus segera meninggalkan tempat tersebut

Review Text: Another historic site restored thanks to the work of UNESCO. This is as challenging a giant jigsaw puzzle as the terracotta warriers. Seen with Borobodur it is a great day to appreciate the cultural heritage of Jave.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
4歳。11歳の子連れでホテルに送迎だけお願いして行きました。有償で日本人ガイドもいましたが、特に依頼することなく入ったところ、現地の観光を専攻する高校生が、実習として英語でガイドの打診受け、お願いをしました。コミュニケーションには問題なく、色々遺跡について教えてくれた上に、子ども達にも親切に面倒を見てくれたので、結果とても良かったです。
外国人向けにはミニトレイン(園内バス)もフリーで使えるとのことでしたが、10人集まらないと発車できないとのこと、小銭を持ち合わせていなかったため、他の園内カートも利用できず、結局歩いて周りました。広大な敷地は緑豊かな公園のようで、散歩には気持ち良い距離ですが、4歳は最初のプランバナン遺跡の階段の上り下りと暑さで疲れてしまい、あとの遺跡は結局抱っこになり大変でしたので、個別のカートをお勧めします。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Posto meraviglioso. La visita è stata perfetta grazie alla nostra guida Dwi che con un perfetto inglese ci ha raccontato la storia dell'induismo racchiusa tra quelle mura. Visita consigliatissima se vi trovate a Yogyakarta!!! E chiedete di Dwi (che è anche un ottimo fotografo per delle bellissime foto ricordo).

ボロブドゥールほど有名ではありませんが、こちらも世界遺産です。
メインの塔の前には、基壇に山積みにされている崩れた石群があります。崩れる前は圧巻だったと思います。
塔へは急な階段を上がります。内部は狭く、ヒンドゥーの神の像が立っています。照明がないので、携帯のライトをつけてみました。太陽が東にある内は、ライトがなくても見えるのかもしれません。
塔の周囲の彫刻が興味深いです。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
saya dan keluarga Berkunjung ke Candi Prambanan di siang hari. cuaca cerah. panas sangat terik. Siap-siap bawa topi/payung, kacamata hitam dan minum agar tidak dehidrasi. Bisa kasih makan binatang.

Review Text:
Like many other of the negative reviews my option of this whole area is based on the great expense to be here for such average ruins.

If you have been to India, Angor Wat, Tikal or any other such sites I highly suggest skipping this whole area. Its way over priced. We paid $40each for the combined ticket for Prambanan and Borobudur, $100 accommodation for three nights, transport around, transport to and from etc. Not to mention giving up precious days of our holiday.

Honestly unless its your first visit to such a place then by all means go check it all out and spend your two hours combined looking around both sites. If however you have more respect for your hard earned western money then skip the whole area and put the money towards travelling to some of the above mentioned places which will blow your mind instead of leaving you feeling like you just got played.

The Town of Yoga is also a dump, theres really nothing here apart from endless streets of uglyness and random (massive) piles are rotting and smelly garbage. 

Another thing that rubbed me the wrong way -  Elephant rides in Borobudur, seriously !

No me esperaba algo así.
Estabamos en Singapur y probamos a ver algo diferente en la isla de Java , en Yogyakarta.
Que templos tan bonitos y desconocidos. El entorno precioso y la gente espectacular.
Visita imprescindible y con Borobudur ya se convierte en una experiencia única.
Nosotros fuimos con poco tiempo a Prambanan, pero es mejor ir relajados y tener un día para cada templo, aprovechando casi hasta el final que hace menos calor y ya lo ves iluminado.
Esta muy restaurado y si te acompaña un guia  te explicará todo con mucha amabilidad.
Prepárate a hacerte fotos con la gente local que visita aquello. Les gusta tenerlas con los occidentales.
We hebben al veel tempels gezien maar de Prambanan is wel echt de mooiste die we gezien hebben. We vonden het indrukwekkender dan de borobodur.
Complex of several temples, difinitelly worth a visit. Most of the visitors are at the main temple but complex is larger, good place where to spend several hours.

It’s a constant struggle to restore and preserve the Prambanan temple complex against the forces of nature. Only the main temples have been painstakingly restored. There are more than 200 smaller temples and shrines which are still lying in rubbles from previous volcanic eruptions and earthquakes. But what a wonderful job they’ve done. The main temples stand tall and majestic and a sight to behold during the sunset hours. In each temple, lies a Hindu god shrouded in darkness. Our guide had a torchlight to enable us to enjoy these masterpieces from the 8th century. The biggest Hindu temple in Indonesia and a UNESCO world heritage site is another strong reason to visit Yogyakarta.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
How did they build this magnificent structure..that was the questions I have in mind for a long time. Visiting it for first time and many more since then has never stopped me from admiring this structure. The efforts made to rebuild for over 100 years has yet to be completed as it's just like a jigsaw puzzle. 
A must visit for all travelers, put religions aside and look beyond..you will be amazed..

Review Text:

It may be worthwhile to hire a guide so that you can get correct information.  The place well laid out.  On a good day, you can see Mt. Merapi at a distance.

Review Text:

プランバナンはヒンズーの寺院。６つの石塔が立っており、手前左からガルーダ（神鳥）、ナンディ（雄牛）、ハンサ（白鳥）、奥はヒンズーの三大神で左から創造神ブラフマー、維持神ヴィシュヌ、破壊神シバ。前はそれぞれの神様の乗り物だとのこと。

Review Text:
大晦日に訪れました。雨季にも関わらず天気に恵まれラッキーでした。滞在していたハイアットリージェンシーホテルから、日本語ガイドさんの案内（現地で車をチャーター）で寺院まで行き、説明を聞きながら寺院（複数の建築物）の中を見学しました。

Review Text:
Yes, 560k IDR (40$) for Prambanan+Borobudur is expensive compared to cost of living in Indonesia (specially food) and it's 8 times more than for locals (FYI it's 37$ a day in Angkor Wat and free for locals), BUT HEY! it's still quite cheap if you compare to prices in Western Europe for example.

You can go by bus from the center (40min) and it's only 7k for a return ticket.

The temples are definitely worth seeing, specially the main one. And to have both Hindu and Buddhist ancient temples in the same area with a volcano nearby is quite something, no? Also, you can see 2 other ones (including a very nice one) easily by walking east for 1km+ out of the area.

I had the chance to meet a student who's doing guide for free (well, a little tip) thanks to a collaboration between his school and the Prambanan complex. We spent 5h together, including 1h lunch and a lot of interesting discussions.

Hope it helps!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The temples look good and offer an amazing view over a cliff. All photos will surely look nice here. We did enjoy it however we find the entrance fee too much for tourists they offer IDR540,000 combo entrance for Borobudur + Prambanan while the locals pay only about IDR40,000. The only thing you can do is really take photos. We also find the exit way so annoying. You have to go through a jungle of stores just to get out. Imagine if you visited at noon and the sun is just exhausting then you are going to walk to an open area followed by a maze of stores. I don't think one will enjoy shopping there. It is just so tiring to walk from one aisle to another.
The temple area is well reconstructed. In general the whole park is very nice. Personal saying I was expecting more English information almost all informations are “only” given in Bahasa.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Salah satu destinasi Yogyakarta yang fenomenal dan penuh sejarah. Sangat baik untuk anak-anak sebagai edukasi. Dan terpenting fasilitas yang cukup memadai.

The largest candi complex and make sure you have some energy to walk around. Beside taking pictures at each of the candi, you may participate few activities around it like hanging bicycle, hanging swing, watching elephant etc. Those are with additional fees. When you walk around the candi, you'll be listening to the Javanese instrumental music all day long through the speaker surrounding the area. Such a lovely place.

As we arrived at the Carpark we did not like see the temple except for a few modern contemporary buildings. However upon walking in, we were awestruck by this UNESCO world heritage temple constructed about 856 AD. It is located in an enclosed park hidden away with with stalls & facilities.

The Prambanan Temple being the main temple with many other several small temples in the same compound are Hindu Temples dedicated to Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva (The Creator, The Protector and The Destroyer). The steps to these individual temples are quite narrow and steep with many visitors taking selfies which make it a bit difficult to climb through.

Our tour guide walked us through and explained/narrated in detail the history on each and every panel reliefs of stones carving and every temple building which house a statue of Hindu god or goddess.

The Temples Park  are well maintained, many ruins from earthquake could be seen lying neatly. There is an enclosed area with spotted deers, a souvenir shop and café.  For visitors who do not wish to walk , they can pay a price for the Buggy Transport. The driver will gladly stop and wait for you while you explore the temples site . At the Exit , there are plenty of market stalls for souvenirs.

Certainly worth the time to explore this ancient Hindu Temple, definitely one of the best tourist site around Yogyakarta !!!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
The Prambanan Temple is, first, three temples dedicated to the Hindu Deitiies Shiva, Brahma and Vishnu, respectively.  Second, it is a series of smaller temples in various stages of preservation and ruin.

The central three temples are magnificent.  Their relief carvings equal or may even surpass those of its neighbor, The Bhuddist Borobodu.  The sheer number of reliefs and their intricate detail are difficult to comprehend.  They tell stories of the deities and stories of ordinary life at the time the temples were built.  Carved in stone, they are not only rich in detail but often three dimensional and the faces look almost human close up.  

Spend the time to enter each temple and do walk around the temples ascending to the different levels of each.  There are a lot of steps to climb but it is worth it.

After a visit to the three central temples it is equally worth your time to visit the many smaller ones in the area, Sewu in particular.

We had a very knowledgeable anthropologist, PhD candidate and Bhuddist scholar as our guide, which was invaluable and we had no problem spending 7 hours on the site.  Even so, I had a feeling we only scratched the surface but I am glad we did.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Setelah terakhir kali kesini zaman SMP, main kesini lagi. ngantri banget pas ngantri tiket, untung kita beli tiket terusan. Saat itu mau akhir tahun 2018, rame banget pengunjung.

Candi Prambanan merupakan candi Hindu terbesar di Indonesia. Candi agama Hindu yang berada di antara Provinsi Jawa Tengah dan Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta.
Saat ke Jogja jangan lupa mampir ke candi ini di daerah prambanan, kabpaten Sleman, DIY. Ada transportasi yg membuat saya tertarik saat jalan-jalan ke Jogja, yaitu TransJogja. Dengan TransJogja kita bisa keliling Jogja loh. Bahkan dari Bandara Adisucipto menuju Maliobor juga ada.
Indrukwekkend ..... cultureel erfgoed. Het is wel eenrichting verkeer en wij waren verplicht om een grote ronde te lopen langs souvenierswinkels om bij de uitgang te komen.
Ramai dikunjungi orang mulai dari pagi sampai sore hari. Pagi hari untuk foto2 dgn sunrise dan sore hari dengan sunset.
One of the highlights near Yogyakarta - giving it 4* in review as compared to Borododur it is not in that league, but still an amazing site. Well worth being around for sunset.

I visited prambanan temple yesterday (06/02/19) with my hawaian friends. We had a plan to see the sunset and looking the javan sparrow (gelatik jawa), one of endemic birds. The prambanan sunset is amazing one that i ever captured.
Disana tempat yang bagus untuk berlibur sambil belajar sejarah bersama teman dan keluarga. Banyak spot foto yang bagus dan menarik.

We visited Prambanan after a visit to Borobudur and found these equally enchanting and interesting. These temples are Hindu temples dedicated to Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva (the creator, preserver and destroyer). The architecture is typical of temples found in India with a pointed top. There are a few other Buddhist temples in the complex as well. 

They provide with paid buggies for elderly to/from the entrance/exit.

This complex though less famous than Borobudur deserves a visit during a trip to Yogjakarta.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
We enjoyed most the Sewu temple within the Prambanan grounds. It's the second largest Buddhist temple in Central Java and only a handful of the visitors who flock in the Prambanan temple grounds make their way to Sewu - so you have good change of having the whole temple area to yourself. 
Prambanan itself is of course beautiful as well. On a clear day, you have nice views from the temple to the close by Merpati. 
Whatch our video of Prambanan and Sewu in Youtube/Susa and Masa around the world.

He pointed to a group of non-Chinese Indonesian behind us and said that they don’t need to show their ID because they are obviously Indonesian.

Traumatizing and eye-opening experience, thank you.

The Prambanan temple complex at one time comprised 240 temples, but only the eight central temples and eight shrines remain.  The balance are scattered about as carved stones but many stones are missing and presumably used for building materials.  The main shrine has a statue of shiva and other hindu deities.  My wife also enjoyed  dressing up as a Dutch settler and having her picture taken with the temple as a  backdrop.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Must see place when come to Jogjakarta. Impressive Hindu temples. We visited the temples after visiting another well known Buddhist temple Borobudur. Our guide Joko from rentcarjogja is an excellent tour guide, a man of culture; and gave us a good story about the place, the dance performed at night near the temples. We strongly recommend this place.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Prambanan temple very close from Jogjakarta airport 12 minute by the car . Nice park with few temple inside,one of popular place to visit in Jogjakarta.

Ich kann sagen ,dass wir sehr Zufrieden waren .

The stairs and ways are sometimes quite narrow and steep and in our case it was rainy, so you need to be a little bit careful. The price is okay.

This is my first time too for traveled around Prambanan Temples after my 24 years old hihihi.

Review Text: The structure is beautiful and amazingly built, it’s one of the oldest Hindu temple, it’s a good model for your photography.

Well worth taking your time and exploring each of the temples and the surrounds.
There is so much history and the sheer size of the entire grounds can take a few hours to explore. Well worth having a guide explain to you the significance and history.

Review Text: Prambanan = Roro Jonggrang. Another UNESCO world heritage site. Photo taken from Rama and Shinta Cafe and Resto

Kami mengunjungi prambanan karena papa saya sangat ingin melihat keindahan candi ini. Papa tidak bisa berjalan jauh namun fasilitas peminjaman kursi roda membuat papa bisa masuk dan bisa melihat candi dari dekat.
Candi prambanan salah satu yg wajin dikunjungi kalo ke daerah jogja dan sekitarnya.

ボロブドゥールの後からだと多少物足りなさを感じるが十分満足する事は出来る。
日本同様地震と火山の国で偉大なる先人たちが、ボロブドゥールも含めなぜこのような遺跡を作ったのか大変興味深いところである。

O conjunto de Prambanan fica a cerca de 18 Kms de Yogyakarta e faz parte do património da UNESCO, desde 1991. É constituído pelo complexo Loro que é hindu e pelo complexo Sewu que é budista. No complexo hindu destacam-se os magníficos templos de Shiva, Brahma e Vishnu que aconselho vivamente a visitarem, porque o espaço é lindo. Levem calçado confortável, porque vão ter de andar bastante.

Review Text:
昨日は、ボロブドゥール寺院を巡り翌日この「プランバナン寺院跡」をめぐったので割引のあるコンボチケットで観覧しました。

Review Text: Prambanan is by Far my favourite destination in Yogyakarta...have visited this site for 40 yrs so have seen the changes.Its monumental and never ceases to amaze me as to how they could have made this Hundreds of years ago with minimal tools....Amazing. No explanation is going to do it justice ...Just go ...wont be dissapointed...Only now you cannot visit inside the Candis as there was an Earthquake so was considered danderous as still in Fix up state but the site is Wonderful

Review Text:
どこかアンコールワットのような感じのする寺院です。
広いですがブラブラ歩くのには良いと思います。
修理途中なところもありますが、行って良かったと思います‼️
Merupakan candi hindu berjarak 17 km dari jogyakarta. Candi hindu terbesar di Indonesia dan asia tenggara. Bentuk candi tinggi menjulang sangat indah.

Super touristic with shops and everything around like Borobudur. But at least huge and nice temple area! Again in a really good condition after the earth quake over 10 Years ago. 
Buy the double ticket if you wanna see Borobudur as well!

Una de las visitas que esperábamos con más impaciencia y no defraudó. Además del templo de Prambanan, el más conocido de todos e increíble se mire por donde se mire, existen otros tres templos mucho menos conocidos y que casi nadie visita (prácticamente éramos los únicos allí), pero que igualmente valen muchísimo la pena. De norte a sur, se pueden visitar los templos de Sewu, Bubrah y Lumbung para terminar con el de Prambanan.

Nosotros fuimos en transporte privado, pero por lo que nos contaron se llega muy fácilmente y de manera muy rápida en autobús público, una opción mucho más económica y que de haberlo sabido hubiéramos utilizado.

Se puede comprar entrada combinada junto con la de Borobudur para ahorrar unos euros, la única condición es que se visiten ambos templos en dos días consecutivos como máximo. Además, si tenéis carnet de estudiante no dudéis en utilizarlo, gracias a él tuvimos un 30% de descuento.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Desde Mallorca me había puesto en contacto con una guía de habla castellana,Oriza,para visitar los templos de Yogya.La experiencia nos pudo ser mejor,éramos dos españoles y cuatro chinos en todo el conjunto de templos,amén de los estudiantes locales que aprovechan para charlar contigo y hacerse unas fotos.Estos templos hinduistas te recuerdan a los templos de Siam Reap,están en constante restauración y limpieza.Aconsejo comprar la entrada combinada con el templo de Borobudur,con esta entrada puedes elegir entre tomar té o una botella de gua y así sale más económico.A la salida hay un trenito que te lleva a Sewu.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Very beautiful Hindu temple of 5th century. site is under UNESCO. Very nicely developed. worth going there. You can spend 2-3hrs .

otra visita obligada en yogyakarta son los templos Prambanan, imponentes estructuras que se conservan a pesar de los desastres naturales.  Junto a Borobudur son dos visitas obligadas, Yogyakarta posee bastantes templos asi como tours a estos, pero creo que prambanan y borobudur son los que vale la pena visitar

Review Text: Sicuramente il primo tempio da visitare in assoluto, il parco è motlo bello e ben attrezzato, è sempre pieno di turisti quindi è meglio arrivare in mattinata presto. Molto suggestivo soprattutto per le storie che lo circondano.

Candi Prambanan...situs purbakala warisan leluhur yang semakin mempercantik dengan penambahan beberapa atraksi saat musim liburan atau hari libur besar nasional...perlu tambahan informasi pada masing-masing candi sehingga dapat menambah wawasan dan pengetahuan pengunjung.

However they have such a horrible service.

Basically be ready to get ripped off in those historical sites.
Foreign tourists are charged almost 10 times of local tourists.

Not mentioning their horrible customer service.

Prambanan Tempel, is het grootste Hindoe-tempelcomplex in Indonesië. Het is minder bekend dan de Borobudur (Hindoe versus Boeddhistisch), maar zeker zo mooi en indrukwekkend. Dit complex bestaat uit verschillende bouwwerken en tempels, waarvan de drie hoofdtempels, waarvan de grootste 47 meter hoog is, het meest indrukwekkend zijn. De rijkversierde bouwwerken zijn opgedragen aan de hindoegoden Shiva, Vishnu en Brahma, Je kunt via trappen de tempels binnen gaan, bij binnenkomst kom je in een kleine kamer, waar een beeld van een de hindoegoden  bevinden. Alles nog niet herbouwd., want er liggen nog enkele ruïnes en heel veel stenen.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
It has been said everything positive about Prambanan temples, but Indonesian government should be seriously concerned about the damage that mainly local recklessness visitors are causing to the temples by seating or standing or touching parts of the temples while the so-called guards do nothing to prevent that. 
For that reason, in other parts of the world, some ancient sites have been either closed to the public or have left as only possibility to see them from a certain distance (i. e. Stonehenge).
Wajib dikunjungi candi prambanan karena kita bisa sekalian belajar sejarah mengenai candi prambanan ini. Lebih baik dikunjungi sore hari karena siang hari sangat panas.

Visited here early morning around 8am to avoid the crowds and it 80% worked. Temples were stunning and the grounds are very well maintained. There are multiple temples within the grounds, it is worth seeing all of these. There is also a small museum though none of the information boards on displays were in English so if you are into the history side of things it would be worth getting a guide. Even though we went very early, it was still very hot and there is a fair amount if walking around to do. We visited the far end of the park first and worked our way back towards main temple (Prambanan), by the time we got back it was starting to get very busy (around 9.30am). As westerners, we also got asked to pose for a lot of photos with the local kids. Only negative was having to walk through the market to get out, though we didn't get harrassed to buy stuff. This is a must see.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Two of the must-see temples Prambanan (Hindu temple) and Borobudur (Buddhist temple). We bought a combined ticket for both. Prambanan is a beautiful charming temple. It's worth going up to each of the main temple to take the picture. The temples have suffered a couple of earthquakes but we still enjoy their beauty.
We got a local guide to explain things and made it easier to direct what needs to be seen even though his English was just so-so.
One very annoying thing was that we needed to spend 30 minutes to get to the exit as we were forced to go around the "amusement park" and shops. The management should make it an option only but not a requirement
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: もっとジャングルの中にあるのかと思っていたら、意外に開発が進み開けていました。遺跡もほんとに古いものと修復されたものとの区別がつかずどこまで歴史的な場所なのかわかりづらかったです。それでも行く価値はありますしガイドさんはつけた方が良いと思います。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Destinasi wajib ketika berlibur ke Yogyakarta dan sekitarnya. Situs wisata iconik yang selalu jadi spot untuk rekreasi bersama keluarga besar tercinta. Pertama ke Candi Prambanan waktu umur 3 tahun dan hingga kini masih menjadi destinasi wisata favorit ke Yogyakarta. Banyak spot photo yang photogenik dan seru sekali mengelilinginya
Candi Prambanan adalah warisan leluhur yg Samapi saat ini masih kokoh berdiri dengan begitu megahnya. Jika anda berlibur ke Yogyakarta dan sekitarnya. Wajib untuk mengunjungi candi prambanan

We visited when the temples opened at 9.00am, it was still very hot but you are provided with a small bottle of  water on arrival. Take extra water though. You need about 2 hrs to look and walk around. It is a beautiful cultural site. Wear good walking shoes as there are many step stairs up into the temples. On our visit it was very busy, large groups of students and other tourists so the narrow, step stairs can get a bit crowded and tricky to navigate. The local people were very friendly, many of the Indonesian students approached us to practice their English and to take a photo, on the day we visited most other tourists were Indonesians so as Aussies we were a bit of a novelty. The temples are in a small well kept park, there is also a few enclosures for deer, a souvenir shop, food etc. There are plenty of market stalls for souvenirs at the exit.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Pergi bersama anak2 saat liburan sekolah di desember 2018, anak2 senang mengunjungi candi dan banyak pertanyaan tentang bagaimana dan kenapa candi ini dibuat, untung banyak poster informasi disekitar candi, banyak jg pedagang buku cerita tentang candi prambanan ini
Went to Prabanam Temple after lunch in the afternoon. The rain stopped when we arrived here. It was cooling and scenery was beautiful.

It is said that according to the story (this is outside the official writings of Wikipedia) that this Prambanan temple was built by Prince Bandung Bondowoso in just one night with the help of ghost and spirits. to visit to visit this UNESCO world heritage temple, tourists will be charged a fee of 40 thousand rupiah per person. if you are a foreign tourist, you can hire a guide to accompany you in the language of origin of your country. the last time I saw a group of Japanese tourists was escorted by a local guide who was proficient in Japanese. So for those of you who want to know more about the history of Prambanan, you don't need to worry about not getting good information about the history of this place.

Ini adalah salah Satu peninggalan sejarah yg sangat bagus untuk dikunjungi wisatawan baik Dari Mancanegara maupun domestik, cocok sekali untuk travel yg suka paca sat musim liburan & sekaligus belajar, member ilmuwan bagi masyarakat

Prambanan is one of the popular temple. If you visit here in long week end or holidayseason..better you come in early morning because its very crowded in evening. This temple is located between Solo and Yogya. Ticket for indonesia citizen  is rp 40rb for adults n 20 rb(under 12 yo), 75rb for a special.  package

One of the 2 main temple attraction in Jogya. The other is Borobodur temple to the North. Unlike borobudur, Prambanan is actually closer to town and can be reach in less than 1 hour. It also means you can take e-hailing services from town and back. 

Please note than the Prambanan Temple complex contains several temple with Prambanan being the main temple. So do allow sufficient time to visit all the temples. Furthermore, there are other attractions such as video gallery showing the mythical story linked to the temple, a deer park, stall and restaurants, playgrounds etc so it is a fun place to bring the whole family. You can take the leisurely walked around the place form one temple to the other OR you can take buggy or mini train to get from Prambanan to the furthest temple and back. The driver will gladly stop and wait for you while you explore the temples. The driver told us within the complex and surrounding housing area they started to discover more temples covered by the earth after hundred of years so history could be rewritten as they uncover them!!

Some people would come toYogya and only goes to Borobodur and Merapi. It's a shame as Prambanan has it's own uniqueness and history. Collectively, Prambanan temple complex is  arguably bigger than Borobudur. Make sure you visit them.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: The show at Prambanan specially for a Rotary Zonal Institute was very good. Steps are very high and difficult to climb. Only temple with a statue of Brahma.
This temple complex is an absolute beauty.  Nice grounds, impressive views, and beautiful carvings are all available.  Only gripe - expensive for foreigners!

It is a must-see place in Yogyakarta. The place is large. Suggest to hire a bicycle to go around, but study the site first and map out the route. In the months of raining session, it rains most of the time in the afternoon, so be prepared with raincoat or umbrella. Absolutely stunning to witness this historic remains.

Review Text:
I was there at around 4 p.m. and it was full of people taking selfies, to the point that I couldn't even sneak myself up the stairs of the temples, let alone see what was inside. It was disappointing. This experience could have prompted me to rate this place 3 stars, but the unique, enigmatic Hindu architecture was worth it. I loved, loved, loved and was super intrigued by the reliefs, which were well-preserved. I was amazed by the size of the complex and each temple.
It was also worth watching the Prambanan Ramayana Ballet. I watched it on a Saturday. There are different classes for seating; I bought Class I for IDR 200,000. The show started at 7:30 p.m. and lasted 2 hours. Since it was a dance, they projected the storyline in English and Bahasa Indonesian on 2 screens. I had a good time, the dance was visually pleasing.

A highlight of any trip to Jogja, the Prambanan temples are impressively restored and definitely worth a visit.

Pictures might not give this impression but the temples are in fact located in an enclosed park with stalls and facilties. Not quite as in a rural setting at they might appear!

Be prepared for lots of people asking to have photos with you!

Canadian pianist and singer Diana Krall performed on the Rorojonggrang stage at Prambanan Temple.  Krall is a two-time Grammy Award-winning singer.

It was truly enjoyable seeing the beautiful singer singing beautiful jazz songs on the stage with Prambanan Temple in the background brightened up. Truly amazing.
A wonderful UNESCO world heritage site. Although the price is a bit high for foreigners, it is definitely worth the visit.

普兰巴南最著名的是要看日落，然而这是一个多云的天气，等到4点就开始转阴，并没有日落～(￣▽￣～)~
手动滑稽
感觉票价有点贵，也许是我不懂其中的历史故事。在这个地质活动频繁的国家，能有这样一座佛塔历经百年自然矗立也不容易。
出口处好大的小商品市场，看着就烦，义乌多的是，谁要买啊

The Prambanan temples are referred to as the most beautiful Hindu temples in the world and I agree!  The temples are tall and majestic with beautiful panels and details.  Each of the 7 main temples are dedicated to Hindu gods with the temple of Siva in the middle.  
Restoration is still being undertaken to reconstruct the smaller temples which were flattened by the earthquake.  I can imagine the temple complex to be even more beautiful once the minor temples are up.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Going to Prambanan for a sunset was not a disappointment! During our visit, the sunset was around 5:30pm and we left Yogyakarta around 3pm. Even with traffic, we arrived before 4 pm. The temple complex itself is very large and leaving extra time to walk around before the sunset is a good idea! In addition to the main temple, there were smaller temples we didn’t have enough time to see it all. I was amazed by the beautiful details. We paid for a tour guide and it was well worth it since we didn’t know a whole a lot about this temple. It was a very memorable visit and you save money when you buy a “bundle ticket”’with Borobudur as opposed to just buying a ticket for Prambanan.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
外国人の入場料が高過ぎます。

O conjunto de templos impressiona. Antes eram dezenas, ou centenas. Agora poucos estão de pé,  mas mesmo assim são impressionantes. E vale passar por todos os templos de lá, não somente o conjunto principal de Candi Prambanan. Recomendo!

Review Text: Prambanan es una persona muy extranjera y un lugar muy caluroso, pero el edificio es muy impresionante, por lo que los indonesios son muy amables y muchos hablan español, estoy muy contento de viajar, muy feliz también con la comida indonesia como Gado Gado.

Review Text: Tempatnya besar. Butuh 2-3 jam untuk keliling semua, foto-foto. Banyak spot yang menarik untuk diambil fotonya.

Went to the temples and overall, it was good...a must see? Perhaps not unless you really like temples or have lots of time in Yogyakarta.  For starters, very pricey at about $30 Cad but with combo ticket to Borobudir, it was about $50 Cad.  I understand that foreigners pay more to help with maintenance and just because we have a much higher standard of living...but it seems like we are paying almost 10 times the domestic prices...to me that is somewhat gouging.  If for about $10-$15 Cad, I would say that is reasonable.  The temples themselves were nice and have good history...didn't get a guide as that costs another $10 and didn't really need it unless you want to learn more about the history.  A number of smaller temples surrounding the main one...somewhat busy but not crowded at all, which was great.

This temple is very beautiful but sadly unfinished. You can see that some blocks have carvings and some have unfinished carvings. It is just simply beautiful and amazing. Do note that the steps are quite high and steep, so you have some problems going up staircases, then maybe avoid climbing up the temples. Just staying around the grounds is also beautiful and mesmerising enough.

Prambanan is complex temples, in this area not one temples but many temples here
if you interesting about history of hindu-budha in Java you will get more attraction in here because not only Hindu's temple in here, you must around this location you can found the Budha's temple like Sewu temple

Review Text: Prambanan is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.  Built in the 9th century CE, this is said to be the largest Hindu temple in Indonesia.  The site has been on my wish list for a long time.  A small group tour to Java in October 2018 made my wish come true.  The temple spires, bas reliefs, and sculptures are exquisite.  The steps up onto and into the various temples are steep, uneven, and without handrails - - not at all handicapped accessible. One cannot exit the site by the route one enters.  Hence, to get back to our bus, we had to forge through a "gauntlet" of stalls and hucksters even  though we were hot, tired and not in the mood to buy souvenirs or art.  Having said that, I caved and bargained for two nice masks and two puppets!  Our guide chuckled and thanked me for helping the native economy!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This is a temple built by Indian kings and the efforts to restore it was a history in itself. Our guide explained everything to us very poetically and we were amazed by the restoration efforts taken by the government specially its very vulnerable to frequent earthquakes and volcanic eruptions. Its a must visit for people traveling to central java.

Take you time, because the grounds are really big!
We went here by public transport: super cheap and convenient. 
The temples at the end of the day were amazing! 
Do not forget your isic student card: a lot of discount.

ook uit de ca 9e eeuw als de borobudur. De Prambanan is een hindu tempel. Fe tempel is prachtig gedetailleerd.

ボロブドゥールが仏教遺跡の代表なら、ヒンズー遺跡の代表格がプランバナン寺院群であり、こちらも世界遺産に指定されています。もっともプランバナンには仏教遺跡もあるので、２つの宗教が共存していたのでしょう。整然とした階段ピラミッド構造のボロブドゥールと対照的に、天を衝くようなプランバナンの方が迫力を感じます。中心のシヴァ堂の両側にヴィシュヌ堂とブラーマン堂を配し、背後にはナンディ堂、さらにその両側にガルーダ堂とアングサ堂が並ぶ中心部は圧巻です。残念なことに２００６年の地震で被害を受けて、一部はまだ修復途上でした。

Review Text:
Excellent Hindu temple complex not far from central Yogyakarta. Large temple remain in the centre, with many ruins patiently being reconstructed. Easy to get around, a personal guide for 1hr will cost around IDR100,000. Entry for foreigners USD35, though credit cards are accepted. Easily spend around 2hrs. Complex is large, with several small ruins nearby in the same park. Golf buggy trip at around IDR20,000 a life saver when travellin in the heat. Lots of domestic tourists, so avoid weekends. 
NOTE: Lots of domestic school kids, and if you are an obvious foreigner, they will shyly but keenly asking you for a photo together - which is worth indulging for the smiles.

Review Text: Храмовый комплекс Прамбанан находится в пешей доступности от аэропорта Джогьякарты. Легко добраться на автобусе за 3500 рупий или электричке. Стоимость  входного билета 75000 рупий для местных и 350000 для иностранцев. Я в принципе не пожалел потраченных рупий, но был немного разочарован. Объясню почему: надеялся увидеть богатое внутреннее убранство храмов, а вместо этого серый и черный вулканический камень с красивой резьбой и отсутствие статуй некоторых божеств в храмах. Впечатлила архитектура храмов Дурги, Шиве , Вишну и Брахмы. Есть статуи Ганеши в главном храме. Всех имен божеств я не запомнил. Есть храмы поменьше где нет никаких статуй божеств. Много разрушенных маленьких храмов и ступ (чади).  Землятресения разрушали храмы, их потом снова возводили или собирали. Достаточно красив парк храмового комплекса. Лично я восхищен Ангкор Ват, что в Камбодже.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
These Hindu temples date from the 9th century, and like Borobudur are a UNESCO world heritage site.
The site opens at 6 a.m. but I got there at about 8 a.m. and there weren't many people, which allowed for some good photos, and to enjoy the atmosphere of the place. However by 9 a.m. the crowds started to arrive, and even that early the sun started to feel very hot, as there is no shade. After visiting the main temple complex there is a small train to take you onto further temples including the Candi Sewu “thousand temples”. 
There’s also a museum on the main site which has a documentary film but it was quite old and not very good. Also the air con in the room was not working so I didn't manage to sit through it, as the room was unbearably hot. 
I visited Prambanan as a stop off on the way to Borobudur (only 90 min drive), and as it’s only a 10 minute drive from JOG airport it made the visit worthwhile, but with an entrance fee of 375K IDR it isn't cheap. If staying in Jogjakarta it’s worth visiting as I’d say it’s the best attraction nearby.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:

Prambanan temple - the seat of Shiva. 

Take your time, witness and explore the beauty of the temple. 📷📷📷

I love this temple. The structure of the temple clearly indicates the influence of Hinduism in Java in past. The temples are built for 3 Hindu Gods, God Shiwa, God Brahma and God Vishu. 

The main temple, Shiwa temple consists of 4 chambers with God Shiwa, God Durga, God Ganesha and Akastya statues. 

Most of the temple at the entrance been collapsed after an earthquake in 2016. I amazed with the construction intelligence of our ancestors to build such standstill buildings after decades. 

However, there is a myth of the building. The Javanese princess Loro Jonggrang – the eponymous slender virgin – was to be taken as a bride to Prince Bandung after he defeated her father King Boko in battle. She reluctantly agreed, but set the prince a challenge first. She would only agree to marry him if he built one thousand temples before sunrise. The prince agreed, and called on spirits to help him. With the help of the spirits he quickly built nine hundred and ninety nine temples. Not wanting to marry the man who had killed her father, the princess called on her people to help save her and light a large fire to the east of the temples. Fooled into thinking it was dawn, the spirits that had been helping the prince fled before building the final temple and he failed in his task. Prince Bandung was furious when he discovered the deception, and curse princess Jonggrang and turned her into stone. Making her the final, and most beautiful of all the temples. The temples that eventually became known as Prambanan.

I wasn't bothered about how the temple been build but I amazed with the structure and consider one of the largest Hindu temples too

You can get the entrance ticket to go to Borobodur and Prambanan and the ticket can be used for 2 days.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This complex is absolutely stunning it still amazes me how structures like this were created so many years ago and still stand the test of time. That said many of the smaller temples were destroyed in the 2006 earthquake but I think it actually adds to the history and intrigue of this place. We hired a guide at the desk who made the experience a lot more fun and then hired a bike to visit the other temples in the complex which I would advise as they are much quieter so you can actually relax and enjoy it with the added chance of getting a photo with no-one else in. We took the bus there which was easy enough and stayed for sunset for which my top tip would be stay until you get asked to leave by the guides. Most people left as the sun dipped below the horizon but around 30 minutes later the whole sky was pink and made the most impressive backdrop to an already impressive view. Getting home was a struggle in the dark but just barter and walk a little further from the complex and you’ll find the taxis suddenly drop their rates - enjoy it!!

Historical place and witness another great architecture ! Many people awaiting for sunset
.
We stayed until Almost sunset, beautiful.

The Temples are stunning view with amazing architecture . It is Unesco World Heritage Site . It was built around mid - 9 AD according to the Wiki . The entrance fee is 350,000 IDR (~ SGD 35) . So , we can visit to both Borobudur Temple and Prambanan Temple and get more time to enjoy and take photos . There is Grab service to go there . I saw the public transport mini busses too but I am not sure about the details for it . Anyway , we got very good time and enjoyed to go there .

Review Text: Prambanan menjadi salah satu Object wisata dunia Krn keunikan bentuk ornamen yg ada di setiap candi ada 5 bh candi tersebar di area yg cukup luas.  Pemerintah dgn bantuan UNESCO merenovasi kembali candi ini yg sempat rusak. Jika berkunjung ke Jogja candi ini menjadi salah satu Object wisata yg harus di lihat setelah Borobudur yg dgn kemegahannya

Note: this review is for the main temple. There are other temples within the gates that you go through with your Prambanan ticket, which are listed separately on TA (I didn't see those, they are quite a long walk from the main temple and the mini-train to them does not run in the late afternoon).
I hadn't heard of this temple before I started researching Yogyakarta, but I ended up enjoying it more than Borobudar - Borobudar is over-restored, whilst this place is still partly in ruins which is much more evocative. This place is huge with lots of little nooks to explore (you'll have to read up on the layout, or get a guide, if you want to be sure not to miss anything), so visiting feels adventurous even if you're there when it's crowded. It was very crowded when I arrived around 4, but by sunset (which was stunning!) almost everyone had left!
Just seeing the main temple took me 1.5hrs, so allocate plenty of time if you want to see the other temples on the site. I'd also recommend allocating some time to Plaosan, which is nearby but not within the gates.

Three main temples are Brahma the Creator, Vishnu the Keeper, and Shiva the Destroyer. Shiva is the biggest one and has 4 different chambers for 4 different gods: Shiva, Durga, Ganesha, and Agastya.

Prambanan is an incredible place.  Over 1200 years old, just outside Jogjakarta.  Definitely worth the visit. I was there in late morning and it was super hot but so worth it.  There are 8 temples in the complex and I went in each of them.  Most have various chambers inside with a statue dedicated to a Hindu god or goddess. After a while it gets annoying and you are allowed to say no.  But it's all part of the experience.

A lovely grouping of temples on a vast block of land, provides the perfect opportunity to wander at your leisure amongst some of the most stunning temples examples in the Asia region.

Sunglasses for the intermittent dust wind and don’t forget the umbrella as there is precious little sun shade around.

Prambanan temple complex is a UNESCO heritage site. It was built around 9th century and is primarily a hindu temple complex with the main temple dedicated to shaivite    hindu sect. One of the largest hindu temple complex in South-East Asia. It is situated nearly 17kms away from Yogyakarta. It reflects the influence of Indian temple architecture having pointed domes. The central chamber of the main temple has a deity with the likeness of King Balitung as described by the locals. Many temples in the compound indicates the role of Brahmins in offering daily religious rituals. Being in the volcanic and earthquake prone zone it was soon neglected and deserted. Many mythological stories were originated by locals. Surrounding area is used as archeological park and dance based on epic Ramayana performance site. Five of the main temples are visible from a distance. Currently 16 big and small renovated shrines are worth visiting and viewing temples in the fading sun is marvelous. Ramayan scenes adorns the complex. Multi-religious visitors make it an interesting site for all. Like Borobudur it is a reflection of human genius of creativity. Trinity of hindu religion [Shiv, Vishnu and Brahma] and their Wahanas [Nandi. Garuda and Angsa] were source for temples inspiration. The walls of the temples are decorated with panels of Natural life, Danseuses, Kuber [hindu lord of riches], slaying of Ravan by Ram, and even commoners makes it an interesting mix. A large numbers of panels are poorly maintained and needs urgent renovation.
Failure to add photos make me sad.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah
