Review Text: First, let me preface this review by saying I have visited literally tens of dozens of UNESCO world heritage sites in over 40 countries and have yet to see such a significant temple ruin, so poorly presented - just about anywhere else in the world. At an eye watering entrance fee of 21 euros, or $36.00 dollars (AUD) p.p for foreigners (about twice the most expensive fees charged for historically significant sites in other parts of Asia, Europe or Americas) this is being milked as a lucrative cash cow with very little done to even explain the visitor experience.  I have a a fairly comprehensive understanding of Hinduism having studied history to post grad level and have spent five months in India, so have some knowledge of the Hindu pantheon and the Ramayana, thank goodness, as I had to guide my own husband as we went around  Apart from some panels explaining the damage from the 2006 earthquake, there is zero information for foreigners about the origins, building history, religious or historical contexts of these ruins anywhere on this entire site.  There is a small onsite museum where the very limited information panels are in Bihasa only. Foreign visitors should be prepared, that in order to understand what you are seeing, you will need to do your own extensive research first, before visiting.  The reconstructed temple structures themselves are impressive, and clearly restoration work will be ongoing for several decades to come.  But by and large, the  Prambanam temple complex is a let down, if you want more bang for your buck, than just a really expensive photo opportunity.  Incidentally, my own research indicates that since 2013, entrance fees for foreigners have increased by a whopping 50%. At this rate of increase the authority that runs the temples, risk killing the golden goose in a few years time.

Entrance fee for foreign tourist is 362.5k (same as Borobudor non sunrise ticket) if you buy a double ticket (Prambanan/Borobodor which lasts only 2 days) you save money at 580k.
Prambanan is an amazing temple rebuilt from the ground up, must have been the worlds biggest 3D puzzle. Don't forget to go to the Budist temple Candi Sewu which is the furthest temple at the back of the site, it is worth seeing and has a lot of charm.
In the middle of the Prambanan site there are lots of things to do, you have to pay for them all though.
You can get a bus from Yogyakarta but you will probably have to change.

Pranbanan is an old Hindu temple located about 45 minutes to an hour by bike from Yogyakarta (depending on traffic).

Pranbanan is actually a group of stone carved temples with an alley between them. I find it personally nicer than Borobudur as it less crowded. 

Pranbanan is definitely a sunset place (unlike Borobudur) . The sun will set exactly behind the temples offering a gorgeous scenery an a superb opportunity to take great sunset shots.

Definitely one of the best thing around Yogyakarta.

Review Text:
Ce lieux où a l'origine il y avait 240 monuments et où le temps a fait des ravages, est quand même un lieu magnifique. la vingtaine de temple remis en état avec les pierres des édifices passé rappelle un bout de l'histoire indonésienne.

A faire

Les temples de Borobudur et Prambanan sont très beaux. Les lieux sont propres. Les vendeurs ambulants ne sont là qu'en fin de visite. RAS. 

PRIX du ticket : 25$ par personne et par site. Si vous faites les deux sites vous pouvez acheter un ticket combiné à 40$ par personne - seule condition faire les deux sites en deux jours. 

Pour le TRANSPORT vers les sites, ne vous faites pas avoir avec les nombreuses agences qui proposent des services pour aller à Borobudur et Prambanan. Dans la grande majorité elles ne proposent finalement que la navette aller retour en jeep pour aller sur les sites. Le tout pour des sommes de 100 000 ou 150 000 RP voir plus... Avec le bus de ville TRANSYOGYA le ticket coûte 3500 RP par personne (0.20 € !) et ce mini bus s'arrête juste à côté des sites. Même s'il y a un changement à faire tout le monde vous indiquera avec plaisir et avec le sourire le chemin à suivre et c'est très simple. Seule contrainte éventuelle les horaires ne sont pas fixes et pas indiqués dans les petites stations mais les navettes sont régulières. 
Vous avez ainsi la liberté de visiter les temples avec le timing que vous voulez et pourrez rencontrer des indonésiens dans le bus qui ont plaisir à venir vous parler. 

Nous avons utilisé les navettes pour faire les deux sites et ne regrettons absolument pas !

There are many temples on the site. They are really different from the ones you can see around Yogyakarta. For people who went to Angkor Vat, memories will come back. For us, one of the most beautiful place we have ever seen, just do not miss Prambanan (make sure to take a lot of water to drink).

There is a few temples sites here. Therefore a good walking shoes is essential basics. Umbrella, tons of sunblock n even a mask might b some help. At times e wind blew hard that e sands might b a bit harsh. 

We walked almost 2km to get ard e temples. Photographic scenic.

This Unesco World Heritage Site is definitely a must see! I'd personally recommend a sunset visit, so please remind that the entrance will close at 5 p.m. (august time), but the compound will remain open till 6 p.m.
An entrance time within 4 p.m. fits perfectly to see all the temples and have enough time to watch the beauty of the sun falling beneath the walls and of the statues.
For a truly unique experience I'd also recommend to arrive with the public bus 1A running every 20 minutes or so from jl Malioboro. However remind that from Yogya it will take about 1 h and from the bus stop (end of race) to the ticket office is a 10 minutes walk.
Go there!

Ticket was Rupiah 362,000 and parking 15,000.  They have different prices for foreigners.  Copy of passport is required to purchased the ticket.  You get a welcome drink (Mineral water/canned juice) with the ticket.  Was there at noon, so it was very hot and humid.  Not many people around as it was during the Muslim's Friday prayers, so we could stroll and take our time to explore the different structures.  Wear comfortable shoes as you need to climb up stairs to view most of the statues.  Interesting architecture, lots of intricate stone carvings and Hindu Gods statues to keep you busy.  The temple was still undergoing reconstruction due to the last earthquake but it did not interfere with our visit.  One of the must dos if you are in Yogyakarta.  Before you can exit to the car park, there are rows of stalls selling local products and souvenirs.  If you are keen to get an authentic (at least that is what I was told by locals) mortar and pestle made of rocks from Mount Merapi, this is the place to purchase it.  According to locals if it is authentic, the rock will turn very black when you splash water on the mortar.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: We are a family of 4 visiting Yogyakarta for the first time, from the US. We just visited the temple now and it was amazing. Better to wear walking shoes because of the dust and the long walks. You can literally spend the whole day here to make the most out of it. Ramayana ballet has another entrance if you are interested in attending it.

Was bit surprised that everyone is allowed to go inside the Karuvarai with shoes. Most of the main statues inside the temple are damaged and even that is not repaired. 
For Some Indians, this may not be exciting as there are such big temple in every village.

4 great temples on lovely grounds with lots of trees. The distance is not far so you should walk to see them. Prambanan is the biggest and most interesting one(s). Totally worth seeing the other ones as well as we were alone there which was a treat.

Sangat senang rasanya bisa mengunjungi salah satu candi hindu terindah dan terbesar di indonesia. Tempat yg begitu menenangkan dan penuh dengan keajaiban. Ditambah dengan nuansa cinta dari latar belakang candi ini menambah kekaguman terhadap candi ini

Precioso templo hinduista en reconstruccion dado su magnitud y diferentes incidentes pasados (terremotos, erupciones).
Es un templo que conviene visitar acompañado de un/a guía que pueda contextulizar la visita.
La simbología e historia que guardan sus muros es muy interesante y ayuda a realizar una visita más provechosa.
Preciosas formas, faltan muchas estatuas pero es un lugar muy impresionante.
También muy visitada y como Borobudur tendrá que afrontar la racionalización del turismo para su conservación.

Si tienes pensado ir, llevate algo que te proteja del sol, por que como el.dia sea soleado, te vas a fundir!!. La verdad que impresiona ver como han podido mantener muchos templos en pie, otros por un terremoto que pasó hace tiempo se cayeron. Pagas la entrada, y empieza la visita. Es una zona donde tienes 3 grandes templos,  y además es un parque con actividades para hacer. Dispone de bicis para pasear, de un tren de carretera que te da una vuelta por el parque etc...todo ello gratis. Los templos están bastante concurridos, y como dije se mantienen bien, si puedes usar un guía,  mejor, así te explica bien bien todo.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Sangat indah pemandangan di tempat ini,  tempat tinggal yang nyaman,  pelayanan yang ramah.  Sangat cocok bagi anda travellers. 
Tempat tempat di indonesia sangatlah bagus , rencanakanlah perjalanan anda.
Sebuah karya hebat yg sulit terbayangkan secara teknologikal. Bagaimana membuat bangunan indah dari bahan full batu berikut ornamennya tanpa semen perekat ttp kokoh dan kuat. Luar biasa

Super aanrader om te bezoeken. Door miscommunicatie kwamen wij iets later in de ochtend aan dan gepland. Maar alsnog vonden wij het erg rustig ten opzichte van de Borobodur. Vooral de tempel helemaal achteraan op het complex hadden wij helemaal voor ons zelf. We hebben voor 10.000 roepiah p.p. een fiets gehuurd op het terrein en zo alles rustig langs gefietst en bekeken. Zeer aan te raden de fietsen als je een tijdsafspraak hebt met een chauffeur oid.

The temple is very suggesstive. we saw it in august 2018 and there were not many people so it was a fantastic trip. i suggest to see it with a guide because there are a lot of history and religion to learn. if I had to return to Indonesia, I would definitely go back to visit this temple.

Il tempio è davvero bello e affascinante, in una bella giornata è molto rilassante camminare nel sito. Appena entrati avete un drink in omaggio. All'interno del parco troverete dei cervi (in gabbia) ai quali potrete dargli da mangiare (il cibo viene dato da un signore all'ingresso in cambio di pochi spicci).
for second after 2 years we come back to this temple..nice place to recharge our mood..some renovation after earthquak still on progress

We visited the temple at noon. Let's say that we checked in to the site "late", because they close the gate at 17.30. We arrived at around 2.00 p.m when sun was shining at its best.. So hot.. Hha
The ticket price is different for local tourist and foreigner. The local would only pay for 40k rupiah while others will be charged around 25dollars if i'm not wrong. I think that for foreigner the temple would be a good destination. It would be quite hard to find "candi" outside south east asia region. It's also good for locals tho. The complex is very big, so they offered some vehicles to be rented, but i prefer walk by foot.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: We loved our visit here. The temples are beautiful. The carving and scale of the construction really impressed us. Make sure you make the effort to explore all of the temples within the grounds and not just the ones closest to the entrance. The further away temples are much quieter than the main one, but still we did not find the volume of people a problem.
Prambanan gerçekten etkileyici bir tapınak. Yapısı diğer tapınaklardan çok farklı. Eğer Yogyakarta’ya yolunuz düşerse ziyaret etmeden gitmeyin derim.
Sudah lebih tertata, rapi dan bersih dibandingkan kunjungan saya ke sini beberapa tahun lalu. Ditambah sekarang ada pentas ramayana ballet yg bagus dan membuat suasana magis semakin terasa

Il complesso è molto grande ed è fatto di tanti templi. A mio avviso però vale la pena soffermarsi solo sul principale (quello più grande e all'ingresso).
Comunque un tempio molto bello...si può visitare tranquillamente da soli senza guida, magari leggendo storia e curiosità su internet prima di arrivare.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Die verschiedenen Tempelanlagen waren sehr beeindruckend und man kann hier super Zeit verbringen. Insgesamt viel entspannter als beim Tempel Borobudur! 
Die meisten Leute tummeln sich bei der größten Tempelanlage. Die anderen, kleineren dagegen waren kaum besucht und wir konnten uns in aller Ruhe umsehen. Seht euch also ruhig auf dem großen Gelände ein wenig um!
Der Preis ist zwar hoch, aber man kann ja, wie beschrieben, viel Zeit dort verbringen.

Der Besuch beginnt mit einerm für Touristen separierten Eintrittsbereich, damit man die 20 Euro, die bezahlt werden müssen, nicht mit den lokalen Preisen vergleichen kann. Ich habe für 3 Euro übernachtet und für 3 Euro ein Moped gemietet.
Der Haupttempel ist sehr voll, stark zerstört und teilweise restauriert. Einheimische benutzen den Tempel eher als Spielplatz.
Es lohnt sich, die weiteren Tempel auf dem Gelände anzuschauen, da dort kaum Leute hinlaufen.
Es gibt eine Kombikarte (wenn man fragt) zusammen mit Borobodur - ABER ohne den Sonnenaufgang, der dort separat bezahlt werden muß.
Leider gibt es KEIN Mehrtagesticket, um den Tempel mal morgens, mal abends zu besuchen - da ist Kambodscha viel besser auf diese Art Touristen eingestellt.
Insgesamt eine sehenswerte Anlage, wer aber öfters in Asien unterwegs ist, wird viele Elemente bereits kennen.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The time of day to visit the temples is at sunset (and probably also at sunrise) when there is little crowd, the temples take the colour of the sky, and mount Merapi is free of clouds in the background

Pensé que visitaba un sitio menor hindú en Java y en realidad me encontré con un conjunto de templos impresionante en una gran extensión. Bien conservados. Me dio la impresión que en su momento debió ser un lugar hinduísta de gran importancia. Es de visita imprescindible si vas a Java y especialmente a Yogyakarta
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Candi prambanan is not the bigger but still a good place to go and take some pictures nice place for beautiful moment so you must come here
遺跡に関しては塔が高く、とても迫力がありﾚﾘｰﾌや彫刻なども見ごたえがあった。子連れ視点からだと、園内が公園になっていて遊具もある、自転車やプチトレイン、セグウエイの様な物（子供でも乗れた10分20000ルピー）もあり、見るだけ観光の苦手な子連れには良かった。
The most beautiful and biggest hindu temple in indonesia.. and it's become one of the most famous tourism object in indonesia...

this is a huge temple complex where you find a temple dedicated to brahma, one of the three temples in the world dedicated to brahma. around the three main temples dedicated to brahma, vishnu and shiva, are a huge number of small temples, mostly in ruins.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This temple is often depicted as a poor alternative to Borobudur. This couldn't be further from the truth. The setting of Prambaman is simply stunning and the temples itself are spectacular, especially at sunset. This coupled with superb facilities for all ages makes it a great way to spend an afternoon / evening
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: The biggest hindu temple in the world open it's four entrances for everyone that wants to enjoy it's beauty. We suggest around 2 hours in the temple. When we were there it was full, as it was indonesian independece day, and a saturday. There were many local tourists. It's definitely better to avoid crowds by going a bit early than midday. You pay IDR 350k per person, but you can also buy Borobudur combined with Prambanan for around IDR 600k (look for more info on Borobudur's website). You can buy any a regular ticket or this combined ticket at the entrance, or you can talk to your hotel.
That’s another fantastic site in Indonesia. Here I suggest to arrive early in the morning or in the late afternoon... it is crowded of tourist !

Die Tempelanlage ist ganz nett, rechtfertigt aber in keinster Art und Weise den Eintrittspreis für ,,TOURISTEN''.Genauso wie der Borobodur Tempel...fast 20,-pro Peron pro Tempel.Da habe ich in Asien schön schönere gesehen.

ボロブドゥール遺跡に行くのが、目的で、旅に出ましたが、半日を近くにあるPRAMBANAN寺院と言うヒンドゥー教の遺跡に寄ってみました。凄い！ ビックリ！
9世紀に、こんな凄い寺院を建てたヒンドゥー教が、今は殆ど流行っていないのは、何故か？ ボロブドゥール遺跡の仏教も同じく、この国に馴染まなかったのは？何故？
今回この寺院を訪れ、最高の気分で十二分です、本当は、色々考えさせられる旅になりました。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
De Prambanan is een prachtige tempel. Wij waren er s morgens om ongeveer 9 uur en het was nog helemaal niet druk ondanks dat het zondag was. Om nog. 11 uur begint het drukkere worden. De Prambanan bezoeken kan heel goed met het openbaar vervoer. Vraag in de kleine (stads)busjes hoe je er moet komen en ze leggen het je precies uit. Veel goedkoper dan georganiseerd en net zo goed want je hebt de tijd aan jezelf. Je kunt eventueel ook een gids inhuren die bij het park zichzelf aanbieden. Bekijk daarna ook de andere (kleinere) tempels die achter de Prambanan staan, dit staat goed aangegeven op de borden.
Let er wel op dat het wel zo netjes is om bedekkende kleding aan te doen. Wij zagen veel mensen in te korte broeken en nietsverhullende topjes, Indonesiërs  zullen hier niet zo snel iets van zeggen, maar het is wel een vorm van respect!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Pengalaman yang seru bisa masuk ke candi candi tidak seluas Borobudur jadi bisa ajak anak biar tidak terlalu lelah, ada tempat penangkaran rusa kita bisa memberi makan anak saya suka sekali banyak spot photo yang bagus

ジョグジャカルタ市内からトランスジョグジャの1Aで40分ほど，3,500ルピアで行けます。到着するHalte TJ Prambananバスターミナルは，遺跡公園の南西の角外側になります。遺跡入口は遺跡公園の東側になるので，中央分離帯のある４車線道路を東に歩き，信号の交差点を左折して北に少し行くと到着します。歩いて10分ほどです。
プランバナン寺院を含む４つのヒンズー教寺院遺跡が，遺跡公園として大きく囲まれて整備されています。園内には緑も多くビュッフェレストランもあってのんびりと見学することができます。外国人用ゲートを抜けた所のインフォメーションセンターで，日本語のマップも貰えます。
平日は観光客も少ないので，２〜３時間かけてじっくりと鑑賞すると良いです。
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: We visited Prambanan temple in the evening and the whole atmosphere around the temple was so serene n peaceful. Even with crowds, one can relate to the place n enjoy the stunning views. Lot of photo opportunities. Can climb into many of the temples up until the altar to find different Hindu God Idols. A must visit while in Jogja. Cheaper to buy combo tickets to Prambanan n Borobudur temples. Wear comfortable shoes.

Déçus par le temple et prix excessif pour l entrée 1120000 roupies ( 68 euros ) pour 2 heures de visite à 2 adultes et 2 enfants 
Site assez petit et rénovation incomplète 
Coucher du soleil très rapide

Ne recommande pas d y aller
È oggettivamente bello e probabilmente non mi ha emozionato tanto per la grande quantità di persone...comunque è tappa obbligatoria.

This is a really majestic place that makes you feel as if you were stopped in time. I strongly suggest to take a guide as the sculptures and carvings tell a beautiful story. Each of the big temples is dedicated to a different god and the smaller one to the animals they rode. It will be much more informative with the guide. Review Text:
ボロブドゥール観光のために訪れたジョグジャカルタでしたが、最終日の飛行機が夜発だったので立ち寄りました。
日本語のガイドさんが着いたのですが、説明が浅くてヒンドゥー教の世界観とどう結びついているのかが理解できませんでした。少し予習をしていけば良かったと後悔。

Templi indù meravigliosi, utile prendere una guida locale oppure informarsi per capire in fondo la storia dietro ogni tempio. Nei giorni caldi raccomando di portare acqua in abbondanza. Da vedere assolutamente

Si vede che molto è stato ricostruito ma vedere tutti i cumuli di pietre che lo circondano ti fa capire la bellezza che doveva essere all’origine. Completamente diverso da Borobudur anche questo tempio merita una visita e l’attesa del tramonto

Templos de uma beleza extraordinária e onde pudémos observar um belíssimo pôr-do-sol.
É possível subir aos templos e visitar o seu interior. A não perder os relevos em todos os templos dedicados a divindades hindús.
Magnifique ensemble de temples. Il faut bien prévoir entre deux et trois heure de visite et beaucoup d’eau !

We hired a guide who was very knowledgeable and explained all the intricacies of the temples, the history and symbolism. Well worth paying for. He also made sure we got the best pictures possible - knew exactly where to stand, had a torch so we could take pictures inside and even made sure other tourists didn't stand in our way (nicely:) Brought back memories of Angkor Wat. A must visit when visiting Yogya.

Review Text: Na de Borobudur bezochten we Prambanan. Eigenlijk veel mooier dan zijn  bekendere Boeddhistische zus! Hoewel van het oorspronkelijke complex veel is verloren gegaan door aardbevingen doen de restanten je voorstellen hoe rijk het hindoeïsme hier ooit geweest is. Er was voor onze groep geen gids meer beschikbaar maar gelukkig liepen we tegen studenten aan die graag hun Engels wilden oefenen op ons in ruil voor uitleg over het complex. Vooral de Vishnoe tempel is indrukwekkend. Trek voor een bezoek ruim de tijd uit. Op het complex bevinden zich tevens Boeddhistische tempels, wij hadden hiervoor helaas te weinig tijd.

Review Text: Bagus banget. Pertama kali kesini seumur hidup dan berkesan banget. Ada hal pribadi yang terjadi di hidupku karena pergi kesini.

Wij zijn met een tour van de Borobudur naar de Pranbanan geweest. Wij hadden ruim de tijd om de tempel te bezoeken, maar door de warmte hebben wij geen uitgebreide ronde gedaan. Wel op het park even gegeten en gedronken bij een all you can eat restaurant.

We had een free guide (2 students who wanted to practise their English). We went there at the end of the day to we could visit the Ballet after that. The ballet takes about 2 hours. You will see the Prambanan Temples on the background. TIP take VIP seats.

Review Text:
PRAMBANAN TEMPLE

This amazing Hindu's temple is located in Prambanan Klaten Central Java. It's in the eastern border part of Yogyakarta and it's mostly well-known as Yogyakarta tourism destination.

Prambanan temple is One of Indonesia's cultural heritage that is still preserved its sustainability.

Apart from being a holy place hindu adherents also become the main tourist destination of Indonesia.

Indonesia is the country with the largest Muslim population in the world, through the symbol of Bhinneka Tunggal Ika, Indonesia still maintains the cultural heritage of the country from various religions as a form of beauty of unity in diversity and peace.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: De sfeer doet je goed om daar rustig rond te gaan een bijzonderheid was dar er vele vlinders waren op dat moment echt honderden. De vorige keer dat ik er was kon ik kennis maken met 'n speciale dienst met heel veel bloemen en prachtige fruitstukken op gemaakt.

I arrived in Prambanan in the afternoon at 3pm. I've been told that it will be very hot and that umbrellas are available. After paying a 40k entrance fee cause I have a Indonesian ID card, it was surprisingly enjoyable, cause there was always a cooling breeze. The whole temple ground has been maintained well and the park surrounding it has lots of greens, which I guess cools the area a bit.

The sight it self is impressive and very interesting. There are many students which offer to show you around and explain you the sights.

Highly recommended to visit!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: We only spent about 90 minutes here, it was nice to walk around and look at the temples but I mush prefer Borobudur. I also think the $25USD entry fee is a little steep for what you get.

Indonesia has it's fair share of earth quakes and you can see this temple has been rebuilt with a mixture of original and fillers. It is good to get a sense of how it was but it doesn't give you the sense of awe of a place like Angkor Wat.

So if you are in Indonesia - and there are MANY reasons to go - it's worth a visit but to be honest we got Prambanan and Borobudur covered on the first 1.5 days of a two week visit and then moved on to more impressive things: extraordinary animals, beautiful landscapes, wonderful people, delicious food...

Prambanan, built in the 9th Century, was dedicated to the trimurti, the trinity of Brahma  the Creator, Vishnu the Protector, and Shiva the Destroyer.  The complex comprises hundreds of temples of various sizes, most of which have not been restored.  The largest temples are marvelous, and feature large statues of various deities and multiple reliefs depicting important myths.  It is beautiful and awe-inspiring.  

You can choose to climb the steps to the various temple chambers-- if you hire a guide he'll have a flashlight to show you some of the features of the dark interiors.  It's wonderful to just walk among the beautiful structures.

We visited in the late afternoon, when the light was still good for photographs, and elected not to stay through sunset because it was somewhat cloudy and we wanted to avoid walking back to the exit in the dark.  (The beautiful Ramayana Ballet is presented here; our driver suggested seeing a performance in Jogja that worked out better for our visit).

You can easily visit both Prambanan and its contemporaneous Buddhist counterpart, Borobudur, in a single day if you hire a car and driver. Visit one in the early morning and the other in late afternoon, to avoid the strongest heat of the day. You can buy a combined entrance ticket for foreigners at the first UNESCO site you visit, for roughly 50 USD. There appear to be no special dress rules for Prambanan. 

Both sites offer guide services; we had very good English-speaking guides at each location. The cost of the guides is a very reasonable Rp.100,000, payable at the entrance. The guides provide good information and also steer you to good locations for photographs, help you move through the temples by herding other visitors into more organized lines moving up and down the various narrow stairways.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: These structures are decorated with intricate reliefs dedicated to the great Hindu divinities of Shiva, Vishnu and Brahma.  Prambanan is not as well known as the nearby Buddhist temple of Borobudur,  they are not similar in design. When I visited Prambanan, there were not many people, so it was quite nice to walk around in relative solace! It was really nice to visit all the different sculptures of the different divinities! I suggest you to visit it
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I visited Prambanan temple again after several years ago.  Now its more beautiful with many umbrellas in front of the temples.  Really Instagramable.  After visiting there are many café and souvenir shop that offer many choice. Always love to visit this temple!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Bello, tappa obbligata nella zona, però, in giro per il mondo, ci sono templi induisti migliori
Il fatto poi che non sia un luogo di culto vivo lo fa un monumento un po’ asettico.

This temple is awesome. We've been there for the sunset, which is certainly not the best moment for pictures but the site is quiet. To fully appreciate the temple (history, religion)  a guide is recommended (100k/h).

We went to Prambanan twice during our stay in Jogja. Take your time to visit each temple and learn about the history of the site, how it was destroyed and rebuilt. It is actually still a work in progress but felt amazing to know this site is protected. Great for insta worthy pics also if you are patient enough to brace the crowds!

Review Text: Es el templo hinduista más grande del mundo, y aunque le falten bastantes templos por culpa de los terremotos es grandioso y sobrecogedor verlo. 100% recomendable.

We had gone to Yogyakarta to specially visit Prambanan and Borubudhur temple. The temple is a absolute treat to look at. It's a temple dated back to 825 AD.. it's a Hindu temple of Brahma, Vishnu and Shiv. There are many other small temples there too. The architecture is just so beautiful and mesmerising.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Il complesso dei templi di Prambanan ricorda molto Angkor Wat: la visita è molto interessante e il parco in cui sono inseriti offre molte possibilità per svagarsi e rilassarsi, tra cui spiccano dei cerbiatti, un po' messi lì a caso..

In generale da vedere.

Review Text:
We walked around the whole parc. We started at the tempel at the back and we ended with the great Prambanan. there are 4 tempels in total.
The other smaller tempels are defenitely worth a visit. 
Try to avoid weekends, there will be a lot less people during weekdays. For students dont forget to bring your studentcard, you will get some discount

Me sorprendió enormemente el conjunto de templos de Prambanan, construido en torno al siglo IX. Están dedicados a la Trimurti, en consecuencia podremos observar que  hay tres templos principales, cada uno de ellos con la escultura de la deidad a la que está consagrado: Brahma, Visnú y Shivá. Sus muros de piedra están esculpidos con el Ramayana.Tuve la suerte de visitarlos a primera hora de la mañana sin apenas gente, pese a coincidir con la fiesta de la finalización del Ramadán. Desde mi última visita a Angkor Wat, no ha había disfrutado tanto de una construcción  hinduista. Desde luego merece la pena desplazarse hasta la isla de Java para visitarlos. Este conjunto arquitectónico está a unos 15 kilómetros de Yogyakarta.
A cuarenta  kilómetros de esa ciudad también se puede visitar el templo de Borobudur, una auténtica joya arquitectónica del siglo VIII, con más de quinientas esculturas de Buda (afirman que es el templo budista más grande del mundo). Si van a Java, no dejen tampoco de visitarlo. En sus muros de piedra está esculpida gran parte del Mahayana.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Un temple incontournable sur l'île  de Java pas loin de Jogjakarta. C'est un  magnifique  travail qui a été fait les détails des pierres les statues,etc... a visiter si vous êtes sur Java
這邊門票是園區型式，包含附近其他兩間小廟，我跟day tour來訪，發現時間不夠參觀其他廟宇，有點可惜。因為園區離市區不遠，建議自行包車前往，利用半天~一天時間悠閒參觀

Très beau temple, cela vaut la peine de faire un detour pour le voir. Le site comporte aussi un petit train pour aller d un point à un autre et un petit parc avec des biches et des chevaux , de quoi rejouir les enfants
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Amazing, très belle vue, avec beaucoup de gens utiles et souriants. J'espère que je peux revenir ici avec ma famille, c'est le célèbre temple et vraiment bonne vue

We stopped here on our way up to Borobudur and it didn't disappoint! The history is written all around the temples and the crowds were minimal. Admission was a bit steep in my opinion but there's lots to see. To get out, you have to navigate a gigantic marketplace which I didn't really enjoy.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: 가이드를 고용하시어 돌아다니시면 더욱 좋습니다. 가끔 일본어나 한국어가 가능한 가이드도 계십니다. 힌두교 사원으로 3개의 신과 신들의 탈것을 모셔두고 있습니다. 출구가 굉장히 멀기때문에 사원 내부에 있는 차량을 이용하시어 빠져나가심을 추천드립니다.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Wij hadden  een combinatietour gedaan. Eerst waren we vroeg vertrokken  naar de Borobodur. Vervolgens zijn we door gereden naar deze tempel. Het is een prijzig bezoekje, maar ik denk dat het zeker de moeite waard is. De drukte vonden wij meevallen. Je kan prima foto's maken. Wij waren op een warm tijdstip aangekomen. Verder zijn er wat extra activiteiten rondom de tempel. Niet echte aanraders.

Superbes temples hindouistes très bien reconstruits, guides francophones disponibles pour expliquer l’histoire de ces temples.  Beaucoup de monde mais cela ne gêne pas pour visiter chaque temple accessible et voir les statues.

Beautiful temple complex, very different from the Borobudur. Several temples for different Hindu gods. We did not use a local guide, but once in the temple area, two students of the tourism high school asked to practice their guide-skills and English with us. They gave us lots of information and took us around the main temple. Interesting place.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Amazing bgt suka bgt apa lagi tempatnya bersih sblmnya ke jogja tp gak sempet ke prambanan ke candi borobudur aja eh ternyata candi prambanan jg gak kalah bagusnya Dr candi borobudur Dan x ni aku kunjungin candi prambanan, next nanti Datang lagi ajak keluarga saya untuk liburan ke candi prambanan.... Love it

わざわざボロブドゥールに行ったのなら、近くのここを外すわけにもいかないが、敷地内ではロロ・ジョグラン寺院だけを３０分～１時間ぐらい見れば十分。セウ寺院まで歩いたが、途中の寺院も含め時間を使うほどの場所ではない。

チケットブースは外国人用が左側、インドネシア人用が右側で分かれている。
まず、外国人用に行って、ボコの丘との共通券を求めたところ、インドネシア人用のブースで購入するように言われ、インドネシア人用ブースに移動。ところが、この共通券はクレジットカードが使えないとのことだったので諦め、再び外国人用ブースへ。
　大人IDR350,000で、学生IDR210,000でした。英語で大学名が書いてあるが他の部分は日本語の、普通の日本の学生証でも学生料金の適用を受けることができました。

ウェルカムセンターで、ペットボトルの水をもらうか、コーヒー又は紅茶をいただくことができます。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Very nice temple. Amazing time you spend there. 
Tempe is hand build long time ago. Amazing job.
better than borobudur. very good spot

Complejo de templos principalmente  hindúes aunque también se aprecia alguno budista. Muy impactantes desde fuera más que por dentro. Bonito atardecer que despierta los sentidos dónde se puede apreciar el Volcán Merapi al fondo. Sin duda alguna la única pega son los precios pagados a pesar de comprar la entrada combinada con el Templo de Boroboudur.

Un site exceptionnel! Le prix de l'entrée peut rebuter au départ mais il est tout à fait justifié. Une visite empreinte de spiritualité pour laquelle un guide francophone peut s'avérer intéressant tellement il y a à savoir sur ce monument. Un magnifique lieu qui se visite sur une demi journée. Ne vous contentez pas du temple principal mais allez aussi vers le temple boudhiste au fond du parc!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: For a combo ticket it's 560000 or €40 dollars each to get to both borobudur and prambanam. It takes less than an hour to get to the first temple where it's reasonably quiet and a further hour and a half to get to prambanan temple althoigh there is Sewu temple on the same site also. It's open from 6am and you can get very cheap shared taxis that take you to the temples. We paid 120000 each which was very reasonable for 8 hours out of the day.

Definitely a must see in Djogja. These temples were built in the 8-9th century and are part of the UNESCO world heritage. 
We got a combination ticket for Prambanan and Borobodur for around 40$. As an international visitor you also get a free welcome drink (water, coffee or tea). The area is breathtaking, but can also be very hot because there is not much shade. 
Two trainee guides walked us through the ancient temples. It was a lovely afternoon!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: A morning visit to Borobudur or Prambanan is recommended. Since it will be too hot in the afternoon.

A really huge Hindu temple at Indonesia. Stunning and beautiful. We really love the place because it was full of history and so beautiful. If only the foreigners ticket is not that expensive, it will be perfect.
Visita assolutamente imperdibile. La collocazione dei templi è magnifica e,anche se di dimensioni molto minori, per la sua struttura complessiva, ricorda la cambogiana Angkor-Wat.
bagus banget candinya, pengunjung nya selalu banyak, dan klo ke jogja harus slalu kesini... ga pernah bosen .
The structures left me in awe! I couldn't stop staring at the temples. The construction is unique and impressive!

Fasilitas yg ada di candi prambanan sudah banyak mengalami peningkatan. Seperti jalan menuju ke candi yang berlubang sekarang sudah rapi. Untuk yang belum pernah kesini, wajib kesini karena lokasinya yang strategis dan dekat dengan Kota Yogyakarta maupun Kota Klaten. Datang kesini harus pagi agar dapat menikmati suasana candi prambanan yang masih sepi dan bisa puas keliling-keliling dan jangan lupa bawa topi apabila berkunjung kesini siang hari.

Complesso spettacolare, consigliatissimo. Acquistate il biglietto combinato Borobudur e Prambanan per risparmiare. Oltre al sito più famoso, vicino all'ingresso, presenti anche altri templi camminando nel vasto parco ed alcuni animali. Tappa obbligatoria de si sta a Yogyakarta.

Prambanan is really easy to reach. You can use bus 1A od TransJogja to reach this temple. My reccomendation is you learn a little about the history before you come to visit this temple. Each building have their own meaning, so it will better if you bring someone which understand the history.
It us also recommended to buy some souvenirs here, because it was cheaper compared to malioboro price

i like this one more that Borobudur and it is closer from jogya city. We met students there that they wanted to give us a tour for free. At then we gave them something but they did not want to take it. It looks that their teachers when they are in the high school they bring them to this tourist place to speak with tourists and learn English. Amazing, inst it?

Prambanan est un très beau temple, il y a du monde dans le temple principal mais dans les 3 autres temples mineurs il y a très peu de visiteur. C'est un incontournable de Yogyakarta, je le recommande !
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Banyak perubahan untuk wahana dan fasilitas yang ada di Situs Candi Prambanan. Mulai dari tiketing untuk turis lokal dan mancanegara antrian sudah dibedakan. Banyak fasilitas spot foto kursi angkasa / sepeda gantung di sisi utara Candi, tentu saja dengan biaya tambahan. Untuk tiket masuk wisata candi sendiri, untuk turis lokal dewasa sebesar Rp 40.000, sedangkan untuk anak - anak lokal sebesar Rp 25.000

ボロブドゥールは仏教寺院の遺跡ですが、こちらはヒンズー教の寺院遺跡です。
遺跡の崩れた石が周囲においてありますが、全体的に緑豊で解放感のある公園になっています。シヴァ神、ブラフマ神、ヴィシュヌ神の寺院の向いには、それぞれの乗り物であるナンディ、ハンサ、ガルーダがおさめられている塔がありますが、ガルーダの像はありませんでした。
Beautiful temples dedicated to the gods. You can see all the temples like a mandala, perfectly and simetric with the statues inside.

Our trip to Yogyakarta was importantly based on visiting Borobudur and other of the region’s mainly Buddhist temples. Prambanan resulted a very pleasant surprise due to its extraordinary architecture and religious significance. Because our schedule, we were there during Indonesian holidays causing a very crowded and somehow a bit unpleasant visit. Fortunately, the site also includes other three very interesting temples worth to explore that are excluded by most of the site visitors.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
La entrada para entrar aquí y a borobudur son unos 40€, dos entradas nos salieron por más de 1millon de rupias.
Merece la pena tanto dinero?no, pero es un apartada obligatoria si estás en yogyakarta.
Es bonito pero se hace pesado que la gente de allí te incordie pidiéndote fotos y llamándote cosas... Hace que estés deseando acabar la visita para que te dejen en paz

This is my first time visiting in this temple. Ticket prices is fair and the area inside a temple is very clean and it have a beautiful garden. The temple Prambanan have more than one temple and all temple have so many histories. So Amazing ...
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
We did not expect to spend hours at this attraction. If we could stay longer to appreciate the art and culture this place carries, it would be amazing.

Ticket costs: IDR350,000 (cheaper with a student card but none of us has one)

There are four temples here and, of course, prambanan is the largest. The structure is unique and special. We wanted to catch sunset there but it was too cloudy and we could barely see the sun. It was super crowded too as it was Saturday.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: You can buy ticket online with Traveloka to avoid queuing.. try to avoid weekend or public holiday.. best time to visit is in the afternoon you can enjoy sunset at prambanan temple or ratu boko temple ( you can buy one package ticket for both temple they have bus shuttles) if you want to watch ramayana ballet at prambanan  in the night you better check the schedule on the website...

Visita obligada si estas en yogjakarta, esta bastante bien y no hay demasiada gente, se puede hacer andando, no hace falta ni bicis ni el tren de turista. El recinto esta bien cuidado. Eso si, si ya has visto Angkor en Camboya se te quedara algo pequeño.

Prambanan Temple has been on my bucket list for a long time. Only thing that stopped me was the fact there is no international airport near it. You have to travel through domestic airpo4t either from Bali or Jakarta.
I combined my Bali trip with a 1day trip from Bali to visit Prambanan and Borobudur Temple. I should say the experience was worth the effort. The very sight of this huge temple complex of Prambanan is a visual treat by itself. No where in the world we can find the unique combination of Shiva, Vishnu and Bramha temple along with the temple of each of their vehicle of god's facing their respective god's.

The fact that these  temples have been carefully restored peice by price after several earthquakes the recent one being 2010 earth quake means a lot of the effort goes into restoring the temple.

It is told the temple complex in its original form had around 1000 temples surrounding the 3main temples. What We can see now is only around dozen temples in different stages. But even those add a great touch to this huge temple complex.

There are lot of Instagram's let locations both naturally and props made by the authorities.
The temple complex of such huge size is maintained superb and well laid out with tourist amenities all clearly marked. You also have a option of renting bicycle and pedal your way into the house complex.

 overall a great experience and I would recommend everyone to go for it along with the other superb experience of Borobudur Buddhist temple
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Der Tempel  ist sehr beeindruckend. Auch wenn leider durch ein Erdbeben einiges zerstört wurde.
Was ein wenig schade ist ist das in der Anlage eine Art Freizeitpark errichtet wurde.
Es ist sehr voll und nimmt ein wenig die Stimmung und Atmosphäre.
Trotzallem ein Besuch wert.
Kombiticket mit Borobudur 560.000 IDR.

Pertama kali saya melihat bangunan batu itu, saya langsung merasa di dalam mimpi, kenapa? Karena saya dulu saya hanya melihatnya di televisi saja, dan baru kali ini melihat bangunan indah itu di depan mata saya sendiri. Dengan corak hindu dan susunan bangunan yang sangat terlihat naturalis, membuat saya semakin terpesona. Dan di setiap bangunan candi tersebut, terdapat satu patung di dalamnya. Namun sayangnya, banyak candi yang hancur disebabkan gempa Yogyakarta pada tahun 2006.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Datang kemari dengan tujuan memperkenalkan kepada anak akan peninggalan sejarah  dari kerajaan jaman dulu. Datang kemari sebaiknya dipagi hari, karena menjelang siang, panas sekali. Disarankan membawa topi dan menggunakan sun block. Candi ini tidak sulit ditemukan. Tidak jauh dari bandara yogyakarta. Tempat parkirnya luas. Tiket masuk yang ditawarkan bervariasi. Ada yang dipaketkan dengan tiket ke candi borobudur, ada yang dipaketkan dengan perjalanan ke Candi Ratu Boko, dan ada juga yang dipaketkan dengan perjalanan ke candi sojiwan, dan candi palaosan. 
Candi ini adalah candi tertinggi di Indonesia. Setelah masuk ke area candi, tidak jauh dari pintu masuk ada spot untuk berfoto dengan latar pemandangan candi prambanan secara keseluruhan. Cantik sekali.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Many don't take the time to visit the Chandi Sewu (Buddhist) Temple at the back of the Prambanan Temple complex. There is a building behind the Chandi Sewu Temple that has many of the actual statues from the Temple complex. Those with a good camera with a decent lens can take a few good photos of the damaged and unbandaged statues through the bars of the building. This building is not marked on the free maps. On this same building the explanation about some of the more common statues can also be found.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Saya mengunjungi Candi Prambanan pada tanggal 2 Juli 2018 dan ini pertama kalinya saya melihat candi ini dan candi ini sangat cantik, indah dan artistik. Tempat ini wajib dikunjungi dan sangat ramai, biaya masuknya untuk wisatawan domestik sebesar Rp 40ribu dan wisatawan asing sebesar US$ 25. Candi ini merupakan peninggalan dari kebudayaan Hindu dari abad ke-20.
We really enjoyed spending a few hours wandering around this temple, and the grounds to visit the other temples close to it.

Très beau temple qui mérite le détour quand est sur yogyakarta. Mais foule estivale des locaux principalement.  Quelques touristes européens donc assez peu fréquenté finalement par rapport à d'autres monuments.  
Toujours l'impression d'être une attraction pour les locaux. Presque plus que le temple en lui même . 
Site qui mériterait d'être visite hors saison au lever ou coucher du soleil.  
Hors de prix par rapport à la prestation. Nous sommes pris pour de vrais tiroirs caisses. Déçu par rapport aux commentaires très élogieux. Rien d'exceptionnel non plus mais à voir tout de même.

Legend in overnight. Prambanan temple look like differen with Borobudur temple. Consists of several temple buildings in one area. Prambanan temple is one of the heritage buildings, we need to preserve its existence. Very beautiful, very interesting for anyone who comes to there
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Częściowo odrestaurowane budowle, do czytania jak książka hinduizmu,w otoczeniu park i udogodnienia dla dzieci w postaci parku i kolejki wąskotorowej dla maluchów.Konieczny punkt przy zwiedzaniu Jawy
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Taman wisata Candi Prambanan untuk kondisi yang sekarang sudah lebih tertata, banyak fasilitas pendukung untuk wisatawan, banyak pilihan permainan untuk wisatawan seperti sepeda, mobil golf, panahan, kereta wisata, dll dengan harga yang terjangkau, sehingga wisatawan tidak hanya bisa menikmati kemegahan arsitektur Candi Prambanan yang lengkap dengan segala sejarahnya, tetapi juga bisa menikmati wahana hiburan lain disana. Hal tersebut membuat wisatawan tidak jenuh dan menambah daya tarik dari Taman Wisata Candi Prambanan sendiri. Selain itu kebersihan lingkungannya juga mengalami kemajuan yang sangat pesat dan penjual juga lebih tertata, sehingga membuat wisatawan nyaman dan senang berkunjung kesana.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: The temple is located in Klaten, 20km (around 30-45 minutes drive) from Yogyakarta. I visited this temple in the afternoon to see the sunset. We have to arrive at the temple at 5:15pm the latest (the last admission is 5:15pm). Need to walk around 10 minutes from the parking area. It's very touristy.

Since most tourists visit Borobudur in the morning and Prambanan in the afternoon, it is empty and beautiful here early in the morning!
Unfortunately, many things are destroyed, but there is still enough to admire. It is unbelievable how big the temple was. In the distance you can see the volcano.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Es increíble cuando te acercas y encuentras este hermoso templo, muy bien mantenido,eso si lleva una sombrilla ,agua pues el sol y el calor es mucho. pero vale la pena los grabados etc no te arrepentiras
This temple consists of a few other smaller temples so don't forget to see them also. Prambanan itself is amazing as you might expected.

This Hinduism temple is magnificent. Around 45 minutes from the city by car. The best time to come is before 11am or above 3pm to avoid the heat, and don't forget to bring hat or umbrella especially during the rainy season. There will be a tour guide offered at the main gate who will explain about this place and the history. For those who like photography, this might be a very good place.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: ternyata bangunan ini membuat saya berdecak kagum. bangunan megah yang dibangun pada jaman dulu dimana peralatan tidak secanggih dan semaju sekarang.butuh waktu seharian juga untuk bermain disini.selain banyak spot foto ,juga anak anak bisa bermain dan berfoto dengan burung hantu dan ular. ada spot foto naik sepeda gantung dengan latar candi . ada naik kuda. ada cinema untuk kisah seputat candi.jadi butuh waktu hampir seharian juga untuk bermain disini.bagus sekali untuk wisata anak
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: A long walk. Check combined ticket with Borobudur or Ratu Boko. Amazing place and worth visiting in Yogyakarta.  Many places for taking photos. Be ready for a long walk and many photos.  Enjoyed.
Candi besar peninggalan majapahit ini sangat menarik mata ketika sunset dengan cahaya matahari yang menyilaukan keindahan mata

Un esempio magnifico di architettura orientale, molto geometrica, imponente. La restaurazione post-terremoto e' in stato molto avanzato e di eccellente qualita'; splendide le sculture ed i  bassorilievi. Da non perdere.
Candi prambanan sangat ramai pengunjungnya,bagus sekali tempatnya untuk melihat candi2 peninggalan leluhur kita
the temple is a must visit list if u going to Indonesia. 9th century marvel and dedicated to three hindu gods- Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva

It's still a mystery to me why foreigners were being charged at 10x more than the locals, are we that 'rich' to get ripped off?
Anyway if you are not doing any of the sunrise tours, you can get combo tickets online or at the desk easily together with Raku boro and Borobudur temples.
It's a stunning temple, within the complex you will get to see the sewu temple (another unesco complex), bubrah temple and Lumburg temple). You may walk there within 10 minutes to these sites from the prambanan temple or you may take their scheduled shuttle service. Do make it to the sewu temple. It's very similar to the Angkor wat putt with much less people.
In the end of course there's the big souvenir shopping area, it's relatively cheaper than the ones along malioboro street IMO.

My daughter and I visited for half a day and it was the perfect amount of time to see the temples and grounds. We hired a hotel driver who took us there stopping along the way in the rice paddies for a view of Mt. Merapi. He went with us to the ticket office where we paid by credit card and then hired an English speaking guide for a small fee. The temples are spectacular especially when you know they have been reconstructed from the rubble after an earthquake. The stones interlock without mortar. There are many smaller temples which have not been rebuilt but imagining what the entire complex must have looked like adds to the ambience of the site. This is another “must see” UNESCO World Heritage Site!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This 9th century Hindu temple is really beautiful and it's amazing to see the main temple still standing on it ground after hit by the powerful earthquake in 2006. The sunset view over the Prambanan Plain is magnificent. Thanks to our guide Aan suggestion and arrangement, we have our dinner there and watch the Ramayana Ballet which performed near the temple.It's an interesting and impressive performance. This show completed our trip in Jogja perfectly. It was a great and wonderful experience. Hopefully we will able to visit this wonderful city again. And definite I would recommend Aan as private guide to one who would like to visit that city. Such a knowledgeable and fun person.  Aan Purnama Yoga's contact:62 821 45854996 (whatsapp) and email:aan_moonyoga@yahoo.com
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
We never get tired of going to Prambanan Temple.

Only took less then 2 hours going around the area of temple. Use the golf car if you are worried of being tired.

With wife
27 December 2017

Hicimos la excursión junto con el templo de Borobudur como la mayoría de los turistas. Este templo me pareció algo más monótono, menos fotografías originales que en Borobudur, aún así, merece la pena por donde esta ubicado, en un sitio precioso, alrededor solo se ve el verde de los árboles.

This school holiday, my mom, my daughter and I are doing temple crawls. So the first day we visit Prambanan Temple and other small temples nearby.

We hired a buggy car and a driver to take us around Prambanan complex. With only IDR 200000, the guy drove us around with the brief explanations about the Prambanan and other smaller temples.

It was a very informative and educative trip for us, especially for my 11 years old daughter. Of course she was doing what an 11 years old do, took a lot of pictures and posted them in Instagram.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This hindu temple is more than 1200 yrs old and has survived many earthquakes. I highly recommend engaging the services of a temple guide. They’re so professional and their sharing makes the tour more meaningful for me as a tourist. They also know the best spots for photo taking! Try to time your visit near the sunset hours, the view is amazing then.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Prambanan is a temple complex consisting of temples of Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva with their vahana Swan, Garuda and Nandi. Its a huge temple complex with the walls narrating stories of great epics of India Ramayana and Mahabharatha. Its surprising to see the sculptures done to the detail of the epic and anyone can easily understand and follow the sequence of the events in the story. It is a must see place. The complex has cycling, train, play area and lots of fun activities with kids. We visited the complex twice during the visit. Plan a decent time to relish the beauty of the temples.

Review Text: There are 4 major temples to see in the Prambanan Temples complex, and thus, you really have to give yourself time to see all of them (well, there are probably 500 structures, but not all are available or in good condition). Probably 3 hours is enough if you want to explore, not rush, and follow the stated route. This is the one negative: They have entrances and exits and you cannot deviate from this. Thus, you really have to end up walking the "long way around" if you choose to do it in any other direction than what they want. That said, it is a great complex to visit. The main Prambanan Temple, dating from the 9th century is a wonderful example of Hindu building and architecture, showing an amazingly number of bas-relief stone carvings that depict the Indonesian version of the Ramayana epic. Thus, monkeys and animals with various gods are depicted throughout. You can climb on nearly all of the buildings, giving you an interior as well as an exterior view of the buildings. The next biggest temple is Sewu, that contains four pairs of Dwarapala giant statues at each compass point as the entry way into the complex. There is much more "reconstruction" going on at this building that some of the others, with tarps in various places. The ability to wander around at your own pace is great.  I would pass on the museum and on some of the other garden sites (including a zoo), as they are not unique per se. Overall, this is a great complex to highlight the Hindu influence in the country.

Review Text:
午前中、ボロブドゥールを見学し、昼はショッピングで時間を潰し、夕方の涼しくなる時間帯を狙って見に行きました。

非常に清々しい場所に大きな石造りの建造物が立っています。

10年ほど前の地震で周辺の建物は崩れて、修復を待っている状態ですが。

それでも楽しめました。

ボロブドゥールに引き続きプランバナン寺院遺跡を訪れました。入場券はボロブドゥールとセットでRp.560,000（約\4,700）但し2日間までですので、私は中1日だったので、それぞれRp.350,000（約\3,000）、合計Rp.700,000（約\6,000）を払いました。地元の人はRp.40,000ですので約10分の1です。昨年5月まではRP.260,000だったので値上げしたばかりでした。
地震で大きな被害を受けて改修を少しづつ進めていますが、時間と金がかかるのはわかるような気がします。日本もアンコールワットやここプランバナンの修復を支援しているようです。
ヒンドゥー教の遺跡群で9世紀くらいの建設ですので、ボロブドゥールの方が100年ほど古いことになります。ボロブドゥールは大乗仏教の遺跡ですがストゥーパという仏塔が象徴的でジャワ仏教の独自性が示されていましたが、ここプランバナンの遺跡群の中でもひと際存在感を示しているのが、ロロ・ジョングラン寺院でその中心に位置するシヴァ聖堂の存在感が圧倒的です。
また遺跡群の一番奥にあるのがチャンディ・セウですが、ここには2体のクラベラ（守護神）が独特の愛嬌で迎えてくれます。ガイドによるとこれを「あ」「ん」と言い、日本でいう狛犬の阿吽と一緒でした。

Review Text:
To see here are six tower-like "Hindu" temples (with cone-shaped tops) which are pretty easy to go up (each with a stone staircase and it takes just like a minute to get above).  I went up all six of them where there's "a small room" above each temple (actually the largest temple has four rooms, one on each of the four sides), and there's a statue of a deity or such inside some of those small rooms (but some are empty); then to see as you walk above around each temple are carving scenes & these interesting-shaped identical objects that look like "stone jars" (you can just see them from the ground too without going up, and actually there are more of them on the sides of the cone-shaped top of each temple, so I figured those jars must have some religious significance).

And apart from these six temples, there are three more temples on a far side of the temple grounds with the farthest one called Candi Sewu about a 15-minute walk away (from the area with the six temples), and yes it's "worthwhile" walking over that way to that farthest temple which is a "pretty-sizeable" structure still standing (despite the "plenty of" ruined parts as well) and where there are also two big human statues facing each other as if maybe guarding the entrance to the temple (I was only able to see it from outside though since there was a fence around its immediate grounds).

There's the transjogja bus 2A (I took it direct from the bus stop right in front of Fort Vredeburg on the south end of the "shopping street" Jl. Malioboro) to the station from which it's about a 10-minute walk to the temple grounds that are really "well-maintained" with spacious lawns & some beautiful flowers along the pathway leading to the ticket entrance; there's the "combo ticket" with Borobudur (an iconic "world-famous" Buddhist temple that absolutely should not be missed) available for 500-something-thousand rupiah (as of last October when I visited) with the "only catch" being that you only have two consecutive days to do both temples.

Review Text: Candi Prambanan atau Candi Roro Jonggrang adalah kompleks candi Hindu terbesar di Indonesia yang dibangun pada abad ke-9 masehi. Candi ini dipersembahkan untuk Trimurti, tiga dewa utama Hindu yaitu Brahma sebagai dewa pencipta, Wishnu sebagai dewa pemelihara, dan Siwa sebagai dewa pemusnah.

Note: tolong kita bersama menjaga kelestarian dengan bersikap sopan dan santun ketika mengunjungi bangunana atau adat bersejarah. Karena ini warisan yang tidak dapat dibangun lagi kalau kadung hancur. Ingat anak cucu yang belum melihat dan merasakan.

De templene som er restaurerte er ikke mange i forhold til totalen, men er allikevel imponerende i antall og størrelse.Veldig flott! Jeg klarte ikke å slutte å ta bilder. Detaljrikdommen i statuer og relieffer er helt utrolig. Dette tempelet er et "must".

On my third and last day in Yogyakarta, my friend took me to Prambanan on his motorcycle. We arrived early in the morning at around 7 am. The sun was still manageable and there were not too many people, so I was able to get good shots of the site.

I paid the entrance fee when I purchased my ticket to Borobudur the day earlier because I availed of the package that includes entrance fee for both Borobudur and Prambanan. The entrance fee for foreigners is much higher for foreigners at IDR 520,000 (although I’ve read that they have implemented another price increase after my visit to Prambanan).  Guests have the option of paying in cash or credit card. I used my card and I spent about US$ 23.00 since my bank provided a favorable exchange rate. There were no additional services provided to foreigners and I felt that the higher rate for foreigners was unfair and exploitative.

Although there was a Ramayana Performance at Prambanan, I consciously chose not to see it because I was apprehensive that I might not appreciate it because the performance was said to be in Bahasa Indonesia, and because I was not too familiar with this Hindu epic.

Prambanan is a sight to behold. Photos of Prambanan do not capture the size and magnificence of the place. The main complex of Prambanan originally had plenty of temples numbering up to 240 that have since fallen into ruin and are now mere rubble. The oldest of the temples date back to the 9th century. Eighteen of these temples have been reconstructed, including all the main temples. The main temples are dedicated to Vishnu, Brahma, and the largest, to Shiva. Visitors may enter all of the reconstructed temples and shrines.

Prambanan is very picturesque and multidimensional. Remember to encircle the different temples. There are sights/angles to behold even from behind. Also, some of the temples, especially Candi Siwa (Shiva), have rooms and chambers at the sides and at the back.

A few minutes’ walk from the main temple complex you will find Candi Lumbung, Candi Bubrah, and Candi Sewu. There were no other visitors to these three temples when I went there. These three, together with the Prambanan Temple, compose the Prambanan Temple Compound, which was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1991.

We toured the Prambanan Museum afterward. With the price I paid as a foreigner, I expected a guide to assist me; there was none. Moreover, not all of the displays in the Museum had English translations, though. I hope that they do something about it. 

Remember that even if portions of the temple are in ruins, the site is still a temple so dress appropriately—comfortable but modest. It saddens me when I see tourists wearing outfits that are too revealing (think of shorts that are less than 12 inches long).  When visiting the temple complex, bring sunscreen and drinking water because it will get hot. Coming from a tropical country, I did not mind the heat; in fact, it felt cooler there than in Manila, but when I returned to the hotel I was slightly sunburnt. All in all, I found my visit to Prambanan enjoyable and informative.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Extraordinary that 1300 years ago this temple was hewn from lava rock, carved ins such detail and assembled block by block without any mortar. A recent earthquake did damage and a sensitive repair has bene undertaken although a lot of the smaller temples - there were 999 built apparently in one night as a challenge for a suitor to take the hand of the queen.  The detailed carvings are like new - the hardness of the lava rock I think has meant erosion and wear has been minimal.  Well worth a visit.

I don't mean to sound like a spoilt sport but after having stayed in Dubai and Singapore for over 12+ years, we haven't experienced such scorching and scalding sunburn grade heat.  

Frankly, we need to do a reality check on the splendour, scale and beauty of temples in India from the sun temple of Konarak, the monasteries of Ladakh, cave temples of Vaishno Devi, erotica of Khajuraho, the spectacular Ajanta & Ellora caves that are rock cut and the huge complex of Akshar Dham. Not to mention the gravity defying  gopurams in South India and marble temples and sandstone temples of Western India. That is too just provide perspective on the variety and scale. 

There are 6 temples which have the idols of Shiv, Ganesha, Nandi, Brahma, Angsa & Agastya. The first 4 are from Hindu mythology but the other two are probably some creative licence. It is a short walk to the temples and was thankfully not as busy as Borbodur so lots of photo ops.  The caveat is wear a wide brimmed hat, slap on lots of sunscreen and replenish water to avoid imminent dehydration. We chose a time slot between 10am to 12pm when the sun was at it's zenith. Try to aim for early morning or sunset slots.

We gave the Ramayana ballet a pass as it is nearly 2.5 hrs long and the deal breaker is that it is in Bahasa. There is an indoor performance in the city but we were too exhausted after tramping about in the heat from one site to another.

Entry fee of USD 25 per head is really extortion when you get value for money in a multiple entry pass for Angkor Wat in Cambodia.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Candi peninggalan sejarah yang masih berdiri kokoh. 
Makin siang cuacanya makin panas dan makin banyak juga pengunjungnya.

So this temple complex is nice. It originally had 240+ temples but most are now rubble though the main temples are all standing. The pamphlet markets this as the most beautiful Hindu temple in the world. Really? I mean has whoever created this pamphlet visited or even Google searched India? 

Putting aside any feelings of righteous anger / pride on that claim...I'd cite similar considerations as I did for Borbodur. It's incredibly hot. Like incredibly, crazy, sweltering hot. Its not great value - you pay USD 25 per head (15 for kids under 12) You can spend a max of 2 hours exploring the temples assuming you don't wilt / melt. If you've visited Angkor or temples in India you might be underwhelmed. 

It is still beautiful with lovely carvings. It was also far less crowded than Borbodur so nicer that way. We skipped the Ramayana performance as it was indoors and also as we learnt it was in bahasa and for 2-2.5 hours which seemed too long to sustain interest. Would've still liked to see the costumes and experience the music and dance. Maybe if it was shorter. 

Overall I'd only recommend visiting this and Borbodur if you are really into temples / historic / religious sites. It's well marketed but nothing as awe inspiring as Angkor or any historic and still in use temples - Hindu or Buddhist in India.

Candi Prambanan atau Candi Roro Jonggrang adalah kompleks candi Hindu terbesar di Indonesia yang dibangun pada abad ke-9 masehi.

Candi Prambanan merupakan kompleks Candi Hindu tertinggi sekaligus tercantik di Indonesia. Candi ini sarat akan kisah cinta.

Lokasi  Bokoharjo, Kec. Prambanan, Kabupaten Sleman, Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta

This 10th century Hindu temple complex located in Central Java, Indonesia, 17km from the City of Yogyakarta. It was neglected for over hundred years and was discovered in the 17th century and restored to its original graceful architectural structure with its original method of holding the structure blocks together by interlocking stone. Prambanan was declared a UNESCO World Heritage site in 1991. There are three main shrines dedicated to the Hindu Trimurti - the tallest and largest shrines is dedicated to Shiva the destroyer and the other two flanking left and right is dedicated to Brahma the God of Creator and Vishnu the Keeper. In the main chamber enshrines the staue of Shiva, Durga (Shiva’ wife), Agasta (Shiva’s Teacher), Ganesha (Shiva’s sonThe temple walls carved with reliefs if the epic of the Ramayana The earthquake in 2006  has damage some part of the complex
There is a legends to it said that a man Bandung Bondowoso loved Roro Jonggrang, (it is said Durga statue is said to be Roro Jonggrang). Refuse his loved, Jonggrang ask Bondowoso to make her a temple with 1000 statues in one a night time. The request was nearly fulfilled however when Bondowoso completed the 999 statue, Jonggrang set a fire to lit up and look like morning had broken hence feeling cheated Jonggrang was cursed to be the thousandth statue.
It has been an important annual religious centre for Hindu rituals ceremonies in Java for the Balinese and Javanese Hindu of Yogyakarta and Central Java
It is best to wander around on foot so that you explore the amazing intricate details stone craving. The nearby cities to Prambanan is Yogyakarta.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
带着婆罗浮屠的梦想，带着婆罗浮屠的回味，上午去了日惹另一处的估计普兰巴南神庙，他是印度教神庙，位于印尼日惹东北16公里。由250座大大小小的陵庙组成，建于公元900年左右，是为埋藏当时国王及王后骨灰而修建的。它是印尼又一个世界著名的历史古迹，被联合国教科文组织列入世界文化贵产名录，是印尼最宏伟壮丽的印度教寺庙，是世界建筑、雕刻和绘画艺术史上一颗璀璨的明珠。
    陵庙群分成两个大院。主院基础较高，院内有16座陵庙，其余均建在一个地势较低的院内。主院内有三座高高耸立的塔形石砌陵庙，南边的为梵天庙，北边的为毗湿努庙，中央的是最受古代印尼人崇拜的大自在天神湿婆庙，塔身高达47米。庙内四壁上均有精美的浮雕，讲述的是印度史诗《罗摩衍那》中的故事。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Best time to visit is morning or late afternoon(may you can go for Ramayana Ballad later). Architecture of the Hindu Temples is amazing and so are the statues of Hindu Gods. Being from India it was really interesting to discover the differences in the sculptures. There are more than one big temples and hundreds of smaller ones. Many small ones got destroyed by the regular earthquakes. Some of them were being restored.

A lot of local tourists also visit and may be more so on the weekends.

We got a combined ticket for both Borobudur and Prambanan(had it prearranged by our transport  provider Losari)-it was around 520k IDR per person I think. There is a discount for students with a valid ID. We did not encounter any queues. It will take 2+ hours to explore the place at a relaxed place. A guide is recommended to understand the significance of the various parts of the temple. 

There is also a cassowary enclosure just before the exit, we saw two beautiful birds.

Again same as borobudur there is a maze of shops waiting for you at the exit. If you are not interested to shop like we were, take a good look - at the end you can see a wall from  the distance next to some sort of small parking. There is an opening in the wall which lets you bypass the shops. Many locals were seen using that.

We went to Prambanan after a long day of seeing the sights Yogyakarta has to offer and we were pleasantly greeted by the sun setting and a beautiful rainbow in the background of the temple. The temple compounds was full of ruins and it will make you wonder how it would have looked like in the past.
Get a tour guide because with that you get to listen to the stories craved on the walls and it makes the place come alive.

These temples are so beautiful that I spent a long time wondering around each of them, checking out the fine details. Our local guide told us that the temples would look the best at sunset, and we were certainly impressed. The afternoon we went, it wasn't very busy (as you can tell from the photos), however, we were lucky enough to experience a very magical sunset. I cannot wait to return there and admire the beautiful temples again.

I love temples so I couldn't skip this complex! The temple itself is in similar style to those in Cambodian Angkor Wat, there are also smaller temples in the complex (included in the same ticket). You can take a walk there or take a mini-train (good idea in the scorching hot sun).

Downside - Indonesian tourists wanting to take pictures with you ALL. THE. TIME. Sure, it's nice a first few times, but after that when you get stopped by everyone for a few minutes it gets annoying.
Also - the deers... I'm against zoos in general and I was sad to see them there.

Also, the museum was in Indonesian only - i don't mind paying more than locals for the entrance, but if I am, i expect translations.

I know I focused on the bad points, but all in all I enjoyed my visit A LOT and I highly recommend it.

ここはヒンドゥーの寺院なので、今回はヒンドゥーの神々を写すのに専心しました。ビシュヌ、シバ、ブラフマ、ガネーシャ・・・照明のない屋内に安置されていますので、ISOを稼げるカメラが必須になります。露出を落として撮影して画像処理で明度をあげるのがよいかもしれません。

We had a great day trip to the deeply impressive Prambanan. This is a 9th century Hindu temple compound. Located about 17km from Yogyakarta. We travelled there by bus, it takes about 50mins on the 3a bus when boarding at maliboro stop, the staff there are very helpful and will ensure you board the correct bus if you ask.

The site is a UNESCO world heritage site and is the largest Hindu temple in Indonesia, one the of the largest in Southeast Asia. I thought this place was wonderful, a spectacle of grand proportions. As impressive as the famous Angkor Wat. We met some local students who took us on a tour of the temples in order to practice their English, they were a true credit to their education and region and so mature and sensible. We were deeply impressed by them.

It’s a great shame that ‘foreigners’ are charged in the region of 10 times the entrance fee for Prambanan than that of locals, about £18 each. Whilst some difference is understandable this smacks of exploitation of visitors.

That said, this place is magnificent. Worth a visit.

This is a Must visit when  you are in Yogjarkarta. The history of this temple dates back to the 9th century (slightly younger than Candi Borobudur). There are 240 big and smaller temples . Unfortunately due to a major earthquake many smaller Temples ended up in ruins. Restoration is still in progress, according to the guide it can take up to 10 years to rebuilt The temple. A lot of hardwork by the locals involving the  architect , illustrators to piece them back without any blueprints as reference.  We are fortunate now to have 3 major temples which received lesser damages ( Shiva- centre accompanied by Vishnu and Bhrama on each sides) our guide led us through , we had a good understanding and look at the statue inside each temple.  The last highlights here is the Sunset view - do not miss it!!

Review Text:
空港に朝着いたので、そこからトランスジョグジャ1Aに乗っていきました。3500Rps。遺跡最寄りのプランバナンまでは10分程度。周囲の人にプランバナンに行きたいと話しておくと、停留所で教えてくれます。停留所から、大きい通りにでると、そこには遺跡のある公園エリアが見えますが、入口はそこから通りを道沿いに10分程度歩いたところ。横断歩道のない道路を横断しないといけないので、気を付けてください。
遺跡は入場料は25ドル。ボロブドゥールとの共用チケット40ドルもありますが、ボロブドゥールのサンライズツアーに参加する場合には共用チケットは使えないので、別々で購入してください。クレジットカードが使えました。
遺跡はよく整備された公園内に唐突に立っています。

ボロドゥブールとのセット価格で54万ルピア（外国人価格）。
USD40と表記されているので、場合によっては米ドルがいいかもです。
ボロブドゥールに負けない、細かいレリーフ、彫刻。
建物は、威厳を感じさせる圧倒的な外観で素晴らしい。
ここも、建物の中の石像を見るために階段の上り下りがあるので
汗をかく。タオル必要です。
すごく広い公園で、ボロブドゥールとセットで同日に見るより、
別々にして、じっくり見た方が良かったかなぁと思いました。

Review Text: A wonderful experience. Fantastic photo opportunities. Grounds immaculately kept. Temples well worth the money and time. The Ramayana Ballet also well worth seeing whilst visiting.

The Prambanan Temple is the reminder of the Hinduism in its pinnacle . The temple has been dedicated to lord shiva. This built in the early 9th century when shivaisim was widespread . Most kings and rulers were follower of the all mighty Shiva. The twist here is the temple also have idols of Brahma and Vishnu. What really seems little different in Indonesia is worship of Brahma. According to Hindu scriptures Brahma should not be worshipped. In India we only have one Brahma temple in Puskar, but in this region this about 3 rd major temple to have the Brahma as an idol.
It is great to see the architecture the 3 stages of life from earth to swarg Lok. The temple can be visited from Yogyakarta. It takes about 2 hours to see it. Worth visiting if you are historical buff.

I had always wanted to go to Prambanan temple since when I was a kid and heard about the Roro Jongrang folklore for the first time. I had seen many pictures of this old and big Hindu temple so many times, but honestly speaking, I think it looks a lot better in person. Visiting this temple made me think of the past and wonder how people built such magnificent construction without modern technology. 

The only thing that I wasn't satisfied with during my visit was the temperature. It was really hot and I found it inconvenient to use an umbrella.

Review Text:
After visiting many of the significant Hindu Temples in Bali we had Prambanan Temple in Java on our bucket list. It certainly didn’t disappoint and was more spectacular than any of the photos depict. You can’t appreciate the scale of the structure from a photo. 

We opted for a tour guide which was imperative to understand the many renovations and more importantly the significance of the carvings and statues. It is so majestic. You can only imagine the painstaking process of the renovations spanning generations to restore this temple to its current state. There are many temples surrounding the main temples that are still piles of rocks awaiting archeologists to piece together the puzzle to rebuild.

There are several smaller temples walking distance from the main temple so ask your tour guide to show you them as well. There is a nominal additional fee but worth it. There is a complementary train that will take you to the other temples, but we enjoyed the walk. 

We were fortunate to visit in early February and enjoyed our visit without many other visitors. 

We included a visit to Borobudur Temple as well. They are about 90 minutes apart by car. You would be remiss not to visit both if you are in the area. Borobudur is a Buddhist Temple. We decided to stay close to the Borobudur Temple for the tranquility the area offered. You can also include a visit to Prambanan on your way to and from Yogyakarta Airport.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah
