Review Text:
Definitely worth a visit !!  Amazing & beautiful architecture with an interesting history.
The weather wasn't too favourable during my visit here, however this did not really dampen the overall experience and opportunity to spend some time here exploring.  Note: if you're a blonde female solo traveller - be prepared to exchange many photo opportunities with the locals if you're keen :-)

Reminds me of the Angkor complex in Cambodia -- although less of a scene than there. We went on a Sunday morning, and were one of only a handful of tourists who weren't Indonesian. There were many, many groups of school kids -- most of whom had the task to interview a "foreigner". (It was really endearing more than annoying to be mobbed by them.) The complex itself is rather large, but focuses on the grand Hindu temples which you will encounter first. Save your energy for these temples -- with the three big ones being Vishnu, Shiva and Brahma -- with a handful of other temples in the same complex. Shiva is center stage in this complex -- and I found it the most moving. There's a lot of detail to be observed here and a lot of exploration. 8th and 9th century temples which are still in pretty good shape. 

You can combine this visit with Borobudur for a discounted rate. (Currently 40.00 dollars two day pass.) There's a train that can help with getting around the whole area -- plus bikes and golf carts you can also rent. There are plenty of free bathrooms throughout the temples, a restaurant -- and a gauntlet of souvenir shops that you have to get through to reach the parking lot. 

The day we went -- there was a welcome drink of water, coffee or tea -- which we appreciated. Although we saw a sign for the museum, we actually never saw the buildling itself. 

As others have noted, the sun can be hot! So know your limits. There's also limited climbing to get into the interior of the temples.

Review Text: Wirklich eine lohnende Tempelanlage mit wunderschönen Gärten (und zahlreichen kleineren Tempeln). Wunderschöner Tempel!

Quite impressive 10th century Hindu temple, although parts of it have been reduced to rubble from the earthquakes. Most people congregate at the main Prambanan Temple structure, although there are a few other (smaller) temples in the overall compound. You can walk to each - skip the tacky train tour.

We went during the peak holiday period between Christmas and New Year, when much of Indonesia is on holiday. Hordes of domestic tourists, many school kids on school trips.

Note that the entrance for foreigners is separate from the (crowded) one for locals. You pay more (USD$25), but you also get to use a separate (cleaner) washroom.

Prambanan is about an hour from the north part of Jogja city, with traffic. We spent 2.5 hours there.

In accordance to the Borobodur, which is a buddhist temple, this one is hindoe.  It's huge towers can be seen between the forrest threes when entering the park.
You have 6 big towers on this domain.  The three biggest towers are the ones for Shiva, Visnu and Brahma.  The smaller towers in front of these are for their rides:
a holy cow, a bird and a goose.  This temple is still one of the biggest places hindu-pelgrims come to.  We saw some small rituals being performed for the gods in this temple.
It's less touristic then the Borobodur, but here too, you can see that tourism is taking over.  It's a nice place to visit when in Yogyakarta though!

Review Text: Faca primeiro Borobodur e depois Prambanan porque você compra o ingresso duplo e fica mais barato. Tem q ir nos dois.

Unlike, Borobdur, Prambanan is not really a great temple. Its just spread across large area and well maintained. Being an Indian I have probably seen many such temples in my country. Visit only if have extra time.

...I really do. But due to my travel plans I had to go on a Sunday, which was a mistake. First, even though I arrived early, the site was jampacked. It became hard to move between the five main buildings of the main complex, as the narrow pathways were completely stuffed with people. 

As a single white male, I also was stopped every minute or two for photos or a school-mandated basic english conversation, which gets a little old when you're just trying to absorb the experience of a 1200+ year old Hindu temple. 

Fortunately, the visitors to Prambanan only seem to believe it has the main complex. By walking less than 10 minutes from the main complex, I had several sites, including the mindblowing Candi Sewu, to myself. To show you both how small the world is, and how nobody does this, in a little offshoot temple in the greater complex I ran into someone who grew up 10 miles away from me. 

So the complex is an easy five stars, for me the experience was at best 3 stars, so we split the difference. Go on a weekday, and/or go early in the morning, and even then it'll depend on how comfortable you are with constant interruptions.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
I grow up with folktales of Roro Jonggrang, the story about the knight and the cursed princess and it feels like fairy tale for me to be here, like I feels the magic.
This is my story,  I've injured my leg before my trip to Jogja, so it's hard for me to go upstairs, when it was too many steep step. 
This temple is not really friendly for travelers with disabilities, no handle in the step. 
Overall this temple is really worth it for learning about historical of great Hindu in Nusantara. 

PS. I feels some bad spirit when I come closer to Siwa statue in Siwa temple, it feels like tight my leg

Prambanan temple is located on the main road between Yogyakarta and Solo. We can easily notice from the mainroad. 
I visited this temple on January 2, 2018. I thought the temple would be not that crowded after new year. But there was hundreds of people there. I had to be patient waiting for my turn entering temples and have a photo taking with gods statues.
This temple is as beautiful as my first visit when I was a child.
If you need to hear story and legend on the prambanan making there are many tour guides. But I chose not to have one.

I went to this UNESCO world heritage archaeological site in the afternoon. Even though most of the temple was destroyed by an earthquake, we were still privileged to witness the remaining 9th century temple. They were built using lock-and-key style. I was also mesmerised by the intricate designs on the temple. It is still a mystery on how such an ancient temple function as only certain temples have the statue of the Hindu gods and goddesses. Thankfully, we hired a knowledgeable guide who told us the history of the temple. I was also amazed by the folk story of the beautiful lady becoming one of the statues. The guide was good as we were told about different stories when we passed by the stone carvings One of which is the story of Ramayana and Sita.

Don't forget to stay till sunset. The view is magnificent. As it was getting late, we headed back to the hotel. If there was more time, one can stay for performance for the open theatre and be shown Javanese dance. The story of Ramayana and Sita can be depicted through the dance.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
We opted for a late-afternoon visit and although it was quite full, especially due to the holiday time, it was still ok to get around and explore and get some photos.

Nothing like Angkor but a nice spot to visit with an impressive set of temples and well-restored. 

All the local tourists seem to only visit the main temple complex so we actually enjoyed walking out through the other smaller temples which we more or less had completely to ourselves until closing time. The furthest out temple was the most interesting to visit and had a nice atmosphere being all alone there.

We would recommend getting the combination-ticket with Borobudur to at least save some on the very high ticket prices.

Getting there and back is quite easy on the air-conditioned Transjogja bus as no need to change buses and you just get off at the last stop. Allow about 1 hour each way. Only 3500 per person each way. It’s about 15-20 minute walk to the entrance from the bus stop and just make sure you are going in the right direction (past all the food stands).
Great and very nice temple. Clean toilet for visitor. Very good museum. Overall is well maintained temple complex...keep it!

Zabytek wyjątkowy, wart zwiedzenia. Cały kompleks świątynny wymaga przygotowania. Zwiedzanie każdej części świątyni to znakomity dowód na mistrzostwa budowniczych. Warto zabrać latarkę czołową by słabo oświetlone pomieszczenie móc podziwiać w pełnej krasie.

I visited Prambanan temple during peak season so it was quite crowded. The entrance fee for adult (December 2017) is 40.000 IDR, quite expensive but it's worth it! Because the area is neat and well-maintained. Don't forget to bring water and umbrella/hat/cap/as you want because it's so hot! This temple is not really suitable for elderly because the stairs in the temple is so high.

Review Text: It is strange that Yogyakarta which is 90 % muslim is home to the Borobudur budhist and Prambanan Hindi temple, build from 8 century to the 9th century. The Prambanan temples have more that 290 temple, and are continuously being restored after it was destroyed by mt. Merapis eruptions. At the center are 5 big temples, where the guide explained. It has a lot of carvings and status. There are trams and golf card that takes you to the many temple. All in all the complex is big and reminds me of Ankorwat in Cambodia.

Review Text: This temple has thousand temples surrounding. If you explore until Sewu Temple, well I suggested you all using bike or by walking cos the location from Prambanan to Sewu around 300 metres. In Prambanan itself, the temple has three big temples and many rocks temple surrounding. My friends and I felt happy when visited this place due to we took photoshoot from the rocks out of the main complex of Roro Jonggrang Temple. Also we did walking around due to many people inside the Roro Jonggrang and lucky we found the best spot. The ticket is IDR 40K and there is a package tour IDR 75K if we would like to visit Ratu Boko Temple. This place is very recommended one.

We went midday and between the crowds, heat and humidity, the conditions were pretty far from ideal (go early or late).  Still, the temples are extremely impressive.  Very different from Borobodur.  FYI, the combo ticket (all int'l tickets?) includes the little 'train' ride.  Modest dress is recommended, but many people did not obey and no one seemed to care.

The restaurant in a nearby little village that our guide took us to - and many others from the looks of it - is fine but definitely priced for int'l tourists.  A small Bintang beer was 50k IDR.  Be warned lest you get sticker shock.

Review Text: Bagi saya tiada candi yang lebih cantik dari candi prambanan. Kemegahannya mengagumkan mata dan keanggunan bangunannnya menentramkan jiwa

An amazing Hindu temple built about 100 years after the construction of Borobudur. Prambanan is located approximately a one hour drive from Borobudur and easily be done on the same day. The architecture is very different from Borobudur and looks very imposing as you approach. The Indonesian government has done a great job in integrating Prambanan into a family friendly park, keeping touts to a minimum and ensuring sufficient parking spaces for visitors. The site is very much a work in progress with evidence of continuing conservation work being done. Unlike Borodudur that has no internal chambers, Prambanan still has some of the statues inside the large structures. Worth a visit.

Review Text: The relics and architecture of the temples were beyond words. It also offers a beautiful view during afternoon and sunsets as you can see in below pictures. A must go to for you who stepped foot in Yogyakarta.

One of the beauty of ancient cultures and technologies. Different with Buddhist candi (temple) of Borobudur, Prambanan is a group of Hindu temples.  Each temple is dedicated for a certain god. The highest one stands up to 47 m. 

In my visit on 24-Dec-2017.. There was a tour package for both Prambanan and Ratu Bokor Temples for only 75K IDR per person, with shuttle bus included. Good deal..!! 

My wife and I also got a caricature picture from a local artist there. Its rate is 50K IDR for one person, and 80K IDR for couples. It could be varied depending on how many people and/or typical tourist (domestic or foreigner). Unfortunately, it is normal for foreigners to get a slightly higher rate. Well.. I guess.. Nobody doesn't need more money, right? Just try to bargain harder if you want.. LOL.

Anyway.. Tips.. Bring your cap or umbrella. The sun can be cruel. It could be deadly hot and humid. Use sun cream if needed. And bring a lot to keep being hydrated. 

At the end of your journey before the exit.. You will come to the shopping area. You will find a lot of options for souvenirs, from key chains, food, clothes, to high-end art items. 

Thus, if you like an adventure.. Like to explore.. Like to walk a lot.. Prambanan could be a perfect option. It has so many candi (temples). You can learn a lot of culture and history there, if you like. So...Have fun..!

Review Text:
On your way to the Prambanan complex, prepare yourself by visiting the small candi along the way – Kalasan, Sari and Sambisari. Not only are they worth a visit in their own right, but the entrance fee is a mere 10,000 rupiah and there are few if any visitors.

The entrance fee for the Prambanan complex is decidedly pricey. The large complex is well maintained, with lawns, large trees and good footpaths. In addition to the Prambanan buildings themselves, the ground contains Candi Lumbung, Bubrah and Sewu. It can be argued that the most impressive is Candi Sewu, even though much of it has collapsed.

There is also a museum, which was closed during our visit.

At the exit, you have to pass the gauntlet of souvenir shops to return to the car park. This is nowhere near as bad as at Borobodur. This was useful as it was still raining and had been raining heavily during our visit and our shoes were soaked. The stalls are covered and we bought some cheap flip-flops.

Visited Prambanan after a visit to Borobudur.  Good to explore and compare the structural and architecture difference between that of Hindu and Buddhist temple.  Heartwarming to see that both of the Temples being restored and conserved through the passage of time.  Be prepared on the steep ticker pricing difference between a local and foreigner.

Review Text:
Both Borobudur and Prambanan are such great sights. Both built about the same time with Prambanan built later. The Prambanan temple is the largest Hindu temple of ancient Java, and the first building was completed in the mid-9th century. It was likely started by Rakai Pikatan as the Hindu Sanjaya Dynasty's answer to the Buddhist Sailendra Dynasty's Borobudur and Sewu temples nearby.

Prambanan Temple Compounds contains the original structures that were built in the 9th century AD. The temples collapsed due to earthquake, volcanic eruption and a shift of political power in the early 11th century, and they were rediscovered in the 17th century. These compounds have never been displaced or changed.

Very impressed with how the sites are preserved. It's majestic as you imagine how ancient this ruins is!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Borobudur is the main attraction and reason to visit Jogja but Prambanan is certainly worth your time as well.  If you’re staying near Borobudur you can visit Prambanan straight from the airport.

We took a package of going to Prambanan & Borobudur in which the Travel Agent said that we saved compared to buying it separately but still we find the rate for tourist is very much expensive compared to the local rates. Security aan de voet van de tempel derigeerde ons (standaard) de andere kant op te gaan, met het gevolg dat wij een omweg moeten maken om weer terug bij de auto te kunnen komen. Niet alleen wij, maar alle toeristen moeten zo’n omweg maken. Dit met de bedoeling dat toeristen langs de kraampjes lopen waar allerlei spullen te koop worden aangeboden. Ik ben speciaal met de auto weer terug gereden naar de ingang en heb de manager van het complex erop aangesproken dat ze moeten waken dat senioren en met name die slecht ter been zijn natuurlijk liever niet omweg maken. Review Text: Sangat bagus buat wisata keluarga, dalam rangka meningkatkan pengetahuan tentang maha karya bangsa indonesia dalam peradapan seni memahat batu yang punya nilai seni yang tinggi

Dit geweldige tempelcomplex is ongeveer in 850 n.Chr. gebouwd en bestaat uit een aantal hoofd-tempels met aan beide zijkanten nog enkele tempelgebouwen (genaamd: candi) waaromheen in totaal nog eens 224 pewara (heiligdommetjes) stonden met kleine hoogteverschillen waardoor het geheel er uitzag als een soort van "getrapte piramide". Snel na de afbouw werd het complex al weer verlaten en begon het te vervallen en pas in 1893 is men beginnen met afgraven en in 1918 werd de reconstructie hervat. Begin jaren 50 van de vorige eeuw is het hoofdgebouw voltooid en tot op de dag van vandaag is men nog druk bezig met de heropbouw van tempels en penara. Omdat veel van de originele bouwstenen elders zijn hergebruikt of zelfs ontvreemd is het een kostbaar karwei; uit de grote "bergen met stenen" die er nog liggen moet minstens 75 % van de originele steenwerk bij elkaar gezocht zijn en beschikbaar voor de herbouw. Toen wij in 1995 hier waren stonden er slechts een paar tempels en intussen zijn er 19 in volle glorie te bezichtigen. Volgens onze gids Jono die een duidelijk verhaal had, is de belangrijkste  45 meter hoge hoofdtempel de Lara Jonggrang - ten onrechte vaak genoemd als "de Prambanan" - gewijd aan Shiva met daaromheen ten noorden en zuiden tempels voor Vishnoe en Brahma. De Shiva-tempel met 4 toegangspoorten heeft de bekende reliëfs van de Boom des Levens met veel dieren-afbeeldingen. Het complex staat na de herbouw als gevolg van de ernstige beschadiging  bij de aardbeving op Midden-Java van 2006 op de werelderfgoed-lijst van Unesco.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The Prambaban temple looks quite a bit like Angkor Wat, and many other temples in Cambodia for that matter. Each temple is however quite special in its own way. Review Text:
i bought combo tickets for prambanan and borobudur, can save more. this is ancient ruins, with amazing story. i was amazed by the details, which is great for photography. there is main temple surrounded by other temples. the design for each are similar. prambanan temple has its own charm, not to be missed during your trip to yogyakarta and this temple was easy, as compared to borobudur. no steep stairs, easily accessible.

To learn about people you have to learn about their history and this site, in conjunction with other temple sites in the area, certain helps gain that knowledge. It would be a mistake to draw comparisons with other temple sites (such as  Angkor) as the historical development is different even though there are undeniable architectural similarities with the spread of the Hindu religion?culture.

Review Text: A trimurthi temple, based on Brahma (The creator), Vishnu (The Preserver) and Shiva (The destroyer). Apart from the structures dedicated to these 3 gods, much of complex is in ruins.Though it is often compared to and overshadowed by the Angkor Wat,it is huge and is considered to be the second largest Hindu temple outside India! This is historical place that you should visit when in yogyakarta. Very close to the city. Got a knowledge from tour guide about roro jonggrang is just a folklore.

L'ensemble de temples, vieux de plus de 1200 ans, offre une perspective imposante lorsque l'on s'en approche et surprend à Java, car on se croirait plutot dans le sud de l'Inde.
Les monuments sont bien conservés ainsi que les magnifiques bas reliefs et les statues de dieux hindouistes à l'intérieur de chaque temple.
La visite est assez sportive sous un soleil de plomb car l'accès à chaque temple se fait par un escalier abrupt, mais les vues que l'on a de l'ensemble du site en hauteur font ne pas regretter ces "ascensions".
Contrairement à Borobodur, cet ensemble est peu fréquenté par les touristes étrangers...ce qui en augmente son charme.

Located to the east of Yogyakarta, the temples rise majestically. The stone walls are rich of elaborate carvings. Some temples are in various states of ruin, but the beauty is not lost, though. Get ready to burn if you arrive here at noon. You can get into the temple, which is dark inside, and you will see some sort of god statues, which I believe there must be legends or stories behind.

Review Text:
台風接近のために前日は豪雨でした。当日の未明（～6時）も雨であったのであまり期待せずにプランバナン寺院に行きましたが(7時50分ごろ到着）、雨があがり多少日も差すようになり、ラッキーでした。外壁の像が雨でしっとり濡れ、非常に感情がこもった有様で絶好なシャッターチャンスを提供してくれました。
出発したホテルは寺院の西15kmに位置しており、行きはタクシーを使いました(120000ルピア）。往復のチャーターもできたのですが（250000ルピア）、観光地だしたやすくタクシーを見つけられるであろうとたかをくくり、片道のみを選択為ました。一方通行の逆方向なので多少迂回をしたこと、ラッシュに当たっていたことから45分ぐらいかかって寺院に到着。入場料はクレジットカードで支払い可能です。25米ドル分のルピア(この日は337000ルピア）を支払い入場し、1時間30分ほど当地におりました。帰りに困ったのは、タクシーがまったくいないことです。しかしラッキーなことにバイクタクシーのお誘いがあり、値段を聞いたところ70000ルピアだったので（値切ることもできるかもしれません）即決。振り落とされるのを避けるため、しっかりバイクにしがみついていたため、ホテルに到着した時は全身がこわばってました。しかし初めてバイクタクシーを経験できたこと、また行きの半分以下の時間で帰れたことを考えると実に満足な経験です。
当日は時間の関係で近くにある仏教寺院を訪問できませんでした。仏教寺院も訪問するのならば3時間程度は必要に思います。

The temples are interesting but nothing to brag about. Hard to enjoy with the hordes of students taking selfies. Unfortunately, the museum was closed the day of my visit. The museum gardens looked lovely. (The workers let me view them from the entryway).

There is more than one temple to view. Take a walk around the grounds to see other temples in various states of ruin.
Letaknya dipinggir jalan raya jogja solo..arealnya luas dan semakin tertata rapi juga bersih. Idealnya berwisata candi waktunya kalau nggak pagi ya sore hari. Biaya tiket masuk Rp 40.000
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: One of the most impressive Hindu temples I have ever seen. Make sure not to miss the Buddhist Temple Sewu which is situated in the same compound!

The temples are amazing, we were there around sunset and it was sublime. The colour and the structure with the blue skies background is stunning. But its very touristy and lots of Indonesians want to take picturrs with your kids, so be aware and prepared!

Prambanan is a very beautiful place. Some of you might cant resist with the heat of this place but that's not even matter. Because it's historical-monumental place in Indonesia. You should visit there.

But unfotunately, there are some ppl that couldnt take responsiblity to put their own garbage/trash there.

What a stunning place. Fascinating to walk around. Pretty busy when we were there around 9am. 

Must have been awe inspiring when they 're-discovered' it. Lots of restoration work has been done and more is on going.

Van afstand is dit al indrukwekkend, en dit prachtige bouwwerk mag je gewoon beklimmen! Ga zeker kijken met zonsondergang, dit geeft prachtige beelden. Wij hebben een rondleiding gehad van een gids en hij/zij vertelt veel interessante informatie die je anders niet gekregen zou hebben.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Toutes les religions ont leur place danss ce pays, c'est ce qui en fait l'équilibre. On passe du site bouddhique Borobudur à ce site hindou situé à une heure de route du centre-ville. Route en bus public pour 3500 IDR. L’entrée est à 60 000 pour les Indonésiens et …337 000 pour les étrangers. A chacun de juger. Ce monument en plusieurs édifices est très imposant et se parcourt dans l’attente d’un « fameux coucher de soleil » ce qui n’est évidemment pas toujours le cas. Si les contrejours sont encore trop forts sur la façade (côté entrée), commencer plutôt par le côté opposé pour les photos, la luminosité est encore belle. Constitué de blocs de basalte parfois finement sculptés, non jointés, l’ensemble a souffert du dernier tremblement de terre (5.9) en 2006. Il y a toujours des fouilles et des restaurations sous l’égide de l’UNESCO. Les quatre éléments qui entourent le principal édifice contiennent chacun la statue d’une divinité. D’autres éléments complètent cet ensemble qui siège sur une grande esplanade. Des allées périphériques permettent plus de recul pour apprécier la beauté et la grandeur du temple. On peut opter pour visite avec un guide, ou acheter la brochure, ce qui permet d’être pleinement informé des divinités et du sens des sculptures. A part à l'entrée et près des parkings, le site lui-même n'a ni bar ni restaurant, il faut en sortir.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Ik had een combinatie-ticket voor Borobudur en Prambanan en in dezelfde dag gedaan. Aan te raden om hiervoor een privé-chauffeur voor een dag voor te boeken, zodat je een powernapje kan doen in de auto.

Heb de zon op zien komen bij Borobudur en onder zien gaan bij Prambanan. Beide echt bijzondere bouwwerken. Ik reisde die dag met een Indiaas meisje die me veel kon vertellen over de goden en de ornamenten van de tempel. Dat maakte het extra bijzonder. Maar anders zijn er ook flyers met uitleg in diverse talen te vinden, o.a. in het Nederlands.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: You guys should visit this temple. Upon arriving there, i felt there was alot of heritage going on in this temple. Not looking at the temple as a whole, I did take a look at the details of each building and it is amazing. Come on down and experience it yourself.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
One of the best restored Hindu temples in the world. The beautiful architecture was put together centuries after the whole complex was flattened by the erupting volcano. Gorgeous carvings, imposing statutes and the imposing temples are set within well tended gardens make this a must visit place. Do give yourself enough time to explore and experience the whole complex.

Don’t forget to see the Ramayana Ballet in the evening, from where you’ll be treated to an unforgettable view of the Temple.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Uhh no idea what should I write, because it's really classic and I love it, it's make me and my friends know better about the history.. just please keep clean the area, it's will be perfect.. will come again
Something about the uniqueness of the structure. Beautiful,artistic temples. Even partly of the temples was destroyed by an earthquake but the main temple still standing majestically.

Brahma, Shiva and Vishnu as central temples - in a form of Mandalas, build in the 9th cent.  as an opposition to the buddhist Borobudur. A Unesco cultural heritage.  Great monument. A bit expensive entrance fee even in a combo w / Borobudur. Sewu is included and you can visit a small zoo : horses, deers and exotic birds.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Selalu mengesankan setiap mengunjungi candi prambanan. Megah, hasil karya yg mengagumkan. Wisata yg sangat mendidik, sangat cocok utk keluarga dgn anak2. Perlu perbaikan untuk jalan akses bagi orang tua dan anak2. Karena pintu keluar sangat jauh dan memutar. Utk orang tua yg menggendong anak kecil yg sedang tidur menempuh jalan keluar lokasi wisata sangat melelahkan. Potensi cidera pinggang dan punggung. Sebaiknya bawa kereta bayi
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: First visited Prambanan 20 years ago and it was with the same awe that i visited again recently.  The earthquake of 2006 has affected the main temple which elegantly rises up before you.  The detailed carvings are intricate and the whole complex is calmer and less touristy that Borobudur.  We hired bikes to visit the temples at the furthest reaches of the complex grounds which was definitely worthwhile. Don't leave Yogakarta without visiting.

Il sito merita una visita, sicuramente la luce tagliente del tramonto lo rende suggestivo e fotogenico. Nel biglietto d'ingresso è compresa una bibita e/o un'acqua, usufruitene appena entrati, perché poi non sarà più possibile raggiungere il bar.

Don't get me wrong Borobudur is a UNESCO site for a reason. It is large and impressive with all of the detail.  For some reason though Prambanan had more of a impact on me. Something about the uniqueness of the structures. I a sure this was even more impressive before an earthquake in the area.
I prefer Prambanan rather than Borobudur temple... It has several beautiful temples rather than one big temple like Borobudur.  Beautiful, artistic, worth visited and lots of instagramable spot

Prambanan temple saat ini sudah ditata sedemikian rupa sehingga menjadi lokasi wisata sejarah yang nyaman dikunjungi.  Selesai melihat Candi Prambanan, kita bisa singgah di ruang teather untuk mempelajari lebih banyak mengenai cerita yang terpatri pada relief2 candi.  Namun sayang, jalan dari Yogyakarta menuju Candi Prambanan agak macet.

A really beautiful Hindu temple which was partly destroyed by an earthquake in 2006. The main temples are still standing though and are in „good shape“. There are a lot of beautiful reliefs to discover that tell Hindu God stories. We had a really good guide so it was even more interesting to discover everything. Really a must-see when you’re in Yogyakarta.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Saya tidak menyangka Candi Prambanan itu secantik ini apalagi langit senja sebagai backroundnya. 

Saran saya, lebih bagus agak sore ke sini. Pemandangannya bagus. Namun, jangan lebih dari jam 5 sore karena loket sudah ditutup.

Maravilloso conjunto de 4 templos incluidos en la entrada. El templo de Prambanam es el más espectacular y el mayor. Recuerda al templo de Angkot Wat en Camboya, aunque más pequeño. Debido a que la entrada al conjunto arqueológico lleva directamente a este templo, la mayoría de las personas no visitan los tres templos restantes. El más lejano, el templo de Sewu, es otra maravilla arquitectónica. Hay un trenecito que hace paradas en cada templo, incluido en la entrada. Pero nosotros decidimos llegar a los templos paseando. Si no tienes problemas de piernas, se llega pronto y es agradable el paseo. Unos 5 ó 7 minutos de un templo a otro. En el recinto también hay un lugar donde comprar algún refresco.
 Si como nosotros decides ir por tu cuenta y sin guías. Se coge un autobús en la céntrica calle Malioboro que te lleva hasta los templos. Por sólo 50 centimos de euro.

Même si beaucoup de touristes se limitent au temple "candi Prambanan", il serait dommage de ne pas voir les autres temples qui sont tout proches. Certes, le candi Prambanan est le plus grand et le moins abimé (les statues sont émouvantes et les frises sur les extérieurs valent le détour pour leur bestiaire et les détails des scènes de vie) mais le candi Sewu, même en partie délabrée, est également est très bel ensemble et sans aucun touriste.

Insieme al complesso di Borobudur è un posto che deve essere visto, noi siamo arrivati dopo pranzo e il sito era abbastanza affollato ma tutto sommato vivibile.
Abbiamo incontrato due studentessa che per far pratica con l'inglese ci hanno fatto da guida per il sito gratuitamente e facendoci apprezzare ancor di più il posto.
Il complesso è stato in gran parte ristrutturato dopo il terremoto che praticamente lo aveva raso a zero.
Si può fare il biglietto combinato con il tempio di Borobudur da utilizzare entro 2 giorni per 1080000RP per due persone (68€)
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Stati oggi, molto bello!!!
Appena entrati due ragazze del posto si sono offerte di farci da guida per migliorare il loro inglese, troverete tanti studenti che si offrono a questo scopo.
Grazie a loro abbiamo scoperto la storia di questo imponente tempio, visitate le 4 camere della torre principale con relativa storia.
Molto molto bello, considerate un paio d'ore di visita.
Il biglietto se combinato anche con la visita a Borobudur costa 1.080.000 RP, circa 68 euro x 2 persone.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
ジョグジャカルタから見て空港を越えたすぐの場所にあります。
「午後〜夕方くらいに飛行機に乗る人が午前中から行く」「午前中に空港に到着した人が見学してからホテルにチェックイン」とかが効率的にちょうど良いと思います。
(トランスジョグジャでもジョグジャ市内〜空港〜プランバナン寺院と向かい、帰りはその逆になります)

外国人はもちろん、現地の子供たちも社会科見学で来ています。遺跡内自体は混み合っていて、階段などは注意が必要です

入場料は、インドネシア人と外国人で分かれており、私が行った時で337,500ルピア。
米ドル建で換算しており、レートによって頻繁に変わるようです。

敷地自体は広大な公園となっており、他の寺院も点在しています。距離が離れているので、全部見て回りたい人は、入場してすぐのところにあるレンタサイクルを借りましょう。
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Sejak dulu hingga kini, Candi Prambanan tetap menjadi kawan favorit para turis baik turis mancanegara maupun turis domestic. Ketika mengunjungi Candi Prambanan disarankan utk memakai jasa tour guide sehingga bukan segera melihat-lihat bangunanya saja tetapi juga dapat mengetahui history nya. Sehingga bukan sekadar jalan-jalan biasa tetapi jalan-jalan berfaedah.

Nous y sommes allés en scooter depuis Yogyarkarta. Au départ on est un peu déçu car c est une veritable usine a touriste, on s'attendait a un temple paisible au fin fond de la forêt!! Rien a voir c est en pleine ville, avec des dizaines de warung pour vous accueillir, et pour courroner le tout, un tarif "locaux" et un tarif "étranger" 10 fois plus cher!!!!
Ça reste à voir, les monuments sont impressionnants, et au coucher de soleil la lumière est splendide.

This ancient Hindu temple looks impressive as you get close to it. We had a guide who pointed out some of the more historical and religious elements of it. It certainly is a magnificent site and we had the benefit of local school children asking for photos and interviews to try out their English.

I have also been to Angkor Wat and it is not on the scale of the latter but is certainly worth a visit.

Anda dapat melihat peninggalan bersejarah yg cukup menarik, sy sarankan anda menaiki kereta khusus untuk berkeliling hingga candi sewu, karena candinya cukup menarik untuk diabadikan dan tidak banyak pengunjung, arealnya cukup bersih dan tersedia pusat souvenir dengan harga yg sangat terjangkau mulai dari Rp 1.000,-
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Indonesian must be proud to have this historical temple PRAMBANAN TEMPLE. I went here and spent almost 1 hour to look around , there was also guide optionally with payment to learn more about its story.
Como en Borobudur, la entrada es muy cara, aunque descuento si compras las dos juntas y si llevas el carnet de estudiante. El templo es precioso (una versión muy pequeñita de Angkor Wat en Camboya)
Dit is een mooi tempelcomplex met veel details om te bekijken. Maar vanuit een punt eea geruime tijd zittend te bekijken is ook een goede optie.

Indrukwekkend om deze tempel te bekijken. Neem een gids bij de ingang ze vertellen veel en wijzen je op veel details die je anders ontgaan. De zonsondergang maakt het extra mooi. Het is een van de hoogte punten van Java. De tempel ligt in een mooie omgeving. Je kunt hier makkelijk een halve dag doorbrengen. Neem wel wat water mee.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: 인도네시아의 힌두사원인 쁘람바난은 족자 도시에서 1시간 가량 떨어진 곳에 위치해 있고 비교적 덥고 햇빛이 강하니 양산이나 우산을 준비해가시면 도움 될거 같습니다. 둘러보는데는 1시간정도면 충분하다고 생각됩니다.
Tempatnya bersih dari sampah, lingkungannya indah dan tidak ada penjual keliling seperti di candi borobudur. Waktu berkunjung beli tiket terusan borobudur dan prambanan dgn harga 75rb

El precio de la entrada para turistas es excesivamente cara. Hemos viajado por India viendo sus templos gratis o por poco dinero. Nuestra experiencia como mochileros nos demuestra que este tipo de lugares son negocios que se aprovechan de los extrangeros de manera exagerada. No participaremos de esta tomadura de pelo. Hemos visto muchas personas dar media vuelta en la puerta de entrada por su precio exagerado.

I highly recommend these temples, but also we had to pay guide (at the place, wright next to entrance) and it was the best spended 6€. He is great speaker, he told us some info (like years of buildings, names of the royals, years of earthquake, etc) but for us the best part was presentation of the ramajana story portrayed on the walls of shiva temple. Our guide was dancer at ramajana performance, and he still has it. His moves and performance of the story was excellent. I regret that we didn’t make photo with him🤦🏻‍♀️
ジョグジャカルタ発のツアーで訪問しました。現在残っている遺跡は中心部のみで、本来は周辺にも小さな寺院がたくさんあったそうですが、災害で倒壊してしまい、修復されないまま地元住民などによって持ち帰られてしまったそうです。寺院自体はとても見どころが多く、ぜひガイド付で見て回っていただきたいです。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: One of the most beautiful Hindu's temple. It was my third visit, but the first time with kiddos. I thought kiddos wouldn't excited. But yeaaay.. "I love this place, Dad. It's amazing that Javanese people able to bricking this giant temple like a giant lego."

Take your time to go there...it's also nice to see the sunset, the whole area and read about the history of the temple. 
It's just awesome!

Die Tempelanlage ist sehr schön, wurde vor einigen Jahren bei einem Erdbeben leider stark beschädigt. Hier gibt es (wie an den meisten Orten) sehr viele Touristen. Trotzdem kann man sich die Zeitnehmen die man braucht / möchte um alles zu erkunden. 
Wir wurden von "Tourist-Hunters" (einer Englisch-Lernenden Schulklasse) angesprochen. Wir unterhielten uns bestimmt eine Stunde (Fragen über unsere Heimat / Kultur, unseren Urlaub bisher, und Tipps ihrerseits). Das war ein sehr schönes Erlebnis!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: ジャワ島と言うとボロブドゥール遺跡が有名ですが、ここプランバナン遺跡も必見です！遺跡内敷地も広く、遺跡も大きく見ごたえがありました。過去の地震で倒壊してしまった塔があるそうで、その昔は地元の方たちは持って帰って自分の家に使ってしまたそうで、崩れたままの状況も一味も二味もありました。アンコールも行きましたがどことなくスリムで力強さ神秘さも感じられました。

Coming here with TransJogja bus and a short walk from its bus stop was a pure bliss. I was paying a entrance ticket and was given a sarong to wear since it is a temple as well. I came to explore ancient creation which is still magnificent although it hit with strong earthquake and ashes from nearby mount Merapi eruptions. The fallen blocks remains us how the nature damaged the structure of this temple. But,the rest is still beautiful
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Kami ke Candi Prambanan sekitar siang hari. Bawa payung. atau topi jika anda ke sini saat siang hari. Dari jalan masuk anda dapat melihat candi ini dari kejauhan. Di pintu masuk ditawarkan beberapa paket ke Candi lainnya, tapi kami pilih ke Prambanan saja. Anda dapat ambil foto dari kejauhan tepatnya di bawah suatu pohon yang besar untuk mengabadikan seluruh bangunan candi. Nah ini yang gak enaknya, jalan keluarnya dibuat muter-muter sama pengelola. Jalannya keluarnya lebih pendek daripada jalan keluar Candi Borobudur. Orang Indonesia wajib datang ke Candi Prambanan

Salah satu tempat wisata yang wajib di kunjungi, candi bersejarah dan punya nilai mistis.
Salah satu peninggalan sejarah Hindu....
Sangat mengagumkan, bagus untuk study tour untuk pelajaran sejarah, anak saya sangat suka datang kesini, di pagi hari atau sore hari waktu yang menyenangkan untuk explore prambanan, karena tidak terlalu panas
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Prambanan temple was built by Hindus devotees many hundred years ago when most Javanese hasn’t converted to Moslem yet. 
Most of the temples still remain intact, while few had been destroyed during last 2006 earthquake in Yogyakarta. 
It is an interesting place for those who likes artifacts and history - also a good place to take nice pictures. 
It is located in the border of Yogyakarta and could be a good spot to watch sunset.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Naast de Borobudur een must als je in Yogjakarta bent. Hoewel kleiner in omvang zeker niet minder interessant. Het is mogelijk een toegangskaart te kopen in combi met de Borobudur totaal 35.00 euro pp
Ini candi exotic banget.. udah deket sama klaten.. candi borobudur ini merupakan candi bersejarah.. dari bandara adisucipto menuju candi ini memakan waktu kurang lebih 15 menit menggunakan kendaraan
Peninggalan candi hindu yang luar biasa ... Begitu megah, tapi jangan lupa bawa payung . Karna panas sekali
Lokasi di pinggir kota dimana banyak bertebaran candi-candi kecil di sekitar wilayah candi prambanan
Peninggalan nenek moyang yang luar biasa...jangan lupa bawa payung karna panas sekali . Prambanan sempat direnovasi karena gempa, tapi sekarang sudah bagus

short history of The Prambanan temple
is the largest Hindu temple of ancient Java, and the first building was completed in the mid-9th century
A temple was first built at the site around 850 CE by Rakai Pikatan and expanded extensively by King Lokapala and Balitung Maha Sambu the Sanjaya king of the Mataram Kingdom
------------
above all, its really great temple along with great ancient story !!
Très beau temple où respire une certaine sérénité! Prendre le temps de poser pour une photo avec les locaux est non seulement très sympathique mais fait partie du rituel!

I would definitely say that Prambanan is way more worth visiting if you have to choose between Borobudur or Prambanan. Don't miss the Sewu temple while you are there, it's worth the walk!

//Jacken

Prambanan es un conjunto de más de 200 templos hindúes que están dedicados a la Trímurti, la expresión de Dios como el Creador (Brahma), el Preservador (Visnú) y el Destructor (Shivá).
El Patrimonio de la Humanidad según UNESCO y se encuentra a 18 km de Yogyakarta.
Muy lindo lugar.
Recomendable.
Lo hicimos por tour. En el día hicimos Merapi, Borobudur y Prambanan.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Any place that has been in the path of destructive and vengeful muslim invaders leaves a tell-tale signs of total and complete destruction of everything in its path - so is the story of Prambanan Temple. 

It must have been a large and ancient temple site but all that remains is really the destroyed remains of once (probably a 1000-1200  years ago) magnificent temples. What has been done in more recent time (perhaps in the last 40-50 years) is rebuilding of the temple complex - on-site - with construction of new temples - in the old style - on in full swing in plain view right on the site itself. One can easily make out that most of the temples have been reconstructed (with old damaged pillars / stone slabs replaced by newly carved stones - sufficiently cleverly carved not to look too good or too neatly done)

It is very similar to similar Hindu Temples found in Thailand (which have not been reconstructed - and so are really in a ruinous state - as they were left by the muslim invadors). This one is just a redone-up version of the same.

The entry charge is again a rip-off - IDR 350,000 per head. So quite a put-off.

Ini kunjungan saya pertama kalinya ke candi prambanan di jogjakarta..

Ternyata lokasinya gak jauh dari kota jogja (re: malioboro), sekitar 40 menit saja!! no macet (jalan sekitar jam 9 dari hotel di daerah malioboro).

Saat masuk kesini, dari pintu depan, memang gak keliatan bentuk candinya macem di borobudur. Tapi lapangan parkir yang luas, cukup menguras tenaga kalo kita parkir kendaraannya jauh dari pintu karcis. fyi, jalur masuk dan jalur keluar candi BERBEDA. jadi disarankan, parkir mobilnya di jalur keluar candi aja, biar gak terlalu jauh jalannya nanti.

Disini mereka punya paket. Kalo mau ke candi prambanan aja, harga tiket masuknya Rp 45.000 per orang. Tapi kalo mau masuk ke candi prambanan dan candi ratu boko (paket) yaitu Rp 85.000 (kalo gak salah) per orang. Nanti dianter gitu sama mobil mereka, jadi kita tinggal di jemput balik ke candi prambanan menggunakan kendaraan mereka. Lebih ekonomis 5000 rp sih memang, cuma untuk kita yang mau lanjut jalan lagi, kayanya mending ambil per satu-satu aja, biar bisa langsung gausah bolak balik lagi ke candi prambanan.

Jarak candi prambanan ke candi ratu boko, jauh???
- enggak kok sebenernya, jaraknya kalo naik mobil sekitar 15-20 menit aja.. deketan ko mereka

disini super panas. yaiyalah di wilayah candi kan..

disaat jalur keluar, banyak penjual pernak pernik seperti di candi borobudur atau di monas (gambarannya). tapi jangan mau ketipu harga ya, harus pinter-pinter nawar dan memperkirakan apakah harganya wajar atau tidak.

Buat yang capek jalan, disini ada kereta yang mengelilingi wilayah candi ko, harganya per orang kalo ga salah 20.000, atau ada juga golf cart gitu harganya cukup mahal diatas 100rb per-jam.

Btw di sini, deket pintu keluar, ada rumah pohon gitu yang lucu bisa kita naikin, dan bisa skalian duduk-duduk dan mandang-mandang sekeliling candi. adem pula.
lokasinya pas di depan cafe serabi yang ada di dalem wilayah candi.

disini juga ada cafe ala-ala keraton yang jual serabi norotuman (kalo ga salah) harganya cuma 5.000 kok!! SUPER ENAK.
dan juga jual jamu ala jogja :D
wajib di coba..

Itu kurang lebih suasana di candi prambanan..
buat yang mau liat lokasi atau spot foto nya, bisa check di IG ( @herdinavm ) atau youtube ( dina manurung ) :)

Review Text:
Indrukwekkend dit bouwwerk. Helaas heeft een aardbeving een en ander vernield. Maar dat zijn ze heel langzaam weer aan het restaureren.
Wij waren er in september en dan is het redelijk rustig.

Visita obligada. Se puede entrar en los templos, cada uno tiene la figura de un dios, aunque si quieres verlo mejor lleva linterna. La entrada a los 2 templos (prambanan y borobudur ) cuesta 540,000. Hay descuento para estudiantes.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: They may be similar to others but this is not a reason to not visit. Very close to Jogjakarta and very accessible. Very beautiful  , wonderful architecture and even better if you can see performance of the nearby ballet with the temples in the background.
Que decir, es una visita obligada en Yogyakarta. El templo es espectacular y realmente impresiona. Algo cara la entrada comparado con otros.

Interesting architecture, much of the buildings have been restored and reassembled due to earthquakes. Still a nice place to walk around see 9th century architecture. Extremely busy on weekends, with tons of school kids.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Candi ini merupakan candi hindu. Pemandangan di sini sangat bagus sekali. Terdapat 3 candi utama di sini. Anda bisa membeli paket tiket candi prambanan & candi ratu boko. Di paket tersebut, sudah termasuk transport untuk menuju candi ratu boko pp dari prambanan, yang berangkat setiap 15-30 menit sekali.

일부러 프람바난 방문을 위해서 족자의 경계에 있는 쉐라톤으로 숙소를 정해서 라마야난 저녁공연두보고 낮에는 프람바난사원을 관광함. 
라마야난 저녁 공연이 매일 있지않아 공연은 전날 관람한 후, 사원은 그 다음날 오전에 일정짜서 방문. 힌두사원의 꽃인 프람바난은 힌두의 3대신인 브라흐만, 비슈누, 시바신의 신전과 그들의 자가용격인 가루다, 난디 등의 신전이 있다. 그외에도 아직도 복구 중인 사원이 훨씬 많은 상태이다. 천년의 사원이지만 아직도그 디테일이 살아움직일 듯 살아있어 보르드부르 보다 다 정교해보였다. 325kIDR 정도로 비싼 외국인 입장료지만 아깝지 않은 사원이다. 
 
라마야난 공연이 있는 날을 미리 검색하여, 낮엔 사원투어 저녁 공연을 본다면(VIP석 4만원선) 아마도 평생 잊지 못할 장면으로 기억될 듯 하며, 개인적으로 뿌라와사키 극장공연보다는 프람바난 야외공연을 강추한다. 야외공연이 있는 10월까지가 적기일듯..
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah, Merencanakan perjalanan

Review Text: jika kesini siang-siang jangan lupa bawa topi atau payung karena tempatnya sangat panas dan terik. tp seru pengalaman berharga naik motor pergi ke prambanan.

Good temples but a little copy of Angor wat temples.
Very good At the Sun set.
Nice market close to the temples

in 3 settimane di viaggio in Indonesia questo è il sito che più mi è piaciuto !
Siamo arrivati qui all'apertura alle 6 ed è stato meraviglioso, avevamo il sito tutto per noi, eravamo gli unici turisti! 
Poi con lo stesso biglietto siamo rientrati al tramonto ed in questa circostanza due giovani studenti locali c'hanno fatto un pò da ciceroni fornendoci un pò di spiegazioni sulla simbologia del tempio e dei suoi altorilievi .-)
Certo chissà come doveva essere spettacolare se non fosse stato tutto distrutto dal terremoto..
Consiglio poi di fermarvi a cena nel ristorante qui dietro che offre una bella vista sul tempio illuminato, meglio se prenotate perchè noi ci siamo arrivati alle 18,30 ed era tutto gia pieno purtroppo

Review Text:
Beautiful temples against a sunset backdrop. If you're up for it, try climbing among all the rumbles of the rock. I'm not sure if it's allowed but many people seemed to be doing that when I was there.

Overall, the environment was great and lots of photo-taking opportunities. A word of advise, bring along a face mask - it's really windy and dusty here!

Panaass nya luar biasa! Kalo bawa anak anak jangan lupa pakein dia topi atau kalau perlu pake sunglasses. Dan janfan lupa bawa air mineral selalu karena panasnya takut bikin mereka dehidrasi. 
Jangan lupa sambil jelaskan ke anak anak kita tentang sejarah di balik candi ini, apakah candi ini warisan hindu atau budha dengan cara yg fun tp edukatif. Jadi jalan jalan tidak cuma foto foto saja.

I was at the temple close to evening time. The best direction to take photos of yourself with the temples will be from the back.

While walking out towards the exit, you can take a nice overview of all the temples.
Une superbe visite en ce lieu historique et religieux. Impressionnant monument à découvrir pour son passé chargé d'histoire et la neauté du lieu
The temple itself is stunning and huge. There were plenty domestic come over the island but they are really nice people. Make sure bring your camera!
Nice temples. Takes about 1 to 2 hours to visit...too expensive. We want by bus 3000 rp and easy. We visited in the afternoon to go to the ballet.

Visited the temples last month and was really impressed. Just handfull of them are restored and you can only imagine how the complex would have been back when it was functional.
Again tonnes of guide book info out there so I will only mention couple of things here:
1. Plan your trip there to avoid excessive crowds and overexposure to the scorching sun.
2. Keep couple of hours to walk through the main complex and other small temples nearby.
3. Access from the parking lot to the temples and back is a LONG way, so get good sun protection.
I wish they would have spent some amount of the $$ they get from thousands of tourists paying US$25 to get some shade on the way...

Mérite le détour pour ces sculptures. Beaucoup de détérioration par le temps.....ou vandalisme sur certaines sculptures
Les marches sont irrégulières, et souvent hautes, glissantes par temps pluvieux.
La vue sur les alentours est magnifique, mais pour les visiteurs à bobos articulaires l'accès au sommet du temple est à proscrire.
Il est à noter qu'une rampe inox bien conçue permet facilement l'accès au premier niveau de terrasse, et permet déjà d'apprécier le site en étant assis sur des bancs confortables.
Quant aux remarques sur les prix, de nombreux pays, et pas qu'en Asie, pratiquent un prix ethnique et un prix touristes.

Thousand years before here people was Hinduism and Buddhist they build up nice temple old culture of Ramayana, still can see most of Hindu and Buddhist temple in Indonesia sumatra java bali etc.

Review Text: 世界文化遺產之一，實在是很壯觀，來日惹必去的重要景點，慢慢一步步的沈靜在這歷史古寺中，感受文化古蹟的洗禮

So much has been restored since the 2006 earthquake in such a sympathetic way not to remove any of the original impact
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Oltre che il complesso di Borobudur, un altro complesso di templi induisti si trova nei pressi della città di Yogyakarta. Prambanan. Anche questa struttura è circondata da un parco molto esteso e da una struttura teatrale, una grande arena all'aperto, dove vengono rappresentati spettacoli di danza e teatrali. Il complesso è costituito da molti templi di forma conica che sono gli unici rimasti dopo i grandi terremoti uno nel 1600 e l'altro recente del 2006. Sono rimasti quasi integri i tre grandi templi dedicati a Shiva, Brahma e Vishnu. Sono costruzioni di grande bellezza e scenografia.

In addition to the Borobudur complex, another Hindu temples complex is located near the city of Yogyakarta. Prambanan. This structure is surrounded by a very large park and a theater, a large outdoor arena, where dance and theater are represented. The complex is made up of many conic-shaped temples that are the only ones left after the great earthquakes one in 1600 and the other recent in 2006. The three great temples dedicated to Shiva, Brahma and Vishnu remained almost intact. They are great-looking buildings and scenery.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: sudah kesekian kali saya kesini setiap kali saya liburan ke jogja, aksesnya pun cukup mudah untuk menuju objek wisata candi prambanan. jika dari kota jogja bisa naik bus trans jogja 1A yang rute terakhir halte prambanan, setelah itu bisa jalan kaki ataupun naik becak ke wisaat candi prambanan, kalau dari arah solo/klaten ke candi lokasi sudah strategis karena ada jalur bis karena tempatnya sudah dekat. sangat disarankan jika ke wisata  candi ini pada pagi hari sekitar pukul 6 pagi karena cuaca masih terasa sejuk, dan berkabut, dibanding siang hari yang sangat panas dan terik.

Этот храмовый комплекс называется “Лара Джонгранг» (стройная дева). Находится в городе Прамбанан. В самом центре комплекса расположен храм Шивы, в котором огромная, 3-х метровая статуя бога Шивы- считается, что этот храм самый красивый во всем комплексе. Также есть храмы, посвящённые индуистским богам Брахме и Вишну. Без относительно знания об индуизме, этих богах, а только основываясь на ощущениях, безусловно, место интересное, завораживающее, и притягивающее к себе архитектурой и энергетикой. Огромное количество туристов, в том числе местных. Мы были с индивидуальным гидом, который посоветовал не очень сильно обращать внимание на их просьбы сфотографироваться. Это только сначала увлекательно, а потом выстраивается очередь это может происходить бесконечно. В целом место конечно же является уникальным и обязательным к посещению на Яве.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Wer einmal in Angkor in Kambodscha war, wird hier sicher das ein oder andere Element wieder erkennen. Natürlich ist der Prambanan nicht annähernd so groß, trotzdem lohnt sich der Besuch. An den einzelnen Gebäuden gibt es schöne, gut erhaltene bzw. restaurierte Reliefe zu sehen. 

Ich würde den Besuch zum Sonnenuntergang empfehlen. Das weiche Licht strahlt die Tempel an. Ideal für schöne Fotos. Man sollte sich von einem Taxi oder Mietfahrer hinfahren lassen. Dann wird man direkt am Eingang abgesetzt. Die Wege in der Anlage sind ohnehin relativ weit.

Review Text: Beautiful temple to see and take pictures under rays of setting/rising sun. There are few activities and a restaurant as well. One of few must see places in Yogyakarta

2x ke prambanan cuaca nya panas banget. Jadi wajib bawa payung dan sunglasses. Sama pake sunblock. Jalan k pintu keluar lumayan jauh. Alternatifnya bisa naik mobil kereta yang gambar batik. Cuma nunggu agak penuh baru jalan. Worth it siy. Cz kita diajak muter sampe belakang. Masih ada beberapa candi disana yang jarang didatengin karena lokasinya jauh. 

Sekarang ada juga paket wisata k beberapa candi seperti ratu boko, plaosan, atau borobudur. Disediakan mobil elf dari pengelola. Kl ambil paket, Kita juga bisa masuk lewat pintu khusus. Kl mau ambil paket, datengnya dari pagi cz bisa seharian tournya
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: I visit this ancient Hindu Temple world heritage site during my trip to Yogyakarta in August 2017. There are 3 main temples / shrines (represent God of the Creator, the Preserver and the Destroyer) standing majestically inside the temple compound which are magnificent. A lots more ruins of the temple waiting for reconstruction around the main temple compound.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This temple is smaller than Borobudur but it has incredible story behind that. Its really nice to visit historical site once you know the story. We went on afternoon which alreadyfull with local and foreigner tourist. The parking arwa is wide and they have some spot which worth to visit as well inside the temple area.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
But, you know. This is not that wonderful. When I entered on of the temple (Brahmana Temple, the largest on the centre) I was left nothing with the dissapointment. Why? The reconstructed this temple using cement. Guess they were rushed when reconstruting it after the massive earth quake that happened to Jogja a few years back. And if the temple were closed for some time, well where would be people getting their money right? I know nothing about reconstruction but I know very well that there are no cement back than at 900 century. So it was no where near the original. It has lost the magic, the feel of ancient temple that still rise up high until now.

Other than that it was actually fine, until, I saw a few people (local ,foreigner) climbing out the stone, taking pictures, despite clear warning (DO NOT CLIMB). Well, that's dissapointing since there are no staff that reminds them at all.

And the other thing is, it was quiet cheap for  local (40k IDR or around 3 USD), but how does it was very expensive for foreign tourists? Some might even say that it was a tourist trap. Well, massive price is fine, but please also make Candi Prambanan worth to come for. If nothing worth to see here, they'll remember this place not for its beauty, but for the trap where they have to pay a lot to see nothing.

Невероятный храмовый комплекс.Посещали на закате и в лучах заходящего солнце зрелище было впечатляющим. Древние величественные постройки, очень необычная архитектура. В каждом храме находится по индуистской статуи. Минус, конечно же, толпы туристов, отчего сложно сделать снимок или зайти в каждый храм, но оно того стоит. Если вы добрались до Явы, то этот храм для вас обязателен к посещению.

My driver decided to take me to Candi Prambanan which is a 9th-century Hindu temple compound about 20 km away from my hotel. It was dedicated to the Trimurti, the expression of God as the Creator (Brahma), the Preserver (Vishnu) and the Destroyer (Shiva). 

I had researched the temple compound prior to my trip, and it was one of the reasons for me to go to Yogyakarta. (Tomorrow I will be going to Borobudur). It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and is also the largest Hindu temple site in Indonesia. 

Unfortunately it was pouring today, which, no pun intended, put a little bit of a damper on the afternoon. However, while we were waiting out the afternoon, my driver took me around the site, and showed me other temples extremely close to the main area, including one Buddhist temple. 

It was well worth the trip, rain or not, and highly recommended. 

Entry fee was 325,000 rupiah, which today is worth approximately $24 USD.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Seperti candi candi yang lain tempat ini menawarkan spot foto yang luas dan bisa sambil mempelajari sejarah juga. Saya sarankan kalau kesini bawa payung atau penutup topi di kala panas karna cuaca di sini kalau sudah panas terik sekali cahaya mataharinya dan pakain jangan pake yang tebal di karenakan nantinya akan ke panasan

Candi Prambanan mudah diakses dengan angkutan umum, Sehingga Anda yang berpergian dengan transportasi publik tidak akan kebingungan. Di sana, Anda akan disuguhkan dengan maha karya masa lalu yang indah. Anda bisa banyak belajar di sana.

Genius doesnt even begin to describe the engineering marvel gone into the complex which has stood for centuries. The temple complex is a testimony to human endevour. 
Plan to spend 2-3hrs. Stock up on water and fluids. Keep some light snacks handy. Best is to start from the furthest temple in the complex, i think Sewu and make your way to main attraction of Prambanan. Take your time go around each temples. The different sides with sun from different angle provide some great photo-ops too.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
ボロブドゥールに行きたくて申し込んだツアー、最初に訪れたのがここでした。こんな素晴らしい遺跡だとは知らずに来たのもあったのですが、あまりの大きさ、美しさに感動しました。ガイドさんの説明も分かりやすく、ヒンドゥー教寺院としてはアンコールワットよりも古く、8世紀～9世紀（アンコールは12世紀）頃の建物だという事に驚きました。修復されているのもありますが、アンコールワットよりもかなり綺麗だと思いました。ただ、手で触れてもＯＫなので、触れる感動もありつつ、ガネーシャの鼻や、シバ神の身体が撫でられ過ぎてピカピカ光ってしまっているのはどんなんだろう．．．？と、思いました。
でも、是非、観に行くべき遺産だと思います。

Apres le levé du soleil à Borobudur, nous voila sur le site impressionnant de Prambanan. Le site principal est très beau avec ces ruines et ces immenses temples. Si vous avez le temps vous pouvez vous promenez dans le parc qui regroupe d'autres sites.
Beaucoup de monde, comme partout dans ces lieux très touristiques. À faire avec un Guide je pense.

Sur le chemin du retour vous pourrez comme moi vous tester au tir à l'arc pour le fun (ne me demandez pas pourquoi mais oui il y un stand).

The prambanan temples are amazing. You can walk around and even wakl through the temples. A visit of these temples is just a must but you have to know that the price for a tourist is 10 times higher than for a local. You have to pay around 30 dollers. If you visit the temples make sure you are not going in high season, best time to visit is in september because it is not high season and it is not raining that much.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
ボロブドゥールと一緒に回りました。それぞれの寺院の歴史や、細かな彫刻を見るとその当時からの信仰について学ぶ事ができます。
外せないところじゃないでしょうか？
Amazing temple. You can see many tourists around. The engraving on the strictures very magnificent. Good place to take photo.

Visited this place with family members in June 2017. The unique structures at Prambanan have attracted many tourists from all over the world.  It was a very hot day during our visit and walking around the places and going up and down the stairs could be very tiring.  The whole place was very well maintained. Many beautiful pictures have been captured to share with friends and family members. We had our lunch at the restaurant near the entrance.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
I visited with my mother and 2 year old toddler on a Sunday afternoon at about 4pm. It was less crowded than I would have expected - no queues and quite easy to walk around. The most difficult challenge was that we were generally followed by a large crowd of people wanting photos with my very blonde blue-eyed daughter. Apart from that, it was a nice time to visit, not too hot, however the sunset wasn't much. 

There was alot around the temples including deer and horses. A good distraction for a tired toddler.

To make things easier we had arranged a taxi from our hotel in town to the temple, the driver waited and then drove us back within 3-4 hours for 300,000.
Really lovely temples in pretty good state considering they were made in 900 A.D and have also been hit with earthquakes. Quite steep steps which may be a struggle for some
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Ten eerste wij hadden een hele goede gids, hij legde veel uit, ook over alle vier de beelden in de tempel hoe en wat.
Wat heel erg indrukwekkend is om te zien dat na de aardbeving in 2006 ze alle stukjes bij beetjes weer bij elkaar zoeken en er toch al weer 4 hebben opgebouwd.

Review Text: A real majestic place - meant for those who really can appreciate ancient architecture and want to know more about life in Indonesia before the arrival of Islam. The intricate architecture and motifs found on these temples are still able to be found in Indonesian culture today. A great place to visit for those who love ancient civilisation history.

While the temples are impressive and deserve 5*, the experience as a whole was disappointing for a number of reasons.

1) 350,000 IDR.... for what can be seen in less than 2 hours. It is a massive rip off for what it is. Luckily, as I work in Indonesia, I get the same rate as locals, which was 35,000. Even though I didn't pay the full price, it still annoyed me that locals payed only 10% what everyone else had to.

2) It's normal in Indonesia as a European to have your pictures taken and have local school kids interview you, but this place was out of control. Normally we will pose, this this was getting so much that people would just walk next to you and take selfies without consent, and people would line up for you to hold their baby for a photo. This behaviour is weird, and the people who run the place should do more to prevent it. We didn't even get to see the whole place before we left in a bad mood because of it. In the worst cases, they seemed to get angry when we said no to a photo.

3) When you leave, you are marched through some awful market where people try to sell you absolute junk, and again, they can be pretty rude about it, shoving things in your hands and telling you the price, and not leaving you alone when you say no. 

All of these things happened on a week day, I would hate to imagine it during weekends or public holidays. 

So this place is beautiful and historic, and can be easily seen before jumping on the plane from Yogyakarta, but is not worth the hassle in my opinion.

Borobudur is of course more famous, but 9th century Prambanan is at least as interesting, if not more. The site facilities were good (no toilet paper in the bathrooms, though) and parking was easy. The site itself is impressing: the main temple was once one of the tallest manmade constructions on Earth. There is so much details in the temples you'll need at least a couple of hours to get through them all. There's a small café where you can order traditional medicinal Indonesian drinks. We tried to catch the sunset but the area is usually cloudy, so it's a matter of luck.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Prambanan Temple (Candi Prambanan) is a Hindu temple dedicated to the Trimurti s - Bramha, Vishnu and Shiva. Its a World Heritage site along with the Bhuddisht Borobudur temple in Yogyakarta, Indonesia. 
The temple is located roughly 20 kms from the town of Yogyakarta on the Yogyakarta- Solo main road and is the largest Hindu temple in Indonesia. Its characteristic of Hindu architecture and the central building is almost 150 feet tall. It was built in the 9th century by Sanjaya dynasty rulers.
There are 3 main temples for Lord Bramha, Vishnu and Shiva. The central tallest temple for Shiva. Just opposite to these 3 main temples are 3 smaller temples of Vahana of these dieties namely swan, garuda and nandi. Most of the temples are damaged with passage of time and negligence and also due to earthquakes and eruption of volcanoes. There are numerous other small temples in this large temple complex. Lot of restoration work is still going on and best efforts are made to restore the beautiful temple complex.
The central Shiva temple has other statues of Durga, Ganesha and saint Agasthya in the complex. Just opposite to the shiva temple is the Nandi temple with a statue of Nandi (Bull) but the other Vahana temples of swan and Garuda does not have the respective statues. Also there are temples for Chandra (Moon) and Surya (Sun). 
We visited in the afternoon and if its sunny better to wear hats and use sunscreens.U have to enter from one entry gate and exit at another which is a round about. Rest rooms are there for visitors. U need a minimum of around 3 hours for a leisurely sight of these beautiful temples. 
one can book for Borobudur - Prambanan - Rato Baku visit tickets for the same day ( this saves some dollars) and this can be done along with the popular Ramayan ballet at prambanan in the night after dinner at Rama shinta restaurant (Hectic but can be done). Book for Borobudur sunrise and sunset at Ratu Bako.
Prambanan  is one of the best sights of Jogya along with Borobudur. Do not miss these two gems of Indonesia if you are travelling in this part of the world.

Review Text: It's amazing to see the sun go down at Prambanan temple complex - which has more than one temple. There are temples for different gods, and stone carvings everywhere, all telling ancient stories. There was a jazz festival ongoing in the temple complex, which I thought was a great way to bring the youth in and promote culture.

Aside from the famous Borobudur Temple, another place worth-visiting in Central Java, Indonesia is the series of temples in Prambanan. Like the Borobudur Temple, the Prambanan Temples were also constructed in the 9th century. However, while the Borobudur was a Buddhist temple, those of Prambanan are Hindu temples. In fact, they form the largest Hindu complex in Indonesia.

The three main temples in Prambanan are dedicated to the three supreme gods of Hinduism: Shiva the destroyer of the universe, Vishnu the keeper of the universe, and Brahma the creator of the universe. As to the structure of the temples, we see the same mandala pattern and the elaborately designed pointed spires. Some of the temples have collapsed and the pieces of stone composing there are strewn all over the place.

The temples are a spectacular sight to behold and will get photo enthusiasts really excited! Some of the corridors and towers are quite narrow and tend to become overcrowded with tourists. Sometimes you have to queue and wait for a while before you can enter and climb up the towers. Perhaps it would have been better if we visited the place early in the morning.

If you're planning to visit both the Borobudur Temple and the Prambanan Temples, I suggest that you get a combined "package ticket" for US$ 40. And don't forget to wear your sarong when you visit the place. Everybody's required to wear it.

Un lugar precioso, recomiendo ir a primera hora y tener paciencia con los locales q no dejan de pedir fotos a los extranjeros.

Hindu temples in Indonesia was interesting to see, I would suggest reading up about Java and this temple before the visit. We bout combined tickets for Borobadur and Prambanan - and in reality you can do both in one day if you have your own transport. May be early morning for Borobodur and evening for Prambanan. Its a large site with - four large temples and many smaller temples clustered together. There are plenty of tourists at the site but not too crowded. The steps to climb up into the temple can be steep so sensible shoes are advisable. You can spend up to an hour or two here easily. If you are in Yogyakarta then this is a must see.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It was a sight to behold! Totally unexpected to see the majestic stupas. It's wonderful to catch the sunset there.
You can buy tickets that allow visiting both Borobudur and Prambanan. This ticket saves money. Both places can be visited in one day. But Prambanan closes at 5pm.

El templo de Prambanan es el segundo templo más importante de Yogyakarta después de Borobudur. Es importante saber que Borobudur es mucho más bonito que Prambanan por lo que no esperéis lo mismo. 
Es un conjunto de templos dedicados a los dioses hinduístas, cada dios tiene su construcción y entre ellos hay un espacio de tierra al sol por lo que hay que evitar las horas de más calor, pues yo llegué allí sobre las 11, después de haber ido a Borobudur, y el calor hizo que no disfrutara tanto de esta visita.
Es por esto por lo que lo recomendable es visitarlo al atardecer pues ya no hace tanto calor y regala unos paisajes bonitos.
Dentro de los templos no esperéis grandes cosas, simplemente una estatua del dios correspondiente. 
La vista más bella de este sitio es desde lejos donde se aprecian todas las edificaciones.
El precio es caro para lo que es.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The Prambanan temple complex is without a doubt one of the great World wonders. The awe-insipring temples and especially the incredibly detailed and well preserved stone carvings are truly impressive but you need a knowledgeable guide to understand them because they all tell a story. We used a Spanish-speaking local guide who explained the meaning of them to us and she did it so well that our eight-year old daughter listened intensely for over an hour in order not to miss the slightest detail of this seemingly never-ending love story.
Sangat senanglah aku kesana candi dengan bebagai nama pemandangannya indah saat sunset sangatlah seru
Es como Angkor Wat pero en chiquitín. Esto no significa q sea pequeño, es enorme, lo que pasa es q Angkor es inmenso. Visita imprescindible

Perhaps it was too hot; perhaps I have seen too many temples; but I was not sufficiently wowed by Prambanan on a painfully-sunlit afternoon. The light was harsh, and I wished I had arrived at dawn. 

However, the ballet after dark revealed the magic of the location -- the temples magically illuminated in the background. The ballet performance was excellent: captivating and beautiful. And it didn't hurt that the buffet dinner at the ballet restaurant beforehand was terrific as well.

So by all means visit Prambanan by day... but pick a day when the ballet is on and be there for the magic after dark as well!
This is the best temple I had visited in Bali. This temple is beautiful and can give you a feeling of peace with the beautiful surroundings.

This is definitely an attraction worthy of your time.  It's a short drive from Yogyakarta.  As always, wear comfortable shoes, and carry drinking water. The carvings at this temple are truly amazing.  We hired an English speaking guide for very inexpensive price, and he was very knowledgeable.  We never would have gotten so much out of the tour without him.

Uns wurde angeboten, die Tempelanlage bei Sonnenaufgang anzusehen. 

Wir haben uns jedoch für den Sonnenuntergang entschieden. Wir waren um ca. 14 Uhr an der Tempelanlage und haben uns die inneren Bereiche und auch die Trümmer und den Park angesehen und wunderschöne Photographien gemacht. 

Um ca. 17:00 Uhr beginnt der Sonnenuntergang. Die Atmosphäre in dieser Zeit ist mystisch und die Tempelanlage in diesem besondern Licht, mit dem Vulcan Merapi im Hintergrund strahlt eine unheimliche Schönheit aus! Gänsehaut pur! 

DEFINITIV SEHENSWERT! 

Geht um 14:00 Uhr hin und sucht euch um 16:30 Uhr einen guten Platz aus und genießt es.

Bonitas estupas a las que puedes acceder. 
Te puedes hacer la típica foto molona con las construcciones por detrás. Después serás el más guay de la clase. 
Recomiendo seguir al fondo del parque, donde se pueden encontrar más templos derruídos y más chulos aún.

Un templo muy bonito, recomendable 100%, sobretodo ir con un guía que os explique cada templo y su historia.
Nos quedamos enamorados
Prambanan temple is a truly beautiful and grand temple which has a long history. It truly deserves its UNESCO Heritage Site status.

Great and impressive Hindu temples. A must for travelers on Yogyakarta. The foreigner prices (almost 8x the price for locals) are a rip-off, but the temples are majestic and one canb almost feel the vibrations of the old Hindu gods. Its worthwile to read the story about the temples before visiting them or taking a tour guide. Otherwise must of the mystic gets lost. Take your time to stroll around the different temples and learn more about the history of multi-religious Indonesia.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
This place reminds me of temple complex in Siem Reap, Cambodia. Though this is the mini version and quieter. I reached this place in 1 hour ride East of Yogyakarta, paid 40k IDR entrance tickets (local price) to Prambanan and nearby temples (including Sewu, less touristy temple). The foreigner's ticket price was 25USD. And you could buy a bundle ticket for both Borobudur and Prambanan.

Car/bike parking was priced at 5k/3k IDR. The ticket booths are located 5 mins walk away, and another 10 minutes walk to Prambanan temple area. This place is vast and only has a handful of shades to rest. So, bring your umbrellas/hats/whatever as it could get crowded on weekends. I came on Monday, and it was less crowded.

Sewu temple is located 1 km away and you could pay for the small train's car or you could walk. On my way there, I could spot some smaller temples, some are under construction. There was less than 10 people there when I arrived and I could take a picture devoid of humans, lol.

Spent 10 minutes at the nearby bench and watched the locals harvest from the mango's tree with sticks. 1 dude climbed it and grabbed a bag full of mangos. Guess he will go to the market and sell those.

On my way back, there are some eating places with decent prices, so don't miss those. Or you could walk all the way out from the complex, and grab some food and drinks at cheaper price at the warungs/small stalls. After that, grab yourself some souvenirs and go back to Yogyakarta for massage. Life is awesome.

The Hindu temples are spectacular. The carved relief around the walkways on the second level in the 2 main temples tell the life story of Rama. The carvings are magnificent. Inside each room area another floor up you will find a large carving. Be sure to see comfortable shoes,  a hat and bring water. It will take about 1.5 hours to view everything n this site.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Na eerder op de dag bij borobudur te zijn geweest gingen we naar deze hindu-tempel.
Eerste indruk : veel interessanter dan borobudur ...
Met gids (wel handig, anders loop je langs 
Een hoop stenen zonder dat je weet wat wat is)
Prima uitleg& zeer toegankelijk !!
En dus m.i. Veel leuker om naar toe te gaan dan borobudur ...
Is ook mooi om te zien rond/na zonsondergang
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Het was een mooie tempel maar de entree prijs 325.000 roepia vond ik erg prijzig. 
Als je een combinatieticket koopt voor deze tempel en de borobudur zijn ze 1.000000 roepia samen. (Voor 2 personen).

Es lohnt sich hier mit einem Guide die verschiedenen Tempel zu erwandern und die Geschichten die auf den Reliefs zu sehen sind zu hören. Auch wenn es hier von Besuchern nur so wimmelt, kann man an einigen Stellen die Aussicht in Ruhe genießen. Auch wenn nicht ganz preiswert, ein MUSS für Touristen. Festes Schuhwerk ist empfehlenswert.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Went here at sunset, terrific stone carvings, a bit like very ornate pyramids.

We thought this temple was more spectacular than Borobudur which we visited earlier in the day. It was also less busy.
