Well worth the visit, jaw dropping when you first set eyes on the structures

Site aussi incontournable que Borobodur, à faire peut être avant ce dernier car moins monumental. L'entrée est comme d'habitude plus chère pour les étrangers que pour les locaux(environ 40€ pour 2) mais 4 candi sont à visiter. Un édifice principal vous occupera une bonne heure et demie si vous souhaitez en faire complètement le tour et 3 sites un peu plus éloignés sont aussi a voir(comptez 20 bonnes minutes de marche) et à ne surtout pas manquer.
L'endroit y est plus reposant que Borobodur car il attire moins, ce qui le rend plus intéressant pour les personnes voulant éviter l'afflux touristique.
La sua fama lo precede, bellissimo da visitare al tramonto! Prendete una bicicletta e fate tutto il giro del parco dalle 16 in poi per godere dalla luce migliore ;)

During the day time its really hot and better to visit early in the morning or late afternoon. There are few other temples around and you can use the small train which travel frequently around this place.

Prambanan.

From Bororbudur the drive took about 90 minutes to get to Prambanan via small narrow roads and pleasant countryside.

On arrival around 1pm the car park was quiet and peaceful. The dual ticket purchased at Borobudur was checked and we were admitted. 

After a short walk the Hindu temple came into view and was breathtaking. There were few tourists and so it was easy and comfortable to move around and to linger in this incredible place.

Again I spent around 90 minutes here and I loved it. It was incredibly peaceful and I wasn't sure if this was because of the place or lack of tourists.

Close up the structures are intricate and detailed but from a short distance they are magnificent. In my view some of the best viewing points are as you exit.

Here again the exit is not the same route as the entrance and the grounds are extensive. There are some places to eat and drink but the first one I visited had no food. The second had a buffet which looked unattractive so I settled on water!

Like Borobudur the exit is via a market but this time much much much bigger. It's huge and it took ages to navigate it and get out.

I loved Prambanan more than I liked Borubador. It should be on everyone's bucket list!

Biglietto carissimo ma merita sicuramente di essere visto una meraviglia la distesa di templi è bellissima si gira con facilità noi all'apertura abbiamo fatto una visita in solitaria conservato benissimo da vedere assolutamente

Sehr beeindruckend und absolut lohnenswert. Wir sind um 6 Uhr morgens dort gewesen und bereuen es nicht. Wir waren fast die einzigen Gäste auf dem Gelände und hatten unsere Ruhe. Ab 7 Uhr wurde es voller und voller. Daher unbedingt um 6 hin! Auch sollte man bis zum Ende des Gelände laufen, wo der Sewu Tempel steht. Dieser ist ebenso beeindruckend und wir hatten ihn für uns alleine, da die meisten übersehen, dass es noch weitere Tempel auf der Anlage gibt.

Beside Borobudur temple, Prambanan temple is another must when you come to Yogyakarta. The architecture and the cravings on the stones will ensure you will regret for missing it.
Note : If possible, get a local tour, so he/she can explain to you the stories behind all the cravings (there is a story behind all the cravings). I understand from my guide that you will watch the same story in Ramayana ballet.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Al pari del Borobudur, una meraviglia da non perdere assolutamente se si visita la regione.
Vicinissimo al centro città (raggiungibile anche in bus), è consigliabile visitarlo lo stesso giorno della visita al Borobudur

Da non perdere

Absolutely beautiful. You can buy a combined ticket for Prambanan and Borobodur for 520 thousand rupies, or if you have a student card it's 320 thousand. Take your time to explore this amazing site!  Dress modest and with respect, especially for Borobodur. There are two more temples in Prambanan complex, so dont make the mistake of exploring just Prambanan. The whole site is beautiful for families, couples or solo travellers. You can buy water and snacks there so dont worry about that. I reccomend not going on the weekend, choose a working day. We went on a monday and it was great because there werent many people there.
un lugar histórico de visita obligada. mucha gente pero no es molesto. más gente local que turistas. hay un tiene cito que te lleva a las zonas más lejanas

Impresionantes templos, pero ir a una hora concurrida es mala idea si quieres buenas fotos sin ponerte malo. Me gustó más que Borobudur. Los templos por dentro no valen nada, es oscuro y húmedo, y aún encontrándose una obra de arte (que no la hay) no se apreciaría. VISITA OBLIGADA.

Every time I've visited Prambanan in the last 25+ years I say "wow".  It's amazing that this massive stone structure of this mainly Hindu temple (chedi) complex were carved so delicately in the 9th century.  Note that you do have to wend your way through a tented collection of vendors to exit the site.  However, the signage is much improved, only a few repairs are still going on after the 2008(?) earthquake, a tram runs through the complex sometimes (not the Monday morning that we visited), each visitor gets a small bottle of water at entry, and the site still retains a serene feeling since it's not overrun with tourists.  Although small, the on-site museum with some good stones both inside and out is worth checking out.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This review will not be about the temple complex (excellent), but I would like to share how to get to the temple, and more important how to get back to your hotel in Yogyakarta.  You cannot get a metered taxi to the place, so you would have to negotiate the price (which I hate). We decided to beat the process by installing the Grab App onto our smart phone. It is super easy to use.  We only paid 60000 IDR to get to the temple from our hotel north of the city (Hyatt Regency), so less than 100000 IDR from downtown.  We paid a bit more for the way back, but did not have to do the bargaining game with fake taxi drivers at the complex (their starting point was 250000 IDR).

What a place. It is already spectacular from afar, but up close you can see all the details in the stonework.  So happy that I've been here. It helped though that I was with an Indonesian friend who helped vend off streetvendors. :)

Situé dans une plaine, ce monument est facile d'accès en scooter.. la visite de Prambanam est intéressante mais il faut s'intéresser au préalable à la tradition shivaite pour comprendre au minimum à tous les détails des sculptures.
Beaucoup de pierres sur le site où les autres temples n'ont pas été reconstruits.
Se visite très facilement en 1h30
Meestal ga je naar de prambanan tempel bij zins ondergang . Maar dat hebben wij niet gedaan . Dus was het lekker rustig en kon je normaal lopen. Mooie Tempel en zeker een bezoek waard

Another temple complex not too far from the city. it will be good to attend the video documentary show in the Temple complex where you can get a good overview of the temple's history and legends/stories associated with the structures built long ago..

please wear good walking shoes and dress modestly.

Ein empfehlenswertes kulturelles Erlebnis, was allerdings recht teuer geworden ist. Mittlerweile (Stand August 2017) liegt der Normalpreis bei 325.000 IDR (ca. 21€). Das Gute ist, von Yogyakarta fahren die Trans Jogja Busse für nur 0,25€ direkt zum Prambanan.

Es gibt einige Guides (Tourismus Studenten) die kostenfrei wissenswerte Informationen zu den Götter-Statuen im inneren der einzelnen Tempel preisgeben. Wer daran interessiert ist, sollte diese Möglichkeit definitiv wahrnehmen.

Fazit
Gemessen am gestiegenen Preis nicht mehr für jeden eine klare Empfehlung. Allerdings für jene, die an der Kultur und Geschichte interessiert sind.

Prambanan temple is one of hindus temple in java. The location about 20 mnutes from city center by bus. You can take bus 2B if i am not mistaken, but you can always ask the ticketman for sure before you get in to the bus. The bus cost 3500idr. The entrance ticket to prambanan about 40k idr for local and for foreigner about 25usd. First time i step in to the location i was amazed, i saw nice temples, there are 5 or 6 big temples and some little one. Some people come mostly in the afternoon for catching sunset. You can climb to the inside temple, if you want to know more the history about those temple you can hire a guide for explain everything about the story, about the myth, or all about prambanan temple. The temple will open from 6am - 5pm.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This spectacular complex of Hindu Temples is definitely worth the visit.  Plan on spending a couple of hours walking among the 6 temples and then the gardens - beautiful!
Un temple incontournable en l'Indonésie, vraiment sublime, par contre il fait chaud, très chaud ! Alors prévoyez des bouteilles d'eau !

Neben Borobodur ein weiteres Highlight von Java - und ein Muss!!! Führer (100.000 Rupiah/1 Std.) ebenfalls sehr zu empfehlen. Am besten mit Borobodur gemeinsam an einem Tag per Travel Agency (z.B. Bromo Tours - alles toll geklappt) buchen, z.B. in Kombination mit dem Sunrise up the Hills - traumhaft!!!

We organised a tour to see the Prambanan Temples at sunset and the Raymana Ballet in the evening from Yogyakarta leaving at 2pm. This was a more expensive way of getting there at it is easy to get the bus from one of the main streets we heard from other tourists. However for piece of mind of the taxi booked for there and back it was worth it as the buses don't run late in the evening. The sunset was great and crowds were quieter in the cooler temperature. The ballet was also good, but the buffet restaurants were very average and overcharged due to the captive market!

It is my favorite place in yogyakarta! It is just beautiful! The place is huge, walk around the area, there is so much more to see and do ! I believe 3-4 hours would be the perfect to visit everything and also give a look on the stores near the exit
The largest hindu temple in indonesia. The location is accessible from the airport. So it is best to visit and see the place at sunset. One of the best places to visit in yogya. So don't miss it!!!

La vista fin dal primo momento è da togliere il fiato. Decine di templi Induisti sparsi in una pianura. Appartengo al nono secolo e pur trovandosi nelle vicinanze del tempio di Borobodur, si coglie subito la grande differenza tra i due luoghi. Questi agili, leggero mentre l'altro massiccio ed imponente. Bellissimi i bassorilievi che ci introducono ad una civiltà e religione poco conosciuta da noi europei. Quello che è comunque ammirevole è il grande lavoro di restauro fatto per preservare questi templi devastati da terremoti nei secoli. I templi sono numerosi , ma i più suggestivi sono quelli dedicati a Vishu, Brahma, e a Shiva.
La nostra guida privata è stata bravissima e di grande cultura a farci capire questa storia e religione molto lontane da noi.
Emozionante la veduta del tempio di Shiva , sia di giorno che di notte, a mio parere il più bel tempio induista di tutta la Indonesia.
Una bellissima giornata dedicata alla architettura e alla filosofia induista .
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Prambanan is very different from the Buddhist temple of Borobudur that we visited the day before. It was built slightly later in the 9th century by the Hindu kings of Sumatra & Java, who apparently considered themselves gods.
The centrally placed largest temple is dedicated to Shiva & it overlooks a series of smaller shrines. All the shrines can be entered up steep stairs & there is a small enclosure with the statue of the god that it is dedicated to.
The gardens surrounding the temples are beautifully kept & there is a big market selling souvenirs on your way out.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Après la visite de Borobudur direction le temple de Prambanan - il est super également - prenez un guide car son histoire est aussi intéressante
pesona yang sangat menakjubkan saat anda melihat pemandangan di sore hari, apalagi melihat matahari tenggelam di candi prambanan

Candi Prambanan merupakan salah satu warisan leluhur Indonesia yang bernilai estetik klasik. Patut dijaga dan dipelihara. Namun nilai estetik itu perlu didukung dengan tata kota yang asri dan bebas macet. Ketika kami datang ke Jogja hari ini (11/8/2017) menuju Candi, kami seperti menelusuri sesuatu yg sulit ditemukan karena suasana macet dan tata kota yg agak semrawut. Namun, terimakasih buat keindahan candi Prambanan.
Entree is nu 325 duizend. Dus blijft stijgen. Wel Gratis flesje water. Per stadsbus goed te doen Kost 3.5 duizend enkeltje.  Start malioborostraat

Beautiful temples and is a must do in the area. We had been to an orchestra the night before and did not want to lose that feeling but we were surprised at the visit. Interesting history and lovely area.

Les avis sur Trip advisor laissaient entendre qu'en comparaison de Borobudur la visite de Prambanan serait moins intéressante. Du coup, j'ai été très agréablement surpris ! Borobudur n'est que sur un site alors que Prambanan ce sont plusieurs temples. Nous y étions au coucher du soleil jusqu'à la fermeture (18h) et le spectacle était top. Nous aurions aimé pouvoir rester plus tard mais pas possible, les gardes nous ont gentiment reconduit à la.sortie. Si vous venez de Yogya, la route est vraiment chouette si vous passez par les petites routes. À ne pas louper !

Most people just spend time in the front temple (which is awesome but can get crowded). Do yourself a favor and walk to the back for the other temples and you might get a temple all to yourself! hardly anyone ventures back there but well worth the walk. This is wonderful complex!
９～１０世紀につくられたインドネシア最大級のヒンズー教寺院。９～１０世紀につくられたインドネシア最大級のヒンズー教寺院。ボロブドゥールと双璧をなすジャワ最高傑作の建造物のひとつで世界文化遺産にも登録されている。ボロブドゥールはブッダの生涯だったが、ここは、ヒンドゥー教のシバァ神殿、ブラフマ神殿、ヴィシュヌ神殿が並ぶ。

You must visit this UNESCO World Heritage site if you are in Yogykarta. If you have seen Borobudur, don’t think that it is not worth to visit this temple complex. These two are completely different. This temple is an example of a magnificent and graceful Hindu temple built during 9th century and it reminded me Ankor wat that we have seen few months back. There are three main temples in the complex. The biggest one is dedicated to Lord Shive and the other two was built for Lord Vishnu and Brahma. In the main yard other than the three main temples there are thirteen smaller temples. In the outer yard the total number of temples is 224 but many are now only stone piles mainly due to earthquake.  The landscape park around the temple complex has added beauty and easy accessibility to enjoy the intricate and sophisticated stone carvings of the temple complex. From a distance you will be mesmerized to see the cluster of huge majestic temples. When you reach near the temple complex you will be bewildered with the mammoth size and artistic stone works of these temples. It is better to visit the temple in the morning as its get hot and uncomfortable. In many places the steps are high, so be careful. If you want, you can complete your visit within 2-3 hours. However if you want to see in detail all the reliefs on the temple walls (mostly stories from Indonesian version of Ramayana) you will probably need 4-5 hours.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Great site to see while visiting Indonesia. You can buy a combined ticket with Borobudur which you can use over 2days. The tickets are expensive for foreigners (525,000 IRp) but worth it, there are student discounts. We did both on the same day but it would be better to see them over two days, as the light is too harsh in the afternoon and it takes 1 & 1/2 hours to travel between the sites. Transportation to Yogyakarta at the end of the day took an hour.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Op een maandag in juli hier geweest met het gezin. We waren er rond 10:30 en het was er erg rustig. Voor 7 euro een engels sprekende gids erbij genomen. Een groot deel van de meer dan 500 oorspronkelijke tempels is verwoest tijdens de aardbeving/vulkaanuitbarsting vorige eeuw. Inmiddels zijn de grootste tempels weer gerestaureerd en is het tempelcomplex zeker een bezichtiging waard. De gids wist heel veel te vertellen over de tempels en vooral ook over de Hindoeistische afbeeldingen welke op de tempels zijn afgebeeld. 
Op het terrein was ook een fotograaf welke mooie familiefoto's (20 x 30 cm) met de Prambanan op de achtergrond voor je kon maken voor 2 euro per stuk, zeker de moeite waard als aandenken.
Wel veel verkopers bij de uitgang, de route naar de uitgang loopt langs een heleboel winkeltjes. Als je vriendelijk maar beslist bedankt is het geen probleem.

Walau panas, tidak menyurutkan semangat untuk datang ke peninggalan kebudayaan Hindu di tanah Jawa ini. Arsitektur dan ukiran di candinya selalu sukses membuat kita berdecak kagum. Di sana dijual buku panduan tentang sejarah candi Prambanan dan penjelasan tentang relief di candi. Bagi yang kesulitan bisa menyewa guide untuk menjelaskan tentang candi Prambanan. Jangan lewatkan berlatih memanah saat berjalan ke pintu keluar. Kita akan dibantu dari komunitas Jemparingan Jogja, cukup dengan membayar Rp 20.000,- untuk 12 anak panah. Saya dan kawan ketagihan mencobanya.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Imperdibile complesso religioso a pochi chilometri da Jogjakarta.
Emozionante. Consiglio anche la visita con guida, combinando al mattino Borobudur e al pomeriggio il Prambanan.
Bellissimo
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Même si le Borobudur reste le top, Prambanan n 'est pas en reste!!! Il tout autant incontournable, et différent! Très intéressant de voir cette mixité de culture religieuse, et là c'est l'hindouisme qui est mis en avant. A ne pas manquer!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Complesso simile ad un Angkor Wat in miniatura ;-) Si raggiunge in breve tempo da yogya...traffico permettendo in meno di un'ora di auto ci si arriva. Noi abbiamo deciso di acquistare il trasporto in una delle mille agenzie di Prawirotaman che con 100000 rupie (6 euro) ti accompagna al sito in auto e ti riaccompagna in hotel. Ci siamo fermati fino al tramonto e la visita è piacevole e interessante. Biglietto di ingresso da acquistare in combinato con il Borobudur per risparmiare qualcosina...e se siete studenti portatevi dietro la tessera universitaria perché lo pagherete la metà!!!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
ジョグジャカルタを基点に西の仏教遺跡ボロブドゥル、東のヒンドゥー教遺跡プランバナンというぐらい代表的な遺跡です。
以前の地震でかなり倒壊し、修復途中でした。
主要な塔はほぼ修復が終わっていましたが、小さいものはパーツにわかれたまま地面に置かれていました。
I Visit This Beautiful Temple in 2010 with friends and i think this place really beautiful. I wish i can back as soon as possible :)

First off, make sure to stay hydrated.  It gets hot climbing in to each temple and walking the grounds.  Just taking in all of the beautiful carvings can be a little overwhelming.  Beautiful scenery and the view is just breathtaking.  Highly recommend the archery course that was set up nearby the temples in the background.  A very different and unexpected kind of activity to try.

More beautiful than the Borobudur. 

It needs more benches and shadow places to enjoy the view.

At the end after the exit you can take beautiful pictures of the temple.

Goed om te zien dat ze zoveel moeite doen om zo'n oud werk te blijven restaureren. Heel toegankelijk voor ons toeristen. Ook mooie plek om rond te wandelen. Wij hadden de pech dat we hier op een zondag waren, dan is het nog drukker dan normaal bij dit soort bezienswaardigheden. Maar er was ruime parkeerplaats, geen lange rij voor de kaartjes en terrein groot genoeg ook ook echt even rust te vinden.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: De tempel is leuk en interessant om te zien. Je hebt een grote tempel (de hoofd tempel) en allemaal kleinere erbij staan. Voor jonge kinderen of tieners raad ik het niet aan. Die vonden er namelijk niet veel aan... maar voor de oudere generatie onder ons is het wel leuk en interessant.😉
I enjoyed these temples much more than Borobudor. These structures are really fascinating. A must see.

A very miraculous heritage hindu temple. Nice sunset view. A deer and kasuari bird feeding ground and many more attraction. A wonder of the world here in Yogyakarta Indonesia. Dont forget to bring water because the place is vast to explore

This was our primary reason for visiting Yogyakarta. As we entered through the main gate, the view was simply amazing. It was like seeing an historical place come to live right in front of you. The place was fairly crowded as it was a weekend when we visited the temple. My Wife and I slowly navigated through the crowd and climbed to see the deities inside the temple - Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva. For some people, climbing the steps can be challenging as they were not steep and uneven at certain areas. It was amazing to see many tourists and locals visiting the Hindu artefacts and taking several photos. There are also several scriptures on the walls of the Hindu tales and religion. 

We really enjoyed it and felt it was a blessing to visit this temple. It is a must visit; although it can be a little expensive for tourist - about 300,000+ rupiah per person. There are locals asking if you want a tour guide - trust me you don't need one. Just do the adventure on your own. 

Verdict: Highly recommended. Experience a piece of Hindu history
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Rond de klok van 9.30 is het zelfs in augustus prima te doen wat drukte betreft.  De meeste toeristen staan te fotograferen op het middendeel van het complex terwijl het aan de achterzijde erg rustig was en net zo mooi is! Onvergetelijk bezoek!

Très facile pour s'y rendre, en utilisant la ligne 1A de bus (45 minutes environ).
Depuis le terminal du bus, prévoir 15 minutes à pied, le long de la grande route.
L'entrée du parc coûte 25 $ pour les adultes et 15 $ pour les enfants ou étudiants (sur présentation de la carte).
Possibilité de louer des vélos dans le parc, même si tout se fait à pied.
Peu d'explication dans le parc. Sinon, prendre un guide.
Un restaurant se trouve dans le parc. Très moyen mais cela peut dépanner sans problème.
Une belle visite.

We took a whole day tour to Pramanan and Borobudur temple today. It is about a 8h day if you got your own driver. The temples are nice but rather small, surrounded by a huge garden area. My "problem" was, that i have seen Ankor Wat already....which is much more impressive. From my point of view, the entrance fee of 520.000 IDR (combined ticket) is too high, for 2hours at Borobudur/max 1,5hours at Pramanan.

A faire! Magnifique temple. Y aller tôt le matin car il fait déjà chaud à 9h. Très peu d'explication même en anglais (sauf si vous prenez 1 guide!)
Pour y aller: prendre le bus 1A sur maliobo ro street: transjogya vers prambanan (0,25€). Le bus vous depose à une petite station à 10 min à pied du temple. Ne cédez pas aux propositions des becaks, c'est très facile d'accès à pied.

Tempat bersejarah yang bagus dan penuh akan seni. Harga tiket terjangkau. Membutuhkan waktu kurang lebih 1jam untuk mengelilingi lokasi ini. Orang sekitar ramah dan siap membantu anda jika dalam kesulitan. Candi ini menceritakan tentang tokoh wayang mahabarata.
Ole bole degil. Uzak dogu seyahatimin en guzel parcasi yogyakarta idi. Inanilmaz bor kent.. ve tapinak inanilmaz bit manzara ve guzellikle dolu... gorulesi bir mekan
It's a very nice place to go to. I would recommend to do one excursion to the borobudur and prambanan on the same day.

Il complesso dei templi è da vedere la mattina presto. Sono ben tenuti, i migliori della cultura indù nel paese. Si vede il restauro recente, con i recenti contributi dell'Unesco.
Sono da vedere insieme al vicino complesso di templi buddisti. Il fatto che templi buddisti e hindù siano nello stesso periodo , forse nella stessa dinastia testimonia della tolleranza religiosa dell'Indonesia
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
C'est très impressionnant et tout à fait incontournable.
A voir absolument, et y prendre son temps pour apprécier.

This is our trip for a week in yogyakarta. An amazing itinerary while visiting Prambanan Temple. Unexpectedly we could finally visit this place, though it took a long time. True temples are incredible from the pictures we always see. We highly suggestion to come Prambanan Temple, guaranteed no regrets!!!
Belleza que recuerda a Ankor Wat. Imprescindible si se va a Yogya. Se tarde como una hora desde el centro y es perfectamente asequible en moto. Recomendaría combinar con Plaosan, Kalasan y Ratu Boko.

Prambanan is another UNESCO site in Yogyakarta, about an hours drive away from the city. It is the biggest Hindu temple in Indonesia, and well worth a visit. In my opinion it is best to go before sunset, experience the sunset there
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This review is for travelers on a budget. Arrived at the airport in the afternoon, took the TransJogja 1A bus (ask around and locals will direct you to the bus terminal outside the airport) for RP3,500. Final stop is at Prambanan. Head to the counter and have your student pass ready, you get the student ticket at a much cheaper price (USD15). I visited Angkor Wat before, hence did not get a tour guide to introduce the various features, would be nice to have one if in a group. The temple is overall smaller but still as majestic and well-maintained. Stay for the sunset (around 5.30pm), and head back to Yogyakarta city via 1A again.

If you have been to Angkor Wat I would say . it s much smaller but still impressive and worth the visit 
When visiting Yogyakarta the highlight will be Borobudur Temple what is a Buddhist Temple  and . Prambanan Temple is a hindu temple - the visit will take a halfday and you can combine with the trip to the volcano at Merapi
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Magnifique - autre chose que le Burubudur - bcp moins touristique.
Marchez jusqu'au temple Sewu - ça vaut le peine (même complexe).
Personne sur le site et presque plus beau que le temple principal

It was an amazing view as soon as we entered the gate. It's grand, beautiful, right on your face wow!!! Needn't say this is a must place to visit in Indonesia... 
reached there late (~4), was still crowded and was a bit cloudy, but good enough to walk around in a relaxed way without being so hot... Surprisingly the foreigners queue was longer than the local people queue, but was not too bad... went to the Ramayana ballet afterwards and it was awesome too...
Ci siamo andati in bus (N°1) un'avventura di 2 ore..... ma ne valeva la pena. Non si può andare a Yogya senza vederli

我們從日惹市區搭了1A公車來，票價3500，非常便宜。路程車子挺多的，走走停停，大概搭了一小時多才抵達。下車的地方會有很多人力車伕拉客，其實那時已經抵達園區圍牆邊了，順著邊邊走大約十來分鐘就可以看到大門，但懶得走的人還是可以搭人力車啦（只是不知道多少錢）。

寺廟非常的美，我們待了三個多小時，看了日落才走。但回到公車站時，也因為人潮太多，公車無法消化，於是在車站等非常久，也沒有計程車可以叫。在那裡排隊了快兩小時才搭上公車，車上很擠，還發現有人趁亂性騷擾！

Baru pertama kali ke candi prambanan, suasananya cukup asri dan segar.

Ketika melihat candi prambanan cukup takjub dan memiliki nilai sejarah yang bagus.

Bagus untuk kunjungan bersama keluarga sekaligus menambah wawasan tentang sejarah indonesia

This is quite impress about temple and we go by private group with guide  So excited to see the  UNESCO site is quite worth and it the main reach 47 metres in height and the 47 metres in height and the stairs was quite big so be careful and it like a thousand years of historical and we go exit we see surrounding by construcion many brick.and its getting tired and hot weather This is the Reason we visit the unesco in yogyakarta  for keeping the Traditional or spread the Hinduism in Asia
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Prambanan is amazing! I loved the architecture and the atmosphere of the place. We went quite early, around 7h30am and it was already starting to get busy. By the time we left it was crowded in tourists! 

The museum was quite interesting and it's nice to walk around the grounds.

I prefered Prambanan to Borododur, but it is difficult to compare!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: As you would expect from a much hyped UNESCO site this is very impressive. The main collection of temples and stupas are closely grouped and form an impressive site with the main one reaching 47 metres in height. It was a little surprising to see entry to all structures is still allowed and it was all disorganised and congested on a very busy local holiday. With the surrounding strewn ruins of structures stretching over hundreds of square metres it is a major sight with other significant compounds such as Sewu only a short walk away..
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
This is quite an extensively spread complex where you are mesmerized by the majestic temple art standing for more than thousand years  with ample photo opportunities .
This is the reason for Yogyakarta  visit to most and rightly so .
The place  gives  great idea of the extent of spread and grandeur of Hinduism in Asia  .

Una vez pises Yogyakarta, tu primera meta debe ser obligatoriamente visitar los templos de Prambanan.
Son una auténtica joya que han sobrevivido a terremotos. Sus ruinas, y los templos que han perdurado o han sido reconstruidos te trasladan a un mundo mágico y exótico.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Bellissimo sito archeologico, girare fra le sue rovine ti fa sentire un novello Indiana Jones! Consiglio di trovarsi lì verso l'ora del tramonto, uno spettacolo impagabile!
Mooie tempel. Hier moet je geweest zijn als je in de buurt van Yogjakarta bent. Mooi om te zien hoe ze dit na aardbevingen hebben weten te herbouwen!

Though the actual temples only cover a small area, you can spend hours here. In comparison with its Buddhist counterpart of Borobudur, I found this much more stunning as the grandeur can be seen at ground level. Borobudur's impact has to be seen from above to be appreciated fully. 
This temple complex dates from the 800's and has suffered greatly from Indonesia's frequent earthquakes combined with looting. It was "rediscovered" by the British as the same time as Borobudur. There are loads of stone piles still surrounding the extensive, well-kept grounds. The grounds contain a gift shop, theatre, audio-visual theater, 2 smaller temples, campground, restaurant, playground, a deer enclosure and a small train to transport people around the grounds for an extra 10,000INR. A combined ticket of $40 US can be purchased at the entrance that will cover Borabudur and Prambanan for two consecutive days. Take the 1A Transjog bus from Malioboro Road in Jogja for 3,500 and get off in Prambanan. Cross the busy four lane road and turn right and go around the block to the left to find the entrance. Guides can be hired by the entrance if the spirit moves you.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: En un entorno inesperado y pagando una fortuna para los precios del país. Con las maravillas que puedes encontrar en la naturaleza de Java... No pierdas un día en esta patata mal cuidada.
Kawasannya cukup luas, cocok dikunjungi pagi hari. Di sekitar kawasan terdapat tempat makan dan penjual oleh-oleh yang tentunya tidak boleh dilupakan.

Kagum ke kawasan ini, karena semakin dipercantik pada jalan keluarnya  selepas kita  mengintari kompleks Candi Prambanan nya dihiasi dengan payung-payung yang digantung beraneka warna.  Cocok untuk foto-foto yang kekinian istilahnya.  Kemudian supaya anak-anak tidak jenuh, disiapkan juga wahana bermain untuk anak-anak seperti permainan memanah untuk anak-anak dan lain-lain.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
If you like traditional cultural tourism, this spot is a right place to visit.
They serve ramayana dancing attraction in the afternoon

Lokasi strategis karena di tepi jalan raya, akses parkir mudah dan luas. Banyak wahana untuk pendidikan seperti museum dan juga tempat bermain anak-anak. Kondisi candi nya sekarang sudah banyak yang dipugar jadi lebih bersih dan terlihat rapi.

Nous avons payé 100'000 roupies pour une visite guidée. Notre guide au fort accent n'était pas toujours très compréhensible, mais il nous a expliqué l'histoire du temple et les légendes autour de Shivas et autres dieux hindous.
Il n'y avait pas une grande foule sur le site. Nous en avons profité pour voir le temple Sewu qui se trouve à 500m, qui est très beau également et surtout vide de touristes !
Le site propose des balades à vélo et dispose d'une grande place de jeux pour les enfants.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
I think this place is twinned commercially with Borobodur and the entrance fee - again specially for foreigners - seems steep. We would like to think the cash goes towards to massive restoration work still to do. Really pleased we did both temples, this and Borobodur. Incredibly impressive Hindu temple complex. There is actually also a large Buddhist temple complex in the park which has the potential to be just as stunning when fully restored. There is a rather embarrassing train which you can take around the park and it's free for foreigners but not ironically for Indonesians. This takes you to the Buddhist complex. Worth seeing. Second largest Buddhist temple complex in Indonesia.

So certainly worth the effort to see this site as well as getting up before dawn to see the sun rise from Borobodur. Do both if you get the chance.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It's 325,000 entry which seems dear but actually it's well worth it. It's an impressive site. We weren't sure whether to visit as well as Borobodur but I highly recommend both. This is a Hindu temple. The largest temple is really tall and reminded me of Angor Wat temples in Cambodia. Well worth visiting! We visited later in the day which was great as it was quiet and also cooler. Perfect!

Be perfectly honest we preferred Borobudur. But these temples were cool too. Looked around and your able to go up and look at carvings and statues.

We didn't get a guide, left feeling we didn't miss out by not getting one. But I'm sure the history is fascinating.
Waktu itu kesini langit gelap ,sempat gerimis lama,tapi tetep mau gak mau harus masuk,karena anak2ku pengen bgt ngeliat candi prambanan,bagus sangat bagus,anak2ku suka

Man kommt an einem Massen Parkplatz an. So weit so gut. 

Die Tempel Anlage liegt jedoch nicht, wie man es vermuten könnte, umgeben von einer schönen Landschaft, sondern noch in der Stadt. Drum herum also Häuser und laute Straßen. 

Da geht die Athmosphäre einer solchen Anlage total verloren.

Zudem recht wenig Informationen über den Tempel vorhanden. Wobei das an den asiatischen Touristenmassen, die sich im Selfie schiessen total zum Affen machen, eh total egal zu sein scheint.

Ganz klar Touri Nepp
Realmente son majestuosos. Unicamente añadir que se hace un pelín pesado. Toda la simbología que guardan y la estética preciosa. Es una visita obligada,por su puesto.
The temples are much bigger than expected. Very wide garden, with interesting historical background.

This is a must see and a wonderful unesco accredited site. If you can find a day where it is not too warm and not a public holiday you should do that, because there is a lot of visitors both locals and tourists. 

At one time we found ourselves being photographed more than the temple complex. To avoid misunderstandings you should not refuse entirely ;-)

The temple is built in the 10th century, and is the largest temple  dedicated to Shiva in Indonesia. 

It consists of three temples with beautiful reliefs dedicated to the three great Hindu divinities (Shiva, Vishnu and Brahma) and to the animals who serve them.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Prambanan is a 9th century Hindu temple dedicated to the trinity of Hindu Gods Brahma-Vishnu-Shiva. So there are three main temples for these three Gods, and a number of smaller temples for their transport, and other Gods. The temples are very well restored from ruins. Your ticket also includes a complimentary toy train ride of the entire complex, so you can also see an ancient Buddhist temple in the same complex.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Ancient Hindu temple in Jogjakarta Indonesia. Simply mesmerizing, the structure, the design... the beauty of it all is beyond words.

After reading some reviews, we were expecting this to be a relatively small complex largely in ruins. The temples here are exceptional, and they have restored it to a high standard and are working at restoring other areas nearby. 

You can enter many of the main temples and spend lots of time looking at the carvings and wonderful architecture, while we also squeezed in some archery on site for only 20k IDR pp. 

At 325k IDR pp it is perhaps a little more expensive than other attractions, but I feel it is more than worth it.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
ジョグジャカルタのホテルからカーチャーターして、ボロブドゥール寺院の後に行きました。

２回目の訪問でしたが、前回は地震の影響で中まで入って見れませんでしたので、今回はゆっくりと敷地内の寺院を見て回りました。

１４：００位から見学しましたが、入場料はボロブドゥール寺院で購入したジョイントチケットで入場しました。
両方の寺院併せてＵＳ＄４０ですが、今はインドネシアルピアでしか支払い出来ませんので、注意が必要です。

寺院自体はとても見ごたえがあり、まだ修復が終わってない所も多々ありますが、それでも感動します。

ジョグジャカルタに行く際には必見です。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: An awesome monument / structure that was built in the 9th Century. Prambanan Temple Compounds consist of Prambanan Temple, Sewu Temple, Bubrah Temple and Lumbung Temple (closed for restoration). The Prambanan Temple is decorated with reliefs illustrating the Indonesian version of the Ramayana epic which are masterpieces of stone carvings.

Although Borobudur is special, I liked Prambanan better since it was a bit easier to explore (less crowds) and could also enjoy it from several corners in relative solitude and peace (excluding my own kids). Definitely a must see as well.

Wij hebben de Prambanan met zonsondergang bezocht. Mooi om te zien hoe de zon steeds een stukje zakt. Ondanks dat we niet de mooiste zonsondergang hadden van de week, wel een aanrader! Veel lokale mensen die met je op de foto willen. Druk, maar hoe donkerder het wordt, hoe rustiger. Heb dus vooral wat geduld! 
Jammer dat als je eruit komt, je terecht komt in een enorme markt. Maar dat is helaas bijna overal zo op de toeristische plekken...

This monument is one of those place you need to go when you are in Yogya. It is close to Airport and on the main road from Yogya to Solo. 

It has been hit be earthquakes many times, but still the Indonesians managed to restore the main site. On surrounding temples is still worked, but that does not disturb you when you visit the main temple buildings.

Take some time to visit and walk around the outside of the temples to see another mankind creation of history!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Conjunto de templos increibles muy cerca de la ciudad de Yogyakarta, a los cuales se puede llegar en el bus urbano tal y como hicimos nosotros. Si te gustan este tipo de templo-ruinas, imagino que sí, cuando uno viaja hasta allí, te quedaras con la boca abierta y quedaras impresionado!! Lo único malo es que a mi parecer abusan con los precios hacia el turista! Creo que se han pasado en los precios, si pusieran precios mas económicos creo que los visitaría mas turistas, aunque finalmente lo pagas y merece la pena!
ボロブドゥール遺跡をメインにした旅行で、ついでに寄るイメージが強かったプランバナン遺跡（あくまで個人的なイメージです）。想像以上の美しさと規模にも驚かされたが、同じ公園内にある他の寺院も地震でほとんど原型をとどめていないながらも美しい。夜にこの公園内で行われる『RAMAYANA BALLET』という演目も、プランバナン寺院をバックに幻想的な雰囲気で楽しめました。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
If it's possible for you don't book a fixed trip, but go by scooter (our hotel was in Yogyakarta) There are a lot smaller temples close by, and also very beautiful.

We liked prambanan very much, but you need to see all of them. The most far away is also incredible and so quiet.

Off course there are a lot of tourist, so try to go not in the weekend or holiday.

Tempat wisata untuk semua umur.
Ada taman bermain, museum tentang pembangunan ulang candi yang dikerjakan oleh Dinas Pubakala, renovasi pasca gempa.
DI pintu keluar ditawarkan bermacam souvenir untuk oleh-oleh.

Bring a student id if you have one and consider buying the package ticket (prambanan and Borobudur two day validity). 315,000 IDR

You can take the local bus here (1A) from malioboro to terminal station for 3500 IDR. From the bus station turn left, walk about 300 meters and you will see signs for the temples. Be aware the local bus will be crowded if you stay until sunset and you might have to wait a while for an empty bus.

Salah satu candi yg harus dikunjungi jika lagi berlibur di jogja. Letaknya tdk jauh dari pusat kota jogja dan bisa dijangkau pakai transportasi umum apapun termasuk bus transjogja. Viewnya indah sekali apalagi pas sunset tiba..indahnya gk kalah sama liat sunset di pantai loh...

Prambanan Temple also known as Roro Jonggrang Temple/Temple of the Slender Virgin, was built 9th century, during the reign of two kings, Rakai Pikatan and Rakai Balitung.  The temple complex covers an area of 39.8 hectares which include 240 temples, making it the largest Hindu temple in Indonesia.  The tallest temple stands 47 metres high, (the highest Hindu temple in Indonesia) and is dedicated to Shiva, the destroyer, which is flanked by temples dedicated to Brahma, the creator and Vishnu, the sustainer.  The complex has been UNESCO listed since 1991.  The legend that goes with the temple about Roro Jonggrang and Bandung Bondowoso is interesting and can be found online.

This is a huge area to see, so a good deal of time should be put aside, as there are numerous beautiful bas-reliefs, (these are time consuming in themselves) and sculptures inside some of the temples.  If the opportunity arises do try and see the Ramayana Ballet here, it is brilliant, even though it rained when we attended and saw it undercover, rather than outside with the temple as a backdrop.  There are four classes of tickets available from Rp 125,000 - Rp 400,000.  

As lovely as Prambanan was, we both preferred Plaosan Temple 2.5kms away, it was built by Queen Pramodhawardhani, wife of Rikai Piatan.  The temple is a lot smaller but it was quieter, very tranquil and beautiful, with only a couple of other people visiting.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Take your time (2hours) and rent a tandem bike to visit the second temple (30' max for 2 perd) Few people and back to the deposit you can climb on a plateform to take great pictures of the pramabanan temple

Невозможно побывать на Яве и не посетить Прамбанан! Это все равно, что побывать в Москве и не посетить Кремль. Это не один храм, а храмовый комплекс. Прамбанан- единственный индонезийский, все остальные храмы в комплексе буддийские, и он представляет индонезийскую версию эпоса Рамаяна. По преданию, храм Прамбанан был построен по причине безответной любви. По другому называют его  Лара Джонгранг или «Стройная дева»  Возлюбленная принца Бондовосо  Лара поставила перед женихом невыполнимую задачу: построить храм с 1000 статуей в одну ночь и тогда она выйдет за него замуж ( очень напоминает русскую сказку) И принц почти все исполнил, но хитрая Джонгранг попросила местных жителей сымитировать рассвет, разведя костры  Чувствуя что его обманули, Бондовосо, который, завершил только 999 статуй, проклял Джонгранг, и она окаменела. Окаменелое тело стало тысячной статуей, благодаря вмешательству Шивы и стоит  сейчас в северной части его Храма. Титаническая и одновременно тонкая работа! Легенд там полно. Архитектура, но чтобы было интересно требуется небольшая подготовка. Брали индивидуального гида, который с очень нетрадиционно и с чувством юмора показывал нам остров.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Visited Borobudur in the morning and Prambanan in the afternoon. The temples are so beautiful and we enjoyed walking there and take beautiful photos.
Very Nice to visit at sunset. Not huge but beautifull. Certainly Worth the visit. I spent almost two hours. Walking around.  Enjoying the peaceful atmosphere. Listening to guides...:-)
Very good historical site, 30k rupiahs for the ticket or 75k if you have interest to visit Ratu Boko. Just missing the ramayana ballet and visit to candi sewu
Very cool place. Much cheaper with student price. Dont miss the also large temple a bit further away in the area, when we came there it was nearly empty of people and awesome!

Komplek candi nya luas dan panas banget kalau siang hari kesana, disarankan bawa payung dan air minum secukupnya karna penjual hanya ada diluar komplek candi. Dekat pintu keluar candi prambanan ada kereta dan sewa mobil untuk keliling komplek, biar nggak capek, disarankan naik kendaraan tersebut sampai pintu keluar.

Unbelievably impressive complex of temples !
The complex has been only partly reconstructed, but even so, it is amazing !
One cannot forget these temples were built almost 25 centuries ago!
Awesome!

Honestly i went there knowing i will pay more than my local girlfriend but she paid 75k to visit prambanan and ratu boko. Me i paid....520k what an insane discrimination especially when inside you dont have any cultural informations about temples unless in the small museum quite far from buildings. And even in the museum it is often in indonesian only.
So you pay a lot, dont understand, and...they dont accept credit card (like foreigners always have millions of rupiah in there pocket as a gift for thieves) and inside half of activities still ask for money.
We want visit historic temple, we dont want go to an attraction park, and we are not bank of indonesia. Honestly ive been amazed by the constructions but it sounds like they did the minimum and ask the maximum price.
There is such a good potential but not well done. 
In add seeing people sitting everywhere without care about the old stones makes me sad. Sometimes im thinking they are treating better a poor mosquee in the street than their heritage even indonesia is pancasila.

I recommend the visit as a something important in indonesia but if you have at least 300k to spend only for this otherwise go to borobodur.

The good point if we can say that is that shops around are easy to bargain and prices are  fair compare to malioboro street.

How to get there: 
1. You can order online car (uber/grabcar/gocar) 
2. By transjogja line 1A, get on at Malioboro 1 stop near malioboro mall (ticket IDR 3,500) and get off at Prambanan stop. Continue by walking to the temple (about 950 m walk) or hire a pedicab for about IDR 20,000.

Entrance ticket: local tourist (adult) IDR 40,000, foreign tourist USD 25

Suitable for: history buff, photo hunting, relaxing walk around, architecture, culture buff

I visited Prambanan before, but that time I visited on afternoon. And it's scorching hot that you can't enjoy walking around the temples.
The stones become hot to touch, too. Taking pictures also not enjoyable when your sweating glands are busy.

This time I tried to visit on Evening (sunset time). I entered the temples at 5 pm and it's perfect. It's breezy to walk around and also you can enjoy beautiful panorama with orangey skies as its background.

But.. if you plan to take bundling package ticket for Prambanan&Ratu Boko, don't come after 3 as the bundling tickets are just sold until 3 pm at the counter (you have to recheck this info as I'm not sure whether it's last sold at 2 or 3 pm)

Een must see als je Indonesie bezoekt. Mooi om te zien hoe zoiets ooit gebouwt is. Helaas heeft de aardbeving veel verwoest en worden dingen langzaam weer hersteld. We hadden een engels sprekende gids die al aardig op leeftijd was maar hij wist dan ook wel alles over de tempels te vertellen. Erg druk door lokale bevolking. Wij waren de enige blanke op dat moment en waren zelf ook een attractie.
자연과 어우러진 고요하고 아름다운 유적지입니다. 평온하고 세속에서 벗어난 기분을 느낄수있습니다.

Sekarang saya akan membahas tentang objek wisata yang ada di kota Yogyakarta salah satunya adalah objek wisata Candi Prambanan. Candi Prambanan merupakan mahakarya kebudayaan Hindu dari abad ke-9 yang memiliki ketinggian bangunan sekitar 47 meter. Candi Prambanan atau Candi Roro Jonggrang merupakan Candi Hindu tercantik didunia dan juga Candi Hindu terbesar di Indonesia.

Keindahan Wisata Candi Prambanan ini memiliki begitu banyak keindahan mulai dari arsitek bangunannya yang betigu megah dilengkapi dengan 3 candi utama yang berada di halaman utama Candi Prambanan. Tiga candi utama tersebut adalah Candi Wisnu, Candi Braha dan Candi Siwa. Ketiga candi tersebut merupakan lambing dari Trimurti dalam kepercayaan Hindu dan ketiga candi tersebut sama–sama menghadap kearah timur. Dari ketiga canti tersebut memillki keunikan sendiri dan setiap candi didampingi satu candi yang menghadap kearah barat. Candi ini memiliki 2 candi apit, 4 candim kelir, 4 candi patok dan 224 candi perwara .
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Met de taxi van yogyakarta naar het Prambanan tempelcomplex gereden.
Leuke rit om vervolgens bij de kassa te worden doorverwezen naar een aparte kassa voor vreemdelingen waar je in plaats van de lokale prijs van omgerekend 5 euro ineens 21 euro per persoon mag betalen.
Imprescindible si vas a Java, un sitio espectacular, sobre todo en la puesta de sol. Un poco cara la entrada, pero merece la pena. No puedes obviar la visita junto con bodobudur

We finally can scratch this one off our bucket list. Our driver/tour guide Teguh took us here one early morning about 7:30am around Ramadan.  We planned to do the sunset tour but instead we had a change of plan. We got here  when the place barely opened.. There weren't many visitors and we felt like we had the park all to ourselves. The temples were an amazing sight, hard to imagine how anyone  from hundreds years ago had the technical know how to build structures like them. We didn't get any guide. We  explored the park ourselves. We first visited the primary temple that's near the entrance of the park and made our way to the 2nd largest one, Candi Sewu.  The Sewu temple is quite far from the entrance. You will need to get a shuttle or ride a bike(rental available near the museum) to get there if you are not in a mood to walk 30min or more.  Bare in mind if you are there too early like us, the bikes aren't even at the rental place for rent. Furthermore one thing I did noticed is that the are bathrooms all through out the park. The ones closed to the entrance have western toilet. Good for you if  you aren't accustomed to the old way of doing business. BTW, there appears to be a zoo there, I saw a herd of roaming mammals(can't tell what they are from a distance" and a strangely looking "bird". Lastly we didn't visit the museum as it were just interested in visiting the temples.

Sebbene la giornata cominci con una levataccia, i templi di Prambanan riescono a ripagare abbondantemente il sonno perduto. Magnifici edifici, in un luogo di un amenità rara, se spiegati da una guida locale guadagnano ancora più fascino!
Attenzione alle ore calde ma assolutamente consigliato!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: A good counterpoint to Borobudur, these temples are on the opposite (east) side of Yogyakarta, but well worth a visit. They are about a thousand years old and very interesting, still undergoing restoration.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Nicely restored.  A long visit isn't required to appreciate the accomplishment.  Convenient to visit on way to central Yogya from the airport.

I visited in the late afternoon where the sun wasn't at its hottest.  I thoroughly enjoyed this place and spent a few hours going around the site a few times.  Like Angkor Wot, this style of temple is breath-taking, why do we not build structures like this anymore instead of big glass skyscrapers!

Such a shame the perimeter houses many stacked up boulders from an earthquake that devastated a lot of the temples, however all the main ones are still fully in tact in the centre.

Sunset was wonderful here and I would most definitely recommend it as a must do.  I didn't have a tour guide because I was being cheap and got an uber here.  I wish I had got here earlier so I could have enjoyed spending more time walking around this lovely place.  I even got a few moments to meditate inside one of the smaller temples at the perimeter.

Also a random deer enclosure inside and some weird turkey creature. They don't appear to look after these animals very well and that was the only downside...
wisata keluarga,tempatnya luas dan disarankan naik kereta yg dikelola oleh pihak candi untuk bisa berkeliling melihat candi candi disekitar...

It's an easy drive from central Yogy. We paid rp250,000 from Yogy and back including wait time. Rp325,000pp entrance. We arrived at 11:00 and there was no queue at all - the site was very quiet, perhaps because it was Ramadan. It's a wonderful Ankor style site. The main Prambanan temple takes about 30 min to stroll around. We virtually had it to ourselves. We then walked the short and tree shaded road to the other smaller temples and into the excellent museum on the way back. I think the photo opportunities are better from the side of the main temple as you walk to the other temples. As you exit, as in Borobudur too, there are literally hundreds of shops. Fortunately we were not hassled. Overall a really wonderful site, which we had virtually to ourselves.

Mooi om even te zien, en eigenlijk een must see als je in Yogya bent. Moet wel zeggen dat we de Borobudur veel mooier vinden! Dus als je moet kiezen, kies dan voor de Borobudur. Anders kun je op beide locaties een combiticket kopen: 520.000 idr per persoon. Tickets zijn dan twee dagen geldig (de dag van aankoop en de dag erna). Er is bij de Prambanan trouwens geen dresscode. Wij zijn nog helemaal naar achteren gelopen, als je tempels interessant vindt is dat een leuke optie.
Paid 325K for entrance, is pretty expensive to me. Not a very big complex. Well maintained temple complex.

like many temples in Indonesia, Prambanan temple does have its beauty as the symbol of trinity and sacrifice. Hindhu people devote their life to follow the path of Three Gods, Brahma, Vishnu, Siva, who teach them about how to use and keep the nature as well as impact of neglecting the duty in preserving the nature. sacrifice of a man (Bandung Bondowoso) who did everything he could to be together with the woman (Rara Jonggrang) he loved. though at the end he was unable to have her due to her refusal of him and turned into a cursed.

As an Indonesian, i think the 2017 price for sightseeing the prambanan is a bit pricey. The sorrounding's improvement is good. But still its not worth the price.
But if you are a temple lover, it may worth.
Mooi, maar als het gezien hebt, dan heb je het ook gezien, entree duur, Gids is wel goedkoop. Alss je een goede hebt dan geeft die een complete voorstelling

Very expensive for foreigners! Other Temples around 100 times cheaper. This is not a Zoo, what is a point to have deers and ostrich parked in a small area? There are more shops for tourist than temples.
We are coming to visit a historical place not to go to Disneyland!

Visiting the ruins of the temple certainly always leave a deep impression. How our ancestors who have technological limitations can build this grand building. Even if you see the legend, this can be done Bandung Bondowoso in a day! Yes, a day!

In an official visit, my colleagues and I always look for time to mengunjngi tourist attractions somewhere, as narrow whatever time we have and as a tourism object is shaped. Well, this time we traveled from the city of Yogya heading outside the city through Sleman District. We used chartered taxi at that time. Prambanan can be reached in about an hour. The distance is relatively short compared to the distance Yogya to another phenomenal temple namely Borobudur.

One of the most beautiful temples in the world is a complex of temple ruins. The number reached hundreds. This is the uniqueness of these attractions because you can enjoy the panoramic view of some temple buildings. Prambanan itself is the largest Hindu temple ever built generation of ancient Java. Some interesting temples here such as Shiva temple, Brahma temple and Vishnu temple. There are temples that have statues inside. According to legend, one of the statues is Roro Jonggrang, the figure who became the ambition of Bandung Bondowoso so he would accept the challenge of building a thousand temples in one night.

Taking photos in the temple complex is indeed beautiful. I think come when the day before the afternoon so you get a beautiful sunset lighting. At that time, I came when the new day was raining. So the atmosphere tends to overcast. And other lessons we can get from this legend of ruins. There is a will, there is a way. As long as we want to take our targets then we will get the way. Bandung Bondowoso has a desire to live together with Roro Jonggrang then he also took the path to build a thousand temples. Roro Jonggrang has a desire to thwart the plan of Bandung Bondowoso He also took a tricky way to thwart the construction of wells and a thousand temples. Well, from this ancient ruins we get a lot of beauty and a good moral message. Highly recommended!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Candi Prambanan or Candi Rara Jonggrang is an 9th-century Hindu temple compound in Central Java, Indonesia, dedicated to the Trimurti, the expression of God as the Creator (Brahma), the Preserver (Vishnu) and the Destroyer (Shiva). The temple compound is located approximately 17 kilometres (11 mi) northeast of the city of Yogyakarta. The temple is well preserved, The Ramayana is engraved on the walls of the temple, the temple also has Lord Ganesha, Goddess Durga, Shiva linga etc.,

One of the must do ofcourse ..so i did ...
Expensive entries..almost 250000idror was it more ?I don't recall ..
Huge complex alright and hymns and music in background to add to the server feel.
Hindu relic and ancient temple with shivalinga inside one of them .
Temple complex very well maintained and can while time sitting under a tree and basking ..
Soaking it in..

But india has way way better temples and hoohaaa  hoopla..so couldn't find myself admiring and being in awe ...
Didnt bother with guide .but enjoyed the sunset views ..
Almost all places gice a good sunset view .
Darker black stone formations .nearby is ratuboku temple so if u wish to visit ..buy both places together ..u get discount..and temple shuts by 5pm..make sure to come earlier than that ..

Highlight is the Ramayana ballet at 7pm which is alternate days ..so check the timings and dates before heading here or u will be disappointed if they not airing it that day .
Options are in open complex which is far better and better experience but if it is raining:  it is staged indoors in their auditorium. 

If u yet miss this ; u can catch it in Yogyakarta which is nice ..maybe not as nice as this ..and it is aired everyday .

Dinner options available at restaurant within complex served as buffet ..
Keep the car with you whole day as going back to town maybe an issue by grab or Uber. 

Enjoy

The view and the temples are nice, but what makes it great is to hear the stories from all of these amazing stones and the details on them. For this you need a guide, but it's worth it. The temples has different gods with different stories, which won't make any sence without a guide. But make sure to take your time to visit this place.

Magnifiques temples même si beaucoup de ruines. 
Visite faite en juin en fin de matinée avec très peu de touristes. 
Le site est immense, ne pas oublier d'aller voir les autres temples qui sont tout aussi magnifiques. 
Juste un conseil éviter d'y aller en fin de matinée, début d'après midi il y fait très très chaud et les 3 arbres présents sont pris d'assaut. 
Seul point négatif pour sortir nous sommes obligés de passer devant tous les vendeurs de souvenirs qui parfois peuvent être insistants.

Un lugar muy especial, accesible fácilmente en autobús y con grandes grabados. Es una parada obligatoria.
Lo visitamos al atardecer y merece la pena, menos turistas y un clima mágico.

Do not forget to visit Prambanan Temple if you are in Yogyakarta or Central Java! It will be an unforgettable experience. Or even you can try to calculate if there are 1000 temples there?
Roro Jongrang story is tells the love of a prince to a princess who ends with the cursed of the princess due to the ruse that he did asking to make 1000 temples overnight! Amazing!
Prambanan is a relic of Hindu temple in central java, for hindu who can pray in monument that have been prepared, and do not forget to pray, may your prayer be granted .. experience that will not forgotten, one day I will visit again.
Great moments, great place!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: My first visit to Indonesia and listed this site as the first. One of the Hinduism temple which still exist in Java Island. How a great architecture which created amazing sculpture and complicated design.

Incontournable si vous êtes dans l'est de Java. Superbe temple magnifiquement bien rénové. Très peu de monde en mai/juin pendant le ramadan, à n'importe quelle heure de la journée. Billet combiné Prambanan-Borobudur à 530 000 idr par personne, valable pour 2 jours pour les deux temples. N'hésitez pas à prendre un guide, c'est pas cher et très utile.

A ne pas manquer. Attention aux orages en fin de journée!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Zeker met zonsondergang een hele indrukwekkende tempel en de toegangsprijs meer dan waard. Een must see bij een bezoek aan Yogyakarta

This is already place you must visit if you stay on Java. History, respect of build....There is no problem to take a guide and listen history and story about Prambanan. The entrance ticket is little bit expensive but if you are here once in your live, don´t pass it

While Borobudur gets most of the attention, Prambanan is equally impressive. One Buddhist and one Hindu, the two temples differ markedly in terms of religious background, architecture and also purpose. Prambanan is in regular use to this day. In my view, you must go and see Prambanan if you visit Borobudur. Personally I would not do them on the same day for cultural and logistical reasons but that will also depend on how time you have got. Out of the many surrounding lesser temples Plaosan is probably most worthwhile though you could skip it if you are short of time.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Don't get me wrong, Prambanan was really nice.! I still think it is a must visit when you are in the area. However, it was appalling to find graffiti inside one of the temples.
When we were there on a weekend, there was a gathering of people (an event) on the lawn not far from the temples, and the loud sound from their microphone and speakers took away the experience. We left in about 90 minutes after exploring just the biggest temple that is dedicated to Shiva.

At $25 per person, kind of a rip off. It's a great view, but compared with other temple city areas in SE Asia, it's pretty sterile -- the reconstruction is OK, but the inner statues don't seem to have been well restored or are missing. The smaller temples in the back are in various states of reconstruction. If you're on limited time or budget, the see Borobudur for sure -- also expensive, but that one is like no other in the region. This one is OK, but just don't expect to be wowed.

Junto con Borobudur las entradas mas caras pero ambos lo ameritan. Estan a 18 Km nada mas de Yogya y si visitaste Angkor Wat te resultaran familiares, pero son anteriores y bien conservados. Son tresm templos el central dedicado a Shiva es el mas alto cerca de 50 metros en el interior 4 estatuas la del dios, su esposa, su hijo Gaeesha (el de la cabeza de elefante)y su profesor.cada uno en un punto cardinal, los tres templos muestran tallas que relatan el Ramayana. Alrededor ruinas de 224 templos aunque dicen que eran mil. Me pidieron sacarse fotos conmigo decenas de Indonesios familias y escolares, ahora se que siente Maradona, ja
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Awe inspiring site covering a large area. Exquisite temples. This will take at least 2 hours or more and the drive out to see it is very interesting too.
This is a beautiful temple. Very impressive. We did the visit directly after visiting the Borobodur and there is no compare. Both are must visits but better the other way arround.

The towering construction of the temples is a real humbling experience, definitely worth a visit.

There's also a museum that gives a very brief introduction on the temples.

However, it's really quite pricey for foreigners to visit, so you need to plan your trip accordingly. 

Also do bring some toilet paper with you as the toilets don't stock toilet papers!

Prambanan is a really stunning Hindu temple. I purchsed the combination ticket for 32 US$ !! and sent to see BOROBODUR next day. I took a guide, which I strongly recomend, as he told me so many secrets spots to take best photos, the history of course and many other things, I would have not noticed myself. A realy beautiful temple with nice gardens within a huge ground. MANY MANY loud school children though - very undisciplined  and disrespectful of the place! ...actually  very sad !
I experienced same next day at BOROBODUR.  
Prambanan is very easy to walk around, visit each  each individual temple. All temple have multiple stone carvings  - and each has  a different Hindu god. It really got on my nerves the locals and esp. those nagging school children wanting to to take photos with me!  Still, I highly recommend this place ! Before exiting, go up on the tree house in the far gardens and take more awesome photos of this place!!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Prachtig complex met verschillende tempels. Uiteraard is de prambanan de meest bekende tempel. Je kunt hier relax rondlopen. Wij waren er rond 2 uur 's middags en toen was het lekker rustig. 

Op het complex kun je ook in een treintje of een fiets huren. Wij hebben rondgewandeld. 

Onderweg kwam een dame op de fiets nog drinken verkopen. Prima prijs en heerlijk koud water.

Bagi para traveler yang akan ke jogja tidak lengkap jika tidak ke candi prambanan, jarak dari bandara adisujipto tidak jauh hanya sekitar 15 menit saja, jika tidak ada kendaraan bisa menggunakan bus trans jakarta langsung ke jogja hanya dengan Rp3500,00. Kemudian setelah sampai di halteu prambanan, dari halteu menuju candi bisa jalan kaki atau naik ojek/beca sekitar Rp10.000 sd Rp20.000. Harga tiket masuk Rp40.000 tetapi ada paket2 ke candi lain. Saya pilih paket candi prambanan dan boko Rp75.000 (termasuk fasilitas untuk menuju candi boko). Disarankan untuk mengunjunginya di pagi hari atau sore hari, karena cuaca disana panas. Jangan lupa bawa payung atau topi. Bagi yang gampang cape, di prambanan juga terdapat semacam transport jika ingin berkeliling tanpa merasakan lelah, tapi tetap harus merogoh kocek anda. Candi prambanan adalah candi yang sangat megah dan indah.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Among the temples that I think this is a very romantic, not one crowned as one of the most beautiful temples in Southeast Asia

This 10th century Hindu complex includes the temples of Prambanan & Sewu (also 2 other smaller temple sites) and was worth the admission price (300,000 idr each).  Allow yourself at least a couple hours to see it all especially if you go inside all the individual shrines like I did. It was a hot day when we visited but there are a few shade trees to get a reprieve when needed.  Also, this site was not crowded like Borobudur which made for a better experience. A must see
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Equally stunning as the Borobodur Buddhist Temple which is a few kilometers away. This is said to be the biggest and grandest Hindu Temple in all Indonesia. The complex is vast and there are also bas reliefs, the scale of the temples are quite astonishing making it a UNESCO World heritage site, one of 2 in Yogyakarta. 

The Ramayana ballet at night on selected days is highly recommended as the Prambanan becomes the backdrop. As with any popular site, best to go early to avoid the crowd.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Hele mooie tempel. Gigantisch groot. Er is een mooi park omheen. Je moet het echt gezien hebben. We waren hier wat later ej daardoor kwamen er veel groepen van de lokale bevolking vragen of ze met ons op de foto mochten. Het leek wel of wij de atractie waren. De mensen van het platteland kennen alleen maar blanke mensen van televisie en wij waren daardoor erg bijzonder.
We vonden het niet erg om op de foto te gaan.
プランバナン寺院はこじんまりとしていて、小さなアンコールワットをみているような感じでした。同じ敷地内には他の寺院もあったので自転車を借りて回りました。

It felt like you're in a different time! Magnificent and beautiful. One of my favorite cultural sites in Indonesia. I would recommend every traveler to visit this beauty once traveling to Indonesia. The bus options to go to this temple were not too difficult to navigate. When you stay in Yogyakarta, it was pretty straight forward. Everybody also guessed where you're going and would help directing you to the right place!! 10/10 would recommend!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Op het complex vindt je meerdere tempels maar Prambanan is de grootste en de meest indrukwekkend. Op de muren van dit uit meerdere tempels bestaande complex is het verhaal van Rama en Shinta afgebeeld wat ook door het Ramayana ballet wordt uitgevoerd. Beste tijd om te gaan is rond 2 uur 's middags  (mits je tegen de hitte kunt) aangezien het dan  minder druk is.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Amazing place with huge temples in a green big park. All are made in stone with many clear beautiful scruptures.

Easy & convenient to go. Sit on aircon bus 1A from one of 3 stations at Malioboro street in very centre of Jogja. The las bus station is just outside the fence of the park. You can see the top of some temples from the main street so it is not difficult to orientate.

Temple à 25 minutes en voiture de Yogakarta.
À voir absolument pour sa magnificence et son calme. Très différent du temple de Borobodur, il est intéressant par son architecture assez élancée.
À voir absolument

Tempat wisata yang sedikit mahal untuk warga lokal,hanya untuk masuk ke kawasan candi.
Namun memiliki nilai sejarah yang bagus,perkenalkan tempat sejarah ini untuk anak-anak anda

Prambanan Temple is indeed a must visit place at Yogyakarta city. It is so amazingly beautiful. Actually our itinerary is to visit before sunset to take sunset picture with Prambanan as highlight and so we can watch Ramayana Ballet show at evening. But there are some changes on our itinerary and we change our plan to visit at morning. At morning are not many visitors which are the plus point so I can take as much as picture and explore all temples as I like. Read some history about this UNESCO World Heritage Site, the largest Hindu temple site in Indonesia. Three Trimurti main temples dedicated to Shiva, Visnu, and Brahma and three Vahana temples in front of Trimurti temples dedicated to the vahana of each gods; Nandi, Garuda, and Hamsa. We met with some primary students with their teacher and took picture together. The kids are very curious with other people even we are same Indonesian. And they are not shy to take picture with us.
There is an interesting tale or legend saying that there is son of the king named Bandung Bondowoso that fall in love with Roro Jonggrang a beautiful daughter of the king of Prambanan. Bandung Bondowoso then proposes to Roro Jonggrang. But Roro Jonggrang knows that Bandung Bodowoso is the person who killed her father. She gave him a condition if he can build 1000 temple and 2 well in one night, she will marry him. With the help of genie friends, Bandung Bondowoso manages to build 999 temples. Roro Jonggrang panic and ask all the ladies at Prambanan village to pound the rice and the entire rooster calling means sunrise is coming. Bandung Bondowoso is very angry with Roro Jonggrang’s trick and curse Roro Jonggrang become a statue and be the one thousandth temple at Prambanan.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: My family group of 3 adults and 3 children visited the Prambanan Temple site upon reaching Yogyakarta in the afternoon. We found that the tickets are really expensive for foreigners and around 10%for our Indonesian friend. You should buy the "Prambanan and Borobudur" package ticket at US$40 per adult and around US$26 per kid. The savings are around 50% compared to buying individual site tickets at location. And any visitors to Jogja must visit both sites!😄The only catch is this combo ticket is valid for 2 consecutive days only, so do plan your trip with your local driver or guide. While I grumbled at the high cost at the beginning, I am happy I had the experience of viewing an archeological and architectural wonder! 👏🏻And you must stay till sunset...look at my photos, no extra charge for that!😜

Diantara candi yang ada menurut saya ini candi yang sangat romantis ditambah saya mengunjungi ketika sore hari ketika senja :) tidak salah dinobatkan sebagai salah satu candi terindah di Asia Tenggara

Polecam każdemu, niezwykłe miejsce pełne ducha minionych wieków. Zwiedzasz nie jedna ale aż 4 kompleksy świątynne. Warta uwagi jest restauracja wewnątrz kompleksu ma niskie ceny w stosunku do cen na Bali

Tres templos consagrados a cada una de las deidades principales del hinduismo: Siva, Visnú y Brahma. Estos santuarios están ornamentados con relieves ilustrativos de la epopeya del Ramayana.

Have been several time to this temple.
This time I came early to get sunrise and praying.

Be first guest when the temple gate are open are really enjoyable stll silent with sunrise come up from the east accompanying by bird singing rejuvenate my soul.

It's really worth to visit early in the morning if you like silent, peace and realxing feelibg moment. Alsi getting sunrise which beautifully add the siluette of the temple.

Recommend go late afternoon so you can

And finally Yogyakarta is full of amazingly friendly people. Fun food it's not a tourist place. We loved it. If food history and culture are your thing and meeting people. Brilliant

Review Text: We went to Prambanan Temples complex after our Mt Merapi trip on our 1st day in Yogyakarta. We reached the Temples complex about 4.30 pm. The entrance ticket per person is Indo Ruppiah 234k per person (foreigners). We hired a guide to bring us around the temple complex for one hour at Indo Ruppiah 100k. Within the complex there are also Buddhist temples which are located further away. One can choose to hire bicycle as it is quite a distance away. We were told to take a train ride, but to our disappointment, we were told that there must have at least 10 passengers before they move. The Prambanan is also a place to watch for sunset. We were supposed to go to Ratu Boko to catch the sunset which is about 15 minutes drive from Prambanan. However, we were advised by our guide to stay at Prambanan to catch the sunset instead otherwise we would missed the sunset when we reached Ratu Boko. We stayed at the main entrance point to catch the sunset which was expected by 5.30 pm. We saw a few photographers were already taken position with all their cameras ready. It was also disappointing that the evening was cloudy. I would said Prambanan is another historical heritage to visit.
