Review Text:
Travelling around SE Asia you come across a lot of temples, so much so that they become a tad repetitive. However, Prambanan Temple stands out as one of the nicest I've seen...similar in structure to Angkor Wat, although on a smaller scale. 

We had the whole place to ourselves, unusual in Asia, so it was really enjoyable. There is 3 other temples on the grounds that make for a pleasant walk around. Or if your feeling lazy you can hop on a golf caddy. 

The temple is really easy to get to from Yogyakarta, hop on a bus from Malioboro street for 3,500Rp (20c) and it gets you there in an hour. Much cheaper than a taxi and just as easy.

Great to go and see the temples at Borobudur and Prambanan. A lot more hassle from local sellers than anywhere else in Indoesia which is a slight downside but if you want tourist market stuff then it might be useful to you. Do not use the toilets outside the entrance gate - there is a charge for these; the ones inside are free!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
This is a very majestic Hindu temple in Yogyakarta which is now more than a thousand years old.  The temple is absolutely stunning and you will definitely be awed by the sight and the intrigue designs of most of the temples. 

The sad part is basically the place is not very well maintained and tourist friendly.  Of course there a lot of opportunities for great photography session but for those for wanted to learn more about the history of the place you will be left disappointed.  They only have a brief general explanation on the history of the temple on a board at the entrance but nothing on each individual temple once you are in the temple's ground.  They should have erected signages explaining more on the history of the each individual temple and further elaborate on the significant roles of the Hindus' Gods such Lord Shiva, Lord Brahma and Lord Vishnu during the 9th century.

However it is still a must visit place when you are in Yogyakarta.

Fantastic temple complex. Awe inspiring tribute to the skill, dedication and religious devotion of the 9th century Javanese

Magnificent, breath taking and very memorable

Shame on those responsible or taking international aid in money and expertise for all these years and then ripping-off international visitors $25 each to get in to enjoy the result

Shame for the lack of english signage so a few  "guides" can rip us off a bit more

Shame for the disgusting bazzar of rubbishy tatt that you force us to exit through so that you can make some rent from the stall holders

SHAME for betraying your duty to humankind, to the international community which has paid for the rebuilding of these temples by your cheap, tawdry profiteering

Shame

No one should pass by Yogyakharta (Jogja) without going to Prambanan temples! It is simply stunning and so much bigger than Borobudur! Make sure to go and see Sewu temple on the back-end of the site (as there is more than just the main temple) as it is also in great shape and you can make stunning pictures. You can stay on the site until the sunset so stick around as it is worth it and you don't need to pay extra for the nearby Ratu Bako temple. 

There are young Indonesian training as tour guides so you can have free tour guides (only in English) when visiting which we found great.

Our recommendation is to get the combo ticket with Borobudur (you can do it on two separate days as long as they are consecutive days) as it is cheaper (but still far above the price locals are paying!). If you have a student ID without an expiry date, bring it to lower your cost as you get a 50% discount which feels good as the combo ticket is 32$ for foreigners! Our recommendation is to first visit Borobudur and then Prambanan as we found Prambanan to be far more interesting with more things to see, not doing justice to Borobudur temple. Both temples are different but you will understand when you see the temples. 

The temple is easily accessed by Trans Jogja bus 1A (3500 IDR from the center - unbeatable). 

We visited during the low season (October) and managed to get pictures without people on them. During high season, forget it as we heard that thousands of people are on the site!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Wir haben den Ausflug zur Borobudur Tempelanlage mit dem Besuch von Prambanan verbunden. Das Kombiticket Borobudur und Prambanan war preislich ok. Prambanan hat uns besser gefallen.

udah sering banget kesini tapi ga pernah bosen tiap liburan ksini, karena salah satu ikonnya jogja. ga cuma liat candi, foto foto tapi bisa beli beraneka ragam oleh oleh jogja di pasar prambanannya sekitaran candinya

The Prambanan Temple site is located a bit outside Yogyakarta but worth the effort to get there. Onsite you can hire a guide for about 10$ cdn (8$ us) who will take you into the site and explain the many carvings and panels. It is very old being built back in 9th century I believe and is the largest Hindu temple in Indonesia. If history is your thing you will love this site.... And if you just like to pictures of cool things than this is also a great site for you! Enjoy the visit! Also, if you like local crafts there is a large collection of vendors hawking their wares as you exit the grounds.... So bring cash if this interests you!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
If you have been to Temples like Angkor Wat and Borobudur, this temple disappoints you a touch. It was probably a great and massive structure when it was built centuries ago, but the remains aren't that magnificent today. Of course, a lot of renovation work is constantly going on but its still tough to imagine that this would be as great at Borobudur once they are finished. Unlike Borobudur, Prambanan has multiple temple complexes, which are quite far away from each other. The main temple complex is pretty sizeable with restored Temples of shiva, Vishnu and other Gods. The temple walls have carvings of the Ramayana, which was good to see but if you have seen carvings on temple walls in countries like India, this pales a bit in comparison. We had a reasonably good guide who showed us around the main temple complex - would recommend you to hire one as they add a bit of history and context to the temple. 

It also happened to be a fairly wet evening when we visited this temple, so that prevented us from exploring the other temple complexes and also from watching the Ramayana performance.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
This is another UNESCO side popular with visitor.
An ancient temples with beautiful stone carving with the main three towers prominently visible from afar.
Once you step into the complex, you were brought back to hundreds years of history.
It is a wonder to think the skill of those craft man who did the stone carving with so much care and precision.
Spent some time, do enjoy this wonderful setting of this site.
The sunset at this set is so beautiful.It is a must view for visitors.
BTW, there is an entrance fee of Rp 234000 for international visitor and discount of Rp 10000 if ticket bought at the agency ( ask your local guide)

Best to visit early morning or late afternoon for the sunset viewing.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Wspaniały zespół światyń hinduistycznych poświęconych Sziwie,Wisznu i Brahmie..W znacznej mierze usunięto skutki trzęsienia ziemi z 2006r.Obserwowanie tu zachodu słońca robi duże wrażenie..
我是下午五点左右到的普兰巴南，已经开始落日了，走进公园里，疾步趋向前，第一眼看到普兰巴南时，内心非常震撼。落日余晖下，雄伟的古寺庙显得格外壮丽，仿佛披上了一道金色的外衣，我坐在阶梯上，默默地凝视远方，彻底放松我的大脑。整个世界在此刻特别宁静，我仿佛听到了古寺庙千年的倾诉。

Diciamo che se paragonato a Borobudur è molto meno bello a mio avviso..ma se si è in zona merita assolutamente una visita. 
Io ho scelto il pomeriggio per visitarlo...non c'era ressa e diciamo che è uno di quei posti che trasmette pace e serenità..
參觀完婆羅浮屠之後來到這裡，只能說，心理落差太大。浮雕的精美程度不論是與婆羅浮屠還是與柬埔寨吳哥窟相比，都相差甚遠。當然，如果在日惹待上一日，作為兩大世界文化遺產，還是要看完婆羅浮屠及普拉巴南兩個寺廟的。如果時間緊張，個人更推薦婆羅浮屠。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I'd suggest to visit Prambanan temple before Borobudur, It's slightly smaller compare to Borobudur,so it's to to visit Prambanan so you wont be disappointment. I visited around 1pm, was very hot but lesser crowd but more enjoyable to me. Remember to apply sunblock and bring umbrella and water along with you.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This was my first destination upon arrival in Yogyakarta and what a Beautiful experience! It was great seeing the mix of Hindu, Buddhist, and Muslim cultures found in this part of the world..! Bring your camera of course!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: My number one favourite temple in Indonesia. It is so beautiful at night. Nice lighting. Make sure you watch the Sendratari Ramayana (Ramayana Dance). It is the must-see performance in Yogyakarta. The music is extremely amusing.

It rained heavily during the afternoon that I visited so the visit was quite miserable.  I took TransJogja to the site.  There is absolutely no signage that tells you how to get to the pedestrian entrance.  From the map, it seems like it is a 400m walk to the entrance, however that entrace is blocked.  You must walk about 800m to hear the south east corner.  GPS (-7.755077,110.494965).  It can be difficult to cross the busy road so you may need to walk further to an intersection.  Note that to leave, you must walk through a large maze of shops so it is a bit further of a walk to get back. The site itself can become quite muddy so beware.  The temples are quite expensive by local standards but there is nothing else in the areas to see.  There is a toy train that takes you around the park.  When I went up to it, the driver was asleep.  I woke him up and asked for a ride but he said no and went back to sleep.  It is a bit of a walk to the other end of the site to see the other temples.  On the way back, I did see the toy train go past me but no one was aboard.  Overall the temples are worth a visit.

Architectural rival of the famous Borubudur Temples, Prambanan campus has lot of Hindu temples and is also a UNESCO World Heritage site! 
Most of them were damaged/destroyed and has lot of reconstruction work going on! When I visited in Dec 2015, there were 18 out of 240 temples to be seen! 

Some people visit both Borubudur and Prambanan in one day, we did the same! But , if possible, don't do it unless you start quite early! There are some other small temples nearby as well, you can see them if you have enough time! 

And hire a guide. The temples deserve lot of love :)
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
写真映えはしますが、正直あまり感動しませんでした。想像より規模も小さい・・・。
入場するとき腰巻を巻きます。
塔の中に上ることもできます。
真ん中の塔はヘルメットが必要で、ものすごい人なので上りませんでした。

Beautiful Hindu Temple complex to visit while in Java. Make sure you arrive in the morning (earlier is better), as it gets hot and crowded quite quickly. On some days, you might find schoolchildren (teens), that are there to practice their English and can give you some information/tour of the site. (we were there on a Sunday and had a nice chat/tour with a group of teens). Generally if you want some more info, a guide (or some schoolkids or your guide book) will be usefull as there is (almost) no signage.

The other few temples on site are less restored, but much more quiet, so worth a walk (or take the tourist train...). We found the museum not worth a lot of time.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
I am sure many travelers have already said how amazing these temples are. So I am just going to give some tips.

If you are not able to walk a long distance, please be warned - because the compound of this temple complex is huge. 

Near the Prambanan temple, there is a pretty majestic temple named Candi Plaosan. Make sure you do not miss it.

If you think Borobudur is jaw dropping, wait till you see Prambanan and other temples surrounding it

低い遺跡がかなり壊れていました。
津波の爪痕だとあとから気づきました。
ロロジョグランはたくさんの観光客がいましたが、ほかの遺跡はひっそりしていてちょっと寂しかったです。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Adoro l'Induismo e questi palazzi sia a livello di arte e atmosfera danno soddisfazione. Siamo andati a vedere il tramonto, bellissimo.

Se come noi avete carnagione, occhi e capelli chiari preparatevi ad essere "investiti" da gruppi di scolaresche che vorrano fare 10 mila foto e selfie con voi. 
(A lungo andare un po' questa cosa mi ha annoiata, ma anche questa è una bella possibilità per parlare con le persone del posto).
Sono molto incuriositi dagli occidentali gli indonesiani.
Tempatnya sangat luas, cocok untuk piknik juga. Semuanya terkesan sangat rapi dan sangat dirawat, sehingga pengunjung pun dapat nyaman berkunjung ke sini.
Мы прилетели на Яву чтобы увидеть самый большой индуистский храм в мире Прамбанан. Храмовый комплекс 8 века необыкновенной красоты и величия. Обязателен к посещению.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The site looks amazing and you will enjoy the culture of the friendly Javanese people, their culture and beliefs and how the temple serves to protect them from dangers. It would appear that generally, people with various religions lived well together,  as the Buddhist, Javanese and Hindu temples were not far from one area to the next.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Knowing about the 2006 eartquake that shattered a big part of this complex I was amazed by the quality of the structures. There is still a lot of damage and work to be done, but this site is a must-see and really beautifully detailed. Having seen many Hindu temple complexes this one wad one of the most impressive ones.

4 tempel att titta på, två områden som var lite större medan det andra två var mindre. Om ni tycker om att vara för er själva rekommenderas att åka dit på morgonen! Vi var där klockan 7 och då var det bara vi och ett annat par på hela området. När vi kollat klart kring 9 såg vi strömmar av människor komma in på området. Ta med studentkort om du har (eller haft) då får ni halva priset på inträde!

We have visit Prambanan and Borobudur during our stay at Alamanda Villa's in Yogyakarta, both are special and both we spend a long time together with our private guide from the hotel, we think next time we go back to Prambanan to see again and to see the Ramayana , we love this temple more than de Borobudur!

Sebagai salah satu ikon kota Yogyakarta, tentu sudah banyak yang berkunjung kemari. Walaupun pamornya masih kalah dari candi borobudur, terbukti masih ramai turis asing maupun domestik yang penasaran kemari. Mendengar kisah-kisah dari orang lokal membuat kita berimajinasi mengenai pembangunan candi ini. Saran saya lebih baik membawa sandal ataupun sepatu olahraga ketika berkunjung karena akan banyak berjalan, cuaca yang panas juga membuat cepat berkeringat, kalau mau hemat silakan membawa air minum sendiri walaupun banyak penjual makanan-minuman di sekitar kompleks.

Sayang banyak candi yang belum selesai direnovasi, begitu saya tanyakan ke petugasnya mereka mengaku masih belum pasti kapan candi-candi di kompleks prambanan ini akan selesai direnovasi. Semoga ke depannya pemerintah terus menggenjot pariwisata di sini.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Candi yang luas. Ada 4 struktur candi yang berbeda di lokasi yang berbeda. Tidak seperti candi borobudur, anda tidak perlu mendaki tangga untuk ke candi ini karena ia terletak di tanah.

Miejsce, które koniecznie musisz zobaczyć! W ciągu jednego dnia spokojnie można zwiedzić Borobudur, Parambanan i kilka pomniejszych okolicznych miejsc. Niestety miejsca te ściągają sporo turystów, ale poza lokalnym sezonem nie jest tak źle.

A 17 km de Yogyakarta é um conjunto de templos imperdível! Apesar de ser muito turístico, arranja sempre um cantinho ou um espaço de tempo entre excursões, para melhor ver este conjunto de templos. Dê uma volta pelos jardins fora do complexo, usualmente têm manifestações culturais e vê melhor a vida local.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Candi Prambanan ini sangat luasss.. gak kalah sih sebenarnya dengan Borobudur.. dan kompleks candi Prambanan ini konon merupakan candi Hindu terbesar se Asia Tenggara... jadi meski kamu di Bali kamu gak bakal nemu kompleks candi yang sebesar dan seluas ini..
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Très beau temple. Le temple à côté et très joli. Prévoir 1h30 de visite. Attention au prix de l'entrée, 225000rp soit environ 18€

Die Tempel sind sehr schön zum besichtigen. Ein absolutes Muss wenn man in Yogikarta Zeit verbringt. Es werden Broschüren in allen möglichen Sprachen kostenlos angeboten, dies sollte man nutzen damit man den Tempel auch versteht. Optional kann man auch eine geführte Tour buchen. Wir hatten einen Guide dabei, welcher uns alles wunderbar erklärt hat.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Jolis temples remontés pas le Unesco. Belles fresques racontant le Ramayana.
Bel ensemble. 
Peu de touristes, beaucoup de collégiens sympathiques, ne pas hésiter à se laisser prendre en photo

Got here May 2016.  It was really a great experience seeing these majestic temples.  
If you want to know about the history of the place, get a tour guide.  He'll accompany you for an hour and show you a great spot for pictures.  That's for 100,000 IDR.

Особенное впечатление от этого храмового комплекса: индуистские рельефы  и скульптуры - впечатляют. Интересная история, рассказанная гидом. Не менее интересны маленькие храмы не подалеку от Прамбанана, туда возят на специальных маршрутках. Рекомендую всем путешественникам!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
4 tahun lalu jadi guide di Taman Wisata Candi Prambanan. 2 tahun lebih kemudian balik lagi jadi wisatawan yang murni mau liburan di candi Hindu yang dibangun abad ke-9 dan terbesar di Nusantara bahkan Asia Tenggara ini.

Dulu, pas masih jadi guide, sering heran sendiri lihat tamu saya tak bisa berhenti berdecak kagum dan berkali-kali bilang "Très magnifique! Oh Mon Dieu, C'est comme un paradis!" (Luar biasa! Ya Tuhan ini seperti surga!). Bingung saya, apanya yg bikin mereka jadi amaze banget seperti itu.

Well, setelah jdi wisatawan, dan mencurahkan segenap perasaan demi melihat candi peninggalan sekaligus bukti kekuatan Dinasti Sanjaya tersebut, saya tanpa sadar bergumam, "Memang menakjubkan".

Lantas apakah saya menemukan apa yang membuat tempat ini seperti surga? Itu tergantung pengalaman spiritual pribadi kawan-kawan. Saya sendiri susah menjelaskannya.

Silakan berkunjung dan menemukan "Surga" pribadi Anda!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Мы специально прилетели в Джокьякарту, чтобы посетить храмы Прамбанан и Боробудур. В Прамбанан мы поехали сразу из аэропорта (15 - 20 минут езды на машине). Нам поезло - был пасмурный день, не очень жарко и не было дождя. Храмовый комплекс занимает не очень большую площадь (если не считать отдельно стоящие храмы). Храмы поражают своим величием, искусством строителей и камнерезов их создавших много лет назад. Они конечно гораздо меньше храмов Сим Рипа в Камбодже, но они великолепны. И если Вы попали на Яву, их обязательно стоит посмотреть. Если есть время, посетите храмы, находящиеся на некотором расстоянии от основных храмов Прамбанана.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I was surprised by the size of the complex grounds. It's really huge. Many temples to visit. Many are still being restored. Each has it's own architectural style. The good thing is that there's a shuttle bus that goes round the complex. You can hop on and hop off at each site.
Se siete di passaggio o per un periodo più lungo questo tempio è una tappa obbligatoria. Molto bella la struttura, imponente e maestosa, si trova all'interno di un parco ben pulito!

Helaas hebben wij deze tempel bezocht in het weekend. Dit betekende dat er heel veel lokals waren die de tempel bezochten. Het probleem hieraan is dat wij zelf ook een attractie zijn voor de lokals. Er worden meer foto's van Europeanen gemaakt dan van de tempel zelf. Hou hier dus rekening mee.

De tempel zelf is prachtig en zeker de moeite waard om te gaan bekijken.

Al 3 keer bezocht in de loop de jaren.
Mooie tempels en nog steeds volop in restauratie en er is veel te zien.
Aanrader is om aan het eind vd dag te komen. Je hebt dan mooie licht, rood achtig zonsondergang waardoor je mooie fotos kunt maken.
Gravures in de hoofdtempel zijn wat pikant maar valt niet zo op.

Los templos Prambanan están a menos de una hora de Yogya y vale la pena hacer una visita. El conjunto de templos es precioso. Yo hice un combi con Borobudur en un dia por 500.000rp con private driver y fue perfecto. Puedes comprar una entrada para los dos templos por 420.000rp que es valido para dos dias.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The Hindu Temple at Prambanan is another of those 'must visit' sites when you are in Yogyakarta. These structures are imposing and leave one wondering how they managed to build them without modern technology. The carvings in the walls are exquisite and no doubt tell the stories related to Hindu tradition. The site was extensively damaged by an earthquake centuries ago, and sadly even when restoration work began, there was evidence of valuable pieces having been looted. A great site to visit especially if you are wanting to take photographs.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
I visited Borobudur and Prambanan on the same day. Their was one combined ticket for both the temples, which certainly come out to be bit cheaper. Temple complex is quite huge and need atleast 2-3 hours to cover the entirety of it!!
A must visit and shouldn't be missed. 
Just to notify, there is student discount available on the ticket purchase, for both separate as well as combined ticket of the attractions. Also, the payment can be made through credit/debit card as well.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Para mí, mucho mejor que el templo de Borobudur. Los tres templos principales, dedicados a las principales deidades hinduistas, magníficos, y los templos adyacentes, aunque más pequeños, no desmerecen de los principales.

The Prambanan is the largest Hindu temples complex on Java and is even a few decades older than the nearby Borobudur Buddhist Temple. It is only 40 minutes driving from Yogyakarta and definitely worth a visit. Although parts of the complex were damaged during a 2006 earthquake. The main temples have been restored, using as much as possible of the original stones. There are plans to re-erect the smaller temples, again using original stones. According to my local guide they have to collect money privately, because they don’t get enough support from Unesco, and it might take some time.
Anyway, that’s no reason to not to go – it is an impressive complex as it is. When it’s not too cloudy one can see the smoke rising from the Merapi Volcano.
One tip: try to be there as early as possible, before it becomes too hot. Over weekends it is a very popular destination for local people, and it can become a bit crowded. It is very easy to visit Prambanan and Borobudur in one day.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Very interesting set of temples built in the 9th century. They have restored it and have made beautiful grounds around it. There are several different temples in various stages of restoration. Great carvings.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Si tienes tiempo, aco­nsejo ir en autobús. ­Se coge al principio ­de Malioboro, el 1A d­e la compañía TransJo­gja. Es una gran expe­riencia ir rodeado de­ gente local, eso sí,­ paciencia por el trá­fico, coge música y u­n libro, pero no deje­s de mirar por la ven­tana y observar a la ­gente.

La parada está algo r­etirada de la entrada­ al templo. Hay que s­ubir unos metros y lu­ego en el cruce a la ­izquierda.
Para volver, consegui­mos un taxi por 10000­0Rp, supongo que rega­teando mejor, sería m­ás barato. Pero coinc­idimos con más person­as que iban hacia Mal­ioboro y lo compartim­os (buena opción para­ ahorrar).

En cuanto al templo… ­me gustó mucho, no ob­stante me esperaba al­go más, pero está muy­ bien. Eso sí, mucha ­gente.

La entrada es bastant­e cara para los preci­os en general en Indo­nesia, pero hacen des­cuento de estudiante ­con el carné.
Aconsejo visitar prim­ero Prambanan y luego­ Borodubur, no al rev­és.
Il tempio è grande e molto bello. Si può prendere il trenino che gratuitamente porta ad un'altra zona, dove la ricostruzione è ancora indietro.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Che dire, rimani di stucco sempre davanti a queste manifestazioni di grande tecnica architettonica e artistica del passato.. I templi sono tutto bellissimi, il parco è enorme e molto bello.. con la possibilità di camminare o di usare il trenino per visitarlo.. passando da Yogyakarta non è possibile non visitare questo luogo!

Harga tiket masuk bebas pilih anda akan pilih yang hanya untuk ke candi prambanan atau 2 paket mengunjungi candi bako juga .. di prambanan ini ada beberapa candi yang runtuh karna gempa yogyakarta yang terjadi beberapa tahun yang lalu tapi tempat ini tidak akan pernah sepi pengunjung karna memiliki daya tarik sendiri .. sebaiknya anda membawa bekal minum karna dari depan untuk menuju k candi lumayan jauh karna jalan kaki dan ditambah cuaca yang terik disiang hari.

pemilihan waktu yg tepat deh. dtg jam 4 pas udh adem mataharinya bersahabat. ngga lama sunset. bagus buat foto2. nah kali ini kami pake jasa tour guide. beliau enak dlm membawa suasana, jago foto, jago cari spot yg ok. dan pastinya pengetahuannya luas.

Una o dei pochi patrimoni dell'Unesco in Indonesia, decisamente da vedere se ci si trova in zona. Piace sia ai locali che agli stranieri. Carino anche il parco che si attraversa dopo la visita ai templi con giochi per i bambini e zone tranquille per pic nic o rilassarsi per un po'.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
O conjunto de templos é muito bonito e vale muito a visita com um guia para contar mais sobre a história do templo e das imagens que estão dentro dos templos e ao redor deles.
 Mas como a cidade é muito quente, acredito que seja melhor ir no inicio da manhã. Fomos durante a tarde e estava extremamente quente.
本人对寺庙不是很了解。只知道这是印度教的建筑。在有点像柬埔寨暹粒的吴哥窟。去的时候遇到当地宗教活动。还蛮新鲜的。

This temple was our last stop of our day trip to Yogyakarta as this is located near the airport. The temple is also located in a huge complex similar to Borobudur and one must walk to see the other temples that were being reconstructed as this was damaged during the earthquake long time ago. The main attraction here is the main temple complex where there stand 3 large structures that is dedicated to the 3 Hindu Gods - Shiva, Brahma and Vishnu and in front of them are 3 smaller structures dedicated to their animal transportation. The largest of the structures is dedicated to Shiva the destroyer and in its chambers you can see his different forms. Along the walls carved the story of Rama and Sita from the the beginning of their love story until how Rama rescued Sita from Ravana. It is recommended that you have a local guide as he will tell you the story and the significance of the temple to the Hindu religion.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Piękny kompleks świątyń. Warto przeznaczyć więcej czasu na zwiedzanie z uwagi na inne mniejsze świątynie na. Tym terenie. Niestety widać ślady zniszczeń po trzęsieniu ziemi, których odbudowa może być wręcz niemożliwa. Odwiedzajcie póki to cudo jest w takiej a nie innej kondycji.

Brahma Siwa dan Wisnu... 
Nama-nama yang identik dengan Candi Prambanan
Manfaatkan jasa tour guide jika memang kalian ingin menggali lebih dalam sejarah yang ada di Candi Prambanan
Masing-masing Candi memiliki arti dan sejarah yang berbeda 
Tempat cukup bersih walau debu bertebaran dimana-mana
Agustus lalu, tempat ini dalam masa renovasi

Yogyakarta'ya varır varmaz gün batımını seyretmek üzere gittim. Manzara ve tapınak görülmeye değer. Ayrıca alanda size eşlik edecek tur rehberlerini bulabilir ve tur süresince birbirinden güzel fotoğraflar çektirme imkanına sahip olabilirsiniz.

Candi Prambanan sangat mudah dijangkau, sekitar 1 jam naik kendaraan roda dua atau empat dari Kota Yogyakarta melewati jalanan yang relatif mulus. Areal Candi Hindu ini sangat luas sehingga lumayan menyita tenaga untuk mengitari seluruh arealnya. Pihak pengelola menyediakan kendaraan yang termasuk dalam paket wisata untuk mengelilingi seluruh areal Candi. Di Candi Prambanan kita bisa menikmati keindahan dan kemegahan arsitektur Hindu.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Buat pejalan mandiri mengakses tempat ini tidaklah sulit. Cukup naik transjogja no 1A dari salah satu halte di Malioboro. 45 menit kemudian sudah sampai. Bis nya nyaman (meski agak penuh) dan murah hanya Rp.3.500.
Dari halte Prambanan di depan pasar kecil anda tinggal menyeberang. Lalu jalan sekitar 10 menitan. Harapan saya semoga terminal ini bisa dipindahkan ke halaman parkir komplek candi Prambanan. Jadi semakin mudah dan gampang buat pengunjung yang datang.
Candi nya memang sangat impresif dan mengagumkan. Bukti peradaban masa lalu yang hebat di tanah Jawa.
Kalau mau datang sebaiknya sore hari menjelang sunset. Selain tidak terlalu terik juga pemandangan matahari terbenam berlatar siluet menara2x candi ini dijamin sangat fotogenik !

The temple is great, definitely a must visit if you're in Java.
It has many similarities with some of the temples around Angkor and exquisite carvings, some of them very well preserved.
Be prepared to wrestle with the crowds and repeat hundreds of times that you don't want to buy anything. It is a shame to see how there is an entire market of cheap souvenirs all around such a historical symbol, but at the end these are people trying to make a living.
Don't know why there's a big fuss about going there for sunset, they close at 6 right before it. Having said that it was nice to go in the late afternoon, a bit cooler..but perhaps more crowded?
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I have to say, I enjoyed prambanan temple as much as I enjoyed borobudur. just as amazing , just as many photo opportunities imo. i know borobudur is much different depending on the time of day you go, prambanan can be good no matter what time of day you visit. It was an overcast day when we visited but our pictures still came out nice. I enjoyed exploring up and down each individual temple. Also I heard that the tale about this temple is quite intriguing. Almost missed visited this place because of the lack of time, but I'm very glad we got to visit before going to Solo. Overall, go to this place, its nice.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
El templo se encuentra a 20 min del centro y se trata de un conjunto de templos para los diferentes dioses hindúes.
Es una obra majestuosa que a pesar de que este parcialmente destruida por el terremoto que tuvo lugar en Indonesia es muy recomendable visitar.
Una cosa curiosa es que los niños de los colegios que están de visita se quieren hacer fotos contigo y hacerte preguntas en inglés como parte de su trabajo de clase y por curiosidad de los extranjeros a los que no están acostumbrados.
Sicuramente ci sono templi molto più affascinanti ma ci ha comunque colpito. Se fate il tour di Java è sicuramente da visitare.

We enjoyed Prambanan so much more than Borobudur. Usually I find Hindu temples to be overwhelming (in their architecture), but Prambanan was beautiful and situated in a way that allowed for a lot of open space and few crowds. Don't skip it in favor of Borobudur, it's easy to do both in a day.

Die Tempelanlage ist zwar sehr beeindruckend für Touristen und indonesische Verhältnisse völlig überteuert! Der Eintrittspreis beträgt 234.000 IDR!
Die Anbindung mit der öffentlichen Buslinie 1A ist jedoch sehr lobenswert.

Cocok untuk dikunjungi bersama keluara ataupun teman-teman. Bisa juga berkunjung ke sini dalam rangka study tour sekolah untung menambah wawasan pelajar tentang betapa kayanya Indonesia memiliki beragam situs budaya.Hati-hati akan cuaca yang cukup panas, jangan lupa membawa topi atau payung. Air mineral bisa dibeli di luar area candi.

Deze Hindoestaanse tempel is een mooie tegenhanger van de boeddhistische tempel de Borobudur. Zeker een bezoek waard! Wij hebben ze beiden op 1 dag bezocht, dan heb je een mooi gevulde dag. Er zijn combinatietickets verkrijgbaar waarbij je entree hebt voor beide tempels (wordt niet actief gepromoot moet je zelf om vragen). Deze zijn niet combineerbaar met de sunrise Borobudur, maar geven je een aardige korting.

Great spot near Yogyakarta!
We took a public bus from Yogyakarta airport (where we left our bags for RPI 20.000 each) and it takes like 15 minutes to get there ( RPI 3.600 each ticket). The ticket for the temples is about RPI 252.000 each, but if you are going to do Borobudur on the next day you can buy a more convenient ticket for both.
The first Temple is amazing! But a little bit crowed... there is another temple (the last one) that is very near.. maybe 5 minutes by walking, and is also beautiful and more empty ... totally recommended!

Abbiamo soggiornato a Yogyakarta durante il nostro viaggio di nozze proprio per visitare i siti patrimonio dell'Unesco di Prambanan e Borodubur.
I templi di Prambanan ti lasciano senza parole e noi, che era la prima volta in oriente, siamo rimasti ammaliati da tanta maestosità! Consigliamo di visitare il sito accompagnati da una guida che saprà raccontarvi nel dettaglio la storia e le caratteristiche del luogo!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
トランスジョグジャの停留所から、プランバナン史跡公園のチケット売り場まで15分くらい歩きました。バスを降りたらトゥクトゥクの運転手さんがたくさん客引きしていたのですが、こんなに歩くとは思わず、「これだったらトゥクトゥクを使えば良かった」と思うくらいの距離です。

公園内もめちゃくちゃ広く、メインのロロ・ジョングランを見学した後、自転車をレンタルするのがオススメ。30分で10万ルピアで借りれるのですが、時間内に一番奥のセウ寺院までラクラク行けます。

ちなみにボロブドゥールよりもプランバナンのほうが全然空いていて、私的にはこっちのほうがレリーフとか建物の感じとか好きでした。改修工事の最中だったので、その工事が終わったらぜひもう1度行きたいなと思っています。

This one of the famous temples in Indonesia. It is almost known world-wide. It has mainly 4 - 6 building/temples in one compound, others are still on restoration face. Do not visit it in mid day time! It is darn hot over there! Try to visit at night where you can see a drama. The drama is about the myth of the temple. The drama is at International Recognition. So if you're a foreigner... don't worry about it :)
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
We cycled to this complex and took 2 hours inside. It was a wonderful visit. We had a local guide named Ismanto, who spoke Dutch! A big plus for us, as we are native Dutch speakers. He took us around the main complex for an hour and then we visited the second complex (Candi Sewu) ourselves. 

Tip: students get 50% off so make sure to bring a student card if you're enrolled somewhere!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Tempio sicuramente bello ma se siete già stati in India o Cambogia o thai questo passa sicuramente in secondo piano..... un parco immenso con questi 3/4 templi o candi tra i quali 2 in ristrutturazione.... un'area dove sin presenti molti cervi e forse sin troppi per in recinto esistente

I came to see Borobudur and was in rush to catch my flt and make it a point to see it quickly and I did it from outside. 

The place is very close to airport so make it a point to see it first. 

the architecture is beautiful.

The prambanan temple was part of our daytrip with Kresna Tours - which I reccommend if you want to see the temples in one day. The grounds are very  soothing and beautifully maintained. Unfortunately the earthquake destroyed many structures but they are restoring it. A tip is to not only stick around the main building but also walk around the grounds and breath the zen atmosphere there. The buildings are very interesting. Unbelievable they managed to build it in the past!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Maravilloso templo hindu reconstruido sobre todo el conjunto central que es espectacular. Merece la pena la visita. Muy cerca de yogyakarta
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Un beau temple à faire si vous passez dans le coin bien conservé dans un grand parc, j'ai eu la chance de le faire un jour sans beaucoup de touriste mais sous la pluie...

Prambanan is a Hindu Temple that have many temple, it is suitable for students to come and visit this temple as it has a lot of historical story long time a go..
Not only the main temple, but also it have another small temple around
Nach Borobudur schon das 2. (für mich) Weltwunder zur Besichtigung. Das muß man einfach gesehen haben, wenn man in der Nähe ist. Das kann man schlecht beschreiben, wie schön das ist....

Visited the temple site in August, shortly before sunset, with good weather (combination with Borobudur, with a hired private car for 500.000 Rp. Definitely worth a visit, esp. if you have not visited temple-sites Myanmar or Cambodia since the temples there are, admittedly, much more spectacular. 
We hired a guide, about 100.000 Rp, and while he did provide us with some useful information, he seemed as if in a hurry and after taking us to 3-4 temples, left us alone. 
From what we learned, there are some theater performances on specific evenings - ask ahead and maybe arrange a visit on that day.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Ben je in yogya, dan moet je hier ook naar toe. Dit hindoeïstisch tempel complex is als een groot park met veel mooie tempels, met elk zijn eigen god. Een gids is een aanrader.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Este es un templo hindú que es muy interesante yo lo llamaría descomunal por su diseño. Visitamos este lugar a mediodía y fue muy fuerte el calor. Le dedicamos aproximadamente una hora y media a este lugar lo cual me parece que vale la pena.

Firstly, don't compare to Angkor Wat, view Prambanan as its own. Next, take your time to see each carving and statue. And most importantly, do get a licensed guide. We are lucky, we get Mr Hari at the counter. From a brief history, he gives us a history lesson of Hinduism, Trimurtiu, Brahma, Visnu and Shiva. He explains the 'long tongue', lion in croc mouth, kirana and kirani, the wall carvings-the fierce women, a little of karmasutra.He combines jokes with serious stuffs. He has done a good job

This hindu temple (actually several temples) is really worth the visit, and like many places in Yogyakarta a good guide will be worth the (small) cost. I did prefer it to Borobudur, maybe because we visited it at the end of the afternoon, enjoying the softer light (and lower temperature too !). It is worth to do the shuttle ride (included in internationals ticket).
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: One of the most beautiful temple in Indonesia. located in Jogjakarta , this temple is very famous with its legend - The Loro Jongrang- my son is very happy to visit the temple because before he is only read in the book but now he can see it in his own eyes. The atmosphere is amazing, and very convenience also. it is a must when you visit jogjakarta. dont forget your camera and smartphone because you can read the legend while you are browsing throug the ruin
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Sostanzialmente sono 3 stupa con dentro le statue delle maggiori divinità, difronte ci sono le loro tre cavalcature. Tutto intorno decorazioni con gli dei minori e storie del Ramayana. Il tempio è stupendo perfettamente restaurato secondo i canoni unesco, se non erro quindi sono riusciti a trovare e ricollocare più del 50 o del 75% delle vecchie pietre. Quelle nuove tagliate a misura dove non si trovavano i pezzi vecchi hanno un tagliandino quadrato. Le statue sono originali e in condizioni impeccabili, qualche fregio laterale ha subito la classica mutilazione della testa, soprattutto la figura centrale negli altorilievi più sporgenti, le cose sulle statue il calendario i simboli gli attributi di ciascuna statua sono tante e per apprezzare il tutto ed avere la conoscenza di tutto al momento giusto è necessaria una guida.gratuitamente si può prendere il treno che porta ai templi minori del complesso, il treno parte solo dopo che hai aspettato 20 minuti o che alti si siano accodati formando almeno se non erro 10 persone. Inutile cercare di attirare la gente che si incammina a piedi, molti sono turisti locali che hanno un biglietto a costo minore per il quale il treno non è gratuito e molti leggendo anche il cartello che è da pagare non vi crederanno. Fatto sta che abbiamo visto degli americani che aspettavano da 20 minuti e dopo che abbiamo aspettato altrri 5 minuti con loro ci hanno fatto partire. Adesso però vi dico che il giro in trene ve lo potete tranquillamente evitare, meglio spendere 20/30 minuti in più nel tempio principale con la guida. Gli altri sono ricostriti al 10 o 20% ed hanno tutti i massi intorno ancora da catalogare.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I found the Prambanan Temples disappointing, I read a lot about it and create many expectations. They are beautiful temples but not as spectacular as I imagined. Having said that, I had a nice time walking around the temples, despite the tourist crowds.

Kunjungan ke candi Prambanan merupakan agenda lain dari liburan dengan memberi manfaat edukasi bagi anak-anak.

Menarik dari segi sejarah, wow dari sisi arsitektur dan tentunya juga kekinian (obyek foto group maupun selfie)

Candi Prambanan memiliki banyak cerita, namun sayangnya banyak statue maupun bangunan candi yang rusak dan/atau dicuri orang, saya membayangkan jika semua dapat di rekonstruksi ulang, candi ini sangat mengagumkan.

Datang saat menjelang sunrise menjadi salah satu pemandangan yang mengagumkan.

prachtige tempel. super mooi. er werd nog wel gerestaureerd. jammer dat het zo druk op de trappen is. is soms best lastig om voorzichtig weer naar beneden te gaan, als het zo druk is. de trappen zijn steil.

We were visiting prambanan temple last wednesday for family trip. I can't imagine how they build such nice temple in that era,stunning and still standing with the great architecture.
Great history of hindu temple.
Visited in the morning and bowled over by these temples. It was quite and our guide 'You' was superb, took us through the whole complex with great stories and patience. Really magical visit.
Tempatnya luas banget, lumayan kalau keliling jalan kaki.. paling bagus kalau ada guidenya, bs menjelaskan dan minta tlg foto2..:)

The UNESCO wh sites at candi prambanan are worth a visit and its best if u reach early morning. $32 entry fee  & hire a guide preferably clubbed with someone. 100000 rupiyah for 1-4 people about $ 8 specially if you know less about Hindu mythology. No signage in English inside and you might be lost without one. Open area with virtually no shade in the temple area so a nice hat, sunscreen, umbrella whatever works for you is good. Ask the guides to show you the combination of new and old stones in restoration as per world heritage guidelines. Earthquakes damage many structures here and checkout broken temple towers in the complex
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Prambanan are Hindu temples of the 9th century. Originally 240 off temples but now only about a dozen remain. The temples are dedicated to Lord Shiva and have beautiful carving of the ramayana on the walls...
Different huge status of Lord Bhrama, Visnu, Shiva, Durga Ma and Ganesha can be found in the temples.

Very peaceful and well maintained. Would be better if a daily Arti could be performed at this fantastic temple!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Slightly less impressive than Borobudur but a very nice experience. Surrounding area is quite big so a good walk in nice settings. Well organised and friendly staff. Go early to avoid the tour groups. If you are looking for a driver, I can recommend Malik on +62 87 839 699 202 who can organise your visit in and around Yogyakarta.
The temple has big and small temples, you can climb to see the inside in some temples. Unfortunately the place has only 1 restaurant. The souvenir shops isn't as many as in Borobudur temples area.
Le temple est fascinant et il est a faire absolument si vous passez par la région. Par contre le prix d'entrée est élevé, aucune explication n'est fourni sauf si vous prenez un guide.

Espectacular, quizás me gustó más  Borobudur pero este monumento no deja de tener un encanto especial. La primera vez que ves el primero templo te quedas sin palabras. Aprovecho a recomendar que se visiten TODOS los monumentos, hasta el final del recinto, aunque haga calor y aunque crean que hay un camino largísimo al final hay un tren gratuíto que lleva a la zona de salida.
Los templos de Prambanan se encuentran dentro de las misma ciudad de Yogyakarta y aunque son majestuosos no tienen la esencia de Borobudur, perdido en la selva. Es bonito y visita interesante.

Zoals zovele toeristen ook de Prambanan tempel bezocht. Wij hadden een niet erg goed Engels sprekende gids. Hierdoor niet alles meegekregen. Gelukkig is er na het scannen van je kaartje links in een ander gebouw een Nederlandstalig boekje verkrijgbaar dat het verhaal verteld over de tempel.

A great Hindu temple and several smaller temples (some Buddhist) in an amazing setting.  The great towers of the temples are awe inspiring and there are original free standing statues in some of the shrines.  A must see if you are in Central Java.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Muito bonito, com uma historia linda... aconselho e ter um guia neste templo para conhecer a historia e perceber o que significa cada estatua.

Take time to see this when you are in Jogja. It is about 30 minutes from the city centre and worth the trip. The location and structure is amazing. Climb into the main temples, see the statues inside and hieroglyphics and learn of how this amazing site came into the world.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: To arrive quickly and smoothly take a taxi Blue Bird. They have fixed prices for visit and you will be expected to return at hotel. Go to catch the sunset is dreamlike. Visit entire complex is big and beautiful.

This is a place I will always remember.  I went with my son who speaks Bahasa and was knowledgeable and could ask questions.  It's a lovely spiritual place with wonderful stone work cut to make narrative panels.  I wish I'd read more about it before I went as I would have enjoyed it even more.
prambanan mepakan candi megah dengan tempat startegis, dan dekat perbatasan anatara klaten dan yogykarta, arsitekturnya yang bagus dan besar membuat wisata asing banyak mengunjunginya
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
magari prima di angkor wat in cambogia. Dopo in effetti è un pò ridondante.
Il sito è in parte ricostruito ma devo dire che si eleva in possanza. Prendete una guida. é necessaria per capire molto della storia di questi templi e delle divinità induiste.

Great place and good price. If you have a student card, take it! Massive discount if you do. The temples were beautiful. Everyone is drawn to the biggest however there are some others that are just as good at the back and so quiet as no body bothers to look at them. I preferred the slightly smaller ones at the back overall and was able to get some great photos too. I was disappointed about the lack of information regarding the temples and how they were built so Google the facts before hand.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Super mooi tempelcomplex! Er zijn iets van 19 van de 120 tempels herbouwd na de aardbeving van jaren terug (alles was daarna ingestort). Met een gids (wij hadden een scholiere die ons graag rondleidde om haar Engels te oefenen) krijg je alles mee over de goden, gebruiken en verhalen die staan afgebeeld. Heel interessant. 

Neem wel genoeg water mee want midden op de dag is er nergens schaduw vinden. Als je slecht ter been bent raad ik je aan niet teveel op 1 dag te plannen naast dit bezoek; het complex is groot met veel trappen. Daarnaast is de uitgang aan de andere kant van het complex; iets waar je je even op kunt instellen ;)
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Un des deux temples à faire absolument sur Yogyakarta. Il est incontournable mais un peu moins impressionnant que Borobudur.

About 30 minutes from the center of Yogya, the complex of Prambanan is an amazing park with about 4 temples. Candi Prambanan is the only one that have an entrance fee, the others are free of charge. It's a smaller version of Angkor wat but still beautiful and interesting. To avoid the crowds and the oven like sun try to go early in the morning.

We decided during our next trip to Bali in June 2016, to travel to Yogyakarta (Java) for 2-3 days, our plan was to visit Prambanan Temples, Borobudur Temple and spend left over time visiting some local Yogyakarta attractions.  
We got off the plane & our driver was waiting, in went the bags and off to Prambanan, it was only a short drive, we bought our entrance ticket (funny even though the tickets were priced & marked $32 US, combined package for Prambanan & Borobudur only Indonesia rupiah was accepted).
Now off to investigate. The site was a lot larger than anticipated, with 3 main temple dedicated to Shiva, Visnu, and Brahma, with three smaller temples in front containing Garuda, Nandi the bull & Hamsa the swan, the temples were all ornately decorated with reliefs. 
My wife & I were very impressed by the temple complex and were excited to be there at the same time learning more about the Hindu religion. 
What a great start to our Yogya trip!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
The Prambanan Temple Complex show cases the Hindu Culture.Parts of Indonesia including Java was under the influence of Hinduism before Muslim religion took over.This temple complex was built during the reign of Sanjaya Dynasty in 9th Century .Even today the influence of Hindu culture still remains.

The complex has temples of the Trimurti concept of Hindu religion-Bramha-The creator,Vishu-The preserver and Shiva-The destroyer.The temples are being restored which were partially damaged during recent earthquake.The staircase to these temples are steep but worth going up to see the carvings and the idols carved out of stone.The main temple is Shiva Temple and on its two sides are the Brahma and Vishnu temple.In front of these temples are temples of their "vahanas"-The Shiva temple is 47 mts tall and its complex has small temples of Lord Agastya,Lord Ganesha,Goddess Durga.
The Temple complex have now become archaeological and cultural attraction in Indonesia.This complex being a UNESCO World Heritage Site is now being maintained by archaeological authority to maintain the historical monument.
We visited in July 2016.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

There are many hindu ancient architecture and temples constructed and well maintained in India. But there is something about this huge Hindu temple in Central Java. 

Beautiful and different style of Hindu architecture with narration of Ramayana and 'krishnayana' in the form of carvings on temple wall. 

Much like the Angkor Wat this temple is no longer a worship place. The temple was abandoned when this area experienced one of the worst earthquakes in Java island, probably due to eruption of mount merapi in 1006 AD. 

It's amazing the way this beautiful architecture has been revived and renovated and well a managed now. The compound used to have more than 200 temples but now has just around 7-8 and the debris of the other temples can be found around the 'garbha graha' - central place of temples.

Review Text: Da visitare assolutamente, è un complesso di templi induisti enormi e bellissimi. Abbiamo atteso poi il tramonto ed è stato davvero eccezionale.

Diese UNESCO Weltkulturerbe-Stätte ist eine ausgedehnte Tempelanlage aus verschiedenen Epochen. Um sie zu besuchen, sollte man einen kompletten Tag einplanen und sich idealerweise einen Führer nehmen.
Die buddhistische Tempelanlage Borobodur aus dem 8./9. Jahrhundert ist die größte Tempelanlage der Welt.
Der Prambanan-Tempel aus dem 10. Jahrhundert ist der höchste Hindutempel der gegenwärtig noch existiert. 
Überhaupt ist die Erhaltung der gesamten Anlage eindrucksvoll - fast ein Wunder angesichts des vulkanischen Gebiets, in dem wir uns hier befinden.
Das Gesamtpanorama, das die Anlage und die umgebende Natur bieten, ist ein ästhetischer Genuss und wird Fotografen begeistern.
Diese Anlage in der Nähe von Yogyakarta ist der kulturgeschichtliche Höhepunkt einer Indonesienreise und ein einzigartiges Erlebnis. Absoult empfehlenswert!
Man sollte sich übrigens als westlicher Besucher darauf einstellen, dass man von den vielen Schulkindern, die die Anlage mit ihren Lehrern besuchen, gerne interviewt wird. Das manchmal noch bescheidene Englisch wird durch die Begeisterung und Freude der Kinder mehr als ausgeglichen - die Kommunikation klappt perfekt.
So ein eindrücklicher Ort, den muss man besuchen, wenn man in der Nähe ist! Genug Zeit sollte man einberechnen, denn es befinden sich noch drei weitere Tempel auf der Anlage.

The only two major attractions in Jogyarkarta are Prambanan and Borobudur. Both are located far from each other. You could visit the Ramayana epic show at night. It is an outdoor type where the show will be behind the Prambanan temples. Recommended to visit the show.

The temple compound, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is the largest Hindu temple site in Indonesia, and one of the biggest in Southeast Asia. Built in 856AD this complex consists of three yards. What one can see today is the main yard consisting of temples devoted to Shiwa, Durga, Brahma , Wishnu, Agastya , Ganesha. Only Shiwa temple has four chambers. The climb to these temples is steep but the view of the complex, the refief and carvings on stone is exquisite as each relief has a story to tell. Definitely worth a visit.

Candi Prambanan or Candi Rara Jonggrang is a 9th-century Hindu temple compound inCentral Java, Indonesia, dedicated to theTrimurti, the expression of God as the Creator (Brahma), the Preserver (Vishnu) and the Destroyer (Shiva). The temple compound is located approximately 17 kilometres (11 mi) northeast of the city of Yogyakarta on the boundary between Central Java andYogyakarta provinces.

The temple compound, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is the largest Hindu temple site in Indonesia, and one of the biggest in Southeast Asia. It is characterized by its tall and pointed architecture, typical of Hindu temple architecture, and by the towering 47-metre-high (154 ft) central building inside a large complex of individual temples.Prambanan attracts many visitors from around the world.

Ok, non è il tempio di Borobudur (che tra l’altro potete visitare in combinato data la possibilità di comprare un biglietto cumulativo e risparmiare qualche soldino…occhio però che sono parecchio distanti l’uno dall’altro!) ma è comunque un sito spettacolare da non perdere! Prambanan è facilmente raggiungibile con i mezzi pubblici…io ci sono arrivato con i bus: direzione aeroporto dove dovrete fare un cambio…il personale del servizio di trasporto vi darà tutte le indicazioni…sono gentilissimi (come tutti gli indonesiani!). Il sito è molto vicino alla città di Jogja: al mattino presto (il servizio bus parte alle 5.30) ci metterete circa una mezzora (qualcosina in più con il traffico che si scatena durante la giornata)…la biglietteria apre alle 6 e nelle prime ore troverete meno turisti. Ci sono alcuni templi chiusi per restauro e le relative impalcature rovinano un po’ il colpo d’occhio ma va bene così, specialmente se pensiamo che questi templi sono stati in parte rovinati durante il periodo coloniale (ho scoperto che molte pietre che componevano il tempio di Prambanan e Borobudur sono state trafugate dagli olandesi e utilizzate nella costruzione di altri palazzi…ora si sta lavorando per il loro recupero e relativa ricostruzione) e che comunque gli interventi di restauro/mantenimento sono necessari per conservare questo patrimonio dell’umanità a beneficio delle future generazioni (le sorti dei due templi non sono state delle migliori tra terremoti, eruzioni vulcaniche e altre spiacevoli vicende storiche)! Inoltre, è affascinante pensare come il sito apparisse nella sua completezza e nel suo massimo splendore quando centinaia di templi minori, in parte ancora visibili, costellavano la pianura circostante…chiudete gli occhi e fate lavorare l’immaginazione! Come per il Borobudur, troverete dei giovani studenti di lingua inglese che si offriranno per farvi da guida…sono gentilissimi e competenti e non chiedono altro che di poter fare un po’ di pratica…non rifiutate il loro aiuto: vi racconteranno le avvenute di Rama (Ramayana) incise sulle pietre del tempio e altri mille aneddoti che impreziosiranno la vostra visita. Vicino al tempio di Prambanan troverete quello di Sewu raggiungibile a piedi o con un trenino (è compreso nel prezzo del biglietto)…meno affollato e forse ancora più affascinante. Ultima nota: nell’area si svolgono spesso degli spettacoli di danza e musica tradizionale molto carini e troverete anche uno zoo con cervi e uccelli variopinti…una sosta sdraiati sul prato per recuperare le energie e godere dell’atmosfera è vivamente consigliata!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Le temple de Prambanan s'intégre avant tout un parc immense et très bien entretenu qui pourra être l'occasion d'une balade bucolique et reposante (à pieds ou à vélo). Ce patrimoine reste exceptionnel par son âge et sa symbolique hindou mais il peut cependant vous laissez sur votre faim pour deux raisons. La première est le manque d'information et de contexte pour nous qui ne sommes pas forcément au fait de toute la symbolique et l'on a parfois le sentiment de visiter un beau tas de pierres. La seconde est qu'il faut garder en tête qu il s'agit d'un site qui reste en cours de reconstruction/rénovation et le champ des possibles de la visite reste limité. Le site bénéficie avant tout du billet combiné avec Borobudur, malheureusement il n'atteint pas la magnificience de ce dernier.
