メインのロロジョグランやサンビサリはヒンズーですが、セウやプラオサン、サリは仏教寺院です。このあたりはヒンズーを信奉する王国の勢力圏だったのですが仏教に対する理解があったのでしょうか。いいとか悪いとかではなくクメール王国とは大分違いますね。サンビサリなんて６ｍも埋もれていたというので他にもまだ未発掘の寺院があるかもしれません。
いくつかの寺院の中心部は修復されていますが周囲の小祠堂群は崩壊したまま手つかずで石の山のまま放置されています。それが遺跡らしい味を出しています。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Wir haben uns den Sonnenuntergang angesehen, der wirklich sehr schön war. Zeitlich haben wir nur den Haupttempel geschafft, wer aber mehr Zeit hat sollte sich unbedingt ein Kombiticket kaufe (Studenten/Schüler zahlen nur den halben Preis). In der Anlage selbst gibt es auch noch ein Rehgehege, die Tiere können auch gefüttert werden. 
Ich würde nochmal die Anlage besuchen und dann ein wenig mehr Zeit für die anderen Tempel einplanen

Mooi en indrukwekkend om te zien. Wij vonden deze tempel zelfs leuker om te zien dan de Borobudur. Als je de mogelijkheid hebt om s'ochtends te gaan, ga s'ochtends, s'middags is het erg warm. En vergeet je studentenkaart niet ( scheelt je de helft van de entreeprijs)

The sight of the Hindu temples is breath-taking, prodigious, and delicate all at the same time.  There is a main temple with satellite temples in various stages of restoration.  The temples have suffered a lot of damage over the years due to volcanoes, earthquake, etc., but the Government has done an excellent job of restoration.  It was explained to me that when they started the restoration effort the site was like a giant puzzle with many pieces that had to be put together.

The park setting was very beautiful and easy to walk through.  We arrived late in the day, which was peak sun, and it made it rather uncomfortable.

We hired a guide and he was able to explain the history of the site, which I would recommend.

I would recommend Prambanan to anyone traveling to the region.  It’s a must see destination.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This vast 9th century Hindu temple complex, the largest of its kind in Java, is located some 14km from Yogyakarta. UNESCO World Heritage site since 1991.The central temple, dedicated to Lord Shiva, stands at 47m. Among the many smaller structures, some in disrepair, are some Buddhist candis. A 2006 earthquake caused some damage which has been or is being repaired. Entrance for foreigners: USD 18.  (By rented car, IDR 750,000 = USD 56 for ten hours, one can easily visit both Prambanan and Borobudur from Yogyakarta on the same day.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Solo con la visita a los dos templos ya merece la pena el viaje a Indonesia? Este es una joya hinduista bastante bien conservado

visita obbligata per chi viaggia in Indonesia. Templi imponenti. Il parco si visita in un paio d'ore e vi sono diversi siti archeologici in cui passeggiare in libertà. Molto affollato, traffico intenso per arrivarci dal centro. I mezzi pubblici straeconomici ma temo ci mettano il triplo di un autista privato che con 7 euro ti prende e porta all'hotel (tour acquistabile in qualsiasi agenzia turistica del luogo in pochi minuti).

Personally I like this temple more than Borobudur. The shape is more beautiful, and since this one's Hindu's temple then the philosophy and the pattern is pretty much different than Borobudur. The Shiva temple is the biggest one (around 47meters tall) and is the main temple in 3 Trimurti temples area. In the afternoon it can be really hot up there, and dusty. You wouldn't want to spend most of your time there, as the main temple complex was always crowded with people taking pictures and some security guards telling you not to climb the stones or sit on the statues. Instead, take some clicks and then walk north, around 800meters to the Sewu Temple, the second biggest Buddhist temple after Borobudur. You'll like it better there. I've been there three times and it's always been so peaceful and quiet. Not many locals want to walk there. Mostly just some foreigners seeking for peace. You can climb inside the main temple and walk around the ruins, taking beautiful shots with no one else in sight.
It's very easy to reach Prambanan from the city center with TransJogja, there's Transjogja's bus stop 1km before the entrance gate. If you want to go to Boko Temple to see the sunset, buy the combined ticket and they provide shuttle bus to go to Boko and you'll be dropped in Prambanan again. About the Ramayana Ballet, it was beautiful, but a bit boring for me personally, so only do that if you have plenty of time in the evening.

It was large complex you must walk around to see many temple. The complex does not have proper shelter to take rest when hot and humid day. The temple looks not well maintenance. The different with Borobudur no sales person bug you to buy any souvenirs.

The story behind these temples make it special..according to the story, those temples requested to be build in 1,000 statues and upposed to be completed in one night, but only 999 statues finished befor the dateline..and the last statue is the one in the main temple..

Temples majestueux qui nécessitent un guide si vous souhaitez comprendre un peu l'histoire.  Le site est en rénovation.  On a e la chance depuis  2 ans,  le site principal est à nouveau ouvert au public.  L'ensemble est majestueux.  Pour avoir visité pas mal de sites similaires en Asie,  c'est un style encore différent.  
Si vous faites Borobudur,  prenez un ticket qui inclus les deux temps,  c'est plus économe.  Un petit plus,  attendez le coucher du soleil,  vous ferez des photos sympas.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Zijn er 's avonds geweest om de zonsondergang mee te pikken, het aantal toeristen loopt dan al aardig terug. Zeer mooi complex

kami menghadiri musik di prambanan. tempat yg indah. semakin malam semakin indah karena lampu yg menerangi sehingga walaupun sudah malam tetap indah diliat. berfoto ditempat ini jg bagus dengan sudut2 yg menarik. sudah sering kami kesini walaupun kadang ada renovasi atau perawatan kadang kala. tetapi tetap menarik.

Sono stata in questo templio dopo aver acquistato la combo di biglietti prambanan+borobudur. Ho preferito nettamente l'altro sia per atmosfera che per il sito in sè. In questo sono presenti lavori di ristrutturazione che precludono la visita a un paio di strutture. Inoltre l'ambiente circostante prevede campi da golf e ristoranti. Comunque tappa obbligatoria per chi passa da yogyakarta!

bagi anda yang ingin mengunjungi candi prambanan, lokasi ini mudah ditempuh baik dengan transportasi umum ataupun transportasi pribadi. penataan bangunan yang luar biasa, kawasan yang teratur, dan wisatawan yang hampir tiap hari memadati kawasan ini. tak lupa ada juga pementasan ramayaha ballet, prambanan jazz dll. jangan lupa mampir untuk membeli oleh oleh saat menuju pintu keluar
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
It's $18 to enter. The temple is interesting but has been badly renovated and is often like looking at a jigsaw where all the pieces have been put in wrong. Sorry but it doesn't compete at all with Borobudur and other temple sites which is why I think they are massively overcharging for what it is. If you are on a tight schedule or budget I would miss it out. 
By the way it's very easy to get to on the public bus in Yogyakarta, 1A, grey line, which you catch outside the Government Tourist Information office and costs 7,000Rps

中心となるCandi Prambananは、高い塔のような寺院が並ぶ外観と外壁を取り囲む彫刻や装飾に見応えがあった。角度により遠くからみる寺院群の表情が変わるので面白い。周囲のセウ寺院などとともに史跡公園として大きく整備されており、木陰のある道を散策して回ると楽しい。公園内のトイレは比較的清潔。トランスジョグジャ（公共バス）だとマリオボロ通りから乗り換えなしで５０分程度と便利なので、安く旅行したい人にはおすすめできる。停留所の係員に言えば、プランバナン行きのバスを案内してくれる。アジスジプト空港からだとさらに近く２０分程度。バス停から入り口までは徒歩15分程度かかるが、しばらく幹線道路沿いを歩き信号のある交差点で横断する必要がある。停留所には人力車や馬車タクシーもいるので利用するのも手。アクセスしやすいこともありジョグジャカルタに来たのであればぜひ寄りたい世界遺産。
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Outstanding 9th century Buddhist  temple comparable with Ankor Wat in Cambodia. Lots of steps, and people, best time to visit is early morning or late in the day. You really need a guide to explain the stories behind the murals.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Temple à ne pas manquer car très différent de Borobudur, des lumières superbes en fin de journée, le parc est très sympa pour flâner. Surtout, se donner la peine d'aller jusqu'au Ceru Lewu

We made the right decision to hire a local guide, who is very knowledgeable about the history, religion and the culture, to show us around the ruins of Prambanan, one of the largest and oldest Hindu temples in Southeast Asia, that rivals Angkor Wat.  He also turned out to be an expert in taking jumping photos.  Our kids really enjoyed his company.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Le site est beau mais rien d'exceptionnel si vous avez eu l'occasion de voir d'autres temples en Asie. De plus le prix d'accès (environ 15euros) est démesuré pour la qualité des temples, il y a beaucoup de ruines et au final la visite ce fait assez rapidement.
Hemos visitado muchos templos pero nunca dejan de sorprenderme la belleza de los templos hindúes. Lo visitamos en la misma excursión a Borobudur y tampoco hay que perdérselo.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
We also did not get the chance to see the entire temple complex but the main temple we explored quite well.  There are maintenance work happening around Prambanan but that does not impede one from appreciating the majestic temples.  It was cloudy when we were there but it seems to me that on good days there is a nice sunset at the back.

I saw a photo giving an aerial view of Prambanan and it was beautiful.  It seemed to me that the main temples were surrounded by smaller temples.  One can still see a couple of these small temples near the entrance to the larger temples.  

We had access inside the rooms of the larger temples but it could get suffocating and it is also quite dark.  We had to rely on our mobile phones to somehow light up the room.
I went in the late morning and there was hardly anyone there, and had Candi Sewu to myself. Wroth the visit!

Best visited before the heat of the day if possible. A huge 9th century complex to the gods Vishnu, Brahma and Shiva. Their height and complexity of carving is just awesome. Dark on the inside, better viewed on the outside. The minor temples are in ruins which gives one an appreciation for the enormity of reconstruction. If you don't want a personal guide, go to the audio-visual film first at the museum. The museum isn't well marked or lit but the building on reconstruction of ruins was worth a visit. Our two hours there was not enough. Well worth the visit!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Świątynia uległa dużemu zniszczeniu podczas trzęsienia ziemii i duża jej część nie jest odnowiona. Mimo to urzeka swoim wyglądem i atmosferą. Nie jest tak okazała jak Angkor w Kambodży ale warto ją zobaczyć będąc w Yogyakarcie.
The visit was wonderful. Lots of tourist but still space to walk around. The only bad point was the deers and birds in cages
The shear size of the temples is amazing. Great place to walk around and imagine the inginuity required to construct these massive temples. Not to be missed.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
ik vond de entree kaartjes beetje aan de dure kant. Touristen betalen veel meer als de lokale bevolking. Dacht mij te herinneren dat je zeker wel 18E pP kwijt bent.
Mooie tempelcomplex, in sommige tempels kun je met een klein trap naar boven.
Zeker een bezoek waard!

Si vous passez par Yogyakarta, il est certain que vous avez prévu de faire les 2 grands temples que sont Borobudur et Prambanan. L'endroit est somptueux malgré une chaleur étouffante. Le lieu renferme en fait plusieurs temples dont beaucoup sont des ruines, il faut le reconnaître.
Si vous êtes serré niveau temps, préférez un tour organisé qui vous fera faire les 2 temples dans la journée, vous gagnerez ainsi un temps précieux et vous éviterez de vous faire arnaquer à chaque coin de rue. Si par contre vous avez le temps et décidez de faire Prambanan sur un journée, alors prenez le bus local transjogja qui s'y rend directement (ce qui n'est pas le cas avec Borobudur). Pour seulement 3500 roupies (25 centimes !!!) par personne et par trajet, le bus part directement de Malioboro et met environ 1h. Il vous dépose dans une gare de bus située à 10 minutes à pied de l'entrée du temple.

Le temple est très joli et l'environnement très vert! C'est une visite à faire mais je vous recommande vivement de grouper avec Borobudur! En effet, les 2 temples se visitent assez rapidement, vous pouvez même en faire un des 2 très tôt le matin pour assister au lever du soleil! 
Attention les prix est différent pour les touristes étrangers ! et oui, vous êtes plus riches qu'eux donc vous payez plus! Nous avons payé 34€ à 2 c'est un peu cher pour la visite .....
CONSEIL : prenez un tour organisé qui groupe les 2 temples et vous feront ainsi bénéficier d'une remise

Even I only visit this temple once (I wish there will be the third, forth, and more) but I instantly fall in love with this! Its big statue, its architecture, and many more that really made me can't stop staring and saying 'the most powerful god'. I'll always fall in love with it.
The place is pretty nice but the very bad thing is the earthquake which has destroyed a big part of the monument, very pity :(

This is the tallest hindu temple in indonesia built on 9th century dedicated to the Trimurti, the expression of God as the Creator (Brahma), the Preserver (Vishnu) and the Destroyer (Shiva)

The temple is quite well maintained. When we come here Brahma temple is under renovation.

We managed to go inside Shiva Temple (the biggest temple among all temples in prambanan), vishnu temple and some other temples. Other than that we also see around and managed to see some reliefs.

There are also some ruins yet to be built around the main temples. And the damage caused by eartquake that preserved to be remembered.

Temples complex location is quite convinient. So we not really need to walk very far from parking area. We also can see and feed many deers located not far from temples exit.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Très beau temple. Nous avons acheté un billet pour faire borobudur + brambanan (416k les deux au lieu de 260k chaque). Y aller tôt car beaucoup de touristes (locaux et occidentaux) sinon très beau
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Ingresso 16$ e accettano la Visa.
Sito molto bello, soprattutto per u n occidentale. Originariamente era molto grande (vedrete i resti anche dei piccoli templi distrutti dal tempo e dal terremoto), ora si visitano i templi del complesso principale (solo 1rimasto in ristrutturazione) ma dovete considerare anche gli altri complessi all'interno del sito archeologico (almeno 3ore per tutto, senza uccidersi sotto il sole). I templi all'interno hanno statue di divinità, non sono decorati. Si può fare in giornata assieme al Borobudur (driver o escursione organizzata).
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Ce site classé au patrimoine mondial de l'Unesco, et une bonne base de départ pour tenter de comprendre la logique de la trinité hindoue que représente Vishnou, Brahma et Shiva. Ces temples du 9ème siècle sont bien conservés. Attention à l'inégalité des marches.

Als je in de buurt bent zeker bezoeken. Mooie Hindoe tempels. Grootste deel is gerestaureerd in de afgelopen decennia. Deels bij de aardbeving in 2006 weer ingestort. Neem er een gids bij voor geschiedenis, achtergronden.

This is the largest Hindu temple in Indonesia. It is dedicated to the Hindu Gods Siva, Brahma and Vishnu. The Shiva temple is the tallest one at 154ft. There are also temples for their carriers or vahanas, e.g., Nandi, Gardura ans Hansa. The temples have the most beautiful bass relief work depicting the stories of the Hindu epic Ramayana. It was built in 850AD, around 50 years after Barabadour.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Mooi tempelcomplex. Waarbij de prambanan tempel hindoeïstisch is en de sewu tempel boeddistich. Verder werd er wel veel gerestaureerd als gevolg van de aardbeving 10 jaar terug. De overige tempels waren daarom niet de moeite waard. Zeker doen als je op Java bent
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The temples are quite well preserved and well worth visiting if you can afford the steep price of IDR 416K per person to visit Prambanan and Borobudur together. It is also a very long walk to the exit where one is forced to pass by hundreds of small shops selling souvenirs and t-shirts, which could have been avoided
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
One of the most beautiful temple I have ever seen. We payed 250.000 IDR per person for the ticket plus the guide, definitely useful because the temple is big and you won't understand anything alone. It is huge and rich of stories as the one of rama and his wife and rituals. Our guide, Mr Supri, was nice, fluent english and amazing. So many people but not too crowded.
We ate at the restaurant inside the park, the rice with shrimps is excellent.

Templo hinduista más famoso del mundo.
Vale la pena ir temprano, no sólo por la luz para las fotos si no para poder recorrer los jardines y ver los alrededores.
En la tarde hay muchísima gente.
Es realmente ESPECTACULAR

They are beautiful but very expensive. They asked as 416000rupias (28€) to get into prambanan and borobudur all together. Other temples close to theese ones that cost Just 10000-15000 and were really really nice as well.
Even with that I think It worth It.

We were shouted to a dinner at the buffet restaurant overlooking the temples.
Food was awesome and the people (like at Jogja residents) were great.
Worth a trip just for the spectacular photos!
Een goede gids die bij elk tableau het goede verhaal wist.. . Prachtig onderhouden park. Alleen die markt bij de uitgang hoeft van mij niet...
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: This temple complex is on a very large plot of land and also includes the Sewu Temple.  The entrance is near Prambanan Temple and Sewu Temple can be reached by walking or much easier using the little train that goes round the gardens.  Sewu is still being renovated and there is not so much to see but it is a dramatic photo op.  The Prambanan Temple is spectacular and every one in my group loved it.  Try to climb into every chamber and get a guide as it will very much help you understand the significance and meaning of what your looking at.  There is a combined entry ticket that lets you see both this and Borobudur on back to back days for only $32 which is an a steal considering these amazing UNESCO Heritage sites your visiting.  Very highly recommended.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: De Borobudur hebben we eerder op onze reis bezocht maar dit complex met de Prambanan rn Sewu Tempel zijn ook erg indrukwekkend om zien. Wat ons betreft een must see als je in Jogja bent
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Bello!Merita una visita obbligatoria se si viene in questa zona.Consiglio la visita al tramonto...si crea una bella atmosfera...
Letaknya tak jauh dr kota jogja.. jadi kesananya bisa naik TransJogja..  . . Walau enggak langsung nyampe lokasi - masih harus berjalan -+200 meter.. tapi seruu..murah dan mudah...

Reached Pramabanan in the afternoon. The overcast condition was a perfect backdrop for this Hindu temple remains and saved me from the scorching Indonesian heat. There were many many people visiting this place, awing at its intricate structural features and its epic landscape and hence it would be a bit difficult to maneuver yourselves to get a decent view of every nook and corner of this temple.
The temple looks exquisite from a distance, but up close not much so. The insides of the temples are mostly empty and I was kind of disappointed as I was hoping to see some deities inside.
It is also worth mentioning that the premises are reasonably well kept and maintained, considering the quantum of visitors it sees from all over the world every day. The pathways to various temples are clearly marked and you wouldnt lose your way in compound. But then, the tour comes with a high price tag, and you wouldn't expect anything less, would you?

Personally, the ticket is very expensive for what you see. It cost the same as Borobudur but Borobudur is 10 times better. Good thing is that in the same enclosure you can also visit Sewu Temple which is also very nice (recommendation to go for the sunset).

Wow!! Never knew such great stories hidden in the Prambanan temples !! Is it an art of man or .... don't know! ! A great place to visit !! One must visit to understand Hindu creations and stories hidden behind the Temples! ! Built thousands year back - is a piece of engineering and Vastu!! Also great to see that how the restoration was going on for years !! Highly recommend place to visit Prambanan Temples,  as this is also an UNESCO heritage sites !!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: We visited the Prambanan temple on the same day as Borobudur. This temple is very beautiful. We attended without a guide so we read information about the temple before attending. There are mosques around the temple which was interesting to me since I love learning about other cultures and religions. This temple is a must when visiting Yogyakarta.

Vale la pena andare anche se il sito è meno sontuoso rispetto a borobudur. È affascinante ascoltare le storie che narrano di dei e uomini poi reincarnati in altre vite... Nessuna pietra è a caso. Il tutto è armonizzato con la natura e la terra circostante anche se è sempre più evidente il procedere del progresso che se non bene organizzato distrugge in modo sconsiderato la natura.
Tempat wisata yang sangat bagus, cocok untuk wisata murah meriah.jangan.lupa untuk membawa payung karena panas terik matahari
Most beautiful and highest Hindu Temple in Indonesia with Ramayana story in the relief and sculpture located near Yogyakarta

Bellissimo sito induista a pochi km da yogyakarta, visitando borobudur conviene fare il ticket cumulativo. All'ingresso abbiamo avuto la fortuna di incontrare due giovani studentesse di scuola che per fare pratica con l'inglese è il lavoro di guida ci hanno accompagnato gratis spiegandoci la logica dei templi e la storia induista, davvero gentili e competenti

It is a nice area to walk around and relax. The temple is ok, but not as spledid as ankor wat which I have been to before. So I don't recommend it if you have been to a better one. The decoration on the stones are not as delicate as well. 

There's another thing I have to say also, is the route to the exit. You could have walked back to your car easily after visiting, however the exit sign led you to a lot of shops.... This is quite annoying....

Prambanan is easy to visit from Yogja. Only 17 kilometers from the city. This compound is worth your trip, we combined it with a visit to the Borobudur. You can buy a combo ticket for the two temples. If you're a student, make sure u bring ur student with a ID card with you. You will receive a discount (50% off). 

The biggest temple is 47 meters high and it looks beautiful among the other towers and ruines. Unfortunately we visited the compound when they were renovating two temples because of the earthquake. Nevertheless it was worth our visit.

As others have said, appalling pricing. This was not worth £1M rupiah (£57) for 4 people. All for lower rates for local people but this is ridiculous. The temple itself is interesting but not that special in comparison to many others in India, Nepal and Thailand where they don't cynically rip you off.

Un des plus beau temple d'Indonésie. Sa grandeur. Un site magnifique. 
Mais je vous conseille de venir tôt le matin pour ne pas être dérangé par trop de monde.
A phenomenal ancient Hindu Temples complex, beautifully laid out and well maintained.Very impressive indeed.

Great experience and this is a large hindu temple with huge compound area.. It probably will take 2hours to walk through all temples.  Will advise to go there before 3pm as sunset in Yogyakarta is 5.30pm to 6pm local time. Ticket for foreigner seem way too expensive.  Local tourist ticket cost rp.30000 (USD2), foreigner ticket cost USD18.  Student ID may get some discount. Bring along your intentional student ID.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Go there if you have a bucket list and need to see everything what seems to be famous, historical, etc...

..otherwise really skip it!! For me after seeing so many nice temples in Japan, Thailand & Myanmar before, it was definitely a huge disappointment! The entrance fee of 234/- is 8x more of what the locals pay & way to expensive for what it is. The main temple site was nice but not stunning & the three other temples were just stone ruins & / or construction sites...

You don't miss out anything at all, I never felt like visiting the biggest hindu temple of IND & there is not a lot of information available..! Just don't go there & don't accept the discrimination with the entrance fee any longer.

Tolle Tempelanlage. Für den Besuchs sollte man sich ca. 1:30 h einplanen. Wir hatten den Besuch mit einem Fahrer aus unserem Hotel gebucht. Es war nicht viel los und es war sehr angenehm über die Anlage zu laufen.

Combining this with a visit to Borobudur is a must if you are in Yogyakarta area of Java.

The fact these temples were built 1200 years ago - and were then completely destroyed by earthquakes in the 16th century - makes seeing them now humbling and memorable.

The main temples have now been rebuild stone by stone - but 150+ minor temples still await restoration - which is ongoing at the site.  The painstaking nature of this restoration is staggering - and needs support!  All entry fees go towards this - so well worth paying to both see and in a small way contribute.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: とても青々、広々とした敷地内です。その一角にプランバナン寺院があります。日影がないので、日傘が帽子は必須です。レストランは、出口周辺に屋台が沢山ありますが、境内にあるレストランで食べた方がよいともいます。屋台は味が問題と言うよりも、味⚫素を入れすぎたような感じがしたので。境内のレストランは、軽食しか食べてませんが、さほどメニューは高くないし、ある程度のクオリティはあるようでした。

ボロブドゥールの帰りに3時間程度寄り道ができそうだったので、寄ってみました。

ジョグジャカルタ空港でタクシーをチャーターしました。Rp350K/3時間です。空港から寺院までは20分程度要しました。Trans Jogshaのルート1Bてもいけそうでしたが、バスのくる頻度が読めないのと、来ても満員で乗れない可能性もあったのでやめました。こっちならRp37Kで圧倒的に安いのですが、ケチってフライトに遅れたりしたら、気分もよくありません。

到着したら、タクシーの降り場の目の前が外国人用のチケットセンターです。文字を読み間違えて、Information   Centerと思い通り過ぎ、Ticket Centerの看板のところに行ったら、インドネシア人用のチケットセンターで、「あなたはあちらです。」と元の場所に戻ることに。外国人用価格Rp234Kを支払い中に。チケットにはUSD18とあるので、多分、Rpに換算して支払ったのだと思います。

広大な敷地の奥に、メインのCandi Lolo Jonggrangが見えます。公園になっていて、入場ゲートの奥に、さらにセキュリティーゲートがありましたが、アラートがなってもそのまま通してくれました。近寄るとLolo Jonggrangのそびえ立つ塔たちが近寄ってきます。どの塔も中に入れるようで、一番背の高い真ん中の塔(主堂)は東西南北の4箇所の入口と、中段に小さな回廊があります。いずれの入口にも小さな小部屋があって、それぞれ異なるヒンズーの神様の像が鎮座していました。なかなか神秘的で興味深いです。
この寺院以外にも、Candi Sewu, Candi Bubrah, Candi Limbung複数の寺院を観覧できるようでしたが、移動距離が相当ありそうで、往復の時間を考えると不安だったので諦めました。
園内の移動には、シャトルが運行されていて、有償か無償かはわかりませんが、移動時間の節約には活用できそうでした。
次回来ることがあれば、1日をフルにあててまわってみたいと思います。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

prambanan tempel is prachtig om te zien.De reliefs zijn goed gedetailleerd zeker de eerste Op dit moment wordt er veel gerestaureerd,aardbeving 2006 degene die het verst van de ingang af zou ikook zeker bezoeken,treintje terug😉.

It may not be visited by every one who comes to see Borobudur but they should. Both the temples are from the 9th Century when Java was ruled by Hindu-Buddhist kings. Although Borobudur is ostensibly a Buddhist temple albeit with strong Hindu/Indian influences there is no such ambiguity in Prambanan temple complex. It is purely a Hindu temple. It is in opposite direction to Borobudur from Jogja but it is possible to do both the temples in one day and if you have a combination ticket then you must do both in 1 day otherwise you will have to pay extra. Prambanan temple is dedicated to the Hindu Trimurti (3 faces), the expression of God as the Creator, the Preserver & the Destroyer. Overall the temple is supposed to be dedicated to Shiva the destroyer. Prambanan is the largest Hindu temple  in Indonesia, and one of the largest in Southeast Asia. Typical of other Hindu temples in India of that era, the temple complex has a central temple with its tall and pointed architecture, and by the towering central building inside a large complex of individual temples. The 3 main temples are dedicated to the 3 "faces" of the trimurti, Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, Then there are smaller temples that support the 3 main temples. It is said that there were over 250 temples originally built in this complex but due to volcanic eruptions but more importantly due to the arrival of Islam in the 10th century Java slowly became Muslim and this  marked the beginning of the decline of the temple. It was soon abandoned and began to deteriorate. In 16th century there was a major earthquake in Java and many of the temples collapsed. There are literally thousands of stones scattered throughout the compound waiting to be put together at some stage but it will take hundreds of years I suspect.
Just like Borobudur it is a must see temple
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Templo precioso para visitar tranquilamente, y sacar fotos por todos lados. Puedes llegar desde Yogyo y es fácil de encontrar.

Well, the temples of the Prambanan site are spectaculair. Although, to increase your experience it is recommended to read a little about it before your visit as local employees and directions are poor of content.

Ich war im Juli mit meinem Freund da. Wir sind gegen 10 Uhr mit dem Auto von Hotel losgefahren und waren ca. gegen 10:40 Uhr am Tempel. Es gibt dort ausreichen Parkmöglichkeiten und alles ist gut ausgeschildert. Das Parkticket kostet 10.000 Rph. Der Eintritt um die 250.000. Für Studenten die Hälfte. Man braucht ca. eine bis 1,5 Stunden um sich alles anzusehen. Auf jeden Fall eine Kopfbedeckung mitnehmen, da es wenig Schatten gibt und die Sonne wirklich extrem auf einen scheint!!!! Review Text:
Vanuit Yogyakarta met een gewone 'taksi' naar de Prambanan gegaan. Via hotel taxi laten reserveren en de chauffeur wacht bij de tempel tot je klaar bent. Kostte ons IRP 295.000 waarbij hij 3 uur bij de Prambanan heeft gewacht. Huur je een privé chauffeur dan ben je in ons hotel ongeveer 400.000 kwijt. 
We vertrokken om 7:00 uur en waren rond 7:45 bij de tempel. Was nog heel rustig en weinig toeristen. Het is absoluut aan te raden om een gids te huren. Die vertelt je heel veel. Erg leuk!! Aan 3 uur heb je ruim genoeg.

Mejor por la tarde, es tan amplio que aunque haya mucha gente puedes encontrar sitios donde hacerte fotos solo. El precio por entrada 240.000 IDR. Muy recomendable ir con tiempo para visitar los otros templos menores (hay un trenecito que te lleva hasta ellos).

We got the same driver to drop us at Manohara hotel which is a good option as the driver stayed for 2 hours+.

The structure is amazing and may be crowded on public holidays as many locals turn up. Actually it was fully packed with queues and people pushing each other to climb the main monuments. If it's crowded just try smaller ones first as many are interested on the bigger monuments. Later you can try the bigger monuments when crowd drops, which occasionally happen as people come in waves.

Мы провели 2 ночи в Джогьякарте, чтобы посетить Прамбанан и Боробудур. Оба комплекса построены в одну историческую эпоху, очень интересны и хорошо сохраняются.

Настоятельно рекомендую найти хорошего гида, так как, чтобы понять сюжеты и символы храмовых комплексов вам необходимо погрузиться в культуру той эпохи.

Дороги в этой местности узкие и плохого качества, поэтому не рекомендую арендовать автомобиль самостоятельно.

Прамбанан - комплекс Индуизма с центральными храмами посвящёнными Шиве, Брахме и Вишну. Индуизм был основной религией Явы до 15 века, когда он был вытеснен Исламом. Жители, которые не пожелали конвертироваться в Ислам, бежали на Бали, где и сегодня Индуизм - главная религия.

Если вы находитесь на Бали или Сингапуре, то оба храмовых комплекса, Прамбанан и Боробудур реально посетить за один день, если прилететь в Джогьякарту утром и улететь вечером.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Прамбанан - очень атмосферное место, как мне кажется, обязательное для всех туристов, приехавших на Яву. Это средневековый индуистский храмовый комплекс, расположенный в парке недалеко от Джокьякарты. Основная часть комплекса - несколько небольших храмов, расположенных на одной площади и посвященных Тримурти - Шиве, Брахме и Вишну, а также их ездовым животным. Храмы очень изящны, украшены прекрасными рельефами и скульптурами мифических животных. Рядом с "главной площадью" расположен небольшой музей, посвященный процессу реставрации Прамбанана. А если прогуляться по парку, то можно дойти до руин средневекового буддийского храма Севу. Туда почти никто из туристов не доходит, поэтому на территории храма тихо и умиротворенно.

The rip off came when we realised that our guide had 'special' travel agent price tickets but we still paid full price.

Мы сглупили и пожалели деньги на аренду зонтиков у торговцев. Это была большая наша ошибка, т.к. храм расположен на открытой местности, тени вокруг нет и печёт как в аду. Никогда и негде нам не было так жарко, как при осмотре этого храма. Поэтому зонтик для комфортного и безопасного для жизни просмотра этого великолепного храма обязателен. Нас чуть солнечный удар не хватил. Храм смотрели перебежками от одной тени к другой. Но этот храмовый комплекс нам очень понравился. Всем рекомендую его к посещению.

Candi Prambanan and Poeri Devata Resort Hotel: 
We were definitely not prepared for our visit to Prambanan temple. It was an add-on to our Borobudur tour. Prambanan completely took us by surprise. Besides Borobudur, it turned out to be the highlight of our visit to Yogyakarta. As we were heading towards the temple complex we could see the spectacular black temple spires in the distance. We immediately realized that we have no knowledge or inklings whatsoever of those giant monuments staring at us. That's when we quickly read up as much as we could of the write-ups on the display boards at the entrance gate. There are several temples scattered around the 1km radius complex. Interestingly it's a sacred sanctuary of both Hinduism and Buddhism. These monuments were constructed between the 8th and 9th century AD left in complete ruins until mid 1900s when restoration works started which today is still ongoing, an effort that has produced a magnificent masterpiece. Throughout the outer compound are piles of rocks or remains of over 200 temples surrounding the completed & restored temples and also half completed structures which workmen are still busily jigsaw-puzzling. The rebuilding, restoration and preservation of this complex really left us in awe, what an amazement! Briefly; the 3 biggest temples are dedicated to the Hindu Divinities; Shiva, Vishnu & Brahma with 3 more smaller temples dedicated to the animals who serve them. Shiva temple with its podium surrounded by little lion statues and intricate carvings is the most impressive, largest and tallest at 47m high. Along the podium galleries and balustrades are narrative illustrations on relief panels depicting the story of Ramayana. Now is when you should invest in an English speaking guide (who are everywhere) who would enthusiastically explain the epic story of Ramayana on the relief panels of Shiva temple and story of Lord Krishna at Vishnu temple. In the main chamber of Shiva temple  is a huge 3m high statue of Shiva standing on a lotus flower base (Buddhism?). Elements of both Hinduism and Buddhism can be seen throughout the complex. The other 2 main temples, Vishnu and Brahma temples are identical twins at 33m tall. Many more smaller temples are scattered around the complex. You need to spend a whole day or more if you're the historical, architectural, archaeological type cos you'll be spellbound by these magnificent masterpieces! Stay at a hotel nearby. Poeri Devata hotel (cottages style) surrounded by paddy fields (nice!) is affordable, reasonably clean, decent meals available, nice friendly staff and within walking distance with free shuttles to the temple. You can walk back through the back gate of the temple complex which is a stone's throw away from the hotel. The hotel can also arrange for tickets with free shuttles bothways for the popular Ramayana ballet performance held at the outdoor theatre (indoors during rainy season) at the temple grounds. After watching the show, you'll have a better understanding of the story behind the wall carvings of the Prambanan temples. If you are planning to visit Borobudur temple, do make sure you head over to Prambanan too. No regrets, hands down! What an experience!!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

entry is cheaper for students (half price) so bring a PHYSICAL student card. Can't remember student price but around 6-9 USD$.

Another UNESCO World Heritage site that is not to be missed when in the Jogjakarta area. We bought the combination ticket for about US $30 which covers entrance to Borobudur as well. Very large site, be prepared  walk a couple of kilometers to see it all. Nice and hot as well with minimal protection from the sun except in the shadows of the tall structures. Lots of carved stones laying around from the earthquake damaged structures. There is ongoing repair and restoration work in progress. Well worth the visit and associated costs.

Sadly, we decided not to stay and see the nearby dance performances. We are regretting that decision after talking with others that attended.

Храм своей атмосферой понравился больше, чем Боробудур. Предполагаю, что это связано с тем, что в тот день здесь было много индонезийских туристов, и меньше европейских, я очень полюбила местный народ. Сам храм просто красив, слов нет. Обязателен для посещения, кстати, вход стоил 234 тысячи рупий (май 2016), Боробудур 217.

Indonesiens größte hinduistische Tempelanlage gehört zum Pflichtbesuch, wenn man in Yogy ist. Ca 1 Autostunde entfernt, wird sie von den meisten Veranstaltern im Doppelpack mit Borubodur angeboten. Neben den schönen Tempeln, ist auch die angrenzende Anlage einen Besuch, insbesondere für Kinder, wert.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Definitely worth visiting if you're nearby. It's a biggest group of hindu temples in the world. Be careful to cover up, since some temples still serve as a place of worship.

Candi Prambanan adalah salah satu sejarah budaya yang wajib kita lestarikan sebagai orang Indonesia, kekaguman akan budaya dan indah serta megahnya candi ini patut untuk kita kunjungi.
Saya datang berkunjung bersama anak-anak saya untuk memberikan pengalaman kepada mereka agar selalu mencintai negeri kita, yang sangat beragam budaya.
Pengelola candi ini sangat baik, dilihat dari kebersihan dan pengaturan wilayahnya yang tidak sembarangan dalam berjualan jadi terlihat rapi. Untuk harga souvenir pun hampir rata dan tidak mahal untuk daerah wisata.

Un tempio, anzi un quantità immensa di templi, veramente stupendo. Da visitarli uno ad uno, tutti veramente belli. Poi anche la gente del luogo molto cordiale! Un esperienza stupenda! La consiglio assolutamente.

Indrukwekkende en kunstig gebouwde tempel. Laat een gids je vooral meer vertellen over de historie e.d. Voldoende water mee voor rondom de middag is een aanrader aangezien het een stukje lopen is naar de winkeltjes als je zonder komt te zitten.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Prambanan je jeden z najväčších chrámových komplexov v Indnézii. Nejedná sa len o jeden chrám, v jeho okolí je viacero  iných chrámov a je porovnateľný s Angkorom v Kambodži. Kamenné svätyne sú doplnené ornamentami a príbehmi z eposu Ramajána vztesanými do kameňa. Nevynechajte tento chrám.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This is an awesome and deceivingly large attraction. There is a lot to explore. We had a tour guide that was more interested in cracking lame jokes instead of giving us valuable information about the temples. The tour guide was one of the tour guides assigned to us at the counter. I sent him after 30 minutes and we decided to explore the attraction on our own. Unfortunately we did not catch the Ramayana Ballet since it was on off day and would love to have caught the ballet.

Le temple principal que l'on trouve sur la majorité des photos car vraiment photogénique est très impressionnant.
Les connaisseurs de la mythologie hindouïste se régaleront des magnifiques fresques sculptées dans la roche volcanique ayant permis l'edifications des temples. 
Deux autres candi sans doute très beaux étaient fermés au public car en rénovation, le site ayant souffert de tremblements de terre. On se dit aussi alors que le prix payé assez élevé (cf site internet de Borobudur) n'est pas vain

Luego de Borobudur es el templo más visitado de la región. Hicimos la visita desde Jogyakarta, donde estábamos hospedados. De allí en taxi son aproximadamente 30-40 minutos de viaje. Se suele visitar al atardecer y así lo hicimos, pese a que el día estuvo nublado pero igualmente fue lo mejor debido al calor sofocante del día. A la entrada nos prestaron una especie de polleras muy bonitas, ya que no se puede ingresar en short. El templo es fascinante y se puede recorrer fácilmente en una hora y media aproximadamente.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Zeer mooie tempels. Jammer dat niet meer gerestaureerd kan worden want dan wordt het een indrukwekkend complex. Midden op de dag erg warm om te bezoeken.
Pretty impressive to see, what older cultures built in the past. Nice place to spend 1-2hours sightseeing. Compared to other activities EXTREMLY expensive.

I really enjoyed this temple.  We bought a joint ticket for here and Borobudur.  We also paid for a guide for 100,000 rp who seemed very knowledgeable but I struggled to understand his English.  This temple is well restored after the EQs and looks beautiful. I hope the rebuild some of the temples just outside the main complex but it is a great  way to spend a morning.

I been to Prambanan twice and I think it's still very pretty from far. The day was little warm as temperature can be high in summer. However the skies during these times can be amazing pretty (pix below). Walking around need at least 1 hour, check out each temple while inside. When you exit, there will be hawkers (food, local delights, souvenirs and handicrafts) waiting for you. Bargain is a must but exercise moderation as it's not price like LV, PRADA.

Lots of history here and also interesting facts to discover; definitely worth a guided visit. 
The site is well kept and there is a huge park around the temple where you can relax or have a walk - nature, religion and culture at once!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Candi ini menurut saya memiliki bentuk yang lebih indah daripada Borobudur dan tidak terlalu terik, karena pelatarannya terkena bayangan bangunan yang tinggi-tinggi, jadi tidak masalah datang ke sini pada siang hari. Prambanan dekat dengan pintu masuk, tetapi kalau mau mengunjungi candi-candi lainnya harus berjalan kaki cukup jauh.

Located in east of Yogyakarta, quite far but still accessable by public transportation, it is an ancient art of building. The structure of main temple is quite tall about 70 meters probably. The touch of hinduism gives epic stories in every edge of the temple. But, if you do not interested in history, legend, or ancient building you won't stand long here.

Almost all of the "things to see" here are outdoor, so beware of heat and rain fall. At night there is Ramayana Ballet, see the schedule on the web, where the temple is becoming the backgroud of the show, its really great.

Come early in the morning to get the best experience of this place.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
The other spectacular site in Yogyakarta, after Borobodur. Literally the only reason I can think of as to why it is not internationally famous is that Borobodur is not very far from it.

However this means that it is less crowded, less of hassle and every bit as spectacular as Borobodur. The size of everything is much bigger than it looks in pictures. Just bring a sunset, and make sure you give yourself enough time to explore the rest of the park.
A really cool temple with a rich history. It is too bad that parts of have been reduced to rubble but still a great take. They also do theater shows which look spectacular

Such a beautiful place with great spirit 
I enjoyed visiting the several temples and watching the walls and climbing the stairs to see the temples from inside

L'imponenza di questo luogo la si avverte dal percorso che è necessario seguire per raggiungere il sito. I templi  che si vedono da distante danno l'idea dell' atmosfera che ti affascina è il più importante d'Indonesia.
 Consiglio vivamente una visita con la guida per apprezzare il significato ed il motivo della loro costruzione e della loro storia

It does make sense to take a guide, though it costs 100k. Only then can you get interesting stories about the stones and events they describe.. That on a few stones the figures are a bit different as if made by some other craftsmen ( see the attached 'monkey-looking' faces of the characters)... A figure of a moderately rich man (big belly) and evil guys who would like to take it from him.. You learn about Brahma; Shiva & Vishnu... I spent there 1.5h to slowly see everything. Very interesting!

To accompany the first time my brother on vacation to Yogya. Today I spoke to Prambanan. Crowded all because fitting holiday long. My advice if you want to visit here better the morning because if the afternoon or off long, jammed and bus no.
原本想看Prambanan的日落, 但竟然下起雨來, 唔通連個天都唔鐘意我..... 當地人馬上拿出雨傘買給遊客, 真有生意頭腦, 不過令氣溫下降, 也許舒服些.

Ad un'ora di auto circa da Malioboro street (Yogyakarta) si trova il complesso del Prambanan. Il costo del biglietto d'ingresso è di 270.000 rupie (15 euro circa) a persona e ne vale assolutamente la pena. 
Immerso in un parco davvero immenso e ben curato, la struttura è costituita da  un insieme di templi, di cui quello centrale di dimensione maggiore rispetto alle strutture circostanti. Davvero suggestivo e spettacolare. Consigliato per chi alloggia a Yogyakarta.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Kemegahan candi ini begitu mempesona sehingga tidak sungkan untuk mendatanginya kembali. Fasilitas yang ditawarkan juga semakin lengkap seperti kendaraan keliling hingga museum.

Tips: Ada sanggar pamujan untuk umat Hindu dan Budha di tengah kompleks candi.

We reached the temple using the local bus from Malioboro (very cheap & efficient service, staff at every bus-stop to ask for advice if necessary)  & walked 500m to the entrance (ignore the rickshaw touts) Do bring lots of water as the grounds are huge & sensible footwear. Entry for foreigners isn't cheap but it is an incredible sight & think of all the restoration :) Beware of the huge maze of shops as you exit. We just followed the signs which may or may not be misplaced on purpose to funnel the tourist traffic .

Prambanan is a very beautiful temple. It reminds me of al small version of Angor. 

We loved it very much to walk around and take beautiful pictures. Sometimes it is very busy near the temple. But if you have time you just wait 15 minutes because large groups will only stay for a short time. 

We decided to combine Borobudur and Prambanan on one day. We bought a ticket for transportation to both locations from Kresna Tourist Service (IDR 100.000 per person). First we went to Borobudur. At 10 am we arrived at Prambanan. At that time it is still not very crowded but the temperature is rising fast. 

Note: When you combine Borobudur and  Prambanan you get an discount on the ticket fee. Total with discount is IDR 425.000 per person. 

When you are going to the exit of Prambanan you will pass a lot of small shops.

It was about 45 minutes from Yogya main city, I've hired a driver for the whole day tour where he took me from hotel (Colombo Rd), to Prambanan Temple, Merapi Volcano Mountain & Borobodur. Costed me Rp400,000 for car, fuel & driver for the 12 hours tour. Its really worth. 

About the temple, its a must go place if you are at Yogya. Spent about 2 hours plus at the temple. Very mesmerizing temple. Unfortunately the temple was not maintained well and the irreplaceable asset is damaged a lot. 

Very photogenic place, advisable to go by 9am. I wish to go there again and spend a whole day there. Its an awesome place!
Ticket price is only about IDR30.000 for only to prambanan. But if you want to visit another temples just buy the package, IDR50.000.

PRAMBANAN Temple  is The  Beautiful Temple in the World. Beautiful environment
and   the beautiful garden

A really nice walk around the temples and some great photo opportunities too. The only downside for me was the guide. He was very knowledgeable but, I would rather have done it without which wasn't possible with the group I was with

rata2 semua orang di jogja pasti tau lokasi candi ini. candi ini termasuk salah satu candi peninggalan kerajaan2 di pulau jawa, terkenal akan mitosnya. lokasi candi strategis, gampang untuk sampai disana. harga masuk murah, jajanan kuliner juga ada banyak di sana.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
While undeniably worth doing, this visit was quite frustrating, especially after the magic of Borobudur. 

These ruins, the restoration of which is still quite incomplete, are being treated with alarming carelessness.  :(  I visited on a Friday afternoon, but it was still quite crowded with student groups, tour groups, and families -- despite which I only saw one guard in the whole temple complex, and he just sat there.  Meanwhile, many tourist families were letting their kids run wild over the temples -- climbing on reliefs and statues, eating food while walking through the temples, and other things that are supposedly against the rules (and for good reason!).  While in the temple of Nandi I saw a father encourage his 6-year-old son to actually climb up on the ancient statue and ride it like a pony, while the father snapped photos.  I tried to ask the father to please stop, but he just laughed and kept taking pictures.  A few minutes later, a temple guide came in with another couple of tourists, and both the *guide* and the tourists kept roughly slapping their palms on the nose of the statue as they talked.  You could see how the stone was already being worn down in that spot from the sweat and friction of all these human visitors' rough handling.

It's very concerning and frustrating to see these ancient temples being treated with such a shocking lack of respect -- not only by tourists, but more significantly, by the management and the so-called guards themselves.  There's no way that this careless treatment will not cause damage.  :(  I hope that the management will get more serious about preserving this irreplaceable heritage -- if not for the sake of future generations, then at least out of respect for the remarkable efforts of those who built Prambanan. 

On a more practical note: I'd recommend seeing this first and then Borobudur.  Otherwise, Borobudur will kind of spoil you for this. (;

旅程の都合上、到着した日の午後しか向かう時間がなく、１５時ぐらいからまわりましたが、クッソ暑いです。１５時前なら身体中の水分持っていかれるんじゃないかと思うので、朝一か１５時半以降が良いと思います。
また、夕方は逆行になるので、きれいに写真を撮りたいなら午前中がいいよとガイドが言っていました。もしくは１７時以降のサンセットに照らされた遺跡も良いかも。
遺跡にはヒンドゥー教の神々のお話がレリーフに刻まれていますが、知識がない私にとってはいまいち入ってこなかったので、予習しておくと良いかな。

peninggalan sejarah yang amat menanggumkan, cukup bayar Rp 30.000,- per orang kita bisa menikmati bangunan amazing ini. ada juga yang menawarkan guide untuk menjelaskan sejarah candi ini. datang sore hari pas untuk foto-foto amazing dengan latar belakang candi prambanan ini.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Wir sind aus Yogyakarta, von der Jl. Maliboro los. Von dort kann man mit der Buslinie 1A in 45min (für 3500Rp p.P - 22Cent) direkt zum Prambanam fahren. 

Falls man eine Tour machen will, oder zum Borobudur fahren will (dauert ca. Anderthalb Stunden), am besten an der Touristinfo buchen. 

Es gibt Kombitickets für beide Tempel, so dass beide insgesamt 410.000Rp kosten. Lohnt sich definitiv.

The Prambanan temple gives a great contrast in style to the Borobudur temple ... you can tell the focus on Hindu beliefs, and see some similarities to structures like Angkor Wat in Cambodia. There are also some nearby temples in the same complex, although when we visited only Sewu was open to visit because of restoration works. It's definitely worth the visit ... and you can even see this on the way to or from the JOG airport because it's only about 20 minutes from the airport and not too far out of the way before heading into town.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
L'imponenza di questo posto la si percepisce dal percorso che è necessario seguire per raggiungere il sito. Gia da molto lontano si vedono i templi sovrastare qualunque cosa... mano a mano che ci si avvicina ci si sente sempre più piccoli, e ci si trova in mezzo a camminare nel tempio induista più importante d'Indonesia.
Inutile raccomandare la visita, se si va a Yogyi uno dei motivi é sicuramente Prambanan.

A quelques dizaines de minutes du centre agité de Yogyakarta , ce site est très facilement accessible .
Un lieu calme, reposant, comprenant plusieurs temples .
La visite vaut vraiment le détour. 
Nous avons un seul regret , à savoir qu'un temple était fermé et qu'un autre était en travaux ....
Néanmoins nous avons passé un excellent moment

Having been to Borodubur Temple on Sunday, we took in the Hindu temple and while it didn't quite match the majesty of the Buddhist complex, it was a lovely visit well worth the trip if you are in the area!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Huge area with a number of  beautiful templs. Stunning architecture and interesting reliefs relaying the religious stories of the hindu faith. The visit was highly enjoyable and I definitely recommend it.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Candi Pramabanan memiliki bangunan induk yang dikelilingi oleh ribuan candi-candi kecil. Mitosnya dulu ada seorang pria yang tergila-gila pada seorang gadis dan untuk meminangnya harus sanggup membangun candi dalam satu malam. Maka pria itu minta bantuan mahluk halus untuk menyelesaikan candi itu. Saat ini sering digunakan untuk pementasan sendratari Ramayana, khususnya pada saat bulan purnama.

jogjakarta , penuh sejarah.

Very nice place to get pictures too. However, be aware of the steep stairs going up and down the temples. It can be dangerous especially when it's crowded.

Review Text: 広いです。日陰ないです。人多いです・・・。ので、朝のオープンと同時に入場しました。見物客は我々とオランダからの家族連れのみ！彼らと写真の撮り合いっこをして、涼しい中、思う存分貸切状態で観光できました。

Candi Prambanan yang terletak kurang lebih 15km dari kota jogja ke arah timur yang berbatasan langsung dengan Klaten sekaligus Jawa tengah ini memiliki nilai filosofis tentang kehidupan kerajaan pada jaman dahulu,menurut Cerita terbentuknya candi ituu akibat salah satu raja yang bernama bandung Bondowoso yang gagal membuat 1000 candi dalam satu malam tekad supaya sang putri yang bernama Roro jonggrang menjadi istrinya tetapi tekad itu sendiri di gagalkan oleh roro jonggrang sendiri.akibat ketidakjelasan janji roro jonggrang tersebut bandung Bondowoso mengutuk sang roro jonggrang menjadi candi dan dinamakan candi Prambanan
普兰班南和婆罗浮图一样，同为世界文化遗产，只不过前者是印度教建筑，后者是佛教建筑。普兰班南类似柬埔寨的吴哥窟但又不尽相同。

Beautiful architecture and wonderfully maintained. 

Site dedicated to the Indian Trinity - Bramha(Creator), Vishnu(Sustainer) Mahesh(Destroyer) with their vahanas(transportation vehicals)

The grounds where the prambanan temples are, are huge. They look pretty much all the same, even with the various carvings.  It is quite a challenge for older visitors.  Best to go when there are not too many people around.  The crowds are a real distraction but I guess that can't be helped.

Long walk to temple you can walk inside most of the temples, a lot of them or empty as the gods have been stolen over the years, but you can still see a lot of the history and the historic monuments that are still standing. You can higher a guide at the entrance this is well worth doing as they have lots of interesting facts you won't get otherwise.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: One of my favourite moments in Java has to be visiting Prambanan during a heavy downpour! Most of the tourists left and the most amazing happened: the dragon statues unveils its functionality as a water drainage system! It was quaint and picturesque. The temples are well-maintained and immense.

Got here on weekend and school holiday so its make this site very crowded and its quite hard to get beauty pict of this temple. On this complex not only one temple but has many and some on process rebuilding it after earthquake on jogja before. For sure will come here again and will try it to come at night to see their dance because I miss it last time.
For one who afraid of sunburn prepare your sunblock because there are no place to hide from sun here.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I went to Prambanan on my second day touring Jogja.  The price was 243,000 rupiah for foreign visitors (the guy didn't give me back my 7,000 change) and I don't feel like I got my money's worth.  After paying all of that money, these people tried to sell me guide services for an additional 100,000 rupiah.  That's the first thing that annoyed me; you would think that for the exorbitant amount they charge, a guide would be included!  Especially considering that I just googled it and found all I needed to know (duh).  I wandered around the temples for a while and was impressed by the work it took to build them way back in the 9th century.  That's about the only thing that impressed me.  Climbing up into each temple and descending again can be a little tricky since some of the steps are steep, but going slowly is the remedy for that.  The park itself is quite large and they have made a play area for children.  There is a museum that's OK but not that great and you exit through a market - happily, no-one harassed me to buy anything.  Overall, this experience started on a sour note and didn't really improve, although it didn't deteriorate either.  Later that night, I went to see the Ramayana Ballet with Prambanan as a backdrop.  Honestly, that's WAY more worth your money that to go see the temples up close.  If I had it to do again, I wouldn't return to the temples but I'd totally see the ballet again.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: If you are a foreigner, there are guides for pay that speak English, Dutch, Deustch (others might be also available, I am not sure). If you are local and need guide, they are welcome to do so too. Be prepare to be tanned :)

wahh udah lama ga ke prambanan, banyak candi yang hancur sih sekarang akbt gempa dlu, dsni angin nya berhembus agak kencang jadi ga usah sewa payung kayak di borobudur, tempat yang bagus utk berfoto, tapi ingat jgn merusak ya hehe

After you've seen a few dozen temples in Asia, it's easy to get a bit jaded, but Prambanan is really a must see!  After Angkor Wat in Cambodia, Prambanan is probably the most impressive in all of Asia.  As a Hindu temple, it's completely different from Borobudor (Buddhist).  Surprisingly, beautiful and impressive.  Highly recommended!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The ticket was 18$ per person/ 243.000 rp/. No one will tell you, that this price INCLUDES welcome drink that you must take BEFORE you enter the temple and after you pay your ticket. You can choose between tea, coffee, water or juice.  I must admit this is my favorite place in yogayakarta. it was a bit crowded but very charming. It has it's own spirit :)

I found this place still beautiful, authentic and sacred but the only complain that I have is the huge difference  (USB 18) in the entrance fee since I last visited Prambanan Temple 2 years ago, which was disappointing.
Overall; it is still definitely worth the visit

The Prambanan Temples are so huge once you get inside the complex! It's good to spend a lot of time here since aside from the main temples of Brahma, Shive and Vishnu there are smaller temples that have interesting stories behind it. Was able to catch the sunset while in the main area and the view was really beautiful! 

Next time we visit, we will go and see the Prambanan ballet!

Los templos son otra maravilla arquitectónica que cualquier descripción no haría justicia al ver las imágenes. Todo el entorno es armonía en este homenaje a las deidades Hinduistas. Sin duda si uno llego hasta esa parte del mundo no puede dejar de verlas pero aqui viene la parte poco espiritual muy similar a lo que pasa en Borobudur, el costo de las entradas es abusivo no tiene relación en nada con el resto de lo que ofrece Indonesia.

Wij hebben Prambanan in de namiddag bezocht zodat we zonsondergang konden bekijken. Echter was het te bewolkt maar dat heeft de pret niet bedorven. 
Zorg dat je genoeg water bij je hebt. Toen wij wachten op de zonsondergang was ons water op en dan moet je een stukje omlopen voor je water kunt kopen.

Wij hadden in Yogyakarta een ritje erheen geboekt die ons in ons hotel ophaalde. Entree was apart. Bij aankomst kun je naast tickets kopen genieten van een kopje Yasmin thee. 
Binnen bieden gidsen zich aan. Wij hebben met een groep gedeeld en waren zo maar 35000 kwijt voor een gids van 1 uur. Dat is wel een aanrader. Ze vertellen je zo veel meer over de tempels!
