Review Text: Pemandangan paling bagus di sini saat sunset. Lokasi persis di pinggir jalan raya. Tersedia shuttle bus ke candi Ratu Boko maks. sampai jam 4 sore.
ที่นี่กว้างใหญ่มากเดินเหนื่อยควรใช้บริการรถลากหรือเช่าจักรยาน ควรมีเวลาทั้งวันเดินชมให้ทั่วจนอิ่มกับโบราณสถานต่างในพื้นที่แห่งนี้ แดดร้อนมากควรเตรียมหมวกหรือร่มไปด้วย

We did it the day that we arrived to the city. You can go by public bus from the airport too (line 1A, it goes to malioboro street, airport and prambanan temple, just for 3500 rupias by person!!!). The temples are amazing, no enough words to describe it.

I dont remember the price of the ticket... but with student card (any of them... they dont ask too much about it) it has a 50% of discount.
Candi Hindu terbesar , dan dikelilingi dengan banyak candi-candi yang lain. Kali kedua memgunjungi candi Prambanan and i still excited being there.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: 普兰巴南寺是印尼著名的印度教历史遗迹，位于日惹。从日惹市区开车前往不到1小时的时间。寺庙中供奉着几尊印度教的神明，其中长着大象鼻子的是智慧神。来到这里参观不能穿短裙短裤。
普兰巴南寺，是一个非常壮观的印度教的寺庙群。经历了多次地震后的坍塌，又不断地被重新堆起来再现原貌。我们参观时，现场寺庙的周边，仍然有大堆的乱石块，还没来得及堆起寺庙来。

The temples are awesome and majestic, especially the towering Shiva temple. however the Entrance Fee of 2,42,000 IDR is ridiculously high. Not even Taj Mahal has that high fee! Indonesian govt.seems to be hungry for money or they want to discourage tourists from visiting Yogyakart.               a.

We visited Prambanan on a Sunday - cycling there. Took just over an hour - and it was quite hot. But well worth the effort as you got to cycle through some lovely countryside. The temples were stunning - 100% worth a visit.

In the distant Prambanan looks slender & graceful with its stiletto like top. I could not imagine how each stone was piled on top each other forming an architectural masterpiece unique even in our time. Its cone like shape is awesome. Different bas-reliefs lined up the walls each portraying a story in the life of that ancient empire. One can see the piles of square shaped stones which are silent witnesses of its glorious days . Built in the 9th century, this is one of the unique temples of Indonesia that is worth visiting.

It was raining a bit when we visited and that made it tough to see. It was very muddy which doesn't normally bother me but there was no refuge anywhere. We wanted to go up into the various temples but people were blocking the stairs and just standing in the way not wanting to go into the rain.

On the flip side, we went to see the ballet afterwards in the theater facing the temples and they looked beautiful all lit up at night.

Candinya sudah bisa dipastikan luar biasa... tp jalan menuju candi dan kembali ke area parkiran sangaaaattttt jauh... sebaiknya sedia stroller untuk yg bawa anakdari pd gendong lumayan bangeettt dan ga rekomendasi untuk lansia yg sdh mulai sakit dibagian kaki.

Saya mengunjungi Candi Prambanan pada saat agenda Study Tour dari kampus.
kami datang pagi, tetapi suasananya sudah ramai dengan turis.
jalan dari parkiran ke candi lumayan jauh, jadi diharapkan membawa air mineral, payung (cuaca lumayan panas) dan kamera..!!

As this is one of the most known temples in Indonesia, we had to go see it, and we did not regret it. Beautiful temples; there are different temples across the area, but the main temple complex is the real deal. Entrance fee is not cheap (for tourists it's about 9 times the fee locals pay...), but it's only fair as they keep the place clean and beautiful.
Pro-tip: if you're not Indonesian, get yourselve a guide. As an added bonus, this will keep local students from constantly asking for a picture together.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Très émouvant ce lieu chargé d'histoire, avec ces constructions qui ont traversé les siècles !
Nous avons également pu voir que les indonésiens se donnent énormément de mal pour reconstruire à l'identique des temples qui ont été détruits avec le temps, bravo à eux !
Ajoutant à cela un contact avec les locaux toujours aussi touchant de gentillesse et de sourires (nous sommes maintenant des stars nationales chez eux tant nous avons été pris en photo par des enfants), et voilà un grand moment à ajouter à notre voyage !

A faire absolument !!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Het is heel erg mooi zeker je kan hier netjes lopen en mooie foto's maken. Zeker als je rond zonsondergang er bent.
Wonderful, wonderful, quiet, full of positive energy. For us the best of Java, we liked it even more than Borobudur. It reflects the history, it reflects the spirit of the place. WOW!

The stone craving of the temples are delicate and nice and amazingly well preserved. Not recommended to go in the afternoon as the weather will be TOO HOT! Suggest to have a guide to explain the structure and the history of the temples along the visit.

There are multiple Candi but these are the main: Brahma, Siva and Vishnu, there is a legend that the king wanted to marry the beautiful Rara Jonggrang and took her challenge to build 1000 temples in a night but failed. The temple is about 40min away from Jogja town and a joined tour in van to Prambanan Temple and Ramayana Ballet costs about 100krph with pickup from hostel. Prambanan half day tour only is about 80k rph. The entrance fee is 234k per pax for foreigner and any valid student card (same with foreign countries) will be entitled for 50% discount. The other temples in same compound such as Sewu temple and Lombong temple are under restoration but within walking distance. Rent a bicycle if you want to enjoy the peaceful atmosphere.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: We went late afternoon and had very bad light. A must see, just like Borobudur. We thought the latter was (even) more impressive. Do try to find a spot from where you can see (almost) the whole bunch of temples.

Berkunjung ke sini pada sore hari, ketika cuaca tidak terlalu panas dan pengunjung tidak terlalu ramai. Sebenarnya berniat untuk beli tiket paket Candi Prambanan dan sunset di Candi Boko, tapi sayang kami kesorean. Tiket paket tersebut terakhir dijual jam 1500. 

Candi ini sendiri merupakan tempat tujuan wajib wisatawan yang berkunjung ke Yogyakarta, karena disebut sebagai candi Hindu terindah di dunia. Saya setuju untuk hal ini. Jika Borobudur terkesan megah, maka Prambanan terkesan dengan keindahannya.

Aksesnya mudah, terletak di pinggir jalan raya Yogyakarta dan Solo, persis di perbatasan DIY - Jawa Tengah. Bahkan kompleks ini memang terbelah dua antara kedua provinsi ini. Jika masih punya waktu, hadiri juga pertunjukan balet Ramayana yang terletak di seberang candi ini. Pertunjukan tidak setiap hari, jadi pastikan untuk mencari info terlebih dahulu.

Храмовый комплекс Прамбанан один из самых красивых, мною увиденных буддийстких комплексов. Поражает своей изящностью и масштабом. относится к одним из тех мест, которые следует посетить обязательно каждому уважающему себя путешественнику.

We went there in the hot month of May. Took a scooter and got there by 10 in the morning after a trip to Borobudur. It was in Indonesian holiday as well, so it was tok crowded.
The temples are really beautiful with ruins in the compound. Although it was really hot inside the temples but we managed to get inside each one of them.
Plenty of food stalls around along with kind of a small flea market. Would suggest to go in the mornings as it can be really crowded later on.
Siapkan stamina kala mengunjungi candi ini. Tiap candi ada patung di tiap sisinya. Jangan lupa bawa topi/payung dan kacamata. Karna cukup panas di sini. Ato mending datang pagi aja.

Went there after the earthquake that somehow damage this temple. Its great that they are already begins the restoration here. In Prambanan Temple you can also watch the Ramayana Ballet in the evening for a true ancient experience.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Auch Prambanan ist absolut sehenswert. Kleiner als Angkor Wat, aber dennoch ausreichend, um einen zu beeindrucken. Vor allem der Kontrast der steinernen Tempel mit den grünen Rasenflächen bietet sich für tolle Fotos an. 

Was mich etwas gestört hat, war, dass unser Guide die Tickets organisiert hat. Zwar hat er, wie angeschlagen, 234.000 Rupieh verlangt, aber ein Ticket haben wir nie erhalten und sind vor den Schranken in den Park geleitet worden. Sehr merkwürdig das Ganze... 

Prambanan ist nicht so überlaufen wie Borobudur, Selfies werden von den Schulkinder aber dennoch öfter mal angefragt.

On est saisi dès l'arrivée par la majesté du temple principal qui trône et vous toise du haut de ses 47 mètres.
Le plus difficile est d'arriver à faire une photo sans une grappe de touristes qui pose dans les escaliers des différents temples. La rançon de la gloire et de la beauté.
Les trois autres temples en cours de restauration sont beaucoup moins fréquentés. Le dernier, le plus éloigné, vaut la peine de marcher 15 minutes sous le soleil, à moins que le petit train soit opérationnel.
Pour nous, site incontournable.

Locals pay considerably less - approx 30,000Rp, whereas international visitors are charged 234,000Rp! Unless you are a student you can get in for 117,000Rp, but still thats 4x the amount they pay. 

There is a fair bit to see within the site like a museum, 3 other temples and also the deer garden which tbh is quite sad. There are loads of deer in there with no growing grass to even feed on, or enough space to roam around!

We tried to visit Prambanan for sunset, however this was ruined by the daily storm. Therefore we didnt manage to fully admire the temples, and instead were left running for cover. What we saw was very nice and somewhat unique, so it was worth a visit.

If you think the price is worthy, go and visit and bring your rain jacket, but if you only have time for one temple in Yogya, make it Borobudor.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Temple is really something special. We visited it at afternoon, sun and moon were in some special geometric position (each of them was on the same distance from the horizon). It is obvious that Shiva is the most "respectable" god, so "believers" built  an excellent structure. Lots of details despite huge buildings/temples. Go visit it!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
My friends and I went to the temple in April (not yet high season), and it was packed, which isn't surprising as it's one of the main tourist attractions in the area. We used a guide, who was informative, and climbed in and out of the main buildings to see the various statues housed inside (tough work on a hot day!). 

It was beautiful, but we much preferred Sewu Temple, which is in the same grounds. When exiting the main temple, turn left while everyone else turns right, and after about a 15 minute walk you will reach Sewu - and have the place almost to yourselves :)
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Krásné místo, levný dojezd z Yogakarty, i taxi, za vstupné se platí, zážitek na celý život, výhled na Merapi sopku.

Saya berkujung pada super looong weekend Mei kemarin. sangat ramai dan ditambah lagi ada acara panggung di kawasan Taman Candi. sedikit menggangu keintiman saya dengan candi, sedikit mengurangi ketenangan saat berada di kawasan candi. namun itu bukan masalah, karena ada spot-spot yang masih sepi dan jauh dari kebisingan dan tetap dapat menikmati bangunan candi secara utuh, yakni di daerah belakang candi. saya kurang paham kenapa sepi di daerah situ, padahal lokasinya sangat menarik. banyak reruntuhan-reruntuhan batu candi dan dapat menatap seluruh candi besar. entah karena banyak wisatawan yang tidak tahu, atau hanya malas jalan hehe.dapat menyewa pemandu dengan tarif kurang lebih 100ribu. anda akan diajak berkeliling sekitar candi sekitar 1 jam sembari mendengar sejarah tentang candi
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
過去数回訪れていますが地震のために壊れた部分の修復はあまり進んでいない様子でした。
ヒンドゥー教の神様を祭る寺院ですので、ヒンドゥー教について多少知識を入れていった方がより楽しめると思います。
ちなみにインドネシアの祭日の為、凄まじい人の数。歩くのも、見るのも、写真撮るのも大変です。のんびり見たいのであればカレンダーは最低限確認した方が良いかもしれません。

Kompleks świątynny jest dobrze utrzymany jak na przeżycie trzęsienia ziemi. Choć mam wrażenie, że dopiero od niedawna zaczął ktoś dbać o ten obiekt tak na serio. 

Mało turystów. Spokojnym tempem można zajrzeć do każdego budynku, w którym znajdują się posągi bogów i bogini.

Jak na hinduistyczną świątynię to przyznam, że bliżej jej do klimatu Angkor z Kambodży niż np. świątyń w Radżastanie w Indiach. Jest dość surowa. 

Ładne zdjęcia panoramiczne wychodzą przed wejściem w wyznaczonym miejscu do robienia zdjęć oraz po wyjściu w kierunku mini zoo i sklepików.

Conjunto de templos patrimonio de la humanidad por la Unesco.

Los templos son impresionantes y es una visita obligada. No le doy la máxima puntuación porque el precio de la entrada me parece un abuso.

Recomiendo su visita.

A acheter: billet combiné avec Borobudur (416 000 IDR en avril 2016), et à visiter en fin d'après-midi, pour le coucher du soleil, puis dîner au restaurant du théâtre où se produit  le spectacle du Ramayana à 19h30. Superbe soirée!

It's not the place to find Lara Croft in. But it has some hidden gems. Been there just before and after sunset, when it was less crowded. Enjoyed the appearance with the lights on. As usual foreign tourists have to pay twenty times more than locals.

Diese hinduistische Tempelanlage ist sehr eindrücklich von ihrer Grösse und Ausdehnung her. Der Eintrittspreis ist etwas hoch. Wir haben etwas ausserhalb einen kleinen Rabatt gekriegt. (Nur noch 220'000 INR also etwa Fr.18.-- Das ist doch etwas teuer für diese vielen Steine.)
Schöne Fotosujets möglich.
Muss man hier wohl einfach gesehen haben.

FYI kalau kesini sebaiknya pagi.. apalagi kalau bawa anak kecil.. suasana pagi lebih sejuk dan pengunjung jg blm terlalu banyak.. jd bs foto2 selfie sepuasnya.. baguss lohh buat foto2..hahaha..
Namun kalau terlambat untuk datang pagi jgn lp bawa air mnum dan menyewa payung yg banyak di tawarkan di pintu masuk candi..  cuaca disana sangat terik..

Prachtig bouwwerk. 
Wij gingen op eigen gelegenheid met privechauffeur (nemen nooit een veel te dure Tour) eerst naar de Borobudur, lunchen en daarna naar Prambanan. Bij Borobudur een combi ticket gekocht. Toeristen betalen (geldt voor nagenoeg alle toeristische attracties) altijd een hogere prijs dan de locals (logisch)  

Tip: aan het begin bieden gidsen zich tegen betaling aan. Een stukje verderop zijn er (gratis) studenten die jou heel graag en enthousiast alles laten zien en alle details en geschiedenis kunnen vertellen!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: ที่นี่สวยงามกว่าที่คิดไว้ โดยส่วนตัวแล้วชอบกว่า บุโรพุทโธ เสียอีก การเดินสำรวจทำได้ในเวลาไม่นานนัก แต่ถ้ามาในวันที่แดดออกจัดจะร้อนมาก ควรพกหมวกหรือร่มมาด้วย

1st day of our trip. Magnificent view of the building, and Love story had been draw down on the stone of the building. Is a historical place for us to understand one part of the hindu people God . For people who love photo taking, is a nice place for it.
Loved my visit to the Prambanan temple complex. There were hordes of visitors but you'd still get time to admire and explore the place. This to me was one of the major highlights of my trip to Yogya

This temple dates from around 850AD. The temple, or "candi" (pronounced chandi) as the Indonesian say is a Hindu temple. The temple is not far out of Jogjakarta in central Java. The entry price is not cheap, but you can get a joint ticket with Borobodur, another major temple.. If you don't know much about Asian religions, you may wish to go on a tour.

Wao, sungguh luar biasa", entahlah kata apalagi yang bisa menggambarkan keindahan dan keagungan candi Prambanan. Mungkin kamu sudah tahu banyak tentang candi pramabanan dengan kisahnya. Tapi, kamu harus berburu lokasi fhoto yang bagus disini bersama sahabat kamu.

Candi Prambanan tidaklah sebesar Candi Borobudur, tapi termasuk dalam daftar "must visit" di Yogja. Candi Prambanan merupakan candi peninggalan agama Hindu dan situs peninggalan bersejarah. Untuk masuk ke lokasi candi, tidaklah mahal. Namun disarankan untuk memakai perlengkapan anti matahari misalnya sunblock, topi dll karena cukup panas.

Gak jauh dari kota yogyakarta (malioboro), bisa di capai dengan transjogja yg saya nilai kurang recomended soal kualitas armada, supir, kernek dan ruang tunggunya. Masuk candi prambanan cukup membayar 30ribu, jika cuaca panas saya sarankan membawa payung atau topi, karena sungguh menyengat panas mataharinya. Bawalah minuman dan makanan. Karena saya tidak menemukan penjual makanan dan minuman di dalam candi prambanan, kalian akan menemukan penjual makanan dan minuman setelah pintu keluar.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: El ticket de ingreso cuesta 234.000rp, para los locales el mismo ticket cuesta 30.000. Esto es un abuso, una frescura, considerando que la Unesco, les da dinero para mantener los templos. Esto provoca para que las agencias de viaje compren tickets para locales y te hagan pasar como local ante los que chequean las entradas. Esta especie de mafia es común en Java. Olvida que podrás hacer esto mismo por ti solo. Si en tu viaje fuiste a Angkor Wat, o has ido allá, no vale la pena malgastar el dinero acá.

Candi ini terletak di kota jogjakarta, dalam komplek candi terdapat beberapa candi dengan satu candi yang besar.panoramanya cukup indah. Suasana cukup panas apabila di siang hari jadi disarankan untuk sewa payung.

personally i think prambanan temple is more beautiful compared to the borobudur temple. though a bit smaller, it is more artistic. you can buy the entrance ticket for both the borobudur temple and the prambanan temple at a cheaper price but the ticket is valid for two days only.

二度目のプランバナン。前回は10年以上前。あの美しい造形美をもう一度目にしたくてやって来ました。
やはり美しい！
大きな塔が六つ。その他に小さな塔がいくつか。遠くからは、見る角度によって表情が変化します。
実際に大きな塔に登ってみると、ラーマ王の物語の彫刻が施され、見ごたえがあります。
塔から隣の塔を臨むのも、別の楽しみ方です。
やはり感銘を受ける素晴らしい造形物でした。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Was able to visit this wonderful Hindu temples and it just wonderful to see these 8th century old temples. Though place is too crowded as we visit it on a holiday. Would want to come back again and get up close with these temples
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Prepare your hat or umbrella when enter this attraction. Rent the guide for better information of the history, enjoy the surrounding area, rent the bike if you would see the other temple which still under renovation. Better you go earlier.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
If you were a history and culture aficionado, then when in Jogja, don't just come to Borobudur temple, which was the remnant of Indonesia's time as a Buddhist nation. Come also to Prambanan temple, a remnant of the glorious Hindu era of Java. 

Prambanan is much closer and easier to get to from Jogja, so you don't need to spend a night especially for the trip, whereas for Borobudur you have to. It is also very majestic and has an interesting folklore to it, the Roro Jonggrang story. 

Try to come in the afternoon when the sun is friendlier and the crowd dissipated, so you'll appreciate it more.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Menurut saya... karna saya baru ke candi ini saya merasa senang sekali apalagi jalan2 bersama keluarga saya... diawal tempat masuknya kita disambut oleh taman yg luas dan indah...tapi sayang sekali waktu saya kesana beberapa candinya sedang di perbaiki. Kalo mau naik candi jangan lupa membawa minum ya / ketoilet dulu....soalnya kalo udah diatas nyari toliet susah...(namanya juga jalan2😂😂😂)

Tempat wisata ini dapat dijangaku dengan bus transogja. Saat naik busini bilang saja mau ke prambanan. Nnti petugasnya akaan memberitau cara kesana. Harga masuk ke ptambanan 30.000 untuk WNi sedangkan untuk WNA saya tidak tahu. Karena loket penjualan tiketnya dibedakan. Saat menuju ke prambanna lita akan melewati taman yang sanat luas dan bersih. Saat memasuki prambanan tidak akan beliha kompleks cadi. Ab seluluh wisatawan harus keluar sebelum jam 6. Namu disini juga tersedia tempat untu berkemah.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: 結構な見応えがあります。寺院の外壁に刻まれた叙情詩ラーマヤナのレリーフは傷みも激しいけど素晴らしいです。
An amazing architecture that explains about the root of Hinduism in Jogja. Great carving and unique work that is truly amazing...

Candi Prambanan is one of the UNESCO heritage site which has tremendous architecture. An old Hindu temple and its structures depict mainly the Ramayana story.
The beauty of this temple can be fully enjoyed if you avoid visiting it during weekends or public holidays in Indonesia. The temple and its surrounding area is really wide, so it would be a good choice to hire a bicycle at the entrance.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: the heat temperature totally crazy so need umbrella to cover. A lot of domestic visit this temple. Unbelievable Ramayana history carving on the temple even though had to pay a lot entrance especially for tourist. I would like to recommend to come  in the morning instead at noon very hot and overcrowded.

we had a really good guide YUNUS ( whom we booked from the hotel phoenix ) he was very informative and walked us through every detail of the temple. was an amazing amazing feel, beautiful. would be nice to spend the whole day at the temples.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Awesome .... with traditional Javanese charm attached to the culture . Prambanan is very beautiful and amazing.

We visited this temple on a day tour with Borobudur so bought the combined ticket. Foreign tourists have a special entrance, which we found rather odd but it made it very easy and relaxing. Once inside the temple complex the temple itself is very impressive, the main building is HUGE. The only problem we had was that it was tough to fully enjoy as we were constantly being stopped by school groups and domestic tourists wanting to practice English or pose for photos with us. It was OK to start, but became a bit much when a queue began to form...

This is one of the most famous Hindunese temple in Indonesia. When you're at Yogyakarta, this place is a must-visit for those Jogja-first-timers. The whole temple itself consists of small temples scattered around an area, with the biggest temple located at the center.
If you pay Prambanan a visit, you would want to grab a package of Prambanan + Ratu Boko temple ticket. It costs about IDR 45.000 for locals the last time I visited in in November 2015. With this package you'll get entrance tickets for both Prambanan temple and Ratu Boko temple, plus a free shuttle from Prambanan to Ratu Boko, vice versa.

Pertama kali keluar Bali, mengunjungi situs bersejarah sebelum pulang ke Bali.
Mengelilingi 2 jam lebih. Berfoto ria, naik kereta putar-putar keliling candi, berfoto dengan badut.
Masuk kedalam candi untuk foto. pengalaman tak terlupakan. terimakasih.

Very beautiful just too many people we were there on a Sunday. There's a small group of temples at the far end of the area it's worth a visit because it is so quiet and serene, not many people go that far.

I rented a driver at the airport for 4 hours, to be dropped off at my jogja hotel. I did 3 temples including the sunset Ratu Boko complex.  This was around 400k rupiah but convenient.  You could probably haggle it down.  It's worth quickly doing the museum in the complex mainly for the old pictures before restoration. It was really dilapidated, unrecognizable compared to what you see now.  It's all  tidy now and lacks lost world mystery, but still amazing.  I wish the security would watch the visitors more, people fingering intricate ancient carvings is painful to see, but it's a massive task.  I didn't do Suwa temple because it seemed so far away, I was confused as to whether it was even in the same complex.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Candi Prambanan or Candi Rara Jonggrang is a 9th-century Hindu temple compound dedicated to the Trimurti, the expression of God as the Creator (Brahma), the Preserver (Vishnu) and the Destroyer (Shiva).
The present temple compound is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and is the largest Hindu temple site in Indonesia. It is characterized by its tall and pointed architecture, typical of Hindu temple architecture, and by the towering 47-metre-high central building inside a large complex of individual temples.
It was very hot, no haven from the scorching sun there...

This temple site is also a UNESCO heritage site and its construction was done in multiple stages in 8th and 9th centuries. It is a reflection of the Hindu religious beliefs and culture, so old in human history. The temples are very well maintained and are very unique architecture. The site compound has been well complimented by the green lawns, plants, shrubs and flowers. A serene religious site, well worth the entry ticket. This temple site alongwith Borobudur temples is also reflection of how three different faiths (Buddhist, Hindus and majority Muslims) in Indonesia respect each other, tolerate and get along so well. Bravo!
Eines der highlichts in Jogja. Umbedingt sehenswert. Es ist wohl der grösste Hindutempel Indonesiens. Nur die Tiere die auf der Anlage gehalten werden sind eher arme Schweine.

If you are in Indonesia you will be accustomed to densely populated areas, if not yet the you will soon. But Prambanan has slightly less visitors than Borobudur and is again extremely beautiful. Visited in the late afternoon and missed the midday heat which made walking around far more pleasant and is the weather conditions are right you can get the sunset peaking through the temple and it creates an impressive silhouette of  the statues.

从远处看那仅存建筑是非常美丽的。
但一走进景区，就会看见有很多被地震摧毁的建筑。 可以想象若全部都还存在的话，那是多么的雄伟。那些仅存的建筑物中，你可以看到浓浓的吴哥窟的感觉。你还能在上面发现和吴哥窟一样故事的浮雕（猴子王）。对历史有兴趣的人一定要来看看
The story of Ramayana is very popular Indonesian society while Worldwide will be stunned to see this story and visitors every year Prambanan growing
Pěkný komplex hinduistických chrámů.Cena je vyšší,ale stojí to za to. (Jsou zde místa relaxaci i pro děti hřiště).

It's really big and awesome. How could they build stones into this majestic temple?? You will walk onto long brick road before arrived at the main area. There will be a lot people who sells round hats and renting umbrella. In the main area, there will be a couples of temple and you can go inside too, its really dark with statue in there. After the main area, there will be a shopping center where you can buy a lot of traditional stuff.

Just 30 minutes driving from Yogyakarta, the Prambanan temple site offers a small area of hindu temples. Its definitely a must see.

Pros:
- very well conserved and very impressive.
- there is not too many people.
- the gardens are well kept.
- there is a few different areas with different temples.

Cons:
- ridiculously expensive.
- walking distances are a bit long to be walked under the heat.
- the area looks like a park, very artificial... They should have kept it wilder!
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This temple makes you quiet. Breathtaking views from a distance and once you enter it is truly impressive. Make sure to visit it with a guide so you get the stories behind it.

Prambanan Temples are a must while in Yogya. It is the largest Hindu temple of Java. The history of it is very interesting. It was only in the past century they began reconstruction after being covered for a long period due to volcano eruption and earthquakes. The reconstruction is still in progress.

We also went to Borobudur the same day. Make sure to get the package for both and spend less money. If you can afford to, get a guided tour. The temple, like many are up steep stairs, but not too difficult. The park covers a large area and you can walk to other temples. Go early, as it seems to rain often in the afternoon. We took an umbrella, and did not mind the shower that happened.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: not so known, but easily accesible from the airport, several complex of temples (3) full of history and interesting reliefs, to be seen slowly and enjoying it all
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
We had a guide take us early to avoid the crowds.  Arriving at 07:30 there was only one school group there.  The site is well- maintained and the temples are impressive, dedicated to Shiva, Vishnu and Brahma.  
Those on departing flights from the Jogja airport can get a great flyover.  Some planes went by on one side and some on the other so it does not seem that getting a window seat on the one side or the other is any guarantee.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I choose that title due this place is great for walking because the area so huge, the air is nice especially in the morning or afternoon. It is a nice place for selfie peoples and it is a memorable of stone ages. :D  My suggestion is wear your sport shoes or with sandals and wear comfortable suites.

If you travel to Yogya, this is the must visit icon. 
Majestic views for you who interest in history, architecture or even just to take a nice and amazing selfies photos. 

an hour ride from Yogyakarta, but it so worth to take. 
even when you just arrive at the site, you can directly feel the majestic sense by seeing the ruins in front of the temple.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Prambanan Notes
September 11th, disliking tours, I rented an automatic motorbike (70,000 RP) for a jaunt to Prambanan. It took, including finding the actual highway, 5 hours total to go, see & return.
What a miracle...........religious cohabitation......Well, of course, there is NO profit in peaceful living, man.....there is MUCH NET profit to be made from hate, religious strife, greed & war. And so it goes....
Photos show the temple & surrounding temples plus some bas-reliefs. To me, it is amazing what it must have looked like with the colors right after it was finished.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Easily accessible, about 45 minutes from central Yogya, a stunning set of temples. Its an exaggeration to say its as good as Angkor Wat, but the similarities are clear and with the temples set in a large park its possible to appreciate them close up and from afar.
When we went it was busy but not overcrowded with the vast majority of visitors being local school parties, rather than tourists.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Not far from Mt. Merapi and the Buddhist Borobudur Temple is the site of the Hindu Prambanan Temples. While Borobudur is imposing and somewhat isolated, the Prambanan Temples and their ruins are a haunting reminder of days past. This is absolutely something to see, and it won't take long to go through. See the Ramayana ballet at night.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This is the biggest Hindu temple, I've ever seen. Also known as Candi Rara Jonggrang! The temples are beautiful. The architecture is magnificent and tall. Cravings are wonderful and the history behind it is lovely too. Beautiful and clean lush green park surrounding. Watch out for the steep steps, though.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Beeindruckend gut erhalten sind vor allem die Figuren im Tempel. Die ganze Anlage ist sehr gut restauriert - und sehr gut besucht. Kann man sich nicht entgehen lassen
住在王宫附近。我是代理点，大概50rmb，往返。之前去过吴哥窟，所以觉得这里没有很壮观。有学生证的记得带，我带了打了五折。60人民币。

This UNESCO world heritage Hindu Temple is a must-visit if you are in Jogja, you can learn so much about the history and culture about the people here and the view is simply breathtaking.

We brought a prambanan + borobudur package ticket for the entrance as it is cheaper than the individual entrance tickets, do inquire at the ticket counter if you are planning to visit multiple sites too. Near the entrance, we also hired a tour guide to bring us around the temple compound and tell us the stories of this place.

As we stroll across the garden and when Prambanan temples first came to my view, I am truly amazed as the view is so beautiful and surreal, completely different from its surroundings, it's a very very picturesque scene that you have to see it with your own eyes.

As we move around the temple area, the guide told us the history of the place and how it was tragically ruined by the volcano eruption and what is left today. He also explained the stone carvings and statues to us in detail, it is really interesting. Hiring a guide enhances your experience ten folds, it's very worthy.

You can see many stones are stacked and scattered around the temple area as reconstruction is still happening, but it is impossible to return the temples to its full glory as they simply do not have enough materials to rebuild all 240 temples.

As the sun goes down, the temple is lit up with strong lights and the night view is very magnificent. We got to enjoy this view as we exit the temple grounds and when we were eating dinner nearby.

It is definitely worth visiting to learn the history, culture and the religion and to enjoy the amazing view, the art of stone carvings during ancient times, the architecture of the towers, and you will never know if the temples will be here forever.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Templo muito bonito do século 8 e que ainda está em recuperação. Vale muito a pena. Localizado a 30 minutos do aeroporto da cidade de Yogyakarta.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: We had an amazing guide who told us a lot about Hinduism in a very approachable way. We had great fun and it made the temple and Hindu culture come alive. Thank you, mister Eddy!

near Yogyakarta city centre. The temples are in excellent condition and you can climb them easily. Unlike Borobodur which is like a single gigantic structure, the Prambanan temples are spread on a small area. There are lesser tourists here though but I feel that this temple complex is at par with Borobodur's beauty.

The temple is clean, nice and comfortable. I like the tour guide because they're not just talk and just touring around the temple, the park and the museum. They like taking us to the past, telling the story of Roro Jonggrang. I like this place. I also love the performances in the temple and the sunset view. Definitely, will come back.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: It was about to rain when I was there. It's a huge temples xD if you are afraid you will be exhausted to walk around the temples, you can take the bus tour but I don't know how much does it cost. Make sure you bring your own umbrella because it's really hot

乾季だったということもあり私が訪れた時はとても暑かったです。
帽子が必須だなということを感じました。
日陰はあまりなかったように記憶しています。

英語のガイドを頼んだのですが、予備知識もあった為か途中から自分らで見てるだけで楽しくなってきたのであんまり必要ないかな〜と思いました。

Stunning Prambanan will take your breath away. Arrive early so you can have it all to yourself. The buildings are absolutely beautiful and very well preserved. Walk through the massive grounds and the smaller, equally impressive sites.

Borobudur &  Prambanan Temples must be visit in Indonesia for holiday. Those are the major icon of tourist attaraction which is rich culture, historic and high philosophy. Some buildings told the ancient story of Hinduism epic. Worth to see and good idea to learn more about history.

The temple is imposing , grandious architecture . The turret temples contain a single statue each . Maybe just go up a couple of them the climb up each of them is rather arduous for all , the young were also panting half way up . Take your time in the area of the temple to get the feeling of stepping back in time . Try to avoid a weekend visit as hundreds of locals and mainly schools come to visit then . All want photos with you and all wNt to interview you as part of their school projects !

Review Text: Irwan Yusrief with Java Indah Tour and Travel was very helpful in arranging our visit to the Prambanan temples.  These ancient Hindu temples are extraordinary.

Indrukwekkend en imposant Hondoe bouwwerk. En wat moet het nog veel   ruïnes weer opgebouwd worden.
Erg leuk om het met een gids te bezoeken zodat je wat meer van de historie en de religie komt te weten.
Temples with few stupas and the story inside them, with clean and bright blue sky as the background.
this temple is so majestic. Ramayana story is sculptured in here, we visited with children and the heat is so high. worth to visit this site while holiday in Indonesia

Kami sekeluarga memilih paket wisata yang mengunjungi 3 candi, yaitu Candi Plaosan, Candi Sojiwan, dan terakhir Candi Prambanan seharga Rp60.000 untuk sekali perjalanan menggunakan kendaraan sejenis elf.
Di Candi Plaosan dan Candi Sojiwan, kami diberi waktu 30menit  untuk mengexplore masing-masing candi tersebut.
Kami tidak menyangka ternyata kedua candi tersebut berada di tengah-tengah permukiman warga. Keadaan kedua candi tersebut juga berbeda dengan Candi Prambanan yang tertata.
Tempat ini cocok bagi pecinta sejarah Indonesia. Mungkin Anda dapat membayangkan bagaimana kehidupan masyarakat Hindu pada zaman dahulu.

Review Text: Este templo nos gustó más que Borobudur. Además el lugar en el que está situado es muy bonito y puedes caminar alrededor, con los árboles muy grandes y el césped, es muy agradable. Aconsejo visitar los otros templos que están en el mismo recinto. No hay muchos visitantes y me parecen muy interesantes. Solo el precio me parece desorbitado porque no es tan importante como otros templos en Asia, ni tan grande y sin embargo el precio para extranjeros es exagerado, no creo que lo visitará de nuevo por el precio tan elevado que tiene.

We visited this temple after a trip to the Borobudur so it was around noon, and be warned that it is really hot then. It is possible to buy an umbrella there, we didn't do it, but afterwards is might have been a godd idea. You can walk around the towers and the statues inside of them. It's no problem to do this without a guide or a tour, but we suggest you do hire a guide still. Why you ask? Cause you'll be amazed by the stories and details he or she explains. It is totally worth it. Mainly because the site has so much history and religion to it, that we can't even imagine. The temple has a great history with story of Ramayana engraved on the wall. It's a very beautiful place with a beautiful story. You can't got to Java without seeing the Prambanan Temples and you won't forget the trip for a long long time!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: 入り口でガイドを雇いました。たまたま日本語を話せる方で詳しく説明頂き助かりました。費用は、100Kルビーでした。効率的にもガイドさんを雇うのが良いです。

Ich werde diese "Sehenswürdigkeit" ganz sicher nicht mehr aufsuchen.
Nice staff. The guide spoke perfect french.Only thing is the huge differences of the fee when you 're a foreigner and a local (6 times more)

Wow, bangga ada tempat wisata seperti ini di Indonesia. Tempatnya luas tapi bersih dan banyak spot. Lebih bagus ini dibandingkan wisata religi di negara lain. Tempat ini menyenangkan dan edukatif, cocok juga untuk liburan keluarga.

Sebenarnya nggak ada rencana mau mampir Prambanan sih, walau hampir tiap bulan lewat. entah ada ide dari mana tiba-tiba tangan ini menuntun Stir mobil masuk ke area parkir candi. hehehe 
akhirnya masuk candi di temani dengan pemandu, di ceritakan lah legenda bandung bondowoso.. roro jongrang dan lain-lain. sebenarnya males denegrin karena hari dah mulai panas.. 
yang menarik adalah pas mau keluar dari candi itu kan melewati pasar.. harganya gaiss murah-murah banget. batik sarimbit di jual dengan harga 100 rb satu pasang. akhirnya kita borong dah beberapa pasang. lumayan lah buat stok kalau mau ke undangan.:-)

Review Text:
Kesini sma temen" sekolah... 
udaranya panas tapi tetep ajh adem..

bentuknya indah tapi sayang banyak candi yg kecil" pada hancur waktu kesana jga lagi perbaikan

From far away the temples look already impressive but when you enter the park you will get to see all the stones that were found and are waiting to be used to rebuild the other temples around the current ones. 
It is like one giant temple puzzle park with in the middle a lot of impressive temples with each there own statues inside. 

Having a nice guide that told us about the story of each god made the experience even better. 

This was more than a visit, it was a nice lesson in history and religion that I will keep in my mind.
タクシーを貸し切り観光しました。敷地は広いのですが、日陰が少なく熱中症対策が必要です。修復途中でしたが、建造物は、素晴らしかったです。

We got a car and driver for the day to go to this site and the Ratu Boko site which are so close together. This was a beautiful site well worth visiting, beautifully kept , so clean and gorgeous gardens, this made it much nicer to appreciate. When we arrived the staff at the ticket office decided to refuse to accept credit cards so lucky we had enough cash- come prepared. It was a credit to the locals who take care of the whole site- beautiful
Pertama kali dan aku bawa anak 2,4tahun jalan ke Yogya Prambanan sore2 enak adem dengan megah menyaksikan sesuatu yg menurut kU sangat incredible ciptaan nya

I did a sunset tour that was organized by my hotel.  

The driver dropped us off and we had 3 whole hours to roam the large complex.  For 100,000 IDR, we got a wonderful guide who took us around inside each of the temples and told us the colorful stories and history.  He even helped us take pictures.

That evening, I watched the Ramayana Ballet.  It was excellent!  It was located inside because it is still rainy season.  Beginning in May they move it outside with the temple as the back drop.

Wear comfortable shoes, as the complex is large and there are stairs to navigate.  Bring sunscreen!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Jalan-jalan di jogja sayang jika harus melewatkan Candi Prambanan, Candi yang terletak di Sleman ini sangat mudah di jangkau karena dekat jalan utama.
Di dalam komplek Candi kamu akan di suguhkan jejeran Candi yang menjulang tinggi dan megah.
Jika ingin mengetahui lebih detail tentang candi, tidak ada salahnya kita menyewa guide untuk menjelaskan sejarah tentang candi.
Setiap sudut komplek candi pun sangat fotogenic jadi silahkan berwisata sambil belajar sejarah.

Review Text: 从maliboro大街坐1A到终点站，再稍微走5到10分钟就可以到了，很像吴哥窟的寺庙的感觉，但是可惜因为去的时候天有点下雨，所以没有看到普兰巴南最好的一面。不过，相比而言，婆罗浮屠真的震撼很多。
Worth the visit. Rent an umbrella for Rph10,000 as you surely need it later. The ground is large to wear comfortable shoes and enjoy
Beautiful temples and nature view. It's very cozy and kept well. Better to use hat/umbrella at noon cause it's quite hot.

Amongst the largest and oldest Hindu temples of the world, this temple has the trinity of Brahma, Vishnu and Mahesh in one compound, I have not seen another such complex. Although the temples were severely damaged by a devastating earthquake, these are still in very good condition. The complex is very well managed, thanks to the management.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
9世紀に造られたヒンズー教寺院の遺跡郡。このような多くの石と彫刻が出来るには、大きな権力があったと想像され、興味深い。
遺跡の一部は、地震で崩れたままであったり、石が盗まれたりしているそうです。なおあ、修復された石には彫刻がありません。オリジナルと修復箇所が区別できるようにするためとのこと。

Templo muy interesante muy bien cuidado. A media hora de la ciudad . La entrada  conviene comprarla junto con la de boro udur 32 dólares . El guía local 100000 rupias. Puedes coger un vehículo con chofer por 10 horas por 35 dólares que te lleve a los 2 templos y te ahorras muchos dolores de cabeza.
Great view and surprisingly its very clean and well organized . Dont forget to bring umbrellas or sunnies its really hot!!!
It'll be good if you want to know more about religion. This temple can be easily reached by taking the local bus from Malioboro street or from the airport.

Setiap ke Jogja selalu tidak sempat mampir ke Prambanan, baru awal tahun 2016 sempat-sempatin ke Prambanan karena jadwal penerbangan malam.
Lokasi sudah pasti dekat bandara.

Never felt more discriminated in my 29 year old life. Local entrance fee was 30k, while tourist was 234k. I have before tried 2-3 times the local price. Thats fair enough... But paying a staggering 8x the amount choked me 😡 -- Luckily for me they accepted my 2 year old study card and I "only" paid 4x local prices. Furthermore the museum inside the complex was closed and temples closed 30 mins before scheuduled time at 1800... The big structure was decent. Not Ankor Wat but ok.
One of the main reasons for visiting Yogyakarta. Beautiful temple set in lovely lush green landscape. Would recommend a guide, plenty to be found at the gate.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Nothing much if you have been to Angkor wat like me .
We were there for a company sales meeting maybe a guide with info would have helped more
the major attractions that define Yogyakarta. Rich in historic, cultural, and religious heritage. A must-visit when in Jogjakarta.

It is such a magnificent Hindu temple where the place is well maintained. For those who love history & nature, never miss this place when you are in Jogja. A lot to see and learn especially if we have a good knowledgeable tour guide.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Pemandangan nya bagus, fasilitas toiletnya juga bersih. Cuma waktu ke sana pas lagi musim panas, dan matahari sangat terik sehingga jalan menuju candi menjadi berdebu. Tersedia kereta kelinci untuk menikmati candi sewu. Karena bila jalan kaki sangat jauh.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Went there in the noon. Not much crowded and quite peaceful.
Very beautiful and simply amazing structure. It might look like small structure from far but its really big and need time to explore each of the structure and the shrines.
Must do for history lover. Just within the compound, few minutes walk, You will see three more temples (Sewu, Lumbung and Bubrah)

Review Text: Templos muy bonitos. Visitar por la mañana para evitar lluvias de media tarde. El complejo tiene un tren gratuito para ver todo el recinto y los distintos templos. Hay guías locales en prácticas que te explican detalles curiosos sobre el lugar, la religión, la cultura y significado de los templos... muy recomendable además de darles una propina simbólica.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: El templo es impresionante, aunque la entrada para extranjeros es bastante cara (200.000idr por persona). Sin embargo, vale la pena visitarlo
Borobudur, Prambanan and Ratu Boko Temples are the major attractions that define Yogyakarta. Rich in historic, cultural, and religious heritage. A must-visit when in Jogja.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Lokasi gak terlalu jauh dari bandara,so jadi pilihan pertama kali saat menginjakan kaki di jogja.paling suka datang pagi hari

A fantastic park with a very impressive Monument. The only rather disturbing experience is their pricing policy.

Foreigners pay 240'000 (USD 18)
KITAS (Expats with work permit) holder and locals only 30'000 (USD 2.30)
The Prambanan is nonetheless a magnificent place with its rich historical value. However, I found the place has become too crowded and commercialized. Give it a go, though, it's a must-visit.

Being in this area this magnificent tempel is a must. 
 Price is a bit high, 30 $ but a combined ticket is available on request.

Tallest temple in Asia according to the brochure, bigger and more impressive than I expected. Go to the Sewa temple at the back of the complex - still under renovation but beautifully quiet and worth seeing
Beautiful place to spend time with family. I was here 10 years ago, now this place seems looking way better than before.
A must-see if in Yogyakarta. Could not say enough how glad I am to have seen this place, as someone who truly appreciates historical architecture.

One of the highest temple structure I've seen in South East Asia. Though parts were renovated due to damage caused by earthquake, the temples still look close to their original structure. There are no covered areas nearby and the weather can be extremely hot. Not a good idea if you're going to visit at noon.

We arrived at this temple during thunderstorm. Since we have bought the package (borobudur + prambanan), we waited for the rain to subside, but the rain only getting bigger. We decided to visit the temple under the rain before the temple close. Rainy day mean less crowd and our effort (under the rain and thunder) is definitely worth it. The temple is great!  Steep stairs that lead to the inner temple with no light, total darkness inside the temple. We spend around 40mins at the temple and the rain finally subsided but all of our shoes are soaked in water. but, YOLO!

Diese Tempelanlage schein etwas weitläufiger als der Borobudur Komplex und es gibt viele schöne Ecken zu Entdecken. Durch verschiedene Erdbeben wurde einiges zerstört, teilweise wird es wieder aufgebaut. Aber auch die "zerstörten Bereiche" haben ihren Charme.

Restoration of the Hindu temple was in progress during our visit.  Great stone architecture with different chambers for the Hindu gods.  The Prambanan compound also house Buddhist temples, where restoration work was also in progress.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
I came here in the middle of the day. I was not able to explore much of the temple because the weather was just too hot. 

For locals, you only pay 12k Rp for foreigners with no KITAS it's a lot more. You need to bring your own hat, a sunscreen and an umbrella. If you do forget to bring an umbrella, you can rent one for 5,000 Rupiah just outside the temple gates.

Indrukwekkend en imposant bouwwerk. En wat moet het nog veel imposanter worden als alle ruïnes weer zijn opgebouwd.
Erg leuk om het met een gids te bezoeken zodat je wat meer van de historie en de religie komt te weten.
It doesn't have the beautiful natural setting like Borobudur, but the temple it self is quite impressive. Would definitely recommend a visit if in the area

Mooie tempel, maar wij hadden  het er vlug gezien. De site is groot. Je kan er vanalles doen, maar de tempel zelf zijn ze terug aan het heropbouwen. Ik begrijp dat toeristen een andere prijs krijgen, maar de prijs is niet in verhouding. Voor 1 persoon 214000 IDR. 
Wij zijn met lijnbus 1A naar daar gegaan voor 3600 IDR enkel per persoon. De bus stopt in de buurt van de tempel. Je moet nog halve km stappen tot tempel. Vrij rustige buurt.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: candi hindhu yang sangat indah dan view yang menawan, apalagi menjelang sore hari dimana sinar matahari mulai temaram, kekurangan benahi pedagang di sekitar candi

ボロブドゥール観光の拠点としてジョグジャカルタに宿泊したので、近くにあるこの遺跡にも行ってみようと、行ってみました。
マリオボロ通りから１Aのトランスジョグジャ（バス）に揺られて終点まで。所要45分くらい。地図で見るとバスターミナルから遺跡は近いのですが、エントランスまでは回り込んで歩かないといけません。（ベチャの勧誘もあります、もちろん）
外国人の入園料はRP234000。クレジットカード可。
メインのロロ・ジョングラン寺院を観た後は、列車型のバスに乗って広い園内を回りながら、出口へ向かうのがおすすめ。外国人は無料で乗れるのですが、乗客は多くはなかったです。
雨季のため途中で豪雨に降られたりしたのですが、行ってよかったです。

Salah satu candi yang fenomenal selain candi borobudur yang berlokasi di Yogyakarta. Akibat Gempa Bantu beberapa tahun yang lalu mengakibatkan banyak reruntuthan batu yang menggunung di arrrea lokasi candi prambanan

One of my main reasons for visiting Yogyakarta was to visit the Temple sites. I organized a private tour with Deckyseventours. The temple sites are rather far out so you need transportation. It is a very well preserved UNESCO site and our guide was a wealth of information, helping us to understand the various motifs and stories. Definitely wear cool clothes as it was very hot, and a hat is a must with lots of water. I visited on the weekend and it was quite crowded.

Go in the morning as there is little shade around the temple grounds which is quite large. 

However you can finish walking around it in an hour. 

Entry is around 240,000pp. 

If you do go in the afternoon...have a hat or umbrella to keep the scorching sun off your face - you are definitely going to sweat.

A must-see. Buy your tickets to Prambanan and Borobudur together to get a discount. 
Wish there were fewer and more respectful tourists, but that is the same problem everywhere. Also, get a guide. It's worth it.
This is the biggest Hindu stone temple in Indonesia, the view and the feel is just fantastic, the time you are inside the complex, the feeling is amazing ...

We visited in the rain which was great as the crowds thinned.  Prambanan main complex is beautiful, we loved being able to enter the temples and see the statues to the gods. Make sure you have a torch and look up to spot the bats. Also look at the decoration on the inner walls. 
Don't stop just at Prambanan, we walked onto Sewu temple and because of the rain we were there alone - really beautiful. Great day!
Prambanan memiliki banyak candi, didukung dengan taman-taman dan gazebo, prambanan bisa direkomendasikan untuk acara gathering karyawan ataupun keluarga.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: 空港から、バイタクで遺跡まで。見学の間、荷物を預かってもらい、２時間後に市内のホテルまでおくってもらいました。中は広いので、レンタサイクルが便利です。

Lesser known than Borobudur but equally, if not more spectacular.  A must-visit site, besides Borobudur.  The Hindu temple complex is huge and spread out.  It is one of the most beautiful Hindu temple in the world.  All visitors will have to wear a sarong around the waist when entering this temple.  As restoration works are underway, certain sites require hard hats to be able to enter.  Enjoyed this visit very much.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The major buildings are still standing but majority of the surrounding  buildings are in ruins - but you can still grasp the magnificence of the place. I think they offer a Ramayana show in the evening with this temple as the backdrop.

Fee is 234k per pax with guide @100k. Journey is about 50mins from yog central. Few temples are still being restored & still many "lego" ruins. 

Prambanan & the other temples are within an enclosed fenced up boundary, surrounded with shop houses. A shuttle train runs around the site.

View is magnificent & history is rich, especially after we had watched the Ramayana ballet the night before & we appreciated the bas relief & understand their history after guide explained.

I prefer here (214 temples with many still in ruins) than Borobudur (one temple). Be prepare to be crowded & interviewed by kids.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Make sure to get a guide and enough time. Beware of the many stairs you have to climb. Less crowded then the borbordur temple.
Though the entry price is expensive for Indonesia it certainly worth it. We were fortunate to have 2 high school students as guides. Their English was good and they were informative.

Hele mooi tempel en indrukwekkend. Het is gelegen op een heel ruim complex, dus bereid je voor om veel lopen. Ik ben op een door de weekse dag gegaan. Er waren veel scholen met kinderen en groepen die kwamen bezichtigen, naast de toeristen. Maar ik heb er geen (over) last van gehad. Met veel momenten liep ik ook alleen door het park.
It was my first time here. It's amazing. Unfortunately, it's cloudy and started to rain. The location is a bit far from the city but you can reach this place using Trans Jogja.

tempat yang luar biasa, prambanan salah satu tempat wisata yang saya kunjungi dengan pengelolaan yang sangat rapih, dari pertama masuk area parkir dilayani dengan baik karena ada petugas parkirnya, kita bisa datang ke kawasan pasar oelh-oleh dengan kios-kios yang tertata rapih dan bersih, penjualnya lumayan ramah-ramah, apalagi nyoba pecel sayur disana yang harga relatif terjangkau, banyak batik2 yang murah2,

lokasi candinya juga sangat bersih dan tertata baik, walaupun suhu udara disana panas tapi gak menyurutkan antusias kita untuk keliling-keliling di prambanan.. seruuu
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: A Hindu temple which is grand & majestic looking. It is a Unesco site. Entrance fee is Rp 234,000. If you visit together with Borobudur, it cost Rp 400,000. The entrance fees cover 3 other temples & the other temple worth visiting is Sewu temple. A guide costs another Rp 100,000 which you can share with 4 pax. The temple was found by a staff of Stamford Raffles. There were ruins round the site and a museum nearby. It can get very hot in the afternoon so bring an umbrella & water. If you are visiting Sewu temple, it is 15 minutes walk or you can take a tram which is in frequent or rent a bicycle.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Sangat2 indah & tidak pernah membosankan pokoe..apalagi kalo bias menyaksikan atraksi sendratari Prambanan Night nya..
Amazing to see such a quality of sculptures so far away from India. Shiva, Vishnu, brahma. They're all here. Carving of the Ramayana. Top class
Setelah beberapa kali ke Jogja, baru kali ini berkesempatan mengunjungi situs Candi tersebut, kesannya bagus dan cukup terawat .

Everything was good when we were in Prambanan. The problem was only the heat,,, it was soooooo hot there. But we love it. Oohh,,, the only thing that bothers me a lot, my partner is a foreigner. And he wanted to see my country with different cultures,,, which is good, right ?!?!?!,,,, but he had to pay for Rp. 230.000 while I only had to pay for Rp. 30.000. And the compliment that he had only a cup of coffee. To be honest, I don't mind, we don't mind if the managements give different price to foreigners. But please do give a reasonable price and compliments. Even for a tour guide he had to pay more.
beberapa candi tidak terlalu terawat, namun 5 candi utama sangat indah dari kejauhan karena. disitu juga cukup dekat dengan candi sewu.
It's a beautiful temple over all and it does give you an other worldly experience. But since it's hot outside during the day, early or late visit is advised.

敷地の大きいが、見るべき建物は固まっているので比較的見やすい。一見の価値ありです。土産物を売るアンちゃんが笛を売りに来たが「500円500円」とよってきたが、無視してたらすぐに「300円」にさがった。結局150円（15000ルピア）で購入。土産物の菓子も33000ルピアで言ってきたが、現地人には20000ルピアで売っているらしい。結局、現地人通訳が交渉して15000ルピアで購入。東南アジアはどこもそんなもんです。

Great Temple in Yogyakarta.One hour from the cetral of Yogyakarta .
Nice place to experience. To explore your time,your knowledge .It's Amazing Temple .
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: We visited the Prambanan Temples in the afternoon.  Had such a nice time going in/out of the various temples.  Not overly crowded.  Would recommend going in the morning when it isn't as hot/sunny.  Much more costly for foreigners. If you are living/working in Indonesia, bring your ID to get the discounted rate.

If you happen to be at Yogyakarta, then Prambanan temple is also a must visit place apart from Borobudur.

The architecture is different than borobudur.. Be sure to also watch the ramayana dance starts at 7PM
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: When on Java, you must make a trip to Central Java to see Prambanan.  As it draws both local and foreign tourists, it can be busy and very crowded.  Many schools bring hundreds of students on "study tours" so if you are a foreign tourist, be prepared for photo and interview requests.  That being said, it is worth the heat and crowds of people.  Prambanan is breathtaking and full of a fascinating history.  Highly recommended.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Biaya masuk tidak terlalu mahal.. tempatnya bersih.. pemeliharaannya bagus.. terbukti dengan masih terlihat dengan keasliannya..
O templo é muito legal, tem estilo mais rústico, e as ruínas estão bem preservadas. Vale a pena contratar um guia para contar a história. Porém Borobodur é mais bonito e merece mais tempo.
A very beautiful historical hindu temples in the world...but it's just so many people...and making so much noise everywhere in the temple. Serenity no more. Haha...

I always love visit Prambanan Temple with my family, my friends and sometimes with  my foreigner collegue. 

It is not only presents Hindu-Indonesia's heritage temple but also offers traditional dance performance, called as ramayana Ballet.If the show performs in the night, the athmosphere of java culture will be felt especially in the opened air theater. The fascinating blue LED for the  stage lighting  is so amazing and romantic
坐飞机从巴厘岛来到日惹，下车就做1A，记不得多少钱了，直接到终点站普兰巴兰。下车后过马路，顺着路一直走，大概1000米左转就到售票处。国内和国外游客不在一个地方买票检票，需要绕道左边单独买票进入，我买了普兰巴兰和婆罗浮屠的联票，390RP，两天有效

Very good site to visit but pictures look better from outside the entrance, once inside, pictures dont do it justice as you are too close to grasp the scale of the wonder. 
Seemed to be busy with school children, if you are western then be prepared to do a few interviews with these children as they are practising their english. All are very friendly though. 
The entry fee is quite expensive by Indonesian standards, about 250,000 idr per person.
Die Prambanantempelanlage ist sehr weitläufig und beeindruckend. Will man den größeren Menschenmassen entgehen kann man zu den kleineren aber auch sehr schönen Tempeln auf der Anlage ausweichen.

Prambanan Temples were the best part of my trip. The government did a great job with restoration and it is absolutely beautiful. Foreigners have a different ticket price from the public and receive "VIP treatment" (basically being served coffee). Visiting the temple is an outdoor activity and I highly recommend hiring a tour guide or doing a lot of research or else the trip to the temples is only for pictures. Overall, great place to visit with the family and I highly reccomend it.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Prambanam ist ein schöner hinduistischer  Tempel ungefähr eine Autostunde vom Zentrum von Yogyakarta entfernt. Der Eintritt ist mit über 200.000 Rupien für Ausländer relativ teuer. Die Architektur erinnert an Angkor. Wenn man Yogyakarta ist sollte man den Tempel besichtigen.

Its a really special place. It is the biggest temple complex on Java. Manny temples but stil alot are damaged by the earthquike in 2006. Sun set is beautifull here. Bring your student card. Saves you alot. We had bad luck with the weather.

The stunning architecture of these temples built centuries ago is even more amazing when seen up close. The structures consists of thousands of interlocking volcanic stones, intricately carved with pictures of Hinduism. The visit was made more interesting by our English speaking guide who gave us captivating stories and explanations of the historical significance of each temple.
A must see if visiting Yogyakarta. If you are not familiar with the Ramayana or Mahabarata then definitely get a guide to explain the reliefs for you.

This place has a great story. 

This is a #mustvisitplace when #visiting #indonesia

cause it will be very hot (even for Indonesian people), please bring: enough money to enter the temple area, umbrella/hat, camera.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Beberapa kali saya kalau ke jogja melewati lokasi ini. Pada akhirnya bersama istri saya menyempatkan untuk mengunjungi area ini. Dan sangat layak untuk disinggahi. Selain dapat menambah pengetahuan. Di area ini kita juga bagus untuk melakukan foto.

Seru banget kemari pas 1 hari sblm hari raya nyepi...  Gak nyangka bisa liat momen2 umat hindu sembahyang..disana..  Ini situs budaya yg bagus.. Sayang sekali beberapa candi sudah hancur...  Kalau masih lengkap mungkin komplek candi prambanan akan lebih bagus lagi.  Harga tiket masuk relatif murah...  Wajib kesini jika liburan ke jogja.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Prambanan was one of the key reasons I went to Jogja for my trip. However, the state of affairs at the temples was pretty disappointing. The vandalism and theft which has happened at the place is truly disappointing. Also the pace of restoration is pretty slow and the ruins lying around tell the story. Having said that to see the temples itself was pretty humbling considering that they are a 9th century creation and most of the idols are from those times. It was a bit of eerie too and did give me a few goosebumps owing to the lack of any natural light inside the individual temples. If you are in Jogja then definitely worth a visit.

Luogo incantevole se visitato al mattino presto (quando ci sono meno visitatori), circondato da un grande parco. All'entrata a disposizione curatori per visite guidate personali (dietro pagamento).
Conviene acquistare il biglietto combinato per le visite ai due templi di Borobudur e Prambanan, risparmiando circa 20 $ sul totale dei biglietti: costo del biglietto combinato 780'000.- Rupie indonesiane. Con questo biglietto però non è possibile entrare nei templi per vedere l'alba, ma soltanto a partire dalle 6 del mattino.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
From Jogjakarta we rode a cab from our hotel at Malioboro street to Prambanan Temple and it drove us for about 30 minutes. We arrived at the Prambanan complex and continue on foot for a 15 minutes walk to the temple. 

The temple was included in the World Heritage Site which is protected by UNESCO, was granted UNESCO status in 1991. Now, some of the temples of Prambanan are being renovated to repair damage from the 2006 Yogyakarta earthquake. The earthquake has damaged several buildings and statues.
There are ongoing renovation efforts still being carried out even today. After the massive restoration at Prambanan now its back into the center of Hindu worship in Java. The revival of religious values Prambanan is because there are quite a lot of Hindu society, both migrants from Java, Bali or residents who returned to the area adopt Hindu as their religion. 

Each year Hindus of the province of Central Java and Yogyakarta Prambanan temple gathered to hold the ceremony on the holy day of Galungan and Nyepi.

This Prambanan complex is a MUST to visit!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Besides the Borubudur and candi Ratu Boko, this temple is a sight to behold. The structures alone are mind boggling that these Hindu temples were constructed by a civilization in the 8th century. Enlightening were the stories carved intricately on the walls of these temples that a visit to this historical site is a must for all visitors to Yogyakarta !

Located approx. 40 km from Jogjakarta, this temple is one of the most visited tourist attractions in Java Central. That is the largest temple compound dedicated to Shiva in Indonesia and the most beautiful Hindu temple with great architecture. In the main yard, there are three main temples. The biggest one is dedicated to Shiva and the two smaller ones which sit on its right and left are dedicated to Brahma and Visnu. It's a pity that some parts of the temple was destroyed by an earthquake a few years ago. Better visit the temple in the morning or late afternoon to avoid the heat. I assisted in a very impressive show at night at this place: the Ramayana ballet. Strongly recommended.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Ini candi yang sangat cantik. Jika anda kesini usahakan bukan di saat musim hujan. Di dalam candi terdapat patung-patung besar salah satunya adalah patung dewa Wisnu, yang hanya bisa dipotret dengan kamera flash khusus, tidak bisa dengan kamera hp biasa. Jika anda kesini usahakan sebelum jam 1 siang di saat langit masih cerah. Banyak spot cantik yang bisa dijadikan obyek foto disini
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Love this place..Great architecture though some of them were destroyed by the quake..Restoration are still ongoing and definitely a place for visitors to capture their moments when in Jogjakarta..

Beautiful temples in a beautiful location. We got a guide to show us around and there were mixed feelings about how good he was. For me he talked much about the Hindu gods and not enough about how and why the temples were built. He also started the tour by talking us through an information board that was already in English so I felt a bit cheated.
We arrived at 4.00 in the afternoon so the site was quietening down which was nice. Unfortunately it also rained which stopped us from getting our sunset pictures but gave it a different view if you caught the light in the right way. 
If I was going again I'd avoid the expensive tour company transport and opt for a local taxi and skip the guide so that you can take the site at your own speed. Read up on it before you go though so that you have a little bit of back ground.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Candi prambanan adalah candi terluas yang berada di daerah klaten. Candi prambanan memiliki banyak sekali candi yang indah, untuk mengelilingi candi anda tidak perlu khawatir disini juga menyediakan bus kereta yang siap menghantar anda keliling candi prambanan tanpa harus berjalan jauh. Disini juga sentra belanja "murah meriah" untuk oleh2 khas jogja.
Very beautiful temple, even though an earthquake destroyed it partly. The design of the temple is more beautiful than the famous Borobudur temple. Pretty park around the temple as well.

Senengnya pas datang kemarin, bertepatan 1 hari sebelum perayaan hari Nyepi, banyak umat Hindu yang melakukan ritual (sembahyang) di Candi Prambanan ini, Seneng banget melihat kebudayaan Indonesia yang begitu beragam.
A good place to admire the stunning and awesome arcitechture of ancient Hindu temples home to the largest Hindu temple in South East Asia.
The temple built in 9 century, an amazing architectural heritage of Hindu culture. Made me realize how great is the Indonesian ancestor way of life and appreciate it.

Prambanan suatu tempat yang mesti dikunjungin, cantik sekali banhunannya.

 Будьте готовы, что местные будут просить сфотографироваться с вами, а дети школьного возраста (12-14 лет) - подписать им сертификаты на знания английского- это может немного подпортить впечатление от общения с вечностью. Review Text:
Templi visitati in marzo col brutto tempo, il che mi ha fatto optare per una visita indipendente, senza sveglie all'alba, gruppi o ritmi altrui. 
Dalla fermata di Jln Malioboro davanti all'ufficio turistico, ho preso il bus 1A. Il biglietto si compra alla fermata e costa 3600 rupie, cioè €0.26. Ci vogliono 50 minuti per raggiungere il capolinea, da dove in 7/8 minuti si arriva alla biglietteria, dove sono gratuitamente a disposizione acqua, tè e caffè in un salottino per me provvidenziale visto l'improvviso scroscio di pioggia.  
Ingresso singolo 234000 rupie (€16.50), combinato con Borobudur per il giorno seguente 380000 (€27), quindi si risparmia un 20% scarso. 
Il sito è sicuramente bello e suggestivo. Il complesso iniziale è quello coi templi più numerosi e più alti, ma è anche il più affollato. L'ultimo (candi Sewa), non lo raggiunge nessuno perché è in fondo ma invece merita e si riesce a fare foto senza gente in giro. Tra i due ce n'è uno semidistrutto con le impalcature. 
C'è da dire che tutto il sito ha drasticamente sofferto il terremoto del  2006 e ci sono pile di pietre ovunque. 
Invece che seguire i cartelli di uscita che rimandano all'ingresso, sono uscito dal lato opposto, vicino al candi Sewa (dove c'è anche un micromuseo con didascalie solo in indonesiano!), così dopo una passeggiata di un quarto d'ora tra le risaie ho raggiunto il sito di Plaosan (recensione a parte).
Considerazioni finali: 
- se avete già visitato Ayutthaya, Angkor Wat o l'India, probabilmente non vi stupirà. Rimane comunque un posto suggestivo, soprattutto immaginandolo nella sua interezza originaria. 
- se avete poco tempo e volete fare in un giorno Prambanan e Borobudur, troverete in città mille agenzie che vi proporranno tour di 10 ore a 100/150000 rupie.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:

Review Text: Candi Prambanan, letak nya di Klaten Jawa Tengah . Perbatasan antara Jawa Tengah dengan Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta. Arah selatan ke Yogyakarta dan Utara ke Kota Solo (Surakarta) . Pertama kali saya berwisata sejarah di Candi Prambanan ini , dengan biaya tiket masuk 30.000 utk dewasa dan anak 12.000 . Kita bisa masuk di Kawasan Candi Prambanan ini . Yakni Candi ini peninggalan Hindu . Letaknya sangat strategis pinggir jalan Solo - Jogja jadi midah jika kita ingin menuju tempat ini . Kawasan Candi Prambanan ini sangat lah luas , capek juga saat saya berjalan kaki , dan panas sekali saat siang hari . Ditambah tidak ada pedagang minuman/makanan setelah loket masuk . Saran terbaik jika ingin datang ke lokasi ini , gunakanlah sandal atau flat shoes agar nyaman , jangan lupa membawa payung dan minuman . Setelah kita masuk menggunakan tiket , kita bebas berjalan jalan sekitar candi , berfoto2 di candi , dan banyak sekali turis asing . Masyallah view Candi Prambanan ini sangat lah indah , peninggalan sejarah yang sangat menawan . Banyak juga yang menawarkan foto langsung jadi disini , hargany sekitar 10rb - 50rb silahkan bisa saling tawar disini . Overall tempat ini sangat bagus untuk wisata sejarah , spot foto , dan jalan jalan . Saat kita sudah keluar dr arena candi , arah pintu keluar kita akan banyak menemui pedagang pakaian , pernak pernik candi . Disini kita bisa saling tawar menawar . Oya wisata di Candi Prambanan ini buka jam 07.00 s.d 17.30 dan kadang ada jadwal sendratari ramayana namun tidak setiap jam ada .

Review Text: It was a sight to behold! Easily reachable by Jogja bus. Had a great time visiting all the surrounding temple ruins and also the Ratu Boko temple. Overall, had a great day. 💗

It takes around 45 minutes riding from the city center and the location was pretty easy to find. You can rent a motorbike (less then $6/ day) and find it by yourself or using GPS will be very useful to track the location. The entrance fee is 2-3 dollar ( you can pay either in Rupiah or Dollar) and you can see around 4 temples including the Prambanan, Sewu, Lambing, etc. To see all those temples, we choose to rent a bike for only less than 1 dollar and in 30 to 60 minutes you can finish all temples. 

We plan to take a sunset or sunrise package on this temple but as it was raining season, so it would not possible for us to make it. It is recommended if visitor want to take a sunset or sunrise, probably better find the hotel or motel which located just next to the temple, we found out the price quite cheap around IDR 100,000 ($8 dollar/ night) with air condition. Not far from Prambanan temple, you can find many local foods and Plaosan temple which is also interested to see.
Not very far from Yogyakarta, you can ride a bus from Jalan Malioboro or airport. This majestic temple is one of the must go spot in Java even if you have been to Angkor Wat.

I've visited Prambanan Temple (Candi Prambanan) several times and this ancient building never cease to amaze me. March 2016 was the first time I took my 6 years daughter and she truly enjoyed her visit. It's a Hindu temple dedicated for the Trimurti but it's history was mixed was local folklore Roro Jonggrang. The temples are simply stunning, it's a must when you visit Yogyakarta. The garden around the temple are well maintained which add the beauty of the temples.

Several tips when you visit Prambanan Temple :
1. The stairs are steep, you must be very careful mostly when you are with elderly or younger children. Wear comfortable footwear.
2. It's better to visit the temple when it's cloudy or sunny. When it's raining, the stairs are very slippery. Also it's hard to climb the stairs while holding umbrella since the hallway was narrow.
3. Wear hat to avoid sunburn during hot day.
4. Bring flashlight if you wish to see the statues inside the temples.
5. Notice that Shiva temple, the tallest temple in the complex, has three chambers for Ganesh, Durga, and Agastya statues.
6. Bring some water and prepare your stamina.
7. Be a respectful visitor, the temple is considered sacred for some people.
8. It'd be more interesting to learn Prambanan history prior to visiting. If you are too lazy to read, you can hire a guide. But if you only wish to look around and take some magnificent photos, Prambanan Temple is still a perfect choice.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

names of the hindu gods were written in white on a stone. Overall the temple was good (not excellent) to go. Prices different for local n tourist. Local paid around usd3 while tourist need to pay around usd20. If you find usd20 was a little too exp for temple, you can choose to skip this temple.
