Review Text:
We reached this great temple in the afternoon.  It was pouring - very heavy rain indeed.  Our guide, named Supy, bravely took out umbrellas from the car and suggested to us to leave our footwear in the car itself.  Clutching the umbrella in one hand, we plunged barefoot into the rain, at times getting ankle-deep in the water.

We were led to the Reception area.  Very impressive arrangements.  While Supy bought the tickets, we were given sarongs to wear and tea/coffee to drink.  The available toilets were very neat and clean.  After using all the facilities, we once again came out into the incessant rain.  Since the rain was not cold, it was great fun wading ankle-deep in the clean rain water and sloshing along listening to the erudite explanations from Supy.

This Hindu temple is just wonderful.  Dating back to the 9th century, legend has it that the temple got completely buried in ash due to a huge volcanic eruption of Mount Morapi in the 10th century, and was resurrected only in the 18th century.  The temple walls have an excellent depiction by way of sculptures of scenes from the great epic, Ramayana.  Just superb.  

You will love it.  The temple visit would need about 90 minutes.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

However, it becomes a ritual to visit this place if you are in Jogja. I visited this place under heavy pouring rain. The umbrella rental goes up from IDR5000 to IDR10,000. Anywhere, one has to prepare to spend money when one travels or else you can just watch youtube at home. No hard feeling.
Just a great place to visit. The full area is well maintain and green. We first visited 20 years ago, quiet a big change. Really a MUST DO in Jogja.
The temples are beautiful. However it is quite pricey and the exit is ridiculous! You have to walk the whole way around through all the local stalls just to get back to the car park.

It is our second temple in that day, when we were there the temple was kind of packed with school kids, too crowded I have to say. But walked a bit around and there are other temples that more quiet and nice. The walking out was a challenge, have to pass many lines of shops.

Review Text: Ini adalah kunjungan kedua saya di Candi Prambanan. Entah kenapa tempat ini sepertinya mempunyai daya tarik tersendiri bagi wisatawan untuk datang kembali. Harga tiket masuknya hanya 20rb. Tetapi, jika anda bersama rombongan, anda bisa mendapatkan diskom dengan syarat ketentuan yang berlaku. Menurut sejarah, candi ini di buat hanya dalam waktu satu malam oleh Bandung Bondowoso atas permintaan Roro Jonggrang. Namun ketika pembuatan candi ini hampir selesai, Roro Jonggrang menggagalkan keberhasilan Bondowoso untuk menyelesaikan candi dengan 1000 arca ini dengan satu malam saja. Mengapa? Karena dia tidak mencintai Bondowoso. Ia mencari cara agar Bondowoso gagal. Akhirnya, ia membuat api besar seolah-olah suasana seperti pagi hari dan membuat ayam-ayam berkokok nyaring. Bondowoso yang mengetahui hal ini pun marah besar dan mengutuk Roro Jonggrang sebagai arca ke-1000. Entah ini benar atau hanya mitos saja, yang pasti saya pribadi sangat berterimakasih pada pembuat candi prambanan ini. karenanya, Indonesia mempunya tempat bersejarah yang memiliki julukan 'candi hindu tercantik di dunia' ayooo readers, segera kunjungi tempat wisata bersejarah ini. Tentunya anda jangan sampai kalah  dengan wisatawan asing yang sudah pernah kesini:D
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Sadly, an earthquake did some damage a few years back, but most of the destruction has been painstakingly repaired. Bring your sneakers and your camera for this cool place, because if you're going to be in the neighborhood, you will regret missing it!

While the visit there is highly recommended, I would also like to suggest the tour guide we had - Surantini. She is a very fun, friendly and super knowledgeable person who taught us a lot about both the temples as well as the history of the country. If anyone is interested, hes email address is: tini.yudanti@gmail.com

This temple, about 45 minutes from the Grove Express Timoho Hotel, is truly worth the visit.The temple is dedicated to Shiva with two temples on either side, one to Brahma and the other to Vishnu. Facing each temple are the Vehicle Temples of the gods, the Swan for Brahma, Nandi the bull for Shiva and the Garuda for Vishnu. Do visit the side altar in the Vishnu Temple dedicated to the beautiful consort of Shiva, Durga. Observe her face and you will see that the goddess is looking at you. In the Vishnu temple do contemplate sculptures from the Karma Sutra. Everything in this complex has a meaning and a message.
Maria and I took the package tour proposed by the Grove Express Timoho Hotel. It cost us only 140.0000 Rupia. Speak to Echo or Andy at the Grove Express Timoho Hotel about this tour.

Review Text: 普兰班南寺（Prambanan Temple）：建于公元9世纪，大约与吴哥窟属同一时代。同婆罗浮屠一样，整个遗址建筑群也被列入“世界遗产”名录，是东南亚最大的佛教寺庙，有三个主寺，专门供奉印度教三大主神湿婆神（Shiva）、毗湿奴神（Vishnu）、梵天神（Brahma），同时在每个主神寺庙前还建有三个稍小的寺庙，是专门为主神服务的“坐骑”。历史上在三大主神寺庙周边曾有224座圣所。在建筑群内是Sewu寺，由一个主寺和250个小寺组成。2006年5月27日发生的里氏5.9级地震对建筑群造成严重损毁。现在在中心区主要有6个寺庙（见照片1），中心寺庙高47米。寺庙周围浮雕主要取材于印度史诗《罗摩衍那》（Ramayana和Krisnayana）。以上译自现场英文介绍牌。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
You need quite some time to visit this site, even though it's still under renovation from the 2006 earthquake. We were lucky enough to go when it was quiet and able to spend time looking around with a friendly guide we met on site. Take a torch as the deities inside the stacks are in the pitch dark and impossible to see without light.
It's more expensive than other sites in Yogyakarta (approx $S24) but well worth it to contribute to the rebuilding.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Amazing..just amazing. So lovingly restored its a credit to all those involved. The guide we had was an older man who knew his subject thoroughly and with an obvious love and connection with the site. Loved it.

Review Text: I think, Prambanan Temples is the most majestic temple in the world, no doubt about it. The temple itself is dedicated to the three great Hindu divinities Shiva, Vishnu and Brahma. Not to far from the entrance we could see the the whole complex of Prambanan, and you can take a photo the whole and front side of Prambanan Temples. As soon as you reach the temple complex, you could feel the incredible feeling just by looking at the tall structure and amazed by the carving and architecture. There are some other temple that you could visit around the area, they provide train transportation for visitor that who wants to visit the other temples. Review Text:
Definitely should get the guide. They really do know their stuff and add a lot to the trip.

As you go around there are panels which by yourself would just be a carving, with the guide they are brought to life as the stories of Hinduism. You also get to learn the history of the place in much more detail than Wikipedia or the on-site-signs.

Did feel that it was quite expensive for entry until I a) saw the beauty of the temples and b) saw the scale of work that has been and continues to be done to restore and protect this monument

These sets of temples pretty much pale in comparison to the Borobudur temple. 

Not worth visiting unless you need time to kill in Jogjakarta.

Mammoth gopuras make these a true spectacle. We hired a guide to give us history about the place and though his descriptions were a bit graphic the stories were good. The temples have been hit by earthquakes multiple times and its a commendable effort by the Indonesia tourism to have these temples in a good state despite this.
Truly stunning Hindu temples set in pleasant garden grounds that were enjoyable for a stroll to see the smaller temples.  Recommend to go early to beat the crowds and heat.
Prambanan temple have the good view and give the beautifull. We are so very happy and so execise and give us the new experience.

Pro tip: Skip the tour guide and pay a local to take you. I found a student who took me and acted as my tour guide and it was far better than any tour guide and we are still friends today. The sites all have clear signage with the history of each temple. And the locals gave me a much better idea of the level of destruction from the earthquake that caused damage to the site. If you want to see the sunrise over the site, just head over extremely early.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Lovely , places, perfect for one day visit to Prambanan Temples.  Its near to Jogja Airport, Temple premises is excellent, I am Indonesian work  permit holder , so i paid Rp 30000 ( 2.23 USD ) , but for foreign tourist its little high  Appt.  Rp 224,000 (16.67 USD ) , but surely must visit place in Yogyakarta ( Jogja) .

Но предварительно почитайте литературу. Где какой храм, какому божеству посвящен и т.д., тогда получите невероятное удовольствие! Но парк тенистый, гулять - одно удовольствие. Можно купить пучок травы за три копейки и покормить оленей). Можно поесть, кафешек много, цены, конечно, дороже, чем в городе, но все равно приемлемые. Посетить обязательно!)

Review Text:

Near klaten and airport adisucipto, this temple bigger than ulundanu bali,  must visit here, top attraction in near jogjakarta, 1.5 hour to malioboro street

Review Text:

Overall, awesome UNESCO world heritage site. Cool to see Buddhist and Hindu sites so close together.

Review Text: I had great time with my friend and teacher. I recommend you to study about this temple and Hinduism before you visit! (Actually we didn't study a lot, and had little problem of understanding)

Prambanan is the highest temple in Indonesia. It's the closest temple from the city of Jogja that you can reach with scooter or take the public transport. The main temple is prambanan which is absolutely stunning. In the temple area though, they have other two temples so once you enter the temple area you can explore another temple not just the Prambanan which is the main attraction. It can be very hot during the day, I got sunburned for not applying enough sunblock. 

For foreigners, be aware that the local visitors come from many parts of Java that they had never seen foreign people* in the flesh before so they would ask for photographs and interviews. Weird? Yes but if you don't like it you can always say no and just walk away. There are loads of school boys and girls who are doing their school trip. Reason why they will ask you questions and stuff like you would not be experiencing in your home country is that, they would like to try to speak in English with foreigners as the way to build up their confidence in speaking English. 

There will also be a market at the exit where you can buy cheap and nice souvenirs and traditional foods. Always bargain for the price of souvenirs! As for the entrance fee, if you're local it's 30k but if you are not, it's about 255k. Show them your student ID or the one that looks like a student ID then you can get a 50% discount. 

*(includes, White, African, Chinese looking, Basically if you do not have the same skin colour as they are. They'll look at you differently as if you're celebrity)
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
There are so many reviews about this place that I decided to write something people need to know before going there instead of celebrating the beauty of it. 

1) CAN USE PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION
It's much cheaper if you are alone or a couple. A bus ticket from Yogyakarta is Rp 3.500 (30 cent USD) per person. You need to change couple of connection (eventually) but it's easy and kind of fun to experience local transportation. FYI  the bus to Prambanan is 1A, but you can ask your hotel.

2) DO NOT BOOK A TOUR
If you do not want to go by bus. The alternative is a taxi or a driver. From Yogyakarta the temple is just 20 mins drive. Taxi will charge you around Rp 80.000 (6 USD). No need to ask your taxi to wait for you. You can deal with other drivers up on exit. Remember the price you should pay. If you mention that there is a bus station just behind they will realise that you can't be cheated easily and the price will drop.

3) FAMILY FRIENDLY
If you are afraid temple are not suitable for kids, you are wrong. We went there with a 2 years old baby and a 3 weeks old infant. The temple is accessible with a stroller (of course needs to be lifted from time to time) and once you are there there are threes and benches where you can rest. Plus the park behind have a large playground. 

4) ENTRANCE FEE
If you are a foreigner who work in Indonesia DO NOT FORGET the Kitas. A tourist entrance ticket is Rp 245.000 (18 USD), a Local people ticket is Rp 30.000 (2 UDS).

5) FOOD
The restaurant inside the park is not too expensive, but the quality is bad. So I suggest to bring your own snacks.

Review Text:
Prambanan temple is grand and it is different in style compared to Borobudur. 
I don't think it is a good idea to visit this monument when it is raining as  water puddles forms in the main temple ground and makes it rather messy. If you do go, perhaps it would be a good idea to wear shoes instead of sandals or slippers as very fine sand gets in between your toes. You can also climb up to go into the three temples, but be careful as the steps are steep and can get slippery in the rain. There are no railings to hold on to.  
There is a museum in the temple complex. After seeing how badly this temple was destroyed and the amount of effort it took to restore it, it left me in awe and wonder. 
Maybe it was because it was raining and it was 4.15 pm that there weren't many tourist around,that was a good thing. 
Allow yourself at least two hours to visit this temple and its surroundings.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Visit there was most memorable in my life. This temple is full of historical. Some of the statue is damage. When you are there, make sure that you keep save this magnificent cultural of heritage
candi in sangatlah indah, selain itu banyak nilai sejarah yang bisa kita dapatkan jika berkunjung ke candi ini, lokasinya un mudah di jangkau.

Wij gingen naar Jogja voor de tempels. Wij vonden de prambanan echt helemaal niks. Je betaalt 30 dollar voor een combi kaart. Wat al redelijk veel is. De tempel zelf is prachtig maar het toeriste disney achtige sfeertje wat er hangt is echt dood en dood zonde van de pracht van de tempel.

I visited Prambanan temple along with my Friends in Feb 2016, the temple itself is very unique and treat to your eyes and it is an UNESCO world heritage site.

The temple is dedicated to the Trimurthi - The Shiva, The Vishnu and The Brahma. The temple is very old and the main idols are damaged (guide said due to earth quake but to me the damage seemed to be deliberate ) . It was fascinating how Hindu Epics like Ramayana , Mahabaratha occupied an unique place in Yogyakarta , Indonesia. The entire temple area is connected well with Lights and I think it would be awesome to view the temple at Night in the lights( we missed it).

I suggest to visit the temple inorder to rediscover the lost Hindu civilization in Central Java , indonesia.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: You're probably in Yogyakarta to visit Borobudur but Prambanan Temple should be added to your list of sites.  Your best bet would be to get a tour that will take you to both locations and probably a couple other good sites,  You can get a personal tour for a decent price.

A must visit temple if you visit Jogjakarta. Very relaxing because not so crowd of tourists as compared to Borobudur Temple. Inside the complex there are alos Sewu Temple & 2 small temples.

The complex is huge and recommended to bring umbrella / raincoat. Souvenir shop at Prambanan Temple is much cheaper as compared to Malioboro Street!!!

Candi prambanan merupakan kumpulan beberapa lokasi candi. Candi utama merupakan candi termegah umat hindu lengkap dgn candi pengapit dan candi tunggangan 3dewa utama hindu. Disisi lain terdapat candi sewu dan candi lumbung. Wisatawan disediakan kereta untuk berkeliling dgn harga terjangkau. Ajak keluarga tercinta belajar sambil menikmati kehangatan bersama keluarga
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: The attractions not so crowded with tourists, actually it's a good place for me to exchange ideas with my Indonesia friends at there. The weather is windy, so no need to worries about putting sunblock. After visiting, there is many shops that you need to pass through before exits come.

We used the services of a guide at Prambanan and this added to the enjoyment of our visit. We were given information about the history and construction of the temple and our guide also gave us a brief explanation of the Ramayana story as depicted in the stone carvings. This explanation was complete with actions and enjoyed very much by us. Rp 100,000 well spent.

Anch'esso me lo ero perso nel lontano 1989; sono tornato per chiudere i conti ... e non mi ha deluso !!! Veramente imponente. Situato a circa 17 km dalla citta', nel 1991, unitamente a Borobudur, venne inserito nella lista dei siti Patrimoni dell'Umanita' tutelati dall'Unesco. Nonostante il terremoto del 2006 ne abbia danneggiato una buona parte, attualmente il suo restauro procede anche se con ritmi.... indonesiani. Non e' un tempio buddista, ma dedicato a Shiva. Eretto nella meta' del 9 secolo, poco dopo il tempio di Borobudur.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Must visit this place,
This temple have great histori,beatiful design..
Prepare for umbrella,because in the afternoon this place is very hot...
Prachtige tempel! Zeker de moeite waard om deze te gaan bezoeken. Er zitten veel mooie details en prachtige versiering om de tempels heen. Ga wat vroeger als het kan want dan is het nog niet zo warm.

Me pareció similar a Angkor Watt sólo que en un ambiente más adaptado para turistas. La entrada es cara a mi parecer aunque puedes obtener descuento para estudiante. Lo mejor de todo es que puedes llegar a esta atracción mediante la vía pública ya que el camión 1A te deja a 500 mts de la entrada, la linea 1A del bus tiene la estación de prambanan por lo cual es muy simple llegar ahí. 

Los templos están alejados de cada uno y muchos están en proceso de reconstrucción. Sin duda, la arquitectura y cultura de Prambanan es algo único y de lo mejor de Asia .
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: 整体是一个大公园，建筑跟吴哥窟的大玉米棒很像。浮雕很精美，是印度教的故事。我是坐公交去的，非常喜欢日惹的公交站，特别有趣，很适合躲雨。
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Beberapa hotel yang baik untuk menginap. Dekat dengan lokasi candi. Saya menginap di hotel yang jauh dari lokasi yaitu the sahid hotel. Tapi sanga5 bagus hotel. Karyaran hotel ramah dan baik.Good people. Good vacation

Wenn du das hier lesen solltest, bist wahrscheinlich gerade an deiner nächsten Reiseplanung und hast Yogyakarta in deiner engeren Auswahl. Vielleicht bist du dir nicht so sicher, weil dieser Ort weit von Bali und dem nächsten Strand entfernt ist.
Ich kann dir jedoch Yogyakarta und Prambanan sehr empfehlen.
Yogya bietet in dir in seiner Umgebung zahlreiche beeindruckende buddhistische und hinduistische Tempelanlagen, die es wert sind gesehen zu werden. Darunter auch das Borobodur, dass du unbedingt mit einplanen solltetst.
Meine Tipps dazu findest du hier. 

https://www.tripadvisor.de/ShowUserReviews-g790291-d320054-r337056007-Borobudur_Temple-Borobudur_Magelang_Central_Java_Java.html.

Nun zu Prambanan:

Bus / Lage
Prambanan liegt fast genau 17 km nordöstlich von Yogya.
Ihr könnt tagsüber (beginnend früh morgens) mit dem Bus 1a ab Jalan Mariboro ( die Hauptstraße für Touristen) direkt zum Tempel fahren. Das ist auch äußerst günstigt.
Zeitlich solltet ihr in etwa 40 Minuten bis eine Stunde einplanen, je nach Verkehr.
Von dem Busbahnhof aus könnt ihr etwa in 10 Minuten zum Tempel laufen.
Achtung!!!
Direkt am Busbahnhof Prambanan warten Rikscha-Fahrer, die euch für hohe Preise anbieten, euch zum Tempel zu fahren. Das braucht ihr wirklich nicht.

Abends kann es etwas knapp werden. Wir hätten fast eine Stunde auf den Bus warten müssen, haben uns dann jedoch in einer motorisierten Rikscha oder so etwas ähnlichem zurück in die Stadt fahren lassen. Das hat fast eine Stunde gedauert und man fühlte sich in dem extrem hektischen sehr verletzlich.
In diesem Fall muss man schon hart um den Preis handeln.
Also... gebt euch nicht mit dem ersten Preis ab. Handelt ohne euch zu schämen auf einen drittel von dem was man euch anbietet. 

Eintritt
Tja... hier mal wieder der unsympathische Teil.
Der Eintritt ist unterteil in Ausländer und Einheimische. Aktuell (2015) ist der Preis bei 18 USD.
Man kann es schon nachvollziehen, dass man die Preise für "reiche" Touristen anhebt, aber es ist ziemlich grenzwertig, sollte euch aber nicht abschrecken, denn das wird euch in Ankor Wat genauso passieren, wenn nicht sogar noch teurer.
Ich werde dazu den aktuellen Preisplan als Foto hier hochladen.

Eindrücke
...die sind immer subjektiv aus dem Auge des Betrachters und Abhängig davon, welche Tempel man bereits vorher gesehen hat.
Ich persönlich fand diese wunderschön. Eine grandiose Architektur mit viel Liebe zum Detail. Speziell für Nichtasiaten, die solche Tempel nur aus Reise-Magazinen kennen, wird der Anblick beeindrucken.
Ich habe es wirklich sehr genossen.
Die Türme des Tempels sind über einen quadratischen Platz verteilt.
Zeitlich kann man sich für die Besichtigung etwa 1 bis 2 Stunden Zeit nehmen. je nachdem wie sehr man sich mit der Architektur beschäftigen oder diese Eindrücke genießen will.
Soweit ich mich erinnere, gibt es innerhalb der Anlage nichts zu essen. Also solltet ihr euch etwas zu trinken und kleine Snacks mit einpacken.

Fazit:
Für Yogyakarta kann ich eine hohe Empfehlung aussprechen.
Ich würde je nach Aktivität 2 bis 4 Übrenachtunge einplanen.
Bei 2-3 Übernachtungen:
Nach Ankunft erst Ankommen. Hotel, Abendessen etc.
Tag 1 Prambanan
Tag 2 Bordobudur

Bei 4 Übernachtungen und/oder mehr könnt ihr auch gerne mal schauen, wie es mit Vulkan Wandertouren aussieht. Denn nicht weit von Yokya liegen zahlreiche zum Teil noch aktive Vulkane.
Südlich gibt es auch Strände, diese sind jedoch ohne Auto uäßerst scher zu erreichen und vor allem zu verlassen. Wir kamen nur dort an, nachdem wir den Busfahrer bestochen hatte, und konnten nur weg, nachdem wir Menschen gefragt hatten und nach Yogya gegen Geld zu fahren.

Tipps:

Tip 1
Wenn du ein großer heller (mittel-nord-) europäischer, sportlicher Typ sein solltest, dann mach dich schon mal darauf gefasst, dass du alle zehn Meter um ein Gruppenfoto gefragt wirst. Du bist in einem Land in dem Respekt und Höflichkeit mehr zählt, als deine schlechte Laune.
Sei also bitte höflich und gönne den Menschen den Spaß. Lächel, sage "Ja, gerne." und mach mit den Leuten Fotos.
Und irgendwann merkst selbst du als ständig schlecht gelaunter Europäer, der nur paar Tempel sehen wollte, dass menschlicher Kontakt und lächeln, tatsächlich die eigene Stimmung hebt.
Sie werden dich fragen woher du kommst. Sei auch dann höflich uns sage es einfach.
Wenn du nach dem Foto weiter gehen möchtest, lächel, winke und sag "Thank you!".

Tip 2
In Yogyakarta, speziell in der Maliboro Straße gibt es viele Leute, die euch anquatschen, eventuell in eurer Heimatsprache, deutsch, englisch, niederländisch, etc. und euch dann irgendwann fragen ob ihr mitkommt in eine "unglaublich tolle Kunstgalerie und wie viel Glück ihr doch habt, dass ihr jetzt gerade da seid".
Geht nicht. Ihr habt keine Ahnung wer das ist und wo er euch hin bringt.
Im besten Fall wollen sie euch unnötige Gemälde für einen horrenden Preis verkaufen.
Seid dennoch höflich und sagt, dass ihr was anderes vor habt, aber morgen gerne kommt.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Si puedes disfrutarlo un día soleado y con un guía que explique todo mucho mejor. Uno de mis sitios favoritos en Jogja.
lokasi candi hawanya dingin dan sejuk, bagus buat foto-foto dan nuansa jaman doeloe nya terasa banget. Kamar mandi / toilet nya bersih.

This temple is located near the highway and only around 20 minutes from Jogja city. It's very good place to visit and mainly very good spot for taking picture. Check weather forecast, avoid rainy season. Go there around afternoon time and wait for the sunset there for best photo. Also check the schedule for Ramayana Dance Theater so you can end the trip for it at night time under the moonlight.

What a wonderful place!! Yeaahh! I was totally happy!!! :) :)
Someday i want come back to see you again! :D
Yeaaaaaaahhhhhhhhhhhhh!!!! :)
walaupun tempatnya panas sekali tapi kalau sudah masuk kedalam semua terbayarkan, suasana candi yang agung dan kaya akan sejarah benar2 terasa

A great place to visit in the morning before the crowd sets in and makes it a picnic area,  all in all good, Entrance fee is a little steap (IDR 207,000) but they do a good job of maintaining it now also it is a world heritage site, as soon as you enter you are presented with a printed cloth that is wrapped around ur waist I figured that u get that as a souvenir but unfortunately it is to be returned... The temple Itself is wonder full to behold with the trio of temples dedicated to Bramah, Vishnu, and Shiva another 3 temples for the animals the mounted. A lot of locals would ask for a foto if you're Caucasian, so have fun and smile!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Картинка как на открытке, одевают на туристов каски, чтобы ничего не упало на голову, по времени ну максимум на 1 час, комплекс красив, но без особого впечатления, но посетить стоит
如果可以，請早一點去看這個景點，可以看得比較多人也比較少，可惜經過多次地震，建築有點殘破，但仍看得出完整的時候會很美跟壯觀。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Hari pertama di jogja kami check in hotel di Grand Zuri Malioboro dan langsung bergegas untuk menikmati tempat-tempat wisata di Yogyakarta.
pertama kami menuju candi perambanan yang terkenal sebagai salah satu situs keajaiban dunia.
begitu sampai tempat, kami dikenakan biaya masuk Rp 25,000/orang.
setelah kami masuk, ternyata perjalanan dari pintu masuk ke candi nya masih agak jauh, lumayn lah bisa sambil foto-foto dengan pemandangan yang bagus dan latar candi perambanan dari kejauhan. disana juga banyak penjual yg menjual berbagai macam cindra mata khas candi perambanan.
saya dan teman saya membeli gantungan kunci yang dibandrol dengan harga sangat murah, yaitu Rp1,000/buah lumayan buat oleh-oleh hehehhe.
sesampainya didekat candi, kami menyayangkan karena candinya sedang di renovasi, ada beberapa alat berat disana, sehingga lumayan merusak pemandangan kalo mau foto heehe.
tapi di pelataran belakang candi kami menemukan spot yang bagus untuk foto, terlihat juga dari kejauhan kompleks candi...... apa namanya saya lupa, tapi bagus jg.

setelah puas berfoto saya menuju jalan keluar, dan dijalan keluar ada pasar seni yg banyak penjual dan harganya sangat murah.
kami belanja beberapa barang, teman saya beli baju jumpsuit dan saya membeli topi meraah. sangat puas belanja disini dengan harga murah.
semoga suatu saat bisa kembali lagi kesini dan bisa belanja lebih banyak hehehhe.
tempat dengan bangunan dan assitektur yang sangat tinggi, akses mudah ( bis trans yogya) dan ongkos masuk sangat murah

berangkat dengan trans jogja,satu kali naik dari malioboro langsung sampai. jalan sedikit untuk masuk komplek candi.
dari jauh sudah keliatan candi2 utamanya. ternyata lebih gede daru yang diperkirakan. untuk yang datang rame2 bisa dipertimbangkan pake guide.
tips, datang pas pagi sewaktu udara belum terlalu panas. juga karena relatif masih sepi, agak siang sedikit mungkin bertemu rombongan2. bawa air minum dan snack seperlunya.
minus 1poin karena : ada perbaikan, powertool dan tukang2nya bikin bedeng di sekitar candi.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Lokasi dekat dengan kota, banyak mainan anak-anak. Candi ini cocok sekali untuk keluarga yang memiliki anak kecil atau orang tua yg sudah sepuh

旅行者は現地の人とは料金が違う。（２７００００IDR？）思ったよりも整備されていて、歴史的な感動は思ったほどないが、やはり目の前で見ると大きさに圧倒される。
おすすめはトランスジョグジャで行くこと。安く（３６００IDR）行くことができ、さらに現地の人の生活も垣間見えて大変面白い。思ったよりも簡単に行けるので、ぜひチャレンジを。

I took Trans Jogja to reach the temple. The bus was so full and I spent around 40 minutes to wait for it. The entrance fee for domestic tourists is Rp 30,000.00. I don't remember the fee for foreigners but there was different locket for foreigners. Unfortunately, it was not written clearly where they should buy. I saw two foreigners got confused about it. 
The temples were very great. They had various reliefs. Take time to enjoy it. I came there at 5 PM and hoped to see the sunset. But, it was cloudy at the time.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Tempat wajib jika ke yogya, sekitar candi sangat panas sebab tidak ada pohon, tetapi komplek candi ini terletak di dalam sepert kebun raya. Jadi panas hanya di wilayah candi nya saja.

These temples are stunning to gaze at, surprisingly even the boulders surrounding the main complex. 
Being a solo traveller in a red shirt I believe I stuck out a little too much, I know how Angelina Jolie feels now when she's goes anywhere...
Millions of children learning english (not exaggerating) stopped me every 2 minutes for an interview and photo. Even some of the locals (not students) got in on the action.
I'm expecting to see myself on a billboard in no time. 
Whilst the temples were magical, I found it hard to enter and explore any of them. 
With limited time I began to decline some interviews much to the dissapointment of those simply wanting what the previous group of children had achieved.

Sorry, back to the temples.... they were beaut.
Hot tip- pretend you don't speak english, have the camera ready and on your marks, get set, go...

Beau, à voir. Il y a par contre beaucoup de monde et il y a une partie en reconstruction. Nous sommes allés voir la partie en reconstruction également, mais ça ne vaut pas la marche. La partie principale est plus intéressante. 
Je conseille d'y aller quand il n'y a pas trop de soleil.

Bol to nevšedný zážitok. Trošku sme sa nachodili, hlavne do schodov, ale stálo to za to. Odporúčam zobrať si niečo na pitie a dobrú obuv. No a ešte opaľovací krém. Ten odporúčam použiť :-), aby ste po výlete nemali červený nos, ako ja :-)

De Bodebudur is indrukwekkend maar dit zeker ook. De beelden hier zijn minder verweerd en de restauratie is heel goed uitgevoerd. Dit is voor mij de derde bezoek over een periode van 20 jaar en zie dat er veel ten goede is veranderd. Jammer dat er diverse beelden ontbreken.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Best time to visit the Temple is sunset. The temples looked magnificent during the sunset. Best time to go is off peak season.

The temple complex is ancient and beautiful. It's really amazing the entire complex. It closes at 5.30 - 6.00PM. Please wear comfortable shoes. You need to climb stairs. Please ensure you have water, hat and sunglasses with you. Please do visit the sevu temple too.

外国人入口ではドリンクサービスがありましたが、ボロブドゥールのようにペットボトルはありませんでした。整備された公園を、建ち並ぶ石塔を目指して歩くと、その風景に圧倒されます。時間が修復を進め、地震がそれを壊す、そんな繰り返しのようです。また遺跡の上、低空を航空機が飛び、過去と現在が混在するような写真も撮れました。ただ乾いた白い砂埃と強烈な日差しにはご注意を。
敷地は広大で、全部回るとかなり時間がかかりますが、夕日を後光のように従えたセウ寺院は神々しく、廃れた遺跡の斜陽感に感動でした。子供用の公園や、夕方地元の人が集まる、鹿のいる公園みたいな所もありました。

Это место поражает не меньше храмов Ангкора своими колоссальными строениями и развалинами. Вход для иностранцев стоит 20$ но за эти деньги можно часа три разглядывать и поражаться удивительным резным фигурам и настенной резьбе.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Temple is really great but for locals price 13000r for foreigners 252000. That is make my trip not so exiting.

Pada Hari Minggu saya bersepeda dari Jogja kota menuju Candi Prambanan di pagi hari.
Sampai di Candi Prambanan masuk ke lapangan banyak penjual jajanan pasar.
Selagi istirahat menikmati makanan dan minuman di hari minggu pagi.
Setelah itu masuk ke Candi Prambanan yang sangat besar ini.

The temples themselves are very cool (and different enough from Borobudur to make the trip worth it. The whole area in general is kind of weird. turnstiles to get in, a camping area, a little train that can take you to the nearby Sewu temple (and stops for only a few minutes...very weird). 

You have to go through a MASSIVE market to exit as well which is a bit annoying. I was there in January so it was all quite quiet, but I can imagine when it's busy it would all get a bit "amusement park"ish. Treat yourself to a coconut once you get to the very end of the exit.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: интересный индуистский храмовый комплекс. белых туристов мало, потому постоянно просили с нами сфотографироваться. под конец уже очень устали от такого внимания и жары

Definitely worth seeing.Important for understanding the religious history of this country. It would be worthwhile to retain a guide, only be sure the specify that the guide include the ancillary temples as well. The site is very large and a tram ticket would also be worthwhile.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
ボロブドゥールにも行きましたが、まあこちらの方が比較的近く、多少なりとも遺跡感はあってよかったです。

ボロブドゥールかこちらか、二者択一なら、こっちの方がいいです。

Prambanan is an architecturally important Hindu temple of the classic era. It has wonderful bas-relief carvings, and is elaborately decorated on the exterior. Unfortunately some of the idols are no longer in their proper temples; or in some cases replaced with copies. The weird thing about this place and Borobudur is the school groups. The kids are fun and charming and love nothing better than taking pictures with foreigners, and we enjoyed sharing the park with happy, chatty groups...but the students came in knowing very little about the Hindu and/or Buddhist cultures and religions, and the adults did not explain any of it to them. It was literally just a photo op for selfies with their BFFs.

Seru juga bersama rombongan ke Prambanan, area yg luas, alam, dan ada sejarah nya juga. pas buat keluarga.
kebersihan selalu di jaga dengan baik.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
I was here at New Year 2016. For me, it was too crowded. Too many people along with their "selfie stick". 
Prambanan Temple is truly a great temple, along with temple near Prambanan. Ironically, too many people these days with selfie stick which somehow makes them become more ignorant as long as they have a photo to be showed off to others. 

Probably need some education for visitors in near future to prevent any damage done by them due to ignorance.

I will admit to loving a temple so I am probably biased, but I really did love this place. I could have spent far longer than I had to see everything. The temple certainly has an aesthetic quality I have not seen elsewhere. Worth the trip.

This is a Hindu temple built during the 9th and 10th Centuries. I am in awe of what these builders were able to accomplish without modern tools. These structures have been standing more or less for 12 centuries. It is both a monument to the Hindu gods and the people that built these structures. Even today restoration is still taking place. Slowly things are being rebuilt and one day the site may indeed be restored to all of it's early and spectacular glory. It rained really hard during part of our time there. We just waited out the rain and continued exploring.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Excelente lugar, muy místico y con una arquitectura fabulosa, llegar en día soleado es de lo mejor, conseguirse un guía en la entrada del complejo porque es bien informativo y vale la pena. Totalmente recomendable.

The Prambanan Temples were average, did not have the wow factor in it, there was not much to see and the site is severely damaged. Felt the place was overrated and overpriced. However if you insist on going, get the bicycle and cycle around the temple grounds, so that you can cover more ground and make the most out of your money.

Nusantara adalah nama terdahulu sebelum Indonesia.
Memiliki begitu banyak kekayaan yang berlimpah terutama budaya, salah satunya Candi Prambanan.
Candi Hindu terbesar di negaraku, menyimpan begitu banyak sejarah serta pelajaran yang tak ternilai harganya.
Dibangun pada abad ke-8 wangsa dinasti Sanjaya oleh Raja Balitung, seperti pada candi hindu pada umumnya, candi ini memiliki 3 tingkatan: bhurloka, madyaloka, dan nirvanaloka. Ketiganya menggambarkan tingkatan manusia dari dalam kandungan hingga menuju kesempurnaan batin.
Begitu banyak pertanyaan mengenai candi ini, Bukankah konon di kisahkan bahwasanya Hindu berasal dari India?
Lalu mengapa di India justru tidak ditemukan peninggalan semegah ini?
Siapakah sesungguhnya nenek moyang penduduk asli Nusantara?
Bagaimana kita penduduk asli nusantara justru memilih meninggalkan kepercayaan sejati demi memeluk paham modern?
A good few hours but very hot and dusty, would recommend taking water and umbrella, still very striking and beautiful, and would recommend it

A great cultural site consist of complex of temples. Suit people with culture or history interest you can walk about yourself or hire your private guide on site for a reasonable rate if you really into the details of this historical place.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
We had a short pitstop here after we went to borobudur. 
It's really beautifull but I found the borobudur more impressive. Non the less it's so worth it to bring this temple a visit.

It's a beautiful temple. 
If you think about it, it's amazing how they made this.
You can see it's not finished yet, i don't know if they ever going to finish it. But still it's amazing. 
Try to go in the morning if you want to visit the temple as it's very hot in the afternoon.

Candi Prambanan sangat dekat dengan Bandara Adi Sucipto. Kami pesawat pagi, maka kami singgah kesana terlebih dahulu sebelum ke malioboro. 
Biaya masuknya IDR 30.000 (tidak termasuk ratu Boko), area ini sangat luas dan terbuka, disarankan bila datang pada pukul 10am - 3pm sebaiknya memakai topi atau payung, sun block (kulit langsung merah) serta ingat bawa air minum, karena area lantai candi adalah pasir, maka semakin memantulkan panas. 
Bila anda pernah melihat film india Mahadewa, maka anda serasa dibawa ke film tersebut, ada monumen depan yang didalamnya ada patung sapi yang tanduknya sebelah, itulah Nandi yang setia menemanin Siwa, serta ada monumen garuda dan angsa yang menjadi tunggangan wisnu dan brahma. dibelakang ketiga wahana candi inilah barulah bangunan candi wisnu, siwa dan brahma. Candi Siwa paling besar dan paling luas.
 
Disini saya tidak menjumpai patung Roro Jonggrang.
Saat ini saya pergi dengan suami saya, jadi tidak takut dengan "mitos" bahwa bila yang pacaran bila ke sana akan putus hubungannya, benar tidaknya saya mau mencoba hal-hal yang dipercayai masyarakat sana, karena ternyata disana sangat kental akan cerita mistiknya.
Jalan masuk dan jalan keluar candi berbeda, jadi saran saya ambillah gambar sepuasnya dulu didepan candi sebelum kita tdk bisa balik kembali kesana.
Belanja di area sini saya sarankan potongkan harganya hingga 50-70%, bila tidak bakal sakit hati loo
Air minum pocari sweat, 1 botol 500ml senilai 10.000
topi bisa ditawar hingga 20.000
Selain candi Prambanan masih banyak candi lagi, bila anda banyak waktu silakan gunakan fasilitas kereta kelilingnya, mungkin akan dikenakan biaya
Disini juga telah dibangun tempat bermainan anak-anak, dan kadang malam hari ada pengelaran seni drama tari, serta ada restoran makan dan jamu.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text:
Prambanan temple is a hindu temple.
Its great and gorgeous.
Its not far from adi sutjipto airport (jogjakarta's airport).
Or from jogjakarta town you can take jogjatrans, its cheap, just pay Rp 3,600 you could reach prambanan temple.
Die Tempelanlage ist beeindruckend. Ja, der große Tempel sowieso, aber unbedingt auch die kleineren in der Umgebung mitnehmen. Must see 😊

Candi Prambanan atau Candi Loro Jonggrang adalah termasuk salah satu kompleks candi terbesar di Indonesia, saya bersama anak dan suami pertama kalinya mengunjungi wisata ini, cukup kagum dengan bangunan ini yang dihiasi relief-relief, lokasinya juga cocok untuk anak saya yang suka lari-larian dengan pelataran yang sangat luas, ketika kami kesini cuaca cukup panas dan sebaiknya membawa payung atau bisa juga menyewa karena banyak yang menyewakan payung. di sekitaran komplek candi juga banyak yang menjual pernak pernik oleh-oleh sebagai buah tangan.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: candi prambanan menyuguhkan bangunan yang menakjubkan, karya sejarah dari para leluhur bangsa di masa lampau. bangunan hindu ini menjadi tempat yang menarik untuk sejarah. wajib dikunjungi.
Very beautiful temple, telling the story of ancien Indonesian history. Valuable knowledge, when visit, ask tuorist guide to expalin the history of the temple.

Candi Prambanan yang terletak di Kabupaten Klaten, Jawa Tengah  memilliki legenda di balik pembuatannya. Roro Jonggrang yang sangat digilai oleh Bandung Bondowoso akan tetapi ia tidak menyukai Bandung Bondowoso dikarenakan lelaki tersebut sudah membunuh ayahnya dan bersifat jahat. Roro Jonggrang yang tidak mau dipinang tersebut memiliki akal untuk menolak dengan meminta dibuatkan candi berjumlah seribu dan harus selesai dalam satu malam. pesona Seribu Candi yang memiliki latar agama Hindu tersebut sangat menarik untuk dikunjungi, selain itu pada bulan purnama terdapat pementasan sendratari Ramayana yang tak kalah bagus dan sangat pantas untuk dilihat
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Prambanan is a unique temple site, one of famous and must-see destination. Its well-preserved temples will makes you adore it right away. Umbrella is advisable to keep you comfort from sunlight and rain.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Храмовый комплекс посетили зимой 2015-2016 . при входе местные учащиеся предлагают бесплатно провести экскурсию по храмам на английском языке. Их английский далёк от совершенства, слушать тяжеловато, но они искренне стараются выдать заученный текст с какими-то эмоциями. В конце просят написать отзыв о своей работе в тетрадочку. Мы сначала решили послушать их рассказ, но скоро отказались от этой затеи. Решили перейти к заключительной части экскурсии-отзову в тетрадочку. Посмотрели все сами. 
По входным билетам для иностранцев  можно на паровозике доехать еще и до храма Севу. Для местных нужен на паровозик отдельный билет. В начале приняли паровозик как аттракцион для детей, а оказалось, что это транспорт до другого объекта.

Mit der Reise nach Prambanan habe ich mir einene lang gehegten Wunsch erfüllt. Aber die Realität hat meine Erwartungen um ein Vielfaches übertroffen. Der Sonnenaufgang in Prambanan ist einer der beeindruckendsten Momente, die man in Süd-Ost-Asien erleben kann.
One of the must visit sites. We had a good guide who help in telling the story behind all the 3 Temples and the significance of each one . That really help us to enjoy the site so much more.

ボロブドゥール観光が目当てでしたが、こちらのプランバナン寺院群も観光についていました。
行けて実際に見学できたことはいいですが、ボロブドゥールがすごかったので、結果行かなくても良かったのか？って思いもありました。
언제 봐도 귀여운 가루다 상, 인도에서 보던 것과는 또 느낌이 다른 쉬바 상, 처음 본 브라흐마 상(인도에도 푸쉬카르 딱 한 곳에만 그의 사원이 있지요), 요염한 비슈누 상 등을 구경하고, 그 웅장함을 한 번 느껴보세요! 전 스쿠터 타고 다녀왔습니다. 돌아오는 길에 비를 쫄딱맞았지만 ㅋㅋ 좋았어요.
Очень впечатляет! Несколько храмвых сооружений, посвящённых разным индуистским божествам. Рядом с комплексом бесплатное представления из сцен Рамаяны. Вход дешёвый, в отличие от Боробудура
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Prambanan is a great place to visit. Its the big temple of hindu. With the amazing historical story. You could see merapi volcano as from prambanan. Easy to reach this place, u can take jogjatrans and stop at last shelter, then go through about 300m from the bus shelter. Or you could take becak as well from there.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Huge area with few nice temples - Sewu is the tallest. Nice to walk around and a great place for sunset photo shooting. Advisable to visit from July to Sept.
Preservation job is not doing too well. People climbing up the statues is causing damage and cracks.

This is not to be missed. There is no either or option here. You must check these out. 

I would reaching early in the day. I reached around 7 am. The complex for almost completely empty with just the cleaning people around. This works well also because it's an early time in the day which is a lot cooler. It gets quite hot and humid as the day progresses. 

There is a separate entrance and a separate fee for foreigners. 
There is apparently a shuttle to take you around the temples. But I could not find it.  I walked around the complex to all the other surrounding temples as well. 
Be prepared to be asked for selfies with the locals / bunch of school kids -  possibly because they don't see a whole lot of tourists(?) 

Spend an hour at least at candi prambanan and walk around through the lush green areas of the complex to make your way to sewu temple. 

It is safe to go alone. Sewu temple did seem a tad too deserted though. 

There is a small restaurant here for refreshments. This is towards exit/museum. Carry a water bottle for sure. There is a small souvenir shop inside and many once you exit the complex. 

This is around 30-40 mins from. Yogyakarta and you should he able to find a taxi easily! 

This is beautiful and you must not miss it.

This is one of the many temples you can visit in Java, all the better if you have a professional guide to explain its history reflected in the many carved stones, statues etc. Much of the site is in ruins, whether it will be fully re built is unlikely. But it is a great place to see

Enjoy

Con menos reconocimiento que Borobudur aunque para nosotros mucho más bello, pase lo que pase jamás te arrepentirás de haber ido y sí a la inversa.
Una sorpresa maravillosa

Посещали храмовый комплекс в рамках путешествия по островам Индонезии. Комплекс находится в стадии реставрации, но уже сейчас видно, что это было величественное культовое сооружение. Несколько напоминающий Ангкор Ватт в Камбодже, он будет несомненно интересен для любителей подобных таинственных мест, возрожденных буквально из пепла и обломков после извержения вулкана. Фотографировать его лучше на рассвете или закате, при хорошем освещении, у нас, увы, было облачно и дождливо. На территории есть так же зоопарк с местными ручными оленями, которых можно покормить, приобретя специальный корм, либо просто газонной травой ). Рядом есть местный рынок, на котором очень дешево продаются яванские сладости ручной работы и сувениры.

Sebagai salah satu destinasi wisata paling populer, sangat mudah sekali jika Anda ingin mengunjungi Candi Prambanan. Berbagai macam alat transportasi memiliki tujuan ke Yogyakarta, apalagi kalau memakai pesawat terbang. 
Senang sekali kami bisa mengajak Aiman melihat objek wisata Candi Prambanan, ini merupakan salah satu cara kami mengenalkannya pada keindahan budaya dan peninggalan sejarah Indonesia. Aiman tidak ada hentinya berlarian di kompleks candi, bahkan saat naik ke salah satu candi dia tidak mau saya gendong. Dia berusaha menaiki tangga-tangga candi yang tinggi itu dengan langkahnya sendiri, untungnya dia mau saya tuntun agar tidak sampai jatuh mengingat kemiringan tangganya yang cukup curam.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This is a MUST for al travelers to Yogya , its just amazing and beautiful . I have been here before and its just as amazing every time i come to see it. DONT go during any big Holidays like New Year or Idul Fitri or long weekends as the place is crawling with visitors (local)  and it hampers the beauty of this magnificent place.
Become much more well organized than the last time i go (about 5/6 years ago). had some bike rent, train service so you can see every temple there. Clean environment.

You may visit the temple morning or afternoon before sun set. Avoid mid afternoon visiting Prambanan because it is widely open space and hardly to find shelter when there is alot of tourist. Get a tour guide to explain to your about the place. Jogja Bus is the cheapest way to get there.

Hal yang menyengkan ketika berkunjung di Candi Prambanan adalah, candi ini tidak memiliki undak-undakan yang tinggi dan lokasinya landai. Sehingga bagi pengunjung tidak terlalu capai naik turun tangga. Disamping itu apabila ingin menjelajahi keseluruhan lokasi yang luas, ada transportasi kereta mini yang bisa mengantar kita. Dimalam harinya ada pertunjukan sendratari ramayana yang sangat spectakuler karena berada diluar ruangan lengkap dengan tata panggung yang bagus. Namun tidak akan ada pertunjukan outdoor saat musim hujan tiba.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Wir hatten das Glück, das nur wenige Besucher sich mit uns die Anlage angeguckt haben. Als Weisser sollte man sich jedoch zwecks Fotos mit den sehr netten Einheimischen etwas mehr Zeit einplanen. ;)

Breathtaking. Read up because you are in for an experience you will never forget.
Emotional. Be prepared to wear your best shoes for climbing and use sunscreen and a very good camera.

We finally made it to Prambanan after hearing about it for a while. Definitely a worthwhile visit. 

The temple complex is just stunning. The work of art and the devotion of those who built this architecture is unquestionable. Everything is full of history and packed with meanings/ symbolism. It also shows harmonious living between different religious views in the area. We could spend all day here admiring all the details. 

We are also happy to see that the area is tidy and well looked after. Garden is well tended and no rubbish on the ground. 

Have a walk around the whole complex if possible, a very nice stroll around, either on foot or by bike. There are other smaller temples within the area definitely worth a visit.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: When I first saw the complex I was in awe of its enormity and complexity. Getting a closer look, the carvings were so intricate and rich with symbolism and we learn spirituality has a concrete manifestation. Take your time to wander the area. This is a Hindu Temple and Candi Sewu, a Buddhist Temple, is located in the North of Prambanan temple, signifying a tolerance between two religions.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Temple en reconstruction. Prix pour les étrangers de 235000 rp contre 30000 rp pour les locaux. Je conçois tout à fait devoir payer plus cher ayant un pouvoir d'achat beaucoup plus important. 
Néanmoins à l'intérieur, beaucoup de travaux suite au tremblement de terre de 2006 et nous n'avons pas eu l'impression que les travaux avançaient. 
A VOIR car il s'agit d'un monument de l'ile de Java mais décevant finalement

We scape to Yogja from Bali for a weekend to have a break of the tourists and the beach and visit the temples in Yogja.
We went to Prambanan on a Saturday afternoon. There were lots of locals but not to crowded. 
It took us just over an hour to walk around all the temples and we were very lucky to get a free tour from some students that were there practising their English. They gave us really good info that helped us to understand the temples better.
The entry fee was 252k idr. 
There is a market as you leave were you can buy cheap souvenirs and local stuff.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: sebenarnya letak candi ini adalah di Klaten Jawa Tengah bukan di Yogyakarta, namun orang lebih mengenal yogyakarta. BAngunan - bangunanya sungguh menakjubkan, saat saya berkunjung masih ada renovasi. Namun renovasi yang dilaukan tidak bisa sesempurna bentuk bangunan awal

After the restoration, this place looks better now. With the temples around, the view it offers is very nice. They still keep the old parts of the temple as parts of the museum located on the way to the exit.

Very unique temples and architecture. If you get a good guide understanding the history just makes it more interesting. Lot of temple towers have collapsed over a period of time due to natural disasters but are in the process of being reconstructed. There is a Ramayana performance in the outdoors with the temples as the backdrop everyday however since we visited during the rainy season there were no performances.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Mto legal! As ruinas estao bem preservadas, os detalhes entalhados na pedra. Incrível! Vale mto a visita!

Mas o Borobodur é  melhor, entao se possivel vá neste primeiro, pois se for no Borobodur antes nao vai valorizar esse tanto qto ele merece hehehehhe
sungguh memikat pesona keindahan candi penataran. berterimakasih kepada nenek moyang yang tlah membuatkan bangunan seperti ini
A gem of a temple reflecting Indonesia's rich and diverse cultural history!  I highly recommend going around the temple complex on rented bikes (Rp10K for half hour will do).
lokasinya dekat dengan pusat kota jadi tidak perlu capai2 menuju tempat ini. dan juga terletak di pinggir jalan mudah terlihat.

Безумно величественный храмовый комплекс! Обязательно для посещения. 
Находясь там, очень сложно поверить, что такое вообще возможно. Фотографии не способны передать величия и масштабов этих сооружений!

Prambanan is beautiful and my favorite Temple in Indonesia. However, it is very crowded. Also, as a Westerner, it is difficult to enjoy the experience when you can't turn around without somebody trying to take a photo of YOU instead of the TEMPLE.
I recommend visiting Prambanan to see the amazing architecture and I suggest getting a guide so you can get the full story.  Put aside some extra time to visit all the temples in the compound as well! (Yes, there is more than just Pramabanan in the same park!)
But before you go, make sure you've had your coffee and are prepared to play celebrity for the day so you don't get annoyed with all the well-meaning folks that want to get a snapshot with you :)
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Went around noon time and it was really hot! Despite being caught in that weather, i really enjoyed looking at the cravings and the beautiful stupas. 

Tips: Please bring an umbrella and water when visiting this place. Wear proper shoes so you will be more comfortable walking around this amazing temple!

Came here in the morning, still not so many tourists (which was good).

Clean air and compound combine with grand building of the past, a wonderful morning!

And i just knew that they have deers in the area, a caged area but still ok.

Im totally amaze with this temple. Sebenernya saya gak suka liburan yang jalan jauh2 cuma buat liat candi tapi yang 1 ini exception banget. Pertama kali saya liat saya amaze banget. Hypnotize. Saya bener2 duduk dipinggiran sambil memandangi candi2 itu. I dont know about other people tapi buat saya candi prambanan bener2 amazing. Ada atmospir tersendiri yang bikin orang betah lama2 memandangi tempat itu. Gak jauh dari pusat kota juga dan gak jauh jalan ketempat parkir. Saya bahkan bisa pegang patung roro jongrang. Saya definitely mau kesana lagi dan sekalian nonton tari ramayana. My bucket list.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Berkunjung ke candi prambanan maka anda harus mengerahui cerita rakyat yang menjadi sejarah candi ini. Panorama di sekitar candi tentu saja indah. Anda wajib ke sini jika berkunjung ke jogjakarta.

Totally cool temple, many have been rebuilt since the earthquakes a few years ago. Amazing to see how much work has gone into the rebuild, as well as the originals. 
Beautiful place. I didn't get a tour, just did it on my own. Took a bus from downtown directly there, then walked about 15 minutes to the entrance. 
Spent about 2-3 hours walking around. Amazing, amazing. If you're in Yogya for Borobodur and skip this, it's a big mistake! Enjoy.

El sitio ha sufrido de destrucción por el tiempo y fenómenos naturales; sin embargo, la reconstrucción ha creado un espacio con las principales edificios que da una muy buena idea de cómo fue el templo en su época de apogeo.
Los guías locales están certificados y vale la pena hacerse acompañar por uno de ellos, no son caros y tienen excelente actitud.
El paseo en el tren local también es recomendable para dar un vistazo a otros templos sin caminar tanto bajo el intenso sol.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
This is one of our heritage which we are proud of and place for Hindu people to have their praying to their gods and doing their rituals during a specific days, it really large, the area was about a hundreds acre or more.

Every tourist that visited Indonesia must come to this place at least once and enjoy the beauty of the Temple, you can also get a guide if you want and an slow train circling the temple it self. other than that they have a unique tradition that each people that went into the temple complex need to wear a batik scarf while sightseeing, and return it when they want to go home.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Prambanan salah satu candi hindu yang terbesar. Candi ini sangat indah dan juga mudah di akses dengan kendaraan umum. Dari bandara adi sucipto cukup naik trans yogya, tidak sampe 20 menit sudah tiba disini. Jangan lupa kalo ke prambanan cobain deh melihat pertunjukan ramayana teater yang jadwalnya bisa digoogling dulu (maklum gak hapal.. hehe). Kalo pas langit cerah bisa langsung melihat keindahan gunung merapi yang jaraknya tidak jauh dari prambanan.

Both temples borobodur and prambanan have to be seen. It.s a must. It is stunning how big people.s faith can be building these things! Every centimeter of stone wasn.t just there for supporting the building, but for the sake of being beautiful!! Sculpted perfectly.

Great temples, definitely worth a visit. Only complaint I have is that the entrance fee for tourists is literally 5 times the amount for locals. As a foreigner LIVING in Indonesia, I find this to be ridiculous. I'm not surprised it's more for tourist entry, but there is no reason it should be so much higher than local entry fee.
although they still reconstruct some of the temples. this are the highest hindu temples in yogyakarta. this temples consist of tri hindu gods brahma, wishnu, shiwa. good place to visit.
This is a very beautiful candi complex in Indonesia. Beautifully crafted by the masters of the past. Really family friendly, kids love exploring the wide area and not become too exhausted.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana

Review Text: Kalau ke Jogja saya dan keluarga selalu mampir ke Candi Prambanan. Komplek candinya luas banget.Cuman cuacanya selalu panas, tapi tetep asik sih. Cuman yang disayangkan harga tiket masuknya agak mahal..
my tips here, dont go during national holiday. because while taking the picture use camera, the background full of the people.

Candi ini terletak tidak jauh dari pusat kota yogyakarta, hanya 15 menit berkendara dari pusat kota, kawasan wisata candi prambanan ini dikelola sangat baik, bersih dan ada fasilitas umumnya, biaya tiket masuk juga cukup murah, kalo capek berkeliling juga ada kendaraan seperti kereta mini yang akan membawa anda berkeliling kompleks candi ini

入場料に見合うほどの広さもなく、行かなくてもよかったかなと思いました。
ボロブドール遺跡とは全く異なりますが、ボロブドール遺跡程見応えがなかった。

Nice place, very good to see. Do not choose the day off in Indonesia as there would be plenty od people and it would qiute low down experience. Be prepared for 10times more expensive entrance fee than domestic people. Take your time to walk around and read about this place before visit so you can enjoy more what you just looking at.
Amazing temple to visit. Worth to take the guide for extra 100 rp. Who can explain the story of this place. The entrance costs 252 rp
I really enjoyed the visit. The temples are really amazing and impressive. Eventhough it rained a lot that day, it was an unforgettable place to be.

Candi Prambanan juga dikenal dengan candi Roro Jonggrang merupakan Candi Umat Hindu terbesar di Indonesia. Candi ini terletak di dua Provinsi jawa Tengah dan DIY. Butuh waktu hanya 30 menit dari Kota Jogjakarta. Lokasinya sangat Luas menggambarkan kebesaran Kerajaan Indonesia saat itu. arsiteknya luar biasa sulit dibayangkan. Don't Forget..to Hunting with Best Camera....
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
We were here last November, this temple just super beautiful architectures.
The massive area and the temples surrounding it self just so fantastic.

People who wrote negative reviews most likely did not to their homework first. Jogjakarta with Prambanan and Borobudur is very popular local, Indonesian tourism destination. It is especially popular with schoolchildren.

So, if you want to have your visit memorable then:

- don't go there on weekends
- don't go there during school holidays
- best time to visit the site is on early morning - you should be there around 7AM to enjoy morning coolness. 

Another option would be to go there during sunset. But I'd recommend to do it only if you plan to see Ramayana ballet after visiting the site. Otherwise it will be too hot.

Please note that it is not a small place to cover and it would require some walking from temple to temple. It would also help if you have a local guide with you which can explain everything, but I'd suggest to arrange your guide _before_ visiting the site instead of looking for him after arrival.

Finally, to make the visit enjoyable, please try NOT TO combine it with Borobudur. It would require too much distance and time and you can't enjoy both sites in one set.

子連れには日中の見学は辛い。朝一の現地ツアーがなかったので、行きはタクシーでドロップしてもらい、（１５００００R）帰りは路線バス、トランスジョクジャ（３６００R）を利用。市内から朝なら30分ほどで到着し、７時すぎから遺跡を見学。早朝といっても日が昇ってくるとそれなりに暑くて、子供もばててきたため、セウ寺院は主人のみで見学にいってもらい、私は子供をプランバナンわきの遊具のある公園で遊ばせながら待つことに。公園は木陰が多く涼しい。３０００Rでミニ電車、三輪車にも乗れる。セウ寺院を見てきた夫は感動していた。カンボジアのバイヨン並みの規模、かなり大きいし、見応えもあったそう。そしてほとんどの人は知らないのか、見に行かないらしく、独り占めで見学できたらしい。ただ、歩くとかなり遠く、厳しい日差しのしたかなりこたえたらしい。リュックまであせびっしょりでした。

ちなみに車をチャーターしてプランバナン行くなら３５００００～４０００００Rで行けるそう。行きのタクシーもプランバナンは市外なので１５００００Rと決まってるといわれたけど、メリアプロサニで呼んでもらったタクシーIndra Kelana　はメーターを使いたがらない運転手が多かったので、メーターを使ってくれたらもっと安くで行けたのかも。

Prambanan yang terletak di Kabupaten Sleman, Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta merupakan Cagar Budaya yang dilindungi oleh UNESCO. Prambanan merupakan Candi Hindu terbesar di Indonesia dengan 3 Candi Utama yang menjadi perlambang Trimurti (Dewa Brhama - Pencipta, Dewa Wisnu - Pemelihara, & Dewa Siwa - Perusak). Candi Perwara lainnya merupakan Candi pengiring daro Candi Utama yang konon diibaratkan sebagai kendaraan dari Para Dewa Trimurti tersebut. Candi ini terkenal dengan Kisah Fiksi Roro Jongrang yang dikutuk oleh Bondan Bondowoso menjadi Patung. Padahal sesungguhnya Patung Roro Jongrang ini merupakan Patung Dewi Durga (Isteri Dewa Siwa). Candi ini dibangun Abad 9 Masehi oleh Wangsa Sanjaya yang memeluk Agama Hindu sebagai tempat Ibadah. Melihat Candi ini membuat kita berdecak kagum akan teknologi Arsitektural masyarakat Mataram Kuno ketika itu di dalam membuat Bangunan, karena kendatipun sudah berumur sangat Tua, Bangunan masih kokoh berdiri (kendatipun dibutuhkan perawatan dan pemugaran yang tidak sedikit).
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
When rediscovered in the 18th century, only the lower level stumps remain of the temples together with collapsed piles of stones. Reconstruction in the 1970s and again after the earthquake in 2006 resulted in what we see today. The original stones show their wear and tear of having withstood the centuries. The new "filler" stones are relatively easy to pick out with sharper edges not having been subjected to the elements for centuries.

Entrance is US$25 for foreigners and much less for Infonesians to appreciate their heritage. It gets hot and the black volcanic stones absorb heat so arrive very early in the morning or late in the afternoon. It opens from 7.30 until 5.30. You'll avoid the crowds too that way. Bring water with you if you plan on staying long studying the carvings which tell the story of the Ramayana. The 3 main temples are dedicated to the Hindu trinity of Siva, Vishnu and Brahma. They are surrounded by smaller subsidiary temples. On the outer grounds are ruins of even smaller shrines that are still be reconstructed. 

The Siva Temple in the middle is the largest and gets swarmed with the most tourists. It's main alcove contain a state of Siva and in the other alcoves are Durga his consort, Ganesh his elephant headed son and an old sage respectively. The Brahma and Vishnu Temples contain only the statute of the respective deity. Durga, the consort of Siva is believed by the locals to also be a representation of Loro Jonggrang, a new ancient Javanese princess whose story reflects the creation myth of Prambanan. Read up on the various characters and the background information will make your visit more interesting. We hired a guide who had local knowledge but limited English proficiency meant the explanations were rather basic.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Het hindoeïstische tempelcomplex Prambanan ligt ongeveer 20 kilometer ten oosten van Yogyakarta en is met de auto goed bereikbaar. Het is een zeer indrukwekkend gebouwencomplex met ontelbare in steen uitgehouwen afbeeldingen, die in de tijd dat er nog geen film of boeken bestonden als een soort stripverhalen de vertellingen en legenden representeerden. Prambanan is adembenemend mooi bij zonsondergang. Het complex is rond 850 na Chr. gebouwd en in 2006 door een aardbeving getroffen. De restauratie is inmiddels grotendeels voltooid. De centrale binnenhof bestaat uit 8 bijzondere bouwwerken waaronder drie tempels, die zijn gewijd aan de goden Vishnu, Brahma en Shiva. De grootste tempel is 47 meter hoog. Voor deze tempels staan iets kleinere bouwwerken die onderdak boden aan "de voertuigen" van deze goden; de zonnevogel garuda (het nationale symbool van Indonesië), de gans en de stier. Als je alles wilt zien en alle verhalen wilt horen kun je hier een dag vertoeven. Onze ervaring is dat je na een paar uur verzadigd bent van de prachtige gebouwen, het gedetailleerde beeldhouwwerk langs de balustrades en de prachtige beelden zoals Shiva en zijn zoon Ganesha de god met het olifantenhoofd.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

This was well worth the trip to Indonesia and the views from the temple were beautiful.  I would recommend a private driver to get you around the area and if he/she is a tour guide too, all the better.

We had purchased a combined ticket for the two temple areas and like many, chose to visit Borobudur on one day and Prambanan the next day.  The combined ticket offered us a saving of about AUD15.00 but we still considered that e were being ripped-off when compared to the local price which was 10% of the foreigners price.
We are in the fortunate position of having visited many temples across Asia, including Ankor Wat, and although this was well presented in a well-kept garden area and the temples were beautiful, the numbers of people claiming over them, the heat and the additional cost of getting from Jogjakarta to the temples and return made this a less than fully rewarding experience for us.  
If you have to get a cab from Jogja, you are probably best to pay to have it wait about an hour for you, rather than let it go and try to get a return cab, as that is difficult to do and you are at their mercy.  We did get an unofficial taxi back for a negotiated INR100,000 (AU$10), which wasn't too bad compared to others.

Prambanan is majestic Hindu temple located around 30 minute drive from Yogyakarta city centre (direction airport). The main temple is surrounded by beautiful park with trees and green grass. During our visit we could hear gamelan music from the park which created amazing atmosphere. The Prambanan temples consist of several buildings. These were reconstructed in the 20th century. Originally temples were built between 9th and 10th century. Prambanan is enlisted in as UNESCO Heritage Site. You will be overwhelmed by beauty of this site :-)

Prambanan is one of Central Java's top tourist attractions. Prambanan is not far from Jogjakarta. This temple is certainly impressive. It dates from around the 9th century, but it was in ruins for hundreds of years. The temple memorialises the three expressions of the supreme being: Creator (Brahma); Preserver (Vishnu) and Destroyer (Shiva). The main temple is dedicated to Shiva. There was competition between the Buddhist kingdom that built Borodudur and the Hindu kingdom that built Prambanan, but in the end, their fate was the same: they were overwhelmed by rhe Muslim kingdoms and these temples neglected for centuries. Prambanan is well seeing; I have seen it three times and it never ceases to fascinate

Many of our tour group friends rated Prambanan higher than Borobudur.  The temple's 9th Century architecture and carvings display much more complexity than Borobudur's.  And the arrangement of the many temples around the square show an elegance that Borobudur's simplicity cannot match.  We arrived about 4:00pm which gave enough time to tour the grounds, the temple complex and view the exquisite carvings featuring the Ramayana myth on the central temple exterior before sunset.  The sunset experience added some grandeur to the temples for sure.  And the crowds diminish somewhat that late in the day.  This is a must-see place during any visit to Java Island.

I am a Malaysian staying in Yogyakarta. Here are all the tips and tricks I have to share about coming to this place:

This place is underrated. I dont understand how people can go to borobodur and skip this place.Truly beautiful place no doubt.

Bring an umbrella, a raincoat if rainy season. No roof that shades you from the sun. I read reviews here and I brought an umbrella and I went at 2pm. Wisest decision ever.

I was at Malioboro going through all the tour agencies. One honest agency told me just drive there! Thank God I did, half an hour from my place(UGM). I'd be damned if I spent 300k on transport. (If you can drive, do the same for borobodur too, one hour away, I am glad I saved 300k again) 

Wanna save money? Buy the package that comes with borobodur too. The catch: Must visit Borobodur the other day. Be advised, the Prambanan Ramayana show has its dates so I picked the first day to Borobodur and the next day to Prambanan. If you can spend, buy the vip tickets, they let you sit on cushy sofas, or else you will have to sit on stone bench and for one and half hour, that hurts! I am a student backpacker so stone bench was ok for me. Go for either VIP or class 1. Class 2 is at the sides, not a good angle to take pictures. Most people recommend class 1.

Unless you are an architect, you will only spend max 2 hours there. What I did was I did two rounds through the compound, and then I went back to my place and take a rest and I went back again for the Ramayana show. You cant do that if you dont have a personal driver or u are with tour group. The tour will probably sign u up for ratu boko while you wait for the show to start(Prambanan closes at 5pm, show starts at 7pm). I have never been to Ratu Boko but the locals told me it was nothing much to see ( and the tickets are kinda expensive). So I never go there anyways.

There are 2 or 3 mini temples at the edge of the compound, less crowd coz far, have to walk a bit. Just two temples and me. But the beautiful thing is that in a radius of 300m, there's a church and mosque(outside) and then the hindu temples. Truly Indonesia.

I was stupid coz I had KITAS ( Temporary stay permit) but then I bought the local student ticket. Kitas owners only had to pay 30k while I paid around 110k?? I forgot. 

Once I saw two Japanese guys trying to take photos with their remote-controlled heli cameras and then they got warned. Nobody can retrieve the camera for you if it is stuck at 9 stories high XD (without a fee of course)

Last thing, wear something that goes well with sarong. I look weird in sarong and my striking sport shoes. I would wear sport shoes anyway coz you have to walk a distance around the compound.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Candi Prambanan adalah Salah Satu yang wajib dikunjungi bila berkunjung ke Yogyakarta. Lokasi nya tidak jauh dari Bandara. Candi Prambanan ini adalah Candi Kuno Bagi Umat Hindu. Persiapkan Sun block apabila datang pada siang hari, walaupun banyak Penyewaan Payung.
Lokasi candi tidak terlalu masuk, sehingga dapat terlihat dari jalan raya. Kalau kesini sebaiknya pada musim panas, walaupun matahari terik namun bagus untuk berfoto.

Really enjoyed these temples. Fine reconstruction, and good assemblage of stones to give you an idea of the extraordinary efforts to restore this site. We visited after 3pm, there were fewer tourists, and all tourists were concentrated at the 8 main temples. Once you ventured to the northern sites within the park, you will have the place to yourself. Really great to see Hindu & Buddhist temples in one location, from the same era, to see the differences in their styles. Facilities, including maps, signs & bathrooms are very good. You could visit the main complex in about an hour, or three hours for real armchair archaeologists. Personally, I enjoyed this complex and found it more impressive than Borobrodur.

Review Text: I felt that the entrance fee of 200,000 was a bit much for this place personally. If I had to choose between Borobudur or Prambanan and had only short amount of time, would choose to visit Borobudur. Some temples did not have statues inside and some did. If you have time, it is a must visit.

I went there yesterday with my family and we were all in awe of the whole site. First of all, the parks and the whole area is very well maintained. It's clean and tourist friendly. 

When you enter the site, there are tour guides offering you their service. We decided to get one guide and it was the best decision. He explained everything to us with his rich knowledge and passion.

We arrived at around 3PM and the weather was perfect. Not too hot but not dark yet..just enough to get some great photos. After walking around the entire site for almost 2 hours, it started to rain and it quickly became so heavy. Luckily we were almost finished with the tour so we went back to the car. 

Next time we will get there a little earlier so we have more time to absorb the magnificence of the temples.

Tip: if you're traveling with young kids don't bring a stroller. Bring a baby carrier instead. There are a lot of steps and stone stairs.

Review Text:
Prambanan était un très beau lieu : un plaine embrumée au matin ou l'on découvrait en marchant des vestiges de temples ça et là dans le paysage.
C'est désormais un resort enclavé dans le bruit et l'agitation, cerné de boutiques et e parking.
L'ayant visité dans les années 80, je ne peux qu'exprimer une énorme déception.
De beaux vestiges, mais rien avoir avec Bagan (Birmanie), Angkor (Cambodge) ou Hampi (Inde) ,etc. 
Il faut le voir (en semaine et tôt le matin, pour éviter le soleil et la foule). Mais il faut, en sortant faire le souhait de voir, ou de revoir, des sites ou l'on peut encore rêver, être émerveillé.
Cela dit, le site reste tout de même beaucoup moins "Disneyland" que Borobodur...
Il faut aussi savoir que ce site n'est pas loin du centre ville (juste après l'aéroport) et que l'on peut s'y rendre en bus (immensément moins cher que les tour-opérateurs qui vous harcèlent en ville ou dans votre hébergement).

Review Text:
Prambanan temple or Candi Rara Jonggrang is a 9th-century Hindu temple compound in Central Java, Indonesia. The temple is dedicated to the Trimurti, an expression of God as the Creator (Brahma), the Preserver (Vishnu) and the Destroyer (Shiva). The temple compound is located approximately 17 kilometres northeast of the city of  Yogyakarta.
The temple compound is a UNESCO World Heritage site, it is the largest Hindu temple site in Indonesia, and one of the biggest in Southeast Asia. It characterized by its tall and pointed architecture, typical of Hindu temple architecture. The temple towering 47 meter high.

Review Text: Our main goal for visiting Jogya was the Borobudur. Yes, we expected Prambanan would be a nice extra, but in the end we were surprised by the beauty of Prambanan. Several temples are damaged by the earthquake a few years ago and some are in rebuilding mode. But the main temples are simply stunning. The black colour, the gracious architecture....you have to see them in real life. Reminded me of Angkor, but far less impressive though. Still, for me just as worth seeing as Borobudur.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Melihat megahnya peninggalan sejarah ini sangat memorable. Candi Prambanan yang menjulang tinggi. Dan kawasan candi yang sangat terawat membuat wisatawan puas dengan tempat ini.
