Review Text:
I wasn't expecting to love these as much as those at Angkor but I loved them.
Really worth spending your time here. Amazing to walk around the temples.

Stunning, beautiful and ancient.  An absolute must see stop! Great to have a guide so you can get the full account of it's history.  There is a tram to get you around the site if walking or the heat is difficult.

No need to say, this is one of the must-to-go places when coming to Yogya. And yes, they are right about prambanan, it's all about cultural heritage, and everything is so amazing. Can't believe that people still maintain this after such a long time. 
In order to get there, I prefer you should read the wikitravel carefully, and I believe that everyone can go on their own, no need tour. From city, take the 1A bus in Malioboror to the temple. Don't trust others when they talked about the unsafe bus. They just want you to pay more money so that you can use their motorbike. The bus staff are very friendly and professional. She wrote everything I need to do on a paper and gave it to bus driver so that he can take me off the correct bus stope. Remember to bring your student ID card. If don't, show the ticket seller anything that proves you are student, so you will get half price ticket for foreigner. Moreover, buy the package ticket which includes prambanan and borobudur and last 2 days. It will be cheaper than buying seperated ones. The package ticket is 420,000 rp. Yeah I know it is super expensive, especially when you know that the price for locals is only under 100,000 rp. 
Don't hire a tour guide at the ticket selling box since it will be 100,000 rp. Instead, going into the entrance of the biggest temple, look on the left side to find some teenagers wearing blue or red jackets. Those are students coming there to practice English as well as doing voluntary work. Therefore, they will take you around, explain everything about the temples and it's free. Even though their English is not too good and their knowledge is not too profound, but you will admire their effort and find more Indonesian friends. It's worth, isn't it? Since they told me that there are just 4 students per day and they will guide in couple; therefore, you need to wait a little bit if not seeing them at the entrance. At the end, they took photo with me and asked me to write some comments for them in the notebook. Trust me, they are extremely friendly. Two students going with me, even though sometimes they find it hard to say something, they tried their best to show me the beauty of prambanan.
Since I travelled alone and prambanan needs to be explained in order to be understood, I find this way of travelling is far more interesting.
After that, you can choose to walk to other temples or take the mini train. I prefer the second one since other temples will take you about 10 - 20' walk. The train is right at the exit of the biggest temple and it's free for foreigners.
You also need to go to the temple early since it's very hot at noon and can make you dizzy.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

I chanced upon this guide, Mr Subarno (author of Guide to Prambanan Temples) at the entrance of Prambanan Temples. The two-hour tour was very interesting and informative as he brought my husband and I to see the many great statues of Hindu gods, carving relic of Ramayana story (and etc) and enabling us to have an understanding of these historical structures. There were rebuilding/ construction work being carried out since the earthquakes in 2006 and the recent ones in January 2014. One can easily detect the old and new stones put in place, some with carvings. He directed us where to snap great shots too!

According to Mr Subarno, the foreigner's ticket include the tram(train) to Sewu Temples which is much further into the temple grounds. At least 15-30 minutes if walking. I knew of the deer park but since I had my own car driver at the main entrance, we took the car and drove to an entrance (back) to Sewu Temples, catching a glimpse of the small deer park along the way. We were allowed to enter Sewu Temples after showing our tickets to the guard at the security house.

The structures at Sewu Temples were of Buddhist religion. Rubbles of temples were found around the main temples which were not so badly damaged by the earthquakes. Very peaceful and we seemed to be the only ones there at that time of visit.

After dropping Mr Subarno back at the main entrance, we continued to Ratu Boko since we bought the Prambanan/Ratu Boko package tickets. Alternatively, one can catch the shuttle bus that takes about 20min (last bus about 3.00 p.m) provided inside Prambanan Temples to Ratu Boko Temples (or Palace).
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Walau telah beberapa kali ke sini, tapi tetap wajib dikunjungi kembali. Walau awalnya ingin menonton Sendra Tari, namun tidak kesampaian karena waktu yang mepet. Sehingga akhirnya kami melakukan photo session, bukan foto biasa, namun menggunakan kostum adat jawa.. Kereen lah berkostum ria dengan latar belakang candi Prambanan.. Review Text: This is a good example where Hinduism and Buddhism coexisted long ago. It is worthwhile to view and appreciate the carvings on the walls despite the afternoon heat. The Prambanan consist of Hindu temples while Candi Sewu is Buddhism. At the time of my visit, Candi Lumbung and Bubrah are still under restoration. It is cheaper to buy the combined ticket for Prambanan & Ratu Boko which cost only IDR350,000.

Review Text:
My wife and I were driven to the entrance by our perfectly located Poeri Deva Resort as part of our stay.  There we walked through the parking area to the Foreign Visitor Entrance where they officially accept the 252K In. Rup fee, then point you on your way.  Much like Borobudur, the site is a bit overwhelming in what they had to do to reconstruct after time and earthquakes.  Then to walk around the site and see the remaining stone piles, to grasp what is still needed to do.  We persevered in the increasingly hot sun to walking the entire area and discovered the other huge complex, the 8th C Buddhist Temple Sewu, a needed addition to our Asian Temple required visit list.  Disturbing to see so many headless Buddhas!
We enjoyed seeing the local girls riding tandem bikes, others at the campground and the general peaceful environment until the museum opened.  Here were preserved Buddhas and others and also enjoyed a free professional movie about the sites history and place in present Indonesia in a freezing auditorium. The exit is within sight of our hotel which we could easily walk to return.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

In the evenings you can visit the Wayang show, something you cannot miss while staying in Yogyakarta.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: 이슬람 국가인 인도네시아에서 힌두사원의 웅장함과 신비로움을 느낄수 있다. 근처의 보로부드르 사원도 같이 구경할수 있는 좋은 기회가 될것이다.
O conjunto de templos é muito bonito. Vale a pena a visita. Pegamos um ônibus circular local para chegar ao local. Do centro de Yogyakarta demoramos uns 45 minutos. É uma boa experiência.

Pros: beautiful Hindu temple complex. 
Cons: I think Angkor Wat - another Hindu temple complex would be similar architectural styles but far more impressive. Plus the price is crazy Rp 252k. 
Conclusion: visit if you are in the area but if u are visiting Angkor Wat you could skip this, given the very high entrance fee.

It is one of Indonesia's prominent temples and surely I learnt a lot of history throughout the visit through the carvings on the stones. This was my second visit - the other one was during my school time many years back, and it seemed the temple was under some restoration work. There were not so many trees around the complex, especially at the temple main site, so it was scorching hot. I joined a combined tour with Ratu Boko Temple Complex, which was equally warm. I visited the Museum for the first time and learnt a lot about the work done to bring the temple back as a place of interest in Jogja and surrounds. This visit was not done during school holiday so the place was pretty quiet, but from experience during school holidays and prime time of school visitations the temple would be very crowded.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Its nice with a traditional night show and sightseeing for family too because of a legendary story to tell

Sehenswerte Tempelanlage- Gott sei Dank wieder aufgebaut. War 2006 nach dem Erdbeben bereits einmal vor Ort- damals durfte man wegen der Einsturzgefahr die Anlage nicht betreten. Unbedingt zum Sonnenauf- oder -untergang besuchen. Das Licht ist einfach zu schön!
They have very informative guide to tour you around the temple. You'll not as amazed if you have visited Angkor Wat at Siem Reap because both are Hinduism temple.

the largest archeological remind temple in Central Java.
See late back historical sculptures surrounding the temples.

Sulit menggambarkan kemegahan yang ditawarkan oleh candi ini. Kumpulan candi-candi yang megah bersebelahan satu sama lain memukau mata. Sangat pantas untuk dikunjungi bersama teman atau keluarga dan mengajarkan kepada anak-anak akan kekayaan peninggalan sejarah Indonesia

It's a nice place and you can get there easily with a bike from Jogja.
However I'm not a Temple-Hunter and I've seen Angkor Wat before so it wasn't that astonishing. There are few temples around that are not crowded and have some charm. But still I would rather choose Merapi.
After the Borobudur I went to Prambanan and I thought it was way more impressive. Even though quit a big part was destroyed by an earthquake in 2006.

The Prambanan Temples, dating from the 9th century, make up a Hindu temple complex, located just outside the main city of Yogyakarta and they are well worth a visit! They are also a UNESCO world heritage site. 
The temples are absolutely stunning to look at and will amaze you at the workmanship that must have gone into them. There was something quite powerful about walking around this site - it was a really great experience. 
The area is vast so be sure to bring plenty of water with you. We visited in September and the heat was almost unbearable so maybe going early morning or early evening would be better.

Prambanan is very easily and quickly reached by bus from Malioboro in Yogyakarta so you dont need to splash out on an organised tour. The tourist information staff at Malioboro are very helpful with bus information.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Situs bersejarah yang sangat menakjubkan. Bedanya dengan Candi Borobudur adalah, Candi Prambanan peninggalan umat beragama Hindu, sedangkan Borobudur adalah Buddha.

Prambanan is a really impressive temple complex - make sure you wander over to the other temples.
Not sure it's worth coming at sunrise - the people we talked to yawned and said no. But staying for sunset is worthwhile.
Worth getting a good guide - ours was just average, but any guide better than none.
If you have 30 mins beforehand, clue yourself up on shiva, brahma and Vishnu
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Echt veel indruk heeft dit complex op mij gemaakt. 1 grote en 2 iets kleinere tempels en daaromheen een aantal kleinere monumenten. Niet alles stond er omdat er eerst 80% van de stenen beschikbaar moet zijn voor een herbouw. Daarom lagen er veel stenen aan de zijkant van het complex. En de tempel 12 zijn ze nu weer aan t opbouwen. Heel anders dan de Borobudur omdat die tempel maar om 1 god gaat en hier 3 goden voor de tempels zijn.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
2015年5月のG.W.に行ってきました。

インドネシアでも5月1日は休日で､地方の学生たちがバスを連ねてあちこちの名所旧跡を訪れるのが一般的らしく､この日も遺跡の入り口にあたる緩い階段で集合写真を撮っていました。

「日中の混雑はすごいので､必ず朝一（6時だったかな……）に入場するのがベスト」と頼んだ現地ガイドさんは云ってました。

入り口からチャンディ・ロロ・ジョングランまでは徒歩5分程度。
チャンディ・ロロ・ジョングラン自体はそれほど広い敷地ではありませんが､一つ一つの塔を昇ったり降りたりと上下運動がたっぷりな上に階段は結構急なのでご注意を。
また日陰になるようなものがないので､夏行かれる方は飲み物と帽子､サングラスは必須です。

ここだけだとゆっくり見て回って1時間弱､園内すべてを歩いて回ると2〜3時間くらいでしょうか。
トイレは広い園内に数ヶ所しかないのと､朝早いと開いていない場合もあるらしいので､園内の地図で確認しておくとよいでしょう。

それから､フリーで行かれて車をチャーターした場合､駐車料金は別払いで5,000ルピアでした。周辺の遺跡もだいたい3,000〜5,000ルピアでしたので､予算を立てる時は1ヶ所5,000ルピアで計算するとよいと思います。
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: A complex of a number of beautiful temples. You can walk through them and enjoy sunset in the evening.

Very impressive, a must see when you are in Yogjakarta. We went there by motorcycle with the trave agency Via Via and it was great. First of all it was fast and the boys (students) took us not through the main roads so we were able to see more and other parts of Yogja. Perfect experience!
The structure and architecture is so amazing that it makes you think how the ancient managed to build such an amazing temple.

Complesso situato a pochi chilometri dalla città, la parte principale è molto bella ma non è ancora completamente ricostruita dopo l'ultimo terremoto. Nel complesso sono visitabili alcuni templi minori ed un piccolo zoo
Absolutely not to be missed, very impressive well-restored Hindu temples constructed from 8th century a.c.. Take a local guide at the entrance, you will learn so much more!

posto pieno di magia bisogna pagare in una fila per stranieri  ma ti offrono del te o acqua al ingresso nella biglietteria  , i bagni sono abbastanza puliti , consiglio di andare al tramonto e un spettacolo mozza fiato
It is very close to Yogjakarta, so it was very easy to reach by motorbike. The entrance fee was high.

Мы нисколько не пожалели, что специально прилетели с Бали в Джокьякарту (остров Ява), хотя это было несколько не по пути и требовало дополнительных затрат, при том, что по сути в Джокьякарте кроме Прамбанана и Боробудура смотреть нечего, там мало кто говорит по-английски, и в целом это далеко не туристический городок.
Про сам Прамбанан. Древний индуистский храм, очень интересно и необычно. Мы брали англоговорящего гида, который рассказал об истории и значении храма, отвечал на вопросы. Я впервые была в храмах подобного типа, поэтому мне было все вновинку и очень понравилось. Если позволяет время, обязательно съездите туда, это познавательно.

You can walk around the tourist attractions covering an area of 39.8 hectares is on foot. This complex courtyard planted many plants so that it looks like a large garden. Walking while watching the carvings on each temple will certainly make you more amazed at the results this great work. Carvings in the temples seem impossible done by humans when technology has not evolved in the past. If you want to enjoy Prambanan in a different way, come on the eve of the full moon each month at 8 p.m. to 22:00. At that time, held Ramayana ballet performances on the outdoor stage background trine with third highlighted god temple lamp. Performing at the open stage is only done during the dry season, while in the rainy season, the show moved to the location of the covered stage.

Do come with a guide or some pre-read before you enter. As most of the ancient monument were poorly maintain, you cant really see the true depiction of the old times (but it does give you an opportunity to really visualize about how the place looks like in the past). It is definitely a place with a lot of history to appreciate
Una de las mejores visitas de Yogya. El templo es Patrimonio de la Humanidad y es muy chulo, pero lo han subido demasiado de precio, para lo que son los precios en Indonesia.

Dekat dari Bandara Adi Sucipto, kalaupun naik kendaraan pribadi rutenya hanya lurus saja, nanti pintu masuknya ada di sebelah kiri.
Waktu kesana sedang ada pembangunan untuk Candi baru sepertinya. Sempat masuk ke salah satu Candinya, dan wow sangat mengagumkan.
Jalan keluar dari Candi ini terdapat semacam pasar yang menjual kaos, cinderamata dan banyak penjual makanan.

Went on a Saturday morning with an expat friend. Whilst she had to go in the local entry and we went in the tourist "VIP" entry, she was shocked at the difference in entry fee charged. Her ticket cost the equivalent of $2.50 AU and ours $25.00 AU but you have to see this place so no argument. Once we received our ticket, we were wrapped tightly in a "special" cloth which seemed only to be a clear marker that we were tourists and probably fair game for souvenir sellers. We quickly whipped them off and no one said a word! It is a fair walk to the site so take water with you. The return walk is just as long and steers you back through a market with some over priced souvenirs. Haggle hard after you have handed in your tourist sarong! Tour back through the park and pay a tiny amount to feed the deer kept in the grounds.

Candi Prambanan merupakan candi peninggalan sejarah yang terletak di kota Yogyakarta, candi yang indah yang dapat di jangkau dengan kendarann pribadi maupun kendaraan umum.., marilah kita ajak anak kita , teman dan handai tauland untuk mengunjungi candi ini agar kita lebih mengetahui dan menghargai sejarah nenek moyang kita terdahulu..

Great temple.. worth every penny that you wound spent on its slighly expensive ticket.

I opt for combination ticket Borobudur & Prambanan - cost USD 30, childeren/student USD 15

Tips: 
1) There is a place to store bags, so, for those coming from the airport, you can consider for this option
2) From Malioboro St. get on to Trans Jogja Bus 1A, only cost IDR 3600 per person, last bus is at 8pm. You may ask the ticket operator at the bus stop, there are really helpful. 
3) Time around 10-2pm is the hottest, but it is also the best as there was not many people, so, it is up to you to decide 
4) Stay for the sunset (i stayed till ner sunset, as need to catch the bus back to hotel
5) Bring water & keep hydrated
Enjoy the temple & snap lots of photos :)

Candi Prambanan berada di Jogja. Yang menjadi menarik di Prambanan adalah sendratari Ramayana yang bisa dipentaskan pada hari Jumat Malam. Penasaran, datanglah ke Prambanan dan masih ada banyak lagi tempat wisata di sekitar Prambanan dan Yogyakarta

Prepare to be awed. 
Just remember that it's a long-ish walk to Sewu Temple in the complex and so stay hydrated in the heat of the day... or take the little tram/train/people mover. 
Other than that, I have insufficient superlatives to describe the place - look at the photos which do it no justice in terms of the sense of awe the place instills in you but at least gives you a hint as to what to expect.
This place is very good for those who are interesting in heritage and history. Built by Hindu King who ruled the region before the entry of Islam. This is an UNESCO's World heritage site.
Ho visitato diversi tempi indù in India ed a Bali ma questo a Yogyakarta è in assoluto il migliore. Ci sono diversi templi ognuno per un dio diverso, molto bello. Evitate le ore più calde.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Schitterende complex van Hindoetempels, weliswaar heropgebouwd na herhaalde malen verwoest door aardebevingen. We kregen tijdens de wandeling naar het complex nog een gratis voorstelling
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: We liked Prambanan better than Borobudur to be honest, but it was still a bit pricey for what it was. They have done some impressive restoration from the earthquake and the two major temples were beautiful on the outside, but I would not go out of my way to visit. We paired this visit with a trip to Borobudur and it was a reasonable day, although you should be warned that the park is large and really hot, so be sure to prepare accordingly. There is a small train that will take you between the temples if necessary. Also, we arrived in the afternoon (after visiting Borobudur) and there were a number of school groups, who were very very loud. If you want to avoid that, an early or late arrival would be advised. It took us about 90 minutes to visit the entire complex and we walked between the temples.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: This is too expensive you pay 250-300k per person as a foreigner and its just garbage.. The place is small, hot, dry and dusty - would never waste my money with that

Candi Prambanan adalah salah satu candi yang sangat wajib dikunjungi jika sedang berkunjung ke Yogyakarta. lokasi Candi Prambanan tidak terlalu jauh dari pusat kota dan dekat dengan Bandara. suasana lebih bagus jika sore hari terlebih saat matahari terbenam
Use a carrier if you have a baby. Wear comfy shoes. For some reason, there are less tourists here than Borobodur, so there are less sellers trying to sell souvenirs.

I cannot imagine how the they build that huge temple. Its so magnificent. My suggestion is snap when the sunset or sunrise. Beautiful. In addition the temple is in town. Therefore you can go with trishaw or ojek or by taxi.

Была в этом месте дважды и все равно восхищена. Храм состоит из большого количества больших и маленьких сооружений. Там тихо, чисто и мало туристов летом, но много местных (!) зимой. Еще зимой там сезон дождей и соответственно комаров, так что берем зонт и репеллент. 
В мини зоопарке можно покормить оленей, прямо возле вольера есть деревья с зелеными плодами, на вид как незрелая слива. Местные научили меня, что олени очень любят эти плоды. Дети были в восторге.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
It's a very well maintained heritage site. There's still some construction for conservation of the old buildings ongoing. There's a few buildings there and basically all are almost the same.

You have to walk quite awhile before reaching the temple from the entrance. Thinking of all the reasons why do people last time loves building temples on a very big land that would mean even the king would need to walk that far before reaching but of course he'll have his servants helping.

We reached around 3pm and it was sunny hot but surprisingly it was also windy. The wind definitely helped in making the trip pleasant. We went straight to the temple using TransJogja bus from the airport. From the bus stop, we''l have to walk quite a distance to the temple thus we decided to just use the becak. Glad we did. 

Once in the area, there's other candi's that could be visited too. Took taxi straight back to our hotel as we're just too tired to take the bus again. Oh yes, students received half price for entrance. Just show them student card for any country will works.

Lugar lindo!
Prambanan é um conjunto de templos formado por dois complexos: o Loro Jonggrang hindu e o Sewu budista.
Faz muito calor, por isso o ideal é ir no final da tarde, pois é bem difícil aguentar o sol quente.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: 広い敷地内にいくつかの寺院遺跡があり、まだまだ修復中のものも多数あり。壁画にはストーリーがあってガイドさんの説明は興味深かったです。ガイドと行くほうが面白いと思います。
Candi Prambanan merupakan tempat yang indah untuk menghabiskan akhir pekan. Pemandangan sekitar candi benar-benar Asri. Sore hari ketika matahari akan terbenam adalah puncak keindahan candi ini

Same great temples to go and check out if you are in Yogyakarta. Very impressive. When I visited there seemed to be a lot of restoration work happening rebuilding more of the temples here which will make the place even more impressive once completed
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Go here if you need to, not worth it, most of the site is in ruins, if good restoration work in progress.

If you are visiting Borobudur as well, buy a combo ticket for both (30 USD) and save 8 USD.
Very interesting compound of temples. In the morning it is less crowded. But it is good anytime, because October is not a high season and there are no so many tourists. Most of the visitors at this time - kids from schools :) 
Easy to walk, plenty of WC, inside the territory there is no annoying sellers. Just great!
You can book an oficial guide for 100 000 IDR, if you need.
But if you have read the history about Prambanan, you can just walk and admire it :)
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Fascinating history. Not quite as crazy with the hawkers as Borobodur but still hard work. Lots of effort been put into restoration and stunning to see. Not much effort has gone into managing and engaging tourists on the site so it's a bit of a free-for-all. And it's expensive - but it's still a must see.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
suasana prambanan yang khas dengan di setiap sudutnya memberikan kesan tersendiri bagi kami saat berkunjung ke sana. sekalipun ini kunjungan yang pertama, tapi tiap kunjungan memberikan kesan yang berbeda.

teriknya matahari ketika itu tidak membuat kami lelah karena kami kembali disegarkan dengan segelas jamu khas Jogja yang di racik alami dengan bahan2 alami pula.
tepat begitu masuk ke museum kami dapat langsung menemui kios jamu tradisional yang dapat menyegarkan dahaga.

A must if you are staying in yogjakarta. Extraordinary view at late hours and wait for the sunset. Don't forget to bring a camera. 
Also if you are planing to visit borobudur, buy a combined ticket.

These temples are majestic. There is no other word for it. Give yourself plenty of time to explore the carvings and sculptures and the stories they tell. The detail work is fantastic. Check out all the different animal pairs along the walls. When you go to the main Shiva temple don't forget to check out the three other temple chambers on the other three sides with the Goddess Durga, Sage Agastya and a wonderful Lord Ganesha.  The temples of the mounts of the Gods are empty at least the Brahma and Vishnu ones. But the Shiva one does have a Narada which I did not get to see. Lot of steps to climb but well worth it. The nearby Buddhist temples get less traffic and are a bit of a walk (though there is a little train) but go there. We were just one of few people amidst the ruins. The massive dwarpala guard statues are wonderful. I hear the Ramayana performances with Prambanan as backdrop are fantastic.
Lokasi candi prambanan lebih dekat dari pusat kota jogja dibanding borobudur, namun memang tidak semegah borobudur. Selain itu masih ada pembangunan ulang di candi ini.

If U never been to Prambanan, U should do then.
It nice in the evening watching sunset.
Location is close to the Yogya City so it easy to get there.
The statue is vey different from borobudur
tres beau temple a visiter absolument. Essayer d'etre accompagné par un guide pour avoir des explications ! noter que le port du sarong est obligatoire pour hommes et femmes
Zeer indrukwekkend complex. Wat groot en wat gigantisch veel werk zit hier in. We kregen een goedkope rondleiding van twee studentes die heel veel wisten te vertellen, erg leuk!
Amazing complex. Worth-visiting. TIP: For great photo ops, visit this site in the late afternoon for lovely sunset view.
The interesting place in Yokyakartar... near from Airport. The place is attraction but so hot. The service for tourist should more suggestion to us.

Awe-inspiring temples amid a lovely, well-maintained large park. Difficult to avoid the hordes of selfie-clicking tourists. But if you're interested in Hindu temple architecture, this is a must-see. It cannot match Angkor Wat in scale, but definitely lives up to its reputation as one the greatest Hindu sites in the world. The Ramayana ballet (check for exact dates) is highly recommended.

Close to the city this site offers a wonderful experience with traditional music playing in the background.  The setting is beautifully maintained and the museum adds to the insight surrounding the history of a majestic Hindu temple complex.  It is peaceful and not commercialised.  The way the complex has been rebuilt is sympathetic and appears accurate creating a fabulous experience.  We spent about three hours there and refreshed with local Jamu drinks that were delicious and supposedly good for the body.

Ini adalah candi yang menakjubkan. Terletak di perbatasan Jawa Tengah dan Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta. Jaraknya sekitar 19 km dari pusat kota Yogyakarta. Menempati lahan yang cukup luas, sehingga agak melelahkan untuk bisa mengitari seluruh lokasi dbila berjalan kaki. Candi Prambanan mdi emiliki 3 candi utama yaitu Candi Siwa, Candi Brahma dan Candi Wisnu. Di bagian tengah terdapat Candi Siwa yang ukurannya sama besar dengan kedua candi utama lainnya. Ada 4 ruangan di dalam Candi Siwa dimana masing-masing memiliki pintu yang menghadap ke Timur, Barat, Utara dan Selatan. Di setiap ruangan terdapat patung yang berbeda. Untuk mengetahui sejarah dan informasi seputar Candi Prambanan, pengunjung bisa nonton di ruang audio visual yang menyerupai bioskop kecil.
Selain Candi Prambanan, masih ada 3 candi lainnya yang berada di areal Kompleks Candi Prambanan, yaitu Candi Bubrah, Candi Sewu dan Candi Lumbung. Bila lelah berjalan kaki, pengunjung bisa menyewa sepeda seharga Rp.20.000 atau menumpang mini-train seharga Rp.7.500 per orang. 
Bila lelah mengelilingi seluruh areal Candi Prambanan, tersedia sebuah restoran di jalur pintu keluar candi. Pengunjung juga bisa melihat-lihat rusa yang terletak tak jauh dari restoran Prambanan. Tempat ini sungguh luar biasa dan rugi rasanya bila tidak dikunjungi. Retribusi masuk Rp.30.000 per orang
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Do hire a guide if you really intend to learn about the history, the stories depicted from the artwork and statues. Really magnificent world heritage.

La entrada cuesta 235.000 IDR unos 15€ y te invitan a una bebida de bienvenida, agua o café. El templo es muy bonito y parte de él está aún en restauración después de haber sido dañado por el terremoto de 2006.Está considerado Patrimonio de la Humanidad por la Unesco desde 1991. Puedes alquilar una bicicleta para recorrer los otros templos que hay cerca. También hay un tren turístico que recorre el recinto.
Faktor Penarik: Ketertarikan Budaya, Ketertarikan Fasilitas, Ketertarikan Suasana
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Voilà assurément un site qui mérite un arrêt. Nous avons eu l'occasion de le visiter tôt le matin et c'est un moment où les couleurs sont particulièrement chaudes et vivaces. Malgré que le site a été reconstruit, l'unité garde un caractère harmonieux et plein d'histoire. 
Nous avons pu assister au spectacle de danse en soirée qui donne un autre aspect de ce magnifique ensemble. À recommander

I enjoyed a quick stop here with my family last November and came back with a friend in June. It's a beautiful temple and worth your time. I highly suggest you hire a guide who can give you the insight to the history of the temple...unless you are an expert on Hinduism. I also recommend seeing the "ballet" that they perform some evenings with the temple in the background.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Es hatte nicht viele Leute. Viele Baustellen, Restaurierung. Aufgrund der Erzählungen habe ich mir den Prambanan imposanter vorgestellt. War aber den Besuch auf jeden Fall wert!

Charakterystyczne budowle hinduistyczne, piaszczysty plac wokół, dodatkowo wiatr podbijający kłęby piasku stworzył wrażenie, że jest się w innym świecie.
Warto zwiedzić w godzinach popołudniowych. Godzina na cały niewielkich rozmiarów teren w zupełności wystarczy.

i have promise to my self that i will review Candi Prambanan, Yogyakarta - Jawa Tengah, Indonesia​ Prambanan, Jawa Tengah, Indonesia​ 
When all my family went together to Candi Ratu Boko, in the middle of uphill, My father suddenly got heart attack (minor stroke); hard breathing and could not speak well, the mouth already inappropriate way, so we searched the needle and puncture all the 10 fingers. After the situation better we went back to the Candi Prambanan using the travel package of Prambanan-Ratu Boko.

In Candi Prambanan, we tell the security about the incident. The security said that My father will be taken by ambulance to Rs Panti Rapih Djogjakarta​, the branch of Rumah Sakit Panti Rini​. After the treatmen 5days all the payment was free, paid by the Jasamarga-Candi Prambanan.

I want to say thank you to the agile security and the ambulance crew of Candi Prambanan that brought my father to the hospital and not forget also to Jasamarga-Candi Prambanan.

This magnificent Hindu temple complex was reduced to rubble by a massive earthquake, and it is now being reconstructed painstakingly like a jigsaw puzzle.The complex is vast, and the temples have steep steps. If you are visiting Borobudur, you should not give this temple complex a miss. They have a very infrequent dance performed on site, apparently very good. Check it out and book early. Tickets get sold out very quickly.When we were there, tickets got sold out.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
Incontournable si vous êtes à Yogyakarta.
Un peu cher mais vaut le coup.
J'ai été un peu déçu du coucher de soleil par contre. Je ne suis pas expert en photo mais ca me semble mieux d'y être le matin au lever.

This makes for a good day's outing when combined with Borobudur visit in the morning - with a driver this should cost no more than 400k rupiah. However it involves a long walk and three of the temples are under major renovation.

Prambanan temple was amazing. It wasn't a very big area to explore and can be done in about 2 hours. 

When we went in March, it was drizzling at the temples. Inconvenient. But, some parts of the area were flooded and it made for some very interesting photos. In one shot, it even looked like some parts of the temple was surrounded by a lake. Haha! 

Make the best of it we say :)

However, if you visit Borobudur first before Prambanan, you will find that this pales in comparison. Kinda an anti climax. Heh. 

A good visit! Go :)

Perjalanan darat dari jogja ke prambanan serasa singkat. Menakjubkan menyasikan nya dari pintu masuk. 
Menyimak tentan cerita roro jongrang jadi objek yang sangat menarik ... salam trip trip
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text:
The temples look exotic and the architecture noteworthy. But its still some similar looking builings with a lot of damage all standing on a dusty plain. The area is smaller then you would think, all surrounding gemples but one and a half are nothing more then rubble. 

Its packed with people, many of them indonesians. The schoolclasses rather take pictures with you then of the temples. Its quite funny to experience how a celebrity must feel... :P

Its kind of a must see when you are there, the tours are well organised, but in this case you should take a guide to understand what you are seeing or it gets boring really soon. 

We did the ballet there and it was nice. Again many indonesians and school classes. Therefore doesnt feel to touristy. I would recommend seeing it. 

The sundown was better from behind the temples, in the garden, then being on top, where everybody thinks he is supposed to be. 

Dont't expect too much and you wont be disappointed. Its just some old buildings, the rest is up to your imagination. 

From jogya the tour is about 600k, 1mio. if you add the ballet. Food excluded.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Don't be put off by the sheet size of this place.  Be sure to re-charge your camera batteries and bring a spare.  You'll need it.  This is the real McCoy, the genuine article.  Read up before you go or hire a local guide.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Un peu deçu a vrai dire, après avoir visité les temples d angkor et ceux de kajuraho en inde mais chaque temple est unique et c est ce qui font d eux des oeuvres d exceptions

when i look inside the temples, hiiii.. its yui. dont go inside alone. hahaha :D
stunning, every temple have different story.

Review Text: Visiting the temple during Prambanan Jazz Festifal on Oct 2015.  The temple have very easy access from Yogyakarta.  from Yogya, the temple will be on your left side of Yogya- Solo road.  It is literaly beside the road, but once you come in, it is quite.  Surrounded by the 3 large temple and many smaller temples as the 3 main temple complement, you will be back to the ancient java. Be there on sun rise or sunset, and find an angle where you can not spot the modern structure, it just magnificent.  During the night the temple will be illuminated, for the purpose of art and also for some nights as the background of Ramayana Dancing performance that is held not far from the temple area.
욕자카르타에 왔다면 꼭 봐야할 힌두 사원이다. 입장권을 사면 커피는 무료다. 주변에 깨끗한 식당은 없다.

Einfach super. Muss man gemacht haben. Trotz Knieprobleme kein Thema mit dem Aufstieg.  Der Sonnenaufgang ist klasse, der Tempel auch und man fühlt (solange keiner schnattert) die Erhabenheit des Ortes. 

Ein Must in Yogja.

Ach ja ab 8:00 wird es dann proppevoll mit Einheimischen Touristen und Schulklassen.

We currently live in Indonesia so we showed our kitas and paid a minimal amount to get tickets to both Prambanan and Ratu Boko (Rp 50,000 for adults and Rp 20,000 for kids).  We got there after lunch so it was super hot.  We were able to climb up the temples and enter them to enjoy a moment of coolness inside.  It was dark inside so we were not able to see anything inside the temple.  But we enjoyed walking around and taking in the intricate carvings on the temple.  Even our little one enjoyed as he busied himself with a camera. When we exited the place, we saw lots of stalls selling simple food and drinks and the usual souvenirs.
It is stunning and the work that is going into rebuilding the temple makes it all the more special!!
I was there to see a music concert. With beautiful lightings, the temple looked very fabulous and amazing. It was just stunning. Amazing!

Stunning monument in terms of architecture. And nice grounds to stroll around on a sunny day with plenty of shade. Ballet was interesting and the temple when lit up behind the ballet at night makes for a good experience.

However, the staff were all extremely unhelpful when trying to find tickets for the ballet. We must have been sent to 3 different places and walked 2km before we finally gave up and just happened to stumble across it near the entrance we had first entered and asked at! Also remember to take water and a snack because there are limited places within the actual temple complex bar around the entrance. Worth the visit none the less and very impressive. I wish we had gone slightly earlier to beat the crowds.
Een mooi tempelcomplex, maar wel erg stoffig, juist door al de mensen die aan het vergen waren. De restauratie is nog steeds gaande, dus het kan alleen maar mooier worden.

There's a construction going on in some areas. Need to wear a sarong when entering the premise, regardless of male or female and regardless if you wore long sleeve or long pants. But overall, it's a nice and fun experience.

Wir hatten uns vorgenommen Prambanan bei Sonnenuntergang zu besuchen. Kann ich nur jedem empfehlen! Die Tempelanlage ist wirklich imposant und bei Sonnenuntergang strahlen die Tempel eine ergreifende Atmosphäre aus. 
Nachdem wir einen Tag zuvor Borobudur besucht hatten, hat, für mich, Prambanan Borobudur noch getoppt. Wirklich beeindruckend.
Aber auch hier gibt es Punktabzug. Die Touristenabzocke wird in Prambanan im Vergleich zu Borobudur noch deutlicher.
Ich musste RP 250 000 (ca. 15 €), meine indon. Frau dagegen nur Rp 30 000 (ca. 2 €) Eintritt zahlen. Für mich persönlich eine Frechheit und lässt doch immer einen leicht bitteren Beigeschmack zurück, nach einem Besuch solcher Touristenattraktionen in Indonesien.
Auch hier ist der Weg vom Eingang zum Tempel relativ kurz. Der Weg zurück zum Parkplatz dagegen ungleich länger. Und natürlich führt der Weg auch hier durch einen Basar. Der Basar an der Prambanan-Tempelanlage ist aber deutlich kleiner als in Borobudur.
Der Vorteil wenn man zum Sonnenuntergang und kurz vor Schließung der Anlage hin geht. Die Händler auf dem Basar packen da schon ihre Sachen zusammen. So dass man nur wenig "belästigt" wird.
Vom Zentrum Yogyakartas bis zur Prambanan-Tempelanlage haben wir für das Taxi Hin und Zurück (ca. 40 km) Rp 300 000 (ca. 20 €) bezahlt.

identik dengan legenda loro jongrang.....candi ini terletak di pinggiran kota Yogya. Mempunyai arsitektur yang cantik dan secara rutin mengadakan wisata sendratari ramayana yang dapat dinikmati oleh para pengunjung.

Most of the building are still in reconstruction. 

Never go at 10am to 1pm. You will DEFINETLY get roasted under the sun.  

If you are interested,  can always get a tour guide to explain.  You will feel more about the place with explaination.

Candi prambanan menurut saya semegah candi Borobudur.
Meskipun luas nya tidak sebesar candi Borobudur, tetapi memiliki daya tarik sendiri, letaknya tidak jauh dari pusat kota malah dipinggir jalan raya jogja-solo.
Bangunannya sangat cantik,

Review Text: absolutely stunning. just go there in the early morning cause its gonna get boiling afterwards.. we did the combined tour with borobodur but its better to split cause when you get to see the second one is too hot

Prambanan Temple was built in the 9th Century, and was badly affected by the earthquake that struck Jogjakarta in 2006. The local government is currently spending much effort to re-construct the temple. Many of the pieces that collapsed had been painstaking brought to a nearby storage, properly sorted, so that they can be used to reconstruct the temple. However, many of the pieces were damaged, and could not be used. Upon closer inspection, some of the newer replacement pieces can be seen on the temple, due to the colour of the "stone. Worth a visit.
we went there and it was so crowded. not really enjoying the site. there's a market next to it. those who keen for a quick shopping can visit it.
Naast de Borobudur mag ook een bezoek aan de Prambanan Tempel niet ontbreken. De tempels liggen in een afgeschermd open gebied waardoor het extra lading krijgt.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Walaupun Candi Prambanan tidak semegah Borobudur, tapi bagi saya ia memiliki keindahannya tersendiri. Ada 3 candi utama di Kompleks Candi Prambanan iaitu Candi brahma , Shiwa, dan Candi Wisnu. Sayangnya pada saat saya kesini Candi Brahma ditutup untuk pembaikan. Gak banyak informasi  berkenaan candi yang ada disini, jadi harus sewa tourguide kalau mahu tahu lebih lanjut tentang sejarah candi prambanan. Sebaiknya berkunjung di pagi hari karna cuaca sangat panas. Tiket masuknya cuma IDR30K. Didalam kompleks candi Prambanan juga ada Candi Sewu dan Candi Lumbung. Bisa naik sepeda karna kawasannya sangat luas.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Tienes que pasar por aquí, es una visita INDISPENSABLE cuando vas a Indonesia. Su grandiosidad te dejará alucinado. Eso sí, ve pronto, porque sino estará llenísimo.

Beautiful place, recommend to visit. In 2006 an Earthquake distroyed the temples, but with Unesco help they started to rebuild it, major part is ready, but still big area full of stones which are waiting to be placed to the big construction. If you come to visit Borobudur you should not miss Prambanan temple, it is close to the airport, so good idea to visit before you go to Borobudur. (2 hours by car the distance between the two temple, prambanan is about 30 minutes the other side of the airport.) be prepared it can be warm there. 
You must wear a sarung there, if you forget to take one, you can get one at the entrance. Entrance fee is 230k rupiah fo a foreign visitor, you can gat a welcome coffee/tea/water at the entrance and borrow the sarung in this price included.
I have been there many times, yet Prambanan still gives me a glimpse of phenomenon in the past about the history, the architecture and the culture that I like most.

Nice place to see, seems bigger un pics, but is a very interesting temple to visit.

I recommended take A1 bus to arrive from jogya (only 3500 rupiah x pax instead 150.000 rupiah to take a taxi)
Tak jak Borobudur i tych świątyni nie można nie zobaczyć. Przepiękne, zmuszają do refleksji, pokazują co człowiek jest w stanie osiągnąć. Jak - nie wiem, ale to niewiarygodne .

The Prambanan temples is a must-visit in Yogyakarta. Majestic and beautiful. The downside is that there was construction going on right beside the temples and I don't know... it was just odd and weird. It can be accessed by using Trans-Jogja bus.
Absoluut schitterende site - je bezoek zeker waard. Er dient nog veel heropgebouwd te worden - zal nu al wel anders zijn dan in 1994.

This temple is better than Borobudur in terms of area. There are different temples that you could visit inside the complex and getting in and out of the temples is simple and easy. I like the intricacy of Prambanan than Borobudur.

Z Yogjakarty blisko; warto pojechać - bilety łączone, z wejściem do Borobudur, kosztują 30USD/os. dorosła. Piękne widoki, zjawiskowe miejsce, robi wrażenie, nawet jak widziało się już co nieco w kambodżańskiej dżungli ;-)

Este es el primer templo que vimos en Indonesia y por eso quiza, nos pareció impresionante. Nosotros decidimos ir en bus de linea para ahorrar, porque las excursiones que te venden son bastante carillas. La entrada al templo tambien nos pareció que tenia un precio desorbitado. Pero el conjunto de templos indues es muy bonito, si vas a yogyakarta es visita obligada!
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Good place to visit, seeing how blocks of stones put together into amazing work of art .Early civilization  took place here in Jogja. The evening show was fantastic with the temple as backdrop.Those visiting Jogja must visit this temple,,,awesome.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Masuk candi untuk wisatawan domestik cukup 35.ribu rupiah saja. Saya bersama keluarga hanya berfoto saja sebab tidak dibantu guide yang menceritakan riwayat candi.
Un site très intéressant, grandiose, à ne rater sous aucun prétexte. Surtout n'oubliez pas le chapeau, l'ambre solaire et la bouteille d'eau.
Candi yang sangat artistik. Dengan relief2 yang bercerita kehidupan jaman dahulu. Dilengkapi sendra tari ramayana yang disajikan dengan sangat bagus. Pemain tang profesional dan terlatih.

Me esperaba algo mucho más espectacular. El año anterior estuve en Angkor Wat y no tiene absolutamente nada que ver, son un conjunto de templos pequeños que los ves en un par de hora. Recomiendo que vayáis por vuestra cuenta y no con Tours organizados. Desde el centro de Yogya, puedes coger un bus directo hasta allí.

the small temple of Prambanan always reflect how strong there were the Hindusm in Indonesia.
You must visit this separately from your visit in Borobudur. Small but yet so beautiful.

Review Text:
de très beaux temples , faciles à visiter .Un "parc" agréable pour toute la famille .Ne pas rater la photo souvenir , à l'entrée .. 
une très belle visite , pour un excellent souvenir

panas banget, lebih banyak ngaso drpd semangatnya. dan karena masih dalam pemugaran, gak ad yg bisa diliat, minum jamu godhog aja enak ko, berkhasiat, museum prambanan juga bagus, bisa ng-AC pula. 

kalo pengen jalan kaki dari halte transjogja, 1KM, kalo mo pake delman 15rb/org. belanja di prambanan jauh lebih murah ketimbang di malioboro.

We hired a guide for 100k to show us the main temple   He was excellent and was a former member of the ballet and still had some of the moves to prove it. This is a must if you want to fully understand what all the carvings mean.

enjoy an ethnic history of Hindu Java here.  there's so many temple in this area. Rara Jonggrang,  Sewu,  and many temple. in this area you'll find Hindu temple and also Buddhist Temple living together.  the best time to come in is in the morning and afternoon.

Review Text: This is a great site with several important temples (Buddhist and Hindu) all on the same grounds.  It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and a must see, if you are in the area.

Review Text: The opportunity to see these fantastic temples is hard to describe. I loved the history and the stories told by the guides. A great way to understand the background culture of the Indonesian people

Review Text:
Este lugar es hermoso sin embargo los precios a extranjeros son elevados (30 mil a locales y 250 mil rupias a extranjeros)

Los detalles son increibles y merece la pena contemplarlos son prisa. Es bueno elegir uno de los templo donde no haya caso gente para poder admirael central y el complejo. Las vistas des de lejos no tiene desperdicio. El precio es algo excesivo (18€) pero merece la pena. se puede comprar el ticket conjunto con el templo de Borobodur y te sale algo más economico.

Review Text: Mooie indrukwekkende bouwwerken, maar helaas ook weer volledig uitgemolken door het indonesische toerisme. Ticket als toerist is zoals overal weer 1.5 keer zo duur als voor een local. Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Das Bauwerk ist überschaubarer als der Borobudur, aber es gibt viel Detail zu sehen und die Anlage ist beeindruckend. Natürlich wird auch hier an vielen Ecken restauriert, so dass es kaum möglich ist ein Gesamtfoto ohne Baustellen machen zu können. Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: I visit Prambanan many times, when child, teenage and adult, hehe. Last time i visit here, prambanan still nice beautiful temple. when i visit in sunset time, there are Ramayana Sendratari Show, and i was amaze watching it, so i can know the history of java kingdom. All the players perform very well.
An interesting temple. Would recommend getting a guide since they are quite cheap and they can give you better explanations about the temples

This is a huge temple complex. Very unique, with its hindu influence on the murals and also in its architecture.Smaller temples surrounding the main big temples are still in ruins and in  various stages of being assembled back, especially after the 2006 5.9 Richter scale earthquake thet rocked Yogya. It is majestic looking upon arrival and intriguing upon inspection. Definitely a must visit.
Faktor Pendorong: Keinginan untuk belajar, Keinginan untuk menjelajah

Review Text: Jogja overall is a great place to roam around. The Ramayana Ballet dance which takes place just behind the temple shrine is magical in in full moon nights. There are ncie small handicraft shops surrounding the temple campus. Don't miss to do the bargain get your great collection of Indonesian handicraft. These are available on half or 1/3rd of the price in Jakarta. Use the ESIATALK app while roaming around. It gives an Indonesia number for free and just with 20000IDR (USD1.3)topup you can call anywhere for 50mins and also can send and receive SMS. To recharge ask any local recharge shop  for ESIA voucher or Electronic topup.

Enorme complesso di templi che merita assolutamente una visita composto da imponenti strutture di pietra scura.

Review Text: Prambanan merupakan candi yang indah dan megah selain Borobudur. tentunya sarat dengan sejarah dan budaya serta mitos yang beredar.

Magnifique site avec plusieurs temples
Ne pas hésiter à aller jusque celui du fond, tout aussi riche et avec beaucoup moins de monde. 
Dommage que 2 temples étaient en travaux. 
Accès facile en transports en commun  (bus transjoja) depuis Yogyakarta

Pertama kalinya ke prambanan di malam hari, dan ini untuk makan malam ketika acara internasional yang berlangsung di jogja pada awal oktober 2015 ini.

Pengalaman yang mengagumkan. Prambanan yang megah ditambah dengan pencahayaan yang sedemikian rupa dan live performance ramayana, wowww..wowww...dan WOW!!!

Forgot to put on sunscreen and didn't wear a hat. Bit of a mistake, but it was ok in the end. There's a fair bit of walking, but it's pretty incredible to walk around and look at the different temples. The Prambanan temple complex is actually made up of four different temples, Prambanan, Sewu, Lumbung, and Bubrah. I only saw Prambanan and Bubrah. They are currently doing refurbishments to Prambanan, but that doesn't stop you from being able to view some of the temples in that area of the complex and go inside a few of them. Be aware the steps to get inside are quite steep and may not be easy to climb for the elderly or the young. The temples are located about 25 min drive from the airport, so definitely closer and easier to access than Borobudur. (We didn't go to Borobudur due to the distance from Jogja.) Make sure that if you travel there by taxi that you have transport arranged following your visit; very difficult to flag a taxi down or find a taxi in that area. Be aware that when visiting Prambanan temple, visitors may be asked to wear a sarong, which is provided. There is quite a large souvenir shopping area at the exit of the complex. Souvenirs here tend to be cheaper than in Jakarta.
salah situs bersejarah yang harus dikunjungi jika ke jogja,oya jika berkunjung ke candi pramabanan,jangan lupa unutk ke candi sewu dan candi plaosan ngak kalah wah nya

Candi prambanan adalah salah satu candi yang menarik untuk dikunjungi, karena di kita tidak hanya disuguhkan candi prambanan saja tetapi juga candi-candi lainnya seperti candi sewu. Tempatnya cocok untuk berfoto-foto apalagi kalau menjelang sore hari dan mendapat sunset yang pas. 

Waktu yang tepat untuk mengunjunginya kalau tidak siang atau sore hari supaya dapat sunset speerti yang saya bilang. cukup membayar 30.000 saja anda akan mendapat pelayanan oke, kebersihan tempat areanya cukup bersih dan ada tempat penyewaan sepeda kalau anda ingin berkeliling kompleks candi prambanan.

Pertunjukan dimulai pukul 19.30 sampai 21.30 dan pembelian tiket dilayani secara langsung di ticket box. Untuk harganya saya kalau tidak salah untuk pertunjukan outdoor sekitar Rp. 100.000 - Rp. 375.000 dan indoor sekitar Rp. 100.000 - Rp. 250.000.

Bisa mempelajari sejarah dan budaya Indonesia, terutama yang menyangkut masa hindu. Prambanan adalah candi hindu terbesar di Indonesia. Candi ini terletak di Kabupaten Magelang, Jawa Tengah.

Lokasi candi prambanan ini memang sangat mudah dijangkau, bagi yang hendak berkunjung dari kota Jogja ke Solo atau sebaliknya pasti dapat melihat candi ini. Selain itu juga kini mudah dijangkau dengan adanya Trans Jogja

We loved visiting Prambanan. Spent many hours there. We took Trans Joga bus right from hotel area directly to Prambanan.. quick and very affordable.  Loved exploring all the temples, taking photography, and resting in shade and doing meditation.  Hilarious fun was renting a tandem bike to go the 3km to visit nearby Sewu Temple.

As a local, I probably have visited this temples for about 6 times already. I never get bored, always as charming as usual. If you have time, please do watch the ballet performance at night. The view will be stunning

These temples are really interesting, especially if you haven't been to Khajuraho in India. They are expensive but worth it if you're interested in culture and have the cash. We agreed to one of the local students in blue jackets giving us a tour of the main temples. It was free and well worth it - our guide's English was great and we learnt loads. It's definitely worth it! We tipped our guide but it wasn't expected - the students do it for free as part of their course so you don't have to tip of you don't want to or don't have any spare cash.

Prambanan is easy to reach by local bus. It's a 20 minute ride and costs very little. The bus stop is about a ten minute walk south of the temple on the other side of the busy road. 

The Buddhist complex of temples at the back of the Prambanan complex is also worth visiting. There are heaps of shops on your way out and there's also a restaurant inside where you can eat.

Review Text:

Review Text: This is one of the greatness inheritance of our ancestor that we should see and learn and conserve. Come here and buy one ticket for  2 package of Historical  Temple, Ratu Boko and Prambanan.

This was our destination after visiting Borobudur, and we got to compare and contrast Buddhist and Hinduism holy places. Being located near the volcano, Gunung Merapi, this ancient site was subjected to volcanic ashes ,lavas and earthquakes. So far, only a few of the ancient temples have been restored and restoration work is still ongoing of the other ancient temples that have been affected by the volcanic eruption. We got to visit and were impressed by the temples dedicated to God Vishnu, Brahma and Siva. Do also help yourself to the hot tea and coffee provided before starting your visit.  Visit during the late afternoon , around 4 pm so that after visiting the different temples, you can watch sunset.

Candi Prambanan or Candi Rara Jonggrang is a 9th-century Hindu temple compound in Central Java, Indonesia, dedicated to the Trimurti, the expression of God as the Creator (Brahma), the Preserver (Vishnu) and the Destroyer (Shiva). The temple compound is located approximately 17 kilometres northeast of the city of Yogyakarta on the boundary between Central Java and Yogyakarta Provinces.

I could go there over and over again, it is just beautiful... Especially during the off season when there are fewer tourists. And wait for the sunset, it's worth it... Keep in mind that there is a combination ticket with Borobudur that can be used on 2 subsequent days.
This temple is big enough and the location close to hills. The weather is good at the tim and I saw the performance in the evening. Its cool and awesome.

Review Text: Magnificent! The temples are just breathtaking.  Sadly some of the centre pieces are missing from the Garuda and the Angsa temples. Though the earthquake did some damage to this lovely complex,  the restored parts were awesome.  A must see!

Great destination to bring your family, kids love the architecture. Get a guide to tell story about the carvings around the temples.
Get there early to avoid the tourist flock. There's a deer enclosure near the exit, be sure to visit that.
